`runtime/control_mem.c`:

```c
// Development-only guest memory inspection. No host pointers outside the guest window.
#ifndef _GNU_SOURCE
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#endif
#include "control.h"
#include "rt.h"
#include "memscan.h"
#include <errno.h>
#include <float.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <time.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <mach/mach_vm.h>
#else
#include <sys/uio.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

#define LIMIT 100000
#define REGIONS 2048
#define SLICE_NS 1000000ull
static const char *types[] = {"u8", "u16", "u32", "u64", "s32", "f32", "f64", "hex"};
static const unsigned widths[] = {1, 2, 4, 8, 4, 4, 8, 1};
typedef union { uint64_t u; int32_t s; float f; double d; unsigned char b[8]; } Value;
typedef struct { uint64_t addr; Value old; } Candidate;
static Candidate candidates[LIMIT];
static size_t count, input_count, cursor;
static int type, mode, region_count;
static uint64_t starts[REGIONS], sizes[REGIONS];
static Value target;
static double tolerance;
static bool active, pending, capped;
// Only the worker writes candidates during an initial scan. Release/acquire on
// running publishes the final list. The presenter never waits for the worker.
static atomic_bool running, cancel_scan;
static atomic_uint_fast64_t scanned_bytes, found_count;
static uint64_t total_bytes;
static atomic_uint_fast64_t skipped_bytes;
// The initial scan's timers and counters (mem scan status), so a slow scan shows where its time goes.
static atomic_uint_fast64_t st_resident_ns, st_scan_ns, st_zero, st_compared, st_nonresident, st_faults, st_runs;
static uint64_t st_start_ns, st_end_ns, st_regions_ns;
static bool use_resident, regions_truncated;
// mode: 0 initial scan, 1 changed, 2 unchanged, 3 increased, 4 decreased, 5 equal, 6 near.

static bool integer(const char *s, uint64_t *v) {
    if (!*s || *s == '-' || *s == '+' || *s == ' ' || *s == '\t') return false;
    char *end; errno = 0;
    *v = strtoull(s, &end, s[0] == '0' && (s[1] == 'x' || s[1] == 'X') ? 16 : 10);
    return !errno && end != s && !*end;
}
static int get_type(const char *s) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (!strcmp(s, types[i])) return i;
    return -1;
}
static bool number(const char *s, double *v) {
    char *end; errno = 0; *v = strtod(s, &end);
    return *s && end != s && !*end && !errno && isfinite(*v);
}
static bool parse(const char *s, int t, Value *v) {
    memset(v, 0, sizeof *v);
    if (t < 4) return integer(s, &v->u) && (t == 3 || v->u < (1ull << (8 * widths[t])));
    if (t == 4) {
        char *end; errno = 0; long long x = strtoll(s, &end, 0);
        if (!*s || end == s || *end || errno || x < INT32_MIN || x > INT32_MAX) return false;
        v->s = (int32_t)x; return true;
    }
    double x;
    if (!number(s, &x) || (t == 5 && fabs(x) > FLT_MAX)) return false;
    if (t == 5) v->f = (float)x; else v->d = x;
    return true;
}
static double floating(Value v) { return type == 5 ? v.f : v.d; }
static bool equal(Value a, Value b, double tol) {
    if (type >= 5) return fabs(floating(a) - floating(b)) <= tol;
    if (type == 4) return fabs((double)a.s - (double)b.s) <= tol;
    uint64_t delta = a.u > b.u ? a.u - b.u : b.u - a.u;
    return tol == 0 ? delta == 0 : (long double)delta <= (long double)tol;
}
static bool equal_as(int t, Value a, Value b, double tol) {
    int saved = type; type = t;
    bool e = equal(a, b, tol);
    type = saved;
    return e;
}
static int compare(Value a, Value b) {
    if (type >= 5) return (floating(a) > floating(b)) - (floating(a) < floating(b));
    if (type == 4) return (a.s > b.s) - (a.s < b.s);
    return (a.u > b.u) - (a.u < b.u);
}
uint64_t g_mem_direct_lo, g_mem_direct_hi;
static bool window(uint64_t a, size_t n) {
    return a >= GUEST_LO && a < GUEST_HI && n <= GUEST_HI - a;
}
// OS copies report inaccessible pages rather than raising a process exception. This also
// covers a mapping changing after validation, without SEH or a process-wide signal handler.
static bool copy_memory(uint64_t a, void *buf, size_t n, bool write) {
    if (!window(a, n)) return false;
#ifdef _WIN32
    // WriteProcessMemory can bypass read-only protection for debuggers. Require
    // ordinary writable pages explicitly before invoking it.
    uint64_t end = a + n, page = a;
    while (page < end) {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION m;
        if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)page, &m, sizeof m) || m.State != MEM_COMMIT ||
            (m.Protect & PAGE_GUARD)) return false;
        DWORD p = m.Protect & 0xff;
        bool writable = p == PAGE_READWRITE || p == PAGE_WRITECOPY || p == PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE || p == PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY;
        bool readable = writable || p == PAGE_READONLY || p == PAGE_EXECUTE_READ;
        if (!readable || (write && !writable)) return false;
        uint64_t next = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m.BaseAddress + m.RegionSize;
        if (next <= page) return false;
        page = next;
    }
    SIZE_T done = 0;
    return (write ? WriteProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(), (void *)(uintptr_t)a, buf, n, &done)
                  : ReadProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(), (void *)(uintptr_t)a, buf, n, &done)) && done == n;
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
    if (write) return mach_vm_write(mach_task_self(), a, (vm_offset_t)buf, (mach_msg_type_number_t)n) == KERN_SUCCESS;
    mach_vm_size_t done = 0;
    return mach_vm_read_overwrite(mach_task_self(), a, n, (mach_vm_address_t)buf, &done) == KERN_SUCCESS && done == n;
#else
    struct iovec local = {buf, n}, remote = {(void *)(uintptr_t)a, n};
    ssize_t done = write ? process_vm_writev(getpid(), &local, 1, &remote, 1, 0)
                         : process_vm_readv(getpid(), &local, 1, &remote, 1, 0);
    if (done < 0 && a >= g_mem_direct_lo && a + n <= g_mem_direct_hi) {  // (the heap's dma-buf mapping: control_mem.h)
        if (write) memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)a, buf, n);
        else memcpy(buf, (const void *)(uintptr_t)a, n);
        return true;
    }
    return done >= 0 && (size_t)done == n;
#endif
}
static void address(ControlReply *r, const char *key, uint64_t a) {
    char s[32]; snprintf(s, sizeof s, "0x%" PRIx64, a); control_field_str(r, key, s);
}
static void value_field(ControlReply *r, const char *key, Value v, int t) {
    char s[64];
    if (t < 4) snprintf(s, sizeof s, "%" PRIu64, v.u);
    else if (t == 4) snprintf(s, sizeof s, "%" PRId32, v.s);
    else if (t == 5) snprintf(s, sizeof s, "%.9g", (double)v.f);
    else snprintf(s, sizeof s, "%.17g", v.d);
    control_field_str(r, key, s);
}
static void list(ControlReply *r, size_t n) {
    control_field_str(r, "type", types[type]);
    control_field_int(r, "count", (int64_t)count);
    control_field_bool(r, "partial", pending);
    if (pending && mode) { control_field_int(r, "checked", (int64_t)cursor); control_field_int(r, "of", (int64_t)input_count); }
    control_field_bool(r, "capped", capped);
    if (pending) control_field_str(r, "continue", mode ? "mem rescan continue" : "mem scan continue");
    if (n > count) n = count;
    control_field_int(r, "shown", (int64_t)n);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char key[48]; snprintf(key, sizeof key, "candidate.%zu.addr", i); address(r, key, candidates[i].addr);
        snprintf(key, sizeof key, "candidate.%zu.value", i); value_field(r, key, candidates[i].old, type);
    }
}
// Rescan reads: in place under the crash guard (copy_memory's VirtualQuery + ReadProcessMemory cost about a millisecond
// each on the PC, so one rescan step per frame). A candidate came from a committed page; if it has gone away, it drops.
typedef struct { void *buf; size_t n; } PeekCtx;
static size_t peek_fn(const void *p, size_t n, void *ctx) { PeekCtx *c = ctx; memcpy(c->buf, p, c->n); return n; }
static bool peek(uint64_t a, void *buf, size_t n) {
    if (!window(a, n)) return false;
    PeekCtx c = {buf, n}; size_t ret;
    return ms_guarded((const void *)(uintptr_t)a, n, peek_fn, &c, &ret);
}
static void slice(ControlReply *r) {
    uint64_t deadline = plat_now_ns() + SLICE_NS;
    unsigned steps = 0;
    while (pending && steps++ < 8192 && plat_now_ns() < deadline) {
        if (cursor == input_count) { pending = false; break; }
        Candidate c = candidates[cursor++]; Value v = {0};
        if (!peek(c.addr, v.b, widths[type])) continue;
        bool keep = mode == 1 ? !equal(v, c.old, tolerance) : mode == 2 ? equal(v, c.old, tolerance) :
                    mode == 3 ? compare(v, c.old) > 0 : mode == 4 ? compare(v, c.old) < 0 : equal(v, target, tolerance);
        if (keep) candidates[count++] = (Candidate){c.addr, v};
    }
    list(r, 20);
}

// The initial scan (a worker thread): the regions mapped once when the scan starts, read in place (with resident=1 only
// in runs of pages resident in RAM, via ms_resident; off by default because a page the OS trimmed out of RAM still
// holds data and would be missed), each run compared by ms_scan under ms_guarded, so a page
// that goes away mid-scan (a reboot decommitting the guest) costs that run, not the game.
#define CHUNK (1024 * 1024)  // (also ms_guarded's limit where it copies: Linux, macOS)
static MsMatch match;
static bool skip_zero;
static uint32_t offsets[LIMIT];
typedef struct { uint64_t guest; } RunCtx;

static size_t run_cb(const void *p, size_t n, void *vctx) {
    const RunCtx *c = vctx;
    MsStats st = {0, 0};
    size_t k = ms_scan(p, n, &match, skip_zero, offsets, LIMIT - count, &st);
    unsigned w = widths[type];
    for (size_t i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        Value v = {0};
        memcpy(v.b, (const unsigned char *)p + offsets[i], w);
        candidates[count++] = (Candidate){c->guest + offsets[i], v};
    }
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&st_zero, st.zero_bytes, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&st_compared, st.compared, memory_order_relaxed);
    return k;
}

// [a, a + n): one run of resident pages. On a fault, page by page, so readable neighbours still count.
static void scan_run(uint64_t a, size_t n) {
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&st_runs, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    size_t before = count, ret;
    RunCtx c = {a};
    if (ms_guarded((const void *)(uintptr_t)a, n, run_cb, &c, &ret)) return;
    count = before;  // (the matches before the fault come again below)
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&st_faults, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    for (uint64_t q = a; q < a + n && count < LIMIT;) {
        size_t part = (size_t)((((q & ~4095ull) + 4096) < a + n ? ((q & ~4095ull) + 4096) : a + n) - q);
        size_t mark = count;
        RunCtx pc = {q};
        if (!ms_guarded((const void *)(uintptr_t)q, part, run_cb, &pc, &ret)) {
            count = mark;
            atomic_fetch_add(&skipped_bytes, part);
        }
        q += part;
    }
}

static void *scan_worker(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
#ifdef _WIN32
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
#endif
    static uint8_t resident[CHUNK / 4096 + 2];
    unsigned w = widths[type];
    for (int i = 0; i < region_count && count < LIMIT; i++) {
        for (uint64_t off = 0; off < sizes[i] && count < LIMIT;) {
            if (atomic_load_explicit(&cancel_scan, memory_order_relaxed)) goto finished;
            uint64_t a = starts[i] + off;
            // chunks end on a page boundary (and a whole value) so the pages line up with ms_resident's
            uint64_t lim = ((a & ~4095ull) + CHUNK);
            size_t n = (size_t)((starts[i] + sizes[i] < lim ? starts[i] + sizes[i] : lim) - a);
            n -= n % w;
            if (!n) n = w;
            uint64_t page0 = a & ~4095ull;
            size_t npages = (size_t)((((a + n + 4095) & ~4095ull) - page0) / 4096);
            uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
            bool known = use_resident && ms_resident(page0, npages, resident);
            uint64_t t1 = plat_now_ns();
            atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&st_resident_ns, t1 - t0, memory_order_relaxed);
            if (!known) scan_run(a, n);
            else {
                // runs of resident pages, clipped to [a, a + n) and to whole values
                for (size_t pg = 0; pg < npages && count < LIMIT;) {
                    size_t e = pg;
                    bool res = resident[pg];
                    while (e < npages && resident[e] == res) e++;
                    uint64_t lo = page0 + pg * 4096, hi = page0 + e * 4096;
                    if (lo < a) lo = a;
                    if (hi > a + n) hi = a + n;
                    lo = (lo + w - 1) / w * w;
                    if (hi > lo) {
                        size_t len = (size_t)(hi - lo) / w * w;
                        if (!res) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&st_nonresident, hi - lo, memory_order_relaxed);
                        else if (len) scan_run(lo, len);
                    }
                    pg = e;
                }
            }
            atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&st_scan_ns, plat_now_ns() - t1, memory_order_relaxed);
            off += n;
            atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&scanned_bytes, n, memory_order_relaxed);
            atomic_store_explicit(&found_count, count, memory_order_relaxed);
        }
    }
finished:
    st_end_ns = plat_now_ns();
    capped = count == LIMIT;
    pending = false;
    atomic_store_explicit(&running, false, memory_order_release);
    return NULL;
}
static void scan_status(ControlReply *r) {
    bool busy = atomic_load_explicit(&running, memory_order_acquire);
    uint64_t done = atomic_load(&scanned_bytes);
    control_field_num(r, "scanned_mb", (double)done / 1048576);
    control_field_num(r, "total_mb", (double)total_bytes / 1048576);
    control_field_num(r, "percent", total_bytes ? 100.0 * (double)done / (double)total_bytes : 100);
    control_field_int(r, "candidates", (int64_t)atomic_load(&found_count));
    control_field_bool(r, "done", !busy);
    control_field_int(r, "skipped_bytes", (int64_t)atomic_load(&skipped_bytes));
    // where the time goes (all ms), and how much memory each step left out
    double el = (double)((busy ? plat_now_ns() : st_end_ns) - st_start_ns) / 1e9;
    control_field_num(r, "elapsed_s", el);
    control_field_num(r, "mb_per_s", el > 0 ? (double)done / 1048576 / el : 0);
    control_field_num(r, "regions_ms", (double)st_regions_ns / 1e6);
    control_field_num(r, "resident_ms", (double)atomic_load(&st_resident_ns) / 1e6);
    control_field_num(r, "scan_ms", (double)atomic_load(&st_scan_ns) / 1e6);
    control_field_num(r, "nonresident_mb", (double)atomic_load(&st_nonresident) / 1048576);
    control_field_num(r, "zero_mb", (double)atomic_load(&st_zero) / 1048576);
    control_field_num(r, "compared_mb", (double)atomic_load(&st_compared) / 1048576);
    control_field_int(r, "runs", (int64_t)atomic_load(&st_runs));
    control_field_int(r, "faults", (int64_t)atomic_load(&st_faults));
    control_field_bool(r, "resident_only", use_resident);
    if (regions_truncated) control_field_bool(r, "regions_truncated", true);
    if (!busy) {
        control_field_bool(r, "cancelled", atomic_load(&cancel_scan));
        list(r, 20);
    }
}
static void region_field(ControlReply *r, unsigned i, uint64_t a, uint64_t n) {
    char key[48]; snprintf(key, sizeof key, "region.%u.start", i); address(r, key, a);
    snprintf(key, sizeof key, "region.%u.size", i); control_field_int(r, key, (int64_t)n);
    snprintf(key, sizeof key, "region.%u.scale", i); control_field_str(r, key, n >= 64 * 1048576ull ? "big" : "small");
    snprintf(key, sizeof key, "region.%u.likely_heap", i); control_field_bool(r, key, a < HEAP_BASE + HEAP_MAX && a + n > HEAP_BASE);
}
static int collect_regions(uint64_t *addr, uint64_t *size, bool *writable) {
    unsigned count_regions = 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    uint64_t a = GUEST_LO;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION m;
    while (a < GUEST_HI && VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &m, sizeof m)) {
        uint64_t end = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m.BaseAddress + m.RegionSize;
        DWORD p = m.Protect & 0xff;
        if (m.State == MEM_COMMIT && !(m.Protect & PAGE_GUARD) &&
            (p == PAGE_READONLY || p == PAGE_READWRITE || p == PAGE_WRITECOPY ||
             p == PAGE_EXECUTE_READ || p == PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE || p == PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY))
            {
            if (count_regions == REGIONS) break;
            writable[count_regions] = p == PAGE_READWRITE || p == PAGE_WRITECOPY ||
                                      p == PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE || p == PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY;
            addr[count_regions] = a; size[count_regions++] = (end < GUEST_HI ? end : GUEST_HI) - a;
        }
        if (end <= a) break;
        a = end;
    }
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
    mach_vm_address_t a = GUEST_LO; mach_vm_size_t n;
    while (a < GUEST_HI) {
        vm_region_basic_info_data_64_t info; mach_msg_type_number_t cnt = VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_COUNT_64;
        mach_port_t object = MACH_PORT_NULL;
        if (mach_vm_region(mach_task_self(), &a, &n, VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_64, (vm_region_info_t)&info, &cnt, &object) != KERN_SUCCESS) break;
        if (object != MACH_PORT_NULL) mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self(), object);
        if (a >= GUEST_HI) break;
        uint64_t lo = a < GUEST_LO ? GUEST_LO : a, end = a + n < GUEST_HI ? a + n : GUEST_HI;
        if (info.protection & VM_PROT_READ) {
            if (count_regions == REGIONS) break;
            writable[count_regions] = (info.protection & VM_PROT_WRITE) != 0;
            addr[count_regions] = lo; size[count_regions++] = end - lo;
        }
        a += n;
    }
#else
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/self/maps", "r");
    if (!f) return -1;
    char line[1024], perms[5]; uint64_t a, end;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        if (sscanf(line, "%" SCNx64 "-%" SCNx64 " %4s", &a, &end, perms) != 3 || perms[0] != 'r' || end <= GUEST_LO || a >= GUEST_HI) continue;
        if (a < GUEST_LO) a = GUEST_LO;
        if (end > GUEST_HI) end = GUEST_HI;
        if (count_regions == REGIONS) break;
        writable[count_regions] = perms[1] == 'w';
        addr[count_regions] = a; size[count_regions++] = end - a;
    }
    fclose(f);
#endif
    return (int)count_regions;
}
static void regions(ControlReply *r) {
    uint64_t addr[REGIONS], size[REGIONS];
    bool writable[REGIONS];
    int n = collect_regions(addr, size, writable);
    if (n < 0) { control_fail(r, "Cannot read memory mappings"); return; }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) region_field(r, (unsigned)i, addr[i], size[i]);
    control_field_int(r, "regions", n);
}
static void path_cmd(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r);
static void cmd_mem(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    if (argc < 2) goto usage;
    const char *cmd = argv[1];
    if (!strcmp(cmd, "path")) { path_cmd(argc, argv, r); return; }
    if (!strcmp(cmd, "regions") && argc == 2) { regions(r); return; }
    if (!strcmp(cmd, "scan") && argc == 3 && (!strcmp(argv[2], "status") || !strcmp(argv[2], "continue"))) {
        if (!active) goto no_scan;
        scan_status(r); return;
    }
    if (atomic_load_explicit(&running, memory_order_acquire)) {
        if (!strcmp(cmd, "reset") && argc == 2) {
            atomic_store(&cancel_scan, true); control_field_bool(r, "cancelling", true); return;
        }
        control_fail(r, "Scan in progress"); return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(cmd, "reset") && argc == 2) {
        active = pending = capped = false; count = 0; control_field_int(r, "count", 0); return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(cmd, "read") || !strcmp(cmd, "write")) {
        bool write = !strcmp(cmd, "write"); uint64_t a, len; int t; Value v;
        if (argc < 4 || argc > 5 || !integer(argv[2], &a)) goto usage;
        if (write) {
            if (argc != 5 || (t = get_type(argv[3])) < 0 || t == 7 || !parse(argv[4], t, &v)) goto usage;
            len = widths[t];
        } else {
            t = argc == 5 ? get_type(argv[4]) : 7;
            if (t < 0 || !integer(argv[3], &len) || !len || len > 4096 || len % widths[t]) goto usage;
        }
        unsigned char buf[4096];
        if (write) memcpy(buf, v.b, (size_t)len);
        if (!copy_memory(a, buf, (size_t)len, write)) {
            control_fail(r, "Address range not accessible"); return;
        }
        address(r, "addr", a); control_field_int(r, "bytes", (int64_t)len);
        if (write) { value_field(r, "value", v, t); return; }
        if (t == 7) {
            char hex[8193]; for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) snprintf(hex + 2 * i, 3, "%02x", buf[i]);
            control_field_str(r, "hex", hex);
        } else for (size_t i = 0; i < len / widths[t]; i++) {
            char key[32]; v.u = 0; memcpy(v.b, buf + i * widths[t], widths[t]);
            snprintf(key, sizeof key, "value.%zu", i); value_field(r, key, v, t);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(cmd, "list")) {
        uint64_t n = 20; if (argc > 3 || (argc == 3 && (!integer(argv[2], &n) || n > 1000))) goto usage;
        if (!active) goto no_scan;
        list(r, (size_t)n); return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(cmd, "scan") || !strcmp(cmd, "rescan")) {
        bool rescan = !strcmp(cmd, "rescan");
        if (argc == 3 && !strcmp(argv[2], "continue")) {
            if (!pending || rescan != (mode != 0)) { control_fail(r, "No partial scan"); return; }
            slice(r); return;
        }
        if (rescan) {
            if (!active) goto no_scan;
            if (pending) { control_fail(r, "Partial scan pending"); return; }
            int next_mode = 0; Value next_target = {0}; double tol = tolerance;
            if (argc == 3) {
                const char *names[] = {"changed", "unchanged", "increased", "decreased"};
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (!strcmp(argv[2], names[i])) next_mode = i + 1;
            } else if (argc == 4 && !strcmp(argv[2], "equal") && parse(argv[3], type, &next_target)) { next_mode = 5; tol = 0; }
            else if (argc == 5 && !strcmp(argv[2], "near") && parse(argv[3], type, &next_target) && number(argv[4], &tol) && tol >= 0) next_mode = 6;
            if (!next_mode) goto usage;
            mode = next_mode; target = next_target; tolerance = tol; input_count = count; cursor = count = 0;
        } else {
            int t; Value v; double tol = 0;
            if (argc < 4 || (t = get_type(argv[2])) < 0 || t == 7 || !parse(argv[3], t, &v)) goto usage;
            bool selected[REGIONS] = {false}, filter = false, have_from = false, have_to = false, want_resident = false;
            uint64_t from = GUEST_LO, to = GUEST_HI;
            int arg = 4;
            if (arg < argc && !strchr(argv[arg], '=')) {
                if (t < 5 || !number(argv[arg++], &tol) || tol < 0) goto usage;
            }
            for (; arg < argc; arg++) {
                const char *opt = argv[arg];
                if (!strncmp(opt, "region=", 7)) {
                    if (filter) goto usage;
                    filter = true; opt += 7;
                    do {
                        char *end; errno = 0;
                        if (*opt < '0' || *opt > '9') goto usage;
                        unsigned long idx = strtoul(opt, &end, 10);
                        if (errno || idx >= REGIONS || (*end && *end != ',')) goto usage;
                        selected[idx] = true;
                        if (!*end) break;
                        opt = end + 1;
                    } while (true);
                } else if (!strcmp(opt, "resident=0") || !strcmp(opt, "resident=1")) {
                    want_resident = opt[9] == '1';
                } else if (!strncmp(opt, "from=", 5)) {
                    if (have_from || !integer(opt + 5, &from)) goto usage;
                    have_from = true;
                } else if (!strncmp(opt, "to=", 3)) {
                    if (have_to || !integer(opt + 3, &to)) goto usage;
                    have_to = true;
                } else goto usage;
            }
            if (have_from != have_to || from < GUEST_LO || to > GUEST_HI || from >= to) goto usage;
            uint64_t addr[REGIONS], size[REGIONS];
            bool writable[REGIONS];
            uint64_t tr = plat_now_ns();
            int n = collect_regions(addr, size, writable);
            st_regions_ns = plat_now_ns() - tr;
            if (n < 0) { control_fail(r, "Cannot read memory mappings"); return; }
            regions_truncated = n == REGIONS;
            for (int i = n; i < REGIONS; i++) if (selected[i]) {
                control_fail(r, "Unknown region"); return;
            }
            region_count = 0; total_bytes = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (filter ? !selected[i] : !writable[i]) continue;
                uint64_t lo = addr[i] > from ? addr[i] : from;
                uint64_t hi = addr[i] + size[i] < to ? addr[i] + size[i] : to;
                lo = (lo + widths[t] - 1) & ~(uint64_t)(widths[t] - 1);
                if (lo >= hi || hi - lo < widths[t]) continue;
                starts[region_count] = lo; sizes[region_count] = (hi - lo) / widths[t] * widths[t];
                total_bytes += sizes[region_count++];
            }
            type = t; target = v; tolerance = tol; count = 0; capped = false; mode = 0;
            atomic_store(&scanned_bytes, 0); atomic_store(&found_count, 0); atomic_store(&skipped_bytes, 0);
            match = (MsMatch){.type = t};
            if (t == 5 || t == 6) { double x = t == 5 ? (double)v.f : v.d; match.flo = x - tol; match.fhi = x + tol; }
            else if (t == 4) match.slo = match.shi = v.s;
            else match.ulo = match.uhi = v.u;
            Value zero = {0};
            skip_zero = !equal_as(t, zero, v, tol);
            use_resident = want_resident;
            atomic_store(&st_resident_ns, 0); atomic_store(&st_scan_ns, 0); atomic_store(&st_zero, 0);
            atomic_store(&st_compared, 0); atomic_store(&st_nonresident, 0); atomic_store(&st_faults, 0);
            atomic_store(&st_runs, 0);
            st_start_ns = plat_now_ns();
            atomic_store(&cancel_scan, false);
            active = pending = true;
            atomic_store(&running, true);
            pthread_t thread;
            if (pthread_create(&thread, NULL, scan_worker, NULL)) {
                atomic_store(&running, false); active = pending = false;
                control_fail(r, "Cannot start scan"); return;
            }
            pthread_detach(thread);
            control_field_bool(r, "started", true); return;
        }
        active = pending = true; slice(r); return;
    }
usage:
    control_fail(r, "mem: use regions | read <addr> <bytes 1-4096> [u8|u16|u32|u64|s32|f32|f64|hex] | write <addr> <type> <value> | scan <type> <value> [float tolerance] [region=<n>[,<n>...]] [from=<addr> to=<addr>] [resident=1] | scan status | scan continue | rescan <changed|unchanged|increased|decreased|equal value|near value tolerance|continue> | list [0-1000] | reset");
    return;
no_scan:
    control_fail(r, "No scan");
}
// ---- for other control commands (runtime/control_mem.h)
bool control_mem_peek(uint64_t a, void *buf, size_t n) { return peek(a, buf, n); }
// Windows: in place under the crash guard, like peek (a write to a page that is not writable faults inside the guard
// and fails; copy_memory's VirtualQuery + WriteProcessMemory cost about a millisecond each). Elsewhere copy_memory.
static size_t poke_fn(const void *p, size_t n, void *ctx) { PeekCtx *c = ctx; memcpy((void *)p, c->buf, c->n); return n; }
bool control_mem_poke(uint64_t a, const void *buf, size_t n) {
    unsigned char tmp[64];
    if (n > sizeof tmp || !window(a, n)) return false;
    memcpy(tmp, buf, n);
#ifdef _WIN32
    PeekCtx c = {tmp, n}; size_t ret;
    return ms_guarded((const void *)(uintptr_t)a, n, poke_fn, &c, &ret);
#else
    (void)poke_fn;
    return copy_memory(a, tmp, n, true);  // (ms_guarded hands out a copy here, so it can't carry a write)
#endif
}

// Every place in writable guest memory that holds three floats in a row within tol of v[0..2], found by one background
// pass (about 0.3 s for 3 GB, below-normal priority; the frame never waits).
#define VEC_MAX 256
typedef struct { const float *v; float tol; uint64_t guest; size_t found; } VecCtx;
static uint64_t vec_out[VEC_MAX];
static float vec_v[3], vec_tol;
static atomic_int vec_state;  // 0 none, 1 running, 2 done (found list ready), read with acquire
static size_t vec_found;
static size_t vec_cb(const void *p, size_t n, void *vctx) {
    VecCtx *c = vctx;
    static uint32_t offs[CHUNK / 4 + 16];
    MsMatch m = {.type = MS_F32, .flo = (double)c->v[0] - c->tol, .fhi = (double)c->v[0] + c->tol};
    size_t k = ms_scan(p, n, &m, true, offs, sizeof offs / sizeof *offs, NULL);
    const unsigned char *b = p;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < k && c->found < VEC_MAX; i++) {
        if (offs[i] + 12 > n) continue;
        float y, z;
        memcpy(&y, b + offs[i] + 4, 4); memcpy(&z, b + offs[i] + 8, 4);
        if (fabsf(y - c->v[1]) <= c->tol && fabsf(z - c->v[2]) <= c->tol) vec_out[c->found++] = c->guest + offs[i];
    }
    return k;
}
static void *vec_worker(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
#ifdef _WIN32
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
#endif
    static uint64_t addr[REGIONS], size[REGIONS];
    static bool writable[REGIONS];
    int n = collect_regions(addr, size, writable);
    VecCtx c = {vec_v, vec_tol, 0, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < n && c.found < VEC_MAX; i++) {
        if (!writable[i]) continue;
        for (uint64_t off = 0; off < size[i] && c.found < VEC_MAX;) {
            uint64_t a = addr[i] + off;
            uint64_t lim = (a & ~4095ull) + CHUNK;
            size_t len = (size_t)((addr[i] + size[i] < lim ? addr[i] + size[i] : lim) - a);
            len -= len % 4;
            if (!len) len = 4;
            c.guest = a;
            size_t ret;
            ms_guarded((const void *)(uintptr_t)a, len, vec_cb, &c, &ret);  // (a faulting chunk is just skipped)
            off += len;
        }
    }
    vec_found = c.found;
    atomic_store_explicit(&vec_state, 2, memory_order_release);
    return NULL;
}
bool control_mem_find_vec3_start(const float v[3], float tol) {
    if (atomic_load(&vec_state) == 1) return false;
    memcpy(vec_v, v, sizeof vec_v); vec_tol = tol; vec_found = 0;
    atomic_store(&vec_state, 1);
    pthread_t t;
    if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, vec_worker, NULL)) { atomic_store(&vec_state, 0); return false; }
    pthread_detach(t);
    return true;
}
int control_mem_find_vec3_poll(uint64_t *out, size_t max, size_t *n) {
    int st = atomic_load_explicit(&vec_state, memory_order_acquire);
    if (st != 2) return st;
    size_t k = vec_found < max ? vec_found : max;
    memcpy(out, vec_out, k * sizeof *out);
    *n = k;
    atomic_store(&vec_state, 0);
    return 2;
}

// ---- mem path <root> <target> [depth=N] [window=N]: how to reach a heap cell from a known object without searching.
// Heap addresses move between runs but the layout of the game's objects does not, so a chain "read the pointer at
// root+o1, then the one at that+o2, ..., then add the last offset" finds the same cell on every boot. Breadth first
// over every pointer-looking value in the first `window` bytes of each object (shortest chains first), on a
// background thread (below-normal priority, nothing waits for it). Reads only already committed memory.
#define PATH_NODES 2000000
#define PATH_SLOTS (1u << 22)
#define PATH_OUT 32
typedef struct { uint64_t base; int32_t parent; uint16_t off; uint8_t depth; } PNode;
static atomic_int path_state;  // 0 none, 1 running, 2 done
static uint64_t path_root, path_target, path_window, path_depth;
static char path_out[PATH_OUT][96];
static atomic_uint_fast64_t path_found, path_nodes, path_ms;
static bool path_truncated;
static bool path_in(const uint64_t *addr, const uint64_t *size, int n, uint64_t v, uint64_t *end) {
    int lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int m = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (v < addr[m]) hi = m - 1; else if (v >= addr[m] + size[m]) lo = m + 1; else { *end = addr[m] + size[m]; return true; }
    }
    return false;
}
static void *path_worker(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
#ifdef _WIN32
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
#endif
    static uint64_t addr[REGIONS], size[REGIONS];
    static bool writable[REGIONS];
    uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
    int nr = collect_regions(addr, size, writable);
    PNode *nodes = malloc(PATH_NODES * sizeof *nodes);
    uint64_t *seen = calloc(PATH_SLOTS, sizeof *seen);
    unsigned char *buf = malloc(path_window);
    size_t n = 0;
    if (nr > 0 && nodes && seen && buf) {
        nodes[n++] = (PNode){path_root, -1, 0, 0};
        for (size_t head = 0; head < n; head++) {
            PNode nd = nodes[head];
            uint64_t end;
            if (nd.depth >= path_depth || !path_in(addr, size, nr, nd.base, &end)) continue;
            size_t len = (size_t)(end - nd.base < path_window ? end - nd.base : path_window) & ~7ull;
            if (!len || !peek(nd.base, buf, len)) continue;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i += 8) {
                uint64_t v, e2;
                memcpy(&v, buf + i, 8);
                if (v < 0x10000 || (v & 3) || !path_in(addr, size, nr, v, &e2)) continue;
                if (path_target >= v && path_target < v + path_window && atomic_load(&path_found) < PATH_OUT) {
                    uint64_t offs[16]; int k = 0;
                    offs[k++] = path_target - v; offs[k++] = i;  // (built backwards)
                    for (int64_t j = (int64_t)head; j > 0 && k < 16; j = nodes[j].parent) offs[k++] = nodes[j].off;
                    char *o = path_out[atomic_load(&path_found)]; size_t used = 0; o[0] = 0;
                    for (int j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) used += (size_t)snprintf(o + used, 96 - used, j == k - 1 ? "0x%llx" : ",0x%llx", (unsigned long long)offs[j]);
                    atomic_fetch_add(&path_found, 1);
                }
                uint64_t h = (v * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 42;  // (22 bits)
                bool dup = false;
                for (;; h = (h + 1) & (PATH_SLOTS - 1)) {
                    if (!seen[h]) { seen[h] = v; break; }
                    if (seen[h] == v) { dup = true; break; }
                }
                if (dup) continue;
                if (n == PATH_NODES) { path_truncated = true; continue; }
                nodes[n++] = (PNode){v, (int32_t)head, (uint16_t)i, (uint8_t)(nd.depth + 1)};
            }
            atomic_store(&path_nodes, n);
        }
    }
    atomic_store(&path_nodes, n);
    free(nodes); free(seen); free(buf);
    atomic_store(&path_ms, (plat_now_ns() - t0) / 1000000);
    atomic_store_explicit(&path_state, 2, memory_order_release);
    return NULL;
}
static void path_cmd(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    int st = atomic_load_explicit(&path_state, memory_order_acquire);
    if (argc == 3 && !strcmp(argv[2], "status")) {
        control_field_str(r, "state", st == 1 ? "running" : st == 2 ? "done" : "none");
        control_field_int(r, "nodes", (int64_t)atomic_load(&path_nodes));
        if (st == 2) {
            control_field_int(r, "ms", (int64_t)atomic_load(&path_ms));
            control_field_bool(r, "truncated", path_truncated);
            uint64_t f = atomic_load(&path_found);
            control_field_int(r, "paths", (int64_t)f);
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < f; i++) { char k[24]; snprintf(k, sizeof k, "path.%llu", (unsigned long long)i); control_field_str(r, k, path_out[i]); }
        }
        return;
    }
    uint64_t root, target, window = 0x400, depth = 4;
    if (argc < 4 || argc > 6 || !integer(argv[2], &root) || !integer(argv[3], &target)) goto usage;
    for (int i = 4; i < argc; i++) {
        uint64_t v;
        if (!strncmp(argv[i], "depth=", 6) && integer(argv[i] + 6, &v) && v >= 1 && v <= 6) depth = v;
        else if (!strncmp(argv[i], "window=", 7) && integer(argv[i] + 7, &v) && v >= 16 && v <= 0xfff8 && !(v & 7)) window = v;
        else goto usage;
    }
    if (st == 1) { control_fail(r, "Path search in progress"); return; }
    path_root = root; path_target = target; path_window = window; path_depth = depth;
    path_truncated = false; atomic_store(&path_found, 0); atomic_store(&path_nodes, 0);
    atomic_store(&path_state, 1);
    pthread_t t;
    if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, path_worker, NULL)) { atomic_store(&path_state, 0); control_fail(r, "Cannot start path search"); return; }
    pthread_detach(t);
    control_field_bool(r, "started", true);
    return;
usage:
    control_fail(r, "Usage: mem path <root> <target> [depth=1..6] [window=16..65528] | status");
}

void control_mem_init(void) {
    static const ControlCmd cmds[] = {{"mem", "regions|read|write|scan|rescan|list|reset|path", "Inspect and search guest memory", cmd_mem}};
    control_register(cmds, 1);
}
```

```h
// (test and development only) Guest memory helpers of the control endpoint for other control commands.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

// Guest memory the OS copy cannot read or write but that is always mapped read-write while the game runs: on Linux, the
// guest heap as a dma-buf mapped over it (vulkan/exec.c heap_export, heap_dmaheap; RADV's default, the Steam Deck's):
// process_vm_readv / writev fail there (EFAULT: no page structs behind a dma-buf mapping), so peeks and pokes inside
// this range copy in place. 0, 0: none.
extern uint64_t g_mem_direct_lo, g_mem_direct_hi;
bool control_mem_peek(uint64_t addr, void *buf, size_t n);        // read n bytes (committed guest memory only)
bool control_mem_poke(uint64_t addr, const void *buf, size_t n);  // write n <= 64 bytes (ordinary writable pages only)
// Where three floats in a row are within tol of v[0..2] (writable memory), found on a background thread (about 0.3 s,
// never blocks the caller). _start returns false if one is already running. _poll: 0 nothing started, 1 still running,
// 2 done (writes up to max addresses to out and the count to *n; the result is handed over once).
#define CONTROL_MEM_VEC_MAX 256
bool control_mem_find_vec3_start(const float v[3], float tol);
int control_mem_find_vec3_poll(uint64_t *out, size_t max, size_t *n);
```

`runtime/control_places.c`:

```c
// Named places for `goto` and `places` (see control_places.h). The lookup is plain C on a static table.
#include "control_places.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define PLACE(kind, number, key, name, sub, x, y, z, ground) {kind, number, key, name, sub, x, y, z, ground},
static const Place table[] = {
#include "control_places_data.inc"
};
#undef PLACE
#define PLACE_TOTAL ((int)(sizeof table / sizeof *table))

static const char *const kind_names[PLACE_KINDS] = {"shrine", "tower", "stable", "village", "landmark", "korok"};

const char *place_kind_name(PlaceKind kind) { return kind >= 0 && kind < PLACE_KINDS ? kind_names[kind] : "?"; }

int place_kind_count(PlaceKind kind) {
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < PLACE_TOTAL; i++) n += table[i].kind == kind;
    return n;
}

const Place *place_by_number(PlaceKind kind, int number) {
    for (int i = 0; i < PLACE_TOTAL; i++)
        if (table[i].kind == kind && table[i].number == number) return &table[i];
    return NULL;
}

// (case-insensitive equality; strcasecmp is not on every platform the runtime builds for)
static bool ieq_eq(const char *a, const char *b) {
    for (; *a && *b; a++, b++) if (tolower((unsigned char)*a) != tolower((unsigned char)*b)) return false;
    return !*a && !*b;
}
static bool word_is(const char *word, const char *a, const char *b, const char *c) {
    return ieq_eq(word, a) || (b && ieq_eq(word, b)) || (c && ieq_eq(word, c));
}

int place_kind_from_word(const char *w) {
    if (word_is(w, "shrine", "shrines", "dungeon")) return PLACE_SHRINE;
    if (word_is(w, "tower", "towers", NULL)) return PLACE_TOWER;
    if (word_is(w, "stable", "stables", NULL)) return PLACE_STABLE;
    if (word_is(w, "village", "villages", NULL) || word_is(w, "town", "city", "towns")) return PLACE_VILLAGE;
    if (word_is(w, "landmark", "landmarks", NULL)) return PLACE_LANDMARK;
    if (word_is(w, "korok", "koroks", "seed") || ieq_eq(w, "seeds")) return PLACE_KOROK;
    return -1;
}

// ---- matching text: lower case, apostrophes dropped, anything else that is not a letter or digit separates words
static void normalize(char *dst, size_t n, const char *src) {
    size_t o = 0;
    bool gap = false;
    for (const unsigned char *s = (const unsigned char *)src; *s && o + 2 < n; s++) {
        if (*s == '\'') continue;
        if (s[0] == 0xE2 && s[1] == 0x80 && s[2] == 0x99) { s += 2; continue; }  // (a typographic apostrophe)
        if (isalnum(*s)) {
            if (gap && o) dst[o++] = ' ';
            gap = false;
            dst[o++] = (char)tolower(*s);
        } else gap = true;
    }
    dst[o] = 0;
}

// Does every query word start a word of the text?
static bool words_start_words(const char *text, int nq, char (*q)[64]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < nq; i++) {
        bool found = false;
        for (const char *p = text; *p && !found; ) {
            size_t len = strlen(q[i]);
            if (!strncmp(p, q[i], len)) found = true;
            while (*p && *p != ' ') p++;
            while (*p == ' ') p++;
        }
        if (!found) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool all_digits(const char *s) {
    if (!*s) return false;
    for (; *s; s++) if (!isdigit((unsigned char)*s)) return false;
    return true;
}

// The query words, normalized; words that vanish (only punctuation) are dropped. Returns how many are left.
static int normalize_words(int nwords, char *const *words, char (*q)[64], int max) {
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nwords && n < max; i++) {
        normalize(q[n], 64, words[i]);
        if (q[n][0]) n++;
    }
    return n;
}

static bool in_kind(const Place *p, int kind) { return kind < 0 || (int)p->kind == kind; }

// stage 1: the whole query is the name, or the name without its last word ("Rito Stable" = "rito", "Oman Au Shrine" = "oman au")
static bool exact_name(const Place *p, const char *joined) {
    char nm[128];
    normalize(nm, sizeof nm, p->name);
    if (!strcmp(nm, joined)) return true;
    char *last = strrchr(nm, ' ');
    if (last && p->kind != PLACE_KOROK) { *last = 0; return !strcmp(nm, joined); }
    return false;
}

int place_list(int kind, int nwords, char *const *words, const Place **out, int max) {
    char q[8][64];
    int nq = normalize_words(nwords, words, q, 8);
    int total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < PLACE_TOTAL; i++) {
        const Place *p = &table[i];
        if (!in_kind(p, kind)) continue;
        if (kind < 0 && p->kind == PLACE_KOROK) continue;  // (900 ids would drown everything; ask for them by kind)
        char hay[256], nm[128], sub[128];
        normalize(nm, sizeof nm, p->name);
        normalize(sub, sizeof sub, p->sub);
        snprintf(hay, sizeof hay, "%s %s", nm, sub);
        if (nq && !words_start_words(hay, nq, q)) continue;
        if (total < max) out[total] = p;
        total++;
    }
    return total;
}

static void say_matches(char *why, size_t n, const char *what, const Place *const *m, int total, int shown) {
    size_t o = (size_t)snprintf(why, n, "\"%s\" matches %d places:", what, total);
    for (int i = 0; i < shown && o < n; i++)
        o += (size_t)snprintf(why + o, n - o, "%s %s %d %s", i ? "," : "", place_kind_name(m[i]->kind), m[i]->number, m[i]->name);
    if (total > shown && o < n) snprintf(why + o, n - o, ", ...");
}

static const Place *nearest(int kind, const float from[3], char *why, size_t why_size) {
    if (!from) { snprintf(why, why_size, "Nearest needs a world: Link has no position yet"); return NULL; }
    const Place *best = NULL;
    double best_d = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < PLACE_TOTAL; i++) {
        const Place *p = &table[i];
        if (!in_kind(p, kind)) continue;
        double dx = p->x - from[0], dz = p->z - from[2];  // (sideways distance: the map is flat enough for "nearest")
        double d = dx * dx + dz * dz;
        if (!best || d < best_d) { best = p; best_d = d; }
    }
    if (!best) snprintf(why, why_size, "No place to be nearest");
    return best;
}

static const Place *by_key(int kind, const char *word) {
    for (int i = 0; i < PLACE_TOTAL; i++)
        if (in_kind(&table[i], kind) && ieq_eq(table[i].key, word)) return &table[i];
    return NULL;
}

static bool is_nearest(const char *w) { return ieq_eq(w, "nearest") || ieq_eq(w, "closest"); }
static bool is_filler(const char *w) { return ieq_eq(w, "go") || ieq_eq(w, "to") || ieq_eq(w, "the"); }

// allow_kind false: the first word is part of a name even if it also names a kind ("korok forest" is Korok Forest, a village)
static const Place *find(int nwords, char *const *words, const float from[3], char *why, size_t why_size, bool allow_kind) {
    int all_n = nwords;
    char *const *all_words = words;
    // leading filler: "go to the shrine 5"
    while (nwords > 0 && is_filler(words[0])) { words++; nwords--; }
    if (nwords == 0) { snprintf(why, why_size, "Where to? Try: shrine 5, korok H23, stable wetland, tower 2, hateno, nearest korok"); return NULL; }

    int kind = -1;
    bool want_nearest = false;
    if (!allow_kind) {
        // (no kind word)
    } else if (is_nearest(words[0]) && nwords >= 2 && place_kind_from_word(words[1]) >= 0) {
        kind = place_kind_from_word(words[1]);
        want_nearest = true;
        words += 2; nwords -= 2;
    } else if ((kind = place_kind_from_word(words[0])) >= 0) {
        words++; nwords--;
        if (nwords == 1 && is_nearest(words[0])) want_nearest = true;
    }
    if (want_nearest) return nearest(kind, from, why, why_size);

    if (kind >= 0 && nwords == 0) {
        snprintf(why, why_size, "Which %s? Give its number or name (places %s lists them)", place_kind_name((PlaceKind)kind), place_kind_name((PlaceKind)kind));
        return NULL;
    }
    if (nwords == 1) {
        // a number within the kind, or the game's id (Koroks: H23)
        if (kind >= 0 && all_digits(words[0])) {
            long number = strtol(words[0], NULL, 10);
            const Place *p = number <= 100000 ? place_by_number((PlaceKind)kind, (int)number) : NULL;
            if (!p) {
                int lo = 1 << 30, hi = -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < PLACE_TOTAL; i++)
                    if ((int)table[i].kind == kind) { if (table[i].number < lo) lo = table[i].number; if (table[i].number > hi) hi = table[i].number; }
                snprintf(why, why_size, "There is no %s %s (numbers go from %d to %d)", place_kind_name((PlaceKind)kind), words[0], lo, hi);
            }
            return p;
        }
        const Place *p = by_key(kind, words[0]);
        if (p && (kind >= 0 || p->kind == PLACE_KOROK)) return p;
    }

    // text: the whole name, then words starting words of the name, then of the quest title too
    char q[8][64], joined[600] = "";
    int nq = normalize_words(nwords, words, q, 8);
    if (!nq) { snprintf(why, why_size, "Where to? Try: shrine 5, korok H23, stable wetland, tower 2, hateno, nearest korok"); return NULL; }
    for (int i = 0; i < nq; i++) { strncat(joined, i ? " " : "", sizeof joined - strlen(joined) - 1); strncat(joined, q[i], sizeof joined - strlen(joined) - 1); }

    const Place *hit[PLACE_TOTAL];
    for (int stage = 0; stage < 3; stage++) {
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < PLACE_TOTAL; i++) {
            const Place *p = &table[i];
            if (!in_kind(p, kind) || p->kind == PLACE_KOROK) continue;
            char nm[128], sub[128], hay[256];
            normalize(nm, sizeof nm, p->name);
            normalize(sub, sizeof sub, p->sub);
            bool ok;
            if (stage == 0) ok = exact_name(p, joined);
            else if (stage == 1) ok = words_start_words(nm, nq, q);
            else { snprintf(hay, sizeof hay, "%s %s", nm, sub); ok = words_start_words(hay, nq, q); }
            if (ok) hit[n++] = p;
        }
        if (n == 1) return hit[0];
        if (stage == 0 && n > 1) {  // ("hateno" is the village, not the tower or the lab)
            const Place *village = NULL;
            int villages = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (hit[i]->kind == PLACE_VILLAGE) { village = hit[i]; villages++; }
            if (villages == 1) return village;
        }
        if (n > 1) {
            char what[200] = "";
            for (int i = 0; i < nwords; i++) { strncat(what, i ? " " : "", sizeof what - strlen(what) - 1); strncat(what, words[i], sizeof what - strlen(what) - 1); }
            say_matches(why, why_size, what, hit, n, n < 6 ? n : 6);
            return NULL;
        }
    }
    if (kind >= 0 && allow_kind) return find(all_n, all_words, from, why, why_size, false);
    snprintf(why, why_size, "No place called \"%s\". Try places %s to see the names", joined, kind >= 0 ? place_kind_name((PlaceKind)kind) : "shrine");
    return NULL;
}

const Place *place_find(int nwords, char *const *words, const float from[3], char *why, size_t why_size) {
    return find(nwords, words, from, why, why_size, true);
}
```

`runtime/control_places.h`:

```h
// Named places for `goto` and `places`: shrines, Koroks, towers, stables, villages and a few landmarks, with the game's world
// coordinates (the frame of `pos`). The data is runtime/control_places_data.inc (generated by tools/gen_places.py). The lookup
// has no game state in it, so tools/test_places.c tests it on its own.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>

typedef enum { PLACE_SHRINE, PLACE_TOWER, PLACE_STABLE, PLACE_VILLAGE, PLACE_LANDMARK, PLACE_KOROK, PLACE_KINDS } PlaceKind;

typedef struct {
    PlaceKind kind;
    int number;        // shrine: the game's number (Dungeon005 = 5, from 0); tower: the game's tower number; others: 1.. in list order
    const char *key;   // the game's own id: Dungeon005, Tower07, RitoHatago, Korok H23
    const char *name;  // English name ("Ne'ez Yohma Shrine", "Rito Stable", Korok: the id)
    const char *sub;   // shrine: the quest title; Korok: the map square; else empty
    float x, y, z;
    bool ground;       // the position is a spot the game itself puts Link on (a start position), so he needs only a small lift
} Place;

const char *place_kind_name(PlaceKind kind);  // "shrine", "korok", ...
int place_kind_count(PlaceKind kind);
const Place *place_by_number(PlaceKind kind, int number);  // NULL when there is none

// What `goto` takes after the word goto: "shrine 5", "korok H23", "stable wetland", "oman au", "korok nearest", "nearest shrine".
// words are single words (split at spaces). `from` is where Link is now, for "nearest" (NULL when unknown).
// Returns the place, or NULL with the reason in why (no match, several matches with the first ones listed, bad number).
const Place *place_find(int nwords, char *const *words, const float from[3], char *why, size_t why_size);

// What `places` shows: kind filter (-1 = all kinds) and words that must each start a word of the name or title. Fills out[0..max)
// and returns how many places match in all.
int place_list(int kind, int nwords, char *const *words, const Place **out, int max);

// The kind a word names ("shrine", "shrines", "seed", "town", ...), or -1.
int place_kind_from_word(const char *word);
```

`runtime/control_prof.c`:

```c
// Control endpoint profiling commands. All handlers run on the presenting thread.
#include <errno.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "control.h"
#include "prof.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "perfcount.h"
#include "platform.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <intrin.h>
#define PSAPI_VERSION 2
#include <psapi.h>
#else
#include <sys/resource.h>
#include <time.h>
#endif

// sampler.c (the legacy `sample` command): status is a static string; start returns NULL on success, an error otherwise.
const char *sampler_status(void);
const char *sampler_request(double seconds, unsigned interval_us);

// 60 seconds at the frame pacer's 300 fps ceiling, with headroom. No work when control is off.
#define FRAME_CAP 32768
static struct { uint64_t end, ns; } frames[FRAME_CAP];
static uint64_t sorted[FRAME_CAP];
static unsigned head, used;
static uint64_t last_ns, last_frame;
static bool hooked;

_Atomic uint64_t g_perfcount[PC_COUNT];
_Atomic int64_t g_texmem[TM_COUNT], g_texmem_n[TM_COUNT];
int (*g_gpu_heaps)(uint64_t *usage, uint64_t *budget, uint64_t *size, uint32_t *device_local, int max);

// The process's page faults so far (soft and hard: guest memory touched for the first time, memory paged back in)
static uint64_t os_page_faults(uint64_t *major) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS pmc = {.cb = sizeof pmc};
    *major = 0;
    return K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), &pmc, sizeof pmc) ? pmc.PageFaultCount : 0;
#else
    struct rusage ru;
    if (getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, &ru)) { *major = 0; return 0; }
    *major = (uint64_t)ru.ru_majflt;
    return (uint64_t)(ru.ru_minflt + ru.ru_majflt);
#endif
}

// ---- `frametrace`: per presented frame, its time and what the counters of perfcount.h did in it (hitch attribution:
// tools/perf_routes.py). Off until `frametrace start`; then one snapshot of the counters and one page-fault count a frame.
// Also the CPU time of the game's main thread, the render thread and the recorder in each frame (a spike of one of them
// with no stall: game logic, translation or recording).
#define FT_COLS (PC_COUNT + 5)  // counters, page faults, hard page faults, main / render / recorder CPU (us)
typedef struct { uint64_t end, ns, d[FT_COLS]; } FtRow;
static FtRow *ft_rows;
static unsigned ft_n, ft_cap;
static bool ft_on;
static uint64_t ft_last[FT_COLS];
static pthread_t ft_th;  // (the main thread; render and recorder: ft_named)
static int ft_named[3];
static bool ft_has[3];
static double ft_tsc_per_ms = 1;
static double thread_cpu_ms(pthread_t th, double tsc_per_ms);
static double named_cpu_ms(int i, double tsc_per_ms);
static void ft_snapshot(uint64_t *v) {
    for (int i = 0; i < PC_COUNT; i++) v[i] = atomic_load_explicit(&g_perfcount[i], memory_order_relaxed);
    v[PC_COUNT] = os_page_faults(&v[PC_COUNT + 1]);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        double ms = !ft_has[i] ? -1 : i ? named_cpu_ms(ft_named[i], ft_tsc_per_ms) : thread_cpu_ms(ft_th, ft_tsc_per_ms);
        v[PC_COUNT + 2 + i] = ms > 0 ? (uint64_t)(ms * 1000) : 0;
    }
}
static uint64_t ft_cost_ns, ft_cost_max_ns;  // (the trace's own time on the presenting thread)
static void ft_frame(uint64_t now, uint64_t ns) {
    uint64_t v[FT_COLS];
    ft_snapshot(v);
    uint64_t cost = plat_now_ns() - now;
    ft_cost_ns += cost;
    if (cost > ft_cost_max_ns) ft_cost_max_ns = cost;
    if (ft_n < ft_cap) {
        FtRow *r = &ft_rows[ft_n++];
        r->end = now;
        r->ns = ns;
        for (int i = 0; i < FT_COLS; i++) r->d[i] = v[i] - ft_last[i];
    }
    memcpy(ft_last, v, sizeof v);
}

// Integration: declare this and call control_prof_frame(frame) at the start of control_game_frame.
// Both this hook and the commands must run on the presenting thread.
void control_prof_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    if (hooked && frame == last_frame) return;
    if (ft_on && hooked && frame > last_frame && now > last_ns) ft_frame(now, now - last_ns);
    if (hooked && frame > last_frame && now > last_ns) {
        frames[head].end = now;
        frames[head].ns = now - last_ns;
        head = (head + 1) % FRAME_CAP;
        if (used < FRAME_CAP) used++;
    } else if (hooked) {
        head = used = 0;  // a frame counter or clock reset starts a new history
    }
    hooked = true;
    last_ns = now;
    last_frame = frame;
}

static bool number(const char *s, double lo, double hi, double *out) {
    char *end;
    errno = 0;
    double n = strtod(s, &end);
    if (end == s || *end || errno || !isfinite(n) || n < lo || n > hi) return false;
    *out = n;
    return true;
}
static int compare_ns(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uint64_t x = *(const uint64_t *)a, y = *(const uint64_t *)b;
    return (x > y) - (x < y);
}
static void cmd_frames(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    double seconds = 5;
    if (argc > 2 || (argc == 2 && (!number(argv[1], 0, 60, &seconds) || seconds <= 0))) {
        control_fail(r, "Usage: frames [seconds] (up to 60)"); return;
    }
    if (!hooked) {
        control_fail(r, "Frame hook missing"); return;
    }
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns(), window = (uint64_t)(seconds * 1e9);
    unsigned n = 0, over33 = 0, over50 = 0;
    double total = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < used; i++) {
        unsigned at = (head + FRAME_CAP - 1 - i) % FRAME_CAP;
        if (now < frames[at].end || now - frames[at].end >= window) break;
        uint64_t ns = frames[at].ns;
        sorted[n++] = ns;
        total += (double)ns;
        over33 += ns > 33000000;
        over50 += ns > 50000000;
    }
    if (!n) { control_fail(r, "No frames in this window"); return; }
    qsort(sorted, n, sizeof *sorted, compare_ns);
    control_field_num(r, "seconds", seconds);
    control_field_int(r, "count", n);
    control_field_num(r, "covered_s", total / 1e9);
    control_field_bool(r, "capacity_limited", used == FRAME_CAP && now >= frames[head].end && now - frames[head].end < window);
    control_field_num(r, "fps_avg", n * 1e9 / total);
    control_field_num(r, "frame_ms_avg", total / n / 1e6);
    // Nearest-rank percentiles, including the full interval ending inside the window.
    control_field_num(r, "frame_ms_p50", sorted[(n * 50 + 99) / 100 - 1] / 1e6);
    control_field_num(r, "frame_ms_p95", sorted[(n * 95 + 99) / 100 - 1] / 1e6);
    control_field_num(r, "frame_ms_p99", sorted[(n * 99 + 99) / 100 - 1] / 1e6);
    control_field_num(r, "frame_ms_max", sorted[n - 1] / 1e6);
    control_field_int(r, "over_33_ms", over33);
    control_field_int(r, "over_50_ms", over50);
}
static void cmd_sample(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "status")) {
        control_field_str(r, "status", sampler_status());
        control_field_str(r, "path", "build/samples.txt");
        return;
    }
    double seconds, interval = 1000;
    if ((argc != 3 && argc != 4) || strcmp(argv[1], "start") ||
        !number(argv[2], 0.001, 3600, &seconds) ||
        (argc == 4 && (!number(argv[3], 100, 1000000, &interval) || interval != floor(interval)))) {
        control_fail(r, "Usage: sample start <seconds> [interval_us] | status"); return;
    }
    const char *error = sampler_request(seconds, (unsigned)interval);
    if (error) { control_fail(r, "sample: %s", error); return; }
    control_field_str(r, "status", "started");
    control_field_num(r, "seconds", seconds);
    control_field_int(r, "interval_us", (unsigned)interval);
    control_field_str(r, "path", "build/samples.txt");
}
// ---- `threads`: CPU time used so far by each guest thread and by the named host threads (render: the NVN queue thread
// that translates and records the command lists; recorder: the Vulkan recorder). Two calls a few seconds apart give
// each thread's busy time per frame (tools/perf_routes.py), which tells the game thread from the render thread as the
// limit. Windows: QueryThreadCycleTime (TSC ticks, turned into ms with the TSC rate measured since startup).
#define PROF_THREADS 8
static struct { const char *name; pthread_t th; void *h; } named[PROF_THREADS];  // (h: Windows, a handle of its own)
static _Atomic int nnamed;
static uint64_t tsc0, ns0;
void control_prof_thread(const char *name) {  // (any thread, once, at its start)
    int i = atomic_fetch_add(&nnamed, 1);
    if (i >= PROF_THREADS) return;
    named[i].th = pthread_self();
#ifdef _WIN32  // (a detached thread's pthread handle is closed: the recorder's was, and its CPU time read as -1)
    HANDLE h = NULL;
    if (DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentThread(), GetCurrentProcess(), &h, THREAD_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, 0))
        named[i].h = h;
#endif
    named[i].name = name;
}
static double thread_cpu_ms(pthread_t th, double tsc_per_ms) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    ULONG64 cycles;
    HANDLE h = (HANDLE)pthread_gethandle(th);
    if (!h || !QueryThreadCycleTime(h, &cycles)) return -1;
    return (double)cycles / tsc_per_ms;
#else
    (void)tsc_per_ms;
    clockid_t id;
    struct timespec ts;
    if (pthread_getcpuclockid(th, &id) || clock_gettime(id, &ts)) return -1;
    return ts.tv_sec * 1e3 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6;
#endif
}
static double named_cpu_ms(int i, double tsc_per_ms) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    ULONG64 cycles;
    if (named[i].h) return QueryThreadCycleTime((HANDLE)named[i].h, &cycles) ? (double)cycles / tsc_per_ms : -1;
#endif
    return thread_cpu_ms(named[i].th, tsc_per_ms);
}
static void cmd_threads(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    (void)argv;
    if (argc != 1) { control_fail(r, "Usage: threads"); return; }
    uint64_t ns = plat_now_ns();
    double tsc_per_ms = 1;
#ifdef _WIN32
    uint64_t tsc = __rdtsc();
    if (ns <= ns0 + 100000000) { control_fail(r, "threads: TSC rate not measured yet; retry in a second"); return; }
    tsc_per_ms = (double)(tsc - tsc0) / ((double)(ns - ns0) / 1e6);
#endif
    extern uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);
    control_field_num(r, "now_ms", ns / 1e6);
    control_field_int(r, "presents", (int64_t)renderer_present_count());
    char key[64];
    int n = atomic_load(&nnamed);
    for (int i = 0; i < n && i < PROF_THREADS; i++) {
        snprintf(key, sizeof key, "host.%s", named[i].name);
        control_field_num(r, key, named_cpu_ms(i, tsc_per_ms));
    }
    pthread_t host[128];
    uint32_t handle[128];
    uint64_t entry[128];
    int m = kernel_running_threads(host, handle, entry, 128);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        if (handle[i] >= 0xf000) continue;  // (host threads the sampler also takes: the named ones above)
        snprintf(key, sizeof key, "guest.%x_%llx", handle[i], (unsigned long long)entry[i]);
        control_field_num(r, key, thread_cpu_ms(host[i], tsc_per_ms));
    }
}

// SAVAGEWIND_GPUPROF_AT's capture of one frame, asked for now (vulkan/device.c takes it on the next present):
// "[gpuprof]" lines in the log
volatile int g_gpuprof_request;

static void cmd_vkprof(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    if (argc > 2 || (argc == 2 && strcmp(argv[1], "0") && strcmp(argv[1], "1") && strcmp(argv[1], "2"))) {
        control_fail(r, "Usage: vkprof [0|1|2]"); return;
    }
    control_fail(r, "Set at startup with SAVAGEWIND_VK_PROF (1 detailed, 2 coarse)");
}
static void cmd_gpuprof(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    (void)argv;
    if (argc != 1) { control_fail(r, "Usage: gpuprof"); return; }
    extern uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);
    g_gpuprof_request = 1;
    control_field_str(r, "status", "requested: GPU time per pass of the next frame, as [gpuprof] lines in the log");
    control_field_int(r, "presents", (int64_t)renderer_present_count());
}
// prof [start | stop | toggle | status | report]: the on-demand profiler (runtime/prof.h; report with tools/swprof.py)
static void cmd_prof(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    char out[512];
    bool ok = prof_command(argc, argv, out, sizeof out);
    if (!ok) { control_fail(r, "prof: %s", out); return; }
    control_field_str(r, "status", out);
    control_field_str(r, "file", prof_last_file());
}
static void cmd_frametrace(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "start")) {
        if (!ft_rows) {
            ft_cap = FRAME_CAP;
            ft_rows = malloc(sizeof *ft_rows * ft_cap);
            if (!ft_rows) { ft_cap = 0; control_fail(r, "frametrace: out of memory"); return; }
        }
        ft_n = 0;
        ft_cost_ns = ft_cost_max_ns = 0;
        ft_has[0] = ft_has[1] = ft_has[2] = false;
        pthread_t host[128];
        uint32_t handle[128];
        uint64_t entry[128];
        int m = kernel_running_threads(host, handle, entry, 128);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            if (handle[i] == 0x101) ft_th = host[i], ft_has[0] = true;  // (the game's first thread)
        for (int i = 0; i < atomic_load(&nnamed) && i < PROF_THREADS; i++) {
            int k = !strcmp(named[i].name, "render") ? 1 : !strcmp(named[i].name, "recorder") ? 2 : -1;
            if (k > 0) ft_named[k] = i, ft_has[k] = true;
        }
#ifdef _WIN32
        uint64_t ns = plat_now_ns();
        if (ns > ns0 + 100000000) ft_tsc_per_ms = (double)(__rdtsc() - tsc0) / ((double)(ns - ns0) / 1e6);
#endif
        ft_snapshot(ft_last);
        ft_on = true;
        control_field_str(r, "status", "tracing");
        control_field_int(r, "capacity", ft_cap);
        return;
    }
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "stop")) {
        ft_on = false;
        control_field_int(r, "frames", ft_n);
        return;
    }
    if (argc == 3 && !strcmp(argv[1], "dump")) {
        ft_on = false;
        FILE *f = fopen(argv[2], "w");
        if (!f) { control_fail(r, "frametrace: cannot write %s: %s", argv[2], strerror(errno)); return; }
        fprintf(f, "end_ms,frame_ms,builds,build_ms,build_waits,build_wait_ms,upload_mb,tex_mb,astc_ms,astc_mb,gpu_wait_ms,"
                   "file_reads,file_mb,file_ms,valloc_ms,present_ms,faults,hard_faults,main_ms,render_ms,recorder_ms\n");
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < ft_n; i++) {
            const FtRow *w = &ft_rows[i];
            const uint64_t *d = w->d;
            fprintf(f, "%.3f,%.3f,%llu,%.3f,%llu,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%llu,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%llu,%llu,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f\n",
                    w->end / 1e6,
                    w->ns / 1e6, (unsigned long long)d[PC_BUILDS], d[PC_BUILD_NS] / 1e6, (unsigned long long)d[PC_BUILD_WAITS],
                    d[PC_BUILD_WAIT_NS] / 1e6, d[PC_UPLOAD_BYTES] / 1048576.0, d[PC_TEX_BYTES] / 1048576.0, d[PC_ASTC_NS] / 1e6,
                    d[PC_ASTC_BYTES] / 1048576.0, d[PC_GPU_WAIT_NS] / 1e6, (unsigned long long)d[PC_FILE_READS],
                    d[PC_FILE_BYTES] / 1048576.0, d[PC_FILE_NS] / 1e6, d[PC_VALLOC_NS] / 1e6, d[PC_PRESENT_NS] / 1e6,
                    (unsigned long long)d[PC_COUNT], (unsigned long long)d[PC_COUNT + 1], d[PC_COUNT + 2] / 1e3,
                    d[PC_COUNT + 3] / 1e3, d[PC_COUNT + 4] / 1e3);
        }
        bool ok = fclose(f) == 0;
        if (!ok) { control_fail(r, "frametrace: writing %s failed", argv[2]); return; }
        control_field_int(r, "frames", ft_n);
        control_field_num(r, "cost_us_avg", ft_n ? ft_cost_ns / 1e3 / ft_n : 0);
        control_field_num(r, "cost_us_max", ft_cost_max_ns / 1e3);
        control_field_bool(r, "capacity_limited", ft_n == ft_cap);
        control_field_str(r, "path", argv[2]);
        return;
    }
    control_fail(r, "Usage: frametrace start | stop | dump <path>");
}

// ---- `memstats`: process memory, GPU memory heaps (VK_EXT_memory_budget: the whole process's use of each heap) and
// texture memory by kind
static void cmd_memstats(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    (void)argv;
    if (argc != 1) { control_fail(r, "Usage: memstats"); return; }
    const double MB = 1048576.0;
    uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
#ifdef _WIN32
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX pmc = {.cb = sizeof pmc};
    if (K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), (PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS *)&pmc, sizeof pmc)) {
        control_field_num(r, "rss_mb", pmc.WorkingSetSize / MB);
        control_field_num(r, "rss_peak_mb", pmc.PeakWorkingSetSize / MB);
        control_field_num(r, "private_mb", pmc.PrivateUsage / MB);
    }
    MEMORYSTATUSEX ms = {.dwLength = sizeof ms};
    if (GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&ms)) {
        control_field_num(r, "sys_total_mb", ms.ullTotalPhys / MB);
        control_field_num(r, "sys_used_mb", (ms.ullTotalPhys - ms.ullAvailPhys) / MB);
    }
#else
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/self/status", "r");
    char line[256];
    static const char *const keys[][2] = {{"VmRSS:", "rss_mb"}, {"VmHWM:", "rss_peak_mb"}, {"RssAnon:", "private_mb"},
                                          {"RssFile:", "rss_file_mb"}, {"RssShmem:", "rss_shmem_mb"}, {"VmSwap:", "swap_mb"}};
    while (f && fgets(line, sizeof line, f))
        for (size_t k = 0; k < sizeof keys / sizeof *keys; k++)
            if (!strncmp(line, keys[k][0], strlen(keys[k][0]))) control_field_num(r, keys[k][1], atof(line + strlen(keys[k][0])) / 1024.0);
    if (f) fclose(f);
    f = fopen("/proc/meminfo", "r");
    double total = -1, avail = -1;
    while (f && fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        if (!strncmp(line, "MemTotal:", 9)) total = atof(line + 9) / 1024.0;
        if (!strncmp(line, "MemAvailable:", 13)) avail = atof(line + 13) / 1024.0;
    }
    if (f) fclose(f);
    if (total > 0 && avail >= 0) control_field_num(r, "sys_total_mb", total), control_field_num(r, "sys_used_mb", total - avail);
#endif
    uint64_t major, faults = os_page_faults(&major);
    control_field_int(r, "page_faults", (int64_t)faults);
    if (g_gpu_heaps) {
        uint64_t use[16], bud[16], size[16];
        uint32_t local[16];
        int n = g_gpu_heaps(use, bud, size, local, 16);
        double dl = 0, host = 0;
        char key[48];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            snprintf(key, sizeof key, "heap%d_%s_used_mb", i, local[i] ? "local" : "host");
            control_field_num(r, key, use[i] / MB);
            snprintf(key, sizeof key, "heap%d_budget_mb", i);
            control_field_num(r, key, bud[i] / MB);
            snprintf(key, sizeof key, "heap%d_size_mb", i);
            control_field_num(r, key, size[i] / MB);
            if (local[i]) dl += use[i] / MB; else host += use[i] / MB;
        }
        control_field_num(r, "gpu_local_mb", dl);
        control_field_num(r, "gpu_host_mb", host);
    }
    static const char *const kinds[TM_COUNT] = {"astc_native", "astc_rgba8", "bc", "rt", "other", "astc_src"};
    char key[48];
    for (int k = 0; k < TM_COUNT; k++) {
        snprintf(key, sizeof key, "tex_%s_mb", kinds[k]);
        control_field_num(r, key, atomic_load(&g_texmem[k]) / MB);
        snprintf(key, sizeof key, "tex_%s_n", kinds[k]);
        control_field_int(r, key, atomic_load(&g_texmem_n[k]));
    }
    control_field_num(r, "astc_decode_ms", atomic_load(&g_perfcount[PC_ASTC_NS]) / 1e6);
    control_field_num(r, "astc_decoded_mb", atomic_load(&g_perfcount[PC_ASTC_BYTES]) / MB);
    control_field_num(r, "self_us", (plat_now_ns() - t0) / 1e3);  // (this command's own time on the presenting thread)
}

void control_prof_init(void) {
    static const ControlCmd cmds[] = {
        {"frametrace", "start | stop | dump <path>", "Per-frame counters (builds, uploads, ASTC, waits, file reads, faults) to a CSV", cmd_frametrace},
        {"memstats", "", "Process RAM, GPU memory heaps and texture memory by kind", cmd_memstats},
        {"frames", "[seconds]", "Frame times over the last seconds (default 5, maximum 60)", cmd_frames},
        {"sample", "start <seconds> [interval_us] | status", "Sample guest stacks to build/samples.txt; show status", cmd_sample},
        {"vkprof", "[0|1|2]", "Vulkan timers (startup setting)", cmd_vkprof},
        {"gpuprof", "", "GPU time per pass of the next frame, to the log", cmd_gpuprof},
        {"threads", "", "CPU time so far of each game thread and the render threads (ms)", cmd_threads},
        {"prof", "[start | stop | toggle | status | report]", "Profiler capture (swprof.py reads the file)", cmd_prof},
    };
    ns0 = plat_now_ns();
#ifdef _WIN32
    tsc0 = __rdtsc();
#endif
    control_register(cmds, (int)(sizeof cmds / sizeof *cmds));
}

```

`runtime/control_settings.c`:

```c
// Control settings use the same field updates as ui/game_options.mm. Window changes are queued to the
// window loop; Vulkan notices VSync/HDR changes at frame begin and recreates its swapchain there.
#include "control.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "language.h"
#include "nvn/output_scale.h"

#include <errno.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

void menu_request_window_apply(void);

typedef enum { BOOL, INT, FLOAT, TEXT } Kind;
typedef struct {
    const char *key;
    void *value;
    Kind kind;
    double min, max;
    const char *names; // enum names in numeric order, separated by '|'
} Setting;
#define B(k) {#k, &g_settings.k, BOOL, 0, 1, "off|on"}
#define I(k, lo, hi, names) {#k, &g_settings.k, INT, lo, hi, names}
#define F(k, lo, hi) {#k, &g_settings.k, FLOAT, lo, hi, NULL}
static const Setting settings[] = {
    B(fullscreen), I(window_w, 0, 16384, NULL), I(window_h, 0, 16384, NULL),

    I(perf_overlay, 0, PERF_FULL, "off|fps|full"), I(fps_limit, 0, 360, NULL), B(fps_display),

    B(async_shaders), B(precompile_shaders), B(dlss_download), B(quick_sort), B(quick_drop), B(discord_rpc),

    I(hdr, 0, HDR_COUNT - 1, "auto|on|off"), I(hdr_white, 0, 1000, NULL),
    I(hdr_peak_nits, 0, 10000, NULL), I(hdr_game_nits, 0, 1000, NULL), I(hdr_hue, 0, 100, NULL),
    I(hdr_blowout, 0, 100, NULL), I(hdr_sdr_blend, 0, 60, NULL), I(hdr_vanilla_saturation, 0, 100, NULL),
    I(hdr_bloom, 0, 100, NULL), I(hdr_clamp, 0, 1, "bt709|bt2020"),

    I(color_tint, -100, 100, NULL),

    B(infinite_stamina), B(infinite_rupees), I(weather, 0, WEATHER_COUNT - 1,
                           "game|no_rain|no_storms|clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|snow|heavy_snow|thunderstorm|thunder_rain|sun_shower"),
    B(god_mode), B(one_hit_kill), I(damage_taken, 25, 400, NULL), I(damage_dealt, 25, 400, NULL),
    I(text_language, 0, 0, NULL), I(voice_language, 0, 0, NULL), B(save_backups), B(stick_cam_on), I(stick_cam_x, STICK_CAM_MIN, STICK_CAM_MAX, NULL),
    I(stick_cam_y, STICK_CAM_MIN, STICK_CAM_MAX, NULL), B(auto_continue), B(menu_tip_seen),
```
