```c
#undef B
#undef I
#undef F

static const Setting *find(const char *key) {
    if (!strcmp(key, "fps")) key = "fps_limit";
    if (!strcmp(key, "left_stick_deadzone")) key = "stick_deadzone[0]";
    if (!strcmp(key, "right_stick_deadzone")) key = "stick_deadzone[1]";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof settings / sizeof *settings; i++)
        if (!strcmp(key, settings[i].key)) return &settings[i];
    return NULL;
}
static bool is(const Setting *s, const char *key) { return !strcmp(s->key, key); }

static int named(const char *names, const char *value) {
    if (!names) return -1;
    for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
        const char *end = strchr(names, '|');
        size_t n = end ? (size_t)(end - names) : strlen(names);
        if (strlen(value) == n && !strncmp(names, value, n)) return i;
        if (!end) return -1;
        names = end + 1;
    }
}
static void emit(const Setting *s, ControlReply *r) {
    if (s->kind == TEXT) { control_field_str(r, s->key, s->value); return; }
    if (s->kind == BOOL) { control_field_bool(r, s->key, *(bool *)s->value); return; }
    if (s->kind == FLOAT) { control_field_num(r, s->key, *(float *)s->value); return; }
    int v = *(int *)s->value;
    const char *name = s->names;
    if (name && v >= 0 && v <= s->max) {
        for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) name = strchr(name, '|') + 1;
        size_t n = strcspn(name, "|");
        char buf[64];
        memcpy(buf, name, n); buf[n] = 0;
        control_field_str(r, s->key, buf);
    } else control_field_int(r, s->key, v);
}
static void window_size_reply(ControlReply *r) {
    char buf[48];
    if (!g_settings.window_w && !g_settings.window_h) strcpy(buf, "default");
    else snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%dx%d", g_settings.window_w, g_settings.window_h);
    control_field_str(r, "window_size", buf);
}
static void cmd_get(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    if (argc > 2) { control_fail(r, "Usage: get [key]"); return; }
    if (argc == 2) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[1], "window_size")) { window_size_reply(r); return; }
        const Setting *s = find(argv[1]);
        if (!s) control_fail(r, "Unknown setting: %s", argv[1]);
        else emit(s, r);
    } else {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof settings / sizeof *settings; i++) emit(&settings[i], r);
        window_size_reply(r);
    }
}
static void cmd_set(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    if (argc != 3) { control_fail(r, "Usage: set <key> <value>"); return; }
    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "window_size")) {
        int w = 0, h = 0;
        if (strcmp(argv[2], "default")) {
            char *end;
            errno = 0;
            long width = strtol(argv[2], &end, 10);
            if (end == argv[2] || *end != 'x' || errno || width < 320 || width > 16384) {
                control_fail(r, "window_size must be default or WIDTHxHEIGHT (320 to 16384 by 200 to 16384)"); return;
            }
            const char *height_start = end + 1;
            errno = 0;
            long height = strtol(height_start, &end, 10);
            if (end == height_start || *end || errno || height < 200 || height > 16384) {
                control_fail(r, "window_size must be default or WIDTHxHEIGHT (320 to 16384 by 200 to 16384)"); return;
            }
            w = (int)width; h = (int)height;
        }
        g_settings.window_w = w; g_settings.window_h = h;
        menu_request_window_apply();
        window_size_reply(r);
        control_field_str(r, "applied", "live");
        return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "hdr_preset")) {  // (0 Off, 1..3 a saved slot: apply the whole look)
        int v = atoi(argv[2]);
        if (v < 0 || v > 3) { control_fail(r, "hdr_preset must be 0 (Off) or 1..3"); return; }
        hdr_look_apply(v);
        char buf[32];
        snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%d", v);
        control_field_str(r, "hdr_preset", buf);
        control_field_str(r, "applied", "live");
        return;
    }
    const Setting *s = find(argv[1]);
    if (!s) { control_fail(r, "Unknown setting: %s", argv[1]); return; }
    // These need paired window dimensions, file discovery, or are bookkeeping rather than menu options.
    if (is(s, "window_w") || is(s, "window_h")) {
        control_fail(r, "Width and height must change together: use window_size WIDTHxHEIGHT or default"); return;
    }
    if (s->kind == TEXT) {
        control_fail(r, "LUT selection is only available in the Colour menu"); return;
    }
    if (is(s, "color_lut_set") || is(s, "menu_tip_seen")) {
        control_fail(r, "%s is read-only", s->key); return;
    }
#ifdef __APPLE__
    if (is(s, "anisotropy") || is(s, "sharpening") || is(s, "frame_gen") || is(s, "game_fxaa") ||
        !strncmp(s->key, "color_", 6) || is(s, "hdr") || is(s, "hdr_white") || is(s, "vsync")) {
        control_fail(r, "%s is not supported by this backend", s->key); return;
    }
#endif
    double value;
    int n = named(s->names, argv[2]);
    if (s->kind == BOOL && !strcmp(argv[2], "true")) n = 1;
    if (s->kind == BOOL && !strcmp(argv[2], "false")) n = 0;
    if (is(s, "fps_limit") && (!strcmp(argv[2], "off") || !strcmp(argv[2], "unlimited"))) n = 0;
    bool text = is(s, "text_language"), voice = is(s, "voice_language");
    int languages = text ? language_text_count() : voice ? g_nvoice_languages : 0;
    if (text || voice) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[2], text ? "auto" : "text")) n = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < languages; i++) {
            if (!strcmp(argv[2], text ? g_text_languages[i].folder : g_voice_languages[i].folder) ||
                !strcmp(argv[2], text ? g_text_languages[i].name : g_voice_languages[i].name)) n = i;
        }
    }
    if (n >= 0) value = n;
    else {
        char *end;
        errno = 0;
        value = strtod(argv[2], &end);
        if (end == argv[2] || *end || errno || !isfinite(value)) {
            control_fail(r, "%s must be %s", s->key, s->names ? s->names :
                         text ? "a text language index or folder (auto for system)" :
                         voice ? "a voice language index or folder (text to follow text)" : "a finite number"); return;
        }
    }
    double max = languages ? languages - 1 : s->max;
    if (value < s->min || value > max || (s->kind != FLOAT && value != floor(value))) {
        control_fail(r, "%s must be %s from %g to %g%s%s", s->key,
                     s->kind == FLOAT ? "a number" : "an integer", s->min, max,
                     s->names ? " or " : "", s->names ? s->names : ""); return;
    }
    int v = (int)value;
    if (is(s, "fps_limit")) {
        const int *fps;
        int nfps = fps_choices(&fps);
        bool offered = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < nfps; i++) offered |= fps[i] == v;
        if (!offered) {
            char list[96] = "";
            for (int i = 0; i < nfps; i++)
                snprintf(list + strlen(list), sizeof list - strlen(list), "%s%d", i ? ", " : "", fps[i]);
            control_fail(r, "fps must be one of %s%s", list, settings_handheld() ? "" : " (0: unlimited)");
            return;
        }
    }
    if (is(s, "hdr_white") && v != 0 && v < 80) {
        control_fail(r, "hdr_white must be 0 (automatic) or 80 to 1000 nits"); return;
    }
    if (is(s, "hdr_peak_nits") && v != 0 && v < 80) {
        control_fail(r, "hdr_peak_nits must be 0 (not set yet: read the ICC peak on the next start) or 80 to %g nits",
                     s->max); return;
    }
    if ((is(s, "hdr_game_nits") || is(s, "hdr_ui_nits")) && v != 0 && v < 80) {
        control_fail(r, "%s must be 0 (the default) or 80 to %g nits", s->key, s->max); return;
    }
    if (is(s, "upscaler") && !upscaler_available(v)) {
        control_fail(r, "Upscaler unavailable"); return;
    }
    if (is(s, "upscale_quality") && !upscale_modes_available()) {
        control_fail(r, "Quality modes unavailable"); return;
    }
#ifdef __APPLE__
    if (is(s, "antialias") && v == AA_TAA) {
        control_fail(r, "TAA requires the Vulkan backend"); return;
    }
#endif
    if (s->kind == BOOL) *(bool *)s->value = value != 0;
    else if (s->kind == FLOAT) *(float *)s->value = (float)value;
    else *(int *)s->value = v;
    if (is(s, "hdr_peak_nits") || is(s, "hdr_game_nits") || is(s, "hdr_ui_nits")) hdr_look_init_peak();
    if (is(s, "fullscreen")) menu_request_window_apply();
    // Do not call settings_save(): file I/O on the presenting thread would block. A menu save may persist these.
    emit(s, r);
    control_field_str(r, "applied", text || voice || is(s, "precompile_shaders") ? "needs_restart" : "live");
}
void control_settings_init(void) {
    static const ControlCmd get[] = {
        {"get", "[key]", "List the settings or show one", cmd_get, CONTROL_PLAYER},
    };
    static const ControlCmd set[] = {
        {"set", "<key> <value>", "Change a setting", cmd_set, 0},
    };
    control_register(get, 1);
    if (control_enabled()) control_register(set, 1);
}
```

`runtime/control_tp.c`:

```c
// (test and development only) teleport for the control endpoint (docs/CONTROL.md).
//
// pos reads a copy of Link's position (uking::act::PlayerInfo +0x88) that the game rewrites every frame, so writing
// to it does nothing. The real position is a vec3 somewhere on the game's heap. The first teleport finds it without
// ever blocking a frame and without a visible move:
//   1. a background scan lists every place holding three floats equal to Link's position (about 0.3 s);
//   2. the list is cut to the real one in a few rounds: split it into four groups, nudge the members of group g by
//      g * 0.05 (a few centimetres, undone right after) and read how far pos moved. Copies the game rewrites do not
//      move it, the real one does, so the amount names its group. Four rounds narrow 256 candidates to one;
//   3. the target is written to it and checked.
// That address is reused (re-checked before each use, found again when the game moved it). Better still, path_addr() reaches
// it straight from PlayerInfo (a pointer chain found with mem path), so even the first teleport needs no search.
//
// Far jumps (a few hundred units and more): the game pauses the world (pause reason 9) every update in which the map
// sections around Link are not loaded, and loading them is done by the world's own update, so after such a jump the
// world waited for itself for good (clock stopped, "No world loaded" from camera). The jump is the same single write,
// but the game's question "is the ground around Link still loading?" is answered "no" while the runtime holds Link at
// the target (tools/patches.py _tp_gate calls rt_tp_gate_begin / rt_tp_gate_end around the game's own function). The
// world keeps running and loads the map; the game's real answer is counted, and once the ground has been ready for
// several updates in a row the hold ends and Link falls onto it as after a short teleport.
#include <math.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "control.h"
#include "control_cells.h"
#include "control_mem.h"
#include "rt.h"
#include "game_sites.h"

uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);  // presented frames (the backend)

#define MAX_CAND CONTROL_MEM_VEC_MAX
#define NUDGE 0.05f
#define GROUPS 4
#define WAIT_FRAMES 3
#define WAIT_NS 120000000ull  // (the game updates slower than it presents; give it a whole update to overwrite copies)

enum { IDLE, SCAN, PROBE, TEST, VERIFY, HOLD, DONE, FAILED };
static const char *state_names[] = {"idle", "scanning", "probing", "testing", "verifying", "settling", "done", "failed"};
static int state = IDLE;
static float target[3], ttol = 2.0f;      // ttol: how close counts as "at the target" (smaller for a short hop)
static uint64_t cache;                    // the real position's address (0: not found yet)
static uint64_t cand[MAX_CAND];
static float orig[MAX_CAND][3];           // what each candidate held before we touched it
static size_t ncand, tried;
static float p0x;                         // pos.x when a round wrote its nudges
static uint64_t wrote_frame, wrote_ns;
static char why[200];

// ---- the hold for a far jump
#define HOLD_DIST 300.0f                    // a jump this far (x and z) or more needs the hold (600 was fine without it, 800 froze)
#define HOLD_READY_UPDATES 12               // the game's own answer "ground ready" this many updates in a row ends the hold
#define HOLD_MIN_NS 1500000000ull
#define HOLD_TIMEOUT_NS 120000000000ull
static _Atomic int hold_on;                 // the game's ground question is answered "ready" (and Link is kept at the target)
static _Atomic int ready_run;               // updates in a row in which the game itself said the ground is ready
static _Atomic uint64_t hold_updates;       // updates seen while holding
static bool want_hold;                      // this teleport is a far one
static uint64_t hold_t0;
static _Atomic uint64_t hold_cell;                  // where the hold writes Link's position (the teleport's address)
static __thread int in_gate;

// Called by the game's ground question (tools/patches.py _tp_gate) on the game's thread.
int rt_tp_gate_begin(void) {
    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&hold_on, memory_order_relaxed) || in_gate) return 0;
    in_gate = 1;
    return 1;
}
static void hold_write(void) {  // keep Link at the target, and the fall (damage is the drop from the highest point) from building up
    uint64_t cell = atomic_load(&hold_cell);
    if (!cell) return;
    control_mem_poke(cell, target, sizeof target);
    double y = target[1];
    control_cell_set(&control_cell_player_fall_top, &y);
    control_cell_set(&control_cell_player_fall_top2, &y);
}
void rt_tp_gate_end(uint64_t x0) {  // x0: the game's answer, bit 0 set = the ground is still loading
    in_gate = 0;
    atomic_fetch_add(&hold_updates, 1);
    if (x0 & 1) atomic_store(&ready_run, 0); else atomic_fetch_add(&ready_run, 1);
    hold_write();
}
static void hold_stop(void) { atomic_store(&hold_on, 0); want_hold = false; atomic_store(&hold_cell, 0); }

static float *pinfo_pos(void) {
    uint64_t pinfo = g_site.player_info ? *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)g_site.player_info : 0;
    return pinfo ? (float *)(uintptr_t)(pinfo + 0x88) : NULL;
}
// Where the real position lives: the player.pos cell (control_cells.c), a pointer chain from PlayerInfo found with mem
// path and checked against pos on every use; if no chain matches (another game version) the memory search takes over.
static uint64_t path_addr(void) { return control_cell_addr(&control_cell_player_pos); }
static bool near_pos(const float *a, const float *b, float tol) {
    return fabsf(a[0] - b[0]) <= tol && fabsf(a[2] - b[2]) <= tol;  // (not y: Link falls after a teleport)
}
// goto asks for the camera to be turned once Link has arrived (the game may re-aim it during the warp)
bool control_look_start(bool use_yaw, double yaw, bool use_pitch, double pitch, int settle);  // runtime/control_input.c
static struct { bool have, use_yaw, use_pitch; double yaw, pitch; } then_look;
void control_tp_then_look(bool use_yaw, double yaw, bool use_pitch, double pitch) {
    then_look.have = true; then_look.use_yaw = use_yaw; then_look.yaw = yaw; then_look.use_pitch = use_pitch; then_look.pitch = pitch;
}
// After an arrival Link drops the last bit onto the ground; a target that is higher than the ground (a place's data is only
// as good as its height) must not hurt him, so for a few seconds the fall height follows him down instead of staying at the top.
#define LAND_NS 4000000000ull
static uint64_t land_until;
static void land_follow(const float *pp) {
    double y = pp[1];
    control_cell_set(&control_cell_player_fall_top, &y);
    control_cell_set(&control_cell_player_fall_top2, &y);
}
static void finish(int st, const char *msg) {
    if (st == DONE) land_until = plat_now_ns() + LAND_NS;
    if (st == FAILED || st == DONE) hold_stop();
    state = st;
    snprintf(why, sizeof why, "%s", msg);
    if (st == DONE && then_look.have) control_look_start(then_look.use_yaw, then_look.yaw, then_look.use_pitch, then_look.pitch, 30);
    if (st == DONE || st == FAILED) then_look.have = false;
}
static bool waited(uint64_t frame) { return frame >= wrote_frame + WAIT_FRAMES && plat_now_ns() - wrote_ns >= WAIT_NS; }
static void stamp(uint64_t frame) { wrote_frame = frame; wrote_ns = plat_now_ns(); }

static void restore_round(void) {  // undo this round's nudges (each member that still holds what we wrote)
    size_t sz = (ncand + GROUPS - 1) / GROUPS;
    for (size_t i = sz; i < ncand; i++) {
        float v[3], n = (float)(i / sz) * NUDGE;
        if (control_mem_peek(cand[i], v, sizeof v) && fabsf(v[0] - (orig[i][0] + n)) < NUDGE / 2) control_mem_poke(cand[i], orig[i], sizeof orig[i]);
    }
}

// One round: group 0 is the control, group g gets x + g * NUDGE.
static void start_round(uint64_t frame, bool first) {
    const float *pp = pinfo_pos();
    if (!pp) { finish(FAILED, "World unloaded"); return; }
    if (ncand == 0) { finish(FAILED, "Position not found"); return; }
    if (ncand == 1) {  // the last one: write the target and see
        if (!control_mem_peek(cand[0], orig[0], sizeof orig[0]) || !control_mem_poke(cand[0], target, sizeof target)) { finish(FAILED, "Position not writable"); return; }
        stamp(frame); state = TEST; tried++;
        return;
    }
    size_t sz = (ncand + GROUPS - 1) / GROUPS;
    if (first) p0x = pp[0];  // (later rounds keep it: the game's copy has not yet shown the undone nudge, so reading it now would be off)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ncand; i++) {
        float v[3];
        if (!control_mem_peek(cand[i], v, sizeof v)) { memset(orig[i], 0, sizeof orig[i]); continue; }
        memcpy(orig[i], v, sizeof v);
        if (i >= sz) { float n3[3] = {v[0] + (float)(i / sz) * NUDGE, v[1], v[2]}; control_mem_poke(cand[i], n3, sizeof n3); }
    }
    tried++; stamp(frame); state = PROBE;
}

void control_tp_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    const float *pp = pinfo_pos();
    if (land_until) {
        if (pp && plat_now_ns() < land_until && state != HOLD) land_follow(pp);
        else if (state != HOLD) land_until = 0;
    }
    if (state == SCAN) {
        size_t n = 0;
        int st = control_mem_find_vec3_poll(cand, MAX_CAND, &n);
        if (st == 1) return;
        if (st == 0) { finish(FAILED, "Position search failed to start"); return; }
        if (!pp) { finish(FAILED, "World unloaded"); return; }
        size_t keep = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((uintptr_t)cand[i] != (uintptr_t)pp) cand[keep++] = cand[i];  // (the game's own copy)
        ncand = keep;
        start_round(frame, true);
        return;
    }
    if (state == HOLD) {
        if (!pp) { finish(FAILED, "World unloaded"); return; }
        hold_write();
        uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
        if (atomic_load(&ready_run) >= HOLD_READY_UPDATES && now - hold_t0 >= HOLD_MIN_NS) { finish(DONE, "Arrived"); return; }
        if (now - hold_t0 >= HOLD_TIMEOUT_NS) {
            char m[200];
            snprintf(m, sizeof m, "The ground around the target did not load in %d s (%llu updates, ground ready %d in a row)", (int)(HOLD_TIMEOUT_NS / 1000000000ull), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&hold_updates), atomic_load(&ready_run));
            finish(FAILED, m);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (state != PROBE && state != TEST && state != VERIFY) return;
    if (!waited(frame)) return;
    if (!pp) { finish(FAILED, "World unloaded"); return; }
    if (state == PROBE) {
        float d = pp[0] - p0x;
        long g = lroundf(d / NUDGE);
        bool clean = fabsf(d - (float)g * NUDGE) < NUDGE / 2.5f;
        size_t sz = (ncand + GROUPS - 1) / GROUPS;
        restore_round();
        if (!clean || g < 0 || g >= GROUPS || (size_t)g * sz >= ncand) {
            char m[200]; snprintf(m, sizeof m, "his position changed while searching (stand still, no stick, not riding) and the search was unclear (moved %.4f with %zu candidates); try again", d, ncand);
            finish(FAILED, m); return;
        }
        size_t from = (size_t)g * sz, to = from + sz < ncand ? from + sz : ncand;
        memmove(cand, cand + from, (to - from) * sizeof *cand);
        ncand = to - from;
        start_round(frame, false);
        return;
    }
    if (near_pos(pp, target, ttol)) {
        if (state == TEST) cache = cand[0];
        if (want_hold) { atomic_store(&hold_cell, cache); hold_t0 = plat_now_ns(); state = HOLD; why[0] = 0; return; }
        finish(DONE, "Arrived");
        return;
    }
    // the address is not the real position (TEST), or went stale (VERIFY): put it back
    float v[3];
    uint64_t a = state == TEST ? cand[0] : cache;
    if (control_mem_peek(a, v, sizeof v) && !memcmp(v, target, sizeof v)) control_mem_poke(a, orig[0], sizeof orig[0]);
    if (state == TEST) { finish(FAILED, "Position verification failed"); return; }
    cache = 0;
    if (!control_mem_find_vec3_start(pp, 0.001f)) { finish(FAILED, "Position search failed to start"); return; }
    state = SCAN; why[0] = 0;
}

static bool number(const char *s, float *v) {
    char *end;
    double d = strtod(s, &end);
    if (end == s || *end || !isfinite(d) || fabs(d) > 1e7) return false;
    *v = (float)d;
    return true;
}

static void status_fields(ControlReply *r) {
    control_field_str(r, "state", state_names[state]);
    if (why[0]) control_field_str(r, "message", why);
    if (cache) { char s[32]; snprintf(s, sizeof s, "0x%llx", (unsigned long long)cache); control_field_str(r, "address", s); }
    if (state == PROBE || state == TEST) { control_field_int(r, "candidates", (int64_t)ncand); control_field_int(r, "rounds", (int64_t)tried); }
    if (state == HOLD) { control_field_int(r, "updates", (int64_t)atomic_load(&hold_updates)); control_field_int(r, "ground_ready_run", atomic_load(&ready_run)); }
    const float *pp = pinfo_pos();
    if (pp) { control_field_num(r, "x", pp[0]); control_field_num(r, "y", pp[1]); control_field_num(r, "z", pp[2]); }
}

// teleport <x> <y> <z> | teleport status | teleport forget
static void cmd_teleport(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    uint64_t frame = renderer_present_count();
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "status")) { status_fields(r); return; }
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "forget")) { cache = 0; hold_stop(); state = IDLE; why[0] = 0; control_field_str(r, "state", "idle"); return; }
    float t[3];
    if (argc != 4 || !number(argv[1], &t[0]) || !number(argv[2], &t[1]) || !number(argv[3], &t[2])) {
        control_fail(r, "Usage: teleport <x> <y> <z> | status | forget");
        return;
    }
    const float *pp = pinfo_pos();
    if (!pp) { control_fail(r, "No world loaded"); return; }
    if (state == SCAN || state == PROBE || state == TEST || state == VERIFY) { control_fail(r, "Teleport in progress"); return; }
    memcpy(target, t, sizeof target);
    then_look.have = false;   // (a plain teleport turns nothing; goto sets this after it starts one)
    {
        float d = hypotf(t[0] - pp[0], t[2] - pp[2]);
        if (d < 0.05f) { control_fail(r, "Distance below 0.05"); return; }
        ttol = fmaxf(0.01f, fminf(2.0f, 0.25f * d));  // (a copy that did not move is d away; the real one is at the target)
    }
    why[0] = 0; tried = 0;
    {
        float d = hypotf(t[0] - pp[0], t[2] - pp[2]);
        want_hold = d >= HOLD_DIST || fabsf(t[1] - pp[1]) >= 4.0f * HOLD_DIST;
        if (want_hold) { atomic_store(&ready_run, 0); atomic_store(&hold_updates, 0); atomic_store(&hold_on, 1); }  // (before the write: the next update must not see the far position first)
    }
    float at[3];
    uint64_t pa = path_addr();
    if (pa) cache = pa;  // (the direct route: no search)
    if (cache && control_mem_peek(cache, at, sizeof at) && near_pos(at, pp, 1.0f)) {
        memcpy(orig[0], at, sizeof at);
        if (control_mem_poke(cache, target, sizeof target)) {
            if (want_hold) atomic_store(&hold_cell, cache);
            stamp(frame); state = VERIFY; status_fields(r); return;
        }
    }
    cache = 0;
    if (!control_mem_find_vec3_start(pp, 0.001f)) { hold_stop(); control_fail(r, "Position search busy"); return; }
    state = SCAN;
    status_fields(r);
}

// The same command for another command (goto) to run.
void control_tp_run(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) { cmd_teleport(argc, argv, r); }

void control_tp_init(void) {
    static const ControlCmd cmds[] = {
        {"teleport", "<x> <y> <z> | status | forget",
         "Move to a position; status shows progress", cmd_teleport},
    };
    control_register(cmds, (int)(sizeof cmds / sizeof *cmds));
}
```

`runtime/cpu.h`:

```h
// Guest CPU state and helpers used by recompiled code.
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct __attribute__((aligned(16))) Cpu {
    uint64_t x[32];          // x0-x30 (x[31] unused; sp is separate)
    uint64_t sp;             // 256
    uint64_t pc;             // 264: target for indirect dispatch
    uint64_t nzcv;           // 272: flags in bits 31..28
    uint64_t tpidr;          // 280
    uint64_t tpidrro;        // 288
    uint64_t excl_addr;      // 296
    uint64_t excl_val;       // 304
    void *thread;            // 312: runtime thread object
    uint64_t fpcr;           // 320: guest FPCR/FPSR (portable FP/SIMD lowering only; the asm path uses the host's)
    uint64_t fpsr;           // 328
    uint8_t _pad[512 - 336];
    __uint128_t v[32];       // 512
} Cpu;

_Static_assert(offsetof(Cpu, sp) == 256, "sp");
_Static_assert(offsetof(Cpu, pc) == 264, "pc");
_Static_assert(offsetof(Cpu, nzcv) == 272, "nzcv");
_Static_assert(offsetof(Cpu, fpcr) == 320, "fpcr");
_Static_assert(offsetof(Cpu, fpsr) == 328, "fpsr");
_Static_assert(offsetof(Cpu, v) == 512, "v");

typedef void (*GuestFn)(Cpu *);

// ---- runtime services (runtime/*.c)
void rt_dispatch(Cpu *c);                 // call function at c->pc
void rt_svc(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc);
void rt_brk(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) __attribute__((noreturn));
void rt_udf(Cpu *c, uint64_t pc) __attribute__((noreturn));
uint64_t rt_ticks(void);

#if defined(__aarch64__)
static inline uint64_t rt_get_fpcr(void) { uint64_t v; __asm__ volatile("mrs %0, fpcr" : "=r"(v)); return v; }
static inline uint64_t rt_get_fpsr(void) { uint64_t v; __asm__ volatile("mrs %0, fpsr" : "=r"(v)); return v; }
static inline void rt_set_fpcr(uint64_t v) { __asm__ volatile("msr fpcr, %0" :: "r"(v)); }
static inline void rt_set_fpsr(uint64_t v) { __asm__ volatile("msr fpsr, %0" :: "r"(v)); }
#else
// Host FP state is not the guest's here: code lifted with --simd=c keeps FPCR/FPSR in Cpu (c->fpcr, zeroed
// with the Cpu), so the host-side reset in thread start-up has nothing to do.
static inline uint64_t rt_get_fpcr(void) { return 0; }
static inline uint64_t rt_get_fpsr(void) { return 0; }
static inline void rt_set_fpcr(uint64_t v) { (void)v; }
static inline void rt_set_fpsr(uint64_t v) { (void)v; }
#endif

// ---- memory: guest addresses are host addresses
typedef uint16_t __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) u16u;
typedef uint32_t __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) u32u;
typedef uint64_t __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) u64u;
typedef uint8_t __attribute__((may_alias)) u8a;

// Function-entry profiler (runtime/fnprof.c, SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF): one predictable branch per call when off.
extern volatile int g_fnprof;
void fnprof_hit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0);
#define FN_ENTER(a) do { if (__builtin_expect(g_fnprof, 0)) fnprof_hit(a, c->x[30], c->x[0]); } while (0)

#define LD8(a)  (*(const u8a *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define LD16(a) (*(const u16u *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define LD32(a) (*(const u32u *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define LD64(a) (*(const u64u *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define ST8(a, v)  (*(u8a *)(uintptr_t)(a) = (uint8_t)(v))
#define ST16(a, v) (*(u16u *)(uintptr_t)(a) = (uint16_t)(v))
#define ST32(a, v) (*(u32u *)(uintptr_t)(a) = (uint32_t)(v))
#define ST64(a, v) (*(u64u *)(uintptr_t)(a) = (uint64_t)(v))

// ---- exclusive monitor (emulated with compare-and-swap)
#define EXCL(N, T)                                                                         \
    static inline uint64_t ldx##N(Cpu *c, uint64_t a) {                                    \
        T v = __atomic_load_n((T *)(uintptr_t)a, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);                        \
        c->excl_addr = a;                                                                  \
        c->excl_val = v;                                                                   \
        return v;                                                                          \
    }                                                                                      \
    static inline uint32_t stx##N(Cpu *c, uint64_t a, uint64_t v) {                        \
        if (c->excl_addr != a) return 1;                                                   \
        c->excl_addr = ~0ull;                                                              \
        T expected = (T)c->excl_val;                                                       \
        return !__atomic_compare_exchange_n((T *)(uintptr_t)a, &expected, (T)v, 0,         \
                                            __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);           \
    }                                                                                      \
    static inline uint64_t lda##N(uint64_t a) {                                            \
        return __atomic_load_n((T *)(uintptr_t)a, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);                       \
    }                                                                                      \
    static inline void stl##N(uint64_t a, uint64_t v) {                                    \
        __atomic_store_n((T *)(uintptr_t)a, (T)v, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);                       \
    }
EXCL(8, uint8_t)
EXCL(16, uint16_t)
EXCL(32, uint32_t)
EXCL(64, uint64_t)

// ---- flags (packed NZCV in bits 31..28)
#define FLAG_N(c) (((c)->nzcv >> 31) & 1)
#define FLAG_Z(c) (((c)->nzcv >> 30) & 1)
#define FLAG_C(c) (((c)->nzcv >> 29) & 1)
#define FLAG_V(c) (((c)->nzcv >> 28) & 1)
#define COND_EQ(c) (FLAG_Z(c))
#define COND_NE(c) (!FLAG_Z(c))
#define COND_CS(c) (FLAG_C(c))
#define COND_CC(c) (!FLAG_C(c))
#define COND_MI(c) (FLAG_N(c))
#define COND_PL(c) (!FLAG_N(c))
#define COND_VS(c) (FLAG_V(c))
#define COND_VC(c) (!FLAG_V(c))
#define COND_HI(c) (FLAG_C(c) && !FLAG_Z(c))
#define COND_LS(c) (!(FLAG_C(c) && !FLAG_Z(c)))
#define COND_GE(c) (FLAG_N(c) == FLAG_V(c))
#define COND_LT(c) (FLAG_N(c) != FLAG_V(c))
#define COND_GT(c) (!FLAG_Z(c) && FLAG_N(c) == FLAG_V(c))
#define COND_LE(c) (!(!FLAG_Z(c) && FLAG_N(c) == FLAG_V(c)))

#define MKFLAGS(n, z, cy, v) \
    (((uint64_t)(n) << 31) | ((uint64_t)(z) << 30) | ((uint64_t)(cy) << 29) | ((uint64_t)(v) << 28))

static inline uint64_t adds64(Cpu *c, uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    uint64_t r = a + b;
    c->nzcv = MKFLAGS(r >> 63, r == 0, r < a, ((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> 63);
    return r;
}
static inline uint64_t subs64(Cpu *c, uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    uint64_t r = a - b;
    c->nzcv = MKFLAGS(r >> 63, r == 0, a >= b, ((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) >> 63);
    return r;
}
static inline uint32_t adds32(Cpu *c, uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
    uint32_t r = a + b;
    c->nzcv = MKFLAGS(r >> 31, r == 0, r < a, ((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> 31);
    return r;
}
static inline uint32_t subs32(Cpu *c, uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
    uint32_t r = a - b;
    c->nzcv = MKFLAGS(r >> 31, r == 0, a >= b, ((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) >> 31);
    return r;
}
static inline uint64_t logic64(Cpu *c, uint64_t r) { c->nzcv = MKFLAGS(r >> 63, r == 0, 0, 0); return r; }
static inline uint32_t logic32(Cpu *c, uint32_t r) { c->nzcv = MKFLAGS(r >> 31, r == 0, 0, 0); return r; }

#define ADC_IMPL(N, S)                                                                     \
    static inline uint##N##_t adc##N(Cpu *c, uint##N##_t a, uint##N##_t b) {               \
        return a + b + (uint##N##_t)FLAG_C(c);                                             \
    }                                                                                      \
    static inline uint##N##_t sbc##N(Cpu *c, uint##N##_t a, uint##N##_t b) {               \
        return a - b - 1 + (uint##N##_t)FLAG_C(c);                                         \
    }                                                                                      \
    static inline uint##N##_t adcs##N(Cpu *c, uint##N##_t a, uint##N##_t b) {              \
        uint##N##_t cin = FLAG_C(c), r = a + b + cin;                                      \
        int carry = cin ? r <= a : r < a;                                                  \
        c->nzcv = MKFLAGS(r >> (N - 1), r == 0, carry, ((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> (N - 1));    \
        return r;                                                                          \
    }                                                                                      \
    static inline uint##N##_t sbcs##N(Cpu *c, uint##N##_t a, uint##N##_t b) {              \
        return adcs##N(c, a, (uint##N##_t)~b);                                             \
    }
ADC_IMPL(64, )
ADC_IMPL(32, )

// ---- function-local flags (tools/flags.py, gen.py --locals)
// From TotK Recomp's runtime/cpu.h (https://github.com/valentderah/totk-pc-recomp, commit f469c5a), Copyright (c) 2026
// Valiantsin Dzerakh, MIT License: third_party/totk-pc-recomp/LICENSE.
// Functions generated with --locals keep NZCV in a local Flags F, and write c->nzcv only where they leave by a tail
// exit or before a patch site. A definition of a known kind stores its operands (a - b, a + b, or a logic result in
// a); fc_<kind>(&F, CC_xx) computes a condition from them, so a compare and its branch become one host compare. F.nz
// holds the packed form for definitions only known packed (CCMP, FCMP, MSR, ADCS), for a call's flags and for
// readers that several kinds of definition reach. Every helper is always inlined with a constant condition, so F
// stays in registers and only the condition's own arithmetic remains.
typedef struct { uint64_t a, b, nz; } Flags;
enum { CC_EQ, CC_NE, CC_CS, CC_CC, CC_MI, CC_PL, CC_VS, CC_VC, CC_HI, CC_LS, CC_GE, CC_LT, CC_GT, CC_LE };
#define CPU_FL static inline __attribute__((always_inline))

CPU_FL int fl_cond(int cc, int n, int z, int cy, int v) {
    switch (cc) {
    case CC_EQ: return z;
    case CC_NE: return !z;
    case CC_CS: return cy;
    case CC_CC: return !cy;
    case CC_MI: return n;
    case CC_PL: return !n;
    case CC_VS: return v;
    case CC_VC: return !v;
    case CC_HI: return cy && !z;
    case CC_LS: return !cy || z;
    case CC_GE: return n == v;
    case CC_LT: return n != v;
    case CC_GT: return !z && n == v;
    default: return z || n != v;
    }
}

// Subtract (SUBS, CMP): conditions as host compares of the operands.
#define FL_SUB(N, U, S)                                                                    \
    CPU_FL U fsub##N(Flags *f, U a, U b) { f->a = a; f->b = b; return (U)(a - b); }            \
    CPU_FL int fc_sub##N(const Flags *f, int cc) {                                             \
        U a = (U)f->a, b = (U)f->b, r = (U)(a - b);                                        \
        switch (cc) {                                                                      \
        case CC_EQ: return a == b;                                                         \
        case CC_NE: return a != b;                                                         \
        case CC_CS: return a >= b;                                                         \
        case CC_CC: return a < b;                                                          \
        case CC_MI: return (S)r < 0;                                                       \
        case CC_PL: return (S)r >= 0;                                                      \
        case CC_VS: return (S)((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) < 0;                                     \
        case CC_VC: return (S)((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) >= 0;                                    \
        case CC_HI: return a > b;                                                          \
        case CC_LS: return a <= b;                                                         \
        case CC_GE: return (S)a >= (S)b;                                                   \
        case CC_LT: return (S)a < (S)b;                                                    \
        case CC_GT: return (S)a > (S)b;                                                    \
        default: return (S)a <= (S)b;                                                      \
        }                                                                                  \
    }                                                                                      \
    CPU_FL uint64_t nz_sub##N(U a, U b) {                                                      \
        U r = (U)(a - b);                                                                  \
        return MKFLAGS((S)r < 0, r == 0, a >= b, (S)((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) < 0);              \
    }                                                                                      \
    CPU_FL uint64_t fnz_sub##N(const Flags *f) { return nz_sub##N((U)f->a, (U)f->b); }
FL_SUB(64, uint64_t, int64_t)
FL_SUB(32, uint32_t, int32_t)

// Add (ADDS, CMN) and logic results (ANDS, TST, BICS): conditions from N, Z, C, V.
#define FL_ADD(N, U, S)                                                                    \
    CPU_FL U fadd##N(Flags *f, U a, U b) { f->a = a; f->b = b; return (U)(a + b); }            \
    CPU_FL uint64_t nz_add##N(U a, U b) {                                                      \
        U r = (U)(a + b);                                                                  \
        return MKFLAGS((S)r < 0, r == 0, r < a, (S)((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) < 0);               \
    }                                                                                      \
    CPU_FL int fc_add##N(const Flags *f, int cc) {                                             \
        U a = (U)f->a, b = (U)f->b, r = (U)(a + b);                                        \
        return fl_cond(cc, (S)r < 0, r == 0, r < a, (S)((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) < 0);           \
    }                                                                                      \
    CPU_FL uint64_t fnz_add##N(const Flags *f) { return nz_add##N((U)f->a, (U)f->b); }         \
    CPU_FL U flogic##N(Flags *f, U r) { f->a = r; return r; }                                  \
    CPU_FL int fc_logic##N(const Flags *f, int cc) {                                           \
        U r = (U)f->a;                                                                     \
        return fl_cond(cc, (S)r < 0, r == 0, 0, 0);                                        \
    }                                                                                      \
    CPU_FL uint64_t fnz_logic##N(const Flags *f) { return MKFLAGS((S)f->a < 0, (U)f->a == 0, 0, 0); }
FL_ADD(64, uint64_t, int64_t)
FL_ADD(32, uint32_t, int32_t)

// Packed flags.
CPU_FL int fc_nz(const Flags *f, int cc) {
    return fl_cond(cc, f->nz >> 31 & 1, f->nz >> 30 & 1, f->nz >> 29 & 1, f->nz >> 28 & 1);
}
CPU_FL uint64_t fnz_nz(const Flags *f) { return f->nz; }

// ADC, SBC, ADCS, SBCS with the carry in from F.
#define FL_ADC(N, U)                                                                       \
    CPU_FL U adc##N##f(int cin, U a, U b) { return (U)(a + b + (U)cin); }                      \
    CPU_FL U sbc##N##f(int cin, U a, U b) { return (U)(a - b - 1 + (U)cin); }                  \
    CPU_FL U adcs##N##f(Flags *f, int cin, U a, U b) {                                         \
        U r = (U)(a + b + (U)cin);                                                         \
        int carry = cin ? r <= a : r < a;                                                  \
        f->nz = MKFLAGS(r >> (N - 1), r == 0, carry, ((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> (N - 1));      \
        return r;                                                                          \
    }                                                                                      \
    CPU_FL U sbcs##N##f(Flags *f, int cin, U a, U b) { return adcs##N##f(f, cin, a, (U)~b); }
FL_ADC(64, uint64_t)
FL_ADC(32, uint32_t)
#undef CPU_FL

// ---- bit ops
#define ROR64(v, r) ((uint64_t)(v) >> ((r) & 63) | (uint64_t)(v) << ((64 - ((r) & 63)) & 63))
#define ROR32(v, r) ((uint32_t)(v) >> ((r) & 31) | (uint32_t)(v) << ((32 - ((r) & 31)) & 31))
static inline uint64_t clz64(uint64_t v) { return v ? __builtin_clzll(v) : 64; }
static inline uint32_t clz32(uint32_t v) { return v ? __builtin_clz(v) : 32; }
static inline uint64_t cls64(uint64_t v) { return clz64(v ^ (uint64_t)((int64_t)v >> 1)) - 1; }
static inline uint32_t cls32(uint32_t v) { return clz32(v ^ (uint32_t)((int32_t)v >> 1)) - 1; }
static inline uint64_t rbit64(uint64_t v) { return __builtin_bitreverse64(v); }
static inline uint32_t rbit32(uint32_t v) { return __builtin_bitreverse32(v); }
static inline uint32_t rev16_32(uint32_t v) { return ((v & 0x00ff00ffu) << 8) | ((v >> 8) & 0x00ff00ffu); }
static inline uint64_t rev16_64(uint64_t v) {
    return ((v & 0x00ff00ff00ff00ffull) << 8) | ((v >> 8) & 0x00ff00ff00ff00ffull);
}
static inline uint64_t rev32_64(uint64_t v) {
    return ((uint64_t)__builtin_bswap32((uint32_t)v)) | ((uint64_t)__builtin_bswap32((uint32_t)(v >> 32)) << 32);
}
static inline uint64_t udiv64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return b ? a / b : 0; }
static inline uint32_t udiv32(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) { return b ? a / b : 0; }
static inline uint64_t sdiv64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    if (!b) return 0;
    if ((int64_t)a == INT64_MIN && (int64_t)b == -1) return a;
    return (uint64_t)((int64_t)a / (int64_t)b);
}
static inline uint32_t sdiv32(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
    if (!b) return 0;
    if ((int32_t)a == INT32_MIN && (int32_t)b == -1) return a;
    return (uint32_t)((int32_t)a / (int32_t)b);
}

// Portable FP/SIMD helpers for code lifted with --simd=c (default off AArch64; gen.py includes simd.h itself
// in that mode, so AArch64 hosts can build it too).
#if !defined(__cplusplus) && !defined(__aarch64__)
#include "simd.h"
#endif

// Scalar single FSUB for a patch (tools/patches.py _surf_boost_remove), whichever way the SIMD was lifted: through
// the FP helpers of simd.h on x86-64, natively on AArch64 (there the host's FSUB is the guest's, and simd.h is only
// included by --simd c, so fp_op_s does not exist in the default asm mode, #413).
static inline void rt_fsub_s(Cpu *c, int d, int n, int m) {
#if !defined(__cplusplus) && !defined(__aarch64__)
    fp_op_s(c, FOP_SUB, d, n, m);
#else
    uint32_t au = (uint32_t)c->v[n], bu = (uint32_t)c->v[m], ru;
    float a, b, r;
    __builtin_memcpy(&a, &au, 4);
    __builtin_memcpy(&b, &bu, 4);
    r = a - b;
    __builtin_memcpy(&ru, &r, 4);
    c->v[d] = ru;
#endif
}

// Scalar single float from a vector register for a patch (tools/patches.py _grass_blade_lateral), whichever
// way the SIMD was lifted.
static inline float rt_vf32(const Cpu *c, int n) {
    uint32_t u = (uint32_t)c->v[n];
    float f;
    __builtin_memcpy(&f, &u, 4);
    return f;
}

// Scalar single FCMP for a patch (tools/patches.py _grass_blade_lateral), returning NZCV flags in bits 31..28,
// whichever way the SIMD was lifted: through the FP helpers of simd.h on x86-64, natively on AArch64 (where
// simd.h is only included by --simd c, so cmp_s does not exist in the default asm mode, #612).
static inline uint64_t rt_fcmp_s(Cpu *c, float a, float b) {
#if !defined(__cplusplus) && !defined(__aarch64__)
    return cmp_s(c, a, b);
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
    uint64_t nzcv;
    __asm__("fcmp %s1, %s2\n\tmrs %0, nzcv" : "=r"(nzcv) : "w"(a), "w"(b));
    return nzcv;
#else
    return a == b ? 0x60000000ull : a < b ? 0x80000000ull : a > b ? 0x20000000ull : 0x30000000ull;
#endif
}

```

`runtime/deck_imu.c`:

```c
// In Gaming mode Steam Input takes the Deck's controller and hands the game a virtual gamepad without motion sensors
// (#136), so SDL sees no gyroscope. The controller (28de:1205, interface 2) still sends its state report to every reader
// of its hidraw node, 250 times a second, motion included; Steam keeps reading it too. Report layout and scale cross-
// checked with SDL's HIDAPI Steam Deck driver (zlib) and kmicki/SteamDeckGyroDSU (MIT); an independent implementation.
#include "deck_imu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef __linux__
#include <dirent.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

static int16_t le16s(const uint8_t *p) { return (int16_t)(p[0] | (uint16_t)p[1] << 8); }
static uint32_t le32(const uint8_t *p) { return p[0] | (uint32_t)p[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[3] << 24; }

bool deck_imu_decode(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, DsuPacket *out, uint32_t *num) {
    // Header: report 1, type 9 (the Deck's state), 64 bytes. Then the packet number, buttons and pads; the accelerometer
    // at 24 and the gyroscope at 30 (x, y, z, signed 16-bit: 2 G and 2000 degrees per second at full scale).
    if (n < 36 || p[0] != 1 || p[2] != 9 || p[3] != 64) return false;
    double a[3], w[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) a[i] = le16s(p + 24 + 2 * i) / 16384.0, w[i] = le16s(p + 30 + 2 * i);
    if (a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1] + a[2] * a[2] < 0.01) return false;  // (no motion in the report)
    // SDL's axes are (x, z, -y), then motion_sensor_event's SDL -> Switch mapping: gravity (-x, -y, -z), turn (x, y, z).
    // Flat on a table the Deck reads +1 G on z: (0, 0, -1), as at rest elsewhere.
    const double rad = 2000.0 / 32768 * 3.14159265358979323846 / 180;
    DsuPacket v = {.type = 0x100002, .connected = true};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) v.acc[i] = -a[i], v.gyro[i] = w[i] * rad;
    *out = v;
    *num = le32(p + 4);
    return true;
}

void deck_imu_init(DeckImu *d) {
    memset(d, 0, sizeof *d);
    d->fd = -1;
}

void deck_imu_close(DeckImu *d) {
#ifdef __linux__
    if (d->fd >= 0) close(d->fd);
#endif
    d->fd = -1;
    d->fresh = d->have_num = false;
}

#ifdef __linux__
// The hidraw node of the controller's interface 2 (the one with the state reports), or -1. Also a virtual Deck
// controller (InputPlumber's deck-uhid target on other handhelds - Legion Go, ROG Ally - under Steam Input, #136:
// 28de:12fe or 28de:1205 made through uhid, so no USB interface): the same state reports (deck_imu_decode checks them).
static int open_deck(char *name, size_t size) {
    DIR *dir = opendir("/sys/class/hidraw");
    if (!dir) return -1;
    int fd = -1;
    for (struct dirent *e; fd < 0 && (e = readdir(dir));) {
        if (strncmp(e->d_name, "hidraw", 6)) continue;
        char path[512], link[PATH_MAX], line[256];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/sys/class/hidraw/%s/device/uevent", e->d_name);
        FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
        if (!f) continue;
        bool deck = false;
        while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f))
            deck |= !strncmp(line, "HID_ID=0003:000028DE:00001205", 29) || !strncmp(line, "HID_ID=0003:000028DE:000012FE", 29) ||
                    !strncmp(line, "HID_ID=0006:000028DE:00001205", 29) || !strncmp(line, "HID_ID=0006:000028DE:000012FE", 29);
        fclose(f);
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/sys/class/hidraw/%s/device", e->d_name);
        if (!deck || !realpath(path, link)) continue;  // (the link itself is relative: "../../../0003:28DE:1205.0005")
        char *dev = strrchr(link, '/');  // ".../3-3:1.2/0003:28DE:1205.0005": the interface before it
        bool uhid = strstr(link, "/uhid/") != NULL;  // (".../virtual/misc/uhid/0003:28DE:12FE.0007")
        if (!uhid && (!dev || dev - link < 4 || memcmp(dev - 4, ":1.2", 4))) continue;
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/dev/%s", e->d_name);
        fd = open(path, O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK | O_CLOEXEC);
        if (fd >= 0) snprintf(name, size, "%s", path);
        else fprintf(stderr, "[motion] Steam Deck: cannot open %s: %s\n", path, strerror(errno));
    }
    closedir(dir);
    return fd;
}
#endif

void deck_imu_poll(DeckImu *d, uint64_t now, DsuSampleFn sample, void *user) {
#ifdef __linux__
    if (d->fd < 0) {
        if (d->retry && now < d->retry) return;
        d->retry = now + 2 * DSU_RETRY_NS;
        char name[64];
        d->fd = open_deck(name, sizeof name);
        if (d->fd < 0) {
            if (!d->failed) fprintf(stderr, "[motion] Steam Deck: no controller HID node to read its gyroscope from\n");
            d->failed = true;
            return;
        }
        d->failed = false;
        fprintf(stderr, "[motion] Steam Deck: gyroscope and accelerometer read from %s (Steam Input's gamepad has none)\n",
                name);
    }
    if (d->fresh && now - d->received >= DSU_TIMEOUT_NS) d->fresh = d->have_num = false;
    // Bounded work: a frame's worth of reports and some (8 a frame at 30 fps).
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        uint8_t p[64];
        ssize_t n = read(d->fd, p, sizeof p);
        if (n < 0) {
            if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK && errno != EINTR) {
                fprintf(stderr, "[motion] Steam Deck: reading the controller failed (%s); trying again\n", strerror(errno));
                deck_imu_close(d);
            }
            break;
        }
        DsuPacket v;
        uint32_t num;
        if (!deck_imu_decode(p, n, &v, &num)) continue;
        if (d->have_num && num == d->num) continue;
        d->num = num, d->have_num = true;
        d->received = now, d->fresh = true;
        // The packet numbers count 4 ms steps: the sensor's own clock, steady however late the frame reads them (a
        // step back, after 198 days of packets, is a gap the fusion skips).
        v.timestamp = (uint64_t)num * (DECK_IMU_PERIOD_NS / 1000);
        if (sample) sample(&v, 0, user);
    }
#else
    (void)d; (void)now; (void)sample; (void)user;
#endif
}

```

`runtime/deck_imu.h`:

```h
// The Steam Deck's own motion sensors, read from its controller's HID node (Linux). No SDL, threads or blocking I/O.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "dsu.h"

#define DECK_IMU_PERIOD_NS 4000000ull  // one state report every 4 ms (250 Hz)

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    bool fresh, have_num, failed;
    uint32_t num;       // the last report's packet number
    uint64_t received;  // host time of the last report
    uint64_t retry;     // next time to look for the device
} DeckImu;

// One 64-byte state report -> fusion axes (as DsuPacket: gravity in G, rad/s), its packet number in *num.
bool deck_imu_decode(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, DsuPacket *out, uint32_t *num);
void deck_imu_init(DeckImu *d);
void deck_imu_close(DeckImu *d);
// Reads the queued reports and hands each to sample (timestamp: microseconds from the packet numbers).
void deck_imu_poll(DeckImu *d, uint64_t now, DsuSampleFn sample, void *user);
```

`runtime/discord_rpc.c`:

```c
// Discord Rich Presence (discord_rpc.h). The pipe speaks frames: op and length (little endian u32 each), then JSON.
// op 0 is the handshake, op 1 a command, op 2 Discord closing the connection.
#include "discord_rpc.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

bool discord_app_id_valid(const char *id) {
    if (!*id) return false;
    for (; *id; id++)
        if (*id < '0' || *id > '9') return false;
    return true;
}

// s as the inside of a JSON string; the next free byte of out, NULL when it doesn't fit
static char *json_text(char *out, const char *end, const char *s) {
    for (; *s; s++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)*s;
        if (end - out < 3) return NULL;
        if (c == '"' || c == '\\') *out++ = '\\';
        if (c >= 0x20) *out++ = (char)c;
    }
    *out = 0;
    return out;
}

int discord_activity_json(char *out, size_t size, long pid, uint64_t start, const char *details, const char *state, unsigned nonce) {
    char d[260], s[260], *e = d + sizeof d;
    if (!json_text(d, e, details) || !json_text(s, s + sizeof s, state)) return -1;
    int n;
    if (*s)
        n = snprintf(out, size, "{\"cmd\":\"SET_ACTIVITY\",\"args\":{\"pid\":%ld,\"activity\":{\"details\":\"%s\",\"state\":\"%s\","
                     "\"timestamps\":{\"start\":%llu}}},\"nonce\":\"%u\"}", pid, d, s, (unsigned long long)start, nonce);
    else
        n = snprintf(out, size, "{\"cmd\":\"SET_ACTIVITY\",\"args\":{\"pid\":%ld,\"activity\":{\"details\":\"%s\","
                     "\"timestamps\":{\"start\":%llu}}},\"nonce\":\"%u\"}", pid, d, (unsigned long long)start, nonce);
    return n < 0 || (size_t)n >= size ? -1 : n;
}

int discord_frame(uint8_t *out, size_t size, uint32_t op, const char *json) {
    size_t len = strlen(json);
    if (size < 8 + len) return -1;
    uint32_t head[2] = {op, (uint32_t)len};
    memcpy(out, head, 8);
    memcpy(out + 8, json, len);
    return (int)(8 + len);
}

#ifndef DISCORD_RPC_TEST

#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "rt.h"
#include "settings.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>

#define RETRY_MS 15000
#define REPLY_MS 5000

static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static char want_details[128], want_state[128];
static unsigned want_serial;
static bool want_on;
// The project's Discord application (a public id, not a secret). Empty keeps the feature
// off. A build can set it with -DSAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_DEFAULT_APP_ID=\"123...\"; the environment's
// SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_APP_ID overrides it.
#ifndef SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_DEFAULT_APP_ID
#define SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_DEFAULT_APP_ID "1571656894538326026"  // Savage Wind (Discord Developer Portal)
#endif
static char app_id[32];  // the id in use ("" none: the feature stays off)

static HANDLE pipe_open(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        char name[32];
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "\\\\.\\pipe\\discord-ipc-%d", i);
        HANDLE h = CreateFileA(name, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
        if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return h;
    }
    return NULL;
}

static bool pipe_send(HANDLE h, uint32_t op, const char *json) {
    uint8_t f[2048];
    int n = discord_frame(f, sizeof f, op, json);
    DWORD done;
    return n > 0 && WriteFile(h, f, (DWORD)n, &done, NULL) && done == (DWORD)n;
}

static bool pipe_read(HANDLE h, void *out, DWORD n) {
    DWORD done;
    return ReadFile(h, out, n, &done, NULL) && done == n;
}

// One frame, waiting REPLY_MS at most (the text cut to fit); false: nothing came, or the pipe broke
static bool pipe_receive(HANDLE h, uint32_t *op, char *text, size_t size) {
    for (int waited = 0; ; waited += 50) {
        DWORD ready = 0;
        if (!PeekNamedPipe(h, NULL, 0, NULL, &ready, NULL)) return false;
        if (ready >= 8) break;
        if (waited >= REPLY_MS) return false;
        Sleep(50);
    }
    uint32_t head[2];
    if (!pipe_read(h, head, 8)) return false;
    *op = head[0];
    size_t kept = 0;
    for (uint32_t left = head[1]; left;) {
        char part[512];
        DWORD n = left < sizeof part ? left : sizeof part;
        if (!pipe_read(h, part, n)) return false;
        left -= n;
        size_t take = kept + n < size ? n : size - 1 - kept;
        memcpy(text + kept, part, take);
        kept += take;
    }
    text[kept] = 0;
    return true;
}

static bool handshake(HANDLE h) {
    char json[96], reply[512] = "";
    uint32_t op = 0;
    snprintf(json, sizeof json, "{\"v\":1,\"client_id\":\"%s\"}", app_id);
    if (!pipe_send(h, 0, json) || !pipe_receive(h, &op, reply, sizeof reply)) return false;
    if (op == 2 || !strstr(reply, "\"READY\"")) {
        LOG("[discord] refused: %s\n", reply);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool send_activity(HANDLE h, uint64_t start, const char *details, const char *state) {
    static unsigned nonce;
    char json[1024], reply[512] = "";
    uint32_t op = 0;
    if (discord_activity_json(json, sizeof json, (long)GetCurrentProcessId(), start, details, state, ++nonce) < 0) return true;
    if (!pipe_send(h, 1, json) || !pipe_receive(h, &op, reply, sizeof reply)) return false;
    if (op == 2) return false;
    if (strstr(reply, "\"ERROR\"")) LOG("[discord] %s\n", reply);
    return true;
}

static void *discord_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    uint64_t start = (uint64_t)time(NULL);
    bool told_waiting = false;
    HANDLE h = NULL;
    unsigned sent = 0;
    for (;;) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
        bool on = want_on;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        if (!on) {  // the switch went off: Discord clears the status when the pipe closes
            if (h) CloseHandle(h), h = NULL, LOG("[discord] off\n");
            Sleep(500);
            continue;
        }
        if (!h) {
            h = pipe_open();
            if (!h || !handshake(h)) {
                if (h) CloseHandle(h), h = NULL;
                if (!told_waiting) LOG("[discord] not connected, trying every %d s\n", RETRY_MS / 1000);
                told_waiting = true;
                Sleep(RETRY_MS);
                continue;
            }
            LOG("[discord] connected\n");
            told_waiting = false;
            sent = 0;  // (a new connection tells Discord the text as it is)
        }
        char details[128], state[128];
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
        unsigned serial = want_serial;
        memcpy(details, want_details, sizeof details);
        memcpy(state, want_state, sizeof state);
        on = want_on;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        if (!on) continue;  // (the head of the loop closes the pipe)
        DWORD ready;
        if (!PeekNamedPipe(h, NULL, 0, NULL, &ready, NULL)) {
            CloseHandle(h), h = NULL;
            LOG("[discord] connection lost\n");
            Sleep(1000);
            continue;
        }
        if (serial != sent) {
            if (!send_activity(h, start, details, state)) {
                CloseHandle(h), h = NULL;
                LOG("[discord] connection lost\n");
                Sleep(1000);
                continue;
            }
            LOG("[discord] %s | %s\n", details, state);
            sent = serial;
        }
        Sleep(1000);
    }
    return NULL;
}

void discord_rpc_set(const char *details, const char *state) {
    static bool up;  // the thread exists and an application id is set (else nothing runs, whatever the switch says)
    if (!up) {
        const char *id = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_APP_ID");
        if (!id || !*id) id = SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_DEFAULT_APP_ID;
        snprintf(app_id, sizeof app_id, "%s", id);
        if (!app_id[0]) LOG("[discord] off: no Discord application id (built-in default or SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_APP_ID)\n");
        else if (!discord_app_id_valid(app_id)) {
            LOG("[discord] off: the application id is not valid\n");
            app_id[0] = 0;
        } else {
            pthread_t t;
            if (!pthread_create(&t, NULL, discord_thread, NULL)) pthread_detach(t);
            else app_id[0] = 0;
        }
        up = app_id[0] != 0;
    }
    // On by the switch (Options > Gameplay), unless the environment forces it either way (SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD=0|1)
    const char *env = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD");
    bool on = env && *env ? atoi(env) != 0 : g_settings.discord_rpc;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    want_on = on;
    if (on && (strcmp(want_details, details) || strcmp(want_state, state))) {
        snprintf(want_details, sizeof want_details, "%s", details);
        snprintf(want_state, sizeof want_state, "%s", state);
        want_serial++;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}

#else

void discord_rpc_set(const char *details, const char *state) { (void)details; (void)state; }

#endif
#endif
```

```h
// Discord Rich Presence, through the local pipe of the Discord app (Windows; elsewhere nothing happens). Its own thread
// does all the talking: with Discord closed the game loses nothing, and it connects whenever Discord opens.
// Off by default: the switch is Options > Gameplay (savagewind.ini discord_rpc), and SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD=0|1 forces it
// either way. The Discord application is the project's built-in public id (SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_DEFAULT_APP_ID in
// discord_rpc.c); the environment's SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_APP_ID (digits) overrides it. With neither the feature does nothing.
// SAVAGEWIND_DISCORD_LANG: en, es, USen, EUde...
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

// The two lines of the player's status (state may be empty). Never blocks; only a change goes to Discord.
void discord_rpc_set(const char *details, const char *state);

// (the messages, on their own for tests/test_discord_rpc.c)
bool discord_app_id_valid(const char *id);
int discord_activity_json(char *out, size_t size, long pid, uint64_t start, const char *details, const char *state, unsigned nonce);
int discord_frame(uint8_t *out, size_t size, uint32_t op, const char *json);
```

`runtime/dispatch.c`:

```c
// Guest address -> recompiled function lookup, and host (HLE) function registry.
#include <pthread.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "control_mem.h"
#include "gamelib.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "kernel.h"

typedef struct { const uint64_t *addrs; const GuestFn *fns; uint64_t count, lo, hi; } FnTable;
static FnTable tables[MAX_MODULES];  // one per module of the game code (runtime/gamelib.h)
static int ntables;

// HLE stubs live at fake addresses HLE_BASE + 16*i
#define MAX_HLE 4096
typedef struct { const char *name; HostFn fn; } HleSlot;
static HleSlot hle_slots[MAX_HLE];
static int hle_count;

// Overrides of recompiled guest functions (by address)
#define MAX_OVERRIDE 1024
static struct { uint64_t addr; HostFn fn; const char *name; } overrides[MAX_OVERRIDE];
static int override_count;

// Host implementations registered by name (runtime/hle/*.c fill this via HLE_FUNC)
typedef struct { const char *name; HostFn fn; } HleImpl;
#ifdef __APPLE__
extern const HleImpl __start_hle_impls[] __asm__("section$start$__DATA$__hle_impls");
extern const HleImpl __stop_hle_impls[] __asm__("section$end$__DATA$__hle_impls");
#elif defined(__linux__)
extern const HleImpl __start_hle_impls[], __stop_hle_impls[];  // (ELF: defined by the linker)
#else
// PE/COFF: the linker sorts .hle$a < .hle$m (entries, hle.h) < .hle$z by the text after '$'.
__attribute__((section(".hle$a"), used)) static const HleImpl __start_hle_impls[1];
__attribute__((section(".hle$z"), used)) static const HleImpl __stop_hle_impls[1];
#endif

HostFn hle_lookup_impl(const char *name) {
    const char *skip = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_HLE_SKIP");  // debugging: disable HLE for names containing this
    if (skip && strstr(name, skip)) return NULL;
    const HleImpl *start = __start_hle_impls, *stop = __stop_hle_impls;
    __asm__("" : "+r"(start), "+r"(stop));  // separate objects: keep the compiler from reasoning about them
    for (const HleImpl *p = start; p < stop; p++)
        if (p->name && !strcmp(p->name, name)) return p->fn;
    return NULL;
}

static void hle_unimplemented(Cpu *c);

uint64_t hle_register(const char *name, HostFn fn) {
    for (int i = 0; i < hle_count; i++)
        if (!strcmp(hle_slots[i].name, name)) return HLE_BASE + 16ull * i;
    if (hle_count == MAX_HLE) FATAL("too many HLE stubs\n");
    hle_slots[hle_count].name = strdup(name);
    hle_slots[hle_count].fn = fn;
    return HLE_BASE + 16ull * hle_count++;
}

void hle_override(uint64_t addr, HostFn fn, const char *name) {
    if (override_count == MAX_OVERRIDE) FATAL("too many overrides\n");
    overrides[override_count].addr = addr;
    overrides[override_count].fn = fn;
    overrides[override_count].name = name;
    override_count++;
}

static __thread uint64_t unimpl_pc;
static int unimpl_counts[MAX_HLE];
static void hle_unimplemented(Cpu *c) {
    int i = (int)((unimpl_pc - HLE_BASE) / 16);
    if (unimpl_counts[i]++ < 3)
        LOG("[hle] UNIMPLEMENTED %s (x0=%llx x1=%llx lr=%llx) -> returning 0\n", hle_slots[i].name, c->x[0],
            c->x[1], c->x[30]);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

uint64_t guest_sym(const char *name) {
    // small cache: callers pass string literals, so pointer identity is a good key
    static struct { const char *name; uint64_t addr; } cache[64];
    static pthread_mutex_t m = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m);
    for (int i = 0; i < 64 && cache[i].name; i++)
        if (cache[i].name == name) { uint64_t a = cache[i].addr; pthread_mutex_unlock(&m); return a; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m);
    uint64_t a = loader_find_symbol(name);
    if (!a) FATAL("guest symbol %s not found\n", name);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m);
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) if (!cache[i].name) { cache[i].name = name; cache[i].addr = a; break; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m);
    return a;
}

static uint64_t hle_next = HLE_HEAP;
RT_ON_RESET(hle_heap_reset) { hle_next = HLE_HEAP; }  // (guest memory, wiped by the reboot)

void *hle_alloc(uint64_t size) {
    static pthread_mutex_t m = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m);
    uint64_t a = hle_next;
    hle_next += (size + 63) & ~63ull;
    if (hle_next > HLE_HEAP + HLE_HEAP_SIZE) FATAL("HLE heap exhausted\n");
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m);
    plat_commit(a, size);
    memset((void *)a, 0, size);
    return (void *)a;
}

void dispatch_init(void) {  // (after gamelib_load)
    const GameLibTables *g = gamelib_tables();
    ntables = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < *g->nmodules && i < MAX_MODULES; i++) {
        const GameLibModule *m = &g->modules[i];
        uint64_t n = *m->count;
        if (n) tables[ntables++] = (FnTable){m->addrs, m->fns, n, m->addrs[0], m->addrs[n - 1]};
    }
}

GuestFn dispatch_lookup(uint64_t addr) {
    for (int t = 0; t < ntables; t++) {
        FnTable *ft = &tables[t];
        if (addr < ft->lo || addr > ft->hi) continue;
        uint64_t lo = 0, hi = ft->count;
        while (lo < hi) {
            uint64_t mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (ft->addrs[mid] < addr) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        if (lo < ft->count && ft->addrs[lo] == addr) return ft->fns[lo];
    }
    return NULL;
}

// Small direct-mapped cache in front of the binary search
#define DCACHE 4096
static __thread struct { uint64_t addr; GuestFn fn; } dcache[DCACHE];

static GuestFn dispatch_slow(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t pc = c->pc;
    if (pc >= HLE_BASE && pc < HLE_BASE + HLE_SIZE) {
        rt_unwind_point();  // (HLE calls aren't cached below, so every one passes here: a reboot's safe point)
        int i = (int)((pc - HLE_BASE) / 16);
        if (i < hle_count) {
            if (hle_slots[i].fn) return hle_slots[i].fn;
            unimpl_pc = pc;
            return hle_unimplemented;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < override_count; i++)
        if (overrides[i].addr == pc) return overrides[i].fn;
    GuestFn f = dispatch_lookup(pc);
    if (!f) {
        uint64_t off;
        const char *s = loader_symbol_at(c->x[30], &off);
        FATAL("no function at %llx (lr=%llx %s+%llx)\n", pc, c->x[30], s ? s : "?", off);
    }
    unsigned h = (unsigned)(pc >> 2) & (DCACHE - 1);
    dcache[h].addr = pc;
    dcache[h].fn = f;
    return f;
}

// Always tail-calls, so chains of indirect jumps don't grow the host stack.
void rt_dispatch(Cpu *c) {
    KThread *t = c->thread;  // (a better thread waiting for this one's core gets it: kernel.c kernel_preempt)
    if (t && t->core_held >= 0 && __builtin_expect(g_core_best_wait[t->core_held].v < t->prio, 0)) kernel_preempt(t);
    unsigned h = (unsigned)(c->pc >> 2) & (DCACHE - 1);
    GuestFn f = dcache[h].addr == c->pc ? dcache[h].fn : dispatch_slow(c);
    __attribute__((musttail)) return f(c);
}

void guest_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30];
    c->x[30] = 0;
    c->pc = addr;
    rt_dispatch(c);
    c->x[30] = lr;
}

// Host pc -> recompiled guest function containing it ("f_<addr>"), for hosts without symbol lookup.
static int cmp_host(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uint64_t x = ((const uint64_t *)a)[0], y = ((const uint64_t *)b)[0];
    return x < y ? -1 : x > y;
}
const char *rt_host_fn_name(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset) {
    static uint64_t (*byhost)[2];  // {host address, guest address}, sorted by host address
    static uint64_t n;
    static __thread char name[32];
    if (!byhost) {
        uint64_t total = 0, k = 0;
        for (int t = 0; t < ntables; t++) total += tables[t].count;
        uint64_t (*v)[2] = malloc(total * sizeof *v);
        if (!v) return NULL;
        for (int t = 0; t < ntables; t++)
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < tables[t].count; i++) {
                v[k][0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)tables[t].fns[i];
                v[k++][1] = tables[t].addrs[i];
            }
        qsort(v, k, sizeof *v, cmp_host);
        n = k;
        byhost = v;
    }
    uint64_t lo = 0, hi = n;  // last entry with host address <= pc
    while (lo < hi) {
        uint64_t mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (byhost[mid][0] <= pc) lo = mid + 1;
        else hi = mid;
    }
    if (!lo || pc - byhost[lo - 1][0] > 0x100000) return NULL;
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "f_%llx", (unsigned long long)byhost[lo - 1][1]);
    if (offset) *offset = pc - byhost[lo - 1][0];
    return name;
}

static const char *host_sym(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset) {
    const char *s = plat_symbol(pc, offset);
    return s ? s : rt_host_fn_name(pc, offset);
}

void (*rt_crash_note)(void);

void rt_fatal_trace(void) {
    fprintf(stderr, "host backtrace (guest functions are f_<addr>):\n");
    plat_print_backtrace();
    if (rt_crash_note) rt_crash_note();
    Cpu *c = kernel_current_cpu();
    if (c) {
        fprintf(stderr, "guest: sp=%llx lr=%llx\n", c->sp, c->x[30]);
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i += 4)
            fprintf(stderr, "  x%-2d %016llx  x%-2d %016llx  x%-2d %016llx  x%-2d %016llx\n", i, c->x[i], i + 1,
                    c->x[i + 1], i + 2, c->x[i + 2], i + 3, c->x[i + 3]);
        // Who called: the frame records ([fp] the caller's fp, [fp + 8] its return address). And what the registers
        // point at: an object's first word inside the game's modules is its vtable, which names its class. (A crash
        // writing 0x8 after the game's allocator returned NULL, #363, showed only lr.)
        fprintf(stderr, "guest frames:");
        uint64_t fp = c->x[29];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16 && fp; i++) {
            uint64_t rec[2];
            if ((fp & 7) || !control_mem_peek(fp, rec, sizeof rec)) break;
            fprintf(stderr, " %llx", (unsigned long long)rec[1]);
            if (rec[0] <= fp) break;
            fp = rec[0];
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            uint64_t w;
            if ((c->x[i] & 7) || !control_mem_peek(c->x[i], &w, sizeof w) || w < MAIN_BASE || w >= MAIN_BASE + 0x4000000)
                continue;
            fprintf(stderr, "  x%d -> %llx\n", i, (unsigned long long)w);
        }
    }
    extern int fs_recent_files(const char **out, int max);  // runtime/services/fs.c
    const char *files[8];
    int nfiles = fs_recent_files(files, 8);
    if (nfiles) fprintf(stderr, "last RomFS files read (newest last):\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < nfiles; i++) fprintf(stderr, "  %s\n", files[i]);
    plat_fatal_notice();
    // our crash handler also catches SIGABRT: without this abort() re-entered it forever (a 5 GB log)
    signal(SIGABRT, SIG_DFL);
    abort();
}

void rt_udf(Cpu *c, uint64_t pc) {
    (void)c;
    FATAL("undefined instruction / trap at %llx\n", pc);
}

void rt_brk(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) {
    (void)c;
    FATAL("brk #%u at %llx\n", imm, pc);
}

// ---- crash reporting

// Debug data watchpoint: the page is protected; accesses in [lo, hi) are attributed to the host
// function (f_<guest addr>) doing them, then the page is reopened until the next re-arm.
uint64_t g_watch_lo, g_watch_hi;
int g_fault_is_write;
static uint64_t watch_page;
static uint64_t retired_pages[8];  // pages watched before a retarget: the protect thread may still close one
// SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_STEP=1 (Windows): the page closes again right after each access (single-step) instead of on
// the 100 us timer below, so every access in the range is seen.
static int watch_step = -1;
static bool watch_stepping(void) {
    if (watch_step < 0) watch_step = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_STEP") != NULL;
    return watch_step;
}
// A second range, the node SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_FOLLOW moves to (its own page; the first range stays watched too).
static uint64_t node_lo, node_hi, node_page;

uint64_t rt_watch_step_page(uint64_t fa) {
    uint64_t page = fa & ~(PLAT_PAGE - 1);
    return watch_stepping() && (page == watch_page || page == node_page) ? page : 0;
}

bool rt_watch_in_range(uint64_t fa) { return (fa >= g_watch_lo && fa < g_watch_hi) || (fa >= node_lo && fa < node_hi); }

// SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_FOLLOW=<off>[:<len>] (hex, with WATCH_STEP): each time a write stores a pointer at watch_lo + off
// (a list head's next), the second range moves to [pointer, pointer + len) (default 0x20: a block header), so the
// writes to the newest node are caught. Returns that node's page to close now, or 0.
uint64_t rt_watch_after_write(uint64_t addr, uint64_t value) {
    static int follow = -1;
    static uint64_t off, len;
    if (follow < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_FOLLOW");
        follow = e != NULL;
        if (e) { off = strtoull(e, (char **)&e, 16); len = *e == ':' ? strtoull(e + 1, NULL, 16) : 0x20; }
    }
    if (!follow || addr != g_watch_lo + off || !value || (value & 7) || (value >= g_watch_lo && value < g_watch_hi))
        return 0;
    uint64_t old = node_page;
    node_lo = value;
    node_hi = value + len;
    node_page = value & ~(PLAT_PAGE - 1);
    if (old && old != node_page && old != watch_page) {
        static int nretired_nodes;  // (another thread's single-step may close it again: rt_fault_watch reopens it)
        retired_pages[nretired_nodes++ & 7] = old;
        plat_protect(old, PLAT_PAGE, PLAT_PROT_RW);
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[watch] node %llx+%llx\n", (unsigned long long)value, (unsigned long long)len);
    return node_page;
}

static void *watch_thread(void *a) {
    (void)a;
    int r = plat_protect(watch_page, PLAT_PAGE, PLAT_PROT_NONE);
    fprintf(stderr, "[watch] page %llx protect -> %d\n", (unsigned long long)watch_page, r);
    if (watch_stepping()) return NULL;
    for (;;) { plat_protect(watch_page, PLAT_PAGE, PLAT_PROT_NONE); usleep(100); }
    return NULL;
}
void watch_arm(void) {
    if (!g_watch_lo || watch_page) return;
    watch_page = g_watch_lo & ~(PLAT_PAGE - 1);
    pthread_t t;
    pthread_create(&t, NULL, watch_thread, NULL);
}

// Points the watchpoint at [lo, hi) (runtime/kernel.c SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_TRAP follows a list node with it).
void watch_retarget(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    uint64_t old = watch_page;
    g_watch_lo = lo;
    g_watch_hi = hi;
    fprintf(stderr, "[watch] trap now on %llx+%llx\n", (unsigned long long)lo, (unsigned long long)(hi - lo));
    if (!old) { watch_arm(); return; }
    static int nretired;
    retired_pages[nretired++ & 7] = old;
    watch_page = lo & ~(PLAT_PAGE - 1);
    if (watch_page != old) plat_protect(old, PLAT_PAGE, PLAT_PROT_RW);
}

bool rt_fault_watch(uint64_t fa, uint64_t pc) {
    uint64_t page = fa & ~(PLAT_PAGE - 1);
    bool retired = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) retired |= retired_pages[i] && retired_pages[i] == page;
    if (retired && page != watch_page && page != node_page) {
        plat_protect(page, PLAT_PAGE, PLAT_PROT_RW);
        return true;
    }
    bool on_node_page = node_page && page == node_page;
    if (!on_node_page && (!watch_page || fa < watch_page || fa >= watch_page + PLAT_PAGE)) return false;
    static int log_writes = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_WRITES=<n>: every write (not one line per pc), up to n lines
    if (log_writes < 0) log_writes = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_WRITES") ? atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WATCH_WRITES")) : 0;
    if (log_writes && rt_watch_in_range(fa)) {
        static _Atomic int nlogged;
        if (g_fault_is_write && nlogged++ < log_writes) {
            uint64_t off = 0;
            const char *nm = host_sym(pc, &off);
            bool node = fa >= node_lo && fa < node_hi;
            if (!nm) {  // our own executable: its offset from rt_fault_watch maps to a function with nm/addr2line
                nm = "savagewind";
                off = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&rt_fault_watch;
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "[watch] %.6f write %s+%#llx by %s%s%llx (thread %x)\n", plat_now_ns() / 1e9,
                    node ? "node" : "head", (unsigned long long)(fa - (node ? node_lo : g_watch_lo)), nm,
                    !strcmp(nm, "savagewind") ? " rt_fault_watch+" : "+", (unsigned long long)off,
                    kernel_current_thread_handle());
            extern void kernel_log_guest_chain(void);
            kernel_log_guest_chain();
        }
    } else if (fa >= g_watch_lo && fa < g_watch_hi) {
        static uint64_t seen[256];  // one line per host pc (the module offset maps to f_<addr> with nm)
        static int nseen;
        uint64_t off = 0;
        const char *nm = host_sym(pc, &off);
        if (!nm) nm = "?";
        bool found = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < nseen; i++) found |= seen[i] == pc;
        if (!found && nseen < 256) {
            seen[nseen++] = pc;
            fprintf(stderr, "[watch] +%#llx of %llx by %s+%llx\n", (unsigned long long)(fa - g_watch_lo),
                    (unsigned long long)g_watch_lo, nm, (unsigned long long)off);
            extern void kernel_log_guest_chain(void);
            kernel_log_guest_chain();  // (the guest calls that led there: lr and frame records)
        }
    }
    plat_protect(page, PLAT_PAGE, PLAT_PROT_RW);
    return true;
}

void rt_fault_report(const char *what, uint64_t fa, uint64_t pc, uint64_t lr) {
    uint64_t po = 0, lo = 0;
    const char *ps = host_sym(pc, &po), *ls = host_sym(lr, &lo);
    fprintf(stderr, "\n*** %s accessing %#llx\n    host pc %llx (%s+%llx)\n    host lr %llx (%s)\n", what,
            (unsigned long long)fa, (unsigned long long)pc, ps ? ps : "?", (unsigned long long)po,
            (unsigned long long)lr, ls ? ls : "?");
    rt_fatal_trace();
}

void crash_handler_install(void) { plat_crash_handler_install(); }
```
