`runtime/dlc_check.c`:

```c
// Downloadable content check (dlc_check.h): tells whether the game will see and mount both DLC packs, and when not,
// which setup mistake kept it from working (#497, #470, #383, #188).
#include "dlc_check.h"
#include "romfs_build.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#ifndef O_BINARY
#define O_BINARY 0
#endif

static const char *const DLC1_DIRS[] = {
    "Game", "Map", "Movie", "NavMesh", "Pack", "Physics", "Sound", "System", "Terrain", "UI", "Voice",
};

static bool join2(char *out, size_t cap, const char *a, const char *b) {
    int n = snprintf(out, cap, "%s/%s", a, b);
    return n > 0 && (size_t)n < cap;
}

static bool is_dir_path(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode);
}

static bool file_exists_path(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0;
}

static bool reg_nonempty(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode) && st.st_size > 0;
}

static bool can_read_bytes(const char *p) {
    int fd = open(p, O_RDONLY | O_BINARY);
    if (fd < 0) return false;
    struct stat st;
    bool ok = fstat(fd, &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode);
    if (ok && st.st_size > 0) {
        unsigned char b;
        ok = read(fd, &b, 1) == 1;
    }
    close(fd);
    return ok;
}

// Printable ASCII without '%' (the start screen's trv replaces "%s" in status lines).
static void sanitize_text(char *dst, size_t cap, const char *src) {
    if (!cap) return;
    size_t w = 0;
    for (; src && src[w] && w + 1 < cap; w++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)src[w];
        dst[w] = c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7e && c != '%' ? (char)c : '?';
    }
    dst[w] = 0;
}

static bool is_dlc_romfs_dir(const char *dir) {
    char aoc_ver[2048], game_ver[2048];
    return join2(aoc_ver, sizeof aoc_ver, dir, "System/AocVersion.txt") &&
           join2(game_ver, sizeof game_ver, dir, "System/Version.txt") &&
           reg_nonempty(aoc_ver) && !file_exists_path(game_ver);
}

static bool read_aoc_version(const char *dir, char *out, size_t cap) {
    out[0] = 0;
    char p[2048];
    if (!join2(p, sizeof p, dir, "System/AocVersion.txt")) return false;
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (!f) return false;
    char raw[64] = "";
    size_t n = fread(raw, 1, sizeof raw - 1, f);
    fclose(f);
    raw[n] = 0;
    char *a = raw, *b = raw + n;
    if (!strncmp(a, "\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3)) a += 3;
    while (a < b && isspace((unsigned char)*a)) a++;
    while (b > a && isspace((unsigned char)b[-1])) *--b = 0;
    sanitize_text(out, cap, a);
    return out[0] != 0;
}

// True when a direct subfolder of dir holds System/AocVersion.txt (e.g. extracted/aoc1/romfs/).
static bool has_nested_dlc(const char *dir) {
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    if (!d) return false;
    bool found = false;
    struct dirent *e;
    while (!found && (e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        char sub[2048];
        if (join2(sub, sizeof sub, dir, e->d_name) && is_dir_path(sub) && is_dlc_romfs_dir(sub)) found = true;
    }
    closedir(d);
    return found;
}

// First non-empty regular file in dir (writes its path to first_out when non-NULL).
static bool dir_first_file(const char *dir, char *first_out, size_t cap) {
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    if (!d) return false;
    bool found = false;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        char p[2048];
        if (join2(p, sizeof p, dir, e->d_name) && reg_nonempty(p)) {
            if (first_out) snprintf(first_out, cap, "%s", p);
            found = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
    return found;
}

static bool eq_ascii_icase(const char *a, const char *b) {
    for (; *a && *b; a++, b++)
        if (tolower((unsigned char)*a) != tolower((unsigned char)*b)) return false;
    return *a == *b;
}

static int cmp_str(const void *a, const void *b) { return strcmp(*(char *const *)a, *(char *const *)b); }

// With no aoc1..aoc8 folders, checks whether root has a sibling folder (e.g. dlc1/) holding a DLC RomFS (#383).
static bool find_misnamed_dlc(const char *root, char *name_out, size_t cap) {
    DIR *d = opendir(root);
    if (!d) return false;
    char **names = NULL;
    int n = 0, c = 0;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        if (eq_ascii_icase(e->d_name, "exefs") || eq_ascii_icase(e->d_name, "romfs") ||
            eq_ascii_icase(e->d_name, "save") || eq_ascii_icase(e->d_name, "save-backups") ||
            eq_ascii_icase(e->d_name, "cache"))
            continue;
        char sub[2048];
        if (!join2(sub, sizeof sub, root, e->d_name) || !is_dir_path(sub)) continue;
        char *copy = strdup(e->d_name);
        if (!copy) continue;
        if (n == c) {
            int nc = c ? c * 2 : 8;
            char ** grown = realloc(names, (size_t)nc * sizeof *names);
            if (!grown) { free(copy); break; }
            names = grown, c = nc;
        }
        names[n++] = copy;
    }
    closedir(d);
    if (n > 1) qsort(names, (size_t)n, sizeof *names, cmp_str);
    bool found = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!found) {
            char sub[2048];
            if (join2(sub, sizeof sub, root, names[i]) && (is_dlc_romfs_dir(sub) || has_nested_dlc(sub))) {
                sanitize_text(name_out, cap, names[i]);
                found = true;
            }
        }
        free(names[i]);
    }
    free(names);
    return found;
}

const char *rt_dlc_state_name(RtDlcState state) {
    switch (state) {
    case RT_DLC_NONE: return "none";
    case RT_DLC_READY: return "ready";
    case RT_DLC_ONLY_ONE: return "only-one";
    case RT_DLC_SWAPPED: return "swapped";
    case RT_DLC_WRONG_VERSION: return "wrong-version";
    case RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE: return "incomplete";
    case RT_DLC_MERGED: return "merged-into-romfs";
    case RT_DLC_MISNAMED: return "misnamed-folder";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

RtDlcCheck rt_dlc_check(const char *root) {
    RtDlcCheck out;
    memset(&out, 0, sizeof out);
    if (!root || !*root) return out;

    for (int i = 1; i <= RT_DLC_MAX; i++) {
        char name[16], dir[2048];
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "aoc%d", i);
        if (join2(dir, sizeof dir, root, name) && is_dir_path(dir)) out.present_mask |= 1u << (i - 1);
    }

    if (!out.present_mask) {
        if (find_misnamed_dlc(root, out.detail, sizeof out.detail)) {
            out.state = RT_DLC_MISNAMED;
            return out;
        }
        char m1[2048], m2[2048];
        if ((join2(m1, sizeof m1, root, "romfs/System/AocVersion.txt") && file_exists_path(m1)) ||
            (join2(m2, sizeof m2, root, "romfs/Pack/AocMainField.pack") && file_exists_path(m2)))
            out.state = RT_DLC_MERGED;
        return out;
    }

    bool has1 = (out.present_mask & 1u) != 0, has2 = (out.present_mask & 2u) != 0;
    if (!has1 && !has2) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
        snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "aoc1");
        return out;
    }

    char aoc1[2048], aoc2[2048], pack1[2048], pack2[2048];
    if (!join2(aoc1, sizeof aoc1, root, "aoc1") || !join2(aoc2, sizeof aoc2, root, "aoc2") ||
        !join2(pack1, sizeof pack1, aoc1, "Pack/AocMainField.pack") ||
        !join2(pack2, sizeof pack2, aoc2, "Pack/AocMainField.pack")) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
        return out;
    }

    if (has1 != has2) {
        const char *sole = has1 ? aoc1 : aoc2, *sole_name = has1 ? "aoc1" : "aoc2";
        if (!is_dlc_romfs_dir(sole)) {
            out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
            out.nested = has_nested_dlc(sole);
            snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "%s/System/AocVersion.txt", sole_name);
            return out;
        }
        read_aoc_version(sole, out.version, sizeof out.version);
        out.state = RT_DLC_ONLY_ONE;
        out.only_pack = reg_nonempty(has1 ? pack1 : pack2) ? 1 : 2;
        return out;
    }

    if (!is_dlc_romfs_dir(aoc1)) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
        out.nested = has_nested_dlc(aoc1);
        snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt");
        return out;
    }
    if (!is_dlc_romfs_dir(aoc2)) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
        out.nested = has_nested_dlc(aoc2);
        snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "aoc2/System/AocVersion.txt");
        return out;
    }

    read_aoc_version(aoc1, out.version, sizeof out.version);
    bool data1 = reg_nonempty(pack1), data2 = reg_nonempty(pack2);
    if (!data1 && data2) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_SWAPPED;
        return out;
    }

    // If aoc1 has Pack/ or Map/ (not a copy of the 1-file second DLC), check its version before its folder list so an
    // older 1.0 / 2.0 dump without Movie/ reports the version rather than a missing folder.
    char sub[2048];
    bool looks_like_dlc1 = (join2(sub, sizeof sub, aoc1, "Pack") && is_dir_path(sub)) ||
                           (join2(sub, sizeof sub, aoc1, "Map") && is_dir_path(sub));
    if (looks_like_dlc1 && strcmp(out.version, RT_DLC_VERSION) != 0) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_WRONG_VERSION;
        return out;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof DLC1_DIRS / sizeof DLC1_DIRS[0]; i++) {
        if (!join2(sub, sizeof sub, aoc1, DLC1_DIRS[i]) || !is_dir_path(sub)) {
            out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
            snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "aoc1/%s", DLC1_DIRS[i]);
            return out;
        }
    }
    if (!data1) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
        snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "aoc1/Pack/AocMainField.pack");
        return out;
    }
    if (!join2(sub, sizeof sub, aoc1, "Movie") || !dir_first_file(sub, NULL, 0)) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
        snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "aoc1/Movie");
        return out;
    }
    if (strcmp(out.version, RT_DLC_VERSION) != 0) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_WRONG_VERSION;
        return out;
    }

    out.state = RT_DLC_READY;
    return out;
}

RtDlcCheck rt_dlc_verify(const char *root) {
    RtDlcCheck out = rt_dlc_check(root);
    if (out.state != RT_DLC_READY) return out;

    for (int idx = 1; idx <= 2; idx++) {
        char name[16], dir[2048], why[128] = "";
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "aoc%d", idx);
        if (!join2(dir, sizeof dir, root, name)) {
            out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
            snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "%s", name);
            return out;
        }
        RomfsLayout layout;
        memset(&layout, 0, sizeof layout);
        if (!romfs_layout(dir, &layout, why, sizeof why) || layout.nfiles <= 0) {
            romfs_layout_free(&layout);
            out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
            sanitize_text(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, name);
            return out;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < layout.nfiles; i++) {
            out.files++;
            out.bytes += layout.files[i].size;
        }
        romfs_layout_free(&layout);
    }

    // Confirm key files open and read cleanly on the host (catches unreadable permissions or offline cloud stubs).
    const char *const must_read[] = {
        "aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt",
        "aoc2/System/AocVersion.txt",
        "aoc1/Pack/AocMainField.pack",
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof must_read / sizeof must_read[0]; i++) {
        char p[2048];
        if (!join2(p, sizeof p, root, must_read[i]) || !can_read_bytes(p)) {
            out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
            snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "%s", must_read[i]);
            return out;
        }
    }
    char movie_dir[2048], movie_file[2048] = "";
    if (!join2(movie_dir, sizeof movie_dir, root, "aoc1/Movie") ||
        !dir_first_file(movie_dir, movie_file, sizeof movie_file) || !can_read_bytes(movie_file)) {
        out.state = RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE;
        snprintf(out.detail, sizeof out.detail, "aoc1/Movie");
        return out;
    }

    return out;
}
```

`runtime/dlc_check.h`:

```h
// Downloadable content check (runtime/dlc_check.c). The game unlocks The Master Trials and The Champions' Ballad only
// when aoc:u lists both add-on contents (extracted/aoc1 and extracted/aoc2) and fsp-srv can mount aoc1, which in DLC
// 3.0 holds the data of both while aoc2 only marks the second pack.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define RT_DLC_MAX 8
#define RT_DLC_VERSION "3.0"

typedef enum {
    RT_DLC_NONE = 0,        // no add-on content folders, and none misplaced or merged
    RT_DLC_READY,           // aoc1 (complete 3.0 data) and aoc2 (second pack's RomFS) are both valid
    RT_DLC_ONLY_ONE,        // only one of the two DLC folders is present (#470: the game needs both to unlock DLC)
    RT_DLC_SWAPPED,         // aoc1 and aoc2 are swapped (the 1.4 GB data pack is in aoc2 instead of aoc1)
    RT_DLC_WRONG_VERSION,   // aoc1's System/AocVersion.txt isn't "3.0" (older DLC, or Wii U's "0300")
    RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE,      // an aoc folder lacks System/AocVersion.txt (or is nested a folder deeper), or aoc1 lacks folders / files
    RT_DLC_MERGED,          // no aoc folders, and romfs/ has the DLC merged into it (#188, #242)
    RT_DLC_MISNAMED,        // no aoc folders, and another folder in root (e.g. dlc1) holds a DLC RomFS (#383)
} RtDlcState;

typedef struct {
    RtDlcState state;
    unsigned present_mask;  // bit (i - 1) set when root/aoc<i> is a directory (1..RT_DLC_MAX)
    int only_pack;          // RT_DLC_ONLY_ONE: 1 = the data pack, 2 = the second pack's marker
    bool nested;            // RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE: System/AocVersion.txt was found a folder deeper (e.g. aoc1/romfs/)
    char version[32];       // aoc1's System/AocVersion.txt (printable ASCII, '%' replaced), when present
    char detail[128];       // missing item ("aoc1/Movie"), misnamed folder ("dlc1"), or unreadable path
    unsigned files;         // rt_dlc_verify: files across aoc1 + aoc2
    uint64_t bytes;         // rt_dlc_verify: total bytes across aoc1 + aoc2
} RtDlcCheck;

// Fast metadata check of root (no full tree walk: safe on the UI thread when opening or refreshing the page).
RtDlcCheck rt_dlc_check(const char *root);

// Deep verification of root (lays out both RomFS images as the game does and checks key files for reading).
RtDlcCheck rt_dlc_verify(const char *root);

// Short log tag for a state ("ready", "only-one", ...).
const char *rt_dlc_state_name(RtDlcState state);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

```

`runtime/dlss_fetch.c`:

```c
// NVIDIA's DLSS library, downloaded from NVIDIA's repository (dlss_fetch.h). WinHTTP (part of Windows) does the
// download; libavutil's SHA-256 (linked anyway, for the movies) checks it. Each file goes to <name>.part first and is
// renamed over only once its size and hash are the recorded ones, so an interrupted or altered download never stays.
#include "dlss_fetch.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef _WIN32

#include <windows.h>
#include <winhttp.h>
#include <libavutil/mem.h>
#include <libavutil/sha.h>

#define HOST L"raw.githubusercontent.com"
#define PATH L"/NVIDIA/DLSS/v" WIDEN(DLSS_FETCH_VERSION) L"/"
#define WIDEN2(s) L##s
#define WIDEN(s) WIDEN2(s)

static const struct {
    const wchar_t *src;   // in NVIDIA/DLSS at the tag
    const wchar_t *name;  // next to savagewind.exe
    uint64_t size;
    const char *sha256;
} k_files[] = {
    {L"lib/Windows_x86_64/rel/nvngx_dlss.dll", L"nvngx_dlss.dll", 58956912,
     "d00b5b0ab29c3ca101b70c3a5ecb3a01b7ef33766a3383a28a18623083e6123e"},
    {L"LICENSE.txt", L"NVIDIA-DLSS-LICENSE.txt", 26620,
     "d4216e39ebef5f9b50a6712ebb37beeb5379862a67733a9999c651f21592aaf0"},
};
enum { NFILES = sizeof k_files / sizeof *k_files };

static bool exe_path(const wchar_t *name, wchar_t *out, size_t cap) {
    wchar_t dir[MAX_PATH];
    DWORD len = GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, dir, MAX_PATH);
    if (!len || len >= MAX_PATH) return false;
    while (len && dir[len - 1] != L'\\' && dir[len - 1] != L'/') len--;
    dir[len] = 0;
    int n = _snwprintf(out, cap, L"%ls%ls", dir, name);
    return n > 0 && (size_t)n < cap;
}

static uint64_t file_size(const wchar_t *path) {
    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA a;
    if (!GetFileAttributesExW(path, GetFileExInfoStandard, &a)) return 0;
    return ((uint64_t)a.nFileSizeHigh << 32) | a.nFileSizeLow;
}

bool dlss_fetch_offered(void) {
    HKEY k;
    if (RegOpenKeyExA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "SOFTWARE\\NVIDIA Corporation\\Global\\NGXCore", 0, KEY_READ, &k) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
        return false;
    RegCloseKey(k);
    return true;
}

bool dlss_fetch_present(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < NFILES; i++) {
        wchar_t p[MAX_PATH + 64];
        if (!exe_path(k_files[i].name, p, sizeof p / sizeof *p) || file_size(p) != k_files[i].size) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool dlss_fetch_missing(void) {
    static int missing = -1;
    if (missing < 0) missing = dlss_fetch_offered() && !dlss_fetch_present();
    return missing;
}

static void hex(const uint8_t *d, char *out) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) snprintf(out + 2 * i, 3, "%02x", d[i]);
}

// One file into dest (its .part first); done / total: the progress over all files
static bool fetch_one(HINTERNET con, int i, const wchar_t *dest, uint64_t *done, uint64_t total,
                      void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t), char *why, size_t why_size) {
    wchar_t path[512], part[MAX_PATH + 64];
    _snwprintf(path, 512, L"%ls%ls", PATH, k_files[i].src);
    path[511] = 0;
    _snwprintf(part, MAX_PATH + 64, L"%ls.part", dest);
    part[MAX_PATH + 63] = 0;
    bool good = false;
    HANDLE f = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    struct AVSHA *sha = av_sha_alloc();
    HINTERNET req = WinHttpOpenRequest(con, L"GET", path, NULL, WINHTTP_NO_REFERER, WINHTTP_DEFAULT_ACCEPT_TYPES,
                                       WINHTTP_FLAG_SECURE);
    DWORD status = 0, sl = sizeof status;
    if (!sha || av_sha_init(sha, 256) < 0) {
        snprintf(why, why_size, "out of memory");
        goto out;
    }
    if (!req || !WinHttpSendRequest(req, WINHTTP_NO_ADDITIONAL_HEADERS, 0, WINHTTP_NO_REQUEST_DATA, 0, 0, 0) ||
        !WinHttpReceiveResponse(req, NULL)) {
        snprintf(why, why_size, "no connection to %ls (error %lu)", HOST, GetLastError());
        goto out;
    }
    WinHttpQueryHeaders(req, WINHTTP_QUERY_STATUS_CODE | WINHTTP_QUERY_FLAG_NUMBER, WINHTTP_HEADER_NAME_BY_INDEX,
                        &status, &sl, WINHTTP_NO_HEADER_INDEX);
    if (status != 200) {
        snprintf(why, why_size, "%ls: HTTP %lu", k_files[i].name, status);
        goto out;
    }
    f = CreateFileW(part, GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    if (f == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        snprintf(why, why_size, "can't write next to savagewind.exe (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        goto out;
    }
    uint64_t got = 0;
    static uint8_t buf[1 << 16];
    for (;;) {
        DWORD n = 0, w = 0;
        if (!WinHttpReadData(req, buf, sizeof buf, &n)) {
            snprintf(why, why_size, "%ls: download interrupted (error %lu)", k_files[i].name, GetLastError());
            goto out;
        }
        if (!n) break;
        if (got + n > k_files[i].size) {
            snprintf(why, why_size, "%ls: larger than NVIDIA's release", k_files[i].name);
            goto out;
        }
        if (!WriteFile(f, buf, n, &w, NULL) || w != n) {
            snprintf(why, why_size, "%ls: disk full or not writable", k_files[i].name);
            goto out;
        }
        av_sha_update(sha, buf, n);
        got += n, *done += n;
        if (progress) progress(*done, total);
    }
    CloseHandle(f);
    f = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    uint8_t d[32];
    char h[65];
    av_sha_final(sha, d);
    hex(d, h);
    if (got != k_files[i].size || strcmp(h, k_files[i].sha256)) {
        snprintf(why, why_size, "%ls: not the file of NVIDIA's release %s (size or SHA-256 differs)", k_files[i].name,
                 DLSS_FETCH_VERSION);
        goto out;
    }
    if (!MoveFileExW(part, dest, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)) {
        snprintf(why, why_size, "%ls: in use? (error %lu)", k_files[i].name, GetLastError());
        goto out;
    }
    good = true;
out:
    if (f != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(f);
    if (!good) DeleteFileW(part);
    if (req) WinHttpCloseHandle(req);
    av_free(sha);
    return good;
}

bool dlss_fetch_run(void (*progress)(uint64_t done, uint64_t total), char *why, size_t why_size) {
    why[0] = 0;
    wchar_t dest[NFILES][MAX_PATH + 64];
    bool need[NFILES];
    uint64_t total = 0, done = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NFILES; i++) {
        if (!exe_path(k_files[i].name, dest[i], MAX_PATH + 64)) {
            snprintf(why, why_size, "savagewind.exe's folder has too long a path");
            return false;
        }
        need[i] = file_size(dest[i]) != k_files[i].size;
        if (need[i]) total += k_files[i].size;
    }
    if (!total) return true;
    HINTERNET ses = WinHttpOpen(L"Savage Wind", WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_AUTOMATIC_PROXY, WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_NAME,
                                WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_BYPASS, 0);
    HINTERNET con = ses ? WinHttpConnect(ses, HOST, INTERNET_DEFAULT_HTTPS_PORT, 0) : NULL;
    bool good = con != NULL;
    if (!good) snprintf(why, why_size, "no connection to %ls (error %lu)", HOST, GetLastError());
    for (int i = 0; good && i < NFILES; i++)
        if (need[i]) good = fetch_one(con, i, dest[i], &done, total, progress, why, why_size);
    if (con) WinHttpCloseHandle(con);
    if (ses) WinHttpCloseHandle(ses);
    return good;
}

#else

bool dlss_fetch_offered(void) { return false; }
bool dlss_fetch_present(void) { return false; }
bool dlss_fetch_missing(void) { return false; }
bool dlss_fetch_run(void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t), char *why, size_t why_size) {
    (void)progress;
    snprintf(why, why_size, "NVIDIA DLSS is for Windows");
    return false;
}

#endif
```

```h
// NVIDIA's DLSS library for Video > Upscaler's NVIDIA DLSS (nvn/vulkan/dlss.c), which Savage Wind doesn't ship:
// downloaded by the setup from NVIDIA's own repository, NVIDIA/DLSS on GitHub, at a pinned release, checked by size and
// SHA-256, and written next to savagewind.exe with NVIDIA's licence. Windows only.
#pragma once

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define DLSS_FETCH_VERSION "310.9.16"  // (NVIDIA/DLSS's release tag v310.9.16)

// An NVIDIA driver with NGX is installed (the library is of use here)
bool dlss_fetch_offered(void);
// The library and its licence are next to savagewind.exe at their recorded size

// once, as the files don't change while the game runs
```

`runtime/draw_distance.c`:

```c
// Video > Draw distance (settings.h DRAWDIST_*): how far from the camera the game keeps the actors placed on the map,
// draws its grass and its distant trees. Original leaves every one of the game's values untouched.
//
// Actors.
// Every placed actor (trees, bushes, rocks, buildings, enemies, and the full model of a building that has a "_Far"
// version) exists only within its traverse distance of the camera: the actor's traverseDist from ActorInfo (100 when it
// has none) times a scale that is 1 in the released game (tools/patches.py _traverse_scale). Beyond it a building
// shows its "_Far" model and a tree the terrain's distant trees, or nothing. A longer draw distance multiplies that
// scale: the game itself creates the actors further out and keeps them there, with the same rules as at its own
// distances. Original returns the game's value untouched.
//
// Only the far models (a distance of FAR_DIST or more of their own: "_Far" buildings, Hyrule Castle, the mountains'
// rock models) go past FAR_DIST; everything else stops there. Actors with a nearer distance of their own, made beyond
// it, crashed the game while it loaded the world (2x: distances of 1000-2000 m taken to 2000-4000 m, at the Great
// Plateau; 2x capped at 2000 m, and 2x of only the 2000 m-and-more ones, both loaded and played). The far models go
// at most FAR_MAX times out: at 2x, buildings far off flickered and whole blocks of them went missing (Tabantha, user
// play test 2026-10-29), and 1.5x was fine.
//
// High's factor for the nearer actors, 1.6, was the highest that kept every actor in round 3 (2026-10-29: a copy of a 100%
// save warped to Kakariko, Hyrule Castle's front, Korok Forest, Lurelin, Hateno and Gerudo Town, walking and turning
// for 4700 frames). Past it the game leaves actors out, silently: at the castle's front its wall and banners were
// missing at 1.75x (twice), 2x (twice), 2.25x and 4x, and there at 1x, 1.5x (twice) and 1.6x (twice). Further out it
// crashed while it loaded the world (a null call from 1.9.0 0x7001405cd8, or an access to 0): 2.5x at Gerudo Town,
// 3x at Korok Forest and Gerudo Town, 4x at Kakariko, Hateno and Gerudo Town; 2.25x loaded everywhere.
//
// The nearer actors also stop at NEAR_MAX (#384, #453: rock edges and a Korok's statues missing at High in dense
// places). What drops them is the number of long-range actors, not one distance: at 1.75x in front of the castle,
// with the nearer actors held to 1000 or 1250 m the wall and banners were there, at 1312 m the banners went, from
// 1375 m both. The game's lists there were all under capacity (the placement manager's near lists 3900 and 4060,
// its placed actors 3874 of 6000, resource heaps far from full), so the budget it runs out of was not found. NEAR_MAX
// was 1250 m until bushes popped in near and far at High around Rito Village, and only at High (user play test
// 2026-11-05): 1000 m made it rarer, and so did leaving actors under 300 m at the game's distance, about as
// much. 1000 m keeps the whole factor for anything whose own distance is under 1000 / factor (about 830 m at
// High): trees, rocks, enemies and most buildings.
//
// Grass (tools/patches.py _grass_range, _grass_fade, _grass_blade_*). Each layer (blades: 3 m cells in a 47-cell grid,
// +-69 m; crossed quads: 10 m cells, 59-cell grid, +-290 m) makes grass in the cells of a region in front of the
// camera (blades about 24 m in play, crossed quads 120 m), lists them nearest first (blades: at most 512, crossed quads
// 768), and draws them fading by distance (blades out to about 21.5 m, crossed quads about 46 m). The crossed quads'
// region already reaches past their fade, so only their fade goes further. The blades need both, and their region is
// bounded by their list (holes in the grass by Link when it fills), so their factor follows how full it is. At High
// the blades also get 512 draw slots and a cone-shaped region past the game's own near part, which lets them reach
// about 2.45x (their fade out to about 53 m) within the same list. Every pass that walks the slots goes to the last
// one: the per-frame one that points each slot at this frame's half of its shader block stopped at the 256th, and the
// cells past it flickered at High (round 4, user play test 2026-10-29).
//
// Distant trees (tools/patches.py _tree_ranges): the terrain's far trees fade in where the actor trees end, at the
// actors' factor (the game's hand-off, half way through that fade), and end and fade out the far models' factor times
// further out.
//
// The terrain's own detail levels are not changed: no distance that picks them was found. Its heights and materials
// come from maps rendered around the camera (tera::ApertureMaps) whose extents follow their texture sizes.
//
// (tests) SAVAGEWIND_TRAVERSE_SCALE=<x>: this factor instead of the setting's; SAVAGEWIND_FAR_SCALE=<x>: the far
// models' and the distant trees' factor; SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_BLADES / _QUADS=<x>: the grass layers' factors;
// SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_PROBE=1: their numbers in the log; SAVAGEWIND_DRAWDIST_AT=<frame>:<level>,...: levels in one run.
// SAVAGEWIND_NEAR_MAX=<m>: the nearer actors' cap; SAVAGEWIND_NEAR_MIN=<m>: actors nearer than it at the game's distance.
#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "hle.h"
#include "settings.h"

#define FAR_DIST 2000.0f  // (metres)
#define NEAR_MAX 1000.0f  // (metres: the nearer actors' scaled distance at most)
#define FAR_MAX 1.5f

// the level in use: the setting's, or (tests) SAVAGEWIND_DRAWDIST_AT=<script frame>:<level 0-3>,... from that frame of
// SAVAGEWIND_SCRIPT_CLOCK on, so one run (one weather, one camera) shows several levels
static int level(void) {
    static const char *at;
    static int init, forced = -1;
    if (!init) init = 1, at = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DRAWDIST_AT");
    if (at && *at) {
        extern uint64_t framepace_script_now(void);
        char *end;
        unsigned long long fr = strtoull(at, &end, 10);
        if (*end == ':' && framepace_script_now() >= fr) {
            forced = (int)strtol(end + 1, &end, 10);
            at = *end == ',' ? end + 1 : end;
        }
    }
    return forced >= 0 ? forced : g_settings.draw_distance;
}

// The nearer actors' factors were 1.5 and 1.6 until 2026-10-30: at Rito Village, a denser place than the six of round
// 3, the game then left the entrance bridge, its rocks and the houses out (only the far model of the cliffs was drawn,
// right next to Link). Walking onto that bridge from a save there (High's other factors kept): 1.1, 1.25 and 1.4 kept
// them, 1.5 and 1.6 did not. Medium 1.15 and High 1.3 (the user's choice) kept a margin under that, until High left
// out the wooden bridge with lanterns east of the village and its Rito NPC (user play test 2026-11-05, at
// -3421.5, 251, -1871.9): there 1.1, 1.2 and 1.25 kept them and 1.3 did not. High is 1.2 since.
// Potato (Alpha 5): nearer than on the console, for weak PCs, where the render thread's draws are the limit. 0.6 of the
// game's distances for the actors and the grass, 0.75 for the far models and the distant trees (RTX 3060 limited to
// 4 cores at 1280x720: Rito 101 -> 120 fps, the castle 148 -> 190-200, Kakariko 148 -> 159, Korok Forest 181 -> 197).
static const float k_factor[DRAWDIST_COUNT] = {1.0f, 1.15f, 1.2f, 0.6f};  // (DRAWDIST_*)
#define POTATO_FAR 0.75f

float draw_distance_factor(void) {
    static float env = -1;
    if (env < 0) {
        const char *s = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_TRAVERSE_SCALE");
        float f = s ? (float)atof(s) : 0;
        env = f >= 0.25f && f <= 8.0f ? f : 0;
    }
    if (env > 0) return env;
    int d = level();
    return d > DRAWDIST_ORIGINAL && d < DRAWDIST_COUNT ? k_factor[d] : 1.0f;
}

// the far models' and the distant trees' factor: the actors' one, at most FAR_MAX
static float far_factor(void) {
    static float env = -1;
    if (env < 0) {
        const char *s = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FAR_SCALE");
        float f = s ? (float)atof(s) : 0;
        env = f >= 0.25f && f <= 8.0f ? f : 0;
    }
    if (env > 0) return env;
    if (level() == DRAWDIST_POTATO && !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_TRAVERSE_SCALE")) return POTATO_FAR;
    float f = draw_distance_factor();
    return f > FAR_MAX ? FAR_MAX : f;
}

// The grass's own factors, by layer (1: the game's own; see the top).
// - Blades: their near region (the cells that get grass made and drawn) and their fade, at most these factors, and
//   only while their cell list has room: it holds 512 cells (inline in their manager, +0x878), the game's own play
//   fills 335-342 of it at the Great Plateau and in Hyrule Field, and a full list leaves holes in the grass by Link
//   (seen at 3x). The factor in use follows the list (blades_factor).
// - Crossed quads: their fade only. Their region (about 120 m in play) already holds the cells, and its list is full
//   in the game's own play (718-768 of 768).
static const float k_blades[DRAWDIST_COUNT] = {1.0f, 1.15f, 2.5f, 0.6f};  // (DRAWDIST_*)
static const float k_quads[DRAWDIST_COUNT] = {1.0f, 1.6f, 2.5f, 0.6f};
#define BLADE_LIST 512
#define BLADE_LIST_HIGH 485  // (listed cells past this: the factor goes down)
#define BLADE_LIST_LOW 455   // (below this: back up towards the level's)

// (tests) SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_BLADES=<x>, SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_QUADS=<x>: these factors instead of the setting's
static float env_factor(const char *name, float *cache) {
    if (*cache < 0) {
        const char *s = getenv(name);
        float f = s ? (float)atof(s) : 0;
        *cache = f >= 0.25f && f <= 8.0f ? f : 0;
    }
    return *cache;
}
static float grass_target(int quads) {
    static float env[2] = {-1, -1};
    float e = env_factor(quads ? "SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_QUADS" : "SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_BLADES", &env[quads]);
    if (e > 0) return e;
    int d = level();
    return d > DRAWDIST_ORIGINAL && d < DRAWDIST_COUNT ? (quads ? k_quads : k_blades)[d] : 1.0f;
}

static int grass_probe(void) {  // (tests) SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_PROBE=1: the grass layers' numbers in the log
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_PROBE") != NULL;
    return on;
}

// The blades' factor in use this frame: set once a frame by their fade store (grass_fade, which runs before their view
// context in the same update), from the level's target and how full their list was last frame: it climbs slowly
// while the list has room, drops fast when it nears full, and starts from the game's own where there is no grass (an
// empty list says nothing about how full the next field's would be).
static float g_blades = 1.0f;

static void blades_factor(uint64_t mgr) {
    float target = grass_target(0);
    if (target == 1.0f) { g_blades = 1.0f; return; }  // (Original)
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_NOGUARD")) { g_blades = target; return; }  // (tests: the target, list or not)
    uint32_t listed = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(mgr + 0x878);  // (last frame's: the update clears it later)
    float f = g_blades < 1.0f ? 1.0f : g_blades;
    if (listed == 0) f = 1.0f;
    else if (listed >= BLADE_LIST_HIGH) f = 1.0f + (f - 1.0f) * 0.8f;
    else if (listed < BLADE_LIST_LOW) f += 0.005f;
    if (f > target) f = target;
    g_blades = f;
}

// The blades' region is two slabs along the view (near, far), each as wide as the view is at its end. Grown 2.5 times
// it lists more cells than their list holds, so at High the part past the game's own near distance is a cone instead,
// CONE_WIDEN times as wide as the view (tan(fovy / 2) x aspect) plus CONE_MARGIN m (rt_grass_blade_lateral).
#define CONE_WIDEN 1.0f
#define CONE_MARGIN 4.0f
#define CONE_AHEAD 6.0f  // (the far part keeps this much past the near one: cells made just before they are needed)
static int g_cone;
static float g_cone_from, g_cone_to, g_cone_k;

// a blade cell's distance from the view's axis is checked against `lim` (part 0 near, 1 far: its half width + 1.5 m):
// x, z the cell's offset from the camera, d2 its squared distance, a, b the view direction (float bits) -> the half
// width to use. The far part, which lists cells ahead of the near one to make them early, keeps only CONE_AHEAD m.
float rt_grass_blade_lateral(int part, float lim, float x, float z, float d2, uint32_t a_bits, uint32_t b_bits) {
    if (!g_cone || d2 <= g_cone_from * g_cone_from) return lim;  // (Original, Medium, and the game's own near cells)
    float ahead = g_cone_to + CONE_AHEAD;
    if (part == 1 && d2 > ahead * ahead) return -1.0f;  // (never inside)
    union { uint32_t u; float f; } a = {.u = a_bits}, b = {.u = b_bits};
    float axis = a.f * x + b.f * z;  // (along the view; the half width is |a z - b x|)
    float w = axis * g_cone_k + CONE_MARGIN;
    return w < lim ? w : lim;
}

// the grass's view context (x2 the camera, s3 the layer's cell size: blades 3 m, crossed quads 10 m): s0 the least
// tan(fovy / 2) it takes (tan(10 deg)) and its two screen-size limits (float bits), as the game passes them; the
// region its cells are made in reaches 1 / (max(tan, s0) * limit) -> 1 when they change. For the blades the limits go
// down by their factor and s0 up by it: the near region reaches that many times further in a normal view, and the
// furthest one (a narrow view) stays the game's own, inside their grid.
int rt_grass_range(uint64_t cam, uint32_t cell_bits, uint32_t *s0, uint32_t *a, uint32_t *b) {
    union { uint32_t u; float f; } cell = {.u = cell_bits};
    int quads = !(cell.f < 5);
    if (grass_probe()) {
        static long n;
        if ((++n & 511) < 2) {
            union { uint32_t u; float f; } x = {.u = *s0}, p = {.u = *a}, q = {.u = *b};
            float t = *(float *)(uintptr_t)(cam + 0x134), tt = t > x.f ? t : x.f;
            LOG("[grass] %s: tan(fovy/2) %g, region %g m (the game's), furthest %g m\n", quads ? "crossed quads" : "blades",
                t, 1 / (tt * p.f) - 1 / (tt * q.f), 1 / (x.f * p.f));
        }
    }
    float f = quads ? 1.0f : g_blades;
    if (!quads) {  // (the blades' cone, for rt_grass_blade_lateral: at High only, past the game's own near distance)
        union { uint32_t u; float f; } x = {.u = *s0}, p = {.u = *a}, q = {.u = *b};
        float tn = *(float *)(uintptr_t)(cam + 0x134), asp = *(float *)(uintptr_t)(cam + 0x12c);
        float tt = tn > x.f ? tn : x.f;
        g_cone = f > 1.0f && level() == DRAWDIST_HIGH && !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_NOCONE");
        g_cone_from = 1 / (tt * p.f) - 1 / (tt * q.f);  // (the game's near distance this frame)
        g_cone_k = tn * (asp > 0 ? asp : 1.0f) * CONE_WIDEN;
    }
    if (f == 1.0f) return 0;  // (Original, and the crossed quads: the game's own)
    union { uint32_t u; float f; } t = {.u = *s0};
    if (t.f > 0 && t.f < 3.0e38f) t.f *= f;
    *s0 = t.u;
    uint32_t *v[2] = {a, b};
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        union { uint32_t u; float f; } x = {.u = *v[i]};
        if (x.f > 0 && x.f < 3.0e38f) x.f /= f;  // (0 or less, or FLT_MAX: the game's "no limit")
        *v[i] = x.u;
    }
    if (!quads) {  // (the near part's distance now, for the far part's cut)
        union { uint32_t u; float f; } x = {.u = *s0}, p = {.u = *a}, q = {.u = *b};
        float tn = *(float *)(uintptr_t)(cam + 0x134), tt = tn > x.f ? tn : x.f;
        g_cone_to = 1 / (tt * p.f) - 1 / (tt * q.f);
    }
    return 1;
}

// a grass layer's fade scale (float bits; its fades go as 1 / (k * distance)) as the game stores it once a frame (x: its
// manager) -> the one to store: k / the layer's factor, so its grass fades that many times further out
static uint32_t grass_fade(uint64_t mgr, uint32_t k, int quads) {
    if (!quads) blades_factor(mgr);
    float f = quads ? grass_target(1) : g_blades;
    if (grass_probe()) {
        static long n[2];
        if ((++n[quads] & (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_PROBE_ALL") ? 0 : 255)) == (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_PROBE_ALL") ? 0 : 1)) {
            const uint32_t *m = (const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)mgr;
            // (each list entry: u16 cell, u16 squared distance in m^2; the furthest one of each list)
            uint32_t dl = quads ? 0x288 : 0x68, ll = quads ? 0xe98 : 0x878, nd = m[dl / 4], nl = m[ll / 4], fd = 0, fl = 0;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nd && i < 1024; i++) { uint32_t d = m[dl / 4 + 1 + i] >> 16; if (d > fd) fd = d; }
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nl && i < 1024; i++) { uint32_t d = m[ll / 4 + 1 + i] >> 16; if (d > fl) fl = d; }
            if (quads) LOG("[grass] crossed quads: %u cells drawn (furthest %.0f m), %u listed (of 768, furthest %.0f m), "
                           "factor %g\n", nd, sqrt((double)fd), nl, sqrt((double)fl), f);
            else {
                // (the draw slots, 0x78 bytes each at +0x37388: +0x41 the half of their shader block in use; slots
                // the per-frame pass skipped keep another half than slot 0's)
                const uint8_t *slots = *(const uint8_t *const *)(uintptr_t)(mgr + 0x37388);
                uint32_t ns = m[0x37380 / 4], stale = 0;
                for (uint32_t i = 1; slots && i < nd && i < ns; i++) stale += slots[i * 0x78 + 0x41] != slots[0x41];
                LOG("[grass] blades: %u cells drawn (of %u, furthest %.0f m, %u on another half), %u listed (of %d, "
                    "furthest %.0f m), factor %g (level's %g)\n", nd, ns, sqrt((double)fd), stale, nl, BLADE_LIST,
                    sqrt((double)fl), f, grass_target(0));
            }
        }
    }
    if (f == 1.0f) return k;  // (Original: the game's own, bit for bit)
    union { uint32_t u; float f; } x = {.u = k};
    if (x.f > 0 && x.f < 3.0e38f) x.f /= f;
    return x.u;
}
// The blades' draw slots, made once when the grass is set up at boot (the game's 256). At High there are 512, for a
// region up to 2.5 times the game's; the two passes that stop at the 256th cell stop at the last slot instead.
// (Original and Medium: the game's 256 and 255, so a game started at those levels draws as the game does.)
#define BLADE_SLOTS_HIGH 512
static uint32_t g_blade_slots = 0x100;
uint32_t rt_grass_blade_slots(uint32_t game) {
    const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_SLOTS");  // (tests: this many instead)
    g_blade_slots = e && atoi(e) >= 16 && atoi(e) <= 4096 ? (uint32_t)atoi(e) :
                    level() == DRAWDIST_HIGH ? BLADE_SLOTS_HIGH : game;
    if (g_blade_slots != game) LOG("[draw distance] grass blades: %u draw slots (game %u)\n", g_blade_slots, game);
    return g_blade_slots;
}
uint32_t rt_grass_blade_cap(void) { return g_blade_slots - 1; }
// ... and the per-frame pass that points each slot at this frame's half of its shader block (tools/patches.py
// _grass_blade_cap_swap): every slot, or a slot past the 256th keeps another frame's half and its cell flickers.
// (tests) SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_OLDSWAP=1: the game's 256 there, as round 3 had it.
uint32_t rt_grass_blade_swap_cap(void) {
    static int old = -1;
    if (old < 0) old = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GRASS_OLDSWAP") != NULL;
    return old ? 0xff : g_blade_slots - 1;
}

uint32_t rt_grass_fade_blades(uint64_t mgr, uint32_t k) { return grass_fade(mgr, k, 0); }
uint32_t rt_grass_fade_quads(uint64_t mgr, uint32_t k) { return grass_fade(mgr, k, 1); }

// the terrain's distant trees (x0 of their per-frame shader setup): their five ranges at +0x14cb0 (where they fade in,
// that fade, how far they go, the fade out, where their blocks change detail) from the game's values times the
// factor. The game writes them again as it plays (about twice a frame in play; the end distance is 4000 m, sometimes
// 4444.5), so ranges that aren't the ones last set here are the game's new ones and are scaled again. (Each object
// keeps its own: one object's ranges are never taken from another's, already scaled ones.)
void rt_tree_ranges(uint64_t tree) {
    static struct { uint64_t obj; float game[5], set[5]; } t[4];
    static int n, next;
    static float logged = 1.0f;
    float *r = (float *)(uintptr_t)(tree + 0x14cb0);
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n && t[i].obj != tree) i++;
    if (i == n) {
        i = n < 4 ? n++ : next++ & 3;
        t[i].obj = tree;
        memcpy(t[i].game, r, sizeof t[i].game);
        memcpy(t[i].set, r, sizeof t[i].set);
    } else if (memcmp(r, t[i].set, sizeof t[i].set)) {
        memcpy(t[i].game, r, sizeof t[i].game);
        memcpy(t[i].set, r, sizeof t[i].set);
    }
    // Where they fade in (the first two) stays the game's (100-200 m) at every level. Actor trees made farther out
    // overlap them for longer, but there is always a tree drawn while the game makes the actors entering range a few at
    // a time: with the fade-in moved out with the actors (High: 160-320 m), a tree inside 160 m whose actor was not made
    // yet was not drawn at all, then popped in (the user's play test, #88). How far they go (the last three) takes
    // the far models' factor.
    float f = far_factor(), fnear = 1.0f, want[5];
    static float env_near = -1, env_far = -1;  // (tests) SAVAGEWIND_TREE_NEAR / _FAR=<x>: the first two / last three
    float fn = env_factor("SAVAGEWIND_TREE_NEAR", &env_near), ff = env_factor("SAVAGEWIND_TREE_FAR", &env_far);
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++)  // (Original: x 1, the game's own bits)
        want[k] = t[i].game[k] * (k < 2 ? (fn > 0 ? fn : fnear) : (ff > 0 ? ff : f));
    if (!memcmp(want, r, sizeof want)) return;  // (nothing to write)
    memcpy(r, want, sizeof want);
    memcpy(t[i].set, want, sizeof want);
    if (f != logged) LOG("[draw distance] terrain's distant trees: to %.0f m (game %.0f m)\n", want[2], t[i].game[2]);
    logged = f;
}

// the traverse distance scale (float bits) as the game has it, and the actor's own distance (float bits; 0 or less:
// the game takes 100) -> the scale to use
uint32_t rt_traverse_scale(uint32_t scale, uint32_t dist) {
    float f = draw_distance_factor();
    if (f == 1.0f) return scale;  // (Original: the game's own, bit for bit)
    static float near_max = -1, near_min = -1;
    if (near_max < 0) {
        const char *a = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NEAR_MAX"), *b = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NEAR_MIN");
        near_max = a && atof(a) >= 100 ? (float)atof(a) : NEAR_MAX;
        near_min = b ? (float)atof(b) : 0;
    }
    union { uint32_t u; float f; } s = {.u = scale}, d = {.u = dist};
    float game = (d.f > 0 ? d.f : 100.0f) * s.f;  // (the game's distance)
    if (game >= FAR_DIST) f = far_factor();
    else if (game < near_min) f = 1.0f;
    else if (f > 1.0f && game * f > near_max) f = game < near_max ? near_max / game : 1.0f;  // (never below the game's)
    s.f *= f;
    return s.u;
}
```

`runtime/dsu.c`:

```c
// Protocol reference: https://v1993.github.io/cemuhook-protocol/
// Axis cross-check: kmicki/SteamDeckGyroDSU (MIT), cemuhookadapter.cpp / sdhidframe.h,
// and SDL's HIDAPI Steam Deck driver (zlib). This is an independent implementation.
#include "dsu.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <mstcpip.h>
#ifndef SIO_UDP_CONNRESET
#define SIO_UDP_CONNRESET _WSAIOW(IOC_VENDOR, 12)
#endif
#else
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

static uint16_t le16(const uint8_t *p) { return p[0] | (uint16_t)p[1] << 8; }
static uint32_t le32(const uint8_t *p) { return le16(p) | (uint32_t)le16(p + 2) << 16; }
static uint64_t le64(const uint8_t *p) { return le32(p) | (uint64_t)le32(p + 4) << 32; }
static void put32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) p[i] = v >> (8 * i); }
static float lefloat(const uint8_t *p) {
    uint32_t bits = le32(p);
    float f;
    memcpy(&f, &bits, 4);
    return f;
}

uint32_t dsu_crc(const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    uint32_t crc = ~0u;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        crc ^= i >= 8 && i < 12 ? 0 : p[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb88320u & (0u - (crc & 1)));
    }
    return ~crc;
}

size_t dsu_request(uint8_t out[28], uint32_t client, uint32_t type, int slot) {
    size_t n = type == 0x100000 ? 20 : 28;
    memset(out, 0, 28);
    memcpy(out, "DSUC", 4);
    out[4] = 0xe9, out[5] = 3;  // protocol 1001
    out[6] = n - 16;
    put32(out + 12, client);
    put32(out + 16, type);
    if (type == 0x100001) {
        put32(out + 20, 4);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) out[24 + i] = i;
    } else if (type == 0x100002) {
        out[20] = 1, out[21] = slot;  // subscribe to exactly one slot
    }
    put32(out + 8, dsu_crc(out, n));
    return n;
}

bool dsu_decode(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, DsuPacket *out) {
    if (n < 20 || memcmp(p, "DSUS", 4) || le16(p + 4) != 1001) return false;
    size_t size = 16u + le16(p + 6);
    if (size < 20 || size > n) return false;
    // SteamDeckGyroDSU 2.1: VersionData has two C++ padding bytes, CRC covers all 24 bytes,
    // and PrepareAnswerConstants leaves eventType at zero. Accept only that exact legacy reply.
    bool deck_version = size == 22 && n == 24 && le32(p + 16) == 0 &&
                        le16(p + 20) == 1001 && !p[22] && !p[23] && le32(p + 8) == dsu_crc(p, 24);
    if (!deck_version && le32(p + 8) != dsu_crc(p, size)) return false;
    DsuPacket v = {.type = deck_version ? 0x100000 : le32(p + 16), .server = le32(p + 12)};
    if (v.type == 0x100000) {
        if (size != 22 || le16(p + 20) < 1001) return false;
    } else if (v.type == 0x100001 || v.type == 0x100002) {
        if (size != (v.type == 0x100001 ? 32 : 100) || p[20] > 3 || p[21] > 2) return false;
        v.slot = p[20], v.state = p[21], v.model = p[22];
        memcpy(v.mac, p + 24, 6);
        if (v.type == 0x100002) {
            v.connected = p[31] == 1 && v.state == 2;
            v.sequence = le32(p + 32);
            v.timestamp = le64(p + 68);
            double a[3], w[3];
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                a[i] = lefloat(p + 76 + 4 * i);
                w[i] = lefloat(p + 88 + 4 * i);
                if (!isfinite(a[i]) || !isfinite(w[i]) || fabs(a[i]) > 32 || fabs(w[i]) > 10000) return false;
            }
            // DSU -> SDL: acceleration = (-X,-Y,-Z)*gravity; gyro = (pitch,-yaw,-roll)*pi/180.
            // Then the same SDL -> Switch mapping as motion_sensor_event. Flat DSU: (0,-1,0).
            const double rad = 3.14159265358979323846 / 180;
            v.acc[0] = a[0], v.acc[1] = -a[2], v.acc[2] = a[1];
            v.gyro[0] = w[0] * rad, v.gyro[1] = w[2] * rad, v.gyro[2] = -w[1] * rad;
        }
    } else return false;
    *out = v;
    return true;
}

static void forget(DsuClient *c) {
    c->fresh = c->have_sequence = false;
    c->slot = -1;
    c->generation++;
}

void dsu_expire(DsuClient *c, uint64_t now) {
    if (c->have_sequence && now - c->received >= DSU_TIMEOUT_NS) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[dsu] disconnected: motion timeout; retrying\n");
        forget(c);
        c->retry = 0;
    }
}

bool dsu_accept(DsuClient *c, const DsuPacket *p, uint64_t now) {
    if (p->type != 0x100002 || c->slot != p->slot || c->server != p->server || memcmp(c->mac, p->mac, 6)) return false;
    if (!p->connected) { forget(c); c->retry = 0; return false; }
    if (c->have_sequence) {
        uint32_t delta = p->sequence - c->sequence;
        if (!delta || delta >= 0x80000000u || p->timestamp <= c->timestamp) return false;
    }
    double an = p->acc[0]*p->acc[0] + p->acc[1]*p->acc[1] + p->acc[2]*p->acc[2];
    if (an < 0.01) return false;  // uninitialized/all-zero motion is not a usable sensor
    if (!c->fresh) fprintf(stderr, "[dsu] connected: slot %d, server %08x\n", c->slot, c->server);
    c->fresh = c->have_sequence = true;
    c->sequence = p->sequence, c->timestamp = p->timestamp, c->received = now;
    return true;
}

// "a.b.c.d" -> the address in network order (as inet_pton gives it)
static bool ipv4(const char *s, uint32_t *out) {
    uint8_t b[4];
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        char *end;
        if (*s < '0' || *s > '9') return false;
        unsigned long v = strtoul(s, &end, 10);
        if (v > 255 || end - s > 3 || (i < 3 ? *end != '.' : *end != 0)) return false;
        b[i] = (uint8_t)v, s = end + (i < 3);
    }
    memcpy(out, b, 4);
    return true;
}

bool dsu_init(DsuClient *c, const char *endpoint, uint32_t client) {
    *c = (DsuClient){.fd = -1, .slot = -1, .client = client, .port = 26760};
    char host[64] = "127.0.0.1";
    if (endpoint) {
        const char *colon = strchr(endpoint, ':');
        if (!colon || colon == endpoint || (size_t)(colon - endpoint) >= sizeof host) goto bad;
        memcpy(host, endpoint, colon - endpoint);
        host[colon - endpoint] = 0;
        char *end;
        long port = strtol(colon + 1, &end, 10);
        if (!colon[1] || *end || port < 1 || port > 65535) goto bad;
        c->port = port;
    }
    if (!ipv4(host, &c->address)) goto bad;
    c->enabled = true;
    fprintf(stderr, "[dsu] enabled: %s:%u (nonblocking)\n", host, c->port);
    return true;
bad:
    fprintf(stderr, "[dsu] invalid SAVAGEWIND_DSU_ENDPOINT; use numeric IPv4:port\n");
    return false;
}

// ---- the socket: UDP, nonblocking (POSIX sockets; Winsock on Windows)
#ifdef _WIN32
#define SOCK(c) ((SOCKET)(c)->fd)
#endif

void dsu_close(DsuClient *c) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (c->fd >= 0) closesocket(SOCK(c));
#else
    if (c->fd >= 0) close((int)c->fd);
#endif
    c->fd = -1;
    forget(c);
}

static bool dsu_open(DsuClient *c) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    static bool wsa;
    if (!wsa) {
        WSADATA data;
        if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &data)) return false;
        wsa = true;
    }
    SOCKET s = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
    if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) return false;
    u_long on = 1;
    BOOL no = FALSE;
    DWORD got = 0;
    ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &on);
    // (no server listening: Windows reports ICMP "port unreachable" as a reset on the next recv; not an error here)
    WSAIoctl(s, SIO_UDP_CONNRESET, &no, sizeof no, NULL, 0, &got, NULL, NULL);
    c->fd = (intptr_t)s;
#else
    int s = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
    if (s < 0) return false;
    c->fd = s;
#endif
    struct sockaddr_in addr;
    memset(&addr, 0, sizeof addr);
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET, addr.sin_port = htons(c->port), addr.sin_addr.s_addr = c->address;
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (connect(SOCK(c), (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof addr)) { dsu_close(c); return false; }
#else
    if (connect((int)c->fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof addr)) { dsu_close(c); return false; }
#endif
    return true;
}

static void request(DsuClient *c, uint32_t type) {
    uint8_t p[28];
    size_t n = dsu_request(p, c->client, type, c->slot);
    // Transient errors (including ICMP port unreachable) are retried at the next heartbeat.
#ifdef _WIN32
    (void)send(SOCK(c), (const char *)p, (int)n, 0);
#else
    (void)send((int)c->fd, p, n, MSG_DONTWAIT);
#endif
}

// One datagram: its length (more than size: cut short), 0 none waiting, -1 the socket failed
static long receive(DsuClient *c, uint8_t *data, size_t size) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    int n = recv(SOCK(c), (char *)data, (int)size, 0);
    if (n >= 0) return n;
    int e = WSAGetLastError();
    return e == WSAEMSGSIZE ? (long)size + 1 : e == WSAEWOULDBLOCK || e == WSAECONNRESET || e == WSAEINTR ? 0 : -1;
#else
    ssize_t n = recv((int)c->fd, data, size, MSG_DONTWAIT | MSG_TRUNC);
    if (n >= 0) return (long)n;
    return errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK || errno == ECONNREFUSED || errno == EINTR ? 0 : -1;
#endif
}

void dsu_poll(DsuClient *c, uint64_t now, DsuSampleFn sample, void *user) {
    if (!c->enabled) return;
    dsu_expire(c, now);
    if (!c->retry || now >= c->retry) {
        c->retry = now + DSU_RETRY_NS;
        if (c->fd < 0 && !dsu_open(c)) return;
        request(c, 0x100000);
        request(c, 0x100001);
        if (c->slot >= 0) request(c, 0x100002);
    }
    // Bounded work even if a server floods the socket. Process each queued motion sample for fusion.
    for (int i = 0; i < 128 && c->fd >= 0; i++) {
        uint8_t data[2048];
        long n = receive(c, data, sizeof data);
        if (n <= 0) {
            if (n < 0) dsu_close(c);
            break;
        }
        DsuPacket p;
        if ((size_t)n > sizeof data || !dsu_decode(data, n, &p)) {
            if (!c->invalid_log || now >= c->invalid_log) {
                fprintf(stderr, "[dsu] invalid packet ignored (header/length/CRC/motion)\n");
                c->invalid_log = now + 5000000000ull;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (p.type == 0x100001) {
            if (c->slot >= 0 && p.server != c->server) { forget(c); c->retry = 0; }
            if (p.slot == c->slot && (p.state != 2 || memcmp(c->mac, p.mac, 6))) { forget(c); c->retry = 0; }
            if (c->slot < 0 && p.state == 2 && p.model == 2) {
                c->slot = p.slot, c->server = p.server;
                memcpy(c->mac, p.mac, 6);
                c->generation++;
                request(c, 0x100002);
            }
        } else if (dsu_accept(c, &p, now) && sample) sample(&p, c->generation, user);
    }
}
```

`runtime/dsu.h`:

```h
// Small Cemuhook (DSU) client, Linux and Windows. No SDL, threads, DNS or blocking I/O.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define DSU_TIMEOUT_NS 500000000ull
#define DSU_RETRY_NS 1000000000ull

typedef struct {
    uint32_t type, server, sequence;
    uint8_t slot, state, model, mac[6];
    bool connected;
    uint64_t timestamp;  // server microseconds
    double acc[3], gyro[3];  // existing motion fusion axes: gravity in G, angular velocity in rad/s
} DsuPacket;

typedef struct {
    intptr_t fd;  // the socket (-1: none; Windows: a SOCKET)
    int slot;
    bool enabled, fresh, have_sequence;
    uint32_t client, server, sequence, generation;
    uint8_t mac[6];
    uint64_t received, timestamp, retry, invalid_log;
    uint32_t address;
    uint16_t port;
} DsuClient;

typedef void (*DsuSampleFn)(const DsuPacket *, uint32_t generation, void *);
// Packet helpers are independent of sockets and host endianness (also used by tests).
uint32_t dsu_crc(const uint8_t *p, size_t n);
size_t dsu_request(uint8_t out[28], uint32_t client, uint32_t type, int slot);
bool dsu_decode(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, DsuPacket *out);
void dsu_expire(DsuClient *c, uint64_t now);
bool dsu_accept(DsuClient *c, const DsuPacket *p, uint64_t now);
bool dsu_init(DsuClient *c, const char *endpoint, uint32_t client);
void dsu_close(DsuClient *c);
void dsu_poll(DsuClient *c, uint64_t now, DsuSampleFn sample, void *user);
```

`runtime/fnprof.c`:

```c
// Function-entry profiler. SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF=<from>:<to> counts guest function entries (every generated
// function calls FN_ENTER) between those presented frames, then writes build/fnprof.txt (addr count, most
// called first). Diffing two runs shows which game functions a change brings in; counts also show hot code.
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "hle.h"
#include "platform.h"

volatile int g_fnprof;

#define NSLOT (1 << 18)
static struct { _Atomic uint64_t addr; _Atomic uint64_t count; } slots[NSLOT];

// SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_BT=<hex addr>[,...]: also print the host backtrace (guest functions are f_<addr>) the first time
// each listed function is entered inside the window - who calls it
static uint64_t bt_addrs[256];
static int bt_n = -1;
static _Atomic uint8_t bt_done[256];

uint64_t g_bt_first_x0;

static void bt_check(uint64_t a, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) {
    if (bt_n < 0) {
        bt_n = 0;
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_BT");
        for (const char *p = e; p && *p && bt_n < 256;) {
            bt_addrs[bt_n++] = strtoull(p, (char **)&p, 16);
            while (*p == ',' || *p == ' ') p++;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < bt_n; i++)
        if (bt_addrs[i] == a && !atomic_exchange(&bt_done[i], 1)) {
            if (i == 0) g_bt_first_x0 = x0;
            uint64_t vt = x0 >= 0x7000000000ull && x0 < 0x7800000000ull ? *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)x0 : 0;
            uint64_t v100 = vt >= 0x7000000000ull && vt < 0x7800000000ull ? *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(vt + 0x100) : 0;
            uint64_t p8 = x0 >= 0x7000000000ull && x0 < 0x7800000000ull ? *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(x0 + 8) : 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "[fnprof-bt] %llx entered from guest lr %llx x0 %llx (vtable %llx, +0x100 %llx, [x0+8] %llx):\n",
                    (unsigned long long)a, (unsigned long long)lr, (unsigned long long)x0, (unsigned long long)vt,
                    (unsigned long long)v100, (unsigned long long)p8);
            plat_print_backtrace();  // (execinfo is macOS / glibc only)
        }
}

// SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_ARGS=<hex addr>[,...]: log x0-x5 and the caller on each entry of those functions (the first
// SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_ARGS_MAX entries each, default 64) - what a function is called with, without a debugger - and
// what one register points to: SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_DEREF=<reg>:<qwords> (default 1:4, x1: often a descriptor or out
// argument).
static uint64_t args_addrs[64];
static int args_n = -1, args_max = 64, deref_reg = 1, deref_n = 4;
static _Atomic int args_count[64];

static void args_check(uint64_t a, uint64_t lr) {
    if (args_n < 0) {
        args_n = 0;
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_ARGS");
        if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_ARGS_MAX")) args_max = atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_ARGS_MAX"));
        if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_DEREF")) sscanf(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_DEREF"), "%d:%d", &deref_reg, &deref_n);
        if (deref_reg < 0 || deref_reg > 30) deref_reg = 1;
        if (deref_n < 0 || deref_n > 64) deref_n = 4;
        for (const char *p = e; p && *p && args_n < 64;) {
            args_addrs[args_n++] = strtoull(p, (char **)&p, 16);
            while (*p == ',' || *p == ' ') p++;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < args_n; i++)
        if (args_addrs[i] == a && atomic_fetch_add(&args_count[i], 1) < args_max) {
            Cpu *c = kernel_current_cpu();
            if (!c) return;
            char line[1600];
            int n = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[fnprof-args] %llx from %llx: %llx %llx %llx %llx %llx %llx [x%d:",
                             (unsigned long long)a, (unsigned long long)lr, (unsigned long long)c->x[0],
                             (unsigned long long)c->x[1], (unsigned long long)c->x[2], (unsigned long long)c->x[3],
                             (unsigned long long)c->x[4], (unsigned long long)c->x[5], deref_reg);
            uint64_t p = c->x[deref_reg];
            for (int k = 0; k < deref_n && p >= GUEST_LO && p + 8 * (k + 1) <= GUEST_HI; k++) {
                uint64_t v = ((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)p)[k];
                n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, " %llx", (unsigned long long)v);
                const char *s = (const char *)(uintptr_t)v;  // a pointer to text (a name): show it
                int len = 0;
                if (v >= GUEST_LO && v + 64 <= GUEST_HI)
                    while (len < 64 && s[len] >= 0x20 && s[len] < 0x7f) len++;
                if (len >= 4 && (len == 64 || !s[len]) && n < (int)sizeof line - 80)
                    n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, "=\"%.*s\"", len, s);
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "%s]\n", line);
        }
}

void fnprof_hit(uint64_t a, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) {
    if (bt_n) bt_check(a, lr, x0);
    if (args_n) args_check(a, lr);
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)((a >> 2) * 0x9E3779B1u) & (NSLOT - 1);
    for (int n = 0; n < NSLOT; n++, h = (h + 1) & (NSLOT - 1)) {
        uint64_t cur = atomic_load_explicit(&slots[h].addr, memory_order_relaxed);
        if (cur == a || (cur == 0 && atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&slots[h].addr, &cur, a)) || cur == a) {
            atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&slots[h].count, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
            return;
        }
    }
}

static int cmp(const void *x, const void *y) {
    uint64_t a = ((const uint64_t *)x)[1], b = ((const uint64_t *)y)[1];
    return a < b ? 1 : a > b ? -1 : 0;
}

void fnprof_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    static long from = -2, to;
    if (from == -2) {
        from = -1;
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF");
        if (e && sscanf(e, "%ld:%ld", &from, &to) != 2) from = -1;
    }
    if (from < 0) return;
    if ((long)frame == from) { g_fnprof = 1; LOG("[fnprof] on at frame %llu\n", (unsigned long long)frame); }
    if ((long)frame != to) return;
    g_fnprof = 0;
    uint64_t (*rows)[2] = malloc(sizeof(uint64_t[2]) * NSLOT);
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NSLOT; i++)
        if (slots[i].addr) { rows[n][0] = slots[i].addr; rows[n][1] = slots[i].count; n++; }
    qsort(rows, n, sizeof rows[0], cmp);
    const char *out = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_OUT") ? getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF_OUT") : "build/fnprof.txt";  // (parallel runs)
    FILE *f = fopen(out, "w");
    for (int i = 0; f && i < n; i++) fprintf(f, "%llx %llu\n", (unsigned long long)rows[i][0], (unsigned long long)rows[i][1]);
    if (f) fclose(f);
    free(rows);
    LOG("[fnprof] %d functions, written %s (frames %ld-%ld)\n", n, out, from, to);
    from = -1;
}

// SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF=0:<to>: profile from process start (threads the game starts before the first frame)
__attribute__((constructor)) static void fnprof_early(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FNPROF");
    if (e && e[0] == '0' && e[1] == ':') g_fnprof = 1;
}
```

`runtime/game_file_size.c`:

```c
#include "game_file_size.h"
#include "game_files.h"
#include <errno.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#else
#include <dirent.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

typedef struct {
    RtGameFilesSize result;
    bool (*cancelled)(void *);
    void *user;
} Scan;

static bool stopped(Scan *s) {
    if (s->result.cancelled || (s->cancelled && s->cancelled(s->user))) {
        s->result.cancelled = true;
        s->result.complete = false;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static void add(Scan *s, unsigned long long bytes) {
    if (bytes > ULLONG_MAX - s->result.bytes) s->result.complete = false;
    else s->result.bytes += bytes;
}

#ifdef _WIN32
static wchar_t *child_path(const wchar_t *parent, const wchar_t *name) {
    size_t a = wcslen(parent), b = wcslen(name);
    wchar_t *p = malloc((a + b + 2) * sizeof *p);
    if (p) { memcpy(p, parent, a * sizeof *p); p[a] = L'\\'; memcpy(p + a + 1, name, (b + 1) * sizeof *p); }
    return p;
}

// Absolute, extended-length paths keep the worker independent of relative-path parsing and preserve Unicode names.
static wchar_t *windows_root(const char *path) {
    int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, path, -1, NULL, 0);
    if (!n) return NULL;
    wchar_t *input = malloc((size_t)n * sizeof *input);
    if (!input) return NULL;
    if (!MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, path, -1, input, n)) { free(input); return NULL; }
    for (wchar_t *p = input; *p; ++p) if (*p == L'/') *p = L'\\';
    DWORD len = GetFullPathNameW(input, 0, NULL, NULL);
    wchar_t *full = len ? malloc((size_t)len * sizeof *full) : NULL;
    DWORD got = full ? GetFullPathNameW(input, len, full, NULL) : 0;
    free(input);
    if (!got || got >= len) { free(full); return NULL; }
    if (!wcsncmp(full, L"\\\\?\\", 4)) return full;
    bool unc = !wcsncmp(full, L"\\\\", 2);
    const wchar_t *prefix = unc ? L"\\\\?\\UNC\\" : L"\\\\?\\";
    size_t prefix_len = wcslen(prefix), skip = unc ? 2 : 0;
    wchar_t *extended = malloc((prefix_len + got - skip + 1) * sizeof *extended);
    if (extended) {
        memcpy(extended, prefix, prefix_len * sizeof *extended);
        memcpy(extended + prefix_len, full + skip, (got - skip + 1) * sizeof *extended);
    }
    free(full);
    return extended;
}

static void windows_entry(Scan *s, const wchar_t *path, DWORD attributes, DWORD high, DWORD low) {
    if (stopped(s) || (attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT)) return;
    if (!(attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)) { add(s, ((unsigned long long)high << 32) | low); return; }
    wchar_t *pattern = child_path(path, L"*");
    if (!pattern) { s->result.complete = false; return; }
    WIN32_FIND_DATAW entry;
    HANDLE find = FindFirstFileExW(pattern, FindExInfoBasic, &entry, FindExSearchNameMatch, NULL, 0);
    free(pattern);
    if (find == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        if (GetLastError() != ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) s->result.complete = false;
        return;
    }
    for (;;) {
        if (stopped(s)) break;
        if (wcscmp(entry.cFileName, L".") && wcscmp(entry.cFileName, L"..") &&
            !(entry.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT)) {
            if (entry.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) {
                wchar_t *child = child_path(path, entry.cFileName);
                if (!child) s->result.complete = false;
                else { windows_entry(s, child, entry.dwFileAttributes, 0, 0); free(child); }
            } else add(s, ((unsigned long long)entry.nFileSizeHigh << 32) | entry.nFileSizeLow);
        }
        if (!FindNextFileW(find, &entry)) {
            if (GetLastError() != ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES) s->result.complete = false;
            break;
        }
    }
    FindClose(find);
}
#elif defined(__linux__)
// One metadata lookup per child, relative to the open parent rather than resolving its whole path again.
static void linux_directory(Scan *s, int fd) {
    DIR *dir = fdopendir(fd);
    if (!dir) { close(fd); s->result.complete = false; return; }
    while (!stopped(s)) {
        errno = 0;
        struct dirent *entry = readdir(dir);
        if (!entry) { if (errno) s->result.complete = false; break; }
        if (!strcmp(entry->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(entry->d_name, "..")) continue;
        struct stat st;
        if (fstatat(fd, entry->d_name, &st, AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW)) { s->result.complete = false; continue; }
        if (S_ISLNK(st.st_mode)) continue;
        if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
            int child = openat(fd, entry->d_name, O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
            if (child < 0) s->result.complete = false;
            else linux_directory(s, child);
        } else if (st.st_size < 0) s->result.complete = false;
        else add(s, (unsigned long long)st.st_size);
    }
    closedir(dir);
}
#else
// macOS retains the portable traversal; native bulk metadata fetching needs its own platform validation.
static void portable_entry(Scan *s, const char *path) {
    if (stopped(s)) return;
    struct stat st;
    if (lstat(path, &st)) { s->result.complete = false; return; }
    if (S_ISLNK(st.st_mode)) return;
    if (stat(path, &st)) { s->result.complete = false; return; }
    if (!S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) { add(s, (unsigned long long)st.st_size); return; }
    DIR *dir = opendir(path);
    if (!dir) { s->result.complete = false; return; }
    while (!stopped(s)) {
        errno = 0;
        struct dirent *entry = readdir(dir);
        if (!entry) { if (errno) s->result.complete = false; break; }
        if (!strcmp(entry->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(entry->d_name, "..")) continue;
        size_t len = strlen(path) + strlen(entry->d_name) + 2;
        char *child = malloc(len);
        if (!child) { s->result.complete = false; break; }
        snprintf(child, len, "%s/%s", path, entry->d_name);
        portable_entry(s, child);
        free(child);
    }
    closedir(dir);
}
#endif

RtGameFilesSize rt_game_files_size_scan(const char *game_dir, bool (*cancelled)(void *), void *user) {
    Scan s = {.result = {.complete = true}, .cancelled = cancelled, .user = user};
    if (!game_dir || !*game_dir) { s.result.complete = false; return s.result; }
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t *root = windows_root(game_dir);
    if (!root) { s.result.complete = false; return s.result; }
#endif
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof GAME_FILES / sizeof *GAME_FILES && !stopped(&s); ++i) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        wchar_t name[64];
        if (!MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, GAME_FILES[i], -1, name, 64)) { s.result.complete = false; break; }
        wchar_t *path = child_path(root, name);
        if (!path) { s.result.complete = false; break; }
        WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA data;
        if (GetFileAttributesExW(path, GetFileExInfoStandard, &data))
            windows_entry(&s, path, data.dwFileAttributes, data.nFileSizeHigh, data.nFileSizeLow);
        else {
            DWORD error = GetLastError();
            if (error != ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND && error != ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND) s.result.complete = false;
        }
        free(path);
#else
        size_t len = strlen(game_dir) + strlen(GAME_FILES[i]) + 2;
        char *path = malloc(len);
        if (!path) { s.result.complete = false; break; }
        snprintf(path, len, "%s/%s", game_dir, GAME_FILES[i]);
        struct stat st;
        if (lstat(path, &st)) {
            if (errno != ENOENT && errno != ENOTDIR) s.result.complete = false;
        } else if (!S_ISLNK(st.st_mode)) {
#if defined(__linux__)
            if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
                int fd = open(path, O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC);
                if (fd < 0) s.result.complete = false;
                else linux_directory(&s, fd);
            } else if (st.st_size < 0) s.result.complete = false;
            else add(&s, (unsigned long long)st.st_size);
#else
            portable_entry(&s, path);
#endif
        }
        free(path);
#endif
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    free(root);
#endif
    return s.result;
}

unsigned long long rt_game_files_size(const char *game_dir) { return rt_game_files_size_scan(game_dir, NULL, NULL).bytes; }
```

```h
// Informational logical size of the recognized extracted game files. Never used to authorize deletion.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct {
    unsigned long long bytes;
    bool complete;   // false on an access/enumeration error; bytes is then only a partial total
    bool cancelled;
} RtGameFilesSize;

// The caller owns game_dir for the duration of the call. Windows paths are UTF-8.
// cancelled may be NULL; otherwise it is polled between entries and directory operations.

unsigned long long rt_game_files_size(const char *game_dir);

}
#endif
```

`runtime/game_place.c`:

```c
// Where the player is (game_place.h). game_place_on_read keeps the last stage the game loaded; game_place_text turns it
// and Link's position into text.
#include "game_place.h"

#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef enum { INTERIOR_SHRINE, INTERIOR_BEAST, INTERIOR_TRIAL } InteriorKind;
#define PLACE_LANGUAGES 16
typedef struct { float x, z, radius; bool town; const char *name[PLACE_LANGUAGES]; } PlaceEntry;
typedef struct { const char *pack, *name[PLACE_LANGUAGES]; InteriorKind kind; } InteriorEntry;

// The names are the game's own text, so the table is never committed: make writes it from your extracted/ (Makefile)
#if __has_include("game_place_table.inc")
#include "game_place_table.inc"
#else  // (no game files: no names, English)
static const char *const place_languages[PLACE_LANGUAGES] = {"USen"};
static const char *const place_texts[PLACE_LANGUAGES][5] = {{"In the main menu", "Exploring", "Inside a shrine", "Divine Beast", "Interior"}};
static const PlaceEntry place_table[] = {{0, 0, 1, false, {NULL}}};
static const char *const region_names[1][PLACE_LANGUAGES] = {{"Hyrule"}};
static const char region_grid[80][101] = {{0}};
static const InteriorEntry interior_table[] = {{"", {"Interior"}, INTERIOR_TRIAL}};
#endif

#define COUNT(a) (sizeof(a) / sizeof *(a))
enum { STAGE_TITLE = -2, STAGE_FIELD = -1 };  // or an index of interior_table
static atomic_int stage = STAGE_TITLE;
static int lang;  // an index of place_languages

void game_place_set_language(const char *language) {
    if (!strcmp(language, "en")) language = "USen";
    if (!strcmp(language, "es")) language = "USes";
    for (int i = 0; i < PLACE_LANGUAGES; i++)
        if (place_languages[i] && !strcmp(language, place_languages[i])) lang = i;
}

void game_place_on_read(const char *path) {
    if (!path) return;
    // The main field is coming back. Its map files stay cached over a shrine, these are read again; none of them is read
    // inside one (unlike UI/MapTex/MainField/, the map screen's)
    static const char *const field[] = {"Map/MainField/", "Physics/StaticCompound/MainField/",
                                        "Physics/TeraMeshRigidBody/MainField/", "NavMesh/MainField/"};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < COUNT(field); i++)
        if (!strncmp(path, field[i], strlen(field[i]))) { atomic_store(&stage, STAGE_FIELD); return; }
    if (strncmp(path, "Pack/", 5)) return;
    const char *name = path + 5;
    if (!strcmp(name, "Title.pack")) { atomic_store(&stage, STAGE_TITLE); return; }
    size_t len = strcspn(name, ".");
    if (strcmp(name + len, ".pack")) return;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < COUNT(interior_table); i++)
        if (strlen(interior_table[i].pack) == len && !strncmp(name, interior_table[i].pack, len)) {
            atomic_store(&stage, (int)i);
            return;
        }
}

const char *game_place_name(float x, float z) {
    const char *best = NULL;
    float best_score = 1;  // (a town scores below 0: inside one, its name wins)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < COUNT(place_table); i++) {
        const PlaceEntry *p = &place_table[i];
        float dx = x - p->x, dz = z - p->z, score = (dx * dx + dz * dz) / (p->radius * p->radius);
        if (score >= 1) continue;
        if (p->town) score -= 1;
        if (score < best_score) { best_score = score; best = p->name[lang]; }
    }
    return best;
}

const char *game_place_region(float x, float z) {
    int col = (int)((x + 5000.0f) / 100.0f), row = (int)((z + 4000.0f) / 100.0f);
    if (x < -5000.0f || z < -4000.0f || col >= 100 || row >= 80) return NULL;
    char c = region_grid[row][col];
    return c < 'a' ? NULL : region_names[c - 'a'][lang];
}

bool game_place_text(float x, float z, bool has_link, char *details, size_t details_size, char *state, size_t state_size) {
    int s = atomic_load(&stage);
    if (s == STAGE_TITLE && has_link) {  // (Continue: the map files may come before the title leaves)
        int title = STAGE_TITLE;
        atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&stage, &title, STAGE_FIELD);
        s = STAGE_FIELD;
    }
    if (s == STAGE_TITLE) {
        snprintf(details, details_size, "%s", place_texts[lang][0]);
        snprintf(state, state_size, "%s", "");
        return true;
    }
    if (!has_link) return false;
    if (s >= 0) {
        snprintf(details, details_size, "%s", interior_table[s].name[lang]);
        snprintf(state, state_size, "%s", place_texts[lang][2 + interior_table[s].kind]);
        return true;
    }
    const char *name = game_place_name(x, z), *region = game_place_region(x, z);
    snprintf(details, details_size, "%s", name ? name : place_texts[lang][1]);
    snprintf(state, state_size, "%s", region ? region : "Hyrule");
    return true;
}
```

```h
// The game versions Savage Wind knows, by the build id of their main module (its first 8 bytes as hex, as
// tools/sw_probe.py prints it). The configuration screen sets up the supported ones; a known one that isn't supported
```
