```c
void motion_sensor_event(const SDL_Event *e) {
    const float *d = e->gsensor.data;
    if (e->gsensor.sensor != SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL && e->gsensor.sensor != SDL_SENSOR_GYRO) return;
    if (!isfinite(d[0]) || !isfinite(d[1]) || !isfinite(d[2])) return;
    uint64_t ts = e->gsensor.sensor_timestamp ? e->gsensor.sensor_timestamp : e->gsensor.timestamp;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (!backend.enabled || e->gsensor.which != backend.pad_id) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return; }
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    // Use event time for freshness: the native path below also supports a stalled device clock.
    uint64_t fresh_ts = e->gsensor.timestamp ? e->gsensor.timestamp : ts;
    if (e->gsensor.sensor == SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL) {
        double an = (double)d[0]*d[0] + (double)d[1]*d[1] + (double)d[2]*d[2];
        if (an < 0.01 || an > 100000 || (backend.acc_time && fresh_ts == backend.acc_ts)) {
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return;
        }
        backend.acc_time = now, backend.acc_ts = fresh_ts;
        memcpy(backend.acc, d, sizeof backend.acc);
    } else {
        if (backend.gyro_time && fresh_ts == backend.gyro_ts) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return; }
        backend.gyro_time = now, backend.gyro_ts = fresh_ts;
    }
    if (native_first(now) && g_settings.motion_source != MOTION_SOURCE_DSU && g_settings.motion_source != MOTION_SOURCE_OFF) {
        bool changed = backend.source != SRC_PAD;
        select_motion(SRC_PAD);
        if (changed) {
            const float *a = backend.acc;
            double acc[3] = {-a[0] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY, a[2] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY, -a[1] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY};
            sensor_accel(acc);
        }
    }
    if (backend.source != SRC_PAD) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return; }
    if (e->gsensor.sensor == SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL) {
        double acc[3] = {-d[0] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY, d[2] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY, -d[1] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY};
        sensor_accel(acc);
    } else if (g.started) {
        double raw[3] = {d[0], -d[2], d[1]};
        uint64_t host = e->gsensor.timestamp;
        bool first = !g.gyro_ts;
        double dt = !first && ts > g.gyro_ts ? (double)(ts - g.gyro_ts) / 1e9 : 0;
        double host_dt = hs.host_ns && host > hs.host_ns ? (double)(host - hs.host_ns) / 1e9 : 0;
        // The same report again: the sensor's time and its values unchanged. A controller polled faster than its
        // sensor runs (a DualSense at 1000-8000 Hz, #759, and some that pass for one) repeats its last report; each
        // copy was taken for a reading one sample period long, and the aim turned several times too far.
        if (!first && ts == g.gyro_ts && !memcmp(d, g.last_gyro, sizeof g.last_gyro)) {
            hs.repeated++;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
            return;
        }
        memcpy(g.last_gyro, d, sizeof g.last_gyro);
        g.gyro_ts = ts;
        hs.gyro++;
        if (host_dt * 1e9 > hs.max_gap) hs.max_gap = (uint64_t)(host_dt * 1e9);
        if (host_dt > 0.25 && hs.notes < 64) {
            hs.notes++;
            LOG("[motion] no gyroscope readings for %.2f s\n", host_dt);
        }
        hs.host_ns = host;
        // The reading's time is the sensor's own clock (SDL's sensor timestamp). A controller that passes for a
        // DualShock 4 or a DualSense may keep that clock still or move it in jumps (a still 16-bit DualShock 4 tick
        // reads as a third of a second through SDL's wrap): every reading then looked 0 s or 0.1 s and more after the
        // last one and was dropped, and the aim stood still while the readings went on (suspected in #220). A reading
        // without a usable time is timed by when it came (SDL's event time), else by one sample period (SDL's rate).
        if (!first && !(dt > 0 && dt < 0.1)) {
            if (dt == 0) hs.stalled++;
            else hs.jumped++;
            if (++hs.bad_run == 8 && hs.notes < 64) {
                hs.notes++;
                LOG("[motion] the controller's sensor clock %s (%.4f s from one reading to the next): readings timed "
                    "by when they come\n", dt == 0 ? "stands still or goes back" : "jumps", dt);
            }
            dt = host_dt > 0 && host_dt < 0.1 ? host_dt : hs.period;
        } else if (!first) {
            if (hs.bad_run >= 8 && hs.notes < 64) {
                hs.notes++;
                LOG("[motion] the controller's sensor clock runs again (after %d readings)\n", hs.bad_run);
            }
            hs.bad_run = 0;
        }
        if (dt > 0 && dt < 0.1) {
            fuse_gyro(raw, dt);
            hs.fused++, hs.total++;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

// ---- DSU (all systems) and the Steam Deck's HID node (Linux)
// Controls' motion_dsu_axes (or SAVAGEWIND_DSU_AXES): the server's three turns as the game should take them, pitch,
// yaw and roll; a server that packs them in another order or sign ("pitch roll -yaw") is set right here (#136: a
// relay on a Legion Go sent roll in yaw's place).
static int dsu_axis[3] = {0, 1, 2}, dsu_sign[3] = {1, 1, 1};

static void dsu_axes_parse(void) {
    const char *s = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DSU_AXES");
    if (!s || !*s) s = g_settings.motion_dsu_axes;
    if (!s || !*s) return;
    static const char *const names[3] = {"pitch", "yaw", "roll"};
    int axis[3], sign[3], k = 0, used = 0;
    for (const char *p = s; *p && k <= 3;) {
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == ',') p++;
        if (!*p) break;
        int sg = 1, a = -1;
        if (*p == '-' || *p == '+') sg = *p == '-' ? -1 : 1, p++;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            if (!strncmp(p, names[i], strlen(names[i]))) a = i;
        if (a < 0 || k == 3 || used >> a & 1) { k = -1; break; }
        used |= 1 << a;
        axis[k] = a, sign[k] = sg, k++;
        p += strlen(names[a]);
    }
    if (k != 3) {
        LOG("[dsu] motion_dsu_axes = %s: not three of pitch, yaw, roll (each once, - flips one); kept as they come\n", s);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(dsu_axis, axis, sizeof axis), memcpy(dsu_sign, sign, sizeof sign);
    LOG("[dsu] the server's axes taken as %s\n", s);
}

static void dsu_sample(const DsuPacket *p, uint32_t generation, void *user) {
    (void)user;
    if (native_first(plat_now_ns()) && g_settings.motion_source != MOTION_SOURCE_DSU) return;
    if (backend.dsu_generation != generation && backend.source == SRC_DSU) select_motion(SRC_NONE);
    backend.dsu_generation = generation;
    select_motion(SRC_DSU);
    sensor_accel(p->acc);
    // (the packet's turns back in the server's order - pitch, yaw, roll - for motion_dsu_axes)
    double t[3] = {p->gyro[0], -p->gyro[2], p->gyro[1]}, o[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) o[i] = dsu_sign[i] * t[dsu_axis[i]];
    double gyro[3] = {o[0], o[2], -o[1]};
    // Microseconds -> ns, without overflowing on a malformed timestamp.
    sensor_gyro(gyro, p->timestamp <= UINT64_MAX / 1000 ? p->timestamp * 1000 : 0);
}

#ifdef __linux__
static void deck_sample(const DsuPacket *p, uint32_t generation, void *user) {
    (void)generation, (void)user;
    select_motion(SRC_DECK);
    sensor_accel(p->acc);
    sensor_gyro(p->gyro, p->timestamp * 1000);
}
#endif

// ---- a PC handheld's own sensors (SDL's sensor API; Windows: the system's sensor framework)
// Opened once, the first time a handheld has nothing better (SAVAGEWIND_DEVICE_SENSORS=0: never). Called under g_lock.
static void device_open(void) {
    if (backend.dev_tried) return;
    backend.dev_tried = true;
    const char *env = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEVICE_SENSORS");
    if (env && !atoi(env)) return;
    if (!SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_SENSOR)) {
        LOG("[motion] the handheld's own sensors: SDL's sensors unavailable (%s)\n", SDL_GetError());
        return;
    }
    int n = 0;
    SDL_SensorID *ids = SDL_GetSensors(&n);
    for (int i = 0; ids && i < n; i++) {
        SDL_SensorType type = SDL_GetSensorTypeForID(ids[i]);
        if (type == SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL && !backend.dev_acc) backend.dev_acc = SDL_OpenSensor(ids[i]), backend.dev_acc_id = ids[i];
        if (type == SDL_SENSOR_GYRO && !backend.dev_gyro) backend.dev_gyro = SDL_OpenSensor(ids[i]), backend.dev_gyro_id = ids[i];
    }
    SDL_free(ids);
    if (backend.dev_acc && backend.dev_gyro) {
        LOG("[motion] the handheld's own sensors: %s and %s\n", SDL_GetSensorName(backend.dev_acc),
            SDL_GetSensorName(backend.dev_gyro));
        return;
    }
    LOG("[motion] the handheld's own sensors: %s (%d sensor%s); a DSU server (Handheld Companion...) can give them\n",
        backend.dev_acc ? "no gyroscope" : backend.dev_gyro ? "no accelerometer" : "none the system shows", n,
        n == 1 ? "" : "s");
    if (backend.dev_acc) SDL_CloseSensor(backend.dev_acc);
    if (backend.dev_gyro) SDL_CloseSensor(backend.dev_gyro);
    backend.dev_acc = backend.dev_gyro = NULL;
}

void motion_device_sensor_event(const SDL_Event *e) {
    const float *d = e->sensor.data;
    if (!isfinite(d[0]) || !isfinite(d[1]) || !isfinite(d[2])) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    bool acc = backend.dev_acc && e->sensor.which == backend.dev_acc_id;
    bool gyro = backend.dev_gyro && e->sensor.which == backend.dev_gyro_id;
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns(), ts = e->sensor.sensor_timestamp ? e->sensor.sensor_timestamp : e->sensor.timestamp;
    if (acc) {
        backend.dev_acc_time = now;
        memcpy(backend.dev_acc_v, d, sizeof backend.dev_acc_v);
        double a[3] = {-d[0] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY, -d[1] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY, -d[2] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY};
        if (backend.source == SRC_DEVICE) sensor_accel(a);
    } else if (gyro) {
        backend.dev_gyro_time = now;
        double w[3] = {d[0], d[1], d[2]};
        if (backend.source == SRC_DEVICE) sensor_gyro(w, ts);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

void motion_poll(void) {
    static bool initialized, dsu_force;
#ifdef __linux__
    static bool deck_on;
#endif
    if (!initialized) {
        initialized = true;
#ifdef __linux__
        // SAVAGEWIND_DECK_IMU=0: not the Steam Deck's own sensors
        deck_on = !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DECK_IMU") || atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DECK_IMU"));
        deck_imu_init(&backend.deck);
#endif
        const char *mode = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DSU");
        bool enabled = !mode || strcmp(mode, "off");
        dsu_force = mode && !strcmp(mode, "on");
        if (mode && strcmp(mode, "auto") && strcmp(mode, "off") && strcmp(mode, "on"))
            LOG("[dsu] unknown SAVAGEWIND_DSU=%s; using auto\n", mode);
        if (enabled) backend.dsu_on = dsu_init(&backend.dsu, getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DSU_ENDPOINT"), (uint32_t)plat_now_ns());
        else LOG("[dsu] disabled (SAVAGEWIND_DSU=off)\n");
        dsu_axes_parse();
    }
    int setting = g_settings.motion_source;
    bool force = dsu_force || setting == MOTION_SOURCE_DSU;
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (now - hs.rate_ns >= 1000000000ull) {  // (the readings per second, for the Controls page)
        hs.rate = hs.rate_ns && now > hs.rate_ns ? (float)((hs.total - hs.rate_total) * 1e9 / (double)(now - hs.rate_ns)) : 0;
        hs.rate_total = hs.total, hs.rate_ns = now;
    }
    bool off = setting == MOTION_SOURCE_OFF;
    bool native = native_first(now) && !off && setting != MOTION_SOURCE_DSU;
    if (backend.source == SRC_PAD && !native) {
        if (native_fresh(now) && !off && setting != MOTION_SOURCE_DSU)
            LOG("[motion] a DSU server answers: it comes before %s's sensor, which has no rate\n", backend.pad_name);
        else
            LOG("[motion] SDL motion timeout; trying fallback\n");
        select_motion(SRC_NONE);
    }
    bool deck_fresh = false;
#ifdef __linux__
    // With Steam Input's gamepad (no sensors), the Deck's own sensors, unless DSU is asked for (SAVAGEWIND_DSU=on)
    bool deck = deck_on && !native && !force && backend.steam_pad && setting == MOTION_SOURCE_AUTO;
    if (deck) deck_imu_poll(&backend.deck, now, deck_sample, NULL);
    else if (backend.deck.fd >= 0) deck_imu_close(&backend.deck);
    if (backend.source == SRC_DECK && (!backend.deck.fresh || !deck)) select_motion(SRC_NONE);
    deck_fresh = deck && backend.deck.fresh;
#endif
    bool dsu = backend.dsu_on && (setting == MOTION_SOURCE_AUTO || setting == MOTION_SOURCE_DSU) &&
               (force || backend.unrated || (!native && !deck_fresh));
    if (dsu) dsu_poll(&backend.dsu, now, dsu_sample, NULL);
    else if (backend.dsu_on && backend.dsu.fd >= 0) dsu_close(&backend.dsu);
    if (backend.source == SRC_DSU && (!backend.dsu.fresh || !dsu)) select_motion(SRC_NONE);
    // A PC handheld's own sensors, when nothing else gives motion
    bool dev = setting == MOTION_SOURCE_AUTO && !native && !deck_fresh && !(dsu && backend.dsu.fresh) && settings_handheld();
    if (dev) device_open();
    bool dev_fresh = dev && backend.dev_acc && backend.dev_acc_time && backend.dev_gyro_time &&
                     now - backend.dev_acc_time < DSU_TIMEOUT_NS && now - backend.dev_gyro_time < DSU_TIMEOUT_NS;
    if (dev_fresh && backend.source == SRC_NONE) {
        select_motion(SRC_DEVICE);
        const float *d = backend.dev_acc_v;
        double a[3] = {-d[0] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY, -d[1] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY, -d[2] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY};
        sensor_accel(a);
    }
    if (backend.source == SRC_DEVICE && !dev_fresh) select_motion(SRC_NONE);
    if (off && backend.source != SRC_NONE) select_motion(SRC_NONE);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

void motion_tilt_held(bool held) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    g.tilt_held = held;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

// Mouse forward tilts the controller's front down, mouse right its right side down (as a tilt maze leans)
void motion_mouse(float dx, float dy) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (g.tilt_held && isfinite(dx) && isfinite(dy)) g.tilt_pitch += dy * TILT_PER_PIXEL, g.tilt_roll += dx * TILT_PER_PIXEL;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

// The tilt key and the mouse wheel: the third axis, six degrees per wheel step
void motion_mouse_yaw(float steps) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (g.tilt_held && isfinite(steps)) g.tilt_yaw += steps * 6 * PI / 180;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

void motion_script(float pitch_deg, float roll_deg, float pitch_speed, float yaw_speed) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    g.sc_pitch = pitch_deg * PI / 180, g.sc_roll = roll_deg * PI / 180;
    g.sc_pitch_speed = pitch_speed * PI / 180, g.sc_yaw_speed = yaw_speed * PI / 180;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

static void virtual_recenter(void) {  // (under g_lock)
    memset(&g.keyboard, 0, sizeof g.keyboard);
    g.tilt_pitch = g.tilt_roll = g.tilt_yaw = 0;
    g.recenter = true;
}

void motion_keyboard(int pitch, int roll, int yaw, bool reset) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    g.key_pitch = pitch, g.key_roll = roll, g.key_yaw = yaw;
    if (reset) virtual_recenter();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

// ---- the game's samples (its controller thread, under g_lock)
static struct {
    bool init;
    uint64_t t;                  // time of the newest sample
    int64_t sampling;            // its sampling number
    int head;                    // its place in ring
    SixAxisState ring[NSAMPLES];
    int src;                     // last source: 0 still / mouse / script, positive = sensor source epoch
    double src_yaw;              // ... and its yaw then
    double yaw, pitch, roll;     // the newest sample's orientation as the game gets it
    Quat sensor_q, output_q;     // physical pose last consumed, and delivered pose (no Euler singularity)
    Mat m;                       // ... as a matrix
    double angle[3];             // turns, summed
    uint64_t last_ns;            // last update (the mouse tilt's levelling, scripted turning)
    double sc_yaw, sc_pitch;     // scripted turning so far
    uint64_t logged;
} s;
RT_ON_RESET(motion_reboot_reset) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
    memset(&g.keyboard, 0, sizeof g.keyboard);
    g.key_pitch = g.key_roll = g.key_yaw = 0;
    g.tilt_held = false;
    g.tilt_pitch = g.tilt_roll = g.tilt_yaw = 0;
    g.recenter = false;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

static void euler_mat(double yaw, double pitch, double roll, Mat m) { quat_mat(euler_quat(yaw, pitch, roll), m); }

// The virtual controller's horizontal turn with sensitivity and inversion applied.
static double game_turn(double turn) { return sens() * (g_settings.motion_invert & MOTION_INVERT_LR ? -turn : turn); }
// The virtual controller as the game gets it (sensitivity and inversion applied; no pitch limit, it turns over)
static double virtual_pitch(void) {
    double p = g.tilt_pitch + g.sc_pitch + s.sc_pitch + g.keyboard.pitch * PI / 180;
    return sens() * (g_settings.motion_invert & MOTION_INVERT_UD ? -p : p);
}
static double virtual_roll(void) { return g.tilt_roll + g.sc_roll + g.keyboard.roll * PI / 180; }
static double virtual_yaw(void) { return s.sc_yaw + g.tilt_yaw + g.keyboard.yaw * PI / 180; }

// Turn the virtual controller by `delta`, a rotation in the table's axes (X right, Y forward, Z up) as the game sees
// it: composed as quaternions, so any axis works at any pose, then kept as continuous angles. Of the two angle
// triples of the new pose, the one nearest the old is taken, so turning over the top goes on smoothly. (under g_lock)
static void virtual_turn(Quat delta) {
    double oldp = virtual_pitch(), oldr = virtual_roll(), oldy = game_turn(virtual_yaw());
    Mat m;
    quat_mat(qnorm(qmul(delta, euler_quat(oldy, oldp, oldr))), m);
    double yaw, pitch, roll;
    euler_of(m, &yaw, &pitch, &roll);
    double p2 = (pitch >= 0 ? PI : -PI) - pitch, r2 = wrap(roll + PI), y2 = wrap(yaw + PI);
    double d0 = pow(wrap(pitch - oldp), 2) + pow(wrap(roll - oldr), 2) + pow(wrap(yaw - oldy), 2);
    double d1 = pow(wrap(p2 - oldp), 2) + pow(wrap(r2 - oldr), 2) + pow(wrap(y2 - oldy), 2);
    if (d1 < d0) pitch = p2, roll = r2, yaw = y2;
    double invp = g_settings.motion_invert & MOTION_INVERT_UD ? -1 : 1, invy = g_settings.motion_invert & MOTION_INVERT_LR ? -1 : 1;
    g.tilt_pitch += wrap(pitch - oldp) / sens() * invp;
    g.tilt_roll += wrap(roll - oldr);
    g.tilt_yaw += wrap(yaw - oldy) / sens() * invy;
    g.keyboard.active = true;
}

// The drag at a shrine apparatus (runtime/ui/gyro_drag.h): an incremental quaternion in the virtual controller's axes
void motion_gizmo_arcball(float w, float x, float y, float z) {
    if (!isfinite(w) || !isfinite(x) || !isfinite(y) || !isfinite(z)) return;
    double length = sqrt((double)w * w + (double)x * x + (double)y * y + (double)z * z);
    if (length < 1e-8) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    virtual_turn((Quat){w / length, x / length, y / length, z / length});
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

// The sticks at a shrine apparatus (runtime/hle/input.c): the right stick turns the table (its X) and tilts it
// front / back (its Y), the left stick banks it (X) and tilts it front / back too (Y); 100 degrees per second at full
// tilt, times the motion sensitivity; the inversion options flip them. reset: recenter. With a gyroscope they take over
// once pushed past half way (a gyroscope lying still, a handheld's on its dock, left no way to solve it), until the
// recenter or the end of the apparatus gives it back.
void motion_dualstick(float lx, float ly, float rx, float ry, double dt, bool reset) {
    if (!isfinite(lx) || !isfinite(ly) || !isfinite(rx) || !isfinite(ry)) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (!reset && g.sensors && !g.keyboard.active && !g.tilt_pitch && !g.tilt_roll && !g.tilt_yaw &&
        fmax(fmax(fabs(lx), fabs(ly)), fmax(fabs(rx), fabs(ry))) < 0.5) {
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        return;
    }
    if (reset) virtual_recenter();
    else if (isfinite(dt) && dt > 0) {
        double k = 100 * PI / 180 * (dt > 0.25 ? 0.25 : dt) * sens();
        double p = (ry + ly) * k * (g_settings.motion_invert & MOTION_INVERT_UD ? -1 : 1), r = lx * k;
        double y = -rx * k * (g_settings.motion_invert & MOTION_INVERT_LR ? -1 : 1);
        double n = sqrt(p * p + r * r + y * y);
        if (n > 1e-9) virtual_turn((Quat){cos(n / 2), p * sin(n / 2) / n, r * sin(n / 2) / n, y * sin(n / 2) / n});
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

// Leaving the apparatus (runtime/pc_gyro_scene.c): the virtual controller lies flat again, nothing queued
void motion_virtual_end(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    memset(&g.keyboard, 0, sizeof g.keyboard);
    g.key_pitch = g.key_roll = g.key_yaw = 0;
    g.tilt_held = false;
    g.tilt_pitch = g.tilt_roll = g.tilt_yaw = 0;
    g.sc_pitch = g.sc_roll = g.sc_pitch_speed = g.sc_yaw_speed = 0;
    g.recenter = false;
    if (s.src == 0) {
        int64_t sampling = s.sampling;
        memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
        s.sampling = sampling;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

// The source's orientation now: the virtual controller when something tilts or turns it (the mouse, the gyro keys, a
// drag, the sticks, a script), else the controller's sensors, else flat
static int source(double dt, Mat m) {
    pc_gyro_step(&g.keyboard, g.key_pitch, g.key_roll, g.key_yaw, dt);
    // At a shrine apparatus the tilt key is a clutch: letting go keeps the pose, so the mouse can take a new grip;
    // only the recenter key (or leaving) levels it. Anywhere else a let-go tilt levels again (~0.15 s), as before, so
    // it never stays in front of the controller's own gyroscope (motion aiming).
    if (!g.tilt_held && !pc_gyro_keyboard_active() && (g.tilt_pitch || g.tilt_roll || g.tilt_yaw)) {
        double k = exp(-dt / 0.15);
        g.tilt_pitch = wrap(g.tilt_pitch) * k, g.tilt_roll = wrap(g.tilt_roll) * k, g.tilt_yaw = wrap(g.tilt_yaw) * k;
        if (fabs(g.tilt_pitch) < 1e-4 && fabs(g.tilt_roll) < 1e-4 && fabs(g.tilt_yaw) < 1e-4)
            g.tilt_pitch = g.tilt_roll = g.tilt_yaw = 0;
    }
    s.sc_yaw += g.sc_yaw_speed * dt;
    s.sc_pitch += g.sc_pitch_speed * dt;
    if (s.sc_pitch > PITCH_MAX) s.sc_pitch = PITCH_MAX;
    if (s.sc_pitch < -PITCH_MAX) s.sc_pitch = -PITCH_MAX;
    bool virt = g.keyboard.active || g.tilt_held || g.tilt_pitch || g.tilt_roll || g.tilt_yaw || g.sc_pitch || g.sc_roll ||
                s.sc_yaw || s.sc_pitch;
    if (g.sensors && g.started && !virt) {
        // (a shrine apparatus: the controller as it is held, no sensitivity or lean; a change of source for the game)
        bool apparatus = pc_gyro_keyboard_active();
        quat_mat(apparatus ? g.q : g.aim_q, m);
        return (int)(backend.epoch & 0x3fffffff) * 2 + 1 + apparatus;
    }
    euler_mat(virtual_yaw(), g.tilt_pitch + g.sc_pitch + s.sc_pitch + g.keyboard.pitch * PI / 180,
              g.tilt_roll + g.sc_roll + g.keyboard.roll * PI / 180, m);
    return 0;
}

static void fill(SixAxisState *st, Mat m, const double gyro[3], const double lin[3]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        st->acc[i] = (float)(-m[2][i] + lin[i]);
        st->gyro[i] = (float)gyro[i];
        st->angle[i] = (float)s.angle[i];
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) st->dir[i][k] = (float)m[k][i];
    }
    // (an identity direction means "no data" to the game: lying exactly flat and facing ahead, turn it a hair)
    static const float id[3][3] = {{1, 0, 0}, {0, 1, 0}, {0, 0, 1}};
    if (!memcmp(st->dir, id, sizeof id)) st->dir[0][1] = 1e-6f, st->dir[1][0] = -1e-6f;
    st->delta_time = (int64_t)SAMPLE_NS;
    st->attributes = 1;  // IsConnected
}

// Physical motion is an incremental rotation in controller axes. Euler yaw/roll become
// ambiguous at vertical, and clamping Euler pitch makes an overhead controller stop
// responding. Keep the full pose; sensitivity/inversion was already applied at sensor rate.
static void sensor_samples(int kind, uint64_t n, Quat pose) {
    Quat current = qnorm(pose);
    double v[3] = {0};
    if (kind != s.src) {
        Mat m;
        quat_mat(current, m);
        double yaw, pitch, roll;
        euler_of(m, &yaw, &pitch, &roll);
        Quat heading = euler_quat(s.yaw - yaw, 0, 0);
        s.output_q = qnorm(qmul(heading, current));
    } else {
        Quat prev = s.sensor_q;
        Quat delta = qnorm(qmul((Quat){prev.w, -prev.x, -prev.y, -prev.z}, current));
        if (delta.w < 0) delta = (Quat){-delta.w, -delta.x, -delta.y, -delta.z};
        double sn = sqrt(delta.x * delta.x + delta.y * delta.y + delta.z * delta.z);
        double k = sn > 1e-12 ? 2 * atan2(sn, delta.w) / sn : 2;
        v[0] = delta.x * k;
        v[1] = delta.y * k;
        v[2] = delta.z * k;
    }
    double a = sqrt(v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]);
    double h = a / (2 * n), k = a > 1e-12 ? sin(h) / a : 1.0 / (2 * n);
    Quat step = {cos(h), v[0] * k, v[1] * k, v[2] * k};
    double gyro[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) gyro[i] = v[i] / (n * (SAMPLE_NS / 1e9) * 2 * PI);
    for (uint64_t j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        s.output_q = qnorm(qmul(s.output_q, step));
        quat_mat(s.output_q, s.m);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) s.angle[i] += gyro[i] * (SAMPLE_NS / 1e9);
        s.head = (s.head + 1) % NSAMPLES;
        SixAxisState *st = &s.ring[s.head];
        st->sampling_number = ++s.sampling;
        fill(st, s.m, gyro, g.lin);
    }
    s.sensor_q = current;
    s.src = kind;
    euler_of(s.m, &s.yaw, &s.pitch, &s.roll);  // diagnostics / transition to virtual controls only
}

// The samples due by now (200 Hz)
static void update(uint64_t now) {
    double dt = s.last_ns && now > s.last_ns ? (double)(now - s.last_ns) / 1e9 : 0;
    if (dt > 0.25) dt = 0.25;
    static const double zero[3];
    if (!s.init) {  // (first call: 16 samples of the controller at rest)
        s.last_ns = now;
        Mat m;
        s.src = source(0, m);
        euler_of(m, &s.src_yaw, &s.pitch, &s.roll);
        if (!s.src) s.src_yaw = virtual_yaw(), s.pitch = virtual_pitch(), s.roll = virtual_roll();
        s.yaw = 0;
        euler_mat(s.yaw, s.pitch, s.roll, s.m);
        if (s.src) {
            s.sensor_q = qnorm(s.src & 1 ? g.aim_q : g.q);
            s.output_q = qnorm(qmul(euler_quat(-s.src_yaw, 0, 0), s.sensor_q));
            quat_mat(s.output_q, s.m);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < NSAMPLES; i++) {
            s.ring[i].sampling_number = ++s.sampling;
            fill(&s.ring[i], s.m, zero, zero);
        }
        s.head = NSAMPLES - 1;
        s.t = now;
        s.init = true;
        return;
    }
    if (now < s.t + SAMPLE_NS) return;
    // (the time since the last sample, not the last poll: polls come more often than samples, from several handles,
    // and a virtual turn would slow down with them)
    s.last_ns = now;
    uint64_t n = (now - s.t) / SAMPLE_NS;
    if (n > NSAMPLES) {
        s.t = now - NSAMPLES * SAMPLE_NS;
        n = NSAMPLES;
    }
    s.t += n * SAMPLE_NS;
    Mat src;
    int kind = source(dt, src);
    if (kind != s.src && hs.notes < 64) {  // (what the motion comes from now, and why)
        hs.notes++;
        LOG("[motion] the game's motion now comes from %s\n",
            kind                                                ? "the controller's sensors"
            : g.tilt_held                                       ? "the mouse (tilt key held)"
            : g.tilt_pitch || g.tilt_roll                       ? "the mouse tilt, levelling"
            : g.sc_pitch || g.sc_roll || s.sc_yaw || s.sc_pitch ? "a script"
            : !g.sensors                                        ? "nothing: no controller sensors (lying still)"
                                                                : "nothing yet: no accelerometer reading (lying still)");
    }
    if (kind) {
        sensor_samples(kind, n, kind & 1 ? g.aim_q : g.q);
        goto motion_log;
    }
    double yaw = virtual_yaw(), pitch = virtual_pitch(), roll = virtual_roll();
    s.src = 0;
    // the virtual controller goes to its pose at a bounded speed, every turn of the way (pc_gyro_follow)
    double virtual_now[3] = {s.yaw, s.pitch, s.roll}, virtual_target[3] = {game_turn(yaw), pitch, roll};
    if (g.recenter) {  // (the recenter key: the nearest level pose, not back through every turn made)
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) virtual_now[i] = wrap(virtual_now[i]);
        g.recenter = false;
    }
    const double *lin = zero;
    for (uint64_t j = 1; j <= n; j++) {  // (in between: the way there in equal steps)
        Mat m;
        pc_gyro_follow(virtual_now, virtual_target, SAMPLE_NS / 1e9);
        euler_mat(virtual_now[0], virtual_now[1], virtual_now[2], m);
        // the turn from the last sample: R_last^T R_now as a rotation vector, per second, in turns
        Mat d;
        for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++)
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) d[r][c] = s.m[0][r] * m[0][c] + s.m[1][r] * m[1][c] + s.m[2][r] * m[2][c];
        double v[3] = {(d[2][1] - d[1][2]) / 2, (d[0][2] - d[2][0]) / 2, (d[1][0] - d[0][1]) / 2};
        double sn = sqrt(v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]), cs = (d[0][0] + d[1][1] + d[2][2] - 1) / 2;
        double a = sn > 1e-12 ? atan2(sn, cs) / sn : 1;
        double gyro[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            gyro[i] = v[i] * a / (SAMPLE_NS / 1e9) / (2 * PI);
            s.angle[i] += gyro[i] * (SAMPLE_NS / 1e9);
        }
        memcpy(s.m, m, sizeof m);
        s.head = (s.head + 1) % NSAMPLES;
        SixAxisState *st = &s.ring[s.head];
        st->sampling_number = ++s.sampling;
        fill(st, m, gyro, lin);
    }
    s.yaw = virtual_now[0], s.pitch = virtual_now[1], s.roll = virtual_now[2];
motion_log:
    if (ENV("SAVAGEWIND_MOTION_LOG") && now - s.logged > 1000000000ull) {
        s.logged = now;
        const SixAxisState *st = &s.ring[s.head];
        LOG("[motion] %s: yaw %.1f pitch %.1f roll %.1f deg | gyro %.3f %.3f %.3f turns/s | acc %.2f %.2f %.2f G | "
            "bias %.2f %.2f %.2f deg/s (spread %.4f rad/s, %.4f G) | sample %lld | readings %u gyro %u accel, "
            "%u fused, %u stalled %u jumped %u repeated, longest gap %.0f ms, last %.0f ms ago | game reads %u\n",
            kind ? "sensors" : g.keyboard.active ? "virtual gyro" : g.tilt_held || g.tilt_pitch || g.tilt_roll ? "mouse tilt"
                                                                                                    : "still/script",
            s.yaw * 180 / PI, s.pitch * 180 / PI, s.roll * 180 / PI, st->gyro[0], st->gyro[1], st->gyro[2], st->acc[0],
            st->acc[1], st->acc[2], g.bias[0] * 180 / PI, g.bias[1] * 180 / PI, g.bias[2] * 180 / PI, g.gyro_sd,
            sqrt(g.acc_var), (long long)st->sampling_number, hs.gyro, hs.accel, hs.fused, hs.stalled, hs.jumped, hs.repeated,
            hs.max_gap / 1e6, hs.host_ns ? (double)(SDL_GetTicksNS() - hs.host_ns) / 1e6 : -1.0, hs.reads);
        hs.gyro = hs.accel = hs.fused = hs.stalled = hs.jumped = hs.repeated = hs.reads = 0, hs.max_gap = 0;
    }
}

// ---- nn::hid
// SixAxisSensorHandle: {u8 npad style index (FullKey 3, Handheld 4, JoyDual 5, JoyLeft 6, JoyRight 7), u8 npad id,
// u8 device (0 left, 1 right, 2 none), u8}
// int GetSixAxisSensorHandles(SixAxisSensorHandle *out, int count, const NpadIdType &id, NpadStyleSet style)
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn3hid23GetSixAxisSensorHandlesEPNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleEiRKjNS_4util10BitFlagSetILi32ENS0_12NpadStyleTagEEE",
         hid_sixaxis_handles) {
    uint32_t *out = (uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    int count = (int)c->x[1];
    uint32_t id = *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2], style = (uint32_t)c->x[3];
    int type = style & 1 ? 3 : style & 2 ? 4 : style & 4 ? 5 : style & 8 ? 6 : style & 16 ? 7 : 3;
    uint32_t dev[2] = {type == 5 || type == 6 ? 0u : type == 7 ? 1u : 2u, 1};
    int n = type == 5 ? 2 : 1;
    if (n > count) n = count < 0 ? 0 : count;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = (uint32_t)type | (id & 0xff) << 8 | dev[i] << 16;
    static int nlog;
    if (nlog++ < 4) LOG("[motion] six-axis sensor handles for npad %#x (style %#x): %d\n", id, style, n);
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)n;
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn3hid18StartSixAxisSensorERKNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleE", hid_sixaxis_start) { (void)c; }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn3hid25SetGyroscopeZeroDriftModeERKNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleERKNS0_22GyroscopeZeroDriftModeE",
         hid_sixaxis_zero_drift) { (void)c; }

// int GetSixAxisSensorStates(SixAxisSensorState *out, int count, const SixAxisSensorHandle &handle): the newest
// `count` samples, newest first. Player 1's controller only (the others are disconnected).
HLE_FUNC("_ZN2nn3hid22GetSixAxisSensorStatesEPNS0_18SixAxisSensorStateEiRKNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleE",
         hid_sixaxis_states) {
    SixAxisState *out = (SixAxisState *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    int count = (int)c->x[1];
    uint32_t h = *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2];
    if (!out || count <= 0) {
        c->x[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (count > NSAMPLES) count = NSAMPLES;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    hs.reads++;
    update(plat_now_ns());
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if ((h >> 8 & 0xff) == 0) {
            out[i] = s.ring[(s.head - i + NSAMPLES) % NSAMPLES];
        } else {
            memset(&out[i], 0, sizeof out[i]);
            out[i].sampling_number = s.sampling - i;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)count;
}
```

```c
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ MediaData (8-byte handle)
typedef struct { char *key; char *sval; int64_t ival; bool is_str; } MdEntry;
typedef struct { MdEntry e[32]; int n; void *codecpar; } MediaData;

static MediaData *md(uint64_t guest) {
    MediaData **p = (MediaData **)(uintptr_t)guest;
    if (!*p) *p = calloc(1, sizeof(MediaData));
    return *p;
}
static void md_clear(MediaData *m) {
    for (int i = 0; i < m->n; i++) { free(m->e[i].key); free(m->e[i].sval); }
    m->n = 0;
    m->codecpar = NULL;
}
static MdEntry *md_slot(MediaData *m, const char *k) {
    for (int i = 0; i < m->n; i++) if (!strcmp(m->e[i].key, k)) return &m->e[i];
    if (m->n == 32) return NULL;
    MdEntry *e = &m->e[m->n++];
    memset(e, 0, sizeof *e);
    e->key = strdup(k);
    return e;
}
static void md_set_int(MediaData *m, const char *k, int64_t v) { MdEntry *e = md_slot(m, k); if (e) { e->ival = v; e->is_str = false; } }
static void md_set_str(MediaData *m, const char *k, const char *v) {
    MdEntry *e = md_slot(m, k);
    if (e) { free(e->sval); e->sval = strdup(v); e->is_str = true; }
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN5movie9MediaDataC1Ev", md_ctor) { *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)calloc(1, sizeof(MediaData)); }
HLE_FUNC("_ZN5movie9MediaDataC1ERKS0_", md_copy) {
    MediaData *src = md(c->x[1]), *dst = calloc(1, sizeof(MediaData));
    for (int i = 0; i < src->n; i++) {
        dst->e[i].key = strdup(src->e[i].key);
        dst->e[i].sval = src->e[i].sval ? strdup(src->e[i].sval) : NULL;
        dst->e[i].ival = src->e[i].ival;
        dst->e[i].is_str = src->e[i].is_str;
    }
    dst->n = src->n;
    dst->codecpar = src->codecpar;
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)dst;
}
HLE_FUNC("_ZN5movie9MediaDataD1Ev", md_dtor) {
    MediaData *m = *(MediaData **)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    if (m) { md_clear(m); free(m); }
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0] = 0;
}
HLE_FUNC("_ZN5movie9MediaData5ClearEv", md_clear_hle) { md_clear(md(c->x[0])); }
HLE_FUNC("_ZNK5movie9MediaData9FindInt32EPKcPi", md_find_int32) {

    static int nlog;
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_DEBUG") && nlog++ < 60) LOG("[movie] FindInt32 \"%s\" (lr=%llx)\n", k, c->x[30]);
    for (int i = 0; i < m->n; i++)
        if (!m->e[i].is_str && !strcmp(m->e[i].key, k)) { *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = (int32_t)m->e[i].ival; c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
static uint64_t make_vtable(HostFn *fns, int n, const char *prefix) {
    uint64_t *t = hle_alloc(64 * 8);
    char name[96];
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "<%s slot %d>", prefix, i);
        t[i] = hle_register(name, i < n ? fns[i] : NULL);
    }
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t;
}

// The game reads the audio and video tracks from different threads; FFmpeg's demuxer is not thread-safe.
static pthread_mutex_t ex_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static void *self_state(Cpu *c) { return (void *)(uintptr_t)((uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0])[1]; }

static void signal_guest_event(Cpu *c, uint64_t event) {
    if (!event) return;
    uint64_t saved[8];
    memcpy(saved, c->x, sizeof saved);
    c->x[0] = event;
    guest_call(c, guest_sym("_ZN2nn2os11SignalEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE"));
    memcpy(c->x, saved, sizeof saved);
}

static void ok(Cpu *c) { c->x[0] = 0; }

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Extractor
typedef struct {
    AVFormatContext *fmt;
    int map[16], ntracks;  // exposed track -> stream
    uint64_t selected;  // bitmask of streams
    AVPacket *pkt;
    bool have_pkt, eof;
    bool skippable;  // the launch opening (forced on the first launch, no save yet): A / B / + ends it
} Extractor;

static bool g_skip_held;           // ex_fill: A / B held at the last look
static double g_skip_pressed_at;    // when they were pressed (0 = not yet)

static void ex_fill(Extractor *e) {
    if (e->skippable && !e->eof) {
        // the game skips the opening with Plus (once a save exists); A and B do too (we press Plus for it)
        extern uint64_t input_buttons_now(void);
        extern volatile int g_inject_plus;
        bool held = g_skip_held;
        double pressed_at = g_skip_pressed_at;
        uint64_t b = input_buttons_now();
        bool now = (b & ((1u << 0) | (1u << 1) | (1u << 10))) != 0;  // A / B / Plus
        if (now && !held) {
            LOG("[movie] opening: A/B/+ -> Plus (skip)\n");
            if (b & 3) g_inject_plus = 1;
            if (!pressed_at) pressed_at = av_gettime_relative() / 1e6;
        }
        held = now;
        // With no save file yet the game ignores Plus (first viewing can't be skipped): if the movie still plays
        // half a second after the press, jump to its last half second so it ends the normal way (ending the
        // stream outright makes the game restart it).
        if (pressed_at && av_gettime_relative() / 1e6 - pressed_at > 0.5 && e->fmt->duration > 1000000) {
            pressed_at = 0;
            int64_t to = e->fmt->duration - 500000;
            if (av_seek_frame(e->fmt, -1, to, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD) >= 0) {
                if (e->have_pkt) { av_packet_unref(e->pkt); e->have_pkt = false; }
                LOG("[movie] opening: still playing -> seek to the end\n");
            }
            e->skippable = false;  // (done: later presses on the title / file select are the menus' own)
        }
        g_skip_held = held, g_skip_pressed_at = pressed_at;
    }
    while (!e->have_pkt && !e->eof) {
        if (av_read_frame(e->fmt, e->pkt) < 0) { e->eof = true; break; }
        if (e->selected & (1ull << e->pkt->stream_index)) e->have_pkt = true;
        else av_packet_unref(e->pkt);
    }
}

static void ex_set_data_source(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    const char *path = (const char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2];
    // "rom:/region_common/movie/title.webm" -> extracted/romfs/region_common/movie/title.webm
    const char *rel = path && strstr(path, ":/") ? strstr(path, ":/") + 2 : path;
    char host[1024];
    snprintf(host, sizeof host, "%s/%s", g_romfs_dir, rel ? rel : "");
    // an add-on content's movie (the Champions' Ballad's, in another mount): extracted/aoc<index>/, the DLC's RomFS
    for (int i = 1; i <= 8 && rel && access(host, R_OK); i++) {
        const char *slash = strrchr(g_romfs_dir, '/');
        int dir = slash ? (int)(slash - g_romfs_dir) + 1 : 0;
        snprintf(host, sizeof host, "%.*saoc%d/%s", dir, g_romfs_dir, i, rel);
    }
    if (rel && access(host, R_OK)) snprintf(host, sizeof host, "%s/%s", g_romfs_dir, rel);
    // the RomFS overlay's copy first (SAVAGEWIND_ROMFS_OVERLAY, services/fs.c): movies are read from the host
    const char *ov = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_ROMFS_OVERLAY");
    if (ov && *ov && rel) {
        char alt[1024];
        snprintf(alt, sizeof alt, "%s/%s", ov, rel);
        if (access(alt, R_OK) == 0) snprintf(host, sizeof host, "%s", alt);
    }
    LOG("[movie] open %s -> %s\n", path ? path : "(null)", host);
    if (avformat_open_input(&e->fmt, host, NULL, NULL) < 0 || avformat_find_stream_info(e->fmt, NULL) < 0) {
        LOG("[movie] cannot open %s\n", host);
        c->x[0] = 1;
        return;
    }
    e->pkt = av_packet_alloc();
    e->ntracks = 0;
    // Link's Awakening's opening at launch could always be skipped (with no save yet the game forces it); no movie of
    // this game is made skippable yet
    e->skippable = rel && strstr(rel, "movie/opening.webm");
    if (e->skippable) g_skip_pressed_at = 0;  // (a press that ended the title's attract replay isn't for this one)
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < e->fmt->nb_streams && e->ntracks < 16; i++)
        if (e->fmt->streams[i]->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO ||
            (e->fmt->streams[i]->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && g_settings.movie_audio && !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NO_MOVIE_AUDIO")))
            e->map[e->ntracks++] = (int)i;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// slot 2: SetDataSource(const char* path) (BOTW opens its movies this way; slot 15 takes a DataSource first)
static void ex_set_data_source_path(Cpu *c) {
    c->x[2] = c->x[1];
    ex_set_data_source(c);
}

static void ex_get_track_count(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = e->fmt ? e->ntracks : 0;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_get_track_config(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    MediaData *m = md(c->x[2]);
    md_clear(m);
    if (!e->fmt || i >= e->ntracks) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    AVStream *s = e->fmt->streams[e->map[i]];
    AVCodecParameters *p = s->codecpar;
    m->codecpar = p;
    if (p->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO) {
        md_set_str(m, "mime", p->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_VP9 ? "video/x-vnd.on2.vp9" :
                              p->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_VP8 ? "video/x-vnd.on2.vp8" : "video/avc");
        md_set_int(m, "width", p->width);
        md_set_int(m, "height", p->height);
        int fps = s->avg_frame_rate.den ? s->avg_frame_rate.num / s->avg_frame_rate.den : 30;
        md_set_int(m, "frame-rate", fps ? fps : 30);
    } else {
        md_set_str(m, "mime", p->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_VORBIS ? "audio/vorbis" : "audio/mp4a-latm");
        md_set_int(m, "sample-rate", p->sample_rate);
        md_set_int(m, "channel-count", p->ch_layout.nb_channels);
    }
    if (e->fmt->duration > 0) md_set_int(m, "durationUs", e->fmt->duration);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_select_track(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    if (i >= 0 && i < e->ntracks) e->selected |= 1ull << e->map[i];
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_get_sample_track(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    ex_fill(e);
    if (!e->have_pkt) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    uint64_t t = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < e->ntracks; i++) if (e->map[i] == e->pkt->stream_index) t = (uint64_t)i;
    *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = t;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_read(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    MBuffer *b = BUF(c->x[1]);
    ex_fill(e);
    if (!e->have_pkt) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)e->pkt->size;
    if (n > b->capacity) { LOG("[movie] packet %u > buffer %llu\n", n, b->capacity); n = (uint32_t)b->capacity; }
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)b->base, e->pkt->data, n);
    b->offset = 0;
    b->size = (int32_t)n;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_advance(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    if (e->have_pkt) { av_packet_unref(e->pkt); e->have_pkt = false; }
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void ex_get_sample_time(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    ex_fill(e);
    if (!e->have_pkt) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    AVStream *s = e->fmt->streams[e->pkt->stream_index];
    int64_t ts = e->pkt->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? e->pkt->pts : e->pkt->dts;
    *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = av_rescale_q(ts, s->time_base, (AVRational){1, 1000000});
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// slot 8: SeekTo(int64 timeUs)
static void ex_seek(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    if (!e->fmt) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    if (e->have_pkt) { av_packet_unref(e->pkt); e->have_pkt = false; }
    e->eof = false;
    av_seek_frame(e->fmt, -1, (int64_t)c->x[1], AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// slot 14: GetCachedDuration(out1, int64* durationUs) -- local files are fully cached
static void ex_cached_duration(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    int64_t dur = e->fmt && e->fmt->duration > 0 ? e->fmt->duration : INT64_MAX / 4;
    if (c->x[1]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = 1;
    if (c->x[2]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = dur;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// Movie objects of this boot (host side; a reboot mid-movie closes them): vtables live in the HLE heap.
static uint64_t g_ex_vt, g_dec_vt;
#define MAX_MOVIE_OBJS 32
static void *g_movie_objs[2][MAX_MOVIE_OBJS];  // [0] Extractor, [1] Decoder
static pthread_mutex_t g_movie_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static void movie_track(int kind, void *p, bool add) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_movie_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIE_OBJS; i++)
        if (g_movie_objs[kind][i] == (add ? NULL : p)) { g_movie_objs[kind][i] = add ? p : NULL; break; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_movie_lock);
}

static void ex_dtor(Cpu *c) {
    Extractor *e = self_state(c);
    if (e && e->fmt) avformat_close_input(&e->fmt);
    if (e) movie_track(0, e, false);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void movie_log_slot(Cpu *c) {
    static int n;
    if (n++ < 20) LOG("[movie] unimplemented virtual (lr=%llx)\n", c->x[30]);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

#define EX_LOCKED(fn) \
    static void fn##_l(Cpu *c) { pthread_mutex_lock(&ex_lock); fn(c); pthread_mutex_unlock(&ex_lock); }
EX_LOCKED(ex_dtor)
EX_LOCKED(ex_get_track_count)
EX_LOCKED(ex_get_track_config)
EX_LOCKED(ex_select_track)
EX_LOCKED(ex_seek)
EX_LOCKED(ex_get_sample_track)
EX_LOCKED(ex_read)
EX_LOCKED(ex_advance)
EX_LOCKED(ex_get_sample_time)
EX_LOCKED(ex_cached_duration)
EX_LOCKED(ex_set_data_source)
EX_LOCKED(ex_set_data_source_path)

HLE_FUNC("_ZN5movie9ExtractorC1ENS_13ContainerTypeE", movie_extractor_ctor) {
    uint64_t vt = g_ex_vt;
    if (!vt) {
        HostFn f[16] = {ex_dtor_l, ex_dtor_l, ex_set_data_source_path_l, movie_log_slot, ex_get_track_count_l,
                        ex_get_track_config_l, ex_select_track_l, movie_log_slot, ex_seek_l, ex_get_sample_track_l,
                        ex_read_l, ex_advance_l, ex_get_sample_time_l, movie_log_slot, ex_cached_duration_l,
                        ex_set_data_source_l};
        vt = g_ex_vt = make_vtable(f, 16, "Extractor");
    }
    uint64_t *self = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    self[0] = vt;
    Extractor *e = calloc(1, sizeof(Extractor));
    self[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e;
    movie_track(0, e, true);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Decoder
#define NIN 4
#define NOUT 6
#define NPENDING 16

typedef struct {
    int idx;
    int64_t time;
    uint32_t flags;
} OutReady;

typedef struct {
    AVCodecContext *ctx;
    AVFrame *frame;
    AVPacket *pkt;
    bool video;
    uint64_t events[4];  // input available, output available, format changed, error
    uint8_t *in_mem[NIN];
    uint32_t in_cap;
    bool in_busy[NIN];
    uint8_t *out_mem[NOUT];
    uint32_t out_cap, out_size[NOUT];
    bool out_busy[NOUT];
    OutReady ready[NOUT];
    int nready;
    int width, height, stride, sample_rate, channels;
    struct SwsContext *sws;
    uint8_t *rgba;
    AVFrame *pending[NPENDING];
    int64_t pending_time[NPENDING];
    int npending;
    bool eos_pending;
    int64_t eos_time;
    bool stopped;  // Stop / destroyed: no more events (see dec_stop)
    bool playing;  // a started video decoder, counted in g_movie_playing
    int fps;       // a video's frame rate (its file's)
    int64_t clock_ns, clock_us;  // pacing: when the frame of time clock_us was handed out (0: not yet)
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
    pthread_cond_t pace_cv;
} Decoder;

// Input / output buffers live in the HLE heap, which only a reboot frees: buffers of destroyed decoders are kept
// for the next movie (the title's attract loop replays the opening, ~37 MB of buffers per showing).
static struct { uint8_t *mem; uint32_t size; } g_buf_pool[64];
static int g_nbuf_pool;
static pthread_mutex_t g_pool_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static uint8_t *buf_get(uint32_t size) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_pool_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nbuf_pool; i++)
        if (g_buf_pool[i].size == size) {
            uint8_t *m = g_buf_pool[i].mem;
            g_buf_pool[i] = g_buf_pool[--g_nbuf_pool];
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pool_lock);
            return m;
        }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pool_lock);
    return hle_alloc(size);
}
static void buf_put(uint8_t *m, uint32_t size) {
    if (!m) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_pool_lock);
    if (g_nbuf_pool < 64) g_buf_pool[g_nbuf_pool++].mem = m, g_buf_pool[g_nbuf_pool - 1].size = size;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pool_lock);
}

// Signal one of the game's decoder events unless the decoder was stopped. Under the lock so a Stop on another
// thread can't slip between the check and the signal.
static void dec_signal(Cpu *c, Decoder *d, int i) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (!d->stopped) signal_guest_event(c, d->events[i]);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
}

#include "../nvn/nvn.h"
void renderer_upload_rgba(NvnTexture *t, const void *rgba, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t stride);

static void dec_configure(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    MediaData *m = md(c->x[1]);
    AVCodecParameters *p = m->codecpar;
    if (!p) { LOG("[movie] Configure without codec parameters\n"); c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    const AVCodec *codec = avcodec_find_decoder(p->codec_id);
    d->ctx = avcodec_alloc_context3(codec);
    avcodec_parameters_to_context(d->ctx, p);
    d->ctx->thread_count = 4;
    if (avcodec_open2(d->ctx, codec, NULL) < 0) { LOG("[movie] cannot open decoder\n"); c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    d->frame = av_frame_alloc();
    d->pkt = av_packet_alloc();
    d->video = p->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO;
    d->width = p->width;
    d->height = p->height;
    d->stride = (p->width + 255) & ~255;
    d->sample_rate = p->sample_rate;
    d->channels = p->ch_layout.nb_channels;
    if (d->video) {  // (the "frame-rate" the extractor put in the track's MediaData)
        for (int i = 0; i < m->n; i++)
            if (!m->e[i].is_str && !strcmp(m->e[i].key, "frame-rate")) d->fps = (int)m->e[i].ival;
        if (d->fps <= 0) d->fps = 30;
    }
    d->in_cap = d->video ? 4 << 20 : 256 << 10;
    d->out_cap = d->video ? (uint32_t)(d->stride * ((d->height + 15) & ~15) * 3 / 2) : 64 << 10;
    for (int i = 0; i < NIN; i++) d->in_mem[i] = buf_get(d->in_cap);
    for (int i = 0; i < NOUT; i++) d->out_mem[i] = buf_get(d->out_cap);
    LOG("[movie] decoder %s configured: %dx%d %d fps %d Hz %d ch\n", codec->name, d->width, d->height, d->fps,
        d->sample_rate, d->channels);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_register_events(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    memcpy(d->events, (void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1], sizeof d->events);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_output_format(Decoder *d, MediaData *m) {
    md_clear(m);
    if (d->video) {
        md_set_str(m, "mime", "video/raw");
        md_set_int(m, "width", d->width);
        md_set_int(m, "height", d->height);
        md_set_int(m, "nv12-y-stride", d->stride);
        md_set_int(m, "nv12-y-offset", 0);
        md_set_int(m, "nv12-uv-offset", d->stride * ((d->height + 15) & ~15));
        md_set_int(m, "nv12-colorspace", 0);
    } else {
        md_set_str(m, "mime", "audio/raw");
        md_set_int(m, "sample-rate", d->sample_rate);
        md_set_int(m, "channel-count", d->channels);
    }
}

static void dec_get_output_format(Cpu *c) { dec_output_format(self_state(c), md(c->x[1])); c->x[0] = 0; }
static void dec_get_output_buffer_format(Cpu *c) { dec_output_format(self_state(c), md(c->x[2])); c->x[0] = 0; }

// Video decoders started and not stopped: a movie is playing. The game shows a new picture every frame it gets one,
// so the pictures are paced by their time (movie_paced, dec_acquire_output) and the game keeps its frame rate, as Cemu
// does; without the pacing (SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_PACE=0) the frame rate is held at the movie's own meanwhile
// (runtime/hle/framepace.c): 30 for the game's, 60 for a 60 fps replacement in the RomFS overlay.
volatile int g_movie_playing;
volatile int g_movie_fps = 30;

bool movie_paced(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_PACE") || atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_PACE")) != 0;
    return on;
}

static void dec_start(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    d->stopped = false;
    if (d->video && !d->playing) {
        d->playing = true;
        d->clock_ns = 0;
        g_movie_fps = d->fps > 0 ? d->fps : 30;
        __atomic_add_fetch(&g_movie_playing, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    dec_signal(c, d, 0);  // all input buffers are free
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// slot 6: Stop. The game's player (0x7000912640) stops both decoders, stops its renderer threads, deletes the
// decoders and nulls its pointers to them, and only then tells its decoder thread (0x70009114b0) to exit: an event
// of ours still set by then wakes that thread into a virtual call through the null decoder (signal 11 after the
// title's attract movie, when the thread was slow to run). A stopped hardware decoder signals nothing, so stop
// signalling here and clear what is still set.
static void dec_stop(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    static uint64_t clear_event;
    if (!clear_event) clear_event = guest_sym("_ZN2nn2os10ClearEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE");
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (d->playing) d->playing = false, __atomic_sub_fetch(&g_movie_playing, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (!d->stopped) {
        d->stopped = true;
        pthread_cond_broadcast(&d->pace_cv);
        LOG("[movie] decoder %s stopped\n", d->video ? "video" : "audio");
        uint64_t saved[8];
        memcpy(saved, c->x, sizeof saved);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            if (d->events[i]) { c->x[0] = d->events[i]; guest_call(c, clear_event); }
        memcpy(c->x, saved, sizeof saved);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static uint64_t n_acq_in, n_send, n_acq_out, n_get_out, n_rel_out, n_frames;
static void movie_stats(void) {
    static uint64_t last;
    uint64_t now = n_acq_in + n_send + n_acq_out + n_rel_out;
    if (now / 200 != last / 200)
        LOG("[movie] acq_in %llu send %llu frames %llu acq_out %llu get_out %llu rel_out %llu\n", n_acq_in, n_send,
            n_frames, n_acq_out, n_get_out, n_rel_out);
    last = now;
}

static void dec_acquire_input(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_acq_in++;
    movie_stats();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (d->stopped) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock); c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    int out_free = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NOUT; i++) if (!d->out_busy[i]) out_free++;
    if (out_free < 2 || d->npending) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock); c->x[0] = 1; return; }  // backpressure
    int idx = -1, free_n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NIN; i++)
        if (!d->in_busy[i]) { if (idx < 0) idx = i; else free_n++; }
    if (idx >= 0) d->in_busy[idx] = true;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    if (idx < 0) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = idx;
    if (c->x[2]) *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = free_n;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_get_input_buffer(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    MBuffer *b = BUF(c->x[2]);
    if (i < 0 || i >= NIN) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    memset(b, 0, sizeof *b);
    b->base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)d->in_mem[i];
    b->capacity = d->in_cap;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// Copy a decoded frame into an output slot; caller holds the lock.
static bool emit_frame(Decoder *d, AVFrame *f, int64_t time, uint32_t flags) {
    int slot = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < NOUT; i++) if (!d->out_busy[i]) { slot = i; break; }
    if (slot < 0) return false;
    uint8_t *o = d->out_mem[slot];
    uint32_t size = 0;
    if (flags & MOVIE_EOS) {
        size = 0;
    } else if (d->video) {
        int h = d->height, w = d->width, uv_off = d->stride * ((h + 15) & ~15);
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) memcpy(o + y * d->stride, f->data[0] + y * f->linesize[0], w);
        for (int y = 0; y < h / 2; y++) {  // interleave U and V into NV12
            uint8_t *uv = o + uv_off + y * d->stride;
            const uint8_t *u = f->data[1] + y * f->linesize[1], *v = f->data[2] + y * f->linesize[2];
            for (int x = 0; x < w / 2; x++) { uv[2 * x] = u[x]; uv[2 * x + 1] = v[x]; }
        }
        size = (uint32_t)(uv_off + d->stride * (h / 2));
    } else {
        // planar float -> interleaved s16
        int ch = f->ch_layout.nb_channels, n = f->nb_samples;
        int16_t *out = (int16_t *)o;
        if ((uint32_t)(n * ch * 2) > d->out_cap) n = (int)(d->out_cap / (ch * 2));
        // FFmpeg reorders Vorbis 5.1 to FL FR FC LFE BL BR; the game expects Vorbis order (FL FC FR BL BR LFE)
        // and reorders itself.
        static const int vorbis51[6] = {0, 2, 1, 4, 5, 3};
        bool native = ch == 6 && d->ctx->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_VORBIS;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int k = 0; k < ch; k++) {
                int src = native ? vorbis51[k] : k;
                float s = f->format == AV_SAMPLE_FMT_FLTP ? ((const float *)f->data[src])[i] : 0.0f;
                if (s > 1.0f) s = 1.0f;
                if (s < -1.0f) s = -1.0f;
                out[i * ch + k] = (int16_t)(s * 32767.0f);
            }
        size = (uint32_t)(n * ch * 2);
    }
    d->out_busy[slot] = true;
    d->out_size[slot] = size;
    d->ready[d->nready++] = (OutReady){slot, time, flags};
    return true;
}

// Emit queued frames (and a pending end-of-stream marker) into free output slots.
static bool flush_pending(Decoder *d) {
    bool any = false;
    while (d->npending && emit_frame(d, d->pending[0], d->pending_time[0], 0)) {
        av_frame_free(&d->pending[0]);
        memmove(d->pending, d->pending + 1, (d->npending - 1) * sizeof d->pending[0]);
        memmove(d->pending_time, d->pending_time + 1, (d->npending - 1) * sizeof d->pending_time[0]);
        d->npending--;
        any = true;
    }
    if (!d->npending && d->eos_pending && emit_frame(d, NULL, d->eos_time, MOVIE_EOS)) {
        d->eos_pending = false;
        any = true;
    }
    return any;
}

static void dec_send_input(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_send++;
    int idx = (int)c->x[1], off = (int)c->x[2], size = (int)c->x[3];
    int64_t time = (int64_t)c->x[4];
    uint32_t flags = (uint32_t)c->x[5];
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (d->stopped) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock); c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    if (size > 0 && idx >= 0 && idx < NIN) {
        av_packet_unref(d->pkt);
        d->pkt->data = d->in_mem[idx] + off;
        d->pkt->size = size;
        d->pkt->pts = time;
        avcodec_send_packet(d->ctx, d->pkt);
    }
    if (flags & MOVIE_EOS) avcodec_send_packet(d->ctx, NULL);
    bool produced = false;
    while (avcodec_receive_frame(d->ctx, d->frame) == 0) {
        int64_t t = d->frame->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? d->frame->pts : time;
        // keep order: queue behind anything already pending
        if (d->npending || !emit_frame(d, d->frame, t, 0)) {
            if (d->npending < NPENDING) {
                d->pending[d->npending] = av_frame_clone(d->frame);
                d->pending_time[d->npending++] = t;
            } else {
                LOG("[movie] output queue full, dropping frame\n");
            }
        }
        n_frames++;
        produced = true;
    }
    if (flags & MOVIE_EOS) { d->eos_pending = true; d->eos_time = time; }
    produced |= flush_pending(d);
    if (idx >= 0 && idx < NIN) d->in_busy[idx] = false;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    dec_signal(c, d, 0);
    if (produced) dec_signal(c, d, 1);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_acquire_output(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_acq_out++;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (d->stopped || !d->nready) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock); c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    OutReady r = d->ready[0];
    if (d->video && !(r.flags & MOVIE_EOS) && movie_paced()) {
        // A picture is handed out once its time has come on a clock started at the first one: the game's player
        // thread waits here until then (the emulated core released), and the game shows the last one meanwhile.
        // (Answering "none yet" instead stalled the player: it waits for the output event, which a full decoder
        // doesn't signal again.) Late by more than a frame or two (a hitch): the clock moves on to the picture
        // instead of rushing through the ones after it.
        int64_t now = av_gettime_relative() * 1000;
        if (!d->clock_ns) d->clock_ns = now, d->clock_us = r.time;
        int64_t due = d->clock_ns + (r.time - d->clock_us) * 1000;
        if (now < due) {
            int64_t wait = due - now < 100000000 ? due - now : 100000000;  // (100 ms at most: a bad timestamp)
            int64_t deadline = now + wait;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
            kernel_host_work_begin();
            pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
            while (!d->stopped && d->nready) {
                int64_t rem = deadline - av_gettime_relative() * 1000;
                if (rem <= 0) break;
                struct timespec ts;
                clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
                int64_t nsec = ts.tv_nsec + rem;
                ts.tv_sec += nsec / 1000000000LL;
                ts.tv_nsec = nsec % 1000000000LL;
                if (pthread_cond_timedwait(&d->pace_cv, &d->lock, &ts) == ETIMEDOUT) break;
            }
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
            kernel_host_work_end();
            pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
            if (d->stopped || !d->nready) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock); c->x[0] = 1; return; }  // (stopped meanwhile)
            r = d->ready[0];
        } else if (now - due > 100000000) d->clock_ns = now, d->clock_us = r.time;
    }
    memmove(d->ready, d->ready + 1, --d->nready * sizeof *d->ready);
    int remaining = d->nready;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = r.idx;
    if (c->x[2]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = r.time;
    if (c->x[3]) *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[3] = r.flags;
    if (c->x[4]) *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[4] = remaining;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_get_output_buffer(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_get_out++;
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    MBuffer *b = BUF(c->x[2]);
    if (i < 0 || i >= NOUT) { c->x[0] = 1; return; }
    static int nlog;
    if (d->video && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_DEBUG") && nlog++ < 4) {
        LOG("[movie] GetOutputBuffer %d: base %llx capacity %llu (lr=%llx)\n", i, (unsigned long long)b->base,
            (unsigned long long)b->capacity, c->x[30]);
        if (b->base && b->capacity == 8) {
            NvnTexture *t = *(NvnTexture **)(uintptr_t)b->base;
            if (t) LOG("[movie]   texture %ux%u format %u target %u flags %#x stride %llu block_h %u fmt %s\n", t->width,
                       t->height, t->format, t->target, t->flags, (unsigned long long)t->stride, t->layout.block_height_log2, t->layout.fmt ? t->layout.fmt->name : "?");
        }
    }
    if (d->video && b->base && b->capacity == 8) {
        // texture output mode: the buffer points at the game's NVNtexture; write RGBA into it
        NvnTexture *t = *(NvnTexture **)(uintptr_t)b->base;
        int w = d->width, h = d->height;
        if (!d->sws)
            d->sws = sws_getContext(w, h, AV_PIX_FMT_NV12, w, h, AV_PIX_FMT_RGBA, SWS_BILINEAR, NULL, NULL, NULL);
        if (!d->rgba) d->rgba = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
        const uint8_t *src[2] = {d->out_mem[i], d->out_mem[i] + d->stride * ((h + 15) & ~15)};
        int src_stride[2] = {d->stride, d->stride};
        uint8_t *dst[1] = {d->rgba};
        int dst_stride[1] = {w * 4};
        sws_scale(d->sws, src, src_stride, 0, h, dst, dst_stride);
        renderer_upload_rgba(t, d->rgba, (uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h, (uint32_t)w * 4);
        c->x[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    int w = d->width, h = d->height;
    if (d->video && b->base && b->capacity >= (uint64_t)w * h * 3 / 2) {
        // the game's own buffer (BOTW: output format 4, mode 1, two buffers of width x height x 1.5): the picture
        // goes into it packed, the luma at a stride of the width and the chroma right after it (NV12, or I420 with
        // SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_PLANAR=1)
        static int planar = -1;
        if (planar < 0) planar = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_PLANAR") && *getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_PLANAR") != '0';
        const uint8_t *src = d->out_mem[i], *src_uv = src + d->stride * ((h + 15) & ~15);
        uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)b->base, *dst_uv = dst + (size_t)w * h;
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) memcpy(dst + (size_t)y * w, src + (size_t)y * d->stride, (size_t)w);
        if (!planar) {
            for (int y = 0; y < h / 2; y++) memcpy(dst_uv + (size_t)y * w, src_uv + (size_t)y * d->stride, (size_t)w);
        } else {
            uint8_t *u = dst_uv, *v = dst_uv + (size_t)(w / 2) * (h / 2);
            for (int y = 0; y < h / 2; y++) {
                const uint8_t *row = src_uv + (size_t)y * d->stride;
                for (int x = 0; x < w / 2; x++) u[(size_t)y * (w / 2) + x] = row[2 * x], v[(size_t)y * (w / 2) + x] = row[2 * x + 1];
            }
        }
        b->size = (int32_t)((size_t)w * h * 3 / 2);
        b->offset = 0;
        c->x[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    memset(b, 0, sizeof *b);
    b->base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)d->out_mem[i];
    b->capacity = d->out_cap;
    b->size = (int32_t)d->out_size[i];
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_release_output(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    n_rel_out++;
    dec_signal(c, d, 0);  // input may be accepted again
    int i = (int)c->x[1];
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (i >= 0 && i < NOUT) d->out_busy[i] = false;
    bool produced = !d->stopped && flush_pending(d);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    if (produced) dec_signal(c, d, 1);
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

static void dec_dtor(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = self_state(c);
    if (!d) { c->x[0] = 0; return; }
    dec_stop(c);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    if (d->ctx) avcodec_free_context(&d->ctx);
    for (int i = 0; i < NIN; i++) buf_put(d->in_mem[i], d->in_cap), d->in_mem[i] = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < NOUT; i++) buf_put(d->out_mem[i], d->out_cap), d->out_mem[i] = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < d->npending; i++) av_frame_free(&d->pending[i]);
    d->npending = d->nready = 0;
    av_frame_free(&d->frame);
    av_packet_free(&d->pkt);
    if (d->sws) sws_freeContext(d->sws), d->sws = NULL;
    free(d->rgba), d->rgba = NULL;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    movie_track(1, d, false);  // (d itself stays: the game's object may still point at it)
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

// Reboot: close what a movie left open (decoder threads, the file), new vtables in the next boot's HLE heap.
RT_ON_RESET(movie_reset) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIE_OBJS; i++) {
        Extractor *e = g_movie_objs[0][i];
        if (e && e->fmt) avformat_close_input(&e->fmt);
        Decoder *d = g_movie_objs[1][i];
        if (d && d->ctx) avcodec_free_context(&d->ctx);
        g_movie_objs[0][i] = g_movie_objs[1][i] = NULL;
    }
    g_ex_vt = g_dec_vt = 0;
    g_nbuf_pool = 0;  // (the HLE heap starts over)
    g_movie_playing = 0;
    g_skip_held = false, g_skip_pressed_at = 0;
}

static void dec_get_counts(Cpu *c) {  // slot 14: (int*, int64*) queried after Configure
    if (c->x[1]) *(int32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1] = 0;
    if (c->x[2]) *(int64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2] = 0;
    c->x[0] = 0;
}

HLE_FUNC("_ZN5movie7DecoderC1ENS_11DecoderTypeENS_19DecoderOutputFormatENS_11DecoderModeEi", movie_decoder_ctor) {
    uint64_t vt = g_dec_vt;
    if (!vt) {
        HostFn f[19] = {dec_dtor, dec_dtor, dec_configure, dec_register_events, dec_get_output_format,
                        dec_start, dec_stop, ok, ok, dec_acquire_input, dec_get_input_buffer, dec_send_input,
                        dec_acquire_output, dec_get_output_buffer, dec_get_counts, dec_release_output, ok,
                        movie_log_slot, dec_get_output_buffer_format};
        vt = g_dec_vt = make_vtable(f, 19, "Decoder");
    }
    uint64_t *self = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MOVIE_DEBUG"))
        LOG("[movie] Decoder(type %llu, output format %llu, mode %llu, %lld) (lr=%llx)\n", c->x[1], c->x[2], c->x[3],
            (long long)c->x[4], c->x[30]);
    Decoder *d = calloc(1, sizeof *d);
    movie_track(1, d, true);
    pthread_mutex_init(&d->lock, NULL);
    pthread_cond_init(&d->pace_cv, NULL);
    self[0] = vt;
    self[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)d;
}
```

`runtime/hle/nvn_boot.c`:

```c
// NVN entry points: every NVN function is looked up by name and bound to a host stub.
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../hle.h"

// (debug) SAVAGEWIND_NVN_REAL=1: also asks the game's own NVN driver (the sdk's nvnBootstrapLoader, recompiled
// like the rest) where each function lives and logs it. The real implementations, read in Ghidra, show the NVN
// version's struct sizes (what SetDefaults clears, what Initialize reads), which the HLE layouts must fit in.
static void log_real_proc(Cpu *c, const char *name) {
    static int on = -1;
    static uint64_t real_gpa;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NVN_REAL") != NULL;
    if (!on || !name) return;
    Cpu saved = *c;
    if (!real_gpa) {
        uint64_t boot = loader_find_symbol_in("sdk", "nvnBootstrapLoader");
        if (!boot) { on = 0; LOG("[nvn-real] sdk exports no nvnBootstrapLoader\n"); return; }
        c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)"nvnDeviceGetProcAddress";
        guest_call(c, boot);
        real_gpa = c->x[0];
        LOG("[nvn-real] bootstrap %llx -> nvnDeviceGetProcAddress %llx\n", (unsigned long long)boot,
            (unsigned long long)real_gpa);
        *c = saved;
        if (!real_gpa) { on = 0; return; }
    }
    c->x[0] = 0;  // (no device: the lookup the game itself does first, FUN_710000eb00(0, ...))
    c->x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)name;
    guest_call(c, real_gpa);
    LOG("[nvn-real] %s %llx\n", name, (unsigned long long)c->x[0]);
    *c = saved;
}

static uint64_t nvn_proc(const char *name) {
    if (!name || !*name) return 0;
    static int log = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_NVN_LOG: every function the game looks up
    if (log < 0) log = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NVN_LOG") != NULL;
    HostFn fn = hle_lookup_impl(name);
    if (log) LOG("[nvn] proc %s%s\n", name, fn ? "" : " (not implemented)");
    return hle_register(name, fn);
}

HLE_FUNC("nvnBootstrapLoader", nvn_bootstrap_loader) {
    const char *name = (const char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[0];
    c->x[0] = nvn_proc(name);
}

// void* nvnDeviceGetProcAddress(const NVNdevice*, const char*)
HLE_FUNC("nvnDeviceGetProcAddress", nvn_device_get_proc_address) {
    const char *name = (const char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[1];
    log_real_proc(c, name);
    c->x[0] = nvn_proc(name);
}
```

`runtime/hle/photo.c`:

```c
// Photo mode extras for the free camera (hle/freecam.c), only while it is on: a colour filter, the hour of the day,
// and a picture saved to screenshots/. Keys: F8 next filter, [ and ] an hour back and on, F7 a picture; on a
// controller the d-pad: up filter, left / right hour, down picture (the free camera has the controller then, so the
// game sees none of these). Turning the free camera off puts the hour back and drops the filter: the photo's look is
// not left on the game.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "../hle.h"
#include "../platform.h"

// Over Video > Colour's own settings, which stay as they are (runtime/color_grade.c color_grade_get)
static const struct { const char *name; int saturation, contrast, temperature, exposure; } filters[] = {
    {"none", 0, 0, 0, 0},      {"black and white", -100, 15, 0, 0}, {"faded", -50, 15, 85, -3},
    {"vivid", 45, 15, 0, 0},   {"golden", 0, 10, 55, -3},           {"cold", -10, 5, -60, 0},
};
#define FILTERS ((int)(sizeof filters / sizeof filters[0]))
static atomic_int filter;

// Requests from the input thread, taken up on the game's own (photo_frame): the clock lives in guest memory
static atomic_int hour_steps, hour_reset;
static float hour_before = -1;  // the hour when the free camera came on and the photo first changed it

float test_warp_hour(bool *held);       // runtime/services/test_warp.c (the control socket's `hour`)
void test_warp_set_hour(float hour);
bool freecam_active(void);

bool photo_filter_get(int *saturation, int *contrast, int *temperature, int *exposure) {
    int f = filter;
    if (!f || !freecam_active()) return false;
    *saturation = filters[f].saturation, *contrast = filters[f].contrast;
    *temperature = filters[f].temperature, *exposure = filters[f].exposure;
    return true;
}

static void filter_next(void) {
    filter = (filter + 1) % FILTERS;
    LOG("[photo] filter: %s\n", filters[filter].name);
}

static atomic_bool shot_pending;  // (the next saved picture is the photo mode's: device.c calls photo_saved)
static char saved_path[256];
static atomic_int saved_seq;

// (vulkan/device.c, the presenter) the picture asked for has been written to path
void photo_saved(const char *path) {
    if (!atomic_exchange(&shot_pending, false)) return;
    snprintf(saved_path, sizeof saved_path, "%s", path);
    atomic_fetch_add(&saved_seq, 1);
}

// (ui/menu.mm) a number that changes with each picture saved, and its path
int photo_saved_seq(const char **path) {
    *path = saved_path;
    return atomic_load(&saved_seq);
}

static void shot(void) {
    extern char g_window_shot_request[256];  // (hle/input.c: the presenter saves the next frame there)
    char when[32] = "0";
    time_t t = time(NULL);
    struct tm *tm = localtime(&t);
    if (tm) strftime(when, sizeof when, "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S", tm);
    SDL_CreateDirectory("screenshots");  // (in the data folder: the working directory, runtime/paths.h)
    static int same_second;
    static char last[32];
    same_second = strcmp(last, when) ? 0 : same_second + 1;
    snprintf(last, sizeof last, "%s", when);
    if (same_second) snprintf(g_window_shot_request, sizeof g_window_shot_request, "screenshots/savagewind-%s-%d.png", when, same_second);
    else snprintf(g_window_shot_request, sizeof g_window_shot_request, "screenshots/savagewind-%s.png", when);
    atomic_store(&shot_pending, true);
    LOG("[photo] picture: %s\n", g_window_shot_request);
}

// (freecam.c) on or off
void photo_reset(bool on) {
    filter = 0;
    hour_steps = 0;
    if (!on) hour_reset = 1;
}

// Request a screenshot to be saved by the presenter on the next frame
void photo_take(void) {
    shot();
}

// (hle/input.c) keys while the free camera is on; true: taken
bool photo_key(int scancode) {
    switch (scancode) {
    case SDL_SCANCODE_F8: filter_next(); return true;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_F7: shot(); return true;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_LEFTBRACKET: hour_steps--; return true;
    case SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHTBRACKET: hour_steps++; return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// (hle/input.c) the controller's buttons while the free camera is on (SDL_GamepadButton bits): new presses only
void photo_pad(uint32_t buttons) {
    static uint32_t was;
    uint32_t down = buttons & ~was;
    was = buttons;
    if (down >> SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_UP & 1) filter_next();
    if (down >> SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN & 1) shot();
    if (down >> SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT & 1) hour_steps--;
    if (down >> SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT & 1) hour_steps++;
}

// (freecam.c freecam_frame, each frame on the game's thread) the hour changes asked for
void photo_frame(void) {
    if (hour_reset) {
        hour_reset = 0;
        if (hour_before >= 0) test_warp_set_hour(hour_before);
        hour_before = -1;
    }
    int steps = atomic_exchange(&hour_steps, 0);
    if (!steps || !freecam_active()) return;
    float now = test_warp_hour(NULL);
    if (now < 0) return;  // (no world yet)
    if (hour_before < 0) hour_before = now;
    float h = (float)((int)now + steps);
    while (h < 0) h += 24;
    while (h >= 24) h -= 24;
    test_warp_set_hour(h);
    LOG("[photo] hour %.1f -> %.0f\n", now, h);
}
```
