`runtime/ksync.c`:

```c
// Futex-style locks and conditions (ksync.h).
#include "ksync.h"

#include "platform.h"

#include <errno.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <windows.h>
typedef BOOL(WINAPI *WaitOnAddressFn)(volatile VOID *, PVOID, SIZE_T, DWORD);
typedef VOID(WINAPI *WakeFn)(PVOID);
static WaitOnAddressFn p_wait;
static WakeFn p_wake1, p_wakeall;
static bool park_init(void) {
    HMODULE h = LoadLibraryA("api-ms-win-core-synch-l1-2-0.dll");
    if (!h) h = LoadLibraryA("kernelbase.dll");
    if (!h) return false;
    p_wait = (WaitOnAddressFn)(void *)GetProcAddress(h, "WaitOnAddress");
    p_wake1 = (WakeFn)(void *)GetProcAddress(h, "WakeByAddressSingle");
    p_wakeall = (WakeFn)(void *)GetProcAddress(h, "WakeByAddressAll");
    return p_wait && p_wake1 && p_wakeall;
}
// Sleeps while *a == expect, for at most rel_ns (< 0: no limit). Returns at any wake-up, spurious ones included.
static void park(uint32_t *a, uint32_t expect, int64_t rel_ns) {
    DWORD ms = INFINITE;
    if (rel_ns >= 0) {
        int64_t m = (rel_ns + 999999) / 1000000;
        ms = m >= 0xFFFFFFFELL ? 0xFFFFFFFEu : (DWORD)m;
    }
    p_wait((volatile VOID *)a, &expect, sizeof expect, ms);
}
static void wake(uint32_t *a, bool all) {
    if (all) p_wakeall(a);
    else p_wake1(a);
}
#elif defined(__linux__)
#include <linux/futex.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <unistd.h>
static bool park_init(void) { return true; }
static void park(uint32_t *a, uint32_t expect, int64_t rel_ns) {
    struct timespec ts, *tp = NULL;
    if (rel_ns >= 0) {
        ts.tv_sec = rel_ns / 1000000000;
        ts.tv_nsec = rel_ns % 1000000000;
        tp = &ts;
    }
    syscall(SYS_futex, a, FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE, expect, tp, NULL, 0);
}
static void wake(uint32_t *a, bool all) { syscall(SYS_futex, a, FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, all ? 0x7fffffff : 1, NULL, NULL, 0); }
#else
static bool park_init(void) { return false; }
static void park(uint32_t *a, uint32_t expect, int64_t rel_ns) { (void)a, (void)expect, (void)rel_ns; }
static void wake(uint32_t *a, bool all) { (void)a, (void)all; }
#endif

static int g_mode = -1;  // 1: the futex words, 0: the pthread members
static int g_mtries = 64;
static uint64_t g_spin_ns;

static void ksync_setup(void) {
    int mode = 1;
    const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_KSYNC");
    if (e && !strcmp(e, "0")) mode = 0;
    if (mode && !park_init()) mode = 0;
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_KLOCK_SPIN")) g_mtries = atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_KLOCK_SPIN"));
    long us = 20;
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_KSYNC_SPIN")) us = atol(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_KSYNC_SPIN"));
    int cpus = plat_cpu_count();
    g_spin_ns = cpus < 6 || us < 0 ? 0 : (uint64_t)us * 1000;
    __atomic_store_n(&g_mode, mode, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}
static inline int mode(void) {
    int m = __atomic_load_n(&g_mode, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (__builtin_expect(m < 0, 0)) {
        ksync_setup();
        m = g_mode;
    }
    return m;
}

static inline void relax(void) {
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
    __builtin_ia32_pause();
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
    __asm__ volatile("yield");
#endif
}
static uint64_t now_ns(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ mutex
void kmutex_init(KMutex *m) {
    pthread_mutex_init(&m->pm, NULL);
    m->s = 0;
}

bool kmutex_trylock(KMutex *m) {
    if (!mode()) return pthread_mutex_trylock(&m->pm) == 0;
    uint32_t z = 0;
    return __atomic_compare_exchange_n(&m->s, &z, 1, false, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

void kmutex_lock(KMutex *m) {
    if (!mode()) {  // (a short spin first: the section is a microsecond or two, a sleep is 5-10)
        for (int i = 0; i < g_mtries; i++) {
            if (!pthread_mutex_trylock(&m->pm)) return;
            relax();
        }
        pthread_mutex_lock(&m->pm);
        return;
    }
    uint32_t c = 0;
    if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&m->s, &c, 1, false, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_mtries; i++) {
        if (__atomic_load_n(&m->s, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) == 0) {
            c = 0;
            if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&m->s, &c, 1, false, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) return;
        }
        relax();
    }
    if (c != 2) c = __atomic_exchange_n(&m->s, 2, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    while (c != 0) {
        park(&m->s, 2, -1);
        c = __atomic_exchange_n(&m->s, 2, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    }
}

void kmutex_unlock(KMutex *m) {
    if (!mode()) {
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->pm);
        return;
    }
    if (__atomic_exchange_n(&m->s, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE) == 2) wake(&m->s, false);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ condition
void kcond_init(KCond *c) {
    pthread_cond_init(&c->pc, NULL);
    c->seq = 0;
    c->parked = 0;
}

void kcond_destroy(KCond *c) { pthread_cond_destroy(&c->pc); }

static void cond_wake(KCond *c, bool all) {
    if (!mode()) {
        if (all) pthread_cond_broadcast(&c->pc);
        else pthread_cond_signal(&c->pc);
        return;
    }
    __atomic_add_fetch(&c->seq, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&c->parked, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)) wake(&c->seq, all);  // (nobody asleep: no kernel call)
}
void kcond_signal(KCond *c) { cond_wake(c, false); }
void kcond_broadcast(KCond *c) { cond_wake(c, true); }

// abs: NULL waits without a limit. Returns false if the time ran out.
static bool cond_wait(KCond *c, KMutex *m, const struct timespec *abs) {
    if (!mode()) {
        if (!abs) {
            pthread_cond_wait(&c->pc, &m->pm);
            return true;
        }
        return pthread_cond_timedwait(&c->pc, &m->pm, abs) == 0;
    }
    uint32_t s = __atomic_load_n(&c->seq, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    kmutex_unlock(m);
    bool ok = true;
    if (g_spin_ns) {  // (the signal usually comes within a few microseconds: no sleep, no wake-up call for it)
        uint64_t t0 = now_ns();
        for (unsigned i = 1; __atomic_load_n(&c->seq, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == s; i++) {
            relax();
            if (!(i & 31) && now_ns() - t0 > g_spin_ns) break;
        }
    }
    if (__atomic_load_n(&c->seq, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == s) {
        __atomic_add_fetch(&c->parked, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
        while (__atomic_load_n(&c->seq, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) == s) {
            int64_t rel = -1;
            if (abs) {
                struct timespec now;
                clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &now);
                rel = ((int64_t)abs->tv_sec - (int64_t)now.tv_sec) * 1000000000ll + ((int64_t)abs->tv_nsec - (int64_t)now.tv_nsec);
                if (rel <= 0) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            park(&c->seq, s, rel);
        }
        __atomic_sub_fetch(&c->parked, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    }
    kmutex_lock(m);
    return ok;
}
void kcond_wait(KCond *c, KMutex *m) { cond_wait(c, m, NULL); }
bool kcond_timedwait(KCond *c, KMutex *m, const struct timespec *abs) { return cond_wait(c, m, abs); }

```

`runtime/ksync.h`:

```h
// Locks and condition variables for the guest kernel layer (kernel.c's g_klock, the per-thread wait conditions and the
// core tokens; nvn/cmdbuf.c's shadow lock).
//
// A winpthreads mutex or condition costs a kernel call each time it sleeps or wakes someone (a semaphore or event), and
// a frame of the game's main thread has ~30 hand-offs between threads. These are futex-style instead: a word in
// memory, a kernel call only when a thread really has to sleep or to be woken, and a short spin before sleeping (the
// other side usually answers within ~20 us). The sleep is the OS's address wait (Windows 8+ WaitOnAddress, Linux
// futex). Where there is none (macOS, Windows 7) or SAVAGEWIND_KSYNC=0, every call goes to the pthread members
// instead, as before.
//   SAVAGEWIND_KSYNC_SPIN=<us>  how long a waiting thread spins before it sleeps (default 20, 0: never; and 0 on
//                               machines with fewer than 6 logical processors)
#pragma once
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <time.h>

typedef struct {
    pthread_mutex_t pm;  // (the fallback)
    uint32_t s;          // 0 free, 1 held, 2 held with sleepers
} KMutex;
typedef struct {
    pthread_cond_t pc;  // (the fallback)
    uint32_t seq;       // changed by every signal
    uint32_t parked;    // threads asleep (or about to be) on seq
} KCond;

#define KMUTEX_INIT {PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER, 0}
#define KCOND_INIT {PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER, 0, 0}

void kmutex_init(KMutex *m);
void kmutex_lock(KMutex *m);
bool kmutex_trylock(KMutex *m);
void kmutex_unlock(KMutex *m);
void kcond_init(KCond *c);
void kcond_destroy(KCond *c);
void kcond_signal(KCond *c);
void kcond_broadcast(KCond *c);
// Wait on c with m held; m is let go while waiting and held again on return. May return early without a signal (as
// pthread_cond_wait). The timed one takes an absolute CLOCK_REALTIME time; false if it ran out.
void kcond_wait(KCond *c, KMutex *m);
bool kcond_timedwait(KCond *c, KMutex *m, const struct timespec *abs);

```

`runtime/language.c`:

```c
// Game languages: which text language the game is told is the system's (am GetDesiredLanguage, set GetLanguageCode)
// and which voices it plays. BOTW picks its region language (USen, EUes, JPja, ...) from that code and loads
// Pack/Bootup_<it>.pack (the texts) and Voice/<it or a fallback>/ (the voices: JPja for Korean and Chinese, USen for
// British English). On the console the voices always follow; here Voice/ can be redirected to another language's
// folder (runtime/services/fs.c, voice_redirect).
#include "language.h"

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

#include "paths.h"
#include "platform.h"
#include "settings.h"
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

const TextLanguage g_text_languages[] = {
    {"Auto (system)", NULL, NULL},
    {"English (US)", "en-US", "USen"},
    {"English (UK)", "en-GB", "EUen"},
    {"Spanish (Latin America)", "es-419", "USes"},
    {"Spanish (Spain)", "es", "EUes"},
    {"French (Canada)", "fr-CA", "USfr"},
    {"French (France)", "fr", "EUfr"},
    {"German", "de", "EUde"},
    {"Italian", "it", "EUit"},
    {"Dutch", "nl", "EUnl"},
    {"Russian", "ru", "EUru"},
    {"Portuguese (Brazil)", "pt-BR", "USpt"},
    {"Japanese", "ja", "JPja"},
    {"Korean", "ko", "KRko"},
    // (the switch's own codes, as the game compares them: it has zh-Hans / zh-Hant in its table, not zh-CN / zh-TW)
    {"Chinese (Simplified)", "zh-Hans", "CNzh"},
    {"Chinese (Traditional)", "zh-Hant", "TWzh"},
    {"Thai", "th", "THth"},  // (1.9.0 on: language_text_count; last, so the others keep their place)
};
const int g_ntext_languages = sizeof g_text_languages / sizeof g_text_languages[0];

// Thai came with 1.9.0 (Pack/Bootup_THth.pack and its fonts; the game takes the LanguageCode "th"): offered when the
// game files have it. On 1.8.2 a Thai setting is kept but reads as Auto.
// (every menu text asks, through language_text_code: a stat a call was hundreds a frame with the overlay up; the answer
// is looked at again at most once a second, as a setup may extract the pack meanwhile)
static bool has_thai(void) {
    static bool have;
    static uint64_t checked_ns;
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    if (checked_ns && now - checked_ns < 1000000000ull) return have;
    checked_ns = now;
    char p[1200];
    struct stat st;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/extracted/romfs/Pack/Bootup_THth.pack", rt_data_root());
    have = stat(p, &st) == 0;
    return have;
}

int language_text_count(void) { return has_thai() ? g_ntext_languages : g_ntext_languages - 1; }

int language_text_index(void) {
    int i = g_settings.text_language;
    return i > 0 && i < language_text_count() ? i : 0;
}

const VoiceLanguage g_voice_languages[] = {
    {"Same as text", NULL},
    {"English", "USen"},
    {"Spanish (Latin America)", "USes"},
    {"Spanish (Spain)", "EUes"},
    {"French", "EUfr"},
    {"German", "EUde"},
    {"Italian", "EUit"},
    {"Russian", "EUru"},
    {"Japanese", "JPja"},
};
const int g_nvoice_languages = sizeof g_voice_languages / sizeof g_voice_languages[0];

// A host locale name ("es-MX", "pt_BR.UTF-8", "zh-Hant-TW") -> one of the game's codes
static const char *code_for_locale(const char *loc) {
    char l[16] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 15 && loc[i] && loc[i] != '.' && loc[i] != '@'; i++) l[i] = loc[i] == '_' ? '-' : loc[i];
    if (!strncmp(l, "en-GB", 5) || !strncmp(l, "en-IE", 5) || !strncmp(l, "en-AU", 5) || !strncmp(l, "en-NZ", 5))
        return "en-GB";
    if (!strncmp(l, "es-ES", 5) || !strcmp(l, "es")) return "es";
    if (!strncmp(l, "es", 2)) return "es-419";  // (es-MX, es-AR, es-419, ...)
    if (!strncmp(l, "fr-CA", 5)) return "fr-CA";
    if (!strncmp(l, "fr", 2)) return "fr";
    if (!strncmp(l, "pt", 2)) return "pt-BR";  // (the only Portuguese the game has)
    if (!strncmp(l, "zh", 2))
        return strstr(l, "Hant") || strstr(l, "TW") || strstr(l, "HK") || strstr(l, "MO") ? "zh-Hant" : "zh-Hans";
    static const char *const two[] = {"de", "it", "nl", "ru", "ja", "ko"};
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) if (!strncmp(l, two[i], 2)) return two[i];
    return "en-US";
}

static const char *host_code(void) {
    static const char *code;
    if (code) return code;
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t w[LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH];  // (the display language, not the formats' locale)
    char n[LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH] = {0};
    if (LCIDToLocaleName(MAKELCID(GetUserDefaultUILanguage(), SORT_DEFAULT), w, LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH, 0))
        WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, n, sizeof n, NULL, NULL);
    code = code_for_locale(n);
#else
    const char *e = getenv("LC_ALL");
    if (!e || !*e) e = getenv("LC_MESSAGES");
    if (!e || !*e) e = getenv("LANG");
    code = code_for_locale(e && *e && strcmp(e, "C") && strcmp(e, "POSIX") ? e : "en-US");
#endif
    return code;
}

const char *language_text_code(void) {
    int i = language_text_index();
    return i > 0 ? g_text_languages[i].code : host_code();
}

static int booted_text = -1, booted_voice = -1;
void language_booted(void) { booted_text = g_settings.text_language, booted_voice = g_settings.voice_language; }
int language_pending(void) {
    return booted_text >= 0 && (booted_text != g_settings.text_language || booted_voice != g_settings.voice_language);
}

const char *language_text_folder(void) {
    int li = language_text_index();
    if (li > 0) return g_text_languages[li].folder;
    const char *code = language_text_code();  // (Automatic: the language the game is given, by its code)
    for (int pass = 0; code && pass < 2; pass++)
        for (int k = 1; k < g_ntext_languages; k++) {
            const char *kc = g_text_languages[k].code;
            if (kc && (pass ? !strncmp(kc, code, 2) : !strcmp(kc, code))) return g_text_languages[k].folder;
        }
    return "USen";
}

const char *language_voice_folder(void) {
    int i = g_settings.voice_language;
    return i > 0 && i < g_nvoice_languages ? g_voice_languages[i].folder : NULL;
}
```

`runtime/launch_flags.c`:

```c
// Launch options without any UI or platform code: see launch_flags.h.
#include "launch_flags.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include "platform/win_compat.h"  // (setenv, unsetenv)
#endif

#define PREFIX "SAVAGEWIND_"

static int ci_cmp(const char *a, const char *b) {
    for (;; a++, b++) {
        int x = toupper((unsigned char)*a), y = toupper((unsigned char)*b);
        if (x != y) return x - y;
        if (!x) return 0;
    }
}

static bool ci_prefix(const char *s, const char *prefix) {
    for (; *prefix; s++, prefix++)
        if (toupper((unsigned char)*s) != toupper((unsigned char)*prefix)) return false;
    return true;
}

const char *lf_error_text(LfError e) {
    switch (e) {
    case LF_OK: return "";
    case LF_ERR_EMPTY: return "Type the name of the flag first.";
    case LF_ERR_BAD_NAME: return "A flag name has only letters, digits and underscores, and doesn't start with a digit.";
    case LF_ERR_NAME_LONG: return "That name is too long.";
    case LF_ERR_BAD_VALUE: return "The value can't have line breaks or other control characters.";
    case LF_ERR_VALUE_LONG: return "That value is too long.";
    case LF_ERR_INTERNAL: return "Savage Wind uses this one itself, so it can't be set here.";
    case LF_ERR_LAUNCHER: return "This one would skip or lock this screen, so it can't be set here.";
    case LF_ERR_BUILD: return "This one is for building the game code, not for playing, so it can't be set here.";
    case LF_ERR_SYSTEM: return "This is a system setting, so it can't be set here.";
    case LF_ERR_SWITCH_OFF:
        return "This flag is on whenever it is in the list, a 0 doesn't turn it off. Remove it from the list instead.";
    case LF_ERR_FULL: return "The list is full. Remove a flag first.";
    }
    return "";
}

const LfInfo *lf_find(const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < LF_TABLE_N; i++)
        if (!ci_cmp(LF_TABLE[i].name, name)) return &LF_TABLE[i];
    return NULL;
}

static char *trim(char *s) {
    char *e = s + strlen(s);
    while (e > s && isspace((unsigned char)e[-1])) *--e = 0;
    char *b = s;
    while (*b && isspace((unsigned char)*b)) b++;
    if (b != s) memmove(s, b, strlen(b) + 1);
    return s;
}

void lf_normalize_name(char *name) {
    trim(name);
    if (!ci_prefix(name, PREFIX) && strlen(name) + sizeof PREFIX <= LF_NAME_MAX + 8) {
        // A short name ("FPS_CAP") means the listed flag of that name, so it must not end up as a different variable
        char full[LF_NAME_MAX + 8];
        snprintf(full, sizeof full, PREFIX "%s", name);
        if (lf_find(full)) memcpy(name, full, strlen(full) + 1);
    }
    if (ci_prefix(name, PREFIX))
        for (char *c = name; *c; c++) *c = (char)toupper((unsigned char)*c);
}

void lf_normalize_value(char *value) { trim(value); }

// Variables the process (or the way it finds its files and window) depends on
static bool system_name(const char *n) {
    static const char *const names[] = {"PATH", "HOME", "USERPROFILE", "SYSTEMROOT", "WINDIR", "TEMP", "TMP", "TMPDIR",  // i18n-skip
                                        "SHELL", "USER", "LOGNAME", "DISPLAY", "WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "XDG_DATA_HOME",  // i18n-skip
                                        "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", "APPDATA", "LOCALAPPDATA", "COMSPEC"};  // i18n-skip
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof names / sizeof *names; i++)
        if (!ci_cmp(n, names[i])) return true;
    return ci_prefix(n, "LD_") || ci_prefix(n, "DYLD_");  // i18n-skip
}

bool lf_value_is_off(const char *v) {
    return !ci_cmp(v, "0") || !ci_cmp(v, "off") || !ci_cmp(v, "false") || !ci_cmp(v, "no");
}

LfError lf_check(const char *name, const char *value) {
    if (!name || !*name) return LF_ERR_EMPTY;
    size_t len = strlen(name);
    if (len >= LF_NAME_MAX) return LF_ERR_NAME_LONG;
    if (isdigit((unsigned char)name[0])) return LF_ERR_BAD_NAME;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++)
        if (!isalnum((unsigned char)name[i]) && name[i] != '_') return LF_ERR_BAD_NAME;
    if (value) {
        if (strlen(value) >= LF_VALUE_MAX) return LF_ERR_VALUE_LONG;
        for (const char *c = value; *c; c++)
            if ((unsigned char)*c < 0x20 || *c == 0x7f) return LF_ERR_BAD_VALUE;
    }
    if (system_name(name)) return LF_ERR_SYSTEM;
    if (ci_prefix(name, PREFIX "LAUNCHER_")) return LF_ERR_LAUNCHER;  // (any test hook of the start screen, listed or not)  // i18n-skip
    const LfInfo *i = lf_find(name);
    if (i) {
        if (i->group == LF_GROUP_INTERNAL) return LF_ERR_INTERNAL;
        if (i->group == LF_GROUP_LAUNCHER) return LF_ERR_LAUNCHER;
        if (i->group == LF_GROUP_BUILD) return LF_ERR_BUILD;
        if (i->kind == LF_KIND_SWITCH && value && *value && lf_value_is_off(value)) return LF_ERR_SWITCH_OFF;
    }
    return LF_OK;
}

bool lf_skipped(const LfFlag *f) {
    const LfInfo *i = lf_find(f->name);
    return i && i->kind == LF_KIND_SWITCH && lf_value_is_off(f->value);
}

void lf_clear(LfList *l) { l->n = 0; }

int lf_index(const LfList *l, const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < l->n; i++)
        if (!ci_cmp(l->flag[i].name, name)) return i;
    return -1;
}

LfError lf_set(LfList *l, const char *name, const char *value) {
    char n[LF_NAME_MAX + 8], v[LF_VALUE_MAX + 8];
    snprintf(n, sizeof n, "%s", name ? name : "");
    snprintf(v, sizeof v, "%s", value ? value : "");
    lf_normalize_name(n);
    lf_normalize_value(v);
    if (!v[0]) snprintf(v, sizeof v, "1");
    LfError e = lf_check(n, v);
    if (e) return e;
    int at = lf_index(l, n);
    if (at < 0) {
        if (l->n >= LF_MAX_FLAGS) return LF_ERR_FULL;
        at = l->n++;
    }
    snprintf(l->flag[at].name, sizeof l->flag[at].name, "%s", n);
    snprintf(l->flag[at].value, sizeof l->flag[at].value, "%s", v);
    return LF_OK;
}

void lf_remove(LfList *l, int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= l->n) return;
    memmove(&l->flag[index], &l->flag[index + 1], (size_t)(l->n - index - 1) * sizeof l->flag[0]);
    l->n--;
}

int lf_parse(LfList *l, const char *text) {
    int skipped = 0;
    l->n = 0;
    if (!strncmp(text, "\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3)) text += 3;  // (Notepad's byte order mark)
    while (*text) {
        const char *end = strpbrk(text, "\r\n");
        size_t len = end ? (size_t)(end - text) : strlen(text);
        char line[LF_NAME_MAX + LF_VALUE_MAX + 16];
        if (len >= sizeof line) {  // too long to be a valid line
            skipped++;
        } else {
            memcpy(line, text, len);
            line[len] = 0;
            char *s = trim(line);
            if (*s && *s != '#') {
                char *eq = strchr(s, '=');
                if (eq) *eq = 0;
                if (lf_set(l, s, eq ? eq + 1 : "") != LF_OK) skipped++;
            }
        }
        text += len;
        while (*text == '\r' || *text == '\n') text++;
    }
    return skipped;
}

size_t lf_format(const LfList *l, char *out, size_t cap) {
    static const char head[] =
        "# Savage Wind launch options: environment flags set at every start. One NAME=value per line.\n"  // i18n-skip
        "# Change them in Settings > Prelaunch. Delete this file, or start Savage Wind with " LF_OFF_SWITCH ", to start without them.\n";  // i18n-skip
    size_t n = 0;
    int w = snprintf(out, cap, "%s", head);
    if (w < 0 || (size_t)w >= cap) return 0;
    n = (size_t)w;
    for (int i = 0; i < l->n; i++) {
        w = snprintf(out + n, cap - n, "%s=%s\n", l->flag[i].name, l->flag[i].value);
        if (w < 0 || (size_t)w >= cap - n) return 0;
        n += (size_t)w;
    }
    return n;
}

bool lf_load(LfList *l, const char *path) {
    l->n = 0;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return false;
    static char buf[32768];  // (a hand-made file bigger than this is cut, not trusted)
    size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, f);
    fclose(f);
    buf[n] = 0;
    lf_parse(l, buf);
    return true;
}

bool lf_save(const LfList *l, const char *path) {
    if (!l->n) return remove(path) == 0 || fopen(path, "rb") == NULL;  // (nothing saved = no file)
    static char buf[32768];
    size_t len = lf_format(l, buf, sizeof buf);
    if (!len) return false;
    char tmp[1100];
    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp", path);  // i18n-skip
    FILE *f = fopen(tmp, "wb");
    if (!f) return false;
    bool ok = fwrite(buf, 1, len, f) == len;
    ok = fflush(f) == 0 && ok;
    ok = fclose(f) == 0 && ok;
    if (!ok) {
        remove(tmp);
        return false;
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    remove(path);  // (rename won't replace a file there)
#endif
    if (rename(tmp, path) != 0) {
        remove(tmp);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// ---- the environment

static uint32_t fnv(uint32_t h, const char *s) {
    for (; *s; s++) h = (h ^ (unsigned char)*s) * 16777619u;
    return h;
}

void lf_signature(const LfList *l, char *out, size_t cap) {
    int order[LF_MAX_FLAGS], n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l->n; i++) {  // (what applying sets, by name: the same list in another order is the same)
        if (lf_skipped(&l->flag[i])) continue;
        int j = n++;
        while (j > 0 && ci_cmp(l->flag[order[j - 1]].name, l->flag[i].name) > 0) order[j] = order[j - 1], j--;
        order[j] = i;
    }
    if (!n) {
        if (cap) out[0] = 0;
        return;
    }
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) h = fnv(fnv(fnv(h, l->flag[order[k]].name), "="), l->flag[order[k]].value), h = fnv(h, "\n");
    size_t at = (size_t)snprintf(out, cap, "%08x:", (unsigned)h);
    for (int k = 0; k < n && at < cap; k++)
        at += (size_t)snprintf(out + at, cap - at, "%s%s", k ? "," : "", l->flag[order[k]].name);
}

const char *lf_applied(void) {
    const char *e = getenv(LF_APPLIED_ENV);
    return e ? e : "";
}

int lf_apply(const LfList *l) {
    char prev[LF_MAX_FLAGS * (LF_NAME_MAX + 1) + 16];
    snprintf(prev, sizeof prev, "%s", lf_applied());
    char *names = strchr(prev, ':');
    for (char *p = names ? names + 1 : NULL; p && *p;) {  // (what an earlier apply set: gone unless wanted again)
        char *comma = strchr(p, ',');
        if (comma) *comma = 0;
        unsetenv(p);
        p = comma ? comma + 1 : p + strlen(p);
    }
    int set = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l->n; i++) {
        if (lf_skipped(&l->flag[i])) continue;
        if (setenv(l->flag[i].name, l->flag[i].value, 1) == 0) set++;
    }
    char sig[LF_MAX_FLAGS * (LF_NAME_MAX + 1) + 16];
    lf_signature(l, sig, sizeof sig);
    if (sig[0]) setenv(LF_APPLIED_ENV, sig, 1);
    else unsetenv(LF_APPLIED_ENV);
    return set;
}

bool lf_in_effect(const LfList *l) {
    char sig[LF_MAX_FLAGS * (LF_NAME_MAX + 1) + 16];
    lf_signature(l, sig, sizeof sig);
    return !strcmp(sig, lf_applied());
}

// ---- suggestions

typedef struct {
    int rank, group, index;
} Cand;

static const char *short_name(const char *n) { return ci_prefix(n, PREFIX) ? n + sizeof PREFIX - 1 : n; }

static bool ci_contains(const char *hay, const char *needle) {
    for (; *hay; hay++)
        if (ci_prefix(hay, needle)) return true;
    return false;
}

static int cand_cmp(const void *a, const void *b) {
    const Cand *x = a, *y = b;
    if (x->rank != y->rank) return x->rank - y->rank;
    if (x->group != y->group) return x->group - y->group;
    return x->index - y->index;  // (the table is sorted by name)
}

int lf_suggest(const char *typed, const LfInfo **out, int max) {
    char t[LF_NAME_MAX + 8];
    snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%s", typed ? typed : "");
    trim(t);
    enum { CAP = 1024 };
    static Cand c[CAP];  // (UI thread; the table is a few hundred names)
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < LF_TABLE_N && n < CAP; i++) {
        const LfInfo *f = &LF_TABLE[i];
        if (f->group > LF_GROUP_DEV) continue;
        int rank;
        if (!t[0]) rank = f->group == LF_GROUP_PLAY ? 0 : -1;
        else if (ci_prefix(f->name, t)) rank = 0;
        else if (ci_prefix(short_name(f->name), t)) rank = 1;
        else if (ci_contains(short_name(f->name), t)) rank = 2;
        else if (ci_contains(f->name, t)) rank = 3;
        else rank = -1;
        if (rank >= 0) c[n++] = (Cand){rank, (int)f->group, i};
    }
    qsort(c, (size_t)n, sizeof *c, cand_cmp);
    int count = n < max ? n : max;
    for (int k = 0; k < count; k++) out[k] = &LF_TABLE[c[k].index];
    return count;
}
```

`runtime/launch_flags.h`:

```h
// Launch options: environment flags (SAVAGEWIND_*) a tester sets from the start screen instead of a shell.
//
// A developer asks a tester to "try SAVAGEWIND_VK_NO_FEEDBACK_LOOP=1"; most players can't set an environment variable.
// The start screen keeps a list of NAME=value flags in <data root>/launch-flags.txt (a separate file, not savagewind.ini:
// they are read before settings_load() and before the data root's other files, by a process that may restart itself,
// and a file the player can delete is the recovery from a bad entry). They start empty. This file is the part
// without any UI or platform code: checking, the file, suggestions, and the environment (runtime/launch_flags_boot.c
// does the start-up and restart, runtime/ui/launch_flags_ui.mm the screen; tools/test_launch_flags.c tests this).
//
// Flags read once and cached, or read before main() (runtime/sampler.c, runtime/fnprof.c), must be in the environment
// when the process starts. So the saved flags are applied by restarting the process once with them set (the restart
// is skipped when nothing is saved, which is the normal case) and the process remembers what it applied in
// SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCH_FLAGS_APPLIED ("<hash>:<name>,<name>").
//
// A flag that is on by being set (getenv() != NULL) can't be turned off by a value: 0 would still turn it on. Such a
// flag ("switch" kind, found by tools/gen_launch_flags.py) is only ever on or removed, and a hand-written 0 is
// ignored when applying.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define LF_MAX_FLAGS 48
#define LF_NAME_MAX 64   // with the terminator
#define LF_VALUE_MAX 128 // with the terminator
#define LF_FILE "launch-flags.txt"
#define LF_APPLIED_ENV "SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCH_FLAGS_APPLIED"
#define LF_OFF_SWITCH "--no-launch-flags"  // start without the saved flags (recovery)

typedef enum { LF_KIND_SWITCH, LF_KIND_NUMBER, LF_KIND_TEXT } LfKind;
// play: suggested first; other: a runtime flag without a description; dev: dumps, traces, logs, profiling, tests;
// internal / launcher / build: can't be added (see tools/launch_flags_curated.txt)
typedef enum { LF_GROUP_PLAY, LF_GROUP_OTHER, LF_GROUP_DEV, LF_GROUP_INTERNAL, LF_GROUP_LAUNCHER, LF_GROUP_BUILD } LfGroup;

typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    LfKind kind;
    LfGroup group;
    const char *example;  // the value a suggestion fills in ("" = none)
    const char *desc;     // one line ("" = none)
} LfInfo;

extern const LfInfo LF_TABLE[];  // runtime/launch_flags_table.c (generated), sorted by name
extern const int LF_TABLE_N;

typedef struct {
    char name[LF_NAME_MAX];
    char value[LF_VALUE_MAX];
} LfFlag;

typedef struct {
    LfFlag flag[LF_MAX_FLAGS];
    int n;
} LfList;

typedef enum {
    LF_OK = 0,
    LF_ERR_EMPTY,           // no name
    LF_ERR_BAD_NAME,        // not letters, digits and underscores
    LF_ERR_NAME_LONG,
    LF_ERR_BAD_VALUE,       // a line break or other control character
    LF_ERR_VALUE_LONG,
    LF_ERR_INTERNAL,        // Savage Wind's own, or needed before the saved flags can be found
    LF_ERR_LAUNCHER,        // would skip or lock the start screen, or hide the window
    LF_ERR_BUILD,           // belongs to the game code build
    LF_ERR_SYSTEM,          // a system variable (PATH, HOME, LD_PRELOAD, ...)
    LF_ERR_SWITCH_OFF,      // a 0 for a flag that is on whenever it is set: remove it instead
    LF_ERR_FULL,
} LfError;

// Plain-words English text for an error (the UI translates it)
const char *lf_error_text(LfError e);

const LfInfo *lf_find(const char *name);  // exact name, or NULL
// A typed name tidied up: spaces trimmed, a name that starts like SAVAGEWIND_ in any case upper-cased whole
void lf_normalize_name(char *name);
// A typed value tidied up: spaces trimmed
void lf_normalize_value(char *value);
// Whether this name and value can be added. An empty value is fine (it means 1).
LfError lf_check(const char *name, const char *value);
// A value that leaves a switch flag off (0, off, false, no, or nothing)
bool lf_value_is_off(const char *value);
// Is the value, for this flag, one that applying skips (a switch with an off value)?
bool lf_skipped(const LfFlag *f);

void lf_clear(LfList *l);
int lf_index(const LfList *l, const char *name);  // -1 = not in the list
// Adds NAME=value (an empty value becomes 1) or replaces the value of NAME. The strings are tidied first.
LfError lf_set(LfList *l, const char *name, const char *value);
void lf_remove(LfList *l, int index);

// The file's text: one NAME=value per line; a bare NAME means NAME=1; blank lines and # lines are skipped; lines that
// don't pass lf_check are skipped too. Returns how many lines were skipped for a problem.
int lf_parse(LfList *l, const char *text);
// The text for a file (starts with a comment saying what the file is). Returns the length (0 on a too small buffer).
size_t lf_format(const LfList *l, char *out, size_t cap);
bool lf_load(LfList *l, const char *path);  // false = no file (the list is then empty)
bool lf_save(const LfList *l, const char *path);  // written whole and swapped in; an empty list removes the file

// What applying a list sets: its hash and names ("<hash>:<name>,<name>"; "" for nothing to apply)
void lf_signature(const LfList *l, char *out, size_t cap);
// The signature of what this process was started with (LF_APPLIED_ENV; "" = nothing)
const char *lf_applied(void);
// Make the process environment hold exactly this list: variables of an earlier apply that are no longer wanted are
// removed, the list's are set, LF_APPLIED_ENV is updated. Returns how many variables were set.
int lf_apply(const LfList *l);
// Does the environment already hold this list?
bool lf_in_effect(const LfList *l);

// Matches for what is being typed, best first: names that start with it, then that contain it (case ignored, with or
// without the SAVAGEWIND_ prefix); play flags before other ones before developer ones. Nothing for a blocked flag.
// Empty text lists the play flags. Returns how many were written to out.
int lf_suggest(const char *typed, const LfInfo **out, int max);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

```

`runtime/launch_flags_boot.c`:

```c
// Launch options at start and at PLAY: see launch_flags_boot.h.
#include "launch_flags_boot.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "launch_flags.h"
#include "paths.h"
#include "platform.h"

static bool g_off;

bool launch_flags_disabled(void) { return g_off; }

bool launch_flags_path(char *out, size_t n) {
    char root[1024];
    const char *known = rt_data_root();  // (set once rt_paths_init has run: the start screen)
    if (known && *known) snprintf(root, sizeof root, "%s", known);
    else if (!rt_peek_data_root(root, sizeof root)) return false;
    return (size_t)snprintf(out, n, "%s/" LF_FILE, root) < n;
}

void launch_flags_boot(int argc, char **argv) {
    bool config = false;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], LF_OFF_SWITCH)) g_off = true;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--config")) config = true;
    }
    LfList none = {.n = 0};
    if (g_off) {
        if (lf_applied()[0]) lf_apply(&none);  // (a restart from an earlier start with them)
        fprintf(stderr, "[flags] " LF_OFF_SWITCH ": the saved launch options are not used\n");
        return;
    }
    if (config) return;  // (the start screen is always clean; PLAY restarts with the flags)
    char path[1100];
    static LfList l;
    if (!launch_flags_path(path, sizeof path)) return;
    lf_load(&l, path);  // (no file: an empty list)
    if (lf_in_effect(&l)) return;
    int n = lf_apply(&l);
    fprintf(stderr, "[flags] %d launch option(s) from %s: restarting with them\n", n, path);
    plat_exec(NULL);
    fprintf(stderr, "[flags] could not restart; going on with the options set from here\n");
}

void launch_flags_play(const char *root) {
    if (g_off) return;
    char path[1100], exe[4096];
    static LfList l;
    if (!launch_flags_path(path, sizeof path)) return;
    lf_load(&l, path);
    if (lf_in_effect(&l)) return;
    lf_apply(&l);
    if (!plat_exe_path(exe, sizeof exe)) return;
    char *av[4] = {exe, (char *)"--play", NULL, NULL};
    if (root && *root && strcmp(root, "extracted")) av[2] = (char *)root;
    fprintf(stderr, "[flags] launch options changed: restarting into the game\n");
    plat_exec(av);
    fprintf(stderr, "[flags] could not restart\n");
}
```

`runtime/launch_flags_boot.h`:

```h
// Launch options at start and at PLAY (the platform side of runtime/launch_flags.h).
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

// First thing in main() after the log is set up: unless this is the configuration screen (--config, which always starts
// clean so a bad flag can't keep a player out of it) or --no-launch-flags was given, puts the saved flags in the
// environment and restarts the process once so every reader, constructors included, sees them. Does nothing when no
// flags are saved.
void launch_flags_boot(int argc, char **argv);
// --no-launch-flags was given: the saved flags are ignored for this start (and PLAY doesn't restart for them)
bool launch_flags_disabled(void);
// <data root>/launch-flags.txt, also from the start screen (where the working directory is the data root)
bool launch_flags_path(char *out, size_t n);
// PLAY on the start screen: if the saved flags differ from the ones this process started with, restarts straight into
// the game (--play) with them. Returns when nothing needed to change, or the restart failed. root: the game folder
// argument of this start ("extracted" is the default).
void launch_flags_play(const char *root);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

```

`runtime/loader.c`:

```c
// NSO loading, relocation, and symbol resolution.
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "game_versions.h"
#include "gamelib.h"
#include "lz4.h"
#include "rt.h"

Module g_modules[MAX_MODULES];
int g_nmodules;

enum { DT_NULL = 0, DT_PLTRELSZ = 2, DT_HASH = 4, DT_STRTAB = 5, DT_SYMTAB = 6, DT_RELA = 7, DT_RELASZ = 8,
       DT_JMPREL = 23, DT_INIT_ARRAY = 25, DT_FINI_ARRAY = 26, DT_INIT_ARRAYSZ = 27, DT_FINI_ARRAYSZ = 28,
       DT_RELRSZ = 35, DT_RELR = 36, DT_GNU_HASH = 0x6FFFFEF5 };
enum { R_ABS64 = 257, R_GLOB_DAT = 1025, R_JUMP_SLOT = 1026, R_RELATIVE = 1027 };

typedef struct { uint32_t name; uint8_t info, other; uint16_t shndx; uint64_t value, size; } Elf64Sym;
typedef struct { uint64_t off, info; int64_t addend; } Elf64Rela;

static uint8_t *read_file(const char *path, size_t *len) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    *len = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *p = malloc(*len);
    fread(p, 1, *len, f);
    fclose(f);
    return p;
}

// Number of dynsym entries from a DT_GNU_HASH table: the end of its last chain. Newer SDK modules (sdk and subsdk0
// of BOTW 1.8.2) have no DT_HASH, whose nchain says it directly.
static uint64_t gnu_hash_nsyms(uint64_t h) {
    const uint32_t *w = (const uint32_t *)h;
    uint32_t nbuckets = w[0], symoffset = w[1], bloom_size = w[2];
    const uint32_t *buckets = (const uint32_t *)(h + 16 + 8ull * bloom_size), *chain = buckets + nbuckets;
    uint32_t last = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nbuckets; i++)
        if (buckets[i] > last) last = buckets[i];
    if (last < symoffset) return symoffset;  // (no hashed symbols)
    while (!(chain[last - symoffset] & 1)) last++;
    return (uint64_t)last + 1;
}

// Loads the module where the game code expects it (lm: its entry in the library's layout). The file must be the one
// the code was generated from: same build id, and so the same image size.
static void load_nso(Module *m, const char *path, const GameLibModule *lm) {
    size_t len;
    uint8_t *raw = read_file(path, &len);
    if (!raw || len < 0x100 || memcmp(raw, "NSO0", 4)) FATAL("cannot load %s\n", path);
    char id[65];
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) snprintf(id + 2 * i, 3, "%02x", raw[0x40 + i]);
    if (strcmp(id, lm->build_id))
        FATAL("%s is not the file the game code was built from (build %.16s, the code's %.16s): build it again\n",
              path, id, lm->build_id);
    uint64_t base = lm->base, size = lm->size;
    if (base < MAIN_BASE || base + size > MODULES_END || size > MODULES_END)
        FATAL("%s: the game code puts it at %llx-%llx, outside the module area %llx-%llx\n", m->name, base,
              base + size, MAIN_BASE, MODULES_END);
    uint32_t flags = *(uint32_t *)(raw + 0xC);
    uint32_t seg[3][3];  // file_off, mem_off, size
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) memcpy(seg[i], raw + 0x10 + i * 0x10, 12);
    uint32_t bss = *(uint32_t *)(raw + 0x3C);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        if ((uint64_t)seg[i][1] + seg[i][2] + (i == 2 ? bss : 0) > size)
            FATAL("%s: segment %d past its image\n", path, i);
    plat_commit(base, size);  // inside the guest window: zero-filled, read/write
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        uint32_t csize = *(uint32_t *)(raw + 0x60 + i * 4);
        uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)base + seg[i][1];
        if (flags & (1 << i)) {
            size_t got = lz4_decompress(raw + seg[i][0], csize, dst, seg[i][2]);
            if (got != seg[i][2]) FATAL("lz4 %s seg %d: %zu != %u\n", path, i, got, seg[i][2]);
        } else {
            memcpy(dst, raw + seg[i][0], seg[i][2]);
        }
    }
    free(raw);
    m->base = base;
    m->size = size;
    m->text_off = seg[0][1]; m->text_size = seg[0][2];
    m->ro_off = seg[1][1];   m->ro_size = seg[1][2];
    m->data_off = seg[2][1]; m->data_size = seg[2][2] + bss;

    uint32_t mod0 = *(uint32_t *)(base + 4);
    uint64_t mod = base + mod0;
    m->dynamic = mod + *(int32_t *)(mod + 4);
    uint64_t gnu_hash = 0;
    for (uint64_t *d = (uint64_t *)m->dynamic; d[0] != DT_NULL; d += 2) {
        switch (d[0]) {
        case DT_SYMTAB: m->symtab = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_STRTAB: m->strtab = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_HASH: m->nsyms = *(uint32_t *)(base + d[1] + 4); break;
        case DT_GNU_HASH: gnu_hash = base + d[1]; break;
        case 12: m->init = base + d[1]; break;  // DT_INIT
        case 13: m->fini = base + d[1]; break;  // DT_FINI
        case DT_INIT_ARRAY: m->init_array = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_INIT_ARRAYSZ: m->init_array_sz = d[1]; break;
        case DT_FINI_ARRAY: m->fini_array = base + d[1]; break;
        case DT_FINI_ARRAYSZ: m->fini_array_sz = d[1]; break;
        }
    }
    if (!m->nsyms && gnu_hash) m->nsyms = gnu_hash_nsyms(gnu_hash);
    LOG("loaded %-8s at %llx size %llx syms %llu\n", m->name, base, size, m->nsyms);
}

Module *loader_module(const char *name) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nmodules; i++)
        if (!strcmp(g_modules[i].name, name)) return &g_modules[i];
    return NULL;
}

static Elf64Sym *sym(Module *m, uint64_t i) { return (Elf64Sym *)m->symtab + i; }
static const char *symname(Module *m, Elf64Sym *s) { return (const char *)(m->strtab + s->name); }

uint64_t loader_find_symbol_in(const char *module, const char *name) {
    for (int mi = 0; mi < g_nmodules; mi++) {
        Module *m = &g_modules[mi];
        if (strcmp(m->name, module)) continue;
        for (uint64_t i = 1; i < m->nsyms; i++) {
            Elf64Sym *s = sym(m, i);
            if (s->shndx && !strcmp(symname(m, s), name)) return m->base + s->value;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

uint64_t loader_find_symbol(const char *name) {
    for (int mi = 0; mi < g_nmodules; mi++) {
        Module *m = &g_modules[mi];
        for (uint64_t i = 1; i < m->nsyms; i++) {
            Elf64Sym *s = sym(m, i);
            if (s->shndx && !strcmp(symname(m, s), name)) return m->base + s->value;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

const char *loader_symbol_at(uint64_t addr, uint64_t *offset) {
    const char *best = NULL;
    uint64_t best_addr = 0;
    for (int mi = 0; mi < g_nmodules; mi++) {
        Module *m = &g_modules[mi];
        if (addr < m->base || addr >= m->base + m->size) continue;
        for (uint64_t i = 1; i < m->nsyms; i++) {
            Elf64Sym *s = sym(m, i);
            uint64_t a = m->base + s->value;
            if (s->shndx && (s->info & 0xF) == 2 && a <= addr && a > best_addr) {
                best = symname(m, s);
                best_addr = a;
            }
        }
    }
    if (offset) *offset = addr - best_addr;
    return best;
}

static uint64_t resolve(Module *m, uint32_t symidx) {
    Elf64Sym *s = sym(m, symidx);
    const char *name = symname(m, s);
    if (s->shndx) return m->base + s->value;
    HostFn impl = hle_lookup_impl(name);
    if (impl) return hle_register(name, impl);  // host implementation wins over the guest SDK's
    uint64_t a = loader_find_symbol(name);
    if (a) return a;
    if ((s->info >> 4) == 2) return 0;  // weak undefined
    return hle_register(name, NULL);
}

// DT_RELR: packed relative relocations (newer SDKs: every module of BOTW 1.8.2 keeps its R_RELATIVE ones only here).
// An even entry is the offset of a word to relocate; an odd one is a bitmap of the 63 words after the last one
// relocated. The addend is the word itself. Returns how many words were relocated.
static uint64_t relocate_relr(Module *m, uint64_t relr, uint64_t size) {
    uint64_t *where = NULL, n = 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < size / 8; i++) {
        uint64_t e = ((uint64_t *)relr)[i];
        if (!(e & 1)) {
            where = (uint64_t *)(m->base + e);
            *where++ += m->base;
            n++;
            continue;
        }
        if (!where) FATAL("%s: DT_RELR bitmap before any address\n", m->name);
        for (int b = 0; b < 63; b++)
            if ((e >> (b + 1)) & 1) where[b] += m->base, n++;
        where += 63;
    }
    return n;
}

static void relocate(Module *m) {
    uint64_t rela = 0, relasz = 0, jmprel = 0, pltsz = 0, relr = 0, relrsz = 0;
    for (uint64_t *d = (uint64_t *)m->dynamic; d[0] != DT_NULL; d += 2) {
        if (d[0] == DT_RELA) rela = m->base + d[1];
        if (d[0] == DT_RELASZ) relasz = d[1];
        if (d[0] == DT_JMPREL) jmprel = m->base + d[1];
        if (d[0] == DT_PLTRELSZ) pltsz = d[1];
        if (d[0] == DT_RELR) relr = m->base + d[1];
        if (d[0] == DT_RELRSZ) relrsz = d[1];
    }
    uint64_t packed = relr ? relocate_relr(m, relr, relrsz) : 0;
    int unresolved = 0;
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        Elf64Rela *r = (Elf64Rela *)(pass ? jmprel : rela);
        uint64_t n = (pass ? pltsz : relasz) / sizeof(Elf64Rela);
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            uint64_t *where = (uint64_t *)(m->base + r[i].off);
            uint32_t type = (uint32_t)r[i].info, si = r[i].info >> 32;
            switch (type) {
            case R_RELATIVE: *where = m->base + r[i].addend; break;
            case R_ABS64:
            case R_GLOB_DAT:
            case R_JUMP_SLOT: {
                uint64_t s = resolve(m, si);
                *where = s ? s + r[i].addend : 0;
                if (s >= HLE_BASE && s < HLE_BASE + HLE_SIZE) unresolved++;
                break;
            }
            default: FATAL("%s: reloc type %u\n", m->name, type);
            }
        }
    }
    LOG("relocated %-8s (%llu packed relative, %d imports bound to host stubs)\n", m->name,
        (unsigned long long)packed, unresolved);
}

// The modules the game code was generated for, in its layout's order (tools/layout.py: main, subsdk0..9, sdk).
void loader_load(const char *exefs) {
    char path[1024];
    const GameLibTables *g = gamelib_tables();
    if (*g->nmodules > MAX_MODULES) FATAL("the game code has %u modules\n", *g->nmodules);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < *g->nmodules; i++) {
        Module *m = &g_modules[g_nmodules++];
        memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
        m->name = g->modules[i].name;
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", exefs, m->name);
        load_nso(m, path, &g->modules[i]);
    }
    // A subsdk the code doesn't have: other game files than it was built from, unless main is a known game version,
    // whose code leaves out the subsdks that aren't the game's (a mod copied into the ExeFS, #165; tools/layout.py
    // GAME_SUBSDKS)
    bool known = false;
    const char *main_id = NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < *g->nmodules; i++)
        if (!strcmp(g->modules[i].name, "main")) main_id = g->modules[i].build_id;
#define KNOWN_MAIN(ver, id, ok, files, bytes) known = known || (main_id && !strncmp(main_id, id, 16));
    GAME_VERSIONS(KNOWN_MAIN)
#undef KNOWN_MAIN
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        char name[16];
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "subsdk%d", i);
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", exefs, name);
        FILE *f = loader_module(name) ? NULL : fopen(path, "rb");
        if (!f) continue;
        fclose(f);
        if (!known) FATAL("%s is not in the game code: build it again\n", path);
        LOG("[loader] %s is not one of the game's modules (a mod?): left out\n", path);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nmodules; i++) relocate(&g_modules[i]);
}
```

`runtime/lz4.h`:

```h
// LZ4 block decompression (NSO segments: loader.c, nvn/shader_archive.c).
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

// Bytes written to dst; less than dstlen when src is short or damaged.
static inline size_t lz4_decompress(const uint8_t *src, size_t srclen, uint8_t *dst, size_t dstlen) {
    const uint8_t *s = src, *se = src + srclen;
    uint8_t *d = dst, *de = dst + dstlen;
    while (s < se) {
        uint8_t tok = *s++;
        size_t lit = tok >> 4;
        if (lit == 15) { uint8_t b; do { b = *s++; lit += b; } while (b == 255); }
        if (d + lit > de || s + lit > se) break;
        memcpy(d, s, lit);
        d += lit; s += lit;
        if (s >= se) break;
        size_t off = s[0] | (s[1] << 8);
        s += 2;
        size_t ml = tok & 15;
        if (ml == 15) { uint8_t b; do { b = *s++; ml += b; } while (b == 255); }
        ml += 4;
        uint8_t *m = d - off;
        if (m < dst || d + ml > de) break;
        while (ml--) *d++ = *m++;
    }
    return d - dst;
}
```

`runtime/main.c`:

```c
// Savage Wind entry: load modules, set up the kernel, run nn::init::Start on the main thread.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "gamelib.h"
#include "paths.h"
#include "post_update.h"
#include "steam_shortcuts.h"
#include "nvn/maxwell/shader.h"
#include "nvn/shader_archive.h"
#ifndef __APPLE__
#include "nvn/precompile.h"
#include "nvn/vulkan/shaders.h"  // (the shader key log: --scan-shaders)
#endif
#include "romfs_image.h"
#include "services/save_convert.h"
#include "services/save_profiles.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "control.h"
#include "launch_flags_boot.h"

const char *g_romfs_dir;
uint64_t g_program_id;

// rtld normally passes these to nn::init::Start: run every module's init/fini arrays.
static void run_array(Cpu *c, uint64_t arr, uint64_t size) {
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < size / 8; i++) {
        uint64_t fn = ((uint64_t *)arr)[i];
        if (fn) guest_call(c, fn);
    }
}

// nn::init::Start calls x2 right after nnosInitialize and x3 after nninitStartup, just before
// nnMain: SDK constructors run early, the game's run once nninitStartup has set up its heap.
// Newer SDKs (BOTW 1.8.2's) also take x4, called if nnMain returns, before nninitFinalizeSdkModule
// and nnosQuickExit: the finalizers of what x3 set up (the SDK's never run: the exit is quick).
// rtld runs a module's DT_INIT, which registers it (and its TLS template) with musl via
// __nnmusl_init_dso and then runs its init_array; fall back to the array if there is no DT_INIT.
static void module_init(Cpu *c, Module *m) {
    LOG("init %s (DT_INIT %llx, %llu init_array entries)\n", m->name, m->init, m->init_array_sz / 8);
    if (m->init) guest_call(c, m->init);
    else run_array(c, m->init_array, m->init_array_sz);
}

static void module_fini(Cpu *c, Module *m) {  // DT_FINI, else the fini_array backwards
    LOG("fini %s (DT_FINI %llx, %llu fini_array entries)\n", m->name, m->fini, m->fini_array_sz / 8);
    if (m->fini) { guest_call(c, m->fini); return; }
    for (uint64_t i = m->fini_array_sz / 8; i-- > 0;) {
        uint64_t fn = ((uint64_t *)m->fini_array)[i];
        if (fn) guest_call(c, fn);
    }
}

// x2 runs the SDK's; x3 the others, once the heap is up (their constructors may allocate), dependencies first: the
// reverse of load order, subsdk9..0 then main. x4 undoes x3 in load order: main, then subsdk0..9.
static void rtld_init_sdk(Cpu *c) { module_init(c, loader_module("sdk")); }
static void rtld_init_main(Cpu *c) {
    for (int i = g_nmodules - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        if (strcmp(g_modules[i].name, "sdk")) module_init(c, &g_modules[i]);
    extern void rt_title_menu_prepare(void);  // runtime/ui/game_options.mm: tables the constructors filled
    rt_title_menu_prepare();
}
static void rtld_fini_main(Cpu *c) {
    LOG("nnMain returned\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nmodules; i++)
        if (strcmp(g_modules[i].name, "sdk")) module_fini(c, &g_modules[i]);
}

// Claim the guest address range before anything else can map there. The host allocator places
// regions at random addresses in the same window; on a collision, re-exec for a fresh layout.
__attribute__((constructor(101))) static void reserve_guest_space(void) {
    if (plat_reserve_guest(GUEST_LO, GUEST_HI)) return;
    const char *tries = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_REEXEC");
    int n = tries ? atoi(tries) : 0;
    if (n >= 20) {
        fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: guest address range %llx-%llx is not free\n", GUEST_LO, GUEST_HI);
        exit(1);
    }
    char buf[16];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%d", n + 1);
    setenv("SAVAGEWIND_REEXEC", buf, 1);
    plat_exec(NULL);
    perror("re-exec");
    exit(1);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ boot / in-place reboot
// Going back to the start screen reboots the game inside this process: the window, GPU device, settings and shader
// caches stay. rt_request_reboot (menu, any thread) makes ui_run return on the main thread, which then: stops every
// guest thread (kernel_stop_threads: each unwinds at its next svc / HLE call / wait), resets the renderer (textures,
// address-keyed caches) and all per-boot host state (RT_ON_RESET hooks: services, HLE features, audio), empties the
// kernel, wipes guest memory, and boots again.
static _Atomic int g_reboot;
void rt_request_reboot(int kind) {
    LOG("[reboot] requested (%s)\n", kind == RT_REBOOT_TITLE ? "start screen" : "boot");
    g_reboot = kind;
}
int rt_reboot_requested(void) { return g_reboot; }

// SAVAGEWIND_REBOOT_AT=<frame>:<game | title>[,...] (test): at that presented frame, reboot the game in place, or go
// back to the start screen (with SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCHER_AUTOPLAY it plays again). Frames count on across reboots. Called
// by the presenter every frame.
void reboot_test_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    static const char *next;
    static int init;
    if (!init) { init = 1; next = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_REBOOT_AT"); }
    long at;
    char what[128];
    if (!next || !*next || sscanf(next, "%ld:%127[^,]", &at, what) != 2 || (long)frame < at) return;
    next = strchr(next, ',');
    if (next) next++;
    rt_request_reboot(!strcmp(what, "title") ? RT_REBOOT_TITLE : RT_REBOOT_GAME);
}

#ifdef __APPLE__
extern const ResetFn __start_resets[] __asm__("section$start$__DATA$__rt_reset");
extern const ResetFn __stop_resets[] __asm__("section$end$__DATA$__rt_reset");
#elif defined(__linux__)
extern const ResetFn __start_resets[], __stop_resets[];  // (ELF: defined by the linker)
#else
// PE/COFF: .rst$a < .rst$m (entries, hle.h) < .rst$z (the linker sorts by the text after '$')
__attribute__((section(".rst$a"), used)) static const ResetFn __start_resets[1];
__attribute__((section(".rst$z"), used)) static const ResetFn __stop_resets[1];
#endif

void backend_reset(void);             // renderer: GPU idle, game textures and address-keyed caches dropped
void backend_guest_memory_reset(void);  // renderer: guest memory was replaced (re-wrap the heap)
void backend_clear_window(void);      // a black frame while the game is down

static void reboot_idle(void) {  // (main thread, while guest threads stop) keep the window alive
    SDL_Event e;
    while (SDL_PollEvent(&e))
        if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_QUIT) { LOG("window closed\n"); exit(0); }
}

static void teardown(void) {
    extern void prof_shutdown(void);
    prof_shutdown();  // finish sampling before guest thread handles or the game library can be replaced
    uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
    kernel_stop_threads(reboot_idle);
    extern void nvn_queue_idle(void);
    nvn_queue_idle();  // (runtime/nvn/objects.c: what the game submitted has run)
    backend_clear_window();
    backend_reset();
    const ResetFn *start = __start_resets, *stop = __stop_resets;
    __asm__("" : "+r"(start), "+r"(stop));  // separate objects: keep the compiler from reasoning about them
    int n = 0;
    for (const ResetFn *p = start; p < stop; p++)
        if (*p) { (*p)(); n++; }
    kernel_reset();
    if (!plat_reset_guest(GUEST_LO, GUEST_HI)) FATAL("cannot reset guest memory\n");
    backend_guest_memory_reset();
    g_nmodules = 0;
    g_reboot = RT_REBOOT_NONE;
    LOG("[reboot] game torn down in %llums (%d reset hooks)\n", (unsigned long long)((plat_now_ns() - t0) / 1000000), n);
}

static void boot(const char *root) {
    char exefs[1024], romfs[1024], npdm_path[1024];
    snprintf(exefs, sizeof exefs, "%s/exefs", root);
    snprintf(romfs, sizeof romfs, "%s/romfs", root);
    snprintf(npdm_path, sizeof npdm_path, "%s/main.npdm", exefs);
    if (!g_romfs_dir) g_romfs_dir = strdup(romfs);

    char why[512];
    if (!gamelib_load(root, why, sizeof why)) FATAL("%s\n", why);
    loader_load(exefs);
    { extern void fs_title_version_patch(void); fs_title_version_patch(); }  // (runtime/services/fs.c)
    { extern void settings_load(void); settings_load(); }
    { extern void language_booted(void); language_booted(); }  // (runtime/language.c)
    plat_cpu_placement();
    kernel_init();
    dispatch_init();
    { extern void rupees_start(void); rupees_start(); }  // (Cheats > Infinite rupees, `rupees`: runtime/rupees.c)
    { extern void jpeg_debug_init(void); jpeg_debug_init(); }

    uint32_t stack_size = 0x100000;
    int prio = 44;
    FILE *f = fopen(npdm_path, "rb");
    if (f) {
        static uint8_t npdm[0x10000];
        size_t n = fread(npdm, 1, sizeof npdm, f);
        if (n >= 0x80 && !memcmp(npdm, "META", 4)) {
            prio = npdm[0xE];
            stack_size = *(uint32_t *)(npdm + 0x1C);
            uint32_t aci = *(uint32_t *)(npdm + 0x70);  // ACI0: the program id at +0x10
            if (aci + 0x18 <= n && !memcmp(npdm + aci, "ACI0", 4)) g_program_id = *(uint64_t *)(npdm + aci + 0x10);
        }
        fclose(f);
    }
    LOG("main thread: prio %d, stack 0x%x, program %016llx\n", prio, stack_size, (unsigned long long)g_program_id);

    // nn::init::Start(thread_handle, args_region, init_sdk, init_main[, fini_main]): with x4 in newer SDKs
    uint64_t start = loader_find_symbol("_ZN2nn4init5StartEmmPFvvES2_S2_");
    bool has_fini = start != 0;
    if (!start) start = loader_find_symbol("_ZN2nn4init5StartEmmPFvvES2_");
    if (!start) FATAL("nn::init::Start not found\n");
    LOG("nn::init::Start at %llx (%s)\n", (unsigned long long)start, has_fini ? "init, init, fini" : "init, init");
    uint64_t init_sdk = hle_register("<rtld_init_sdk>", rtld_init_sdk);
    uint64_t init_main = hle_register("<rtld_init_main>", rtld_init_main);
    uint64_t fini_main = has_fini ? hle_register("<rtld_fini_main>", rtld_fini_main) : 0;
    KThread *t = kernel_create_main_thread(start, stack_size, prio);
    kernel_run_main(t, t->handle, 0, init_sdk, init_main, fini_main);
}

// --scan-shaders: what runtime/nvn/shader_archive.c finds in the game's RomFS image (a check of the enumeration the
// shader precompilation uses).
static int scan_shaders(const char *root) {
    char image[1100], why[256] = "";
    snprintf(image, sizeof image, "%s/romfs", root);
    SaSet set;
    uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
    if (!shader_archive_scan(image, &set, NULL, NULL, why, sizeof why)) { fprintf(stderr, "[shaders] %s\n", why); return 1; }
    int n[6] = {0}, prog[3] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < set.nshaders; i++) n[set.shaders[i].stage]++;
    for (int i = 0; i < set.nprograms; i++) prog[set.programs[i].cs >= 0 ? 2 : 0]++;
    fprintf(stderr, "[shaders] %llu files (%llu MB) in %.1f s: %d archives, %d programs (%d compute), %d shaders: %d vertex, "
            "%d fragment, %d compute\n", (unsigned long long)set.files, (unsigned long long)(set.bytes >> 20),
            (plat_now_ns() - t0) / 1e9, set.nsources, set.nprograms, prog[2], set.nshaders, n[STAGE_VERTEX], n[STAGE_FRAGMENT],
            n[STAGE_COMPUTE]);
#ifndef __APPLE__
    {   // the shader key log of earlier sessions (SAVAGEWIND_CACHE_DIR): which of the shaders the game drew are in the
        // archives found, and the vertex attribute kinds they were drawn with, by archive and attribute
        VkKeyLogEntry *e;
        int n = vk_keylog_read(&e), found[6] = {0}, all[6] = {0};
        int (*kinds)[32][5] = calloc((size_t)set.nsources + 1, sizeof *kinds);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (e[i].stage > 5) continue;
            all[e[i].stage]++;
            int k = shader_archive_find(&set, e[i].code);
            if (k >= 0) found[e[i].stage]++;
            if (e[i].stage != STAGE_VERTEX) continue;
            uint32_t in = k >= 0 ? vk_sph_inputs(set.shaders[k].code, STAGE_VERTEX) : 0;
            for (int a = 0; a < 32; a++)
                if ((in >> a) & 1 && e[i].key.attr_kind[a] < 5) kinds[k >= 0 ? set.shaders[k].source : set.nsources][a][e[i].key.attr_kind[a]]++;
        }
        if (n)
            fprintf(stderr, "[shaders] key log: %d shader keys; found in the archives: vertex %d of %d, fragment %d of %d, compute %d of %d\n",
                    n, found[STAGE_VERTEX], all[STAGE_VERTEX], found[STAGE_FRAGMENT], all[STAGE_FRAGMENT], found[STAGE_COMPUTE], all[STAGE_COMPUTE]);
        for (int src = 0; src <= set.nsources && n; src++)
            for (int a = 0; a < 32; a++) {
                int *c = kinds[src][a];
                if (c[1] + c[2] + c[3] + c[4])
                    fprintf(stderr, "  attribute %2d: float %d, int %d, uint %d, int->float %d, uint->float %d  %s\n", a, c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4],
                            src < set.nsources ? set.sources[src] : "(not in the archives)");
            }
        free(kinds);
        free(e);
    }
#endif
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SCAN_LIST")) {
        int *per = calloc((size_t)set.nsources, sizeof *per);
        for (int i = 0; i < set.nshaders; i++) per[set.shaders[i].source]++;
        for (int i = 0; i < set.nsources; i++) if (per[i] || getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SCAN_LIST")[0] == '2') fprintf(stderr, "  %5d %s\n", per[i], set.sources[i]);
        free(per);
    }
    shader_archive_free(&set);
    return 0;
}

#ifndef __APPLE__
// --precompile-shaders: the shader precompilation without the start screen (runtime/nvn/precompile.h). The pipelines
// need the Vulkan device: a window is made for it (SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_NO_PIPELINES=1: translations and SPIR-V
// only, no window).
static void *precompile_progress(void *arg) {
    ShaderPrecompile *p = arg;
    while (atomic_load(&p->state) < SP_DONE) {
        fprintf(stderr, "\r[precompile] %3d%%", (int)(shader_precompile_progress(p) * 100));
        SDL_Delay(500);
    }
    return NULL;
}

static int precompile_shaders(const char *root) {
    extern void ui_window_init(void);  // (the Vulkan device, for the pipelines; SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN keeps the window hidden)
    if (!getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_NO_PIPELINES")) ui_window_init();
    char image[1100];
    snprintf(image, sizeof image, "%s/romfs", root);
    static ShaderPrecompile p;
    pthread_t t;
    pthread_create(&t, NULL, precompile_progress, &p);
    bool ok = shader_precompile_run(&p, image);
    pthread_join(t, NULL);
    fprintf(stderr, "\n[precompile] %s: %d shaders, %d translations (%d made, %d cached, %d failed) in %.1f s%s%s\n",
            ok ? "done" : "stopped", p.shaders, p.keys, p.made, p.cached, p.failed, p.seconds, ok ? "" : ": ", ok ? "" : p.why);
    return ok ? 0 : 1;
}

// --export-pipeline-seed <file>: this install's pipeline list (cache/vk_pipelines.list) as a portable seed that any
// install's precompilation reads (runtime/nvn/vulkan/precompile.c): a developer's playthrough gives every install its
// first boot's pre-warm. Needs the Vulkan device (the list is named after it) and the game files.
static int export_pipeline_seed(const char *root, const char *out) {
    extern void ui_window_init(void);
    ui_window_init();
    char image[1100], why[256] = "";
    snprintf(image, sizeof image, "%s/romfs", root);
    bool ok = shader_precompile_export_seed(image, out, why, sizeof why);
    fprintf(stderr, "[precompile] pipeline seed %s: %s%s\n", ok ? "written" : "NOT written", out, ok ? "" : why);
    return ok ? 0 : 1;
}
#endif

// --dump-romfs <file>: writes the RomFS image the game reads (runtime/romfs_image.h) to a file, to compare it with
// another build's or check it with RomFS tools (development). Exit status 0 when the image was written.
static int dump_romfs(const char *root, const char *out_path) {
    char dir[1100], why[256] = "";
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/romfs", root);
    RomfsImage *img = romfs_image_open(dir, why, sizeof why);
    if (!img) { fprintf(stderr, "[romfs] cannot read %s: %s\n", dir, why); return 1; }
    FILE *out = fopen(out_path, "wb");
    uint64_t size = romfs_image_size(img), chunk = 8u << 20;
    uint8_t *buf = malloc(chunk);
    bool ok = out != NULL;
    for (uint64_t off = 0; ok && off < size; off += chunk) {
        uint64_t n = size - off < chunk ? size - off : chunk;
        ok = romfs_image_pread(img, buf, n, off) == (ssize_t)n && fwrite(buf, 1, n, out) == n;
        if ((off / chunk) % 64 == 0) fprintf(stderr, "\r[romfs] %llu / %llu MB", (unsigned long long)(off >> 20),
                                             (unsigned long long)(size >> 20));
    }
    if (out && fclose(out) != 0) ok = false;
    if (!ok) remove(out_path);
    free(buf);
    romfs_image_close(img);
    fprintf(stderr, "\n[romfs] %s %s\n", ok ? "wrote" : "failed to write", out_path);
    return ok ? 0 : 1;
}

// The start screen (runtime/ui/launcher.mm), in one of two modes: SETUP sets the game files up and nothing else (a
// plain start before they're ready; the game starts once they are), CONFIG is the whole configuration screen - Play,
// Settings, the game files, Quit ("Savage Wind Configuration", --config; Quit to Start Screen comes back to it).
enum { LAUNCHER_SETUP, LAUNCHER_CONFIG, LAUNCHER_NONE };
void launcher_run(const char *root, int mode);
bool launcher_game_ready(const char *root);
int launcher_prepare(const char *root, const char *src);  // --prepare --game <folder>: the setup, without a window
bool launcher_config_key_held(void);  // (macOS: Option held while the app opens)

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    // SW Update asks this of a version it has just installed: getting here means every DLL loaded
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++)
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--update-health")) return POST_UPDATE_HEALTH_EXIT;
    if (post_update_recover_if_cut()) return 0;  // (a new copy of this program is running now, with its files put back)
    plat_init();
#ifdef _WIN32
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);  // the Windows CRT treats _IOLBF as full buffering
#else
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
#endif
    // every log starts with which Savage Wind made it: the version and the source it was built from (Makefile SW_SOURCE)
    extern const char *rt_version(void);  // (runtime/ui/launcher.mm)
    fprintf(stderr, "[savagewind] Savage Wind %s (%s)\n", rt_version(), SW_SOURCE);
    launch_flags_boot(argc, argv);  // the saved launch options (runtime/launch_flags.h): in the environment before anything reads it
    control_init();
    const char *root = "extracted";  // (in the data root)
    bool skip_launcher = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NO_LAUNCHER") || getenv("SAVAGEWIND_INPUT");  // tests boot straight in
    bool config = false, game_first = false;
    static char arg_root[1024];
    const char *dump = NULL, *seed_out = NULL, *game_src = NULL;
    bool scan = false, precompile = false, add_steam = false, prepare = false;
    // (--game takes a folder only with --prepare: a plain --game stays the Steam entry below)
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) prepare |= !strcmp(argv[i], "--prepare");
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--play")) skip_launcher = true;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--config")) config = true;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--game")) {
            game_first = true;  // (the Steam entry: into the game when it's ready)
            if (prepare && i + 1 < argc && argv[i + 1][0] != '-') game_src = argv[++i];
        }
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--dump-romfs") && i + 1 < argc) dump = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--scan-shaders")) scan = true;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--add-to-steam")) add_steam = true;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--precompile-shaders")) precompile = true;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--export-pipeline-seed") && i + 1 < argc) seed_out = argv[++i];
        else if (argv[i][0] != '-' && !realpath(argv[i], arg_root)) root = argv[i];  // (relative to where we started)
        else if (argv[i][0] != '-') root = arg_root;
    }
#ifdef __APPLE__
    if (launcher_config_key_held()) config = true;  // (the Mac's "Savage Wind Configuration": Option held)
#endif
    rt_paths_init();  // the data root becomes the working directory (runtime/paths.h)
    // (after it: savagewind.ini is in the data root; before it the file wasn't found where that isn't where we started)
    settings_load();
    static const char *const sparse_heap_modes[SPARSE_HEAP_COUNT] = {"auto", "on", "off"};
    int sparse_heap = g_settings.sparse_heap;
    if (sparse_heap < 0 || sparse_heap >= SPARSE_HEAP_COUNT) sparse_heap = SPARSE_HEAP_AUTO;
    LOG("[settings] sparse_heap=%s\n", sparse_heap_modes[sparse_heap]);
    if (dump) return dump_romfs(root, dump);
    if (scan) return scan_shaders(root);
    if (add_steam) {  // what Configuration's Add to Steam does, from a terminal (runtime/steam_shortcuts.h)
        char msg[800];
        bool ok = steam_add_savage_wind(msg, sizeof msg);
        fprintf(stderr, "[steam] %s\n", msg);
        printf("%s\n", msg);
        return ok ? 0 : 1;
    }
    if (prepare) {  // a launcher brings the player's own copy: the setup of the start screen, with no window
        if (!game_src) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[prepare] --prepare needs --game <folder with exefs and romfs>\n");
            return 1;
        }
        return launcher_prepare(root, game_src);
    }
#ifndef __APPLE__
    if (precompile) return precompile_shaders(root);
    if (seed_out) return export_pipeline_seed(root, seed_out);
#else
    (void)precompile;
    (void)seed_out;
#endif
    // A plain start goes straight into the game once the game files are set up and the game code built from them
    // matches this build; the start screen only when there is something to set up, or when asked for.
    int mode = config ? LAUNCHER_CONFIG : skip_launcher || launcher_game_ready(root) ? LAUNCHER_NONE : LAUNCHER_SETUP;
    // A release (runtime/post_update.h): the first start of a new version finishes setting it up first (the shader caches
    // go now, before Vulkan opens them), and a plain start opens Savage Wind Configuration, where updates are offered.
    if (!skip_launcher && !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN")) {
        bool new_version = post_update_pending(rt_version());
        if (new_version) post_update_reset_shaders(rt_version());
        else post_update_tidy(rt_version());
        if (new_version || (mode == LAUNCHER_NONE && g_settings.start_in_config && !game_first && post_update_shipped()))
            mode = LAUNCHER_CONFIG;
    }
    // (tests of the start screen - screenshots, setup and delete runs - show it: the configuration screen, or
    // SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCHER_MODE=setup / config)
    const char *test_mode = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCHER_MODE");
    if (test_mode || getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCHER_SHOT") || getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCHER_EXTRACT") ||
        getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCHER_SETUP") || getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCHER_DELETE"))
        mode = test_mode && !strcmp(test_mode, "setup") ? LAUNCHER_SETUP : LAUNCHER_CONFIG;
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (mode == LAUNCHER_NONE) {
        // Select the GPU before the game's SetHeapSize chooses eager or lazy backing. (Hidden: shown with the boot
        // picture's first frame, boot_splash_start, not as an empty black window while the game code loads.)
        extern void ui_window_init_hidden(void);
        ui_window_init_hidden();
    }
#endif
    for (;;) {
        if (mode != LAUNCHER_NONE) {
            launcher_run(root, mode);
            launch_flags_play(root);  // changed launch options: restart straight into the game with them
        }
        // The game holds the lock on its save folder while it runs, so the Saves tab of another Savage Wind refuses to
        // swap or copy saves under it. Not getting it (somebody else has it, or no lock file can be made) never stops
        // the game; it is let go before the start screen of a reboot, which is this same process.
        { extern void save_backup_at_start(void); save_backup_at_start(); }  // (Saves > Back up at each start; before the lock)
        ScLock *save_lock = NULL;
        sp_session_begin();  // the save profile chosen on the start screen (runtime/services/save_profiles.h)
        if (sc_lock_take(sp_session_save_dir(), &save_lock) == SC_LOCK_BUSY)
            fprintf(stderr, "[saves] another Savage Wind is running with this save folder; saving from both can overwrite saves\n");
#ifndef __APPLE__
        // the start screen's picture, moving, until the game's title screen is up (vulkan/device.c; a window made
        // already: Windows, or back from the start screen)
        extern void boot_splash_start(void);
        boot_splash_start();
#endif
        boot(root);
        int kind = ui_run();  // window and input on the main thread; returns when a reboot is requested
        teardown();
        sc_lock_drop(save_lock);
        mode = kind == RT_REBOOT_TITLE ? LAUNCHER_CONFIG : LAUNCHER_NONE;
    }
}
```
