```c
                                   .descriptorCount = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER,
                                   .pImageInfo = &mi};
        rec_UpdateDescriptorSets(1, &mw);
        rec_CmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, hdr_ui_pipe);
        rec_CmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, hdr_ui_layout, 0, 1, &ds, 0, NULL);
        rec_CmdPushConstants(cb, hdr_ui_layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, sizeof nits, nits);
        rec_CmdDraw(cb, 3, 1, 0, 0);
    }
    rec_CmdEndRendering(cb);
    vk_dyn_forget();
    image_barrier(cb, hdr_sc_images[i], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR);
}

uint64_t g_present_split[6];  // (VK_PROF) acquire, end pass, draw + menu, submit, present, slot wait
typedef struct { uint32_t image; VkSemaphore acquired; bool ok; bool hdr_game, menu; } Frame;
static Frame cur_frame;

// The image the frame is drawn into: the game's float picture for an HDR frame, else the 8-bit window image (game
// frames without a float source: menus, movies, the start screen; it is also where the overlay menu is drawn).
static VkImage frame_image(void) {
    return cur_frame.hdr_game ? hdr_game_images[cur_frame.image] : g_vk.sc_images[cur_frame.image];
}
static VkImageView frame_view(void) {
    return cur_frame.hdr_game ? hdr_game_views[cur_frame.image] : g_vk.sc_views[cur_frame.image];
}
static VkFormat frame_format(void) {
    return cur_frame.hdr_game ? VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT : g_vk.sc_format;
}
VkFormat vk_frame_format(void) { return frame_format(); }
bool vk_frame_hdr(void) { return cur_frame.hdr_game; }

// Acquire the next window image and begin rendering into it (cleared to `clear`). hdr_game: the caller has the game's
// float picture (hdr.c) and draws it into RGBA16F. Returns false when there is nothing to draw into (minimised window).
static bool frame_begin(const float clear[4], bool hdr_game) {
    cur_frame.ok = false;
    cur_frame.hdr_game = false;
    cur_frame.menu = false;
    int w, h;
    SDL_GetWindowSizeInPixels(window, &w, &h);
    // minimised (Windows keeps the window's size then, but its surface is 0 x 0: every acquire was out of date)
    if (!w || !h || (SDL_GetWindowFlags(window) & SDL_WINDOW_MINIMIZED)) return false;
    uint64_t tp = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    { SW_ZONE("present/wait_room"); present_wait_room(); }
    g_present_split[4] += SDL_GetTicksNS() - tp;
    float white;  // (Windows HDR turned on or off, the window moved to another display, Video > HDR changed)
    bool hdr = hdr_wanted(&white);
    if (g_hdr) g_hdr_white = white;
    if (!g_vk.swapchain || (uint32_t)w != g_vk.sc_extent.width || (uint32_t)h != g_vk.sc_extent.height ||
        atomic_exchange(&pres_stale, 0) || g_vk.sc_mode != wanted_present_mode() || hdr != (g_hdr || hdr_failed))
        recreate_swapchain();
    if (!g_vk.swapchain) return false;
    static int trace = -1;
    if (trace < 0) trace = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_TRACE") != NULL;
    if (trace) LOG("[vk] frame begin %dx%d (swapchain %ux%u)\n", w, h, g_vk.sc_extent.width, g_vk.sc_extent.height);
    slot = (slot + 1) % FRAMES;
    if (!acquire_sem[slot]) acquire_sem[slot] = binary_semaphore();
    uint64_t tw = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    { SW_ZONE("present/slot_wait"); vk_wait_seq(slot_seq[slot]); }
    g_present_split[5] += SDL_GetTicksNS() - tw;
    uint64_t ta = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    VkResult r;
    { SW_ZONE("present/acquire"); r = acquire_image(acquire_sem[slot], &cur_frame.image); }
    g_present_split[0] += SDL_GetTicksNS() - ta;
    if (r == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR) {
        recreate_swapchain();
        r = acquire_image(acquire_sem[slot], &cur_frame.image);
    }
    if (r == VK_TIMEOUT) {  // (no image came: acquire_image, #224) this frame is left out, the swapchain made again
        static unsigned timeouts;
        if (timeouts++ < 5 || timeouts % 100 == 0)
            LOG("[vk] no window image within %llu ms (%u times; %s, %s): frame left out, swapchain made again\n",
                (unsigned long long)(ACQUIRE_GIVE_UP_NS / 1000000), timeouts,
                (SDL_GetWindowFlags(window) & SDL_WINDOW_MINIMIZED) ? "minimised" : "not minimised",
                (SDL_GetWindowFlags(window) & SDL_WINDOW_INPUT_FOCUS) ? "focused" : "not focused");
        atomic_store(&pres_stale, 1);
        return false;
    }
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS && r != VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) {
        static unsigned failed;  // (a few, then every 1000th: one a frame filled the log)
        if (failed++ < 5 || failed % 1000 == 0) LOG("[vk] acquire failed: %d (%u times)\n", r, failed);
        return false;
    }
    cur_frame.acquired = acquire_sem[slot];
    cur_frame.hdr_game = hdr_game && g_hdr && cur_frame.image < hdr_game_count;
    slot_seq[slot] = vk_pending_seq();
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    // The window pass reads the game's image, written by an earlier submission's passes: only the full barrier that
    // ends an upload command buffer made those writes visible, when this submission had uploads (validation:
    // READ_AFTER_WRITE on the present draw once the recorder thread changed when they come)
    vk_full_barrier(cb);
    image_barrier(cb, frame_image(), VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
    VkRenderingAttachmentInfo ca = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO, .imageView = frame_view(),
                                    .imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL,
                                    .loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR, .storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE,
                                    .clearValue.color.float32 = {clear[0], clear[1], clear[2], clear[3]}};
    VkRenderingInfo ri = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO, .renderArea = {{0, 0}, g_vk.sc_extent}, .layerCount = 1,
                          .colorAttachmentCount = 1, .pColorAttachments = &ca};
    rec_CmdBeginRendering(cb, &ri);
    VkViewport vp = {0, 0, (float)g_vk.sc_extent.width, (float)g_vk.sc_extent.height, 0, 1};
    VkRect2D sc = {{0, 0}, g_vk.sc_extent};
    rec_CmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vp);
    rec_CmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &sc);
    vk_dyn_forget();
    cur_frame.ok = true;
    return true;
}

bool vk_frame_begin(const float clear[4]) { return frame_begin(clear, false); }

// Passes of their own between vk_frame_begin and vk_frame_end (exec.c post passes): end the window image's
// rendering, and begin it again keeping what was drawn.
void vk_frame_suspend(void) {
    if (cur_frame.ok) rec_CmdEndRendering(vk_cmd());
}
void vk_frame_resume(void) {
    if (!cur_frame.ok) return;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    VkRenderingAttachmentInfo ca = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO, .imageView = frame_view(),
                                    .imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL,
                                    .loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD, .storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE};
    VkRenderingInfo ri = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO, .renderArea = {{0, 0}, g_vk.sc_extent}, .layerCount = 1,
                          .colorAttachmentCount = 1, .pColorAttachments = &ca};
    rec_CmdBeginRendering(cb, &ri);
    VkViewport vp = {0, 0, (float)g_vk.sc_extent.width, (float)g_vk.sc_extent.height, 0, 1};
    VkRect2D sc = {{0, 0}, g_vk.sc_extent};
    rec_CmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vp);
    rec_CmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &sc);
    vk_dyn_forget();
}

// The overlay menu into the 8-bit window image while the game's float picture is in hdr_game (it is composed after
// the PQ encode at the HUD's white, so the menu keeps its colours).
static void frame_menu_begin(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (!cur_frame.ok || !cur_frame.hdr_game) return;
    rec_CmdEndRendering(cb);
    image_barrier(cb, g_vk.sc_images[cur_frame.image], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
    const float zero[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    VkRenderingAttachmentInfo ca = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO,
                                    .imageView = g_vk.sc_views[cur_frame.image],
                                    .imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL,
                                    .loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR, .storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE,
                                    .clearValue.color.float32 = {zero[0], zero[1], zero[2], zero[3]}};
    VkRenderingInfo ri = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO, .renderArea = {{0, 0}, g_vk.sc_extent}, .layerCount = 1,
                          .colorAttachmentCount = 1, .pColorAttachments = &ca};
    rec_CmdBeginRendering(cb, &ri);
    VkViewport vp = {0, 0, (float)g_vk.sc_extent.width, (float)g_vk.sc_extent.height, 0, 1};
    VkRect2D sc = {{0, 0}, g_vk.sc_extent};
    rec_CmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vp);
    rec_CmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &sc);
    vk_dyn_forget();
    cur_frame.menu = true;
}

VkExtent2D vk_frame_extent(void) { return g_vk.sc_extent; }
void *vk_frame_cmd(void) {  // (the start screen's ImGui records into it itself: what was queued before goes first)
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    rec_drain();
    return (void *)cb;
}

static void save_window_image(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkSpan *out) {
    uint32_t w = g_vk.sc_extent.width, h = g_vk.sc_extent.height;
    *out = vk_readback((uint64_t)w * h * 4);
    image_barrier(cb, frame_image(), VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    VkBufferImageCopy rg = {.bufferOffset = out->off, .imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                            .imageExtent = {w, h, 1}};
    rec_CmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, frame_image(), VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, out->buf, 1, &rg);
    image_barrier(cb, frame_image(), VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
}

// The HDR game picture is RGBA16F: 8 bytes a pixel, converted to sRGB for the PNG (linear 1.0 is white) when the
// submission has completed.
static void save_hdr_game_image(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkSpan *out) {
    uint32_t w = g_vk.sc_extent.width, h = g_vk.sc_extent.height;
    *out = vk_readback((uint64_t)w * h * 8);
    image_barrier(cb, hdr_game_images[cur_frame.image], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL,
                  VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    VkBufferImageCopy rg = {.bufferOffset = out->off, .imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                            .imageExtent = {w, h, 1}};
    rec_CmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, hdr_game_images[cur_frame.image], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, out->buf, 1, &rg);
    image_barrier(cb, hdr_game_images[cur_frame.image], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                  VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
}

// End rendering into the window image and present it. shot_path: also save the window image as PNG.
static int frame_kind;  // (frame generation: PRES_GEN / PRES_AFTER_GEN for the next vk_frame_end's present)
void vk_frame_end(const char *shot_path) {
    if (!cur_frame.ok) return;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    bool hdr_game = cur_frame.hdr_game;
    rec_CmdEndRendering(cb);
    VkSpan shot = {0};
    if (shot_path) {
        if (hdr_game) save_hdr_game_image(cb, &shot);
        else save_window_image(cb, &shot);
    }
    if (hdr_game) hdr_game_write(cb, cur_frame.image, cur_frame.menu);
    else if (g_hdr) hdr_write(cb, cur_frame.image);
    else image_barrier(cb, g_vk.sc_images[cur_frame.image], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR);
    uint32_t img = cur_frame.image;
    if (!done_sem[img]) done_sem[img] = binary_semaphore();
    uint64_t seq = vk_pending_seq();
    uint64_t ts = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    { SW_ZONE("present/submit"); vk_submit_extra(cur_frame.acquired, done_sem[img], VK_NULL_HANDLE); }
    g_present_split[3] += SDL_GetTicksNS() - ts;
    ts = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    bool presented_ok;
    { SW_ZONE("present/queue_present"); presented_ok = present_image(img, done_sem[img], frame_kind, seq); }
    if (!presented_ok) recreate_swapchain();
    frame_kind = PRES_PLAIN;
    g_present_split[4] += SDL_GetTicksNS() - ts;
    cur_frame.ok = false;
    cur_frame.menu = false;
    cur_frame.hdr_game = false;
    if (shot_path) {
        vk_wait_seq(seq);
        uint32_t w = g_vk.sc_extent.width, h = g_vk.sc_extent.height;
        if (hdr_game) {
            _Float16 *hp = shot.ptr;
            uint8_t *px = shot.ptr;
            float mx = 0.0f;
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < (uint64_t)w * h; i++)
                for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                    float l = (float)hp[i * 4 + c];
                    if (!(l > 0.0f)) l = 0.0f;
                    if (l > mx) mx = l;
                    sum += l;
                    float s = l <= 0.0031308f ? 12.92f * l : 1.055f * powf(l, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f;
                    if (s > 1.0f) s = 1.0f;
                    px[i * 4 + c] = (uint8_t)(s * 255.0f + 0.5f);
                }
            LOG("[hdr] float picture: max %.3f (%.0f nits), mean %.3f (%.0f nits)\n", mx, mx * g_hdr_white,
                (float)(sum / ((double)w * h * 3)), (float)(sum / ((double)w * h * 3)) * g_hdr_white);
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < (uint64_t)w * h; i++) px[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
            vk_save_png(shot_path, px, w, h);
        } else {
            uint8_t *px = shot.ptr;
            bool bgr = g_vk.sc_format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || g_vk.sc_format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;
            for (uint64_t i = 0; bgr && i < (uint64_t)w * h; i++) { uint8_t t = px[i * 4]; px[i * 4] = px[i * 4 + 2]; px[i * 4 + 2] = t; }
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < (uint64_t)w * h; i++) px[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
            vk_save_png(shot_path, px, w, h);
        }
    }
}

// Saved opaque: render targets often keep data in alpha (BOTW's G-buffer), which image viewers turn into black.
void vk_save_png(const char *path, const uint8_t *rgba, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    if (rt_save_png(path, rgba, (int)w, (int)h)) LOG("[vk] saved %s (%ux%u)\n", path, w, h);
    else LOG("[vk] saving %s failed\n", path);
}

// ================================================================== game presentation (metal.m backend_present)
// Draws the game's image into the window with the widescreen crop, then the overlay menu.
extern void vk_present_draw(VkCommandBuffer cb, TexBackend *b, float vx, float vy, float vw, float vh, const float pv[8]);
void renderer_submit(void);
void renderer_set_scale(float sx, float sy);
void renderer_set_scene_scale(float sx, float sy);
uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);
void renderer_save_texture_tex(TexBackend *b, const char *path);

static uint64_t frames, total_frames, g_frame_counter;
uint64_t renderer_present_count(void) { return total_frames; }
static uint64_t presented_frames(void) { return total_frames; }
uint64_t vk_frame_counter(void) { return g_frame_counter; }
static float g_shot_crop[4] = {0, 0, 1, 1};
static double last_fps_time;
static NvnTexture *g_last_presented;

const float *vk_shot_crop(void) { return g_shot_crop; }

void backend_present(NvnTexture *t);
void backend_represent(void) {
    if (g_last_presented) backend_present(g_last_presented);
    else SDL_Delay(16);
}

// ---- pipeline pre-warm (exec.c): the first frame that looks like gameplay waits until the pipelines of the list are
// built. When that takes more than a moment, the window shows a bar of how far it is meanwhile (black, the bar a
// third of the width near the bottom; clears only, nothing to compile).
bool vk_pso_wait_needed(void);
bool vk_pso_wait(int ms, float *done);

static void present_progress(float done) {
    static const float black[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1};
    if (!vk_frame_begin(black)) return;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    int32_t w = (int32_t)g_vk.sc_extent.width, h = (int32_t)g_vk.sc_extent.height;
    int32_t bw = w / 3, bh = h / 90 > 4 ? h / 90 : 4, x = (w - bw) / 2, y = h - h / 8;
    int32_t fill = (int32_t)(done * (float)bw);
    struct { VkRect2D r; float c; } parts[3] = {{{{x - 2, y - 2}, {(uint32_t)bw + 4, (uint32_t)bh + 4}}, 0.4f},
                                                {{{x, y}, {(uint32_t)bw, (uint32_t)bh}}, 0.06f},
                                                {{{x, y}, {(uint32_t)(fill > 0 ? fill : 0), (uint32_t)bh}}, 0.85f}};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (!parts[i].r.extent.width || x < 2 || y < 2) continue;
        VkClearAttachment a = {.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, .colorAttachment = 0,
                               .clearValue.color.float32 = {parts[i].c, parts[i].c, parts[i].c, 1}};
        VkClearRect cr = {parts[i].r, 0, 1};
        rec_CmdClearAttachments(cb, 1, &a, 1, &cr);
    }
    static int shot;  // (SAVAGEWIND_PSO_SLOW_MS, exec.c: the first bar frame past a quarter)
    bool save = !shot && done > 0.25f && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PSO_SLOW_MS");
    if (save) { shot = 1; mkdir("build", 0755); }
    vk_frame_end(save ? "build/pso_wait.png" : NULL);
}

static uint64_t pso_wait(void) {  // ns waited
    if (!vk_pso_wait_needed()) return 0;
    uint64_t t0 = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    float done = 0;
    int bars = 0;
    while (!vk_pso_wait(100, &done))
        if (SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0 > 300000000ull) { present_progress(done); bars++; }
    uint64_t dt = SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0;
    LOG("[pso] frame %llu waited %.0f ms for the pipeline pre-warm (%d frames with the bar)\n", (unsigned long long)total_frames + 1,
        dt / 1e6, bars);
    return dt;
}

// Frame generation (Video > Frame generation; exec.c vk_fg_generate): wanted in play, not over the menus (the pause
// menu's pages, the map, the title screen, the F1 menu), where the picture mostly stands and the game's own frames
// keep its cursor crisp. SAVAGEWIND_FG=0/1 overrides the setting (tests).
extern volatile int g_fg_want;
extern volatile int g_fg_active;  // (framepace.c: the game draws every other presented frame)
TexBackend *vk_fg_generate(NvnTexture *t, TexBackend *b);
static uint64_t gen_frames;
#ifdef SW_PGO_GENERATE
static void write_runtime_profile(void) {
    extern int __llvm_profile_write_file(void);
    if (__llvm_profile_write_file()) LOG("[pgo] could not write the runtime profile\n");
}
#endif

static char fg_real_shot[256];  // (SAVAGEWIND_FG_SHOT_AT: the game's frame after a generated one saved)

void vk_fg_wait_idle(void) {
    vk_present_idle();
    if (!rec_on_recorder()) rec_drain();
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.dev);
}

static bool fg_wanted(void) {
    static int forced = -2;
    if (forced == -2) forced = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG") ? atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG")) : -1;
    if (g_hdr) return false;  // (frame generation's copies are 8-bit and would clip the HDR picture)
    if (!(forced >= 0 ? forced : g_settings.frame_gen)) return false;
    static int log = -1;
    static uint64_t n;
    if (log < 0) log = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG_LOG") != NULL;
    if (log && n++ % 300 == 0)
        LOG("[fg] wanted? title %d menu %d paused %d F1 menu %d\n", framepace_title_ui(), framepace_menu_ui(),
            framepace_paused(), menu_is_open());
    return !framepace_title_ui() && !framepace_menu_ui() && !framepace_paused() && !menu_is_open();
}

// The image being presented, for the control endpoint's `shot` (runtime/control_game.c; commands run in this frame).
static TexBackend *ctl_present_tex;
bool control_shot_now(const char *path) {
    if (!ctl_present_tex) return false;
    renderer_save_texture_tex(ctl_present_tex, path);
    return true;
}

// The world camera's view matrix (3x4, row-major, as the shaders read it) of the last finished frame, for the control
// endpoint's `camera` (runtime/control_game.c). false: none (motion recording is off, or no scene was drawn).
bool control_camera_view(float view[12]) {
    if (!mvec_enabled()) return false;  // switching TAA off leaves the old camera cached; it no longer follows the game
    const MvecCamera *c = mvec_camera(true);
    if (!c) return false;
    memcpy(view, c->view, 12 * sizeof(float));
    return true;
}

// ---- the boot picture (ui/launcher.mm boot_splash_*): the start screen's background, moving, in the window from the
// game's start until its title screen shows, in place of ~11 s of black (launcher.mm says where they come from). A
// thread draws it while Savage Wind loads and the game has presented nothing (the main thread is busy in boot, then
// waits for events); from the game's first present on, present_locked draws it instead of the game's frames. The
// game's title screen is up ~2.5 s before anything of it shows (its world loads, black): the picture stays until the
// draws a frame have settled (BOOT_SETTLE_NS within 15 % of each other, at least BOOT_MIN_DRAWS: the title's world is
// drawn), then fades into the game's frames over BOOT_FADE_NS. A loading screen (a start straight into the world) ends
// it too, and BOOT_MAX_NS. Off with SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN (tests) and SAVAGEWIND_NO_BOOT_SPLASH.
void boot_splash_open(void);
bool boot_splash_active(void);
void boot_splash_draw(void *cmd, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, float alpha);
void boot_splash_close(void);
uint64_t vk_draw_total(void);  // (exec.c)
#define BOOT_SETTLE_NS 400000000ull
#define BOOT_FADE_NS 500000000ull
#define BOOT_MAX_NS 30000000000ull
#define BOOT_MIN_DRAWS 20
static bool boot_hold;          // (GPU lock) the picture is up
static float boot_alpha = 1;    // (GPU lock) how much of it (fading out: below 1)
static atomic_bool boot_drawing;  // the thread draws it (until the game's first present)
static uint64_t boot_hold_since, boot_title_at, boot_settled_at, boot_fade_at, boot_draws_last, boot_draws_prev;

static void boot_splash_frame(void) {  // (GPU lock held)
    static const float black[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1};
    vk_end_pass();
    if (!vk_frame_begin(black)) return;
    boot_splash_draw(vk_frame_cmd(), g_vk.sc_extent.width, g_vk.sc_extent.height, 1);
    vk_frame_end(NULL);
}

static int boot_splash_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    while (atomic_load(&boot_drawing)) {
        gpu_lock();
        if (atomic_load(&boot_drawing)) boot_splash_frame();
        gpu_unlock();
        SDL_Delay(16);  // (~60 a second: the picture moves slowly)
    }
    return 0;
}

static bool window_hidden;  // (made hidden: ui_window_init_hidden) until ui_window_show
static void ui_window_show(void) {
    if (window && window_hidden && !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN")) SDL_ShowWindow(window);
    window_hidden = false;
}

// (runtime/main.c, before each boot; the main thread) the picture up, and the window shown with it
void boot_splash_start(void) {
    if (!window) return;  // (made later, in ui_run: Linux and macOS)
    if (!getenv("SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN") && !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NO_BOOT_SPLASH") && g_settings.boot_picture) {
        gpu_lock();
        boot_splash_open();
        boot_hold = true, boot_alpha = 1, boot_hold_since = SDL_GetTicksNS();
        boot_title_at = boot_settled_at = boot_fade_at = boot_draws_prev = 0;
        boot_draws_last = vk_draw_total();
        boot_splash_frame();
        gpu_unlock();
        LOG("[boot] picture up (%.0f ms to make)\n", (SDL_GetTicksNS() - boot_hold_since) / 1e6);
        atomic_store(&boot_drawing, true);
        SDL_Thread *th = SDL_CreateThread(boot_splash_thread, "boot picture", NULL);
        if (th) SDL_DetachThread(th);
        else atomic_store(&boot_drawing, false);
    }
    ui_window_show();
}

static bool boot_held(void) {  // (GPU lock held: present_locked)
    if (!boot_hold) return false;
    atomic_store(&boot_drawing, false);  // (the game presents: the picture goes with its frames now)
    uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    if (boot_fade_at) {  // fading into the game's frames
        boot_alpha = 1.0f - (float)(now - boot_fade_at) / (float)BOOT_FADE_NS;
        if (boot_alpha <= 0) {
            boot_hold = false, boot_alpha = 1;
            LOG("[boot] picture gone %.2f s after the start (frame %llu)\n", (now - boot_hold_since) / 1e9,
                (unsigned long long)total_frames);
        }
        return boot_hold;
    }
    // the draws of the frame before this one
    uint64_t total = vk_draw_total(), d = total - boot_draws_last;
    boot_draws_last = total;
    if (!boot_title_at && framepace_title_ui()) {
        boot_title_at = now;
        LOG("[boot] title screen up %.2f s after the start (frame %llu)\n", (now - boot_hold_since) / 1e9,
            (unsigned long long)total_frames);
    }
    if (boot_title_at) {
        bool steady = d >= BOOT_MIN_DRAWS && boot_draws_prev && d * 100 >= boot_draws_prev * 85 &&
                      d * 85 <= boot_draws_prev * 100;
        if (!steady) boot_settled_at = 0;
        else if (!boot_settled_at) boot_settled_at = now;
        boot_draws_prev = d;
    }
    const char *why = boot_settled_at && now - boot_settled_at > BOOT_SETTLE_NS ? "title screen drawn"
                    : framepace_loading_ui()                                    ? "loading screen"
                    : now - boot_hold_since > BOOT_MAX_NS                       ? "time limit"
                                                                                : NULL;
    if (why) {
        LOG("[boot] picture fading %.2f s after the start (frame %llu, %s, %llu draws a frame)\n",
            (now - boot_hold_since) / 1e9, (unsigned long long)total_frames, why, (unsigned long long)d);
        boot_fade_at = now;
    }
    return boot_hold;
}

static void present_locked(NvnTexture *t) {
    g_last_presented = t;
    TexBackend *b = vk_tex(t, true);
    ctl_present_tex = b;
    b->presented = true;
    uint64_t t0 = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    { SW_ZONE("present/end_pass"); vk_end_pass(); }
    g_present_split[1] += SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0;
    t0 += pso_wait();  // (not the acquire's time)
    bool held = boot_held();
    if (!held && boot_splash_active()) boot_splash_close();  // (the game's own frames from here on)
    // HDR: the game copied its float 10-bit image (linear, HUD included) into the 8-bit image it presents (hdr.c). Use
    // the float source instead, so the picture keeps the tonemap's highlights. The boot picture is SDR and has its own
    // 8-bit pipeline, so HDR waits until it is gone.
    VkImage hsrc = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkFormat hfmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    uint32_t hw = 0, hh = 0;
    bool hdr_src = g_hdr && !held && vk_hdr_source(b->image, &hsrc, &hfmt, &hw, &hh);
    if (!hdr_src && g_hdr && !held && b->hdr_upgraded) {  // (a game that presents its float image directly)
        hdr_src = true;
        hsrc = b->image, hfmt = b->format, hw = b->width, hh = b->height;
    }

    // The float source as its own backend. Static, so its cached views survive frames; forgotten below when the
    // source changes (resize, reload, reboot: the old view must not be reused for new image memory).
    static TexBackend hb;
    static VkImage hb_image;
    static VkFormat hb_fmt;
    TexBackend *src = b;
    if (hdr_src && (hsrc != hb_image || hfmt != hb_fmt || b->image != hb.image)) {
        hb = *b;
        hb.image = hsrc, hb.format = hfmt, hb.width = hw, hb.height = hh;
        vk_views_forget(&hb);  // (the previous source's cached views must not be reused for the new image)
        hb_image = hsrc, hb_fmt = hfmt;
    }
    if (hdr_src) src = &hb;
    static int hdr_missing, hdr_found_told;
    if (hdr_src) {
        hdr_missing = 0;
        if (!hdr_found_told++) LOG("[hdr] presenting the game's float picture (HDR)\n");
    } else if (g_hdr && !held && ++hdr_missing == 10) {
        LOG("[hdr] HDR10 output, but the game's float picture was not found (the 8-bit copy is shown)\n");
    }
    // Frame generation: the frame between the last one and this (exec.c vk_fg_generate), presented first. Its copies
    // are 8-bit and would clip the HDR picture, so it stays off while the game's float picture is presented.
    TexBackend *gen;
    { SW_ZONE("present/frame_gen"); gen = (held || hdr_src) ? NULL : vk_fg_generate(t, b); }
    {   // (measuring) SAVAGEWIND_FG_TEST=1: the frame made, not presented
        static int test = -1;
        if (test < 0) test = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG_TEST") ? atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG_TEST")) : 0;
        if (test == 1) gen = NULL;
    }
    g_fg_active = gen != NULL;
    static const float black[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1};
    bool have;
    { SW_ZONE("present/frame_begin"); have = frame_begin(black, hdr_src); }
    if (hdr_src && !vk_frame_hdr()) {  // (HDR was turned off while the swapchain was remade)
        hdr_src = false;
        src = b;
        gen = NULL;  // (the generated frame path was skipped above for HDR)
    }
    uint64_t nd = SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0;
    if (nd > 30000000) {
        static int warned;
        if (warned++ < 20) LOG("[vk] acquire blocked %llums\n", (unsigned long long)(nd / 1000000));
    }
    if (have) {
        double dw = g_vk.sc_extent.width, dh = g_vk.sc_extent.height;
        // render scale + placement in the window: runtime/nvn/output_scale.c (Video page "Upscaler"). A window that
        // isn't 16:9 shows more of the world (Video > Fill wide screens: the game's views widened, output_scale.c
        // rt_persp), else the game's 16:9 image fitted into it with bars.
        // Fullscreen on a size the display has no mode for (runtime/window_size.c): that size, scaled to the screen.
        OutScale os;
        int iw, ih;
        if (winsize_virtual(&iw, &ih) && (iw != (int)dw || ih != (int)dh)) {
            output_scale(iw, ih, g_settings.wide_view, &os);
            output_scale_screen(dw, dh, iw, ih, &os);
        } else {
            output_scale(dw, dh, g_settings.wide_view, &os);
        }
        double sx = os.sx, sy = os.sy, vx = os.vx, vy = os.vy, vw = os.vw, vh = os.vh;
        float crop[4] = {(float)os.crop[0], (float)os.crop[1], (float)os.crop[2], (float)os.crop[3]};  // (uv origin, size)
        renderer_set_scale((float)sx, (float)sy);
        renderer_set_scene_scale((float)os.scene_sx, (float)os.scene_sy);
        renderer_set_shadow_size(shadow_map_size(total_frames + 1));
        if (held && !boot_fade_at) {  // (the game's frame is still black: the boot picture in its place)
            boot_splash_draw(vk_frame_cmd(), g_vk.sc_extent.width, g_vk.sc_extent.height, 1);
            vk_frame_end(NULL);
            goto presented;
        }
        VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
        float pv[8] = {renderer_origin_lower_left() ? 1.0f : 0.0f, 0, 0, 0, crop[0], crop[1], crop[2], crop[3]};
        memcpy(g_shot_crop, crop, sizeof crop);
        uint64_t td = SDL_GetTicksNS();
        if (gen) {  // the generated frame, as the game's are (crop, anti-aliasing, menu), then this one half a frame later
            vk_present_draw(cb, gen, (float)vx, (float)vy, (float)vw, (float)vh, pv);
            if (menu_render_needed()) rec_drain();  // (ImGui records into cb itself, and may upload its fonts on the queue)
            menu_render((void *)cb, g_vk.sc_extent.width, g_vk.sc_extent.height);
            // SAVAGEWIND_FG_SHOT_AT=<frame>,... (counted as SAVAGEWIND_SHOT_AT): the window at two presents in a row
            // from there, each generated frame and the game's after it -> build/frames/window_N_<0|1>_<gen|real>.png
            // (real 0, gen 1, real 1: a generated frame between the two it was made from)
            static const char *gnext;
            static int ginit, gleft;
            static long gat;
            if (!ginit) { ginit = 1; gnext = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG_SHOT_AT"); if (gnext) mkdir("build/frames", 0755); }
            if (!gleft && gnext && *gnext) {
                extern uint64_t framepace_script_frame(uint64_t presented);
                long at = strtol(gnext, NULL, 10);
                if ((long)framepace_script_frame(total_frames + 1) >= at) {
                    gat = at, gleft = 2;
                    while (*gnext && *gnext != ',') gnext++;
                    if (*gnext == ',') gnext++;
                }
            }
            char gpath[256] = "";
            if (gleft) {
                snprintf(gpath, sizeof gpath, "build/frames/window_%05ld_%d_gen.png", gat, 2 - gleft);
                snprintf(fg_real_shot, sizeof fg_real_shot, "build/frames/window_%05ld_%d_real.png", gat, 2 - gleft);
                gleft--;
            }
            frame_kind = PRES_GEN;
            vk_frame_end(gpath[0] ? gpath : NULL);
            frame_kind = PRES_AFTER_GEN;  // (the game's frame, below)
            gen_frames++;
            perfmon_generated_frame();
            if (!vk_frame_begin(black)) { renderer_submit(); goto presented; }
            cb = vk_cmd();
        }
        { SW_ZONE("present/draw"); vk_present_draw(cb, src, (float)vx, (float)vy, (float)vw, (float)vh, pv); }
        if (held)  // (fading into the game's title screen: the boot picture over it, less each frame)
            boot_splash_draw(vk_frame_cmd(), g_vk.sc_extent.width, g_vk.sc_extent.height, boot_alpha);
        static long menu_at = -1;
        if (menu_at < 0) menu_at = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MENU_AT") ? atol(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MENU_AT")) : 0;
        if (menu_at && (long)total_frames + 1 == menu_at) { extern void menu_test_open(void); menu_test_open(); }
        bool menu = menu_render_needed();
        if (menu) {
            rec_drain();  // (ImGui records into cb itself, and may upload its fonts on the queue)
            if (hdr_src) frame_menu_begin(cb);  // (the float picture is not the menu's target)
            { SW_ZONE("present/menu"); menu_render((void *)cb, g_vk.sc_extent.width, g_vk.sc_extent.height); }
        }
        g_present_split[2] += SDL_GetTicksNS() - td;
        static long win_shot = -1;
        if (win_shot < 0) win_shot = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WINDOW_SHOT") ? atol(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WINDOW_SHOT")) : 0;
        bool shot = win_shot && (long)total_frames + 1 == win_shot;
        // SAVAGEWIND_WINDOW_SHOT_AT=<frame>,... (ascending, counted as SAVAGEWIND_SHOT_AT): the window as presented
        // (bars and menus included) -> build/frames/window_N.png
        static const char *wnext;
        static int winit;
        char wpath[256] = "";
        if (!winit) { winit = 1; wnext = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WINDOW_SHOT_AT"); if (wnext) mkdir("build/frames", 0755); }
        if (wnext && *wnext && !shot) {
            extern uint64_t framepace_script_frame(uint64_t presented);
            long at = strtol(wnext, NULL, 10);
            if ((long)framepace_script_frame(total_frames + 1) >= at) {
                snprintf(wpath, sizeof wpath, "build/frames/window_%05ld.png", at);
                while (*wnext && *wnext != ',') wnext++;
                if (*wnext == ',') wnext++;
            }
        }
        vk_frame_end(shot ? "build/window.png" : wpath[0] ? wpath : fg_real_shot[0] ? fg_real_shot : NULL);
        fg_real_shot[0] = 0;
        if (shot && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_EXIT_AFTER_SHOT")) { fflush(stderr); _exit(0); }
    } else {
        renderer_submit();
    }
presented:
    g_fg_want = fg_wanted();  // (for the next frame's draws)
    extern void vk_prof_frame(uint64_t frame, uint64_t present_ns);
    vk_prof_frame(total_frames, SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0);
    extern void vk_list_stats_frame(void);
    vk_list_stats_frame();
    {   // SAVAGEWIND_FRAME_LOG=1: "[ft] <ms> <frame> <target fps>" at every present (frame time statistics)
        static int ft = -1;
        if (ft < 0) ft = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FRAME_LOG") != NULL;
        extern int framepace_target(void);
        if (ft) LOG("[ft] %.3f %llu %d\n", SDL_GetTicksNS() / 1e6, (unsigned long long)total_frames, framepace_target());
    }
    frames++;
    total_frames++;
    g_frame_counter++;
    extern void input_frame(uint64_t frame);
    extern uint64_t framepace_script_frame(uint64_t presented);
    uint64_t script_frame = framepace_script_frame(total_frames);  // (SAVAGEWIND_SCRIPT_CLOCK: 30ths of a second)
    input_frame(script_frame);
#ifdef SW_PGO_GENERATE
    {   // a training run played by hand ends however the window is closed: keep the profile on disk as it goes
        static unsigned pgo_frames;
        if (++pgo_frames % 3000 == 0) write_runtime_profile();
    }
#endif
    {   // SAVAGEWIND_EXIT_AT=<frame> (counted as SAVAGEWIND_INPUT): end the run there
        static long exit_at = -1;
        if (exit_at < 0) exit_at = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_EXIT_AT") ? atol(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_EXIT_AT")) : 0;
        if (exit_at && (long)script_frame >= exit_at) {
#ifdef SW_PGO_GENERATE
            // The scripted exit skips atexit, so finish the runtime training profile explicitly.
            write_runtime_profile();
#endif
            fflush(stderr);
            _exit(0);
        }
    }
    static long slow_ms = -1;
    if (slow_ms < 0) slow_ms = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SLOW_FRAME_MS") ? atol(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SLOW_FRAME_MS")) : 0;
    if (slow_ms > 0 && total_frames > 2600) SDL_Delay((Uint32)slow_ms);
    prof_frame(total_frames);  // (the profiler: a new frame starts here, for every thread's events)
    extern void fnprof_frame(uint64_t frame);
    fnprof_frame(total_frames);
    extern void reboot_test_frame(uint64_t frame);  // runtime/main.c (SAVAGEWIND_REBOOT_AT)
    reboot_test_frame(total_frames);
    extern void test_warp_frame(uint64_t frame);  // runtime/services/test_warp.c (SAVAGEWIND_TEST_TIME)
    test_warp_frame(total_frames);
    extern void weather_frame(void);  // runtime/weather.c (Cheats > Weather, `weather`)
    weather_frame();
    extern void control_frame(uint64_t frame);  // runtime/control.c (SAVAGEWIND_CONTROL)
    control_frame(total_frames);
    static long shot_every = -1;
    if (shot_every < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SCREENSHOT_EVERY"); shot_every = e ? atol(e) : 0; }
    extern bool g_debug_frame;
    static long debug_at = -1;
    if (debug_at < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_FRAME"); debug_at = e ? atol(e) : 0; }
    extern volatile int g_debug_frame_request;
    if (g_debug_frame_request) { g_debug_frame_request = 0; debug_at = (long)total_frames + 1; }
    // SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_FRAMES=<n> (with SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_FRAME / F9): dump n consecutive frames (build/pass_<frame>_NNN.png)
    static long debug_n = -1;
    if (debug_n < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_FRAMES"); debug_n = e && atol(e) > 1 ? atol(e) : 1; }
    g_debug_frame = debug_at && total_frames >= (uint64_t)debug_at && total_frames < (uint64_t)debug_at + (uint64_t)debug_n;
    if (!g_debug_frame) { extern void vk_pick_report(void); vk_pick_report(); }  // (SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_PICK)
    {   // SAVAGEWIND_GPUPROF_AT=<frame>[,<frame>...]: GPU time per pass of those frames ("[gpuprof]" in the log)
        extern bool g_gpuprof_frame;
        extern void vk_gpuprof_report(void);
        if (g_gpuprof_frame) { g_gpuprof_frame = false; vk_gpuprof_report(); }
        extern volatile int g_gpuprof_request;  // (runtime/control_prof.c: the `gpuprof` command)
        if (g_gpuprof_request) {
            g_gpuprof_request = 0;
            g_gpuprof_frame = true;
            LOG("[gpuprof] capture of frame %llu (gpuprof command)\n", (unsigned long long)total_frames);
        }
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GPUPROF_AT");
        for (const char *p = e; p && *p;) {
            long at = strtol(p, (char **)&p, 10);
            if (at == (long)total_frames) { g_gpuprof_frame = true; break; }
            if (*p == ',') p++; else break;
        }
    }
    extern void vk_gpu_collect(void);
    vk_gpu_collect();  // (the profiler: GPU time of the submissions that have finished)
    if (g_debug_frame) LOG("===== debug frame %llu =====\n", (unsigned long long)total_frames);
    {   // (testing) SAVAGEWIND_UPSCALE_AT=<frame>:<off|ultra|quality|balanced|performance>,... (ascending): the
        // upscaler from that frame on, as the Video page sets it (A/B of the same view a few frames apart): FSR 1, or
        // FSR 3 with a fsr3- in front of the mode (fsr3-quality); fsr3-native: FSR 3 at the window's size (its native
        // AA: the reference for TAA, which is the same reconstruction)
        static const char *next;
        static int init;
        if (!init) { init = 1; next = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_UPSCALE_AT"); }
        while (next && *next) {
            char *end;
            long at = strtol(next, &end, 10);
            if ((long)total_frames < at) break;
            const char *m = *end == ':' ? end + 1 : end;
            static const char *const names[] = {"ultra", "quality", "balanced", "performance", "ultraperf"};  // (UPQ_*; a later match wins)
            bool f4 = !strncmp(m, "fsr4-", 5), f3 = !strncmp(m, "fsr3-", 5);  // (fsr4-<mode>: AMD FSR 4)
            if (f3 || f4) m += 5;
            int tu = f4 ? UPSCALE_FSR4 : f3 ? UPSCALE_FSR3 : UPSCALE_FSR1;
            g_settings.upscaler = UPSCALE_OFF;
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
                if (!strncmp(m, names[i], strlen(names[i]))) g_settings.upscaler = tu, g_settings.upscale_quality = i;
            if ((f3 || f4) && !strncmp(m, "native", 6)) g_settings.upscaler = tu, g_settings.upscale_quality = UPQ_NATIVE;
            LOG("[test] frame %llu: upscaler %d mode %d\n", (unsigned long long)total_frames, g_settings.upscaler,
                g_settings.upscale_quality);
            next = strchr(m, ',');
            if (next) next++;
        }
    }
    {   // (testing) SAVAGEWIND_FILTER_AT=<frame>:<anisotropy 0-4>/<sharpening 0-10>,... (ascending): Video >
        // Anisotropic filtering and Sharpening from that frame on (A/B of the same view)
        static const char *next;
        static int init;
        if (!init) { init = 1; next = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FILTER_AT"); }
        while (next && *next) {
            char *end;
            long at = strtol(next, &end, 10);
            if ((long)total_frames < at) break;
            int a = 0, s = 0;
            if (*end == ':' && sscanf(end + 1, "%d/%d", &a, &s) == 2) {
                g_settings.anisotropy = a;
                g_settings.sharpening = s;
                LOG("[test] frame %llu: anisotropy %d sharpening %d\n", (unsigned long long)total_frames, a, s);
            }
            next = strchr(end, ',');
            if (next) next++;
        }
    }
    {   // (testing) SAVAGEWIND_COLOUR_AT=<frame>:<exposure>/<contrast>/<saturation>/<temperature>/<tint>/<LUT %>/<LUT>,...
        // (ascending; the LUT as the ini names it, may be empty): Video > Colour from that frame on (A/B of one view)
        static const char *next;
        static int init;
        if (!init) { init = 1; next = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_COLOUR_AT"); }
        while (next && *next) {
            char *end;
            long at = strtol(next, &end, 10);
            if ((long)total_frames < at) break;
            Settings *s = &g_settings;
            int k = 0, used = 0;
            if (*end == ':' && sscanf(end + 1, "%d/%d/%d/%d/%d/%d/%n", &s->color_exposure, &s->color_contrast,
                                      &s->color_saturation, &s->color_temperature, &s->color_tint,
                                      &s->color_lut_strength, &used) == 6 && used) {
                const char *l = end + 1 + used;
                while (l[k] && l[k] != ',' && k < (int)sizeof s->color_lut - 1) k++;
                memcpy(s->color_lut, l, (size_t)k);
                s->color_lut[k] = 0;
                LOG("[test] frame %llu: colour %d/%d/%d/%d/%d LUT \"%s\" %d%%\n", (unsigned long long)total_frames,
                    s->color_exposure, s->color_contrast, s->color_saturation, s->color_temperature, s->color_tint,
                    s->color_lut, s->color_lut_strength);
            }
            next = strchr(end, ',');
            if (next) next++;
        }
    }
    {   // SAVAGEWIND_SHOT_AT=<frame>,<frame>,... (ascending): the game image at those frames -> build/frames/frame_N.png
        static const char *next;
        static int init;
        if (!init) { init = 1; next = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SHOT_AT"); if (next) mkdir("build/frames", 0755); }
        while (next && *next) {
            long at = strtol(next, (char **)&next, 10);
            if ((long)script_frame < at) { while (next > getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SHOT_AT") && next[-1] != ',') next--; break; }
            if ((long)script_frame >= at) {  // (the script clock can step over a number)
                char path[256];
                snprintf(path, sizeof path, "build/frames/frame_%05ld.png", at);
                renderer_save_texture_tex(b, path);
            }
            if (*next == ',') next++;
        }
    }
    {   // A picture asked for (runtime/hle/photo.c, the free camera's F7; test scripts' `shot`): this game image
        extern char g_window_shot_request[256];
        if (g_window_shot_request[0]) {
            extern void photo_saved(const char *path);  // (hle/photo.c: its own pictures get a notice)
            renderer_save_texture_tex(b, g_window_shot_request);
            photo_saved(g_window_shot_request);
            g_window_shot_request[0] = 0;
        }
    }
    {   // F12 (runtime/hle/input.c): every other game image -> build/frames/rec_N.png until F12 again (catches flicker
        // too short to see; the saves slow the game down meanwhile)
        extern volatile int g_record_frames;
        static int recording;
        if (g_record_frames != recording) {
            recording = g_record_frames;
            if (recording) mkdir("build/frames", 0755);
            LOG("[shot] recording %s at frame %llu\n", recording ? "on" : "off", (unsigned long long)total_frames);
        }
        if (recording && !(total_frames & 1)) {
            char path[256];
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "build/frames/rec_%05llu.png", (unsigned long long)total_frames);
            renderer_save_texture_tex(b, path);
        }
    }
    static long shot_from = -1;
    if (shot_from < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SCREENSHOT_FROM"); shot_from = e ? atol(e) : 0; }
    if (shot_every && total_frames % shot_every == 0 && (long)total_frames >= shot_from) {
        char path[256];
        if (shot_from) mkdir("build/frames", 0755);
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, shot_from ? "build/frames/frame_%05llu.png" : "build/frame_%05llu.png",
                 (unsigned long long)total_frames);
        renderer_save_texture_tex(b, path);
        // a series (SCREENSHOT_FROM) runs on until SAVAGEWIND_WINDOW_SHOT exits
        if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_EXIT_AFTER_SHOT") && !shot_from) { fflush(stderr); _exit(0); }
    }
    double now = SDL_GetTicks() / 1000.0;
    static double fps_iv = -1, prev_present, max_gap;
    if (fps_iv < 0) fps_iv = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FPS_INTERVAL") ? atof(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FPS_INTERVAL")) : 2.0;
    if (prev_present > 0 && now - prev_present > max_gap) max_gap = now - prev_present;
    prev_present = now;
    if (now - last_fps_time >= fps_iv) {
        if (last_fps_time > 0)
            LOG("[vk] t=%.1f frame %llu %.1f fps max %.0fms (%s)\n", now, (unsigned long long)total_frames,
                frames / (now - last_fps_time), max_gap * 1000.0, renderer_stats());
        {   // Video memory over its budget: the driver moves memory out to system RAM, and draws that sample it there
            // crawl. On an MX350 (2 GB) that took a pass seconds after half an hour of play and Windows reset the GPU
            // (#332). Said when it starts and when it ends, with the numbers, so a slow-frame report shows it.
            static bool over;
            uint64_t usage, budget, size;
            vram_device_local(&usage, &budget, &size);
            if (budget && (usage > budget) != over) {
                over = !over;
                LOG("[vram] t=%.1f video memory %s its budget: %llu MB in use of %llu MB (%llu MB on the card)\n", now,
                    over ? "over" : "back under", (unsigned long long)(usage >> 20), (unsigned long long)(budget >> 20),
                    (unsigned long long)(size >> 20));
            }
        }
        if (gen_frames && last_fps_time > 0)
            LOG("[fg] %.1f generated frames/s: %.1f presented\n", gen_frames / (now - last_fps_time),
                (frames + gen_frames) / (now - last_fps_time));
        max_gap = 0;
        frames = 0;
        gen_frames = 0;
        last_fps_time = now;
    }
}

// ================================================================== UI thread
void vk_exec_init(void);
void vk_shaders_init(void);

// exit() from any thread: let the GPU finish, keep the pipeline cache, then end the process without the DLL
// teardown (driver / validation-layer threads can stall it for minutes while the game's threads still run).
static void quick_exit_handler(void) {
    static int trace = -1;
    if (trace < 0) trace = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_TRACE") != NULL;
    if (trace) LOG("[vk] exit: waiting for the GPU\n");
    if (g_vk.dev) {
        vk_present_idle();
        rec_drain();
        vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.dev);
        vk_dlss_shutdown();
        if (trace) LOG("[vk] exit: saving the pipeline cache\n");
        vk_pipeline_cache_save();
        extern void vk_pso_flush(void);
        vk_pso_flush();
        extern void vk_keylog_flush(void);
        vk_keylog_flush();
    }
    if (trace) LOG("[vk] exit: terminating\n");
    fflush(stdout);
    fflush(stderr);
#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(__linux__)
    plat_terminate();
#endif
}

void ui_window_init(void) {
    if (window) return;
    atexit(quick_exit_handler);
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_JOYSTICK_ALLOW_BACKGROUND_EVENTS, "1");
    settings_load();
    { extern void motion_before_sdl_init(void); motion_before_sdl_init(); }  // (hle/motion.c: Steam Input's hidden pads)
    if (!SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO | SDL_INIT_GAMEPAD)) FATAL("SDL_Init: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
    // Video > Window size (runtime/window_size.c: pixels; SDL's window size is pixels / the display's pixel density)
    winsize_refresh(NULL);
    WinSize ws = winsize_effective(false);
    // made on Video > Monitor's display (the primary one: Automatic; test windows too)
    bool test = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WINDOW") || getenv("SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN");
    SDL_DisplayID disp = test ? 0 : (SDL_DisplayID)winsize_start_display();
    const SDL_DisplayMode *dm = SDL_GetDesktopDisplayMode(disp ? disp : SDL_GetPrimaryDisplay());
    float density = dm && dm->pixel_density > 0 ? dm->pixel_density : 1;
    int win_w = (int)lroundf(ws.w / density), win_h = (int)lroundf(ws.h / density);
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WINDOW")) sscanf(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_WINDOW"), "%dx%d", &win_w, &win_h);
    SDL_WindowFlags wflags = SDL_WINDOW_VULKAN | SDL_WINDOW_RESIZABLE | SDL_WINDOW_HIGH_PIXEL_DENSITY;
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN") || window_hidden) wflags |= SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN;
    SDL_PropertiesID props = SDL_CreateProperties();
    SDL_SetStringProperty(props, SDL_PROP_WINDOW_CREATE_TITLE_STRING, "Savage Wind");
    SDL_SetNumberProperty(props, SDL_PROP_WINDOW_CREATE_WIDTH_NUMBER, win_w);
    SDL_SetNumberProperty(props, SDL_PROP_WINDOW_CREATE_HEIGHT_NUMBER, win_h);
    SDL_SetNumberProperty(props, SDL_PROP_WINDOW_CREATE_FLAGS_NUMBER, (Sint64)wflags);
    if (disp) {
        SDL_SetNumberProperty(props, SDL_PROP_WINDOW_CREATE_X_NUMBER, (Sint64)SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED_DISPLAY(disp));
        SDL_SetNumberProperty(props, SDL_PROP_WINDOW_CREATE_Y_NUMBER, (Sint64)SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED_DISPLAY(disp));
    }
    window = SDL_CreateWindowWithProperties(props);
    SDL_DestroyProperties(props);
    if (!window) FATAL("SDL_CreateWindow: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
    rt_window_icon(window);
    // the Fullscreen setting applies from the start screen on (not only once the game runs); test windows stay windows
    winsize_apply(window);
    create_instance();
    if (!SDL_Vulkan_CreateSurface(window, g_vk.inst, NULL, &g_vk.surface)) FATAL("SDL_Vulkan_CreateSurface: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
    pick_device();
    create_device();
    if (g_settings.upscaler == UPSCALE_FSR4 && !fsr4_available()) {  // (a settings file from a PC with an AMD Radeon)
        g_settings.upscaler = fsr3_available() && fsr3_upscaler_enabled() ? UPSCALE_FSR3 : UPSCALE_SPATIAL;
        LOG("[fsr] FSR 4 is not offered on this GPU: upscaler %d instead\n", g_settings.upscaler);
    }
    create_swapchain();
    vk_exec_init();
    vk_shaders_init();
}

SDL_Window *ui_window(void) { return window; }

// (runtime/main.c: a start straight into the game) the window made hidden, shown with the boot picture's first frame
void ui_window_init_hidden(void) {
    if (!window) window_hidden = true;
    ui_window_init();
}

void vk_wait_ready(void) {  // (a guest thread: the window and device are the main thread's, ui_run)
    while (!atomic_load(&ui_ready)) SDL_Delay(1);
}

void backend_init(void) {
    vk_wait_ready();
    LOG("[vk] %s, swapchain %ux%u\n", g_vk.props.deviceName, g_vk.sc_extent.width, g_vk.sc_extent.height);
}

// ---- in-place reboot (runtime/main.c teardown; main thread, guest threads stopped)
void backend_reset(void) {
    if (!g_vk.dev) return;
    vk_present_idle();
    rec_drain();
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.dev);
    extern void vk_textures_reset(void);
    extern void vk_exec_reset(void);
    vk_textures_reset();
    vk_exec_reset();
    g_last_presented = NULL;
}
void backend_guest_memory_reset(void) {}  // (exec.c: the next SetHeapSize maps the heap again, or it is imported on first use)
void backend_clear_window(void) {
    static const float black[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1};
    if (g_vk.dev && vk_frame_begin(black)) vk_frame_end(NULL);
}

// "[window]" lines for what the window went through (focus, minimised, restored, hidden behind another): an exclusive
// fullscreen window that loses the focus is minimised and gives its display mode back (#224)
static void window_event_log(const SDL_Event *e) {
    const char *what = NULL;
    switch (e->type) {
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_GAINED: what = "focus gained"; break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_LOST: what = "focus lost"; break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_MINIMIZED: what = "minimised"; break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_RESTORED: what = "restored"; break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_OCCLUDED: what = "occluded"; break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_ENTER_FULLSCREEN: what = "entered fullscreen"; break;
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_LEAVE_FULLSCREEN: what = "left fullscreen"; break;
    default: return;
    }
    static unsigned n;  // (a few hundred: a window that flickers between states doesn't fill the log)
    if (n++ < 400) LOG("[window] %s (frame %llu)\n", what, (unsigned long long)total_frames);
}

int ui_run(void) {
    ui_window_init();
    ui_window_show();  // (made hidden for a boot picture that couldn't be shown)
    input_focus_update(window);
    atomic_store(&ui_ready, true);
    for (;;) {
        if (rt_reboot_requested()) return rt_reboot_requested();  // (runtime/main.c tears the game down)
        SDL_Event e;
        // at most a frame's time of events, then the window requests: a controller's motion sensors (gyro) send about
        // a thousand updates a second, so the queue may never run empty, and Fullscreen, Window size and Monitor
        // waited for that until the next restart
        uint64_t t0 = SDL_GetTicks();
        while (SDL_GetTicks() - t0 < 16 && SDL_WaitEventTimeout(&e, 16)) {
            if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_QUIT) {
                LOG("window closed\n");
                exit(0);
            }
            window_event_log(&e);
            if (input_user_blocked(&e)) continue;
            if (menu_handle_event(&e)) continue;
            input_handle_event(&e);
        }
        menu_apply_window_requests(window);
        extern void input_mouse_update(SDL_Window *w);  // runtime/hle/input.c: hold the cursor while the game has it
        input_mouse_update(window);
    }
}

// (game threads present while others submit; the window loop re-presents)
void backend_present(NvnTexture *t) {
    gpu_lock();
    present_locked(t);
    gpu_unlock();
}

```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/dlss.c`:

```c
// NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution (Video > Upscaler) through NGX, loaded at run time. No NVIDIA SDK code, header or library is compiled in or linked: the NGX core is the NVIDIA driver's
// own _nvngx.dll (found through HKLM\SOFTWARE\NVIDIA Corporation\Global\NGXCore), and the few NGX types, values and
// parameter names used below are declared here from the SDK's documented interface. The DLSS library the core loads for
// it, nvngx_dlss.dll, is NVIDIA's own copy, which the setup downloads next to savagewind.exe from NVIDIA's repository
// (../../dlss_fetch.c); without it, or without an NVIDIA RTX driver, NGX is not loaded at all and DLSS stays greyed
// out.
//
// NGX's parameter object is a C++ class whose virtual functions are called through its vtable: the Set overloads in
// slots 0-7 and the Get overloads in 8-15, each group in reverse declaration order (MSVC's layout, the Windows core's).
// vtable_ok checks that layout with a set-then-get round trip before anything relies on it.
#include "dlss.h"
#include "record.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../../paths.h"

#ifdef _WIN32

#include <windows.h>

// ================================================================== NGX's interface (the SDK's documented ABI)
typedef unsigned NgxResult;  // NVSDK_NGX_Result: 1 success, 0xBAD00000 | n failures
#define NGX_OK(r) (((r) & 0xFFF00000u) != 0xBAD00000u)
#define NGX_VERSION_API 0x15
enum { NGX_FEATURE_SUPERSAMPLING = 1 };
enum { NGX_PERF_MAXPERF = 0, NGX_PERF_BALANCED = 1, NGX_PERF_MAXQUALITY = 2, NGX_PERF_ULTRAPERF = 3, NGX_PERF_ULTRAQUALITY = 4 };
enum { NGX_DLSS_IS_HDR = 1 << 0, NGX_DLSS_MV_LOWRES = 1 << 1 };
// The application id NVIDIA's own DLSS samples use for applications without an NVIDIA-issued id
#define NGX_APP_ID 231313132ull

typedef struct NgxParam NgxParam;
typedef struct NgxHandle NgxHandle;
typedef struct { void *slot[17]; } NgxParamVtbl;
struct NgxParam { const NgxParamVtbl *vt; };
typedef struct {  // NVSDK_NGX_Resource_VK, an image view
    union {
        struct {
            VkImageView view;
            VkImage image;
            VkImageSubresourceRange range;
            VkFormat format;
            unsigned width, height;
        } img;
        struct { VkBuffer buffer; unsigned bytes; } buf;
    } r;
    int type;  // 0 image view, 1 buffer
    bool rw;
} NgxResourceVK;
typedef NgxResult (*PFN_Init)(unsigned long long app, const wchar_t *path, VkInstance, VkPhysicalDevice, VkDevice,
                              PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr, PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr, int version, const NgxParam *);
typedef NgxResult (*PFN_ReqExt)(unsigned *ni, const char ***ie, unsigned *nd, const char ***de);
typedef NgxResult (*PFN_Params)(NgxParam **);
typedef NgxResult (*PFN_DestroyParams)(NgxParam *);
typedef NgxResult (*PFN_Create)(VkCommandBuffer, int feature, NgxParam *, NgxHandle **);
typedef NgxResult (*PFN_Evaluate)(VkCommandBuffer, const NgxHandle *, const NgxParam *, void *callback);
typedef NgxResult (*PFN_Release)(NgxHandle *);
// (the core's Shutdown1 writes a count through its second argument without a check: the SDK's library passes one)
typedef NgxResult (*PFN_Shutdown)(VkDevice, unsigned *);

static struct {
    HMODULE core;
    PFN_Init init;
    PFN_ReqExt req_ext;
    PFN_Params caps, alloc_params;
    PFN_DestroyParams destroy_params;
    PFN_Create create;
    PFN_Evaluate evaluate;
    PFN_Release release;
    PFN_Shutdown shutdown;
    int tried, loaded;
} N;

typedef void (*SetI)(NgxParam *, const char *, int);
typedef void (*SetU)(NgxParam *, const char *, unsigned);
typedef void (*SetF)(NgxParam *, const char *, float);
typedef void (*SetP)(NgxParam *, const char *, void *);
typedef NgxResult (*GetI)(const NgxParam *, const char *, int *);
typedef NgxResult (*GetU)(const NgxParam *, const char *, unsigned *);
typedef NgxResult (*GetF)(const NgxParam *, const char *, float *);
typedef NgxResult (*GetP)(const NgxParam *, const char *, void **);
// The SDK declares Set(u64), Set(float), Set(double), Set(u32), Set(int), Set(ID3D11Resource *), Set(ID3D12Resource *),
// Set(void *), then the Get overloads in the same order, then Reset; MSVC reverses each group of overloads.
enum { S_P = 0, S_D12, S_D11, S_I, S_U32, S_D, S_F, S_U64, G_P, G_D12, G_D11, G_I, G_U32, G_D, G_F, G_U64 };
static void p_seti(NgxParam *p, const char *n, int v) { ((SetI)p->vt->slot[S_I])(p, n, v); }
static void p_setu(NgxParam *p, const char *n, unsigned v) { ((SetU)p->vt->slot[S_U32])(p, n, v); }
static void p_setf(NgxParam *p, const char *n, float v) { ((SetF)p->vt->slot[S_F])(p, n, v); }
static void p_setp(NgxParam *p, const char *n, void *v) { ((SetP)p->vt->slot[S_P])(p, n, v); }
static bool p_geti(const NgxParam *p, const char *n, int *v) { return NGX_OK(((GetI)p->vt->slot[G_I])(p, n, v)); }
static bool p_getu(const NgxParam *p, const char *n, unsigned *v) { return NGX_OK(((GetU)p->vt->slot[G_U32])(p, n, v)); }
static bool p_getf(const NgxParam *p, const char *n, float *v) { return NGX_OK(((GetF)p->vt->slot[G_F])(p, n, v)); }
static bool p_getp(const NgxParam *p, const char *n, void **v) { return NGX_OK(((GetP)p->vt->slot[G_P])(p, n, v)); }

static const char *result_name(NgxResult r) {
    switch (r) {
    case 0x1: return "success";
    case 0xBAD00001: return "feature-not-supported";
    case 0xBAD00002: return "platform-error";
    case 0xBAD00004: return "feature-not-found";
    case 0xBAD00005: return "invalid-parameter";
    case 0xBAD00007: return "not-initialized";
    case 0xBAD00008: return "unsupported-input-format";
    case 0xBAD0000A: return "missing-input";
    case 0xBAD0000B: return "unable-to-initialize-feature";
    case 0xBAD0000C: return "out-of-date";
    default: return "failure";
    }
}

static bool ok(NgxResult r, const char *what) {
    if (NGX_OK(r)) return true;
    LOG("[dlss] %s: %s (%#x)\n", what, result_name(r), r);
    return false;
}

// ================================================================== loading NGX
static wchar_t g_exe_dir[MAX_PATH];  // savagewind.exe's folder, where the DLSS library is (no trailing slash)
static wchar_t g_data_dir[1024];     // NGX's logs and caches: the data folder

// NVIDIA's DLSS library is next to savagewind.exe, where NGX loads it from (NGX itself is loaded only then)
static bool dll_here(void) {
    static int have = -1;
    if (have >= 0) return have;
    have = 0;
    DWORD len = GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, g_exe_dir, MAX_PATH);
    if (!len || len >= MAX_PATH) return have;
    while (len && g_exe_dir[len - 1] != L'\\' && g_exe_dir[len - 1] != L'/') len--;
    g_exe_dir[len ? len - 1 : 0] = 0;
    wchar_t p[MAX_PATH + 32];
    _snwprintf(p, MAX_PATH + 32, L"%ls\\nvngx_dlss.dll", g_exe_dir);
    p[MAX_PATH + 31] = 0;
    have = GetFileAttributesW(p) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES;
    return have;
}

static bool core_load(void) {
    if (N.tried) return N.loaded;
    N.tried = 1;
    if (!dll_here()) {
        LOG("[dlss] NVIDIA's DLSS library is not next to savagewind.exe (the setup downloads it): DLSS off\n");
        return false;
    }
    char dir[MAX_PATH] = {0}, path[MAX_PATH + 32];
    DWORD n = sizeof dir;
    if (RegGetValueA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "SOFTWARE\\NVIDIA Corporation\\Global\\NGXCore", "FullPath", RRF_RT_REG_SZ,
                     NULL, dir, &n) != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        LOG("[dlss] no NVIDIA driver with NGX (registry NGXCore missing): DLSS off\n");
        return false;
    }
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\_nvngx.dll", dir);
    N.core = LoadLibraryA(path);
    if (!N.core) {
        LOG("[dlss] cannot load %s (error %lu): DLSS off\n", path, GetLastError());
        return false;
    }
#define FN(f, name) N.f = (void *)GetProcAddress(N.core, name)
    FN(init, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_Init_Ext2");
    FN(req_ext, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_RequiredExtensions");
    FN(caps, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_GetCapabilityParameters");
    FN(alloc_params, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_AllocateParameters");
    FN(destroy_params, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_DestroyParameters");
    FN(create, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_CreateFeature");
    FN(evaluate, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_EvaluateFeature");
    FN(release, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_ReleaseFeature");
    FN(shutdown, "NVSDK_NGX_VULKAN_Shutdown1");
#undef FN
    if (!N.init || !N.req_ext || !N.caps || !N.alloc_params || !N.destroy_params || !N.create || !N.evaluate ||
        !N.release) {
        LOG("[dlss] the NGX core %s lacks Vulkan entry points: DLSS off\n", path);
        return false;
    }
    const char *data = rt_data_root();
    if (!data || !MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, data, -1, g_data_dir, (int)(sizeof g_data_dir / sizeof *g_data_dir))) {
        LOG("[dlss] invalid application data path: DLSS off\n");
        return false;
    }
    N.loaded = 1;
    LOG("[dlss] NGX core %s\n", path);
    return true;
}

// ================================================================== extensions (before the instance and the device)
static const char **g_instance_exts, **g_device_exts;
static unsigned g_instance_ext_count, g_device_ext_count;

static void query_extensions(void) {
    static bool done;
    if (done) return;
    done = true;
    if (!core_load()) return;
    unsigned ni = 0, nd = 0;
    const char **ie = NULL, **de = NULL;
    NgxResult r = N.req_ext(&ni, &ie, &nd, &de);
    if (!ok(r, "required extension query")) return;
    g_instance_exts = ie, g_instance_ext_count = ni;
    g_device_exts = de, g_device_ext_count = nd;
    LOG("[dlss] required extensions: %u instance, %u device\n", ni, nd);
}

void vk_dlss_required_instance_extensions(const char ***names, unsigned *count) {
    query_extensions();
    if (names) *names = g_instance_exts;
    if (count) *count = g_instance_ext_count;
}

void vk_dlss_required_device_extensions(const char ***names, unsigned *count) {
    query_extensions();
    if (names) *names = g_device_exts;
    if (count) *count = g_device_ext_count;
}

// ================================================================== init
static bool g_initialized, g_ngx_up;
static NgxParam *g_capability_params;  // (NGX's: what this driver and GPU run)
static bool g_available;               // DLSS Super Resolution runs here (RTX)

static bool vtable_ok(void) {
    NgxParam *p = NULL;
    if (!NGX_OK(N.alloc_params(&p)) || !p) return false;
    int i = 0;
    unsigned u = 0;
    float f = 0;
    void *v = NULL;
    p_seti(p, "SavageWind.Test.I", -12345);
    p_setu(p, "SavageWind.Test.U", 4000000000u);
    p_setf(p, "SavageWind.Test.F", 1.25f);
    p_setp(p, "SavageWind.Test.P", (void *)p);
    bool good = p_geti(p, "SavageWind.Test.I", &i) && i == -12345 && p_getu(p, "SavageWind.Test.U", &u) &&
                u == 4000000000u && p_getf(p, "SavageWind.Test.F", &f) && f == 1.25f &&
                p_getp(p, "SavageWind.Test.P", &v) && v == (void *)p;
    N.destroy_params(p);
    if (!good) LOG("[dlss] NGX parameter layout check failed (i=%d u=%u f=%g p=%p): DLSS off\n", i, u, f, v);
    return good;
}

bool vk_dlss_init(void) {
    if (g_initialized) return g_available;
    g_initialized = true;
    if (!g_vk.phys || !g_vk.dev || !core_load()) return false;
    if (!ok(N.init(NGX_APP_ID, g_data_dir, g_vk.inst, g_vk.phys, g_vk.dev, vkGetInstanceProcAddr, vkGetDeviceProcAddr,
                   NGX_VERSION_API, NULL),
            "init"))
        return false;
    if (!vtable_ok()) return false;
    g_ngx_up = true;
    if (!ok(N.caps(&g_capability_params), "capabilities") || !g_capability_params) return false;
    int sr = 0, driver = 0;
    g_available = p_geti(g_capability_params, "SuperSampling.Available", &sr) && sr != 0;
    p_geti(g_capability_params, "SuperSampling.NeedsUpdatedDriver", &driver);
    LOG("[dlss] Super Resolution %s on %s%s\n", g_available ? "available" : "unavailable", g_vk.props.deviceName,
        driver ? " (the driver needs an update)" : "");
    return g_available;
}

static void release_feature(void);

void vk_dlss_shutdown(void) {
    if (!g_initialized) return;
    release_feature();
    unsigned left = 0;
    if (g_ngx_up && N.shutdown) N.shutdown(g_vk.dev, &left);
    g_ngx_up = g_available = false;
    g_capability_params = NULL;
    g_initialized = false;
}

static NgxResourceVK image_resource(TexBackend *b, VkFormat f, bool rw) {
    static const VkComponentMapping id = {VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY,
                                          VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY};
    VkImageAspectFlags a = b->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    NgxResourceVK r;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    r.r.img.view = vk_image_view(b, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, f, 0, 1, 0, 1, id, a);
    r.r.img.image = b->image;
    r.r.img.range = (VkImageSubresourceRange){a, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    r.r.img.format = f;
    r.r.img.width = b->width, r.r.img.height = b->height;
    r.type = 0, r.rw = rw;
    return r;
}

// ================================================================== DLSS Super Resolution (Video > Upscaler)
static NgxParam *g_params;
static NgxHandle *g_feature;
static unsigned g_in_w, g_in_h, g_out_w, g_out_h, g_quality;
static VkFormat g_color_format, g_output_format;

static void release_feature(void) {
    if (g_feature) N.release(g_feature);
    if (g_params) N.destroy_params(g_params);
    g_feature = NULL, g_params = NULL;
    g_in_w = g_in_h = g_out_w = g_out_h = g_quality = 0;
    g_color_format = g_output_format = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
}

bool vk_dlss_available(void) { return g_available; }

// The model NGX runs (its render presets). Left to NGX, DLSS 310 picks its transformer models, and for Performance a
// heavier one still: at 4K on an RTX 3060, 5.1 ms a frame in Quality and 11 ms in Performance, against 8.1 ms for the
// whole frame without an upscaler, so DLSS cost frames instead of making them. RTX 20 and 30 cards (no FP8 in their
// tensor cores) get the CNN model, preset E: 2.0 ms in every mode, the frame 6.4 ms in Performance. RTX 40 and later
// get the transformer model K in every mode, not the heavier one NGX picks for Performance.
// SAVAGEWIND_DLSS_PRESET=<n>: another preset for every mode (0: NGX's own choice, 5 E, 11 K).
enum { DLSS_PRESET_DEFAULT = 0, DLSS_PRESET_E = 5, DLSS_PRESET_K = 11 };
static bool dlss_older_rtx(const char *name) {
    static const char *const older[] = {"RTX 20", "RTX 30", "TITAN RTX", "Quadro RTX", "RTX A1", "RTX A2", "RTX A3",
                                        "RTX A4", "RTX A5", "RTX A6", "MX5", "CMP 30"};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof older / sizeof *older; i++)
        if (strstr(name, older[i])) return true;
    return false;
}
static void p_dlss_preset(NgxParam *p) {
    static int preset = -2;
    if (preset == -2) {
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DLSS_PRESET");
        preset = e ? atoi(e) : dlss_older_rtx(g_vk.props.deviceName) ? DLSS_PRESET_E : DLSS_PRESET_K;
        LOG("[dlss] model: preset %d (%s)\n", preset,
            e ? "SAVAGEWIND_DLSS_PRESET" : preset == DLSS_PRESET_E ? "CNN: an RTX 20 / 30 card" : "transformer");
    }
    if (preset <= DLSS_PRESET_DEFAULT) return;
    static const char *const hints[] = {"DLSS.Hint.Render.Preset.DLAA", "DLSS.Hint.Render.Preset.Quality",
                                        "DLSS.Hint.Render.Preset.Balanced", "DLSS.Hint.Render.Preset.Performance",
                                        "DLSS.Hint.Render.Preset.UltraPerformance", "DLSS.Hint.Render.Preset.UltraQuality"};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof hints / sizeof *hints; i++) p_setu(p, hints[i], (unsigned)preset);
}

// One frame's DLSS, as the recorder thread runs it (dlss_run): the images' views made on the queue thread
// (vk_image_view), NGX's calls in the recorder's turn.
typedef struct {
    VkCommandBuffer cb;
    NgxResourceVK color, depth, motion, out;
    unsigned quality;
    float jitter_x, jitter_y, mv_scale_x, mv_scale_y;
    bool reset;
} DlssJob;
static _Atomic int g_failed;  // (a job failed: known to the queue thread a frame late, as FSR 3's)

// The recorder thread (or the queue thread, with the recorder off): NGX's feature made again when the sizes, the
// formats or the mode changed, and the frame evaluated
static void dlss_run(void *arg) {
    const DlssJob *j = arg;
    unsigned cw = j->color.r.img.width, ch = j->color.r.img.height, ow = j->out.r.img.width, oh = j->out.r.img.height;
    VkFormat cf = j->color.r.img.format, of = j->out.r.img.format;
    if (!g_available) { atomic_store(&g_failed, 1); return; }
    if (!g_feature || g_in_w != cw || g_in_h != ch || g_out_w != ow || g_out_h != oh || g_quality != j->quality ||
        g_color_format != cf || g_output_format != of) {
        release_feature();
        static const int q[] = {NGX_PERF_ULTRAQUALITY, NGX_PERF_MAXQUALITY, NGX_PERF_BALANCED, NGX_PERF_MAXPERF,
                                NGX_PERF_ULTRAPERF};  // (UPQ_*: Ultra Performance's 3.0 is DLSS's own)
        unsigned requested = j->quality < 5 ? j->quality : 1;
        // Some driver/NGX combinations reject Ultra Quality at a particular
        // render size. Retry the next conservative mode before disabling DLSS.
        static const unsigned fallback[] = {0, 1, 2, 3};
        bool created = false;
        for (unsigned attempt = 0; attempt < 4 && !created; attempt++) {
            unsigned mode = attempt == 0 ? requested : fallback[attempt];
            if (!ok(N.alloc_params(&g_params), "allocate parameters")) { atomic_store(&g_failed, 1); return; }
            NgxParam *p = g_params;
            p_setu(p, "CreationNodeMask", 1);
            p_setu(p, "VisibilityNodeMask", 1);
            p_setu(p, "Width", cw);
            p_setu(p, "Height", ch);
            p_setu(p, "OutWidth", ow);
            p_setu(p, "OutHeight", oh);
            p_seti(p, "PerfQualityValue", q[mode]);
            p_seti(p, "DLSS.Feature.Create.Flags", NGX_DLSS_IS_HDR | NGX_DLSS_MV_LOWRES);
            p_seti(p, "DLSS.Enable.Output.Subrects", 0);
            p_dlss_preset(p);
            NgxResult r = N.create(j->cb, NGX_FEATURE_SUPERSAMPLING, p, &g_feature);
            if (NGX_OK(r)) {
                created = true;
                if (attempt) LOG("[dlss] quality %u rejected; using fallback mode %u\n", requested, mode);
            } else {
                LOG("[dlss] quality mode %u rejected: %s (%#x)\n", mode, result_name(r), r);
                release_feature();
            }
        }
        if (!created) {
            g_available = false;
            atomic_store(&g_failed, 1);
            return;
        }
        g_in_w = cw; g_in_h = ch; g_out_w = ow; g_out_h = oh;
        g_quality = j->quality; g_color_format = cf; g_output_format = of;
    }
    NgxResourceVK in_color = j->color, in_depth = j->depth, in_motion = j->motion, out = j->out;
    NgxParam *p = g_params;
    p_setp(p, "Color", &in_color);
    p_setp(p, "Output", &out);
    p_setp(p, "Depth", &in_depth);
    p_setp(p, "MotionVectors", &in_motion);
    p_setf(p, "Jitter.Offset.X", j->jitter_x);
    p_setf(p, "Jitter.Offset.Y", j->jitter_y);
    p_setf(p, "Sharpness", 0.0f);
    p_seti(p, "Reset", j->reset ? 1 : 0);
    p_setf(p, "MV.Scale.X", j->mv_scale_x == 0.0f ? 1.0f : j->mv_scale_x);  // (NGX takes them in render pixels)
    p_setf(p, "MV.Scale.Y", j->mv_scale_y == 0.0f ? 1.0f : j->mv_scale_y);
    p_setu(p, "DLSS.Render.Subrect.Dimensions.Width", cw);
    p_setu(p, "DLSS.Render.Subrect.Dimensions.Height", ch);
    p_setf(p, "DLSS.Pre.Exposure", 1.0f);
    p_setf(p, "DLSS.Exposure.Scale", 1.0f);
    if (!ok(N.evaluate(j->cb, g_feature, p, NULL), "evaluate")) {
        release_feature();
        atomic_store(&g_failed, 1);
    }
}

// NGX records into cb itself and may wait for the device: like FSR 3, the recorder thread makes the calls, in their
// turn among the commands queued before. Draining the recorder and calling NGX on the queue thread instead cost that
// thread, where it limits the frame rate, the whole recorder backlog each frame (RTX 3060, 1080p Savage: DLSS 3-6 fps
// under FSR 3). Whether it worked is known a frame late: a failure leaves this frame's output undefined and the
// caller falls back from the next one.
bool vk_dlss_apply(VkCommandBuffer cb, TexBackend *color, TexBackend *depth, TexBackend *motion,
                   TexBackend *output, unsigned quality, float jitter_x, float jitter_y, float mv_scale_x,
                   float mv_scale_y, bool reset) {
    if (!g_available || atomic_exchange(&g_failed, 0) || !cb || !color || !depth || !motion || !output ||
        !color->image || !depth->image || !motion->image || !output->image ||
        color->width == 0 || color->height == 0 || output->width == 0 || output->height == 0)
        return false;
    static DlssJob jobs[8];  // (the recorder is never 8 frames behind: a submission a frame waits for it)
    static unsigned nj;
    DlssJob *j = &jobs[nj++ & 7];
    *j = (DlssJob){cb, image_resource(color, color->format, false), image_resource(depth, depth->format, false),
                   image_resource(motion, motion->format, false), image_resource(output, output->format, true),
                   quality, jitter_x, jitter_y, mv_scale_x, mv_scale_y, reset};
    if (rec_on()) rec_custom(dlss_run, j);
    else dlss_run(j);
    return true;
}

#else

void vk_dlss_required_instance_extensions(const char ***names, unsigned *count) {
    if (names) *names = NULL;
    if (count) *count = 0;
}
void vk_dlss_required_device_extensions(const char ***names, unsigned *count) {
    if (names) *names = NULL;
    if (count) *count = 0;
}
bool vk_dlss_init(void) { return false; }
void vk_dlss_shutdown(void) {}
bool vk_dlss_available(void) { return false; }
bool vk_dlss_apply(VkCommandBuffer cb, TexBackend *color, TexBackend *depth, TexBackend *motion, TexBackend *output,
                   unsigned quality, float jitter_x, float jitter_y, float mv_scale_x, float mv_scale_y, bool reset) {
    (void)cb, (void)color, (void)depth, (void)motion, (void)output, (void)quality, (void)jitter_x, (void)jitter_y;
    (void)mv_scale_x, (void)mv_scale_y, (void)reset;
    return false;
}
#endif

```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/dlss.h`:

```h
// NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution (Windows): the NVIDIA driver's NGX, loaded at run time, and NVIDIA's DLL next to
// savagewind.exe (dlss.c; ../../dlss_fetch.h downloads it). Elsewhere: unavailable.
#pragma once

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#include "vk.h"
```

```c
// Command buffer state draw_ recorded last, so a draw records only what differs (one draw set ~20 pieces of state;

    pthread_mutex_init(&gpu_mutex, &a);
    pthread_mutexattr_destroy(&a);
}
```
