```c
            view_next = *e == ',' ? e + 1 : NULL;
        }
        pc[14] = (float)view;
        VkImageView in[] = {color, post_view(dil), post_view(react), post_view(instab), post_view(hist[p]), post_view(lock)};
        TexBackend *o[] = {hist[c], out};
        cpost_pass(cb, "taa_resolve.comp", in, 6, o, 2, pc, w, h);
    }
    vk_full_barrier(cb);
    gp_mark(cb, "post taa end");
    last = frame;
    lw = w, lh = h;
    pj[0] = J[0], pj[1] = J[1];
    return out;
}

// AMD FSR 3.1 (Video > Upscaler FSR 3; fsr3.h) or FSR 4 (Upscaler FSR 4; fsr_api.h): the scene b (render size, jittered: output_scale.c rt_persp_offset with
// FSR's sequence, rt_jitter_set_phases) to ow x oh (post image 13), from this frame's motion vectors (just filled), the
// scene depth (as R32F, post image 14) and the reactive mask (the vectors' .z as R8, post image 15). The vectors are
// clip-space NDC differences (y up, the image's y down: mvec_fill.frag), FSR wants the UV offset to where the pixel was:
// (-x / 2, y / 2), its motion vector scale over the render size. Its jitter is in render pixels, y down. NULL when an
// input is missing (no camera yet, sizes that differ) or FSR failed: the scene goes on without it.
typedef struct { Fsr3Dispatch d; int api; } FsrJob;
static _Atomic int fsr3_failed;
// The recorder thread: AMD's DLLs when asked for (their failing, logged there and remembered by fsr_api_usable: the
// built-in FSR 3.1 in their place, from this frame on, without the history of the other upscaler), else the built-in one
static void fsr3_run(void *arg) {
    FsrJob *j = arg;
    bool amd_ok = j->api && fsr_api_dispatch(&j->d, j->api);
    if (j->api && !amd_ok) j->d.reset = true;
    if (!amd_ok && !(fsr3_available() && fsr3_dispatch(&j->d))) atomic_store(&fsr3_failed, 1);
}

static TexBackend *fsr3_scene(VkCommandBuffer cb, TexBackend *b, uint32_t ow, uint32_t oh) {
    uint64_t frame = renderer_present_count();
    TexBackend *v = mvec_vectors_img, *db = mvec_depth ? vk_tex(mvec_depth, false) : NULL;
    float jit[2], nr, fr, fov;
    const char *why = mvec_filled != frame ? "no vectors this frame" : !v || v->width != b->width || v->height != b->height ? "vectors' size"
                    : !db || !db->image || db->width != b->width || db->height != b->height ? "depth's size"
                    : ow < b->width || oh < b->height ? "output smaller" : !mvec_camera_now(jit, &nr, &fr, &fov) ? "no camera" : NULL;
    static const char *lwhy;
    if (why != lwhy && why) LOG("[fsr3] skipped: %s (scene %ux%u, vectors %ux%u, depth %ux%u)\n", why, b->width, b->height,
                                v ? v->width : 0, v ? v->height : 0, db ? db->width : 0, db ? db->height : 0);
    lwhy = why;
    if (why) return NULL;
    uint32_t w = b->width, h = b->height;
    static const VkComponentMapping id = {0};
    TexBackend *dep = post_image(14, w, h, VK_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT), *rea = post_image(15, w, h, VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM);
    TexBackend *out = post_image_ex(13, ow, oh, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT);
    float pc[8] = {0};
    VkImageView di[3] = {vk_image_view(db, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, db->format, 0, 1, 0, 1, id, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT)};
    gp_mark(cb, "FSR 3 depth copy");
    post_pass(cb, "fsr3_depth.frag", di, 1, dep, pc, false);
    VkImageView ri[3] = {post_view(v)};
    static int reactive = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_REACTIVE=0: (testing) no reactive mask (all zero)
    if (reactive < 0) reactive = !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_REACTIVE") || atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_REACTIVE")) != 0;
    float rpc[8] = {reactive ? 1.0f : 0.0f};
    gp_mark(cb, "FSR 3 reactive mask");
    post_pass(cb, "fsr3_reactive.frag", ri, 1, rea, rpc, false);
    vk_full_barrier(cb);
    float flip = nvn_window_origin() == 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f;  // (the game's NDC y to clip y: mvec_fill.frag's a.x)
    static uint64_t last = ~0ull, last_ns;
    uint64_t ns = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    Fsr3Dispatch d = {
        .dev = g_vk.dev, .phys = g_vk.phys, .cb = cb,
        .color = {b->image, b->format, w, h}, .depth = {dep->image, dep->format, w, h},
        .motion = {v->image, v->format, w, h}, .reactive = {rea->image, rea->format, w, h},
        .output = {out->image, out->format, ow, oh},
        .jitter = {jit[0] * (float)w * 0.5f, -jit[1] * flip * (float)h * 0.5f},
        .motion_scale = {-0.5f * (float)w, 0.5f * (float)h},
        .dt_ms = last_ns && ns > last_ns ? (float)((ns - last_ns) / 1e6) : 16.7f,
        .near_ = nr, .far_ = fr, .fov_y = fov,
        .sharpness = g_settings.sharpening / 10.0f,
        .reset = last == ~0ull || last + 1 != frame,
    };
    last_ns = ns;
    // Upscaler FSR 4, or SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_API=1: AMD's DLLs (fsr_api.h); else the built-in FSR 3.1 (fsr3.h)
    int api = rt_fsr4() ? 4 : fsr3_api_wanted() ? 3 : 0;
    if (api && !fsr_api_usable(api)) api = 0;  // (it failed before: the built-in one from here on)
    static int last_api = -1;  // (another upscaler: its own history, from none)
    if (api != last_api) d.reset = true;
    last_api = api;
    gp_mark(cb, api == 4 ? "FSR 4 upscaler" : "FSR 3 upscaler");
    // FidelityFX records into cb itself, and may wait for the device: the recorder thread makes the call, in its turn
    // (fsr3_run; with the recorder off, here and now). Waiting for the recorder and dispatching here cost this thread
    // ~0.18 ms a frame (RTX 3060, 1440p Quality), where it limits the frame rate. Whether it worked is known a frame
    // late: a failure leaves this frame's output undefined and the scene goes on without FSR from the next.
    if (atomic_load(&fsr3_failed)) return NULL;
    static FsrJob jobs[8];  // (the recorder is never 8 frames behind: a submission a frame waits for it)
    static unsigned nj;
    FsrJob *j = &jobs[nj++ & 7];
    j->d = d, j->api = api;
    rec_custom(fsr3_run, j);
    gp_mark(cb, api == 4 ? "after FSR 4" : "after FSR 3");
    last = frame;
    vk_dyn_forget();  // (FSR's own pipelines and sets were bound)
    vk_full_barrier(cb);
    rt_jitter_set_phases((uint32_t)fsr3_jitter_phases(w, ow));
    return out;
}

// Inside the window image's rendering (device.c vk_frame_begin): the game image into (vx, vy, vw, vh).
void vk_present_draw(VkCommandBuffer cb, TexBackend *b, float vx, float vy, float vw, float vh, const float pv[8]) {
    if (!b || !b->image || (b->aspect & ~VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT)) return;
    VkImageView src = post_process(cb, b, pv[6] > 0 ? vw / pv[6] : vw, pv[7] > 0 ? vh / pv[7] : vh);
    // Accessibility > Colour vision: the whole picture (HUD included), after the anti-aliasing; off: present.frag.
    // The game's 8-bit image holds sRGB-encoded values (read raw); HDR's float picture (RGBA16F) is linear.
    float cm[9], cpc[12];
    bool cvd = colour_vision_matrix(cm);
    if (cvd) {
        bool lin = b->format == VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT || b->format == VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT ||
                   b->format == VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            cpc[i * 4] = cm[i * 3];
            cpc[i * 4 + 1] = cm[i * 3 + 1];
            cpc[i * 4 + 2] = cm[i * 3 + 2];
            cpc[i * 4 + 3] = 0;
        }
        cpc[3] = lin ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    }
    VkPipeline p = present_pipeline_cvd(vk_frame_format(), cvd);
    VkDescriptorSet ds = vk_alloc_set(present_set_layout);
    VkDescriptorImageInfo ii = {vk_default_sampler(true), src, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL};
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = ds, .dstBinding = 0, .descriptorCount = 1,
                              .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, .pImageInfo = &ii};
    rec_UpdateDescriptorSets(1, &w);
    rec_CmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, p);
    vk_dyn_forget();
    rec_CmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, present_layout, 0, 1, &ds, 0, NULL);
    VkViewport vp = {vx, vy, vw, vh, 0, 1};
    rec_CmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vp);
    rec_CmdPushConstants(cb, present_layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, 32, pv);
    if (cvd) rec_CmdPushConstants(cb, present_layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 32, sizeof cpc, cpc);
    rec_CmdDraw(cb, 3, 1, 0, 0);
    VkViewport full = {0, 0, (float)g_vk.sc_extent.width, (float)g_vk.sc_extent.height, 0, 1};
    rec_CmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &full);
}

static void save_view_png(TexBackend *b, VkImageView src, const char *path);

// Screenshot of a game texture (presented crop applied to build/frame_* shots), via the present shader into RGBA8.
void renderer_save_texture_tex(TexBackend *b, const char *path) {
    if (!b || !b->image || (b->aspect & ~VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT)) return;
    save_view_png(b, raw_view(b), path);
}

// (debug frames) each channel of a colour texture's level 0 as grey, <path> minus .png + _<channel>.png, and
// _L<layer> before that for the layers of an array (up to 8).
static void debug_save_channels(TexBackend *b, const char *path) {
    if (!b || !b->image || (b->aspect & ~VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT) || b->base_type == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D) return;
    VkFormat f = b->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB ? VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM
               : b->format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB ? VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM : b->format;
    uint32_t ly0 = 0, ly1 = 7;  // SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_TEXDUMP_LAYERS=<first>-<last> (default 0-7)
    uint32_t lv = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_TEXDUMP_LEVEL") ? (uint32_t)atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_TEXDUMP_LEVEL")) : 0;  // (stretched)
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_TEXDUMP_LAYERS")) sscanf(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_TEXDUMP_LAYERS"), "%u-%u", &ly0, &ly1);
    for (uint32_t ly = ly0; ly < b->layers && ly <= ly1; ly++)
        for (int ch = 0; ch < 4; ch++) {
            VkComponentSwizzle c = (VkComponentSwizzle)(VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_R + ch);
            VkComponentMapping m = {c, c, c, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_ONE};
            char p2[300], lay[16] = "";
            if (b->layers > 1) snprintf(lay, sizeof lay, "_L%u", ly);
            snprintf(p2, sizeof p2, "%.*s%s_%c.png", (int)strlen(path) - 4, path, lay, "rgba"[ch]);
            save_view_png(b, vk_image_view(b, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, f, lv < b->levels ? lv : 0, 1, ly, 1, m, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT), p2);
        }
}

static void save_view_png(TexBackend *b, VkImageView src, const char *path) {
    extern const float *vk_shot_crop(void);
    float crop[4] = {0, 0, 1, 1};
    if (strstr(path, "frame_")) memcpy(crop, vk_shot_crop(), sizeof crop);
    uint32_t w = (uint32_t)(b->width * crop[2]), h = (uint32_t)(b->height * crop[3]);
    if (!w || !h) return;
    vk_end_pass();
    VkImage img;
    VmaAllocation mem;
    VkImageCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, .format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM,
                            .extent = {w, h, 1}, .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = 1, .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT,
                            .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL, .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
    VK_CHECK(vmaCreateImage(g_vk.vma, &ci, &ai, &img, &mem, NULL));
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    vk_full_barrier(cb);
    vk_image_init_layout(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = img, .viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D,
                                 .format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    VkImageView tv;
    VK_CHECK(vkCreateImageView(g_vk.dev, &vci, NULL, &tv));
    VkRenderingAttachmentInfo ca = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO, .imageView = tv, .imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                                    .loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR, .storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE};
    VkRenderingInfo ri = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO, .renderArea = {{0, 0}, {w, h}}, .layerCount = 1,
                          .colorAttachmentCount = 1, .pColorAttachments = &ca};
    rec_CmdBeginRendering(cb, &ri);
    VkPipeline p = present_pipeline(VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM);
    VkDescriptorSet ds = vk_alloc_set(present_set_layout);
    VkDescriptorImageInfo ii = {vk_default_sampler(true), src, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL};
    VkWriteDescriptorSet wr = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = ds, .dstBinding = 0, .descriptorCount = 1,
                               .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, .pImageInfo = &ii};
    rec_UpdateDescriptorSets(1, &wr);
    rec_CmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, p);
    vk_dyn_forget();
    rec_CmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, present_layout, 0, 1, &ds, 0, NULL);
    VkViewport vp = {0, 0, (float)w, (float)h, 0, 1};
    VkRect2D sc = {{0, 0}, {w, h}};
    rec_CmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vp);
    rec_CmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &sc);
    float pv[8] = {renderer_origin_lower_left() && !strstr(path, "window") ? 1.0f : 0.0f, 0, 0, 0, crop[0], crop[1], crop[2], crop[3]};
    rec_CmdPushConstants(cb, present_layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, 32, pv);
    rec_CmdDraw(cb, 3, 1, 0, 0);
    rec_CmdEndRendering(cb);
    vk_full_barrier(cb);
    VkSpan out = vk_readback((uint64_t)w * h * 4);
    VkBufferImageCopy c = {.bufferOffset = out.off, .imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .imageExtent = {w, h, 1}};
    rec_CmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, out.buf, 1, &c);
    renderer_flush();
    vk_readback_sync();
    vk_save_png(path, out.ptr, w, h);
    vkDestroyImageView(g_vk.dev, tv, NULL);
    vmaDestroyImage(g_vk.vma, img, mem);
}

// (debugging) A 3D image's level 0 as the GPU holds it, raw texels (x, then y, then z), for comparing with what was
// uploaded (SAVAGEWIND_DUMP_TEX3D). debug_save_channels can't show 3D images.
static void debug_save_3d(TexBackend *b, const char *path) {
    uint32_t bpp = b->format == VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT ? 8 : b->format == VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT ? 16
                 : b->format == VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM ? 1 : b->format == VK_FORMAT_R16_SFLOAT || b->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM ? 2 : 4;
    uint64_t size = (uint64_t)b->width * b->height * b->depth * bpp;
    vk_end_pass();
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_cmd();
    vk_full_barrier(cb);
    VkSpan out = vk_readback(size);
    VkBufferImageCopy c = {.bufferOffset = out.off, .imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                           .imageExtent = {b->width, b->height, b->depth}};
    rec_CmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, b->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, out.buf, 1, &c);
    vk_full_barrier(cb);
    renderer_flush();
    vk_readback_sync();
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (f) fwrite(out.ptr, 1, size, f), fclose(f);
    LOG("[vk] 3D image %ux%ux%u vk format %d (%u bytes a texel) read back from the GPU: %s\n", b->width, b->height, b->depth,
        b->format, bpp, f ? path : "(not saved)");
}

// ================================================================== executor (renderer.m exec_list)
// (measuring) SAVAGEWIND_VK_LIST_STATS=1: how self-contained the command lists a frame calls are (whether each could be
// translated on its own): per list, the state its draws use that it did not set itself, and UpdateUniformBuffer writes
// another list's draws read. A "[lists]" line every 120 presents.
static struct { uint32_t set, inh, ubuf_set[2], tex_set[2], ubuf_inh, tex_inh; int draws, uub; } lst[8];
static struct { uint64_t lists, self, draws, self_draws, uub_lists, uub, cross, cat[32], ubuf_inh, tex_inh; } lsum;
static struct { uint64_t lo, hi; int list; } lst_uub[256];
static int lst_nuub, lst_id, lst_cur[8];
static uint32_t lst_cat(uint32_t op) {
    switch (op) {
    case CMD_BIND_PROGRAM: return 1u << 0;
    case CMD_BIND_BLEND: return 1u << 1;
    case CMD_BIND_CHANNEL_MASK: return 1u << 2;
    case CMD_BIND_COLOR: return 1u << 3;
    case CMD_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL: return 1u << 4;
    case CMD_BIND_MULTISAMPLE: return 1u << 5;
    case CMD_BIND_POLYGON: return 1u << 6;
    case CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB: return 1u << 7;
    case CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM: return 1u << 8;
    case CMD_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS: return 1u << 9;
    case CMD_SET_TEXTURE_POOL: return 1u << 10;
    case CMD_SET_SAMPLER_POOL: return 1u << 11;
    case CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS: return 1u << 12;
    case CMD_SET_VIEWPORTS: return 1u << 13;
    case CMD_SET_SCISSORS: return 1u << 14;
    case CMD_SET_DEPTH_RANGES: return 1u << 15;
    case CMD_SET_BLEND_COLOR: return 1u << 16;
    case CMD_SET_STENCIL: return 1u << 17;
    case CMD_SET_POLYGON_OFFSET: return 1u << 18;
    case CMD_SET_PRIMITIVE_RESTART: return 1u << 19;
    case CMD_SET_LINE_WIDTH: return 1u << 20;
    case CMD_SET_DEPTH_CLAMP: return 1u << 21;
    case CMD_BIND_STORAGE_BUFFERS: return 1u << 22;
    default: return 0;
    }
}
static const char *const lst_names[] = {"program", "blend", "chmask", "color", "depthstencil", "multisample", "polygon",
                                        "vattrib", "vstream", "vbuffers", "texpool", "samplerpool", "targets", "viewports",
                                        "scissors", "depthranges", "blendcolor", "stencil", "polyoffset", "restart",
                                        "linewidth", "depthclamp", "storage"};
static void lst_begin(int depth) {
    if (depth < 1 || depth > 7) return;
    memset(&lst[depth], 0, sizeof lst[depth]);
    lst_cur[depth] = ++lst_id;
}
static void lst_op(int depth, CmdRec *r) {
    if (depth < 1 || depth > 7) return;
    lst[depth].set |= lst_cat(r->op);
    if (r->op == CMD_BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS && r->x[0] < 2)
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && r->x[1] + i < 18; i++) lst[depth].ubuf_set[r->x[0]] |= 1u << (r->x[1] + i);
    if ((r->op == CMD_BIND_TEXTURES || r->op == CMD_BIND_TEXTURES_DEFERRED) && r->x[0] < 2)
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && r->x[1] + i < 32; i++) lst[depth].tex_set[r->x[0]] |= 1u << (r->x[1] + i);
    if (r->op == CMD_UPDATE_UNIFORM_BUFFER) {
        lst[depth].uub++;
        if (lst_nuub < 256) lst_uub[lst_nuub++] = (__typeof__(lst_uub[0])){r->x[0] + r->x[2], r->x[0] + r->x[2] + r->x[3], lst_cur[depth]};
    }
}
static int lst_depth;  // (the list the draw in progress is in)
static void lst_draw(Prog *pr) {
    int d = lst_depth;
    if (d < 1 || d > 7) return;
    uint32_t all = (1u << 23) - 1 - (1u << 21) - (1u << 22);  // (depth clamp, storage: not always used)
    lst[d].inh |= all & ~lst[d].set;
    lst[d].draws++;
    ShaderInfo *si[2] = {pr->vi, pr->fi};
    for (int sg = 0; sg < 2; sg++) {
        uint32_t used = 0;
        for (int k = 3; k < 21; k++) if (si[sg]->cbuf_mask & (1u << k)) used |= 1u << (k - 3);
        if (used & ~lst[d].ubuf_set[sg]) lst[d].ubuf_inh = 1;
        uint32_t tu = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < si[sg]->ntex; i++) {
            int slot = ((int)si[sg]->tex[i].handle_offset - 0x20) / 8;
            if (slot >= 0 && slot < 32) tu |= 1u << slot;
        }
        if (tu & ~lst[d].tex_set[sg]) lst[d].tex_inh = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {  // a constant buffer another list's UpdateUniformBuffer wrote
            Range u = st.ubuf[sg][i];
            if (!u.addr || !(used & (1u << i))) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < lst_nuub; k++)
                if (lst_uub[k].list != lst_cur[d] && u.addr < lst_uub[k].hi && lst_uub[k].lo < u.addr + (u.size ? u.size : 256)) {
                    lsum.cross++;
                    break;
                }
        }
    }
}
static void lst_end(int depth) {
    if (depth < 1 || depth > 7) return;
    lsum.lists++;
    lsum.draws += lst[depth].draws;
    uint32_t inh = lst[depth].inh & ~((1u << 10) | (1u << 11));  // (the pools: set once a frame at the top)
    if (!inh && !lst[depth].ubuf_inh && !lst[depth].tex_inh) { lsum.self++; lsum.self_draws += lst[depth].draws; }
    for (int b = 0; b < 23; b++) if (lst[depth].draws && (lst[depth].inh >> b & 1)) lsum.cat[b]++;
    if (lst[depth].draws) { lsum.ubuf_inh += lst[depth].ubuf_inh; lsum.tex_inh += lst[depth].tex_inh; }
    if (lst[depth].uub) { lsum.uub_lists++; lsum.uub += lst[depth].uub; }
}
void vk_list_stats_frame(void) {  // (device.c, each present)
    if (lst_on <= 0) return;
    static int n;
    lst_nuub = 0;
    if (++n % 120) return;
    char buf[1024];
    int o = snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "[lists] 120 frames: %llu lists (%llu with draws self-contained, %llu of %llu draws), "
                     "%llu lists with %llu UpdateUniformBuffer, %llu constant-buffer bindings read another list's; "
                     "inherited by lists with draws: ubuf %llu tex %llu", (unsigned long long)lsum.lists,
                     (unsigned long long)lsum.self, (unsigned long long)lsum.self_draws, (unsigned long long)lsum.draws,
                     (unsigned long long)lsum.uub_lists, (unsigned long long)lsum.uub, (unsigned long long)lsum.cross,
                     (unsigned long long)lsum.ubuf_inh, (unsigned long long)lsum.tex_inh);
    for (int b = 0; b < 23 && o < (int)sizeof buf - 40; b++)
        if (lsum.cat[b]) o += snprintf(buf + o, sizeof buf - o, " %s %llu", lst_names[b], (unsigned long long)lsum.cat[b]);
    LOG("%s\n", buf);
    memset(&lsum, 0, sizeof lsum);
}

static void exec_list(uint64_t handle, int depth) {
    uint64_t p = handle;
    if (depth == 0) { tex_gen[0]++; tex_gen[1]++; }
    if (lst_on < 0) lst_on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_LIST_STATS") != NULL;
    if (lst_on) lst_begin(depth);
    for (int guard = 0; guard < 10000000; guard++) {
        CmdRec *r = (CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)p;
        void *x = r->extra;
        // (the records were written by another core: the first touch of each one missed the cache)
        __builtin_prefetch((const char *)r + 256);
        __builtin_prefetch((const char *)r + 320);
        __builtin_prefetch((const char *)r + 640);  // (a draw's records run to several hundred bytes: one more stride ahead)
        __builtin_prefetch((const char *)r + 704);
        if (r->op < CMD_COUNT) op_counts[r->op]++;
        if (g_debug_frame && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_OPS"))
            LOG("[op] %u depth %d: %llx %llx %llx %llx %llx\n", r->op, depth, (unsigned long long)r->x[0], (unsigned long long)r->x[1],
                (unsigned long long)r->x[2], (unsigned long long)r->x[3], (unsigned long long)r->x[4]);
        if (lst_on) { lst_op(depth, r); lst_depth = depth; }
        switch (r->op) {  // (key_gen: what the program and pipeline keys read)
        case CMD_UI_SCOPE:
            if (r->x[0]) hud_scope_enter(&hud_scope, (unsigned)r->x[0]);
            else hud_scope_leave(&hud_scope);
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_PROGRAM: case CMD_BIND_BLEND: case CMD_BIND_CHANNEL_MASK: case CMD_BIND_COLOR: case CMD_BIND_MULTISAMPLE:
        case CMD_BIND_POLYGON: case CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB: case CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM: case CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS:
        case CMD_SET_DEPTH_CLAMP:
            key_gen++;
            break;
        default: break;
        }
        switch (r->op) {
        case CMD_END:
            if (lst_on) lst_end(depth);
            return;
        case CMD_JUMP: p = r->x[0]; continue;
        case CMD_CALL: {
            const uint64_t *h = x;
            if (g_debug_frame && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_OPS"))
                for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[0] && i < 8; i++) LOG("[call] depth %d -> %llx\n", depth, (unsigned long long)h[i]);
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[0] && depth < 8; i++) {
                if (i + 1 < r->x[0]) __builtin_prefetch((const void *)(uintptr_t)h[i + 1]);  // (~2800 calls a frame)
                exec_list(h[i], depth + 1);
            }
            break;
        }
        case CMD_BIND_PROGRAM: st.program = (NvnProgram *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0]; break;
        case CMD_BIND_BLEND: { uint8_t *b = x; memcpy(st.blend[b[0] & 7], b, 8); break; }
        case CMD_BIND_CHANNEL_MASK: memcpy(&st.channel_mask, x, 4); break;
        case CMD_BIND_COLOR: memcpy(st.color_state, x, 4); break;
        case CMD_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL: memcpy(st.ds, x, 8); break;
        case CMD_BIND_MULTISAMPLE: memcpy(st.ms, x, 0x18); break;
        case CMD_BIND_POLYGON: memcpy(st.poly, x, 4); break;
        case CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB:
            st.nattrib = (int)r->x[0] > 16 ? 16 : (int)r->x[0];
            memcpy(st.attrib, x, st.nattrib * 4);
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM:
            st.nstream = (int)r->x[0] > 16 ? 16 : (int)r->x[0];
            memcpy(st.stream, x, st.nstream * 8);
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS:
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[1] && r->x[0] + i < 16; i++) memcpy(&st.vbuf[r->x[0] + i], (uint8_t *)x + i * 16, 16);
            vbuf_gen++;
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS:
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && r->x[1] + i < 18 && r->x[0] < 6; i++)
                memcpy(&st.ubuf[r->x[0]][r->x[1] + i], (uint8_t *)x + i * 16, 16);
            if (r->x[0] < 6) ubuf_gen[r->x[0]]++;
            if (g_debug_frame && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_BINDS")) {
                LOG("[bind] ubuf stage %llu slots %llu+%llu:", (unsigned long long)r->x[0], (unsigned long long)r->x[1],
                    (unsigned long long)r->x[2]);
                for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && i < 18; i++) {
                    const uint64_t *rg = (const uint64_t *)((uint8_t *)x + i * 16);
                    LOG(" %llx+%llu", (unsigned long long)rg[0], (unsigned long long)rg[1]);
                }
                LOG("\n");
            }
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_STORAGE_BUFFERS:
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && r->x[1] + i < 16 && r->x[0] < 6; i++)
                memcpy(&st.sbuf[r->x[0]][r->x[1] + i], (uint8_t *)x + i * 16, 16);
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_TEXTURES:
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && r->x[1] + i < 32 && r->x[0] < 6; i++)
                memcpy(&st.tex[r->x[0]][r->x[1] + i], (uint8_t *)x + i * 8, 8);
            if (r->x[0] < 6) tex_gen[r->x[0]]++;
            if (g_debug_frame && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_BINDS")) {
                LOG("[bind] stage %llu slots %llu+%llu:", (unsigned long long)r->x[0], (unsigned long long)r->x[1],
                    (unsigned long long)r->x[2]);
                for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && i < 32; i++) {
                    uint64_t h;
                    memcpy(&h, (uint8_t *)x + i * 8, 8);
                    uint32_t tic = h & 0xFFFFF;
                    NvnTexture *t = h && st.tpool && tic < (uint32_t)st.tpool->count ? ((NvnTexEntry *)st.tpool->entries)[tic].tex : NULL;
                    if (t) LOG(" %ux%u/t%u/f%#x", t->width, t->height, t->target, t->format);
                    else LOG(" %llx", (unsigned long long)h);
                }
                LOG("\n");
            }
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_TEXTURES_DEFERRED:  // (stage, first, count, handles): the handles as they are now
            if (r->x[3] >= GUEST_LO && r->x[3] + r->x[2] * 8 <= GUEST_HI)
                for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && r->x[1] + i < 32 && r->x[0] < 6; i++)
                    memcpy(&st.tex[r->x[0]][r->x[1] + i], (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)r->x[3] + i * 8, 8);
            if (r->x[0] < 6) tex_gen[r->x[0]]++;
            break;
        case CMD_BIND_IMAGES:
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[2] && r->x[1] + i < 8 && r->x[0] < 6; i++)
                memcpy(&st.img[r->x[0]][r->x[1] + i], (uint8_t *)x + i * 8, 8);
            break;
        case CMD_SET_TEXTURE_POOL: st.tpool = (NvnDescPool *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0]; tex_gen[0]++; tex_gen[1]++; break;
        case CMD_SET_SAMPLER_POOL: st.spool = (NvnDescPool *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0]; break;
        case CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS: {
            const struct { uint64_t tex[8]; NvnTextureView views[8]; uint8_t has_view[8]; uint64_t depth;
                           NvnTextureView dview; uint8_t has_dview; } *rt = x;
            RtState prev = st.rt;  // the same targets again: keep the pass (a restart = full barrier + reload)
            memset(&st.rt, 0, sizeof st.rt);
            st.rt.ncolor = (int)r->x[0] > 8 ? 8 : (int)r->x[0];
            for (int i = 0; i < st.rt.ncolor; i++) {
                st.rt.color[i] = (NvnTexture *)(uintptr_t)rt->tex[i];
                st.rt.cview[i] = rt->views[i];
                st.rt.has_cview[i] = rt->has_view[i];
            }
            st.rt.depth = (NvnTexture *)(uintptr_t)rt->depth;
            st.rt.dview = rt->dview;
            st.rt.has_dview = rt->has_dview;
            static int always = -1;
            if (always < 0) always = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_PASS_RESTART") != NULL;
            if (always || memcmp(&prev, &st.rt, sizeof prev)) { st.rt_dirty = true; rt_gen++; }
            if (nfbrun && memcmp(&prev, &st.rt, sizeof prev)) fbdump_flush();
            if (logfb > 0 && !fbskip && memcmp(&prev, &st.rt, sizeof prev))
                LOG("[feedback] targets %d (%ux%u fmt %#x) depth %d after %u draws\n", st.rt.ncolor, st.rt.ncolor && st.rt.color[0] ? st.rt.color[0]->width : 0,
                    st.rt.ncolor && st.rt.color[0] ? st.rt.color[0]->height : 0, st.rt.ncolor && st.rt.color[0] ? st.rt.color[0]->format : 0,
                    st.rt.depth != NULL, fb_draws);
            break;
        }
        case CMD_SET_VIEWPORTS:
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[1] && r->x[0] + i < 16; i++) memcpy(st.viewport[r->x[0] + i], (uint8_t *)x + i * 16, 16);
            break;
        case CMD_SET_SCISSORS:
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[1] && r->x[0] + i < 16; i++) memcpy(st.scissor[r->x[0] + i], (uint8_t *)x + i * 16, 16);
            break;
        case CMD_SET_DEPTH_RANGES:
            for (uint64_t i = 0; i < r->x[1] && r->x[0] + i < 16; i++) memcpy(st.depth_range[r->x[0] + i], (uint8_t *)x + i * 8, 8);
            break;
        case CMD_SET_BLEND_COLOR: memcpy(st.blend_color, x, 16); break;
        case CMD_SET_STENCIL: {
            int face = (int)r->x[0];
            for (int f = 0; f < 2; f++) {
                if (!(face & (1 << f))) continue;
                if (r->x[6] == 0) st.stencil_ref[f] = (uint32_t)r->x[1];
                else if (r->x[6] == 1) st.stencil_mask[f] = (uint32_t)r->x[1];
                else st.stencil_vmask[f] = (uint32_t)r->x[1];
            }
            break;
        }
        case CMD_SET_LINE_WIDTH: st.line_width = r->f[0]; break;
        case CMD_SET_DEPTH_CLAMP: {
            // BOTW draws its sun shadow cascades (and its sun occlusion query) with depth clamp: casters nearer the
            // light than a cascade's near plane (the cliff over the Shrine of Resurrection, tree tops above the view)
            // are flattened onto it, not clipped. Clipped, the sun lit cave interiors, and what got clipped changed
            // with the cascades as the camera turned (tree shadows). Pipeline state (PipeState.depth_clamp).
            static int off = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_NO_DEPTH_CLAMP=1: ignored (A/B tests)
            if (off < 0) off = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NO_DEPTH_CLAMP") != NULL;
            static bool logged;
            if (r->x[0] && !logged) { logged = true; LOG("[nvn] SetDepthClamp on (depth clamp %s)\n", g_vk.depth_clamp ? "supported" : "not supported"); }
            st.depth_clamp = r->x[0] != 0 && !off;
            break;
        }
        case CMD_SET_RASTERIZER_DISCARD: {
            static int seen;  // (the first few changes: when and how often the game uses it)
            if (seen < 4 && (!seen || (r->x[0] != 0) != st.rasterizer_discard)) {
                seen++;
                LOG("[nvn] SetRasterizerDiscard %s (frame %llu, %llu draws discarded so far)\n", r->x[0] ? "on" : "off",
                    (unsigned long long)renderer_present_count(), (unsigned long long)stat_discarded);
            }
            st.rasterizer_discard = r->x[0] != 0;
            break;
        }
        case CMD_SET_POLYGON_OFFSET: memcpy(st.poly_offset, r->f, sizeof st.poly_offset); break;
        case CMD_SET_PRIMITIVE_RESTART: st.prim_restart = r->x[0] != 0; st.restart_index = (uint32_t)r->x[1]; break;
        case CMD_SET_COPY_STRIDES: st.copy_row_stride = r->x[0]; st.copy_image_stride = r->x[1]; break;
        case CMD_CLEAR_COLOR: {
            snap_reason = "clear-color"; snapshots_invalidate(NULL);
            int index = (int)r->x[0];
            if (ENV_ONCE("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_CLEARS") && index < st.rt.ncolor && st.rt.color[index])
                LOG("[cclear] frame %llu idx %d %ux%u f%#x mask %#x\n", (unsigned long long)renderer_present_count(), index,
                    st.rt.color[index]->width, st.rt.color[index]->height, st.rt.color[index]->format, (uint32_t)r->x[2]);
            if (index < st.rt.ncolor && st.rt.color[index]) clear(index, (int)r->x[5], x, (uint32_t)r->x[2], false, 0, false, 0, 0);
            break;
        }
        case CMD_CLEAR_TEXTURE: {
            // ClearTexture(cmd, texture, view, region, color, mask): a render-target clear of the texture alone (renderer.m)
            const struct { uint64_t tex; NvnTextureView view; uint8_t has_view; int32_t region[6]; float color[4]; } *ct = x;
            NvnTexture *t = (NvnTexture *)(uintptr_t)ct->tex;
            if (!t) break;
            snap_reason = "clear-texture"; snapshots_invalidate(NULL);
            RtState saved = st.rt;
            int32_t sc[4];
            memcpy(sc, st.scissor[0], sizeof sc);
            vk_end_pass();
            memset(&st.rt, 0, sizeof st.rt);
            st.rt.ncolor = 1;
            st.rt.color[0] = t;
            if (ct->has_view) { st.rt.cview[0] = ct->view; st.rt.has_cview[0] = 1; }
            st.rt_dirty = true;
            const int32_t *rg = ct->region;
            if (rg[3] > 0 && rg[4] > 0) { st.scissor[0][0] = rg[0]; st.scissor[0][1] = rg[1]; st.scissor[0][2] = rg[3]; st.scissor[0][3] = rg[4]; }
            else { st.scissor[0][0] = st.scissor[0][1] = 0; st.scissor[0][2] = st.scissor[0][3] = 16384; }
            clear(0, (int)r->x[6], ct->color, (uint32_t)r->x[4] ? (uint32_t)r->x[4] : 0xF, false, 0, false, 0, 0);
            vk_end_pass();
            st.rt = saved;
            memcpy(st.scissor[0], sc, sizeof sc);
            st.rt_dirty = true;
            break;
        }
        case CMD_CLEAR_DEPTH_STENCIL:
            snap_reason = "clear-depth"; snapshots_invalidate(NULL);
            if (st.rt.depth) {
                bool has_stencil = renderer_format_has_stencil(st.rt.depth->format);
                clear(-1, 0, NULL, 0, r->x[0] != 0, r->f[0], has_stencil && r->x[2] != 0, (uint32_t)r->x[1], (uint32_t)r->x[2]);
            }
            break;
        case CMD_DISPATCH: dispatch_compute((uint32_t)r->x[0], (uint32_t)r->x[1], (uint32_t)r->x[2]); break;
        case CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS: draw(r, false); break;
        case CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS: draw(r, true); break;
        case CMD_UPDATE_UNIFORM_BUFFER:
            if (g_debug_frame && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_BINDS"))
                LOG("[bind] update ubuf %llx (size %llu) +%llu: %llu bytes\n", (unsigned long long)r->x[0], (unsigned long long)r->x[1],
                    (unsigned long long)r->x[2], (unsigned long long)r->x[3]);
            kernel_watch_write("UpdateUniformBuffer", r->x[0] + r->x[2], r->x[3]);
            stat_uub++;
            // The same bytes again (~1 update in 5 in the open world): the copies over the range stay good.
            if (!memcmp((void *)(uintptr_t)(r->x[0] + r->x[2]), x, r->x[3])) { stat_uub_same++; break; }
            mvec_guest_write(r->x[0] + r->x[2], r->x[0] + r->x[2] + r->x[3]);  // (mvec.c: a draw its thread has not read yet)
            memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)(r->x[0] + r->x[2]), x, r->x[3]);
            hc_cpu_wrote(r->x[0] + r->x[2], r->x[3]);
            uub_note(r->x[0] + r->x[2], r->x[0] + r->x[2] + r->x[3]);  // (the shared copies over it are stale now)
            break;
        case CMD_BARRIER:
            if (logfb > 0 && !fbskip) LOG("[feedback] barrier %#llx after %u draws\n", (unsigned long long)r->x[0], fb_draws);
            break;
        case CMD_FENCE_SYNC: {
            static int fence_flush = -1;
            if (fence_flush < 0) fence_flush = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FENCE_FLUSH") ? 1 : 0;
            if (fence_flush) renderer_flush();
            extern void nvn_sync_set_seq(uint64_t guest, uint64_t seq);
            if (r->x[1]) nvn_sync_set_seq(r->x[1], renderer_fence_seq());
            break;
        }
        case CMD_REPORT_COUNTER: {
            // The game times its GPU work with these (two per frame) and picks its 3D resolution from that (docked:
            // 1600x900 down to 1280x720, a scene target of its own per size). Timed here they measured our command
            // translation, not GPU work, and the open world dropped to 1280x720 times the internal-resolution
            // scale. A PC GPU does that work in a fraction of the Switch's time: every counter of a presented frame
            // gets the same timestamp (no GPU time), so the game keeps 1600x900. Video > Advanced > Dynamic
            // resolution (on with the Potato preset), or SAVAGEWIND_VK_COUNTER=live: the time of each counter (as
            // before): the game lowers its 3D resolution when the frame takes long.
            uint64_t *out = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)r->x[1];
            uint32_t type = (uint32_t)r->x[0];
            static uint32_t seen;
            if (type < 32 && !(seen & (1u << type))) { seen |= 1u << type; LOG("[nvn] ReportCounter type %u\n", type); }
            if (g_debug_frame && type != 0 && type != 16)
                LOG("[counter] type %u -> %llx after draw %llu (fs hash %016llx, rt %d %ux%u)\n", type, (unsigned long long)r->x[1],
                    (unsigned long long)stat_draws, (unsigned long long)g_cur_fs_hash, st.rt.ncolor,
                    st.rt.ncolor && st.rt.color[0] ? st.rt.color[0]->width : st.rt.depth ? st.rt.depth->width : 0,
                    st.rt.ncolor && st.rt.color[0] ? st.rt.color[0]->height : st.rt.depth ? st.rt.depth->height : 0);
            static int frozen = -1;
            if (frozen < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_COUNTER"); frozen = !e || strcmp(e, "live"); }
            static uint64_t frame_seen = ~0ull, frame_ts;
            extern uint64_t vk_frame_counter(void);
            bool fixed = frozen && !g_settings.dynamic_res;
            if (fixed && vk_frame_counter() != frame_seen) { frame_seen = vk_frame_counter(); frame_ts = SDL_GetTicksNS(); }
            uint64_t ts = fixed ? frame_ts : SDL_GetTicksNS();
            if (type == 1 && out && oq_on()) {  // SAMPLES_PASSED: written once the queries' submission is done
                pthread_mutex_lock(&readback_lock);
                if (oq_nreports == 32) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&readback_lock); renderer_flush(); pthread_mutex_lock(&readback_lock); oq_apply(); }
                if (oq_nreports < 32) {
                    OqReport *p = &oq_reports[oq_nreports++];
                    p->addr = r->x[1]; p->seq = vk_pending_seq(); p->ts = ts; p->nq = oq_nrun;
                    memcpy(p->q, oq_run, sizeof p->q[0] * (size_t)oq_nrun);
                    if (oneshot_queries()) {  // (the game reads this frame's count, never an uncounted one: renderer_wait_seq)
                        pthread_mutex_lock(&seq_lock);
                        if (p->seq > oneshot_seq) oneshot_seq = p->seq;
                        pthread_mutex_unlock(&seq_lock);
                    }
                }
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&readback_lock);
                break;
            }
            kernel_watch_write("ReportCounter", r->x[1], 16);
            if (out) { out[0] = 0; out[1] = ts; }
            break;
        }
        case CMD_RESET_COUNTER:
            if (r->x[0] == 1) { oq_counting = true; oq_nrun = 0; }  // SAMPLES_PASSED
            break;
        case CMD_COPY_TEXTURE_TO_TEXTURE: { const TexRefRec *t = x; copy_texture(&t[0], &t[1], r->x[6]); break; }
        case CMD_DOWNSAMPLE: { const TexRefRec *t = x; copy_texture(&t[0], &t[1], 1); break; }
        case CMD_COPY_BUFFER_TO_TEXTURE: copy_buffer_to_texture(r->x[0], x); break;
        case CMD_COPY_TEXTURE_TO_BUFFER: copy_texture_to_buffer(x, r->x[3]); break;
        case CMD_COPY_BUFFER_TO_BUFFER:
            renderer_flush();
            kernel_watch_write("CopyBufferToBuffer", r->x[1], r->x[2]);
            memmove((void *)(uintptr_t)r->x[1], (void *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0], r->x[2]);
            hc_cpu_wrote(r->x[1], r->x[2]);
            guest_copy_flush();
            break;
        default: break;
        }
        p += r->size;
    }
}

void backend_execute(uint64_t handle) {
    readbacks_apply();
    ubo_check_done(false);  // (SAVAGEWIND_VK_UBO_CHECK: as soon after each submission is done as the lists come)
    SW_ZONE("backend_execute");
    { SW_ACC("exec_lock"); gpu_lock(); }
    if (g_debug_frame && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_OPS")) LOG("[submit] %llx\n", (unsigned long long)handle);
    PROF_T0();
    in_execute = true;
    {
        SW_ACC("exec");
        guest_copy_flush();  // (a new list: the game may have written the memory of the last one's copies since)
        hc_list_begin();
        exec_list(handle, 0);
        mvec_sync();  // (the game may write the list's memory from here on)
    }
    in_execute = false;
    PROF_ADD(prof_exec);
    if (prof) cum_exec += SDL_GetTicksNS() - prof_t0_;
    static int sync_submit = -1;
    if (sync_submit < 0) sync_submit = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SYNC_SUBMIT") ? 1 : 0;
    if (sync_submit) renderer_flush();
    else renderer_submit();
    gpu_unlock();
}
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/framegen.cpp`:

```cpp
// AMD FSR 3 frame generation (Video > Frame generation): the FidelityFX SDK 1.1.4's frame interpolation and optical
// flow (third_party/FidelityFX, MIT) on its Vulkan backend, driven directly instead of through the SDK's frame
// interpolation swapchain (Windows only, and it would own the present: the runtime's present thread, its HDR10 pass
// and VSync modes stay). exec.c vk_fg_generate gives it the frame's images and camera and presents the result
// (device.c), see docs/SAVAGE-WIND.md "Frame generation".
//
// What the SDK's ffx-api provider (ffx_provider_framegeneration.cpp) does, in C: a shared backend context for the
// resources the two effects exchange (optical flow vectors, scene change detection, dilated depth and motion
// vectors, the previous frame's reconstructed depth, two of each that alternate), the optical flow context and the
// frame interpolation context on a second backend interface; per frame, frame interpolation's prepare (dilates the
// depth and motion vectors), the optical flow, then the interpolation.
#include <malloc.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <FidelityFX/host/backends/vk/ffx_vk.h>
#include <FidelityFX/host/ffx_frameinterpolation.h>
#include <FidelityFX/host/ffx_opticalflow.h>
#include <FidelityFX/host/ffx_fsr3upscaler.h>
#include <ffx_shader_blobs.h>

#include "framegen.h"

#define LOG(...) fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__)

// ---- the shaders: tools/ffx_shaders.py's blobs (wave32, 32-bit floats; frame interpolation for low-resolution
// motion vectors without jitter, both depth directions; the FSR 3 upscaler of vulkan/fsr3.cpp) in place of the SDK's
// FidelityFX_SC permutation tables
#include "ffx_shaders_vk.h"
#include "ffx_fsr3upscaler_vk.h"

enum { FI_PERM_DEPTH_INVERTED = 1 << 2 };
enum { FU_PERM_FP16 = 1 << 7 };  // (ffx_fsr3upscaler_private.h FSR3UPSCALER_SHADER_PERMUTATION_ALLOW_FP16)
extern "C" bool vk_shader_fp16(void);  // (device.c)  // (ffx_frameinterpolation_private.h FRAMEINTERPOLATION_SHADER_PERMUTATION_*)

extern "C" FfxErrorCode ffxGetPermutationBlobByIndex(FfxEffect effect, FfxPass pass, FfxBindStage, uint32_t options,
                                                     FfxShaderBlob *out) {
    if (effect == FFX_EFFECT_FRAMEINTERPOLATION && pass < FFX_FRAMEINTERPOLATION_PASS_COUNT) {
        memcpy(out, &ffx_fi_blobs[(options & FI_PERM_DEPTH_INVERTED) ? 1 : 0][pass], sizeof *out);
        return FFX_OK;
    }
    if (effect == FFX_EFFECT_OPTICALFLOW && pass < FFX_OPTICALFLOW_PASS_COUNT) {
        memcpy(out, &ffx_of_blobs[pass], sizeof *out);
        return FFX_OK;
    }
    // (one permutation per pass, the one fsr3.cpp's context asks for: sharpening is a pass of its own,
    // FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_PASS_ACCUMULATE_SHARPEN; its 16-bit version where the SDK allows it - the device reports
    // shaderFloat16 - and the device was made with it: vk_shader_fp16)
    if (effect == FFX_EFFECT_FSR3UPSCALER && pass < FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_PASS_COUNT && ffx_fu_blobs[0][pass].data) {
        int half = (options & FU_PERM_FP16) && vk_shader_fp16();
        memcpy(out, &ffx_fu_blobs[half][pass], sizeof *out);
        return FFX_OK;
    }
    LOG("[fg] no shader for effect %d pass %d\n", (int)effect, (int)pass);
    return FFX_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
}

extern "C" FfxErrorCode ffxIsWave64(FfxEffect, uint32_t, bool &wave64) {
    wave64 = false;  // (only wave32 blobs: the backend then asks for no subgroup size)
    return FFX_OK;
}

// The backend's hook into its frame interpolation swapchain, which isn't built
FfxErrorCode ffxSetFrameGenerationConfigToSwapchainVK(FfxFrameGenerationConfig const *) { return FFX_OK; }

// ---- contexts
enum { R_OF_VECTOR, R_OF_SCD, R_DILATED_DEPTH, R_DILATED_MV = R_DILATED_DEPTH + 2, R_PREV_DEPTH = R_DILATED_MV + 2,
       R_COUNT = R_PREV_DEPTH + 2 };

static struct {
    bool live;
    FgConfig cfg;
    FfxInterface shared, fi_if;
    void *scratch_shared, *scratch_fi;
    uint32_t shared_id;
    FfxOpticalflowContext of;
    FfxFrameInterpolationContext fi;
    FfxResourceInternal res[R_COUNT];
    unsigned toggle;
} g;

FgVk g_fg_vk;

#define TRY(x) do { FfxErrorCode e_ = (x); if (e_ != FFX_OK) { LOG("[fg] %s failed: %#x\n", #x, (unsigned)e_); return false; } } while (0)

// The backend calls a few extension functions unchecked: the debug labels (VK_EXT_debug_utils, an instance
// extension the runtime enables only with validation) and vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2KHR (core since 1.1 without
// the suffix)
static VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL no_label(VkCommandBuffer, const VkDebugUtilsLabelEXT *) {}
static VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL no_label_end(VkCommandBuffer) {}
static VKAPI_ATTR PFN_vkVoidFunction VKAPI_CALL device_proc(VkDevice d, const char *name) {
    PFN_vkVoidFunction f = vkGetDeviceProcAddr(d, name);
    if (f) return f;
    if (!strcmp(name, "vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2KHR")) return vkGetDeviceProcAddr(d, "vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2");
    if (!strcmp(name, "vkCmdBeginDebugUtilsLabelEXT")) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)no_label;
    if (!strcmp(name, "vkCmdEndDebugUtilsLabelEXT")) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)no_label_end;
    return nullptr;
}

// (the backend's context in it has members the compiler aligns past malloc's 16 bytes)
static void *scratch_alloc(size_t n) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    void *p = _aligned_malloc(n, 256);
#else
    void *p = aligned_alloc(256, n);
#endif
    if (p) memset(p, 0, n);
    return p;
}

static void scratch_free(void *p) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _aligned_free(p);
#else
    free(p);
#endif
}

static bool make_backend(FfxInterface *i, void **scratch, size_t contexts) {
    size_t n = (ffxGetScratchMemorySizeVK(g_fg_vk.phys, contexts) + 255) & ~(size_t)255;
    *scratch = scratch_alloc(n);
    VkDeviceContext dc = {g_fg_vk.dev, g_fg_vk.phys, device_proc};
    TRY(ffxGetInterfaceVK(i, ffxGetDeviceVK(&dc), *scratch, n, contexts));
    return true;
}

extern "C" void fg_destroy(void) {
    if (!g.live) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < R_COUNT; i++) g.shared.fpDestroyResource(&g.shared, g.res[i], g.shared_id);
    ffxFrameInterpolationContextDestroy(&g.fi);
    ffxOpticalflowContextDestroy(&g.of);
    g.shared.fpDestroyBackendContext(&g.shared, g.shared_id);
    scratch_free(g.scratch_shared);
    scratch_free(g.scratch_fi);
    memset(&g, 0, sizeof g);
}

static bool create(const FgConfig *c) {
    g.cfg = *c;
    if (!make_backend(&g.shared, &g.scratch_shared, 1) || !make_backend(&g.fi_if, &g.scratch_fi, 2)) return false;
    TRY(g.shared.fpCreateBackendContext(&g.shared, FFX_EFFECT_SHAREDAPIBACKEND, nullptr, &g.shared_id));
    FfxOpticalflowContextDescription od = {};
    od.backendInterface = g.fi_if;
    od.resolution = {c->display_w, c->display_h};
    TRY(ffxOpticalflowContextCreate(&g.of, &od));
    FfxFrameInterpolationContextDescription fd = {};
    fd.backendInterface = g.fi_if;
    fd.flags = c->depth_inverted ? FFX_FRAMEINTERPOLATION_ENABLE_DEPTH_INVERTED : 0;
    fd.maxRenderSize = {c->render_w, c->render_h};
    fd.displaySize = {c->display_w, c->display_h};
    fd.backBufferFormat = ffxGetSurfaceFormatVK(c->color_format);
    fd.previousInterpolationSourceFormat = ffxGetSurfaceFormatVK(c->hudless_format);
    TRY(ffxFrameInterpolationContextCreate(&g.fi, &fd));
    FfxOpticalflowSharedResourceDescriptions ord = {};
    TRY(ffxOpticalflowGetSharedResourceDescriptions(&g.of, &ord));
    TRY(g.shared.fpCreateResource(&g.shared, &ord.opticalFlowVector, g.shared_id, &g.res[R_OF_VECTOR]));
    TRY(g.shared.fpCreateResource(&g.shared, &ord.opticalFlowSCD, g.shared_id, &g.res[R_OF_SCD]));
    FfxFrameInterpolationSharedResourceDescriptions frd = {};
    TRY(ffxFrameInterpolationGetSharedResourceDescriptions(&g.fi, &frd));
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        TRY(g.shared.fpCreateResource(&g.shared, &frd.dilatedDepth, g.shared_id, &g.res[R_DILATED_DEPTH + i]));
        TRY(g.shared.fpCreateResource(&g.shared, &frd.dilatedMotionVectors, g.shared_id, &g.res[R_DILATED_MV + i]));
        TRY(g.shared.fpCreateResource(&g.shared, &frd.reconstructedPrevNearestDepth, g.shared_id, &g.res[R_PREV_DEPTH + i]));
    }
    g.live = true;
    LOG("[fg] FSR 3 frame interpolation %ux%u (render %ux%u, color format %d, hudless %d)\n", c->display_w, c->display_h,
        c->render_w, c->render_h, (int)c->color_format, (int)c->hudless_format);
    return true;
}

static FfxResource image(const FgImage *im, const wchar_t *name, bool write) {
    VkImageCreateInfo ci = {};
    ci.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    ci.format = im->format;
    ci.extent = {im->w, im->h, 1};
    ci.mipLevels = 1;
    ci.arrayLayers = 1;
    ci.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ci.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | (write ? VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT : 0);
    // (every image of the runtime is in GENERAL: vk.h; the backend puts it back in the state given here)
    return ffxGetResourceVK((void *)im->image, ffxGetImageResourceDescriptionVK(im->image, ci, write ? FFX_RESOURCE_USAGE_UAV
                            : FFX_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY), name, write ? FFX_RESOURCE_STATE_UNORDERED_ACCESS
                            : FFX_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ);
}

static FfxResource shared(int i) { return g.shared.fpGetResource(&g.shared, g.res[i]); }

extern "C" bool fg_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const FgConfig *c, const FgFrame *f) {
    if (g.live && memcmp(&g.cfg, c, sizeof *c)) {
        g_fg_vk.wait_idle();
        fg_destroy();
    }
    if (!g.live && !create(c)) {
        fg_destroy();
        return false;
    }
    FfxCommandList cl = ffxGetCommandListVK(cb);
    g.toggle ^= 1;
    FfxFrameInterpolationPrepareDescription pd = {};
    pd.commandList = cl;
    pd.renderSize = {c->render_w, c->render_h};
    pd.motionVectorScale = f->motion_scale[0] || f->motion_scale[1] ? FfxFloatCoords2D{f->motion_scale[0], f->motion_scale[1]}
                                                                    : FfxFloatCoords2D{(float)c->render_w, (float)c->render_h};
    pd.frameTimeDelta = f->frame_ms;
    pd.cameraNear = f->near_;
    pd.cameraFar = f->far_;
    pd.viewSpaceToMetersFactor = 1;  // (BOTW's units are metres)
    pd.cameraFovAngleVertical = f->fovy;
    pd.depth = image(&f->depth, L"FG_Depth", false);
    pd.motionVectors = image(&f->motion, L"FG_MotionVectors", false);
    pd.frameID = f->frame_id;
    pd.dilatedDepth = shared(R_DILATED_DEPTH + g.toggle);
    pd.dilatedMotionVectors = shared(R_DILATED_MV + g.toggle);
    pd.reconstructedPrevDepth = shared(R_PREV_DEPTH + g.toggle);
    memcpy(pd.cameraPosition, f->cam_pos, sizeof pd.cameraPosition);
    memcpy(pd.cameraUp, f->cam_up, sizeof pd.cameraUp);
    memcpy(pd.cameraRight, f->cam_right, sizeof pd.cameraRight);
    memcpy(pd.cameraForward, f->cam_fwd, sizeof pd.cameraForward);
    TRY(ffxFrameInterpolationPrepare(&g.fi, &pd));

    FfxResource hudless = image(&f->hudless, L"FG_HudlessColor", false);
    FfxOpticalflowDispatchDescription od = {};
    od.commandList = cl;
    od.color = hudless;
    od.reset = f->reset;
    od.backbufferTransferFunction = FFX_BACKBUFFER_TRANSFER_FUNCTION_SRGB;
    od.opticalFlowVector = shared(R_OF_VECTOR);
    od.opticalFlowSCD = shared(R_OF_SCD);
    TRY(ffxOpticalflowContextDispatch(&g.of, &od));

    FfxFrameInterpolationDispatchDescription dd = {};
    dd.flags = f->debug_view ? FFX_FRAMEINTERPOLATION_DISPATCH_DRAW_DEBUG_VIEW : 0;
    dd.commandList = cl;
    dd.displaySize = {c->display_w, c->display_h};
    dd.renderSize = {c->render_w, c->render_h};
    dd.currentBackBuffer = image(&f->color, L"FG_Color", false);
    dd.currentBackBuffer_HUDLess = hudless;
    dd.output = image(&f->out, L"FG_Output", true);
    dd.interpolationRect = {0, 0, (int)c->display_w, (int)c->display_h};
    dd.opticalFlowVector = shared(R_OF_VECTOR);
    dd.opticalFlowSceneChangeDetection = shared(R_OF_SCD);
    dd.opticalFlowBufferSize = {c->display_w / 8, c->display_h / 8};  // (unused by the shaders: the SDK's provider leaves it too)
    dd.opticalFlowScale = {1.0f / c->display_w, 1.0f / c->display_h};
    dd.opticalFlowBlockSize = 8;
    dd.cameraNear = f->near_;
    dd.cameraFar = f->far_;
    dd.cameraFovAngleVertical = f->fovy;
    dd.viewSpaceToMetersFactor = 1;
    dd.frameTimeDelta = f->frame_ms;
    dd.reset = f->reset;
    dd.backBufferTransferFunction = FFX_BACKBUFFER_TRANSFER_FUNCTION_SRGB;
    dd.minMaxLuminance[0] = 0;
    dd.minMaxLuminance[1] = 1;
    dd.frameID = f->frame_id;
    dd.dilatedDepth = pd.dilatedDepth;
    dd.dilatedMotionVectors = pd.dilatedMotionVectors;
    dd.reconstructedPrevDepth = pd.reconstructedPrevDepth;
    TRY(ffxFrameInterpolationDispatch(&g.fi, &dd));
    return true;
}
```

```h
// AMD FSR 3 frame generation (framegen.cpp: the FidelityFX SDK's frame interpolation and optical flow), used by
// exec.c vk_fg_generate. Plain C: the SDK is C++.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct {
    VkImage image;
    VkFormat format;
    uint32_t w, h;
} FgImage;

// What the contexts are made for (a change makes them again)
typedef struct {
    uint32_t display_w, display_h;  // the game's final image (the interpolated frame's size)
    uint32_t render_w, render_h;    // the 3D scene's (depth and motion vectors)
    VkFormat color_format, hudless_format;
    bool depth_inverted;
} FgConfig;

typedef struct {
    FgImage color;     // this frame as presented (with the HUD)
    FgImage hudless;   // ... without it (the 3D scene composited, before the HUD's first draw)
    FgImage depth;     // the 3D scene's depth (D32)
    FgImage motion;    // motion vectors (.xy: where each pixel was in the previous frame - here, times motion_scale)
    float motion_scale[2];  // .xy times this over the render size is that uv offset (0, 0: .xy are uv units)
    FgImage out;       // the interpolated frame (storage image)
    float near_, far_, fovy;  // the world camera's (fovy in radians)
    float cam_pos[3], cam_up[3], cam_right[3], cam_fwd[3];
    float frame_ms;    // time since the previous real frame
    uint64_t frame_id; // +1 per real frame (a gap resets the interpolation)
    bool reset;        // the camera cut: no history
    bool debug_view;   // (SAVAGEWIND_FG_DEBUG_VIEW) the SDK's debug view instead of the interpolated frame
} FgFrame;

typedef struct {
    VkPhysicalDevice phys;
    VkDevice dev;
    void (*wait_idle)(void);  // the GPU idle (before the contexts are made again)
} FgVk;
extern FgVk g_fg_vk;

// Records the interpolated frame between the previous call's frame and this one into f->out. false: failed (logged).
bool fg_dispatch(VkCommandBuffer cb, const FgConfig *c, const FgFrame *f);
void fg_destroy(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/fsr3.cpp`:

```cpp
// AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3.1's upscaler through the FidelityFX SDK's own context and Vulkan backend (fsr3.h)
#include "fsr3.h"

#ifdef SW_FSR3
#include <FidelityFX/host/backends/vk/ffx_vk.h>
#include <FidelityFX/host/ffx_fsr3upscaler.h>

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <malloc.h>
#endif

#include "../../rt.h"

static FfxFsr3UpscalerContext ctx;
static bool have_ctx;
// the images the upscaler keeps from frame to frame that FSR 3.1 has the application own (dilated depth and motion
// vectors, the previous frame's nearest depth), made by the backend for a context of their own, as ffx_fsr3.cpp does
static FfxInterface iface;
static FfxUInt32 shared_ctx;
static FfxResourceInternal shared[3];
static void *scratch;
static uint32_t ctx_rw, ctx_rh, ctx_ow, ctx_oh;
static VkDevice ctx_dev;

// The scratch memory the backend lays its contexts out in: 64-byte aligned (they are alignas(32), and the vendored
// ffx_vk.cpp starts its arrays on 64-byte boundaries: third_party/FidelityFX/README.md)
static void *scratch_alloc(size_t n) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    return _aligned_malloc(n, 64);
#else
    return aligned_alloc(64, n);
#endif
}
static void scratch_free(void *p) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _aligned_free(p);
#else
    free(p);
#endif
}

static void message(FfxMsgType type, const wchar_t *msg) {
    char buf[512];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%ls", msg);
    LOG("[fsr3] %s: %s\n", type == FFX_MESSAGE_TYPE_ERROR ? "error" : "warning", buf);
}

extern "C" bool fsr3_available(void) { return true; }

extern "C" void fsr3_destroy(void) {
    if (!have_ctx) return;
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(ctx_dev);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) iface.fpDestroyResource(&iface, shared[i], shared_ctx);
    iface.fpDestroyBackendContext(&iface, shared_ctx);
    ffxFsr3UpscalerContextDestroy(&ctx);
    have_ctx = false;
    scratch_free(scratch);
    scratch = NULL;
}

// The backend's device functions: an extension's KHR name that this device was not made with is the core function
// it was promoted to (the backend calls vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2KHR without checking it), and its debug labels
// do nothing without VK_EXT_debug_utils (as framegen.cpp's)
// (its job labels become SAVAGEWIND_GPUPROF_AT marks: the time of each of FSR 3's passes)
// (its job labels become marks in the profiler's GPU rows: the time of each of FSR 3's passes)
extern "C" void vk_gpuprof_mark(VkCommandBuffer cb, const char *what);
static VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL no_label(VkCommandBuffer cb, const VkDebugUtilsLabelEXT *l) {
    char buf[96];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "FSR 3: %s", l && l->pLabelName ? l->pLabelName : "?");
    vk_gpuprof_mark(cb, buf);
}
static VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL no_label_end(VkCommandBuffer) {}
static PFN_vkVoidFunction VKAPI_PTR device_proc(VkDevice dev, const char *name) {
    PFN_vkVoidFunction f = vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, name);
    if (!f && !strcmp(name, "vkCmdBeginDebugUtilsLabelEXT")) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)no_label;
    if (!f && !strcmp(name, "vkCmdEndDebugUtilsLabelEXT")) return (PFN_vkVoidFunction)no_label_end;
    size_t n = strlen(name);
    if (!f && n > 3 && n < 128 && !strcmp(name + n - 3, "KHR")) {
        char core[128];
        memcpy(core, name, n - 3);
        core[n - 3] = 0;
        f = vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, core);
    }
    return f;
}

static bool make_context(const Fsr3Dispatch *d) {
    fsr3_destroy();
    enum { CONTEXTS = FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_CONTEXT_COUNT + 1 };  // (+ the shared images')
    size_t n = ffxGetScratchMemorySizeVK(d->phys, CONTEXTS);
    n = (n + 63) & ~(size_t)63;
    scratch = scratch_alloc(n);
    memset(scratch, 0, n);
    static VkDeviceContext dc;  // (the backend keeps a pointer to it)
    dc = {d->dev, d->phys, device_proc};
    FfxFsr3UpscalerContextDescription cd = {};
    FfxErrorCode e = ffxGetInterfaceVK(&cd.backendInterface, ffxGetDeviceVK(&dc), scratch, n, CONTEXTS);
    if (e != FFX_OK) { LOG("[fsr3] backend: error %d\n", (int)e); scratch_free(scratch); scratch = NULL; return false; }
    // (LDR input, low-resolution and jitter-free motion vectors, standard depth; FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_ENABLE_DEBUG_CHECKING
    // with SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_DEBUG=1: its checks of the inputs, in the log)
    cd.flags = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_DEBUG") ? FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_ENABLE_DEBUG_CHECKING : 0;
    cd.maxRenderSize = {d->color.width, d->color.height};
    cd.maxUpscaleSize = {d->output.width, d->output.height};
    cd.fpMessage = message;
    e = ffxFsr3UpscalerContextCreate(&ctx, &cd);
    if (e != FFX_OK) { LOG("[fsr3] context: error %d\n", (int)e); scratch_free(scratch); scratch = NULL; return false; }
    iface = cd.backendInterface;
    FfxFsr3UpscalerSharedResourceDescriptions sd = {};
    e = ffxFsr3UpscalerGetSharedResourceDescriptions(&ctx, &sd);
    if (e == FFX_OK) e = iface.fpCreateBackendContext(&iface, FFX_EFFECT_SHAREDRESOURCES, nullptr, &shared_ctx);
    const FfxCreateResourceDescription *rd[3] = {&sd.dilatedDepth, &sd.dilatedMotionVectors, &sd.reconstructedPrevNearestDepth};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3 && e == FFX_OK; i++) e = iface.fpCreateResource(&iface, rd[i], shared_ctx, &shared[i]);
    if (e != FFX_OK) {
        LOG("[fsr3] shared images: error %d\n", (int)e);
        ffxFsr3UpscalerContextDestroy(&ctx);
        scratch_free(scratch);
        scratch = NULL;
        return false;
    }
    have_ctx = true;
    ctx_dev = d->dev;
    ctx_rw = d->color.width, ctx_rh = d->color.height, ctx_ow = d->output.width, ctx_oh = d->output.height;
    LOG("[fsr3] context %ux%u -> %ux%u\n", ctx_rw, ctx_rh, ctx_ow, ctx_oh);
    return true;
}

static FfxResource resource(const Fsr3Image *m, bool uav, const wchar_t *name) {
    FfxResourceDescription rd = {};
    rd.type = FFX_RESOURCE_TYPE_TEXTURE2D;
    rd.format = ffxGetSurfaceFormatVK(m->format);
    rd.width = m->width, rd.height = m->height, rd.depth = 1, rd.mipCount = 1;
    rd.flags = FFX_RESOURCE_FLAGS_NONE;
    rd.usage = uav ? FFX_RESOURCE_USAGE_UAV : FFX_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY;
    return ffxGetResourceVK((void *)m->image, rd, name, FFX_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);  // (COMMON: GENERAL, kept)
}

extern "C" bool fsr3_dispatch(const Fsr3Dispatch *d) {
    static bool failed;
    if (failed) return false;
    if ((!have_ctx || d->color.width != ctx_rw || d->color.height != ctx_rh || d->output.width != ctx_ow ||
         d->output.height != ctx_oh) && !make_context(d)) {
        failed = true;  // (no FSR 3 this run: the scene goes on with the game's own composite)
        return false;
    }
    FfxFsr3UpscalerDispatchDescription dd = {};
    dd.commandList = ffxGetCommandListVK(d->cb);
    dd.color = resource(&d->color, false, L"FSR3_Color");
    dd.depth = resource(&d->depth, false, L"FSR3_Depth");
    dd.motionVectors = resource(&d->motion, false, L"FSR3_MotionVectors");
    dd.reactive = resource(&d->reactive, false, L"FSR3_Reactive");
    dd.output = resource(&d->output, true, L"FSR3_Output");
    dd.dilatedDepth = iface.fpGetResource(&iface, shared[0]);
    dd.dilatedMotionVectors = iface.fpGetResource(&iface, shared[1]);
    dd.reconstructedPrevNearestDepth = iface.fpGetResource(&iface, shared[2]);
    dd.jitterOffset = {d->jitter[0], d->jitter[1]};
    dd.motionVectorScale = {d->motion_scale[0], d->motion_scale[1]};
    dd.renderSize = {d->color.width, d->color.height};
    dd.upscaleSize = {d->output.width, d->output.height};
    dd.enableSharpening = d->sharpness > 0;
    dd.sharpness = d->sharpness;
    dd.frameTimeDelta = d->dt_ms;
    dd.preExposure = 1.0f;
    dd.reset = d->reset;
    dd.cameraNear = d->near_;
    dd.cameraFar = d->far_;
    dd.cameraFovAngleVertical = d->fov_y;
    dd.viewSpaceToMetersFactor = 1.0f;  // (BOTW's units are meters)
    static int view = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_VIEW=1: FSR's own debug view of its inputs and state in the output
    if (view < 0) view = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_VIEW") != NULL;
    if (view) dd.flags |= FFX_FSR3UPSCALER_DISPATCH_DRAW_DEBUG_VIEW;
    FfxErrorCode e = ffxFsr3UpscalerContextDispatch(&ctx, &dd);
    if (e != FFX_OK) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 8) LOG("[fsr3] dispatch: error %d\n", (int)e);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

extern "C" int fsr3_jitter_phases(uint32_t render_w, uint32_t output_w) {
    return ffxFsr3UpscalerGetJitterPhaseCount((int32_t)render_w, (int32_t)output_w);
}

extern "C" void fsr3_jitter_offset(int i, int phases, float *x, float *y) {
    ffxFsr3UpscalerGetJitterOffset(x, y, i, phases);
}

#else
extern "C" bool fsr3_available(void) { return false; }
extern "C" bool fsr3_dispatch(const Fsr3Dispatch *) { return false; }
extern "C" int fsr3_jitter_phases(uint32_t, uint32_t) { return 8; }
extern "C" void fsr3_jitter_offset(int, int, float *x, float *y) { *x = *y = 0; }
extern "C" void fsr3_destroy(void) {}
#endif
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/fsr3.h`:

```h
// AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3.1's upscaler (fsr3.cpp: the vendored FidelityFX SDK's, third_party/FidelityFX) for
// the 3D scene at its composite (exec.c scene_post, Video > Upscaler FSR 3): this frame's scene, depth, motion vectors
// (vulkan/mvec.c) and reactive mask at the internal resolution in, the scene at its size in the window out. Built in
// with SW_FSR3 (Windows and Linux: the Makefile); elsewhere fsr3_available is false.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct {
    VkImage image;
    VkFormat format;
    uint32_t width, height;
} Fsr3Image;

typedef struct {
    VkDevice dev;
    VkPhysicalDevice phys;
    VkCommandBuffer cb;
    // inputs at the render size (every image in VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, as they are left): the scene (LDR), its depth
    // (R32F, [0, 1], not inverted), the motion vectors (.xy: see motion_scale) and the reactive mask (R8); the output
    // (storage) at the upscaled size
    Fsr3Image color, depth, motion, reactive, output;
    float jitter[2];        // the camera's jitter this frame, render pixels (FSR's convention: x right, y down)
    float motion_scale[2];  // .xy times this (over the render size) is the UV offset to where the pixel was
    float dt_ms;            // time since the last frame
    float near_, far_, fov_y;  // the camera (fov_y: radians)
    float sharpness;        // RCAS, 0..1 (0: off)
    bool reset;             // no usable history (a cut, the first frame)
} Fsr3Dispatch;

bool fsr3_available(void);
// Records FSR 3.1 into d->cb (the context is made, and made again, for the sizes given); false when it failed
bool fsr3_dispatch(const Fsr3Dispatch *d);
// The jitter sequence FSR wants for this render / output width: its phase count and phase i's offset in pixels
int fsr3_jitter_phases(uint32_t render_w, uint32_t output_w);
void fsr3_jitter_offset(int i, int phases, float *x, float *y);
void fsr3_destroy(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/fsr_api.cpp`:

```cpp
// AMD's FSR API: FSR 4 and AMD's FSR 3.1 through the FSR SDK 2.4.0's signed DLLs (fsr_api.h)
#include "fsr_api.h"

#include <atomic>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../../rt.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#else
#define __declspec(x)  // (ffx_api.h marks its functions dllexport; only their types are used here)
#endif
#include <FidelityFX/api/api/include/vk/ffx_api_vk.h>
#include <FidelityFX/api/upscalers/include/ffx_upscale.h>

static PfnFfxCreateContext create_context;
static PfnFfxDestroyContext destroy_context;
static PfnFfxQuery query;
static PfnFfxDispatch dispatch;

extern "C" bool fsr_api_present(void) {
    static int have = -1;
    if (have >= 0) return have;
    have = 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    // (from the game's folder only, by its full path; the loader finds the upscaler DLL next to itself)
    wchar_t path[MAX_PATH + 64];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, path, MAX_PATH);
    if (!n || n >= MAX_PATH) return false;
    wchar_t *slash = wcsrchr(path, L'\\');
    if (!slash) return false;
    wcscpy(slash + 1, L"amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll");
    if (GetFileAttributesW(path) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) return false;
    HMODULE m = LoadLibraryW(path);
    if (!m) {
        LOG("[fsr] amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll did not load (error %lu)\n", (unsigned long)GetLastError());
        return false;
    }
    create_context = (PfnFfxCreateContext)(void *)GetProcAddress(m, "ffxCreateContext");
    destroy_context = (PfnFfxDestroyContext)(void *)GetProcAddress(m, "ffxDestroyContext");
    query = (PfnFfxQuery)(void *)GetProcAddress(m, "ffxQuery");
    dispatch = (PfnFfxDispatch)(void *)GetProcAddress(m, "ffxDispatch");
    if (!create_context || !destroy_context || !query || !dispatch) {
        LOG("[fsr] amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll lacks the FSR API's functions\n");
        return false;
    }
    have = 1;
#endif
    return have;
}

// The versions the DLL offers for this device: the highest of each major version (ids from the DLL's own query, as
// AMD asks: never hard-coded; the list has no promised order)
static uint64_t ver_id[5];
static uint32_t ver_key[5];  // (minor and patch number of the version kept, to keep the highest)
static char ver_name[5][32];
static std::atomic<bool> ver_have[5];
static bool amd_gpu;

// The device functions handed to the DLL: an extension's KHR name this device was not made with is the core
// function it was promoted to (as fsr3.cpp's backend wants)
static PFN_vkVoidFunction VKAPI_PTR device_proc(VkDevice dev, const char *name) {
    PFN_vkVoidFunction f = vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, name);
    size_t n = strlen(name);
    if (!f && n > 3 && n < 128 && !strcmp(name + n - 3, "KHR")) {
        char core[128];
        memcpy(core, name, n - 3);
        core[n - 3] = 0;
        f = vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, core);
    }
    return f;
}
static VkDeviceContext dev_ctx;

extern "C" void fsr_api_probe(VkDevice dev, VkPhysicalDevice phys) {
    if (!fsr_api_present()) return;
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties p;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(phys, &p);
    amd_gpu = p.vendorID == 0x1002;
    dev_ctx = {dev, phys, device_proc};
    ffxQueryDescGetVersions q = {};
    q.header.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_GET_VERSIONS;
    q.createDescType = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE;
    q.device = &dev_ctx;
    uint64_t count = 0;
    q.outputCount = &count;
    ffxReturnCode_t e = query(nullptr, &q.header);
    if (e != FFX_API_RETURN_OK || !count) {
        LOG("[fsr] AMD FSR API: no upscaler versions (error %u)\n", (unsigned)e);
        return;
    }
    if (count > 16) count = 16;
    uint64_t ids[16] = {};
    const char *names[16] = {};
    q.versionIds = ids;
    q.versionNames = names;
    e = query(nullptr, &q.header);
    if (e != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        LOG("[fsr] AMD FSR API: version query failed (error %u)\n", (unsigned)e);
        return;
    }
    char list[256] = "";
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const char *s = names[i] ? names[i] : "?";
        snprintf(list + strlen(list), sizeof list - strlen(list), "%s%s", i ? ", " : "", s);
        // ("4.1.2", or a name with the number after a word: the first number is the major version)
        const char *d = s;
        while (*d && (*d < '0' || *d > '9')) d++;
        unsigned maj = 0, min = 0, pat = 0;
        sscanf(d, "%u.%u.%u", &maj, &min, &pat);
        int major = (int)maj;
        uint32_t key = (min & 0xffff) << 16 | (pat & 0xffff);
        if (major < 1 || major > 4 || (ver_have[major] && key <= ver_key[major])) continue;
        ver_id[major] = ids[i];
        ver_key[major] = key;
        snprintf(ver_name[major], sizeof ver_name[major], "%s", s);  // (a copy: AMD says the names may be overwritten)
        ver_have[major] = true;
    }
    // FSR 4 runs on AMD Radeon graphics only
    if (ver_have[4] && !amd_gpu) ver_have[4] = false;
    LOG("[fsr] AMD FSR API: upscaler versions %s%s\n", list,
        ver_have[4] ? "" : amd_gpu ? " (no FSR 4 for this GPU)" : " (FSR 4: AMD Radeon only)");
}

extern "C" bool fsr_api_has(int major) { return major >= 1 && major <= 4 && ver_have[major]; }
extern "C" bool fsr4_available(void) { return fsr_api_has(4); }
extern "C" bool fsr3_api_wanted(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_API") && atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_API")) != 0;
    return on && fsr_api_has(3);
}

static ffxContext ctx;
static int ctx_major;
static uint32_t ctx_rw, ctx_rh, ctx_ow, ctx_oh;
static VkDevice ctx_dev;

extern "C" void fsr_api_destroy(void) {
    if (!ctx) return;
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(ctx_dev);
    destroy_context(&ctx, nullptr);
    ctx = nullptr;
}

// (the DLL's own messages: a line is logged once in a row, and at most 24 in a run)
static void message(uint32_t type, const wchar_t *msg) {
    static char last[512];
    static int logged;
    char buf[512];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%ls", msg);
    if (!strcmp(buf, last) || logged >= 24) return;
    memcpy(last, buf, sizeof last);
    logged++;
    LOG("[fsr] %s: %s\n", type == FFX_API_MESSAGE_TYPE_ERROR ? "error" : "warning", buf);
}

extern "C" void vk_gpuprof_mark(VkCommandBuffer cb, const char *what);  // (exec.c)

// (testing switches, read once)
static bool env_on(const char *name) {
    const char *v = getenv(name);
    return v && atoi(v) != 0;
}
static bool linear_colour(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = env_on("SAVAGEWIND_FSR4_LINEAR"); return on; }
static bool debug_view(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = env_on("SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_VIEW"); return on; }

static bool make_context(const Fsr3Dispatch *d, int major) {
    fsr_api_destroy();
    ffxCreateContextDescUpscale cd = {};
    cd.header.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE;
    // (LDR input, low-resolution and jitter-free motion vectors, standard depth, as fsr3.cpp. FSR 4 is told the
    // colours are perceptual, sRGB-like: the scene is the game's finished, graded image; SAVAGEWIND_FSR4_LINEAR=1 does
    // not. SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_DEBUG=1: the DLL's checks of the inputs in the log; SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_VIEW=1: its debug view)
    cd.flags = env_on("SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_DEBUG") ? FFX_UPSCALE_ENABLE_DEBUG_CHECKING : 0;
    if (debug_view()) cd.flags |= FFX_UPSCALE_ENABLE_DEBUG_VISUALIZATION;
    if (major == 4 && !linear_colour()) cd.flags |= FFX_UPSCALE_ENABLE_NON_LINEAR_COLORSPACE;
    cd.maxRenderSize = {d->color.width, d->color.height};
    cd.maxUpscaleSize = {d->output.width, d->output.height};
    cd.fpMessage = message;
    dev_ctx = {d->dev, d->phys, device_proc};
    ffxCreateBackendVKDesc bd = {};
    bd.header.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_BACKEND_VK;
    bd.deviceContext = dev_ctx;
    ffxCreateContextDescUpscaleVersion vd = {};
    vd.header.type = FFX_API_CREATE_CONTEXT_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE_VERSION;
    vd.version = FFX_UPSCALER_VERSION;
    ffxOverrideVersion ov = {};
    ov.header.type = FFX_API_DESC_TYPE_OVERRIDE_VERSION;
    ov.versionId = ver_id[major];
    cd.header.pNext = &bd.header;
    bd.header.pNext = &vd.header;
    // (FSR 3: the 3.1.6 asked for by id. FSR 4: no version asked for, so the DLL picks its newest, which may be a
    // driver's own newer build; AMD's docs: an override turns that choice off)
    if (major != 4) vd.header.pNext = &ov.header;
    ffxReturnCode_t e = create_context(&ctx, &cd.header, nullptr);
    if (e != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        LOG("[fsr] FSR %s context %ux%u -> %ux%u: error %u\n", ver_name[major], d->color.width, d->color.height,
            d->output.width, d->output.height, (unsigned)e);
        ctx = nullptr;
        return false;
    }
    ffxQueryGetProviderVersion pv = {};
    pv.header.type = FFX_API_QUERY_DESC_TYPE_GET_PROVIDER_VERSION;
    const char *got = query(&ctx, &pv.header) == FFX_API_RETURN_OK && pv.versionName ? pv.versionName : "?";
    ctx_major = major;
    ctx_dev = d->dev;
    ctx_rw = d->color.width, ctx_rh = d->color.height, ctx_ow = d->output.width, ctx_oh = d->output.height;
    LOG("[fsr] AMD FSR API context %ux%u -> %ux%u (asked for %s, got %s)\n", ctx_rw, ctx_rh, ctx_ow, ctx_oh,
        major == 4 ? "the newest" : ver_name[major], got);
    return true;
}

// SWR's images are all left in VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL: the COMMON state, which the DLL transitions from and back to
static FfxApiResource resource(const Fsr3Image *m, bool uav) {
    FfxApiResourceDescription rd = {};
    rd.type = FFX_API_RESOURCE_TYPE_TEXTURE2D;
    rd.format = ffxApiGetSurfaceFormatVK(m->format);
    rd.width = m->width, rd.height = m->height, rd.depth = 1, rd.mipCount = 1;
    rd.flags = FFX_API_RESOURCE_FLAGS_NONE;
    rd.usage = uav ? FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_UAV : FFX_API_RESOURCE_USAGE_READ_ONLY;
    return ffxApiGetResourceVK((void *)m->image, rd, FFX_API_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON);
}

static bool failed[5];  // (a version that failed once is not tried again this run)
extern "C" bool fsr_api_usable(int major) { return fsr_api_has(major) && !failed[major]; }

extern "C" bool fsr_api_dispatch(const Fsr3Dispatch *d, int major) {
    if (!fsr_api_usable(major)) return false;
    if ((!ctx || ctx_major != major || d->color.width != ctx_rw || d->color.height != ctx_rh ||
         d->output.width != ctx_ow || d->output.height != ctx_oh) && !make_context(d, major)) {
        failed[major] = true;
        return false;
    }
    ffxDispatchDescUpscale dd = {};
    dd.header.type = FFX_API_DISPATCH_DESC_TYPE_UPSCALE;
    dd.commandList = (void *)d->cb;
    dd.color = resource(&d->color, false);
    dd.depth = resource(&d->depth, false);
    dd.motionVectors = resource(&d->motion, false);
    dd.reactive = resource(&d->reactive, false);
    dd.output = resource(&d->output, true);
    dd.jitterOffset = {d->jitter[0], d->jitter[1]};
    dd.motionVectorScale = {d->motion_scale[0], d->motion_scale[1]};
    dd.renderSize = {d->color.width, d->color.height};
    dd.upscaleSize = {d->output.width, d->output.height};
    dd.enableSharpening = d->sharpness > 0;
    dd.sharpness = d->sharpness;
    dd.frameTimeDelta = d->dt_ms;
    dd.preExposure = 1.0f;
    dd.reset = d->reset;
    dd.cameraNear = d->near_;
    dd.cameraFar = d->far_;
    dd.cameraFovAngleVertical = d->fov_y;
    dd.viewSpaceToMetersFactor = 1.0f;  // (BOTW's units are meters)
    if (major == 4 && !linear_colour()) dd.flags |= FFX_UPSCALE_FLAG_NON_LINEAR_COLOR_SRGB;
    if (debug_view()) dd.flags |= FFX_UPSCALE_FLAG_DRAW_DEBUG_VIEW;
    vk_gpuprof_mark(d->cb, major == 4 ? "AMD FSR 4 upscale" : "AMD FSR API upscale");  // (SAVAGEWIND_GPUPROF_AT)
    ffxReturnCode_t e = dispatch(&ctx, &dd.header);
    vk_gpuprof_mark(d->cb, "after the AMD FSR API upscale");
    if (e != FFX_API_RETURN_OK) {
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 8) LOG("[fsr] FSR %s dispatch: error %u\n", ver_name[major], (unsigned)e);
        failed[major] = true;
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}
```
