`runtime/nvn/vulkan/fsr_api.h`:

```h
// AMD's FSR API (fsr_api.cpp): the FSR SDK 2.4.0's signed amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll and
// amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll, loaded at run time from the game's folder (Windows only: AMD ships no others;
// tools/fetch_fsr_dlls.py downloads them). They hold AMD FSR 4 (Video > Upscaler FSR 4: AMD Radeon graphics cards)
// and AMD's own build of the FSR 3.1 upscaler (3.1.6; SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_API=1 has Upscaler FSR 3 use it in place of
// the built-in one, fsr3.cpp). Same inputs as fsr3.h's Fsr3Dispatch. Without the DLLs, or elsewhere, nothing is
// available and the rest of the game is as before.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

#include "fsr3.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

// The loader DLL loads (asked before the device is made: device.c enables FSR 4's device extensions only then)
bool fsr_api_present(void);
// After the device is made: which upscaler versions AMD's DLL offers for it (logged)
void fsr_api_probe(VkDevice dev, VkPhysicalDevice phys);
// A version with this major number (4: FSR 4, 3: FSR 3.1) was offered for this device
bool fsr_api_has(int major);
// ...and has not failed yet this run (fsr_api_dispatch gives up on a version after its first failure)
bool fsr_api_usable(int major);
// Records that version's upscale into d->cb (its context made, and made again, for the sizes given); false when it
// failed (the scene goes on without it, and that version is not tried again this run)
bool fsr_api_dispatch(const Fsr3Dispatch *d, int major);
void fsr_api_destroy(void);

bool fsr4_available(void);  // fsr_api_has(4)
bool fsr3_api_wanted(void);  // SAVAGEWIND_FSR3_API=1 and fsr_api_has(3)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/hdr.c`:

```c
// HDR support for Breath of the Wild's tonemap (Video > HDR).
//
// BOTW renders the 3D scene and bloom into two B10G11R11 float images, then its tonemap (fragment shader 72cb7ff600)
// adds them, applies the game's own 1 - e^-x curve and saturation grade, and writes a 1600x900 A2B10G10R10 image. Its
// upscale/FXAA pass (72caebd800) brings that to the 1920x1080 final image, the HUD is drawn into it, and the game copies
// it sRGB-encoded into the 8-bit image it presents. Everything above 1.0 is gone after the tonemap. With HDR on:
//   - the scene's 1600x900 A2B10G10R10 tonemap target and the 1920x1080 final image are created as RGBA16F
//     (textures.c, vk_hdr_targets_wanted), so the extended curve and the HUD keep values above white;
//   - the tonemap program, recognised at its first draw by its own curve constants and its two float scene/bloom
//     textures, runs RenoDX's extended vanilla curve (the game's own curve to a pivot, then a straight continuation),
//     the game's own saturation grade and a MacLeod-Boynton hue/purity transfer from the game's SDR result, then
//     either the RenoDX BOTW mod's PsychoV test17 with its per-channel Neutwo peak fit (the default, the mod's
//     "RenoDRT" option) or the game's own clipped tonemap (Vanilla);
//   - the last copy into the presented 8-bit image is recorded, and device.c presents the float image it read with the
//     scene at hdr_game_nits, the HUD at hdr_ui_nits, and everything capped by hdr_peak_nits.
// The tonemap approach follows the RenoDX TotK port by ProSep (valentderah/totk-pc-recomp#281) and the RenoDX BOTW mod
// (github.com/clshortfuse/renodx, src/games/botw, MIT): game mod by souperman9, tonemapper by Musa, RenoDX by
// ShortFuse (Carlos Lopez Jr.), RenoVK fork by Ritsu. The MacLeod-Boynton hue/purity math is adapted from its
// macleod_boynton.hlsli (MIT); the rest of the code here is ours.
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../../rt.h"
#include "../../settings.h"
#include "hdr_psycho.h"
#include "vk.h"

static float nits_or(int value, float fallback) {
    return value >= 80 ? (float)value : fallback;
}

void vk_hdr_nits(float *peak, float *game, float *ui) {
    float g = nits_or(g_settings.hdr_game_nits, 203.0f);
    float p = nits_or(g_settings.hdr_peak_nits, 1000.0f);
    if (g > p) g = p;  // the display peak is the final cap: a brighter scene white is capped by it
    float u = g_settings.hdr_ui_nits >= 80 ? (float)g_settings.hdr_ui_nits : g;  // (0: the scene's white)
    *peak = p, *game = g, *ui = u;
}

// The live HDR tonemap parameters: hdr.c's generated shader reads them from the push constant block, so changing
// a setting or a preset applies on the next HDR tonemap draw instead of at the next start.
void vk_hdr_params(VkHdrParams *p) {
    float peak, game, ui;
    vk_hdr_nits(&peak, &game, &ui);
    int hp = g_settings.hdr_hue;
    if (hp < 0) hp = 0;
    if (hp > 100) hp = 100;
    int bp = g_settings.hdr_blowout;
    if (bp < 0) bp = 0;
    if (bp > 100) bp = 100;
    int sp = g_settings.hdr_sdr_blend;
    if (sp < 0) sp = 0;
    if (sp > 60) sp = 60;
    int vp = g_settings.hdr_vanilla_saturation;
    if (vp < 0) vp = 0;
    if (vp > 100) vp = 100;
    int bl = g_settings.hdr_bloom;
    if (bl < 0) bl = 0;
    if (bl > 100) bl = 100;
    int ep = g_settings.hdr_exposure;
    if (ep < 50) ep = 50;
    if (ep > 200) ep = 200;
    int hp2 = g_settings.hdr_highlights;
    if (hp2 < 0) hp2 = 0;
    if (hp2 > 100) hp2 = 100;
    int shp = g_settings.hdr_shadows;
    if (shp < 0) shp = 0;
    if (shp > 100) shp = 100;
    int cp = g_settings.hdr_contrast;
    if (cp < 0) cp = 0;
    if (cp > 100) cp = 100;
    int sap = g_settings.hdr_saturation;
    if (sap < 0) sap = 0;
    if (sap > 100) sap = 100;
    int hsp = g_settings.hdr_highlight_saturation;
    if (hsp < 0) hsp = 0;
    if (hsp > 100) hsp = 100;
    int fp = g_settings.hdr_flare;
    if (fp < 0) fp = 0;
    if (fp > 100) fp = 100;
    int gm = g_settings.hdr_gamma;
    if (gm < 0 || gm > 2) gm = 0;
    p->v[0] = ui > 0.0f ? game / ui : 1.0f;  // (the scene's white relative to the HUD's: 1.0 at both 203)
    p->v[1] = game > 0.0f ? peak / game : 1.0f;
    p->v[2] = sp / 100.0f;
    p->v[3] = hp / 100.0f;
    p->v[4] = bp / 100.0f;
    p->v[5] = vp / 100.0f;
    p->v[6] = bl / 100.0f;
    p->v[7] = g_settings.hdr_clamp == 1 ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    p->v[8] = g_settings.hdr_tonemapper == 0 ? 0.0f : 1.0f;
    p->v[9] = ep / 100.0f;
    p->v[10] = hp2 * 0.02f;
    p->v[11] = shp * 0.02f;
    p->v[12] = cp * 0.02f;
    p->v[13] = sap * 0.02f;
    p->v[14] = 1.0f - hsp * 0.02f;  // (the mod's -(ColorGradeHighlightSaturation - 1))
    // (the mod's BuildPsycho17Config: config.flare = 0.10 * pow(RENODX_TONE_MAP_FLARE, 10), parsed 0..2)
    p->v[15] = 0.10f * powf(fp * 0.02f, 10.0f);
    p->v[16] = (float)gm;
    p->v[17] = p->v[18] = p->v[19] = 0.0f;
}

// ---- the float picture the game's present copy reads

typedef struct { VkImage win, src; VkFormat fmt; uint32_t w, h; } Rec;
static Rec recs[16];
static pthread_mutex_t rec_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

void vk_hdr_record(VkImage win, VkImage src, VkFormat fmt, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    if (!win) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&rec_lock);
    int at = -1, spare = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        if (recs[i].win == win) at = i;
        if (!recs[i].win && spare < 0) spare = i;
    }
    if (!src) {
        if (at >= 0) recs[at] = (Rec){0};
    } else {
        if (at < 0) at = spare;
        if (at >= 0) recs[at] = (Rec){win, src, fmt, w, h};
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&rec_lock);
}

bool vk_hdr_source(VkImage win, VkImage *src, VkFormat *fmt, uint32_t *w, uint32_t *h) {
    bool found = false;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&rec_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        if (recs[i].win == win && recs[i].src) {
            *src = recs[i].src, *fmt = recs[i].fmt, *w = recs[i].w, *h = recs[i].h;
            found = true;
            break;
        }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&rec_lock);
    return found;
}

void vk_hdr_image_gone(VkImage img) {
    if (!img) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&rec_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        if (recs[i].src == img) recs[i].src = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        if (recs[i].win == img) recs[i] = (Rec){0};
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&rec_lock);
}

// ---- the replacement tonemap

static const char *skip_space(const char *p) {
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == '\r' || *p == '\n') p++;
    return p;
}

static bool has_register(const char *s) {
    for (; s && *s; s++)
        if (*s == 'r' && s[1] >= '0' && s[1] <= '9') return true;
    return false;
}

// The coordinate argument of the first texture()/textureLod() read of t<slot> in body. The translator emits
// `texture(t0, vec2(...))` (the source is straight-line GLSL), so the second argument is the UV expression.
static char *sample_arg(const char *body, int slot, const char **at) {
    char tex[32], lod[32];
    snprintf(tex, sizeof tex, "texture(t%d", slot);
    snprintf(lod, sizeof lod, "textureLod(t%d", slot);
    const char *p = strstr(body, lod), *needle = lod;
    int is_lod = p != NULL;
    if (!p) p = strstr(body, tex), needle = tex;
    while (p && p[strlen(needle)] >= '0' && p[strlen(needle)] <= '9') p = strstr(p + 1, needle);
    if (!p) return NULL;
    if (at) *at = p;
    const char *open = strchr(p, '(');
    if (!open) return NULL;
    int depth = 1;
    const char *comma = NULL, *second = NULL, *end = NULL;
    for (const char *q = open + 1; *q; q++) {
        if (*q == '(') depth++;
        else if (*q == ')') {
            if (--depth == 0) { end = q; break; }
        } else if (*q == ',' && depth == 1) {
            if (!comma) comma = q;
            else if (!second) second = q;
        }
    }
    if (!comma || !end) return NULL;
    const char *a = skip_space(comma + 1), *b = is_lod && second ? second : end;
    while (b > a && (b[-1] == ' ' || b[-1] == '\t' || b[-1] == '\r' || b[-1] == '\n')) b--;
    size_t n = (size_t)(b - a);
    if (!n) return NULL;
    char *out = malloc(n + 1);
    if (!out) return NULL;
    memcpy(out, a, n);
    out[n] = 0;
    return out;
}

// The extended-vanilla curve: the game's 1 - e^-x up to the pivot, its tangent there above. BOTW's own tonemap is
// exactly the RenoDX TotK commit's vanilla: luminance and each channel by 1 - e^-x, blended by the luminance curve
// squared. The pivot is hdr_sdr_blend (18%: RenoDX BOTW's default).
//
// The hue/purity transfer is a compact port of RenoDX's MacLeod-Boynton correction (macleod_boynton.hlsli,
// CorrectHueAndPurityMBBT709WithBT2020, MIT): the extended colour takes its hue angle and purity from the game's own
// SDR result, in MacLeod-Boynton chromaticity, holding its luminance. The BT.709/2020 and XYZ_TO_LMS matrices are the
// reference's; the purity/gamut interval is its ApplyBT2020 normalized-purity path.
static const char k_mbbt[] =
    "const mat3 SW_709_TO_XYZ = mat3(\n"
    "  0.41239080, 0.21263901, 0.01933082,\n"
    "  0.35758434, 0.71516868, 0.11919478,\n"
    "  0.18048079, 0.07219232, 0.95053215);\n"
    "const mat3 SW_XYZ_TO_709 = mat3(\n"
    "   3.240969956887, -0.969243657972,  0.055630078074,\n"
    "  -1.537383184825,  1.875967510611, -0.203976958694,\n"
    "  -0.498610761712,  0.041555053406,  1.056971517940);\n"
    "const mat3 SW_2020_TO_XYZ = mat3(\n"
    "  0.63695805, 0.26270021, 0.00000000,\n"
    "  0.14461690, 0.67799807, 0.02807269,\n"
    "  0.16888098, 0.05930172, 1.06098506);\n"
    "const mat3 SW_XYZ_TO_2020 = mat3(\n"
    "   1.716651178394, -0.666684344427, 0.017639855295,\n"
    "  -0.355670774379,  1.616481235365, -0.042770608486,\n"
    "  -0.253366286469,  0.015768542332,  0.942103119340);\n"
    "const mat3 SW_XYZ_TO_LMS = mat3(\n"
    "   0.185082982238733, -0.134433056469973,  0.000789456671966863,\n"
    "   0.584081279463687,  0.405752392775348, -0.000912281325916184,\n"
    "  -0.0240722415044404,  0.0358252602217631, 0.0198490812339463);\n"
    "const mat3 SW_LMS_TO_XYZ = mat3(\n"
    "   2.628474773948,  0.876534283734, -0.064255925692,\n"
    "  -3.761263499280,  1.200303808552,  0.204763599211,\n"
    "   9.976357133974, -1.103378592865, 49.932664133489);\n"
    "const vec3 SW_D65_XYZ = vec3(0.950455927, 1.0, 1.089057751);\n"
    "vec2 sw_mb_from_lms(vec3 lms) {\n"
    "  float t = lms.x + lms.y;\n"
    "  return t > 0.0 ? vec2(lms.x / t, lms.z / t) : vec2(0.0);\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec3 sw_lms_from_mb(vec2 mb, float t) {\n"
    "  return vec3(mb.x * t, (1.0 - mb.x) * t, mb.y * t);\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec2 sw_interval_lower0(float a, float b) {\n"
    "  if (abs(a) < 1e-20) return b >= 0.0 ? vec2(-1e30, 1e30) : vec2(1.0, 0.0);\n"
    "  float t0 = -b / a;\n"
    "  return a > 0.0 ? vec2(t0, 1e30) : vec2(-1e30, t0);\n"
    "}\n"
    "// The colour at purity01 along its own white -> hue ray to the BT.2020 gamut edge (the reference's ApplyBT2020\n"
    "// normalized-purity path, curve gamma 1); purity_cur is the input's own purity in 0..1.\n"
    "vec3 sw_mb_apply(vec3 rgb2020, float purity01, out float purity_cur) {\n"
    "  purity_cur = 0.0;\n"
    "  vec3 lms = SW_XYZ_TO_LMS * (SW_2020_TO_XYZ * rgb2020);\n"
    "  float t = lms.x + lms.y;\n"
    "  if (t <= 1e-6) return max(rgb2020, 0.0);\n"
    "  vec2 white = sw_mb_from_lms(SW_XYZ_TO_LMS * SW_D65_XYZ);\n"
    "  vec2 dir = sw_mb_from_lms(lms) - white;\n"
    "  if (dot(dir, dir) < 1e-14) return max(rgb2020, 0.0);\n"
    "  vec3 lms_t0 = sw_lms_from_mb(white, t);\n"
    "  vec3 rgb_t0 = SW_XYZ_TO_2020 * (SW_LMS_TO_XYZ * lms_t0);\n"
    "  vec3 a = rgb2020 - rgb_t0;\n"
    "  vec2 i0 = sw_interval_lower0(a.x, rgb_t0.x);\n"
    "  vec2 i1 = sw_interval_lower0(a.y, rgb_t0.y);\n"
    "  vec2 i2 = sw_interval_lower0(a.z, rgb_t0.z);\n"
    "  float t_hi = min(1e30, min(i0.y, min(i1.y, i2.y)));\n"
    "  float t_lo = max(0.0, max(i0.x, max(i1.x, i2.x)));\n"
    "  if (t_hi < t_lo) return max(rgb2020, 0.0);\n"
    "  float t_max = max(0.0, t_hi);\n"
    "  purity_cur = t_max > 1e-6 ? clamp(1.0 / t_max, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;\n"
    "  float t_final = clamp(purity01, 0.0, 1.0) * t_max;\n"
    "  vec2 mb_final = white + t_final * dir;\n"
    "  vec3 lms_final = sw_lms_from_mb(mb_final, t);\n"
    "  return max(SW_XYZ_TO_2020 * (SW_LMS_TO_XYZ * lms_final), 0.0);\n"
    "}\n"
    "// Hue and purity from donor709 onto target709, holding the target's luminance (MacLeod-Boynton).\n"
    "vec3 sw_mbbt(vec3 target709, vec3 donor709, float hue_strength, float purity_strength) {\n"
    "  if (hue_strength <= 0.0 && purity_strength <= 0.0) return target709;\n"
    "  vec3 target2020 = SW_XYZ_TO_2020 * (SW_709_TO_XYZ * target709);\n"
    "  vec3 donor2020 = SW_XYZ_TO_2020 * (SW_709_TO_XYZ * donor709);\n"
    "  float tp = 0.0, dp = 0.0;\n"
    "  vec3 tdummy = sw_mb_apply(target2020, 1.0, tp);\n"
    "  vec3 ddummy = sw_mb_apply(donor2020, 1.0, dp);\n"
    "  float purity = mix(tp, dp, clamp(purity_strength, 0.0, 1.0));\n"
    "  vec3 lms_t = SW_XYZ_TO_LMS * (SW_2020_TO_XYZ * target2020);\n"
    "  float target_t = lms_t.x + lms_t.y;\n"
    "  if (target_t <= 1e-6) return target709;\n"
    "  vec2 white = sw_mb_from_lms(SW_XYZ_TO_LMS * SW_D65_XYZ);\n"
    "  vec2 mt = sw_mb_from_lms(lms_t) - white;\n"
    "  vec3 lms_d = SW_XYZ_TO_LMS * (SW_2020_TO_XYZ * donor2020);\n"
    "  vec2 md = sw_mb_from_lms(lms_d) - white;\n"
    "  float lt = length(mt), ld = length(md);\n"
    "  vec2 tu = lt > 1e-14 ? mt / lt : vec2(0.0);\n"
    "  vec2 ru = ld > 1e-14 ? md / ld : tu;\n"
    "  if (lt <= 1e-14) tu = ru;\n"
    "  vec2 bu = mix(tu, ru, clamp(hue_strength, 0.0, 1.0));\n"
    "  float bl = length(bu);\n"
    "  bu = bl > 1e-14 ? bu / bl : (hue_strength >= 0.5 ? ru : tu);\n"
    "  float seed_len = max(lt > 1e-6 ? lt : ld, 1e-6);\n"
    "  vec3 lms_seed = sw_lms_from_mb(white + bu * seed_len, target_t);\n"
    "  vec3 seed2020 = SW_XYZ_TO_2020 * (SW_LMS_TO_XYZ * lms_seed);\n"
    "  float unused = 0.0;\n"
    "  vec3 out2020 = sw_mb_apply(seed2020, purity, unused);\n"
    "  return SW_XYZ_TO_709 * (SW_2020_TO_XYZ * out2020);\n"
    "}\n";

char *vk_hdr_tonemap_source(const char *orig, int scene_texture, int glow_texture) {
    if (!orig || scene_texture < 0 || glow_texture < 0 || glow_texture == scene_texture) return NULL;
    const char *main = strstr(orig, "void main()");
    if (!main) return NULL;
    const char *body = main + strlen("void main()");
    if (!strstr(orig, "out vec4 c0;")) return NULL;
    char tex_decl[48];
    snprintf(tex_decl, sizeof tex_decl, "uniform sampler2D t%d;", scene_texture);
    if (!strstr(orig, tex_decl)) return NULL;
    snprintf(tex_decl, sizeof tex_decl, "uniform sampler2D t%d;", glow_texture);
    if (!strstr(orig, tex_decl)) return NULL;
    const char *scene_at = NULL, *glow_at = NULL;
    char *scene_uv = sample_arg(body, scene_texture, &scene_at);
    char *glow_uv = sample_arg(body, glow_texture, &glow_at);
    if (!scene_uv || !glow_uv) {
        free(scene_uv);
        free(glow_uv);
        return NULL;
    }
    // Keep the statements before the first sample: they compute the texture coordinates. (The translated fragment
    // shaders wrap main's body in `do { ... } while (false);`: skip that one brace.)
    const char *first = scene_at < glow_at ? scene_at : glow_at;
    const char *brace = strchr(body, '{');
    const char *prefix_at = brace ? brace + 1 : body;
    const char *line = first;
    while (line > prefix_at && line[-1] != '\n' && line[-1] != '\r') line--;
    const char *prefix_end = line > prefix_at ? line : prefix_at;
    const char *do_at = NULL;
    int depth = 0, opens = 0, closes = 0;
    for (const char *q = prefix_at; q < prefix_end; q++) {
        if (q[0] == 'd' && q[1] == 'o' && q[2] == ' ' && q[3] == '{') do_at = q;
        if (*q == '{') depth++, opens++;
        else if (*q == '}') depth--, closes++;
    }
    if (!(do_at && opens == 1 && closes == 0) && (depth != 0 || opens != 0)) {
        free(scene_uv);
        free(glow_uv);
        return NULL;
    }
    const char *pre1 = prefix_at, *pre2 = NULL;
    size_t pre1_len = (size_t)(prefix_end - prefix_at), pre2_len = 0;
    if (do_at) {  // (declarations before `do {`, then the statements after it, at main's scope)
        const char *open = strchr(do_at, '{');
        pre1_len = (size_t)(do_at - prefix_at);
        pre2 = open + 1;
        pre2_len = (size_t)(prefix_end - pre2);
    }
    size_t prefix_len = pre1_len + pre2_len;
    if ((prefix_len == 0 && (has_register(scene_uv) || has_register(glow_uv))) || !strstr(orig, "cb3")) {
        free(scene_uv);
        free(glow_uv);
        return NULL;
    }
    char functions[65536];
    int flen = snprintf(functions, sizeof functions,
                        "layout(push_constant) uniform VkHdrParams { vec4 p[5]; } sw_hdr;\n"
                        "float sw_maxc(vec3 c) { return max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)); }\n"
                        "float sw_curve(float x) {\n"
                        "  float pivot = sw_hdr.p[0].z;\n"
                        "  float y0 = 1.0 - exp(-pivot);\n"
                        "  float m0 = exp(-pivot);\n"
                        "  return x <= pivot ? 1.0 - exp(-x) : y0 + m0 * (x - pivot);\n"
                        "}\n"
                        "vec3 sw_curve3(vec3 x) { return vec3(sw_curve(x.r), sw_curve(x.g), sw_curve(x.b)); }\n"
                        "float psy_srgb_decode(float x) {\n"
                        "  return x <= 0.04045 ? x / 12.92 : pow((x + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);\n"
                        "}\n"
                        "float psy_gamma_safe(float x, float g) {\n"
                        "  return psy_srgb_decode(pow(max(x, 0.0), 1.0 / g));\n"
                        "}\n"
                        "%s%s", k_mbbt, vk_hdr_psycho_glsl);
    if (flen <= 0 || flen >= (int)sizeof functions) {
        free(scene_uv);
        free(glow_uv);
        return NULL;
    }
    const char *weights = strstr(orig, "cb1")
                              ? "  float sw_wg = uintBitsToFloat(cb1[0].x), sw_wb = uintBitsToFloat(cb1[0].y);\n"
                                "  float sw_wl = uintBitsToFloat(cb1[0].z);\n"
                              : "  float sw_wg = 0.5866, sw_wb = 0.1144, sw_wl = 0.666667;\n";
    char grade[256];
    snprintf(grade, sizeof grade,
             "  float sw_bias = uintBitsToFloat(cb3[0].x), sw_scale = uintBitsToFloat(cb3[0].y) * sw_hdr.p[1].y;\n");
    size_t prologue = (size_t)(main - orig);
    size_t cap = prologue + prefix_len + strlen(functions) + strlen(scene_uv) + strlen(glow_uv) + 16384;
    char *out = calloc(cap, 1);
    if (!out) {
        free(scene_uv);
        free(glow_uv);
        return NULL;
    }
    char samples[1200];
    snprintf(samples, sizeof samples,
             "  vec3 sw_scene = min(texture(t%d, %s).rgb, vec3(10000.0));\n"
             "  vec3 sw_bloom = min(texture(t%d, %s).rgb, vec3(10000.0)) * sw_hdr.p[1].z;\n"
             "  vec3 sw_x = max(sw_scene + sw_bloom, vec3(0.0));\n",
             scene_texture, scene_uv, glow_texture, glow_uv);
    int n = snprintf(out, cap, "%.*s", (int)prologue, orig);
    n += snprintf(out + n, cap - (size_t)n,
                  "// (SavageWind: BOTW's own tonemap with RenoDX's extended vanilla curve; the picture is kept above white)\n"
                  "%s"
                  "void main() {\n"
                  "%.*s%.*s"
                  "%s"
                  "%s"
                  "%s"
                  "  float sw_game = sw_hdr.p[0].x, sw_peak = sw_hdr.p[0].y;\n"
                  "  float sw_hue = sw_hdr.p[0].w, sw_blowout = sw_hdr.p[1].x, sw_clamp = sw_hdr.p[1].w;\n"
                  "  float sw_tm = sw_hdr.p[2].x, sw_exp = sw_hdr.p[2].y, sw_hl = sw_hdr.p[2].z, sw_sh = sw_hdr.p[2].w;\n"
                  "  float sw_ct = sw_hdr.p[3].x, sw_sat = sw_hdr.p[3].y, sw_ph = sw_hdr.p[3].z, sw_fl = sw_hdr.p[3].w;\n"
                  "  float sw_gamma = sw_hdr.p[4].x, sw_npeak = sw_peak;\n"
                  "  if (sw_gamma > 0.5) sw_npeak = psy_gamma_safe(sw_peak, sw_gamma > 1.5 ? 2.4 : 2.2);\n"
                  "  float sw_lum = max(sw_x.r * 0.2989 + sw_x.g * sw_wg + sw_x.b * sw_wb, 0.0);\n"
                  "  float sw_sdr = 1.0 - exp(-sw_lum);\n"
                  "  vec3 sw_by_lum = sw_lum > 0.0 ? sw_x * (sw_curve(sw_lum) / sw_lum) : sw_x;\n"
                  "  vec3 sw_ext = max(mix(sw_by_lum, sw_curve3(sw_x), clamp(sw_sdr, 0.0, 1.0) * clamp(sw_sdr, 0.0, 1.0)),"
                  " vec3(0.0));\n"
                  "  // The game's own SDR result (vanilla, no grade) is the hue/purity donor: bright saturated colours\n"
                  "  // such as a fire's core read yellow-white there, but the extended curve keeps their ratios, so they\n"
                  "  // would stay deep red here. The transfer is MacLeod-Boynton hue/purity, as RenoDX's BOTW mod.\n"
                  "  vec3 sw_sdr_c = clamp(mix(sw_lum > 0.0 ? sw_x * (sw_sdr / sw_lum) : sw_x,"
                  " vec3(1.0) - exp(-sw_x), sw_sdr * sw_sdr), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
                  "  float sw_dmax = sw_maxc(sw_sdr_c), sw_dmin = min(sw_sdr_c.r, min(sw_sdr_c.g, sw_sdr_c.b));\n"
                  "  float sw_chroma = sw_dmax > 1e-6 ? (sw_dmax - sw_dmin) / sw_dmax : 0.0;\n"
                  "  float sw_hue_strength = sw_hue * smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, sw_chroma);\n"
                  "  if (sw_hue_strength > 0.0 || sw_blowout > 0.0)\n"
                  "    sw_ext = sw_mbbt(sw_ext, sw_sdr_c, sw_hue_strength, sw_blowout);\n"
                  "  // The game's grade, normalized into 0..1 by RenoDX's Neutwo max-channel scale (1/sqrt(max^2+1)).\n"
                  "  float sw_mx = max(sw_maxc(sw_ext), 0.0);\n"
                  "  float sw_norm = 1.0 / sqrt(sw_mx * sw_mx + 1.0);\n"
                  "  vec3 sw_n = sw_ext * sw_norm;\n"
                  "  float sw_l = (sw_n.r + sw_n.g + sw_n.b) * sw_wl;\n"
                  "  float sw_grade = sw_bias + sw_scale * (1.0 - (sw_l - 1.0) * (sw_l - 1.0));\n"
                  "  float sw_m = sw_maxc(sw_n);\n"
                  "  vec3 sw_c = (sw_m + (sw_n - sw_m) * sw_grade) / sw_norm;\n"
                  "  if (sw_clamp > 0.5)\n"
                  "    sw_c = SW_XYZ_TO_709 * (SW_2020_TO_XYZ * max(SW_XYZ_TO_2020 * (SW_709_TO_XYZ * sw_c), vec3(0.0)));\n"
                  "  else\n"
                  "    sw_c = max(sw_c, vec3(0.0));\n"
                  "  vec3 sw_out;\n"
                  "  if (sw_tm < 0.5) {\n"
                  "    // Vanilla: the game's own tonemap and grade, clipped as its A2B10G10R10 target was\n"
                  "    float sw_vl = (sw_sdr_c.r + sw_sdr_c.g + sw_sdr_c.b) * sw_wl;\n"
                  "    float sw_vg = sw_bias + sw_scale * (1.0 - (sw_vl - 1.0) * (sw_vl - 1.0));\n"
                  "    float sw_vm = sw_maxc(sw_sdr_c);\n"
                  "    sw_out = clamp(vec3(sw_vm) + (sw_sdr_c - sw_vm) * sw_vg, 0.0, 1.0);\n"
                  "  } else {\n"
                  "    // RenoDX PsychoV (test17): the mod's ApplyTest17BT2020, then its per-channel Neutwo to peak\n"
                  "    vec3 sw_p = PSY_709_TO_2020 * sw_c;\n"
                  "    sw_p = psy_apply(sw_p, sw_exp, sw_hl, sw_sh, sw_ct, sw_fl, sw_sat, sw_ph);\n"
                  "    sw_c = PSY_2020_TO_709 * sw_p;\n"
                  "    sw_out = psy_neutwo(sw_c, sw_npeak);\n"
                  "  }\n"
                  "  c0 = vec4(max(sw_out, vec3(0.0)) * sw_game, 1.0);\n"
                  "}\n", functions, (int)pre1_len, pre1, (int)pre2_len, pre2 ? pre2 : "", samples, weights, grade);
    free(scene_uv);
    free(glow_uv);
    if (n <= 0 || (size_t)n >= cap) {
        free(out);
        return NULL;
    }
    return out;
}

```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/hdr_psycho.c`:

```c
// PsychoV (Musa's RenoDX test17) as GLSL, ported from the RenoDX BOTW mod's psycho_test17_custom.hlsli
// (MIT; RenoDX by ShortFuse, tonemapper by Musa). Only the path the BOTW mod uses: no LMS tonemap,
// no bleaching, no pre-gamut compression; the post gamut compression and the user grading curves stay.
#include "hdr_psycho.h"

const char vk_hdr_psycho_glsl[] =
    "\n"
    "// ---- RenoDX BOTW PsychoV/test17 subset (GLSL port; MIT, RenoDX by ShortFuse, tonemapper by Musa) ----\n"
    "const vec3 PSY_LMS_W = vec3(0.68990272, 0.34832189, 0.0371597069161);\n"
    "const vec2 PSY_MB_WHITE_D65 = vec2(0.698328122404485, 0.020476134671360377);\n"
    "const vec2 PSY_MB_WHITE_LMS1 = vec2(0.6645023758394631, 0.035791587444743776);\n"
    "const vec3 PSY_MIDGRAY_LMS = vec3(0.19138026586745538, 0.1637524673255161, 0.10420845801917501);\n"
    "const mat3 PSY_XYZ_TO_LMS = mat3(\n"
    "    0.2670502842656, -0.3870688241122, 0.0267277939891,\n"
    "    0.8471990148493, 1.1654299358905, -0.0272913166757,\n"
    "    -0.0347041661246, 0.1030228669661, 0.5333267257603);\n"
    "const mat3 PSY_LMS_TO_XYZ = mat3(\n"
    "    1.8114629636874, 0.6069124057314, -0.0597250591702,\n"
    "    -1.3081492612535, 0.4159062592830, 0.0868409009978,\n"
    "    0.3705694640609, -0.0408482553314, 1.8543617734966);\n"
    "const mat3 PSY_2020_TO_LMS = mat3(\n"
    "    0.3926591886709, 0.0596120884653, 0.0098550488182,\n"
    "    0.6120450440591, 0.7370746834952, 0.0003337481729,\n"
    "    0.0585194665337, 0.1130491576257, 0.5687470808932);\n"
    "const mat3 PSY_LMS_TO_2020 = mat3(\n"
    "    2.9089213537037, -0.2275532729579, -0.0502712320124,\n"
    "    -2.4155642448123, 1.5457966614145, 0.0409489516994,\n"
    "    0.1808342947413, -0.2838427127195, 1.7552839121676);\n"
    "const mat3 PSY_2020_TO_LMS_W = mat3(\n"
    "    0.2708966422970, 0.0207641953211, 0.0003662107257,\n"
    "    0.4222515406589, 0.2567392468262, 0.0000124019843,\n"
    "    0.0403727391346, 0.0393774962471, 0.0211344748354);\n"
    "const mat3 PSY_709_TO_2020 = mat3(\n"
    "    0.6274038959820, 0.0690972893946, 0.0163914388629,\n"
    "    0.3292830383481, 0.9195403951577, 0.0880133079236,\n"
    "    0.0433130656344, 0.0113623156093, 0.8955952532093);\n"
    "const mat3 PSY_2020_TO_709 = mat3(\n"
    "    1.6604910019974, -0.1245504745674, -0.0181507633199,\n"
    "    -0.5876411386509, 1.1328998970431, -0.1005788980734,\n"
    "    -0.0728498631928, -0.0083494226633, 1.1187296614137);\n"
    "const vec2 PSY_CIE_N[7] = vec2[7](\n"
    "    vec2(-0.043889, -0.006807), vec2(-0.007821, -0.008564), vec2(-0.000604, -0.007942),\n"
    "    vec2(0.0, -0.080835), vec2(0.953597, 0.307020), vec2(-0.060969, 0.019752), vec2(-0.106895, 0.004035));\n"
    "const float PSY_CIE_D[7] = float[7](\n"
    "    0.0065035249, 0.00104900495, 0.000207697044, 0.00165556648,\n"
    "    0.252472349, 0.0241967351, 0.0199621232);\n"
    "float psy_div(float a, float b, float fb) { return b == 0.0 ? fb : a / b; }\n"
    "vec3 psy_mb_from_wl(vec3 wl) {\n"
    "    float t = max(wl.x + wl.y, 0.0);\n"
    "    float inv = psy_div(1.0, t, 0.0);\n"
    "    return vec3(wl.x * inv, wl.z * inv, t);\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec3 psy_wl_from_mb(vec2 mb, float t) { return vec3(mb.x, 1.0 - mb.x, mb.y) * t; }\n"
    "float psy_yf(vec3 lms) { return 0.68990272 * lms.x + 0.34832189 * lms.y; }\n"
    "float psy_cross(vec2 a, vec2 b) { return a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x; }\n"
    "bool psy_seg_hit(vec2 o, vec2 d, vec2 a, vec2 b, out float t_hit) {\n"
    "    t_hit = 0.0;\n"
    "    vec2 edge = b - a;\n"
    "    float den = psy_cross(d, edge);\n"
    "    if (abs(den) <= 1e-20) return false;\n"
    "    vec2 ao = a - o;\n"
    "    float t = psy_cross(ao, edge) / den;\n"
    "    float u = psy_cross(ao, d) / den;\n"
    "    if (t < 0.0 || u < 0.0 || u > 1.0) return false;\n"
    "    t_hit = t;\n"
    "    return true;\n"
    "}\n"
    "float psy_ray_exit(vec2 origin, vec2 dir) {\n"
    "    if (dot(dir, dir) <= 1e-14) return 1e20;\n"
    "    vec2 w2o = PSY_MB_WHITE_D65 - origin;\n"
    "    float best = 1e20;\n"
    "    bool hit = false;\n"
    "    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {\n"
    "        vec2 n = PSY_CIE_N[i];\n"
    "        float den = dot(n, dir);\n"
    "        float num = PSY_CIE_D[i] + dot(n, w2o);\n"
    "        float t = den > 1e-8 ? num / den : 1e20;\n"
    "        best = min(best, t);\n"
    "        hit = hit || (den > 1e-8);\n"
    "    }\n"
    "    return hit ? max(best, 0.0) : 1e20;\n"
    "}\n"
    "float psy_ray_exit_d(vec2 dir) { return psy_ray_exit(PSY_MB_WHITE_D65, dir); }\n"
    "float psy_ray_max_t(vec2 origin, vec2 dir, vec2 r, vec2 g, vec2 b, out bool has) {\n"
    "    has = false;\n"
    "    if (dot(dir, dir) <= 1e-14) return 0.0;\n"
    "    float best = 1e20;\n"
    "    float t;\n"
    "    bool hit = false;\n"
    "    if (psy_seg_hit(origin, dir, r, g, t)) { best = min(best, t); hit = true; }\n"
    "    if (psy_seg_hit(origin, dir, g, b, t)) { best = min(best, t); hit = true; }\n"
    "    if (psy_seg_hit(origin, dir, b, r, t)) { best = min(best, t); hit = true; }\n"
    "    has = hit;\n"
    "    return hit ? max(best, 0.0) : 0.0;\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec3 psy_clamp_wl(vec3 wl) {\n"
    "    vec3 lms = max(wl, 0.0);\n"
    "    vec3 mb = psy_mb_from_wl(lms);\n"
    "    if (!(mb.z > 1e-20)) return vec3(lms.x, lms.y, 0.0);\n"
    "    vec2 dir = mb.xy - PSY_MB_WHITE_D65;\n"
    "    if (dot(dir, dir) <= 1e-14) return lms;\n"
    "    float t_clip = psy_ray_exit_d(dir);\n"
    "    float t_final = min(1.0, t_clip);\n"
    "    return psy_wl_from_mb(PSY_MB_WHITE_D65 + dir * t_final, mb.z);\n"
    "}\n"
    "float psy_neutwo_pc(float x, float peak, float clip) {\n"
    "    float p = max(peak, 0.0);\n"
    "    float c = max(clip, p);\n"
    "    float x2 = x * x, c2 = c * c, p2 = p * p;\n"
    "    float den = x2 * (c2 - p2) + c2 * p2;\n"
    "    return (c * p * x) * inversesqrt(max(den, 1e-20));\n"
    "}\n"
    "float psy_neutwo_scale(float tp, float tc) {\n"
    "    float p = max(tp, 0.0);\n"
    "    float c = max(tc, p);\n"
    "    return clamp(psy_neutwo_pc(1.0, p, c), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
    "}\n"
    "float psy_soft_act(float tp) {\n"
    "    float outside = 1.0 - clamp(tp, 0.0, 1.0);\n"
    "    return psy_div(outside, outside + 0.08, 0.0);\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec3 psy_gamut_core(vec3 wl, vec2 br, vec2 bg, vec2 bb, float strength) {\n"
    "    vec3 lms = psy_clamp_wl(max(wl, 0.0));\n"
    "    vec3 mb = psy_mb_from_wl(lms);\n"
    "    float y = mb.z;\n"
    "    vec2 ls = mb.xy;\n"
    "    if (!(y > 1e-20)) return vec3(lms.x, lms.y, 0.0);\n"
    "    vec2 dir = ls - PSY_MB_WHITE_D65;\n"
    "    if (dot(dir, dir) <= 1e-14) return lms;\n"
    "    bool has = false;\n"
    "    float t_peak = psy_ray_max_t(PSY_MB_WHITE_D65, dir, br, bg, bb, has);\n"
    "    float t_clip = psy_ray_exit_d(dir);\n"
    "    if (!has) t_peak = t_clip;\n"
    "    float t_hard = clamp(t_peak, 0.0, 1.0);\n"
    "    float t_soft = psy_neutwo_scale(min(t_peak, t_clip), t_clip);\n"
    "    float soft_mix = clamp(strength, 0.0, 1.0) * psy_soft_act(t_peak);\n"
    "    float t_final = mix(t_hard, t_soft, soft_mix);\n"
    "    return psy_wl_from_mb(PSY_MB_WHITE_D65 + t_final * dir, y);\n"
    "}\n"
    "void psy_triangle(mat3 m, vec3 state, out vec2 r, out vec2 g, out vec2 b) {\n"
    "    r = psy_mb_from_wl(m[0] / state).xy;\n"
    "    g = psy_mb_from_wl(m[1] / state).xy;\n"
    "    b = psy_mb_from_wl(m[2] / state).xy;\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec3 psy_gamut_compress(vec3 lms, vec3 state, mat3 bound, float strength) {\n"
    "    vec3 wl = (lms * PSY_LMS_W) / state;\n"
    "    vec2 r, g, b;\n"
    "    psy_triangle(bound, state, r, g, b);\n"
    "    vec3 out_wl = psy_gamut_core(wl, r, g, b, strength);\n"
    "    return (out_wl * state) / PSY_LMS_W;\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec3 psy_scale_purity(vec3 lms, float ps, vec3 state) {\n"
    "    if (abs(ps - 1.0) <= 1e-7) return lms;\n"
    "    vec3 rel = lms / state;\n"
    "    vec3 mb = psy_mb_from_wl(rel * PSY_LMS_W);\n"
    "    vec2 white = PSY_MB_WHITE_LMS1;\n"
    "    vec2 scaled = white + (mb.xy - white) * ps;\n"
    "    return (psy_wl_from_mb(scaled, mb.z) / PSY_LMS_W) * state;\n"
    "}\n"
    "float psy_hl(float x, float h, float mg) {\n"
    "    if (h == 1.0) return x;\n"
    "    if (h > 1.0) return max(x, mix(x, mg * pow(x / mg, h), min(x, 1.0)));\n"
    "    float b = mg * pow(x / mg, 2.0 - h);\n"
    "    float t = min(x, 1.0);\n"
    "    return min(x, psy_div(x * x, mix(x, b, t), x));\n"
    "}\n"
    "float psy_sh(float x, float s, float mg) {\n"
    "    if (s == 1.0) return x;\n"
    "    float ratio = max(psy_div(x, mg, 0.0), 0.0);\n"
    "    float base_term = x * mg;\n"
    "    float base_scale = psy_div(base_term, ratio, 0.0);\n"
    "    if (s > 1.0) {\n"
    "        float raised = x * (1.0 + psy_div(base_term, pow(ratio, s), 0.0));\n"
    "        float reference = x * (1.0 + base_scale);\n"
    "        return max(x, x + (raised - reference));\n"
    "    }\n"
    "    float lowered = x * (1.0 - psy_div(base_term, pow(ratio, 2.0 - s), 0.0));\n"
    "    float reference = x * (1.0 - base_scale);\n"
    "    return clamp(x + (lowered - reference), 0.0, x);\n"
    "}\n"
    "float psy_cf(float x, float c, float flare, float mg) {\n"
    "    if (c == 1.0 && flare == 0.0) return x;\n"
    "    float xn = x / mg;\n"
    "    float fr = psy_div(xn + flare, xn, 1.0);\n"
    "    return pow(xn, c * fr) * mg;\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec3 psy_apply(vec3 c2020, float exposure, float highlights, float shadows, float contrast, float flare, float ps, float ph) {\n"
    "    vec3 lms = PSY_2020_TO_LMS * c2020;\n"
    "    float lum0 = psy_yf(lms);\n"
    "    float mid = psy_yf(PSY_MIDGRAY_LMS);\n"
    "    float lum = lum0 * exposure;\n"
    "    if (highlights != 1.0) lum = psy_hl(lum, highlights, mid);\n"
    "    if (shadows != 1.0) lum = psy_sh(lum, shadows, mid);\n"
    "    if (contrast != 1.0 || flare != 0.0) lum = psy_cf(lum, contrast, flare, mid);\n"
    "    float scale = psy_div(lum, lum0, 1.0);\n"
    "    lms *= scale;\n"
    "    float p = ps;\n"
    "    if (ph != 0.0) {\n"
    "        float percent = clamp(lum * 100.0 / 10000.0, 0.0, 1.0);\n"
    "        float blow = pow(1.0 - percent, 100.0 * abs(ph));\n"
    "        if (ph < 0.0) blow = 2.0 - blow;\n"
    "        p *= blow;\n"
    "    }\n"
    "    if (p != 1.0) lms = psy_scale_purity(lms, p, PSY_MIDGRAY_LMS);\n"
    "    lms = psy_gamut_compress(lms, PSY_MIDGRAY_LMS, PSY_2020_TO_LMS_W, 1.0);\n"
    "    return PSY_LMS_TO_2020 * lms;\n"
    "}\n"
    "vec3 psy_neutwo(vec3 c, float peak) {\n"
    "    vec3 p = vec3(max(peak, 0.0));\n"
    "    return p * c * inversesqrt(max(c * c + p * p, vec3(1e-20)));\n"
    "}\n"
    ;
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/imgui_glue.cpp`:

```cpp
// Dear ImGui's Vulkan backend on our device (start screen and in-game menu; both draw inside the window image's
// dynamic rendering begun by vk_frame_begin).
#include <vector>

#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_impl_vulkan.h"

extern "C" {
#include "vk.h"
#include "record.h"
}

// Per ImGui context (the start screen and the in-game menu each have one, and the start screen comes back after an
// in-place reboot while the menu's context lives on): the backend keeps its data in the current context.
extern "C" bool vk_imgui_backend_init(void) {
    if (ImGui::GetIO().BackendRendererUserData) return true;
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_InitInfo ii = {};
    ii.ApiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
    ii.Instance = g_vk.inst;
    ii.PhysicalDevice = g_vk.phys;
    ii.Device = g_vk.dev;
    ii.QueueFamily = g_vk.qfam;
    ii.Queue = g_vk.queue;
    ii.DescriptorPoolSize = 512;  // (one per overlay picture: the Cheats tab alone keeps 64 item icons)
    ii.MinImageCount = 2;
    // vertex buffers rotate per image: cover frames in flight (twice: frame generation draws the menu on both frames)
    ii.ImageCount = 2 * (g_vk.sc_count > 3 ? g_vk.sc_count : 3) + 1;
    ii.MSAASamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.PipelineCache = g_vk.pcache;
    ii.UseDynamicRendering = true;
    ii.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RENDERING_CREATE_INFO_KHR;
    ii.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    ii.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo.pColorAttachmentFormats = &g_vk.sc_format;
    bool ok = ImGui_ImplVulkan_Init(&ii);
    if (!ok) LOG("[vk] ImGui Vulkan backend init failed\n");
    return ok;
}

// The current context's fonts were made again: its font texture goes once no submitted frame can still read it, and
// the next NewFrame makes the new one.
extern "C" void vk_imgui_fonts_changed(void) {
    if (!ImGui::GetIO().BackendRendererUserData) return;
    uint64_t pending = vk_pending_seq();
    if (pending > 1) vk_wait_seq(pending - 1);
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_DestroyFontsTexture();
}

extern "C" void vk_imgui_backend_shutdown(void) {
    if (!ImGui::GetIO().BackendRendererUserData) return;
    vk_present_idle();
    rec_drain();
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.dev);
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_Shutdown();
}

// A static RGBA8 image for ImGui (the start screen's picture, runtime/ui/splash.mm). Returns the ImTextureID; 0 when it
// couldn't be made. vk_imgui_texture_free gives it back (before the backend shuts down: its descriptor is the backend's).
struct ImGuiTex { uint64_t id; VkImage img; VkImageView view; VmaAllocation mem; };
static std::vector<ImGuiTex> g_textures;

extern "C" uint64_t vk_imgui_texture_rgba(const void *rgba, int w, int h) {
    VkImageCreateInfo ci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO};
    ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    ci.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    ci.extent = {(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h, 1};
    ci.mipLevels = 1;
    ci.arrayLayers = 1;
    ci.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ci.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ci.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {};
    ai.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE;
    VkImage img;
    VmaAllocation mem;
    if (vmaCreateImage(g_vk.vma, &ci, &ai, &img, &mem, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_cmd();
    vk_image_init_layout(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
    VkSpan s = vk_transient_copy(rgba, (uint64_t)w * h * 4, 16);
    VkBufferImageCopy rg = {};
    rg.bufferOffset = s.off;
    rg.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
    rg.imageExtent = {(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h, 1};
    rec_CmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, s.buf, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, 1, &rg);
    rec_drain();  // (made while the menu draws, on this thread: ImGui records into the frame's buffer next, from the same pool)
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
    vi.image = img;
    vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    vi.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    vi.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    VkImageView view;
    if (vkCreateImageView(g_vk.dev, &vi, NULL, &view) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    uint64_t id = (uint64_t)ImGui_ImplVulkan_AddTexture(vk_default_sampler(true), view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    if (!id) { vkDestroyImageView(g_vk.dev, view, NULL); return 0; }  // (no descriptor left: rare, the image is left)
    g_textures.push_back({id, img, view, mem});
    return id;
}

extern "C" void vk_imgui_texture_free(uint64_t id) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_textures.size(); i++) {
        if (g_textures[i].id != id) continue;
        rec_drain();
        vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_vk.dev);  // (a frame in flight may still draw it)
        ImGui_ImplVulkan_RemoveTexture((VkDescriptorSet)id);
        vkDestroyImageView(g_vk.dev, g_textures[i].view, NULL);
        vmaDestroyImage(g_vk.vma, g_textures[i].img, g_textures[i].mem);
        g_textures.erase(g_textures.begin() + i);
        return;
    }
}

```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/mvec.c`:

```c
// Per-object motion vectors, step 1: draw identity and the previous frame's inputs.
//
// BOTW writes its constants into fresh memory every frame (three quarters of the constant buffers that move between
// frames carry the same bytes), so "the previous frame's data at this address" doesn't exist. Instead each scene draw
// (targets at the internal resolution, RS_SCENE) is identified by a key - its shaders, the non-instanced vertex streams
// its vertex shader reads, its index range - and an ordinal among the frame's draws with that key, and matched to the
// draw of the previous frame with the same key and ordinal (93-99% of them in the spike). The bytes its vertex shader
// reads that change between frames are copied, at draw time, into the frame's history buffer: the game's constant
// buffers (bones and per-object matrices included: no scene vertex shader reads global memory) and the instanced
// streams (rewritten every frame, in place). Per-vertex streams are not: the game never rewrites them between frames.
//
// History buffers (write-combined, often across the PCIe BAR: the CPU writes them and must never read them back, which
// took 17 us a draw): MVEC_SLOTS host-visible buffers, one per frame in flight and the frame being recorded, each
// holding one frame's copies; a frame's copies are read again during the next frame (as "previous"), so a slot is
// reused only once the GPU is done with the frames that read it. A frame that fills its slot stops recording (its
// remaining draws get no motion) and the slot is grown before its next use.
// On with Video > Anti-aliasing TAA (mvec_enabled; SAVAGEWIND_MVEC=1 / 0 whatever the setting).
// SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_LOG=<frames>: statistics every that many frames (default: none).
//
// Threads. The thread that translates the game's command lists (T, exec.c draw_) only describes each scene draw
// (mvec_draw_begin / mvec_draw_commit: 64-byte cells of a ring, two for most draws) and goes on; a thread of its own (W, w_run) does the work:
// the copies, the hashes, the matching, and the draw's push constants, which the recorder thread (record.c) asks for
// when it records the draw (mvec_resolve: by then W is usually done; it waits otherwise). Done on T, all of it cost
// ~1.2 ms a frame of the thread that limits the frame rate (RTX 3060, 1440p: native 130 fps, FSR 3 Quality 104, TAA
// 106). What each thread owns:
//   T   cur, prev, cur_frame; a slot's buffer, capacity, growth and seq; the cameras; the ring's written end (tq)
//   W   w_cur, w_prev; a slot's records and used bytes; the tables (dedupe, indices, sorted keys), camc, mstat
// T reads or resets W's state only after mvec_sync (W has done everything handed on and is idle): at a new frame, for
// the cameras at the composite. W reads guest memory after T handed the draw on, so T also syncs before it changes
// memory a pending draw reads (mvec_guest_write, exec.c guest_copy_flush) and at the end of each command list.
// SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_THREAD=0 (or fewer than 6 logical processors): no thread, the work is done at the commit.
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../../platform.h"
#include "../../prof.h"
#include "../../rt.h"
#include "../../settings.h"
#include "../maxwell/shader.h"
#include "../output_scale.h"
#include "mvec.h"
#include "record.h"

#define MVEC_SLOTS 5
#define HIST_START (2ull << 20)  // (the Great Plateau uses ~0.3 MB a frame; a fuller frame grows it, losing one frame's motion)
#define DEDUPE 8192  // copies of one (address, size, generation) shared within a frame
#define INDEX 32768  // (key, ordinal) -> record of the previous frame; key -> draws so far in the current frame

typedef struct { uint64_t addr, size, gen, hash; const uint64_t *rows; uint32_t off, epoch; } Dedupe;
typedef struct { uint64_t key; int32_t lo, n; uint32_t epoch; } KeyRange;  // a key's candidates in pkeys (prev_match)
typedef struct { uint64_t key; uint32_t ord, epoch; int32_t rec; } Index;  // (an entry of another epoch: empty)

typedef struct {
    VkBuffer buf;
    VmaAllocation mem;
    uint8_t *ptr;
    uint64_t cap, used, grow, seq;  // seq: the last submission that may read it
    uint64_t frame;                 // the frame it holds (~0: none)
    MvecRec *rec;
    int nrec, cap_rec;
    bool full;
    MvecCamera cam;  // (camera_finish, once the frame is recorded)
} Slot;

static Slot slots[MVEC_SLOTS];
static int cur = -1, prev = -1;  // (T) slots of the frame being recorded and of the one before it
static int w_cur = -1, w_prev = -1;  // (W) the same, of the frame whose draws it is doing
static uint64_t cur_frame = ~0ull;
static Dedupe dedupe[DEDUPE];
static Index prev_index[INDEX], ord_index[INDEX];
// Bumped each frame: the tables' entries of other frames count as empty (clearing ~1 MB of tables took 0.1-0.2 ms a frame)
static uint32_t epoch;
// The previous frame's records sorted by key (pkeys: their keys, pidx: their indices), and which are taken
static uint64_t *pkeys;
static int32_t *pidx;
static bool *ptaken;
static int npk, cap_pk;
// The same by key2 (prev_match_loose), and which records either matching took (by record)
static uint64_t *pkeys2;
static int32_t *pidx2;
static bool *rtaken;
// pkeys' ranges by key: a hash table of at least twice the previous frame's records (the two binary searches a draw took
// ~0.1 ms a frame)
static KeyRange *krange;
static uint32_t krange_mask;

static struct {  // since the last log line
    uint64_t dist_hist[2][6];  // chosen matches' fingerprint distances: [key with one candidate / several][bucket]
    uint64_t not_ordinal;      // matches the draw order alone would have made differently
    // draws with the scene shaders' layout (camera block at slot 3, the object's 3x4 world matrix at slot 4) whose object
    // moved more than 1 cm since its match, matched by fingerprint and as draw order alone would have: mismatches look
    // like jumps (most of the world stands still)
    uint64_t moved_checked, moved_order, moved_fp;
    uint64_t masked;  // blended effects drawn into the reactive mask
    uint64_t loose;   // matched by shaders and vertex buffers (prev_match_loose)
    uint64_t still;   // matched draws whose inputs did not change (mvec_still)
    uint64_t frames, draws, matched, repeated, unmatched, dropped, cb_bytes, inst_bytes, copied, dedupe_hits, max_used, motion,
        cameras;    // frames with a valid camera (camera_finish)
} mstat;
// The frame's slot-3 copies by guest address (the camera block: the one most draws read, camera_finish)
#define CAMC 32
static struct { uint64_t addr; uint32_t off, size, n; } camc[CAMC];
static int ncamc;

static void mat4_mul(const float *a, const float *b, float *o) {  // row-major: o = a * b
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++)
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) o[r * 4 + c] = a[r * 4] * b[c] + a[r * 4 + 1] * b[4 + c] + a[r * 4 + 2] * b[8 + c] + a[r * 4 + 3] * b[12 + c];
}

// Inverse of a 4x4 (row-major), by cofactors; false when singular
static bool mat4_inverse(const float *m, float *o) {
    float a[16];
    a[0] = m[5] * m[10] * m[15] - m[5] * m[11] * m[14] - m[9] * m[6] * m[15] + m[9] * m[7] * m[14] + m[13] * m[6] * m[11] - m[13] * m[7] * m[10];
    a[4] = -m[4] * m[10] * m[15] + m[4] * m[11] * m[14] + m[8] * m[6] * m[15] - m[8] * m[7] * m[14] - m[12] * m[6] * m[11] + m[12] * m[7] * m[10];
    a[8] = m[4] * m[9] * m[15] - m[4] * m[11] * m[13] - m[8] * m[5] * m[15] + m[8] * m[7] * m[13] + m[12] * m[5] * m[11] - m[12] * m[7] * m[9];
    a[12] = -m[4] * m[9] * m[14] + m[4] * m[10] * m[13] + m[8] * m[5] * m[14] - m[8] * m[6] * m[13] - m[12] * m[5] * m[10] + m[12] * m[6] * m[9];
    a[1] = -m[1] * m[10] * m[15] + m[1] * m[11] * m[14] + m[9] * m[2] * m[15] - m[9] * m[3] * m[14] - m[13] * m[2] * m[11] + m[13] * m[3] * m[10];
    a[5] = m[0] * m[10] * m[15] - m[0] * m[11] * m[14] - m[8] * m[2] * m[15] + m[8] * m[3] * m[14] + m[12] * m[2] * m[11] - m[12] * m[3] * m[10];
    a[9] = -m[0] * m[9] * m[15] + m[0] * m[11] * m[13] + m[8] * m[1] * m[15] - m[8] * m[3] * m[13] - m[12] * m[1] * m[11] + m[12] * m[3] * m[9];
    a[13] = m[0] * m[9] * m[14] - m[0] * m[10] * m[13] - m[8] * m[1] * m[14] + m[8] * m[2] * m[13] + m[12] * m[1] * m[10] - m[12] * m[2] * m[9];
    a[2] = m[1] * m[6] * m[15] - m[1] * m[7] * m[14] - m[5] * m[2] * m[15] + m[5] * m[3] * m[14] + m[13] * m[2] * m[7] - m[13] * m[3] * m[6];
    a[6] = -m[0] * m[6] * m[15] + m[0] * m[7] * m[14] + m[4] * m[2] * m[15] - m[4] * m[3] * m[14] - m[12] * m[2] * m[7] + m[12] * m[3] * m[6];
    a[10] = m[0] * m[5] * m[15] - m[0] * m[7] * m[13] - m[4] * m[1] * m[15] + m[4] * m[3] * m[13] + m[12] * m[1] * m[7] - m[12] * m[3] * m[5];
    a[14] = -m[0] * m[5] * m[14] + m[0] * m[6] * m[13] + m[4] * m[1] * m[14] - m[4] * m[2] * m[13] - m[12] * m[1] * m[6] + m[12] * m[2] * m[5];
    a[3] = -m[1] * m[6] * m[11] + m[1] * m[7] * m[10] + m[5] * m[2] * m[11] - m[5] * m[3] * m[10] - m[9] * m[2] * m[7] + m[9] * m[3] * m[6];
    a[7] = m[0] * m[6] * m[11] - m[0] * m[7] * m[10] - m[4] * m[2] * m[11] + m[4] * m[3] * m[10] + m[8] * m[2] * m[7] - m[8] * m[3] * m[6];
    a[11] = -m[0] * m[5] * m[11] + m[0] * m[7] * m[9] + m[4] * m[1] * m[11] - m[4] * m[3] * m[9] - m[8] * m[1] * m[7] + m[8] * m[3] * m[5];
    a[15] = m[0] * m[5] * m[10] - m[0] * m[6] * m[9] - m[4] * m[1] * m[10] + m[4] * m[2] * m[9] + m[8] * m[1] * m[6] - m[8] * m[2] * m[5];
    double det = (double)m[0] * a[0] + (double)m[1] * a[4] + (double)m[2] * a[8] + (double)m[3] * a[12];
    if (fabs(det) < 1e-30) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) o[i] = (float)(a[i] / det);
    return true;
}

// The same in double (mvec_reprojection)
static bool mat4_inverse_d(const double *m, double *o) {
    double a[16];
    a[0] = m[5] * m[10] * m[15] - m[5] * m[11] * m[14] - m[9] * m[6] * m[15] + m[9] * m[7] * m[14] + m[13] * m[6] * m[11] - m[13] * m[7] * m[10];
    a[4] = -m[4] * m[10] * m[15] + m[4] * m[11] * m[14] + m[8] * m[6] * m[15] - m[8] * m[7] * m[14] - m[12] * m[6] * m[11] + m[12] * m[7] * m[10];
    a[8] = m[4] * m[9] * m[15] - m[4] * m[11] * m[13] - m[8] * m[5] * m[15] + m[8] * m[7] * m[13] + m[12] * m[5] * m[11] - m[12] * m[7] * m[9];
    a[12] = -m[4] * m[9] * m[14] + m[4] * m[10] * m[13] + m[8] * m[5] * m[14] - m[8] * m[6] * m[13] - m[12] * m[5] * m[10] + m[12] * m[6] * m[9];
    a[1] = -m[1] * m[10] * m[15] + m[1] * m[11] * m[14] + m[9] * m[2] * m[15] - m[9] * m[3] * m[14] - m[13] * m[2] * m[11] + m[13] * m[3] * m[10];
    a[5] = m[0] * m[10] * m[15] - m[0] * m[11] * m[14] - m[8] * m[2] * m[15] + m[8] * m[3] * m[14] + m[12] * m[2] * m[11] - m[12] * m[3] * m[10];
    a[9] = -m[0] * m[9] * m[15] + m[0] * m[11] * m[13] + m[8] * m[1] * m[15] - m[8] * m[3] * m[13] - m[12] * m[1] * m[11] + m[12] * m[3] * m[9];
    a[13] = m[0] * m[9] * m[14] - m[0] * m[10] * m[13] - m[8] * m[1] * m[14] + m[8] * m[2] * m[13] + m[12] * m[1] * m[10] - m[12] * m[2] * m[9];
    a[2] = m[1] * m[6] * m[15] - m[1] * m[7] * m[14] - m[5] * m[2] * m[15] + m[5] * m[3] * m[14] + m[13] * m[2] * m[7] - m[13] * m[3] * m[6];
    a[6] = -m[0] * m[6] * m[15] + m[0] * m[7] * m[14] + m[4] * m[2] * m[15] - m[4] * m[3] * m[14] - m[12] * m[2] * m[7] + m[12] * m[3] * m[6];
    a[10] = m[0] * m[5] * m[15] - m[0] * m[7] * m[13] - m[4] * m[1] * m[15] + m[4] * m[3] * m[13] + m[12] * m[1] * m[7] - m[12] * m[3] * m[5];
    a[14] = -m[0] * m[5] * m[14] + m[0] * m[6] * m[13] + m[4] * m[1] * m[14] - m[4] * m[2] * m[13] - m[12] * m[1] * m[6] + m[12] * m[2] * m[5];
    a[3] = -m[1] * m[6] * m[11] + m[1] * m[7] * m[10] + m[5] * m[2] * m[11] - m[5] * m[3] * m[10] - m[9] * m[2] * m[7] + m[9] * m[3] * m[6];
    a[7] = m[0] * m[6] * m[11] - m[0] * m[7] * m[10] - m[4] * m[2] * m[11] + m[4] * m[3] * m[10] + m[8] * m[2] * m[7] - m[8] * m[3] * m[6];
    a[11] = -m[0] * m[5] * m[11] + m[0] * m[7] * m[9] + m[4] * m[1] * m[11] - m[4] * m[3] * m[9] - m[8] * m[1] * m[7] + m[8] * m[3] * m[5];
    a[15] = m[0] * m[5] * m[10] - m[0] * m[6] * m[9] - m[4] * m[1] * m[10] + m[4] * m[2] * m[9] + m[8] * m[1] * m[6] - m[8] * m[2] * m[5];
    double det = m[0] * a[0] + m[1] * a[4] + m[2] * a[8] + m[3] * a[12];
    if (fabs(det) < 1e-30) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) o[i] = a[i] / det;
    return true;
}

// Whether a camera block's view and projection look like the world camera: a rigid view, and a perspective projection
// with the world camera's field of view and aspect (rt_world_projection; 2%: the field of view can ease between the
// frame that made the block and the last matrix) and (0, 0, -1, 0) as its last row. Its other entries are left free:
// the near plane moves, and an offset (the jitter) may be in [0][2] / [1][2].
static bool camera_plausible(const MvecCamera *c) {
    for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
        const float *a = &c->view[r * 4];
        if (fabsf(a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1] + a[2] * a[2] - 1) > 0.01f) return false;
        for (int q = r + 1; q < 3; q++) {
            const float *b = &c->view[q * 4];
            if (fabsf(a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]) > 0.01f) return false;
        }
    }
    const float *p = c->proj;
    if (p[12] != 0 || p[13] != 0 || p[14] != -1 || p[15] != 0 || p[1] != 0 || p[4] != 0) return false;
    float w[4];
    rt_world_projection(w);
    if (w[0] <= 0 || w[1] <= 0) return false;
    return fabsf(p[5] * w[0] - 1) < 0.02f && fabsf(p[0] * w[0] * w[1] - 1) < 0.02f;
}

// A frame's camera, from its camera block's copy in the slot's history (the block most of the frame's draws so far
// read); false when there is none or it fails camera_plausible
static bool camera_compute(Slot *s, MvecCamera *c) {
    c->valid = false;
    int best = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < ncamc; i++) if (best < 0 || camc[i].n > camc[best].n) best = i;
    if (best < 0 || camc[best].size < 11 * 16) return false;
    float rows[11 * 4];
    memcpy(rows, s->ptr + camc[best].off, sizeof rows);  // (write-combined memory: one read of 176 bytes)
    memcpy(c->view, rows, 12 * 4);
    memcpy(c->proj, rows + 7 * 4, 16 * 4);
    float v4[16];
    memcpy(v4, c->view, 12 * 4);
    v4[12] = v4[13] = v4[14] = 0, v4[15] = 1;
    mat4_mul(c->proj, v4, c->vp);
    static bool warned;
    if (!camera_plausible(c) || !mat4_inverse(c->vp, c->inv_vp)) {
        if (!warned) LOG("[mvec] frame %llu: the scene camera block (%llx, %u draws) is not the world camera's view and "
                         "projection: no camera vectors\n", (unsigned long long)s->frame, (unsigned long long)camc[best].addr,
                         camc[best].n);
        warned = true;
        return false;
    }
    c->valid = true;
    return true;
}

// The finished frame's camera (when the next frame begins)
static void camera_finish(Slot *s) {
    if (camera_compute(s, &s->cam)) mstat.cameras++;
    ncamc = 0;
}


uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);
// Whether frame generation interpolates with these vectors: only with SAVAGEWIND_FG_OBJECT_VECTORS=1. By default it
// takes the camera's and Link's box (exec.c fg_mv.frag): on grass, trees and other instanced foliage some draws match
// the wrong draw of the previous frame and get motion they don't have, and the generated frames broke them up (a
// flicker in the grass around Link while the camera turned, 2026-10-28 captures); making them also cost ~1.5-2 ms of
// CPU and ~0.6 ms of GPU a frame (RTX 3060, 1440p) with frame generation alone.
bool mvec_for_framegen(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG_OBJECT_VECTORS") && atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG_OBJECT_VECTORS")) != 0 &&
                     !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FG_CAMERA_VECTORS");
    return on;
}

// On with Video > Anti-aliasing TAA or Upscaler FSR 3 (output_scale.h rt_temporal), or frame generation when it takes
// them (mvec_for_framegen), read once a presented frame so a frame is all on or all off;
// SAVAGEWIND_MVEC=1 / 0 turns it on or off whatever the setting.
bool mvec_enabled(void) {
    static int env = -2;
    if (env == -2) env = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC") ? atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC")) != 0 : -1;
    if (env >= 0) return env;
    static uint64_t at = ~0ull;
    static bool on;
    uint64_t f = renderer_present_count();
    extern volatile int g_fg_want;  // (vulkan/exec.c: frame generation interpolates with them too)
    if (f != at) at = f, on = rt_temporal() || (g_fg_want && mvec_for_framegen());
    return on;
}

static uint64_t mix(uint64_t h, uint64_t v) { return mvec_mix(h, v); }

static uint32_t slot_hash(uint64_t key, uint32_t ord) { return (uint32_t)(mix(key, ord) >> 32) & (INDEX - 1); }

static void slot_alloc(Slot *s, uint64_t cap) {
    if (s->buf) {
        vk_wait_seq(s->seq);
        vmaDestroyBuffer(g_vk.vma, s->buf, s->mem);
    }
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = cap,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT |
                                      VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO,
                                  .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    VK_CHECK(vmaCreateBuffer(g_vk.vma, &bi, &ai, &s->buf, &s->mem, &info));
    s->ptr = info.pMappedData;
    s->cap = cap;
}

// SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_LOG=<frames>: the statistics every that many frames (0, the default: none, and the costlier ones,
// the matching checks, are not gathered)
static int log_every(void) {
    static int every = -1;
    if (every < 0) every = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_LOG") ? atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_LOG")) : 0;
    return every;
}
static void log_stats(uint64_t frame) {
    int every = log_every();
    if (every <= 0 || ++mstat.frames < (uint64_t)every) return;
    double f = (double)mstat.frames;
    LOG("[mvec] frame %llu: %.0f scene draws a frame, matched %.1f%% (%.0f with a repeated key, %.1f%% drawn with motion), "
        "unmatched %.0f, %.0f matched without their index buffer, %.0f still, "
        "not recorded %.0f; inputs %.0f KB constants + %.0f KB instance data a frame, %.0f KB copied (%.0f copies "
        "shared); history slot at most %.1f MB used of %.1f; camera found in %.0f%% of the frames; %.1f effects a frame in "
        "the reactive mask\n",
        (unsigned long long)frame, mstat.draws / f, mstat.draws ? 100.0 * mstat.matched / mstat.draws : 0.0, mstat.repeated / f,
        mstat.draws ? 100.0 * mstat.motion / mstat.draws : 0.0, mstat.unmatched / f, mstat.loose / f, mstat.still / f, mstat.dropped / f, mstat.cb_bytes / f / 1024, mstat.inst_bytes / f / 1024, mstat.copied / f / 1024,
        mstat.dedupe_hits / f, mstat.max_used / 1048576.0, cur >= 0 ? slots[cur].cap / 1048576.0 : 0.0,
        100.0 * mstat.cameras / f, mstat.masked / f);
    for (int g = 0; g < 2; g++)
        LOG("[mvec]   fingerprint distances, keys with %s: %.0f < 1e-4, %.0f < 1e-3, %.0f < 0.01, %.0f < 0.05, %.0f < 0.2, "
            "%.0f more%s", g ? "several candidates" : "one candidate", mstat.dist_hist[g][0] / f, mstat.dist_hist[g][1] / f,
            mstat.dist_hist[g][2] / f, mstat.dist_hist[g][3] / f, mstat.dist_hist[g][4] / f, mstat.dist_hist[g][5] / f,
            g ? "" : "\n");
    LOG("; %.0f a frame matched differently than by draw order\n", mstat.not_ordinal / f);
    LOG("[mvec]   of %.0f draws with a world matrix, moved > 1 cm: %.1f matched by fingerprint (%.1f by draw order)\n",
        mstat.moved_checked / f, mstat.moved_fp / f, mstat.moved_order / f);
    memset(&mstat, 0, sizeof mstat);
}

typedef struct { uint64_t key; int32_t idx; } KeyIdx;
static KeyIdx *ksort, *ksort2;
// The previous frame's records' indices sorted by a key (then by draw order), into keys / idx: a radix sort, a byte a
// pass (stable: a key's records stay in draw order); qsort took ~0.15 ms a frame for each of the two orders
static void sort_prev_by(const Slot *p, bool second, uint64_t *keys, int32_t *idx) {
    KeyIdx *a = ksort, *b = ksort2;
    for (int i = 0; i < npk; i++) a[i] = (KeyIdx){second ? p->rec[i].key2 : p->rec[i].key, i};
    for (int sh = 0; sh < 64; sh += 8) {
        uint32_t cnt[257] = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < npk; i++) cnt[((a[i].key >> sh) & 0xFF) + 1]++;
        for (int c = 0; c < 256; c++) cnt[c + 1] += cnt[c];
        for (int i = 0; i < npk; i++) b[cnt[(a[i].key >> sh) & 0xFF]++] = a[i];
        KeyIdx *t = a; a = b, b = t;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < npk; i++) keys[i] = a[i].key, idx[i] = a[i].idx;
}

// SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_MATCH=order: (testing) match by draw order alone
static bool match_by_order(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_MATCH") && !strcmp(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_MATCH"), "order");
    return on;
}

static int32_t prev_match(MvecRec *r);

// ---- the ring of draws (T writes, W reads) and of their results (W writes, the recorder reads)
// The ring is 64-byte cells: a draw is its head, then its constant buffers four to a cell, then its instanced streams
// two to a cell; a new frame is a head alone. Each thread's counters sit in a cache line of their own, and T looks at
// W's only when its own copy says the ring is full or a draw is pending: with q_head and q_done in one line, and a
// field of the slot written by T for every draw next to the ones W writes, the line went from core to core twice a draw.
#define MQ 8192    // cells T may be ahead of W (a draw: 2-3)
#define RES 16384  // results kept: draws T may be ahead of the recorder (mvec_draw_commit drains it before that)
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
#define RELAX() __builtin_ia32_pause()
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
#define RELAX() __asm__ volatile("yield")
#else
#define RELAX() ((void)0)
#endif
typedef union { MvecHead h; MvecCb cb[4]; MvecInst in[2]; } Cell;
static Cell *mq;
static uint32_t (*res)[MVEC_PUSH / 4];
static _Alignas(64) struct { _Atomic uint32_t v; char pad[60]; } q_head;  // cells published by T
static _Alignas(64) struct { _Atomic uint32_t cells, draws; char pad[56]; } q_done;  // done by W
static _Alignas(64) struct { _Atomic uint32_t v; char pad[60]; } r_seen;  // the last draw the recorder resolved
static _Alignas(64) struct {  // T's own
    uint32_t w;      // cells handed on so far
    uint32_t dw;     // draws handed on so far: the next one's number
    uint32_t done;   // q_done.cells when T last looked
    uint64_t seq;    // the submission the frame's slots were last marked with (mvec_draw_commit)
    MvecDrawIn in;   // the draw being described (mvec_draw_begin)
    char pad[64];
} tq;
static uint32_t w_dseq;  // (W) draws done so far
static int threaded = -1;  // 1: W does the work, 0: T at the commit
static pthread_mutex_t q_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t q_cv = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static _Atomic int q_asleep;
// W spins this long for the next draw before it sleeps (T hands one on every ~2 us in a scene pass, and a sleeping W
// costs T a wake-up syscall)
static uint64_t q_spin_ns = 200000;

static uint32_t cells_of(const MvecHead *h) { return 1u + (h->ncb + 3u) / 4 + (h->ninst + 1u) / 2; }

static void w_frame(const MvecHead *h);
static void w_draw(const MvecDrawIn *d, uint32_t *pc);
// W: the entry at cell c; how many cells it is
static uint32_t w_process(uint32_t c) {
    const MvecHead *h = &mq[c & (MQ - 1)].h;
    if (h->kind) { w_frame(h); return 1; }
    MvecDrawIn d;
    d.h = *h;
    uint32_t n = 1;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < d.h.ncb; k += 4, n++) memcpy(&d.cb[k], &mq[(c + n) & (MQ - 1)], sizeof(Cell));
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < d.h.ninst; k += 2, n++) memcpy(&d.in[k], &mq[(c + n) & (MQ - 1)], sizeof(Cell));
    w_draw(&d, res[w_dseq & (RES - 1)]);
    w_dseq++;
    return n;
}

static void *w_run(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    prof_thread_name("mvec");
    uint32_t t = 0;
    for (;;) {
        uint32_t h = atomic_load_explicit(&q_head.v, memory_order_acquire);
        if (h == t) {
            uint64_t t0 = plat_now_ns();
            for (unsigned i = 1; h == t; i++) {
                RELAX();
                h = atomic_load_explicit(&q_head.v, memory_order_acquire);
                if (!(i & 63) && plat_now_ns() - t0 > q_spin_ns) break;
            }
        }
        if (h == t) {
            pthread_mutex_lock(&q_mu);
            atomic_store_explicit(&q_asleep, 1, memory_order_seq_cst);
            while ((h = atomic_load_explicit(&q_head.v, memory_order_seq_cst)) == t) pthread_cond_wait(&q_cv, &q_mu);
            atomic_store_explicit(&q_asleep, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&q_mu);
        }
        while (t != h) {
            t += w_process(t);
            atomic_store_explicit(&q_done.draws, w_dseq, memory_order_release);
            atomic_store_explicit(&q_done.cells, t, memory_order_release);
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void q_init(void) {
    mq = calloc(MQ, sizeof *mq);
    res = calloc(RES, sizeof *res);
    if (!mq || !res) FATAL("[mvec] out of memory\n");
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_SPIN")) q_spin_ns = (uint64_t)atol(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_SPIN")) * 1000;
    const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_THREAD");
    threaded = 0;
    if (e ? atoi(e) != 0 : plat_cpu_count() >= 6) {
        pthread_t th;
        int rc = pthread_create(&th, NULL, w_run, NULL);
        if (rc) LOG("[mvec] thread: could not start (error %d): the work stays on the queue thread\n", rc);
        else pthread_detach(th), threaded = 1;
    }
    LOG("[mvec] motion vectors: %s\n", threaded ? "on a thread of their own" : "on the queue thread");
}

// T: hands tq.in on (its head, and the buffers and streams it counts)
static void q_put(void) {
    if (threaded < 0) q_init();
    const MvecDrawIn *d = &tq.in;
    uint32_t n = cells_of(&d->h);
    while (tq.w + n - tq.done > MQ) {  // (W is behind by the whole ring: a short wait)
        tq.done = atomic_load_explicit(&q_done.cells, memory_order_acquire);
        if (tq.w + n - tq.done > MQ) RELAX();
    }
    uint32_t c = tq.w;
    mq[c++ & (MQ - 1)].h = d->h;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < d->h.ncb; k += 4) memcpy(&mq[c++ & (MQ - 1)], &d->cb[k], sizeof(Cell));
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < d->h.ninst; k += 2) memcpy(&mq[c++ & (MQ - 1)], &d->in[k], sizeof(Cell));
    if (!threaded) {
        tq.w += w_process(tq.w);
        tq.done = tq.w;
        atomic_store_explicit(&q_done.draws, w_dseq, memory_order_release);
        atomic_store_explicit(&q_done.cells, tq.w, memory_order_release);
        return;
    }
    tq.w = c;
    atomic_store_explicit(&q_head.v, c, memory_order_seq_cst);
    if (atomic_load_explicit(&q_asleep, memory_order_seq_cst)) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&q_mu);
        pthread_cond_signal(&q_cv);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&q_mu);
    }
}

void mvec_sync(void) {
    if (threaded <= 0 || tq.done == tq.w) return;
    if ((tq.done = atomic_load_explicit(&q_done.cells, memory_order_acquire)) == tq.w) return;
    SW_ZONE("mvec sync");
    while (atomic_load_explicit(&q_done.cells, memory_order_acquire) != tq.w) RELAX();
    tq.done = tq.w;
}

void mvec_guest_write(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    if (threaded <= 0 || tq.done == tq.w) return;
    tq.done = atomic_load_explicit(&q_done.cells, memory_order_acquire);
    for (uint32_t i = tq.done; i != tq.w;) {
        const MvecHead *h = &mq[i & (MQ - 1)].h;
        uint32_t c = i + 1;
        i += cells_of(h);
        if (h->kind) continue;
        bool hit = false;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < h->ncb && !hit; k++) {
            const MvecCb *b = &mq[(c + k / 4) & (MQ - 1)].cb[k & 3];
            hit = b->addr < hi && lo < b->addr + b->size;
        }
        c += (h->ncb + 3u) / 4;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < h->ninst && !hit; k++) {
            const MvecInst *m = &mq[(c + k / 2) & (MQ - 1)].in[k & 1];
            hit = m->addr < hi && lo < m->addr + (m->size ? m->size : 8ull << 20);
        }
        if (hit) { mvec_sync(); return; }
    }
}

void mvec_resolve(uint32_t seq, uint32_t pc[MVEC_PUSH / 4]) {
    if ((int32_t)(atomic_load_explicit(&q_done.draws, memory_order_acquire) - seq) <= 0) {
        SW_ZONE("mvec resolve wait");
        while ((int32_t)(atomic_load_explicit(&q_done.draws, memory_order_acquire) - seq) <= 0) RELAX();
    }
    memcpy(pc, res[seq & (RES - 1)], MVEC_PUSH);
    atomic_store_explicit(&r_seen.v, seq, memory_order_relaxed);
}

// T: a new presented frame: the slot it records into (W idle: its state of the last frame is read and reset here)
static void frame_begin(uint64_t frame) {
    mvec_sync();
    if (cur >= 0) camera_finish(&slots[cur]);
    if (cur >= 0) {
        if (slots[cur].used > mstat.max_used) mstat.max_used = slots[cur].used;
        log_stats(frame);
    }
    int last = cur;
    cur = (int)(frame % MVEC_SLOTS);
    cur_frame = frame;
    Slot *s = &slots[cur];
    vk_wait_seq(s->seq);  // (MVEC_SLOTS frames ago: long done in practice)
    if (!s->buf || s->grow > s->cap) slot_alloc(s, s->grow > HIST_START ? s->grow : HIST_START);
    s->used = 0;
    s->nrec = 0;
    s->full = false;
    s->frame = frame;
    prev = last >= 0 && slots[last].frame + 1 == frame ? last : -1;
    tq.seq = ~0ull;
    tq.in.h = (MvecHead){.kind = 1, .inst = (uint32_t)cur, .base_inst = (uint32_t)prev};
    q_put();
}

// W: the new frame's index of the previous frame's records
static void w_frame(const MvecHead *h) {
    w_cur = (int)h->inst, w_prev = (int)h->base_inst;
    if (++epoch == 0) {  // (wrapped: entries 2^32 frames old would look current)
        memset(dedupe, 0, sizeof dedupe), memset(prev_index, 0, sizeof prev_index), memset(ord_index, 0, sizeof ord_index);
        if (krange) memset(krange, 0, (krange_mask + 1) * sizeof *krange);
        epoch = 1;
    }
    if (w_prev < 0) return;
    if (match_by_order() || log_every() > 0)  // (key, ordinal) -> record: draw-order matching and its statistics only
        for (int i = 0; i < slots[w_prev].nrec; i++) {
            const MvecRec *r = &slots[w_prev].rec[i];
            uint32_t h = slot_hash(r->key, r->ord);
            while (prev_index[h].epoch == epoch) h = (h + 1) & (INDEX - 1);
            prev_index[h] = (Index){r->key, r->ord, epoch, i};
        }
    npk = slots[w_prev].nrec;  // (by key: each key's candidates together, in draw order)
    if (npk > cap_pk) {
        cap_pk = npk * 2;
        pkeys = realloc(pkeys, (size_t)cap_pk * sizeof *pkeys);
        pidx = realloc(pidx, (size_t)cap_pk * sizeof *pidx);
        ptaken = realloc(ptaken, (size_t)cap_pk * sizeof *ptaken);
        pkeys2 = realloc(pkeys2, (size_t)cap_pk * sizeof *pkeys2);
        pidx2 = realloc(pidx2, (size_t)cap_pk * sizeof *pidx2);
        rtaken = realloc(rtaken, (size_t)cap_pk * sizeof *rtaken);
        ksort = realloc(ksort, (size_t)cap_pk * sizeof *ksort);
        ksort2 = realloc(ksort2, (size_t)cap_pk * sizeof *ksort2);
    }
    sort_prev_by(&slots[w_prev], false, pkeys, pidx);
    uint32_t want = 1024;
    while (want < 2u * (uint32_t)npk) want *= 2;
    if (want > krange_mask + 1) {
        free(krange);
        krange = calloc(want, sizeof *krange);
        krange_mask = want - 1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < npk;) {
        int j = i + 1;
        while (j < npk && pkeys[j] == pkeys[i]) j++;
        uint32_t h = (uint32_t)(pkeys[i] >> 40) & krange_mask;
        while (krange[h].epoch == epoch) h = (h + 1) & krange_mask;
        krange[h] = (KeyRange){pkeys[i], i, j - i, epoch};
        i = j;
    }
    memset(ptaken, 0, (size_t)npk * sizeof *ptaken);
    sort_prev_by(&slots[w_prev], true, pkeys2, pidx2);
    memset(rtaken, 0, (size_t)npk * sizeof *rtaken);
}

// How far apart two fingerprints are: the mean relative difference of their values (0 equal, 1 unrelated); values
// that are no finite floats (integers, flags) count as equal or different by their bits
static float fingerprint_distance(const MvecRec *a, const MvecRec *b) {
    int n = a->nfeat < b->nfeat ? a->nfeat : b->nfeat;
    if (!n || a->nfeat != b->nfeat) return 1;
    if (!memcmp(a->feat, b->feat, (size_t)n * sizeof a->feat[0])) return 0;  // (a still object: most draws)
    float d = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        float x = a->feat[i], y = b->feat[i];
        if (!isfinite(x) || !isfinite(y)) { d += memcmp(&x, &y, 4) ? 1.0f : 0.0f; continue; }
        float s = fabsf(x) + fabsf(y);
        d += s > 1e-6f ? fabsf(x - y) / s : 0.0f;
    }
    return d / (float)n;
}

// The previous frame's record for a draw: among the ones with its key and not taken yet, the nearest fingerprint.
// Culling shifts a key's draws by a few places, not hundreds: the search starts at the draw's own place in the key's
// order and looks MATCH_WINDOW places either way (a key can have hundreds of draws: comparing all of them took ~40 us a
// draw), and stops at an identical fingerprint (a still object, the most common case).
#define MATCH_WINDOW 24
static int32_t prev_match(MvecRec *r) {
    if (w_prev < 0 || !npk) return -1;
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)(r->key >> 40) & krange_mask;
    while (krange[h].epoch == epoch && krange[h].key != r->key) h = (h + 1) & krange_mask;
    if (krange[h].epoch != epoch) return -1;
    int lo = krange[h].lo, end = lo + krange[h].n;  // (end: the key's last candidate + 1)
    int ncand = end - lo, at = lo + (int)r->ord;
    if (!ncand) return -1;
    if (at >= end) at = end - 1;
    int best = -1;
    float bd = 2;
    for (int k = 0; k <= 2 * MATCH_WINDOW && bd > 0; k++) {  // (at, at + 1, at - 1, at + 2, ...)
        int i = at + (k & 1 ? (k + 1) / 2 : -(k / 2));
        if (i < lo || i >= end || ptaken[i] || rtaken[pidx[i]]) continue;
        if (slots[w_prev].rec[pidx[i]].ninst != r->ninst) continue;
        float d = fingerprint_distance(r, &slots[w_prev].rec[pidx[i]]);
        if (d < bd) bd = d, best = i;
    }
    if (best < 0) return -1;
    static float limit = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_MATCH_LIMIT: the largest fingerprint distance of a match (default 0.2)
    if (limit < 0) limit = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_MATCH_LIMIT") ? (float)atof(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_MATCH_LIMIT")) : 0.2f;
    float max_d = r->ninst ? fminf(limit, 0.05f) : limit;
    if (bd >= max_d) { mstat.dist_hist[ncand > 1][5]++; return -1; }  // (a new object: the camera's vector)
    ptaken[best] = true;
    rtaken[pidx[best]] = true;
    r->dist = bd;
    static const float edges[5] = {1e-4f, 1e-3f, 0.01f, 0.05f, 0.2f};
    int bucket = 0;
    while (bucket < 5 && bd >= edges[bucket]) bucket++;
    mstat.dist_hist[ncand > 1][bucket]++;
    return pidx[best];
}

// A draw whose key the previous frame did not have: one of the previous frame's draws with its shaders and vertex
// buffers and an equal fingerprint (under 0.01). BOTW draws its distant trees from one vertex pool through index
// lists it writes anew each frame, at other addresses and lengths: matched by key, they never were, and took the
// camera's motion alone, not their swaying (temporal anti-aliasing smeared them, a shimmer on every distant tree).
// Their vertices hold where they are; the motion is in the constants, which any of them gives the same.
static int32_t prev_match_loose(MvecRec *r) {
    if (w_prev < 0 || !npk) return -1;
    int lo = 0, hi = npk;
    while (lo < hi) { int m = (lo + hi) / 2; if (pkeys2[m] < r->key2) lo = m + 1; else hi = m; }
    int best = -1;
    float bd = 0.01f;
    for (int i = lo, n = 0; i < npk && pkeys2[i] == r->key2 && n < 64 && bd > 0; i++, n++) {
        if (rtaken[pidx2[i]]) continue;
        float d = fingerprint_distance(r, &slots[w_prev].rec[pidx2[i]]);
        if (d < bd) bd = d, best = i;
    }
    if (best < 0) return -1;
    rtaken[pidx2[best]] = true;
    r->dist = bd;
    mstat.loose++;
    return pidx2[best];
}

static int32_t prev_lookup(uint64_t key, uint32_t ord) {
    if (w_prev < 0) return -1;
    for (uint32_t h = slot_hash(key, ord);; h = (h + 1) & (INDEX - 1)) {
        if (prev_index[h].epoch != epoch) return -1;
        if (prev_index[h].key == key && prev_index[h].ord == ord) return prev_index[h].rec;
    }
}

// The ordinal of this draw among the frame's draws with its key (counts kept in ord_index, ord = count so far)
static uint32_t next_ordinal(uint64_t key) {
    for (uint32_t h = slot_hash(key, 0);; h = (h + 1) & (INDEX - 1)) {
        if (ord_index[h].epoch != epoch) { ord_index[h] = (Index){key, 1, epoch, 0}; return 0; }
        if (ord_index[h].key == key) return ord_index[h].ord++;
    }
}

// A hash of n bytes (w_draw: equal inputs, a draw that stood still)
static uint64_t content_hash(const uint8_t *p, uint64_t n) {
    uint64_t h = n * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull, v;
    for (; n >= 8; p += 8, n -= 8) memcpy(&v, p, 8), h = (h ^ v) * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull, h ^= h >> 32;
    if (n) v = 0, memcpy(&v, p, n), h = (h ^ v) * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull, h ^= h >> 32;
    return h;
}

// The hash of a constant buffer's vec4s that a vertex shader reads (rows: ShaderInfo cbuf_rows; NULL: all of them).
// The camera block's (camera: slot 3) matrices, vec4s 0-13, and near and far planes (vec4 14's .xy) change with the
// camera, which the fallback's vectors follow: left out. Its other values (time, wind) move things.
static uint64_t cb_hash(const uint8_t *p, uint64_t size, const uint64_t *rows, bool camera) {
    if (!rows) return camera ? (size > 58 * 4 ? content_hash(p + 58 * 4, size - 58 * 4) : 0) : content_hash(p, size);
    uint64_t h = 0, n = size / 16, a, b;
    for (uint32_t w = 0; w < 4; w++)
        for (uint64_t m = rows[w]; m; m &= m - 1) {
            uint32_t r = w * 64 + (uint32_t)__builtin_ctzll(m);
            if (r >= n) break;
            if (camera && r < 14) continue;
            memcpy(&a, p + r * 16, 8), memcpy(&b, p + r * 16 + 8, 8);
            if (camera && r == 14) a = 0;
            h = mix(mix(h, a ^ r), b);
        }
    return h;
}

// Copies [addr, addr + size) of guest memory into the current slot (shared with an earlier copy of the same range in
// the same generation); UINT32_MAX when the slot is full. *hash: cb_hash's.
static uint32_t copy_in(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t gen, bool share, const uint64_t *rows, bool camera, uint64_t *hash) {
    Slot *s = &slots[w_cur];
    uint32_t h = (uint32_t)(mix(mix(addr, size), gen) >> 40) & (DEDUPE - 1);
    if (share && dedupe[h].epoch == epoch && dedupe[h].addr == addr && dedupe[h].size == size && dedupe[h].gen == gen) {
        mstat.dedupe_hits++;
```
