```c
        *hash = dedupe[h].rows == rows ? dedupe[h].hash : cb_hash((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, rows, camera);
        return dedupe[h].off;
    }
    uint64_t align = g_vk.props.limits.minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment;
    if (align < 16) align = 16;
    uint64_t off = (s->used + align - 1) & ~(align - 1);
    if (off + size > s->cap) {
        s->full = true;
        uint64_t want = (off + size) * 2;
        if (want > s->grow) s->grow = want;
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    memcpy(s->ptr + off, (const void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size);
    *hash = cb_hash((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, rows, camera);
    mstat.copied += size;
    s->used = off + size;
    if (share) dedupe[h] = (Dedupe){addr, size, gen, *hash, rows, (uint32_t)off, epoch};
    return (uint32_t)off;
}

MvecDrawIn *mvec_draw_begin(uint64_t frame) {
    if (!mvec_enabled()) return NULL;
    if (frame != cur_frame) frame_begin(frame);
    tq.in.h.kind = 0;
    return &tq.in;
}

uint32_t mvec_draw_commit(void) {
    // (the history of both frames is read by this frame's draws: kept until their submission is done)
    uint64_t sq = vk_pending_seq();
    if (sq != tq.seq) {
        tq.seq = sq;
        slots[cur].seq = sq;
        if (prev >= 0) slots[prev].seq = sq;
    }
    // the recorder still has to read the results of draws up to RES back: never in practice (it is a few hundred
    // draws behind), but a result overwritten would be another draw's history offsets (looked at now and then: the
    // recorder writes that line for every draw)
    if (!(tq.dw & 255) && tq.dw - atomic_load_explicit(&r_seen.v, memory_order_relaxed) > RES - 512) {
        rec_drain();
        atomic_store_explicit(&r_seen.v, tq.dw, memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    uint32_t seq = tq.dw++;
    q_put();
    return seq;
}

// W: one draw: its record, its copies, its match, and its push constants (pc: mflag, then the match's constant buffer
// copies in the previous frame's history; all zero: no vector of its own)
static void w_draw(const MvecDrawIn *d, uint32_t *pc) {
    memset(pc, 0, MVEC_PUSH);
    if (w_cur < 0) return;
    Slot *s = &slots[w_cur];
    mstat.draws++;
    if (s->full) { mstat.dropped++; return; }
    if (s->nrec == s->cap_rec) {
        s->cap_rec = s->cap_rec ? s->cap_rec * 2 : 4096;
        s->rec = realloc(s->rec, (size_t)s->cap_rec * sizeof *s->rec);
    }
    MvecRec *r = &s->rec[s->nrec];
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    const ShaderInfo *vi = d->h.vi;
    uint64_t key = mix(mix(d->h.pkey, d->h.iaddr), ((uint64_t)d->h.count << 32) | d->h.first);
    key = mix(mix(key, (uint32_t)d->h.base_vertex), d->h.skey);
    uint64_t key2 = mix(mix(d->h.pkey, ~0ull), d->h.skey);
    uint64_t used_before = s->used;
    const MvecInst *inst0 = NULL;  // (the first instanced stream copied)
    for (int i = 0; i < d->h.ninst && i < MVEC_INST; i++) {
        const MvecInst *m = &d->in[i];
        uint64_t n = (d->h.base_inst + d->h.inst + m->divisor - 1) / m->divisor, size = n * m->stride;
        if (size > m->size && m->size) size = m->size;
        if (!size || size > (8u << 20)) continue;
        uint64_t ch;
        uint32_t off = copy_in(m->addr, size, d->h.gen, false, NULL, false, &ch);  // (rewritten in place: never shared across draws)
        if (off == UINT32_MAX) goto full;
        r->hash = mix(r->hash, ch);
        if (!inst0) inst0 = m;
        r->inst_stream[r->ninst] = (uint8_t)m->index;
        r->inst_off[r->ninst] = off;
        r->inst_size[r->ninst++] = (uint32_t)size;
        mstat.inst_bytes += size;
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < d->h.ncb && r->ncb < MVEC_CB; k++) {
        if (!d->cb[k].addr || !d->cb[k].size) continue;
        uint64_t ch;
        int sl = d->cb[k].slot;  // (the vec4s the vertex shader reads of it; NULL: any)
        const uint64_t *rows = (vi->cbuf_rows_all >> sl) & 1 ? NULL : vi->cbuf_rows[sl];
        uint32_t off = copy_in(d->cb[k].addr, d->cb[k].size, d->h.gen, true, rows, sl == 3, &ch);
        if (off == UINT32_MAX) goto full;
        r->hash = mix(r->hash, mix(d->cb[k].slot, ch));
        if (d->cb[k].slot == 3) {  // (camera block candidates: camera_finish)
            int i = 0;
            while (i < ncamc && camc[i].addr != d->cb[k].addr) i++;
            if (i == ncamc && ncamc < CAMC) camc[ncamc++] = (typeof(camc[0])){d->cb[k].addr, off, (uint32_t)d->cb[k].size, 0};
            if (i < ncamc) camc[i].n++;
        }
        r->cb_slot[r->ncb] = d->cb[k].slot;
        r->cb_off[r->ncb] = off;
        r->cb_size[r->ncb++] = (uint32_t)d->cb[k].size;
        mstat.cb_bytes += d->cb[k].size;
    }
    // the fingerprint, from guest memory as it is now; not from the camera block (slot 3), which the scene's draws share:
    // it tells no draw apart, and as the camera moves no draw's fingerprint was equal to its match's any more, so the
    // search never stopped early (0.9 ms a frame of matching)
    for (int k = 0; k < d->h.ncb && r->nfeat + 12 <= MVEC_FEAT; k++) {
        if (!d->cb[k].addr || d->cb[k].size < 48 || d->cb[k].slot == 3) continue;
        memcpy(&r->feat[r->nfeat], (const void *)(uintptr_t)d->cb[k].addr, 48);
        r->nfeat += 12;
    }
    if (r->ninst > 0 && r->nfeat + 4 <= MVEC_FEAT) {
        const MvecInst *m = inst0;
        uint64_t ioff = m->divisor ? (uint64_t)(d->h.base_inst / m->divisor) * m->stride : 0;
        if (m->addr && ioff + 16 <= r->inst_size[0]) {
            uint64_t avail = r->inst_size[0] - ioff;
            int nf = (int)(avail / 4);
            if (nf > 12) nf = 12;
            if (r->nfeat + nf > MVEC_FEAT) nf = MVEC_FEAT - r->nfeat;
            memcpy(&r->feat[r->nfeat], (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)m->addr + ioff, (size_t)nf * 4);
            r->nfeat += (uint8_t)nf;
        }
    }
    r->key = key;
    r->key2 = key2;
    r->ord = next_ordinal(key);
    bool by_order = match_by_order();
    r->prev = by_order ? prev_lookup(key, r->ord) : prev_match(r);
    static int loose = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_LOOSE=0: (testing) no prev_match_loose
    if (loose < 0) loose = !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_LOOSE") || atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_LOOSE")) != 0;
    if (r->prev < 0 && !by_order && loose && !r->ninst) r->prev = prev_match_loose(r);
    if (log_every() > 0) {  // (statistics) the object's world position (slot 4's translation) against each matching's previous draw
        int32_t po = prev_lookup(key, r->ord), pf = by_order ? -1 : r->prev;
        if (r->nfeat >= 12 && r->cb_slot[0] == 3 && r->cb_slot[1] == 4 && po >= 0 && pf >= 0) {
            mstat.moved_checked++;
            const float *t = &r->feat[0];
            for (int m = 0; m < 2; m++) {
                const MvecRec *q = &slots[w_prev].rec[m ? pf : po];
                if (q->nfeat < 12) continue;
                float dx = t[3] - q->feat[3], dy = t[7] - q->feat[7], dz = t[11] - q->feat[11];
                if (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz > 1e-4f) { if (m) mstat.moved_fp++; else mstat.moved_order++; }
            }
        }
    }
    if (log_every() > 0 && r->prev >= 0 && r->prev != prev_lookup(key, r->ord)) mstat.not_ordinal++;
    if (r->ord) mstat.repeated++;
    if (r->prev >= 0) mstat.matched++;
    else mstat.unmatched++;
    s->nrec++;
    if (r->prev < 0) return;
    const MvecRec *p = &slots[w_prev].rec[r->prev];
    // its inputs are its match's (the hash): it stood still, and the camera's motion is its vector (most of the world
    // stands still, and a vertex shader run twice costs the GPU: ~5% fps when every matched draw did)
    static int still = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_STILL=0: (testing) every matched draw runs its vertex shader twice
    if (still < 0) still = !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_STILL") || atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_STILL")) != 0;
    if (still && p->hash == r->hash) { mstat.still++; return; }
    for (int k = 0; k < r->ncb; k++) {
        int j = -1;
        for (int m = 0; m < p->ncb; m++) if (p->cb_slot[m] == r->cb_slot[k]) j = m;
        if (j < 0) { memset(pc, 0, MVEC_PUSH); return; }  // (the match lacks a buffer this draw reads)
        int sl = r->cb_slot[k] - 3;
        pc[1 + sl] = p->cb_off[j] / 16;
        pc[15 + sl] = (p->cb_size[j] + 15) / 16;
    }
    pc[0] = 1;
    mstat.motion++;
    return;
full:
    s->used = used_before;
    mstat.dropped++;
}

void mvec_masked(void) { mstat.masked++; }

VkDescriptorBufferInfo mvec_history_info(void) {
    int i = prev >= 0 ? prev : cur;
    return (VkDescriptorBufferInfo){i >= 0 ? slots[i].buf : VK_NULL_HANDLE, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE};
}

int mvec_camera_only(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_CAMONLY") ? atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_CAMONLY")) : 0;
    return on;
}

float mvec_view_enabled(void) {
    static float px;
    static bool init;
    if (!init) {  // (a negative value: raw, red = written, green / blue = |x| / |y| times its size)
        init = true;
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_VIEW");
        px = e ? (atof(e) != 0 ? (float)atof(e) : 16.0f) : 0.0f;
    }
    return px;
}

bool mvec_reprojection(float m[16], float jitter[2]) {
    if (cur < 0 || prev < 0 || !slots[prev].cam.valid) return false;
    mvec_sync();  // (the frame's camera block copies: W's)
    MvecCamera now;
    if (!camera_compute(&slots[cur], &now)) return false;
    // prev proj * (prev view * inverse of this view) * inverse of this proj, in double: the views hold the camera's
    // world position (thousands of meters), and the product of float matrices with an inverse lost the far plane's
    // precision: the sky's and the distance's camera vectors were wrong by ~1 pixel, in step with the jitter (a sway
    // of the sky, clouds and distant trees under TAA and FSR 3). The rigid views' relative motion cancels the position
    // before anything is rounded.
    const MvecCamera *pc_ = &slots[prev].cam;
    double vp4[16] = {0}, vc4[16] = {0}, rel[16], pp[16], pcur[16], pinv[16], t[16], md[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) vp4[i] = pc_->view[i], vc4[i] = now.view[i];
    vp4[15] = vc4[15] = 1;
    double vci[16] = {0};  // (the inverse of a rigid view: transposed rotation, minus it times the translation)
    for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) vci[r * 4 + c] = vc4[c * 4 + r];
        vci[r * 4 + 3] = -(vc4[r] * vc4[3] + vc4[4 + r] * vc4[7] + vc4[8 + r] * vc4[11]);
    }
    vci[15] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) pp[i] = pc_->proj[i], pcur[i] = now.proj[i];
    if (!mat4_inverse_d(pcur, pinv)) return false;
#define MUL_D(a, b, o) for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) \
        o[r * 4 + c] = a[r * 4] * b[c] + a[r * 4 + 1] * b[4 + c] + a[r * 4 + 2] * b[8 + c] + a[r * 4 + 3] * b[12 + c]
    MUL_D(vp4, vci, rel);
    MUL_D(pp, rel, t);
    MUL_D(t, pinv, md);
#undef MUL_D
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) m[i] = (float)md[i];
    // a projection offset (proj[0][2], proj[1][2]) moves the picture by minus itself in NDC
    jitter[0] = -(now.proj[2] - slots[prev].cam.proj[2]);
    jitter[1] = -(now.proj[6] - slots[prev].cam.proj[6]);
    return true;
}

bool mvec_camera_now(float jitter[2], float *near_, float *far_, float *fov_y) {
    MvecCamera now;
    if (cur < 0) return false;
    mvec_sync();
    if (!camera_compute(&slots[cur], &now)) return false;
    jitter[0] = -now.proj[2], jitter[1] = -now.proj[6];
    // (OpenGL-style rows: [2][2] = -(f + n) / (f - n), [2][3] = -2fn / (f - n), [1][1] = 1 / tan(fovy / 2))
    float a = now.proj[10], b = now.proj[11];
    *near_ = b / (a - 1), *far_ = b / (a + 1), *fov_y = 2 * atanf(1 / now.proj[5]);
    return true;
}

const MvecCamera *mvec_camera(bool previous) {
    int i = previous ? prev : -1;  // (the frame being recorded has no camera yet: the previous one and the one before)
    if (!previous && prev >= 0) i = (prev + MVEC_SLOTS - 1) % MVEC_SLOTS;
    return i >= 0 && slots[i].cam.valid ? &slots[i].cam : NULL;
}

```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/mvec.h`:

```h
// Per-object motion vectors (mvec.c): the scene draws of each frame, matched to the same draws of the previous
// frame, with copies of the inputs their vertex shaders read (the game's constant buffers, the instanced streams),
// kept for the frame after. See docs/motion-vectors-spike.md for why it works this way.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "vk.h"

#define MVEC_CB 14    // the game's constant buffers, hardware slots 3..16
#define MVEC_INST 4   // instanced streams copied per draw
#define MVEC_FEAT 48  // a draw's fingerprint: the first 12 floats of each of its first 4 constant buffers
// A motion program's inputs (maxwell/translate.c, ShaderKey mvec): the previous frame's history buffer at this binding
// of the vertex set, and push constants: uint mflag (1: the draw moved, its vertex shader also runs on the previous
// frame's inputs; 0: it stood still or has no match, the camera's motion is its vector), uint pb[14] (where each
// constant buffer slot 3..16 starts, in 16-byte units) then uint pbn[14] (its size, in 16-byte units)
#define MVEC_HISTORY_BINDING 63
#define MVEC_PUSH 116

// A scene draw as draw_ sees it (exec.c): what identifies it and where its vertex shader's inputs are in guest memory.
// Packed: the translating thread writes one for every scene draw and the motion vector thread reads it, so every cache
// line of it crosses from one core to the other (a draw is 2 lines in the ring, mvec.c; at 900 bytes a draw with the
// two threads' counters in one line it cost the translating thread ~0.2 us a draw, 0.5 ms a frame).
typedef struct { uint64_t addr; uint32_t size; uint8_t slot, pad[3]; } MvecCb;                // a constant buffer the vertex shader reads
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, size; uint32_t stride, divisor, index, pad; } MvecInst;      // an instanced stream it reads
typedef struct {
    uint8_t kind;    // (mvec.c: 0 a draw, 1 a new frame: inst, base_inst = its slot and the previous frame's)
    uint8_t ncb, ninst, pad;
    int32_t base_vertex;
    uint64_t gen;    // guest copy generation (exec.c gcopy_gen): equal ranges of one generation hold equal bytes
    uint64_t pkey;   // mvec_mix(vertex shader code address, fragment shader code address)
    uint64_t skey;   // the non-instanced streams the vertex shader reads: their addresses, mvec_mix'ed in stream order
    uint64_t iaddr;  // index buffer (0: not indexed)
    const void *vi;  // the vertex shader's ShaderInfo: the vec4s it reads of each buffer (cbuf_rows)
    uint32_t count, first, inst, base_inst;
} MvecHead;
typedef struct { MvecHead h; MvecCb cb[16]; MvecInst in[MVEC_INST]; } MvecDrawIn;  // (cb: MVEC_CB used)
_Static_assert(sizeof(MvecHead) == 64 && sizeof(MvecCb) == 16 && sizeof(MvecInst) == 32, "mvec ring cells");
static inline uint64_t mvec_mix(uint64_t h, uint64_t v) {
    h ^= v + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
    return h * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull;
}

// One recorded draw: its identity, its match in the previous frame and its copied inputs (offsets in its frame's
// history buffer, mvec_records)
typedef struct {
    uint64_t key;
    uint64_t key2;  // the key without the index buffer and range (mvec.c prev_match_loose)
    uint32_t ord;   // among this frame's draws with the same key, in draw order
    int32_t prev;   // the matching record of the previous frame, -1: none
    float dist;     // its fingerprint's distance from that record's (mvec.c fingerprint_distance)
    uint8_t nfeat;
    float feat[MVEC_FEAT];  // the fingerprint: what tells apart draws of one key (the object's own constants)
    uint8_t ncb, ninst;
    uint8_t cb_slot[MVEC_CB];
    uint32_t cb_off[MVEC_CB], cb_size[MVEC_CB];
    uint8_t inst_stream[MVEC_INST];
    uint32_t inst_off[MVEC_INST], inst_size[MVEC_INST];
    uint64_t hash;  // of its inputs: the constants its vertex shader reads (but the camera block's matrices) and instanced streams
} MvecRec;

bool mvec_enabled(void);  // Video > Anti-aliasing TAA, or SAVAGEWIND_MVEC=1
bool mvec_for_framegen(void);  // frame generation takes them: SAVAGEWIND_FG_OBJECT_VECTORS=1 (default: the camera's)
// A scene draw of the current frame, recorded in two steps by the thread that translates the game's command lists:
// mvec_draw_begin gives the place to describe it in (NULL: off), mvec_draw_commit hands it on and returns its number.
// The work itself - copying the vertex shader's inputs into the history, matching the draw with one of the previous
// frame, telling whether it moved - is done by a thread of its own (mvec.c), while the translating thread goes on:
// it cost that thread ~1.2 ms a frame, and where it is the limit FSR 3 and TAA ran slower than native. The draw's
// push constants (MVEC_PUSH bytes) are therefore not known when it is translated: mvec_resolve gives them, waiting
// for the work if need be, to the thread that records the command (record.c rec_CmdPushConstantsMvec).
MvecDrawIn *mvec_draw_begin(uint64_t frame);
uint32_t mvec_draw_commit(void);
void mvec_resolve(uint32_t seq, uint32_t pc[MVEC_PUSH / 4]);
// Every draw handed on so far is done (the translating thread): before guest memory the draws may read changes
// (mvec_guest_write: only when a draw not done yet reads [lo, hi)), at the end of a command list.
void mvec_sync(void);
void mvec_guest_write(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi);
// A frame's camera, from its scene camera block (the constant buffer at slot 3 that most scene draws share; the scene
// shaders make clip = proj * view * position): the view (rows 0-2, a rigid 3x4) and the projection (rows 7-10, an
// OpenGL-style 4x4, its near plane moving with the camera's distance), row-major as the shaders read them; vp = proj *
// view and its inverse. valid: found and checked against the world camera's projection (rt_world_projection).
typedef struct { float view[12], proj[16], vp[16], inv_vp[16]; bool valid; } MvecCamera;
// The camera of the previous frame (previous) or of the one before it, once its draws are all recorded
const MvecCamera *mvec_camera(bool previous);
// The camera reprojection of the frame being drawn, once its scene is (at the composite): m = the previous frame's
// view-projection * the inverse of this frame's (row-major), which takes this frame's clip position of a point that
// did not move to the previous frame's; jitter = this frame's jitter minus the previous frame's, in the game's NDC
// (from their projections' offsets: rt_persp_offset), what the vectors are cleaned of. false: no camera for either.
bool mvec_reprojection(float m[16], float jitter[2]);
// This frame's camera, for TAA (exec.c mvec_taa) and a temporal upscaler: its jitter (the projection's offset in the
// game's NDC, as mvec_reprojection's), near and far planes and vertical field of view (radians); false: none found yet
bool mvec_camera_now(float jitter[2], float *near_, float *far_, float *fov_y);
// SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_CAMONLY=1: (testing) camera vectors everywhere, the object vectors ignored; 2: where there is an
// object vector, the camera vector minus it (zero on still geometry when both are right)
int mvec_camera_only(void);

void mvec_masked(void);  // a blended effect was drawn with its reactive mask program (statistics)
// The previous frame's history buffer, for MVEC_HISTORY_BINDING (any valid buffer before there is one)
VkDescriptorBufferInfo mvec_history_info(void);
// SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_VIEW=<pixels>: the vectors drawn over the scene (exec.c mvec_scene_view), full colour at that length
// (default 16; negative: raw, red = written, green / blue = |x| / |y| NDC times its size); 0 when off
float mvec_view_enabled(void);

```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/precompile.c`:

```c
// Shader precompilation (runtime/nvn/precompile.h). Every shader binary of the game's RomFS (shader_archive.c) is
// translated and compiled to SPIR-V with the keys the game will give it, by worker threads, into the caches the game
// reads (cache/xlate, cache/spirv); then pipelines are built for them into the pipeline cache (exec.c).
//
// Keys (vk_key_normalize: only what a shader uses of them):
//  - compute: the shared memory size from its control section; nothing else varies.
//  - fragment: which of its inputs the vertex shader provides - all of them (in BOTW's archives each program's vertex
//    shader writes exactly what its fragment shader reads) - and the kind of each color target it writes: float (no
//    integer targets met).
//  - vertex: the window origin and depth mode (game-wide), and the kind of each attribute it reads: float, int or
//    uint. That depends on the models' vertex formats; in BOTW it is the same for an attribute across one archive:
//    learned from the shader key log of this player's sessions (vk_keylog_read), else what the scripted test walks
//    met (kinds[] below), else float.
// Keys of the shader key log for the same binary are added as they are: what this player's game used.
//
// Motion vector variants (Video > Anti-aliasing TAA, FSR 3: vulkan/mvec.c; exec.c draw_ picks them): with motion
// vectors on, a pass with the internal-resolution scene depth gets the motion target appended after its color targets
// (slot = the pass's color target count, exec.c begin_pass), and in it
//  - a depth-writing draw (not full-screen) uses its program's motion variant: vertex key + mvec 1 and fragment key +
//    mvec_rt (slot + 1), whether it moved or not (the push constants say); until that is built, the vertex key as
//    is and fragment mvec_rt 0x40 | (slot + 1) (still: zero motion);
//  - a blended draw that writes no depth: fragment mvec_rt 0x80 | (slot + 1) (the reactive mask), vertex key as is.
// The keys are otherwise those of the draw without motion vectors (in the key log of 2026-10-28 all 522 motion keys
// were a logged key plus these fields). Which shaders: BOTW's motion passes are the G-buffer (6 color targets: slot 6;
// its fragment shaders write targets 0, 1 and 3, and 5 for some, never 6 or 7) and the forward pass after the lighting
// (1 target: slot 1; effects and materials blended into it write target 0 only). So, for every fragment key
// (predicted or logged) of a G-buffer shader, mvec_rt 7 and 0x47, and mvec 1 for the vertex keys of the vertex
// shaders of its programs; for every fragment key of a target-0-only shader of the materials or of an effect, the
// reactive mask 0x82 (blended draws of other archives - post effects, lights, shadows - are full-screen or not in
// those passes). Logged motion keys are taken as they are. Their libraries are built like the others' (a motion
// vertex shader's pipeline layout has the push constants: stage_layouts, from the translation's ShaderInfo.mvec).
// SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_NO_MVEC=1: none of them.
#include <SDL3/SDL_cpuinfo.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL_timer.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#ifdef __GLIBC__
#include <malloc.h>
#endif

#include <zlib.h>

#include "../../kernel.h"
#include "../../paths.h"
#include "../precompile.h"
#include "../shader_archive.h"
#include "shaders.h"
#include "vk.h"

bool shader_precompile_available(void) { return true; }

// Vertex attributes that are integers, by archive (the rest are float): what the scripted test walks met.
static const struct { const char *archive; int attr, kind; } kinds[] = {
    {"/uking_mat.product.sbfsha", 6, 2},    // uint (the bone indices of skinned models)
    {"/uking_grass.product.sbfsha", 2, 4},  // uint read as float
};

typedef struct { int shader; ShaderKey key; bool mvec; } Job;  // (mvec: a motion vector variant made here)
typedef struct { int vs, fs, cs; } Pair;  // (jobs: the predicted key's; vs or fs alone: that shader's libraries)

// (pipe_watch) a pipelines thread: the pair it compiles (-1: none), since when, and whether it has returned
typedef struct { struct Work *w; _Atomic int pair; _Atomic uint64_t since; _Atomic bool out; } PipeTh;

typedef struct Work {
    ShaderPrecompile *p;
    SaSet *set;
    Job *jobs;
    int njobs;
    Pair *pairs;
    int npairs;
    _Atomic int next, made, cached, failed, built, mvec_failed;
    // the pipelines step: the driver's compiles share a memory budget (pipe_take)
    int *order;                   // pairs, largest shader first
    int64_t *need_mb;             // per pair: what its compile is estimated to take
    int next_big, next_small;     // still to take: order[next_big .. next_small]
    int64_t used_mb, budget_mb;
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
    pthread_cond_t cond;
    PipeTh th[32];
} Work;

static void *worker(void *arg) {
    Work *w = arg;
    maxwell_gmem_base = HEAP_BASE;  // (as the game translates: global memory relative to the guest heap)
    maxwell_gmem_size = HEAP_MAX;
    for (int i; !atomic_load(&w->p->cancel) && (i = atomic_fetch_add(&w->next, 1)) < w->njobs;) {
        const Job *j = &w->jobs[i];
        const SaShader *s = &w->set->shaders[j->shader];
        char why[300] = "";
        int r = vk_precompile_one(s->code, s->max_size, s->stage, &j->key, why, sizeof why);
        // (a motion variant the translator refuses - varyings 30 / 31 or the motion target's slot in use - is one the
        // game cannot draw either: not a failure)
        if (r < 0 && j->mvec) atomic_fetch_add(&w->mvec_failed, 1);
        else if (r < 0 && atomic_fetch_add(&w->failed, 1) < 40)
            LOG("[precompile] %s shader %016llx of %s: %s\n",
                s->stage == STAGE_VERTEX ? "vertex" : s->stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? "fragment" : "compute",
                (unsigned long long)s->hash, w->set->sources[s->source], why);
        else if (r >= 0) atomic_fetch_add(r > 0 ? &w->made : &w->cached, 1);
        atomic_fetch_add(&w->p->done, 1);
    }
    return NULL;
}

// Memory: RADV takes up to ~1.3 GB to compile the largest fragment shaders (41 KB of Maxwell code), and a thread per
// core on the largest at once went past 9.5 GB on a 14 GB laptop (Radeon 660M, 12 threads; at 7 GB the kernel killed
// it). So each compile reserves an estimate from a budget (a quarter of the RAM; SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_MEM_MB) and a
// thread takes the largest pair left when it fits, else the smallest: the large ones don't end up alone at the end.
// glibc keeps what the driver frees in each thread's arena (7.1 GB at the end of a quarter of the shaders, 2.7 GB
// trimmed after the large ones): malloc_trim after those.
static int64_t pair_need_mb(const Work *w, const Pair *pr) {
    uint32_t bytes = 0;
    int ids[3] = {pr->vs, pr->fs, pr->cs};
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        if (ids[k] >= 0 && w->set->shaders[w->jobs[ids[k]].shader].size > bytes) bytes = w->set->shaders[w->jobs[ids[k]].shader].size;
    return 16 + bytes / 32;
}

static int pipe_take(Work *w, int64_t *mb) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&w->lock);
    int i = -1;
    while (w->next_big <= w->next_small && !atomic_load(&w->p->cancel)) {
        int64_t big = w->need_mb[w->order[w->next_big]], small = w->need_mb[w->order[w->next_small]];
        if (!w->used_mb || w->used_mb + big <= w->budget_mb) { i = w->order[w->next_big++]; *mb = big; break; }
        if (w->used_mb + small <= w->budget_mb) { i = w->order[w->next_small--]; *mb = small; break; }
        pthread_cond_wait(&w->cond, &w->lock);
    }
    if (i >= 0) w->used_mb += *mb;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&w->lock);
    return i;
}

static void pipe_give_back(Work *w, int64_t mb) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&w->lock);
    w->used_mb -= mb;
    pthread_cond_broadcast(&w->cond);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&w->lock);
}

static const int64_t *sort_need;
static int by_need_desc(const void *a, const void *b) {
    int64_t x = sort_need[*(const int *)a], y = sort_need[*(const int *)b];
    return x < y ? 1 : x > y ? -1 : *(const int *)a - *(const int *)b;
}

static void *pipe_worker(void *arg) {
    PipeTh *t = arg;
    Work *w = t->w;
    int64_t mb;
    for (int i; (i = pipe_take(w, &mb)) >= 0;) {
        atomic_store(&t->since, SDL_GetTicksNS());
        atomic_store(&t->pair, i);
        const Pair *pr = &w->pairs[i];
        bool ok = false;
        if (pr->cs >= 0) {
            const Job *c = &w->jobs[pr->cs];
            const SaShader *s = &w->set->shaders[c->shader];
            ShaderInfo *si = vk_xlate_read(s->code, s->max_size, s->stage, &c->key);
            if (si) ok = vk_pso_warm_compute(si, s->local);
            maxwell_free(si);
        } else if (pr->vs < 0 || pr->fs < 0) {  // (graphics pipeline libraries: a shader alone)
            const Job *j = &w->jobs[pr->vs >= 0 ? pr->vs : pr->fs];
            const SaShader *sh = &w->set->shaders[j->shader];
            ShaderInfo *si = vk_xlate_read(sh->code, sh->max_size, sh->stage, &j->key);
            if (si) ok = vk_pso_warm_stage(si, sh->stage);
            maxwell_free(si);
        } else {
            const Job *v = &w->jobs[pr->vs], *f = &w->jobs[pr->fs];
            const SaShader *vs = &w->set->shaders[v->shader], *fs = &w->set->shaders[f->shader];
            ShaderInfo *vi = vk_xlate_read(vs->code, vs->max_size, vs->stage, &v->key);
            ShaderInfo *fi = vi ? vk_xlate_read(fs->code, fs->max_size, fs->stage, &f->key) : NULL;
            if (vi && fi) ok = vk_pso_warm(vi, fi, v->key.attr_kind);
            maxwell_free(vi);
            maxwell_free(fi);
        }
        if (ok) atomic_fetch_add(&w->built, 1);
#ifdef __GLIBC__
        if (mb >= 128) malloc_trim(0);
#endif
        atomic_store(&t->pair, -1);
        pipe_give_back(w, mb);
        atomic_fetch_add(&w->p->done, 1);
    }
    atomic_store(&t->out, true);
    return NULL;
}

// The pipelines threads, waited for. A driver can take a compile and never give it back: on AMD's Windows driver, with
// its own shader compiler, after fragment shaders went through spirv-opt (0.5.2, the sky fix), setup stopped at
// 21502 of 21503 for good (#359), and Esc could not stop it either - it waited for that thread. So when no compile has
// finished for PIPE_STALL_S seconds, or setup is stopped, the compiles still running are logged (their shaders) and
// left to the driver: their threads are detached and the work they can still touch (w) is kept, never freed. Returns
// whether any was left. SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_STALL_S=<seconds> (180).
#define PIPE_STALL_S 180
static bool pipe_watch(Work *w, pthread_t *th, int nt) {
    static int stall_s = -1;
    if (stall_s < 0) { const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_STALL_S"); stall_s = e && atoi(e) > 0 ? atoi(e) : PIPE_STALL_S; }
    int last = atomic_load(&w->p->done);
    uint64_t last_t = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    for (;;) {
        int out = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) out += atomic_load(&w->th[i].out);
        if (out == nt) break;
        SDL_Delay(100);
        uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicksNS();
        int d = atomic_load(&w->p->done);
        if (d != last) last = d, last_t = now;
        bool cancel = atomic_load(&w->p->cancel);
        if (!cancel && now - last_t < (uint64_t)stall_s * 1000000000ull) continue;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&w->lock);  // (nothing more taken: a thread that comes back leaves)
        w->next_big = 1, w->next_small = 0;
        pthread_cond_broadcast(&w->cond);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&w->lock);
        for (int k = 0; k < (cancel ? 100 : 20); k++) {  // (2 s for the ones between compiles; stopped, 10 s to finish theirs)
            out = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) out += atomic_load(&w->th[i].out);
            if (out == nt) break;
            SDL_Delay(100);
        }
        bool left = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) {
            if (atomic_load(&w->th[i].out)) { pthread_join(th[i], NULL); continue; }
            int pi = atomic_load(&w->th[i].pair);
            uint64_t hv = 0, hf = 0, hc = 0;
            if (pi >= 0) {
                const Pair *pr = &w->pairs[pi];
                if (pr->vs >= 0) hv = w->set->shaders[w->jobs[pr->vs].shader].hash;
                if (pr->fs >= 0) hf = w->set->shaders[w->jobs[pr->fs].shader].hash;
                if (pr->cs >= 0) hc = w->set->shaders[w->jobs[pr->cs].shader].hash;
            }
            LOG("[precompile] a pipeline compile the driver has not given back for %.0f s, left to it (%s): vertex %016llx "
                "fragment %016llx compute %016llx\n", (now - atomic_load(&w->th[i].since)) / 1e9, cancel ? "setup stopped" : "stalled",
                (unsigned long long)hv, (unsigned long long)hf, (unsigned long long)hc);
            pthread_detach(th[i]);
            left = true;
        }
        return left;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) pthread_join(th[i], NULL);
    return false;
}

static int pair_cmp(const void *a, const void *b) { return memcmp(a, b, sizeof(Pair)); }

static void scan_progress(float f, void *user) {
    ShaderPrecompile *p = user;
    atomic_store(&p->done, (int)(f * 1000));
}

float shader_precompile_progress(const ShaderPrecompile *p) {
    // reading the archives 2%, translating and compiling 33%, pipelines 65% (a first start: ~45 s and ~2 minutes)
    int st = atomic_load(&p->state), d = atomic_load(&p->done), t = atomic_load(&p->total);
    float f = t > 0 ? (float)d / (float)t : 0;
    if (f > 1) f = 1;
    switch (st) {
    case SP_READING: return 0.02f * f;
    case SP_COMPILING: return 0.02f + 0.33f * f;
    case SP_PIPELINES: return 0.35f + 0.65f * f;
    case SP_DONE: return 1;
    default: return 0;
    }
}

// The jobs: shader and key, each pair once (a hash set of them: the key log repeats the predicted keys)
typedef struct { Job *jobs; int n, cap; uint64_t *set; size_t set_cap, set_n; } Jobs;

static uint64_t job_hash(int shader, const ShaderKey *k) {
    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull ^ (uint64_t)shader;
    const uint8_t *b = (const uint8_t *)k;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof *k; i++) h = (h ^ b[i]) * 0x100000001B3ull;
    return h ? h : 1;
}

static void add_job(Jobs *J, int shader, const ShaderKey *k, bool mvec) {
    uint64_t h = job_hash(shader, k);
    if ((J->set_n + 1) * 2 > J->set_cap) {
        size_t cap = J->set_cap ? J->set_cap * 2 : 1 << 15;
        uint64_t *t = calloc(cap, sizeof *t);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < J->set_cap; i++) {
            if (!J->set[i]) continue;
            size_t j = J->set[i] & (cap - 1);
            while (t[j]) j = (j + 1) & (cap - 1);
            t[j] = J->set[i];
        }
        free(J->set);
        J->set = t;
        J->set_cap = cap;
    }
    size_t j = h & (J->set_cap - 1);
    for (; J->set[j]; j = (j + 1) & (J->set_cap - 1))
        if (J->set[j] == h) return;  // (that one is there already)
    J->set[j] = h;
    J->set_n++;
    Job **jobs = &J->jobs;
    int *n = &J->n, *cap = &J->cap;
    if (*n == *cap) {
        *cap = *cap ? *cap * 2 : 4096;
        *jobs = realloc(*jobs, sizeof **jobs * (size_t)*cap);
    }
    (*jobs)[*n].shader = shader;
    (*jobs)[*n].key = *k;
    (*jobs)[*n].mvec = mvec;
    (*n)++;
}

// The motion vector variants (see the top): added to J for its keys so far; returns how many.
enum { MVEC_GBUFFER_SLOT = 6, MVEC_FORWARD_SLOT = 1 };  // (BOTW's motion passes: the G-buffer, the forward pass)
static uint32_t fs_omap(const uint8_t *code) {
    uint32_t omap;
    memcpy(&omap, code + 0x30 + 0x48, 4);  // (the SPH's 4 bits per color target, as vk_key_normalize reads it)
    return omap;
}
static bool gbuffer_fs(const uint8_t *code) {
    uint32_t o = fs_omap(code);
    return (o & 0xF0FF) == 0xF0FF && !(o >> 24);  // (targets 0, 1 and 3; nothing at 6 or 7)
}
static bool mask_source(const char *src) {  // (the materials' archive and the effects: what draws blended into the scene)
    size_t n = strlen(src), m = strlen("/uking_mat.product.sbfsha");
    return strstr(src, ".sesetlist") || (n >= m && !strcmp(src + n - m, "/uking_mat.product.sbfsha"));
}

static int add_mvec_jobs(Jobs *J, const SaSet *set) {
    bool *gb_vs = calloc((size_t)(set->nshaders ? set->nshaders : 1), 1);  // vertex shaders of G-buffer programs
    for (int i = 0; i < set->nprograms; i++) {
        const SaProgram *g = &set->programs[i];
        if (g->cs < 0 && g->vs >= 0 && g->fs >= 0 && gbuffer_fs(set->shaders[g->fs].code)) gb_vs[g->vs] = true;
    }
    int n0 = J->n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n0; i++) {
        Job j = J->jobs[i];  // (a copy: add_job may move J->jobs)
        const SaShader *s = &set->shaders[j.shader];
        if (s->stage == STAGE_VERTEX && !j.key.mvec && gb_vs[j.shader]) {
            j.key.mvec = 1;
            add_job(J, j.shader, &j.key, true);
        } else if (s->stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT && !j.key.mvec_rt) {
            if (gbuffer_fs(s->code)) {
                j.key.mvec_rt = MVEC_GBUFFER_SLOT + 1;
                add_job(J, j.shader, &j.key, true);
                j.key.mvec_rt = 0x40 | (MVEC_GBUFFER_SLOT + 1);
                add_job(J, j.shader, &j.key, true);
            } else if (fs_omap(s->code) == 0xF && mask_source(set->sources[s->source])) {
                j.key.mvec_rt = 0x80 | (MVEC_FORWARD_SLOT + 1);
                add_job(J, j.shader, &j.key, true);
            }
        }
    }
    free(gb_vs);
    return J->n - n0;
}

// ---- the pipeline seed: vk_pipelines.seed, the pipeline list of a playthrough in a form any install can use.
// The list (exec.c) names shaders by translation id, which depends on the translator build and is unknown until the
// shader is translated here; the seed names them by the hash of their binary (shader_code_hash, as the shader key
// log does) and the key, with the pipeline's fixed state as the list holds it. `savagewind --export-pipeline-seed
// <file>` writes one from this install's list (a developer's, after playing through the game); the precompilation
// reads the one in the data root or next to the executable (a shipped file): its keys join the translations to make,
// and at the end its records join the list, so a fresh install's first boot pre-warms every pipeline the playthrough
// met instead of linking them where first drawn. A seed of another key or state layout (another build of those
// structures) is ignored. Nothing of the game is in it: hashes, keys and render state.
// File: SeedHeader, then the records deflated (zlib): per record kind (1 graphics, 2 compute), two binary hashes,
// two keys and the state (state_size bytes; compute: the group size in the first 12).
typedef struct { char magic[8]; uint32_t version, nrecs, key_size, state_size, zsize, reserved; } SeedHeader;
#define SEED_MAGIC "SWPSEED1"
#define SEED_NAME "vk_pipelines.seed"

static size_t seed_rec_size(void) { return 4 + 16 + 2 * sizeof(ShaderKey) + vk_pso_state_size(); }

// The data root's, else the shipped one: next to the executable in a release (Makefile dist, tools/linux/package.sh),
// runtime/nvn/vulkan/vk_pipelines.seed in a source checkout.
static bool seed_find(char *path, size_t n) {
    snprintf(path, n, "%s/%s", rt_data_root(), SEED_NAME);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (f) { fclose(f); return true; }
    return rt_resource(SEED_NAME, "runtime/nvn/vulkan/" SEED_NAME, path, n);
}

// The seed's records (malloc'd, seed_rec_size each) or NULL; *why says what is wrong with the file
static uint8_t *seed_read(const char *path, int *nrecs, const char **why) {
    *nrecs = 0;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) { *why = "no file"; return NULL; }
    SeedHeader h;
    uint8_t *z = NULL, *d = NULL;
    bool ok = fread(&h, sizeof h, 1, f) == 1 && !memcmp(h.magic, SEED_MAGIC, 8) && h.version == 1;
    if (!ok) *why = "not a pipeline seed of this format";
    else if (h.key_size != sizeof(ShaderKey) || h.state_size != vk_pso_state_size()) { ok = false; *why = "made by another build (key or state layout)"; }
    else if (h.nrecs > (1u << 20) || h.zsize > (256u << 20)) { ok = false; *why = "damaged"; }
    if (ok) {
        size_t n = (size_t)h.nrecs * seed_rec_size();
        z = malloc(h.zsize ? h.zsize : 1);
        d = malloc(n ? n : 1);
        uLongf len = (uLongf)n;
        ok = z && d && fread(z, 1, h.zsize, f) == h.zsize && uncompress(d, &len, z, h.zsize) == Z_OK && len == n;
        if (!ok) *why = "damaged";
    }
    fclose(f);
    free(z);
    if (!ok) { free(d); return NULL; }
    *nrecs = (int)h.nrecs;
    return d;
}

static void seed_rec(const uint8_t *r, uint32_t *kind, uint64_t code[2], ShaderKey key[2], const void **state) {
    memcpy(kind, r, 4);
    memcpy(code, r + 4, 16);
    memcpy(key, r + 20, 2 * sizeof(ShaderKey));
    *state = r + 20 + 2 * sizeof(ShaderKey);
}

// The seed's keys as translations to make (before the jobs are counted)
static int seed_add_jobs(Jobs *J, const SaSet *set, const uint8_t *recs, int nrecs) {
    int n0 = J->n;
    for (int i = 0; i < nrecs; i++) {
        uint32_t kind;
        uint64_t code[2];
        ShaderKey key[2];
        const void *state;
        seed_rec(recs + (size_t)i * seed_rec_size(), &kind, code, key, &state);
        for (int k = 0; k < (kind == 1 ? 2 : 1); k++) {
            int sh = shader_archive_find(set, code[k]);
            int stage = kind == 1 ? (k == 0 ? STAGE_VERTEX : STAGE_FRAGMENT) : STAGE_COMPUTE;
            if (sh >= 0 && set->shaders[sh].stage == stage) add_job(J, sh, &key[k], key[k].mvec || key[k].mvec_rt);
        }
    }
    return J->n - n0;
}

// The seed's records into the pipeline list, by the ids their translations have with this translator
static int seed_import(const SaSet *set, const uint8_t *recs, int nrecs) {
    int added = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nrecs; i++) {
        uint32_t kind;
        uint64_t code[2], id[2] = {0, 0};
        ShaderKey key[2];
        const void *state;
        seed_rec(recs + (size_t)i * seed_rec_size(), &kind, code, key, &state);
        for (int k = 0; k < (kind == 1 ? 2 : 1); k++) {
            int sh = shader_archive_find(set, code[k]);
            int stage = kind == 1 ? (k == 0 ? STAGE_VERTEX : STAGE_FRAGMENT) : STAGE_COMPUTE;
            if (sh >= 0 && set->shaders[sh].stage == stage)
                id[k] = vk_translate_id_for(set->shaders[sh].code, set->shaders[sh].max_size, stage, &key[k]);
        }
        if (id[0] && (kind != 1 || id[1]) && vk_pso_add((int)kind, id[0], id[1], state, kind == 1 ? vk_pso_state_size() : 12)) added++;
    }
    vk_pso_flush();
    return added;
}

// --export-pipeline-seed: this install's list as a seed. The translation ids are matched to binaries and keys
// through the shader key log (every translation the game made is in it) and the archives.
typedef struct { uint64_t id, code; ShaderKey key; } IdMap;
typedef struct { IdMap *m; size_t cap, n; uint8_t *out; size_t nout, cap_out; int missing; } Export;

static void idmap_put(Export *e, uint64_t id, uint64_t code, const ShaderKey *key) {
    if ((e->n + 1) * 2 > e->cap) {
        size_t cap = e->cap ? e->cap * 2 : 1 << 16;
        IdMap *t = calloc(cap, sizeof *t);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < e->cap; i++) {
            if (!e->m[i].id) continue;
            size_t j = e->m[i].id & (cap - 1);
            while (t[j].id) j = (j + 1) & (cap - 1);
            t[j] = e->m[i];
        }
        free(e->m);
        e->m = t;
        e->cap = cap;
    }
    size_t j = id & (e->cap - 1);
    while (e->m[j].id && e->m[j].id != id) j = (j + 1) & (e->cap - 1);
    if (!e->m[j].id) e->n++;
    e->m[j] = (IdMap){id, code, *key};
}

static const IdMap *idmap_get(const Export *e, uint64_t id) {
    if (!e->cap) return NULL;
    size_t j = id & (e->cap - 1);
    while (e->m[j].id && e->m[j].id != id) j = (j + 1) & (e->cap - 1);
    return e->m[j].id ? &e->m[j] : NULL;
}

static int export_rec(void *ctx, int kind, const uint64_t id[2], const void *state, size_t n) {
    Export *e = ctx;
    const IdMap *m[2] = {idmap_get(e, id[0]), kind == 1 ? idmap_get(e, id[1]) : NULL};
    if (!m[0] || (kind == 1 && !m[1])) { e->missing++; return 0; }
    size_t rs = seed_rec_size();
    if (e->nout + rs > e->cap_out) {
        e->cap_out = e->cap_out ? e->cap_out * 2 : rs * 1024;
        e->out = realloc(e->out, e->cap_out);
    }
    uint8_t *r = e->out + e->nout;
    memset(r, 0, rs);
    uint32_t k = (uint32_t)kind;
    memcpy(r, &k, 4);
    uint64_t code[2] = {m[0]->code, m[1] ? m[1]->code : 0};
    memcpy(r + 4, code, 16);
    memcpy(r + 20, &m[0]->key, sizeof(ShaderKey));
    if (m[1]) memcpy(r + 20 + sizeof(ShaderKey), &m[1]->key, sizeof(ShaderKey));
    memcpy(r + 20 + 2 * sizeof(ShaderKey), state, n < vk_pso_state_size() ? n : vk_pso_state_size());
    e->nout += rs;
    return 1;
}

bool shader_precompile_export_seed(const char *romfs, const char *out, char *why, size_t nwhy) {
    SaSet set;
    if (!shader_archive_scan(romfs, &set, NULL, NULL, why, nwhy)) return false;
    VkKeyLogEntry *log;
    int nlog = vk_keylog_read(&log);
    Export e = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < nlog; i++) {
        int k = shader_archive_find(&set, log[i].code);
        if (k < 0 || (int)log[i].stage != set.shaders[k].stage) continue;
        uint64_t id = vk_translate_id_for(set.shaders[k].code, set.shaders[k].max_size, set.shaders[k].stage, &log[i].key);
        idmap_put(&e, id, set.shaders[k].hash, &log[i].key);
    }
    int n = vk_pso_records(export_rec, &e);
    bool ok = false;
    uLongf zn = compressBound((uLong)e.nout);
    uint8_t *z = malloc(zn ? zn : 1);
    if (z && compress2(z, &zn, e.out ? e.out : (const uint8_t *)"", (uLong)e.nout, 9) == Z_OK) {
        SeedHeader h;
        memset(&h, 0, sizeof h);
        memcpy(h.magic, SEED_MAGIC, 8);
        h.version = 1;
        h.nrecs = (uint32_t)n;
        h.key_size = sizeof(ShaderKey);
        h.state_size = (uint32_t)vk_pso_state_size();
        h.zsize = (uint32_t)zn;
        FILE *f = fopen(out, "wb");
        ok = f && fwrite(&h, sizeof h, 1, f) == 1 && fwrite(z, 1, zn, f) == zn;
        if (f && fclose(f)) ok = false;
        if (!ok) snprintf(why, nwhy, "cannot write %s", out);
    } else {
        snprintf(why, nwhy, "deflate failed");
    }
    LOG("[precompile] pipeline seed: %d of the list's pipelines written to %s (%d whose shaders the key log does not name; "
        "%d keys known), %.1f KB\n", n, out, e.missing, (int)e.n, zn / 1024.0);
    free(z);
    free(e.out);
    free(e.m);
    free(log);
    shader_archive_free(&set);
    return ok;
}

static void status_path(char *out, size_t n) { vk_cache_path(out, n, "precompiled.txt"); }

// cache/precompiled.txt: the shader version with the device's translation variant (vk_shader_version_full), then
// "<shaders> <YYYY-MM-DD>". Another variant (the global memory switches changed with a driver, a device or a new
// default) means the global memory shaders' translations and libraries are missing: offered again, which only redoes
// those (the rest are cache hits).
int shader_precompile_status(int *shaders, char *date, int n) {
    char path[512], version[128] = "", day[32] = "";
    int count = 0;
    status_path(path, sizeof path);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) return 0;
    if (!fgets(version, sizeof version, f) || fscanf(f, "%d %31s", &count, day) != 2) version[0] = 0;
    fclose(f);
    version[strcspn(version, "\r\n")] = 0;
    if (!version[0]) return 0;
    if (shaders) *shaders = count;
    if (date && n > 0) snprintf(date, (size_t)n, "%s", day);
    // (the shaders' libraries go with the GPU and driver: a new driver drops them)
    return strcmp(version, vk_shader_version_full()) || !vk_precompiled_cache_ok() ? 2 : 1;
}

bool shader_precompile_run(ShaderPrecompile *p, const char *romfs) {
    uint64_t t0 = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    atomic_store(&p->done, 0);
    atomic_store(&p->total, 1000);
    atomic_store(&p->state, SP_READING);
    SaSet set;
    if (!shader_archive_scan(romfs, &set, scan_progress, p, p->why, sizeof p->why)) {
        atomic_store(&p->state, SP_FAILED);
        return false;
    }
    // what the shader key log says: keys by binary, and attribute kinds by archive
    VkKeyLogEntry *log;
    int nlog = vk_keylog_read(&log);
    int (*seen)[32][5] = calloc((size_t)set.nsources, sizeof *seen);
    int origin[2] = {0}, depth[2] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < nlog; i++) {
        if (log[i].stage != STAGE_VERTEX) continue;
        origin[log[i].key.flip_y]++;
        depth[log[i].key.depth_minus_one]++;
        int k = shader_archive_find(&set, log[i].code);
        if (k < 0) continue;
        uint32_t in = vk_sph_inputs(set.shaders[k].code, STAGE_VERTEX);
        for (int a = 0; a < 32; a++)
            if ((in >> a) & 1 && log[i].key.attr_kind[a] < 5) seen[set.shaders[k].source][a][log[i].key.attr_kind[a]]++;
    }
    bool flip_y = origin[1] > origin[0], depth_minus_one = depth[1] >= depth[0];  // (BOTW: 0 and 1)
    // the jobs: per shader its predicted key, then the logged ones
    Jobs J = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < set.nshaders; i++) {
        const SaShader *s = &set.shaders[i];
        ShaderKey k;
        memset(&k, 0, sizeof k);
        k.glsl = 1;
        if (s->stage == STAGE_VERTEX) {
            k.flip_y = flip_y;
            k.depth_minus_one = depth_minus_one;
            uint32_t in = vk_sph_inputs(s->code, STAGE_VERTEX);
            const char *src = set.sources[s->source];
            for (int a = 0; a < 32; a++) {
                if (!((in >> a) & 1)) continue;
                int best = -1, most = 0;
                for (int c = 0; c < 5; c++)
                    if (seen[s->source][a][c] > most) most = seen[s->source][a][c], best = c;
                if (best < 0) {
                    best = 0;
                    for (size_t t = 0; t < sizeof kinds / sizeof kinds[0]; t++) {
                        size_t ls = strlen(src), lt = strlen(kinds[t].archive);
                        if (kinds[t].attr == a && ls >= lt && !strcmp(src + ls - lt, kinds[t].archive)) best = kinds[t].kind;
                    }
                }
                k.attr_kind[a] = (uint8_t)best;
            }
        } else if (s->stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
            k.vs_out_mask = vk_sph_inputs(s->code, STAGE_FRAGMENT);
        } else {
            k.shared_size = s->shared;
        }
        vk_key_normalize(s->code, s->stage, &k);
        add_job(&J, i, &k, false);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < nlog; i++) {
        int k = shader_archive_find(&set, log[i].code);
        if (k >= 0 && (int)log[i].stage == set.shaders[k].stage) add_job(&J, k, &log[i].key, false);
    }
    char seed_path[1100];
    const char *seed_why = "no file";
    int nseed = 0, nseed_keys = 0;
    uint8_t *seed = seed_find(seed_path, sizeof seed_path) ? seed_read(seed_path, &nseed, &seed_why) : NULL;
    if (seed) nseed_keys = seed_add_jobs(&J, &set, seed, nseed);
    int nmvec = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_NO_MVEC") ? 0 : add_mvec_jobs(&J, &set);
    Job *jobs = J.jobs;
    int njobs = J.n;
    free(J.set);
    free(seen);
    free(log);
    LOG("[precompile] %d shaders in %d archives (%llu files, %.0f MB) read in %.1f s: %d translations to make (%d of them "
        "motion vector variants)\n", set.nshaders, set.nsources, (unsigned long long)set.files, set.bytes / 1048576.0,
        (SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0) / 1e9, njobs, nmvec);
    if (seed) LOG("[precompile] pipeline seed %s: %d pipelines, %d keys of its own\n", seed_path, nseed, nseed_keys);
    else LOG("[precompile] pipeline seed: none (%s: %s)\n", seed_path, seed_why);
    // translate and compile them
    Work w = {.p = p, .set = &set, .jobs = jobs, .njobs = njobs};
    atomic_store(&p->done, 0);
    atomic_store(&p->total, njobs);
    atomic_store(&p->state, SP_COMPILING);
    int nt = SDL_GetNumLogicalCPUCores();
    if (nt < 1) nt = 1;
    if (nt > 32) nt = 32;
    pthread_t th[32];
    for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) pthread_create(&th[i], NULL, worker, &w);
    for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) pthread_join(th[i], NULL);
    vk_keylog_flush();
    LOG("[precompile] %d translations in %.1f s on %d threads: %d made, %d were cached, %d failed, %d motion variants the "
        "translator refuses (not drawn either)\n", njobs, (SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0) / 1e9, nt, atomic_load(&w.made),
        atomic_load(&w.cached), atomic_load(&w.failed), atomic_load(&w.mvec_failed));
    // into the pipeline cache: the compute pipelines (their whole state is known: the group size); with graphics
    // pipeline libraries (exec.c), every vertex and fragment shader's libraries, into a cache of their own
    // (cache/vk_precompiled.bin, device.c). Without them, whole pipelines only
    // with SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_PIPELINES=1, one per program: those take ~0.85 GB of pipeline cache and help less
    // (in a walk where the driver had seen nothing: 12.7 -> 8.4 s of compiles on the render thread), since a later
    // draw with other blending, target formats or write masks costs the driver much of a compile again.
    bool graphics = !g_vk.gpl && getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_PIPELINES") != NULL;
    if (g_vk.dev && !atomic_load(&p->cancel) && !getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_NO_PIPELINES")) {
        int *first = malloc(sizeof *first * (size_t)(set.nshaders ? set.nshaders : 1));  // shader -> its predicted job
        for (int i = 0; i < set.nshaders; i++) first[i] = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < njobs; i++)
            if (first[jobs[i].shader] < 0) first[jobs[i].shader] = i;
        Pair *pairs = malloc(sizeof *pairs * (size_t)(set.nprograms ? set.nprograms : 1));
        int np = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < set.nprograms; i++) {
            const SaProgram *g = &set.programs[i];
            Pair pr = {-1, -1, -1};
            if (g->cs >= 0) pr.cs = first[g->cs];
            else pr.vs = first[g->vs], pr.fs = first[g->fs];
            if ((g->cs >= 0 && pr.cs >= 0) || (graphics && g->cs < 0 && pr.vs >= 0 && pr.fs >= 0)) pairs[np++] = pr;
        }
        if (g_vk.gpl) {  // (every key's: the predicted, the logged ones that differ, the motion vector variants)
            pairs = realloc(pairs, sizeof *pairs * (size_t)(np + njobs + 1));
            for (int i = 0; i < njobs; i++) {
                int stage = set.shaders[jobs[i].shader].stage;
                if (stage == STAGE_COMPUTE) continue;
                pairs[np++] = stage == STAGE_VERTEX ? (Pair){i, -1, -1} : (Pair){-1, i, -1};
            }
        }
        qsort(pairs, (size_t)np, sizeof *pairs, pair_cmp);
        int nu = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < np; i++)
            if (!nu || memcmp(&pairs[i], &pairs[nu - 1], sizeof *pairs)) pairs[nu++] = pairs[i];
        Work *pw = malloc(sizeof *pw);  // (on the heap: pipe_watch may leave threads that still touch it)
        memcpy(pw, &w, sizeof w);
        pw->pairs = pairs;
        pw->npairs = nu;
        pw->need_mb = malloc(sizeof *pw->need_mb * (size_t)(nu ? nu : 1));
        pw->order = malloc(sizeof *pw->order * (size_t)(nu ? nu : 1));
        for (int i = 0; i < nu; i++) pw->need_mb[i] = pair_need_mb(pw, &pairs[i]), pw->order[i] = i;
        sort_need = pw->need_mb;
        qsort(pw->order, (size_t)nu, sizeof *pw->order, by_need_desc);
        pw->next_big = 0;
        pw->next_small = nu - 1;
        pw->used_mb = 0;
        const char *mem = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PRECOMPILE_MEM_MB");
        pw->budget_mb = mem && atoll(mem) > 0 ? atoll(mem) : (int64_t)SDL_GetSystemRAM() / 4;
        pthread_mutex_init(&pw->lock, NULL);
        pthread_cond_init(&pw->cond, NULL);
        atomic_store(&pw->next, 0);
        atomic_store(&p->done, 0);
        atomic_store(&p->total, nu);
        atomic_store(&p->state, SP_PIPELINES);
        uint64_t tp = SDL_GetTicksNS();
        for (int i = 0; i < nt; i++) {
            pw->th[i].w = pw;
            atomic_store(&pw->th[i].pair, -1);
            atomic_store(&pw->th[i].out, false);
            pthread_create(&th[i], NULL, pipe_worker, &pw->th[i]);
        }
        bool left = pipe_watch(pw, th, nt);
        p->pipelines = atomic_load(&pw->built);
        extern void vk_pipeline_cache_save(void);
        vk_pipeline_cache_save();
        if (g_vk.gpl) vk_precompiled_cache_save();
        LOG("[precompile] %d %s: %d built in %.1f s\n", nu, g_vk.gpl ? "shaders and compute programs (pipeline libraries)" : "programs",
            p->pipelines, (SDL_GetTicksNS() - tp) / 1e9);
        if (seed && !atomic_load(&p->cancel)) {  // (the list's header names the device: only with one)
            int added = seed_import(&set, seed, nseed);
            LOG("[precompile] pipeline seed: %d pipelines added to the pipeline list (%d were there or have no shader here)\n",
                added, nseed - added);
            if (added) vk_pso_rewarm();  // (so that the boot right after this setup pre-warms them, not only the next start)
        }
        free(first);
        if (!left) {
            free(pairs);
            free(pw->order);
            free(pw->need_mb);
            pthread_mutex_destroy(&pw->lock);
            pthread_cond_destroy(&pw->cond);
            free(pw);
        }
    }
    free(seed);
    p->shaders = set.nshaders;
    p->keys = njobs;
    p->made = atomic_load(&w.made);
    p->cached = atomic_load(&w.cached);
    p->failed = atomic_load(&w.failed);
    free(jobs);
    shader_archive_free(&set);
    if (atomic_load(&p->cancel)) {
        atomic_store(&p->state, SP_CANCELLED);
        return false;
    }
    p->seconds = (SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0) / 1e9;
    char path[512];
    status_path(path, sizeof path);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");
    if (f) {
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        char date[32];
        strftime(date, sizeof date, "%Y-%m-%d", localtime(&now));
        fprintf(f, "%s\n%d %s\n", vk_shader_version_full(), p->shaders, date);
        fclose(f);
    }
    atomic_store(&p->state, SP_DONE);
    return true;
}

```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/record.c`:

```c
// The recorder thread: see record.h.
//
// The queue thread translated the game's command lists and made every Vulkan call itself; where it limits the frame
// rate (Kakariko and Gerudo on a Radeon 660M, the GPU at 88-96 %), a quarter of its time was RADV's: building the GPU
// commands behind vkCmd*, writing descriptor sets, the submissions. That work depends on nothing the thread decides
// next. So the translating thread now writes each call's arguments into a packet in a ring, in the order it made them,
// and this thread makes the real calls in that order while the translator goes on. A packet holds everything the call
// needs, by value: the recorder never reads the translator's state or the game's memory.
//
// Shared state and how it is protected (T = the translating thread(s), one at a time under gpu_lock; R = the recorder):
//   ring bytes          written by T before `head` is published (release), read by R after it loads `head`
//                       (acquire); reused by T only past `tail` (R's release store after each packet, T's acquire)
//   head / tail         _Atomic; the only hand-off. `wpos` (T's unpublished end) is T's alone
//   wake-up             R sets `asleep` under `mu` and re-checks `head` before waiting on cv_work (seq_cst stores and
//                       loads on both sides: no lost wake-up); T signals only when it sees `asleep`
//   submitted           _Atomic, stored by R after vkQueueSubmit2 returns (release); anyone reads it
//   cv_done             R broadcasts under `mu` after each submission and whenever it catches up: waiters for a
//                       submission, a drain or ring room sleep on it (timed, so a late broadcast costs at most a tick)
//   command buffers     allocated once, before R starts (exec.c vk_exec_init); from then on only R begins, records,
//   and their pool      ends and submits them. T records into one directly only after rec_drain
//   descriptor sets     allocated and their pools reset by T (exec.c), written and bound by R. Allocation and writes
//                       of other sets of a pool may run at the same time (only the set written is externally
//                       synchronized); a slot's pools are reset once its submission is done on the GPU, which implies
//                       R submitted it, which implies R made every call before it (packets run in order)
//   the queue           R's alone (submissions); T uses it only after rec_drain. Presents go on device.c's own queue
//                       once rec_wait_submitted says the submission that signals their semaphore was made
//   Vulkan objects in   images, views, buffers, samplers, pipelines, layouts, query pools: created by T (or the build
//   packets             workers) before the packet that names them; destroyed by T only once the submission that could
//                       use them is done on the GPU - again after R recorded and submitted it
//   stats               RecStats: T's fields plain, R's and the waits' _Atomic relaxed adds; read by T
//   profiling           the profiler's markers (runtime/prof.h): the recorder thread's batches and submits, T's waits on it
#include "record.h"
#include "mvec.h"
#include "../../prof.h"

#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "../../platform.h"

// ================================================================== the ring
typedef void (*PktFn)(const void *args);
typedef struct { PktFn fn; uint32_t size; uint32_t pad; } PktHdr;  // fn NULL: skip to the ring's start
#define PKT_ALIGN 16
#define PUBLISH_EVERY (4u << 10)  // bytes queued before T publishes them (and at every submission and wait)

static uint8_t *ring;
static uint64_t ring_cap;  // (a power of two)
static _Atomic uint64_t head;  // (T) published end
static _Atomic uint64_t tail;  // (R) recorded end
static uint64_t wpos, published;  // (T) written end, the end last published
static pthread_mutex_t mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t cv_work = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER, cv_done = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static _Atomic int asleep;
static _Atomic int done_waiters;  // threads inside a cv_done wait (WAIT_DONE): R broadcasts only when there are any
static _Atomic uint64_t submitted;
static int on = -1;  // 1: the thread records, 0: calls at once, -1: not started
static bool prof, prof_enq;  // SAVAGEWIND_VK_PROF; the time queuing each packet only when it isn't 2 (two clock reads a packet)
static RecStats st_t;  // T's counters
static _Atomic uint64_t r_busy_ns, r_wakeups, r_submit_ns;
static _Atomic uint64_t a_seq_waits, a_seq_wait_ns;  // (waits from any thread)

bool rec_on(void) { return on > 0; }
static __thread bool is_recorder;
bool rec_on_recorder(void) { return is_recorder; }

#define NOW() plat_now_ns()
#define ADD(v, x) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&(v), (x), memory_order_relaxed)

static void timed_wait(pthread_cond_t *cv, uint64_t ns) {  // (mu held)
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
    ts.tv_nsec += (long)(ns % 1000000000ull);
    ts.tv_sec += (time_t)(ns / 1000000000ull);
    if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000) { ts.tv_sec++; ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000; }
    pthread_cond_timedwait(cv, &mu, &ts);
}

// A wait on cv_done (mu held): re-checks `cond` after announcing itself, so a broadcast R skips for want of waiters
// can't be one this waiter needed (R stores tail / submitted, then reads done_waiters, both seq_cst)
#define WAIT_DONE(cond, ns)                                                         \
    for (;;) {                                                                      \
        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&done_waiters, 1, memory_order_seq_cst);          \
        if (!(cond)) { atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&done_waiters, 1, memory_order_seq_cst); break; } \
        timed_wait(&cv_done, (ns));                                                 \
        atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&done_waiters, 1, memory_order_seq_cst);          \
    }

// R: wake whoever waits for a submission, a drain or ring room (nothing to do, and no syscall, when nobody waits)
static void notify_done(void) {
    atomic_thread_fence(memory_order_seq_cst);
    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&done_waiters, memory_order_seq_cst)) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&mu);
    pthread_cond_broadcast(&cv_done);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&mu);
}

// T: what it wrote so far is the recorder's to run
static void publish(void) {
    if (published == wpos) return;
    published = wpos;
    atomic_store_explicit(&head, wpos, memory_order_seq_cst);
    if (atomic_load_explicit(&asleep, memory_order_seq_cst)) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&mu);
        pthread_cond_signal(&cv_work);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&mu);
    }
}

static void slow_wait(const char *what, uint64_t ns);
// T: room for `need` bytes at wpos (the recorder frees room as it records; a full ring means it is behind by its
// whole size, 16 MB of packets, so the wait is rare)
static void wait_room(uint64_t need) {
    if (wpos + need - atomic_load_explicit(&tail, memory_order_acquire) <= ring_cap) return;
    publish();
    SW_ZONE("recorder ring full");
    uint64_t t0 = NOW();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&mu);
    WAIT_DONE(wpos + need - atomic_load_explicit(&tail, memory_order_acquire) > ring_cap, 1000000);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&mu);
    st_t.full_waits++;
    st_t.full_ns += NOW() - t0;
    slow_wait("room in the ring", NOW() - t0);
}

// T: a packet for fn with `args` bytes of arguments (+ `extra` bytes of arrays after them, each caller aligns its
// own); returns the arguments' place. Committed with commit() once filled.
static void *push(PktFn fn, size_t args, size_t extra) {
    uint64_t need = (sizeof(PktHdr) + ((args + PKT_ALIGN - 1) & ~(size_t)(PKT_ALIGN - 1)) + extra + PKT_ALIGN - 1) & ~(uint64_t)(PKT_ALIGN - 1);
    if (need > ring_cap / 4) FATAL("[vk] recorder: a packet of %llu bytes does not fit the ring\n", (unsigned long long)need);
    uint64_t at = wpos & (ring_cap - 1);
    if (at + need > ring_cap) {  // no room before the end: a skip packet, the real one at the start
        uint64_t skip = ring_cap - at;
        wait_room(skip);
        PktHdr *s = (PktHdr *)(ring + at);
        s->fn = NULL;
        s->size = (uint32_t)skip;
        wpos += skip;
        at = 0;
    }
    wait_room(need);
    PktHdr *h = (PktHdr *)(ring + at);
    h->fn = fn;
    h->size = (uint32_t)need;
    wpos += need;
    st_t.packets++;
    st_t.bytes += need;
    SW_TALLY("vk packets");
    return h + 1;
}
static uint64_t publish_every = PUBLISH_EVERY;  // (rec_init: 64 KB where R doesn't spin)
static void commit(void) {
    if (wpos - published >= publish_every) publish();
}
// (the arrays of a packet: after its arguments, 16-aligned)
#define AL16(n) (((n) + 15) & ~(size_t)15)
static inline void *after(const void *args, size_t args_size) { return (uint8_t *)args + AL16(args_size); }

// ---- the thread
// R spins this long for the next packets before it sleeps: T hands it a few KB every 50-100 us while it translates
// a list, and each of those finds R asleep otherwise, a wake-up syscall (~6 us on T, ~25 us before R runs). On CPUs
// with fewer than 6 logical processors R sleeps at once, as before. SAVAGEWIND_VK_RECORDER_SPIN=<us> (0: never sleeps
// late; default 60).
static uint64_t spin_ns;
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
#define RELAX() __builtin_ia32_pause()
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
#define RELAX() __asm__ volatile("yield")
#else
#define RELAX() ((void)0)
#endif
static uint64_t spin_for_work(uint64_t t) {  // the published end once it moves past t, else t
    uint64_t t0 = NOW(), h;
    for (unsigned i = 1;; i++) {
        if ((h = atomic_load_explicit(&head, memory_order_acquire)) != t) return h;
        RELAX();
        if (!(i & 31) && NOW() - t0 > spin_ns) return t;
    }
}

static void *run(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    is_recorder = true;
    prof_thread_name("vk-record");
    plat_thread_elevate();
    extern void control_prof_thread(const char *name);  // runtime/control_prof.c (`threads`)
    control_prof_thread("recorder");
    uint64_t t = 0;
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t h = atomic_load_explicit(&head, memory_order_acquire);
        if (h == t && spin_ns && (h = spin_for_work(t)) != t) {
            // work came while spinning: no sleep, no wake-up syscall on T's side
        } else if (h == t) {
            pthread_mutex_lock(&mu);
            atomic_store_explicit(&asleep, 1, memory_order_seq_cst);
            while ((h = atomic_load_explicit(&head, memory_order_seq_cst)) == t) pthread_cond_wait(&cv_work, &mu);
            atomic_store_explicit(&asleep, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&mu);
            ADD(r_wakeups, 1);
        }
        uint64_t t0 = prof ? NOW() : 0;
        SW_ZONE("record packets");
        while (t != h) {
            const PktHdr *p = (const PktHdr *)(ring + (t & (ring_cap - 1)));
            if (p->fn) p->fn(p + 1);
            t += p->size;
            atomic_store_explicit(&tail, t, memory_order_release);
        }
        if (prof) ADD(r_busy_ns, NOW() - t0);
        notify_done();  // caught up: drains and waiters
    }
    return NULL;
}

void rec_init(void) {
    if (on >= 0) return;
    prof = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_PROF") != NULL;
    prof_enq = prof && atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_PROF")) != 2;
    {
        const char *sp = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_RECORDER_SPIN");
        long us = sp ? atol(sp) : 60;
        if (!sp && plat_cpu_count() < 6) us = 0;
        spin_ns = us > 0 ? (uint64_t)us * 1000 : 0;
    }
    // Where R sleeps at once (no spin: fewer than 6 logical processors), each publish of 4 KB woke it, a syscall on T
    // (6.7% of T's busy time, 4 cores, Rito): 64 KB there (RTX 3060 limited to 4 cores at 720p: Rito 102 -> 106 fps,
    // castle 149 -> 153; 2 cores / 4 threads: Rito 76 -> 81, castle 105 -> 110). Submissions and waits still publish
    // at once. With the spin, the same either way. SAVAGEWIND_VK_PUBLISH_KB=<KB> sets it.
    if (!spin_ns) publish_every = 64u << 10;
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_PUBLISH_KB") && atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_PUBLISH_KB")) > 0)
        publish_every = (uint64_t)atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_PUBLISH_KB")) << 10;
    const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_RECORDER");
    int want = !e || atoi(e) != 0;
    // ARM's Mali drivers: LAS Recomp lost the GPU a few seconds into its title screen with the recorder thread on
    // (Mali-G610, LAS #358) and ran fine with it off; SAVAGEWIND_VK_RECORDER=1 still turns it on there
    bool mali = g_vk.props.vendorID == 0x13B5;
    if (mali && !e) want = 0;
    on = 0;
    if (want) {
        const char *mb = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_RECORDER_MB");
        uint64_t cap = (uint64_t)(mb && atoi(mb) > 0 ? atoi(mb) : 16) << 20;
        while (cap & (cap - 1)) cap &= cap - 1;  // (a power of two)
        ring = malloc(cap);
        pthread_t th;
        pthread_attr_t attr;
        pthread_attr_init(&attr);
        pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 1 << 20);
        ring_cap = cap;  // (before the thread exists)
        int rc = ring ? pthread_create(&th, &attr, run, NULL) : 0;
        if (rc) {
            // glibc takes the static TLS of every thread out of its stack and fails with EINVAL when a requested
            // size leaves no room for it; the default stack (8 MB on Linux) does
            LOG("[vk] recorder thread: a 1 MB stack failed (%s), trying the default stack\n", strerror(rc));
            rc = pthread_create(&th, NULL, run, NULL);
        }
        if (!ring || rc) {
            LOG("[vk] recorder thread: could not start (%s, error %d): Vulkan calls on the queue thread\n",
                ring ? strerror(rc) : "out of memory", rc);
            free(ring);
            ring = NULL;
            ring_cap = 0;
        } else {
            pthread_detach(th);
            on = 1;
        }
        pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
    }
    LOG("[vk] recorder thread %s%s\n", on ? "on" : "off", mali && !e ? " (Mali driver)" : "");
}

// ================================================================== waits
// A wait on the recorder this long (a quarter second) is logged: the recorder was stuck in a driver call (a slow
// vkQueueSubmit2 is logged too, just before) or the whole process stalled
static void slow_wait(const char *what, uint64_t ns) {
    if (ns <= 250000000) return;
    static _Atomic int n;
    if (atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&n, 1, memory_order_relaxed) < 20) LOG("[vk] recorder: a wait for %s took %llu ms\n", what, (unsigned long long)(ns / 1000000));
}

uint64_t rec_submitted(void) { return atomic_load_explicit(&submitted, memory_order_acquire); }

void rec_wait_submitted(uint64_t seq) {
    if (on <= 0 || rec_submitted() >= seq) return;
    SW_ZONE("wait for recorder submit");
    uint64_t t0 = NOW();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&mu);
    WAIT_DONE(rec_submitted() < seq, 2000000);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&mu);
    uint64_t dt = NOW() - t0;
    ADD(a_seq_waits, 1);
    ADD(a_seq_wait_ns, dt);
    slow_wait("a submission", dt);
}

void rec_drain(void) {
    if (on <= 0) return;
    publish();
    uint64_t upto = wpos;
    if (atomic_load_explicit(&tail, memory_order_acquire) >= upto) return;
    SW_ZONE("recorder drain");
    uint64_t t0 = NOW();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&mu);
    WAIT_DONE(atomic_load_explicit(&tail, memory_order_acquire) < upto, 2000000);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&mu);
    uint64_t dt = NOW() - t0;
    st_t.drains++;
    st_t.drain_ns += dt;
    slow_wait("a drain", dt);
}

// ================================================================== stats
void rec_stats_take(RecStats *o) {
    *o = st_t;
    memset(&st_t, 0, sizeof st_t);
    o->busy_ns = atomic_exchange_explicit(&r_busy_ns, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
    o->wakeups = atomic_exchange_explicit(&r_wakeups, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
    o->submit_ns = atomic_exchange_explicit(&r_submit_ns, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
    o->seq_waits = atomic_exchange_explicit(&a_seq_waits, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
    o->seq_wait_ns = atomic_exchange_explicit(&a_seq_wait_ns, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
}

// (T) time spent queuing: around every rec_* that queues, when profiling in detail
// (and, in the profiler's capture (runtime/prof.h), added up under one name)
#define ENQ_T0() SW_ACC("vk enqueue"); uint64_t enq_t0_ = prof_enq ? NOW() : 0
#define ENQ_END() do { if (prof_enq) st_t.enqueue_ns += NOW() - enq_t0_; } while (0)

// ================================================================== descriptor writes
static bool write_is_image(const VkWriteDescriptorSet *w) {
    switch (w->descriptorType) {
    case VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER: case VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER: case VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE:
    case VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE: case VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT:
        return true;
    default: return false;
    }
}
typedef union { VkDescriptorBufferInfo b; VkDescriptorImageInfo i; } WriteInfo;
typedef struct { uint32_t n; } UpdateArgs;  // then: n VkWriteDescriptorSet, then n WriteInfo
static void update_sets_run(const void *p) {
    const UpdateArgs *a = p;
    VkWriteDescriptorSet *w = after(a, sizeof *a);
    const WriteInfo *inf = after(w, a->n * sizeof *w);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < a->n; i++) {
        if (write_is_image(&w[i])) w[i].pImageInfo = &inf[i].i;
        else w[i].pBufferInfo = &inf[i].b;
    }
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(g_vk.dev, a->n, w, 0, NULL);
}
void rec_UpdateDescriptorSets(uint32_t n, const VkWriteDescriptorSet *w) {
    if (on <= 0) { vkUpdateDescriptorSets(g_vk.dev, n, w, 0, NULL); return; }
    ENQ_T0();
    UpdateArgs *a = push(update_sets_run, sizeof *a, AL16(n * sizeof *w) + n * sizeof(WriteInfo));
    a->n = n;
    VkWriteDescriptorSet *pw = after(a, sizeof *a);
    WriteInfo *inf = after(pw, n * sizeof *pw);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (w[i].descriptorCount != 1 || w[i].pNext || w[i].pTexelBufferView)
            FATAL("[vk] recorder: a descriptor write it can't carry (%u descriptors)\n", w[i].descriptorCount);
        pw[i] = w[i];
        if (write_is_image(&w[i])) inf[i].i = *w[i].pImageInfo;
        else inf[i].b = *w[i].pBufferInfo;
        pw[i].pImageInfo = NULL; pw[i].pBufferInfo = NULL;  // (set again when run)
    }
    commit();
    ENQ_END();
}

// ================================================================== command buffers, submissions
static void push_mvec_forget(void);
static void begin_cb_run(const void *p) {
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO, .flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT};
    VK_CHECK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(*(const VkCommandBuffer *)p, &bi));
    push_mvec_forget();
}
void rec_BeginCommandBuffer(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (on <= 0) { begin_cb_run(&cb); return; }
    ENQ_T0();
    *(VkCommandBuffer *)push(begin_cb_run, sizeof cb, 0) = cb;
    commit();
    ENQ_END();
}
static void end_cb_run(const void *p) { VK_CHECK(vkEndCommandBuffer(*(const VkCommandBuffer *)p)); }
void rec_EndCommandBuffer(VkCommandBuffer cb) {
    if (on <= 0) { end_cb_run(&cb); return; }
    ENQ_T0();
    *(VkCommandBuffer *)push(end_cb_run, sizeof cb, 0) = cb;
    commit();
    ENQ_END();
}

typedef struct {
    VkCommandBufferSubmitInfo cbs[2];
    VkSemaphoreSubmitInfo wait[2], sig[2];
    uint32_t ncb, nwait, nsig;
    uint64_t seq;
} SubmitArgs;
static void submit_run(const void *p) {
    const SubmitArgs *a = p;
    VkSubmitInfo2 si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO_2, .commandBufferInfoCount = a->ncb, .pCommandBufferInfos = a->cbs,
                        .signalSemaphoreInfoCount = a->nsig, .pSignalSemaphoreInfos = a->sig,
                        .waitSemaphoreInfoCount = a->nwait, .pWaitSemaphoreInfos = a->wait};
    SW_ZONE("vkQueueSubmit2");
    uint64_t t0 = NOW();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vk_queue_lock);
    VkResult r = vkQueueSubmit2(g_vk.queue, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vk_queue_lock);
    uint64_t dt = NOW() - t0;
    if (prof) ADD(r_submit_ns, dt);
    if (dt > 50000000) {  // (a driver stall: a slow wait on the recorder shows where it was)
        static int n;
        if (n++ < 20) LOG("[vk] vkQueueSubmit2 of submission %llu took %llu ms\n", (unsigned long long)a->seq, (unsigned long long)(dt / 1000000));
    }
    if (r == VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST) { extern void vk_devlost_dump(void); vk_devlost_dump(); }
    VK_CHECK(r);
    atomic_store_explicit(&submitted, a->seq, memory_order_release);
    if (on > 0) notify_done();
}
void rec_QueueSubmit2(const VkSubmitInfo2 *si, uint64_t seq) {
    SubmitArgs a = {.ncb = si->commandBufferInfoCount, .nwait = si->waitSemaphoreInfoCount, .nsig = si->signalSemaphoreInfoCount, .seq = seq};
    if (a.ncb > 2 || a.nwait > 2 || a.nsig > 2 || si->pNext) FATAL("[vk] recorder: a submission it can't carry\n");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < a.ncb; i++) a.cbs[i] = si->pCommandBufferInfos[i];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < a.nwait; i++) a.wait[i] = si->pWaitSemaphoreInfos[i];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < a.nsig; i++) a.sig[i] = si->pSignalSemaphoreInfos[i];
    if (on <= 0) { submit_run(&a); return; }
    ENQ_T0();
    *(SubmitArgs *)push(submit_run, sizeof a, 0) = a;
    publish();  // (whoever waits for the submission must not wait for the next batch)
    ENQ_END();
}

// fn(arg) made by the recorder in its turn, in order with the commands; published at once, as its caller may count on
// what fn does (device.c's presents)
typedef struct { void (*fn)(void *); void *arg; } CustomArgs;
static void custom_run(const void *p) { const CustomArgs *a = p; a->fn(a->arg); }
void rec_custom(void (*fn)(void *), void *arg) {
    CustomArgs a = {fn, arg};
    if (on <= 0) { custom_run(&a); return; }
    ENQ_T0();
    *(CustomArgs *)push(custom_run, sizeof a, 0) = a;
    publish();
    ENQ_END();
}

// ================================================================== commands
// Scalar arguments: a struct of the command buffer and the values, made by a macro from the parameter list.
#define CMD_ARGS(name, ...) typedef struct { VkCommandBuffer cb; __VA_ARGS__ } name##Args;
#define CMD_QUEUE(name, ...) \
    do { if (on <= 0) { vk##name(__VA_ARGS__); return; } ENQ_T0(); name##Args *a_ = push(name##_run, sizeof *a_, 0); \
         *a_ = (name##Args){__VA_ARGS__}; commit(); ENQ_END(); } while (0)
```
