    // with an entry point per pass. a = SMAA_RT_METRICS (1 / size, size). The vertex-stage offset helpers run per
    // pixel here. Luma edges (t0 = colour) -> blending weights (t0 = edges, t1 = area, t2 = search) -> neighbourhood
    // blending (t0 = colour, t1 = weights). Vulkan's texture origin is top-left, as SMAA expects (no flips).
    if (!strncmp(name, "smaa_", 5)) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        static char *src[3];
        int k = !strcmp(name, "smaa_edge.frag") ? 0 : !strcmp(name, "smaa_weight.frag") ? 1 : !strcmp(name, "smaa_blend.frag") ? 2 : -1;
        if (k < 0) return NULL;
        if (!src[k]) {
            extern const char smaa_hlsl_src[];
            static const char *head =
                "#version 450\n"
                "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
                "#define SMAA_RT_METRICS pc.a\n"
                "#define SMAA_GLSL_4\n"
                "#define SMAA_PRESET_HIGH\n";
            static const char *mains[3] = {
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
                "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
                "void main() {\n"
                "  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy * SMAA_RT_METRICS.xy;\n"
                "  vec4 off[3];\n"
                "  SMAAEdgeDetectionVS(uv, off);\n"
                "  o = vec4(SMAALumaEdgeDetectionPS(uv, off, t0), 0.0, 0.0);\n"
                "}\n",
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D t1;\n"
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 2) uniform sampler2D t2;\n"
                "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
                "void main() {\n"
                "  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy * SMAA_RT_METRICS.xy, pix;\n"
                "  vec4 off[3];\n"
                "  SMAABlendingWeightCalculationVS(uv, pix, off);\n"
                "  o = SMAABlendingWeightCalculationPS(uv, pix, off, t0, t1, t2, vec4(0.0));\n"
                "}\n",
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
                "layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D t1;\n"
                "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
                "void main() {\n"
                "  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy * SMAA_RT_METRICS.xy;\n"
                "  vec4 off;\n"
                "  SMAANeighborhoodBlendingVS(uv, off);\n"
                "  o = vec4(SMAANeighborhoodBlendingPS(uv, off, t0, t1).rgb, 1.0);\n"
                "}\n"};
            size_t n = strlen(head) + strlen(smaa_hlsl_src) + strlen(mains[k]) + 1;
            src[k] = malloc(n);
            snprintf(src[k], n, "%s%s%s", head, smaa_hlsl_src, mains[k]);
        }
        return src[k];
    }
    // AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1 (MIT), EASU: edge-adaptive upscale. a = (in / out scale xy, offset zw),
    // b.xy = input size (alpha: bilinear, for the 3D scene's composite, exec.c scene_upscale). 12 taps around the source pixel, direction / edge length from luma, Lanczos-2-like
    // weights stretched along the edge, clamped to the nearest 4 (no ringing). b.z = 1: the input is linear (BOTW's
    // 3D scene, exec.c scene_post): taken to gamma 2.0 first, as FSR 1 wants perceptual input, and left there for
    // RCAS. In linear light the small differences in shadows and leaves counted for little next to the lit parts', so
    // the edge directions and the clamp to the nearest 4 made flat blotches there once the composite's gamma brought
    // them out: rocks and trees looked posterized, the more the smaller the scene (#141).
    if (!strcmp(name, "easu.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t;\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
               "vec3 tap(ivec2 p) {\n"
               "  vec3 c = texelFetch(t, clamp(p, ivec2(0), ivec2(pc.b.xy) - 1), 0).rgb;\n"
               "  return pc.b.z > 0.5 ? sqrt(max(c, vec3(0.0))) : c;\n"
               "}\n"
               "float lum(vec3 c) { return c.g + 0.5 * (c.r + c.b); }\n"
               "void setf(inout vec2 dir, inout float len, float w, float lA, float lB, float lC, float lD, float lE) {\n"
               "  float dx = lD - lB, dy = lE - lA;\n"
               "  float lx = clamp(abs(dx) / max(max(abs(lD - lC), abs(lC - lB)), 1.0 / 65536.0), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "  float ly = clamp(abs(dy) / max(max(abs(lE - lC), abs(lC - lA)), 1.0 / 65536.0), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "  dir += vec2(dx, dy) * w;\n"
               "  len += (lx * lx + ly * ly) * w;\n"
               "}\n"
               "void tapf(inout vec3 ac, inout float aw, vec2 off, vec2 dir, vec2 len2, float lob, float clp, vec3 c) {\n"
               "  vec2 v = vec2(dot(off, dir), dot(off, vec2(-dir.y, dir.x))) * len2;\n"
               "  float d2 = min(dot(v, v), clp);\n"
               "  float wb = 0.4 * d2 - 1.0, wa = lob * d2 - 1.0;\n"
               "  wb *= wb; wa *= wa;\n"
               "  float w = (1.5625 * wb - 0.5625) * wa;\n"
               "  ac += c * w; aw += w;\n"
               "}\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  vec2 pp = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy) * pc.a.xy + pc.a.zw;\n"
               "  float alpha = texture(t, (pp + 0.5) / pc.b.xy).a;\n"
               "  vec2 fpf = floor(pp); pp -= fpf;\n"
               "  ivec2 fp = ivec2(fpf);\n"
               "  //    b c\n"
               "  //  e f g h\n"
               "  //  i j k l\n"
               "  //    n o\n"
               "  vec3 bC = tap(fp + ivec2(0, -1)), cC = tap(fp + ivec2(1, -1));\n"
               "  vec3 eC = tap(fp + ivec2(-1, 0)), fC = tap(fp), gC = tap(fp + ivec2(1, 0)), hC = tap(fp + ivec2(2, 0));\n"
               "  vec3 iC = tap(fp + ivec2(-1, 1)), jC = tap(fp + ivec2(0, 1)), kC = tap(fp + ivec2(1, 1)), lC = tap(fp + ivec2(2, 1));\n"
               "  vec3 nC = tap(fp + ivec2(0, 2)), oC = tap(fp + ivec2(1, 2));\n"
               "  float bL = lum(bC), cL = lum(cC), eL = lum(eC), fL = lum(fC), gL = lum(gC), hL = lum(hC);\n"
               "  float iL = lum(iC), jL = lum(jC), kL = lum(kC), lL = lum(lC), nL = lum(nC), oL = lum(oC);\n"
               "  vec2 dir = vec2(0.0);\n"
               "  float len = 0.0;\n"
               "  setf(dir, len, (1.0 - pp.x) * (1.0 - pp.y), bL, eL, fL, gL, jL);\n"
               "  setf(dir, len, pp.x * (1.0 - pp.y), cL, fL, gL, hL, kL);\n"
               "  setf(dir, len, (1.0 - pp.x) * pp.y, fL, iL, jL, kL, nL);\n"
               "  setf(dir, len, pp.x * pp.y, gL, jL, kL, lL, oL);\n"
               "  float dr = dot(dir, dir);\n"
               "  bool zro = dr < 1.0 / 32768.0;\n"
               "  dir = zro ? vec2(1.0, 0.0) : dir * inversesqrt(dr);\n"
               "  len = len * 0.5; len *= len;\n"
               "  float stretch = dot(dir, dir) / max(abs(dir.x), abs(dir.y));\n"
               "  vec2 len2 = vec2(1.0 + (stretch - 1.0) * len, 1.0 - 0.5 * len);\n"
               "  float lob = 0.5 - 0.29 * len, clp = 1.0 / lob;\n"
               "  vec3 mn = min(min(fC, gC), min(jC, kC)), mx = max(max(fC, gC), max(jC, kC));\n"
               "  vec3 ac = vec3(0.0);\n"
               "  float aw = 0.0;\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(0.0, -1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, bC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(1.0, -1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, cC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(-1.0, 1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, iC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(0.0, 1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, jC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(0.0, 0.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, fC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(-1.0, 0.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, eC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(1.0, 1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, kC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(2.0, 1.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, lC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(2.0, 0.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, hC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(1.0, 0.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, gC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(1.0, 2.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, oC);\n"
               "  tapf(ac, aw, vec2(0.0, 2.0) - pp, dir, len2, lob, clp, nC);\n"
               "  vec3 bilerp = mix(mix(fC, gC, pp.x), mix(jC, kC, pp.x), pp.y);\n"
               "  vec3 c = aw > 1.0 / 32768.0 ? ac / aw : bilerp;\n"
               "  if (isnan(c.r) || isnan(c.g) || isnan(c.b) || isinf(c.r) || isinf(c.g) || isinf(c.b)) c = bilerp;\n"
               "  o = vec4(clamp(c, mn, mx), alpha);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // FSR 1 RCAS: contrast-adaptive sharpening of the EASU output (same size). a.x = sharpness (exp2(-stops)),
    // b.xy = image size. The lobe is limited so the result stays inside the neighbours' range; noise is damped.
    // b.z = 1: the input is EASU's gamma 2.0 of a linear image, the output linear again.
    if (!strcmp(name, "rcas.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t;\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
               "vec3 tap(ivec2 p) { return texelFetch(t, clamp(p, ivec2(0), ivec2(pc.b.xy) - 1), 0).rgb; }\n"
               "float lum(vec3 c) { return c.g + 0.5 * (c.r + c.b); }\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  ivec2 ip = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy);\n"
               "  //    b\n"
               "  //  d e f\n"
               "  //    h\n"
               "  vec3 b = tap(ip + ivec2(0, -1)), d = tap(ip + ivec2(-1, 0)), e = tap(ip), f = tap(ip + ivec2(1, 0)), h = tap(ip + ivec2(0, 1));\n"
               "  float bL = lum(b), dL = lum(d), eL = lum(e), fL = lum(f), hL = lum(h);\n"
               "  float nz = 0.25 * (bL + dL + fL + hL) - eL;\n"
               "  float rng = max(max(max(bL, dL), max(eL, fL)), hL) - min(min(min(bL, dL), min(eL, fL)), hL);\n"
               "  nz = 1.0 - 0.5 * clamp(abs(nz) / max(rng, 1.0 / 65536.0), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "  vec3 mn4 = min(min(b, d), min(f, h)), mx4 = max(max(b, d), max(f, h));\n"
               "  vec3 hitMin = min(mn4, e) / max(4.0 * mx4, vec3(1.0 / 65536.0));\n"
               "  vec3 hitMax = (1.0 - max(mx4, e)) / min(4.0 * mn4 - 4.0, vec3(-1.0 / 65536.0));\n"
               "  vec3 lobeRGB = max(-hitMin, hitMax);\n"
               "  float lobe = max(-(0.25 - 1.0 / 16.0), min(max(lobeRGB.r, max(lobeRGB.g, lobeRGB.b)), 0.0)) * pc.a.x * nz;\n"
               "  vec3 r = (lobe * (b + d + f + h) + e) / (4.0 * lobe + 1.0);\n"
               "  if (isnan(r.r) || isnan(r.g) || isnan(r.b) || isinf(r.r) || isinf(r.g) || isinf(r.b)) r = e;\n"
               "  r = clamp(r, vec3(0.0), vec3(1.0));\n"
               "  o = vec4(pc.b.z > 0.5 ? r * r : r, texelFetch(t, ip, 0).a);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // AMD FidelityFX CAS (MIT), contrast-adaptive sharpening without scaling (ffx_cas.h CasFilter, its green-weight
    // path): a 3x3 neighbourhood's soft minimum and maximum set how far each pixel may be pushed away from its cross
    // neighbours, so edges sharpen without halos and flat or noisy areas stay. a.x = sharpness 0..1 (peak -1/8 ..
    // -1/5), b.xy = image size. Alpha passes through (exec.c scene_post).
    // Motion vectors over the scene (SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_VIEW, exec.c mvec_scene_view): t0 the scene, t1 the motion vectors
    // (exec.c mvec_fill: NDC distance from the previous frame in .xy; .a 1 for a draw's own vector, 0.5 for the camera's,
    // 0 for none). The scene's grey mixed with a hue for the direction, as strong as the length against a.x pixels;
    // camera vectors hatched; no vector: the scene darkened and blue; the reactive mask (.z, 4x: effects are faint)
    // magenta over them. a.x < 0:
    // raw (red = .a, green / blue = |x| / |y|
    // times -a.x). b.xy: the motion vectors' size, b.zw: the output's.
    if (!strcmp(name, "mvec_view.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D t1;\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / pc.b.zw;\n"
               "  vec4 s = texture(t0, uv);\n"
               "  float l = dot(s.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));\n"
               "  vec4 m = texelFetch(t1, ivec2(uv * pc.b.xy), 0);\n"
               "  if (pc.a.x < 0.0) { o = vec4(m.a, clamp(abs(m.xy) * -pc.a.x, 0.0, 1.0), s.a); return; }\n"
               "  if (m.a < 0.25) { o = vec4(l * 0.3, l * 0.3, l * 0.3 + 0.2, s.a); return; }\n"
               "  vec2 px = m.xy * 0.5 * pc.b.xy;\n"
               "  float k = clamp(length(px) / max(pc.a.x, 0.001), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "  vec3 hue = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(atan(px.y, px.x) + vec3(0.0, 2.094, 4.189));\n"
               "  vec3 c = mix(vec3(l * 0.6), hue, k);\n"
               "  if (m.a < 0.75 && ((int(gl_FragCoord.x + gl_FragCoord.y) >> 3) & 1) != 0) c = mix(c, vec3(l * 0.6), 0.65);\n"
               "  c = mix(c, vec3(1.0, 0.25, 1.0), clamp(m.z * 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.8);\n"
               "  o = vec4(c, s.a);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // Motion vectors for the pixels no draw gave one (exec.c mvec_fill): t0 the object vectors (begin_pass's motion
    // target, alpha 1 where written), t1 the scene depth. Those pixels get the camera's motion: this frame's NDC from
    // their position and depth, taken by m (the previous frame's view-projection * the inverse of this frame's) to the
    // previous frame's; alpha 0.5. Vectors are clip-space NDC differences, as the object vectors (mvec_rt): the
    // viewports have a negative height (exec.c set_viewport: y up), so a pixel's clip y is minus its framebuffer NDC y,
    // and the game's NDC y is that times a.x (-1 when the vertex shaders flip y, ShaderKey.flip_y). a.y: 1 when the
    // game's depth range is [-1, 1] (depth = (z + 1) / 2). a.z: 1 = camera vectors everywhere, 2 = camera minus object
    // vector where there is one (SAVAGEWIND_MVEC_CAMONLY). b.xy: this frame's jitter minus the previous frame's in the
    // game's NDC (mvec_reprojection), taken out of every vector: what remains is the motion alone.
    if (!strcmp(name, "mvec_fill.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler2D t1;\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { layout(row_major) mat4 m; vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  ivec2 p = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy);\n"
               "  vec4 v = texelFetch(t0, p, 0);\n"
               "  vec2 jit = vec2(pc.b.x, pc.b.y * pc.a.x);\n"
               "  if (v.a > 0.5 && pc.a.z == 0.0) { o = vec4(v.xy - jit, v.zw); return; }\n"
               "  if (v.a < 0.5 && pc.a.z == 2.0) { o = vec4(0.0); return; }\n"
               "  vec2 fb = gl_FragCoord.xy / vec2(textureSize(t0, 0)) * 2.0 - 1.0;\n"
               "  vec2 clip = vec2(fb.x, -fb.y);\n"
               "  float d = texelFetch(t1, p, 0).r;\n"
               "  vec4 q = pc.m * vec4(clip.x, clip.y * pc.a.x, pc.a.y != 0.0 ? d * 2.0 - 1.0 : d, 1.0);\n"
               "  vec2 prev = vec2(q.x, q.y * pc.a.x) / q.w;\n"
               "  o = pc.a.z == 2.0 ? vec4(clip - prev - v.xy, 0.0, 1.0) : vec4(clip - prev - jit, v.z, 0.5);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // FSR 3's inputs (exec.c fsr3_scene), at the render size: the scene depth as R32F (t0, a depth view), and the
    // reactive mask from the motion vectors' .z (t0) as R8
    if (!strcmp(name, "fsr3_depth.frag") || !strcmp(name, "fsr3_reactive.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return name[5] == 'd' ? "#version 450\n"
                                "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
                                "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
                                "void main() { o = vec4(texelFetch(t0, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0).r); }\n"
                              : "#version 450\n"
                                "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t0;\n"
                                "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
                                "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
                                "void main() { o = vec4(clamp(texelFetch(t0, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0).z * pc.a.x, 0.0, 1.0)); }\n";
    }
    if (!strncmp(name, "taa_", 4)) {
        static const char *const names[] = {"taa_prepare.comp", "taa_shade_src.comp", "taa_shade_down.comp", "taa_shade.comp",
                                            "taa_reactivity.comp", "taa_instability.comp", "taa_resolve.comp", "taa_lite.comp"};
        static const char *const bodies[] = {taa_prepare, taa_shade_src, taa_shade_down, taa_shade, taa_reactivity,
                                             taa_instability, taa_resolve, taa_lite};
        static char *src[8];
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            if (strcmp(name, names[i])) continue;
            if (!src[i]) {
                size_t a = strlen(taa_common), b = strlen(bodies[i]);
                src[i] = malloc(a + b + 1);
                memcpy(src[i], taa_common, a);
                memcpy(src[i] + a, bodies[i], b + 1);
            }
            *stage = STAGE_COMPUTE;
            return src[i];
        }
        return NULL;
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "cas.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t;\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 a; vec4 b; } pc;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"
               "vec3 tap(ivec2 p) { return texelFetch(t, clamp(p, ivec2(0), ivec2(pc.b.xy) - 1), 0).rgb; }\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  ivec2 ip = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy);\n"
               "  //  a b c\n"
               "  //  d e f\n"
               "  //  g h i\n"
               "  vec3 a = tap(ip + ivec2(-1, -1)), b = tap(ip + ivec2(0, -1)), c = tap(ip + ivec2(1, -1));\n"
               "  vec3 d = tap(ip + ivec2(-1, 0)), f = tap(ip + ivec2(1, 0));\n"
               "  vec3 g = tap(ip + ivec2(-1, 1)), h = tap(ip + ivec2(0, 1)), i = tap(ip + ivec2(1, 1));\n"
               "  vec4 e4 = texelFetch(t, ip, 0);\n"
               "  vec3 e = e4.rgb;\n"
               "  vec3 mn = min(min(min(d, e), min(f, b)), h);\n"
               "  vec3 mn2 = min(min(min(mn, a), min(c, g)), i);\n"
               "  mn += mn2;\n"
               "  vec3 mx = max(max(max(d, e), max(f, b)), h);\n"
               "  vec3 mx2 = max(max(max(mx, a), max(c, g)), i);\n"
               "  mx += mx2;\n"
               "  vec3 amp = clamp(min(mn, 2.0 - mx) / max(mx, vec3(1.0 / 65536.0)), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
               "  amp = sqrt(amp);\n"
               "  float peak = -1.0 / mix(8.0, 5.0, clamp(pc.a.x, 0.0, 1.0));\n"
               "  float w = amp.g * peak;\n"
               "  vec3 r = (b * w + d * w + f * w + h * w + e) / (1.0 + 4.0 * w);\n"
               "  o = vec4(max(r, 0.0), e4.a);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // Colour grading of the 3D scene (Video > Colour; exec.c scene_post, runtime/color_grade.h). The scene holds
    // linear light (BOTW's 10-bit composite input; the game sRGB-encodes the final image when it presents it). In
    // linear light: g.rgb = exposure x white balance, a.x = saturation (Rec. 709 luma kept). Then, sRGB-encoded as the
    // picture is seen: contrast, an S curve through 0, 0.5 and 1 with slope g.w in its middle, and (grade_lut.frag) the
    // LUT, t1, sampled trilinearly at texel centres (a.z = its size) after DOMAIN_MIN / MAX (dmin, dscale), mixed in
    // by a.y. Back to linear for the composite. Alpha passes through.
    if (!strcmp(name, "grade.frag") || !strcmp(name, "grade_lut.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
#define GRADE_BODY                                                                                              \
    "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D t;\n"                                                       \
    "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 g; vec4 a; vec4 dmin; vec4 dscale; } pc;\n"                        \
    "layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;\n"                                                                        \
    "vec3 enc(vec3 c) { return mix(c * 12.92, 1.055 * pow(c, vec3(1.0 / 2.4)) - 0.055, step(0.0031308, c)); }\n" \
    "vec3 dec(vec3 c) { return mix(c / 12.92, pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, vec3(2.4)), step(0.04045, c)); }\n"     \
    "void main() {\n"                                                                                           \
    "  vec4 s = texelFetch(t, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0);\n"                                                    \
    "  vec3 c = s.rgb * pc.g.rgb;\n"                                                                            \
    "  float y = dot(c, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));\n"                                                       \
    "  c = max(mix(vec3(y), c, pc.a.x), 0.0);\n"                                                                \
    "  vec3 hdr = max(c - vec3(1.0), vec3(0.0));\n"                                                             \
    "  vec3 x = enc(min(c, 1.0));\n"                                                                            \
    "  vec3 lo = 0.5 * pow(2.0 * x, vec3(pc.g.w)), hi = 1.0 - 0.5 * pow(max(2.0 - 2.0 * x, 0.0), vec3(pc.g.w));\n" \
    "  x = mix(lo, hi, step(0.5, x));\n"                                                                        \
    "#ifdef LUT\n"                                                                                              \
    "  vec3 u = clamp((x - pc.dmin.xyz) * pc.dscale.xyz, 0.0, 1.0);\n"                                          \
    "  vec3 l = texture(t1, u * ((pc.a.z - 1.0) / pc.a.z) + 0.5 / pc.a.z).rgb;\n"                               \
    "  x = mix(x, clamp(l, 0.0, 1.0), pc.a.y);\n"                                                               \
    "#endif\n"                                                                                                  \
    "  o = vec4(dec(x) + hdr, s.a);\n"                                                                          \
    "}\n"
        if (name[5] == '_')
            return "#version 450\n#define LUT 1\nlayout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform sampler3D t1;\n" GRADE_BODY;
        return "#version 450\n" GRADE_BODY;
#undef GRADE_BODY
    }
    // Frame generation's camera motion vectors (exec.c vk_fg_generate): the 3D scene's depth at each pixel back to
    // NDC, through m (the previous frame's view-projection x this one's inverse) to where that point was, as a uv
    // offset (previous - this). b = depth size, the rows' direction in NDC (+1: row 0 at the bottom), 1 when the depth
    // is OpenGL's -1..1 (NVN's default depth mode). Link's box (uv min, max) and depth range: his own motion there (lk.zw).
    if (!strcmp(name, "fg_mv.frag")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D d;\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { mat4 m; vec4 b; vec4 box; vec4 lk; } pc;\n"
               "layout(location = 0) out vec2 o;\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / pc.b.xy;\n"
               "  float z = texelFetch(d, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0).r;\n"
               "  vec4 c = pc.m * vec4(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, (uv.y * 2.0 - 1.0) * pc.b.z, pc.b.w > 0.5 ? z * 2.0 - 1.0 : z, 1.0);\n"
               "  vec2 p = c.xy / max(abs(c.w), 1e-6) * sign(c.w);\n"
               "  o = vec2(p.x, p.y * pc.b.z) * 0.5 + 0.5 - uv;\n"
               "  bool inbox = all(greaterThanEqual(uv, pc.box.xy)) && all(lessThanEqual(uv, pc.box.zw));\n"
               "  if (inbox && z >= pc.lk.x && z <= pc.lk.y) o = pc.lk.zw;\n"
               "  if (pc.b.w > 1.5) o = vec2(inbox ? 1.0 : 0.0, inbox && z >= pc.lk.x && z <= pc.lk.y ? 1.0 : 0.0);  // (debug)\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "clear.vert")) {
        *stage = STAGE_VERTEX;
        return "#version 450\n"
               "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 c; vec4 d; } pc;\n"
               "void main() {\n"
               "  vec2 p = vec2((gl_VertexIndex << 1) & 2, gl_VertexIndex & 2);\n"
               "  gl_Position = vec4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, pc.d.x, 1.0);\n"
               "}\n";
    }
    // clear.frag.<f|i|u><index>: writes the push-constant colour to colour target <index>
    if (!strncmp(name, "clear.frag.", 11)) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        static __thread char buf[512];
        char k = name[11];
        int idx = atoi(name + 12);
        const char *ty = k == 'i' ? "ivec4" : k == 'u' ? "uvec4" : "vec4";
        const char *cv = k == 'i' ? "floatBitsToInt(pc.c)" : k == 'u' ? "floatBitsToUint(pc.c)" : "pc.c";
        snprintf(buf, sizeof buf,
                 "#version 450\n"
                 "layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 c; vec4 d; } pc;\n"
                 "layout(location = %d) out %s o;\n"
                 "void main() { o = %s; }\n", idx, ty, cv);
        return buf;
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "clear.frag.none")) {
        *stage = STAGE_FRAGMENT;
        return "#version 450\nvoid main() {}\n";
    }
    return NULL;
}

VkShaderModule vk_builtin_shader(const char *name) {
    static struct { char name[32]; VkShaderModule m; } cache[64];
    static int n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(cache[i].name, name)) return cache[i].m;
    int stage = 0;
    const char *src = builtin_src(name, &stage);
    if (!src) FATAL("no built-in shader %s\n", name);
    VkShaderModule m = vk_compile_glsl(src, stage, name);
    if (!m) FATAL("built-in shader %s failed to compile\n", name);
    if (n < 64) { snprintf(cache[n].name, sizeof cache[n].name, "%s", name); cache[n++].m = m; }
    return m;
}

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/spirv.c`:

```c
// GLSL -> SPIR-V: shaderc, the vertex-shader post-processing (no_contraction) and the SPIR-V disk cache. What this
// file makes is part of every shader cache's key (vk_spirv_id: a hash of this file, from the Makefile), so it holds
// only that step.
#include <shaderc/shaderc.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <zlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

#include "shaders.h"

#ifndef SPIRV_ID
#define SPIRV_ID __DATE__ " " __TIME__  // (built without the Makefile's hash: valid for this build only)
#endif
const char *vk_spirv_id(void) { return SPIRV_ID; }

// spirv-opt for this stage. Off by default (see vk_glsl_to_spirv). Fragment shaders get it on AMD's own shader compiler
// (Windows, the GPUs before RDNA 3; device.c): it draws the sky wrong from our unoptimized SPIR-V, on RX 6600 and
// 6700 XT and a Vega 7 (#359, #665), while the same driver's LLPC (RDNA 3 and later) and every other driver draw it
// right; SAVAGEWIND_VK_OPT=1 fixed it on an RX 6600. Vertex shaders stay unoptimized, for the depth pre-pass's match.
// SAVAGEWIND_VK_OPT=1: every stage. A stage's setting is part of its cache key (src_hash): a run with it on found the
// unoptimized SPIR-V of a run with it off, and the sky came back wrong.
static bool opt_fragments;
void vk_spirv_optimize_fragments(bool on) { opt_fragments = on; }
static bool optimized(int stage) {
    static int all = -1;
    if (all < 0) all = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_OPT") != NULL;
    return all || (opt_fragments && stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT);
}

void vk_shaders_init(void) {  // (compilers are per thread: check shaderc works at all)
    shaderc_compiler_t c = shaderc_compiler_initialize();
    if (!c) FATAL("shaderc_compiler_initialize failed\n");
    shaderc_compiler_release(c);
}

static shaderc_shader_kind kind_of(int stage) {
    return stage == STAGE_VERTEX ? shaderc_vertex_shader : stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? shaderc_fragment_shader : shaderc_compute_shader;
}

// SPIR-V disk cache: cache/spirv/<id>/<hash of stage + source>.spz, so a known shader costs a file read instead of a
// GLSL compile (the driver's pipeline cache only covers the step after this one). <id>: this file's (vk_cache_dir_id):
// another build's folder is removed (vk_cache_cleanup). A file: "SPZ1", the SPIR-V's word count, the SPIR-V
// deflated (zlib; a third to a quarter of the size: the precompiled shaders of the whole game take ~0.4 GB instead
// of 1.4).
static uint64_t src_hash(const char *src, int stage) {
    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull ^ (uint64_t)stage ^ (optimized(stage) ? 0x6f707400ull : 0);
    for (const char *p = vk_spirv_id(); *p; p++) { h ^= (uint8_t)*p; h *= 0x100000001B3ull; }
    for (const char *p = src; *p; p++) { h ^= (uint8_t)*p; h *= 0x100000001B3ull; }
    return h;
}

static void spirv_path(char *path, size_t n, uint64_t h) {
    char name[96];
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "spirv/%s/%016llx.spz", vk_cache_dir_id(vk_spirv_id()), (unsigned long long)h);
    vk_cache_path(path, n, name);
}

static uint32_t *cache_load(uint64_t h, size_t *nwords) {
    char path[512];
    spirv_path(path, sizeof path, h);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *z = n > 8 && n < (64l << 20) ? malloc((size_t)n) : NULL;
    if (z && fread(z, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) { free(z); z = NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    uint32_t *d = NULL, words = 0;
    if (z && !memcmp(z, "SPZ1", 4)) {
        memcpy(&words, z + 4, 4);
        uLongf len = (uLongf)words * 4;
        d = words && words < (16u << 20) ? malloc(len) : NULL;
        if (d && (uncompress((Bytef *)d, &len, z + 8, (uLong)(n - 8)) != Z_OK || len != (uLongf)words * 4 || d[0] != 0x07230203)) {
            free(d);
            d = NULL;
        }
    }
    free(z);
    if (d) *nwords = words;
    return d;
}

static void cache_store(uint64_t h, const uint32_t *spv, size_t nwords) {
    static int made;
    char path[512], tmp[540], name[96];
    if (!made) {
        made = 1;
        vk_cache_path(path, sizeof path, "spirv");
        mkdir(path, 0755);
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "spirv/%s", vk_cache_dir_id(vk_spirv_id()));
        vk_cache_path(path, sizeof path, name);
        mkdir(path, 0755);
    }
    spirv_path(path, sizeof path, h);
    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.%llx", path, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)&made ^ (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)spv);
    uLongf zn = compressBound((uLong)(nwords * 4));
    uint8_t *z = malloc(8 + zn);
    if (!z) return;
    memcpy(z, "SPZ1", 4);
    uint32_t w = (uint32_t)nwords;
    memcpy(z + 4, &w, 4);
    bool ok = compress2(z + 8, &zn, (const Bytef *)spv, (uLong)(nwords * 4), 1) == Z_OK;  // (fast: stores happen at draws too)
    FILE *f = ok ? fopen(tmp, "wb") : NULL;
    ok = f && fwrite(z, 1, 8 + zn, f) == 8 + zn;
    if (f && fclose(f)) ok = false;
    free(z);
    if (f && (!ok || rename(tmp, path) != 0)) remove(tmp);  // (another thread may have stored it first)
}

// Vertex shaders: every float add/sub/mul/div/fma gets NoContraction, so no compiler fuses or splits them. Depth
// pre-pass and colour pass are different shaders computing the same position, and the colour pass tests EQUAL:
// any difference in fusing leaves holes (foliage flickered black). GLSL's `precise gl_Position` only covers what
// glslang traces back from the position, which the translated register code defeats.
static bool float_arith(const uint32_t *w, uint32_t wc, uint32_t op) {
    switch (op) {
    case 127: case 129: case 131: case 133: case 136:  // FNegate FAdd FSub FMul FDiv
    case 142: case 143: case 144: case 145: case 146: case 148:  // vector/matrix products, Dot
        return true;
    case 12: return wc >= 5 && w[4] == 50;  // ExtInst GLSL.std.450 Fma
    default: return false;
    }
}

static uint32_t *no_contraction(uint32_t *spv, size_t *nwords) {
    enum { OP_DECORATE = 71, DEC_NO_CONTRACTION = 42 };
    size_t n = *nwords, insert = 0, count = 0;
    uint32_t bound = spv[3];
    uint8_t *done = calloc(bound, 1);  // already decorated (glslang does it for what it traces from precise)
    for (size_t i = 5; i < n;) {
        uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
        if (!wc) break;
        if (!insert && op >= 19 && op <= 39) insert = i;  // first type declaration: end of the annotations
        if (op == OP_DECORATE && wc >= 3 && spv[i + 2] == DEC_NO_CONTRACTION && spv[i + 1] < bound) done[spv[i + 1]] = 1;
        i += wc;
    }
    for (size_t i = 5; i < n;) {
        uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
        if (!wc) break;
        if (float_arith(spv + i, wc, op) && spv[i + 2] < bound && !done[spv[i + 2]]) count++;
        i += wc;
    }
    if (!insert || !count) { free(done); return spv; }
    uint32_t *out = malloc((n + count * 3) * 4);
    memcpy(out, spv, insert * 4);
    size_t o = insert;
    for (size_t i = 5; i < n;) {
        uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
        if (!wc) break;
        if (float_arith(spv + i, wc, op) && spv[i + 2] < bound && !done[spv[i + 2]]) {
            done[spv[i + 2]] = 1;
            out[o++] = 3u << 16 | OP_DECORATE;
            out[o++] = spv[i + 2];  // result id
            out[o++] = DEC_NO_CONTRACTION;
        }
        i += wc;
    }
    memcpy(out + o, spv + insert, (n - insert) * 4);
    *nwords = o + (n - insert);
    free(done);
    free(spv);
    return out;
}

// SPIR-V words of src, or NULL (error logged with the source). *nwords set on success. Thread-safe: one shaderc
// compiler per thread (a shared one behind a lock serialised all the pipeline workers).
// No spirv-opt by default: it rewrote the depth pre-pass and colour-pass vertex shaders differently enough that
// their depths stopped matching (EQUAL test: black holes in foliage), and it was most of the compile time; the
// driver optimises anyway. SAVAGEWIND_VK_OPT=1 turns it back on (experiments).
// The SPIR-V of src in the disk cache (compiled now if missing): 0 it was there, 1 compiled, -1 failed.
int vk_spirv_ensure(const char *src, int stage) {
    char path[512];
    spirv_path(path, sizeof path, src_hash(src, stage));
    struct stat st;
    if (!getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_NO_SPIRV_CACHE") && !stat(path, &st) && st.st_size > 20) return 0;
    size_t n = 0;
    uint32_t *spv = vk_glsl_to_spirv(src, stage, "precompile", &n);
    free(spv);
    return spv ? 1 : -1;
}

// Debug names (OpSource, OpSourceExtension, OpName, OpMemberName, OpString, OpLine, OpNoLine, OpModuleProcessed):
// glslang writes one for every register variable, ~16 % of a translated shader's SPIR-V, read by no driver.
static void strip_names(uint32_t *spv, size_t *nwords) {
    size_t o = 5;
    for (size_t i = 5; i < *nwords;) {
        uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
        if (!wc || i + wc > *nwords) return;  // (malformed: left as it is from here)
        bool name = op == 3 || op == 4 || op == 5 || op == 6 || op == 7 || op == 8 || op == 317 || op == 330;
        if (!name) { memmove(spv + o, spv + i, wc * 4); o += wc; }
        i += wc;
    }
    *nwords = o;
}

uint32_t *vk_glsl_to_spirv(const char *src, int stage, const char *name, size_t *nwords) {
    uint64_t h = src_hash(src, stage);
    static int nocache = -1;
    if (nocache < 0) nocache = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_NO_SPIRV_CACHE") != NULL;
    uint32_t *out = nocache ? NULL : cache_load(h, nwords);
    if (out) return out;
    static __thread shaderc_compiler_t comp;
    if (!comp) comp = shaderc_compiler_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_t o = shaderc_compile_options_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_set_target_env(o, shaderc_target_env_vulkan, shaderc_env_version_vulkan_1_3);
    shaderc_compile_options_set_optimization_level(o, optimized(stage) ? shaderc_optimization_level_performance
                                                                       : shaderc_optimization_level_zero);
    shaderc_compilation_result_t r = shaderc_compile_into_spv(comp, src, strlen(src), kind_of(stage), name, "main", o);
    shaderc_compile_options_release(o);
    if (shaderc_result_get_compilation_status(r) != shaderc_compilation_status_success) {
        static int nlog;
        if (nlog++ < 20) LOG("[shader] %s: GLSL compile failed:\n%s\n%s\n", name, shaderc_result_get_error_message(r), src);
    } else {
        size_t n = shaderc_result_get_length(r);
        out = malloc(n);
        memcpy(out, shaderc_result_get_bytes(r), n);
        *nwords = n / 4;
        strip_names(out, nwords);
        if (stage == STAGE_VERTEX) out = no_contraction(out, nwords);
        if (!nocache) cache_store(h, out, *nwords);
    }
    shaderc_result_release(r);
    return out;
}

```

bool renderer_format_is_depth(uint32_t f) { return f >= 0x31 && f <= 0x36; }
bool renderer_format_has_stencil(uint32_t f) { return f == 0x31 || f == 0x35 || f == 0x36; }
VkFormat vk_format(uint32_t f) { return fmt_of(f).vf; }
bool vk_format_alpha_one(uint32_t f) { return fmt_of(f).alpha_one; }
bool renderer_format_alpha_one(uint32_t f) { return fmt_of(f).alpha_one; }

static VkImageAspectFlags aspect_of(uint32_t f) {
    if (f == 0x31) return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;
    if (f == 0x35 || f == 0x36) return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT | VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;
    if (renderer_format_is_depth(f)) return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT;
    return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
}

static bool format_supports(VkFormat f, VkFormatFeatureFlags want) {
    VkFormatProperties p;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(g_vk.phys, f, &p);
    return (p.optimalTilingFeatures & want) == want;
}

static bool format_is_float(VkFormat f) {  // (uncompressed: these can hold NaN and Inf)
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R16_SFLOAT: case VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT: case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16_SFLOAT:
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT: case VK_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT: case VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SFLOAT:
    case VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32_SFLOAT: case VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT: case VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32:
    case VK_FORMAT_E5B9G9R9_UFLOAT_PACK32:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

// ================================================================== output resolution / per-frame clears
// Render targets are allocated at one of two scales (runtime/nvn/output_scale.c sets both every presented frame):
//   RS_OUT    the game's final image (1920x1080, its halves) and the display images: the window's resolution, so the
//             HUD and menus are drawn sharp at any window size
//   RS_SCENE  the 3D scene's targets (1600x900 docked, and their fractions): the internal resolution, the window's
//             with the upscaler off, smaller by the upscaler's factor with it on (exec.c upscales at the composite)
//   RS_SHADOW shadow maps (BOTW's sun cascades: D16 896x896x3): Video > Shadow resolution, a width (448 for Potato,
//             2048 to 8192) they are made at instead of the game's (output_scale.c shadow_map_size). Also
//             their half-size copy (R16 448x448x3, the max of each 2x2), at the same factor: water and the other
//             forward-shaded surfaces take their shadows from it (issue #101)
static float g_rs[4][2] = {{1, 1}, {1, 1}, {1, 1}, {1, 1}};
static uint32_t g_shadow_size;
void renderer_get_scale(float *sx, float *sy) { *sx = g_rs[RS_OUT][0]; *sy = g_rs[RS_OUT][1]; }
void renderer_set_scale(float sx, float sy) { g_rs[RS_OUT][0] = sx; g_rs[RS_OUT][1] = sy; }
void renderer_get_scene_scale(float *sx, float *sy) { *sx = g_rs[RS_SCENE][0]; *sy = g_rs[RS_SCENE][1]; }
void renderer_set_scene_scale(float sx, float sy) { g_rs[RS_SCENE][0] = sx; g_rs[RS_SCENE][1] = sy; }
void renderer_set_shadow_size(uint32_t n) {  // (never past what the GPU can make: Extreme is 8192)
    g_shadow_size = n < g_vk.props.limits.maxImageDimension2D ? n : g_vk.props.limits.maxImageDimension2D;
}
uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);
static float rs_want(const TexBackend *b, int axis) {  // the scale a texture of b's group is wanted at now
    if (b->rs_group != RS_SHADOW) return g_rs[b->rs_group][axis];
    // (square) bigger than the game's (High and up), or smaller (Potato); 0: the game's own
    return b->guest_w && g_shadow_size && g_shadow_size != b->guest_w ? (float)g_shadow_size / (float)b->guest_w : 1.0f;
}
static bool rs_stale(const TexBackend *b) {
    return b->rs_group && (b->sx != rs_want(b, 0) || b->sy != rs_want(b, 1));
}

// Which scale a texture takes (RS_*): the game's screen-sized targets are 16:9 2D images or 2D arrays (BOTW renders
// some half-size passes into layers of 800x450x2 arrays) with the compressible flag (render targets) or the display
// flag; shadow maps are square depth render targets, 512 or more (BOTW's sun cascades; its 192x192 depth target is no
// shadow map), and the cascades' half-size copy is a square R16 2D array of 3 layers, one per cascade (no
// render-target flag; a looser rule also took a 1024x1024x8 R16 array filled once at load, which a change of the
// setting then made again empty: the terrain went). Everything else keeps its guest size: LUTs, cubemaps, the small
// odd-sized steps of the bloom and exposure chains (sampled with normalized coordinates, they work at any size).
// SAVAGEWIND_NO_SCALE=1: none scaled.
// The sun cascades' half-size copy (R16 2D array of 3 layers, square, 256 or more: 448x448x3 in BOTW): a pass takes the
// max of each 2x2 of the cascades into it, and water, terrain, grass and the other forward-shaded surfaces do their
// shadow comparisons on it.
bool vk_is_shadow_copy(const NvnTexture *t) {
    return t && t->target == 4 && t->format == 0x06 && t->samples <= 1 && t->width == t->height && t->width >= 256 &&
           t->depth == 3;
}

// Above the console's shadow resolution, the copy's readers compare against the cascades themselves (exec.c
// shadow_copy_source): already a depth image, already at the chosen size, sampled at the same normalized coordinates and
// layers. The copy stays at the game's size. Scaling the copy with the cascades instead (as before) made it 4096x4096x3
// at Extreme, drawn every frame and sampled by every forward-shaded pixel: 1.5-1.7 ms of GPU on an RTX 5090 at
// 5120x2160. SAVAGEWIND_NO_SHADOW_DIRECT=1: the scaled copy, as before.
bool vk_shadow_direct(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NO_SHADOW_DIRECT") == NULL;
    return on;
}

// The cascades t are made bigger than the game's (Shadow resolution above Console); at Console the copy's readers keep it
bool vk_shadow_scaled(const NvnTexture *t) { return t && g_shadow_size > t->width; }

static uint8_t tex_scale_group(const NvnTexture *t) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NO_SCALE") == NULL;
    if (!on) return RS_NONE;
    if ((t->target == 1 || t->target == 4) && t->samples <= 1 && (t->flags & 8) && renderer_format_is_depth(t->format) &&
        t->width == t->height && t->width >= 512)
        return RS_SHADOW;
    if (!vk_shadow_direct() && vk_is_shadow_copy(t)) return RS_SHADOW;  // (the copy's readers use the cascades instead)
    if ((t->target != 1 && t->target != 4) || t->samples > 1 || !(t->flags & 9) || t->width < 32 || t->height < 16) return RS_NONE;
    float a = (float)t->width / (float)t->height;
    if (a < 1.74f || a > 1.81f) return RS_NONE;
    if (t->flags & 1) return RS_OUT;  // NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_DISPLAY: the images the game presents
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)       // the final image's 1920x1080 and its halves (rounded either way)
        if ((t->width == 1920u >> k || t->width == (1920u + (1u << k) - 1) >> k) &&
            (t->height == 1080u >> k || t->height == (1080u + (1u << k) - 1) >> k))
            return RS_OUT;
    return RS_SCENE;
}

bool renderer_texture_first_write(NvnTexture *t) {
    TexBackend *b = t ? (TexBackend *)t->backend : NULL;
    uint64_t total_frames = renderer_present_count();
    if (!b || !b->presented || (b->sx == b->sy) || b->touched_frame == total_frames + 1) return false;
    b->touched_frame = total_frames + 1;
    return true;
}

// Bumped when the scene's render targets should start clean (a level change: a game-specific hook; none yet).
static uint32_t g_level_gen = 1;

// (Link's Awakening cleared its scaled scene targets at their first use in each frame. BOTW keeps data in them from
// frame to frame, as on the Switch, where nothing clears them: opt-in, SAVAGEWIND_FRAME_CLEAR=1.)
bool renderer_texture_frame_fresh(NvnTexture *t) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) on = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FRAME_CLEAR") != NULL;
    TexBackend *b = t ? (TexBackend *)t->backend : NULL;
    uint64_t total_frames = renderer_present_count();
    if (!on || !b || !b->scalable || b->frame_cleared == total_frames + 1) return false;
    b->frame_cleared = total_frames + 1;
    return true;
}

bool renderer_texture_level_fresh(NvnTexture *t) {
    TexBackend *b = t ? (TexBackend *)t->backend : NULL;
    static int keep = -1;
    if (keep < 0) keep = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_KEEP_TARGETS") != NULL;
    if (!b || keep || b->level_gen == g_level_gen) return false;
    if (!b->scalable) { b->level_gen = g_level_gen; return false; }
    bool fresh = b->level_gen != 0;
    b->level_gen = g_level_gen;
    return fresh;
}

void renderer_texture_mark_presented(NvnTexture *t) {
    TexBackend *b = t ? (TexBackend *)t->backend : NULL;
    if (b) b->presented = true;
}

bool renderer_texture_presented(NvnTexture *t) {
    TexBackend *b = t ? (TexBackend *)t->backend : NULL;
    return b && b->presented;
}

void renderer_texture_scale(NvnTexture *t, float *sx, float *sy) {
    TexBackend *b = t ? (TexBackend *)t->backend : NULL;
    if (b && b->scalable) { *sx = b->sx; *sy = b->sy; }
    else { *sx = 1; *sy = 1; }
}

// ================================================================== images
void vk_image_init_layout(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage img, VkImageAspectFlags aspect) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
                               .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_NONE, .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                               .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                               .oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, .newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, .image = img,
                               .subresourceRange = {aspect, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS},
                               .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1, .pImageMemoryBarriers = &b};
    rec_CmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
}

// Images destroyed by the guest are kept until the submissions that may use them have completed.
typedef struct { VkImage img; VmaAllocation mem; VkImageView view; uint64_t seq; } Dead;
static Dead *dead;
static int ndead, cap_dead;
static void views_forget(TexBackend *b);
static void evict_idle_images(void);
static bool image_format_fallback_error(VkResult r);
static bool image_out_of_memory(VkResult r);
static void log_memory_budget(const char *when);

static VmaPool image_priority_pools[VK_MAX_MEMORY_TYPES];
static bool image_priority_pool_failed[VK_MAX_MEMORY_TYPES];

static VmaAllocationCreateInfo image_allocation_info(const VkImageCreateInfo *ci) {
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
#ifdef VK_EXT_memory_priority
    if (!g_vk.memory_priority) return ai;
    uint32_t memory_type;
    VkResult r = vmaFindMemoryTypeIndexForImageInfo(g_vk.vma, ci, &ai, &memory_type);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        LOG("[vk] could not select low-priority image memory type (%d); using default allocation\n", r);
        return ai;
    }
    if (!image_priority_pools[memory_type] && !image_priority_pool_failed[memory_type]) {
        VmaPoolCreateInfo pi = {.memoryTypeIndex = memory_type, .priority = 1.0f};
        r = vmaCreatePool(g_vk.vma, &pi, &image_priority_pools[memory_type]);
        if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
            image_priority_pool_failed[memory_type] = true;
            LOG("[vk] could not create high-priority image memory pool for type %u (%d); using default allocation\n",
                memory_type, r);
        }
    }
    if (image_priority_pools[memory_type]) ai.pool = image_priority_pools[memory_type];
#endif
    return ai;
}

void vk_collect_dead(void) {
    uint64_t done = vk_completed_seq();
    int k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ndead; i++) {
        if (dead[i].seq > done) { dead[k++] = dead[i]; continue; }
        if (dead[i].view) vkDestroyImageView(g_vk.dev, dead[i].view, NULL);
        else vmaDestroyImage(g_vk.vma, dead[i].img, dead[i].mem);
    }
    ndead = k;
}

static uint64_t storage_size(const NvnTexture *t);
static bool storage_readable(NvnTexture *t, uint64_t total);

// (control `memstats`) texture memory by kind: what an image holds of its memory, until it is destroyed
static void texmem_note(const NvnTexture *t, TexBackend *b, bool depthfmt) {
    VmaAllocationInfo mi;
    vmaGetAllocationInfo(g_vk.vma, b->mem, &mi);
    VkFormat f = b->format;
    b->mem_kind = b->astc_bw ? TM_ASTC_RGBA8
                : f >= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_4x4_UNORM_BLOCK && f <= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_12x12_SRGB_BLOCK ? TM_ASTC_NATIVE
                : f >= VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB_UNORM_BLOCK && f <= VK_FORMAT_BC7_SRGB_BLOCK ? TM_BC
                : depthfmt || (t->flags & 9) ? TM_RT : TM_OTHER;  // (NVN compressible or display flag: render targets)
    b->mem_bytes = (int64_t)mi.size;
    b->mem_src = b->astc_bw ? (int64_t)storage_size(t) : 0;
    texmem_add(b->mem_kind, b->mem_bytes, 1);
    if (b->mem_src) texmem_add(TM_ASTC_SRC, b->mem_src, 1);
}
static void texmem_forget(TexBackend *b) {
    if (!b->mem_bytes) return;
    texmem_add(b->mem_kind, -b->mem_bytes, -1);
    if (b->mem_src) texmem_add(TM_ASTC_SRC, -b->mem_src, -1);
    b->mem_bytes = b->mem_src = 0;
}

static bool is_bc_or_astc(VkFormat f) {
    return (f >= VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB_UNORM_BLOCK && f <= VK_FORMAT_BC7_SRGB_BLOCK) ||
           (f >= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_4x4_UNORM_BLOCK && f <= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_12x12_SRGB_BLOCK);
}

// The sRGB / UNORM counterpart of a colour format (VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED: none). (g_vk.lean_usage format lists)
static VkFormat srgb_twin(VkFormat f) {
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_UNORM_PACK32: return VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_SRGB_PACK32;
    case VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_SRGB_PACK32: return VK_FORMAT_A8B8G8R8_UNORM_PACK32;
    default: return VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    }
}

VkFormat vk_view_format(TexBackend *b, VkFormat want) {
    if (!b) return want;
    if (b->hdr_upgraded) return b->format;  // (RGBA16F: no 10-bit view of it is format-compatible)
    if (!b->nview_fmt || want == b->format) return want;
    for (int i = 0; i < b->nview_fmt; i++) if (b->view_fmt[i] == want) return want;
    static int nlog;
    if (nlog++ < 10) LOG("[vk] view format %d of an image of format %d not in its list: its own instead\n", want, b->format);
    return b->format;
}

// A HUD button drawing (glyphs_apply_layout)? Sharper menus must leave those alone, or they keep the Switch's icons (#613).
// They are recognised deswizzled, so the check can't be made on the texels as stored.
static bool hud_button_texture(NvnTexture *t) {
    if (t->format != 0x01 || t->width > 100 || t->height > 100) return false;
    LevelLayout l = tegra_level(&t->layout, 0);
    uint8_t *lin = malloc((uint64_t)l.wb * l.hb);
    if (!lin) return false;
    tegra_deswizzle((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr, lin, l.wb, l.hb, l.d, 1, l.block_height_log2, l.block_depth_log2);
    bool icon = glyphs_is_layout_icon(l.w, l.h, lin, l.wb);
    free(lin);
    return icon;
}

// The HUD's partial hearts are two copies of a half heart (Nt_HeartNew_01: R8G8 48x48, alpha in G), the right one
// mirrored, cut hard between columns 23 and 24. Drawn larger than 1:1, the linear filter blends that edge with the
// transparent column next to it, so both halves fade out at the centre and a seam shows. The layout's masks clip each
// half at the centre, except while the heart's healing preview turns them: then only the texture's own edge parts the
// two halves, and the empty part is two see-through halves, which must neither overlap nor leave a gap. So the image
// is HEART_SCALE times wider (the seam runs down it; heights stay), the heart filtered as before but cut sharply at
// the centre, the column past the cut repeating the last one: the filter's edge there is 1/HEART_SCALE of a texel.
#define HEART_SCALE 64
static bool heart_half_known(uint32_t w, uint32_t h, const uint8_t *lin, uint32_t row) {
    if (w != 48 || h != 48) return false;
    uint64_t hash = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++)
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w * 2; x++) hash = (hash ^ lin[(uint64_t)y * row + x]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    return hash == 0x1f80ff910561d6e6ull;
}

// Where the image could not be made larger (create_image): column 24 repeats column 23, enough while the masks clip.
static void heart_half_pad(uint8_t *lin, uint32_t row) {
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < 48; y++) memcpy(lin + (uint64_t)y * row + 24 * 2, lin + (uint64_t)y * row + 23 * 2, 2);
}

// lin: the 48x48 texels; big: 48 * HEART_SCALE x 48 texels. Each half is filtered on its own (clamped to its columns).
static void heart_half_enlarge(const uint8_t *lin, uint32_t row, uint8_t *big) {
    const uint32_t n = 48 * HEART_SCALE;
    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < n; x++) {
        uint32_t sx = x == n / 2 ? x - 1 : x;  // (the column past the cut: the last one's texels)
        int lo = sx < n / 2 ? 0 : 24, hi = lo + 23;
        float fx = (sx + 0.5f) / HEART_SCALE - 0.5f;
        int x0 = (int)floorf(fx);
        float wx = fx - x0;
        int xa = x0 < lo ? lo : x0 > hi ? hi : x0, xb = x0 + 1 < lo ? lo : x0 + 1 > hi ? hi : x0 + 1;
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < 48; y++)
            for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
                float va = lin[(uint64_t)y * row + xa * 2 + c], vb = lin[(uint64_t)y * row + xb * 2 + c];
                big[((uint64_t)y * n + x) * 2 + c] = (uint8_t)(va + (vb - va) * wx + 0.5f);
            }
    }
}

// At create_image: the texture is that half heart (its texels are in place by then)
static bool heart_half_texture(NvnTexture *t) {
    if (t->format != 0x0D || t->width != 48 || t->height != 48 || t->layout.levels != 1 || t->target != 1 ||
        nvn_texture_flags_pitch(t->flags) || !storage_readable(t, storage_size(t)))
        return false;
    LevelLayout l = tegra_level(&t->layout, 0);
    uint8_t *lin = malloc((uint64_t)l.wb * l.hb * 2);
    if (!lin) return false;
    tegra_deswizzle((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr, lin, l.wb, l.hb, l.d, 2, l.block_height_log2, l.block_depth_log2);
    bool known = heart_half_known(l.w, l.h, lin, l.wb * 2);
    free(lin);
    return known;
}

static void create_image(NvnTexture *t, TexBackend *b) {
    VkFmt mf = fmt_of(t->format);
    b->scalable = b->rs_group != RS_NONE;
    // (RS_SHADOW: the cascades' width, also for their half-size copy, so that both grow by the same factor)
    b->guest_w = b->rs_group == RS_SHADOW && !renderer_format_is_depth(t->format) ? t->width * 2 : t->width;
    b->sx = rs_want(b, 0);
    b->sy = rs_want(b, 1);
    uint32_t tw = t->width ? t->width : 1, th = t->height ? t->height : 1;
    if (b->scalable) {
        tw = (uint32_t)lroundf(tw * b->sx); th = (uint32_t)lroundf(th * b->sy);
        if (tw < 1) tw = 1;
        if (th < 1) th = 1;
    }
    VkImageType type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    uint32_t layers = 1, depth = 1;
    switch (t->target) {
    case 0: type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; th = 1; break;
    case 2: type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D; depth = t->depth ? t->depth : 1; break;
    case 3: type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; layers = t->height ? t->height : 1; th = 1; break;
    case 4: case 6: layers = t->depth ? t->depth : 1; break;
    case 8: layers = 6; break;
    case 9: layers = t->depth ? t->depth : 6; break;
    default: break;
    }
    uint32_t levels = t->levels ? t->levels : 1;
    {   // never more levels than the size allows (scaled targets, odd guest values)
        uint32_t m = 1, sz = tw > th ? tw : th;
        if (depth > sz) sz = depth;
        while (sz > 1) { sz >>= 1; m++; }
        if (levels > m) levels = m;
    }
    uint32_t samples = t->samples > 1 ? t->samples : 1;
    if (samples > 1) levels = 1;
    VkFormat vf = mf.vf;
    VkFormatFeatureFlags need = VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    b->astc_bw = b->astc_bh = 0;
    b->bc4_cpu = false;
    {   // SAVAGEWIND_VK_BC4_CPU=1: BC4 (the game's fonts, many sprites) decoded on the CPU into R8, to tell a driver's
        // BC4 sampling apart from the rest of the path (the view's swizzle, the shaders)
        // On by default on Mali-G610: its own BC4 sampling came out as blocky garbage around text (NPCs' lines, the
        // Game Over title); =0 turns it off.
        static int bc4cpu = -1;
        if (bc4cpu < 0) {
            const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_BC4_CPU");
            bc4cpu = e ? atoi(e) != 0 : g_vk.is_mali;
        }
        if (bc4cpu && !b->gpu_bc4 && (t->format == 0x49 || t->format == 0x4A) && t->layout.fmt && t->layout.fmt->bpb == 8) {
            b->bc4_cpu = true;
            vf = t->format == 0x4A ? VK_FORMAT_R8_SNORM : VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
            static int nlog;
            if (nlog++ < 20) LOG("[vk] BC4 texture %ux%u (nvn %#x) at %llx: decoded on the CPU to R8\n", t->width, t->height,
                                 t->format, (unsigned long long)t->addr);
        }
    }
    // Gameplay > Sharper text: a font sheet of the game (BC4, or R8 for NormalS_00) gets an image larger than the game
    // knows of. Its texture coordinates are fractions of the sheet, so nothing else changes.
    b->text_scale = 0;
    uint64_t sheet_bytes = (uint64_t)t->width * t->height / (t->format == 0x49 ? 2 : 1);
    if (g_settings.sharper_text && !b->gpu_bc4 && (t->format == 0x49 || t->format == 0x01) && t->pool &&
        t->layout.levels == 1 && t->addr >= t->pool->storage && t->addr + sheet_bytes <= t->pool->storage + t->pool->size &&
        text_sheet_known((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr, sheet_bytes)) {
        b->text_scale = (uint8_t)g_settings.sharper_text;
        b->bc4_cpu = t->format == 0x49;
        vf = VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
        LOG("[vk] sharper text: font sheet %ux%u (nvn %#x) enlarged %ux\n", t->width, t->height, t->format, b->text_scale);
        tw *= b->text_scale;
        th *= b->text_scale;
        // Mip levels down to the sheet's own size. Text is often drawn smaller than an enlarged sheet (at 1440p, about
        // 1.25 times the original): without them, its edges alias into stair steps on every diagonal.
        levels = b->text_scale == 4 ? 3 : 2;
    }
    // Gameplay > Sharper menus: the same for the menus' one-channel textures (shapes, frames, glows), not small ones
    // (nothing to gain)
    b->menu_tex = false;
    if (!b->text_scale && g_settings.sharper_menus && !b->gpu_bc4 && (t->format == 0x49 || t->format == 0x01) && t->pool &&
        t->layout.levels == 1 && t->width >= 16 && t->height >= 16 && t->addr >= t->pool->storage &&
        t->addr + sheet_bytes <= t->pool->storage + t->pool->size &&
        menu_tex_known((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t->addr, sheet_bytes) && !hud_button_texture(t)) {
        b->text_scale = (uint8_t)g_settings.sharper_menus;
        b->menu_tex = true;
        static int nlog;
        if (nlog++ < 400) LOG("[vk] sharper menus: %ux%u (nvn %#x) enlarged %ux\n", t->width, t->height, t->format, b->text_scale);
        b->bc4_cpu = t->format == 0x49;
        vf = VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
        tw *= b->text_scale;
        th *= b->text_scale;
        levels = b->text_scale == 4 ? 3 : 2;
    }
    b->heart_half = !b->text_scale && !b->scalable && heart_half_texture(t);
    if (b->heart_half) {
        LOG("[vk] half heart: %ux wider, cut sharply at the centre\n", HEART_SCALE);
        tw = 48 * HEART_SCALE;
    }
    if (!b->bc4_cpu && !format_supports(vf, need)) {
        bool astc = vf >= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_4x4_UNORM_BLOCK && vf <= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_12x12_SRGB_BLOCK;
        const FormatInfo *fi = t->layout.fmt;
        if (astc && fi && fi->bpb == 16) {  // desktop GPUs: decoded on the CPU into an RGBA8 image of the same colour space
            b->astc_bw = fi->bw;
            b->astc_bh = fi->bh;
            b->astc_srgb = t->format >= 0x87;
            vf = b->astc_srgb ? VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB : VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        } else {
            static int nlog;
            if (nlog++ < 20) LOG("[vk] format %d (nvn %#x) not supported: RGBA8 instead\n", vf, t->format);
            vf = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        }
    }
    bool depthfmt = renderer_format_is_depth(t->format);
    // HDR (hdr.c): the game's final image is linear 10-bit (A2B10G10R10) with the HUD already drawn into it. Made
    // RGBA16F, the extended tonemap's highlights survive the HUD and the game's sRGB copy into the 8-bit present image.
    bool hdr_up = false;
    // The 3D scene's own tonemap target is at RS_SCENE (1600x900 docked), not the final image: make it RGBA16F too, so
    // the extended curve's highlights reach the game's upscale/FXAA pass and the HUD. (Smaller 10-bit scene targets
    // are effects/copies and stay as they are.)
    bool hdr_scene = b->rs_group == RS_SCENE && t->width >= 1600 && t->height >= 900;
    if (!depthfmt && (b->rs_group == RS_OUT || hdr_scene) && vf == VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32 &&
        vk_hdr_targets_wanted()) {
        VkFormat hf = VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT;
        if (format_supports(hf, VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT |
                                    VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT)) {
            vf = hf;
            hdr_up = true;
        }
    }
    VkImageUsageFlags usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    if (depthfmt) usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
    else if (format_supports(vf, VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT)) usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
    VkImageCreateFlags flags = 0;
    if (!depthfmt) flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT;  // format views (NVN texture views, raw sRGB views)
    // Square 2D arrays of 6 layers or more are made cube compatible (cube views of them can come). On AMD's own driver
    // only cubemaps, cube arrays and arrays of whole cubes (6n layers) are: BOTW's terrain material arrays (512x512 and
    // 1024x1024 BC1, 83 layers, all levels) were cube compatible too, and on AMD's Windows driver (an RX 580, a 7800 XT)
    // rocks, cliffs, ground and grass, all of which sample those arrays, got rainbow blocks that came and went with the
    // mip level sampled, and nowhere else (#59). The cube flag changes how AMD lays such an image out; NVIDIA and RADV
    // draw it right, and keep the rule they had. SAVAGEWIND_CUBE_ALL=1: every square array of 6+ layers, on any driver;
    // SAVAGEWIND_CUBE_STRICT=1: only 6n layers and cube targets, on any driver (testing).
    static int cube_strict = -1;
    if (cube_strict < 0) {
        cube_strict = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_CUBE_ALL") ? 0 : getenv("SAVAGEWIND_CUBE_STRICT") ? 1 : g_vk.amd_proprietary;
        LOG("[vk] cube-compatible arrays: %s\n", cube_strict ? "cube targets and 6n layers only" : "every square array of 6+ layers");
    }
    if (type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D && layers >= 6 && tw == th && samples == 1 &&
        (!cube_strict || t->target == 8 || t->target == 9 || layers % 6 == 0))
        flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT;
    b->slices_renderable = type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D && (usage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT);
    if (b->slices_renderable) flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2D_ARRAY_COMPATIBLE_BIT;  // (Vulkan 1.1) 2D views of slices
    // g_vk.lean_usage: colour targets may only be viewed as their own format and its sRGB / UNORM twin, listed in a
    // VkImageFormatListCreateInfo (no twin: not mutable at all), as LAS Recomp 03ee802f. Mesa's AMD driver keeps DCC
    // for such images before RDNA3 and turns it off for a bare MUTABLE_FORMAT (radv_are_formats_dcc_compatible):
    // without it every render target went uncompressed and every clear wrote the whole image. Views in any other
    // format fall back to the image's own (vk_view_format, logged). Only render targets (DCC is for them; BOTW reads
    // the blocks of a BC4 texture through an RGBA16 view, which a list would refuse), and not one in a feedback loop
    // (vk_texture_drop_format_list).
    VkImageFormatListCreateInfo fl = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_FORMAT_LIST_CREATE_INFO};
    b->nview_fmt = 0;
    if ((usage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT) && g_vk.lean_usage && !b->feedback_seen) {
        VkFormat twin = srgb_twin(vf);
        b->view_fmt[0] = vf;
        b->view_fmt[1] = twin;
        b->nview_fmt = twin != VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED ? 2 : 1;
        if (b->nview_fmt == 1) flags &= ~VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT;
        else fl.viewFormatCount = 2, fl.pViewFormats = b->view_fmt;
    }
    VkImageCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .pNext = fl.viewFormatCount ? &fl : NULL,
                            .flags = flags, .imageType = type, .format = vf,
                            .extent = {tw, th, depth}, .mipLevels = levels, .arrayLayers = layers,
                            .samples = (VkSampleCountFlagBits)samples, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL, .usage = usage,
                            .initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED};
    const bool sparse = plat_guest_sparse_heap_enabled();
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = image_allocation_info(&ci);
    // 2D color targets may be sampled by the draws that render into them (exec.c resolve_feedback: a feedback loop)
    b->feedback_ok = g_vk.feedback_loop && type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D && samples == 1 && (usage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT);
    if (b->feedback_ok) ci.usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_BIT_EXT;
    VkResult r = vmaCreateImage(g_vk.vma, &ci, &ai, &b->image, &b->mem, NULL);
    if (sparse && image_out_of_memory(r)) {
        log_memory_budget("at image allocation failure");
        LOG("[vk] image allocation ran out of memory (%ux%ux%u, %u layers, %u levels); draining GPU work and retrying\n",
            tw, th, depth, layers, levels);
        renderer_flush();
        vk_collect_dead();
        evict_idle_images();
        VmaAllocationCreateInfo retry_ai = ai;
#ifdef VK_EXT_memory_priority
        if (g_vk.memory_priority) {
            retry_ai.pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            retry_ai.flags |= VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_DEDICATED_MEMORY_BIT;
            retry_ai.priority = 1.0f;
            LOG("[vk] retrying image as dedicated high-priority memory\n");
        }
#endif
        r = vmaCreateImage(g_vk.vma, &ci, &retry_ai, &b->image, &b->mem, NULL);
    }
    if ((sparse ? image_format_fallback_error(r) : r != VK_SUCCESS) && b->feedback_ok) {
        b->feedback_ok = false;
        ci.usage &= ~VK_IMAGE_USAGE_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_BIT_EXT;
        r = vmaCreateImage(g_vk.vma, &ci, &ai, &b->image, &b->mem, NULL);
    }
    if (sparse ? image_format_fallback_error(r) : r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        LOG("[vk] image creation failed (%d): nvn fmt %#x %ux%ux%u target %u\n", r, t->format, t->width, t->height, t->depth, t->target);
        ci.format = vf = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        ci.pNext = NULL;  // (the fallback image is mutable as before, no format list)
        ci.flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT;
        b->nview_fmt = 0;
        ci.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT |
                   VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
        ci.flags &= ~VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT;
        ai = image_allocation_info(&ci);
        r = vmaCreateImage(g_vk.vma, &ci, &ai, &b->image, &b->mem, NULL);
        depthfmt = false;
        hdr_up = false;
    }
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        if (sparse && image_out_of_memory(r)) log_memory_budget("after allocation retry failed");
        if (sparse) LOG("[vk] image creation failed (%d): nvn fmt %#x %ux%ux%u target %u\n", r, t->format, t->width, t->height, t->depth, t->target);
        VK_CHECK(r);
    }
    b->cube_ok = (ci.flags & VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT) != 0;
    b->not_attachable = !(ci.usage & (VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT));
    static uint64_t serials;
    b->serial = __atomic_add_fetch(&serials, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    b->format = vf;
    texmem_note(t, b, depthfmt);
    b->hdr_upgraded = hdr_up;
    b->width = tw; b->height = th; b->depth = depth; b->layers = layers; b->levels = levels; b->samples = samples;
    b->aspect = depthfmt ? aspect_of(t->format) : VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
    b->base_type = type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D ? (layers > 1 ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D)
                 : type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D
                 : t->target == 8 ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE : t->target == 9 ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY
                 : layers > 1 || t->target == 4 || t->target == 6 ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    vk_image_init_layout(vk_upload_cmd(), b->image, b->aspect);
    // New float colour targets start zeroed too: fresh memory holds whatever the last image there left, NaN and Inf
    // included. BOTW makes its sky / ambient targets again when it comes back from the pause menu and blends their
    // first contents into the 1x1 colours the CPU reads back (exec.c readbacks_apply): a NaN there stayed for good and
    // washed the picture out (white, or neon green and yellow), about every other time at 2560 x 1440.
    bool float_rt = (usage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT) && format_is_float(vf);
    // Not 3D images: BOTW's sky table (256x32x16 RGBA16F, the atmosphere's scattering) is one, filled from the CPU right
    // after this clear. AMD's Windows driver (RX 6600, 26.6.2) kept part of the clear through that copy: read back from
    // the GPU, 40% of the table was wrong (whole rows empty), the sky came out grey or black everywhere, from Alpha 4 on
    // (#359, #665); not cleared, the table read back whole and the sky was right. On NVIDIA it reads back whole either
    // way. 3D targets the game draws into start as they did before Alpha 4. SAVAGEWIND_VK_CLEAR_3D=1: cleared too.
    static int clear_3d = -1;
    if (clear_3d < 0) {
        clear_3d = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_CLEAR_3D") ? atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_CLEAR_3D")) != 0 : 0;
        if (clear_3d) LOG("[vk] new 3D images cleared too (SAVAGEWIND_VK_CLEAR_3D)\n");
    }
    if (type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D && !clear_3d) float_rt = false;
    if ((b->scalable || float_rt) && !depthfmt) {  // (scalable: made again at a new scale, no stale memory in what frames keep)
        VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_cmd();
        VkClearColorValue zero = {{0}};
        VkImageSubresourceRange rg = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS};
        rec_CmdClearColorImage(cb, b->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, &zero, 1, &rg);
        vk_full_barrier(cb);
    }
    {   // (debugging) SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_NEW_FILL=1: every new colour image starts magenta (texels nothing wrote yet)
        static int fill = -1;
        if (fill < 0) fill = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEBUG_NEW_FILL") != NULL;
        if (fill && !depthfmt && !is_bc_or_astc(vf)) {
            VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_cmd();
            VkClearColorValue mag = {{1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f}};
            VkImageSubresourceRange rg = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS};
            rec_CmdClearColorImage(cb, b->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, &mag, 1, &rg);
            vk_full_barrier(cb);
        }
    }
    if (depthfmt) {
        // New depth / stencil images start zeroed (as fresh memory reads on Apple GPUs). The game builds its depth
        // pyramid with depth-only copies, so the stencil of those images was never written: whatever the memory
        // held, different per image and per run, then failed or passed the depth-of-field passes' stencil test in
        // patches (flicker that came and went between runs, every other frame, below 1x internal resolution).
        VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_cmd();
        VkClearDepthStencilValue zero = {0.0f, 0};
        VkImageSubresourceRange rg = {b->aspect, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS};
        rec_CmdClearDepthStencilImage(cb, b->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, &zero, 1, &rg);
        VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                               .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT, .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                               .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT};
        VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
        rec_CmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
    }
}

static void defer(Dead d) {
    extern void vk_pass_barrier_forget(void);
    if (d.img) vk_pass_barrier_forget();  // (the next pass barrier may name the image, in a later submission)
    if (ndead == cap_dead) { cap_dead = cap_dead ? cap_dead * 2 : 256; dead = realloc(dead, cap_dead * sizeof *dead); }
    d.seq = vk_pending_seq();
    dead[ndead++] = d;
}

void vk_defer_image(VkImage img, VmaAllocation mem) { defer((Dead){.img = img, .mem = mem}); }
void vk_defer_view(VkImageView v) { defer((Dead){.view = v}); }

void vk_dl_note_upload(void *img, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t lv);  // (exec.c: SAVAGEWIND_VK_DEVLOST_TRACE)

static uint32_t level_w(const TexBackend *b, uint32_t lv) { uint32_t v = b->width >> lv; return v ? v : 1; }
static uint32_t level_h(const TexBackend *b, uint32_t lv) { uint32_t v = b->height >> lv; return v ? v : 1; }

static bool image_format_fallback_error(VkResult r) {
    return r == VK_ERROR_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED || r == VK_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT;
}

static bool image_out_of_memory(VkResult r) {
    return r == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY || r == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY;
}

static void log_memory_budget(const char *when) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp;
    VmaBudget budgets[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS] = {0};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(g_vk.phys, &mp);
    vmaGetHeapBudgets(g_vk.vma, budgets);
    LOG("[vk] memory budget %s (VK_EXT_memory_budget %s)\n", when, g_vk.memory_budget ? "enabled" : "unavailable; VMA estimates");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryHeapCount; i++) {
        LOG("[vk]   heap %u flags %#x (device-local flag %s): size %llu MB, budget %llu MB, usage %llu MB; "
            "VMA blocks %llu MB, allocations %llu MB\n",
            i, mp.memoryHeaps[i].flags, (mp.memoryHeaps[i].flags & VK_MEMORY_HEAP_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) ? "yes" : "no",
            (unsigned long long)(mp.memoryHeaps[i].size >> 20), (unsigned long long)(budgets[i].budget >> 20),
            (unsigned long long)(budgets[i].usage >> 20), (unsigned long long)(budgets[i].statistics.blockBytes >> 20),
            (unsigned long long)(budgets[i].statistics.allocationBytes >> 20));
    }
}

static void destroy_image(TexBackend *b) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        if (b->block_lv[i]) {
            destroy_image(b->block_lv[i]);
            free(b->block_lv[i]);
            b->block_lv[i] = NULL;
        }
    b->block = NULL;
    views_forget(b);
    texmem_forget(b);
    if (b->image) vk_hdr_image_gone(b->image);  // (a present record may still name it)
    if (b->image || b->mem) defer((Dead){.img = b->image, .mem = b->mem});  // (never the same allocation twice)
    b->image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    b->mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

// One image per memory and shape. On hardware a texture is its memory: every NVNtexture made over the same memory
// with the same shape reads and writes the same texels. BOTW 1.8.2 has several such objects at once (pool entries
// registered with an object it finalized, copies of NVNtexture objects, command buffers recorded before it made its
// frame's render targets again in the same memory), so they all take the same image. An image no texture holds any
// more waits a few frames for the next texture made there, then goes.
#define PARK_FRAMES 4
#define KEY_BUCKETS 4096
static TexBackend *g_keyed[KEY_BUCKETS];
static uint32_t key_bucket(uint64_t addr) { return (uint32_t)((addr >> 9) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull >> 40) & (KEY_BUCKETS - 1); }
static void key_of(const NvnTexture *t, uint32_t k[7]) {
    k[0] = t->target; k[1] = t->format; k[2] = t->width; k[3] = t->height; k[4] = t->depth; k[5] = t->levels; k[6] = t->samples;
}
static TexBackend *keyed_find(const NvnTexture *t) {
    uint32_t k[7];
    key_of(t, k);
    for (TexBackend *b = g_keyed[key_bucket(t->addr)]; b; b = b->key_next)
        if (b->key_addr == t->addr && !memcmp(b->key, k, sizeof k)) return b;
    return NULL;
}
static void keyed_add(TexBackend *b, const NvnTexture *t) {
    b->key_addr = t->addr;
    key_of(t, b->key);
    uint32_t i = key_bucket(t->addr);
    b->key_next = g_keyed[i];
    g_keyed[i] = b;
}
static void keyed_remove(TexBackend *b) {
    if (!b->key_addr) return;
    for (TexBackend **p = &g_keyed[key_bucket(b->key_addr)]; *p; p = &(*p)->key_next)
        if (*p == b) { *p = b->key_next; break; }
    b->key_addr = 0;
}

// Lists that know each element's slot (index + 1, kept in the element; removal swaps the last one in)
#define SLOT_LIST(name, T, slot)                                                                                    \
    static T **g_##name;                                                                                            \
    static int g_n##name, g_cap_##name;                                                                             \
    static void name##_add(T *x) {                                                                                  \
        if (g_n##name == g_cap_##name) {                                                                            \
            g_cap_##name = g_cap_##name ? g_cap_##name * 2 : 1024;                                                  \
            g_##name = realloc(g_##name, g_cap_##name * sizeof *g_##name);                                          \
        }                                                                                                           \
        g_##name[g_n##name++] = x;                                                                                  \
        x->slot = g_n##name;                                                                                        \
    }                                                                                                               \
    static void name##_remove(T *x) {                                                                               \
