```c
static VkSampler sampler_create(const NvnSamplerDesc *d, float aniso);

VkSampler vk_sampler(NvnSamplerDesc *d, bool aniso_ok, float bias) {
    float an = sampler_aniso(d, aniso_ok);
    float user_bias = sampler_user_lod_bias(d);
    float total_bias = bias + user_bias;
    if (d->min_filter <= 1) total_bias = 0;  // (no mip levels: nothing to bias)
    int k = aniso_ok ? 1 : 0;
    void **slot = total_bias != 0 ? &d->backend_bias[k] : aniso_ok ? &d->backend : &d->backend_plain;
    float *slot_aniso = total_bias != 0 ? &d->backend_bias_aniso[k] : aniso_ok ? &d->backend_aniso : &d->backend_plain_aniso;
    if (*slot && *slot_aniso == an && (total_bias == 0 || d->backend_bias_lod[k] == total_bias)) return (VkSampler)*slot;
    NvnSamplerDesc key = *d;
    key.backend = key.backend_plain = key.backend_bias[0] = key.backend_bias[1] = NULL;
    key.backend_aniso = an, key.backend_plain_aniso = 0;
    key.backend_bias_aniso[0] = key.backend_bias_aniso[1] = key.backend_bias_lod[0] = key.backend_bias_lod[1] = 0;
    key.lod_bias += total_bias;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_sampler_lock);
    VkSampler s = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nsamplers && !s; i++)
        if (!memcmp(&g_samplers[i].key, &key, sizeof key)) s = g_samplers[i].s;
    bool found = s != VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    // maxSamplerAllocationCount (4000 on Intel's Windows driver, the spec's minimum) counts every VkSampler alive;
    // keep some for the rest of the renderer (imgui, FidelityFX, the default samplers). Past it, or when the driver
    // refuses one (#239: -2 on an Intel Iris Xe), the closest existing sampler stands in rather than ending the game.
    uint32_t limit = g_vk.props.limits.maxSamplerAllocationCount;
    bool full = limit > 256 && (uint32_t)g_nsamplers >= limit - 128;
    static int test_max = -1;  // SAVAGEWIND_VK_MAX_SAMPLERS=<n>: the game's samplers stop at n (tests of the reuse)
    if (test_max < 0) test_max = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_MAX_SAMPLERS") ? atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_MAX_SAMPLERS")) : 0;
    if (test_max > 0 && g_nsamplers >= test_max) full = true;
    if (!found && !full) s = sampler_create(&key, an);
    if (!s) {
        int best = -1, best_score = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nsamplers; i++) {
            const NvnSamplerDesc *k = &g_samplers[i].key;
            int score = (k->compare_mode == d->compare_mode) * 8 + (k->min_filter == d->min_filter) * 4 +
                        (k->mag_filter == d->mag_filter) * 2 + (k->wrap[0] == d->wrap[0] && k->wrap[1] == d->wrap[1]);
            if (score > best_score) best_score = score, best = i;
        }
        s = best >= 0 ? g_samplers[best].s : vk_default_sampler(d->mag_filter == 1);
        static bool logged;
        if (!logged) {
            logged = true;
            LOG("[vk] sampler %s (%d made, driver limit %u): reusing the closest one from now on\n",
                full ? "limit reached" : "creation failed", g_nsamplers, limit);
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_sampler_lock);
        *slot = (void *)s;
        *slot_aniso = an;
        if (total_bias != 0) d->backend_bias_lod[k] = total_bias;
        return s;
    }
    if (!found) {
        int made = g_nsamplers + 1;  // (the count in players' logs: #239)
        if (made == 1 || made == 64 || made == 256 || made == 1024 || made == 2048)
            LOG("[vk] samplers: %d (driver limit %u)\n", made, limit);
        if (g_nsamplers == g_cap_samplers) {
            g_cap_samplers = g_cap_samplers ? g_cap_samplers * 2 : 256;
            g_samplers = realloc(g_samplers, g_cap_samplers * sizeof *g_samplers);
        }
        g_samplers[g_nsamplers].key = key;
        g_samplers[g_nsamplers++].s = s;
        static int log = -1;
        if (log < 0) log = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_SAMPLERS") != NULL;
        if (log) LOG("[sampler] #%d min %u mag %u wrap %u %u cmp %u lod %.2f..%.2f bias %.2f aniso game %.0f -> %.0f\n",
                     g_nsamplers, d->min_filter, d->mag_filter, d->wrap[0], d->wrap[1], d->compare_mode, d->lod_min,
                     d->lod_max, d->lod_bias, d->max_aniso, an);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_sampler_lock);
    *slot = (void *)s;
    *slot_aniso = an;
    if (total_bias != 0) d->backend_bias_lod[k] = total_bias;
    return s;
}

static VkSampler sampler_create(const NvnSamplerDesc *d, float aniso) {
    VkSamplerCreateInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO};
    si.magFilter = d->mag_filter == 1 ? VK_FILTER_LINEAR : VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    uint32_t mf = d->min_filter;
    si.minFilter = (mf == 1 || mf == 3 || mf == 5) ? VK_FILTER_LINEAR : VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    si.mipmapMode = mf == 4 || mf == 5 ? VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_LINEAR : VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST;
    VkSamplerAddressMode modes[3];
    bool border = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        switch (d->wrap[i]) {
        case 0: case 7: modes[i] = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE; break;
        case 1: modes[i] = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT; break;
        case 2: case 3: modes[i] = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_MIRROR_CLAMP_TO_EDGE; break;
        case 4: case 5: modes[i] = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_BORDER; border = true; break;
        case 6: modes[i] = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_MIRRORED_REPEAT; break;
        default: modes[i] = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
        }
    }
    si.addressModeU = modes[0]; si.addressModeV = modes[1]; si.addressModeW = modes[2];
    si.minLod = d->lod_min;
    si.maxLod = d->lod_max > 1000 ? VK_LOD_CLAMP_NONE : d->lod_max;
    if (mf <= 1) si.maxLod = si.minLod + 0.25f;  // not mipmapped: stay on the base level
    if (si.maxLod < si.minLod) si.maxLod = si.minLod;
    static float max_bias;
    if (!max_bias) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties pp;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(g_vk.phys, &pp);
        max_bias = pp.limits.maxSamplerLodBias;
    }
    si.mipLodBias = fmaxf(-max_bias, fminf(max_bias, d->lod_bias));
    if (aniso > 1) { si.anisotropyEnable = VK_TRUE; si.maxAnisotropy = aniso; }
    static float lodmin = -1;
    if (lodmin < 0) lodmin = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOD_MIN") ? (float)atof(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOD_MIN")) : 0;
    if (lodmin > 0 && mf > 1) si.minLod = fmaxf(si.minLod, lodmin);
    static int stest = -1;
    if (stest < 0) stest = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SAMPLER_TEST") != NULL;
    if (stest && mf > 1) { si.minLod = 0; si.maxLod = VK_LOD_CLAMP_NONE; si.anisotropyEnable = VK_TRUE; si.maxAnisotropy = 16; }
    if (d->compare_mode) {
        si.compareEnable = VK_TRUE;
        si.compareOp = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NO_SHADOW") ? VK_COMPARE_OP_ALWAYS : compare_op(d->compare_func);
    }
    VkSamplerCustomBorderColorCreateInfoEXT cb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_CREATE_INFO_EXT};
    if (border) {
        const float *c = d->border;
        if (c[0] == 0 && c[1] == 0 && c[2] == 0 && c[3] == 0) si.borderColor = VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_TRANSPARENT_BLACK;
        else if (c[0] == 0 && c[1] == 0 && c[2] == 0 && c[3] == 1) si.borderColor = VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_OPAQUE_BLACK;
        else if (c[0] == 1 && c[1] == 1 && c[2] == 1 && c[3] == 1) si.borderColor = VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_OPAQUE_WHITE;
        else if (g_vk.custom_border) {
            memcpy(cb.customBorderColor.float32, c, 16);
            si.borderColor = VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_CUSTOM_EXT;
            si.pNext = &cb;
        } else si.borderColor = VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_TRANSPARENT_BLACK;
    }
    VkSampler s;
    VkResult r = vkCreateSampler(g_vk.dev, &si, NULL, &s);
    if (r == VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST) VK_CHECK(r);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {  // (vk_sampler reuses another one)
        static int logged;
        if (logged++ < 3) LOG("[vk] vkCreateSampler failed: %d (border %d, aniso %.0f, compare %u)\n", r, border, aniso,
                              d->compare_mode);
        return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    return s;
}

// An enlarged font sheet (Gameplay > Sharper text): the game samples its fonts without mip levels, these have some
VkSampler vk_text_sampler(void) {
    static VkSampler s;
    if (!s) {
        VkSamplerCreateInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO, .magFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR,
                                  .minFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR, .mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_LINEAR,
                                  .addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
                                  .addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
                                  .addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE, .maxLod = VK_LOD_CLAMP_NONE};
        VK_CHECK(vkCreateSampler(g_vk.dev, &si, NULL, &s));
    }
    return s;
}

VkSampler vk_default_sampler(bool linear) {
    static VkSampler s[2];
    if (!s[linear]) {
        VkSamplerCreateInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO,
                                  .magFilter = linear ? VK_FILTER_LINEAR : VK_FILTER_NEAREST,
                                  .minFilter = linear ? VK_FILTER_LINEAR : VK_FILTER_NEAREST,
                                  .addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
                                  .addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE,
                                  .addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE, .maxLod = 0.25f};
        VK_CHECK(vkCreateSampler(g_vk.dev, &si, NULL, &s[linear]));
    }
    return s[linear];
}
```

```h
// Vulkan backend for the NVN layer (Windows; macOS uses runtime/nvn/metal.m + renderer.m).
// Files: device.c (instance, window, swapchain, present, screenshots, ImGui hooks), textures.c (images, uploads,
// views), exec.c (command execution: passes, draws, clears, copies, compute), shaders.c (GLSL -> SPIR-V, programs,
// pipelines). Mirrors the Metal backend's behaviour; differences are noted where they happen.
//
// Synchronisation model: every image lives in VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, and a full memory barrier separates
// render passes, copies and dispatches (Metal tracks these hazards itself). Submissions are numbered; a timeline
// semaphore signals each number, which is what NVN fences (renderer_fence_seq / renderer_wait_seq) wait for.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#if __has_include(<vma/vk_mem_alloc.h>)
#include <vma/vk_mem_alloc.h>

#endif

#include "../nvn.h"
#include "../maxwell/shader.h"

void vk_device_fault_report(void);
#define VK_CHECK(x) do { VkResult r_ = (x); if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) { if (r_ == VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST) { vk_device_fault_report(); \
    FATAL("Vulkan device lost: the GPU stopped responding (%s, %s:%d)\n", #x, __FILE__, __LINE__); } \
    if (r_ == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY || r_ == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY) \
        FATAL("the GPU ran out of memory (%s: %d, %s:%d)\n", #x, r_, __FILE__, __LINE__); \
    FATAL("%s failed: %d (%s:%d)\n", #x, r_, __FILE__, __LINE__); } } while (0)
```

`runtime/nvn/vulkan/vram.c`:

```c
// Video memory: VMA's blocks made ahead of need on a thread of their own, and what the device-local heap has left.
//
// VMA suballocates images and buffers from blocks of device memory (32-256 MB a block, one vkAllocateMemory each).
// When no block of a memory type has room, the allocation that needs it makes a new one on the thread that asked -
// the render / translation threads - and that can take milliseconds (~0.1-0.6 ms on an RTX 3060 with room to
// spare, reportedly ~8-19 ms on other setups: a hitch whenever the game's video memory grows). And VMA gives its one
// empty block of a type back (vkFreeMemory) as soon as anything else of that type is freed, so a type whose use
// goes up and down makes blocks over and over. Now a helper thread keeps room ahead: woken whenever a thread of the
// game makes a block, and every HR_PERIOD_MS besides, it asks VMA, per memory type in use, for half of the largest
// block seen there without making a block (NEVER_ALLOCATE): given, there is room, and it is given back. Refused, it
// asks again letting VMA make a block - on the helper - and keeps that allocation (the anchor: a block holding it is
// never empty, so VMA keeps it) until the next one is made, then frees the old one (its half: room for the game).
// (Approach from another recompiler's VMA setup.) Allocations VMA gives memory of their own (dedicated: render
// targets, the heap copy, images over half a block) are not helped. Under pressure - the heap's usage plus a block
// over HR_PRESSURE of its budget (VK_EXT_memory_budget where the driver has it: what the OS grants this process;
// else VMA's estimate, 80% of the heap) - no spare is made and the anchor is given back.
// Automatic (Alpha 5): on an RTX 3060 a block takes 0.1-0.6 ms, nothing to gain, and the spare holds video memory, so
// the helper starts only once a block made on a game thread took 2 ms or more (SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_AUTO_MS) (slow drivers, integrated GPUs:
// TotK Recomp measured 8-19 ms, valentderah/totk-pc-recomp vk_headroom.c, MIT). SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_HEADROOM=1: on from
// the start; 0: never. SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_LOG=1: every vkAllocateMemory over 1 ms and
// a count every 30 s. Every block made is logged, with the thread that waited for it.
#include <SDL3/SDL_timer.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "vk.h"
#include "vram.h"
#include "../../perfcount.h"

#define HR_PERIOD_MS 250
// (the point textures.c starts letting images go: 0.90 kept spare blocks above it - an MX350's 1669 MB budget, 7 blocks
// of 256 MB within 4 s, ~550 MB of them empty - and their use pushed the heap copy out and textures with it)
#define HR_PRESSURE VRAM_TRIM_TARGET
static uint64_t hr_auto_ns = 2000000;  // (tests: SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_AUTO_MS)

static bool hr_on, hr_log, budget_ext, hr_auto;
static _Atomic bool hr_auto_started;
static _Thread_local bool hr_is_helper;  // (set by hr_main itself: on_helper is right from its first allocation)
static pthread_t hr_thread;
static _Atomic bool hr_thread_up;
static pthread_mutex_t hr_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t hr_cond = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static bool hr_wake;
static _Atomic uint64_t hr_block[VK_MAX_MEMORY_TYPES];  // largest block seen per memory type (0: none yet)
static VmaAllocation hr_anchor[VK_MAX_MEMORY_TYPES];   // (helper) half a block holding the newest spare block
static uint32_t hr_drops;                              // (helper) anchors given back under pressure
static VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties hr_mp;
static uint64_t vr_block;  // (vram_block_size)
_Atomic uint64_t g_vram_alloc_ns;  // vkAllocateMemory time on the game's threads (exec.c's hitch lines)
static _Atomic uint32_t st_game_blocks, st_helper_blocks, st_dedicated;
static _Atomic uint64_t st_game_ns, st_helper_ns, st_dedicated_ns;

static bool on_helper(void) { return hr_is_helper; }
static void *hr_main(void *arg);

static bool dedicated_info(const VkMemoryAllocateInfo *ai) {
    for (const VkBaseInStructure *p = ai->pNext; p; p = p->pNext)
        if (p->sType == VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_DEDICATED_ALLOCATE_INFO) return true;
    return false;
}

// (VMA's vkAllocateMemory) timed; a block made on a thread of the game wakes the helper
static VKAPI_ATTR VkResult VKAPI_CALL vram_allocate(VkDevice dev, const VkMemoryAllocateInfo *ai, const VkAllocationCallbacks *cb,
                                                    VkDeviceMemory *mem) {
    uint64_t t0 = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    VkResult r = vkAllocateMemory(dev, ai, cb, mem);
    uint64_t dt = SDL_GetTicksNS() - t0;
    bool helper = on_helper(), ded = dedicated_info(ai);
    uint32_t type = ai->memoryTypeIndex;
    uint64_t size = ai->allocationSize;
    bool block = r == VK_SUCCESS && !ded && size >= (16ull << 20) && !(size & (size - 1));  // (VMA's blocks: powers of 2)
    if (!helper) atomic_fetch_add(&g_vram_alloc_ns, dt), perfcount_add(PC_VALLOC_NS, dt);
    if (ded) atomic_fetch_add(&st_dedicated, 1), atomic_fetch_add(&st_dedicated_ns, dt);
    if (block) {
        if (helper) atomic_fetch_add(&st_helper_blocks, 1), atomic_fetch_add(&st_helper_ns, dt);
        else atomic_fetch_add(&st_game_blocks, 1), atomic_fetch_add(&st_game_ns, dt);
        uint64_t old = atomic_load(&hr_block[type]);
        while (size > old && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&hr_block[type], &old, size)) {}
        LOG("[vram] t=%.2f new block: %llu MB of memory type %u (heap %u) in %.1f ms on %s\n", t0 / 1e9,
            (unsigned long long)(size >> 20), type, hr_mp.memoryTypes[type].heapIndex, dt / 1e6,
            helper ? "the helper (ahead of need)" : "a game thread");
        bool start = false;
        if (!helper && hr_auto && dt >= hr_auto_ns && !atomic_exchange(&hr_auto_started, true)) {
            LOG("[vram] a block took %.1f ms on a game thread: blocks are made ahead of need from now on\n", dt / 1e6);
            hr_on = true;
            start = true;
        }
        if (start) {
            pthread_mutex_lock(&hr_lock);
            hr_wake = true;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&hr_lock);
            if (pthread_create(&hr_thread, NULL, hr_main, NULL) == 0) atomic_store(&hr_thread_up, true);
            else hr_on = false;
        } else if (!helper && hr_on) {
            pthread_mutex_lock(&hr_lock);
            hr_wake = true;
            pthread_cond_signal(&hr_cond);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&hr_lock);
        }
    } else if (hr_log && dt > 1000000)
        LOG("[vram] t=%.2f vkAllocateMemory %.1f MB type %u%s: %.1f ms on %s%s\n", t0 / 1e9, size / 1048576.0, type,
            ded ? " (dedicated)" : "", dt / 1e6, helper ? "the helper" : "a game thread", r == VK_SUCCESS ? "" : ", failed");
    return r;
}

static void *hr_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    hr_is_helper = true;
    uint64_t last_stats = SDL_GetTicksNS();
    for (;;) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&hr_lock);
        if (!hr_wake) {
            struct timespec ts;
            clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
            ts.tv_nsec += HR_PERIOD_MS * 1000000L;
            if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) ts.tv_sec++, ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
            pthread_cond_timedwait(&hr_cond, &hr_lock, &ts);
        }
        hr_wake = false;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&hr_lock);
        VmaBudget bud[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS];
        vmaGetHeapBudgets(g_vk.vma, bud);
        for (uint32_t t = 0; t < hr_mp.memoryTypeCount && hr_on; t++) {
            uint64_t blk = atomic_load(&hr_block[t]);
            if (!blk) continue;
            uint32_t h = hr_mp.memoryTypes[t].heapIndex;
            if ((double)(bud[h].usage + blk) > HR_PRESSURE * (double)bud[h].budget) {  // pressure: no spare
                if (hr_anchor[t]) vmaFreeMemory(g_vk.vma, hr_anchor[t]), hr_anchor[t] = NULL, hr_drops++;
                continue;
            }
            VkMemoryRequirements req = {.size = blk / 2, .alignment = 256, .memoryTypeBits = 1u << t};
            VmaAllocationCreateInfo probe = {.flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_NEVER_ALLOCATE_BIT, .memoryTypeBits = 1u << t};
            VmaAllocationCreateInfo make = {.memoryTypeBits = 1u << t};
            VmaAllocation a;
            if (vmaAllocateMemory(g_vk.vma, &req, &probe, &a, NULL) == VK_SUCCESS) { vmaFreeMemory(g_vk.vma, a); continue; }
            if (vmaAllocateMemory(g_vk.vma, &req, &make, &a, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) continue;
            if (hr_anchor[t]) vmaFreeMemory(g_vk.vma, hr_anchor[t]);  // (its half: room for the game in the old block)
            hr_anchor[t] = a;
        }
        if (hr_log && SDL_GetTicksNS() - last_stats > 30000000000ull) {
            last_stats = SDL_GetTicksNS();
            LOG("[vram] blocks made on game threads %u (%.1f ms), on the helper %u (%.1f ms); dedicated %u (%.1f ms); "
                "anchors given back under pressure %u\n", atomic_load(&st_game_blocks), atomic_load(&st_game_ns) / 1e6,
                atomic_load(&st_helper_blocks), atomic_load(&st_helper_ns) / 1e6, atomic_load(&st_dedicated),
                atomic_load(&st_dedicated_ns) / 1e6, hr_drops);
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

// (control `memstats`) every heap: VMA's usage and budget of it (the whole process's with VK_EXT_memory_budget), size
static int gpu_heaps(uint64_t *usage, uint64_t *budget, uint64_t *size, uint32_t *device_local, int max) {
    VmaBudget bud[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS];
    vmaGetHeapBudgets(g_vk.vma, bud);
    int n = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < hr_mp.memoryHeapCount && n < max; i++, n++) {
        usage[n] = bud[i].usage;
        budget[n] = bud[i].budget;
        size[n] = hr_mp.memoryHeaps[i].size;
        device_local[n] = (hr_mp.memoryHeaps[i].flags & VK_MEMORY_HEAP_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) != 0;
    }
    return n;
}

void vram_allocator_setup(VmaAllocatorCreateInfo *ai, VmaVulkanFunctions *fn, bool memory_budget) {
    g_gpu_heaps = gpu_heaps;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(g_vk.phys, &hr_mp);
    budget_ext = memory_budget;
    memset(fn, 0, sizeof *fn);
    fn->vkAllocateMemory = vram_allocate;
    ai->pVulkanFunctions = fn;
    if (memory_budget) ai->flags |= VMA_ALLOCATOR_CREATE_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_BIT;
    // VMA makes blocks of heap / 8 in heaps of 1 GB or less and of 256 MB above. A heap of VRAM_SMALL_HEAP or less (an
    // MX350: 1964 MB, 1669 MB budget) then grows in steps of 15% of its budget, the room left in its blocks counted as
    // use: in play it went over the budget twice, and blocks of 1454-1665 MB held 834-1090 MB. Blocks of the power of 2
    // nearest heap / 32 there (64 MB): in the same tour of the map, no step over the budget. (A power of 2, as are VMA's
    // halves of it for a heap's first blocks: vram_allocate tells VMA's blocks by that.)
    uint64_t heap = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < hr_mp.memoryHeapCount; i++)
        if ((hr_mp.memoryHeaps[i].flags & VK_MEMORY_HEAP_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) && hr_mp.memoryHeaps[i].size > heap)
            heap = hr_mp.memoryHeaps[i].size;
    vr_block = heap <= (1024ull << 20) ? heap / 8 : 256ull << 20;
    if (heap > (1024ull << 20) && heap <= VRAM_SMALL_HEAP) {
        uint64_t want = heap / 32, p = 1ull << 20;
        while (p * 2 <= want) p *= 2;
        ai->preferredLargeHeapBlockSize = vr_block = want - p > p * 2 - want ? p * 2 : p;
    } else if (heap > VRAM_SMALL_HEAP) {
        // Bigger heaps: blocks of 64 MB, not VMA's 256. A block is given back only when it is empty, and a 256 MB one
        // with a few images left in it held the rest; system memory's heap takes the same size. On AMD's Windows
        // driver and integrated GPUs video memory counts as the process's own memory, so that waste was RAM too
        // (TotK Recomp's 64 MB blocks: ~230 MB less on a 10-minute route, valentderah/totk-pc-recomp 8e05d2b4).
        // SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_BLOCK_MB=<n> (a power of 2, 16 to 256): another size.
        uint64_t mb = 64;
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_BLOCK_MB");
        if (e && atoi(e) >= 16 && atoi(e) <= 256 && !(atoi(e) & (atoi(e) - 1))) mb = (uint64_t)atoi(e);
        ai->preferredLargeHeapBlockSize = vr_block = mb << 20;
    }
}

uint64_t vram_block_size(void) { return vr_block; }

void vram_start(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_HEADROOM");
    hr_log = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_LOG") && atoi(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_LOG"));
    hr_on = e && atoi(e) != 0;
    hr_auto = !e;  // (unset: started by the first slow block, vram_allocate)
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_AUTO_MS")) hr_auto_ns = (uint64_t)(atof(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_AUTO_MS")) * 1e6);
    uint64_t usage, budget, size;
    vram_device_local(&usage, &budget, &size);
    LOG("[vram] blocks ahead of need: %s; video memory %llu MB, budget %llu MB (%s), in use %llu MB, blocks of %llu MB\n",
        hr_on ? "on" : hr_auto ? "automatic (from the first block over 2 ms)" : "off", (unsigned long long)(size >> 20), (unsigned long long)(budget >> 20),
        budget_ext ? "VK_EXT_memory_budget" : "VMA's estimate", (unsigned long long)(usage >> 20), (unsigned long long)(vr_block >> 20));
    if (!hr_on && !hr_log) return;  // (with the log: the helper only counts)
    if (pthread_create(&hr_thread, NULL, hr_main, NULL) == 0) atomic_store(&hr_thread_up, true);
    else hr_on = false;
}

// The largest device-local heap: VMA's usage and budget of it (the whole process's with VK_EXT_memory_budget), its size
uint32_t vram_device_local(uint64_t *usage, uint64_t *budget, uint64_t *size) {
    uint32_t best = 0;
    uint64_t sz = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < hr_mp.memoryHeapCount; i++)
        if ((hr_mp.memoryHeaps[i].flags & VK_MEMORY_HEAP_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) && hr_mp.memoryHeaps[i].size > sz)
            sz = hr_mp.memoryHeaps[i].size, best = i;
    VmaBudget bud[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS];
    vmaGetHeapBudgets(g_vk.vma, bud);
    if (usage) *usage = bud[best].usage;
    if (budget) *budget = vram_budget_cap(bud[best].budget);
    if (size) *size = sz;
    return best;
}

// SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_BUDGET_MB=<n>: a budget no bigger than n MB (to try a small card's limits on a big one)
uint64_t vram_budget_cap(uint64_t budget) {
    static int64_t cap = -1;
    if (cap < 0) cap = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_BUDGET_MB") ? (int64_t)atoll(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VRAM_BUDGET_MB")) << 20 : 0;
    return cap && (uint64_t)cap < budget ? (uint64_t)cap : budget;
}

// The largest device-local heap: the bytes VMA's allocations take in it (its blocks' free room left out), its budget
void vram_device_local_allocated(uint64_t *allocated, uint64_t *budget) {
    uint32_t best = vram_device_local(NULL, budget, NULL);
    VmaBudget bud[VK_MAX_MEMORY_HEAPS];
    vmaGetHeapBudgets(g_vk.vma, bud);
    *allocated = bud[best].statistics.allocationBytes;
}

bool vram_budget_ext(void) { return budget_ext; }
```

`runtime/paths.c`:

```c
// Data root and shipped resources (runtime/paths.h).
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

#include "game_files.h"
#include "imageload.h"
#include "paths.h"
#include "platform.h"

static char g_root[1024], g_start[1024], g_exe_dir[1024];

#ifdef _WIN32
#define SEP "\\"
static bool is_link(const char *p) {  // symlink or junction
    DWORD a = GetFileAttributesA(p);
    return a != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES && (a & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT);
}
static bool resolve(const char *p, char *out, size_t n) { return _fullpath(out, p, n) != NULL; }
#define path_eq(a, b) (_stricmp(a, b) == 0)
#else
#define SEP "/"
static bool is_link(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return lstat(p, &st) == 0 && S_ISLNK(st.st_mode);
}
static bool resolve(const char *p, char *out, size_t n) {
    char buf[PATH_MAX];
    if (!realpath(p, buf)) return false;
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", buf);
    return true;
}
#define path_eq(a, b) (strcmp(a, b) == 0)
#endif

static bool is_dir(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode);
}

static bool exists(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0;
}

static void mkdirs(const char *path) {
    char p[1024];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s", path);
    for (char *c = p + 1; *c; c++)
        if (*c == '/' || *c == '\\') { char s = *c; *c = 0; mkdir(p, 0755); *c = s; }
    mkdir(p, 0755);
}

static bool writable(const char *dir) {
    char t[1100];
    snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%s" SEP ".write_test", dir);
    FILE *f = fopen(t, "wb");
    if (!f) return false;
    fclose(f);
    remove(t);
    return true;
}

static void fail(const char *msg) {
    fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", msg);
    SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR, "Savage Wind", msg, NULL);
    exit(1);
}

static bool g_dev;  // the data root is the starting folder because it has extracted/ (a source checkout)
bool rt_dev_mode(void) { return g_dev; }

// The data root as rules 1-3 of paths.h choose it, from the starting folder and the executable's folder.
static void choose_root(char *root, size_t n, bool *dev, const char *start, const char *exe_dir) {
    const char *env = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DATA_ROOT");
    if (dev) *dev = false;
    if (env && *env) snprintf(root, n, "%s", env);
    else if (is_dir("extracted")) {  // dev / portable: as before
        snprintf(root, n, "%s", start);
        if (dev) *dev = true;
    } else {
#ifdef _WIN32
        snprintf(root, n, "%s", exe_dir);
#elif defined(__linux__)
        // (the AppImage is read-only): $XDG_DATA_HOME/savagewind, ~/.local/share/savagewind by default
        const char *xdg = getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"), *home = getenv("HOME");
        (void)exe_dir;
        if (xdg && *xdg == '/') snprintf(root, n, "%s/savagewind", xdg);
        else snprintf(root, n, "%s/.local/share/savagewind", home && *home ? home : "/tmp");
#else
        const char *home = getenv("HOME");
        (void)exe_dir;
        snprintf(root, n, "%s/Library/Application Support/" RT_BUNDLE_ID, home && *home ? home : "/tmp");
#endif
    }
}

static void exe_folder(char *out, size_t n) {
    if (!plat_exe_path(out, n)) return;
    char *s = strrchr(out, '/'), *b = strrchr(out, '\\');
    if (b > s) s = b;
    if (s) *s = 0;
}

bool rt_peek_data_root(char *out, size_t n) {
    char start[1024], exe[1024] = "";
    if (!getcwd(start, sizeof start)) return false;
    exe_folder(exe, sizeof exe);
    choose_root(out, n, NULL, start, exe);
    return out[0] != 0;
}

void rt_paths_init(void) {
    if (!getcwd(g_start, sizeof g_start)) g_start[0] = 0;
    exe_folder(g_exe_dir, sizeof g_exe_dir);
    char root[1024];
    choose_root(root, sizeof root, &g_dev, g_start, g_exe_dir);
    mkdirs(root);
    char msg[1400];
    if (!is_dir(root) || !writable(root) || chdir(root) != 0) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "Savage Wind can't write to its folder:\n%s\n\nIt keeps game files, saves and settings "
                 "next to the program. Move the \"Savage Wind\" folder somewhere you can write to (e.g. Documents or "
                 "Desktop, not Program Files) and start it again.", root);
#else
        snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "Savage Wind can't write to its data folder:\n%s", root);
#endif
        fail(msg);
    }
    if (!getcwd(g_root, sizeof g_root)) snprintf(g_root, sizeof g_root, "%s", root);
    fprintf(stderr, "[paths] data: %s\n", g_root);
}

const char *rt_data_root(void) { return g_root; }

bool rt_resource(const char *name, const char *dev_rel, char *out, size_t n) {
    char c[4][1100] = {{0}};
    if (name) {
        snprintf(c[0], sizeof c[0], "%s" SEP "%s", g_exe_dir, name);
        snprintf(c[1], sizeof c[1], "%s" SEP ".." SEP "Resources" SEP "%s", g_exe_dir, name);  // .app/Contents/Resources
    }
    if (dev_rel) {
        snprintf(c[2], sizeof c[2], "%s" SEP "%s", g_start, dev_rel);
        snprintf(c[3], sizeof c[3], "%s" SEP ".." SEP "%s", g_exe_dir, dev_rel);  // build/savagewind -> repo root
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        if (c[i][0] && exists(c[i])) return (size_t)snprintf(out, n, "%s", c[i]) < n;  // (as is: a venv python must stay a link)
    return false;
}

// ---- game files
// game_dir must be <data root>/extracted, a real folder (a dev worktree's symlinked extracted/ is refused)
static bool game_dir_ok(const char *game_dir) {
    char want[1100], got[1100];
    snprintf(want, sizeof want, "%s" SEP "extracted", g_root);
    if (!g_root[0] || is_link(game_dir) || !resolve(game_dir, got, sizeof got)) return false;
    return path_eq(want, got);
}

bool rt_remove_game_file(const char *game_dir, const char *name) {
    bool known = false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof GAME_FILES / sizeof *GAME_FILES; i++) known |= !strcmp(name, GAME_FILES[i]);
    if (!known || !game_dir_ok(game_dir)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[paths] refusing to delete %s/%s (not app-created game files in the data root)\n", game_dir, name);
        return false;
    }
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s" SEP "%s", game_dir, name);
    if (!exists(p) && !is_link(p)) return true;
    if (is_link(p)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[paths] refusing to delete %s (a link)\n", p);
        return false;
    }
    return is_dir(p) ? plat_remove_tree(p) : remove(p) == 0;  // (plat_remove_tree doesn't follow links inside)
}

bool rt_is_link(const char *p) { return is_link(p); }

bool rt_remove_game_files(const char *game_dir) {
    if (!game_dir_ok(game_dir)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[paths] refusing to delete game files in %s (not <data root>/extracted)\n", game_dir);
        return false;
    }
    bool ok = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof GAME_FILES / sizeof *GAME_FILES; i++) ok &= rt_remove_game_file(game_dir, GAME_FILES[i]);
    rmdir(game_dir);  // only if empty: anything else in there stays
    return ok;
}

// The player's own start screen picture (runtime/ui/splash.mm): splash.jpg / splash.jpeg / splash.png in the data root
// (next to the exe; a source checkout's root). Never shipped and never tracked (.gitignore): whatever the player puts
// there, for themselves.
bool rt_user_splash(char *out, size_t n) {
    static const char *const names[] = {"splash.jpg", "splash.jpeg", "splash.png"};
    char p[1100];
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof names / sizeof *names; i++) {
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s" SEP "%s", g_root, names[i]);
        if (exists(p)) return (size_t)snprintf(out, n, "%s", p) < n;
    }
    return false;
}

// Window / Dock icon: icon.png shipped next to the exe or in the .app (none for a plain source build).
void rt_window_icon(SDL_Window *w) {
    char p[1100];
    if (!rt_resource("icon.png", NULL, p, sizeof p)) return;
    int iw, ih;
    unsigned char *px = rt_image_rgba(p, &iw, &ih);  // (not SDL_LoadPNG: that is SDL 3.4, the distributions ship 3.2)
    if (!px) return;
    SDL_Surface *s = SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom(iw, ih, SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32, px, iw * 4);
    if (s) SDL_SetWindowIcon(w, s), SDL_DestroySurface(s);
    rt_image_free(px);
}
```

```h
// Where Savage Wind keeps its files (runtime/paths.c).
//
// Data root: everything the app writes or the user brings - extracted/ (game files), save/,
// cache/ (shaders / pipelines), fonts/ (imported), savagewind.ini. rt_paths_init() picks it and makes it the
// working directory, so the rest of the runtime opens those by their relative names. In order:
```

`runtime/pc_bow.h`:

```h
// Controls > Mouse bow aiming (settings.h pc_bow): hold the right mouse button to draw and aim, click the left one to
// fire, release the right one to put the bow away. The game's own bow is ZR held to draw and released to fire, and
// B to cancel while ZR is still held; this turns the two mouse buttons into that. Pure state, timed in nanoseconds,
// independent of the frame rate (runtime/hle/input.c samples it each time the game reads the controller).
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct {
    bool aiming;  // the right button is held
    enum { PC_BOW_IDLE, PC_BOW_DRAW, PC_BOW_SHOT, PC_BOW_CANCEL, PC_BOW_SETTLE } phase;
    uint64_t until;  // the end of a timed phase
} PcBow;

// The right button down or up. Up while drawing cancels: B with ZR still held, or releasing ZR would fire.
static inline void pc_bow_aim(PcBow *b, bool down, uint64_t now) {
    b->aiming = down;
    if (down && b->phase == PC_BOW_IDLE) b->phase = PC_BOW_DRAW;
    if (!down && b->phase == PC_BOW_DRAW) { b->phase = PC_BOW_CANCEL; b->until = now + 120000000; }
}

// A left click while drawing: ZR let go for 140 ms (the shot), then drawn again while the right button stays held.
static inline void pc_bow_fire(PcBow *b, uint64_t now) {
    if (b->aiming && b->phase == PC_BOW_DRAW) { b->phase = PC_BOW_SHOT; b->until = now + 140000000; }
}

// The buttons to add to the controller's now (Switch button bits: ZR 9, B 1)
static inline uint64_t pc_bow_buttons(PcBow *b, uint64_t now) {
    const uint64_t zr = 1ull << 9, cancel = 1ull << 1;
    if (b->phase == PC_BOW_SHOT && now >= b->until) b->phase = b->aiming ? PC_BOW_DRAW : PC_BOW_IDLE;
    if (b->phase == PC_BOW_CANCEL && now >= b->until) { b->phase = PC_BOW_SETTLE; b->until = now + 60000000; }
    if (b->phase == PC_BOW_SETTLE && now >= b->until) b->phase = b->aiming ? PC_BOW_DRAW : PC_BOW_IDLE;
    if (b->phase == PC_BOW_CANCEL) return zr | cancel;  // (B while ZR is held: the arrow is put away, not shot)
    if (b->phase == PC_BOW_SETTLE) return cancel;       // (ZR let go after B: nothing fires)
    return b->phase == PC_BOW_DRAW ? zr : 0;
}
```
