```c
}

// The screen's cursor type is translated by the UI controller, not used as
// a manager-array index. Only that manager channel may focus this screen.
static bool hover_target(Cpu *c,uint64_t screen,unsigned target) {
    uint64_t ui=LD64(screen+0x28),router=ptr(ui)?LD64(ui+0x48):0;
    uint64_t vt=ptr(router)?LD64(router):0,resolve=ptr(vt)?LD64(vt+0x28):0;
    if(!ptr(resolve))return false;
    return call(c,resolve,router,LD8(screen+0xfc),0)==target;
}

static uint64_t quest_list(uint64_t screen) {
    if(!ptr(screen)||LD64(screen)!=0x7001cf9ad8ull||LD8(screen+0xfe)!=2)return 0;
    uint64_t lists=LD64(screen+0x390);
    if(LD32(screen+0x388)!=3||!ptr(lists))return 0;
    uint64_t list=LD64(lists+8);
    return ptr(list)&&LD64(list)==0x7001cdbb58ull?list:0;
}

// Adventure Log owns a virtualized list. Changing only BoxCursorControl leaves
// that list on the keyboard's old row; its next update restores the old focus.
// Select through the list's own node lookup and selection path instead. The
// native list then updates the highlight, quest details and sound together.
static bool native_item_list(uint64_t list) {
    if(!ptr(list))return false;
    uint64_t vt=LD64(list);
    // The five-row purchase list derives from the same native list class as
    // the selling grid, with its own vtable but the same selection contract.
    return vt==0x7001cdbb58ull||vt==0x7001cfcf78ull;
}
static bool quest_focus(Cpu *c,uint64_t screen,uint64_t node) {
    uint64_t vt=LD64(screen);
    if(vt!=0x7001cf9ad8ull&&vt!=0x7001ceb808ull&&screen!=shop_screen)return false;
    unsigned count=LD32(screen+0x388);uint64_t lists=LD64(screen+0x390);
    if(!ptr(lists)||count>8)return false;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<count;i++) {
        uint64_t list=LD64(lists+8*i);
        if(!native_item_list(list))continue;
        int index=(int)call(c,0x7000d6d710,list,node,0);
        if(index<0)continue;
        // 2dc is a scroll-page index, not the focused item. Selecting that
        // page rebuilds positions and makes a stationary pointer chase rows.
        // The cursor-only path updates 30c/310 and the native highlight.
        if((int)LD32(list+0x30c)!=index||(int)LD32(list+0x310)!=index)
            call(c,0x7000d6c870,list,(unsigned)index,0);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool quest_scroll(Cpu *c,uint64_t screen) {
    if(!quest_list(screen)||LD32(screen+0x3a48)!=2||pointer_keyboard_input)return false;
    extern uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);
    uint64_t frame=renderer_present_count();
    if(quest_scroll_frame==frame)return true;
    uint64_t module=LD64(screen+0x3bb0),master=ptr(module)?LD64(module+0x300):0;
    if(!native_item_list(master))return false;
    unsigned category=LD32(master+0x2e8),count=LD32(screen+0x388);
    uint64_t lists=LD64(screen+0x390);
    if(!ptr(lists)||count>8)return false;
    // The registry also retains the category strip and hidden detail lists.
    // Only the visible row list in the selected category owns wheel scrolling.
    for(unsigned i=0;i<count;i++) {
        uint64_t list=LD64(lists+8*i);
        if(list==master||!native_item_list(list)||!(LD8(list+0x2c)&1)||
           LD32(list+0x2e8)!=category||LD32(list+0xc0)!=1)continue;
        unsigned columns=LD32(list+0x288);uint64_t array=LD64(list+0x290);
        uint64_t column=category<columns&&columns<=16&&ptr(array)?LD64(array+8*category):0;
        if(!ptr(column)||!LD32(column+0x29c))continue;
        // Child lists retain cached offscreen origins after category changes
        // (e.g. Side Quests at -1960,-380). Their viewport is positioned by
        // the outer category list; use that stable origin for wheel hit tests.
        float x=*(float*)(master+0x304),y=*(float*)(master+0x308);
        float left=x+*(float*)(column+0x2f8),right=x+*(float*)(column+0x300);
        float bottom=y+*(float*)(column+0x2fc),top=y+*(float*)(column+0x304);
        if(!isfinite(left)||!isfinite(right)||!isfinite(bottom)||!isfinite(top)||
           point[0]<left||point[0]>right||point[1]<bottom||point[1]>top)continue;
        int scroll=atomic_exchange(&wheel,0);if(!scroll)return false;
        float current=*(float*)(list+0x2d4),minimum=*(float*)(list+0x2b4),maximum=*(float*)(list+0x2bc);
        uint64_t view=LD64(column+0x10);unsigned rows=LD32(column+0x29c);
        if(!ptr(view)||rows>10000)return false;
        float row_height=*(float*)(view+0x34),stride=*(float*)(view+0x44),height=top-bottom;
        if(!isfinite(current)||!isfinite(minimum)||!isfinite(maximum)||maximum<minimum||
           !isfinite(row_height)||!isfinite(stride)||row_height<=0||stride<=0||height<=0)return false;
        // Categories share a virtual canvas, including space reserved for
        // empty preceding categories. Ask the game for this category's first
        // page origin; zero and the global extent are not its scroll bounds.
        float origin[2]={NAN,NAN};Cpu saved_origin=*c;
        c->x[0]=list;c->x[1]=0;c->x[2]=category;c->x[3]=(uintptr_t)origin;
        guest_call(c,0x7000d6ea78);*c=saved_origin;
        if(!isfinite(origin[1]))return false;
        minimum=fmaxf(minimum,-origin[1]);
        float content=row_height+(rows-1)*stride;
        maximum=fmaxf(minimum,fminf(maximum,minimum+fmaxf(0,content-height)));
        float next=fminf(maximum,fmaxf(minimum,current-scroll*stride)),delta=next-current;
        quest_scroll_frame=frame;hover_leave();hover_until=0;
        if(delta) {
            // Queue the native scroll for its own tick, as stick scrolling does.
            // Immediate mode rebuilds row layouts while the cursor manager is
            // still traversing them, which can displace or hide the list.
            Cpu saved=*c;c->x[0]=list;c->x[1]=0;memcpy(&c->v[0],&delta,4);
            guest_call(c,0x7000d6e8e0);*c=saved;
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// These category panes belong to nested button layouts, not the screen root.
static uint64_t button_parent_named(uint64_t screen,const char *name) {
    uint64_t head=screen+0x88,link=LD64(head+8);int offset=(int)LD32(screen+0x9c);
    for(unsigned i=0;ptr(link)&&link!=head&&i<256;i++,link=LD64(link+8)) {
        uint64_t node=link-offset,button=LD64(node+0x18);
        uint64_t layout=ptr(button)?LD64(button+0x20):0,parent=ptr(layout)?LD64(layout+0x18):0;
        if(ptr(parent)&&strncmp((char*)(uintptr_t)(parent+0xb8),name,40)==0)return LD64(button+0x60);
    }
    return 0;
}

static bool quest_categories(Cpu *c,uint64_t screen) {
    if(!quest_list(screen)||LD32(screen+0x3a48)!=2)return false;
    uint64_t quest=LD64(screen+0x3bb0),list=ptr(quest)?LD64(quest+0x300):0;
    // The outer list switches categories and creates their nested row lists.
    // It has no row cursor nodes; those belong to the registered child lists.
    if(!native_item_list(list))return false;
    for(unsigned category=0;category<4;category++) {
        char name[40];snprintf(name,sizeof name,"Pa_ChallengeCategory_%02u",category);
        uint64_t pane=button_parent_named(screen,name);float box[4];
        bool valid=ptr(pane)&&options_box(pane,box);
        if(!valid)continue;
        // A category layout is 211 px wide although icons are 58 px apart.
        // Its 32 px cursor pane identifies the actual icon without overlap.
        float x=*(float*)(pane+0x7c),y=*(float*)(pane+0x8c);
        box[0]=x-(category==0?31:25);box[1]=y-25;box[2]=x+(category==0?31:25);box[3]=y+25;
        if(point[0]<box[0]||point[0]>box[2]||point[1]<box[1]||point[1]>box[3])continue;
        set_hover_rect(box);
        pointer_hover_sound(c,screen,screen+0x300+category);
        if(click_pending) {
            click_pending=false;
            pointer_sound(c,screen,"mc_Decide");
            unsigned count=LD32(list+0x288);uint64_t columns=LD64(list+0x290);
            uint64_t column=category<count&&ptr(columns)?LD64(columns+8*category):0;
            // Locked/empty categories retain the game's disabled behavior.
            if(ptr(column)&&LD32(column+0x29c)>0&&!LD8(column+0x38c)&&!LD8(column+0x38d)&&LD32(list+0x2e8)!=category) {
                // Schedule the normal transition; immediate mode rebuilds
                // nested controls while BoxCursorMgr is still using them.
                call(c,0x7000d6c244,list,0,category);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

static uint64_t pane_named(uint64_t pane,const char *name,unsigned depth,unsigned *budget) {
    if(!ptr(pane)||depth>32||!*budget)return 0;
    --*budget;
    if(strncmp((char*)(uintptr_t)(pane+0xb8),name,40)==0)return pane;
    uint64_t head=pane+0x20,link=LD64(head+8);
    while(ptr(link)&&link!=head&&*budget) {
        uint64_t found=pane_named(link-8,name,depth+1,budget);
        if(found)return found;
        link=LD64(link+8);
    }
    return 0;
}

static bool map_sensor_panel(Cpu *c,uint64_t screen) {
    uint64_t panel=call(c,0x7000f6f800,screen,(uintptr_t)"Pa_SensorBox_00",0);
    unsigned budget=512;uint64_t all=pane_named(panel,"N_All_00",0,&budget);
    return ptr(all)&&(LD8(all+0x58)&1)&&LD8(all+0x5a)>0;
}

// DLCWindow scrolls a native page list, rather than BoxCursor rows. The title
// remains loaded underneath it and must not react to the same mouse gesture.
static void dlc_pointer(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t s=dlc_screen;
    extern uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);
    uint64_t frame=renderer_present_count();
    if(!ptr(s)||dlc_frame==frame)return;
    dlc_frame=frame;
    if(pointer_keyboard_input||!position_inside||LD32(s+0x38c0)!=1||
       !(LD16(s+0x2aa)&0x40))return;
    uint64_t list=LD64(s+0x3628);
    if(!ptr(list)||LD64(list)!=0x7001cdbb58ull)return;
    int count=LD32(list+0x2ac),current=LD32(list+0x2dc);
    if(count<1||count>32||current<0||current>=count)return;
    int step=-atomic_exchange(&wheel,0);
    if(frame_press)dlc_drag=0;
    if(gesture_down&&gesture_dragged) {
        dlc_drag+=gesture_delta[1];click_pending=false;
        int pages=(int)(dlc_drag/80);
        if(pages){step+=pages;dlc_drag-=pages*80;}
    }
    uint64_t layout=LD64(s+0x30),root=ptr(layout)?LD64(layout+0x18):0;
    const char *names[]={"Pa_ArrowU_00","Pa_ArrowD_00","Pa_GuideY_00","Pa_GuideB_00"};
    for(unsigned i=0;i<4;i++) {
        if((i==0&&current==0)||(i==1&&current==count-1))continue;
        unsigned budget=2048;uint64_t pane=pane_named(root,names[i],0,&budget);float box[4];
        if(!options_box(pane,box))continue;
        if(i>=2)box[0]=fmaxf(box[0],440);
        box[2]=fminf(box[2],632);
        if(point[0]<box[0]||point[0]>box[2]||point[1]<box[1]||point[1]>box[3])continue;
        set_hover_rect(box);pointer_hover_sound(c,s,pane);
        if(click_pending) {
            click_pending=false;
            if(i<2)step+=i?1:-1;
            else if(i==2) {
                // Queue the request consumed by the native Staff Credits tick.
                ST8(s+0x38c4,1);pointer_sound(c,s,"mc_Decide");
            } else dlc_back_until=plat_now_ns()+50000000;
        }
        break;
    }
    int next=current+step;if(next<0)next=0;if(next>=count)next=count-1;
    if(next!=current)call(c,0x7000d6c54c,list,next,0);
}

static bool pause_headers(Cpu *c,uint64_t screen,uint64_t screens,unsigned count) {
    if(!quest_list(screen)||count<=0x2f)return false;
    // Submenus retain the pause screen underneath them, but own the input.
    for(unsigned i=0x30;i<=0x3a&&i<count;i++) {
        uint64_t modal=LD64(screens+8*i);
        if(ptr(modal)&&LD8(modal+0xfe)==2)return false;
    }
    uint64_t header=LD64(screens+8*0x2f);
    if(!ptr(header)||LD8(header+0xfe)!=2)return false;
    unsigned current=LD32(screen+0x3a48);
    if(current>2||LD32(screen+0x3a4c)!=current)return false;
    for(unsigned side=0;side<2;side++) {
        float half=current==0?(side?40.f:70.f):46.f;
        float center=side?150.f:-150.f;
        float dy=output_pause_extra_y();
        float box[4]={center-half,272+dy,center+half,327+dy};
        // Both animated text copies share one fixed hit area with the key
        // hint above them. Never let hover geometry follow their animation.
        if(point[0]<box[0]||point[0]>box[2]||point[1]<box[1]||point[1]>box[3])continue;
        int next=side?(current==0?1:current==2?0:-1):(current==0?2:current==1?0:-1);
        if(next<0)return false;
        set_hover_rect(box);
        pointer_hover_sound(c,screen,screen+0x100+side);
        if(click_pending) {
            click_pending=false;
            pointer_sound(c,screen,"mc_Decide");
            ST32(screen+0x3a4c,next);
            // The normal page-change state performs exit/enter and animation.
            call(c,0x7001403a88,screen+0x178,0x7001e2f4a8ull,0);
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// The button prompts along the bottom of the pause menu (Sort, Select, Back, Rotate...) and the one beside Link's
// preview. Clicking one presses its button, so actions whose keyboard binding is a mouse button the pointer keeps for
// itself (Sort is left click by default) stay reachable (#346). Each prompt is a T_Icon_00 glyph (U+E040.. A B X Y,
// runtime/nvn/glyphs.c) beside its T_Guide_00 label; hidden slots fade their N_InOut_00 group out.
static int guide_button(uint16_t glyph) {
    switch(glyph) {
    case 0xE040: case 0xE041: case 0xE042: case 0xE043: return glyph-0xE040;  // A B X Y
    case 0xE044: return 6;  case 0xE045: return 7;   // L R
    case 0xE046: return 8;  case 0xE047: return 9;   // ZL ZR
    case 0xE04B: return 10; case 0xE04C: return 11;  // Plus Minus
    case 0xE056: return 4;  case 0xE057: return 5;   // stick presses
    default: return -1;
    }
}
static bool pane_shown(uint64_t pane) {
    return ptr(pane)&&(LD8(pane+0x58)&1)&&LD8(pane+0x5a)>=0x80;  // visible, global alpha at least half
}
static bool guide_hit(Cpu *c,uint64_t info,unsigned i,const char *slot,uint64_t icon,uint64_t label,uint64_t area,float dy);
static bool pause_guides(Cpu *c,uint64_t screen,uint64_t screens,unsigned count) {
    if(!ptr(screen)||LD64(screen)!=0x7001cf9ad8ull||LD8(screen+0xfe)!=2||count<=0x2f)return false;
    for(unsigned i=0x30;i<=0x3a&&i<count;i++) {
        uint64_t modal=LD64(screens+8*i);
        if(ptr(modal)&&LD8(modal+0xfe)==2)return false;
    }
    uint64_t info=LD64(screens+8*0x2f),name=ptr(info)?LD64(info+0xd0):0;
    if(!ptr(info)||LD8(info+0xfe)!=2||!ptr(name)||strncmp((char*)(uintptr_t)name,"PauseMenuInfo_00",17))return false;
    static const char *const slots[]={"Pa_RotateGuide_00","Pa_Guide_00","Pa_Guide_01","Pa_Guide_02","Pa_Guide_03","Pa_Guide_04"};
    for(unsigned i=0;i<sizeof slots/sizeof*slots;i++) {
        uint64_t slot=call(c,0x7000f6f800,info,(uintptr_t)slots[i],0);
        unsigned budget=8;uint64_t group=pane_named(slot,"N_InOut_00",0,&budget);
        budget=8;uint64_t icon=pane_named(group,"T_Icon_00",0,&budget);
        budget=8;uint64_t label=pane_named(group,"T_Guide_00",0,&budget);
        if(i==0){rotate_info=info;rotate_group=group;}
        if(!pane_shown(slot)||!pane_shown(group))continue;
        float box[4],dy=0;
        if(options_box(icon,box))dy=hud_pause_anchor((box[1]+box[3])*.5f,360)*output_pause_extra_y();
        if(guide_hit(c,info,i,slots[i],icon,label,0,dy))return true;
    }
    return false;
}
// The map's prompt bar (Sheikah Sensor, Hero's Path, Zoom...) belongs to the slate frame AppHome_00 (#451). Its
// prompts are drawn through a capture texture: the glyph sits in N_CaptureText_00 in local coordinates, and the
// P_Text_00 picture in N_InOut_00 shows it on screen.
static bool map_guides(Cpu *c,uint64_t screens) {
    uint64_t home=LD64(screens+8*0x2c),name=ptr(home)?LD64(home+0xd0):0;
    if(!ptr(home)||LD8(home+0xfe)!=2||!ptr(name)||strncmp((char*)(uintptr_t)name,"AppHome_00",11))return false;
    uint64_t root=call(c,0x7000f6f800,home,(uintptr_t)"RootPane",0);
    static const char *const slots[]={"Pa_Guide_00","Pa_Guide_01","Pa_Guide_02","Pa_Guide_03","Pa_Guide_04","Pa_Guide_05"};
    for(unsigned i=0;i<sizeof slots/sizeof*slots;i++) {
        unsigned budget=256;uint64_t slot=pane_named(root,slots[i],0,&budget);
        budget=8;uint64_t group=pane_named(slot,"N_InOut_00",0,&budget);
        budget=8;uint64_t picture=pane_named(group,"P_Text_00",0,&budget);
        budget=8;uint64_t capture=pane_named(slot,"N_CaptureText_00",0,&budget);
        budget=8;uint64_t icon=pane_named(capture,"T_Icon_00",0,&budget);
        if(!pane_shown(slot)||!pane_shown(group)||!pane_shown(picture))continue;
        if(guide_hit(c,home,i,slots[i],icon,0,picture,-output_map_extra_y()))return true;
    }
    return false;
}
// One prompt: its glyph names the button; the box is the glyph with its label, or the picture that shows both.
static bool guide_hit(Cpu *c,uint64_t info,unsigned i,const char *slot,uint64_t icon,uint64_t label,uint64_t area,float dy) {
    if(!pane_shown(icon))return false;
    uint64_t glyphs=LD64(icon+0xe0);
    int button=ptr(glyphs)?guide_button(LD16(glyphs)):-1;
    float box[4],text[4];
    if(button<0||!options_box(area?area:icon,box))return false;
    if(pane_shown(label)&&options_box(label,text)) {
        box[0]=fminf(box[0],text[0]);box[1]=fminf(box[1],text[1]);
        box[2]=fmaxf(box[2],text[2]);box[3]=fmaxf(box[3],text[3]);
    }
    box[1]+=dy-4;box[3]+=dy+4;
    if(point[0]<box[0]||point[0]>box[2]||point[1]<box[1]||point[1]>box[3])return false;
    set_hover_rect(box);
    pointer_hover_sound(c,info,info+0x400+i);
    if(click_pending) {
        // The game plays the action's own sound: no extra cue here.
        click_pending=false;
        guide_bit=(unsigned)button;guide_until=plat_now_ns()+80000000;
        if(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PC_CURSOR_LOG"))LOG("[pc-guide] %s button %d\n",slot,button);
    }
    return true;
}

// Other menus enter a button once per hover, rather than replaying its focus
// callback whenever the screen rebuilds a transient cursor field.
static bool hover_enter(Cpu *c,uint64_t control,uint64_t screen,uint64_t node,uint64_t activate) {
    if(hover_control==control&&hover_screen==screen&&hover_node==node)return false;
    hover_control=control;hover_screen=screen;hover_node=node;
    if(LD64(control+0x48)==node)return false;
    call(c,activate,control,node,0);ST8(screen+0x106,1);
    return true;
}

static bool dialogue_choices(Cpu *c,uint64_t screens,unsigned count) {
    if(!dialogue_active)return false;
    uint64_t s=0;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<count&&i<256;i++) {
        uint64_t candidate=LD64(screens+8*i);
        if(ptr(candidate)&&LD64(candidate)==0x7001d4ed48ull&&LD8(candidate+0xfe)==2){s=candidate;break;}
    }
    if(!s)return false;
    uint64_t head=s+0x88,link=LD64(head+8);int offset=(int)LD32(s+0x9c);
    for(unsigned i=0;ptr(link)&&link!=head&&i<8;i++,link=LD64(link+8)) {
        uint64_t node=link-offset,vt=LD64(node),button=LD64(node+0x18);
        uint64_t pane=ptr(button)?LD64(button+0x60):0;float box[4];
        if(!ptr(vt)||!options_box(pane,box)||box[0]<840||box[0]>1265||box[1]<-320||box[3]>320)continue;
        // The two manager channels run separately. Text advance must never
        // confirm a response merely because its channel has not run yet.
        if((call(c,LD64(vt+0x28),node,0,0)|call(c,LD64(vt+0x28),node,1,0))&1)return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// Wheel navigation on the selling category strip skips empty/unavailable
// columns, using the same native transition as a direct category click.
static void shop_category_scroll(Cpu *c,uint64_t list,uint64_t array,unsigned columns,int scroll) {
    int current=(int)LD32(list+0x2e8),step=scroll>0?-1:1;
    if(!scroll||current<0||current>=(int)columns)return;
    for(int next=current+step;next>=0&&next<(int)columns;next+=step) {
        uint64_t column=LD64(array+8*next);
        if(!ptr(column)||!LD32(column+0x29c)||LD8(column+0x38c)||LD8(column+0x38d))continue;
        call(c,0x7000d6c244,list,0,next);
        return;
    }
}

// The list page index is global across all columns (including unavailable
// categories), while each column stores its own page count.
static void shop_page_scroll(Cpu *c,uint64_t list,uint64_t array,unsigned columns,int scroll) {
    unsigned col=LD32(list+0x2e8);
    if(!scroll||col>=columns)return;
    unsigned first=0;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<col;i++) {
        uint64_t column=LD64(array+8*i);
        unsigned pages=ptr(column)?LD32(column+0x2f4):0;
        if(pages>1000||first+pages>1000)return;
        first+=pages;
    }
    uint64_t column=LD64(array+8*col);
    unsigned pages=ptr(column)?LD32(column+0x2f4):0;
    int current=(int)LD32(list+0x2dc),next=current+(scroll>0?-1:1);
    if(!pages||pages>1000||current<(int)first||current>=(int)(first+pages))return;
    if(next>=(int)first&&next<(int)(first+pages))call(c,0x7000d6c54c,list,next,0);
    else shop_category_scroll(c,list,array,columns,scroll);
}

static bool shop_pointer(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t s=shop_screen;
    if(!ptr(s)||pointer_keyboard_input)return false;
    uint64_t lists=LD64(s+0x390),list=ptr(lists)&&LD32(s+0x388)?LD64(lists):0;
    if(!native_item_list(list))return false;
    unsigned columns=LD32(list+0x288);uint64_t array=LD64(list+0x290);
    if(columns>16||!ptr(array))return false;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<7;i++) {
        char name[32];snprintf(name,sizeof name,"Pa_CategoryS_%02u",i);
        uint64_t pane=call(c,0x7000f6f800,s,(uintptr_t)name,0);float box[4];
        if(!options_box(pane,box))continue;
        float x=*(float*)(pane+0x7c),y=*(float*)(pane+0x8c);
        if(fabsf(point[0]-x)>28||fabsf(point[1]-y)>28)continue;
        set_hover(x,y,27);
        int scroll=atomic_exchange(&wheel,0);
        if(scroll) {
            shop_category_scroll(c,list,array,columns,scroll);
            return true;
        }
        if(click_pending) {
            click_pending=false;
            uint64_t column=i<columns?LD64(array+8*i):0;
            if(ptr(column)&&LD32(column+0x29c)&&!LD8(column+0x38c)&&!LD8(column+0x38d))
                call(c,0x7000d6c244,list,0,i);
        }
        return true;
    }
    int scroll=atomic_exchange(&wheel,0);
    if(scroll)shop_page_scroll(c,list,array,columns,scroll);
    return false;
}

static float dialogue_extra_y(void) {
#ifdef __APPLE__
    return 0;
#else
    float shape=output_view_shape();
    return g_settings.hud_edges&&shape>0&&shape<1?360*(1/shape-1):0;
#endif
}

static bool quantity_pointer(Cpu *c,uint64_t screens,unsigned count) {
    if(!dialogue_active)return false;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<count&&i<256;i++) {
        uint64_t screen=LD64(screens+8*i);
        if(!ptr(screen)||LD64(screen)!=0x7001d4ed48ull||LD8(screen+0xfe)!=2)continue;
        int max=(int)LD32(screen+0x750),value=(int)LD32(screen+0x754);
        if(max<1||max>999999||value<1||value>max||!ptr(LD64(screen+0x650)))continue;
        uint64_t pane=LD64(screen+0x650);float cx=*(float*)(pane+0x7c),cy=*(float*)(pane+0x8c);
        if(!isfinite(cx)||!isfinite(cy)||fabsf(cx)>640||fabsf(cy)>360)continue;
        if(quantity_screen!=screen||(plat_now_ns()>quantity_until&&!quantity_hold)){quantity_edit=false;quantity_request=-1;quantity_hold=0;}
        quantity_screen=screen;quantity_max=max;quantity_value=value;quantity_until=plat_now_ns()+100000000;
        // 640/648 are animation controllers, not panes. Resolve the real
        // arrow panes alongside T_Num_00 and hit-test their rendered locations.
        uint64_t root=LD64(pane+0x18);unsigned budget=80;
        uint64_t left=pane_named(root,"Pa_ArrowL_00",0,&budget);budget=80;
        uint64_t right=pane_named(root,"Pa_ArrowR_00",0,&budget);
        bool row=fabsf(point[1]-(cy-dialogue_extra_y()))<=22;
        bool dec=ptr(left)&&row&&fabsf(point[0]-*(float*)(left+0x7c))<=18;
        bool inc=ptr(right)&&row&&fabsf(point[0]-*(float*)(right+0x7c))<=18;
        bool number=row&&fabsf(point[0]-cx)<=28,over=dec||inc||number;
        // Feedback belongs to the original arrow panes. Keep their disabled
        // animation at the limits; hover scales only an available arrow.
        bool mouse=!pointer_keyboard_input;
        if(ptr(left)) {
            float scale=mouse&&dec&&value>1?(quantity_hold<0?1.12f:1.20f):1.f;
            *(float*)(left+0x48)=*(float*)(left+0x4c)=scale;
        }
        if(ptr(right)) {
            float scale=mouse&&inc&&value<max?(quantity_hold>0?1.12f:1.20f):1.f;
            *(float*)(right+0x48)=*(float*)(right+0x4c)=scale;
        }
        if(mouse) {
            if(dec&&value>1)pointer_hover_sound(c,screen,left);
            else if(inc&&value<max)pointer_hover_sound(c,screen,right);
            else if(number)pointer_hover_sound(c,screen,pane);
        }
        int request=atomic_exchange(&quantity_request,-1);
        uint64_t now=plat_now_ns();
        if(frame_press&&(dec||inc)&&!quantity_hold) {
            quantity_hold=inc?1:-1;quantity_repeat_at=now+350000000;
            request=value+quantity_hold;quantity_edit=false;click_pending=false;
        }
        if(quantity_hold) {
            if(!gesture_down||frame_release||pointer_keyboard_input) {
                quantity_hold=0;click_pending=false;
            } else if(now>=quantity_repeat_at) {
                request=value+quantity_hold;quantity_repeat_at=now+70000000;
            }
        }
        if(over&&click_pending) {
            click_pending=false;hover_until=0;
            if(dec){request=value-1;quantity_edit=false;}
            else if(inc){request=value+1;quantity_edit=false;}
            else {
                quantity_edit=true;quantity_replace=true;
                pointer_sound(c,screen,"mc_Decide");
            }
        } else if(click_pending)quantity_edit=false;
        if(request>=0) {
            if(request<1)request=1;if(request>max)request=max;
            ST32(screen+0x754,request);quantity_value=request;
            call(c,0x70013f59f8,screen,0,0);
            if(request!=value)pointer_sound(c,screen,"mc_CursorMove");
        }
        // Render editing feedback with the game's TextBox and font. No host
        // overlay: hover tints the number; editing adds a blinking text caret.
        if(LD64(pane)==0x7001d0e878ull) {
            uint32_t color=quantity_edit?0xff8ce8ffu:number?0xffffe0a0u:0xffffffffu;
            ST32(pane+0xf0,color);ST32(pane+0xf4,color);
            char digits[24];snprintf(digits,sizeof digits,"%d%s",(int)quantity_value,
                quantity_edit&&(now/500000000)%2==0?"|":"");
            uint16_t text[24];unsigned len=0;
            while(digits[len]&&len<23){text[len]=(unsigned char)digits[len];len++;}text[len]=0;
            call(c,LD64(LD64(pane)+0x140),pane,(uintptr_t)text,len);
        }
        return over||quantity_edit||quantity_hold;
    }
    return false;
}

void rt_pc_cursor_manager(Cpu *c, uint64_t activate, uint64_t bounds) {
    // Restore only our one-call confirm pulse. Some screens retain the last action while input is idle.
    if(injected_manager) {
        if(ptr(injected_manager)&&LD32(injected_manager+0x10)==1)ST32(injected_manager+0x10,saved_action);
        injected_manager=0;
    }
    if (!pc_cursor_active()) return;
    sample_pointer();
    if(dlc_screen){dlc_pointer(c);return;}
    if(beast_pointer(c))return;
    if (!quick_wheel_only && !pointer_test() && !position_inside) {
        float keys[2];extern void input_pc_map_axes(float out[2]);input_pc_map_axes(keys);
        if(keys[0]==0&&keys[1]==0)return;
    }
    uint64_t manager=c->x[0];unsigned target=(unsigned)c->x[1];
    if(target>1)return;
    uint64_t control=LD64(manager+0x18+8*target);
    uint64_t screen_mgr=LD64(g_site.screen_mgr);
    if(!ptr(control)||!ptr(screen_mgr))return;
    uint64_t screens=LD64(screen_mgr+0x30),n=LD32(screen_mgr+0x28);
    if(n>0x2d&&ptr(screens))special_diagnostics(c,screens);
    if(!game_over_screen) {
        if(n>0x34&&ptr(screens)&&options_pointer(c,screens,bounds)){hover_leave();return;}
        if(n>0x39&&ptr(screens)&&native_special(c,screens,bounds)){hover_leave();return;}
        if(quantity_pointer(c,screens,n))return;
    }
    if(pointer_keyboard_input){hover_leave();hover_until=0;return;}
    if(!click_pending&&!pointer_test()&&!motion_at)return;
    if(!game_over_screen&&n>0x2e&&ptr(screens)) {
        uint64_t screen=LD64(screens+8*0x2e);
        if(ptr(screen)&&hover_target(c,screen,target)&&
           (quest_scroll(c,screen)||pause_headers(c,screen,screens,n)||pause_guides(c,screen,screens,n)||quest_categories(c,screen))){hover_leave();return;}
    }
    uint64_t hit=0,hit_screen=0;float best=1e30f;bool choices=dialogue_choices(c,screens,n);
    if(shop_screen&&!choices&&shop_pointer(c))return;
    extern uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);
    static bool dumped_screens[256];
    for(unsigned id=0;id<n&&id<256&&ptr(screens);id++) {
        uint64_t screen=LD64(screens+8*id);
        if(!ptr(screen)||LD8(screen+0xfe)!=2)continue;
        if(game_over_screen&&screen!=game_over_screen)continue;
        if(dialogue_active&&choices&&LD64(screen)!=0x7001d4ed48ull)continue;
        if(shop_screen&&!choices&&screen!=shop_screen)continue;
        if(dialogue_active&&!shop_screen&&LD64(screen)!=0x7001d4ed48ull)continue;
        if(!hover_target(c,screen,target))continue;
        bool dump=getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PC_DUMP_UI")&&!dumped_screens[id]&&renderer_present_count()>300;
        uint64_t link_offset=(int32_t)LD32(screen+0x9c);
        uint64_t head=screen+0x88,link=LD64(head+8);
        for(unsigned i=0;link!=head&&ptr(link)&&i<256;i++) {
            uint64_t node=link-link_offset;
            if(!ptr(node))break;
            uint64_t button=LD64(node+0x18),vtable=LD64(node);
            if(!ptr(button)||!ptr(vtable))break;
            {
                uint64_t pane=LD64(button+0x60);
                if(ptr(pane)) {
                    float box[4];
                    call(c,bounds,(uintptr_t)box,pane,0);
                    float dy=hud_pause_anchor((box[1]+box[3])*.5f,360)*output_pause_extra_y();
                    box[1]+=dy;box[3]+=dy;
                    if(dialogue_active&&LD64(screen)==0x7001d4ed48ull) {
                        // Choice arrows use left-origin X, center-origin Y.
                        float shift=dialogue_extra_y();box[1]-=shift;box[3]-=shift;
                        box[0]-=640;box[2]-=640;box[2]=fminf(625,box[0]+255);
                    }
                    // The native "clip" callback clears the active cursor for
                    // an offscreen row. Calling it while scanning every node
                    // repeatedly cancels real focus. Clip without side effects.
                    if(LD64(screen)==0x7001cf9ad8ull&&LD32(screen+0x368c)) {
                        box[0]=fmaxf(box[0],*(float*)(screen+0x367c));
                        box[1]=fmaxf(box[1],*(float*)(screen+0x3680));
                        box[2]=fminf(box[2],*(float*)(screen+0x3684));
                        box[3]=fminf(box[3],*(float*)(screen+0x3688));
                    }
                    if(dump)LOG("[pc-node] screen %x node %llx button %llx rect %.1f %.1f %.1f %.1f\n",id,node,button,box[0],box[1],box[2],box[3]);
                    uint64_t layout=LD64(button+0x20),parent=ptr(layout)?LD64(layout+0x18):0;
                    if(dump&&ptr(layout)) {
                        LOG("[pc-layout] %llx fields %llx %llx %llx %llx\n",layout,LD64(layout+8),LD64(layout+0x10),parent,LD64(layout+0x20));
                        if(ptr(parent)) LOG("[pc-parent] name %.24s pos %.1f %.1f size %.1f %.1f\n",(char*)(parent+0xb8),*(float*)(parent+0x7c),*(float*)(parent+0x8c),*(float*)(parent+0x50),*(float*)(parent+0x54));
                    }
                    // Title buttons use a 20x20 arrow as cursor geometry. The text occupies the rest of its row.
                    if(id==1 && box[2]-box[0]<32 && ptr(parent)) {
                        float x=*(float*)(parent+0x7c),y=*(float*)(parent+0x8c);
                        box[0]=x-25;box[2]=640;box[1]=y-18;box[3]=y+18;
                    }
                    bool eligible=(call(c,LD64(vtable+0x28),node,target,0)&1)!=0;
                    if(dialogue_active&&LD64(screen)==0x7001d4ed48ull&&eligible&&box[0]>200&&box[0]<625&&box[1]>-320&&box[3]<320)choices=true;
                    if(isfinite(box[0])&&isfinite(box[1])&&isfinite(box[2])&&isfinite(box[3])&&
                        point[0]>=box[0]&&point[0]<=box[2]&&point[1]>=box[1]&&point[1]<=box[3]&&
                        eligible) {
                        float dx=point[0]-(box[0]+box[2])*.5f,dy=point[1]-(box[1]+box[3])*.5f;
                        float score=dx*dx+dy*dy;
                        if(score<best){best=score;hit=node;hit_screen=screen;}
                    }
                }
            }
            link=LD64(link+8);
        }
        if(dump)dumped_screens[id]=true;
    }
    if(!hit){
        if(dialogue_active&&!choices&&click_pending){confirm_until=plat_now_ns()+50000000;click_pending=false;}
        if(hover_control==control)hover_leave();return;
    }
    // The PC hover is drawn this frame; the game's own highlight may still be playing its transition.
    if(hit&&best<1e29f) {
        uint64_t button=LD64(hit+0x18),pane=LD64(button+0x60);
        if(ptr(pane)&&*(float*)(pane+0x50)>40&&*(float*)(pane+0x50)<150)
            set_hover(*(float*)(pane+0x7c),*(float*)(pane+0x8c),*(float*)(pane+0x50)*.5f);
    }
    bool quest=quest_focus(c,hit_screen,hit);
    if(quest&&LD64(control+0x48)!=hit)call(c,activate,control,hit,0);
    if(!quest&&hover_enter(c,control,hit_screen,hit,activate)) {
        if(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PC_CURSOR_LOG"))LOG("[pc-hover] node %llx point %.1f %.1f\n",hit,point[0],point[1]);
    }
    if(click_pending) {
        // A list may have rebuilt the manager cursor after hover entered.
        // Confirmation must still target the row under the pointer.
        if(LD64(control+0x48)!=hit)call(c,activate,control,hit,0);
        injected_manager=manager;saved_action=LD32(manager+0x10);
        ST32(manager+0x10,1); // The exact action used by the game's confirm button, processed by its own code next.
        click_pending=false;
        if(getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PC_CURSOR_LOG"))LOG("[pc-click] confirm node %llx\n",hit);
    }
}
```

`runtime/pc_cursor_math.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <math.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <float.h>
// The native map leaves one vertical pan bound at FLT_MAX: controller cursor
// navigation normally constrains it elsewhere. Direct pan must close that end
// using the opposite, zoom-dependent extent without changing finite bounds.
static inline float pc_map_clamp_center(float value,float lower,float upper) {
    bool lo=isfinite(lower)&&fabsf(lower)<FLT_MAX*.5f;
    bool hi=isfinite(upper)&&fabsf(upper)<FLT_MAX*.5f;
    if(!lo)lower=hi?-upper:0;
    if(!hi)upper=lo?-lower:0;
    if(lower>upper){float mid=(lower+upper)*.5f;lower=upper=mid;}
    if(!isfinite(value))value=0;
    return fmaxf(lower,fminf(upper,value));
}
// SDL window size and mouse position use the same logical coordinate system, including on a high-DPI display.
// BOTW's menu layouts use 1280x720. The presented pause/title image is fitted to the window, with bars if needed.
static inline float pc_cursor_layout_scale(float width,float height,float extra_y) {
    return fminf(width/1280.0f,height/(720.0f+2*extra_y));
}
static inline bool pc_cursor_to_layout(float width,float height,float x,float y,float extra_y,float out[2]) {
    if(width<=0||height<=0)return false;
    float scale=pc_cursor_layout_scale(width,height,extra_y);
    out[0]=(x-width*.5f)/scale;
    out[1]=(height*.5f-y)/scale;
    return fabsf(out[0])<=640&&fabsf(out[1])<=360+extra_y;
}
// The map matrix translation is already zoomed. Invert translation BEFORE dividing by scale.
static inline void pc_cursor_map_world(const float point[2],const float translation[2],float zoom,float out[2]) {
    out[0]=(point[0]-translation[0])/zoom;
    out[1]=(point[1]-translation[1])/zoom;
}
// The view centre that keeps `world` under `point` at `zoom` (translation = centre * zoom, so screen = (world + centre) * zoom).
static inline void pc_map_anchor_center(const float point[2],const float world[2],float zoom,float out[2]) {
    out[0]=point[0]/zoom-world[0];
    out[1]=point[1]/zoom-world[1];
}

// Navigation direction, not drag direction: looking right moves the map image left.
// Edge zones belong to the map canvas, below the top tabs and above the footer.
static inline void pc_map_navigation(const float point[2],float x,float y,bool edges,float dt,float zoom,float extra_y,float out[2]) {
    if(edges&&fabsf(point[0])<=640&&fabsf(point[1])<=285+extra_y&&x==0&&y==0) {
        float ex=fmaxf(0,fminf(1,(fabsf(point[0])-600)/32));
        float ey=fmaxf(0,fminf(1,(fabsf(point[1])-250-extra_y)/30));
        x=copysignf(ex*ex,point[0]);y=copysignf(ey*ey,point[1]);
    }
    float n=hypotf(x,y);if(n>1){x/=n;y/=n;}
    dt=fmaxf(0,fminf(.05f,dt));
    float speed=isfinite(zoom)&&zoom>0?360*dt/zoom:0;
    out[0]=-x*speed;out[1]=-y*speed;
}
```

`runtime/pc_gyro.h`:

```h
// The virtual gyro's keyboard turn and delivery (runtime/hle/motion.c). A gyro key turns the virtual controller while
// it is held; letting go stops the turn and keeps the pose.
#pragma once
#include <math.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

typedef struct {
    double pitch, roll, yaw;  // continuous degrees: wrapped, a sensitivity other than 1 would jump at every turn
    bool active;              // a gyro key, the drag or the sticks moved it since the last recenter
} PcGyro;

// The keys held (-1 / 0 / 1 per axis) over dt seconds: 90 degrees per second
static inline void pc_gyro_step(PcGyro *g, int pitch, int roll, int yaw, double dt) {
    if (pitch || roll || yaw) g->active = true;
    if (!isfinite(dt) || dt <= 0) return;
    if (dt > 0.25) dt = 0.25;  // (a stalled window must not make a large turn)
    g->pitch += pitch * 90 * dt;
    g->roll += roll * 90 * dt;
    g->yaw += yaw * 90 * dt;
}

// Move `current` toward `target` (radians) over one sample of dt seconds, at most 1440 degrees per second across the
// three axes: a fast mouse move or a recenter can ask for several turns at once; they are made, in their direction,
// instead of being wrapped away or handed to the game as one impossible jump.
static inline void pc_gyro_follow(double current[3], const double target[3], double dt) {
    double delta[3], distance = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        delta[i] = target[i] - current[i];
        distance += fabs(delta[i]);
    }
    double budget = 8 * 3.14159265358979323846 * dt;
    double f = distance > budget ? budget / distance : 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) current[i] += delta[i] * f;
}
```

`runtime/pc_gyro_scene.c`:

```c
// The shrine apparatus (BOTW 1.9.0): whether the player is controlling one of the motion-controlled mechanisms
// (DungeonRotateGyro). The game code calls rt_gyro_scene_actor each frame the mechanism reads its input (the
// gyro_scene_actor site, tools/patches.py); pc_gyro_scene_tick turns that heartbeat into "in the apparatus" for the
// virtual gyro: its keys (runtime/hle/input.c), the drag (runtime/ui/gyro_drag.h) and a gyroscope-less controller's
// sticks. Guest memory is read on the game thread only. The drag uses the click point, not the model's place on screen.
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "game_sites.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "motion.h"
#include "pc_gyro_scene.h"
#include "settings.h"

static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static GyroScene scene;           // (the render thread's copy, under lock)
static _Atomic bool active;       // in the apparatus with the mouse drag on (Controls: Shrine mouse drag)
static _Atomic bool apparatus;    // in the apparatus, not paused
static bool interaction;          // in the apparatus, paused or not (game thread)
static uint64_t last_actor_ns;    // the mechanism's last heartbeat (game thread)
static bool paused_before;

static bool enabled(void) { return g_game_version && !strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0"); }
static bool ptr(uint64_t p) { return p >= GUEST_LO && p < GUEST_HI - 0x1000; }

bool pc_gyro_scene_active(void) { return active; }
bool pc_gyro_keyboard_active(void) { return apparatus; }
bool pc_gyro_scene_view(GyroScene *out) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    *out = scene;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return out->active;
}

// Game thread, once a frame (runtime/hle/input.c input_cam_frame). The heartbeat stops while the game is paused: the
// interaction holds through the pause and its clock starts again after it. 0x7001e14d18 (1.9.0) holds the mechanism
// manager while a shrine with one is loaded.
void pc_gyro_scene_tick(void) {
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    bool paused = g_site.pause_state && LD32(g_site.pause_state);
    if (interaction && paused_before && !paused) last_actor_ns = now;
    paused_before = paused;
    bool recent = last_actor_ns && now >= last_actor_ns && now - last_actor_ns < 150000000ull;
    bool on = enabled() && g_site.main_end > 0x7001e14d20ull && ptr(LD64(0x7001e14d18ull)) &&
              (recent || (interaction && paused));
    bool show = on && !paused, drag = show && g_settings.gyro_scene;
    if (interaction && !on) motion_virtual_end();
    if (on != interaction || active != drag) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
        scene.generation++;  // (a drag in progress ends)
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    }
    if (on != interaction) LOG("[gyro-scene] interaction %s\n", on ? "enter" : "leave");
    interaction = on;
    apparatus = show;
    active = drag;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    scene.active = drag;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}

// The gyro_scene_actor site: the mechanism (actor) asked for its input (control) this frame
void rt_gyro_scene_actor(Cpu *c, uint64_t actor, uint64_t control) {
    (void)c;
    if (enabled() && ptr(actor) && ptr(control)) last_actor_ns = plat_now_ns();
}

RT_ON_RESET(gyro_scene_reset) {
    active = apparatus = interaction = false;
    last_actor_ns = 0;
    paused_before = false;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    memset(&scene, 0, sizeof scene);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
```

`runtime/perfcount.h`:

```h
// (profiling) Cumulative event counters for the benchmark (tools/perf_routes.py, docs/PERF-ROUTES.md): the `frametrace`
// control command takes their difference at every presented frame, `memstats` reads the texture memory ones. Each is
// one relaxed atomic add at an event that costs far more itself (a pipeline build, an upload, an ASTC decode, a file
// read), always on: no clock is read for them unless the event already timed itself. Defined in runtime/control_prof.c.
#pragma once
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>

enum {
    PC_BUILDS,         // shader translations, programs, graphics and compute pipelines built (any thread)
    PC_BUILD_NS,       // ... their build time (worker threads included: a worker's build does not stall a frame)
    PC_BUILD_WAITS,    // draws that waited for their pipeline on the render thread (exec.c wait_built)
    PC_BUILD_WAIT_NS,  // ... time waited
    PC_UPLOAD_BYTES,   // staging memory handed out for uploads (textures, buffers, the heap copy: exec.c vk_transient)
    PC_TEX_BYTES,      // guest texture storage read for a full texture upload (textures.c upload_texture)
    PC_ASTC_NS,        // CPU time decoding ASTC to RGBA8 (GPUs without ASTC: textures.c)
    PC_ASTC_BYTES,     // ... RGBA8 bytes made
    PC_GPU_WAIT_NS,    // CPU time waiting for GPU submissions (exec.c vk_wait_seq)
    PC_FILE_READS,     // guest file and RomFS reads (services/fs.c)
    PC_FILE_BYTES,
    PC_FILE_NS,
    PC_VALLOC_NS,      // vkAllocateMemory on the game's threads (vulkan/vram.c)
    PC_PRESENT_NS,     // the back end's present (acquire, blit, present: vulkan/device.c -> exec.c vk_prof_frame)
    PC_COUNT
};
extern _Atomic uint64_t g_perfcount[PC_COUNT];
static inline void perfcount_add(int k, uint64_t v) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_perfcount[k], v, memory_order_relaxed); }

// Texture memory by kind, live bytes (textures.c: added when an image is made, taken off when it is destroyed)
enum { TM_ASTC_NATIVE, TM_ASTC_RGBA8, TM_BC, TM_RT, TM_OTHER, TM_ASTC_SRC, TM_COUNT };  // (TM_ASTC_SRC: the ASTC size of TM_ASTC_RGBA8's images)
extern _Atomic int64_t g_texmem[TM_COUNT], g_texmem_n[TM_COUNT];
static inline void texmem_add(int k, int64_t bytes, int n) {
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_texmem[k], bytes, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_texmem_n[k], n, memory_order_relaxed);
}

// GPU memory heaps, filled by the Vulkan back end (vulkan/vram.c) if there is one: returns the heap count
extern int (*g_gpu_heaps)(uint64_t *usage, uint64_t *budget, uint64_t *size, uint32_t *device_local, int max);
```

`runtime/perfmon.c`:

```c
// Performance overlay numbers (runtime/perfmon.h). Frame times come from the game's presents; the machine's numbers
// are sampled twice a second on a thread of their own (some of the calls take milliseconds), only once the overlay
// asks for them. Libraries that only some machines have are loaded at run time: NVML (NVIDIA's driver library, for
// the GPU), on Windows PDH (the thermal zone counter) and AMD's display library (ADL, for an AMD GPU). A missing one leaves its numbers at -1.
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "perfmon.h"
#include "framepace.h"
#include "game_sites.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "platform.h"
#include "rt.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#define PSAPI_VERSION 2
#include <psapi.h>
#include <pdh.h>
#else
#include <dirent.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
#include <cpuid.h>
#endif

static pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static PerfStats g_stats;
static char g_gpu_hint[96];
#ifdef __linux__
static int g_gpu_drm_major = -1, g_gpu_drm_minor = -1;  // protected by g_lock, like the name
#endif

static void gpu_hint(char out[96]) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    memcpy(out, g_gpu_hint, sizeof g_gpu_hint);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

// PlayerInfo's copy can outlive Link during scene changes. Read it only while playing, on the presenting thread,
// rather than the machine sampler; the heap stays mapped until presents stop for reboot (main.c teardown).
bool perfmon_position(float out[3]) {
    extern volatile int g_movie_playing;  // runtime/hle/movie.c
    if (g_rt_unwind || !g_site.player_info || !g_site.screen_mgr || !g_site.event_mgr || g_movie_playing > 0)
        return false;
    if (framepace_title_ui() || framepace_loading_ui() || framepace_in_event()) return false;
    uint64_t pinfo = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)g_site.player_info;
    uint64_t size = kernel_heap_size();
    if (size < 0x94 || (pinfo & 7) || pinfo < HEAP_BASE || pinfo - HEAP_BASE > size - 0x94) return false;
    float pos[3];
    // Same game-maintained copy as the clock probe (hle/framepace.c), not the actor's writable position.
#define VF(T, base, off) (*(T *)(uintptr_t)((base) + (off)))
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        pos[i] = VF(float, pinfo, 0x88 + 4 * i);
        if (!isfinite(pos[i])) return false;
    }
#undef VF
    memcpy(out, pos, sizeof pos);
    return true;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ frames
static uint64_t g_last_frame_ns;
static float g_ring[PERF_HISTORY];
static uint64_t g_ring_at[PERF_HISTORY];  // when each frame ended
static int g_ring_n, g_ring_pos;

void perfmon_frame(void) {
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (g_last_frame_ns) {
        g_ring[g_ring_pos] = (float)((now - g_last_frame_ns) / 1e6);
        g_ring_at[g_ring_pos] = now;
        g_ring_pos = (g_ring_pos + 1) % PERF_HISTORY;
        if (g_ring_n < PERF_HISTORY) g_ring_n++;
    }
    g_last_frame_ns = now;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

static uint64_t g_gen_at[512];  // when each generated frame was presented (the last 512)
static unsigned g_gen_n;

void perfmon_generated_frame(void) {
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    g_gen_at[g_gen_n++ % 512] = now;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

static void frames_summary(PerfStats *s) {  // (lock held)
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    int gen = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 512 && i < g_gen_n && now - g_gen_at[(g_gen_n - 1 - i) % 512] <= 1000000000ull; i++) gen++;
    s->fps_generated = (float)gen;
    double sum = 0, mx = 0;
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ring_n; i++) {
        int k = (g_ring_pos - 1 - i + PERF_HISTORY) % PERF_HISTORY;
        if (now - g_ring_at[k] > 1000000000ull) break;  // the last second
        sum += g_ring[k];
        if (g_ring[k] > mx) mx = g_ring[k];
        n++;
    }
    s->fps = n && sum > 0 ? (float)(n * 1000.0 / sum) : 0;
    s->frame_ms_avg = n ? (float)(sum / n) : 0;
    s->frame_ms_max = (float)mx;
    for (int i = 0; i < PERF_HISTORY; i++) {  // oldest first; frames not seen yet read 0
        int age = PERF_HISTORY - 1 - i;
        s->frame_ms[i] = age < g_ring_n ? g_ring[(g_ring_pos - 1 - age + 2 * PERF_HISTORY) % PERF_HISTORY] : 0;
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ CPU name
static void cpu_name(char *out, size_t cap) {
    out[0] = 0;
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
    unsigned r[12];
    if (__get_cpuid_max(0x80000000, NULL) >= 0x80000004) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) __get_cpuid(0x80000002 + i, &r[i * 4], &r[i * 4 + 1], &r[i * 4 + 2], &r[i * 4 + 3]);
        char b[49];
        memcpy(b, r, 48);
        b[48] = 0;
        char *p = b;
        while (*p == ' ') p++;
        snprintf(out, cap, "%s", p);
        for (char *e = out + strlen(out); e > out && e[-1] == ' '; e--) e[-1] = 0;
    }
#else
    snprintf(out, cap, "CPU");
#endif
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ NVML (NVIDIA)
typedef struct { unsigned gpu, memory; } NvmlUtil;
typedef struct { unsigned long long total, free, used; } NvmlMem;
static struct {
    bool tried, ok;
    void *dev;
    int (*init)(void);
    int (*count)(unsigned *);
    int (*handle)(unsigned, void **);
    int (*name)(void *, char *, unsigned);
    int (*util)(void *, NvmlUtil *);
    int (*temp)(void *, int, unsigned *);
    int (*mem)(void *, NvmlMem *);
    int (*power)(void *, unsigned *);
    int (*clock)(void *, int, unsigned *);
} nv;

static void *lib_open(const char *name) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    return (void *)LoadLibraryA(name);
#else
    return dlopen(name, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
#endif
}
static void *lib_sym(void *lib, const char *name) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    return (void *)GetProcAddress((HMODULE)lib, name);
#else
    return dlsym(lib, name);
#endif
}

static void nvml_open(PerfStats *s) {
    char hint[96];
    gpu_hint(hint);
    if (!hint[0]) return;  // the launcher can start sampling before Vulkan has selected a device
    nv.tried = true;
#ifdef _WIN32
    void *lib = lib_open("nvml.dll");
    if (!lib) lib = lib_open("C:\\Program Files\\NVIDIA Corporation\\NVSMI\\nvml.dll");
#else
    void *lib = lib_open("libnvidia-ml.so.1");
#endif
    if (!lib) return;
    nv.init = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlInit_v2");
    nv.count = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetCount_v2");
    nv.handle = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex_v2");
    nv.name = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetName");
    nv.util = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates");
    nv.temp = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetTemperature");
    nv.mem = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo");
    nv.power = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetPowerUsage");
    nv.clock = lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetClockInfo");
    if (!nv.init || !nv.count || !nv.handle || nv.init() != 0) return;
    unsigned n = 0;
    if (nv.count(&n) != 0 || !n) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) {  // never substitute a different GPU for the rendering device
        void *d = NULL;
        char nm[96] = "";
        if (nv.handle(i, &d) != 0) continue;
        if (nv.name) nv.name(d, nm, sizeof nm);
        if (nm[0] && strstr(hint, nm)) {
            nv.dev = d;
            snprintf(s->gpu_name, sizeof s->gpu_name, "%s", nm);
            break;
        }
    }
    nv.ok = nv.dev != NULL;
    LOG("[perf] NVML: %s\n", nv.ok ? s->gpu_name : "no device");
}

static void nvml_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    if (!nv.tried) nvml_open(s);
    if (!nv.ok) return;
    gpu_hint(s->gpu_name);
    NvmlUtil u;
    NvmlMem m;
    unsigned v;
    if (nv.util && nv.util(nv.dev, &u) == 0) s->gpu_pct = (float)u.gpu;
    if (nv.temp && nv.temp(nv.dev, 0 /* NVML_TEMPERATURE_GPU */, &v) == 0) s->gpu_temp_c = (float)v;
    if (nv.mem && nv.mem(nv.dev, &m) == 0) s->vram_used_mb = (float)(m.used >> 20), s->vram_total_mb = (float)(m.total >> 20);
    if (nv.power && nv.power(nv.dev, &v) == 0) s->gpu_power_w = v / 1000.0f;
    if (nv.clock && nv.clock(nv.dev, 0 /* NVML_CLOCK_GRAPHICS */, &v) == 0) s->gpu_clock_mhz = (float)v;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ platform: CPU, memory, temperatures
#ifdef _WIN32

// What the OS itself measures, for anything that is not NVIDIA with NVML (above): the GPU Engine and
// GPU Adapter Memory counters cover every adapter — Intel, AMD, NVIDIA without the driver's NVML.
// gpu_pct sums the 3D engine instances (what Task Manager's 3D graph shows); the name is the Vulkan
// device's (perfmon_set_gpu_hint). Fill in what NVML left at -1 only.
#include <pdh.h>
#ifndef PDH_MORE_DATA  // mingw's pdh.h lacks it; PDH returns its own HRESULT, not ERROR_MORE_DATA
#define PDH_MORE_DATA ((PDH_STATUS)0x800007D2)
#endif
static struct { PDH_HQUERY q; PDH_HCOUNTER eng, mem; bool tried, ok, mem_ok; } wp;

static void pdh_open(void) {
    wp.tried = true;
    if (PdhOpenQueryA(NULL, 0, &wp.q) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return;
    if (PdhAddEnglishCounterA(wp.q, "\\GPU Engine(*)\\Utilization Percentage", 0, &wp.eng) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return;
    wp.mem_ok = PdhAddEnglishCounterA(wp.q, "\\GPU Adapter Memory(*)\\Dedicated Usage", 0, &wp.mem) == ERROR_SUCCESS;
    PdhCollectQueryData(wp.q);  // prime: the utilization fractions read from the next sample on
    wp.ok = true;
    LOG("[perf] PDH GPU engine counters (any vendor)\n");
}

// AMD on Windows: AMD's Vulkan driver submits past what the GPU Engine counters above see (they read about 0% at full
// load), and NVML is NVIDIA's only, so an AMD GPU had no load, clock, temperature or power. They come from AMD's own
// display library (atiadlxx.dll, installed with the driver), when it's there: its PM log, the same sensors AMD's own
// overlay reads. Without it an AMD GPU's load shows as unknown, not as 0%.
#define ADL_SENSOR_MAX 256
#define ADL_GFXCLK 1
#define ADL_TEMP_EDGE 8
#define ADL_ACTIVITY_GFX 19
#define ADL_ASIC_POWER 23
#define ADL_BOARD_POWER 73  // (RDNA 4 reports this one and not ASIC power: an RX 9070 XT, 2026-11-07)
typedef struct { int supported, value; } AdlSensor;
typedef struct { int size; AdlSensor sensor[ADL_SENSOR_MAX]; char reserved[4096]; } AdlPmLog;
typedef struct {  // (ADL's AdapterInfo)
    int size, index;
    char udid[256];
    int bus, device, function, vendor;
    char name[256], display[256];
    int present, exist;
    char driver[256], driver_ext[256], pnp[256];
    int os_display;
} AdlAdapter;
static struct {
    bool tried, ok;
    void *ctx;
    int adapter;
    int (*pmlog)(void *, int, AdlPmLog *);
} adl;
static void *__stdcall adl_alloc(int n) { return malloc((size_t)n); }

static void adl_open(void) {
    adl.tried = true;
    void *lib = lib_open("atiadlxx.dll");
    if (!lib) return;
    int (*create)(void *(__stdcall *)(int), int, void **) = lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Main_Control_Create");
    int (*count)(void *, int *) = lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Adapter_NumberOfAdapters_Get");
    int (*info)(void *, AdlAdapter *, int) = lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Adapter_AdapterInfo_Get");
    adl.pmlog = lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_New_QueryPMLogData_Get");
    int n = 0;
    if (!create || !count || !info || !adl.pmlog || create(adl_alloc, 1, &adl.ctx) != 0 || count(adl.ctx, &n) != 0 ||
        n <= 0 || n > 256) {
        LOG("[perf] AMD display library: can't be used\n");
        return;
    }
    AdlAdapter *a = calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *a);
    if (a && info(adl.ctx, a, n * (int)sizeof *a) == 0)
        for (int i = 0; i < n && !adl.ok; i++)  // (the one Vulkan renders on: a CPU's own graphics has a name too)
            if (a[i].present && a[i].vendor == 1002 &&
                (!g_gpu_hint[0] || strstr(g_gpu_hint, a[i].name) || strstr(a[i].name, g_gpu_hint))) {
                adl.adapter = a[i].index;
                adl.ok = true;
                LOG("[perf] AMD display library: %s (adapter %d)\n", a[i].name, a[i].index);
            }
    free(a);
    if (!adl.ok) LOG("[perf] AMD display library: no adapter named \"%s\"\n", g_gpu_hint);
}

static void adl_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    if (!strstr(g_gpu_hint, "AMD") && !strstr(g_gpu_hint, "Radeon")) return;
    s->gpu_pct = -1;  // (see above: PDH's reading is not the GPU's load here)
    if (!adl.tried) adl_open();
    if (!adl.ok) return;
    static AdlPmLog log;
    memset(&log, 0, sizeof log);
    if (adl.pmlog(adl.ctx, adl.adapter, &log) != 0) return;
    const AdlSensor *v = log.sensor;
    if (v[ADL_ACTIVITY_GFX].supported) s->gpu_pct = (float)v[ADL_ACTIVITY_GFX].value;
    if (v[ADL_GFXCLK].supported) s->gpu_clock_mhz = (float)v[ADL_GFXCLK].value;
    if (v[ADL_TEMP_EDGE].supported) s->gpu_temp_c = (float)v[ADL_TEMP_EDGE].value;
    if (v[ADL_ASIC_POWER].supported) s->gpu_power_w = (float)v[ADL_ASIC_POWER].value;
    else if (v[ADL_BOARD_POWER].supported) s->gpu_power_w = (float)v[ADL_BOARD_POWER].value;
    static int shown;
    if (shown++ < 12 && shown % 4 == 0)
        LOG("[perf] AMD sensors: load %d, clock %d, temperature %d, power %.0f W\n", v[ADL_ACTIVITY_GFX].value,
            v[ADL_GFXCLK].value, v[ADL_TEMP_EDGE].value, s->gpu_power_w);
}

static void pdh_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    if (!wp.tried) pdh_open();
    if (!wp.ok || nv.ok) return;  // NVML above is the richer source when it is there
    if (g_gpu_hint[0] && s->gpu_name[0] == 0) snprintf(s->gpu_name, sizeof s->gpu_name, "%s", g_gpu_hint);
    PDH_STATUS cst = PdhCollectQueryData(wp.q);
    static bool diag;
    if (!diag && cst != ERROR_SUCCESS) { diag = true; LOG("[perf] PDH collect failed: %lx\n", (unsigned long)cst); }
    if (cst != ERROR_SUCCESS) return;
    DWORD need = 0, n = 0;
    PDH_STATUS ast = PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayA(wp.eng, PDH_FMT_DOUBLE, &need, &n, NULL);
    if (ast != PDH_MORE_DATA) {
        if (!diag) { diag = true; LOG("[perf] PDH engine array probe: %lx\n", (unsigned long)ast); }
        return;
    }
    PDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_A *items = malloc(need);
    bool got = items && PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayA(wp.eng, PDH_FMT_DOUBLE, &need, &n, items) == ERROR_SUCCESS;
    if (!got) {
        if (!diag) { diag = true; LOG("[perf] PDH engine array failed: %lx\n", (unsigned long)ast); }
        free(items);
        return;
    }
    double sum = 0;
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (strstr(items[i].szName, "engtype_3D")) sum += items[i].FmtValue.doubleValue;
    if (!diag) {  // one diagnostic line: how many engine instances, and what they look like
        diag = true;
        LOG("[perf] PDH %lu engine instances; e.g. \"%s\"; 3D sum %.1f\n", (unsigned long)n,
            n ? items[0].szName : "(none)", sum);
    }
    s->gpu_pct = (float)(sum > 100 ? 100 : sum);
    free(items);
    if (wp.mem_ok) {
        need = n = 0;
        if (PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayA(wp.mem, PDH_FMT_LARGE, &need, &n, NULL) == PDH_MORE_DATA) {
            PDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_A *items = malloc(need);
            if (items && PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayA(wp.mem, PDH_FMT_LARGE, &need, &n, items) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
                long long bytes = 0;
                for (DWORD i = 0; i < n; i++) bytes += items[i].FmtValue.largeValue;
                s->vram_used_mb = (float)(bytes >> 20);
            }
            free(items);
        }
    }
}

static uint64_t ft64(FILETIME f) { return (uint64_t)f.dwHighDateTime << 32 | f.dwLowDateTime; }

typedef LONG (WINAPI *PdhOpenQueryW_t)(LPCWSTR, DWORD_PTR, PDH_HQUERY *);
typedef LONG (WINAPI *PdhAddEnglishCounterW_t)(PDH_HQUERY, LPCWSTR, DWORD_PTR, PDH_HCOUNTER *);
typedef LONG (WINAPI *PdhCollectQueryData_t)(PDH_HQUERY);
typedef LONG (WINAPI *PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayW_t)(PDH_HCOUNTER, DWORD, LPDWORD, LPDWORD, PPDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_W);
static struct {
    bool tried, ok;
    PDH_HQUERY q;
    PDH_HCOUNTER c;
    PdhCollectQueryData_t collect;
    PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayW_t get;
} pdh;

// The ACPI thermal zones (no driver needed). They are the firmware's, near the CPU on most boards; an exact CPU
// package temperature on Windows needs a kernel driver (what monitoring tools install), which Savage Wind doesn't.
static float thermal_zone_c(void) {
    if (!pdh.tried) {
        pdh.tried = true;
        HMODULE l = LoadLibraryA("pdh.dll");
        PdhOpenQueryW_t open = l ? (PdhOpenQueryW_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhOpenQueryW") : NULL;
        PdhAddEnglishCounterW_t add = l ? (PdhAddEnglishCounterW_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhAddEnglishCounterW") : NULL;
        pdh.collect = l ? (PdhCollectQueryData_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhCollectQueryData") : NULL;
        pdh.get = l ? (PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayW_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayW") : NULL;
        pdh.ok = open && add && pdh.collect && pdh.get && open(NULL, 0, &pdh.q) == 0 &&
                 add(pdh.q, L"\\Thermal Zone Information(*)\\Temperature", 0, &pdh.c) == 0;
    }
    if (!pdh.ok || pdh.collect(pdh.q) != 0) return -1;
    DWORD size = 0, count = 0;
    pdh.get(pdh.c, PDH_FMT_DOUBLE, &size, &count, NULL);
    if (!size) return -1;
    PDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_W *items = malloc(size);
    float best = -1;
    if (items && pdh.get(pdh.c, PDH_FMT_DOUBLE, &size, &count, items) == 0)
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < count; i++) {  // the hottest zone, in kelvin
            double c = items[i].FmtValue.doubleValue - 273.15;
            if (c > best && c < 150) best = (float)c;
        }
    free(items);
    return best;
}

static void platform_sample(PerfStats *s, double dt) {
    static uint64_t p_idle, p_kern, p_user, p_proc;
    FILETIME idle, kern, user, cr, ex, pk, pu;
    if (GetSystemTimes(&idle, &kern, &user) && GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &cr, &ex, &pk, &pu)) {
        uint64_t i = ft64(idle), k = ft64(kern), u = ft64(user), p = ft64(pk) + ft64(pu);
        uint64_t total = (k - p_kern) + (u - p_user);  // (kernel time includes idle)
        if (p_kern && total) {
            s->cpu_total_pct = 100.0f * (float)(total - (i - p_idle)) / (float)total;
            s->cpu_game_pct = 100.0f * (float)(p - p_proc) / (float)total;
        }
        p_idle = i, p_kern = k, p_user = u, p_proc = p;
    }
    (void)dt;
    MEMORYSTATUSEX ms = {.dwLength = sizeof ms};
    if (GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&ms)) {
        s->ram_total_mb = (float)(ms.ullTotalPhys >> 20);
        s->ram_used_mb = (float)((ms.ullTotalPhys - ms.ullAvailPhys) >> 20);
    }
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS pmc;
    if (GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), &pmc, sizeof pmc)) s->ram_game_mb = (float)(pmc.WorkingSetSize >> 20);
    s->cpu_temp_c = thermal_zone_c();
    s->cpu_temp_source = "ACPI thermal zone";
}
#else
static float read_float_file(const char *path) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) return -1;
    double v = -1;
    if (fscanf(f, "%lf", &v) != 1) v = -1;
    fclose(f);
    return (float)v;
}

// hwmon: k10temp (AMD Tctl) or coretemp (Intel package); else the x86_pkg_temp thermal zone
static float cpu_temp_linux(const char **src) {
    static char path[300];
    static const char *source;
    static bool found;
    if (!found) {
        found = true;
        DIR *d = opendir("/sys/class/hwmon");
        struct dirent *e;
        while (d && (e = readdir(d)) && !path[0]) {
            char np[300], nm[64] = "";
            snprintf(np, sizeof np, "/sys/class/hwmon/%s/name", e->d_name);
            FILE *f = fopen(np, "r");
            if (!f) continue;
            if (fscanf(f, "%63s", nm) != 1) nm[0] = 0;
            fclose(f);
            if (!strcmp(nm, "k10temp") || !strcmp(nm, "coretemp") || !strcmp(nm, "zenpower")) {
                snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/sys/class/hwmon/%s/temp1_input", e->d_name);
                source = !strcmp(nm, "coretemp") ? "coretemp" : nm[0] == 'k' ? "k10temp" : "zenpower";
            }
        }
        if (d) closedir(d);
    }
    *src = source;
    if (!path[0]) return -1;
    float v = read_float_file(path);
    return v < 0 ? -1 : v / 1000.0f;
}

// Arm Mali and other devfreq GPUs (RK3588's Mali-G610: /sys/class/devfreq/fb000000.gpu): "load" is "<percent>@<Hz>",
// cur_freq the clock; the temperature from the thermal zone whose type names the GPU. Unified memory: no VRAM.
static bool devfreq_gpu_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    static char dev[300], tz[300];
    static bool tried;
    if (!tried) {
        tried = true;
        DIR *d = opendir("/sys/class/devfreq");
        if (d) {
            struct dirent *e;
            while ((e = readdir(d)) && !dev[0])
                if (strstr(e->d_name, "gpu") || strstr(e->d_name, "mali")) snprintf(dev, sizeof dev, "/sys/class/devfreq/%s", e->d_name);
            closedir(d);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 32 && !tz[0]; i++) {
            char p[200], t[64] = {0};
            snprintf(p, sizeof p, "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone%d/type", i);
            FILE *f = fopen(p, "r");
            if (!f) continue;
            if (fgets(t, sizeof t, f) && strstr(t, "gpu")) snprintf(tz, sizeof tz, "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone%d/temp", i);
            fclose(f);
        }
    }
    if (!dev[0]) return false;
    char hint[96];
    gpu_hint(hint);
    snprintf(s->gpu_name, sizeof s->gpu_name, "%s", hint[0] ? hint : "GPU");
    char p[400];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/load", dev);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "r");
    if (f) {
        int load = -1;
        if (fscanf(f, "%d", &load) == 1 && load >= 0) s->gpu_pct = (float)load;
        fclose(f);
    }
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/cur_freq", dev);
    float hz = read_float_file(p);
    if (hz > 0) s->gpu_clock_mhz = hz / 1e6f;
    if (tz[0]) {
        float t = read_float_file(tz);
        if (t > 0) s->gpu_temp_c = t / 1000.0f;
    }
    return true;
}

// Match the Vulkan DRM node first; it can be renderD128 even when the card node is card1. Without an identity,
// only accept an unambiguous AMD device. Never attach another adapter's counters to the rendering GPU's name.
static bool amdgpu_find(char *dev, size_t cap, const char *sysfs, int major, int minor) {
    dev[0] = 0;
    char p[512];
    if (major >= 0 && minor >= 0) {
        snprintf(dev, cap, "%s/dev/char/%d:%d/device", sysfs, major, minor);
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/gpu_busy_percent", dev);
        if (access(p, R_OK) == 0) return true;
        dev[0] = 0;
        return false;
    }
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/class/drm", sysfs);
    DIR *d = opendir(p);
    if (!d) return false;
    struct dirent *e;
    unsigned matches = 0;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (strncmp(e->d_name, "card", 4) || !e->d_name[4] ||
            strspn(e->d_name + 4, "0123456789") != strlen(e->d_name + 4)) continue;
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/class/drm/%s/device/gpu_busy_percent", sysfs, e->d_name);
        if (access(p, R_OK) != 0) continue;
        snprintf(dev, cap, "%s/class/drm/%s/device", sysfs, e->d_name);
        matches++;
    }
    closedir(d);
    if (matches == 1) return true;
    dev[0] = 0;
    return false;
}

// AMD GPUs: amdgpu's sysfs (busy percent, VRAM, hwmon temperature); false: no matching amdgpu device.
static bool amdgpu_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    char dev[512], hint[96];
    int major = -1, minor = -1;
#ifdef __linux__
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    major = g_gpu_drm_major;
    minor = g_gpu_drm_minor;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
#endif
    // Resolve each sample so selection made after the overlay starts also takes effect.
    if (!amdgpu_find(dev, sizeof dev, "/sys", major, minor)) return false;
    gpu_hint(hint);
    snprintf(s->gpu_name, sizeof s->gpu_name, "%s", hint[0] ? hint : "AMD GPU");
    char p[640];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/gpu_busy_percent", dev); s->gpu_pct = read_float_file(p);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/mem_info_vram_used", dev); float u = read_float_file(p);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/mem_info_vram_total", dev); float t = read_float_file(p);
    if (u >= 0) s->vram_used_mb = u / 1048576.0f;
    if (t >= 0) s->vram_total_mb = t / 1048576.0f;
    DIR *d;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/hwmon", dev);
    if ((d = opendir(p))) {
        struct dirent *e;
        while ((e = readdir(d)))
            if (e->d_name[0] != '.') {
                char q[1024];
                snprintf(q, sizeof q, "%s/%s/temp1_input", p, e->d_name);
                float v = read_float_file(q);
                if (v >= 0) s->gpu_temp_c = v / 1000.0f;
            }
        closedir(d);
    }
    return true;
}

static void platform_sample(PerfStats *s, double dt) {
    static unsigned long long p_idle, p_total, p_proc;
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/stat", "r");
    if (f) {
        unsigned long long v[10] = {0};
        if (fscanf(f, "cpu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu", &v[0], &v[1], &v[2], &v[3], &v[4], &v[5], &v[6], &v[7]) >= 4) {
            unsigned long long idle = v[3] + v[4], total = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) total += v[i];
            unsigned long long ut = 0, st = 0;
            FILE *g = fopen("/proc/self/stat", "r");
            if (g) {
                char buf[1024];
                if (fgets(buf, sizeof buf, g)) {
                    char *p = strrchr(buf, ')');
                    // fields after the name: state ppid ... utime (14th) stime (15th)
                    if (p) sscanf(p + 2, "%*c %*d %*d %*d %*d %*d %*u %*u %*u %*u %*u %llu %llu", &ut, &st);
                }
                fclose(g);
            }
            unsigned long long proc = ut + st;
            if (p_total && total > p_total) {
                s->cpu_total_pct = 100.0f * (float)((total - p_total) - (idle - p_idle)) / (float)(total - p_total);
                s->cpu_game_pct = 100.0f * (float)(proc - p_proc) / (float)(total - p_total);
            }
            p_idle = idle, p_total = total, p_proc = proc;
        }
        fclose(f);
    }
    (void)dt;
    f = fopen("/proc/meminfo", "r");
    if (f) {
        char k[64];
        unsigned long long val, total = 0, avail = 0;
        while (fscanf(f, "%63s %llu kB\n", k, &val) == 2) {
            if (!strcmp(k, "MemTotal:")) total = val;
            if (!strcmp(k, "MemAvailable:")) avail = val;
        }
        fclose(f);
        if (total) s->ram_total_mb = total / 1024.0f, s->ram_used_mb = (total - avail) / 1024.0f;
    }
    f = fopen("/proc/self/statm", "r");
    if (f) {
        unsigned long long sz, rss;
        if (fscanf(f, "%llu %llu", &sz, &rss) == 2) s->ram_game_mb = (float)(rss * (unsigned long long)sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE) >> 20);
        fclose(f);
    }
    s->cpu_temp_c = cpu_temp_linux(&s->cpu_temp_source);
    if (!nv.ok) {
        // (no amdgpu: Mali and other devfreq GPUs. Decided by the device, not by gpu_pct: once a devfreq read had set it,
        // a gpu_pct < 0 test stopped every later read, and load, clock and temperature froze at their first values)
        if (!amdgpu_sample(s)) devfreq_gpu_sample(s);
    }
}
#endif

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ sampler thread
static void *sampler(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    PerfStats s;
    memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
    s.cpu_temp_c = s.gpu_pct = s.gpu_temp_c = s.gpu_power_w = s.gpu_clock_mhz = s.vram_used_mb = s.vram_total_mb = -1;
    cpu_name(s.cpu_name, sizeof s.cpu_name);
    uint64_t last = plat_now_ns();
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
        // Do not retain another adapter's readings when identity arrives late or a sensor becomes unavailable.
        s.gpu_name[0] = 0;
        s.gpu_pct = s.gpu_temp_c = s.gpu_power_w = s.gpu_clock_mhz = s.vram_used_mb = s.vram_total_mb = -1;
        platform_sample(&s, (now - last) / 1e9);
        nvml_sample(&s);
#ifdef _WIN32
        pdh_sample(&s);
        adl_sample(&s);  // (after PDH: an AMD GPU's numbers replace its)
#endif
        last = now;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
        PerfStats keep = g_stats;
        g_stats = s;
        memcpy(g_stats.frame_ms, keep.frame_ms, sizeof keep.frame_ms);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        plat_sleep_until_ns(plat_now_ns() + 500000000ull);
    }
    return NULL;
}

void perfmon_set_gpu_hint(const char *n) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    snprintf(g_gpu_hint, sizeof g_gpu_hint, "%s", n ? n : "");
#ifdef __linux__
    g_gpu_drm_major = g_gpu_drm_minor = -1;
#endif
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

#ifdef __linux__
void perfmon_set_gpu_drm(int major, int minor) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    g_gpu_drm_major = major;
    g_gpu_drm_minor = minor;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}
#endif

void perfmon_snapshot(PerfStats *out) {
    static bool started;
    if (!started) {
        started = true;
        g_stats.cpu_temp_c = g_stats.gpu_pct = g_stats.gpu_temp_c = g_stats.gpu_power_w = -1;
        g_stats.gpu_clock_mhz = g_stats.vram_used_mb = g_stats.vram_total_mb = -1;
        pthread_t th;
        pthread_create(&th, NULL, sampler, NULL);
        pthread_detach(th);
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    frames_summary(&g_stats);
    *out = g_stats;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

```

`runtime/perfmon.h`:

```h
// Performance numbers for the overlay (runtime/perfmon.c): the game's frame rate and frame times, and the machine's
// CPU, memory and GPU load and temperatures. A value the platform doesn't give is negative.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define PERF_HISTORY 120  // frame times kept for the graph

typedef struct {
    // the game's frames (presents), over the last second
    float fps, frame_ms_avg, frame_ms_max;
    float fps_generated;           // frames made by frame generation (Video > Frame generation), presented in between
    float frame_ms[PERF_HISTORY];  // oldest first
    // CPU: the whole machine and this process, percent of all logical cores
    char cpu_name[64];
    float cpu_total_pct, cpu_game_pct, cpu_temp_c;
    const char *cpu_temp_source;  // where the temperature comes from ("k10temp", "ACPI thermal zone", ...)
    // memory, MB
    float ram_used_mb, ram_total_mb, ram_game_mb;
    // GPU (NVIDIA through NVML, AMD through sysfs on Linux)
    char gpu_name[96];
    float gpu_pct, gpu_temp_c, gpu_power_w, gpu_clock_mhz, vram_used_mb, vram_total_mb;
} PerfStats;

void perfmon_frame(void);                  // a game frame was presented (any thread)
void perfmon_generated_frame(void);        // a generated frame was presented (vulkan/device.c)
void perfmon_snapshot(PerfStats *out);     // the latest numbers (machine numbers refresh twice a second)
bool perfmon_position(float out[3]);       // render thread: Link's position copy now; false when unavailable
void perfmon_set_gpu_hint(const char *n);  // the Vulkan device's name: which GPU to report
#ifdef __linux__
void perfmon_set_gpu_drm(int major, int minor);  // selected Vulkan device's render (or primary) node
#endif

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```
