`runtime/platform.h`:

```h
// Host OS layer: everything the runtime needs that differs between macOS and Windows.
// Implementations: runtime/platform/macos.c, runtime/platform/windows.c (the Makefile picks one).
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include "platform/win_compat.h"
#elif defined(__linux__)
#include "platform/linux_compat.h"
#endif

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

// ---- guest address space
// Claim [lo, hi) for the guest at exactly that address, readable/writable (pages may be backed lazily).
bool plat_reserve_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi);
// Make sure [addr, addr+size) inside the guest window is backed (before the OS itself writes there, e.g.
// file reads); a no-op where the whole window is backed from the start.
void plat_commit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
// Give the backing of [addr, addr+size) inside the guest window back to the OS (the guest unmapped it): the pages
// read as zero if anything touches them again (Windows: committed again on the first access). The window stays claimed.
void plat_decommit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
// The first run of committed memory at or after addr and before end: *a .. *e (false: none). For reading the game's
// memory from a thread of ours without committing what the game never touched (runtime/rupees.c).
bool plat_committed_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t end, uint64_t *a, uint64_t *e);
// In-place reboot: every page of [lo, hi) back to zero (and unbacked), the window still claimed.
bool plat_reset_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi);
// Vulkan sparse guest-heap backing: report committed 64 KiB pages in a reserved guest range.
bool plat_guest_sparse_heap_enabled(void);
#ifdef _WIN32
uint64_t plat_guest_commit_generation(void);
void plat_guest_sparse_heap_configure(bool auto_on);  // (auto_on: what sparse_heap = auto picks for this GPU)
void plat_guest_sparse_heap_range(uint64_t base, uint64_t size);
uint64_t plat_guest_sparse_heap_committed_word(uint64_t word);
bool plat_guest_commit_sparse_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
#endif
enum { PLAT_PROT_NONE = 0, PLAT_PROT_READ = 1, PLAT_PROT_RW = 3 };
int plat_protect(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int prot);  // 0 on success
#define PLAT_PAGE 0x4000ull  // largest page size we deal with (macOS 16K; multiple of Windows' 4K)
// The 4K pages of [addr, addr + size) (in the guest window) written since the last call for them, which the call
// resets: their addresses into pages (ascending, at most max). -1: not known here (only Windows tracks them: the
// window is reserved with MEM_WRITE_WATCH), or more than max were written (then any page may have been).
long plat_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, size_t max);
// Whether any 4K page of [addr, addr + size) was written since plat_written_pages last reset it (1 / 0), without
// resetting anything. -1: not known here.
int plat_any_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);

// ---- time
uint64_t plat_now_ns(void);                // monotonic
void plat_sleep_until_ns(uint64_t t);      // precise wait for plat_now_ns() >= t
void plat_wait_until_ns(uint64_t t);       // wait for plat_now_ns() >= t without spinning (the OS timer's precision)
void plat_thread_realtime(uint64_t period_ns);  // periodic timing thread (vsync): don't coalesce its timers
void plat_thread_elevate(void);            // latency-critical thread (game main, render, recorder): favor P-cores on hybrid architectures
int plat_cpu_count(void);       // logical processors this process may run on (its affinity, after plat_cpu_placement)
void plat_cpu_placement(void);  // (game start) one logical processor per core where plat_one_per_core_default says
// Whether the game runs on one logical processor per core when SAVAGEWIND_ONE_PER_CORE doesn't say (cores: physical
// cores the process may use, logical: its logical processors). Measured on Windows with a Ryzen 5 5600X: against all
// logical processors it was 6% faster on 6 cores and 18% on 4, and 24% slower on 2 (half the 1% lows: too few
// processors for the game's busy threads). On Linux the Steam Deck (4 cores, 8 threads) lost 3% and a quarter of its
// 1% lows with it, so Linux keeps every logical processor.
static inline bool plat_one_per_core_default(int cores, int logical) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    return logical > cores && cores >= 4;
#else
    (void)cores, (void)logical;
    return false;
#endif
}

// ---- process
void plat_init(void);                                // first thing in main()
bool plat_exe_path(char *buf, size_t size);
const char *plat_log_path(void);  // the log file this run writes ("": stderr goes to a console, pipe or file)
void plat_exec(char *const argv[]);  // replace the process (NULL = same command line); returns only on failure
#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(__linux__)
void plat_terminate(void);  // end the process now, skipping DLL teardown (exit status 0)
// Windows: false turns off the accessibility shortcuts (Shift five times: Sticky Keys) where their feature is off,
// true puts them back as they were (the game's window has the focus or not). Elsewhere nothing.
void plat_accessibility_shortcuts(bool allow);
#endif

// Child processes (game code generator and compiler, game-file setup). stdout + stderr go to log_path (NULL = /dev/null).
typedef intptr_t PlatProc;  // 0 = failed to start
PlatProc plat_spawn(const char *const argv[], const char *log_path, bool append_log);
int plat_proc_wait(PlatProc p, bool block);  // exit code, or -1 while still running (block = false)
void plat_proc_kill(PlatProc p);             // end it and what it started (then it's gone: no wait)
bool plat_remove_tree(const char *dir);      // rm -rf
#ifdef _WIN32
#define PLAT_EXE_SUFFIX ".exe"
#define PLAT_VENV_PYTHON "venv/Scripts/python.exe"  // relative to the venv's parent
#else
#define PLAT_EXE_SUFFIX ""
#define PLAT_VENV_PYTHON "venv/bin/python"
#endif

#ifdef _WIN32
// The display's peak luminance from the active Windows HDR calibration ICC profile (MHC2 tag, nits), 0 if unknown.
// hwnd: the game window (SDL_PROP_WINDOW_WIN32_HWND_POINTER), may be NULL. profile: the applied ICC file name.
int plat_hdr_peak_nits(void *hwnd, char *profile, size_t profile_size);
#endif

// ---- diagnostics
// Name of the host function containing pc (guest functions are f_<addr>), NULL if unknown.
const char *plat_symbol(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset);
void plat_print_backtrace(void);
void plat_fatal_notice(void);  // a fatal error is about to end the process: tell the user (Windows release: message box)
void plat_crash_handler_install(void);  // per thread where the OS needs it (alternate signal stack)
// Called by the crash handler (runtime/dispatch.c): true = fault handled (watchpoint), resume.
bool rt_fault_watch(uint64_t fault_addr, uint64_t host_pc);
extern int g_fault_is_write;  // set by the platform handler before rt_fault_watch: 1 write, 0 read (or unknown)
void rt_fault_report(const char *what, uint64_t fault_addr, uint64_t host_pc, uint64_t host_lr) __attribute__((noreturn));

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/platform/linux.c`:

```c
// Linux host layer (runtime/platform.h). x86-64 and aarch64.
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <execinfo.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "../gamelib.h"
#include "../platform.h"

#ifndef MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE
#define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE 0x100000
#endif

// ---- guest address space
// Everything readable/writable from the start, like macOS: the guest maps at 4K granularity, and untouched pages
// cost nothing (MAP_NORESERVE: the 12 GB window doesn't count against overcommit).
bool plat_reserve_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, hi - lo, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                   MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
    if (p == MAP_FAILED) return false;
    if (p != (void *)(uintptr_t)lo) { munmap(p, hi - lo); return false; }  // (kernels before 4.17: just a hint)
    return true;
}

// Fresh zero pages over the whole window (the old ones are released at once).
long plat_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, size_t max) { return -1; }  // (not tracked)
int plat_any_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { return -1; }

bool plat_reset_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    return mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, hi - lo, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE | MAP_FIXED,
                -1, 0) == (void *)(uintptr_t)lo;
}

void plat_commit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { (void)addr; (void)size; }

bool plat_committed_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t end, uint64_t *a, uint64_t *e) {  // (the whole window is backed)
    if (addr >= end) return false;
    *a = addr, *e = end;
    return true;
}

void plat_decommit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    uint64_t a = (addr + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull, e = (addr + size) & ~0xFFFull;  // (whole pages inside the range only)
    if (e > a) madvise((void *)(uintptr_t)a, e - a, MADV_DONTNEED);  // (private anonymous memory: freed, reads as zero)
}

int plat_protect(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int prot) {
    int p = prot == PLAT_PROT_NONE ? PROT_NONE : prot == PLAT_PROT_READ ? PROT_READ : PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE;
    return mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, p);
}

// ---- time
uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000u + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}

void plat_sleep_until_ns(uint64_t t) {
    struct timespec ts = {.tv_sec = (time_t)(t / 1000000000u), .tv_nsec = (long)(t % 1000000000u)};
    while (clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, TIMER_ABSTIME, &ts, NULL) == EINTR) {}
}

void plat_wait_until_ns(uint64_t t) { plat_sleep_until_ns(t); }  // (clock_nanosleep doesn't spin)

int plat_cpu_count(void) {
    cpu_set_t s;
    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof s, &s) == 0 && CPU_COUNT(&s) > 0) return CPU_COUNT(&s);
    return SDL_GetNumLogicalCPUCores();
}

// The lowest logical processor of cpu's core (its SMT siblings) that the process may run on.
static int core_first(int cpu, const cpu_set_t *all) {
    char path[96], list[256];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/thread_siblings_list", cpu);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) return cpu;
    bool got = fgets(list, sizeof list, f) != NULL;
    fclose(f);
    int first = cpu;
    for (char *p = list; got && *p && *p != '\n';) {  // "0,8" or "0-1"
        char *end;
        long a = strtol(p, &end, 10), b = a;
        if (end == p) break;
        if (*end == '-') b = strtol(end + 1, &end, 10);
        for (long i = a; i <= b && i < CPU_SETSIZE; i++)
            if (i < first && CPU_ISSET((int)i, all)) first = (int)i;
        p = *end == ',' ? end + 1 : end;
    }
    return first;
}

// One logical processor per physical core, as on Windows (runtime/platform/windows.c): the first of each core's
// SMT siblings within the process's affinity, set on every thread the process has so far (later ones inherit it).
void plat_cpu_placement(void) {
    cpu_set_t all, one;
    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof all, &all)) return;
    CPU_ZERO(&one);
    int logical = CPU_COUNT(&all), cores = 0;
    for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; c++)
        if (CPU_ISSET(c, &all) && core_first(c, &all) == c) CPU_SET(c, &one), cores++;
    const char *x = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_ONE_PER_CORE");
    bool on = cores && (x ? atoi(x) != 0 : plat_one_per_core_default(cores, logical));
    fprintf(stderr, "[cpu] %d cores, %d logical processors: %s\n", cores, logical,
            on ? "one logical processor per core" : "all logical processors");
    if (!on || cores == logical) return;
    DIR *d = opendir("/proc/self/task");
    for (struct dirent *e; d && (e = readdir(d));)
        if (e->d_name[0] != '.') sched_setaffinity((pid_t)atoi(e->d_name), sizeof one, &one);
    if (d) closedir(d);
}

// Real-time scheduling where the user may have it (rtkit / limits.conf), else just a higher priority: keeps the
// vsync thread on time while the guest threads load every core.
void plat_thread_realtime(uint64_t period_ns) {
    (void)period_ns;
    struct sched_param sp = {.sched_priority = 1};
    if (pthread_setschedparam(pthread_self(), SCHED_FIFO, &sp) == 0) return;
    setpriority(PRIO_PROCESS, (id_t)gettid(), -10);  // (per thread on Linux; fails quietly without CAP_SYS_NICE)
}

void plat_thread_elevate(void) {}

// ---- process
// stdout / stderr go to savagewind.log in the data folder (runtime/paths.h; rt_paths_init runs later, so the same rule
// is applied here). Processes started by this one (the start screen re-executing itself for the game) append to the
// same log. Started from a terminal (how players set SAVAGEWIND_* switches for a test) the log is shown there too:
// before, the terminal had it instead of the file, and players attached an older savagewind.log (#527). The file is
// written directly, so a crash's last lines are in it; a thread copies what it gets to the terminal, whose descriptor
// stays open across the re-exec (SAVAGEWIND_LOG_ECHO_FD). In a development tree (an extracted/ folder here) stderr
// stays where it goes.
static char g_log_path[1024];
static off_t g_echo_from;  // (where this process's part of the log starts)

static void *log_echo_thread(void *arg) {
    int out = (int)(intptr_t)arg, in = open(g_log_path, O_RDONLY);
    if (in < 0) return NULL;
    lseek(in, g_echo_from, SEEK_SET);  // (this process's part: the start screen's part was shown by it)
    char buf[8192];
    for (;;) {
        ssize_t n = read(in, buf, sizeof buf);
        if (n > 0) { if (write(out, buf, (size_t)n) < 0) break; continue; }
        usleep(100000);
    }
    close(in);
    return NULL;
}

// A launcher that starts this with --prepare (runtime/main.c) reads its progress lines from stdout: stdout stays where
// it is, and only stderr goes to the log. plat_init runs before main() looks at its arguments.
static bool prepare_asked(void) {
    char args[4096];
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/self/cmdline", "rb");
    if (!f) return false;
    size_t n = fread(args, 1, sizeof args - 1, f);
    fclose(f);
    args[n] = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i += strlen(args + i) + 1)
        if (!strcmp(args + i, "--prepare")) return true;
    return false;
}

static void log_to_file(void) {
    char dir[900];
    const char *env = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DATA_ROOT"), *xdg = getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"), *home = getenv("HOME");
    struct stat st;
    if (env && *env) snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", env);
    else if (stat("extracted", &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) return;  // dev mode: wherever stderr goes already
    else if (xdg && *xdg == '/') snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/savagewind", xdg);
    else snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/.local/share/savagewind", home && *home ? home : "/tmp");
    for (char *c = dir + 1; *c; c++)
        if (*c == '/') { *c = 0; mkdir(dir, 0755); *c = '/'; }
    mkdir(dir, 0755);
    snprintf(g_log_path, sizeof g_log_path, "%s/savagewind.log", dir);
    bool append = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_APPEND") != NULL;
    if (!append) {  // the last run's log stays as savagewind.prev.log: opening again after a failed setup kept nothing of it
        char prev[1100];
        snprintf(prev, sizeof prev, "%s/savagewind.prev.log", dir);
        rename(g_log_path, prev);
    }
    const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_ECHO_FD");
    int echo = e && isatty(atoi(e)) ? atoi(e) : -1;
    if (echo < 0 && isatty(STDERR_FILENO) && (echo = dup(STDERR_FILENO)) >= 0) {  // (no close-on-exec: kept by the game)
        char fd[16];
        snprintf(fd, sizeof fd, "%d", echo);
        setenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_ECHO_FD", fd, 1);
        dprintf(echo, "[log] written to %s and shown here\n", g_log_path);
    }
    if (!freopen(g_log_path, append ? "a" : "w", stderr)) { g_log_path[0] = 0; return; }
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);  // (reopened, stderr was buffered: lines lost at the re-exec, or in a crash)
    if (!prepare_asked()) dup2(STDERR_FILENO, STDOUT_FILENO);
    setenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_APPEND", "1", 1);
    g_echo_from = lseek(STDERR_FILENO, 0, SEEK_END);
    pthread_t t;
    if (echo >= 0 && pthread_create(&t, NULL, log_echo_thread, (void *)(intptr_t)echo) == 0) pthread_detach(t);
}

// The recompiled game code is built for a target this CPU runs (runtime/gamelib.h): say so instead of crashing with an
// illegal instruction on a CPU too old for any.
static void require_cpu(void) {
    const char *need = gamelib_cpu_problem();
    if (!need) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Savage Wind needs %s.\n", need);
    exit(1);
}

void plat_init(void) {
    log_to_file();
    require_cpu();
}

// (inside an AppImage: the binary in its mount, which stays mounted while this process lives - re-exec included)
const char *plat_log_path(void) { return g_log_path; }

bool plat_exe_path(char *buf, size_t size) {
    ssize_t n = readlink("/proc/self/exe", buf, size - 1);
    if (n <= 0) return false;
    buf[n] = 0;
    return true;
}

// Our own command line, from /proc/self/cmdline (NUL-separated).
static char **self_argv(void) {
    static char buf[32768];
    static char *argv[256];
    int fd = open("/proc/self/cmdline", O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) return NULL;
    ssize_t n = read(fd, buf, sizeof buf - 1);
    close(fd);
    if (n <= 0) return NULL;
    buf[n] = 0;
    int k = 0;
    for (char *p = buf; p < buf + n && k < 255; p += strlen(p) + 1) argv[k++] = p;
    argv[k] = NULL;
    return argv;
}

void plat_exec(char *const argv[]) {
    if (argv) { execv(argv[0], argv); return; }
    char path[4096];
    char **av = self_argv();
    if (av && plat_exe_path(path, sizeof path)) execv(path, av);
}

// ---- diagnostics
// Exported symbols only (the Makefile links with -rdynamic); frames in the generated code are left to the caller,
// which maps them to guest functions (runtime/dispatch.c). Static runtime functions come out as the nearest guest
// function, so backtrace lines also give the offset in the executable (addr2line -fe savagewind <offset>).
const char *plat_symbol(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset) {
    Dl_info di = {0};
    if (!dladdr((void *)(uintptr_t)pc, &di) || !di.dli_sname) return NULL;
    if (offset) *offset = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)di.dli_saddr;
    return di.dli_sname;
}

// Fatal error without a terminal: say so in a message box rather than vanishing (the details are in the log).
void plat_fatal_notice(void) {
    if (!g_log_path[0]) return;
    fflush(stderr);
    char text[1200];
    // (the GPU out of memory, vk.h VK_CHECK: the reason a player can act on, #117)
    bool oom = false;
    FILE *f = fopen(g_log_path, "rb");
    if (f) {
        static char tail[8192];
        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
        long sz = ftell(f);
        fseek(f, sz > (long)sizeof tail - 1 ? sz - (long)sizeof tail + 1 : 0, SEEK_SET);
        tail[fread(tail, 1, sizeof tail - 1, f)] = 0;
        fclose(f);
        oom = strstr(tail, "FATAL: the GPU ran out of memory") != NULL;
    }
    snprintf(text, sizeof text, "Savage Wind stopped because of an error.%s\n\nDetails: %s",
             oom ? "\n\nThe graphics card ran out of memory. Integrated graphics share the PC's RAM, and Savage Wind keeps "
                   "the game's 3 GB of memory available to the GPU: with integrated graphics it needs 16 GB of RAM. Close "
                   "other programs and lower Video > Shadow resolution and the upscaler quality."
                 : "",
             g_log_path);
    SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR, "Savage Wind", text, NULL);
}

const char *rt_host_fn_name(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset);  // runtime/dispatch.c

void plat_print_backtrace(void) {
    void *bt[64];
    int n = backtrace(bt, 64);
    Dl_info self = {0};
    dladdr((void *)plat_print_backtrace, &self);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t pc = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)bt[i], off = 0;
        Dl_info di = {0};
        if (!dladdr(bt[i], &di)) di.dli_fname = NULL;
        bool ours = di.dli_fbase && di.dli_fbase == self.dli_fbase;
        const char *s = plat_symbol(pc, &off);
        if (!s && ours) s = rt_host_fn_name(pc, &off);
        const char *mod = di.dli_fname ? (strrchr(di.dli_fname, '/') ? strrchr(di.dli_fname, '/') + 1 : di.dli_fname) : "?";
        uint64_t moff = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)di.dli_fbase;
        if (s && ours) fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx %s+%llx (savagewind+%llx)\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc, s,
                               (unsigned long long)off, (unsigned long long)moff);
        else if (s) fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx %s+%llx (%s)\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc, s, (unsigned long long)off, mod);
        else fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx %s+%llx\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc, mod, (unsigned long long)moff);
    }
}

static void crash_handler(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *ctx) {
    ucontext_t *uc = ctx;
    static volatile int depth;
    if (sig == SIGABRT && depth++ > 0) { signal(SIGABRT, SIG_DFL); abort(); }  // (nested: just die)
    uint64_t fa = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)si->si_addr;
#if defined(__aarch64__)
    uint64_t pc = uc->uc_mcontext.pc, lr = uc->uc_mcontext.regs[30];
#else
    // x86-64 has no link register: report the return address on top of the stack (valid at function entry)
    uint64_t pc = (uint64_t)uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RIP], sp = (uint64_t)uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RSP], lr = 0;
    if (sig != SIGSEGV || (fa & ~0xFFFull) != (sp & ~0xFFFull)) lr = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)sp;
#endif
    if (rt_fault_watch(fa, pc)) return;
    char what[32];
    snprintf(what, sizeof what, "signal %d", sig);
    rt_fault_report(what, fa, pc, lr);
}

void plat_crash_handler_install(void) {
    stack_t ss = {.ss_sp = malloc(1 << 20), .ss_size = 1 << 20};
    sigaltstack(&ss, NULL);
    struct sigaction sa = {0};
    sa.sa_sigaction = crash_handler;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_ONSTACK;
    sigaction(SIGSEGV, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGBUS, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGILL, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGFPE, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGABRT, &sa, NULL);
}

// ---- child processes
#include <ftw.h>
#include <spawn.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
extern char **environ;

PlatProc plat_spawn(const char *const argv[], const char *log_path, bool append_log) {
    posix_spawn_file_actions_t fa;
    posix_spawn_file_actions_init(&fa);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_addopen(&fa, 1, log_path ? log_path : "/dev/null",
                                     O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | (append_log ? O_APPEND : O_TRUNC), 0644);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2(&fa, 1, 2);
    posix_spawnattr_t at;  // (its own process group: plat_proc_kill ends what it starts, e.g. a compiler's own child)
    posix_spawnattr_init(&at);
    posix_spawnattr_setflags(&at, POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP);
    posix_spawnattr_setpgroup(&at, 0);
    // The child's environment without LD_PRELOAD: Steam sets it to its x86 overlay libraries, which an aarch64 swgen or
    // compiler cannot load, and ld.so then prints "wrong ELF class" into the output the launcher shows as the error
    // (#413). None of these children (the generator, the compilers) needs the overlay.
    size_t n = 0;
    while (environ[n]) n++;
    char **env = malloc((n + 1) * sizeof *env);
    size_t k = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; env && i < n; i++)
        if (strncmp(environ[i], "LD_PRELOAD=", 11)) env[k++] = environ[i];
    if (env) env[k] = NULL;
    pid_t pid;
    int rc = posix_spawn(&pid, argv[0], &fa, &at, (char *const *)argv, env ? env : environ);
    free(env);
    posix_spawnattr_destroy(&at);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_destroy(&fa);
    return rc ? 0 : (PlatProc)pid;
}

void plat_proc_kill(PlatProc p) {
    kill(-(pid_t)p, SIGKILL);
    waitpid((pid_t)p, NULL, 0);
}

int plat_proc_wait(PlatProc p, bool block) {
    int st = 0;
    pid_t r = waitpid((pid_t)p, &st, block ? 0 : WNOHANG);
    if (r == 0) return -1;
    if (r < 0) return 255;
    return WIFEXITED(st) ? WEXITSTATUS(st) : WIFSIGNALED(st) ? 128 + (WTERMSIG(st) & 127) : 255;  // (as a shell: 137 = killed)
}

static int rm_entry(const char *path, const struct stat *sb, int flag, struct FTW *ftw) {
    (void)sb, (void)flag, (void)ftw;
    return remove(path);
}
bool plat_remove_tree(const char *dir) { return nftw(dir, rm_entry, 16, FTW_DEPTH | FTW_PHYS) == 0; }

// End the process at once, skipping the library teardown: as on Windows, the GPU driver's threads crashed in exit()
// while the game's threads still submitted work.
void plat_terminate(void) { _exit(0); }

bool plat_guest_sparse_heap_enabled(void) { return false; }

void plat_accessibility_shortcuts(bool allow) { (void)allow; }  // (Windows only)
```

`runtime/platform/linux_compat.h`:

```h
// What glibc before 2.38 lacks (included via runtime/platform.h on Linux only): the AppImage is built against
// Ubuntu 22.04's glibc 2.35 (no strlcpy / strlcat until 2.38, no arc4random until 2.36).
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/random.h>

#if !__GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 38)
static inline size_t strlcpy(char *d, const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t len = strlen(s);
    if (n) {
        size_t k = len < n - 1 ? len : n - 1;
        memcpy(d, s, k);
        d[k] = 0;
    }
    return len;
}
static inline size_t strlcat(char *d, const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t dl = strnlen(d, n);
    if (dl == n) return n + strlen(s);
    return dl + strlcpy(d + dl, s, n - dl);
}
#endif

#if !__GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 36)
static inline uint32_t arc4random(void) {
    uint32_t v = 0;
    while (getrandom(&v, sizeof v, 0) != sizeof v) {}
    return v;
}
static inline uint32_t arc4random_uniform(uint32_t n) {
    if (n < 2) return 0;
    uint32_t min = -n % n, r;  // reject the low values that would bias the modulo
    do r = arc4random(); while (r < min);
    return r % n;
}
#endif
```

```c
// macOS host layer (runtime/platform.h).
#include <crt_externs.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <execinfo.h>
#include <mach-o/dyld.h>
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <mach/mach_vm.h>

#include <pthread.h>

#include "../platform.h"

static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb;

void plat_init(void) {}

bool plat_reserve_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    // Everything readable/writable: macOS pages are 16K but the guest maps at 4K granularity.
    // Untouched pages cost nothing.
    mach_vm_address_t a = lo;
    return mach_vm_allocate(mach_task_self(), &a, hi - lo, VM_FLAGS_FIXED) == KERN_SUCCESS;
}

// Fresh zero pages over the whole window (the old ones are released at once).
long plat_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, size_t max) { return -1; }  // (not tracked)
int plat_any_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { return -1; }

bool plat_reset_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    mach_vm_address_t a = lo;
    return mach_vm_allocate(mach_task_self(), &a, hi - lo, VM_FLAGS_FIXED | VM_FLAGS_OVERWRITE) == KERN_SUCCESS;
}

void plat_commit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { (void)addr; (void)size; }

bool plat_committed_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t end, uint64_t *a, uint64_t *e) {  // (the whole window is backed)
    if (addr >= end) return false;
    *a = addr, *e = end;
    return true;
}

void plat_decommit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { (void)addr; (void)size; }

int plat_protect(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int prot) {
    int p = prot == PLAT_PROT_NONE ? PROT_NONE : prot == PLAT_PROT_READ ? PROT_READ : PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE;
    return mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, p);
}

uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) {
    if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    return mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom;
}

void plat_sleep_until_ns(uint64_t t) {
    if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    mach_wait_until(t * tb.denom / tb.numer);
}

void plat_wait_until_ns(uint64_t t) { plat_sleep_until_ns(t); }  // (mach_wait_until doesn't spin)

int plat_cpu_count(void) { int n = (int)sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN); return n > 0 ? n : 1; }

void plat_cpu_placement(void) {}  // (one logical processor per core: measured on Windows only)

// Real-time (time-constraint) thread: exempt from the timer coalescing macOS applies to
// ordinary threads when the app isn't frontmost, which otherwise stretches 16ms waits to ~100ms.
void plat_thread_realtime(uint64_t period_ns) {
    if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    uint64_t period = period_ns * tb.denom / tb.numer;
    thread_time_constraint_policy_data_t pol = {
        .period = (uint32_t)period,
        .computation = (uint32_t)(period / 20),
        .constraint = (uint32_t)(period / 4),
        .preemptible = 1,
    };
    thread_policy_set(pthread_mach_thread_np(pthread_self()), THREAD_TIME_CONSTRAINT_POLICY, (thread_policy_t)&pol,
                      THREAD_TIME_CONSTRAINT_POLICY_COUNT);
}

void plat_thread_elevate(void) {}

const char *plat_log_path(void) { return ""; }  // (the log goes to stderr)

bool plat_exe_path(char *buf, size_t size) {
    uint32_t len = (uint32_t)size;
    return _NSGetExecutablePath(buf, &len) == 0;
}

void plat_exec(char *const argv[]) {
    if (argv) { execv(argv[0], argv); return; }
    char path[4096];
    if (plat_exe_path(path, sizeof path)) execv(path, *_NSGetArgv());
}

const char *plat_symbol(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset) {
    Dl_info di = {0};
    if (!dladdr((void *)(uintptr_t)pc, &di) || !di.dli_sname) return NULL;
    if (offset) *offset = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)di.dli_saddr;
    return di.dli_sname;
}

void plat_fatal_notice(void) {}  // (the log / terminal shows it)

void plat_print_backtrace(void) {
    void *bt[64];
    int n = backtrace(bt, 64);
    char **syms = backtrace_symbols(bt, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) fprintf(stderr, "  %s\n", syms[i]);
}

static void crash_handler(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *ctx) {
    ucontext_t *uc = ctx;
    static volatile int depth;
    if (sig == SIGABRT && depth++ > 0) { signal(SIGABRT, SIG_DFL); abort(); }  // (nested: just die - the report
                                                                               // itself aborting looped, 5.7 GB log)
    uint64_t fa = (uint64_t)si->si_addr;
    uint64_t pc = uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc, lr = uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__lr;
    if (rt_fault_watch(fa, pc)) return;
    char what[32];
    snprintf(what, sizeof what, "signal %d", sig);
    rt_fault_report(what, fa, pc, lr);
}

void plat_crash_handler_install(void) {
    stack_t ss = {.ss_sp = malloc(1 << 20), .ss_size = 1 << 20};
    sigaltstack(&ss, NULL);
    struct sigaction sa = {0};
    sa.sa_sigaction = crash_handler;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_ONSTACK;
    sigaction(SIGSEGV, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGBUS, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGILL, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGABRT, &sa, NULL);
}

// ---- child processes

    posix_spawnattr_init(&at);

    posix_spawnattr_setpgroup(&at, 0);
```

```h
// POSIX bits mingw-w64 lacks (included via runtime/platform.h on Windows only).
// Build with -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 so off_t / stat sizes are 64-bit (RomFS image offsets are > 4 GB).
#pragma once

// Positional read/write (thread-safe: does not move the descriptor's file pointer).
ssize_t pread(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, off_t off);
ssize_t pwrite(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n, off_t off);

static inline int setenv(const char *k, const char *v, int overwrite) {
    if (!overwrite && getenv(k)) return 0;
    return _putenv_s(k, v);
}
static inline int unsetenv(const char *k) { return _putenv_s(k, ""); }

static inline int fsync(int fd) { return _commit(fd); }

int __cdecl rand_s(unsigned int *v);  // (declared by stdlib.h only with _CRT_RAND_S)
#endif
static inline uint32_t arc4random(void) {
    unsigned v = 0;
    rand_s(&v);
    return v;
}

static inline uint32_t arc4random_uniform(uint32_t n) {
    if (n < 2) return 0;
    uint32_t min = -n % n, r;  // reject the low values that would bias the modulo
    do r = arc4random(); while (r < min);
    return r % n;
}

static inline size_t strlcpy(char *d, const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t len = strlen(s);
    if (n) {
        size_t k = len < n - 1 ? len : n - 1;
        memcpy(d, s, k);
        d[k] = 0;
    }
    return len;
}
static inline size_t strlcat(char *d, const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t dl = strnlen(d, n);
    if (dl == n) return n + strlen(s);
    return dl + strlcpy(d + dl, s, n - dl);
}
static inline char *strsep(char **sp, const char *delim) {
    char *s = *sp;
    if (!s) return NULL;
    char *e = s + strcspn(s, delim);
    *sp = *e ? e + 1 : NULL;
    *e = 0;
    return s;
}

static inline int plat_mkdir(const char *p, int mode) { (void)mode; return _mkdir(p); }

#ifndef PATH_MAX
#define PATH_MAX 260
#endif
static inline char *realpath(const char *p, char *out) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0 ? _fullpath(out, p, PATH_MAX) : NULL;
```

`runtime/platform/windows.c`:

```c
// Windows host layer (runtime/platform.h).
#include <windows.h>
#include <wingdi.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <timeapi.h>
#include <io.h>

#include "../gamelib.h"
#include "../platform.h"
#include "../settings.h"

// Hybrid laptops: the dedicated GPU. NVIDIA's Optimus driver can hide its GPU from a program it runs on the
// integrated one (an RTX 3050 laptop ran on its Intel GPU whatever the Windows and NVIDIA settings said, #415); AMD's
// switchable graphics read the second export. The executable's own exports, read when it starts. The GPU setting
// (SAVAGEWIND_GPU, Options) still picks another one.
__declspec(dllexport) DWORD NvOptimusEnablement = 1;
__declspec(dllexport) int AmdPowerXpressRequestHighPerformance = 1;

// ---- guest address space
// The window is reserved up front and committed per region (plat_commit from the loader / kernel). Anything
// the guest touches outside a committed region is committed on its first access by the exception handler
// below, so the window behaves like macOS's all-RW reservation. The OS itself (ReadFile into a guest buffer)
// does not fault: such buffers must be inside committed regions.
static uint64_t g_lo, g_hi;
#define COMMIT_CHUNK 0x10000ull
#define SPARSE_HEAP_MAX_PAGES (4ull * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 / COMMIT_CHUNK)
#define SPARSE_HEAP_BITMAP_WORDS ((SPARSE_HEAP_MAX_PAGES + 63) / 64)
static atomic_uint_fast64_t guest_commit_gen;
static uint64_t sparse_heap_base, sparse_heap_size;
static atomic_uint_fast64_t sparse_heap_pages[SPARSE_HEAP_BITMAP_WORDS];
static bool sparse_heap_enabled;
static bool sparse_heap_configured;

static void sparse_heap_note_commit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!size || addr >= sparse_heap_base + sparse_heap_size ||
        (addr < sparse_heap_base && size <= sparse_heap_base - addr)) return;
    uint64_t end = addr + size;
    if (end < addr || end > sparse_heap_base + sparse_heap_size) end = sparse_heap_base + sparse_heap_size;
    uint64_t first = (addr < sparse_heap_base ? 0 : addr - sparse_heap_base) / COMMIT_CHUNK;
    uint64_t last = (end - sparse_heap_base + COMMIT_CHUNK - 1) / COMMIT_CHUNK;
    for (uint64_t page = first; page < last && page < SPARSE_HEAP_MAX_PAGES; page++)
        atomic_fetch_or_explicit(&sparse_heap_pages[page / 64], 1ull << (page % 64), memory_order_relaxed);
}

static void sparse_heap_clear_pages(void) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < SPARSE_HEAP_BITMAP_WORDS; i++)
        atomic_store_explicit(&sparse_heap_pages[i], 0, memory_order_relaxed);
}

static bool guest_page_allows_access(DWORD protect, ULONG_PTR access) {
    if (protect & PAGE_GUARD) return false;
    protect &= 0xFF;
    if (access == 1)
        return protect == PAGE_READWRITE || protect == PAGE_WRITECOPY ||
               protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE || protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY;
    if (access == 8)
        return protect == PAGE_EXECUTE || protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_READ ||
               protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE || protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY;
    return protect == PAGE_READONLY || protect == PAGE_READWRITE || protect == PAGE_WRITECOPY ||
           protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_READ || protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE || protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY;
}

bool plat_guest_sparse_heap_enabled(void) {
    return sparse_heap_configured && sparse_heap_enabled;
}

void plat_guest_sparse_heap_configure(bool auto_on) {
    const char *override = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_VK_SPARSE_HEAP");
    if (override)
        sparse_heap_enabled = !strcmp(override, "1");
    else
        sparse_heap_enabled = g_settings.sparse_heap == SPARSE_HEAP_ON ||
                              (g_settings.sparse_heap == SPARSE_HEAP_AUTO && auto_on);
    sparse_heap_configured = true;
}

static bool lazy_commit(uint64_t a, ULONG_PTR access) {
    if (a < g_lo || a >= g_hi) return false;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    bool handled = false;
    if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &mi, sizeof mi)) {
        if (mi.State == MEM_RESERVE) {
            uint64_t base = a & ~(COMMIT_CHUNK - 1);
            if (VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)base, COMMIT_CHUNK, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)) {
                atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&guest_commit_gen, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
                sparse_heap_note_commit(base, COMMIT_CHUNK);
                handled = true;
            } else if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &mi, sizeof mi) && mi.State == MEM_COMMIT) {
                handled = guest_page_allows_access(mi.Protect, access);
            }
        } else if (mi.State == MEM_COMMIT) {
            handled = guest_page_allows_access(mi.Protect, access);
        }
    }
    return handled;
}

static bool g_report_crashes;
// (debug) the data watchpoint (runtime/dispatch.c) in single-step mode: after the faulting instruction runs on an
// open page, the trap flag brings us back here to close the page again, so no access slips through.
static __thread uint64_t t_reclose_page, t_written;

static LONG CALLBACK vectored_handler(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ep) {
    EXCEPTION_RECORD *er = ep->ExceptionRecord;
    if (er->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP && t_reclose_page) {
        uint64_t close = t_reclose_page;
        if (t_written) {  // the value the write left (logged by runtime/dispatch.c's watchpoint)
            uint64_t v = *(volatile uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)t_written;
            fprintf(stderr, "[watch]   -> %016llx\n", (unsigned long long)v);
            extern uint64_t rt_watch_after_write(uint64_t addr, uint64_t value);
            uint64_t moved = rt_watch_after_write(t_written, v);
            DWORD o;
            if (moved && moved != close) VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)moved, PLAT_PAGE, PAGE_NOACCESS, &o);
            t_written = 0;
        }
        DWORD old;
        VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)close, PLAT_PAGE, PAGE_NOACCESS, &old);
        t_reclose_page = 0;
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    }
    if (er->ExceptionCode != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION || er->NumberParameters < 2) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    uint64_t fa = er->ExceptionInformation[1];
    if (lazy_commit(fa, er->ExceptionInformation[0])) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    g_fault_is_write = er->ExceptionInformation[0] == 1;
    if (g_report_crashes && rt_fault_watch(fa, ep->ContextRecord->Rip)) {
        extern uint64_t rt_watch_step_page(uint64_t fa);  // runtime/dispatch.c: the page to close again, or 0
        uint64_t page = rt_watch_step_page(fa);
        if (page) {
            extern bool rt_watch_in_range(uint64_t fa);
            t_reclose_page = page;
            t_written = g_fault_is_write && rt_watch_in_range(fa) ? (fa & ~7ull) : 0;
            ep->ContextRecord->EFlags |= 0x100;  // TF: single-step the faulting instruction
        }
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    }
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

// MEM_WRITE_WATCH: Windows keeps which pages were written (plat_written_pages; the Vulkan backend refreshes its copy of
// the heap's geometry from it). SAVAGEWIND_NO_WRITE_WATCH=1, or a system that refuses it: a plain reservation.
static bool g_write_watch;

bool plat_reserve_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    void *p = NULL;
    if (!getenv("SAVAGEWIND_NO_WRITE_WATCH")) {
        p = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, hi - lo, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_WRITE_WATCH, PAGE_READWRITE);
        if (p && p != (void *)(uintptr_t)lo) VirtualFree(p, 0, MEM_RELEASE), p = NULL;
        g_write_watch = p != NULL;
    }
    if (!p) p = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, hi - lo, MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (p != (void *)(uintptr_t)lo) return false;
    g_lo = lo;
    g_hi = hi;
    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, vectored_handler);
    return true;
}

long plat_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, size_t max) {
    if (!g_write_watch || addr < g_lo || addr + size > g_hi || !max) return -1;
    ULONG_PTR n = max;
    DWORD gran;
    if (GetWriteWatch(WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET, (void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, (void **)pages, &n, &gran) != 0) return -1;
    return n >= max ? -1 : (long)n;  // (a full list may have left pages out)
}

int plat_any_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!g_write_watch || addr < g_lo || addr + size > g_hi) return -1;
    void *page;
    ULONG_PTR n = 1;
    DWORD gran;
    if (GetWriteWatch(0, (void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, &page, &n, &gran) != 0) return -1;
    return n != 0;
}

// Decommit everything: the range stays reserved, and pages come back zeroed when committed again (lazily).
bool plat_reset_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    bool ok = VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, hi - lo, MEM_DECOMMIT) != 0;
    if (ok) {
        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&guest_commit_gen, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
        if (lo < sparse_heap_base + sparse_heap_size && hi > sparse_heap_base)
            sparse_heap_clear_pages();
    }
    return ok;
}

void plat_commit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!size) return;
    uint64_t a = addr & ~0xFFFull, e = (addr + size + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull;
    if (!VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)a, e - a, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE))
        fprintf(stderr, "[plat] commit %llx+%llx failed (%lu)\n", (unsigned long long)addr,
                (unsigned long long)size, GetLastError());
    else {
        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&guest_commit_gen, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
        sparse_heap_note_commit(a, e - a);
    }
}

uint64_t plat_guest_commit_generation(void) {
    return atomic_load_explicit(&guest_commit_gen, memory_order_relaxed);
}

void plat_guest_sparse_heap_range(uint64_t base, uint64_t size) {
    sparse_heap_base = base;
    sparse_heap_size = size;
    sparse_heap_clear_pages();
}

uint64_t plat_guest_sparse_heap_committed_word(uint64_t word) {
    if (word >= SPARSE_HEAP_BITMAP_WORDS) return 0;
    return atomic_load_explicit(&sparse_heap_pages[word], memory_order_relaxed);
}

bool plat_guest_commit_sparse_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!size || addr < g_lo || addr >= g_hi || size > g_hi - addr) return false;
    uint64_t begin = addr & ~(COMMIT_CHUNK - 1);
    uint64_t end = (addr + size + COMMIT_CHUNK - 1) & ~(COMMIT_CHUNK - 1);
    if (end > g_hi) end = g_hi;
    bool needs_commit = false;
    for (uint64_t at = begin; at < end;) {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
        if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)at, &mi, sizeof mi) || !mi.RegionSize) return false;
        if (mi.State != MEM_COMMIT) needs_commit = true;
        uint64_t next = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mi.BaseAddress + mi.RegionSize;
        at = next < end ? next : end;
    }
    if (!needs_commit) return true;
    if (!VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)begin, end - begin, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[plat] sparse guest commit %llx+%llx failed (%lu)\n",
                (unsigned long long)addr, (unsigned long long)size, GetLastError());
        return false;
    }
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&guest_commit_gen, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    sparse_heap_note_commit(begin, end - begin);
    return true;
}

bool plat_committed_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t end, uint64_t *a, uint64_t *e) {
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    while (addr < end && VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, &mi, sizeof mi)) {
        uint64_t re = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mi.BaseAddress + mi.RegionSize;
        if (mi.State == MEM_COMMIT && !(mi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD))) {
            *a = addr, *e = re < end ? re : end;
            return true;
        }
        addr = re;
    }
    return false;
}

void plat_decommit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    uint64_t a = (addr + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull, e = (addr + size) & ~0xFFFull;  // (whole pages inside the range only)
    if (e > a && a >= g_lo && e <= g_hi) VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)a, e - a, MEM_DECOMMIT);
}

int plat_protect(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, int prot) {
    DWORD p = prot == PLAT_PROT_NONE ? PAGE_NOACCESS : prot == PLAT_PROT_READ ? PAGE_READONLY : PAGE_READWRITE, old;
    if (addr >= g_lo && addr < g_hi) plat_commit(addr, size);
    return VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size, p, &old) ? 0 : -1;
}

// ---- time
static LARGE_INTEGER qpf;

uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) {
    if (!qpf.QuadPart) QueryPerformanceFrequency(&qpf);
    LARGE_INTEGER t;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t);
    return (uint64_t)((unsigned __int128)t.QuadPart * 1000000000u / (uint64_t)qpf.QuadPart);
}

#ifndef CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION
#define CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION 0x2
#endif

// (one timer per thread, closed when the thread ends: guest threads come and go, a death reload creates new ones)
static pthread_key_t timer_key;
static pthread_once_t timer_once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
static void timer_close(void *h) { CloseHandle((HANDLE)h); }
static void timer_key_init(void) { pthread_key_create(&timer_key, timer_close); }

static HANDLE thread_timer(void) {
    static __thread HANDLE timer;
    if (!timer) {
        timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
        if (!timer) timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, 0, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
        if (timer) {
            pthread_once(&timer_once, timer_key_init);
            pthread_setspecific(timer_key, timer);
        }
    }
    return timer;
}

void plat_sleep_until_ns(uint64_t t) {
    HANDLE timer = thread_timer();
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
        if (now >= t) return;
        uint64_t left = t - now;
        if (left < 200000) { YieldProcessor(); continue; }  // last 0.2 ms: spin (timer slack)
        LARGE_INTEGER due = {.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)((left - 100000) / 100)};  // relative, 100 ns units
        if (!timer || !SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE)) { Sleep(1); continue; }
        WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
    }
}

// The same timer, without the spin: back about 0.5 ms late at worst. (MinGW's nanosleep counts whole milliseconds:
// under 1 ms it returns at once, so a loop around it spins, and 1.9 ms sleeps 1 ms.)
void plat_wait_until_ns(uint64_t t) {
    HANDLE timer = thread_timer();
    for (uint64_t now; (now = plat_now_ns()) < t;) {
        LARGE_INTEGER due = {.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)((t - now + 99) / 100)};
        if (!timer || !SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE)) { Sleep(1); continue; }
        WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
    }
}

void plat_thread_realtime(uint64_t period_ns) {
    (void)period_ns;
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_TIME_CRITICAL);
}

void plat_thread_elevate(void) {
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_ABOVE_NORMAL);
}

// ---- process
// Release builds are GUI-subsystem executables (no console window): stdout / stderr go to savagewind.log next to the
// exe, and a fatal error shows a message box (plat_fatal_notice) instead of vanishing. Processes started by this one
// (the start screen re-executing itself for the game) append to the same log.
static char g_log_path[MAX_PATH];

static void log_to_file_without_console(void) {
    if (GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE) && GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE) != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;  // console / pipe
    char exe[MAX_PATH];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, exe, sizeof exe);
    if (!n || n >= sizeof exe) return;
    char *slash = strrchr(exe, '\\');
    if (slash) slash[1] = 0;
    snprintf(g_log_path, sizeof g_log_path, "%ssavagewind.log", exe);
    bool append = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_APPEND") != NULL;
    if (!append) {  // the last run's log stays as savagewind.prev.log: opening again after a failed setup kept nothing of it
        char prev[MAX_PATH + 16];
        snprintf(prev, sizeof prev, "%ssavagewind.prev.log", exe);
        MoveFileExA(g_log_path, prev, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING);
    }
    if (!freopen(g_log_path, append ? "ab" : "wb", stderr)) { g_log_path[0] = 0; return; }
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    _dup2(_fileno(stderr), _fileno(stdout));
    _putenv("SAVAGEWIND_LOG_APPEND=1");
}

// The recompiled game code is built for a target this CPU runs (runtime/gamelib.h): say so instead of crashing with an
// illegal instruction on a CPU too old for any.
static void require_cpu(void) {
    const char *need = gamelib_cpu_problem();
    if (!need) return;
    char text[256];
    snprintf(text, sizeof text, "Savage Wind needs %s.", need);
    MessageBoxA(NULL, text, "Savage Wind", MB_ICONERROR | MB_OK);
    ExitProcess(1);
}

// Fatal error (rt_fatal_trace): the last FATAL / exception line of the log in a message box, when there is no console.
void plat_fatal_notice(void) {
    plat_accessibility_shortcuts(true);  // (the shortcuts as they were: the process ends)
    if (!g_log_path[0]) return;
    fflush(stderr);
    char text[1024] = "Savage Wind stopped because of an error.";
    FILE *f = fopen(g_log_path, "rb");
    if (f) {
        static char tail[16384];
        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
        long sz = ftell(f), from = sz > (long)sizeof tail - 1 ? sz - (long)sizeof tail + 1 : 0;
        fseek(f, from, SEEK_SET);
        size_t got = fread(tail, 1, sizeof tail - 1, f);
        tail[got] = 0;
        fclose(f);
        char *line = NULL;
        for (char *p = tail; (p = strstr(p, "FATAL: ")) != NULL; p++) line = p;
        if (!line) for (char *p = tail; (p = strstr(p, "*** ")) != NULL; p++) line = p;
        if (line) {
            char *end = strchr(line, '\n');
            if (end) *end = 0;
            snprintf(text, sizeof text, "Savage Wind stopped because of an error:\n\n%.600s", line);
            if (strstr(line, "device lost")) {
                size_t l = strlen(text);
                snprintf(text + l, sizeof text - l, "\n\nThe graphics driver reset the GPU. Usually a frame took it too long "
                         "(Windows resets a GPU after 2 seconds) or it ran out of video memory. Lower Video > Upscaler "
                         "quality and Shadow resolution, close other programs and update the driver; on a laptop, run "
                         "Savage Wind on the dedicated GPU.");
            } else if (strstr(line, "GPU ran out of memory")) {  // (vk.h VK_CHECK: out of device or host memory, #117)
                size_t l = strlen(text);
                snprintf(text + l, sizeof text - l, "\n\nThe graphics card ran out of memory. Integrated graphics share the "
                         "PC's RAM, and Savage Wind keeps the game's 3 GB of memory available to the GPU: with integrated "
                         "graphics it needs 16 GB of RAM. Close other programs and lower Video > Shadow resolution and the "
                         "upscaler quality; with a dedicated GPU, update its driver.");
            } else if (strstr(line, "Vulkan 1.3") || strstr(line, "vkCreateInstance")) {  // (no driver, or too old)
                size_t l = strlen(text);
                snprintf(text + l, sizeof text - l, "\n\nSavage Wind needs a graphics driver with Vulkan 1.3: install the "
                         "latest driver for your GPU (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel).");
            } else if (strstr(line, "Vulkan") || strstr(line, "VK_") || strstr(line, "vk")) {  // (any other driver error)
                size_t l = strlen(text);
                snprintf(text + l, sizeof text - l, "\n\nThe graphics driver reported an error. Updating the driver for "
                         "your GPU may help; if it keeps happening, please report it with the log below.");
            }
        }
    }
    size_t l = strlen(text);
    snprintf(text + l, sizeof text - l, "\n\nDetails: %s", g_log_path);
    MessageBoxA(NULL, text, "Savage Wind", MB_ICONERROR | MB_OK);
}

void plat_init(void) {
    log_to_file_without_console();
    require_cpu();
    _fmode = _O_BINARY;  // fopen/open default to binary (the runtime's "r"/"w" files are binary or LF text)
    _setmode(_fileno(stdout), _O_BINARY);
    _setmode(_fileno(stderr), _O_BINARY);
    SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8);
    // Opt out of EcoQoS and of Windows 11 ignoring the timer resolution while the window is occluded, before asking
    // for 1 ms: a request made earlier stays ignored (Sleep(1) took 15.6 ms in hidden test runs).
    PROCESS_POWER_THROTTLING_STATE pt = {
        .Version = PROCESS_POWER_THROTTLING_CURRENT_VERSION,
        .ControlMask = PROCESS_POWER_THROTTLING_EXECUTION_SPEED | PROCESS_POWER_THROTTLING_IGNORE_TIMER_RESOLUTION,
        .StateMask = 0,
    };
    SetProcessInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), ProcessPowerThrottling, &pt, sizeof pt);
    timeBeginPeriod(1);  // 1 ms Sleep / condition-variable timeouts (default 15.6 ms)
}

// One logical processor per physical core for the whole process: the game's main thread and the render thread then
// never share a core with another busy thread of the game. With fewer cores than the game's busy threads (main, two job
// workers, render, recorder, audio, file loading) they queue for one instead: by default with SMT and 4 or more
// physical cores (plat_one_per_core_default). SAVAGEWIND_ONE_PER_CORE=1: always, 0: never. Called when the game
// starts, so what the start screen runs (the game code build) keeps every logical processor. On hybrid architectures
// (Intel 12th+ Gen, Core Ultra, heterogeneous P/E cores) keeping all logical processors avoids starving P-core SMT
// execution slots and forcing critical threads onto low-clock E-cores. Under Wine / Proton the Linux kernel schedules
// the threads, and there the Steam Deck measured one processor per core as a loss (platform.h): the default keeps
// every logical processor, as the Linux build does.
void plat_cpu_placement(void) {
    DWORD_PTR all, sys, one = 0;
    if (!GetProcessAffinityMask(GetCurrentProcess(), &all, &sys)) return;
    HMODULE ntdll = GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll");
    bool wine = ntdll && GetProcAddress(ntdll, "wine_get_version") != NULL;
    int logical = __builtin_popcountll((unsigned long long)all), cores = 0;
    DWORD len = 0;
    GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx(RelationProcessorCore, NULL, &len);
    char *buf = len ? malloc(len) : NULL;
    BYTE min_eff = 255, max_eff = 0;
    if (buf && GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx(RelationProcessorCore, (void *)buf, &len))
        for (DWORD o = 0; o < len;) {
            SYSTEM_LOGICAL_PROCESSOR_INFORMATION_EX *e = (void *)(buf + o);
            DWORD_PTR m = e->Processor.GroupMask[0].Group == 0 ? e->Processor.GroupMask[0].Mask & all : 0;
            if (m) {
                cores++;
                one |= m & -m;  // (the core's first logical processor)
                BYTE eff = e->Processor.EfficiencyClass;
                if (eff < min_eff) min_eff = eff;
                if (eff > max_eff) max_eff = eff;
            }
            o += e->Size;
        }
    free(buf);
    bool hybrid = (cores > 0 && min_eff != max_eff);
    const char *x = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_ONE_PER_CORE");
    bool on = one && (x ? atoi(x) != 0 : !wine && !hybrid && plat_one_per_core_default(cores, logical));
    fprintf(stderr, "[cpu] %d cores%s, %d logical processors: %s%s\n", cores,
            hybrid ? " (hybrid P/E)" : "", logical,
            on ? "one logical processor per core" : "all logical processors",
            wine && !x ? " (Wine)" : hybrid && !x ? " (hybrid architecture)" : "");
    if (on) SetProcessAffinityMask(GetCurrentProcess(), one);
}

int plat_cpu_count(void) {
    DWORD_PTR proc, sys;
    if (GetProcessAffinityMask(GetCurrentProcess(), &proc, &sys) && proc) return __builtin_popcountll((unsigned long long)proc);
    SYSTEM_INFO si;
    GetSystemInfo(&si);
    return (int)si.dwNumberOfProcessors;
}

const char *plat_log_path(void) { return g_log_path; }

bool plat_exe_path(char *buf, size_t size) {
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, buf, (DWORD)size);
    return n > 0 && n < size;
}

// Quote one argument the way CommandLineToArgvW / the CRT parse it back.
static void append_arg(char *out, size_t cap, const char *a) {
    size_t n = strlen(out);
    bool q = !*a || strpbrk(a, " \t\"") != NULL;
    if (n && n + 1 < cap) out[n++] = ' ';
    if (q && n + 1 < cap) out[n++] = '"';
    for (const char *p = a; *p; p++) {
        int bs = 0;
        while (*p == '\\') { bs++; p++; }
        int reps = !*p ? (q ? 2 * bs : bs) : *p == '"' ? 2 * bs + 1 : bs;
        for (int i = 0; i < reps && n + 1 < cap; i++) out[n++] = '\\';
        if (!*p) break;
        if (n + 1 < cap) out[n++] = *p;
    }
    if (q && n + 1 < cap) out[n++] = '"';
    out[n] = 0;
}

// No exec() on Windows: start the new process with the same console / standard handles, then exit.
void plat_exec(char *const argv[]) {
    STARTUPINFOW si = {.cb = sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    BOOL ok;
    fflush(stdout);
    fflush(stderr);
    if (!argv) {
        ok = CreateProcessW(NULL, GetCommandLineW(), NULL, NULL, TRUE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
    } else {
        static char cmd[32768];
        cmd[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; argv[i]; i++) append_arg(cmd, sizeof cmd, argv[i]);
        static wchar_t wcmd[32768];
        MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, cmd, -1, wcmd, 32768);
        ok = CreateProcessW(NULL, wcmd, NULL, NULL, TRUE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
    }
    if (!ok) return;
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    ExitProcess(0);
}

// ---- diagnostics
// DLL frames are named module+offset; frames in our own executable are left to the caller, which maps
// them to guest functions (runtime/dispatch.c) - mingw builds carry DWARF, not PDB symbols.
const char *plat_symbol(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset) {
    static __thread char name[MAX_PATH];
    HMODULE m;
    if (!GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                            (LPCSTR)(uintptr_t)pc, &m))
        return NULL;
    if (m == GetModuleHandleA(NULL)) return NULL;
    char path[MAX_PATH];
    if (!GetModuleFileNameA(m, path, sizeof path)) return NULL;
    const char *b = strrchr(path, '\\');
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s", b ? b + 1 : path);
    if (offset) *offset = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m;
    return name;
}

const char *rt_host_fn_name(uint64_t pc, uint64_t *offset);  // runtime/dispatch.c

void plat_print_backtrace(void) {
    void *bt[64];
    USHORT n = RtlCaptureStackBackTrace(0, 64, bt, NULL);
    uint64_t exe = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleA(NULL);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t pc = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)bt[i], off = 0;
        const char *s = plat_symbol(pc, &off);
        if (!s) s = rt_host_fn_name(pc, &off);
        if (s) fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx %s+%llx\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc, s, (unsigned long long)off);
        else fprintf(stderr, "  #%-2d %016llx savagewind+%llx\n", i, (unsigned long long)pc,
                     (unsigned long long)(pc - exe));
    }
}

static LONG WINAPI unhandled_filter(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ep) {
    EXCEPTION_RECORD *er = ep->ExceptionRecord;
    uint64_t fa = er->NumberParameters >= 2 ? er->ExceptionInformation[1] : 0;
    if (er->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && er->NumberParameters >= 2) {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi = {0};
        const char *access = er->ExceptionInformation[0] == 0 ? "read" :
                             er->ExceptionInformation[0] == 1 ? "write" :
                             er->ExceptionInformation[0] == 8 ? "execute" : "unknown";
        if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)fa, &mi, sizeof mi))
            fprintf(stderr, "[plat] access violation: %s at %#llx, allocation %#llx+%#llx, state %#lx, protection %#lx\n",
                    access, (unsigned long long)fa, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)mi.AllocationBase,
                    (unsigned long long)mi.RegionSize, (unsigned long)mi.State, (unsigned long)mi.Protect);
        else
            fprintf(stderr, "[plat] access violation: %s at %#llx, VirtualQuery failed (%lu)\n",
                    access, (unsigned long long)fa, GetLastError());
    }
    char what[48];
    snprintf(what, sizeof what, "exception %08lx", er->ExceptionCode);
    // x64 has no link register: report the return address on top of the stack (valid at function entry).
    uint64_t lr = 0;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mi;
    if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)ep->ContextRecord->Rsp, &mi, sizeof mi) && mi.State == MEM_COMMIT)
        lr = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)ep->ContextRecord->Rsp;
    rt_fault_report(what, fa, ep->ContextRecord->Rip, lr);
}

void plat_crash_handler_install(void) {
    ULONG guarantee = 64 << 10;  // room for the report after a stack overflow
    SetThreadStackGuarantee(&guarantee);
    if (g_report_crashes) return;
    g_report_crashes = true;
    SetUnhandledExceptionFilter(unhandled_filter);
}

// ---- POSIX shims (win_compat.h)
static ssize_t prw(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, off_t off, bool write) {
    HANDLE h = (HANDLE)_get_osfhandle(fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return -1;
    size_t done = 0;
    while (done < n) {
        OVERLAPPED ov = {0};
        uint64_t o = (uint64_t)off + done;
        ov.Offset = (DWORD)o;
        ov.OffsetHigh = (DWORD)(o >> 32);
        DWORD chunk = n - done > 0x40000000 ? 0x40000000 : (DWORD)(n - done), got = 0;
        BOOL ok = write ? WriteFile(h, (const char *)buf + done, chunk, &got, &ov)
                        : ReadFile(h, (char *)buf + done, chunk, &got, &ov);
        if (!ok) {
            if (GetLastError() == ERROR_HANDLE_EOF) break;
            return done ? (ssize_t)done : -1;
        }
        if (!got) break;
        done += got;
    }
    return (ssize_t)done;
}
ssize_t pread(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, off_t off) { return prw(fd, buf, n, off, false); }
ssize_t pwrite(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n, off_t off) { return prw(fd, (void *)buf, n, off, true); }

// ---- child processes
PlatProc plat_spawn(const char *const argv[], const char *log_path, bool append_log) {
    static __thread char cmd[32768];
    cmd[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; argv[i]; i++) append_arg(cmd, sizeof cmd, argv[i]);
    static __thread wchar_t wcmd[32768], wlog[MAX_PATH];
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, cmd, -1, wcmd, 32768);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, log_path ? log_path : "NUL", -1, wlog, MAX_PATH);
    SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa = {.nLength = sizeof sa, .bInheritHandle = TRUE};
    HANDLE log = CreateFileW(wlog, append_log ? FILE_APPEND_DATA : GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
                             &sa, append_log ? OPEN_ALWAYS : CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    if (log == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    STARTUPINFOW si = {.cb = sizeof si, .dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES, .hStdInput = NULL, .hStdOutput = log,
                       .hStdError = log};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    // CreateProcess doesn't resolve relative paths written with '/' (e.g. a helper under tools/): pass the program
    // as a full path, like posix_spawn takes it as given
    static __thread wchar_t wprog[MAX_PATH], wfull[MAX_PATH];
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, argv[0], -1, wprog, MAX_PATH);
    for (wchar_t *p = wprog; *p; p++) if (*p == L'/') *p = L'\\';
    const wchar_t *app = GetFullPathNameW(wprog, MAX_PATH, wfull, NULL) ? wfull : NULL;
    // The game code generator (swgen.exe, PyInstaller) without Control Flow Guard, whatever its header says: its code
    // generator longjmps out of the code it generated, which CFG ends the process for. Clearing the header bit
    // (tools/pe_no_cfg.py) isn't enough on some Windows 11 builds (#113); this is what Exploit protection's per-program
    // "CFG: off" does, for this process only. Without the attribute (older Windows), started as before.
    const char *base = strrchr(argv[0], '\\') > strrchr(argv[0], '/') ? strrchr(argv[0], '\\') : strrchr(argv[0], '/');
    base = base ? base + 1 : argv[0];
    BOOL ok = FALSE;
    if (!_stricmp(base, "swgen.exe")) {
        static __thread uint8_t attrs[256];
        LPPROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_LIST list = (LPPROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_LIST)attrs;
        SIZE_T size = sizeof attrs;
        DWORD64 policy = PROCESS_CREATION_MITIGATION_POLICY_CONTROL_FLOW_GUARD_ALWAYS_OFF;
        if (InitializeProcThreadAttributeList(list, 1, 0, &size)) {
            STARTUPINFOEXW six = {.StartupInfo = si, .lpAttributeList = list};
            six.StartupInfo.cb = sizeof six;
            if (UpdateProcThreadAttribute(list, 0, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_MITIGATION_POLICY, &policy, sizeof policy, NULL, NULL))
                ok = CreateProcessW(app, wcmd, NULL, NULL, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW | CREATE_SUSPENDED | EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT,
                                    NULL, NULL, &six.StartupInfo, &pi);
            DeleteProcThreadAttributeList(list);
        }
    }
    if (!ok) ok = CreateProcessW(app, wcmd, NULL, NULL, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW | CREATE_SUSPENDED, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
    if (!ok) fprintf(stderr, "[plat] could not start %s (error %lu)\n", argv[0], GetLastError());
    CloseHandle(log);
    if (!ok) return 0;
    // every child in one job that ends with this process (a compiler's own children too: no leftovers on quit)
    static HANDLE job;
    if (!job && (job = CreateJobObjectW(NULL, NULL))) {
        JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION li = {0};
        li.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE;
        SetInformationJobObject(job, JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, &li, sizeof li);
    }
    if (job) AssignProcessToJobObject(job, pi.hProcess);
    ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    return (PlatProc)pi.hProcess;
}

void plat_proc_kill(PlatProc p) {  // (what it started ends with this process: the job above)
    TerminateProcess((HANDLE)p, 255);
    WaitForSingleObject((HANDLE)p, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle((HANDLE)p);
}

int plat_proc_wait(PlatProc p, bool block) {
    HANDLE h = (HANDLE)p;
    DWORD w = WaitForSingleObject(h, block ? INFINITE : 0);
    if (w == WAIT_TIMEOUT) return -1;
    if (w != WAIT_OBJECT_0) return 255;  // (not a process we can wait for: ended as far as the caller is concerned)
    DWORD code = 255;
    GetExitCodeProcess(h, &code);
    CloseHandle(h);
    return code > 255 ? 255 : (int)code;  // (a crash's NTSTATUS, e.g. 0xC0000409, is not "still running" (-1))
}

// ---- HDR display peak from the Windows HDR calibration ICC profile
// The app's profile has an MHC2 private tag: signature, reserved, regamma LUT size, min luminance, max luminance (both
// ICC s15Fixed16, in cd/m2), then offsets and the LUT data. max_luminance is the display's small-area peak; the standard
// lumi tag is the maximum full-frame luminance. We use the peak, as the game's highlight peak.
static uint32_t icc_be32(const uint8_t *p) {
    return (uint32_t)p[0] << 24 | (uint32_t)p[1] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 8 | p[3];
}

static int icc_file_peak(const wchar_t *path) {
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING,
                           FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    LARGE_INTEGER sz;
    uint8_t *d = NULL;
    DWORD got = 0;
    if (!GetFileSizeEx(h, &sz) || sz.QuadPart < 132 || sz.QuadPart > (1 << 20)) goto done;
    d = malloc((size_t)sz.QuadPart);
    if (!d || !ReadFile(h, d, (DWORD)sz.QuadPart, &got, NULL) || (LONGLONG)got != sz.QuadPart ||
        memcmp(d + 36, "acsp", 4))
        goto done;
    uint32_t n = icc_be32(d + 128);
    if (n > 256 || 132 + (size_t)n * 12 > (size_t)sz.QuadPart) goto done;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const uint8_t *tag = d + 132 + i * 12;
        uint32_t off = icc_be32(tag + 4), len = icc_be32(tag + 8);
        if (off > (uint32_t)sz.QuadPart || len > (uint32_t)sz.QuadPart - off) continue;
        if (!memcmp(tag, "MHC2", 4) && len >= 20) {
            int32_t v = (int32_t)icc_be32(d + off + 16);  // max_luminance, s15Fixed16
            double nits = (double)v / 65536.0;
            if (nits >= 80.0 && nits <= 10000.0) {
                int peak = (int)(nits + 0.5);
                free(d);
                CloseHandle(h);
                return peak;
            }
        }
    }
done:
    free(d);
    CloseHandle(h);
    return 0;
}

// The active HDR profile is in the display class's per-user ICM profile associations (ICMProfileAC), one group per
// monitor. The group's last profile is the HDR one (e.g. {SDR.icc, HDR Calibrated Profile.icc}). Pick the group for
// the game window's monitor; the desktop's GetICMProfile often returns only the SDR sRGB profile.
typedef struct {
    wchar_t sub[64];
} IccGroup;

static int icc_group_cmp(const void *a, const void *b) {
    return wcscmp(((const IccGroup *)a)->sub, ((const IccGroup *)b)->sub);
}

static int icc_registry_peak_for_display(int display, wchar_t *name, size_t name_cap) {
    HKEY hk;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER,
                      L"Software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\ICM\\ProfileAssociations\\Display\\"
                      L"{4d36e96e-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}", 0, KEY_READ, &hk) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
        return 0;
    wchar_t dir[1024];
    UINT dn = GetWindowsDirectoryW(dir, 1000);
    const wchar_t *icc_dir = L"\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color\\";
    if (dn && dn + wcslen(icc_dir) < 1024) wcscat(dir, icc_dir);
    else wcscpy(dir, L"C:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color\\");
    IccGroup groups[32];
    int ng = 0;
    for (DWORD i = 0; ng < 32; i++) {
        wchar_t sub[256];
        DWORD sn = 256;
        if (RegEnumKeyExW(hk, i, sub, &sn, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) != ERROR_SUCCESS) break;
        HKEY k;
        if (RegOpenKeyExW(hk, sub, 0, KEY_READ, &k) != ERROR_SUCCESS) continue;
        DWORD type = 0, cb = 0;
        if (RegQueryValueExW(k, L"ICMProfileAC", NULL, &type, NULL, &cb) == ERROR_SUCCESS && cb > 0 &&
            (type == REG_MULTI_SZ || type == REG_SZ))
            swprintf(groups[ng++].sub, 64, L"%s", sub);
        RegCloseKey(k);
    }
    if (!ng) { RegCloseKey(hk); return 0; }
    qsort(groups, ng, sizeof groups[0], icc_group_cmp);
    int gi = display > 0 ? display - 1 : 0;  // DISPLAY1 -> first monitor group, etc.
    if (gi < 0 || gi >= ng) gi = 0;  // (unknown display: best effort on the first group)
    HKEY k;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(hk, groups[gi].sub, 0, KEY_READ, &k) != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        RegCloseKey(hk);
        return 0;
    }
    int peak = 0;
    DWORD type = 0, cb = 0;
    if (RegQueryValueExW(k, L"ICMProfileAC", NULL, &type, NULL, &cb) == ERROR_SUCCESS && cb > 0) {
        wchar_t *list = malloc(cb + sizeof(wchar_t));
        if (list && RegQueryValueExW(k, L"ICMProfileAC", NULL, &type, (BYTE *)list, &cb) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
            list[cb / sizeof(wchar_t)] = 0;
            for (wchar_t *s = list; *s; s += wcslen(s) + 1) {
                wchar_t path[1024];
                if (wcschr(s, L'\\')) swprintf(path, 1024, L"%s", s);
                else swprintf(path, 1024, L"%s%s", dir, s);
                int p = icc_file_peak(path);
                if (p > 0) {  // the last valid profile is the HDR calibration
                    peak = p;
                    swprintf(name, name_cap, L"%s", s);
                }
            }
        }
        free(list);
    }
    RegCloseKey(k);
    RegCloseKey(hk);
    return peak;
}

int plat_hdr_peak_nits(void *hwnd_, char *profile, size_t profile_size) {
    HWND hwnd = (HWND)hwnd_;
    HMONITOR mon = hwnd ? MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST)
                        : MonitorFromPoint((POINT){0, 0}, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY);
    MONITORINFOEXW mi;
    mi.cbSize = sizeof mi;
    int display = 0;
    if (mon && GetMonitorInfoW(mon, (MONITORINFO *)&mi))
        swscanf(mi.szDevice, L"\\\\.\\DISPLAY%d", &display);
    wchar_t name[512] = L"";
    int peak = icc_registry_peak_for_display(display, name, 512);
    if (!peak) {  // (the display's SDR profile may still carry an MHC2 tag)
        HDC hdc = GetDC(hwnd);
        wchar_t path[1024];
        DWORD n = 1024;
        if (hdc && GetICMProfileW(hdc, &n, path)) {
            peak = icc_file_peak(path);
            if (peak) {
                const wchar_t *slash = wcsrchr(path, L'\\');
                swprintf(name, 512, L"%s", slash ? slash + 1 : path);
            }
        }
        if (hdc) ReleaseDC(hwnd, hdc);
    }
    if (profile && profile_size) {
        profile[0] = 0;
        if (peak) WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, name, -1, profile, (int)profile_size, NULL, NULL);
    }
    return peak;
}

bool plat_remove_tree(const char *dir) {
    // SHFileOperation wants a double-NUL-terminated path with backslashes
    static __thread wchar_t w[MAX_PATH + 2];
    int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, dir, -1, w, MAX_PATH);
    if (n <= 1) return false;
    w[n] = 0;
    for (wchar_t *p = w; *p; p++) if (*p == L'/') *p = L'\\';
    SHFILEOPSTRUCTW op = {.wFunc = FO_DELETE, .pFrom = w, .fFlags = FOF_NO_UI};
    return SHFileOperationW(&op) == 0 && !op.fAnyOperationsAborted;
}

// Windows' accessibility shortcuts while the game has the focus: pressing Shift five times (Sticky Keys), holding the
// right Shift for eight seconds (Filter Keys) or Num Lock for five (Toggle Keys) took the player out to their prompt,
// and Shift is sprint and back. As Microsoft advises for games ("Disabling Shortcut Keys in Games"): the shortcut is
// turned off while the window has the focus, only where the feature itself is off (a player who uses it keeps it),
// and the settings as they were come back when the focus goes and when the game ends. Not written to the user's
// profile (no SPIF_UPDATEINIFILE), so a crash leaves them until the next sign-in at worst.
static STICKYKEYS sk_was = {sizeof(STICKYKEYS)};
static TOGGLEKEYS tk_was = {sizeof(TOGGLEKEYS)};
static FILTERKEYS fk_was = {sizeof(FILTERKEYS)};
static bool shortcuts_read, shortcuts_off;
static void shortcuts_restore(void) { plat_accessibility_shortcuts(true); }

void plat_accessibility_shortcuts(bool allow) {
    if (!shortcuts_read) {
        if (!SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETSTICKYKEYS, sizeof sk_was, &sk_was, 0) ||
            !SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETTOGGLEKEYS, sizeof tk_was, &tk_was, 0) ||
            !SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETFILTERKEYS, sizeof fk_was, &fk_was, 0))
            return;
        shortcuts_read = true;
        atexit(shortcuts_restore);  // (a plain exit; plat_terminate and plat_fatal_notice put them back themselves)
    }
    if (!allow && !shortcuts_off) {
        STICKYKEYS sk = sk_was;
        TOGGLEKEYS tk = tk_was;
        FILTERKEYS fk = fk_was;
        if (!(sk.dwFlags & SKF_STICKYKEYSON)) sk.dwFlags &= ~(DWORD)(SKF_HOTKEYACTIVE | SKF_CONFIRMHOTKEY);
        if (!(tk.dwFlags & TKF_TOGGLEKEYSON)) tk.dwFlags &= ~(DWORD)(TKF_HOTKEYACTIVE | TKF_CONFIRMHOTKEY);
        if (!(fk.dwFlags & FKF_FILTERKEYSON)) fk.dwFlags &= ~(DWORD)(FKF_HOTKEYACTIVE | FKF_CONFIRMHOTKEY);
        SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_SETSTICKYKEYS, sizeof sk, &sk, 0);
        SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_SETTOGGLEKEYS, sizeof tk, &tk, 0);
        SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_SETFILTERKEYS, sizeof fk, &fk, 0);
        shortcuts_off = true;
    } else if (allow && shortcuts_off) {
        SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_SETSTICKYKEYS, sizeof sk_was, &sk_was, 0);
        SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_SETTOGGLEKEYS, sizeof tk_was, &tk_was, 0);
        SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_SETFILTERKEYS, sizeof fk_was, &fk_was, 0);
        shortcuts_off = false;
    }
}

// End the process at once, skipping DLL teardown (from an atexit handler, after flushing). Exit status 0.
void plat_terminate(void) {
    plat_accessibility_shortcuts(true);  // (the atexit handlers after this one don't run)
    TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 0);
}
```

`runtime/platform/windows_config.c`:

```c
// "Savage Wind Configuration.exe" (Windows; build/savagewind-config.exe in a build): starts savagewind.exe from its own
// folder with --config, the configuration screen (runtime/ui/launcher.mm: Play, Settings, the game files, Quit), and
// passes its own arguments on. A plain start of savagewind.exe goes straight into the game once the game files are set
// up. This is its own small program, not savagewind.exe under a second name: the game code library imports from
// savagewind.exe by that name. A GUI program with the same icon (runtime/platform/windows.rc), no console.
#include <wchar.h>
#include <windows.h>

// The command line after the program's own name (as CommandLineToArgvW splits it: quoted, or up to a space)
static const wchar_t *args_after_name(const wchar_t *c) {
    if (*c == L'"') {
        for (c++; *c && *c != L'"'; c++) {}
        if (*c) c++;
    } else
        while (*c && *c != L' ' && *c != L'\t') c++;
    while (*c == L' ' || *c == L'\t') c++;
    return c;
}

int main(void) {
    wchar_t exe[4096];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, exe, sizeof exe / sizeof *exe);
    wchar_t *slash = n && n < sizeof exe / sizeof *exe ? wcsrchr(exe, L'\\') : NULL;
    if (!slash) return 1;
    // An update cut off halfway (a power cut, runtime/platform/windows_update.c): put the files back before anything loads them
    wcscpy(slash + 1, L"update\\journal.txt");
    if (GetFileAttributesW(exe) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
        wcscpy(slash + 1, L"SW Update.exe");
        wchar_t recover[4200];
        swprintf(recover, sizeof recover / sizeof *recover, L"\"%ls\" --recover", exe);
        STARTUPINFOW rsi = {sizeof rsi};
        PROCESS_INFORMATION rpi;
        if (CreateProcessW(exe, recover, NULL, NULL, FALSE, 0, NULL, NULL, &rsi, &rpi)) {
            WaitForSingleObject(rpi.hProcess, INFINITE);
            CloseHandle(rpi.hThread);
            CloseHandle(rpi.hProcess);
        }
    }
    wcscpy(slash + 1, L"savagewind.exe");
    const wchar_t *rest = args_after_name(GetCommandLineW());
    size_t cap = wcslen(exe) + wcslen(rest) + 32;
    wchar_t *line = HeapAlloc(GetProcessHeap(), 0, cap * sizeof *line);
    if (!line) return 1;
    swprintf(line, cap, L"\"%ls\" --config%ls%ls", exe, *rest ? L" " : L"", rest);
    STARTUPINFOW si = {sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    AllowSetForegroundWindow(ASFW_ANY);  // (its window comes up in front, as this one would have)
    // (the working folder stays this one's: savagewind.exe finds its data folder from it, runtime/paths.c)
    if (!CreateProcessW(exe, line, NULL, NULL, FALSE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) {
        wchar_t msg[4400];
        swprintf(msg, sizeof msg / sizeof *msg, L"Savage Wind Configuration can't start\n%ls\n\nIt has to be in the same "
                 L"folder as savagewind.exe.", exe);
        MessageBoxW(NULL, msg, L"Savage Wind", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
        return 1;
    }
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    return 0;
}

```
