```c
    cache_file(q, sizeof q, "");
    MAKE_DIR(q);
#ifdef _WIN32
    clear_amd_vulkan_cache();
#endif
    write_line(p, version);
    fprintf(stderr, "[update] new version %s: shader caches emptied\n", version);
}

#ifdef _WIN32
static bool update_dir(char *out, size_t n) {
    char m[1100];
    if (!rt_resource("sw-manifest.txt", NULL, m, sizeof m)) return false;
    char *s = strrchr(m, '/'), *b = strrchr(m, '\\');
    if (b > s) s = b;
    if (!s) return false;
    *s = 0;
    snprintf(out, n, "%s/update", m);
    return true;
}
#endif

void post_update_finish(const char *version) {
    if (!post_update_shipped()) return;
    char p[1100];
    cache_file(p, sizeof p, "");
    MAKE_DIR(p);
    cache_file(p, sizeof p, "last-version.txt");
    write_line(p, version);
    cache_file(p, sizeof p, "update-failed.txt");
    remove(p);
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (update_dir(p, sizeof p)) remove_tree(p);
#else
    appimage_remove_old();
#endif
    fprintf(stderr, "[update] version %s is set up\n", version);
}

void post_update_tidy(const char *version) {
    char q[1100], last[80] = "";
    if (!post_update_shipped()) return;
    cache_file(q, sizeof q, "last-version.txt");
    if (!read_line(q, last, sizeof last) || strcmp(last, version)) return;
#ifdef _WIN32
    char p[1100];
    if (update_dir(p, sizeof p) && file_there(p)) remove_tree(p);
#else
    appimage_remove_old();
#endif
}

void post_update_mark_failed(const char *version) {
    if (!post_update_shipped()) return;
    char p[1100];
    cache_file(p, sizeof p, "update-failed.txt");
    write_line(p, version);
}

bool post_update_failed_before(const char *version) {
    char p[1100], v[80] = "";
    cache_file(p, sizeof p, "update-failed.txt");
    return read_line(p, v, sizeof v) && !strcmp(v, version);
}

bool post_update_can_rollback(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    char p[1100], q[1200];
    if (!update_dir(p, sizeof p)) return false;
    snprintf(q, sizeof q, "%s/journal.txt", p);
    return file_there(q);
#else
    return appimage_has_old();
#endif
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ asking SW Update
static pthread_mutex_t g_check_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static UpdateState g_state = UPDATE_IDLE;
static char g_version[64], g_message[512];

#ifdef _WIN32
static bool start_tool(const char *args, HANDLE *out_process, DWORD flags) {
    char exe[1100];
    if (!rt_resource("SW Update.exe", NULL, exe, sizeof exe)) return false;
    wchar_t wexe[1200], line[1800], wargs[500];
    if (!MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, exe, -1, wexe, 1200) || !MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, args, -1, wargs, 500)) return false;
    swprintf(line, 1800, L"\"%ls\" %ls", wexe, wargs);
    STARTUPINFOW si;
    memset(&si, 0, sizeof si);
    si.cb = sizeof si;
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    AllowSetForegroundWindow(ASFW_ANY);
    if (!CreateProcessW(wexe, line, NULL, NULL, FALSE, flags, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) return false;
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    if (out_process) *out_process = pi.hProcess;
    else CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    return true;
}

static void *check_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    char out[1100], args[1300];
    snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s/update-check.txt", rt_data_root());
    remove(out);
    snprintf(args, sizeof args, "--check --out \"%s\"", out);
    HANDLE p = NULL;
    UpdateState st = UPDATE_ERROR;
    char version[64] = "", message[512] = "";
    if (!start_tool(args, &p, CREATE_NO_WINDOW)) snprintf(message, sizeof message, "SW Update is missing from this folder");
    else {
        if (WaitForSingleObject(p, 45000) != WAIT_OBJECT_0) {
            TerminateProcess(p, 1);
            snprintf(message, sizeof message, "GitHub took too long to answer");
        }
        CloseHandle(p);
        if (!message[0]) {
            FILE *f = fopen(out, "rb");
            char line[1600];
            while (f && fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
                line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0;
                if (!strcmp(line, "status=available")) st = UPDATE_AVAILABLE;
                else if (!strcmp(line, "status=current")) st = UPDATE_CURRENT;
                else if (!strncmp(line, "version=", 8)) snprintf(version, sizeof version, "%s", line + 8);
                else if (!strncmp(line, "title=", 6)) snprintf(message, sizeof message, "%s", line + 6);
            }
            if (f) fclose(f);
            else snprintf(message, sizeof message, "SW Update did not answer");
            remove(out);
        }
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[update] check: state %d %s %s\n", (int)st, version, message);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_check_lock);
    g_state = st;
    snprintf(g_version, sizeof g_version, "%s", version);
    snprintf(g_message, sizeof g_message, "%s", message);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_check_lock);
    return NULL;
}

#else  // the AppImage asks by itself, with the system's curl
static UcRelease g_release;
static volatile float g_install_progress = -1;

static void *check_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    char work[1100];
    cache_file(work, sizeof work, "");
    MAKE_DIR(work);
    UcRelease r;
    UpdateProblem pb = {{0}};
    bool available = false, ok = appimage_find_update(work, rt_version(), &r, &available, &pb);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_check_lock);
    g_state = !ok ? UPDATE_ERROR : available ? UPDATE_AVAILABLE : UPDATE_CURRENT;
    if (available) {
        g_release = r;
        snprintf(g_version, sizeof g_version, "%s", r.version);
    }
    if (!ok) snprintf(g_message, sizeof g_message, "%s", pb.title);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_check_lock);
    fprintf(stderr, "[update] check: state %d %s %s\n", (int)g_state, g_version, g_message);
    return NULL;
}
#endif

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ installed by a launcher
static const char *g_launcher;

static bool launcher_file(const char *dir, const char *name) {
    char p[1300];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, name);
    return file_there(p);
}

static void launcher_find(void) {
    // the release's folder: the exe's (Windows), the AppImage's (Linux), and the one above it
    char dir[1100] = "", up[1100];
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!plat_exe_path(dir, sizeof dir)) dir[0] = 0;
#else
    const char *img = appimage_path();
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", img ? img : "");
#endif
    char *cut = strrchr(dir, '/'), *cut2 = strrchr(dir, '\\');
    if (cut2 > cut) cut = cut2;
    if (cut) *cut = 0;
    if (!dir[0]) return;
    snprintf(up, sizeof up, "%s", dir);
    cut = strrchr(up, '/'), cut2 = strrchr(up, '\\');
    if (cut2 > cut) cut = cut2;
    if (cut && cut > up && cut[-1] != ':') *cut = 0;  // (none above a drive's or the disk's top)
    else up[0] = 0;
    g_launcher = uc_launcher_installed(dir, up, launcher_file, getenv("RECOMPLAUNCHER"));
    if (g_launcher) fprintf(stderr, "[update] installed by %s, which updates it: no update checks of its own\n", g_launcher);
}

const char *update_launcher(void) {
    if (!post_update_shipped()) return NULL;
    static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
    pthread_once(&once, launcher_find);
    return g_launcher;
}

void update_check_start(void) {
    if (update_launcher()) return;  // (the launcher that installed it updates it)
#ifdef _WIN32
    char exe[1100];
    if (!post_update_shipped() || !rt_resource("SW Update.exe", NULL, exe, sizeof exe)) return;
#else
    if (!post_update_shipped()) return;
#endif
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_check_lock);
    bool go = g_state == UPDATE_IDLE;
    if (go) g_state = UPDATE_CHECKING;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_check_lock);
    if (!go) return;
    pthread_t t;
    if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, check_thread, NULL) == 0) pthread_detach(t);
    else g_state = UPDATE_IDLE;
}

UpdateState update_check_state(char *version, size_t vn, char *message, size_t mn) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_check_lock);
    UpdateState s = g_state;
    snprintf(version, vn, "%s", g_version);
    snprintf(message, mn, "%s", g_message);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_check_lock);
    return s;
}

#ifdef _WIN32
bool update_applies_here(void) { return false; }
void update_apply_here(char *title, size_t tn, char *what, size_t wn) { (void)title, (void)tn, (void)what, (void)wn; }
float update_apply_progress(void) { return -1; }

bool update_apply_start(void) {
    char a[64];
    snprintf(a, sizeof a, "--apply --wait-pid %lu", GetCurrentProcessId());
    return start_tool(a, NULL, 0);
}

bool update_rollback_start(void) {
    char a[64];
    snprintf(a, sizeof a, "--rollback --wait-pid %lu", GetCurrentProcessId());
    return start_tool(a, NULL, 0);
}
#else
bool update_applies_here(void) { return true; }
float update_apply_progress(void) { return g_install_progress; }

void update_apply_here(char *title, size_t tn, char *what, size_t wn) {
    char work[1100];
    cache_file(work, sizeof work, "");
    MAKE_DIR(work);
    UcRelease r;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_check_lock);
    r = g_release;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_check_lock);
    UpdateProblem pb = {{0}};
    g_install_progress = 0;
    if (appimage_install(work, &r, &g_install_progress, &pb)) appimage_relaunch(&pb);  // (returns only if it couldn't)
    g_install_progress = -1;
    snprintf(title, tn, "%s", pb.title);
    snprintf(what, wn, "%s", pb.what);
}

bool update_apply_start(void) { return false; }

bool update_rollback_start(void) {
    UpdateProblem pb = {{0}};
    if (appimage_go_back(&pb)) appimage_relaunch(&pb);
    fprintf(stderr, "[update] going back: %s\n", pb.title);
    return false;
}
#endif

#else  // neither

bool post_update_recover_if_cut(void) { return false; }
bool post_update_shipped(void) { return false; }
bool post_update_pending(const char *version) { (void)version; return false; }
void post_update_reset_shaders(const char *version) { (void)version; }
void post_update_finish(const char *version) { (void)version; }
void post_update_tidy(const char *version) { (void)version; }
void post_update_mark_failed(const char *version) { (void)version; }
bool post_update_failed_before(const char *version) { (void)version; return false; }
bool post_update_can_rollback(void) { return false; }
const char *update_launcher(void) { return NULL; }
void update_check_start(void) {}
UpdateState update_check_state(char *version, size_t vn, char *message, size_t mn) {
    if (vn) version[0] = 0;
    if (mn) message[0] = 0;
    return UPDATE_IDLE;
}
bool update_apply_start(void) { return false; }
bool update_rollback_start(void) { return false; }
bool update_applies_here(void) { return false; }
void update_apply_here(char *title, size_t tn, char *what, size_t wn) { (void)title, (void)tn, (void)what, (void)wn; }
float update_apply_progress(void) { return -1; }

#endif
```

`runtime/post_update.h`:

```h
// What the game does around an update: on Windows SW Update (runtime/platform/windows_update.c) installs it, in a Linux
// AppImage the game itself does (runtime/update_appimage.c). In a source build nothing here does anything.
//
// After an update, the first start of the new version: the shader caches are emptied before Vulkan opens them, the
// game code is built if this version needs it, every shader is precompiled again, and only then is the update
// finished (cache/last-version.txt) and the previous version's files removed. A zip unpacked by hand over an older copy
// comes the same way. Cut off at any point, the next start carries on.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define POST_UPDATE_HEALTH_EXIT 73  // savagewind.exe --update-health: it starts, so its DLLs are all there

// An update cut off halfway (a power cut): true once SW Update has put the old files back and started this program again.
bool post_update_recover_if_cut(void);
bool post_update_shipped(void);                      // a release (sw-manifest.txt next to the exe), not a source build
bool post_update_pending(const char *version);       // game files are set up and this version hasn't finished setting up
void post_update_reset_shaders(const char *version); // before Vulkan starts; once per version
void post_update_finish(const char *version);        // after a good setup: remembers the version, removes update/
void post_update_tidy(const char *version);          // what a busy file kept post_update_finish from removing
void post_update_mark_failed(const char *version);   // not retried by itself at every start
bool post_update_failed_before(const char *version);
bool post_update_can_rollback(void);                 // the previous version's files are still there

typedef enum { UPDATE_IDLE, UPDATE_CHECKING, UPDATE_AVAILABLE, UPDATE_CURRENT, UPDATE_ERROR } UpdateState;

// The launcher that installed this release and updates it (Quiver Launcher, GitHub Launcher, RecompLauncher), or NULL.
// Then update_check_start does nothing: two updaters on one folder would fight over its files. The first start of a
// version the launcher put there still sets it up (post_update_pending), as for a zip unpacked by hand.
const char *update_launcher(void);

void update_check_start(void);  // asks SW Update, in the background (no network code in the game itself)
UpdateState update_check_state(char *version, size_t version_size, char *message, size_t message_size);
// Starts SW Update to install it / to go back; true: this program must quit now so its files can be replaced.
bool update_apply_start(void);
bool update_rollback_start(void);
// Linux: the update runs inside this program, on a thread of the caller's. update_apply_here returns only if it failed,
// saying why; when it works the new version replaces this process. update_apply_progress: 0..1, -1 when not running.
bool update_applies_here(void);
void update_apply_here(char *title, size_t title_size, char *what, size_t what_size);
float update_apply_progress(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

```

`runtime/problem_report.c`:

```c
// A zip file to attach to a bug report (runtime/problem_report.h), in the data folder (the working directory,
// runtime/paths.h). The logs are where the platform writes them (plat_log_path: next to the program on Windows), the
// settings file is the one in use (settings_file). GitHub takes one zip, and neither a folder nor a .ini.
#include "problem_report.h"

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <zlib.h>

#include "gamelib.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "paths.h"
#include "platform.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include <string.h>

const char *rt_version(void);  // runtime/ui/launcher.mm

enum { REPORT_FILES = 6, REPORT_MAX_FILE = 0x40000000 };

typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    uint32_t crc, offset;
    uint32_t size, packed;
    int method;  // 8 deflated, 0 stored
} ZipEntry;

static unsigned char *read_whole(const char *path, size_t *size) {
    FILE *f = path[0] ? fopen(path, "rb") : NULL;  // (the running log is open for writing: fopen shares it)
    if (!f) return NULL;
    unsigned char *data = NULL;
    long n = fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END) == 0 ? ftell(f) : -1;
    if (n >= 0 && n <= REPORT_MAX_FILE && fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET) == 0 && (data = malloc((size_t)n + 1)))
        *size = fread(data, 1, (size_t)n, f);
    fclose(f);
    return data;
}

// Raw deflate (no zlib header, as zip wants it). NULL if it fails.
static unsigned char *deflate_raw(const unsigned char *in, size_t n, size_t *packed) {
    z_stream z;
    memset(&z, 0, sizeof z);
    if (deflateInit2(&z, Z_BEST_COMPRESSION, Z_DEFLATED, -15, 8, Z_DEFAULT_STRATEGY) != Z_OK) return NULL;
    uLong cap = deflateBound(&z, (uLong)n);
    unsigned char *out = malloc(cap);
    int r = Z_STREAM_ERROR;
    if (out) {
        z.next_in = (Bytef *)in;
        z.avail_in = (uInt)n;
        z.next_out = out;
        z.avail_out = (uInt)cap;
        r = deflate(&z, Z_FINISH);
    }
    *packed = z.total_out;
    deflateEnd(&z);
    if (r != Z_STREAM_END) {
        free(out);
        return NULL;
    }
    return out;
}

static void put16(unsigned char **p, unsigned v) {
    *(*p)++ = (unsigned char)v;
    *(*p)++ = (unsigned char)(v >> 8);
}

static void put32(unsigned char **p, uint32_t v) {
    put16(p, v & 0xffff);
    put16(p, v >> 16);
}

// One file into the zip; the entry says where it went. False if the disk write failed.
static bool zip_add(FILE *zip, ZipEntry *e, const unsigned char *data, size_t size, unsigned dos_time, unsigned dos_date) {
    size_t packed = 0;
    unsigned char *deflated = deflate_raw(data, size, &packed);
    bool use = deflated && packed < size;
    unsigned char head[30], *p = head;
    size_t name_len = strlen(e->name);
    e->offset = (uint32_t)ftell(zip);
    e->crc = (uint32_t)crc32(0, data, (uInt)size);
    e->size = (uint32_t)size;
    e->packed = (uint32_t)(use ? packed : size);
    e->method = use ? 8 : 0;
    put32(&p, 0x04034b50);
    put16(&p, 20);  // version needed: 2.0
    put16(&p, 0);
    put16(&p, (unsigned)e->method);
    put16(&p, dos_time);
    put16(&p, dos_date);
    put32(&p, e->crc);
    put32(&p, e->packed);
    put32(&p, e->size);
    put16(&p, (unsigned)name_len);
    put16(&p, 0);
    bool ok = fwrite(head, 1, sizeof head, zip) == sizeof head && fwrite(e->name, 1, name_len, zip) == name_len &&
              fwrite(use ? deflated : data, 1, e->packed, zip) == e->packed;
    free(deflated);
    return ok;
}

// The central directory that ends a zip.
static bool zip_finish(FILE *zip, const ZipEntry *entries, int count, unsigned dos_time, unsigned dos_date) {
    uint32_t start = (uint32_t)ftell(zip);
    uint32_t dir_size = 0;
    bool ok = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const ZipEntry *e = &entries[i];
        unsigned char head[46], *p = head;
        size_t name_len = strlen(e->name);
        put32(&p, 0x02014b50);
        put16(&p, 20);  // made by
        put16(&p, 20);  // version needed
        put16(&p, 0);
        put16(&p, (unsigned)e->method);
        put16(&p, dos_time);
        put16(&p, dos_date);
        put32(&p, e->crc);
        put32(&p, e->packed);
        put32(&p, e->size);
        put16(&p, (unsigned)name_len);
        put16(&p, 0);  // extra
        put16(&p, 0);  // comment
        put16(&p, 0);  // disk
        put16(&p, 0);  // internal attributes
        put32(&p, 0);  // external attributes
        put32(&p, e->offset);
        ok = ok && fwrite(head, 1, sizeof head, zip) == sizeof head && fwrite(e->name, 1, name_len, zip) == name_len;
        dir_size += (uint32_t)(sizeof head + name_len);
    }
    unsigned char end[22], *p = end;
    put32(&p, 0x06054b50);
    put16(&p, 0);
    put16(&p, 0);
    put16(&p, (unsigned)count);
    put16(&p, (unsigned)count);
    put32(&p, dir_size);
    put32(&p, start);
    put16(&p, 0);
    return ok && fwrite(end, 1, sizeof end, zip) == sizeof end;
}

const char *problem_report_make(void) {
    static char zip_name[64];
    char when[32] = "0";
    time_t t = time(NULL);
    struct tm *tm = localtime(&t);
    unsigned dos_time = 0, dos_date = 0x21;  // (1980-01-01, zip's earliest)
    if (tm) {
        strftime(when, sizeof when, "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S", tm);
        dos_time = (unsigned)(tm->tm_hour << 11 | tm->tm_min << 5 | tm->tm_sec / 2);
        if (tm->tm_year >= 80) dos_date = (unsigned)((tm->tm_year - 80) << 9 | (tm->tm_mon + 1) << 5 | tm->tm_mday);
    }
    snprintf(zip_name, sizeof zip_name, "problem-report-%s.zip", when);
    FILE *zip = fopen(zip_name, "wb");
    if (!zip) {
        zip_name[0] = 0;
        return zip_name;
    }
    char log[1100] = "", prev[1100] = "";
    const char *lp = plat_log_path();
    if (lp && *lp) {
        snprintf(log, sizeof log, "%s", lp);
        snprintf(prev, sizeof prev, "%s", lp);
        char *name = strstr(prev, "savagewind.log");
        if (name) snprintf(name, sizeof prev - (size_t)(name - prev), "savagewind.prev.log");
        else prev[0] = 0;
    }
    // The pipeline list and the shader key log (Vulkan, cache/): hashes and render state, nothing of the game or the
    // player. With the same release's build they turn into a pipeline seed (tools/merge_seed_report.py), so the
    // pipelines a player's settings need and the shipped seed lacks go into the next seed.
    const char *cache = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_CACHE_DIR");
    if (!cache || !*cache) cache = "cache";
    char list[1100], keys[1100];
    snprintf(list, sizeof list, "%s/vk_pipelines.list", cache);
    snprintf(keys, sizeof keys, "%s/vk_shader_keys.list", cache);
    const char *const from[] = {log, prev, settings_file(), list, keys};
    static const char *const names[] = {"savagewind.log", "savagewind.prev.log", "savagewind.ini",
                                        "pipelines/vk_pipelines.list", "pipelines/vk_shader_keys.list"};
    ZipEntry entries[REPORT_FILES];
    int count = 0;
    bool ok = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof names / sizeof names[0] && ok; i++) {
        size_t size = 0;
        unsigned char *data = read_whole(from[i], &size);
        if (!data) continue;
        entries[count].name = names[i];
        ok = zip_add(zip, &entries[count], data, size, dos_time, dos_date);
        count++;
        free(data);
    }
    int copied = count;
    char summary[512];
    int n = snprintf(summary, sizeof summary,
                     "Savage Wind %s\n"  // (the build it came from: the log's first line)
                     "System: %s, %d logical processors, %d MB of memory\n"
                     "Game code: %s%s\n"
                     "Made: %s\n"
                     "%s",
                     rt_version(), SDL_GetPlatform(), SDL_GetNumLogicalCPUCores(), SDL_GetSystemRAM(), gamelib_id(),
                     gamelib_compat() ? " (compatible mode)" : "", when,
                     log[0] ? "" : "Log: not in a file (this run's output went to a console or was redirected)\n");
    if (ok && n > 0) {
        entries[count].name = "system.txt";
        ok = zip_add(zip, &entries[count], (const unsigned char *)summary, strlen(summary), dos_time, dos_date);
        count++;
    }
    ok = ok && zip_finish(zip, entries, count, dos_time, dos_date);
    if (fclose(zip) != 0) ok = false;
    if (!ok) {
        LOG("[report] couldn't write %s\n", zip_name);
        remove(zip_name);
        zip_name[0] = 0;
        return zip_name;
    }
    LOG("[report] %s: %d files and system.txt\n", zip_name, copied);
    return zip_name;
}
```

`runtime/prof.c`:

```c
// On-demand profiler: the recorder and the capture file (runtime/prof.h has the markers and the overview).
//
// Memory: one pool of fixed chunks, claimed atomically and written through private thread cursors. The writer closes
// admission and waits for their short writes before reading or clearing the pool. Registration uses bounded slots;
// steady-state markers do not take a mutex. The pool is allocated on first capture and reused. Unused records stay
// zero; after producer completion the writer scans up to the first zero kind. A full pool stops capture and logs it.
//
// File (little endian), read by tools/swprof.py:
//   header   "SWPROF01", u32 version, u32 record size, u64 ticks0, ns0, ticks1, ns1 (the cycle counter and
//            plat_now_ns at start and stop: the tool derives the counter's rate), u64 unix seconds at start,
//            u32 sites, threads, chunks, u32 reserved
//   sites    per site: u32 id, u16 length, name
//   threads  per thread: u32 index, u32 reserved, u64 os thread id, char name[32]
//   modules  (the header's last u32 says how many) per module: u64 base, size, bias, u32 kind, char name[196]
//   chunks   per chunk: u32 thread, u32 records, then the records
#include "prof.h"

#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#include <windows.h>
#elif defined(__linux__)
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#else
#include <pthread.h>
#endif

#include "rt.h"

#define CHUNK_RECS 8192  // 256 KB
#define MAX_THREADS 256
#define FILE_VERSION 1

int g_prof_on;
uint32_t g_prof_gen = 1;
static atomic_uint g_prof_seq;
static atomic_ullong g_prof_frame;
__thread ProfCursor *t_prof;
static __thread char t_name[32];

enum { IDLE, CAPTURING, WRITING };
static atomic_int state;
static atomic_bool stop_requested;  // the pool filled up: the presenting thread ends the capture at the next frame
static atomic_bool full_stop_pending;  // the next toggle acknowledges the automatic stop
static int gpu_on;
static void (*gpu_finish)(void);
static pthread_mutex_t control_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_mutex_t registry_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_key_t cursor_key;
static pthread_once_t cursor_once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
static bool frame_seen;

static pthread_mutex_t site_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static const char *site_names[PROF_MAX_SITES];
static uint32_t nsites;  // ids 1..nsites

static struct ProfThread {
    ProfCursor c;
    ProfAcc acc;
    char name[32];
    uint64_t tid;
    bool owned;
} *threads;
static atomic_uint nthreads;

static ProfRec *pool;
static uint16_t *chunk_thread;
static uint32_t pool_chunks;
static atomic_uint next_chunk;

static uint64_t ticks0, ns0, ticks1, ns1, unix0;
static char last_file[256];

uint32_t prof_register(ProfSite *s) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&site_lock);
    if (!__atomic_load_n(&s->id, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) {
        uint32_t id;
        if (nsites + 1 < PROF_MAX_SITES) {
            site_names[++nsites] = s->name;
            id = nsites;
        } else {
            id = PROF_MAX_SITES - 1;
            site_names[id] = "(too many markers)";
        }
        __atomic_store_n(&s->id, id, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    uint32_t id = __atomic_load_n(&s->id, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&site_lock);
    return id;
}

static uint64_t os_thread_id(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    return GetCurrentThreadId();
#elif defined(__linux__)
    return (uint64_t)syscall(SYS_gettid);
#else
    uint64_t t = 0;
    pthread_threadid_np(NULL, &t);
    return t;
#endif
}

void prof_thread_name(const char *name) {
    prof_sampler_register_thread();
    snprintf(t_name, sizeof t_name, "%s", name ? name : "");
    pthread_mutex_lock(&registry_lock);
    if (t_prof) snprintf(threads[t_prof->thread].name, sizeof threads[0].name, "%s", t_name);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&registry_lock);
}

// ---- names made at run time: copied, deduplicated by a hash table (open addressing)
#define DYN_SLOTS 4096
static uint16_t dyn_slot[DYN_SLOTS];  // site id, 0: free
static uint32_t dyn_count;

uint32_t prof_site_dyn(const char *name) {
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
    for (const char *p = name; *p; p++) h = (h ^ (uint8_t)*p) * 16777619u;
    uint32_t id = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&site_lock);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < DYN_SLOTS; i++) {
        uint16_t e = dyn_slot[(h + i) % DYN_SLOTS];
        if (!e) {
            if (nsites + 1 < PROF_MAX_SITES - 1 && dyn_count < DYN_SLOTS / 2) {
                char *copy = strdup(name);
                if (copy) {
                    site_names[++nsites] = copy;
                    dyn_slot[(h + i) % DYN_SLOTS] = (uint16_t)nsites;
                    dyn_count++;
                    id = nsites;
                }
            }
            break;
        }
        if (!strcmp(site_names[e], name)) { id = e; break; }
    }
    if (!id) {
        id = PROF_MAX_SITES - 1;  // out of ids: the rest share the last one
        site_names[id] = "(too many markers)";
        if (nsites < id) nsites = id;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&site_lock);
    return id;
}

double prof_ticks_per_ns(void) {
    uint64_t dn = plat_now_ns() - ns0, dt = prof_ticks() - ticks0;
    return dn > 1000000 ? (double)dt / (double)dn : 1.0;  // (less than a millisecond in: no measurement yet)
}

static void release_cursor(void *p) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&registry_lock);
    // Keep this capture's totals until the writer consumes them. Another thread can reuse the slot next capture.
    threads[((ProfCursor *)p)->thread].owned = false;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&registry_lock);
}
static void init_cursor_key(void) {
    if (pthread_key_create(&cursor_key, release_cursor)) abort();
    atexit(prof_shutdown);
}
static ProfCursor *claim_cursor(uint32_t gen) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&registry_lock);
    if (gen == prof_generation() && (__atomic_load_n(&g_prof_on, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) ||
                                    __atomic_load_n(&gpu_on, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST))) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < MAX_THREADS; i++) {
            if (threads[i].owned || threads[i].c.gen == gen) continue;
            threads[i].owned = true;
            threads[i].tid = os_thread_id();
            snprintf(threads[i].name, sizeof threads[i].name, "%s", t_name[0] ? t_name : "thread");
            t_prof = &threads[i].c;
            t_prof->thread = i;
            t_prof->acc = &threads[i].acc;
            if (pthread_setspecific(cursor_key, t_prof)) {
                threads[i].owned = false;
                t_prof = NULL;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&registry_lock);
    return t_prof;
}

// A thread announces a short write, then rechecks admission. Sequential consistency orders that recheck and the
// announcement against the stop store and the writer's scan. The flag covers recording, never the timed scope.
static ProfCursor *enter(uint32_t gen, bool gpu) {
    if (gen != prof_generation()) return NULL;
    ProfCursor *c = t_prof ? t_prof : claim_cursor(gen);
    if (!c) return NULL;
    __atomic_store_n(&c->busy, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    if (gen != prof_generation() || !__atomic_load_n(gpu ? &gpu_on : &g_prof_on, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)) {
        __atomic_store_n(&c->busy, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return NULL;
    }
    if (c->gen != gen) {
        c->cur = c->end = NULL;
        memset(c->acc, 0, sizeof *c->acc);
        c->acc_seq = atomic_load(&g_prof_seq);
        c->acc_frame = atomic_load(&g_prof_frame);
        c->gen = gen;
        atomic_fetch_add(&nthreads, 1);
    }
    return c;
}
static void leave(ProfCursor *c) { __atomic_store_n(&c->busy, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }

static bool append(ProfCursor *c, uint32_t kind, uint32_t site, uint64_t t0, uint64_t t1, uint64_t val) {
    if (c->cur == c->end) {
        unsigned i = atomic_fetch_add(&next_chunk, 1);
        if (i >= pool_chunks) {
            atomic_store(&stop_requested, true);
            __atomic_store_n(&g_prof_on, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
            return false;
        }
        chunk_thread[i] = (uint16_t)c->thread;
        c->cur = pool + (size_t)i * CHUNK_RECS;
        c->end = c->cur + CHUNK_RECS;
    }
    *c->cur++ = (ProfRec){t0, t1, val, site, kind};
    return true;
}

void prof_put_gen(uint32_t gen, uint32_t kind, uint32_t site, uint64_t t0, uint64_t t1, uint64_t val) {
    ProfCursor *c = enter(gen, kind == PROF_GPU || kind == PROF_GPU_COUNTER);
    if (!c) return;
    append(c, kind, site, t0, t1, val);
    leave(c);
    if (__builtin_expect(atomic_load_explicit(&stop_requested, memory_order_relaxed), 0)) prof_stop();
}

static bool flush_acc(ProfCursor *c) {
    uint64_t now = prof_ticks();
    for (uint32_t id = 1; id < PROF_MAX_SITES; id++)
        if (c->acc->calls[id]) {
            if (!append(c, PROF_ACC | (c->acc->calls[id] << 8), id, now, c->acc->ticks[id], c->acc_frame))
                return false;  // the writer streams the remaining totals with their original frame
            c->acc->ticks[id] = 0;
            c->acc->calls[id] = 0;
        }
    c->acc_seq = atomic_load(&g_prof_seq);
    c->acc_frame = atomic_load(&g_prof_frame);
    return true;
}

void prof_acc_add_gen(uint32_t gen, ProfSite *s, uint64_t ticks) {
    ProfCursor *c = enter(gen, false);
    if (!c) return;
    if (c->acc_seq != atomic_load(&g_prof_seq) && !flush_acc(c)) {
        leave(c);
        prof_stop();
        return;  // admission closed before this frame's addition; do not merge it into the retained frame
    }
    uint32_t id = prof_site(s);
    c->acc->ticks[id] += ticks;
    c->acc->calls[id]++;
    leave(c);
    if (__builtin_expect(atomic_load_explicit(&stop_requested, memory_order_relaxed), 0)) prof_stop();
}

void prof_gpu_finish_hook(void (*finish)(void)) { __atomic_store_n(&gpu_finish, finish, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }
bool prof_gpu_enabled(uint32_t gen) {
    return gen == prof_generation() && __atomic_load_n(&gpu_on, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
}

void prof_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    // SAVAGEWIND_PROF=<first frame>[:<frames>]: start at a frame, stop after some (without a count: when asked).
    static int env_read, env_done;
    static long env_first = -1, env_count;
    static uint64_t env_stop_at;
    static uint32_t env_gen;
    if (!env_read) {
        env_read = 1;
        const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PROF");
        if (e && *e) {
            char *end;
            env_first = strtol(e, &end, 10);
            if (*end == ':') env_count = strtol(end + 1, NULL, 10);
            if (env_first < 0) env_first = 0;
        }
    }
    if (env_first >= 0 && !env_done && frame >= (uint64_t)env_first && atomic_load(&state) == IDLE) {
        env_done = 1;
        if (prof_start()) {
            env_stop_at = env_count > 0 ? frame + (uint64_t)env_count : 0;
            env_gen = prof_generation();
        }
    }
    if (env_stop_at && env_gen != prof_generation()) env_stop_at = 0;
    if (!prof_enabled()) {
        if (atomic_load(&stop_requested) && atomic_load(&state) == CAPTURING) prof_stop();  // the buffer filled up
        return;
    }
    if (env_stop_at && frame >= env_stop_at) {
        env_stop_at = 0;
        prof_stop();
        return;
    }
    uint64_t now = prof_ticks();
    ProfCursor *c = enter(prof_generation(), false);
    if (!c) return;
    atomic_store(&g_prof_frame, frame);
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_prof_seq, 1);
    frame_seen = true;
    append(c, PROF_FRAME, 0, now, 0, frame);
    leave(c);
}

bool prof_active(void) { return atomic_load(&state) == CAPTURING; }
const char *prof_last_file(void) {
    static __thread char copy[256];
    pthread_mutex_lock(&control_lock);
    snprintf(copy, sizeof copy, "%s", last_file);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&control_lock);
    return copy;
}

bool prof_start(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&control_lock);
    if (atomic_load(&state) != IDLE) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&control_lock); return false; }
    pthread_once(&cursor_once, init_cursor_key);
    if (!pool) {
        const char *mb = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PROF_MB");
        long n = mb ? atol(mb) : 256;
        if (n < 8) n = 8;
        if (n > 4096) n = 4096;
        pool_chunks = (uint32_t)((size_t)n * 1048576 / (CHUNK_RECS * sizeof(ProfRec)));
        pool = calloc(pool_chunks, CHUNK_RECS * sizeof(ProfRec));
        chunk_thread = calloc(pool_chunks, sizeof *chunk_thread);
        threads = calloc(MAX_THREADS, sizeof *threads);
        if (!pool || !chunk_thread || !threads) {
            free(pool);
            free(chunk_thread);
            pool = NULL;
            chunk_thread = NULL;
            free(threads);
            threads = NULL;
            LOG("[prof] no memory for the capture buffer (%ld MB)\n", n);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&control_lock);
            return false;
        }
    }
    atomic_store(&next_chunk, 0);
    atomic_store(&nthreads, 0);
    atomic_store(&stop_requested, false);
    atomic_store(&full_stop_pending, false);
    unix0 = (uint64_t)time(NULL);
    ns0 = plat_now_ns();
    ticks0 = prof_ticks();
    atomic_store(&g_prof_seq, 0);
    frame_seen = false;
    __atomic_add_fetch(&g_prof_gen, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    atomic_store(&state, CAPTURING);
    __atomic_store_n(&gpu_on, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    __atomic_store_n(&g_prof_on, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    prof_sampler_begin();
    LOG("[prof] capture started (buffer %u MB)\n", (unsigned)((uint64_t)pool_chunks * CHUNK_RECS * sizeof(ProfRec) >> 20));
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&control_lock);
    return true;
}

static void put32(FILE *f, uint32_t v) { fwrite(&v, 4, 1, f); }
static void put64(FILE *f, uint64_t v) { fwrite(&v, 8, 1, f); }

static void *writer_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    prof_sampler_end();
    void (*finish)(void) = __atomic_load_n(&gpu_finish, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (finish) finish();
    __atomic_store_n(&gpu_on, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&registry_lock);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < MAX_THREADS; i++)
        while (__atomic_load_n(&threads[i].c.busy, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST))
            plat_sleep_until_ns(plat_now_ns() + 100000);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&site_lock);
    static ProfModule modules[1024];
    int nmod = prof_sampler_modules(modules, 1024);
    uint32_t used = atomic_load(&next_chunk);
    if (used > pool_chunks) used = pool_chunks;
    uint32_t map[MAX_THREADS], totals[MAX_THREADS], nt = 0, extras = frame_seen ? 1 : 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < MAX_THREADS; i++) {
        map[i] = nt;
        totals[i] = 0;
        if (threads[i].c.gen != prof_generation()) continue;
        nt++;
        for (unsigned j = 1; j < PROF_MAX_SITES; j++)
            if (threads[i].acc.calls[j]) totals[i]++;
        if (totals[i]) extras++;
    }

    char dir[] = "profile", path[256];
    struct tm tmv;
    time_t t0 = (time_t)unix0;
#ifdef _WIN32
    _mkdir(dir);
    localtime_s(&tmv, &t0);
#else
    mkdir(dir, 0755);
    localtime_r(&t0, &tmv);
#endif
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/swprof-%04d%02d%02d-%02d%02d%02d.swprof", dir, tmv.tm_year + 1900, tmv.tm_mon + 1,
             tmv.tm_mday, tmv.tm_hour, tmv.tm_min, tmv.tm_sec);
    // two captures in the same second must not overwrite each other: -2, -3, ...
    for (unsigned n = 2;; n++) {
        FILE *e = fopen(path, "rb");
        if (!e) break;
        fclose(e);
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/swprof-%04d%02d%02d-%02d%02d%02d-%u.swprof", dir, tmv.tm_year + 1900,
                 tmv.tm_mon + 1, tmv.tm_mday, tmv.tm_hour, tmv.tm_min, tmv.tm_sec, n);
    }
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    uint64_t records = 0;
    if (!f) {
        LOG("[prof] cannot write %s\n", path);
    } else {
        fwrite("SWPROF01", 1, 8, f);
        put32(f, FILE_VERSION);
        put32(f, sizeof(ProfRec));
        put64(f, ticks0);
        put64(f, ns0);
        put64(f, ticks1);
        put64(f, ns1);
        put64(f, unix0);
        put32(f, nsites);
        put32(f, nt);
        put32(f, used + extras);
        put32(f, (uint32_t)nmod);
        for (uint32_t i = 1; i <= nsites; i++) {
            const char *n = site_names[i] ? site_names[i] : "?";
            put32(f, i);
            uint16_t len = (uint16_t)strlen(n);
            fwrite(&len, 2, 1, f);
            fwrite(n, 1, len, f);
        }
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < MAX_THREADS; i++) {
            if (threads[i].c.gen != prof_generation()) continue;
            put32(f, map[i]);
            put32(f, 0);
            put64(f, threads[i].tid);
            fwrite(threads[i].name, 1, sizeof threads[i].name, f);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < nmod; i++) {
            put64(f, modules[i].base);
            put64(f, modules[i].size);
            put64(f, modules[i].bias);
            put32(f, modules[i].kind);
            fwrite(modules[i].name, 1, sizeof modules[i].name, f);
        }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < used; i++) {
            ProfRec *r = pool + (size_t)i * CHUNK_RECS;
            uint32_t n = 0;
            while (n < CHUNK_RECS && __atomic_load_n(&r[n].kind, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) n++;
            put32(f, map[chunk_thread[i]]);
            put32(f, n);
            fwrite(r, sizeof(ProfRec), n, f);
            records += n;
        }
        // Final totals and the closing frame do not compete for space in a full recording pool.
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < MAX_THREADS; i++) {
            if (!totals[i]) continue;
            put32(f, map[i]); put32(f, totals[i]);
            for (unsigned j = 1; j < PROF_MAX_SITES; j++) {
                if (!threads[i].acc.calls[j]) continue;
                ProfRec r = {ticks1, threads[i].acc.ticks[j], threads[i].c.acc_frame,
                             j, PROF_ACC | (threads[i].acc.calls[j] << 8)};
                fwrite(&r, sizeof r, 1, f);
                records++;
            }
        }
        if (frame_seen) {
            ProfRec r = {ticks1, 0, atomic_load(&g_prof_frame) + 1, 0, PROF_FRAME};
            put32(f, 0); put32(f, 1); fwrite(&r, sizeof r, 1, f);
            records++;
        }
        bool failed = ferror(f) != 0;
        if (fclose(f)) failed = true;
        if (failed) { remove(path); LOG("[prof] failed writing %s (capture discarded)\n", path); }
        else {
            pthread_mutex_lock(&control_lock);
            snprintf(last_file, sizeof last_file, "%s", path);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&control_lock);
            LOG("[prof] wrote %s: %llu events, %u threads, %.2f s\n", path, (unsigned long long)records, nt,
                (double)(ns1 - ns0) / 1e9);
        }
    }
    // back to zero for the next capture (only what was used)
    memset(pool, 0, (size_t)used * CHUNK_RECS * sizeof(ProfRec));
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&site_lock);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&registry_lock);
    atomic_store(&state, IDLE);
    return NULL;
}

void prof_stop(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&control_lock);
    if (atomic_load(&state) != CAPTURING) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&control_lock); return; }
    atomic_store(&state, WRITING);
    __atomic_store_n(&g_prof_on, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    ticks1 = prof_ticks();
    ns1 = plat_now_ns();
    if (atomic_load(&stop_requested)) {
        atomic_store(&full_stop_pending, true);
        LOG("[prof] buffer full, stopping capture\n");
    }
    pthread_t th;
    bool started = pthread_create(&th, NULL, writer_main, NULL) == 0;
    if (started) pthread_detach(th);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&control_lock);
    if (!started) writer_main(NULL);
}

void prof_shutdown(void) {
    prof_stop();
    while (atomic_load(&state) != IDLE) plat_sleep_until_ns(plat_now_ns() + 1000000);
}

bool prof_toggle(void) {
    if (atomic_exchange(&full_stop_pending, false)) {
        LOG("[prof] capture already ended (buffer full); press F6 again to start a capture\n");
        return false;
    }
    if (prof_active()) {
        prof_stop();
        return false;
    }
    return prof_start();
}

void prof_status(char *out, size_t n) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&control_lock);
    int s = atomic_load(&state);
    uint32_t used = atomic_load(&next_chunk);
    if (used > pool_chunks) used = pool_chunks;
    if (s == CAPTURING)
        snprintf(out, n, "capturing for %.1f s, buffer %u of %u chunks used, %u threads",
                 (double)(plat_now_ns() - ns0) / 1e9, used, pool_chunks, atomic_load(&nthreads));
    else if (s == WRITING)
        snprintf(out, n, "writing the capture");
    else
        snprintf(out, n, "idle%s%s", last_file[0] ? ", last file " : "", last_file);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&control_lock);
}

// `prof [start | stop | toggle | status | report]`, for any front end that has words (the control layer's command, a
// console): it needs nothing from them, they only hand over the arguments and show the text.
bool prof_command(int argc, char **argv, char *out, size_t n) {
    const char *a = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "status";
    if (argc > 2) {
        snprintf(out, n, "Usage: prof [start | stop | toggle | status | report]");
        return false;
    }
    if (!strcmp(a, "start")) {
        if (prof_start()) {
            snprintf(out, n, "capture started (prof stop, or F6, ends it)");
            return true;
        }
        char st[256];
        prof_status(st, sizeof st);
        snprintf(out, n, "cannot start: %s", st);
        return false;
    }
    if (!strcmp(a, "stop")) {
        if (!prof_active()) {
            snprintf(out, n, "no capture is running");
            return false;
        }
        prof_stop();
        snprintf(out, n, "capture stopped, writing the file (prof status shows when it is done)");
        return true;
    }
    if (!strcmp(a, "toggle")) {
        bool was = prof_active();
        bool now = prof_toggle();
        if (now) snprintf(out, n, "capture started");
        else if (was) snprintf(out, n, "capture stopped, writing the file");
        else snprintf(out, n, "cannot start now (prof status says why)");
        return now || was;
    }
    if (!strcmp(a, "status")) {
        prof_status(out, n);
        return true;
    }
    if (!strcmp(a, "report")) {
        const char *file = prof_last_file();
        if (!file[0]) {
            snprintf(out, n, "no capture has been written yet");
            return false;
        }
        snprintf(out, n, "python3 tools/swprof.py %s --exe <the swr binary>", file);
        return true;
    }
    snprintf(out, n, "Unknown argument %s. Usage: prof [start | stop | toggle | status | report]", a);
    return false;
}

```

`runtime/prof.h`:

```h
// On-demand profiler: the recorder (runtime/prof.c) and its markers. Analysis: tools/swprof.py.
//
// Off (the normal state) a marker costs one load and one branch. A capture is started with prof_start() (the
// `prof` command, the hotkey, SAVAGEWIND_PROF=<first frame>[:<frames>]) and runs until prof_stop(); then one
// file, profile/swprof-<time>.swprof, is written on a thread of its own. The recorder is built so that a running
// capture uses a cheap cycle counter and a private cursor per thread. First use claims a bounded thread slot and
// registers names; steady-state writes do not allocate or take a mutex. Analysis happens afterwards.
//
//   SW_ZONE("name");      the rest of this block, as one event with a start and an end. Zones nest per thread.
//   SW_ACC("a/b");        like a zone, but the time and the calls are added up per thread and frame and written once a
//                         frame: for work done thousands of times a frame (a draw's steps), where an event each would
//                         fill the buffer. "/" in the name nests it under "a" in the report.
//   SW_TALLY("name");     only counts the calls (per thread and frame, like SW_ACC but with no clock reads): for events
//                         thousands of times a frame, like cache misses
//   SW_COUNT("name", n);  a number for this moment (draws, bytes, queue depth)
//   prof_frame(n);        the presenting thread, once per frame: frame n starts
//   prof_thread_name(s);  names the calling thread in the report
//
// Compile the SW_* marker macros away with -DSW_PROF_DISABLE (direct recorder calls remain).
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

// ---- control (any thread; the command layer, the hotkey and the environment variable call these)
bool prof_start(void);             // false: already running, still writing the last file, or no memory
void prof_stop(void);              // ends the capture; the file is written in the background
bool prof_toggle(void);            // start, stop, or acknowledge a full buffer; true = now capturing
bool prof_active(void);
// One line of state for a command: capturing / writing / idle, how full the buffer is, the last file.
void prof_status(char *out, size_t n);
void prof_frame(uint64_t frame);   // the presenting thread, at the start of each frame
void prof_thread_name(const char *name);
// `prof [start | stop | toggle | status | report]`: argv as a command line gives it (argv[0] is "prof"). The answer
// goes to out; false = it failed (nothing to stop, still writing, ...). No front end is needed to build or use this.
bool prof_command(int argc, char **argv, char *out, size_t n);
// The last file written ("" before the first), for a command to report.
const char *prof_last_file(void);
void prof_shutdown(void);          // stop and wait for the file (normal exit / before a game reboot)
void prof_gpu_finish_hook(void (*finish)(void));  // backend drains its pending timestamps on the writer thread
bool prof_gpu_enabled(uint32_t generation);

// ---- markers
// GPU events are written with prof_put_gpu() from the code that reads the GPU's timestamps (nvn/vulkan/exec.c).
typedef struct { const char *name; uint32_t id; } ProfSite;  // id 0: not registered yet
typedef struct { uint64_t t0, t1, val; uint32_t site, kind; } ProfRec;  // 32 bytes. kind: low 8 bits PROF_*, ACC: calls << 8
enum { PROF_ZONE = 1, PROF_COUNTER = 2, PROF_FRAME = 3, PROF_ACC = 4, PROF_GPU = 5, PROF_SAMPLE = 6, PROF_STACK = 7 };
enum { PROF_GPU_COUNTER = PROF_COUNTER | 0x100 };  // a counter admitted during GPU drain too
// PROF_GPU: a stretch of GPU work (t0..t1 in cycle counter ticks, val = draws | frame << 32), written by whichever
// thread reads the GPU's timestamps back; the tool shows these as a thread of their own, "gpu".

// PROF_SAMPLE (the sampler, runtime/prof_sampler.c): t0 = time, t1 = os thread id, val = kernel handle, kind >> 8 = the stack's
// depth; the PROF_STACK records after it hold the addresses, three to a record in t0, t1, val (innermost first).

// ---- the sampler (runtime/prof_sampler.c): prof_start and the capture's writer call these
enum { PROF_MODULE_RUNTIME = 1, PROF_MODULE_GAME = 2, PROF_MODULE_OTHER = 3 };
typedef struct { uint64_t base, size, bias; uint32_t kind; char name[196]; } ProfModule;  // bias: add to a symbol's address
void prof_sampler_begin(void);
void prof_sampler_end(void);  // waits for the sampler thread to finish
int prof_sampler_modules(ProfModule *out, int max);
void prof_sampler_register_thread(void);  // called by prof_thread_name, including while recording is off

typedef struct ProfAcc ProfAcc;
typedef struct {
    ProfRec *cur, *end;
    ProfAcc *acc;
    uint64_t acc_frame;
    uint32_t gen, acc_seq, thread, busy;
} ProfCursor;

extern int g_prof_on;
extern uint32_t g_prof_gen;  // accessed atomically, changes with every capture
extern __thread ProfCursor *t_prof;

uint32_t prof_register(ProfSite *s);
// A marker named at run time ("pass: 4 color 1920x1080"): the name is copied, the same name gives the same id. Many
// different names run out of ids; those share one.
uint32_t prof_site_dyn(const char *name);
double prof_ticks_per_ns(void);                // the cycle counter's rate, measured since the capture started

static inline uint64_t prof_ticks(void) {
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
    return __builtin_ia32_rdtsc();
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
    uint64_t v;
    __asm__ volatile("mrs %0, cntvct_el0" : "=r"(v));
    return v;
#else
#error "prof_ticks: no cycle counter for this CPU"
#endif
}

static inline int prof_enabled(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&g_prof_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }
static inline uint32_t prof_generation(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&g_prof_gen, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

void prof_put_gen(uint32_t gen, uint32_t kind, uint32_t site, uint64_t t0, uint64_t t1, uint64_t val);
static inline void prof_put(uint32_t kind, uint32_t site, uint64_t t0, uint64_t t1, uint64_t val) {
    prof_put_gen(prof_generation(), kind, site, t0, t1, val);
}

static inline void prof_put_gpu(uint32_t gen, uint32_t site, uint64_t t0, uint64_t t1, uint64_t val) {
    prof_put_gen(gen, PROF_GPU, site, t0, t1, val);
}

static inline uint32_t prof_site(ProfSite *s) {
    uint32_t id = __atomic_load_n(&s->id, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    return id ? id : prof_register(s);
}

typedef struct { ProfSite *site; uint64_t t0; uint32_t gen; } ProfZone;
static inline ProfZone prof_zone_begin(ProfSite *s) {
    uint32_t gen = prof_generation();
    return (ProfZone){s, prof_ticks(), gen};
}

static inline void prof_zone_exit(ProfZone *z) {
    if (z->t0 && z->gen == prof_generation() && prof_enabled())
        prof_put_gen(z->gen, PROF_ZONE, prof_site(z->site), z->t0, prof_ticks(), 0);
}

void prof_acc_add_gen(uint32_t gen, ProfSite *s, uint64_t ticks);
static inline void prof_acc_exit(ProfZone *z) {
    if (z->t0 && z->gen == prof_generation() && prof_enabled())
        prof_acc_add_gen(z->gen, z->site, prof_ticks() - z->t0);
}

#define PROF_CAT2(a, b) a##b
#define PROF_CAT(a, b) PROF_CAT2(a, b)

#ifdef SW_PROF_DISABLE
#define SW_ZONE(name) ((void)0)
#define SW_ACC(name) ((void)0)
#define SW_COUNT(name, n) ((void)0)
#define SW_TALLY(name) ((void)0)
#else
#define SW_ZONE(name) \
    static ProfSite PROF_CAT(prof_site_, __LINE__) = {name, 0}; \
    __attribute__((cleanup(prof_zone_exit), unused)) ProfZone PROF_CAT(prof_zone_, __LINE__) = prof_enabled() ? \
        prof_zone_begin(&PROF_CAT(prof_site_, __LINE__)) : (ProfZone){0}
#define SW_ACC(name) \
    static ProfSite PROF_CAT(prof_site_, __LINE__) = {name, 0}; \
    __attribute__((cleanup(prof_acc_exit), unused)) ProfZone PROF_CAT(prof_zone_, __LINE__) = prof_enabled() ? \
        prof_zone_begin(&PROF_CAT(prof_site_, __LINE__)) : (ProfZone){0}
#define SW_TALLY(name) \
    do { \
        static ProfSite prof_ts_ = {name, 0}; \
        if (prof_enabled()) prof_acc_add_gen(prof_generation(), &prof_ts_, 0); \
    } while (0)
#define SW_COUNT(name, n) \
    do { \
        static ProfSite prof_cs_ = {name, 0}; \
        if (prof_enabled()) prof_put(PROF_COUNTER, prof_site(&prof_cs_), prof_ticks(), (uint64_t)(n), 0); \
    } while (0)
#endif

// Per-thread, per-frame totals for SW_ACC: indexed by site id.
#define PROF_MAX_SITES 2048
struct ProfAcc {
    uint64_t ticks[PROF_MAX_SITES];
    uint32_t calls[PROF_MAX_SITES];
};

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

```

`runtime/prof_sampler.c`:

```c
// The profiler's sampler: while a capture runs, every interval (default 1000 us, SAVAGEWIND_PROF_SAMPLE=<us>, 0 = off)
// it takes the host call stack of every guest thread and writes it into the capture (PROF_SAMPLE + PROF_STACK records,
// runtime/prof.h). tools/swprof.py splits the samples into game code, the SWR runtime and the driver / system, and
// names the runtime's hot functions. The recompiled game code is one total on purpose: nothing here names its functions.
//
// Windows: the thread is suspended, its context read and the stack walked with the x64 unwind data (the game library
//   and the runtime both have it); nothing allocates or locks while a thread is suspended.
// Linux: a tagged realtime signal reads the interrupted PC. No unwinding, locks or allocation in its handler.
// Elsewhere: no samples (the zones and counters of the capture are all there).
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "kernel.h"
#include "prof.h"
#include "rt.h"

#define MAX_THREADS 128
#define DEPTH 18  // frames kept per sample (6 records): the top ones decide where the time is; the callers name the cause

static pthread_t g_thread;
static int g_running;
static uint32_t g_interval_us;

// One sample: the head record (time, os thread id, kernel handle, depth), then the addresses three to a record.
static void emit(uint64_t t, uint64_t tid, uint32_t handle, const uint64_t *pc, int n) {
    prof_put(PROF_SAMPLE | ((uint32_t)n << 8), 0, t, tid, handle);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i += 3)
        prof_put(PROF_STACK, 0, pc[i], i + 1 < n ? pc[i + 1] : 0, i + 2 < n ? pc[i + 2] : 0);
}

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#define PSAPI_VERSION 2
#include <psapi.h>

static uint64_t os_tid(HANDLE h) { return GetThreadId(h); }

// The loaded images (taken before any thread is suspended: listing them then could wait on a suspended thread's
// loader lock). Only their code is looked up and unwound: an address elsewhere (a stale frame) made
// RtlLookupFunctionEntry fault and took the game down.
static struct { uintptr_t lo, hi; } images[512];
#define STACK_COPY (64u << 10)  // (the frames nearest the leaf: enough to tell work from a wait)
static uint8_t stack_copy[STACK_COPY + 65536];  // (slack: an unwind may read a little past the end of the copy)
static int nimages;
static void images_list(void) {
    HMODULE mods[512];
    DWORD need = 0;
    nimages = 0;
    if (!EnumProcessModules(GetCurrentProcess(), mods, sizeof mods, &need)) return;
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < need / sizeof *mods && i < 512; i++) {
        MODULEINFO mi;
        if (GetModuleInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), mods[i], &mi, sizeof mi))
            images[nimages].lo = (uintptr_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll, images[nimages++].hi = (uintptr_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll + mi.SizeOfImage;
    }
}
static bool in_image(uintptr_t a) {
    for (int i = 0; i < nimages; i++) if (a >= images[i].lo && a < images[i].hi) return true;
    return false;
}

// A thread's TEB, looked up once per thread: its NT_TIB says where its stack is (StackBase, the top, and StackLimit,
// how far down it is committed; the guard page lies below that).
typedef LONG (NTAPI *QueryThread)(HANDLE, int, void *, ULONG, ULONG *);
static struct { HANDLE h; NT_TIB *tib; } tibs[MAX_THREADS * 2];
static int ntibs;
static NT_TIB *thread_tib(HANDLE h) {
    for (int i = 0; i < ntibs; i++) if (tibs[i].h == h) return tibs[i].tib;
    static QueryThread q;
    if (!q) q = (QueryThread)(void *)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll"), "NtQueryInformationThread");
    struct { LONG status; void *teb; uintptr_t pid, tid, affinity; LONG prio, base; } tbi;  // THREAD_BASIC_INFORMATION
    NT_TIB *tib = q && q(h, 0, &tbi, sizeof tbi, NULL) >= 0 ? tbi.teb : NULL;
    if (ntibs < MAX_THREADS * 2) tibs[ntibs].h = h, tibs[ntibs++].tib = tib;
    return tib;
}

// Walks the stack of a suspended thread. The thread can be anywhere (a prologue, a system call, a driver's own code),
// so the unwinder may read what is not there. The unwind therefore runs on a copy of the stack (from rsp up, at most
// STACK_COPY bytes), with rsp and the frame register moved into it, and only inside loaded images; a fault still ends
// this one sample, never the game (the thread is resumed by the caller either way).
static int unwind(HANDLE h, CONTEXT *ctx, uint64_t *pc) {
    volatile int d = 0;
    __try {
        NT_TIB *tib = thread_tib(h);
        DWORD64 rsp0 = ctx->Rsp, top = tib ? (DWORD64)(uintptr_t)tib->StackBase : 0;
        if (!tib || rsp0 < (DWORD64)(uintptr_t)tib->StackLimit) top = 0;  // (not on its own stack: the leaf only)
        size_t len = top > rsp0 ? (size_t)(top - rsp0 < STACK_COPY ? top - rsp0 : STACK_COPY) : 0;
        DWORD64 lo = (DWORD64)(uintptr_t)stack_copy, hi = lo + len, delta = lo - rsp0;
        if (len) memcpy(stack_copy, (void *)(uintptr_t)rsp0, len);
        ctx->Rsp += delta;
        while (d < DEPTH && ctx->Rip) {
            pc[d] = ctx->Rip;
            d++;  // (counted here: every exit below leaves it matching what was stored)
            if (!in_image(ctx->Rip) || ctx->Rsp < lo || ctx->Rsp + 16 > hi) break;
            DWORD64 base = 0;
            PRUNTIME_FUNCTION f = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(ctx->Rip, &base, NULL);
            if (!f) {  // a leaf without unwind data: the return address is on top of the stack
                ctx->Rip = *(DWORD64 *)ctx->Rsp;
                ctx->Rsp += 8;
                continue;
            }
            const uint8_t *ui = (const uint8_t *)(base + f->UnwindData);
            unsigned freg = ui[3] & 15;
            if (freg) {  // (a register restored from the stack holds a real stack address: move it)
                DWORD64 *fv = &(&ctx->Rax)[freg];
                if (*fv >= rsp0 && *fv < rsp0 + len) *fv += delta;
                if (*fv < lo || *fv + 256 > hi) break;
            }
            void *hd = NULL;
            DWORD64 fr = 0;
            RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, base, ctx->Rip, f, ctx, &hd, &fr, NULL);
        }
    } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
    }
    return d;
}

static void *sampler_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    prof_thread_name("sampler");
    images_list();  // (before any thread is suspended: listing them then could wait on a suspended thread's loader lock)
    ntibs = 0;  // (a handle can name another thread since the last capture)
    pthread_t host[MAX_THREADS];
    uint32_t handle[MAX_THREADS];
    uint64_t entry[MAX_THREADS];
    for (uint64_t next = plat_now_ns(); __atomic_load_n(&g_running, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) && prof_enabled();
         next += (uint64_t)g_interval_us * 1000) {
        int n = kernel_running_threads(host, handle, entry, MAX_THREADS);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            HANDLE h = (HANDLE)pthread_gethandle(host[i]);
            if (!h || h == GetCurrentThread()) continue;
            uint64_t pc[DEPTH], tid = os_tid(h), t = 0;
            int d = 0;
            if (SuspendThread(h) == (DWORD)-1) continue;
            t = prof_ticks();
            CONTEXT ctx;
            memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof ctx);
            ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
            if (GetThreadContext(h, &ctx)) d = unwind(h, &ctx, pc);
            ResumeThread(h);
            if (d) emit(t, tid, handle[i], pc, d);
        }
        uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
        if (next > now) plat_sleep_until_ns(next);
        else next = now;
    }
    return NULL;
}

int prof_sampler_modules(ProfModule *out, int max) {
    // (a game with the video libraries loaded has hundreds of modules: ask for the size first)
    DWORD need = 0;
    K32EnumProcessModules(GetCurrentProcess(), NULL, 0, &need);
    if (need > UINT32_MAX - 64 * sizeof(HMODULE)) return 0;
    DWORD capacity = need + 64 * sizeof(HMODULE);
    HMODULE *mods = (HMODULE *)malloc(capacity);
    if (!mods) return 0;
    if (!K32EnumProcessModules(GetCurrentProcess(), mods, capacity, &need)) {
        free(mods);
        return 0;
    }
    int n = 0;
    if (need > capacity) need = capacity;  // DLLs can be loaded between the size query and this snapshot
    HMODULE exe = GetModuleHandleA(NULL);
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < need / sizeof(HMODULE) && n < max; i++) {
        MODULEINFO mi;
        if (!K32GetModuleInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), mods[i], &mi, sizeof mi)) continue;
        ProfModule *m = &out[n++];
        memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
        m->base = m->bias = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll;
        m->size = mi.SizeOfImage;
        K32GetModuleFileNameExA(GetCurrentProcess(), mods[i], m->name, sizeof m->name - 1);
        m->kind = mods[i] == exe ? PROF_MODULE_RUNTIME : strstr(m->name, "swgame") ? PROF_MODULE_GAME : PROF_MODULE_OTHER;
    }
    free(mods);
    return n;
}

#elif defined(__linux__)
#include <link.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <ucontext.h>
#include <unistd.h>

// Reserve an otherwise unused realtime signal for the process lifetime. Restoring SIG_DFL at capture stop is
// unsafe: a blocked thread can still have a queued sample. Tagged, expired requests are harmless in this handler.
// Only the interrupted PC is collected on Linux: backtrace() can lock the loader/allocator from a signal handler.
#define SAMPLE_SIGNAL (SIGRTMIN + 6)
static pthread_once_t signal_once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
static bool signal_ready;
static struct {
    uint32_t state;  // request id, high bit set while the handler owns the slot; zero means free
    uint32_t answered;
    uint64_t tid, pc, ticks;
} g_slot;
static uint32_t request_id;
_Static_assert(__atomic_always_lock_free(sizeof(uint32_t), 0), "signal handler needs lock-free request atomics");

// Guest threads name themselves before running guest code. Keep their pthread storage alive while signaling:
// a TLS destructor must pass this lock before the thread can finish, detach or be joined.
static pthread_mutex_t lifetime_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_once_t lifetime_once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
static pthread_key_t lifetime_key;
static struct LiveThread { pthread_t host; uint64_t serial; } live[MAX_THREADS];
static uint64_t lifetime_serial;

static void unregister_thread(void *p) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lifetime_lock);
    ((struct LiveThread *)p)->serial = 0;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lifetime_lock);
}

static void init_lifetime_key(void) {
    if (pthread_key_create(&lifetime_key, unregister_thread)) abort();
}

void prof_sampler_register_thread(void) {
    pthread_once(&lifetime_once, init_lifetime_key);
    if (pthread_getspecific(lifetime_key)) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lifetime_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_THREADS; i++) {
        if (live[i].serial) continue;
        live[i].host = pthread_self();
        live[i].serial = ++lifetime_serial;
        if (pthread_setspecific(lifetime_key, &live[i])) live[i].serial = 0;
        break;  // unregistered threads are skipped rather than signaled without a lifetime guard
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lifetime_lock);
}

static void on_signal(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *uc_) {
    (void)sig;
    if (si->si_code != SI_QUEUE || si->si_pid != getpid()) return;
    uint32_t req = (uint32_t)si->si_value.sival_int;
    if (!req || req & 0x80000000u) return;
    uint32_t expected = req;
    if (!__atomic_compare_exchange_n(&g_slot.state, &expected, req | 0x80000000u, false,
                                     __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) return;
    int saved_errno = errno;
    ucontext_t *uc = uc_;
    uint64_t pc = 0;
#if defined(__x86_64__)
    pc = (uint64_t)uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RIP];
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
    pc = (uint64_t)uc->uc_mcontext.pc;
#endif
    (void)uc;
    g_slot.pc = pc;
    g_slot.tid = (uint64_t)syscall(SYS_gettid);
    g_slot.ticks = prof_ticks();
    __atomic_store_n(&g_slot.answered, req, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    __atomic_store_n(&g_slot.state, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    errno = saved_errno;
}

static void install_signal(void) {
    struct sigaction old, sa;
    if (SAMPLE_SIGNAL > SIGRTMAX || sigaction(SAMPLE_SIGNAL, NULL, &old) || old.sa_handler != SIG_DFL) {
        LOG("[prof] Linux sampler unavailable: realtime signal already in use\n");
        return;
    }
    memset(&sa, 0, sizeof sa);
    sa.sa_sigaction = on_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_RESTART;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    signal_ready = sigaction(SAMPLE_SIGNAL, &sa, NULL) == 0;
}

static void *sampler_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    prof_thread_name("sampler");
    pthread_once(&signal_once, install_signal);
    if (!signal_ready) return NULL;
    pthread_t host[MAX_THREADS];
    uint32_t handle[MAX_THREADS];
    uint64_t entry[MAX_THREADS];
    for (uint64_t next = plat_now_ns(); __atomic_load_n(&g_running, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) && prof_enabled();
         next += (uint64_t)g_interval_us * 1000) {
        struct LiveThread snapshot[MAX_THREADS];
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lifetime_lock);
        memcpy(snapshot, live, sizeof snapshot);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lifetime_lock);
        int n = kernel_running_threads(host, handle, entry, MAX_THREADS);
        for (int i = 0; i < n && prof_enabled(); i++) {
            if (pthread_equal(host[i], pthread_self())) continue;
            // Never reuse a request number: an arbitrarily late signal must not match a future request.
            if (request_id == 0x7fffffffu) return NULL;
            uint32_t req = ++request_id;
            __atomic_store_n(&g_slot.state, req, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            union sigval value = {.sival_int = (int)req};
            int sent = ESRCH;
            pthread_mutex_lock(&lifetime_lock);
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_THREADS; j++) {
                if (snapshot[j].serial && snapshot[j].serial == live[j].serial && host[i] == live[j].host) {
                    sent = pthread_sigqueue(live[j].host, SAMPLE_SIGNAL, value);
                    break;
                }
            }
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&lifetime_lock);
            if (!sent) {
                for (int spin = 0; spin < 250 && __atomic_load_n(&g_slot.state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); spin++) {
                    struct timespec ts = {0, 20000};
                    nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
                }
            }
            uint32_t expected = req;
            __atomic_compare_exchange_n(&g_slot.state, &expected, 0, false, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            // A handler that already claimed the request only reads ucontext and writes this slot, never blocks.
            while (__atomic_load_n(&g_slot.state, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {}
            if (__atomic_load_n(&g_slot.answered, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) == req && g_slot.pc)
                emit(g_slot.ticks, g_slot.tid, handle[i], &g_slot.pc, 1);
        }
        uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
        if (next > now) plat_sleep_until_ns(next);
        else next = now;
    }
    return NULL;
}

static int module_cb(struct dl_phdr_info *info, size_t sz, void *arg) {
    (void)sz;
    struct { ProfModule *out; int n, max; } *a = arg;
    if (a->n >= a->max) return 1;
    uint64_t lo = ~0ull, hi = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < info->dlpi_phnum; i++)
        if (info->dlpi_phdr[i].p_type == PT_LOAD) {
            uint64_t s = info->dlpi_addr + info->dlpi_phdr[i].p_vaddr, e = s + info->dlpi_phdr[i].p_memsz;
            if (s < lo) lo = s;
            if (e > hi) hi = e;
        }
    if (lo >= hi) return 0;
    ProfModule *m = &a->out[a->n];
    memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
    m->base = lo;
    m->size = hi - lo;
    m->bias = info->dlpi_addr;
    snprintf(m->name, sizeof m->name, "%s", info->dlpi_name[0] ? info->dlpi_name : "(runtime)");
    m->kind = a->n == 0 ? PROF_MODULE_RUNTIME : strstr(m->name, "swgame") ? PROF_MODULE_GAME : PROF_MODULE_OTHER;
    a->n++;
    return 0;
}

int prof_sampler_modules(ProfModule *out, int max) {
    struct { ProfModule *out; int n, max; } a = {out, 0, max};
    dl_iterate_phdr(module_cb, &a);
    return a.n;
}

#else  // no sampler on this platform

static void *sampler_main(void *arg) { (void)arg; return NULL; }
int prof_sampler_modules(ProfModule *out, int max) { (void)out; (void)max; return 0; }

#endif

#ifndef __linux__
void prof_sampler_register_thread(void) {}
#endif

void prof_sampler_begin(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PROF_SAMPLE");
    long us = e ? atol(e) : 1000;
    if (us <= 0 || __atomic_load_n(&g_running, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return;
    if (us < 100) us = 100;
    g_interval_us = (uint32_t)us;
    __atomic_store_n(&g_running, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    if (pthread_create(&g_thread, NULL, sampler_main, NULL) != 0) __atomic_store_n(&g_running, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

void prof_sampler_end(void) {
    if (!__atomic_load_n(&g_running, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return;
    __atomic_store_n(&g_running, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    pthread_join(g_thread, NULL);
}

```

`runtime/quick_drop.c`:

```c
// Native quick-selector drop and cancel for BOTW 1.9.0.
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "game_sites.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "quick_drop_action.h"

extern uint64_t input_buttons_now(void);
extern void input_consume_buttons(uint64_t);
enum { QUICK_DROP_BUTTON = 1 << 3, QUICK_BACK_BUTTON = 1 << 1 };
static uint64_t menu_screen, menu_buttons;
static bool guest_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
static uint64_t probe_call(Cpu *, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t, uint64_t);
// Packed heartbeat: no guest memory is read by the render thread.
static _Atomic uint64_t drop_hint;
static uint64_t hint_now_ms(void) {
    struct timespec t;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t);
    return (uint64_t)t.tv_sec * 1000 + t.tv_nsec / 1000000;
}

// 0 hidden, 1/2 drop unavailable/available, 3 back only.
// Expiry also handles reset/load
// transitions that bypass the normal Menu callback.
int quick_drop_hint_state(void) {
    if (!quick_drop_action_enabled()) return 0;
    uint64_t hint = atomic_load(&drop_hint);
    if (!hint || hint_now_ms() - (hint >> 3) > 150) return 0;
    return hint & 7;
}

static void update_drop_hint(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t screen = c->x[0];
    atomic_store(&drop_hint, 0);
    if (!quick_drop_action_enabled() || !guest_range(screen, 0x38e5) ||
        LD8(screen + 0x38e4) == 2) return;
    int category = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738);
    if (category < 0 || category > 4) return;
    if (category > 2) {
        atomic_store(&drop_hint, (hint_now_ms() << 3) | 3);
        return;
    }
    int selected = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c);
    int count = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3880);
    uint64_t mgr = LD64(screen + 0x3640);
    if (!guest_range(mgr, 0x45000)) return;
    int state = 1;
    probe_call(c, g_site.pouch_lock, mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
    if (count > 0 && count <= 20 && selected >= 0 && selected < count) {
        uint64_t item = LD64(screen + 0x37c8 + (uint64_t)selected * 8);
        if (guest_range(item, 0x38) && LD8(item + 0x25) &&
            (int32_t)LD32(item + 0x20) > 0) {
            uint64_t name = LD64(item + 0x30);
            if (guest_range(name, 97) &&
                strncmp((const char *)(uintptr_t)name, "Weapon_Sword_070", 97) &&
                strncmp((const char *)(uintptr_t)name, "Weapon_Sword_502", 97)) state = 2;
        }
    }
    probe_call(c, g_site.pouch_unlock, mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
    atomic_store(&drop_hint, (hint_now_ms() << 3) | state);
}

RT_ON_RESET(quick_drop_reset) {
    menu_screen = menu_buttons = 0;
    atomic_store(&drop_hint, 0);
}

static bool quick_drop_enabled(void) {
    return quick_drop_action_enabled() && quick_drop_action_init();
}

// Called at Menu::enter, before the game's list initialization. Sampling here
// prevents a Y already held when the menu opens from becoming a new press.
void rt_quick_drop_begin(Cpu *c) {
    if (!quick_drop_enabled()) return;
    menu_screen = c->x[0];
    menu_buttons = input_buttons_now();

}

static bool guest_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    return addr >= GUEST_LO && addr < GUEST_HI && size <= GUEST_HI - addr;
}

static uint64_t probe_call(Cpu *original, uint64_t fn, uint64_t x0, uint64_t x1, uint64_t x2) {
    // Keep the interrupted function's entire guest register state unchanged.
    // Guest callees use their normal stack below the caller's current SP.
    Cpu call = *original;
    call.x[0] = x0;
    call.x[1] = x1;
    call.x[2] = x2;
    guest_call(&call, fn);
    return call.x[0];
}

static void quick_drop_menu(Cpu *c) {
    if (!quick_drop_enabled()) return;
    uint64_t screen = c->x[0], buttons = input_buttons_now();
    if (screen != menu_screen) {
        // An old game library may lack the enter hook: do not fabricate an edge.
        menu_screen = screen;
        menu_buttons = buttons;
        return;
    }
    bool back = (buttons & QUICK_BACK_BUTTON) && !(menu_buttons & QUICK_BACK_BUTTON);
    bool pressed = (buttons & QUICK_DROP_BUTTON) && !(menu_buttons & QUICK_DROP_BUTTON);
    menu_buttons = buttons;
    if (!guest_range(screen, 0x38e5)) return;
    // Menu::execute commits only when highlighted != applied. Restore the
    // applied index before requesting its native close transition (1.9.0).
    // Back wins over a simultaneous drop, including on an empty selector.
    if (back && quick_drop_action_enabled() &&
        (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738) >= 0 &&
        (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738) <= 4 && LD8(screen + 0x38e4) != 2) {
        // Let the game observe the opening direction as released, so its normal
        // close path also releases the pause/render state. Consume Back as well
        // to avoid turning the same press into a sprint after closing.
        input_consume_buttons(buttons & ((7ull << 12) | QUICK_BACK_BUTTON));
        ST32(screen + 0x387c, LD32(screen + 0x3878));
        ST8(screen + 0x38e4, 2);
        atomic_store(&drop_hint, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (!pressed) return;
    int category = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738);
    int selected = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c);
    int count = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3880);
    // Menu::execute sets/checks this transition flag when closing.
    if (LD8(screen + 0x38e4) == 2 || category < 0 || category > 2 ||
        count < 1 || count > 20 || selected < 0 || selected >= count) {
        LOG("[quick-drop] ignored category=%d selected=%d count=%d (no inventory change)\n",
            category, selected, count);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t mgr = LD64(screen + 0x3640);
    if (!guest_range(mgr, 0x45000)) return;

    // Native inventory lock. Getters below do not lock; item/page reads and
    // pointer matching must be in the same critical section.
    probe_call(c, g_site.pouch_lock, mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
    uint64_t item = LD64(screen + 0x37c8 + (uint64_t)selected * 8);
    int tab_found = -1, slot_found = -1, matches = 0;
    char name[97] = {0};
    if (guest_range(item, 0x38)) {
        // Every inventory page has at most 20 entries (gear is capped at 20,
        // and other categories are paginated). Reject an unexpected count.
        int tabs = (int32_t)LD32(mgr + 0x44498);
        if (tabs < 0 || tabs > 50) tabs = 0;
        for (int tab = 0; tab < tabs; tab++) {
            int n = (int32_t)probe_call(c, g_site.pouch_page_count, mgr, tab, 0);
            if (n < 0 || n > 20) continue;
            for (int slot = 0; slot < n; slot++) {
                uint64_t candidate = probe_call(c, g_site.pouch_page_item, mgr, tab, slot);
                if (candidate == item) {
                    tab_found = tab;
                    slot_found = slot;
                    matches++;
                }
            }
        }
        // Only dereference an item confirmed in the live inventory, not a stale
        // quick-menu pointer that might have been recycled in another list.
        if (matches == 1) {
            uint64_t str = LD64(item + 0x30);  // SafeString at item+0x28
            if (guest_range(str, sizeof name)) {
                for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < sizeof name; i++) {
                    unsigned ch = LD8(str + i);
                    if (!ch) break;
                    name[i] = ch >= 32 && ch < 127 ? (char)ch : '?';
                }
            }
        }
    }
    probe_call(c, g_site.pouch_unlock, mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
    if (quick_drop_action_enabled() && matches == 1) {
        quick_drop_action_request(c, screen, mgr, item, tab_found, slot_found, name);
        if (quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_PENDING) input_consume_buttons(QUICK_DROP_BUTTON);
    }
}


void rt_quick_drop_menu(Cpu *c) {
    if (!quick_drop_enabled()) {
        menu_screen = menu_buttons = 0;
        atomic_store(&drop_hint, 0);
        quick_drop_action_close(c);
        return;
    }
    quick_drop_menu(c);
    quick_drop_action_close(c);
    update_drop_hint(c);
}
```
