`runtime/quick_drop_action.c`:

```c
// Verified BOTW 1.9.0 quick drop: refresh unequipped items in the selector;
// close it and await native actor detach for equipped items.
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include "game_sites.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "quick_drop_action.h"

extern uint64_t input_buttons_now(void);
extern void input_consume_buttons(uint64_t);
extern uint64_t renderer_present_count(void);

enum { DROP_NAME_CAP = 97 };
static bool drop_ready;
static const char *drop_reason = "not-checked";
typedef struct {
    uint64_t screen, mgr, item, player;
    int type, value, category;
    bool equipped;
    char name[DROP_NAME_CAP];
} DropRequest;
static DropRequest pending_drop;
static QuickDropResult drop_result;
static uint64_t drop_links;
static uint64_t drop_ui_input;
static _Atomic uint64_t drop_generation;
static _Atomic bool drop_actor_consumed;
static struct {
    _Atomic bool active;
    bool recovery;
    uint64_t player, actor_link, actor_id, mgr, started;
    int actor_category;
    char name[DROP_NAME_CAP];
} equipped_drop;

QuickDropResult quick_drop_action_result(void) { return drop_result; }
bool quick_drop_action_busy(void) { return atomic_load(&equipped_drop.active); }

uint64_t quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(uint64_t buttons) {
    if (!quick_drop_action_busy()) return buttons;
    // Bits16..23 are derived stick directions, not equipment/menu actions.
    // Include SL/SR and any other injected action bits outside that range.
    uint64_t actions = buttons & ~UINT64_C(0xff0000);
    input_consume_buttons(actions);
    return buttons & UINT64_C(0xff0000);
}

static void drop_clear_ui_actions(void) {
    if (drop_ui_input >= GUEST_LO && drop_ui_input <= GUEST_HI - 0x118) {
        ST32(drop_ui_input + 0x114, 0);
        ST32(drop_ui_input + 8, 0);
    }
}

RT_ON_RESET(quick_drop_action_reset) {
    drop_ready = false;
    atomic_store(&drop_generation, 0);
    memset(&pending_drop, 0, sizeof pending_drop);
    memset(&equipped_drop, 0, sizeof equipped_drop);
    drop_result = QUICK_DROP_REJECTED;
    drop_links = 0;
    drop_ui_input = 0;
    atomic_store(&drop_actor_consumed, false);
}

bool quick_drop_action_enabled(void) {
    return g_settings.quick_drop && !strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0");
}

static bool drop_range(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    return addr >= GUEST_LO && addr < GUEST_HI && size <= GUEST_HI - addr;
}

// Guest code may only see scratch in its own address space. Leave a 0x100-byte
// area above the lowered SP for ByamlIter/name data, and preserve caller state.
static uint64_t drop_call(Cpu *source, uint64_t fn, uint64_t x0, uint64_t x1, uint64_t x2) {
    Cpu call = *source;
    call.x[0] = x0;
    call.x[1] = x1;
    call.x[2] = x2;
    call.x[3] = 0;
    guest_call(&call, fn);
    return call.x[0];
}

static bool drop_scratch(Cpu *original, Cpu *scratch) {
    if ((original->sp & 15) || original->sp < GUEST_LO + 0x100 ||
        !drop_range(original->sp - 0x100, 0x100)) return false;
    *scratch = *original;
    scratch->sp -= 0x100;
    return true;
}

static bool drop_name(uint64_t item, char out[DROP_NAME_CAP]) {
    uint64_t addr = LD64(item + 0x30);
    if (!drop_range(addr, DROP_NAME_CAP)) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < DROP_NAME_CAP; i++) {
        unsigned ch = LD8(addr + i);
        if (!ch) { out[i] = 0; return i > 0; }
        if (ch < 32 || ch > 126) return false;
        out[i] = (char)ch;
    }
    return false;
}

static bool drop_item_valid(uint64_t item, int type, int value, const char *name, bool equipped) {
    char current[DROP_NAME_CAP];
    return drop_range(item, 0x38) && (type == 0 || type == 1 || type == 3) && value > 0 &&
        (int32_t)LD32(item + 0x18) == type && (int32_t)LD32(item + 0x20) == value &&
        !!LD8(item + 0x24) == equipped && LD8(item + 0x25) && drop_name(item, current) && !strcmp(current, name) &&
        strcmp(name, "Weapon_Sword_070") && strcmp(name, "Weapon_Sword_502");
}

static bool drop_reject(const char *reason) { drop_reason = reason; return false; }

static bool drop_allowed(Cpu *scratch, uint64_t item, int type, int value, const char *name, bool equipped) {
    if (type != 0 && type != 1 && type != 3) return drop_reject("unsupported-type");
    if (!drop_range(item, 0x38) || !LD8(item + 0x25) || value <= 0)
        return drop_reject("invalid-item");
    if (!strcmp(name, "Weapon_Sword_070") || !strcmp(name, "Weapon_Sword_502"))
        return drop_reject("protected-name");
    if (!drop_item_valid(item, type, value, name, equipped)) return drop_reject("stale-item");
    if (drop_call(scratch, g_site.quick_drop_trash_prohibited, 0, 0, 0)) return drop_reject("TrashProhibition");
    if (drop_call(scratch, g_site.quick_sort_player_busy, 0, 0, 0)) return drop_reject("ChangeEquipProhibition");
    if (drop_call(scratch, g_site.quick_sort_event, 0, 0, 0)) return drop_reject("active-event");
    if (drop_call(scratch, g_site.quick_sort_modal, 0, 0, 0)) return drop_reject("screen-0xb-open");
    if (!drop_range(g_site.actor_info, 8)) return drop_reject("missing-actor-info-site");
    uint64_t info = LD64(g_site.actor_info);
    if (!drop_range(g_site.player_info, 8)) return drop_reject("missing-player-info-site");
    uint64_t player_info = LD64(g_site.player_info);
    if (!drop_range(info, 0x80) || !drop_range(player_info, 0x68))
        return drop_reject("missing-actor-or-player-info");
    uint64_t player = drop_call(scratch, g_site.player_actor, player_info, 0, 0);
    if (!drop_range(player, 0xcf9)) return drop_reject("missing-player");
    if ((LD8(player + 0xcf8) & 4) || drop_call(scratch, g_site.player_drop_forbidden, player, 0, 0))
        return drop_reject("player-state");
    uint64_t iter = scratch->sp + 0x10, guest_name = scratch->sp + 0x30;
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)iter, 0, 16);
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)guest_name, name, strlen(name) + 1);
    // Reject unknown actors explicitly; hasTag=false alone cannot distinguish
    // a failed lookup from a known actor without that tag.
    if (!drop_call(scratch, g_site.actor_info_lookup, info, iter, guest_name))
        return drop_reject("unknown-actor");
    if (drop_call(scratch, g_site.actor_info_has_tag, info, iter, 0x4850af43u))
        return drop_reject("Important-tag");
    if (drop_call(scratch, g_site.actor_info_has_tag, info, iter, 0x4873f474u))
        return drop_reject("NotDropFromPlayer-tag");
    drop_reason = "allowed";
    return true;
}

// Called only while holding the native manager mutex. Item identity, not the
// quick-list index or name, determines the page/slot passed to discard.
static bool drop_locate(Cpu *scratch, uint64_t mgr, uint64_t item, int *tab_out, int *slot_out) {
    int tabs = (int32_t)LD32(mgr + 0x44498), matches = 0;
    if (tabs < 1 || tabs > 50) return false;
    for (int tab = 0; tab < tabs; tab++) {
        int count = (int32_t)drop_call(scratch, g_site.pouch_page_count, mgr, tab, 0);
        if (count < 0 || count > 20) return false;
        for (int slot = 0; slot < count; slot++) {
            if (drop_call(scratch, g_site.pouch_page_item, mgr, tab, slot) == item) {
                *tab_out = tab;
                *slot_out = slot;
                matches++;
            }
        }
    }
    return matches == 1;
}

static bool drop_cache_compatible(uint64_t cached, uint64_t item, bool equipped) {
    // This is a scoped pause-UI snapshot: native quick selectors normally
    // leave it empty. A conflicting populated snapshot still fails closed.
    return equipped ? !cached || cached == item : cached != item;
}

// The equipped flag is authoritative only when one live category entry owns
// it. Pin that identity before preparing the native pause-style snapshot.
static bool drop_unique_equipped(Cpu *cpu, uint64_t mgr, uint64_t item, int type) {
    int tabs = (int32_t)LD32(mgr + 0x44498), equipped = 0;
    bool target = false;
    if (tabs < 1 || tabs > 50) return false;
    for (int tab = 0; tab < tabs; tab++) {
        int count = (int32_t)drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_page_count, mgr, tab, 0);
        if (count < 0 || count > 20) return false;
        for (int slot = 0; slot < count; slot++) {
            uint64_t candidate = drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_page_item, mgr, tab, slot);
            if (!candidate) continue;
            if (!drop_range(candidate, 0x26)) return false;
            if ((int32_t)LD32(candidate + 0x18) == type && LD8(candidate + 0x24)) {
                equipped++;
                target |= candidate == item;
            }
        }
    }
    return equipped == 1 && target;
}

static void drop_execute(Cpu *c);
static bool drop_equipped_begin(Cpu *, const DropRequest *, int tab, int slot);
static uint64_t drop_player(Cpu *);

// Runs before the original Menu callback, while its list is still stable.
void quick_drop_action_close(Cpu *c) { drop_execute(c); }

void quick_drop_action_request(Cpu *c, uint64_t screen, uint64_t mgr, uint64_t item,
                               int tab, int slot, const char *name) {
    if (equipped_drop.active || pending_drop.item) return;
    drop_result = QUICK_DROP_REJECTED;
    if (!drop_ready || !quick_drop_action_enabled() || pending_drop.item || !name ||
        !drop_range(screen, 0x38e5) || !drop_range(mgr, 0x45000) ||
        !drop_range(item, 0x38) || tab < 0 || tab >= 50 || slot < 0 || slot >= 20 ||
        strnlen(name, DROP_NAME_CAP) >= DROP_NAME_CAP) return;
    Cpu scratch;
    if (!drop_scratch(c, &scratch)) return;
    drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_lock, mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
    int count = (int32_t)drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_page_count, mgr, tab, 0);
    int type = (int32_t)LD32(item + 0x18), value = (int32_t)LD32(item + 0x20);
    uint64_t equipped_cache = type >= 0 && type < 4 ? LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + (uint64_t)type * 8) : 0;
    drop_reason = "inventory-slot-mismatch";
    bool equipped = !!LD8(item + 0x24);
    bool ok = count > slot && count <= 20 && drop_cache_compatible(equipped_cache, item, equipped) &&
        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_page_item, mgr, tab, slot) == item &&
        drop_allowed(&scratch, item, type, value, name, equipped);
    if (ok) {
        pending_drop.screen = screen;
        pending_drop.mgr = mgr;
        pending_drop.item = item;
        pending_drop.player = drop_player(&scratch);
        pending_drop.type = type;
        pending_drop.value = value;
        pending_drop.equipped = equipped;
        drop_result = QUICK_DROP_PENDING;
        pending_drop.category = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738);
        memcpy(pending_drop.name, name, strlen(name) + 1);
    }
    drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_unlock, mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
    if (ok) {
        LOG("[quick-drop] queued %s; updating open menu\n", name);

    } else LOG("[quick-drop] rejected %s reason=%s; inventory unchanged\n", name, drop_reason);
}

static void drop_execute(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t screen = c->x[0];
    if (equipped_drop.active) return;
    if (!quick_drop_action_enabled()) { memset(&pending_drop, 0, sizeof pending_drop); drop_result = QUICK_DROP_REJECTED; return; }
    // A request belongs to the menu state in which it was queued. If that
    // screen has moved on, do not leave it armed for a later menu session.
    if (pending_drop.item && pending_drop.screen == screen &&
        (!drop_range(screen, 0x38e5) || (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738) < 0 ||
         (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738) > 2 ||
         (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738) != pending_drop.category || LD8(screen + 0x38e4) == 2)) {
        memset(&pending_drop, 0, sizeof pending_drop);
        drop_result = QUICK_DROP_REJECTED;
        return;
    }
    if (pending_drop.item && pending_drop.screen == screen && drop_range(screen, 0x38e5) &&
        (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738) >= 0 &&
        (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738) <= 2 && LD8(screen + 0x38e4) != 2) {
        {
            Cpu scratch;
            if (drop_scratch(c, &scratch)) {
                // Consume the request before any guest code can re-enter this
                // callback. Every subsequent failure leaves inventory unchanged.
                __typeof__(pending_drop) request = pending_drop;
                memset(&pending_drop, 0, sizeof pending_drop);
                drop_result = QUICK_DROP_REJECTED;
                drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_lock, request.mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
                int tab = -1, slot = -1;
                drop_reason = "inventory-item-missing-or-ambiguous";
                bool ok = drop_locate(&scratch, request.mgr, request.item, &tab, &slot);
                if (ok && !drop_cache_compatible(LD64(request.mgr + 0x447e0 + (uint64_t)request.type * 8), request.item, request.equipped))
                    ok = drop_reject("changed-equipped-item");
                if (ok) ok = drop_allowed(&scratch, request.item, request.type, request.value, request.name, request.equipped);
                if (ok && request.equipped) {
                    if (!drop_equipped_begin(&scratch, &request, tab, slot))
                        LOG("[quick-drop] equipped drop rejected name=%s reason=%s; inventory unchanged\n", request.name, drop_reason);
                } else if (ok) {
                    // Confirmed recursive mutex: native ctor calls nn::os::
                    // InitializeMutex(recursive=true). Discard locks it again
                    // on the same guest thread while the outer lock pins identity.
                    drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_discard, request.mgr, tab, slot);
                    if (!LD8(request.item + 0x25)) {
                        // Full pause UI follows trashItem with this sweep (calls
                        // at e38254/e3f978). It recycles invalid entries, rebuilds
                        // tab/list heads and saves. The old pointer is no longer
                        // a live PouchItem afterwards: do not dereference it.
                        int selected = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c);
                        int category = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738);
                        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_cleanup, request.mgr, 0, 0);
                        drop_result = QUICK_DROP_COMPLETE;
                        // Rebuild the native pointer array and equipped index;
                        // never retain a pointer recycled by the cleanup sweep.
                        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_refill, screen, category, 0);
                        int count = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3880);
                        if (selected >= count) selected = count - 1;
                        if (selected < 0) selected = -1;
                        ST32(screen + 0x387c, selected);
                        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_mapping, screen, 0, 0);
                        int cursor = 0;
                        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++)
                            if ((int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3884 + i * 4) == selected) { cursor = i; break; }
                        // The native mapping also includes an unequip entry for
                        // ordinary swords, even when an item is highlighted.
                        // Derive the widget size from that rebuilt mapping, as
                        // category alone misses this slot and hides the last item.
                        int extra = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3884) == -1 ||
                            selected == -1;
                        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_cursor, LD64(screen + 0x37a8), cursor, count + extra);
                        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_labels, screen, 0, 0);
                        int remaining_tab = -1, remaining_slot = -1;
                        bool still_listed = drop_locate(&scratch, request.mgr, request.item,
                                                       &remaining_tab, &remaining_slot);
                        LOG("[quick-drop] cleanup name=%s still_listed=%d\n", request.name, still_listed);
                    }
                } else LOG("[quick-drop] canceled %s reason=%s\n", request.name, drop_reason);
                drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_unlock, request.mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
            } else { memset(&pending_drop, 0, sizeof pending_drop); drop_result = QUICK_DROP_REJECTED; }
        }
    }
}


static uint64_t drop_pending_offset(int category) {
    return category == 0 ? 0x13e0 : category == 1 ? 0x1428 : 0x1470;
}

static uint64_t drop_player(Cpu *cpu) {
    if (!drop_range(g_site.player_info, 8)) return 0;
    uint64_t info = LD64(g_site.player_info);
    return drop_range(info, 0x68) ? drop_call(cpu, g_site.player_actor, info, 0, 0) : 0;
}

static bool drop_index_matches(uint64_t link, uint64_t actor) {
    if (!drop_range(link, 0x10) || !LD8(link + 0xc) || LD32(link + 8) == UINT32_MAX) return false;
    uint64_t block = LD64(link);
    return drop_range(block, 0x54) && LD32(block + 0x40) == LD32(link + 8) && LD64(block + 0x48) == actor;
}

// An indexed retained reference survives actor-job callbacks. Resolve it into
// a fresh ordinary link for this callback only: native actor jobs deliberately
// omit the ordinary reference count, relying on their current-job lifetime.
static bool drop_resolve(Cpu *cpu, uint64_t index, uint64_t local, uint64_t actor) {
    if (!drop_index_matches(index, actor)) return false;
    return drop_call(cpu, g_site.actor_index_resolve, index, local, 0) == actor &&
        LD64(local + 8) == actor && drop_range(actor, 0x980) && LD8(actor + 0x64) == 1;
}

static void drop_release_locals(Cpu *cpu) {
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.actor_link_release, drop_links + 0x20, 0, 0);
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.actor_link_release, drop_links + 0x38, 0, 0);
}

static void drop_release_indices(Cpu *cpu) {
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.actor_index_release, drop_links, 0, 0);
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.actor_index_release, drop_links + 0x10, 0, 0);
}

// Called with the source pouch identity pinned. All checks and reference
// acquisition precede invalidation; after trashItem this code never reads item.
static bool drop_equipped_begin(Cpu *cpu, const DropRequest *request, int tab, int slot) {
    int category = request->type == 0 ? 0 : request->type == 3 ? 1 : 2;
    if (!drop_unique_equipped(cpu, request->mgr, request->item, request->type))
        return drop_reject("equipped-item-ambiguous");
    uint64_t player = drop_player(cpu);
    if (player != request->player || !drop_range(player, 0x1471))
        return drop_reject("equipped-player-changed");
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_lock, player + 0xeb8, 0, 0);
    bool equip_pending = LD8(player + 0x1120 + category);
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_unlock, player + 0xeb8, 0, 0);
    uint64_t pending_mutex = player + drop_pending_offset(category) - 0x40;
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_lock, pending_mutex, 0, 0);
    bool drop_pending = LD8(player + drop_pending_offset(category));
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_unlock, pending_mutex, 0, 0);
    if (equip_pending || drop_pending) return drop_reject("equipped-category-already-pending");
    uint64_t actor = drop_call(cpu, g_site.player_equipment, player, category, 0);
    if (!drop_range(actor, 0xfa0) || LD8(actor + 0x64) != 1 ||
        LD8(actor + 0x934) || !LD64(actor + 0x190))
        return drop_reject("equipped-actor-not-stable");
    if (!drop_call(cpu, g_site.actor_link_alive, actor + 0x938, 0, 0))
        return drop_reject("equipped-actor-owner-missing");
    uint64_t vtable = LD64(actor);
    if (!drop_range(vtable, 0x590) || LD64(vtable + 0x588) != g_site.quick_drop_actor_method)
        return drop_reject("unsupported-equipped-drop-method");
    uint64_t name = LD64(actor + 0x10);
    if (!drop_range(name, DROP_NAME_CAP) || strncmp((const char *)(uintptr_t)name, request->name, DROP_NAME_CAP))
        return drop_reject("equipped-actor-name-changed");
    uint64_t unequip = drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_default_name, request->mgr, request->type, 0);
    if (!drop_range(unequip, 0x10)) return drop_reject("equipped-default-name-missing");
    if (!drop_links) {
        drop_links = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)hle_alloc(0x50);
        if (drop_range(drop_links, 0x50)) {
            memset((void *)(uintptr_t)drop_links, 0, 0x50);
            ST32(drop_links + 8, UINT32_MAX);
            ST32(drop_links + 0x18, UINT32_MAX);
        }
    }
    if (!drop_range(drop_links, 0x50)) return drop_reject("equipped-link-storage");
    uint64_t actor_link_result = drop_call(cpu, g_site.actor_index_assign, drop_links, actor, 1);
    uint64_t player_link_result = drop_call(cpu, g_site.actor_index_assign, drop_links + 0x10, player, 1);
    if (!actor_link_result || !player_link_result ||
        !drop_resolve(cpu, drop_links, drop_links + 0x20, actor) ||
        !drop_resolve(cpu, drop_links + 0x10, drop_links + 0x38, player)) {
        LOG("[quick-drop] retained native link assignment actor_result=%" PRIu64 " player_result=%" PRIu64 "\n",
            actor_link_result, player_link_result);
        drop_release_locals(cpu);
        drop_release_indices(cpu);
        return drop_reject("equipped-actor-link-failed");
    }
    // Full pause modes populate these four words on entry and clear them on
    // exit; native quick mode does neither. Scope the same native snapshot to
    // trashItem's branch selection, under the already-held recursive lock.
    uint64_t saved_equipped[4];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) saved_equipped[i] = LD64(request->mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8);
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_equipped_snapshot, request->mgr, 0, 0);
    bool snapshot_matches = LD64(request->mgr + 0x447e0 + (uint64_t)request->type * 8) == request->item;
    if (!snapshot_matches) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) ST64(request->mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8, saved_equipped[i]);
        drop_release_locals(cpu);
        drop_release_indices(cpu);
        return drop_reject("equipped-snapshot-mismatch");
    }
    equipped_drop.recovery = false;
    atomic_store(&drop_actor_consumed, false);
    equipped_drop.player = player;
    equipped_drop.actor_link = drop_links;
    equipped_drop.actor_id = actor;
    equipped_drop.actor_category = category;
    equipped_drop.mgr = request->mgr;
    equipped_drop.started = renderer_present_count();
    memcpy(equipped_drop.name, request->name, sizeof equipped_drop.name);
    drop_result = QUICK_DROP_PENDING;
    atomic_fetch_add(&drop_generation, 1);
    atomic_store(&equipped_drop.active, true);
    drop_clear_ui_actions();
    // Establish drop intent first. Another guest worker may run between these
    // native calls: it must never consume an unequip before the drop is queued.
    // All remaining arguments are saved values, never the invalidated item.
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.pouch_discard, request->mgr, tab, slot);
    // cbe9b0 queued only a player flag. No later consumer needs this snapshot;
    // restore its exact previous UI scope without touching the invalid item.
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) ST64(request->mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8, saved_equipped[i]);
    // Native player virtual+858 schedules an empty category update and its
    // drop consumer under native locks. d9784c only queues the drop byte;
    // without this companion request idle players can leave it unconsumed.
    drop_call(cpu, g_site.player_schedule_equip, player, unequip, 0xffffffffu);
    // Close through the native selector transition without applying another
    // item. Consuming action buttons prevents reopening or equipping
    // incoming gear while the category-based native drop is queued.
    quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(input_buttons_now());
    ST32(request->screen + 0x387c, LD32(request->screen + 0x3878));
    ST8(request->screen + 0x38e4, 2);
    LOG("[quick-drop] equipped native drop pending name=%s category=%d actor=%" PRIx64 "; selector closing\n",
        equipped_drop.name, category, actor);
    drop_release_locals(cpu);
    return true;
}

void quick_drop_action_tick(Cpu *c) {
    if (!drop_ready || strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0")) return;
    // Remember this callback's native input before Menu::execute can admit a
    // request later in the same update. Admission clears these cached actions.
    drop_ui_input = 0;
    if (drop_range(c->x[0], 0x64c60)) {
        uint64_t input = LD64(c->x[0] + 0x649f0);
        if (drop_range(input, 0x118)) drop_ui_input = input;
    }
    if (!equipped_drop.active) return;
    drop_clear_ui_actions();
    quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(input_buttons_now());
    Cpu scratch;
    if (!drop_scratch(c, &scratch)) return;
    uint64_t player = equipped_drop.player, actor = equipped_drop.actor_id;
    bool identity = drop_player(&scratch) == player &&
        drop_resolve(&scratch, equipped_drop.actor_link, drop_links + 0x20, actor) &&
        drop_resolve(&scratch, drop_links + 0x10, drop_links + 0x38, player);
    if (identity && atomic_load(&drop_actor_consumed) && !LD8(player + 0x1120 + equipped_drop.actor_category) &&
        !LD8(player + drop_pending_offset(equipped_drop.actor_category)) &&
        !drop_call(&scratch, g_site.player_equipment, player, equipped_drop.actor_category, 0) &&
        LD8(actor + 0x920) == 0xff && !LD8(actor + 0x934) &&
        !drop_call(&scratch, g_site.actor_link_alive, actor + 0x938, 0, 0) &&
        !drop_call(&scratch, g_site.actor_link_alive, actor + 0x958, 0, 0)) {
        // Native1220268 has completed detach/placement and released owner links.
        // Only now recycle invalid pouch records; no saved PouchItem is read.
        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_lock, equipped_drop.mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_cleanup, equipped_drop.mgr, 0, 0);
        drop_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_unlock, equipped_drop.mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
        drop_release_indices(&scratch);
        drop_result = QUICK_DROP_COMPLETE;
        atomic_store(&equipped_drop.active, false);
        LOG("[quick-drop] equipped native drop completed name=%s actor=%" PRIx64 "\n", equipped_drop.name, actor);
    } else if (!equipped_drop.recovery && (!identity || renderer_present_count() - equipped_drop.started > 600)) {
        equipped_drop.recovery = true;
        int pending = -1, equip = -1, state = -1, detach = -1, owner = -1, other_owner = -1;
        uint64_t current = 0;
        // Only inspect actors protected by the same freshly resolved links used by
        // completion. This one-shot diagnostic does not admit or cancel work.
        if (identity) {
            pending = LD8(player + drop_pending_offset(equipped_drop.actor_category));
            equip = LD8(player + 0x1120 + equipped_drop.actor_category);
            state = LD8(actor + 0x920);
            detach = LD8(actor + 0x934);
            current = drop_call(&scratch, g_site.player_equipment, player, equipped_drop.actor_category, 0);
            owner = drop_call(&scratch, g_site.actor_link_alive, actor + 0x938, 0, 0) & 1;
            other_owner = drop_call(&scratch, g_site.actor_link_alive, actor + 0x958, 0, 0) & 1;
        }
        LOG("[quick-drop] equipped drop awaiting recovery name=%s identity=%d consumed=%d pending=%d equip=%d"
            " getter=%" PRIx64 " actor=%" PRIx64 " state=%d detach=%d owners=%d/%d; no rollback/requeue\n",
            equipped_drop.name, identity, atomic_load(&drop_actor_consumed), pending, equip,
            current, actor, state, detach, owner, other_owner);
    }
    drop_release_locals(&scratch);
}

// Capture an admitted transaction before the native virtual call. A later
// transaction cannot inherit this call's result, even if it reuses the actor.
uint64_t rt_quick_drop_actor_begin(uint64_t actor, uint64_t method) {
    if (!atomic_load(&equipped_drop.active) || actor != equipped_drop.actor_id ||
        method != g_site.quick_drop_actor_method || !drop_index_matches(equipped_drop.actor_link, actor)) return 0;
    return atomic_load(&drop_generation);
}

void rt_quick_drop_actor_end(uint64_t token, uint64_t actor, uint64_t result) {
    if (token && token == atomic_load(&drop_generation) && atomic_load(&equipped_drop.active) &&
        actor == equipped_drop.actor_id && drop_index_matches(equipped_drop.actor_link, actor) && (result & 1))
        atomic_store(&drop_actor_consumed, true);
}

bool quick_drop_action_init(void) {
    if (strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0")) return false;
    if (drop_ready) return true;
    if (!g_site.actor_info) return false;
    const uint64_t helpers[] = {g_site.pouch_lock, g_site.pouch_unlock, g_site.pouch_page_count, g_site.pouch_page_item,
        g_site.quick_drop_trash_prohibited, g_site.quick_sort_player_busy, g_site.quick_sort_event, g_site.quick_sort_modal, g_site.player_actor,
        g_site.player_drop_forbidden, g_site.actor_info_lookup, g_site.actor_info_has_tag, g_site.pouch_discard,
        g_site.player_equipment, g_site.pouch_default_name, g_site.player_schedule_equip, g_site.pouch_equipped_snapshot, g_site.actor_index_assign,
        g_site.actor_index_resolve, g_site.actor_index_release, g_site.actor_link_release, g_site.actor_link_alive, g_site.quick_drop_actor_method,
        g_site.pouch_cleanup, g_site.quick_sort_refill, g_site.quick_sort_mapping, g_site.quick_sort_cursor, g_site.quick_sort_labels};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof helpers / sizeof *helpers; i++)
        if (!helpers[i] || !dispatch_lookup(helpers[i])) {
            LOG("[quick-drop] missing native helper; action disabled\n");
            return false;
        }
    drop_ready = true;
    LOG("[quick-drop] guarded native quick drop enabled for 1.9.0\n");
    return true;
}
```

`runtime/quick_inventory_sort.c`:

```c
// Native pouch sorting for the verified BOTW 1.9.0 quick selector.
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include "hle.h"
#include "game_sites.h"
#include "quick_inventory_sort.h"
#include "settings.h"

extern uint64_t input_buttons_now(void);
extern void input_consume_buttons(uint64_t);

enum { SORT_X = 1 << 2, SORT_OTHER_ACTIONS = 1 | 2 | 8 };
static bool sort_ready;
static uint64_t sort_screen, sort_buttons;
static _Atomic uint64_t sort_hint_time;
static const int sort_categories[] = {0, 2, 1}; // weapon, shield, bow
static const int sort_types[] = {0, 3, 1};

static uint64_t sort_now(void) {
    struct timespec t;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t);
    return (uint64_t)t.tv_sec * 1000 + t.tv_nsec / 1000000;
}
static bool sort_range(uint64_t p, uint64_t n) {
    return p >= GUEST_LO && p < GUEST_HI && n <= GUEST_HI - p;
}
static uint64_t sort_call(Cpu *source, uint64_t entry, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t d) {
    Cpu call = *source;
    call.x[0] = a; call.x[1] = b; call.x[2] = d; call.x[3] = 0;
    guest_call(&call, entry);
    return call.x[0];
}
bool quick_inventory_sort_enabled(void) {
    return g_settings.quick_sort && !strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0");
}

static bool sort_shape(uint64_t screen) {
    if (!sort_ready || !quick_inventory_sort_enabled() || !sort_range(screen, 0x38e5) ||
        LD8(screen + 0x38e4) == 2) return false;
    int category = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738);
    int count = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3880);
    int selected = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c);
    return category >= 0 && category <= 2 && count > 0 && count <= 20 &&
        selected >= -1 && selected < count && sort_range(LD64(screen + 0x3640), 0x45000) &&
        sort_range(LD64(screen + 0x37a8), 0x40);
}

RT_ON_RESET(quick_inventory_sort_reset) {
    sort_ready = false;
    sort_screen = sort_buttons = 0;
    atomic_store(&sort_hint_time, 0);
}
void rt_quick_inventory_sort_begin(Cpu *c) {
    atomic_store(&sort_hint_time, 0);
    if (!quick_inventory_sort_enabled()) {
        sort_ready = false;
        sort_screen = sort_buttons = 0;
        return;
    }
    sort_ready = quick_inventory_sort_init();
    sort_screen = c->x[0]; sort_buttons = input_buttons_now();
}
void quick_inventory_sort_publish(uint64_t screen) {
    atomic_store(&sort_hint_time, sort_shape(screen) ? sort_now() : 0);
}
bool quick_inventory_sort_hint(void) {
    uint64_t t = atomic_load(&sort_hint_time);
    return g_settings.quick_sort && t && sort_now() - t <= 150;
}

// Every retained identity is pinned by the native recursive inventory mutex.
static bool sort_snapshot(Cpu *c, uint64_t screen, uint64_t mgr, int category,
                          uint64_t items[20], int count) {
    int matches[20] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        uint64_t item = items[i] = LD64(screen + 0x37c8 + i * 8);
        if (!sort_range(item, 0x90)) return false;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) if (items[j] == item) return false;
    }
    int tabs = (int32_t)LD32(mgr + 0x44498);
    if (tabs < 1 || tabs > 50) return false;
    for (int tab = 0; tab < tabs; tab++) {
        int n = (int32_t)sort_call(c, g_site.pouch_page_count, mgr, tab, 0);
        if (n < 0 || n > 20) return false;
        for (int slot = 0; slot < n; slot++) {
            uint64_t item = sort_call(c, g_site.pouch_page_item, mgr, tab, slot);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) matches[i] += item == items[i];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        // Prove live membership before dereferencing a potentially stale UI pointer.
        if (matches[i] != 1) return false;
        uint64_t item = items[i];
        if (!LD8(item + 0x25) || (int32_t)LD32(item + 0x18) != sort_types[category] ||
            (int32_t)LD32(item + 0x20) <= 0) return false;
        uint64_t name = LD64(item + 0x30);
        if (!sort_range(name, 97) || !LD8(name) ||
            strnlen((const char *)(uintptr_t)name, 97) >= 97 ||
            (int32_t)sort_call(c, g_site.pouch_item_type, item + 0x28, 0, 0) != sort_types[category]) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static void sort_execute(Cpu *original) {
    uint64_t screen = original->x[0];
    if (!sort_shape(screen) || (original->sp & 15) || original->sp < GUEST_LO + 0x2000 ||
        !sort_range(original->sp - 0x2000, 0x2000)) return;
    Cpu scratch = *original;
    scratch.sp -= 0x100;
    // Honor the native event, modal and equipment restrictions.
    if (sort_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_event, 0, 0, 0) ||
        sort_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_player_busy, 0, 0, 0) ||
        sort_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_modal, 0, 0, 0)) return;
    uint64_t mgr = LD64(screen + 0x3640), items[20], equipped[4];
    int category = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3738);
    int count = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3880);
    int selected = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c);
    sort_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_lock, mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
    if (!sort_snapshot(&scratch, screen, mgr, category, items, count)) goto done;
    // An unequip cell must exist in the source mapping as well as the rebuilt one.
    if (selected == -1 && (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3884) != -1) goto done;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) equipped[i] = LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8);
    uint64_t selected_item = selected < 0 ? 0 : items[selected];
    sort_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_sort, mgr, sort_categories[category], 0);
    // Pure sort preserves PouchItem nodes. No cleanup/discard sweep is involved.
    sort_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_refill, screen, category, 0);
    int rebuilt = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3880), restored = -1;
    if (rebuilt < 0 || rebuilt > 20) {
        LOG("[quick-inventory-sort] invalid rebuilt count=%d; refresh stopped\n", rebuilt);
        goto done;
    }
    bool intact = rebuilt == count;
    for (int i = 0; intact && i < count; i++) {
        int matches = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < rebuilt; j++)
            matches += items[i] == LD64(screen + 0x37c8 + j * 8);
        intact = matches == 1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) intact &= equipped[i] == LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8);
    if (intact) {
        for (int i = 0; selected_item && i < rebuilt; i++)
            if (LD64(screen + 0x37c8 + i * 8) == selected_item) restored = i;
        ST32(screen + 0x387c, restored);
    }
    // Keep +3878 from the refill: it identifies the actual equipped instance.
    sort_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_mapping, screen, 0, 0);
    int highlighted = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c), cursor = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++)
        if ((int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3884 + i * 4) == highlighted) { cursor = i; break; }
    if (rebuilt >= 0 && rebuilt <= 20 && cursor >= 0) {
        int extra = (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x3884) == -1 || highlighted == -1;
        sort_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_cursor, LD64(screen + 0x37a8), cursor, rebuilt + extra);
        sort_call(&scratch, g_site.quick_sort_labels, screen, 0, 0);
    }
    LOG("[quick-inventory-sort] category=%d native=%d item=%" PRIx64
        " selected=%d->%d count=%d->%d intact=%d\n", category, sort_categories[category],
        selected_item, selected, highlighted, count, rebuilt, intact);
done:
    sort_call(&scratch, g_site.pouch_unlock, mgr + 0x28, 0, 0);
}

void rt_quick_inventory_sort_menu(Cpu *c) {
    if (!quick_inventory_sort_enabled()) {
        sort_screen = sort_buttons = 0;
        atomic_store(&sort_hint_time, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (!sort_ready) sort_ready = quick_inventory_sort_init();
    quick_inventory_sort_publish(c->x[0]);
    uint64_t buttons = input_buttons_now(), pressed = buttons & ~sort_buttons;
    sort_buttons = buttons;
    if (c->x[0] != sort_screen) { sort_screen = c->x[0]; return; }
    if (!(pressed & SORT_X) || !sort_ready || !quick_inventory_sort_enabled()) return;
    // Cancel and other mutations win even when X has the newest edge.
    if (buttons & SORT_OTHER_ACTIONS) return;
    if (!sort_shape(c->x[0])) return;
    input_consume_buttons(SORT_X);
    sort_execute(c);
}

bool quick_inventory_sort_init(void) {
    if (strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0")) return false;
    const uint64_t helpers[] = {g_site.pouch_lock, g_site.pouch_unlock, g_site.pouch_page_count,
        g_site.pouch_page_item, g_site.pouch_item_type, g_site.quick_sort_event, g_site.quick_sort_player_busy,
        g_site.quick_sort_modal, g_site.pouch_sort, g_site.quick_sort_refill, g_site.quick_sort_mapping,
        g_site.quick_sort_cursor, g_site.quick_sort_labels};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof helpers / sizeof *helpers; i++)
        if (!helpers[i] || !dispatch_lookup(helpers[i])) return false;
    return true;
}
```

`runtime/romfs_build.c`:

```c
// RomFS image layout (romfs_build.h). Layout as the game's own image: a 0x50-byte header, file data from 0x200 (each
// file 16-byte aligned), then the directory hash table, directory entries, file hash table and file entries. The image
// itself is never written: runtime/romfs_image.c serves it from this layout and the files. Entries are found by hash
// (the game's RomFS code walks the tables itself), so the order inside them only
// has to be consistent: directories and files are sorted by name, children before siblings' children.
#include "romfs_build.h"

#include "platform.h"  // (Windows: POSIX mkdir)

#include <dirent.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#ifdef __APPLE__
#include <sys/clonefile.h>
#endif
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

#define EMPTY 0xFFFFFFFFu

typedef struct Dir Dir;
typedef struct {
    char *name, *path;
    uint64_t size, data_off;
    uint32_t off;  // entry offset in the file table
    Dir *parent;
} File;
struct Dir {
    char *name, *path;
    Dir *parent;
    Dir **dirs;
    File **files;
    int ndirs, nfiles;
    uint32_t off;  // entry offset in the directory table
};

static int by_name_dir(const void *a, const void *b) { return strcmp((*(Dir *const *)a)->name, (*(Dir *const *)b)->name); }
static int by_name_file(const void *a, const void *b) { return strcmp((*(File *const *)a)->name, (*(File *const *)b)->name); }

static Dir *scan(const char *path, const char *name, Dir *parent, int depth) {
    if (depth > 32) return NULL;
    DIR *d = opendir(path);
    if (!d) return NULL;
    Dir *dir = calloc(1, sizeof *dir);
    dir->name = strdup(name), dir->path = strdup(path), dir->parent = parent;
    int cd = 0, cf = 0;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;  // (".", "..", and hidden files such as .DS_Store aren't the game's)
        size_t n = strlen(path) + strlen(e->d_name) + 2;
        char *p = malloc(n);
        snprintf(p, n, "%s/%s", path, e->d_name);
        struct stat st;
        if (stat(p, &st) != 0) { free(p); continue; }
        if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
            Dir *c = scan(p, e->d_name, dir, depth + 1);
            free(p);
            if (!c) continue;
            if (dir->ndirs == cd) dir->dirs = realloc(dir->dirs, sizeof *dir->dirs * (cd = cd ? cd * 2 : 8));
            dir->dirs[dir->ndirs++] = c;
        } else if (S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) {
            File *f = calloc(1, sizeof *f);
            f->name = strdup(e->d_name), f->path = p, f->size = (uint64_t)st.st_size, f->parent = dir;
            if (dir->nfiles == cf) dir->files = realloc(dir->files, sizeof *dir->files * (cf = cf ? cf * 2 : 16));
            dir->files[dir->nfiles++] = f;
        } else {
            free(p);
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
    if (dir->ndirs) qsort(dir->dirs, dir->ndirs, sizeof *dir->dirs, by_name_dir);
    if (dir->nfiles) qsort(dir->files, dir->nfiles, sizeof *dir->files, by_name_file);
    return dir;
}

static void free_tree(Dir *d) {
    if (!d) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) free_tree(d->dirs[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) free(d->files[i]->name), free(d->files[i]->path), free(d->files[i]);
    free(d->dirs), free(d->files), free(d->name), free(d->path), free(d);
}

// flat lists, in table order
typedef struct { Dir **dirs; File **files; int nd, nf, cd, cf; } Lists;
static void flatten(Dir *d, Lists *l) {
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) {
        if (l->nf == l->cf) l->files = realloc(l->files, sizeof *l->files * (l->cf = l->cf ? l->cf * 2 : 256));
        l->files[l->nf++] = d->files[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) {
        if (l->nd == l->cd) l->dirs = realloc(l->dirs, sizeof *l->dirs * (l->cd = l->cd ? l->cd * 2 : 64));
        l->dirs[l->nd++] = d->dirs[i];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) flatten(d->dirs[i], l);
}

// the RomFS name hash and bucket count (as the game's RomFS code computes them)
static uint32_t name_hash(uint32_t parent, const char *name) {
    uint32_t h = parent ^ 123456789u;
    for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name; *p; p++) h = ((h >> 5) | (h << 27)) ^ *p;
    return h;
}
static uint32_t bucket_count(uint32_t n) {
    if (n < 3) return 3;
    if (n < 19) return n | 1;
    uint32_t c = n;
    while (c % 2 == 0 || c % 3 == 0 || c % 5 == 0 || c % 7 == 0 || c % 11 == 0 || c % 13 == 0 || c % 17 == 0) c++;
    return c;
}

static uint32_t align4(uint32_t x) { return (x + 3) & ~3u; }
static uint64_t align16(uint64_t x) { return (x + 15) & ~15ull; }
static void put32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 4); }
static void put64(uint8_t *p, uint64_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 8); }

uint64_t romfs_dir_bytes(const char *dir) {
    Dir *t = scan(dir, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!t) return 0;
    Lists l = {0};
    flatten(t, &l);
    uint64_t n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) n += l.files[i]->size;
    free(l.dirs), free(l.files);
    free_tree(t);
    return n;
}

bool romfs_layout(const char *dir, RomfsLayout *out, char *why, size_t why_size) {
    #define FAIL(...) do { if (why) snprintf(why, why_size, __VA_ARGS__); goto fail; } while (0)
    bool ok = false;
    uint8_t *dtab = NULL, *ftab = NULL;
    uint32_t *dbuckets = NULL, *fbuckets = NULL;
    Lists l = {0};
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    Dir *root = scan(dir, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!root) FAIL("can't read %s", dir);
    // table order: root, then each directory's subdirectories as flatten() lists them; files likewise
    if (l.nd == l.cd) l.dirs = realloc(l.dirs, sizeof *l.dirs * (l.cd = 64));
    l.dirs[l.nd++] = root;
    flatten(root, &l);
    if (!l.nf) FAIL("no files in %s", dir);

    // entry offsets
    uint32_t dsize = 0, fsize = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nd; i++) l.dirs[i]->off = dsize, dsize += 0x18 + align4((uint32_t)strlen(l.dirs[i]->name));
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) l.files[i]->off = fsize, fsize += 0x20 + align4((uint32_t)strlen(l.files[i]->name));
    // file data offsets (relative to the data start), each 16-byte aligned
    uint64_t data = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) {
        data = align16(data);
        l.files[i]->data_off = data;
        data += l.files[i]->size;
    }

    uint32_t nbd = bucket_count((uint32_t)l.nd), nbf = bucket_count((uint32_t)l.nf);
    dbuckets = malloc(4 * nbd), fbuckets = malloc(4 * nbf);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nbd; i++) dbuckets[i] = EMPTY;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nbf; i++) fbuckets[i] = EMPTY;
    dtab = calloc(1, dsize), ftab = calloc(1, fsize);
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nd; i++) {
        Dir *d = l.dirs[i];
        uint8_t *e = dtab + d->off;
        uint32_t parent = d->parent ? d->parent->off : 0, nl = (uint32_t)strlen(d->name);
        uint32_t sib = EMPTY;
        if (d->parent)
            for (int k = 0; k + 1 < d->parent->ndirs; k++)
                if (d->parent->dirs[k] == d) sib = d->parent->dirs[k + 1]->off;
        uint32_t h = name_hash(parent, d->name) % nbd;
        put32(e, parent);
        put32(e + 4, sib);
        put32(e + 8, d->ndirs ? d->dirs[0]->off : EMPTY);
        put32(e + 12, d->nfiles ? d->files[0]->off : EMPTY);
        put32(e + 16, dbuckets[h]);
        put32(e + 20, nl);
        memcpy(e + 0x18, d->name, nl);
        dbuckets[h] = d->off;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) {
        File *f = l.files[i];
        uint8_t *e = ftab + f->off;
        uint32_t nl = (uint32_t)strlen(f->name), sib = EMPTY;
        for (int k = 0; k + 1 < f->parent->nfiles; k++)
            if (f->parent->files[k] == f) sib = f->parent->files[k + 1]->off;
        uint32_t h = name_hash(f->parent->off, f->name) % nbf;
        put32(e, f->parent->off);
        put32(e + 4, sib);
        put64(e + 8, f->data_off);
        put64(e + 16, f->size);
        put32(e + 24, fbuckets[h]);
        put32(e + 28, nl);
        memcpy(e + 0x20, f->name, nl);
        fbuckets[h] = f->off;
    }

    // header: tables after the file data (4-byte aligned)
    uint64_t dhash_off = (ROMFS_DATA_START + data + 3) & ~3ull;
    uint64_t dmeta_off = dhash_off + 4ull * nbd, fhash_off = dmeta_off + dsize, fmeta_off = fhash_off + 4ull * nbf;
    uint64_t hv[10] = {0x50, dhash_off, 4ull * nbd, dmeta_off, dsize, fhash_off, 4ull * nbf, fmeta_off, fsize,
                       ROMFS_DATA_START};
    memcpy(out->header, hv, sizeof hv);
    // the tables, one blob from dhash_off: dir hash, dir entries, file hash, file entries
    out->tables_off = dhash_off;
    out->tables_size = fmeta_off + fsize - dhash_off;
    out->tables = malloc(out->tables_size);
    memcpy(out->tables, dbuckets, 4ull * nbd);
    memcpy(out->tables + (dmeta_off - dhash_off), dtab, dsize);
    memcpy(out->tables + (fhash_off - dhash_off), fbuckets, 4ull * nbf);
    memcpy(out->tables + (fmeta_off - dhash_off), ftab, fsize);
    out->size = fmeta_off + fsize;
    out->files = malloc(sizeof *out->files * l.nf);
    out->nfiles = l.nf;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++)  // (in data order: sorted by start)
        out->files[i] = (RomfsLayoutFile){ROMFS_DATA_START + l.files[i]->data_off, l.files[i]->size,
                                          strdup(l.files[i]->path)};
    ok = true;
fail:
    free(dtab), free(ftab), free(dbuckets), free(fbuckets), free(l.dirs), free(l.files);
    free_tree(root);
    return ok;
    #undef FAIL
}

void romfs_layout_free(RomfsLayout *l) {
    for (int i = 0; i < l->nfiles; i++) free(l->files[i].path);
    free(l->files), free(l->tables);
    memset(l, 0, sizeof *l);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ copying the player's folder
static bool copy_file(const char *src, const char *dst, uint64_t size, uint64_t *done, uint64_t total,
                      void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    remove(dst);
#ifdef __APPLE__
    if (clonefile(src, dst, 0) == 0) goto linked;  // (APFS: a copy-on-write clone, instant)
#endif
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (CreateHardLinkA(dst, src, NULL)) goto linked;  // (same NTFS volume: a hard link)
#else
    if (link(src, dst) == 0) goto linked;  // (same volume: a hard link)
#endif
    {
        // A read error ends fread as the end of the file does: the copy is whole only with the size the folder listed.
        // A shorter one (an unreadable sector, a drive that went away) would be served to the game as it is, its tail
        // missing, and could crash it only at the first scene that loads it (#368 looks like one): the setup fails.
        FILE *in = fopen(src, "rb"), *out = in ? fopen(dst, "wb") : NULL;
        bool ok = in && out;
        uint64_t copied = 0;
        static uint8_t buf[1 << 20];
        while (ok) {
            size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, in);
            if (!n) { ok = !ferror(in); break; }
            if (fwrite(buf, 1, n, out) != n) ok = false;
            copied += n;
            *done += n;
            if (progress) progress(*done, total);
        }
        if (in) fclose(in);
        if (out && fclose(out) != 0) ok = false;
        if (ok && copied != size) ok = false;
        if (!ok && out) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[romfs] copying %s: %llu of %llu bytes\n", src, (unsigned long long)copied,
                    (unsigned long long)size);
            remove(dst);
        }
        return ok;
    }
linked:
    *done += size;
    if (progress) progress(*done, total);
    return true;
}

static bool copy_dir(Dir *d, const char *dst, uint64_t *done, uint64_t total, void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    mkdir(dst, 0755);
    for (int i = 0; i < d->nfiles; i++) {
        size_t n = strlen(dst) + strlen(d->files[i]->name) + 2;
        char *p = malloc(n);
        snprintf(p, n, "%s/%s", dst, d->files[i]->name);
        bool ok = copy_file(d->files[i]->path, p, d->files[i]->size, done, total, progress);
        free(p);
        if (!ok) return false;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < d->ndirs; i++) {
        size_t n = strlen(dst) + strlen(d->dirs[i]->name) + 2;
        char *p = malloc(n);
        snprintf(p, n, "%s/%s", dst, d->dirs[i]->name);
        bool ok = copy_dir(d->dirs[i], p, done, total, progress);
        free(p);
        if (!ok) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool romfs_copy_tree(const char *src, const char *dst, void (*progress)(uint64_t, uint64_t)) {
    Dir *t = scan(src, "", NULL, 0);
    if (!t) return false;
    Lists l = {0};
    flatten(t, &l);
    uint64_t total = 0, done = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l.nf; i++) total += l.files[i]->size;
    bool ok = copy_dir(t, dst, &done, total, progress);
    free(l.dirs), free(l.files);
    free_tree(t);
    return ok;
}
```

```h
// The game's RomFS image, laid out from a folder of game files (runtime/romfs_build.c). The game reads its data through
// one raw RomFS image; runtime/romfs_image.c serves that image from this layout - the header and tables in memory,
// each file's data straight from its file in the player's romfs/ folder - so no second copy of the game data is kept.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define ROMFS_DATA_START 0x200u
typedef struct { uint64_t start, size; char *path; } RomfsLayoutFile;  // start: offset in the image
typedef struct {
    uint8_t header[ROMFS_DATA_START];  // the image's first bytes (the 0x50-byte header, then zeros)
    uint64_t tables_off, tables_size;  // dir hash, dir entries, file hash and file entries, one blob
    uint8_t *tables;
    RomfsLayoutFile *files;  // sorted by start; the bytes between files read as zeros
    int nfiles;
    uint64_t size;  // the whole image
} RomfsLayout;

// Lays out the RomFS image of the folder `dir`. false = failed (why: a short message).
bool romfs_layout(const char *dir, RomfsLayout *out, char *why, size_t why_size);
void romfs_layout_free(RomfsLayout *l);

// Bytes of file data under dir (the image is about this plus its tables).
uint64_t romfs_dir_bytes(const char *dir);

// Copies the folder tree src to dst (hard links where the file system allows: no second copy of 6 GB). progress as
// above. false = failed.
bool romfs_copy_tree(const char *src, const char *dst, void (*progress)(uint64_t done, uint64_t total));

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

`runtime/romfs_image.c`:

```c
// The RomFS image served from the romfs/ folder (romfs_image.h). The game reads from several threads, so a read only
// holds the lock to find its files' descriptors: the pread runs outside it, and a descriptor in use is never closed.
#include "romfs_image.h"

#include "platform.h"  // (Windows: pread)
#include "romfs_build.h"
#include "rt.h"

#include <fcntl.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#ifndef O_BINARY
#define O_BINARY 0
#endif

// Files kept open (macOS allows 256 open files by default, and the overlay keeps its own open: runtime/services/fs.c)
#define OPEN_FILES 32

typedef struct {
    int file, fd, busy;  // busy: reads using fd right now
    uint64_t used;       // for closing the least recently used
} OpenFile;

struct RomfsImage {
    RomfsLayout layout;
    int bin_fd;  // an older version's romfs.bin; -1: served from the folder
    uint64_t size;
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
    OpenFile open[OPEN_FILES];
    uint64_t tick;
};

RomfsImage *romfs_image_open(const char *dir, char *why, size_t why_size) {
    RomfsImage *img = calloc(1, sizeof *img);
    img->bin_fd = -1;
    pthread_mutex_init(&img->lock, NULL);
    for (int k = 0; k < OPEN_FILES; k++) img->open[k].fd = -1;
    struct stat sb;
    char layout_why[256] = "";
    if (stat(dir, &sb) == 0 && S_ISDIR(sb.st_mode) && romfs_layout(dir, &img->layout, layout_why, sizeof layout_why)) {
        img->size = img->layout.size;
        return img;
    }
    char bin[1100];
    snprintf(bin, sizeof bin, "%s.bin", dir);
    img->bin_fd = open(bin, O_RDONLY | O_BINARY);
    if (img->bin_fd >= 0 && fstat(img->bin_fd, &sb) == 0) {
        img->size = (uint64_t)sb.st_size;
        return img;
    }
    if (why) snprintf(why, why_size, "%s", layout_why[0] ? layout_why : "no game data folder");
    romfs_image_close(img);
    return NULL;
}

uint64_t romfs_image_size(const RomfsImage *img) { return img->size; }

// The descriptor of file i, marked busy in its slot (*slot; -1: every slot busy, the caller closes it). lock held.
static int file_fd(RomfsImage *img, int i, int *slot) {
    int pick = -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < OPEN_FILES; k++) {
        OpenFile *o = &img->open[k];
        if (o->fd >= 0 && o->file == i) {
            o->busy++, o->used = ++img->tick, *slot = k;
            return o->fd;
        }
        if (!o->busy && (pick < 0 || o->used < img->open[pick].used)) pick = k;
    }
    int fd = open(img->layout.files[i].path, O_RDONLY | O_BINARY);
    *slot = fd >= 0 ? pick : -1;
    if (*slot < 0) return fd;
    if (img->open[pick].fd >= 0) close(img->open[pick].fd);
    img->open[pick] = (OpenFile){i, fd, 1, ++img->tick};
    return fd;
}

static bool read_file(RomfsImage *img, int i, uint8_t *dst, uint64_t n, uint64_t off) {
    int slot;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&img->lock);
    int fd = file_fd(img, i, &slot);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&img->lock);
    if (fd < 0) return false;
    bool ok = pread(fd, dst, n, (off_t)off) == (ssize_t)n;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&img->lock);
    if (slot >= 0) img->open[slot].busy--;
    else close(fd);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&img->lock);
    return ok;
}

ssize_t romfs_image_pread(RomfsImage *img, void *dst_, uint64_t n, uint64_t off) {
    if (img->bin_fd >= 0) return pread(img->bin_fd, dst_, n, (off_t)off);
    const RomfsLayout *l = &img->layout;
    uint8_t *dst = dst_;
    memset(dst, 0, n);
    uint64_t end = off + n;
    if (off < ROMFS_DATA_START) memcpy(dst, l->header + off, (end < ROMFS_DATA_START ? end : ROMFS_DATA_START) - off);
    uint64_t ta = l->tables_off, tb = ta + l->tables_size;
    if (off < tb && end > ta) {
        uint64_t a = off > ta ? off : ta, b = end < tb ? end : tb;
        memcpy(dst + (a - off), l->tables + (a - ta), b - a);
    }
    // the files overlapping [off, end): the first by binary search, then in order
    int lo = 0, hi = l->nfiles - 1, first = l->nfiles;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (l->files[mid].start + l->files[mid].size > off) first = mid, hi = mid - 1;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    for (int i = first; i < l->nfiles && l->files[i].start < end; i++) {
        const RomfsLayoutFile *f = &l->files[i];
        uint64_t a = off > f->start ? off : f->start, b = end < f->start + f->size ? end : f->start + f->size;
        if (a >= b) continue;
        if (!read_file(img, i, dst + (a - off), b - a, a - f->start)) {
            LOG("[romfs] can't read %s\n", f->path);
            return -1;
        }
    }
    return (ssize_t)n;
}

void romfs_image_close(RomfsImage *img) {
    if (!img) return;
    for (int k = 0; k < OPEN_FILES; k++)
        if (img->open[k].fd >= 0) close(img->open[k].fd);
    if (img->bin_fd >= 0) close(img->bin_fd);
    romfs_layout_free(&img->layout);
    pthread_mutex_destroy(&img->lock);
    free(img);
}
```

```h
// romfs/ folder the setup copies (the header and tables laid out in memory by runtime/romfs_build.c, each file's data
```

`runtime/rt.h`:

```h
// Runtime-internal declarations.
#pragma once
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "cpu.h"
#include "platform.h"

// One line = one write. stderr is unbuffered (so nothing is lost in a crash), and fprintf on an unbuffered stream
// writes every piece of the format on its own; on Windows that cost ~2 ms per piece, so the fps line stalled the
// render thread for ~55 ms every interval. Format into a buffer first and write it once.
#include <stdarg.h>
static inline void rt_log(const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
static inline void rt_log(const char *fmt, ...) {
    char buf[8192];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    int n = vsnprintf(buf, sizeof buf, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (n < 0) return;
    if (n >= (int)sizeof buf) n = (int)sizeof buf - 1;  // (cut off, never longer than one line in practice)
    fwrite(buf, 1, (size_t)n, stderr);
}
#define LOG(...) rt_log(__VA_ARGS__)
#define FATAL(...) (fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: " __VA_ARGS__), rt_fatal_trace())

// ---- address space layout (guest addresses == host addresses)
// macOS reserves 0x2_0000_0000-0x70_0000_0000, and guest addresses must fit in 39 bits, so the
// guest lives in a 12.5 GB window at 0x70_0000_0000 claimed at startup (see main.c).
#define GUEST_LO     0x7000000000ull
#define GUEST_HI     0x7320000000ull
// The exefs modules (main, subsdk0..9, sdk) sit back to back from MAIN_BASE, main first, as tools/layout.py
// places them; the game code library says where each one is (runtime/gamelib.h). Both bounds: tools/layout.py too.
#define MAIN_BASE    0x7000000000ull
#define MODULES_END  0x7080000000ull
#define HLE_BASE     0x7080000000ull   // fake addresses for host-implemented functions
#define HLE_SIZE     0x0000100000ull
#define TLS_BASE     0x7090000000ull
#define TLS_SIZE     0x0000100000ull
#define HLE_HEAP     0x7092000000ull   // guest-visible memory owned by host code
#define HLE_HEAP_SIZE 0x000E000000ull
#define ALIAS_BASE   0x7100000000ull   // alias region (svcMapMemory targets)
#define ALIAS_SIZE   0x0100000000ull
#define HEAP_BASE    0x7240000000ull
#define HEAP_MAX     0x00D0000000ull   // 3.25 GB

// ---- loader.c
typedef struct Module {
    const char *name;
    uint64_t base, size;
    uint64_t text_off, text_size, ro_off, ro_size, data_off, data_size;
    uint64_t dynamic, init, fini, init_array, init_array_sz, fini_array, fini_array_sz;
    uint64_t symtab, strtab, nsyms;
} Module;

#define MAX_MODULES 12  // main, subsdk0..9, sdk

extern Module g_modules[MAX_MODULES];  // in load order
extern int g_nmodules;
void loader_load(const char *exefs_dir);  // (again after a reboot: modules are reloaded into wiped memory)
Module *loader_module(const char *name);  // NULL if the game has no such module
uint64_t loader_find_symbol(const char *name);
uint64_t loader_find_symbol_in(const char *module, const char *name);  // an export of that module only
const char *loader_symbol_at(uint64_t addr, uint64_t *offset);

// ---- dispatch.c
typedef void (*HostFn)(Cpu *c);
void dispatch_init(void);
GuestFn dispatch_lookup(uint64_t addr);
uint64_t hle_register(const char *name, HostFn fn);  // returns fake guest address
HostFn hle_lookup_impl(const char *name);
void hle_override(uint64_t guest_addr, HostFn fn, const char *name);
void rt_fatal_trace(void) __attribute__((noreturn));
extern void (*rt_crash_note)(void);  // (set by the Vulkan recorder) what it was handing the driver, printed by rt_fatal_trace
void crash_handler_install(void);  // per thread (alternate signal stack)

// ---- kernel.c
typedef struct KThread KThread;

uint32_t kernel_current_thread_handle(void);

// ---- ipc.c
typedef struct Service Service;

// ---- in-place reboot (main.c): boot again or go back to the start screen without leaving the process
```

`runtime/rupees.c`:

```c
// Cheats: Infinite rupees (the wallet kept at 9999, from the Savage Wind overlay's Cheats tab or `rupees lock`) and
// `rupees <n>` (the wallet set once). No patch in the game code: a thread of ours finds the rupee count's game data
// flag in the game's memory and writes it: a set at once, the top-up every RUPEE_POLL_MS while the cheat is on.
//
// The game keeps each game data flag as an object on its heap (ksys::gdt, made once as it starts): an s32 flag is
// 0x28 bytes - +0 its class (vtable, in main), +0x18 its value, +0x1c the crc32 of its name (the save's hash). The
// s32 class is found from a flag every version has (MaxHartValue), then the CurrentRupee object among the objects of
// that class. Both are looked for only while there is something to write, and the object is checked again before
// each write (a new game, or a load, may lay the heap out again). From Slop of the Wild, where the same reader also
// fed its achievements.
#include <errno.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "control.h"
#include "game_sites.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "platform.h"
#include "rt.h"
#include "settings.h"

#define RUPEE_POLL_MS 5000         // (a scan of the heap is long: no one needs the top-up sooner than this)
#define RUPEE_MAX 9999             // (the Infinite rupees top-up target)
#define RUPEE_SET_MAX 999999       // (the game's own wallet limit)
#define RUPEE_HASH 0x23149bf8u     // crc32("CurrentRupee")
#define S32_HASH 0x2906f327u       // crc32("MaxHartValue")

static pthread_t thread;
static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t wake = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static bool running, stop_req, poked;  // (poked: a command wants the thread now, not at the next poll)
static int32_t want = -1;              // `rupees <n>`: the count to write once (-1: none); under lock
static int32_t last_seen = -1;         // the count the thread last read (-1: not found yet), for `rupees`
static uint64_t vt_s32, rupee_obj;

static uint32_t rd32(uint64_t a) { return *(volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)a; }
static uint64_t rd64(uint64_t a) { return *(volatile uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)a; }
static bool stopping(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&stop_req, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

static bool in_main(uint64_t v) { return v >= 0x7000000000ull && g_site.main_end && v < g_site.main_end && !(v & 7); }

// The class of the s32 flag named by `hash` (its object: the hash at +0x1c, the class at +0)
static uint64_t s32_class(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi, uint32_t hash) {
    uint64_t a, e;
    for (uint64_t at = lo; !stopping() && plat_committed_range(at, hi, &a, &e); at = e)  // (only memory that is there)
        for (uint64_t p = ((a + 0x1c + 7) & ~7ull) - 4; p + 4 <= e; p += 8) {  // (p - 0x1c 8-aligned)
            if (rd32(p) != hash) continue;
            uint64_t vt = rd64(p - 0x1c);
            if (in_main(vt)) return vt;
        }
    return 0;
}

// The CurrentRupee flag object, 0: not found (yet)
static uint64_t find_rupees(void) {
    uint64_t lo = HEAP_BASE, hi = HEAP_BASE + kernel_heap_size();
    if (hi <= lo) return 0;
    if (!vt_s32) vt_s32 = s32_class(lo, hi, S32_HASH);
    if (!vt_s32) return 0;
    uint64_t a, e;
    for (uint64_t at = lo; !stopping() && plat_committed_range(at, hi, &a, &e); at = e)
        for (uint64_t p = (a + 7) & ~7ull; p + 0x28 <= e; p += 8)
            if (rd64(p) == vt_s32 && rd32(p + 0x1c) == RUPEE_HASH) return p;
    return 0;
}

static bool still_rupees(uint64_t obj) {
    uint64_t a, e;
    return obj && plat_committed_range(obj, obj + 0x28, &a, &e) && a == obj && e == obj + 0x28 &&
           rd64(obj) == vt_s32 && rd32(obj + 0x1c) == RUPEE_HASH;
}

static void *rupee_thread(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    while (!stop_req) {
        int32_t set = want;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        bool look = (g_settings.infinite_rupees || set >= 0) && kernel_heap_size();
        if (look && !still_rupees(rupee_obj)) {
            rupee_obj = find_rupees();
            if (rupee_obj) LOG("[cheats] rupees: the rupee count is at %llx\n", (unsigned long long)rupee_obj);
        }
        if (look && rupee_obj) {
            if (set >= 0) {
                *(volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(rupee_obj + 0x18) = (uint32_t)set;
                LOG("[cheats] rupees: wallet set to %d\n", (int)set);
            }
            if (g_settings.infinite_rupees && (int32_t)rd32(rupee_obj + 0x18) < RUPEE_MAX) {
                *(volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(rupee_obj + 0x18) = RUPEE_MAX;
                static bool said;
                if (!said) said = true, LOG("[cheats] infinite rupees: wallet filled\n");
            }
            __atomic_store_n(&last_seen, (int32_t)rd32(rupee_obj + 0x18), __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        }
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
        if (set >= 0 && want == set && rupee_obj) want = -1;  // (written; not found yet: tried again at the next poll)
        struct timespec until;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &until);
        long long ns = until.tv_nsec + RUPEE_POLL_MS * 1000000LL;
        until.tv_sec += (time_t)(ns / 1000000000LL), until.tv_nsec = (long)(ns % 1000000000LL);
        while (!stop_req && !poked && pthread_cond_timedwait(&wake, &lock, &until) != ETIMEDOUT) {}
        poked = false;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return NULL;
}

static void poke(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    poked = true;
    pthread_cond_signal(&wake);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}

// rupees: show | <0-999999>: set once | lock: keep at 9999 (Infinite rupees) | unlock
static void cmd_rupees(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    if (!running || !kernel_heap_size()) { control_fail(r, "The game isn't running yet"); return; }
    if (argc > 2) { control_fail(r, "rupees: use rupees, rupees <0-%d>, rupees lock or rupees unlock", RUPEE_SET_MAX); return; }
    if (argc == 2 && (!strcmp(argv[1], "lock") || !strcmp(argv[1], "unlock"))) {
        g_settings.infinite_rupees = argv[1][0] == 'l';
        poke();
        control_field_bool(r, "lock", g_settings.infinite_rupees);
        if (g_settings.infinite_rupees) control_text(r, "Infinite rupees on: the wallet is kept at %d", RUPEE_MAX);
        else control_text(r, "Infinite rupees off");
        return;
    }
    if (argc == 2) {
        char *end;
        long n = strtol(argv[1], &end, 10);
        if (end == argv[1] || *end || n < 0 || n > RUPEE_SET_MAX) {
            control_fail(r, "rupees: a count from 0 to %d, lock or unlock", RUPEE_SET_MAX);
            return;
        }
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
        want = (int32_t)n;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        poke();
        control_field_int(r, "set", n);
        control_text(r, "Setting the wallet to %ld rupees (the first time, finding it takes a few seconds)", n);
        if (g_settings.infinite_rupees) control_text(r, "Infinite rupees is on: it tops the wallet up to %d again", RUPEE_MAX);
        return;
    }
    int32_t seen = __atomic_load_n(&last_seen, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    control_field_bool(r, "lock", g_settings.infinite_rupees);
    if (seen >= 0) control_field_int(r, "rupees", seen);
    control_text(r, "Infinite rupees: %s", g_settings.infinite_rupees ? "on" : "off");
    if (seen >= 0) control_text(r, "Wallet: %d rupees", (int)seen);
    else control_text(r, "Wallet: not read yet (rupees <n> or rupees lock finds it)");
}

// (runtime/control_game.c: developer mode only - it writes the game's memory)
void rupees_control_init(void) {
    static const ControlCmd cmds[] = {
        {"rupees", "[<0-999999> | lock | unlock]", "Cheat: show, set or lock the rupee count", cmd_rupees, 0},
    };
    control_register(cmds, 1);
}

// Set the rupee wallet once from the UI (false if the game isn't running or count is out of range)
bool rupees_set(int32_t count) {
    if (!running || !kernel_heap_size() || count < 0 || count > RUPEE_SET_MAX) return false;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    want = count;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    poke();
    return true;
}

// (runtime/main.c boot: each game start)
void rupees_start(void) {
    if (running) return;
    stop_req = poked = false;
    if (pthread_create(&thread, NULL, rupee_thread, NULL) == 0) running = true;
}

// Reboot: the thread is gone before the guest memory is reset under it; the next boot starts it again
RT_ON_RESET(rupees_reset) {
    if (running) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
        __atomic_store_n(&stop_req, true, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        pthread_cond_signal(&wake);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        pthread_join(thread, NULL);
        running = false;
    }
    vt_s32 = rupee_obj = 0;
    want = last_seen = -1;
}
```
