```c
// Debug overrides seed this boot's options; the Controls switches can still change them at once.
static void pc_controls_env(void) {
    const char *cursor = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PC_CURSOR");
    if (cursor) g_settings.pc_cursor = atoi(cursor) != 0;
}

// SAVAGEWIND_PC_GYRO / SAVAGEWIND_GYRO_SCENE=0|1: the two shrine apparatus switches at start (Controls changes them)
static void gyro_startup_overrides(void) {
    const char *v = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_PC_GYRO");
    if (v && *v) g_settings.pc_gyro = atoi(v) != 0;
    v = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_GYRO_SCENE");
    if (v && *v) g_settings.gyro_scene = atoi(v) != 0;
}
void settings_fps_for_display(float hz) {
    if (!g_settings.fps_display || hz < 20) return;
    // The display's own rate, not the nearest one of the menu's list: a 210 Hz monitor stayed at 165, a 72 Hz one at 60 (#661).
    int best = (int)(hz + 0.5f);
    if (best > 360) best = 360;  // (framepace.c FPS_CEILING)
    if (g_settings.fps_limit != best) LOG("[settings] frame rate %d (Match display: %.0f Hz)\n", best, hz);
    g_settings.fps_limit = best;
}

static const Handheld *handheld(void) {
    static Handheld h;
    static bool done;
    if (!done) {
        h = handheld_detect(), done = true;
        if (h.on) LOG("[settings] PC handheld%s, screen %d x %d\n", h.deck ? " (Steam Deck)" : "", h.w, h.h);
    }
    return &h;
}
bool settings_handheld(void) { return handheld()->on; }
bool settings_steam_deck(void) { return handheld()->deck; }
bool settings_handheld_size(int *w, int *h) {
    if (handheld()->w <= 0) return false;
    *w = handheld()->w, *h = handheld()->h;
    return true;
}

int settings_aa_row(void) {
    return g_settings.antialias == AA_TAA ? AA_ROW_TAA : g_settings.antialias == AA_SMAA ? AA_ROW_SMAA
         : g_settings.game_fxaa ? AA_ROW_FXAA : AA_ROW_OFF;
}
void settings_aa_row_set(int row) {
    g_settings.antialias = row == AA_ROW_TAA ? AA_TAA : row == AA_ROW_SMAA ? AA_SMAA : AA_OFF;
    g_settings.game_fxaa = row == AA_ROW_FXAA;
}

int fps_choices(const int **list) {
    static const int pc[] = FPS_CHOICES, hh[] = FPS_CHOICES_HANDHELD, fast[] = FPS_CHOICES_HANDHELD_FAST;
    static int h_list[FPS_CHOICES_MAX];
    _Static_assert(sizeof pc / sizeof pc[0] <= FPS_CHOICES_MAX, "");
    _Static_assert(sizeof hh / sizeof hh[0] + sizeof fast / sizeof fast[0] <= FPS_CHOICES_MAX, "");
    if (!settings_handheld()) {
        *list = pc;
        return (int)(sizeof pc / sizeof pc[0]);
    }
    extern float winsize_refresh_rate(void);
    float hz = winsize_refresh_rate();
    int n = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof hh / sizeof hh[0]; i++) h_list[n++] = hh[i];
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof fast / sizeof fast[0]; i++)
        if (hz <= 0 || fast[i] <= hz + 0.5f) h_list[n++] = fast[i];
    *list = h_list;
    return n;
}

// The first start on a handheld, also with settings from before this: the handheld's preset, full screen at its size
static void handheld_first_setup(void) {
    if (!settings_handheld() || g_settings.handheld_setup) return;
    g_settings.handheld_setup = true;
    graphics_preset_apply(GPRESET_HANDHELD);
    g_settings.fullscreen = true;
    g_settings.window_w = g_settings.window_h = 0;
    g_settings.fps_limit = FPS_DEFAULT, g_settings.fps_display = false;
    g_settings.fov = 80, g_settings.hud_edges = true;
    g_settings.sharper_menus = g_settings.sharper_text = 2;  // (small screen: the letters and menus stay crisp)
    LOG("[settings] PC handheld: its own settings, the first time\n");
}

// Video > HDR preset: the whole HDR look, as the mod's presets are. The display peak, game and UI whites are
// included, so a preset restores the display setup too; a default slot stores 0 for them (keep the current setup)
// until hdr_look_init_peak fills them after the ICC read. Slots are clamped so a hand-edited INI cannot break the
// shader.
static void hdr_look_get(int *v) {
    v[0] = g_settings.hdr_tonemapper == 0 ? 0 : 1;
    v[1] = g_settings.hdr_exposure;
    v[2] = g_settings.hdr_highlights;
    v[3] = g_settings.hdr_shadows;
    v[4] = g_settings.hdr_contrast;
    v[5] = g_settings.hdr_saturation;
    v[6] = g_settings.hdr_highlight_saturation;
    v[7] = g_settings.hdr_flare;
    v[8] = g_settings.hdr_hue;
    v[9] = g_settings.hdr_blowout;
    v[10] = g_settings.hdr_sdr_blend;
    v[11] = g_settings.hdr_vanilla_saturation;
    v[12] = g_settings.hdr_bloom;
    v[13] = g_settings.hdr_clamp == 1 ? 1 : 0;
    v[14] = g_settings.hdr_peak_nits;
    v[15] = g_settings.hdr_game_nits;
    v[16] = g_settings.hdr_ui_nits;
    v[17] = g_settings.hdr_gamma;
}

static int hdr_look_clamp(int i, int x) {
    switch (i) {
    case 0: return x ? 1 : 0;
    case 1: return x >= 50 && x <= 200 ? x : 100;
    case 7: return x >= 0 && x <= 100 ? x : 0;
    case 8: return x >= 0 && x <= 100 ? x : 70;
    case 9: return x >= 0 && x <= 100 ? x : 65;
    case 10: return x >= 0 && x <= 60 ? x : 18;
    case 11: return x >= 0 && x <= 100 ? x : 100;
    case 12: return x >= 0 && x <= 100 ? x : 100;
    case 13: return x ? 1 : 0;
    case 14: return x == 0 || (x >= 80 && x <= 10000) ? x : 0;
    case 15: return x == 0 || (x >= 80 && x <= 1000) ? x : 0;
    case 16: return x == 0 || (x >= 80 && x <= 1000) ? x : 0;
    case 17: return x >= 0 && x <= 2 ? x : 0;
    default: return x >= 0 && x <= 100 ? x : 50;
    }
}

// The mod's OnPresetOff: ToneMapType 0, peak/game/UI 203, the grading neutral, hue 100, blowout 0, bloom 100.
// -1 means "leave as it is": the mod's OnPresetOff does not set SDR blend, vanilla saturation or the clamp.
static const int k_hdr_off[18] = {0, 100, 50, 50, 50, 50, 50, 0, 100, 0, -1, -1, 100, -1, 203, 203, 203, 0};

static bool hdr_look_matches(const int *a) {
    int cur[18];
    hdr_look_get(cur);
    for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
        if (a[i] < 0 && (i == 10 || i == 11 || i == 13)) continue;  // (Preset Off leaves these as they are)
        int v = hdr_look_clamp(i, a[i]);
        if (v == 0 && (i == 14 || i == 15 || i == 16)) continue;  // (a default slot: keep the current display setup)
        if (v != cur[i]) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int hdr_look_current(void) {
    int slot = g_settings.hdr_preset;
    if (slot == 0) return hdr_look_matches(k_hdr_off) ? 0 : 4;
    if (slot >= 1 && slot <= 3 && hdr_look_matches(g_settings.hdr_look[slot - 1])) return slot;
    return 4;  // (a stored slot with different values is Custom, even if another slot happens to match)
}

void hdr_look_apply(int slot) {
    if (slot < 0 || slot > 3) return;
    const int *v = slot == 0 ? k_hdr_off : g_settings.hdr_look[slot - 1];
    g_settings.hdr_tonemapper = hdr_look_clamp(0, v[0]);
    g_settings.hdr_exposure = hdr_look_clamp(1, v[1]);
    g_settings.hdr_highlights = hdr_look_clamp(2, v[2]);
    g_settings.hdr_shadows = hdr_look_clamp(3, v[3]);
    g_settings.hdr_contrast = hdr_look_clamp(4, v[4]);
    g_settings.hdr_saturation = hdr_look_clamp(5, v[5]);
    g_settings.hdr_highlight_saturation = hdr_look_clamp(6, v[6]);
    g_settings.hdr_flare = hdr_look_clamp(7, v[7]);
    g_settings.hdr_hue = hdr_look_clamp(8, v[8]);
    g_settings.hdr_blowout = hdr_look_clamp(9, v[9]);
    if (v[10] >= 0) g_settings.hdr_sdr_blend = hdr_look_clamp(10, v[10]);
    if (v[11] >= 0) g_settings.hdr_vanilla_saturation = hdr_look_clamp(11, v[11]);
    g_settings.hdr_bloom = hdr_look_clamp(12, v[12]);
    if (v[13] >= 0) g_settings.hdr_clamp = hdr_look_clamp(13, v[13]);
    int pv = hdr_look_clamp(14, v[14]);
    int gv = hdr_look_clamp(15, v[15]);
    int uv = hdr_look_clamp(16, v[16]);
    if (pv != 0) g_settings.hdr_peak_nits = pv;
    if (gv != 0) g_settings.hdr_game_nits = gv;
    if (uv != 0) g_settings.hdr_ui_nits = uv;
    g_settings.hdr_gamma = hdr_look_clamp(17, v[17]);
    g_settings.hdr_preset = slot;
}

void hdr_look_store(int slot) {
    if (slot < 1 || slot > 3) return;
    int *v = g_settings.hdr_look[slot - 1];
    hdr_look_get(v);
    // A platform without the ICC read (Linux) may still have the peak at 0 ("unset"): store what the present uses,
    // so the preset restores the same display setup instead of the wildcard.
    if (v[14] < 80) v[14] = 1000;
    if (v[15] < 80) v[15] = 203;
    if (v[16] < 80) v[16] = v[15];
    g_settings.hdr_preset = slot;
}

void hdr_look_init_peak(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (g_settings.hdr_look[i][14] == 0 && g_settings.hdr_peak_nits > 0)
            g_settings.hdr_look[i][14] = g_settings.hdr_peak_nits;
        if (g_settings.hdr_look[i][15] == 0 && g_settings.hdr_game_nits > 0)
            g_settings.hdr_look[i][15] = g_settings.hdr_game_nits;
        if (g_settings.hdr_look[i][16] == 0 && g_settings.hdr_ui_nits > 0)
            g_settings.hdr_look[i][16] = g_settings.hdr_ui_nits;
    }
}

void settings_load(void) {
    static bool loaded;
    if (loaded) return;
    loaded = true;
    FILE *f = fopen(SETTINGS_FILE, "r");
    if (!f) {
        handheld_first_setup();
        gyro_startup_overrides();
        pc_controls_env();
        hdr_look_init_peak();
        return;
    }
    char line[256];
    bool tip_key = false;
    int version = 1;
    char old_res[16] = "";
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        char key[64];
        char val[128];
        val[0] = 0;
        if (sscanf(line, " %63[^= ] = %127[^\r\n]", key, val) < 1) continue;
        for (size_t n = strlen(val); n && (val[n - 1] == ' ' || val[n - 1] == '\t'); n--) val[n - 1] = 0;  // (a file
        // edited by hand: Notepad's CRLF line ends and stray spaces would make the names below not match)
        if (!strcmp(key, "fullscreen")) g_settings.fullscreen = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "fullscreen_mode")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < FSMODE_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_fsmode[i])) g_settings.fullscreen_mode = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "display")) {  // (auto, or "<n> <name>": the n-th display, named so)
            int n = 0, at = 0;
            g_settings.display = 0, g_settings.display_name[0] = 0;
            if (strcmp(val, "auto") && sscanf(val, "%d %n", &n, &at) >= 1 && n >= 1 && n <= 16) {
                g_settings.display = n;
                snprintf(g_settings.display_name, sizeof g_settings.display_name, "%s", at ? val + at : "");
            }
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "gpu")) g_settings.gpu = gpu_index_parse(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "volume")) g_settings.volume = (float)atof(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "audio_output")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < AUDIO_OUT_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_audio_out[i])) g_settings.audio_output = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "reverb")) g_settings.reverb = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "movie_audio")) g_settings.movie_audio = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "mute_unfocused")) g_settings.mute_unfocused = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "shrine_sensor_volume")) g_settings.shrine_sensor_volume = atoi(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "amiibo_reader")) snprintf(g_settings.amiibo_reader, sizeof g_settings.amiibo_reader, "%s", strcmp(val, "none") ? val : "");
        else if (!strcmp(key, "show_fps")) g_settings.perf_overlay = atoi(val) ? PERF_FPS : PERF_OFF;  // (older files)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "perf_overlay")) g_settings.perf_overlay = !strcmp(val, "full") ? PERF_FULL : !strcmp(val, "fps") ? PERF_FPS : PERF_OFF;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "frame_rate")) {  // (fps / off / display)
            g_settings.fps_display = !strcmp(val, "display");
            if (!g_settings.fps_display) g_settings.fps_limit = !strcmp(val, "off") ? 0 : atoi(val);
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "vsync")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < VSYNC_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_vsync[i])) g_settings.vsync = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "settings_version")) version = atoi(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "resolution")) snprintf(old_res, sizeof old_res, "%s", val);  // (version 1)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "upscaler"))  // (metalfx / fsr1: this OS's spatial upscaler; dlss: NGX; fsr3, fsr4: Vulkan,
            // hidden with SAVAGEWIND_FSR3=0: FSR 1 with the same quality mode, nvn/output_scale.c fsr3_upscaler_enabled)
            g_settings.upscaler = !strcmp(val, "dlss") ? UPSCALE_DLSS
                                : !strcmp(val, "fsr1") || !strcmp(val, "metalfx") ? UPSCALE_SPATIAL
                                : !strcmp(val, "fsr3") ? (fsr3_upscaler_enabled() ? UPSCALE_FSR3_OR_SPATIAL : UPSCALE_SPATIAL)
                                : !strcmp(val, "fsr4") ? (fsr3_upscaler_enabled() ? UPSCALE_FSR4_OR_SPATIAL : UPSCALE_SPATIAL)
                                                       : UPSCALE_OFF;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "upscaler_quality")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < UPQ_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_quality[i])) g_settings.upscale_quality = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "window_size")) {  // (WxH in pixels, or default)
            int w = 0, h = 0;
            if (sscanf(val, "%dx%d", &w, &h) == 2 && w >= 320 && h >= 200 && w <= 16384 && h <= 16384)
                g_settings.window_w = w, g_settings.window_h = h;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "antialias"))  // ("fxaa": SMAA now; "taa": Vulkan only)
            g_settings.antialias = !strcmp(val, "off") ? AA_OFF : !strcmp(val, "taa") ? AA_TAA_OR_SMAA : AA_SMAA;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "render_scale")) {  // (percent: 50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 200)
            int p = atoi(val);
            g_settings.render_scale = p >= 200 ? RSCALE_200 : p >= 150 ? RSCALE_150 : p >= 125 ? RSCALE_125
                                    : p >= 100 ? RSCALE_100 : p >= 75 ? RSCALE_75 : RSCALE_50;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "anisotropy")) {  // (game, 2x .. 16x)
            int a = atoi(val);
            g_settings.anisotropy = a >= 16 ? 4 : a >= 8 ? 3 : a >= 4 ? 2 : a >= 2 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "texture_lod_bias")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < TEX_LOD_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_tex_lod_bias[i])) g_settings.tex_lod_bias = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "game_fxaa")) g_settings.game_fxaa = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "wet_fix")) g_settings.wet_fix = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "frame_generation")) g_settings.frame_gen = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "sharpening")) {  // (percent, in steps of 10)
            int p = atoi(val);
            g_settings.sharpening = p < 0 ? 0 : p > 100 ? 10 : (p + 5) / 10;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "rumble")) g_settings.rumble = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "rumble_strength")) g_settings.rumble_strength = atoi(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "freecam_sticks")) g_settings.freecam_sticks = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "quick_drop")) g_settings.quick_drop = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "quick_sort")) g_settings.quick_sort = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "discord_rpc")) g_settings.discord_rpc = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "dpad_move")) g_settings.dpad_move = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "menu_wrap")) g_settings.menu_wrap = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "left_stick_deadzone")) g_settings.stick_deadzone[0] = (float)atof(val) / 100;  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "right_stick_deadzone")) g_settings.stick_deadzone[1] = (float)atof(val) / 100;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "mouse_bow")) g_settings.pc_bow = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "mouse_camera")) g_settings.mouse_camera = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "pc_cursor")) g_settings.pc_cursor = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "mouse_sensitivity")) g_settings.mouse_sens = (float)atof(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "mouse_vertical_sensitivity")) g_settings.mouse_sens_y = (float)atof(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "mouse_invert_y")) g_settings.mouse_invert_y = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "pc_gyro")) g_settings.pc_gyro = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "gyro_scene")) g_settings.gyro_scene = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "motion_sensitivity")) g_settings.motion_sens = (float)atof(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "motion_vertical_sensitivity")) g_settings.motion_sens_y = (float)atof(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "motion_lean")) g_settings.motion_lean = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "motion_source")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < MOTION_SOURCE_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, g_motion_source_keys[i])) g_settings.motion_source = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "motion_dsu_axes")) snprintf(g_settings.motion_dsu_axes, sizeof g_settings.motion_dsu_axes, "%s", val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "motion_invert")) {  // (off, up_down, left_right, both)
            g_settings.motion_invert = !strcmp(val, "both") ? MOTION_INVERT_UD | MOTION_INVERT_LR :
                                       !strcmp(val, "up_down") ? MOTION_INVERT_UD :
                                       !strcmp(val, "left_right") ? MOTION_INVERT_LR : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "button_icons")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < ICONS_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_icons[i])) g_settings.button_icons = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "button_layout")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < BUTTON_LAYOUT_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_button_layout[i])) g_settings.button_layout = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "async_shaders")) g_settings.async_shaders = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "precompile_shaders")) g_settings.precompile_shaders = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "dlss_download")) g_settings.dlss_download = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "start_in_config")) g_settings.start_in_config = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "start_picture")) {
            int v = atoi(val);
            g_settings.start_picture = v >= 0 && v < START_PICTURE_COUNT ? v : START_PICTURE_SCREENSHOT;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "boot_picture")) g_settings.boot_picture = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "check_updates")) g_settings.check_updates = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "wide_view")) g_settings.wide_view = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hud_edges")) g_settings.hud_edges = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < HDR_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_hdr[i])) g_settings.hdr = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "sparse_heap")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < SPARSE_HEAP_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_sparse_heap[i])) g_settings.sparse_heap = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_paper_white")) {  // (nits; 0: Windows' SDR content brightness)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_white = n >= 80 && n <= 1000 ? n : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_peak_nits")) {  // (0: not set yet; the first start reads the ICC peak)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_peak_nits = n == 0 || (n >= 80 && n <= 10000) ? n : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_game_nits")) {
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_game_nits = n >= 80 && n <= 1000 ? n : 203;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_ui_nits")) {
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_ui_nits = n >= 80 && n <= 1000 ? n : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_hue")) {  // (highlight hue/purity transfer, percent)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_hue = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 70;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_blowout")) {  // (SDR highlight desaturation/purity, percent)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_blowout = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 65;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_sdr_blend")) {  // (extended-curve pivot, percent)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_sdr_blend = n >= 0 && n <= 60 ? n : 18;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_vanilla_saturation")) {  // (the game's saturation grade, percent)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_vanilla_saturation = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 100;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_bloom")) {  // (HDR bloom strength, percent)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_bloom = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 100;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_clamp")) {  // (0: BT.709, 1: BT.2020)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_clamp = n == 1 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_tonemapper")) {  // (0: Vanilla, 1: RenoDX PsychoV)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_tonemapper = n == 0 ? 0 : 1;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_exposure")) {  // (percent)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_exposure = n >= 50 && n <= 200 ? n : 100;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_highlights")) {  // (0..100)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_highlights = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 50;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_shadows")) {
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_shadows = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 50;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_contrast")) {
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_contrast = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 50;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_saturation")) {
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_saturation = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 50;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_highlight_saturation")) {
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_highlight_saturation = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 50;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_flare")) {
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_flare = n >= 0 && n <= 100 ? n : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_gamma")) {  // (0: none, 1: sRGB, 2: gamma 2.4)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_gamma = n >= 0 && n <= 2 ? n : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_preset")) {  // (1..3; 0: Custom)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_preset = n >= 1 && n <= 3 ? n : 0;
        }
        else if (!strncmp(key, "hdr_look", 8) && key[8] >= '1' && key[8] <= '3' && key[9] == 0) {
            int v[18] = {0};
            int n = sscanf(val, "%d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d",
                           &v[0], &v[1], &v[2], &v[3], &v[4], &v[5], &v[6], &v[7], &v[8],
                           &v[9], &v[10], &v[11], &v[12], &v[13], &v[14], &v[15], &v[16], &v[17]);
            // (14 values: the pre-gamma/custom-peak format; the rest stay 0 = keep the current display setup)
            if (n == 18 || n == 14) memcpy(g_settings.hdr_look[key[8] - '1'], v, sizeof v);
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hdr_clip_nits")) {  // (legacy: ignored; the final cap is hdr_peak_nits)
            int n = atoi(val);
            g_settings.hdr_clip_nits = n == 0 || (n >= 80 && n <= 10000) ? n : 0;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "field_of_view")) g_settings.fov = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "hud_size")) g_settings.hud_size = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "menu_speed")) g_settings.menu_speed = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "handheld_setup")) g_settings.handheld_setup = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "draw_distance")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < DRAWDIST_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_drawdist[i])) g_settings.draw_distance = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "no_weapon_wear")) g_settings.no_weapon_wear = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "weapon_wear")) g_settings.weapon_wear = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "infinite_arrows")) g_settings.infinite_arrows = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "save_backups")) g_settings.save_backups = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "save_dir")) snprintf(g_settings.save_dir, sizeof g_settings.save_dir, "%s", strcmp(val, "default") ? val : "");
        else if (!strcmp(key, "stick_camera_speed")) g_settings.stick_cam_on = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "stick_camera_x")) g_settings.stick_cam_x = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "stick_camera_y")) g_settings.stick_cam_y = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "start_at_continue")) g_settings.auto_continue = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "text_speed")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < TEXT_SPEED_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, k_text_speed[i])) g_settings.text_speed = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "infinite_stamina")) g_settings.infinite_stamina = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "infinite_rupees")) g_settings.infinite_rupees = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "weather")) {
            g_settings.weather = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < WEATHER_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, g_weather_keys[i])) g_settings.weather = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_vision")) {
            g_settings.colour_vision = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < COLOUR_VISION_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, g_colour_vision_keys[i])) g_settings.colour_vision = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_vision_strength")) g_settings.colour_vision_strength = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "god_mode")) g_settings.god_mode = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "one_hit_kill")) g_settings.one_hit_kill = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "damage_taken")) g_settings.damage_taken = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "damage_dealt")) g_settings.damage_dealt = atoi(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "haze")) {  // (percent; an older ini's 0-50 reads as 75: HAZE_MIN)
            int v = atoi(val);
            g_settings.haze = v < HAZE_MIN ? HAZE_MIN : v > 100 ? 100 : v;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "bloom")) g_settings.bloom = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "depth_of_field")) g_settings.depth_of_field = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "dynamic_resolution")) g_settings.dynamic_res = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "fast_fma")) g_settings.fast_fma = atoi(val) != 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_exposure")) g_settings.color_exposure = (int)lroundf((float)atof(val) * 10);  // (EV)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_contrast")) g_settings.color_contrast = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_saturation")) g_settings.color_saturation = atoi(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_temperature")) g_settings.color_temperature = atoi(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_tint")) g_settings.color_tint = atoi(val);
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_lut")) {  // (none: no LUT)
            snprintf(g_settings.color_lut, sizeof g_settings.color_lut, "%s", strcmp(val, "none") ? val : "");
            g_settings.color_lut_set = true;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "colour_lut_strength")) g_settings.color_lut_strength = atoi(val);  // (percent)
        else if (!strcmp(key, "sharper_menus"))  // (off / 2x / 4x)
            g_settings.sharper_menus = !strcmp(val, "4x") ? 4 : !strcmp(val, "2x") ? 2 : 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "sharper_text"))  // (off / 2x / 4x)
            g_settings.sharper_text = !strcmp(val, "4x") ? 4 : !strcmp(val, "2x") ? 2 : 0;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "shadow_resolution"))  // (console / high / ultra / extreme)
            g_settings.shadow_res = !strcmp(val, "extreme") ? SHADOW_EXTREME : !strcmp(val, "ultra") ? SHADOW_ULTRA
                                  : !strcmp(val, "high") ? SHADOW_HIGH : !strcmp(val, "potato") ? SHADOW_POTATO
                                  : SHADOW_CONSOLE;
        else if (!strcmp(key, "text_language")) {  // (a region language: USen, EUes, ...; auto)
            g_settings.text_language = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i < g_ntext_languages; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, g_text_languages[i].folder)) g_settings.text_language = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "voice_language")) {  // (a Voice/ folder; text)
            g_settings.voice_language = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i < g_nvoice_languages; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, g_voice_languages[i].folder)) g_settings.voice_language = i;
        }
        else if (!strcmp(key, "menu_tip_seen")) g_settings.menu_tip_seen = atoi(val) != 0, tip_key = true;
        else bind_settings_load(key, val);  // bind_pad_* / bind_key_*: runtime/hle/bindings.c
    }
    fclose(f);
    if (version < 2) {
        // internal resolution: a share of the display is now the upscaler's nearest mode (75%: Ultra Quality,
        // 1 / 1.3; 50% and 25%: Performance, 1 / 2); the upscaler itself is kept (bilinear: Off)
        bool q75 = !strcmp(old_res, "75%") || !strcmp(old_res, "67%");
        bool low = q75 || !strcmp(old_res, "50%") || !strcmp(old_res, "25%");
        g_settings.upscale_quality = q75 ? UPQ_ULTRA : low ? UPQ_PERFORMANCE : UPQ_QUALITY;
        if (fabsf(g_settings.mouse_sens - 1.0f) < 0.005f) g_settings.mouse_sens = MOUSE_SENS_DEFAULT;
        LOG("[settings] %s is from an older version (resolution %s): upscaler %d, mode %d, mouse %.2f\n",
            SETTINGS_FILE, old_res[0] ? old_res : "-", g_settings.upscaler, g_settings.upscale_quality,
            g_settings.mouse_sens);
    }
#ifndef __APPLE__
    if (version < 3 && g_settings.upscaler == UPSCALE_FSR1) {
        bool lower = version < 2 && (!strcmp(old_res, "75%") || !strcmp(old_res, "67%") || !strcmp(old_res, "50%") ||
                                     !strcmp(old_res, "25%"));
        if (!lower) g_settings.upscaler = UPSCALE_OFF;
        LOG("[settings] %s: version %d upscaler fsr1 -> %s\n", SETTINGS_FILE, version, lower ? "fsr1" : "off");
    }
#endif
    if (version < 4 && !g_settings.async_shaders) {
        g_settings.async_shaders = true;
        LOG("[settings] %s: version %d async_shaders 0 -> 1 (the new default)\n", SETTINGS_FILE, version);
    }
    if (!tip_key) g_settings.menu_tip_seen = true;  // (a settings file from before the note: not a first launch)
    if (g_settings.volume < 0) g_settings.volume = 0;
    if (g_settings.volume > 2) g_settings.volume = 2;
    if (g_settings.shrine_sensor_volume < 0) g_settings.shrine_sensor_volume = 0;
    if (g_settings.shrine_sensor_volume > 100) g_settings.shrine_sensor_volume = 100;
    if (g_settings.antialias != AA_OFF) g_settings.game_fxaa = false;  // (one anti-aliasing at a time: settings_aa_row)
    handheld_first_setup();
    if (settings_handheld()) {  // (neither is offered on one)
        g_settings.fps_display = false;
        if (g_settings.fps_limit <= 0) g_settings.fps_limit = FPS_DEFAULT;
    }
    if (g_settings.fps_limit < 0) g_settings.fps_limit = 0;
    if (g_settings.fps_limit > 0) {  // (a frame rate not offered: the nearest one that is)
        const int *fps;
        int nfps = fps_choices(&fps), best = FPS_DEFAULT;
        for (int i = 0; i < nfps; i++)
            if (fps[i] && abs(fps[i] - g_settings.fps_limit) < abs(best - g_settings.fps_limit)) best = fps[i];
        g_settings.fps_limit = best;
    }
    { extern float winsize_refresh_rate(void); settings_fps_for_display(winsize_refresh_rate()); }  // (a reboot: known)
    if (!(g_settings.mouse_sens >= 0.1f && g_settings.mouse_sens <= 10.0f)) g_settings.mouse_sens = MOUSE_SENS_DEFAULT;
    if (!(g_settings.mouse_sens_y >= 0.5f && g_settings.mouse_sens_y <= 2.0f)) g_settings.mouse_sens_y = 1.0f;
    if (!(g_settings.motion_sens >= 0.1f && g_settings.motion_sens <= 10.0f)) g_settings.motion_sens = 1.0f;
    if (!(g_settings.motion_sens_y >= 0.5f && g_settings.motion_sens_y <= 2.0f)) g_settings.motion_sens_y = 1.0f;
    if (g_settings.motion_source < 0 || g_settings.motion_source >= MOTION_SOURCE_COUNT) g_settings.motion_source = MOTION_SOURCE_AUTO;
    if (g_settings.fov < 50 || g_settings.fov > 200) g_settings.fov = 100;
    if (g_settings.hud_size != 0 && (g_settings.hud_size < 50 || g_settings.hud_size > 150)) g_settings.hud_size = 100;
    if (g_settings.menu_speed < 70 || g_settings.menu_speed > 300) g_settings.menu_speed = 100;
#define CLAMP(v, lo, hi) ((v) < (lo) ? (lo) : (v) > (hi) ? (hi) : (v))
    g_settings.color_exposure = CLAMP(g_settings.color_exposure, -20, 20);
    g_settings.color_contrast = CLAMP(g_settings.color_contrast, -50, 50);
    g_settings.color_saturation = CLAMP(g_settings.color_saturation, -100, 100);
    g_settings.color_temperature = CLAMP(g_settings.color_temperature, -100, 100);
    g_settings.color_tint = CLAMP(g_settings.color_tint, -100, 100);
    g_settings.color_lut_strength = CLAMP(g_settings.color_lut_strength, 0, 100);
    g_settings.colour_vision_strength = CLAMP(g_settings.colour_vision_strength, 10, 100);
    g_settings.stick_cam_x = CLAMP(g_settings.stick_cam_x, STICK_CAM_MIN, STICK_CAM_MAX);
    g_settings.stick_cam_y = CLAMP(g_settings.stick_cam_y, STICK_CAM_MIN, STICK_CAM_MAX);
    g_settings.rumble_strength = CLAMP(g_settings.rumble_strength, RUMBLE_STRENGTH_MIN, RUMBLE_STRENGTH_MAX);
    g_settings.weapon_wear = CLAMP(g_settings.weapon_wear, WEAPON_WEAR_MIN, WEAPON_WEAR_MAX);
    if (g_settings.no_weapon_wear) g_settings.weapon_wear = 0;  // (Unbreakable weapons is Weapon wear's Fairy, 0x)
#undef CLAMP
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        if (!(g_settings.stick_deadzone[i] >= 0 && g_settings.stick_deadzone[i] <= 0.5f))
            g_settings.stick_deadzone[i] = STICK_DEADZONE_DEFAULT;
    pc_controls_env();
    gyro_startup_overrides();
    hdr_look_init_peak();
    LOG("[settings] loaded %s\n", SETTINGS_FILE);
}

void settings_save(void) {
    FILE *f = fopen(SETTINGS_FILE, "w");
    if (!f) { LOG("[settings] cannot write %s\n", SETTINGS_FILE); return; }
    fprintf(f, "# Savage Wind settings (edited from the in-game menu: F1, Esc, or Minus+Plus on a controller)\n");
    fprintf(f, "settings_version = %d\n", SETTINGS_VERSION);
    fprintf(f, "fullscreen = %d\n", g_settings.fullscreen);
    int fm = g_settings.fullscreen_mode;
    fprintf(f, "fullscreen_mode = %s\n", k_fsmode[fm >= 0 && fm < FSMODE_COUNT ? fm : FSMODE_AUTO]);
    if (g_settings.display > 0) fprintf(f, "display = %d %s\n", g_settings.display, g_settings.display_name);
    else fprintf(f, "display = auto\n");
    fprintf(f, "# Vulkan GPU index from the startup log, or auto; restart after changing\n");
    if (g_settings.gpu >= 0) fprintf(f, "gpu = %d\n", g_settings.gpu);
    else fprintf(f, "gpu = auto\n");
    if (g_settings.window_w > 0 && g_settings.window_h > 0)
        fprintf(f, "window_size = %dx%d\n", g_settings.window_w, g_settings.window_h);
    else
        fprintf(f, "window_size = default\n");
    if (g_settings.fps_display)
        fprintf(f, "frame_rate = display\n");
    else if (g_settings.fps_limit > 0)
        fprintf(f, "frame_rate = %d\n", g_settings.fps_limit);
    else
        fprintf(f, "frame_rate = off\n");
    int vs = g_settings.vsync >= 0 && g_settings.vsync < VSYNC_COUNT ? g_settings.vsync : VSYNC_DEFAULT;
    fprintf(f, "vsync = %s\n", k_vsync[vs]);
    fprintf(f, "volume = %.2f\n", g_settings.volume);
    int ao = g_settings.audio_output >= 0 && g_settings.audio_output < AUDIO_OUT_COUNT ? g_settings.audio_output : AUDIO_OUT_STEREO;
    fprintf(f, "audio_output = %s\n", k_audio_out[ao]);
    fprintf(f, "reverb = %d\n", g_settings.reverb);
    fprintf(f, "movie_audio = %d\n", g_settings.movie_audio);
    fprintf(f, "mute_unfocused = %d\n", g_settings.mute_unfocused);
    fprintf(f, "shrine_sensor_volume = %d\n", g_settings.shrine_sensor_volume);
    fprintf(f, "amiibo_reader = %s\n", g_settings.amiibo_reader[0] ? g_settings.amiibo_reader : "none");
    fprintf(f, "perf_overlay = %s\n", g_settings.perf_overlay == PERF_FULL ? "full" : g_settings.perf_overlay == PERF_FPS ? "fps" : "off");
    static const char *const ups[UPSCALE_COUNT] = {"off", "metalfx", "fsr1", "fsr3", "dlss", "fsr4"};
    int u = g_settings.upscaler, uq = g_settings.upscale_quality;
    fprintf(f, "upscaler = %s\n", u >= 0 && u < UPSCALE_COUNT ? ups[u] : "off");
    fprintf(f, "upscaler_quality = %s\n", k_quality[uq >= 0 && uq < UPQ_COUNT ? uq : UPQ_QUALITY]);
    {

// (settings.h GPRESET_*). The upscaler's mode counts only with an upscaler. Original is also the defaults above.
static const struct {
    int draw_distance, shadow_res;
    bool bloom, depth_of_field, dynamic_res;
    int anisotropy, antialias;
    bool game_fxaa;
    int upscaler, upscale_quality;
    bool async_shaders;
    int render_scale;
} k_gpreset[GPRESET_COUNT] = {
    {DRAWDIST_POTATO, SHADOW_POTATO, false, false, true, 0, AA_OFF, true, UPSCALE_SPATIAL, UPQ_QUALITY, true, RSCALE_50},
    {DRAWDIST_ORIGINAL, SHADOW_CONSOLE, true, true, true, 1 /* 2x */, AA_OFF, true, UPSCALE_DEFAULT, UPQ_QUALITY, true, RSCALE_100},
    {DRAWDIST_MEDIUM, SHADOW_HIGH, true, true, false, 3 /* 8x */, AA_SMAA, false, UPSCALE_DEFAULT, UPQ_QUALITY, false, RSCALE_125},
    {DRAWDIST_HIGH, SHADOW_EXTREME, true, true, false, 4 /* 16x */, AA_TAA_OR_SMAA, false, UPSCALE_DEFAULT, UPQ_QUALITY, false, RSCALE_150},
    {DRAWDIST_ORIGINAL, SHADOW_CONSOLE, true, true, true, 1 /* 2x */, AA_OFF, true, UPSCALE_SPATIAL, UPQ_ULTRA, true, RSCALE_100},
};
const char *const g_gpreset_names[GPRESET_COUNT] = {"Potato", "Original", "High", "Savage", "PC Handheld"};

int graphics_preset_count(void) { return settings_handheld() ? GPRESET_COUNT : GPRESET_HANDHELD; }

int graphics_preset_current(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < graphics_preset_count(); i++)
        if (g_settings.draw_distance == k_gpreset[i].draw_distance && g_settings.shadow_res == k_gpreset[i].shadow_res &&
            g_settings.bloom == k_gpreset[i].bloom && g_settings.depth_of_field == k_gpreset[i].depth_of_field &&
            g_settings.dynamic_res == k_gpreset[i].dynamic_res && g_settings.anisotropy == k_gpreset[i].anisotropy &&
            g_settings.antialias == k_gpreset[i].antialias && g_settings.game_fxaa == k_gpreset[i].game_fxaa &&
            g_settings.upscaler == k_gpreset[i].upscaler &&
            (g_settings.upscaler == UPSCALE_OFF || g_settings.upscale_quality == k_gpreset[i].upscale_quality) &&
            g_settings.async_shaders == k_gpreset[i].async_shaders && g_settings.render_scale == k_gpreset[i].render_scale)
            return i;
    return -1;
}

void graphics_preset_apply(int preset) {
    if (preset < 0 || preset >= GPRESET_COUNT) return;
    g_settings.draw_distance = k_gpreset[preset].draw_distance;
    g_settings.shadow_res = k_gpreset[preset].shadow_res;
    g_settings.bloom = k_gpreset[preset].bloom;
    g_settings.depth_of_field = k_gpreset[preset].depth_of_field;
    g_settings.dynamic_res = k_gpreset[preset].dynamic_res;
    g_settings.anisotropy = k_gpreset[preset].anisotropy;
    g_settings.antialias = k_gpreset[preset].antialias;
    g_settings.game_fxaa = k_gpreset[preset].game_fxaa;
    g_settings.upscaler = k_gpreset[preset].upscaler;
    if (g_settings.upscaler != UPSCALE_OFF) g_settings.upscale_quality = k_gpreset[preset].upscale_quality;
    g_settings.async_shaders = k_gpreset[preset].async_shaders;
    g_settings.render_scale = k_gpreset[preset].render_scale;
    if (preset == GPRESET_HANDHELD) g_settings.sharpening = 7, g_settings.tex_lod_bias = TEX_LOD_SHARP;  // (the upscaled image's softness)
}
```

`runtime/settings.h`:

```h
// User settings (savagewind.ini in the data root, runtime/paths.h), edited from the in-game menu.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>

// Upscalers (Video > Upscaler; runtime/nvn/output_scale.c): Off renders at the window's size; the others render
// smaller by their quality mode's factor and scale up to the window. DLSS needs NVIDIA's DLL, which the setup downloads.
enum { UPSCALE_OFF = 0, UPSCALE_METALFX = 1 /* macOS */, UPSCALE_FSR1 = 2 /* AMD FSR 1, Vulkan */,
       UPSCALE_FSR3 = 3 /* AMD FSR 3.1, Vulkan where built in (vulkan/fsr3.h) */,
       UPSCALE_DLSS = 4 /* NVIDIA DLSS: Windows, NVIDIA RTX and NVIDIA's DLL (vulkan/dlss.c) */,
       UPSCALE_FSR4 = 5 /* AMD FSR 4, Vulkan on Windows with AMD's DLLs and an AMD Radeon (vulkan/fsr_api.h) */,
       UPSCALE_COUNT };
#ifdef __APPLE__
#define UPSCALE_SPATIAL UPSCALE_METALFX  // each OS's spatial upscaler
#define UPSCALE_FSR3_OR_SPATIAL UPSCALE_METALFX  // (a settings file from another OS)
#define UPSCALE_FSR4_OR_SPATIAL UPSCALE_METALFX
#define UPSCALE_DEFAULT UPSCALE_METALFX  // (Metal has no internal resolution yet: MetalFX scales the image to the window)
#else
#define UPSCALE_SPATIAL UPSCALE_FSR1
#define UPSCALE_FSR3_OR_SPATIAL UPSCALE_FSR3
#define UPSCALE_FSR4_OR_SPATIAL UPSCALE_FSR4  // (without FSR 4 on this PC: vulkan/device.c moves it to FSR 3 or 1)
#define UPSCALE_DEFAULT UPSCALE_OFF      // the 3D image at the window's resolution
#endif
// quality modes, AMD's scale factors (per axis): Ultra Quality 1.3, Quality 1.5, Balanced 1.7, Performance 2.0,
// Ultra Performance 3.0, Native 1.0 (FSR 3 / FSR 4)
enum { UPQ_ULTRA = 0, UPQ_QUALITY = 1, UPQ_BALANCED = 2, UPQ_PERFORMANCE = 3, UPQ_ULTRA_PERFORMANCE = 4, UPQ_NATIVE = 5, UPQ_COUNT };
// TAA (Vulkan): the game's own motion vectors (vulkan/mvec.c) and a jittered camera (output_scale.c rt_jitter_on)
// blend each frame with the ones before it (vulkan/exec.c mvec_taa)
enum { AA_OFF = 0, AA_SMAA = 1, AA_TAA = 2 };
// Video > Anti-aliasing's row: the game's own FXAA (game_fxaa) is one of its choices, never on with SMAA or TAA
enum { AA_ROW_OFF, AA_ROW_FXAA, AA_ROW_SMAA, AA_ROW_TAA, AA_ROW_COUNT };
int settings_aa_row(void);
void settings_aa_row_set(int row);
// Video > Render scale: 50%, 75%, 100% (the window's size), 125%, 150%, 200%
enum { RSCALE_50 = 0, RSCALE_75 = 1, RSCALE_100 = 2, RSCALE_125 = 3, RSCALE_150 = 4, RSCALE_200 = 5, RSCALE_COUNT };
#ifdef __APPLE__
#define AA_TAA_OR_SMAA AA_SMAA
#else
#define AA_TAA_OR_SMAA AA_TAA
#endif
// Shadow resolution (Video > Shadow resolution; runtime/nvn/output_scale.c shadow_map_size): the sun's shadow maps at
// the console's size (BOTW: 896 x 896) or made bigger, for sharper shadows at some GPU time.
enum { SHADOW_CONSOLE = 0, SHADOW_HIGH = 1 /* 2048 */, SHADOW_ULTRA = 2 /* 4096 */, SHADOW_EXTREME = 3 /* 8192 */,
       SHADOW_POTATO = 4 /* 448 */, SHADOW_COUNT };
enum { PERF_OFF = 0, PERF_FPS = 1, PERF_FULL = 2 };
// Frame rate (Video > Frame rate; runtime/hle/framepace.c): frames per second, 0 = no limit. The game's clock is the
// same at every rate. The console runs the game at 30.
#define FPS_DEFAULT 60
#define FPS_CHOICES {0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 144, 165, 240, 360}
// PC handhelds (settings_handheld): 40 for a screen at 40 or 80 Hz, 45 at 90 Hz; no Off, no Match display. Their
// faster screens add their own rates (#712: 90 on a Steam Deck OLED, 120 on a ROG Ally, 144 on a Legion Go): those of
// FPS_CHOICES_HANDHELD_FAST up to the screen's refresh rate, all of them while it isn't known yet.
#define FPS_CHOICES_HANDHELD {30, 40, 45, 60}
#define FPS_CHOICES_HANDHELD_FAST {90, 120, 144}
#define FPS_CHOICES_MAX 9
int fps_choices(const int **list);  // this machine's frame rates (FPS_CHOICES, or FPS_CHOICES_HANDHELD): their count
// VSync (Video > VSync; runtime/nvn/vulkan/device.c picks the present mode): On waits for the display (FIFO; with
// G-SYNC / FreeSync the display waits for the game instead), Fast shows the newest frame at each refresh (MAILBOX),
// Adaptive is On but shows a late frame at once (FIFO_RELAXED), Off shows each frame at once (IMMEDIATE). With On and
// Adaptive the frame rate stays a little under the display's refresh rate (runtime/hle/framepace.c).
enum { VSYNC_ON = 0, VSYNC_FAST = 1, VSYNC_ADAPTIVE = 2, VSYNC_OFF = 3, VSYNC_COUNT };
#define VSYNC_DEFAULT VSYNC_FAST
// Video > HDR: Auto presents in HDR10 while Windows HDR is on for the window's monitor, On always (where the display
// takes it), Off never (an SDR picture, which Windows shows dim and dull while its HDR is on)
enum { HDR_AUTO = 0, HDR_ON = 1, HDR_OFF = 2, HDR_COUNT };
enum { SPARSE_HEAP_AUTO = 0, SPARSE_HEAP_ON = 1, SPARSE_HEAP_OFF = 2, SPARSE_HEAP_COUNT };
// Video > Fullscreen mode (runtime/window_size.c winsize_apply): Automatic is borderless at the desktop's size and the
// display's own mode at any other size it has; Borderless never changes the display's mode (another size is scaled to
// the screen); Exclusive always uses a display mode (the desktop's size too, at its highest refresh rate)
enum { FSMODE_AUTO = 0, FSMODE_BORDERLESS = 1, FSMODE_EXCLUSIVE = 2, FSMODE_COUNT };
// Texture LOD bias (Video > Texture sharpness): pulls forward mipmaps for sharper ground/object textures.
enum { TEX_LOD_DEFAULT = 0, TEX_LOD_SHARP = 1, TEX_LOD_SHARPER = 2, TEX_LOD_COUNT };

// Audio > Audio output (runtime/services/audio.c): Stereo mixes the game's 6 channels (FL, FR, FC, LFE, BL, BR) down
// to 2; Surround 5.1 sends all 6 channels to the audio device; 3D Headphones mixes the 6 channels to stereo with
// binaural head-shadow and ear-delay cues for headphones.
enum { AUDIO_OUT_STEREO = 0, AUDIO_OUT_SURROUND_51 = 1, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D = 2, AUDIO_OUT_COUNT };
// The start screen's background, when there is no splash.jpg / .png of the player's in the data folder
enum { START_PICTURE_ART, START_PICTURE_SCREENSHOT, START_PICTURE_SAVE, START_PICTURE_COUNT };

// Gameplay > Dialogue text speed (runtime/pc_cursor.c): speed at which dialogue text appears during conversations
enum { TEXT_SPEED_NORMAL = 0, TEXT_SPEED_FAST = 1, TEXT_SPEED_INSTANT = 2, TEXT_SPEED_COUNT = 3 };
typedef struct {
    bool fullscreen;
    int fullscreen_mode;     // FSMODE_*
    // Video > Monitor (runtime/window_size.c): 0 the window's own (where it is; the primary display at start), n the
    // n-th display connected; display_name is its name, which finds it again when the displays come in another order
    int display;
    char display_name[64];
    int window_w, window_h;  // Video > Window size, pixels (0: not chosen; runtime/window_size.c)
    int upscaler;        // UPSCALE_*: Off (render at the window's size), or render smaller and scale up
    int upscale_quality; // UPQ_*: the upscaler's mode (how much smaller it renders)
    int antialias;       // AA_*: anti-aliasing of the game image before it is scaled to the window
    bool game_fxaa;      // the game's own FXAA, in its scene -> final image composite (vulkan/exec.c fxaa_patch)
    bool wet_fix;        // Video > Wet grass fix: tames the white glare of rain in sunshine (maxwell/translate.c maxwell_wet_lighting)
    int render_scale;    // 50%, 75%, 100% (RSCALE_100: the window's size), 125%, 150%, 200% (nvn/output_scale.c)
    int anisotropy;      // texture filtering: 0 the game's own, 1..4 = 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x (vulkan/textures.c)
    int tex_lod_bias;    // TEX_LOD_*: texture LOD bias, 0 = default (0.0), 1 = sharp (-0.5), 2 = sharper (-1.0)
    int sharpening;      // AMD CAS sharpening of the 3D image, 0 (off) .. 10 (100%) (vulkan/exec.c scene_post)
    bool frame_gen;      // AMD FSR 3 frame generation: a frame made between each two the game draws (vulkan/framegen.cpp)
    float volume;        // master volume, 1 = 100%
    int audio_output;    // AUDIO_OUT_*: Stereo, Surround 5.1, or 3D Headphones
    bool reverb;         // room reverb effect
    bool movie_audio;
    bool mute_unfocused; // mute audio while the window is in the background or minimized
    int shrine_sensor_volume; // Sheikah sensor volume: 0% (mute) .. 100% (normal)
    char amiibo_reader[128]; // the figure on the virtual reader: its dump as "<series>/<name>" ("": none; runtime/amiibo.h)
    int perf_overlay;    // PERF_*: the performance overlay (F10 cycles it)
    int fps_limit;       // frame rate, frames per second (FPS_CHOICES; 0: no limit)
```

`runtime/shrine_sensor.c`:

```c
// Shrine sensor volume / mute (runtime/shrine_sensor.c).
// Scales or silences the waveform of Sys_Item_SheikSensor inside Sound/Resource/M_UI.bars.
// BOTW keeps M_UI.bars in Pack/Bootup.pack and as a loose file in RomFS, storing waves as BFWAV (FWAV) DSP-ADPCM;
// patching the waveform keeps the exact file sizes and works identically with the SDK AudioRenderer and audren:u.
#include "shrine_sensor.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static inline uint16_t rd16(const uint8_t *p) { uint16_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 2); return v; }
static inline uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
static inline int32_t rd32i(const uint8_t *p) { int32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
static inline int16_t rd16i(const uint8_t *p) { int16_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 2); return v; }

static inline int16_t clamp16(int64_t v) {
    return v > 32767 ? 32767 : v < -32768 ? -32768 : (int16_t)v;
}

static void adpcm_decode_ch(const uint8_t *raw, uint32_t nsamp, const int16_t coefs[16],
                            int16_t h0, int16_t h1, int16_t *pcm) {
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < nsamp; s++) {
        uint32_t fr = s / 14, k = s % 14;
        uint8_t ps = raw[fr * 8];
        int scale = ps & 15, ci = (ps >> 4) & 7;
        uint8_t b = raw[fr * 8 + 1 + k / 2];
        int nib = (k & 1) ? ((int8_t)(b << 4) >> 4) : ((int8_t)b >> 4);
        int64_t pred = (int64_t)coefs[ci * 2] * h0 + (int64_t)coefs[ci * 2 + 1] * h1;
        int16_t v = clamp16((((int64_t)nib * ((int64_t)2048 << scale)) + pred + 1024) >> 11);
        h1 = h0;
        h0 = v;
        pcm[s] = v;
    }
}

static void adpcm_encode_ch(const int16_t *pcm, uint32_t nsamp, const int16_t coefs[16], uint8_t *raw) {
    uint32_t nframes = (nsamp + 13) / 14;
    int16_t h0 = 0, h1 = 0;
    for (uint32_t fr = 0; fr < nframes; fr++) {
        uint32_t base = fr * 14;
        uint32_t len = nsamp - base < 14 ? nsamp - base : 14;
        int64_t best_err = INT64_MAX;
        uint8_t best_frame[8] = {0};
        int16_t best_h0 = 0, best_h1 = 0;

        for (int ci = 0; ci < 8 && best_err > 0; ci++) {
            int64_t c0 = coefs[ci * 2], c1 = coefs[ci * 2 + 1];
            for (int scale = 0; scale <= 12 && best_err > 0; scale++) {
                int64_t step = (int64_t)2048 << scale;
                int16_t th0 = h0, th1 = h1;
                int64_t err = 0;
                uint8_t nibs[14] = {0};
                for (uint32_t k = 0; k < len; k++) {
                    int16_t tgt = pcm[base + k];
                    int64_t pred = c0 * th0 + c1 * th1;
                    int64_t diff = ((int64_t)tgt << 11) - pred;
                    int64_t nib = diff >= 0 ? (diff + step / 2) / step : -((-diff + step / 2) / step);
                    if (nib > 7) nib = 7;
                    if (nib < -8) nib = -8;
                    int16_t dec = clamp16((nib * step + pred + 1024) >> 11);
                    int64_t d = (int64_t)tgt - dec;
                    err += d * d;
                    if (err >= best_err) break;
                    th1 = th0;
                    th0 = dec;
                    nibs[k] = (uint8_t)(nib & 0xF);
                }
                if (err < best_err) {
                    best_err = err;
                    best_h0 = th0;
                    best_h1 = th1;
                    best_frame[0] = (uint8_t)((ci << 4) | scale);
                    for (int k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
                        best_frame[1 + k] = (uint8_t)((nibs[2 * k] << 4) | nibs[2 * k + 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        memcpy(raw + fr * 8, best_frame, 8);
        h0 = best_h0;
        h1 = best_h1;
    }
}

static bool patch_fwav(uint8_t *fwav, size_t wsize, int volume_pct) {
    if (wsize < 0x2C || memcmp(fwav, "FWAV\xFF\xFE", 6)) return false;
    uint16_t nsec = rd16(fwav + 0x10);
    if ((uint64_t)0x14 + (uint64_t)nsec * 12 > wsize) return false;

    uint32_t info_off = 0, info_sz = 0, data_off = 0, data_sz = 0;
    for (uint16_t s = 0; s < nsec; s++) {
        const uint8_t *ref = fwav + 0x14 + s * 12;
        uint16_t type = rd16(ref);
        uint32_t off = rd32(ref + 4), sz = rd32(ref + 8);
        if ((uint64_t)off + sz > wsize) return false;
        if (type == 0x7000) { info_off = off; info_sz = sz; }
        else if (type == 0x7001) { data_off = off; data_sz = sz; }
    }
    if (!info_off || !data_off || info_sz < 0x20 || data_sz < 8) return false;

    uint8_t *info = fwav + info_off;
    uint8_t *wdata = fwav + data_off;
    if (memcmp(info, "INFO", 4) || memcmp(wdata, "DATA", 4)) return false;

    uint8_t enc = info[8];
    uint32_t nsamp = rd32(info + 0x14);
    if (nsamp == 0 || nsamp > (64u << 20)) return false;

    size_t tab_off = 0x1C;
    if (tab_off + 4 > info_sz) return false;
    uint32_t nch = rd32(info + tab_off);
    if (nch == 0 || nch > 16 || tab_off + 4 + (uint64_t)nch * 8 > info_sz) return false;

    if (volume_pct >= 100) return true;

    float factor = volume_pct <= 0 ? 0.0f : (float)volume_pct / 100.0f;
    float gain = volume_pct <= 0 ? 0.0f : powf(factor, 1.5f);

    for (uint32_t ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) {
        int32_t ch_rel = rd32i(info + tab_off + 4 + ch * 8 + 4);
        if (ch_rel < 0 || tab_off + (size_t)ch_rel + 20 > info_sz) return false;
        uint8_t *ci = info + tab_off + ch_rel;

        int32_t soff_rel = rd32i(ci + 4);
        int32_t aoff_rel = rd32i(ci + 12);
        if (soff_rel < 0 || (uint64_t)soff_rel + 8 > data_sz) return false;

        size_t sample_pos = 8 + (size_t)soff_rel;
        uint8_t *sample_ptr = wdata + sample_pos;
        size_t avail_bytes = data_sz - sample_pos;

        if (enc == 2) {  // DSP-ADPCM
            size_t nframes = ((size_t)nsamp + 13) / 14;
            size_t nbytes = nframes * 8;
            if (nbytes > avail_bytes) return false;
            if (aoff_rel <= 0 || tab_off + (size_t)ch_rel + (size_t)aoff_rel + 44 > info_sz) return false;
            uint8_t *adpcm = ci + aoff_rel;

            if (volume_pct <= 0) {
                memset(sample_ptr, 0, nbytes);
                memset(adpcm + 32, 0, 12);  // start & loop context (pred_scale, h0, h1)
            } else {
                int16_t coefs[16];
                for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) coefs[i] = rd16i(adpcm + i * 2);
                int16_t h0 = rd16i(adpcm + 34), h1 = rd16i(adpcm + 36);
                int16_t *pcm = malloc((size_t)nsamp * sizeof(int16_t));
                if (!pcm) return false;
                adpcm_decode_ch(sample_ptr, nsamp, coefs, h0, h1, pcm);
                for (uint32_t s = 0; s < nsamp; s++) {
                    pcm[s] = clamp16(lroundf((float)pcm[s] * gain));
                }
                adpcm_encode_ch(pcm, nsamp, coefs, sample_ptr);
                free(pcm);
                uint16_t pred0 = sample_ptr[0];
                memcpy(adpcm + 32, &pred0, 2);
                memset(adpcm + 34, 0, 10);  // h0=0, h1=0, clear loop context
            }
        } else if (enc == 1) {  // PCM16
            size_t nbytes = (size_t)nsamp * 2;
            if (nbytes > avail_bytes) return false;
            if (volume_pct <= 0) {
                memset(sample_ptr, 0, nbytes);
            } else {
                for (uint32_t s = 0; s < nsamp; s++) {
                    int16_t v = rd16i(sample_ptr + s * 2);
                    v = clamp16(lroundf((float)v * gain));
                    memcpy(sample_ptr + s * 2, &v, 2);
                }
            }
        } else if (enc == 0) {  // PCM8
            if ((size_t)nsamp > avail_bytes) return false;
            if (volume_pct <= 0) {
                memset(sample_ptr, 0, nsamp);
            } else {
                for (uint32_t s = 0; s < nsamp; s++) {
                    int8_t v = (int8_t)sample_ptr[s];
                    int32_t sv = (int32_t)lroundf((float)v * gain);
                    sample_ptr[s] = (uint8_t)(sv > 127 ? 127 : sv < -128 ? -128 : sv);
                }
            }
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

static bool patch_bwav(uint8_t *bars, size_t size, uint32_t wave, int volume_pct) {
    if ((uint64_t)wave + 0x10 > size || memcmp(bars + wave, "BWAV", 4)) return false;
    if (volume_pct >= 100) return true;
    uint16_t num_ch = rd16(bars + wave + 0xE);
    size_t ch_base = (size_t)wave + 0x10;
    if (ch_base + 0x4C > size || rd32(bars + ch_base + 4) < 8000) ch_base = (size_t)wave + 0x40;
    for (uint16_t ch = 0; ch < num_ch && ch_base + (size_t)(ch + 1) * 0x4C <= size; ch++) {
        uint32_t data_start = rd32(bars + ch_base + ch * 0x4C + 0x30);
        uint32_t num_samples = rd32(bars + ch_base + ch * 0x4C + 0xC);
        uint64_t pos = (uint64_t)wave + data_start;
        if (volume_pct <= 0 && data_start && pos < size) {
            size_t bytes = (num_samples + 1) / 2 + 16;
            if (pos + bytes > size) bytes = (size_t)(size - pos);
            memset(bars + pos, 0, bytes);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool shrine_sensor_patch_bars(uint8_t *bars, size_t size, int volume_pct) {
    if (!bars || size < 16 || memcmp(bars, "BARS", 4) || memcmp(bars + 8, "\xFF\xFE", 2)) return false;
    uint32_t cnt = rd32(bars + 12);
    if (16 + (uint64_t)cnt * 12 > size) return false;

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
        uint32_t at = rd32(bars + 16 + cnt * 4 + i * 8);
        uint32_t wave = rd32(bars + 20 + cnt * 4 + i * 8);
        if ((uint64_t)at + 0x1C > size || memcmp(bars + at, "AMTA\xFF\xFE", 6)) continue;

        uint32_t strg_off = rd32(bars + at + 0x18);
        if ((uint64_t)at + strg_off + 8 > size) continue;
        if (memcmp(bars + at + strg_off, "STRG", 4)) continue;

        size_t name_off = (size_t)at + strg_off + 8;
        const void *nul = memchr(bars + name_off, '\0', size - name_off);
        if (!nul) continue;
        if (strcmp((const char *)bars + name_off, "Sys_Item_SheikSensor")) continue;

        if (wave == 0xFFFFFFFFu || wave >= size) return false;
        if (size - wave >= 6 && !memcmp(bars + wave, "FWAV\xFF\xFE", 6)) {
            return patch_fwav(bars + wave, size - wave, volume_pct);
        }
        if (size - wave >= 4 && !memcmp(bars + wave, "BWAV", 4)) {
            return patch_bwav(bars, size, wave, volume_pct);
        }
        return false;
    }
    return false;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ live volume
// The game plays the sensor as DSP-ADPCM voices, one per channel, each with its channel's 16 ADPCM coefficients.
// Those are computed per sound, so they tell the sensor's voices from every other sound's. At start the sensor's
// channels are noted from M_UI.bars (coefficients, samples, start context). Then:
// - the sdk's own renderer (runtime/services/audio.c, the default): each frame, before its command list runs, a data
//   source command whose coefficients are the sensor's has its samples brought to the setting's volume where they
//   lie in the game's memory (shrine_sensor_render): re-encoded from the original once per change, written only over
//   the original or an earlier volume's samples;
// - our audren:u mixer: its voices are scaled by shrine_sensor_gain at mixing.
#define SENSOR_CHANS 8
typedef struct {
    int16_t coefs[16];
    uint32_t nsamp;
    size_t nbytes;
    int16_t h0, h1;
    uint8_t *orig, *cur, *prev;  // the samples as shipped, at the volume now set, at the one before
    int cur_vol;
} SensorChan;
static SensorChan g_ch[SENSOR_CHANS];
static int g_nch;

static void note_chan(const uint8_t *coef_bytes, const uint8_t *samples, uint32_t nsamp, size_t nbytes) {
    int16_t k[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) k[i] = rd16i(coef_bytes + i * 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nch; i++)
        if (!memcmp(g_ch[i].coefs, k, sizeof k)) return;
    if (g_nch >= SENSOR_CHANS) return;
    SensorChan *c = &g_ch[g_nch];
    uint8_t *orig = malloc(nbytes), *cur = malloc(nbytes), *prev = malloc(nbytes);
    if (!orig || !cur || !prev) { free(orig), free(cur), free(prev); return; }
    memcpy(c->coefs, k, sizeof k);
    c->nsamp = nsamp, c->nbytes = nbytes;
    c->h0 = rd16i(coef_bytes + 34), c->h1 = rd16i(coef_bytes + 36);
    memcpy(orig, samples, nbytes), memcpy(cur, samples, nbytes), memcpy(prev, samples, nbytes);
    c->orig = orig, c->cur = cur, c->prev = prev, c->cur_vol = 100;
    g_nch++;
}

// Sys_Item_SheikSensor's FWAV in a BARS file, or NULL
static const uint8_t *sensor_fwav(const uint8_t *bars, size_t size, size_t *wsize) {
    if (!bars || size < 16 || memcmp(bars, "BARS", 4) || memcmp(bars + 8, "\xFF\xFE", 2)) return NULL;
    uint32_t cnt = rd32(bars + 12);
    if (16 + (uint64_t)cnt * 12 > size) return NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
        uint32_t at = rd32(bars + 16 + cnt * 4 + i * 8), wave = rd32(bars + 20 + cnt * 4 + i * 8);
        if ((uint64_t)at + 0x1C > size || memcmp(bars + at, "AMTA\xFF\xFE", 6)) continue;
        uint32_t strg = rd32(bars + at + 0x18);
        if ((uint64_t)at + strg + 8 > size || memcmp(bars + at + strg, "STRG", 4)) continue;
        size_t name = (size_t)at + strg + 8;
        if (!memchr(bars + name, '\0', size - name) || strcmp((const char *)bars + name, "Sys_Item_SheikSensor")) continue;
        if (wave >= size || size - wave < 0x2C || memcmp(bars + wave, "FWAV\xFF\xFE", 6)) return NULL;
        *wsize = size - wave;
        return bars + wave;
    }
    return NULL;
}

int shrine_sensor_note_bars(const uint8_t *bars, size_t size) {
    size_t wsize = 0;
    const uint8_t *fwav = sensor_fwav(bars, size, &wsize);
    if (!fwav) return 0;
    uint16_t nsec = rd16(fwav + 0x10);
    if ((uint64_t)0x14 + (uint64_t)nsec * 12 > wsize) return 0;
    uint32_t info_off = 0, info_sz = 0, data_off = 0, data_sz = 0;
    for (uint16_t s = 0; s < nsec; s++) {
        const uint8_t *ref = fwav + 0x14 + s * 12;
        uint32_t off = rd32(ref + 4), sz = rd32(ref + 8);
        if ((uint64_t)off + sz > wsize) return 0;
        if (rd16(ref) == 0x7000) info_off = off, info_sz = sz;
        else if (rd16(ref) == 0x7001) data_off = off, data_sz = sz;
    }
    if (!info_off || info_sz < 0x20 || !data_off || data_sz < 8) return 0;
    const uint8_t *info = fwav + info_off, *wdata = fwav + data_off;
    if (memcmp(info, "INFO", 4) || memcmp(wdata, "DATA", 4) || info[8] != 2) return 0;  // (DSP-ADPCM only)
    uint32_t nsamp = rd32(info + 0x14), nch = rd32(info + 0x1C);
    size_t nbytes = ((size_t)nsamp + 13) / 14 * 8;
    if (!nsamp || nsamp > (64u << 20) || nch == 0 || nch > 16 || 0x20 + (uint64_t)nch * 8 > info_sz) return 0;
    int found = 0;
    for (uint32_t ch = 0; ch < nch; ch++) {
        int32_t ch_rel = rd32i(info + 0x1C + 4 + ch * 8 + 4);
        if (ch_rel < 0 || 0x1C + (size_t)ch_rel + 20 > info_sz) continue;
        const uint8_t *ci = info + 0x1C + ch_rel;
        int32_t s_rel = rd32i(ci + 4), a_rel = rd32i(ci + 12);
        if (a_rel <= 0 || 0x1C + (size_t)ch_rel + (size_t)a_rel + 44 > info_sz) continue;
        if (s_rel < 0 || 8 + (uint64_t)s_rel + nbytes > data_sz) continue;
        note_chan(ci + a_rel, wdata + 8 + s_rel, nsamp, nbytes);
        found++;
    }
    return found;
}

static SensorChan *chan_of(const int16_t coefs[16]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nch; i++)
        if (!memcmp(g_ch[i].coefs, coefs, sizeof g_ch[i].coefs)) return &g_ch[i];
    return NULL;
}

bool shrine_sensor_voice(const int16_t coefs[16]) { return chan_of(coefs) != NULL; }

float shrine_sensor_gain(int volume_pct) {
    if (volume_pct >= 100) return 1.0f;
    if (volume_pct <= 0) return 0.0f;
    return powf(volume_pct / 100.0f, 1.5f);  // (perceptual: 50 % sounds about half as loud)
}

// c->cur at volume (c->prev keeps the samples it replaces)
static bool encode_at(SensorChan *c, int volume) {
    int16_t *pcm = NULL;
    if (volume > 0 && volume < 100 && !(pcm = malloc((size_t)c->nsamp * sizeof *pcm))) return false;
    uint8_t *t = c->prev;
    c->prev = c->cur, c->cur = t;
    if (volume >= 100) memcpy(c->cur, c->orig, c->nbytes);
    else if (volume <= 0) memset(c->cur, 0, c->nbytes);
    else {
        float g = shrine_sensor_gain(volume);
        adpcm_decode_ch(c->orig, c->nsamp, c->coefs, c->h0, c->h1, pcm);
        for (uint32_t s = 0; s < c->nsamp; s++) pcm[s] = clamp16(lroundf(pcm[s] * g));
        adpcm_encode_ch(pcm, c->nsamp, c->coefs, c->cur);
        free(pcm);
    }
    c->cur_vol = volume;
    return true;
}

bool shrine_sensor_render(const int16_t coefs[16], uint8_t *samples, size_t size, int volume) {
    SensorChan *c = chan_of(coefs);
    if (!c || size < c->nbytes) return false;
    if (volume < 0) volume = 0;
    if (volume > 100) volume = 100;
    if (volume != c->cur_vol && !encode_at(c, volume)) return false;
    if (!memcmp(samples, c->cur, c->nbytes)) return false;
    // (only over the sensor's own samples: as shipped, or as an earlier volume left them)
    if (memcmp(samples, c->orig, c->nbytes) && memcmp(samples, c->prev, c->nbytes)) return false;
    memcpy(samples, c->cur, c->nbytes);
    return true;
}
```

```h
// Shrine sensor volume / mute (runtime/shrine_sensor.c).
// Adjusts the volume of the Sheikah Slate shrine and item sensor (Sys_Item_SheikSensor)
// by scaling or muting its waveform in Sound/Resource/M_UI.bars.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

// Patch M_UI.bars data in-place to adjust the volume of Sys_Item_SheikSensor.
// volume_pct: 0 = mute (silence), 100 = original volume (no-op), 1..99 = attenuated.
// Returns true if the sound asset was found and parsed (or modified).
bool shrine_sensor_patch_bars(uint8_t *bars, size_t size, int volume_pct);

// Live volume (the setting applies at once): note the sensor's ADPCM coefficients from an M_UI.bars (returns the
// channels found), then the mixer asks whether a voice's coefficients are the sensor's and scales it by the gain.
int shrine_sensor_note_bars(const uint8_t *bars, size_t size);
bool shrine_sensor_voice(const int16_t coefs[16]);
float shrine_sensor_gain(int volume_pct);
// The sdk renderer: the samples of a voice with these coefficients, where they lie in the game memory, brought to
// volume (0..100) when they are the sensor ones (as shipped or at an earlier volume). true: they were rewritten.
bool shrine_sensor_render(const int16_t coefs[16], uint8_t *samples, size_t size, int volume);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

```h
// Portable C lowering of AArch64 FP / AdvSIMD / crypto / CRC32 (tools/simd_c.py emits calls with constant
// fields; everything is always_inline so the size/lane/op switches fold at -O1).
// Semantics follow the ARM pseudocode, not the host: NaN propagation (first signalling NaN quietened, then
// first quiet NaN), FPCR.DN default NaN, FPCR.FZ flushing (inputs and pre-rounding-tiny results), FPCR.RMode
// for arithmetic / conversions / FRINTX/I, saturating FP->int conversions, fused multiply-add, ARM estimate
// tables. Not modelled: FPSR cumulative exception bits and QC, FPCR trap enables, FP16 arithmetic (ARMv8.2).
// FPCR.AHP is honoured by the half-precision conversions. Host assumptions: IEEE binary32/64, MXCSR (or the
// host FPU) in round-to-nearest with denormals enabled; fma must be correctly rounded (x86-64: the FMA instructions
// with -mfma, else simd_softfma.h).

#include <fenv.h>
#include <math.h>

#include "cpu.h"

typedef __uint128_t u128;
#define SI static inline __attribute__((always_inline))
#define SN static __attribute__((noinline))
#define SIMD_CAT2(a, b) a##_##b
#define SIMD_CAT(a, b) SIMD_CAT2(a, b)

#define SIMD_VT(name, T) typedef T name __attribute__((vector_size(16), may_alias));

SIMD_VT(vu32, uint32_t) SIMD_VT(vs32, int32_t) SIMD_VT(vu64, uint64_t) SIMD_VT(vs64, int64_t)
SIMD_VT(vf32, float) SIMD_VT(vf64, double)
typedef uint16_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa16;
typedef uint32_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa32;
typedef uint64_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa64;
typedef float __attribute__((may_alias)) saf32;
typedef double __attribute__((may_alias)) saf64;
typedef u128 __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) u128u;

// ---- registers: VREG = whole V register as a vector type; VQ = source with the upper half cleared when
// Q=0; VW = write, zeroing the upper half when Q=0. Scalar views of lane 0: VS8..VS64, VSF32/VSF64.
#define VREG(T, n) (*(T *)&c->v[n])
#define VQ(T, Q, n) ((T)((Q) ? c->v[n] : (u128)(uint64_t)c->v[n]))
#define VW(T, Q, d, e) do { T _w = (e); c->v[d] = (Q) ? (u128)_w : (u128)(uint64_t)(u128)_w; } while (0)
#define VS8(n) (*(uint8_t *)&c->v[n])
#define VS16(n) (*(sa16 *)&c->v[n])
#define VS32(n) (*(sa32 *)&c->v[n])
#define VS64(n) (*(sa64 *)&c->v[n])
#define VSF32(n) (*(saf32 *)&c->v[n])
#define VSF64(n) (*(saf64 *)&c->v[n])
#define VHI64(n) (((sa64 *)&c->v[n])[1])
#define LD128(a) (*(const u128u *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define ST128(a, v) (*(u128u *)(uintptr_t)(a) = (u128)(v))
#define SHUF __builtin_shufflevector
#define CVT __builtin_convertvector

#define FPCR_AHP (1u << 26)
#define FPCR_DN (1u << 25)
#define FPCR_FZ (1u << 24)
#define FPCR_RM (3u << 22)
// FPCR settings the fast paths below can't follow: they go through the slow ones. On x86-64 FZ isn't one of them: the
// thread's MXCSR follows it (rt_fpcr_write, below).
#if defined(__x86_64__)
#define FPCR_SLOW FPCR_RM
#else
#define FPCR_SLOW (FPCR_FZ | FPCR_RM)
#endif

enum { FOP_ADD, FOP_SUB, FOP_MUL, FOP_MULX, FOP_NMUL, FOP_DIV, FOP_ABD, FOP_SQRT, FOP_MADD, FOP_RECPS, FOP_RSQRTS,
       FOP_MAX, FOP_MIN, FOP_MAXNM, FOP_MINNM };

SI int simd_fe_mode(uint64_t fpcr) {
    static const int m[4] = {FE_TONEAREST, FE_UPWARD, FE_DOWNWARD, FE_TOWARDZERO};
    return m[(fpcr >> 22) & 3];
}

// The host's rounding mode for the FPCR paths below. On x86-64 float and double math is SSE, so only MXCSR's
// rounding field matters: MinGW's fegetround / fesetround also read and rewrite the x87 control word, and cost more
// than the operation they wrapped. (BOTW 1.8.2 sets FPCR.FZ, which sends every scalar op down the slow path: its
// main thread spent half its time there.) The paths change the mode only when FPCR asks for one other than
// round to nearest, the host's own, and put it back.
#if defined(__x86_64__)
#include <xmmintrin.h>
// (MXCSR.RC: 0 nearest, 1 down, 2 up, 3 toward zero. The FE_* values differ between C libraries: UCRT's are 0x100
// apart, glibc's and msvcrt's 0x400.)
SI unsigned simd_rc(int fe) { return fe == FE_DOWNWARD ? 1u : fe == FE_UPWARD ? 2u : fe == FE_TOWARDZERO ? 3u : 0u; }
SI int simd_getround(void) {
    static const int m[4] = {FE_TONEAREST, FE_DOWNWARD, FE_UPWARD, FE_TOWARDZERO};
    return m[(_mm_getcsr() >> 13) & 3u];
}
SI void simd_setround(int fe) { _mm_setcsr((_mm_getcsr() & ~0x6000u) | simd_rc(fe) << 13); }
// MSR FPCR. FZ (flush denormal inputs and results to signed zero) is MXCSR's DAZ (inputs) and FTZ (results) on x86-64,
// so the FP ops keep their fast paths: BOTW 1.8.2 sets FZ at the start of its threads (main 0x7000b4de30, the thread
// entry 0x70000c4e3c), and the software flush sent every FP op down the slow path (~40% of the main thread's time in
// the open world). Each guest thread is a host thread of its own whose FP code is the guest's, and lifted FPCR writes
// are the only ones (new threads start with FPCR 0 and the host's default MXCSR). The one difference: a result that
// rounds up to the smallest normal may be kept, where ARM (tininess before rounding) flushes it.
SI void rt_fpcr_write(Cpu *c, uint64_t v) {
    c->fpcr = v & 0x7c00000ull;
    unsigned m = _mm_getcsr() & ~0x8040u;  // (FTZ bit 15, DAZ bit 6)
    _mm_setcsr(c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ ? m | 0x8040u : m);
}
#else
SI int simd_getround(void) { return fegetround(); }
SI void simd_setround(int fe) { fesetround(fe); }
SI void rt_fpcr_write(Cpu *c, uint64_t v) { c->fpcr = v & 0x7c00000ull; }
#endif

// Fused multiply-add (simd_fp.h SIMD_FMA): the FMA instructions where the target has them; x86-64 game code built
// without them (the compatible target, runtime/gamebuild.c) uses its own, which follows MXCSR as they do.
#if defined(__x86_64__) && !defined(__FMA__)
#include "simd_softfma.h"
#define SIMD_SOFT_FMA 1
// Set (by runtime/gamelib.c, from settings.h fast_fma): x*y + z with two roundings in place of the exact fma, which
// costs the compatible target ~10% of its frame rate. The last bit of a result can differ from the console's.
#ifndef _WIN32
__attribute__((visibility("hidden")))
#endif
extern int simd_fma_unfused;
#endif

#define MB 23
#define VT vf32

#include "simd_fp.h"
#undef F
#undef T
#undef U
#undef NB
#undef EB
#undef MB
#undef VT
#undef VTU
#undef VTS
#undef NL

#define T double
#define U uint64_t
#define NB 64
#define EB 11
#define MB 52
#define VT vf64
#define VTU vu64
#define VTS vs64
#define NL 2
#include "simd_fp.h"
#undef F
```
