```h
#undef VTU
#undef VTS
#undef NL

// ---- precision conversions (FCVT, FCVTL/N, FCVTXN); FZ flushes single/double inputs, never halves
SI double simd_s2d(Cpu *c, float x) {
    uint32_t u = fb_s(fz_s(c, x));
    if (isnan_s(u)) {
        if (c->fpcr & FPCR_DN) return fv_d(0x7ff8000000000000ull);
        return fv_d(((uint64_t)(u >> 31) << 63) | 0x7ff8000000000000ull | ((uint64_t)(u & 0x3fffff) << 29));
    }
    return (double)fv_s(u);
}
SN float simd_d2s_slow(Cpu *c, double x) {
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON
    int mode = simd_fe_mode(c->fpcr);
    if (mode == FE_TONEAREST) return (float)x;  // (FZ alone: flushed by the caller)
    int old = simd_getround();
    simd_setround(mode);
    volatile double vx = x;
    volatile float r = (float)vx;
    simd_setround(old);
    return r;
}
SI float simd_d2s(Cpu *c, double x) {
    uint64_t u = fb_d(fz_d(c, x));
    if (isnan_d(u)) {
        if (c->fpcr & FPCR_DN) return fv_s(0x7fc00000u);
        return fv_s((uint32_t)(u >> 63) << 31 | 0x7fc00000u | (uint32_t)((u >> 29) & 0x3fffff));
    }
    x = fv_d(u);
    if (__builtin_expect(c->fpcr & FPCR_SLOW, 0)) {
        if ((c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) && __builtin_fabs(x) < 0x1p-126 && x != 0) return fv_s((uint32_t)(u >> 63) << 31);
        return simd_d2s_slow(c, x);
    }
    return (float)x;
}
// round to odd (FCVTXN)
SI float simd_d2s_odd(Cpu *c, double x) {
    uint64_t u = fb_d(fz_d(c, x));
    if (isnan_d(u)) return simd_d2s(c, x);
    x = fv_d(u);
    if ((c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) && __builtin_fabs(x) < 0x1p-126 && x != 0) return fv_s((uint32_t)(u >> 63) << 31);
    float f = (float)x;
    if ((double)f != x && x == x) {
        uint32_t b = fb_s(f);
        if (__builtin_fabs((double)f) > __builtin_fabs(x)) b--;
        return fv_s(b | 1);
    }
    return f;
}
SI uint64_t simd_rnd_shift(uint64_t m, int sh, int rm, int neg) {
    if (sh >= 64) return (rm == 1 && !neg && m) || (rm == 2 && neg && m);
    uint64_t q = m >> sh, rem = m & ((1ull << sh) - 1), half = 1ull << (sh - 1);
    if (rm == 0) q += rem > half || (rem == half && (q & 1));
    else if (rm == 1) q += rem && !neg;
    else if (rm == 2) q += rem && neg;
    return q;
}
// double (exact image of the single/double source, NaN payload left-aligned) -> half, FPCR rounding
SI uint16_t simd_d2h(Cpu *c, uint64_t u) {
    uint64_t fpcr = c->fpcr;
    int ahp = !!(fpcr & FPCR_AHP), rm = (fpcr >> 22) & 3, neg = (int)(u >> 63);
    uint16_t s = (uint16_t)(neg << 15);
    int e = (int)((u >> 52) & 0x7ff);
    uint64_t f = u & ((1ull << 52) - 1);
    if (e == 0x7ff) {
        if (f) return ahp ? s : (fpcr & FPCR_DN) ? 0x7e00 : (uint16_t)(s | 0x7e00 | (f >> 42));
        return ahp ? (uint16_t)(s | 0x7fff) : (uint16_t)(s | 0x7c00);
    }
    if (!e && !f) return s;
    uint64_t m = e ? f | (1ull << 52) : f;
    int E = e ? e - 1075 : -1074, ue = e ? e - 1023 : -1023;
    uint64_t q;
    int bits;
    if (ue < -14) {
        q = simd_rnd_shift(m, -24 - E, rm, neg);
        bits = (int)q;
    } else {
        q = simd_rnd_shift(m, 42, rm, neg);
        bits = ((ue + 14) << 10) + (int)q;
    }
    if (ahp) return (uint16_t)(s | (bits > 0x7fff ? 0x7fff : bits));
    if (bits >= 0x7c00) {
        int inf = rm == 0 || (rm == 1 && !neg) || (rm == 2 && neg);
        return (uint16_t)(s | (inf ? 0x7c00 : 0x7bff));
    }
    return (uint16_t)(s | bits);
}
SI uint16_t simd_s2h(Cpu *c, float x) {
    uint32_t u = fb_s(fz_s(c, x));
    uint64_t d = isnan_s(u) ? ((uint64_t)(u >> 31) << 63) | 0x7ff0000000000000ull | ((uint64_t)(u & 0x7fffff) << 29)
                            : fb_d((double)fv_s(u));
    return simd_d2h(c, d);
}
SI uint16_t simd_dd2h(Cpu *c, double x) { return simd_d2h(c, fb_d(fz_d(c, x))); }
SI uint64_t simd_h2dbits(Cpu *c, uint16_t h) {
    uint64_t s = (uint64_t)(h >> 15) << 63;
    int e = (h >> 10) & 31, f = h & 0x3ff;
    if (e == 31 && !(c->fpcr & FPCR_AHP)) {
        if (!f) return s | 0x7ff0000000000000ull;
        if (c->fpcr & FPCR_DN) return 0x7ff8000000000000ull;
        return s | 0x7ff8000000000000ull | ((uint64_t)f << 42);
    }
    if (!e) return fb_d((s ? -1.0 : 1.0) * f * 0x1p-24);
    return s | ((uint64_t)(e - 15 + 1023) << 52) | ((uint64_t)f << 42);
}
SI double simd_h2d(Cpu *c, uint16_t h) { return fv_d(simd_h2dbits(c, h)); }
SI float simd_h2s(Cpu *c, uint16_t h) {
    uint64_t d = simd_h2dbits(c, h);
    if (isnan_d(d)) return fv_s((uint32_t)(d >> 63) << 31 | 0x7fc00000u | (uint32_t)((d >> 29) & 0x3fffff));
    return (float)fv_d(d);
}

// ---- scalar FP instructions (FP data processing)
#define FP_SETS(d, x) (c->v[d] = fb_s(x))
#define FP_SETD(d, x) (c->v[d] = fb_d(x))
SI void fp_op_s(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n, int m) { FP_SETS(d, op_s(c, op, VSF32(n), VSF32(m), 0)); }
SI void fp_op_d(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n, int m) { FP_SETD(d, op_d(c, op, VSF64(n), VSF64(m), 0)); }
// FMADD family: neg_a / neg_n negate the addend / first factor before the fused op
SI void fp_fma_s(Cpu *c, int na, int nn, int d, int n, int m, int a) {
    float x = VSF32(a), y = VSF32(n);
    if (na) x = neg_s(x);
    if (nn) y = neg_s(y);
    FP_SETS(d, op_s(c, FOP_MADD, x, y, VSF32(m)));
}
SI void fp_fma_d(Cpu *c, int na, int nn, int d, int n, int m, int a) {
    double x = VSF64(a), y = VSF64(n);
    if (na) x = neg_d(x);
    if (nn) y = neg_d(y);
    FP_SETD(d, op_d(c, FOP_MADD, x, y, VSF64(m)));
}

// ---- integer lanes (complex ops run lane by lane; constant sizes fold to plain loads/stores)
SI uint64_t lmask(int sz) { return sz == 3 ? ~0ull : (1ull << (8 << sz)) - 1; }
SI int64_t lsx(uint64_t v, int sz) { int s = 64 - (8 << sz); return (int64_t)(v << s) >> s; }
SI uint64_t lget(const u128 *v, int sz, int i) {
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)v + (i << sz);
    switch (sz) {
    case 0: return *p;
    case 1: return *(const sa16 *)p;
    case 2: return *(const sa32 *)p;
    default: return *(const sa64 *)p;
    }
}
SI void lset(u128 *v, int sz, int i, uint64_t x) {
    uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)v + (i << sz);
    switch (sz) {
    case 0: *p = (uint8_t)x; break;
    case 1: *(sa16 *)p = (uint16_t)x; break;
    case 2: *(sa32 *)p = (uint32_t)x; break;
    default: *(sa64 *)p = x; break;
    }
}
SI uint64_t sat_s(__int128 v, int sz) {
    __int128 hi = ((__int128)1 << ((8 << sz) - 1)) - 1, lo = -hi - 1;
    return (uint64_t)(v > hi ? hi : v < lo ? lo : v) & lmask(sz);
}
SI uint64_t sat_u(__int128 v, int sz) {
    __int128 hi = ((__int128)1 << (8 << sz)) - 1;
    return (uint64_t)(v > hi ? hi : v < 0 ? 0 : v);
}
SI uint64_t sat_uu(unsigned __int128 v, int sz) { return v > lmask(sz) ? lmask(sz) : (uint64_t)v; }
SI __int128 shl128(__int128 v, int s) { return (__int128)((unsigned __int128)v << s); }
// right shift by s >= 1 with optional rounding, as an infinite-precision value
SI __int128 lshr_s(int64_t v, int s, int rnd) {
    if (s > 100) s = 100;
    return rnd ? ((__int128)v + ((__int128)1 << (s - 1))) >> s : (__int128)v >> s;
}
SI unsigned __int128 lshr_u(uint64_t v, int s, int rnd) {
    if (s > 100) s = 100;
    return rnd ? ((unsigned __int128)v + ((unsigned __int128)1 << (s - 1))) >> s : (unsigned __int128)v >> s;
}
SI uint64_t pmul64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t *hi) { // carry-less
    uint64_t lo = 0, h = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++)
        if ((b >> i) & 1) lo ^= a << i, h ^= i ? a >> (64 - i) : 0;
    if (hi) *hi = h;
    return lo;
}

enum {
    LOP_SQADD, LOP_UQADD, LOP_SQSUB, LOP_UQSUB, LOP_SUQADD, LOP_USQADD,
    LOP_SHL, LOP_RSHL, LOP_QSHL, LOP_QRSHL, // register shifts (b = signed byte), U selects unsigned
    LOP_SHLI, LOP_QSHLI, LOP_QSHLUI, LOP_SHRI, LOP_RSHRI, LOP_SRAI, LOP_RSRAI, LOP_SRI, LOP_SLI,
    LOP_SQDMULH, LOP_SQRDMULH, LOP_PMUL,
    LOP_SQABS, LOP_SQNEG, LOP_ABS, LOP_NEG, LOP_CLS, LOP_CLZ, LOP_CNT, LOP_RBIT, LOP_URECPE, LOP_URSQRTE,
    LOP_HADD, LOP_RHADD, LOP_HSUB, LOP_ABD, LOP_ABA,
    // long: result lanes sz+1
    LOP_ADDL, LOP_SUBL, LOP_ABDL, LOP_ABAL, LOP_MLAL, LOP_MLSL, LOP_MULL, LOP_ADDW, LOP_SUBW,
    LOP_SQDMULL, LOP_SQDMLAL, LOP_SQDMLSL, LOP_PMULL, LOP_SHLL,
    // narrow: sz = destination lane size, a/b are sz+1
    LOP_XTN, LOP_SQXTN, LOP_UQXTN, LOP_SQXTUN, LOP_SHRN, LOP_RSHRN, LOP_QSHRN, LOP_QRSHRN, LOP_QSHRUN,
    LOP_QRSHRUN, LOP_ADDHN, LOP_RADDHN, LOP_SUBHN, LOP_RSUBHN,
    LOP_SHLLI, // SSHLL/USHLL: extend, shift (long)
};
#define LOP_U 256 // unsigned variant flag

SI uint64_t lop(int op, int sz, uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t d) {
    int u = op >> 8, es = 8 << sz;
    op &= 255;
    int64_t sa = lsx(a, sz), sb = lsx(b, sz);
    __int128 xa = u ? (__int128)a : (__int128)sa, xb = u ? (__int128)b : (__int128)sb; // extended operands
    int sh = (int8_t)b;
    switch (op) {
    case LOP_SQADD: return sat_s((__int128)sa + sb, sz);
    case LOP_UQADD: return sat_u((__int128)a + b, sz);
    case LOP_SQSUB: return sat_s((__int128)sa - sb, sz);
    case LOP_UQSUB: return sat_u((__int128)a - b, sz);
    case LOP_SUQADD: return sat_s((__int128)lsx(d, sz) + a, sz);
    case LOP_USQADD: return sat_u((__int128)d + sa, sz);
    case LOP_SHL: case LOP_RSHL: case LOP_QSHL: case LOP_QRSHL: {
        int sat = op == LOP_QSHL || op == LOP_QRSHL, rnd = op == LOP_RSHL || op == LOP_QRSHL;
        if (sh >= 0) {
            if (sat) return u ? sat_uu((unsigned __int128)a << (sh > 64 ? 64 : sh), sz)
                              : sat_s(shl128(sa, sh > 64 ? 64 : sh), sz);
            return sh >= es ? 0 : a << sh;
        }
        return u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, -sh, rnd) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, -sh, rnd);
    }
    case LOP_SHLI: return a << b;
    case LOP_QSHLI: return u ? sat_uu((unsigned __int128)a << b, sz) : sat_s(shl128(sa, (int)b), sz);
    case LOP_QSHLUI: return sat_u(shl128(sa, (int)b), sz);
    case LOP_SHRI: return u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 0) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, (int)b, 0);
    case LOP_RSHRI: return u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 1) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, (int)b, 1);
    case LOP_SRAI: return d + (u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 0) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, (int)b, 0));
    case LOP_RSRAI: return d + (u ? (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 1) : (uint64_t)lshr_s(sa, (int)b, 1));
    case LOP_SRI: {
        uint64_t m = (int)b >= es ? 0 : lmask(sz) >> b;
        return (d & ~m) | ((int)b >= es ? 0 : a >> b);
    }
    case LOP_SLI: { uint64_t m = (lmask(sz) << b) & lmask(sz); return (d & ~m) | ((a << b) & m); }
    case LOP_SQDMULH: return sat_s(((__int128)sa * sb * 2) >> es, sz);
    case LOP_SQRDMULH: return sat_s(((__int128)sa * sb * 2 + ((__int128)1 << (es - 1))) >> es, sz);
    case LOP_PMUL: return pmul64(a, b, 0);
    case LOP_SQABS: return sat_s(sa < 0 ? -(__int128)sa : sa, sz);
    case LOP_SQNEG: return sat_s(-(__int128)sa, sz);
    case LOP_ABS: return sa < 0 ? (uint64_t)-sa : (uint64_t)sa;
    case LOP_NEG: return -a;
    case LOP_CLS: {
        uint64_t x = (uint64_t)(sa ^ (sa >> 1)) & lmask(sz);
        return (x ? (uint64_t)__builtin_clzll(x << (64 - es)) : (uint64_t)es) - 1;
    }
    case LOP_CLZ: return a ? (uint64_t)__builtin_clzll(a << (64 - es)) : (uint64_t)es;
    case LOP_CNT: return (uint64_t)__builtin_popcountll(a);
    case LOP_RBIT: return __builtin_bitreverse8((uint8_t)a);
    case LOP_URECPE: return (a >> 31) ? (uint64_t)(256 | simd_recip_tab[(a >> 23) & 255]) << 23 : 0xffffffffull;
    case LOP_URSQRTE: return (a >> 30) ? (uint64_t)(256 | simd_rsqrt_tab[((a >> 23) & 511) - 128]) << 23 : 0xffffffffull;
    case LOP_HADD: return (uint64_t)((xa + xb) >> 1);
    case LOP_RHADD: return (uint64_t)((xa + xb + 1) >> 1);
    case LOP_HSUB: return (uint64_t)((xa - xb) >> 1);
    case LOP_ABD: return (uint64_t)(xa > xb ? xa - xb : xb - xa);
    case LOP_ABA: return d + (uint64_t)(xa > xb ? xa - xb : xb - xa);
    case LOP_ADDL: return (uint64_t)(xa + xb);
    case LOP_SUBL: return (uint64_t)(xa - xb);
    case LOP_ABDL: return (uint64_t)(xa > xb ? xa - xb : xb - xa);
    case LOP_ABAL: return d + (uint64_t)(xa > xb ? xa - xb : xb - xa);
    case LOP_MLAL: return d + (uint64_t)(xa * xb);
    case LOP_MLSL: return d - (uint64_t)(xa * xb);
    case LOP_MULL: return (uint64_t)(xa * xb);
    case LOP_ADDW: return a + (uint64_t)xb;
    case LOP_SUBW: return a - (uint64_t)xb;
    case LOP_SQDMULL: return sat_s((__int128)sa * sb * 2, sz + 1);
    case LOP_SQDMLAL: return sat_s((__int128)lsx(d, sz + 1) + (__int128)lsx(sat_s((__int128)sa * sb * 2, sz + 1), sz + 1), sz + 1);
    case LOP_SQDMLSL: return sat_s((__int128)lsx(d, sz + 1) - (__int128)lsx(sat_s((__int128)sa * sb * 2, sz + 1), sz + 1), sz + 1);
    case LOP_PMULL: return pmul64(a, b, 0);
    case LOP_SHLL: return a << es;
    // narrowing: a (and b for xHN) are 2*es wide
    case LOP_XTN: return a;
    case LOP_SQXTN: return sat_s(lsx(a, sz + 1), sz);
    case LOP_UQXTN: return sat_u(a, sz);
    case LOP_SQXTUN: return sat_u(lsx(a, sz + 1), sz);
    case LOP_SHRN: return a >> b;
    case LOP_RSHRN: return (uint64_t)lshr_u(a, (int)b, 1);
    case LOP_QSHRN: case LOP_QRSHRN: {
        int rnd = op == LOP_QRSHRN;
        return u ? sat_u((__int128)lshr_u(a, (int)b, rnd), sz) : sat_s(lshr_s(lsx(a, sz + 1), (int)b, rnd), sz);
    }
    case LOP_QSHRUN: return sat_u(lshr_s(lsx(a, sz + 1), (int)b, 0), sz);
    case LOP_QRSHRUN: return sat_u(lshr_s(lsx(a, sz + 1), (int)b, 1), sz);
    case LOP_ADDHN: return (a + b) >> es;
    case LOP_RADDHN: return (a + b + (1ull << (es - 1))) >> es;
    case LOP_SUBHN: return (a - b) >> es;
    case LOP_RSUBHN: return (a - b + (1ull << (es - 1))) >> es;
    case LOP_SHLLI: return (uint64_t)xa << b;
    }
    return 0;
}

// Generic lane loop: ne lanes; result lane i (size szd) goes to lane offd+i of d (other lanes kept when keep,
// else zero); a = n lane offn+i (size szn), b = m lane offm+i (size szm), or lane bidx of m when bidx >= 0,
// or the constant bimm when m < 0; the accumulator is d's old lane offd+i.
SI void sl_gen(Cpu *c, int op, int sz, int ne, int d, int szd, int offd, int keep, int n, int szn, int offn, int m,
               int szm, int offm, int bidx, uint64_t bimm) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], b = m >= 0 ? c->v[m] : 0, o = c->v[d], r = keep ? o : 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) {
        uint64_t y = m < 0 ? bimm : lget(&b, szm, bidx >= 0 ? bidx : offm + i);
        lset(&r, szd, offd + i, lop(op, sz, lget(&a, szn, offn + i), y, lget(&o, szd, offd + i)));
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}
// SADDLP/UADDLP/SADALP/UADALP
SI void sl_addlp(Cpu *c, int u, int acc, int Q, int sz, int d, int n) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], o = c->v[d], r = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (4 << Q) >> sz; i++) {
        uint64_t x = lget(&a, sz, 2 * i), y = lget(&a, sz, 2 * i + 1);
        uint64_t s = u ? x + y : (uint64_t)(lsx(x, sz) + lsx(y, sz));
        lset(&r, sz + 1, i, s + (acc ? lget(&o, sz + 1, i) : 0));
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}
// ADDV, SADDLV/UADDLV, SMAXV/UMAXV, SMINV/UMINV (op 0..3; u = unsigned)
SI void sl_across(Cpu *c, int op, int u, int Q, int sz, int d, int n) {
    u128 a = c->v[n];
    int ne = (8 << Q) >> sz;
    int64_t acc = u ? (int64_t)lget(&a, sz, 0) : lsx(lget(&a, sz, 0), sz);
    for (int i = 1; i < ne; i++) {
        int64_t x = u ? (int64_t)lget(&a, sz, i) : lsx(lget(&a, sz, i), sz);
        if (op <= 1) acc += x;
        else if (op == 2) acc = u ? ((uint64_t)x > (uint64_t)acc ? x : acc) : (x > acc ? x : acc);
        else acc = u ? ((uint64_t)x < (uint64_t)acc ? x : acc) : (x < acc ? x : acc);
    }
    c->v[d] = (uint64_t)acc & lmask(op == 1 ? sz + 1 : sz);
}
// PMULL2/PMULL 1Q (64x64 -> 128 carry-less)
SI void sl_pmull64(Cpu *c, int part, int d, int n, int m) {
    uint64_t hi, lo = pmul64(((sa64 *)&c->v[n])[part], ((sa64 *)&c->v[m])[part], &hi);
    c->v[d] = ((u128)hi << 64) | lo;
}

// ---- FP vector helpers: lanes of the 64-bit form are computed on a zero upper half
SI vf32 vsplat_s(vf32 v, int i, int Q) { float x = v[i]; return Q ? (vf32){x, x, x, x} : (vf32){x, x, 0, 0}; }
SI vf64 vsplat_d(vf64 v, int i, int Q) { double x = v[i]; (void)Q; return (vf64){x, x}; }
#define SV_FOP_S(op, Q, d, n, m, a) VW(vf32, Q, d, vop_s(c, op, n, m, a))
#define SV_FOP_D(op, Q, d, n, m, a) VW(vf64, Q, d, vop_d(c, op, n, m, a))
SI vf32 vneg_s(vf32 v) { return (vf32)((vu32)v ^ 0x80000000u); }
SI vf64 vneg_d(vf64 v) { return (vf64)((vu64)v ^ 0x8000000000000000ull); }
SI float pair_s(Cpu *c, int op, float a, float b) { return op_s(c, op, a, b, 0); }
SI double pair_d(Cpu *c, int op, double a, double b) { return op_d(c, op, a, b, 0); }
// FMAXV/FMINV/FMAXNMV/FMINNMV (4S): pairwise tree
SI void sv_fred_s(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n) {
    vf32 v = VREG(vf32, n);
    c->v[d] = fb_s(pair_s(c, op, pair_s(c, op, v[0], v[1]), pair_s(c, op, v[2], v[3])));
}
// lane-wise FP conversions
SI vu32 vtoint_s(Cpu *c, vf32 v, int rm, int fbits, int uns) {
    vu32 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = (uint32_t)toint_s(c, v[i], rm, fbits, 32, uns);
    return r;
}
SI vu64 vtoint_d(Cpu *c, vf64 v, int rm, int fbits, int uns) {
    vu64 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) r[i] = toint_d(c, v[i], rm, fbits, 64, uns);
    return r;
}
SI vf32 vfromint_s(Cpu *c, vu32 v, int fbits, int uns) {
    vf32 r;
    if (!(c->fpcr & FPCR_RM)) {
        r = uns ? CVT(v, vf32) : CVT((vs32)v, vf32);
        if (fbits) r = r / (float)(1ull << (fbits - 1)) / 2.0f;
        return r;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = fromint_s(c, v[i], 32, uns, fbits);
    return r;
}
SI vf64 vfromint_d(Cpu *c, vu64 v, int fbits, int uns) {
    vf64 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) r[i] = fromint_d(c, v[i], 64, uns, fbits);
    return r;
}
SI vf32 vrecpe_s(Cpu *c, vf32 v) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) v[i] = recpe_s(c, v[i]); return v; }
SI vf64 vrecpe_d(Cpu *c, vf64 v) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) v[i] = recpe_d(c, v[i]); return v; }
SI vf32 vrsqrte_s(Cpu *c, vf32 v) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) v[i] = rsqrte_s(c, v[i]); return v; }
SI vf64 vrsqrte_d(Cpu *c, vf64 v) { for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) v[i] = rsqrte_d(c, v[i]); return v; }

// FCVTL/FCVTL2 (h->s, s->d), FCVTN/FCVTN2 (s->h, d->s), FCVTXN/FCVTXN2
SI void sv_fcvtl(Cpu *c, int sz, int part, int d, int n) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], r = 0;
    if (sz == 0) {
        vf32 o;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) o[i] = simd_h2s(c, (uint16_t)lget(&a, 1, 4 * part + i));
        r = (u128)o;
    } else {
        vf64 o;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) o[i] = simd_s2d(c, fv_s((uint32_t)lget(&a, 2, 2 * part + i)));
        r = (u128)o;
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}
SI void sv_fcvtn(Cpu *c, int sz, int part, int odd, int d, int n) {
    u128 a = c->v[n], r = part ? (uint64_t)c->v[d] : 0;
    if (sz == 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) lset(&r, 1, 4 * part + i, simd_s2h(c, fv_s((uint32_t)lget(&a, 2, i))));
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            double x = fv_d(lget(&a, 3, i));
            lset(&r, 2, 2 * part + i, fb_s(odd ? simd_d2s_odd(c, x) : simd_d2s(c, x)));
        }
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}

// TBL / TBX with len+1 table registers
SI void sv_tbl(Cpu *c, int Q, int len, int tbx, int d, int n, int m) {
    uint8_t tab[64];
    for (int i = 0; i <= len; i++) memcpy(tab + 16 * i, &c->v[(n + i) & 31], 16);
    u128 idx = c->v[m], o = c->v[d], r = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8 << Q; i++) {
        unsigned k = (unsigned)lget(&idx, 0, i);
        lset(&r, 0, i, k < 16u * (len + 1) ? tab[k] : tbx ? lget(&o, 0, i) : 0);
    }
    c->v[d] = r;
}

// ---- CRC32 / CRC32C (bytes = 1, 2, 4, 8)
SI uint32_t simd_crc(const uint32_t *t, uint32_t acc, uint64_t v, int bytes) {
    for (int i = 0; i < bytes; i++) acc = t[(acc ^ (uint8_t)(v >> (8 * i))) & 0xff] ^ (acc >> 8);
    return acc;
}
#define CRC32(acc, v, n) simd_crc(simd_crc32_tab, (uint32_t)(acc), (v), n)
#define CRC32C(acc, v, n) simd_crc(simd_crc32c_tab, (uint32_t)(acc), (v), n)

// ---- crypto (AES, SHA1, SHA256)
SI uint8_t aes_xt(uint8_t x) { return (uint8_t)((x << 1) ^ ((x >> 7) * 0x1b)); }
SI uint8_t aes_mul(uint8_t x, int k) { // k in {9, 11, 13, 14}
    uint8_t x2 = aes_xt(x), x4 = aes_xt(x2), x8 = aes_xt(x4);
    return (uint8_t)(x8 ^ (k & 4 ? x4 : 0) ^ (k & 2 ? x2 : 0) ^ (k & 1 ? x : 0));
}
SI void sv_aes(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n) { // 0 AESE, 1 AESD, 2 AESMC, 3 AESIMC
    uint8_t s[16], r[16];
    u128 v = op < 2 ? c->v[d] ^ c->v[n] : c->v[n];
    memcpy(s, &v, 16);
    if (op == 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) r[i] = simd_aes_sbox[s[(i + 4 * (i & 3)) & 15]];
    } else if (op == 1) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) r[i] = simd_aes_isbox[s[(i - 4 * (i & 3)) & 15]];
    } else {
        for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++) {
            uint8_t *a = s + 4 * col, *o = r + 4 * col;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                uint8_t a0 = a[i], a1 = a[(i + 1) & 3], a2 = a[(i + 2) & 3], a3 = a[(i + 3) & 3];
                o[i] = op == 2 ? (uint8_t)(aes_xt(a0) ^ aes_xt(a1) ^ a1 ^ a2 ^ a3)
                               : (uint8_t)(aes_mul(a0, 14) ^ aes_mul(a1, 11) ^ aes_mul(a2, 13) ^ aes_mul(a3, 9));
            }
        }
    }
    memcpy(&v, r, 16);
    c->v[d] = v;
}
SI uint32_t rol32_(uint32_t x, int s) { return (x << s) | (x >> (32 - s)); }
SI uint32_t ror32_(uint32_t x, int s) { return (x >> s) | (x << (32 - s)); }
SI void sv_sha1hash(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n, int m) { // 0 SHA1C, 1 SHA1P, 2 SHA1M
    uint32_t x[4], w[4], y = (uint32_t)c->v[n];
    memcpy(x, &c->v[d], 16);
    memcpy(w, &c->v[m], 16);
    for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
        uint32_t t = op == 0 ? (((x[2] ^ x[3]) & x[1]) ^ x[3]) : op == 1 ? (x[1] ^ x[2] ^ x[3])
                                                               : ((x[1] & x[2]) | ((x[1] | x[2]) & x[3]));
        y = y + rol32_(x[0], 5) + t + w[e];
        x[1] = rol32_(x[1], 30);
        uint32_t top = x[3];
        x[3] = x[2], x[2] = x[1], x[1] = x[0], x[0] = y, y = top;
    }
    memcpy(&c->v[d], x, 16);
}
SI void sv_sha256hash(Cpu *c, int part1, int d, int n, int m) { // SHA256H (part1), SHA256H2
    uint32_t x[4], y[4], w[4];
    memcpy(part1 ? x : y, &c->v[d], 16);
    memcpy(part1 ? y : x, &c->v[n], 16);
    memcpy(w, &c->v[m], 16);
    for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
        uint32_t chs = ((y[1] ^ y[2]) & y[0]) ^ y[2];
        uint32_t maj = (x[0] & x[1]) | ((x[0] | x[1]) & x[2]);
        uint32_t t1 = y[3] + (ror32_(y[0], 6) ^ ror32_(y[0], 11) ^ ror32_(y[0], 25)) + chs + w[e];
        x[3] = t1 + x[3];
        y[3] = t1 + (ror32_(x[0], 2) ^ ror32_(x[0], 13) ^ ror32_(x[0], 22)) + maj;
        uint32_t t = y[3];
        y[3] = y[2], y[2] = y[1], y[1] = y[0], y[0] = x[3];
        x[3] = x[2], x[2] = x[1], x[1] = x[0], x[0] = t;
    }
    memcpy(&c->v[d], part1 ? x : y, 16);
}
SI void sv_sha_misc(Cpu *c, int op, int d, int n, int m) { // 0 SHA1SU0, 1 SHA1SU1, 2 SHA256SU0, 3 SHA256SU1, 4 SHA1H
    uint32_t a[4], b[4], k[4], r[4], t[4];
    memcpy(a, &c->v[d], 16);
    memcpy(b, &c->v[n], 16);
    memcpy(k, &c->v[m], 16);
    switch (op) {
    case 0:
        t[0] = a[2], t[1] = a[3], t[2] = b[0], t[3] = b[1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = t[i] ^ a[i] ^ k[i];
        break;
    case 1:
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) t[i] = a[i] ^ (i < 3 ? b[i + 1] : 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = rol32_(t[i], 1);
        r[3] ^= rol32_(t[0], 2);
        break;
    case 2:
        t[0] = a[1], t[1] = a[2], t[2] = a[3], t[3] = b[0];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) r[i] = (ror32_(t[i], 7) ^ ror32_(t[i], 18) ^ (t[i] >> 3)) + a[i];
        break;
    case 3: {
        uint32_t t0[4] = {b[1], b[2], b[3], k[0]};
        for (int e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
            uint32_t x = e < 2 ? k[e + 2] : r[e - 2];
            r[e] = (ror32_(x, 17) ^ ror32_(x, 19) ^ (x >> 10)) + a[e] + t0[e];
        }
        break;
    }
    default:
        c->v[d] = rol32_(b[0], 30);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(&c->v[d], r, 16);
}

// ---- loads / stores of lanes
SI uint64_t simd_ld(uint64_t a, int sz) {
    switch (sz) {
    case 0: return LD8(a);
    case 1: return LD16(a);
    case 2: return LD32(a);
    default: return LD64(a);
    }
}
SI void simd_st(uint64_t a, int sz, uint64_t v) {
    switch (sz) {
    case 0: ST8(a, v); break;
    case 1: ST16(a, v); break;
    case 2: ST32(a, v); break;
    default: ST64(a, v); break;
    }
}
// LDn/STn (multiple structures): selem interleaved registers, rpt repeats (LD1 with 2-4 registers)
SI void sl_ldm(Cpu *c, int Q, int sz, int selem, int rpt, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    u128 r[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    int ne = (8 << Q) >> sz;
    for (int k = 0; k < rpt; k++)
        for (int e = 0; e < ne; e++)
            for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++, ea += 1 << sz) lset(&r[k + s], sz, e, simd_ld(ea, sz));
    for (int i = 0; i < rpt + selem - 1; i++) c->v[(t + i) & 31] = r[i];
}
SI void sl_stm(Cpu *c, int Q, int sz, int selem, int rpt, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    u128 r[4];
    int ne = (8 << Q) >> sz;
    for (int i = 0; i < rpt + selem - 1; i++) r[i] = c->v[(t + i) & 31];
    for (int k = 0; k < rpt; k++)
        for (int e = 0; e < ne; e++)
            for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++, ea += 1 << sz) simd_st(ea, sz, lget(&r[k + s], sz, e));
}
// single structure: lane idx of selem registers; LDnR replicates into every lane
SI void sl_lds(Cpu *c, int sz, int selem, int idx, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++) {
        u128 v = c->v[(t + s) & 31];
        lset(&v, sz, idx, simd_ld(ea + (s << sz), sz));
        c->v[(t + s) & 31] = v;
    }
}
SI void sl_sts(Cpu *c, int sz, int selem, int idx, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++) simd_st(ea + (s << sz), sz, lget(&c->v[(t + s) & 31], sz, idx));
}
SI void sl_ldr(Cpu *c, int Q, int sz, int selem, int t, uint64_t ea) {
    uint64_t x[4];
    for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++) x[s] = simd_ld(ea + (s << sz), sz);
    for (int s = 0; s < selem; s++) {
        u128 v = 0;
        for (int e = 0; e < (8 << Q) >> sz; e++) lset(&v, sz, e, x[s]);
        c->v[(t + s) & 31] = v;
    }
}

```

`runtime/simd_fp.h`:

```h
// FP helpers for one precision; included twice by simd.h (F = s/float, d/double). No include guard.
// Scalar entry points take/return T, vector ones VT (all lanes; callers zero the unused half for Q=0).

#define FN(x) SIMD_CAT(x, F)
#define SGN ((U)1 << (NB - 1))
#define EXPM ((((U)1 << EB) - 1) << MB)
#define QB ((U)1 << (MB - 1))
#define DNAN (EXPM | QB)
#define MINN ((U)1 << MB) // smallest normal
#define VK(v) ((VT){} + (T)(v))
#define K(v) ((T)(v))

SI U FN(fb)(T x) { U u; memcpy(&u, &x, sizeof u); return u; }
SI T FN(fv)(U u) { T x; memcpy(&x, &u, sizeof x); return x; }
SI int FN(isnan)(U u) { return (u & ~SGN) > EXPM; }
SI int FN(issnan)(U u) { return FN(isnan)(u) && !(u & QB); }
SI int FN(isqnan)(U u) { return FN(isnan)(u) && (u & QB); }
SI int FN(isinf)(U u) { return (u & ~SGN) == EXPM; }
SI int FN(iszero)(U u) { return !(u & ~SGN); }
// (A denormal by its fraction bits: "u & ~SGN" != 0 compiles to a float compare with zero, which MXCSR.DAZ - FPCR.FZ
// on x86-64 - makes true for denormals, so they were kept instead of flushed.)
SI int FN(isden)(U u) { return !(u & EXPM) && (u & (MINN - 1)); }
SI T FN(flush)(T x) { U u = FN(fb)(x); return FN(isden)(u) ? FN(fv)(u & SGN) : x; }
SI T FN(fz)(Cpu *c, T x) { return __builtin_expect(c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ, 0) ? FN(flush)(x) : x; }
SI T FN(neg)(T x) { return FN(fv)(FN(fb)(x) ^ SGN); }

// FPProcessNaN(s): first signalling NaN (quietened), else first quiet NaN, else (invalid op) default NaN
SN T FN(nan1)(Cpu *c, T a) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a);
    if (!(c->fpcr & FPCR_DN) && FN(isnan)(x)) return FN(fv)(x | QB);
    return FN(fv)(DNAN);
}
SN T FN(nan2)(Cpu *c, T a, T b) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a), y = FN(fb)(b);
    if (!(c->fpcr & FPCR_DN)) {
        if (FN(issnan)(x)) return FN(fv)(x | QB);
        if (FN(issnan)(y)) return FN(fv)(y | QB);
        if (FN(isnan)(x)) return a;
        if (FN(isnan)(y)) return b;
    }
    return FN(fv)(DNAN);
}
SN T FN(nan3)(Cpu *c, T a, T b, T d) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a), y = FN(fb)(b), z = FN(fb)(d);
    if (!(c->fpcr & FPCR_DN)) {
        if (FN(issnan)(x)) return FN(fv)(x | QB);
        if (FN(issnan)(y)) return FN(fv)(y | QB);
        if (FN(issnan)(z)) return FN(fv)(z | QB);
        if (FN(isnan)(x)) return a;
        if (FN(isnan)(y)) return b;
        if (FN(isnan)(z)) return d;
    }
    return FN(fv)(DNAN);
}

// x*y + z with one rounding, for scalars and vectors (simd.h: the FMA instructions or simd_softfma.h)
#ifdef SIMD_SOFT_FMA
SI T FN(sel_fma)(T x, T y, T z) {
    return __builtin_expect(simd_fma_unfused, 1) ? x * y + z : FN(simd_soft_fma)(x, y, z);
}
SI VT FN(vsoft_fma)(VT x, VT y, VT z) {
    if (__builtin_expect(simd_fma_unfused, 1)) return x * y + z;
    VT r;
    for (int i = 0; i < NL; i++) r[i] = FN(simd_soft_fma)(x[i], y[i], z[i]);
    return r;
}
#ifndef SIMD_FMA
#define SIMD_FMA(x, y, z) _Generic((x), T: FN(sel_fma), VT: FN(vsoft_fma))(x, y, z)
#endif
#elif !defined(SIMD_FMA)
#define SIMD_FMA(x, y, z) __builtin_elementwise_fma(x, y, z)
#endif

// The arithmetic itself, for scalars (KK = K) and vectors (KK = VK). MADD: a + b*d (a = addend).
// RECPS/RSQRTS get their first operand already negated (FPNeg happens before NaN processing).
#define FCALC(op, a, b, d, KK)                                                                       \
    ((op) == FOP_ADD ? (a) + (b) : (op) == FOP_SUB ? (a) - (b)                                     \
   : (op) == FOP_MUL || (op) == FOP_MULX ? (a) * (b) : (op) == FOP_NMUL ? -((a) * (b))              \
   : (op) == FOP_DIV ? (a) / (b) : (op) == FOP_ABD ? __builtin_elementwise_abs((a) - (b))          \
   : (op) == FOP_SQRT ? __builtin_elementwise_sqrt(a)                                              \
   : (op) == FOP_MADD ? SIMD_FMA(b, d, a)                                                          \
   : (op) == FOP_RECPS ? SIMD_FMA(a, b, KK(2))                                                     \
   : (op) == FOP_RSQRTS ? SIMD_FMA(a, b, KK(3)) * KK(0.5) : (a))

// Lanes whose fast result needs fixing: NaN results (NaN operand or invalid op), RSQRTS overflow.
#define FBAD(op, r) ((op) == FOP_RSQRTS ? ((r) != (r)) | (__builtin_elementwise_abs(r) == K(INFINITY)) : (r) != (r))

// (3 + a*b) / 2 with one rounding (a already negated): halve a normal operand first, so a product beyond
// the format's range (which the fast path rounds to inf, or to the largest normal when rounding down) is exact.
SN T FN(rsqrts)(T a, T b) {
    if (__builtin_elementwise_abs(a) >= FN(fv)(2 * MINN)) return SIMD_FMA(a * K(0.5), b, K(1.5));
    if (__builtin_elementwise_abs(b) >= FN(fv)(2 * MINN)) return SIMD_FMA(a, b * K(0.5), K(1.5));
    return SIMD_FMA(a, b, K(3)) * K(0.5);
}

// ARM result for a lane flagged by FBAD. (The fast paths' operands aren't flushed: FZ is the host's there.)
SN T FN(fix)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b, T d) {
    a = FN(fz)(c, a), b = FN(fz)(c, b), d = FN(fz)(c, d);
    U x = FN(fb)(a), y = FN(fb)(b), z = FN(fb)(d);
    int nan = FN(isnan)(x) || FN(isnan)(y);
    switch (op) {
    case FOP_SQRT: return FN(nan1)(c, a); // NaN in, or negative -> default NaN
    case FOP_MADD:
        if (FN(isnan)(x) || FN(isnan)(y) || FN(isnan)(z)) {
            if (FN(isqnan)(x) && ((FN(isinf)(y) && FN(iszero)(z)) || (FN(iszero)(y) && FN(isinf)(z))))
                return FN(fv)(DNAN);
            return FN(nan3)(c, a, b, d);
        }
        return FN(fv)(DNAN);
    case FOP_MULX:
        if (!nan) return FN(fv)(((x ^ y) & SGN) | FN(fb)(K(2)));
        break;
    case FOP_RECPS:
        if (!nan) return K(2);
        break;
    case FOP_RSQRTS:
        if (!nan) {
            if ((FN(isinf)(x) && FN(iszero)(y)) || (FN(iszero)(x) && FN(isinf)(y))) return K(1.5);
            return FN(rsqrts)(a, b);
        }
        break;
    case FOP_NMUL: return FN(neg)(FN(nan2)(c, a, b));
    case FOP_ABD: return FN(fv)(FN(fb)(FN(nan2)(c, a, b)) & ~SGN);
    }
    return FN(nan2)(c, a, b);
}

// FMAX/FMIN/FMAXNM/FMINNM (operands already flushed)
SI T FN(minmax)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b) {
    U x = FN(fb)(a), y = FN(fb)(b);
    if (__builtin_expect(FN(isnan)(x) || FN(isnan)(y), 0)) {
        if (op == FOP_MAXNM || op == FOP_MINNM) {
            if (FN(isqnan)(x) && !FN(isnan)(y)) return b;
            if (FN(isqnan)(y) && !FN(isnan)(x)) return a;
        }
        return FN(nan2)(c, a, b);
    }
    if (op == FOP_MAX || op == FOP_MAXNM) return a == b ? FN(fv)(x & y) : a > b ? a : b;
    return a == b ? FN(fv)(x | y) : a < b ? a : b;
}
#define FMINMAX(op) ((op) >= FOP_MAX && (op) <= FOP_MINNM)

// FPCR.FZ / RMode path: flush inputs, round in the FPCR mode, flush tiny results (tininess is detected
// before rounding on ARM: a result rounded up to the smallest normal is recomputed toward zero).
SN T FN(slow)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b, T d) {
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON
    uint64_t fpcr = c->fpcr;
    if (fpcr & FPCR_FZ) a = FN(flush)(a), b = FN(flush)(b), d = FN(flush)(d);
    if (FMINMAX(op)) return FN(minmax)(c, op, a, b);
    int mode = simd_fe_mode(fpcr), old = 0;
    int set = mode != FE_TONEAREST;  // (FZ alone: the host already rounds to nearest)
    if (set) old = simd_getround(), simd_setround(mode);
    volatile T va = a, vb = b, vd = d;
    volatile T vr = op == FOP_RSQRTS ? FN(rsqrts)(va, vb) : FCALC(op, va, vb, vd, K);
    T r = vr;
    if (FBAD(op, r)) vr = FN(fix)(c, op, a, b, d), r = vr;
    if ((fpcr & FPCR_FZ) && (FN(fb)(r) & ~SGN) <= MINN && !FN(iszero)(FN(fb)(r))) {
        if ((FN(fb)(r) & ~SGN) == MINN) {
            if (!set) old = simd_getround(), set = 1;
            simd_setround(FE_TOWARDZERO);
            volatile T vz = FCALC(op, va, vb, vd, K);
            if ((FN(fb)(vz) & ~SGN) < MINN) r = FN(fv)(FN(fb)(r) & SGN);
        } else {
            r = FN(fv)(FN(fb)(r) & SGN);
        }
    }
    if (set) simd_setround(old);
    return r;
}

// Scalar FP op (constant op folds the selection).
SI T FN(op)(Cpu *c, int op, T a, T b, T d) {
    if (__builtin_expect(c->fpcr & FPCR_SLOW, 0)) return FN(slow)(c, op, a, b, d);
    if (FMINMAX(op)) return FN(minmax)(c, op, FN(fz)(c, a), FN(fz)(c, b));  // (picks an operand: flushed by hand)
    T r = FCALC(op, a, b, d, K);
    if (__builtin_expect(FBAD(op, r), 0)) r = FN(fix)(c, op, a, b, d);
    return r;
}

SN VT FN(vslow)(Cpu *c, int op, VT a, VT b, VT d) {
    VT r;
    for (int i = 0; i < NL; i++) r[i] = FN(op)(c, op, a[i], b[i], d[i]);
    return r;
}

SI VTU FN(vsel)(VTS m, VTU x, VTU y) { return (x & (VTU)m) | (y & ~(VTU)m); }

SI VT FN(vfz)(Cpu *c, VT a) {
    if (__builtin_expect(c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ, 0)) {
        VTU u = (VTU)a;
        VTS den = ((u & (MINN - 1)) != 0) & ((u & EXPM) == 0);  // (fraction bits: as isden)
        a = (VT)FN(vsel)(den, u & SGN, u);
    }
    return a;
}

// Vector FP op: native lanes, any NaN (or an FPCR_SLOW setting) reruns all lanes through the scalar path.
SI VT FN(vop)(Cpu *c, int op, VT a, VT b, VT d) {
    if (__builtin_expect(c->fpcr & FPCR_SLOW, 0)) return FN(vslow)(c, op, a, b, d);
    VT r;
    if (FMINMAX(op)) {
        a = FN(vfz)(c, a), b = FN(vfz)(c, b);  // (picks an operand: flushed by hand)
        if (__builtin_expect(__builtin_reduce_or((a != a) | (b != b)) != 0, 0)) return FN(vslow)(c, op, a, b, d);
        VTU x = (VTU)a, y = (VTU)b;
        if (op == FOP_MAX || op == FOP_MAXNM)
            r = (VT)FN(vsel)(a > b, x, FN(vsel)(a == b, x & y, y));
        else
            r = (VT)FN(vsel)(a < b, x, FN(vsel)(a == b, x | y, y));
        return r;
    }
    r = FCALC(op, a, b, d, VK);
    if (__builtin_expect(__builtin_reduce_or(FBAD(op, r)) != 0, 0)) return FN(vslow)(c, op, a, b, d);
    return r;
}

// ---- compares
SI uint64_t FN(cmp)(Cpu *c, T a, T b) { // FCMP NZCV
    a = FN(fz)(c, a), b = FN(fz)(c, b);
    return a == b ? 0x60000000ull : a < b ? 0x80000000ull : a > b ? 0x20000000ull : 0x30000000ull;
}
// FCMEQ/FCMGE/FCMGT/FACGE/FACGT (op 0..4)
SI VTU FN(vcmp)(Cpu *c, int op, VT a, VT b) {
    a = FN(vfz)(c, a), b = FN(vfz)(c, b);
    if (op >= 3) a = __builtin_elementwise_abs(a), b = __builtin_elementwise_abs(b);
    switch (op) {
    case 0: return (VTU)(a == b);
    case 1: case 3: return (VTU)(a >= b);
    default: return (VTU)(a > b);
    }
}

// ---- rounding to integral (FRINT*): rm 0 N, 1 P, 2 M, 3 Z, 4 A; 5 X / 6 I = FPCR mode
// (rint = ties-to-even: the host stays in round-to-nearest outside the slow paths; no roundeven in MinGW's CRT)
SI T FN(rnd)(T x, int rm) {
    switch (rm) {
    case 0: return __builtin_elementwise_rint(x);
    case 1: return __builtin_elementwise_ceil(x);
    case 2: return __builtin_elementwise_floor(x);
    case 3: return __builtin_elementwise_trunc(x);
    default: return __builtin_elementwise_round(x);
    }
}
SI T FN(frint)(Cpu *c, T x, int rm) {
    x = FN(fz)(c, x);
    if (rm >= 5) rm = (int)((c->fpcr >> 22) & 3);
    T r = FN(rnd)(x, rm);
    if (__builtin_expect(r != r, 0)) r = FN(nan1)(c, x);
    return r;
}
SI VT FN(vfrint)(Cpu *c, VT x, int rm) {
    x = FN(vfz)(c, x);
    if (rm >= 5) rm = (int)((c->fpcr >> 22) & 3);
    VT r;
    switch (rm) {
    case 0: r = __builtin_elementwise_rint(x); break;
    case 1: r = __builtin_elementwise_ceil(x); break;
    case 2: r = __builtin_elementwise_floor(x); break;
    case 3: r = __builtin_elementwise_trunc(x); break;
    default: r = __builtin_elementwise_round(x); break;
    }
    if (__builtin_expect(__builtin_reduce_or(r != r) != 0, 0))
        for (int i = 0; i < NL; i++)
            if (r[i] != r[i]) r[i] = FN(nan1)(c, x[i]);
    return r;
}

// ---- FP -> integer (FCVT[NPMZA][SU], fixed point): saturating, NaN -> 0. ib = 32/64.
SI uint64_t FN(toint)(Cpu *c, T x, int rm, int fbits, int ib, int uns) {
    x = FN(fz)(c, x);
    if (fbits) x = x * (T)(1ull << (fbits - 1)) * K(2);
    T r = FN(rnd)(x, rm);
    if (r != r) return 0;
    if (uns) {
        if (r <= K(0)) return 0;
        if (ib == 32) return r >= K(4294967296.0) ? 0xffffffffull : (uint32_t)r;
        return r >= K(18446744073709551616.0) ? ~0ull : (uint64_t)r;
    }
    if (ib == 32) return r >= K(2147483648.0) ? 0x7fffffffull : r < K(-2147483648.0) ? 0x80000000ull : (uint32_t)(int32_t)r;
    return r >= K(9223372036854775808.0) ? 0x7fffffffffffffffull : r < K(-9223372036854775808.0) ? 0x8000000000000000ull
                                                                                              : (uint64_t)(int64_t)r;
}

// ---- integer -> FP (SCVTF/UCVTF, fixed point), rounded in the FPCR mode
SN T FN(fromint_slow)(Cpu *c, uint64_t v, int ib, int uns, int fbits) {
#pragma STDC FENV_ACCESS ON
    int old = simd_getround();
    simd_setround(simd_fe_mode(c->fpcr));
    volatile uint64_t vv = v;
    volatile T r;
    if (uns) r = ib == 32 ? (T)(uint32_t)vv : (T)vv;
    else r = ib == 32 ? (T)(int32_t)vv : (T)(int64_t)vv;
    simd_setround(old);
    T x = r;
    if (fbits) x = x / (T)(1ull << (fbits - 1)) / K(2);
    return x;
}
SI T FN(fromint)(Cpu *c, uint64_t v, int ib, int uns, int fbits) {
    if (__builtin_expect(c->fpcr & FPCR_RM, 0)) return FN(fromint_slow)(c, v, ib, uns, fbits);
    T r;
    if (uns) r = ib == 32 ? (T)(uint32_t)v : (T)v;
    else r = ib == 32 ? (T)(int32_t)v : (T)(int64_t)v;
    if (fbits) r = r / (T)(1ull << (fbits - 1)) / K(2);
    return r;
}

// ---- reciprocal estimates (bit-exact ARMv8.0 pseudocode)
SI T FN(recpe)(Cpu *c, T a) {
    U x = FN(fb)(FN(fz)(c, a)), s = x & SGN;
    if (FN(isnan)(x)) return FN(nan1)(c, a);
    if (FN(isinf)(x)) return FN(fv)(s);
    if (FN(iszero)(x)) return FN(fv)(s | EXPM);
    U mag = x & ~SGN;
    if (mag < ((U)1 << (MB - 2))) { // |x| < 2^(emin - 2): result overflows
        int rm = (c->fpcr >> 22) & 3;
        int inf = rm == 0 || (rm == 1 && !s) || (rm == 2 && s);
        return FN(fv)(s | (inf ? EXPM : EXPM - 1));
    }
    int64_t e = (int64_t)(mag >> MB);
    U frac = mag & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
    if ((c->fpcr & FPCR_FZ) && e >= (int64_t)((1 << EB) - 3)) return FN(fv)(s); // result would be tiny
    if (e == 0) {
        if (!(frac >> (MB - 1))) e = -1, frac = (frac << 2) & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
        else frac = (frac << 1) & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
    }
    int scaled = 256 | (int)(frac >> (MB - 8));
    int64_t re = (int64_t)((1 << EB) - 3) - e;
    U est = (U)simd_recip_tab[scaled - 256]; // 8 fraction bits
    U f = est << (MB - 8);
    if (re == 0) f = (f >> 1) | ((U)1 << (MB - 1));
    else if (re == -1) f = (f >> 2) | ((U)1 << (MB - 2)), re = 0;
    return FN(fv)(s | ((U)re << MB) | f);
}
SI T FN(rsqrte)(Cpu *c, T a) {
    U x = FN(fb)(FN(fz)(c, a)), s = x & SGN;
    if (FN(isnan)(x)) return FN(nan1)(c, a);
    if (FN(iszero)(x)) return FN(fv)(s | EXPM);
    if (s) return FN(fv)(DNAN);
    if (FN(isinf)(x)) return K(0);
    int64_t e = (int64_t)(x >> MB);
    U frac = x & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
    if (e == 0) {
        while (!(frac >> (MB - 1))) frac <<= 1, e--;
        frac = (frac << 1) & (((U)1 << MB) - 1);
    }
    int scaled = (e & 1) ? 128 | (int)(frac >> (MB - 7)) : 256 | (int)(frac >> (MB - 8));
    int64_t re = ((int64_t)(3 * ((1 << (EB - 1)) - 1) - 1) - e) / 2; // (380 - e) / 2, (3068 - e) / 2
    U est = (U)simd_rsqrt_tab[scaled - 128];
    return FN(fv)(((U)re << MB) | (est << (MB - 8)));
}
SI T FN(recpx)(Cpu *c, T a) {
    U x = FN(fb)(FN(fz)(c, a)), s = x & SGN;
    if (FN(isnan)(x)) return FN(nan1)(c, a);
    if (!(x & EXPM)) return FN(fv)(s | (EXPM - MINN));
    return FN(fv)(s | (~x & EXPM));
}

#undef FN
#undef SGN
#undef EXPM
#undef QB
#undef DNAN
#undef MINN
#undef VK
#undef K

```

`runtime/simd_softfma.h`:

```h
// Fused multiply-add in integer arithmetic, for x86-64 game code built without FMA (the compatible target,
// runtime/gamebuild.c). It does what the FMA instructions do with the thread's MXCSR: DAZ flushes denormal
// operands, RC rounds, FTZ flushes tiny results (tininess after rounding, as x86 detects it).
// The C library's fma is no use there: glibc's software fallback (taken on CPUs without FMA) is a few ulp off with
// FTZ/DAZ set or in a directed rounding mode (tools/test_simd.py: fmadd/fnmadd/fnmsub on d registers), and costs
// ~400 cycles a call. tools/test_softfma.c checks this one bit for bit against the FMA instructions.
// NaN results only have to be NaNs: simd_fp.h's FBAD path gives ARM's.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <xmmintrin.h>

typedef __uint128_t sfma_u128;

static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) int sfma_bitlen(sfma_u128 m) {
    uint64_t hi = (uint64_t)(m >> 64), lo = (uint64_t)m;
    return hi ? 128 - __builtin_clzll(hi) : lo ? 64 - __builtin_clzll(lo) : 0;
}

// m >> d, any bits shifted out kept as a sticky bit 0 (the other operand's bit 0 is always clear, so a sum or
// difference with it never lands on a rounding boundary: see sfma_core)
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) sfma_u128 sfma_shr(sfma_u128 m, int d) {
    if (d == 0) return m;
    if (d >= 128) return m != 0;
    return (m >> d) | ((m & (((sfma_u128)1 << d) - 1)) != 0);
}

// x*y + z for finite, non-zero operands of a binary format with MB fraction and EB exponent bits (binary32: 23, 8;
// binary64: 52, 11), as bit patterns. csr: MXCSR (RC, FTZ; DAZ is applied by the caller).
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) uint64_t sfma_core(uint64_t ux, uint64_t uy, uint64_t uz, const int MB,
                                                               const int EB, unsigned csr) {
    const int bias = (1 << (EB - 1)) - 1, emin = 1 - bias, mine = emin - MB;  // mine: the smallest subnormal's
    const int p = MB + 1;                                                    // exponent; p: the precision
    const uint64_t sgn = 1ull << (MB + EB), fmask = (1ull << MB) - 1, inf = (((1ull << EB) - 1) << MB);
    const int rc = (csr >> 13) & 3;  // 0 to nearest, 1 down, 2 up, 3 toward zero
    // operand = m * 2^e
#define SFMA_UNPACK(u, m, e)                                                                                           \
    do {                                                                                                                \
        int be_ = (int)(((u) >> MB) & ((1u << EB) - 1));                                                                \
        m = ((u) & fmask) | (be_ ? 1ull << MB : 0);                                                                     \
        e = (be_ ? be_ : 1) - bias - MB;                                                                                \
    } while (0)
    uint64_t mx, my, mz;
    int ex, ey, ez;
    SFMA_UNPACK(ux, mx, ex);
    SFMA_UNPACK(uy, my, ey);
    SFMA_UNPACK(uz, mz, ez);
#undef SFMA_UNPACK
    int sp = (int)(((ux ^ uy) >> (MB + EB)) & 1), sz = (int)((uz >> (MB + EB)) & 1);
    // the exact product (at most 106 bits) and the addend, both with their top bit at bit 125: the product's lowest
    // set bit is then at bit 20 or above, the addend's at 73 or above. So a shift of 20 bits or less (the only case
    // where the two can cancel) is exact; a longer one leaves the larger operand's top bit at 125 and the sum's at
    // 124 or above, 70 bits over where it is rounded.
    sfma_u128 P = (sfma_u128)mx * my, Z = mz;
    int ep = ex + ey, sh;
    sh = 125 - sfma_bitlen(P), P <<= sh, ep -= sh;
    sh = 125 - sfma_bitlen(Z), Z <<= sh, ez -= sh;
    int e, s;
    if (ep >= ez) Z = sfma_shr(Z, ep - ez), e = ep;
    else P = sfma_shr(P, ez - ep), e = ez;
    sfma_u128 M;
    if (sp == sz) M = P + Z, s = sp;
    else if (P >= Z) M = P - Z, s = sp;
    else M = Z - P, s = sz;
    if (!M) return rc == 1 ? sgn : 0;  // exact zero of opposite signs: +0, -0 rounding down

    // round M * 2^e to the format: k bits (fewer when subnormal), q * 2^qe
    int n = sfma_bitlen(M), L = e + n - 1;  // L: the exponent of the top bit
    int k = L >= emin ? p : L - mine + 1;
    uint64_t q;
    int qe = mine, up = 0;
    if (k <= 0) {  // below the smallest subnormal (k == 0: at least half of it)
        q = 0;
        int above_half = k == 0 && (M & (M - 1)) != 0;
        up = rc == 0 ? above_half : rc == 1 ? s : rc == 2 ? !s : 0;
    } else if (n <= k) {
        q = (uint64_t)M << (k - n), qe = e - (k - n);
    } else {
        int d = n - k;
        sfma_u128 rem = M & (((sfma_u128)1 << d) - 1), half = (sfma_u128)1 << (d - 1);
        q = (uint64_t)(M >> d), qe = e + d;
        up = rc == 0 ? rem > half || (rem == half && (q & 1)) : rc == 1 ? rem && s : rc == 2 ? rem && !s : 0;
    }
    q += up;

    // FTZ: a tiny result (below the smallest normal once rounded to p bits with an unbounded exponent) is zero
    if ((csr & 0x8000u) && L < emin) {
        int tiny = 1;
        if (L == emin - 1 && n > p) {  // just below: rounding may carry it up to the smallest normal
            int d = n - p;
            sfma_u128 rem = M & (((sfma_u128)1 << d) - 1), half = (sfma_u128)1 << (d - 1);
            uint64_t q2 = (uint64_t)(M >> d);
            int up2 = rc == 0 ? rem > half || (rem == half && (q2 & 1)) : rc == 1 ? rem && s : rc == 2 ? rem && !s : 0;
            tiny = q2 + up2 < (1ull << p);
        }
        if (tiny) return s ? sgn : 0;
    }

    uint64_t r;
    if (!q) {
        r = 0;
    } else {
        int lb = 64 - __builtin_clzll(q), Lq = qe + lb - 1;
        if (Lq > bias) {  // overflow: infinity, or the largest finite value when rounding toward zero from it
            r = rc == 0 || (rc == 1 && s) || (rc == 2 && !s) ? inf : inf - 1;
        } else if (Lq >= emin) {
            if (lb > p) q >>= 1, lb--;  // (rounded up to 2^p: exact)
            r = ((uint64_t)(Lq + bias) << MB) | ((q << (p - lb)) & fmask);
        } else {
            r = q;  // subnormal (qe == mine)
        }
    }
    return r | (s ? sgn : 0);
}

// binary32 rounding to nearest (the game's mode), finite non-zero operands: the product is exact in a double, the sum's
// rounding error exact by TwoSum (no double here is ever denormal or near an infinity), and the sum rounded to odd
// (its last bit set when inexact) rounds to the same float as the exact value would.
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) int sfma_fast_s(uint32_t ux, uint32_t uy, uint32_t uz, unsigned csr,
                                                            uint32_t *out) {
    if (csr & 0x6000u) return 0;  // (a directed rounding mode: sfma_core)
    float x, y, z;
    memcpy(&x, &ux, 4), memcpy(&y, &uy, 4), memcpy(&z, &uz, 4);
    double p = (double)x * (double)y, zd = z, s = p + zd, bv = s - p, err = (p - (s - bv)) + (zd - bv);
    if (err != 0) {
        uint64_t u;
        memcpy(&u, &s, 8);
        if (!(u & 1)) u += (err > 0) == (s > 0) ? 1 : (uint64_t)-1;
        memcpy(&s, &u, 8);
    }
    float r = (float)s;  // (MXCSR's FTZ flushes it as the FMA instruction would)
    memcpy(out, &r, 4);
    return 1;
}
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) int sfma_fast_d(uint64_t ux, uint64_t uy, uint64_t uz, unsigned csr,
                                                            uint64_t *out) {
    (void)ux, (void)uy, (void)uz, (void)csr, (void)out;
    return 0;
}

// fma(x, y, z): the cases with an infinity, a NaN or a zero by the host's own multiply and add, which round and
// flush as the FMA instructions do there; the rest exactly.
#define SFMA_DEFINE(name, F, T, U, MB, EB)                                                                              \
    __attribute__((noinline)) static T name(T x, T y, T z) {                                                            \
        const U sgn = (U)1 << (MB + EB), inf = (((U)1 << EB) - 1) << MB;                                                \
        unsigned csr = _mm_getcsr();                                                                                    \
        U ux, uy, uz;                                                                                                   \
        memcpy(&ux, &x, sizeof ux), memcpy(&uy, &y, sizeof uy), memcpy(&uz, &z, sizeof uz);                             \
        if (csr & 0x40u) { /* DAZ */                                                                                    \
            if (!(ux & inf)) ux &= sgn;                                                                                 \
            if (!(uy & inf)) uy &= sgn;                                                                                 \
            if (!(uz & inf)) uz &= sgn;                                                                                 \
        }                                                                                                               \
        U ax = ux & ~sgn, ay = uy & ~sgn, az = uz & ~sgn;                                                               \
        if (ax >= inf || ay >= inf || az >= inf || !ax || !ay || !az) {                                                 \
            volatile T fx, fy, fz;                                                                                      \
            memcpy((T *)&fx, &ux, sizeof ux), memcpy((T *)&fy, &uy, sizeof uy), memcpy((T *)&fz, &uz, sizeof uz);       \
            if (az >= inf && ax < inf && ay < inf) return fz; /* (x*y alone may overflow to the other infinity) */      \
            if (!az && ax && ay && ax < inf && ay < inf) return fx * fy; /* the product's own rounding and sign */      \
            volatile T prod = fx * fy;                                                                                  \
            return prod + fz;                                                                                           \
        }                                                                                                               \
        U r;                                                                                                            \
        if (!sfma_fast_##F(ux, uy, uz, csr, &r)) r = (U)sfma_core(ux, uy, uz, MB, EB, csr);                             \
        T t;                                                                                                            \
        memcpy(&t, &r, sizeof t);                                                                                       \
        return t;                                                                                                       \
    }
SFMA_DEFINE(simd_soft_fma_s, s, float, uint32_t, 23, 8)
SFMA_DEFINE(simd_soft_fma_d, d, double, uint64_t, 52, 11)
#undef SFMA_DEFINE

```

`runtime/steam_shortcuts.c`:

```c
// Savage Wind in the Steam library (runtime/steam_shortcuts.h).
#if defined(__linux__) && !defined(_GNU_SOURCE)
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#endif
#include "steam_shortcuts.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#ifndef _WIN32
#include <strings.h>
#endif
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the binary VDF of shortcuts.vdf
// A map is a list of (type byte, NUL-terminated key, value), ended by 0x08. Types: 0x00 map, 0x01 string, 0x02 int32,
// 0x03 float32, 0x06 colour, 0x07 / 0x0A 64-bit. Read into a tree and written back byte for byte.
typedef struct Node {
    uint8_t type;
    char *key;
    uint8_t *val;  // (strings with their NUL)
    size_t len;
    struct Node *kids;
    int nkids, cap;
} Node;

static void node_free(Node *n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n->nkids; i++) node_free(&n->kids[i]);
    free(n->kids);
    free(n->key);
    free(n->val);
}

static Node *node_add(Node *m) {
    if (m->nkids == m->cap) {
        int c = m->cap ? m->cap * 2 : 8;
        Node *k = (Node *)realloc(m->kids, (size_t)c * sizeof *k);
        if (!k) return NULL;
        m->kids = k, m->cap = c;
    }
    Node *n = &m->kids[m->nkids++];
    memset(n, 0, sizeof *n);
    return n;
}

static bool parse_map(const uint8_t *d, size_t n, size_t *at, Node *m, int depth) {
    if (depth > 16) return false;
    for (;;) {
        if (*at >= n) return false;
        uint8_t t = d[(*at)++];
        if (t == 0x08) return true;
        const uint8_t *k = d + *at, *z = (const uint8_t *)memchr(k, 0, n - *at);
        if (!z) return false;
        Node *c = node_add(m);
        if (!c) return false;
        c->type = t;
        c->key = strdup((const char *)k);
        *at += (size_t)(z - k) + 1;
        size_t len;
        switch (t) {
            case 0x00:
                if (!parse_map(d, n, at, c, depth + 1)) return false;
                continue;
            case 0x01: {
                const uint8_t *e = (const uint8_t *)memchr(d + *at, 0, n - *at);
                if (!e) return false;
                len = (size_t)(e - (d + *at)) + 1;
                break;
            }
            case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x06: len = 4; break;
            case 0x07: case 0x0A: len = 8; break;
            default: return false;
        }
        if (*at + len > n || !(c->val = (uint8_t *)malloc(len))) return false;
        memcpy(c->val, d + *at, len);
        c->len = len;
        *at += len;
    }
}

typedef struct { uint8_t *p; size_t n, cap; bool bad; } Buf;
static void put(Buf *b, const void *d, size_t n) {
    if (b->bad) return;
    if (b->n + n > b->cap) {
        size_t c = b->cap ? b->cap * 2 : 4096;
        while (c < b->n + n) c *= 2;
        uint8_t *q = (uint8_t *)realloc(b->p, c);
        if (!q) { b->bad = true; return; }
        b->p = q, b->cap = c;
    }
    memcpy(b->p + b->n, d, n);
    b->n += n;
}
static void write_map(Buf *b, const Node *m) {
    for (int i = 0; i < m->nkids; i++) {
        const Node *c = &m->kids[i];
        put(b, &c->type, 1);
        put(b, c->key, strlen(c->key) + 1);
        if (c->type == 0x00) write_map(b, c);
        else put(b, c->val, c->len);
    }
    static const uint8_t end = 0x08;
    put(b, &end, 1);
}

static Node *find(Node *m, const char *key) {  // (Steam has written both "AppName" and "appname")
    for (int i = 0; i < m->nkids; i++)
        if (!strcasecmp(m->kids[i].key, key)) return &m->kids[i];
    return NULL;
}

static bool set_string(Node *m, const char *key, const char *v) {
    Node *c = find(m, key);
    if (!c && !(c = node_add(m))) return false;
    if (!c->key) c->key = strdup(key);
    c->type = 0x01;
    free(c->val);
    c->len = strlen(v) + 1;
    c->val = (uint8_t *)malloc(c->len);
    if (!c->val || !c->key) return false;
    memcpy(c->val, v, c->len);
    return true;
}
static bool set_int(Node *m, const char *key, uint32_t v) {
    Node *c = find(m, key);
    if (!c && !(c = node_add(m))) return false;
    if (!c->key) c->key = strdup(key);
    c->type = 0x02;
    free(c->val);
    c->len = 4;
    c->val = (uint8_t *)malloc(4);
    if (!c->val || !c->key) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) c->val[i] = (uint8_t)(v >> (i * 8));
    return true;
}

uint32_t steam_shortcut_appid(const char *exe, const char *name) {
    uint32_t c = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++)
        for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)(s ? name : exe); *p; p++) {
            c ^= *p;
            for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320u & (0u - (c & 1)));
        }
    return ~c | 0x80000000u;
}

static bool parse_root(const uint8_t *in, size_t n, Node *root, char *why, size_t ws) {
    memset(root, 0, sizeof *root);
    if (!n) return true;
    size_t at = 0;
    if (!parse_map(in, n, &at, root, 0) || at != n) {
        snprintf(why, ws, "its shortcuts.vdf has a format this version doesn't know");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int steam_vdf_count(const uint8_t *in, size_t n) {
    Node root;
    char why[100];
    if (!parse_root(in, n, &root, why, sizeof why)) {
        node_free(&root);
        return -1;
    }
    Node *s = find(&root, "shortcuts");
    int c = s && s->type == 0x00 ? s->nkids : 0;
    node_free(&root);
    return c;
}

bool steam_vdf_upsert(const uint8_t *in, size_t n, const SteamEntry *e, int count, uint8_t **out, size_t *out_n,
                      char *why, size_t ws) {
    Node root;
    bool ok = parse_root(in, n, &root, why, ws);
    Node *list = ok ? find(&root, "shortcuts") : NULL;
    if (ok && !list) {
        if (root.nkids) {
            snprintf(why, ws, "its shortcuts.vdf has no list of shortcuts");
            ok = false;
        } else if ((list = node_add(&root))) {
            list->type = 0x00;
            list->key = strdup("shortcuts");
        }
    }
    if (ok && (!list || list->type != 0x00)) {
        snprintf(why, ws, "its shortcuts.vdf has no list of shortcuts");
        ok = false;
    }
    for (int i = 0; ok && i < count; i++) {
        Node *s = NULL;
        for (int k = 0; k < list->nkids && !s; k++) {
            Node *name = find(&list->kids[k], "AppName");
            if (name && name->type == 0x01 && !strcmp((const char *)name->val, e[i].name)) s = &list->kids[k];
        }
        bool fresh = !s;
        if (fresh) {
            char idx[16];
            snprintf(idx, sizeof idx, "%d", list->nkids);
            if (!(s = node_add(list))) { ok = false; break; }
            s->type = 0x00;
            s->key = strdup(idx);
        }
        uint32_t appid = steam_shortcut_appid(e[i].exe, e[i].name);
        ok = set_int(s, "appid", appid) && set_string(s, "AppName", e[i].name) && set_string(s, "Exe", e[i].exe) &&
             set_string(s, "StartDir", e[i].start_dir) && set_string(s, "icon", e[i].icon) &&
             set_string(s, "LaunchOptions", e[i].options);
        if (ok && fresh)
            ok = set_string(s, "ShortcutPath", "") && set_int(s, "IsHidden", 0) && set_int(s, "AllowDesktopConfig", 1) &&
                 set_int(s, "AllowOverlay", 1) && set_int(s, "OpenVR", 0) && set_int(s, "Devkit", 0) &&
                 set_string(s, "DevkitGameID", "") && set_int(s, "DevkitOverrideAppID", 0) && set_int(s, "LastPlayTime", 0) &&
                 set_string(s, "FlatpakAppID", "");
        if (ok && fresh) {
            Node *tags = node_add(s);
            if (!tags) ok = false;
            else tags->type = 0x00, tags->key = strdup("tags");
        }
        if (!ok) snprintf(why, ws, "out of memory");
    }
    if (ok) {
        Buf b = {0};
        write_map(&b, &root);
        if (b.bad) {
            free(b.p);
            snprintf(why, ws, "out of memory");
            ok = false;
        } else *out = b.p, *out_n = b.n;
    }
    node_free(&root);
    return ok;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ this computer's Steam
#if !defined(STEAM_VDF_ONLY) && (defined(_WIN32) || defined(__linux__))  // (STEAM_VDF_ONLY: the file format alone, for its test)
#include <dirent.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#else
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include "update_appimage.h"
extern char **environ;
#endif
#include "paths.h"

static bool exists(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    return stat(p, &st) == 0;
}

static uint8_t *slurp(const char *p, size_t *n) {
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long s = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *b = s >= 0 && s < (64 << 20) ? (uint8_t *)malloc((size_t)s + 1) : NULL;
    if (b && fread(b, 1, (size_t)s, f) != (size_t)s) free(b), b = NULL;
    fclose(f);
    if (b) *n = (size_t)s;
    return b;
}

// The Steam folders here (a test can point SAVAGEWIND_STEAM_ROOT at a copy)
static int steam_roots(char roots[][1100], int max) {
    int n = 0;
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_STEAM_ROOT")) {
        snprintf(roots[n++], 1100, "%s", getenv("SAVAGEWIND_STEAM_ROOT"));
        return n;
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t w[1024];
    DWORD sz = sizeof w;
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, L"Software\\Valve\\Steam", L"SteamPath", RRF_RT_REG_SZ, NULL, w, &sz) == ERROR_SUCCESS &&
        WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, roots[n], 1100, NULL, NULL))
        n++;
#else
    const char *home = getenv("HOME");
    if (home) {
        static const char *const cands[] = {"%s/.local/share/Steam", "%s/.steam/steam",
                                            "%s/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.local/share/Steam"};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof cands / sizeof *cands && n < max; i++) {
            char p[1100], r[1100];
            snprintf(p, sizeof p, cands[i], home);
            if (!realpath(p, r)) continue;
            bool dup = false;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) dup |= !strcmp(roots[k], r);
            if (!dup) snprintf(roots[n++], 1100, "%s", r);
        }
    }
#endif
    (void)max;
    return n;
}

#ifdef _WIN32
static bool steam_running(void) {
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_STEAM_ROOT")) return getenv("SAVAGEWIND_TEST_STEAM_RUNNING") != NULL;
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
    PROCESSENTRY32W e = {sizeof e};
    bool found = false;
    if (Process32FirstW(snap, &e))
        do found |= !_wcsicmp(e.szExeFile, L"steam.exe");
        while (!found && Process32NextW(snap, &e));
    CloseHandle(snap);
    return found;
}
static void run_steam(const char *root, const char *args, bool wait) {
    char exe[1200];
    snprintf(exe, sizeof exe, "%s/steam.exe", root);
    wchar_t w[1200], wa[100];
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, exe, -1, w, 1200);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, args, -1, wa, 100);
    SHELLEXECUTEINFOW s;
    memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
    s.cbSize = sizeof s;
    s.fMask = SEE_MASK_NOCLOSEPROCESS;
    s.lpFile = w;
    s.lpParameters = wa;
    s.nShow = SW_SHOWNORMAL;
    if (ShellExecuteExW(&s) && s.hProcess) {
        if (wait) WaitForSingleObject(s.hProcess, 30000);
        CloseHandle(s.hProcess);
    }
}
#else
static bool steam_running(void) {
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_STEAM_ROOT")) return getenv("SAVAGEWIND_TEST_STEAM_RUNNING") != NULL;
    const char *home = getenv("HOME");
    char p[1100];
    static const char *const pids[] = {"%s/.steam/steam.pid", "%s/.var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.steam/steam.pid"};
    for (size_t i = 0; home && i < sizeof pids / sizeof *pids; i++) {
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, pids[i], home);
        FILE *f = fopen(p, "r");
        if (!f) continue;
        long pid = 0;
        if (fscanf(f, "%ld", &pid) != 1) pid = 0;
        fclose(f);
        char comm[64] = "", cp[64];
        snprintf(cp, sizeof cp, "/proc/%ld/comm", pid);
        FILE *c = pid > 0 ? fopen(cp, "r") : NULL;
        if (c) {
            if (!fgets(comm, sizeof comm, c)) comm[0] = 0;
            fclose(c);
        }
        if (strstr(comm, "steam")) return true;
    }
    return false;
}
// The system's steam, without what the AppImage's runtime or a launcher put in the environment
static void run_steam(const char *root, const char *args, bool wait) {
    bool flatpak = strstr(root, "com.valvesoftware.Steam") != NULL;
    pid_t pid = fork();
    if (pid < 0) return;
    if (!pid) {
        if (!wait) {
            setsid();
            if (fork()) _exit(0);  // (not our child: it outlives this program)
        }
        static const char *const drop[] = {"APPDIR", "APPIMAGE", "ARGV0", "OWD", "LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "LD_PRELOAD"};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof drop / sizeof *drop; i++) unsetenv(drop[i]);
        if (flatpak) execlp("flatpak", "flatpak", "run", "com.valvesoftware.Steam", args, (char *)NULL);
        else execlp("steam", "steam", args, (char *)NULL);
        _exit(127);
    }
    int st;
    waitpid(pid, &st, 0);
}
#endif

static void unsetenv_running(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _putenv("SAVAGEWIND_TEST_STEAM_RUNNING=");
#else
    unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_TEST_STEAM_RUNNING");
#endif
}

bool steam_supported(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    char p[1100];
    return rt_resource("sw-manifest.txt", NULL, p, sizeof p);
#else
    return appimage_path() != NULL;
#endif
}

// This copy's two entries
static int our_entries(SteamEntry *e, char bufs[][1200]) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t w[1024];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, w, 1024);
    if (!n || n >= 1024) return 0;
    char exe[1100];
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, exe, sizeof exe, NULL, NULL);
    char dir[1100];
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", exe);
    char *s = strrchr(dir, '\\');
    if (!s) return 0;
    *s = 0;
    snprintf(bufs[0], 1200, "\"%s\"", exe);
    snprintf(bufs[1], 1200, "\"%s\\Savage Wind Configuration.exe\"", dir);
    snprintf(bufs[2], 1200, "\"%s\\\"", dir);
    snprintf(bufs[3], 1200, "%s", exe);
    e[0] = (SteamEntry){"Savage Wind", bufs[0], bufs[2], bufs[3], "--game"};
    e[1] = (SteamEntry){"Savage Wind Configuration", bufs[1], bufs[2], bufs[3], ""};
#else
    const char *ai = appimage_path();
    if (!ai) return 0;
    char dir[1100];
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", ai);
    char *s = strrchr(dir, '/');
    if (!s) return 0;
    *s = 0;
    // (the icon is inside the AppImage, gone once it closes: a copy in the data folder)
    char src[1100];
    bufs[3][0] = 0;
    if (rt_resource("icon.png", NULL, src, sizeof src)) {
        snprintf(bufs[3], 1200, "%s/steam-icon.png", rt_data_root());
        size_t n = 0;
        uint8_t *png = slurp(src, &n);
        FILE *f = png ? fopen(bufs[3], "wb") : NULL;
        if (f) fwrite(png, 1, n, f), fclose(f);
        else bufs[3][0] = 0;
        free(png);
    }
    snprintf(bufs[0], 1200, "\"%s\"", ai);
    snprintf(bufs[2], 1200, "\"%s/\"", dir);
    e[0] = (SteamEntry){"Savage Wind", bufs[0], bufs[2], bufs[3], "--game"};
    e[1] = (SteamEntry){"Savage Wind Configuration", bufs[0], bufs[2], bufs[3], "--config"};
#endif
    return 2;
}

// Each signed-in user's config/shortcuts.vdf, written. false: why.
static bool write_all(char roots[][1100], int nroots, const SteamEntry *e, int ne, int *users, char *why, size_t ws) {
    *users = 0;
    for (int r = 0; r < nroots; r++) {
        char ud[1200];
        snprintf(ud, sizeof ud, "%s/userdata", roots[r]);
        DIR *d = opendir(ud);
        if (!d) continue;
        struct dirent *de;
        while ((de = readdir(d))) {
            const char *id = de->d_name;
            bool digits = *id && strspn(id, "0123456789") == strlen(id);
            if (!digits || !strcmp(id, "0")) continue;
            char cfg[1300], file[1400], tmp[1450], bak[1450];
            snprintf(cfg, sizeof cfg, "%s/%s/config", ud, id);
            if (!exists(cfg)) continue;
            snprintf(file, sizeof file, "%s/shortcuts.vdf", cfg);
            snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.savagewind-tmp", file);
            snprintf(bak, sizeof bak, "%s.savagewind-backup", file);
            size_t n = 0;
            uint8_t *in = exists(file) ? slurp(file, &n) : NULL;
            if (exists(file) && !in) {
                closedir(d);
                snprintf(why, ws, "Steam's list of shortcuts couldn't be read (%s)", file);
                return false;
            }
            uint8_t *out = NULL;
            size_t on = 0;
            char w2[200] = "";
            bool ok = steam_vdf_upsert(in, n, e, ne, &out, &on, w2, sizeof w2);
            if (ok && steam_vdf_count(out, on) < 0) ok = false, snprintf(w2, sizeof w2, "the result didn't read back");
            if (ok) {
                FILE *f = fopen(tmp, "wb");
                ok = f && fwrite(out, 1, on, f) == on;
                if (f && fclose(f)) ok = false;
                if (ok && in) {
                    FILE *b = fopen(bak, "wb");
                    ok = b && fwrite(in, 1, n, b) == n;
                    if (b && fclose(b)) ok = false;
                }
#ifdef _WIN32
                if (ok) {
                    wchar_t wt[1450], wf[1450];
                    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, tmp, -1, wt, 1450);
                    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, file, -1, wf, 1450);
                    ok = MoveFileExW(wt, wf, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH);
                }
#else
                if (ok) ok = rename(tmp, file) == 0;
#endif
                if (!ok) {
                    remove(tmp);
                    snprintf(w2, sizeof w2, "it couldn't be written");
                }
            }
            free(in);
            free(out);
            if (!ok) {
                closedir(d);
                snprintf(why, ws, "Steam's list of shortcuts was left as it was: %s (%s)", w2, file);
                return false;
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "[steam] %s: Savage Wind entries written\n", file);
            ++*users;
        }
        closedir(d);
    }
    if (!*users) {
        snprintf(why, ws, "No Steam account was found on this computer. Open Steam and sign in once, then try again.");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool steam_add_savage_wind(char *msg, size_t ms) {
    char roots[4][1100];
    int nroots = steam_roots(roots, 4);
    if (!nroots) {
        snprintf(msg, ms, "Steam isn't installed on this computer.");
        return false;
    }
    if (getenv("SteamAppId") || getenv("SteamGameId")) {  // (closing Steam would close this window too)
        snprintf(msg, ms, "Savage Wind was started from Steam. Close it and open Savage Wind Configuration outside Steam to add it.");
        return false;
    }
#ifndef _WIN32
    const char *desk = getenv("XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP");
    if ((desk && strstr(desk, "gamescope")) || getenv("SteamGamepadUI") || getenv("GAMESCOPE_WAYLAND_DISPLAY")) {
        snprintf(msg, ms, "In Gaming Mode Steam can't be closed for a moment. Switch to Desktop Mode, then add it from there.");
        return false;
    }
#endif
    SteamEntry e[2];
    char bufs[4][1200];
    if (our_entries(e, bufs) != 2) {
        snprintf(msg, ms, "This copy of Savage Wind can't tell where it is installed.");
        return false;
    }
    bool test = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_STEAM_ROOT") != NULL;  // (a copy: the real Steam is left alone)
    bool was_running = steam_running();
    if (was_running) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[steam] closing Steam\n");
        for (int r = 0; !test && r < nroots; r++) run_steam(roots[r], "-shutdown", true);
        if (test) unsetenv_running();
        time_t t0 = time(NULL);
        while (steam_running() && time(NULL) - t0 < 60) {
#ifdef _WIN32
            Sleep(500);
#else
            usleep(500000);
#endif
        }
        if (steam_running()) {
            snprintf(msg, ms, "Steam didn't close. Close it yourself (Steam > Exit) and try again.");
            return false;
        }
#ifdef _WIN32
        Sleep(2000);  // (its last write of the file, after the process list says it's gone)
#else
        sleep(2);
#endif
    }
    int users = 0;
    char why[600];
    bool ok = write_all(roots, nroots, e, 2, &users, why, sizeof why);
    if (was_running && !test) run_steam(roots[0], "", false);
    if (!ok) {
        snprintf(msg, ms, "%s", why);
        return false;
    }
    snprintf(msg, ms, "Added to Steam: \"Savage Wind\" (straight into the game) and \"Savage Wind Configuration\".");
    return true;
}

#elif !defined(STEAM_VDF_ONLY)
bool steam_add_savage_wind(char *msg, size_t ms) {
    snprintf(msg, ms, "Not available here.");
    return false;
}
bool steam_supported(void) { return false; }
#endif
```

`runtime/steam_shortcuts.h`:

```h
// Savage Wind in the Steam library (runtime/steam_shortcuts.c): two non-Steam game entries, "Savage Wind" (straight
// into the game, --game) and "Savage Wind Configuration" (--config), written into each Steam user's shortcuts.vdf.
// Steam keeps that file in memory and writes it back when it closes, so Steam is closed first and started again after.
// Entries that are already there (by name) are pointed at this copy instead of added twice; nothing else is changed,
// and the file before is kept as shortcuts.vdf.savagewind-backup.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct {
    const char *name;     // AppName
    const char *exe;      // quoted, as Steam writes it
    const char *start_dir;
    const char *icon;
    const char *options;  // LaunchOptions
} SteamEntry;

// The new file for in (n bytes, 0: no file yet) with the entries added or updated. false: why says why (in is left
// as it was: a file this can't read is never written over). *out is malloc'd.
bool steam_vdf_upsert(const uint8_t *in, size_t n, const SteamEntry *e, int count, uint8_t **out, size_t *out_n,
                      char *why, size_t why_size);
// How many shortcuts a shortcuts.vdf holds, -1: not one this can read
int steam_vdf_count(const uint8_t *in, size_t n);
// The id Steam gives a non-Steam shortcut (what its artwork files are named after)
uint32_t steam_shortcut_appid(const char *exe, const char *name);

// Everything: find Steam, close it, write, start it again. Runs for a while (waits for Steam): call it on a thread.
// true: message says what was done; false: why not, for the player.
bool steam_add_savage_wind(char *message, size_t message_size);
bool steam_supported(void);  // a release that can add itself (the Windows folder or an AppImage)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

```

```h
#pragma once

// Native 1280x720 layout units, relative to the row's horizontal origin (screen x=640).
// Column x is its left edge. Future headers should use these same bounds.
struct BindingRowColumn {
    float x, width;
    constexpr float center() const { return x + width * .5f; }
};
struct BindingRowLayout {
    float label_right, label_width;
    BindingRowColumn key, pad;
    float text_inset, glow_extra;
};
constexpr BindingRowLayout binding_row_layout() {
    // Row band: x -300..300 (the native 540-wide plate, widened by 60 on the label side and the whole row re-centred:
    // the label box grew from 160 to 220, key and controller columns moved 30 right). Label right edge, text left-aligned.
    return {-70.f, 220.f, {-60.f, 170.f}, {128.f, 170.f}, 20.f, 56.f};
}

// The row plate (W_Base_02, natively 540 wide, centred on the row) lives in each button part. Only the key part keeps it.
// Widened to hold the longer label box; the row stays centred (x -300..300).
constexpr float binding_row_plate_width = 600.f;

// Uniform scale for the Key bindings column header text panes (overridable via SAVAGEWIND_HEADER_SCALE).
constexpr float binding_row_header_scale = 0.85f;

// Vertical offset of the header text from the header row's centre (layout units, negative = lower, closer to row 1).
constexpr float binding_row_header_y = -14.f;
```

```h
// The in-game console: a command line over the game (` or F12) that runs the control layer's commands
// (runtime/control.h), the player safe ones in a normal build, all of them in developer mode. The lines, history and
// completion are runtime/console_core.c; this draws it with ImGui and is wired into the overlay in menu.mm.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include "imgui.h"

bool console_is_open(void);   // any thread
void console_set_open(bool open);
// Once per frame on the render thread (also while closed: a reply that arrives after closing is kept for the next time).
void console_collect(void);
// In the ImGui frame, when open. mono: the fixed width font for the lines (columns of `help` line up).
void console_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale, ImFont *mono);
// Main thread: text a command asked to put on the clipboard (the caller frees it), false when there is none.
bool console_take_copy(char **text);
```
