`runtime/ui/console.mm`:

```mm
// The in-game console (runtime/ui/console.h).
#include "console.h"

#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <string>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

extern "C" {
#include "../console_core.h"
#include "../control.h"
}

static std::atomic<bool> g_open{false};
static std::atomic<bool> g_appearing{false};  // just opened: the field starts empty, the lines scroll to the end
static pthread_mutex_t g_copy_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static char *g_copy;  // a command's text for the clipboard, until the main thread takes it

bool console_is_open(void) { return g_open.load(); }
void console_set_open(bool open) {
    if (open && !g_open.load()) g_appearing.store(true);
    g_open.store(open);
}

bool console_take_copy(char **text) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_copy_lock);
    *text = g_copy;
    g_copy = NULL;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_copy_lock);
    return *text != NULL;
}

// (test) SAVAGEWIND_CONSOLE_TEST="help;version;report": opens the console and runs these commands, one every half
// second from about 30 s in, and echoes every line to stderr as "[console] ...", so a run without hands can be read.
static void test_hook(void) {
    static const char *list = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_CONSOLE_TEST");
    static int tick, next;
    if (!list || !*list) return;
    tick++;
    if (tick < 1800 || (tick - 1800) % 30) return;
    if (!console_is_open()) { console_set_open(true); return; }
    const char *c = list;
    for (int i = 0; i < next && c; i++) { c = strchr(c, ';'); if (c) c++; }
    if (!c || !*c) return;
    const char *end = strchr(c, ';');
    char line[256];
    snprintf(line, sizeof line, "%.*s", end ? (int)(end - c) : (int)strlen(c), c);
    next++;
    console_print(CON_INPUT, line);
    fprintf(stderr, "[console] > %s\n", line);
    if (!control_console_submit(line)) fprintf(stderr, "[console] not accepted: %s\n", line);
}

void console_collect(void) {
    test_hook();
    ControlConsoleResult r;
    while (control_console_poll(&r)) {
        if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_CONSOLE_TEST")) fprintf(stderr, "[console] %s%s\n", r.failed ? "(failed) " : "", r.text ? r.text : "");
        if (r.text && *r.text) console_print(r.failed ? CON_ERROR : CON_TEXT, r.text);
        else if (r.failed) console_print(CON_ERROR, "Failed");
        if (r.copy) {
            console_print(CON_NOTE, "Copied to the clipboard");
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_copy_lock);
            free(g_copy);
            g_copy = r.copy;
            r.copy = NULL;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_copy_lock);
        }
        control_console_free(&r);
    }
}

static int input_callback(ImGuiInputTextCallbackData *d) {
    auto replace = [&](const char *text) { d->DeleteChars(0, d->BufTextLen); d->InsertChars(0, text); };
    if (d->EventFlag == ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackHistory) {
        const char *t = console_history_step(d->EventKey == ImGuiKey_UpArrow ? -1 : 1, d->Buf);
        if (t) replace(t);
    } else if (d->EventFlag == ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackCompletion) {
        const char *names[128];
        int total = control_console_names("", names, 128), n = total < 128 ? total : 128;
        char out[256];
        int matches = console_complete(d->Buf, names, n, out, sizeof out);
        if (strcmp(out, d->Buf)) replace(out);
        else if (matches > 1) {  // nothing more to add: list what fits
            std::string list;
            size_t len = strlen(d->Buf);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                if (!strncmp(names[i], d->Buf, len)) list += std::string(list.empty() ? "" : "  ") + names[i];
            console_print(CON_NOTE, list.c_str());
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static void submit(const char *line) {
    while (*line == ' ') line++;
    if (!*line) return;
    char shown[320];
    snprintf(shown, sizeof shown, "> %s", line);
    console_print(CON_INPUT, shown);
    console_history_add(line);
    if (!strcmp(line, "clear") || !strcmp(line, "cls")) { console_clear(); return; }
    if (!control_console_submit(line)) console_print(CON_ERROR, "Command too long or queue full");
}

void console_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale, ImFont *mono) {
    static char buf[256];
    static unsigned seen;
    bool appearing = g_appearing.exchange(false);
    if (appearing) {
        buf[0] = 0;
        console_history_rewind();
        if (!console_line_count()) console_print(CON_NOTE, "Type help for the commands. Up/Down: history. Tab: complete. Ctrl+V: paste. clear: empty the console. ` or Esc: close.");
    }
    float w = io.DisplaySize.x, h = fminf(io.DisplaySize.y * 0.5f, 760 * scale);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(0, 0), ImGuiCond_Always);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, h), ImGuiCond_Always);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0.88f);
    ImGuiStyle &st = ImGui::GetStyle();
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 0);
    ImGui::Begin("##console", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus);
    if (mono) ImGui::PushFont(mono);
    float input_h = ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing();
    ImGui::BeginChild("##lines", ImVec2(0, -input_h), false, ImGuiWindowFlags_NavFlattened);
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
    for (int i = 0, n = console_line_count(); i < n; i++) {
        ConKind kind;
        const char *t = console_line(i, &kind);
        ImVec4 c = kind == CON_INPUT ? ImVec4(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1) : kind == CON_ERROR ? ImVec4(1.0f, 0.45f, 0.40f, 1)
                 : kind == CON_NOTE ? st.Colors[ImGuiCol_TextDisabled] : st.Colors[ImGuiCol_Text];
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, c);
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(*t ? t : " ");
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    }
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    if (console_revision() != seen || appearing) { ImGui::SetScrollHereY(1.0f); seen = console_revision(); }
    ImGui::EndChild();

    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
    ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
    ImGuiInputTextFlags flags = ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue | ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackHistory |
                                ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackCompletion;
    if (ImGui::InputText("##input", buf, sizeof buf, flags, input_callback)) {
        submit(buf);
        buf[0] = 0;
    }
    if (mono) ImGui::PopFont();
    ImGui::End();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
}
```

`runtime/ui/controls_ui.mm`:

```mm
// Control remapping editor (runtime/input_bind.h), shared by the in-game menu's Controls tab (menu.mm) and the start
// screen's Controls page (launcher.mm). First a table of the game's own actions (Jump, Attack...), each with a
// controller button and a key of its own: two actions can share one, and an action keeps the button of its Switch
// input until it is given a binding. Below it the inputs no action covers (sticks, camera, motion, menus), and, folded,
// the Switch buttons the actions follow. Select a binding, then press the new button / key (Esc or 5 s without a
// press cancels; a Switch input's button already in use swaps over). Drawn in whichever ImGui context is current.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "i18n.h"
#include "imgui.h"

extern "C" {
#include "../input_bind.h"
#include "../settings.h"
}
extern "C" bool control_enabled(void);  // runtime/control.c: is the test endpoint on (SAVAGEWIND_CONTROL)?

static void cell(int dev, int slot, int fam, int cap_dev, int cap_slot, int ms_left) {
    char lbl[96];
    bool waiting = cap_dev == dev && cap_slot == slot;
    if (waiting) snprintf(lbl, sizeof lbl, "%s  %d##%d_%d", tr(dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? "Press a button..." : "Press a key..."),
                          (ms_left + 999) / 1000, dev, slot);
    else snprintf(lbl, sizeof lbl, "%s##%d_%d", tr(dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? bind_pad_label(g_bind_pad[slot], fam) :
                                                    bind_key_label(g_bind_key[slot])), dev, slot);
    // changed from the default: gold text; the same button / key on two inputs (a hand-edited savagewind.ini): red
    const int16_t *t = dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_bind_pad : g_bind_key;
    int pushed = 0;
    bool dup = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < BIND_KEY_COUNT; i++)
        dup |= i != slot && (dev == BIND_DEV_KEY ? bind_key_same_context(i, slot) : bind_pad_slot(i)) && t[i] == t[slot] &&
               t[slot] > (dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? -1 : 0);
    if (waiting) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, ImVec4(0.55f, 0.42f, 0.12f, 1)); pushed++; }
    else if (dup) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, ImVec4(0.55f, 0.16f, 0.12f, 1)); pushed++; }
    if (!bind_is_default_slot(dev, slot)) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImVec4(0.98f, 0.82f, 0.38f, 1)); pushed++; }
    if (ImGui::Button(lbl, ImVec2(-FLT_MIN, 0))) {
        if (waiting) bind_capture_cancel();
        else bind_capture_begin(dev, slot);
    }
    ImGui::PopStyleColor(pushed);
    if (waiting && !ImGui::IsItemVisible()) ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);  // (a capture started by a test hook)
}

// ---- what a binding says: a Switch input, or an action (slot BIND_ACTION + id)
static void action_name(int id, char *out, size_t n) {
    if (act_name(id)) snprintf(out, n, "%s", tr(act_name(id)));
    else snprintf(out, n, tr("Action %d"), id);
}
static void slot_name(int slot, char *out, size_t n) {
    if (bind_slot_is_action(slot)) action_name(slot - BIND_ACTION, out, n);
    else snprintf(out, n, "%s", tr(bind_input_name(slot)));
}
static const char *host_name(int dev, int host, int fam) {
    return tr(dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? bind_pad_label(host, fam) : bind_key_label(host));
}
// what the slot is bound to now
static const char *slot_binding(int dev, int slot, int fam) {
    if (!bind_slot_is_action(slot)) return host_name(dev, dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_bind_pad[slot] : g_bind_key[slot], fam);
    const int h = dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_act_pad[slot - BIND_ACTION] : g_act_key[slot - BIND_ACTION];
    return h == ACT_NONE ? tr("Unbound") : h == ACT_FOLLOW ? tr("Default") : host_name(dev, h, fam);
}

// An action's cell: its own binding in gold, or (grey) the button of the Switch input the game reads for it, which
// is what it follows until it is given one. Right-click: back to that, or nothing.
static void action_cell(int dev, int id, int fam, int cap_dev, int cap_slot, int ms_left) {
    const int slot = BIND_ACTION + id;
    const int host = dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_act_pad[id] : g_act_key[id];
    const bool waiting = cap_dev == dev && cap_slot == slot;
    char lbl[96];
    if (waiting) snprintf(lbl, sizeof lbl, "%s  %d##a%d_%d", tr(dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? "Press a button..." : "Press a key..."),
                          (ms_left + 999) / 1000, dev, id);
    else if (host == ACT_FOLLOW) {
        const int b = act_switch_button(id);  // (-1 until the game has run: the start screen)
        snprintf(lbl, sizeof lbl, "%s##a%d_%d", b < 0 ? tr("Default") :
                 host_name(dev, dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_bind_pad[b] : g_bind_key[b], fam), dev, id);
    } else snprintf(lbl, sizeof lbl, "%s##a%d_%d", slot_binding(dev, slot, fam), dev, id);
    int pushed = 0;
    if (waiting) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, ImVec4(0.55f, 0.42f, 0.12f, 1)); pushed++; }
    if (host != ACT_FOLLOW) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImVec4(0.98f, 0.82f, 0.38f, 1)); pushed++; }
    else if (!waiting) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_TextDisabled)); pushed++; }
    if (ImGui::Button(lbl, ImVec2(-FLT_MIN, 0))) {
        if (waiting) bind_capture_cancel();
        else bind_capture_begin(dev, slot);
    }
    ImGui::PopStyleColor(pushed);
    if (ImGui::BeginPopupContextItem()) {
        if (ImGui::MenuItem(tr("Use default"), NULL, false, host != ACT_FOLLOW)) { act_set(dev, id, ACT_FOLLOW); settings_save(); }
        if (ImGui::MenuItem(tr("Unbind"), NULL, false, host != ACT_NONE)) { act_set(dev, id, ACT_NONE); settings_save(); }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
    if (waiting && !ImGui::IsItemVisible()) ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);
}

// The table of actions: every one the game asks about (the ones no code in the game reaches are left out)
static void action_table(const char *id, int fam, int cd, int cs, int ms) {
    if (!ImGui::BeginTable(id, 3, ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg | ImGuiTableFlags_SizingStretchProp | ImGuiTableFlags_PadOuterX)) return;
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn(tr("Action"), ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.0f);
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn(tr("Controller"), ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.3f);
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn(tr("Keyboard"), ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.3f);
    ImGui::TableHeadersRow();
    for (int a = 0; a < ACT_COUNT; a++) {
        if (act_hidden(a)) continue;
        char name[64];
        action_name(a, name, sizeof name);
        ImGui::TableNextRow();
        ImGui::TableNextColumn();
        ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(name);
        ImGui::TableNextColumn();
        action_cell(BIND_DEV_PAD, a, fam, cd, cs, ms);
        ImGui::TableNextColumn();
        action_cell(BIND_DEV_KEY, a, fam, cd, cs, ms);
    }
    ImGui::EndTable();
}

enum { FIXED_ESC = -1, FIXED_F2 = -2, FIXED_F1 = -3 };  // (rows of switch_table that are not a slot)

// Rows of Switch inputs: the controller button and the key bound to each
static void switch_table(const char *id, const int *order, int rows, int fam, int cd, int cs, int ms) {
    if (!ImGui::BeginTable(id, 3, ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg | ImGuiTableFlags_SizingStretchProp | ImGuiTableFlags_PadOuterX)) return;
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn(tr("Action"), ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.0f);
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn(tr("Controller"), ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.3f);
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn(tr("Keyboard"), ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.3f);
    ImGui::TableHeadersRow();
    for (int row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
        const int slot = order[row];
        ImGui::TableNextRow();
        ImGui::TableNextColumn();
        ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
        if (slot == FIXED_ESC || slot == FIXED_F2 || slot == FIXED_F1) {  // hard-wired: shown, never changed
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(tr(slot == FIXED_ESC ? "Pause menu / back" : slot == FIXED_F2 ? "Free mouse cursor" :
                                                                                                    "Savage Wind menu"));
            ImGui::TableNextColumn();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", slot == FIXED_F1 ? tr(bind_pad_label(5 /* guide */, fam)) : "-");
            ImGui::TableNextColumn();
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", tr(bind_key_label(slot == FIXED_ESC ? SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE :
                                                        slot == FIXED_F2 ? SDL_SCANCODE_F2 : SDL_SCANCODE_F1)));
            continue;
        }
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(tr(bind_input_name(slot)));
        ImGui::TableNextColumn();
        if (bind_pad_slot(slot)) cell(BIND_DEV_PAD, slot, fam, cd, cs, ms);
        else ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", tr(slot == BIND_WALK ? "Tilt the stick" : slot == BIND_TILT ? "Motion sensors" :
                                          bind_key_gyro(slot) ? "Motion sensors" : slot < BIND_RS_UP ? "Left stick" : "Right stick"));
        ImGui::TableNextColumn();
        cell(BIND_DEV_KEY, slot, fam, cd, cs, ms);
    }
    ImGui::EndTable();
}

extern "C" void controls_bindings_draw(float scale) {
    (void)scale;
    int fam = bind_label_family();
    static const char *const fam_name[] = {"Nintendo", "Xbox", "PlayStation", "Steam Deck"};
    int n = 0;
    SDL_JoystickID *ids = SDL_GetGamepads(&n);
    const char *pad_name = ids && n > 0 ? SDL_GetGamepadNameForID(ids[0]) : NULL;
    char line[300];
    if (n > 0) snprintf(line, sizeof line, tr("Controller: %s  (%s button names)"), pad_name ? pad_name : tr("connected"), fam_name[fam % 4]);
    else snprintf(line, sizeof line, tr("No controller connected  (%s button names shown)"), fam_name[fam % 4]);
    SDL_free(ids);
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(line);
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", tr("Select a binding, then press the new button or key. Esc (or 5 seconds) cancels. A button "
                                 "that's already in use swaps with the old one."));
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();

    int cd, cs, ms;
    bind_capture_active(&cd, &cs, &ms);
    // a finished capture: say what happened, keep savagewind.ini current
    static int seen_serial = -1;
    static char msg[400];
    int rdev, rslot, rother, serial;
    int kind = bind_last_result(&rdev, &rslot, &rother, &serial);
    if (seen_serial < 0) seen_serial = serial;
    if (serial != seen_serial) {
        seen_serial = serial;
        const char *now = rslot < 0 ? "" : slot_binding(rdev, rslot, fam);
        char name[64] = "", other[64] = "";
        if (rslot >= 0) slot_name(rslot, name, sizeof name);
        if (rother >= 0) slot_name(rother, other, sizeof other);
        if (kind == 5)
            snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "%s", tr(rdev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? "Controller bindings reset to the defaults."
                                                                     : "Keyboard bindings reset to the defaults."));
        else if (kind == 1) snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, tr("%s is now %s."), name, now);
        else if (kind == 2)
            snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, tr("%s is now %s; %s moved to %s (swapped)."), name, now, other,
                     slot_binding(rdev, rother, fam));
        else if (kind == 3) snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, tr("Cancelled: %s unchanged."), name);
        else if (kind == 4) snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, tr("Nothing pressed: %s unchanged."), name);
        else if (kind == 6) snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "%s", tr("A and B swapped, with the actions on them."));
        if (kind == 1 || kind == 2 || kind == 5 || kind == 6) settings_save();
    }
    if (msg[0]) ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1), "%s", msg);

    // the page: the game's actions first (they follow the Switch inputs below until given a binding of their own)
    action_table("##actions", fam, cd, cs, ms);
    bool all_default = true;
    for (int a = 0; a < ACT_COUNT; a++) all_default &= act_is_default(a);
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(all_default);
    if (ImGui::Button(tr("Reset actions to defaults"))) { bind_capture_cancel(); act_reset(); settings_save(); }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();

    // what no action covers: the game's menus and quick menus, then movement, camera and motion. Raw Switch buttons are
    // never listed by their name, only by what they do.
    ImGui::SeparatorText(tr("Menus"));
    static const int menus[] = {BIND_PLUS, BIND_MINUS, BIND_UP, BIND_LEFT, BIND_RIGHT, BIND_A, BIND_B, BIND_X, BIND_Y,
                                BIND_L, BIND_R, BIND_ZL, BIND_ZR, BIND_RSTICK, FIXED_ESC, FIXED_F2, FIXED_F1};
    switch_table("##binds_menus", menus, (int)(sizeof menus / sizeof *menus), fam, cd, cs, ms);
    ImGui::SeparatorText(tr("Movement, camera and motion"));
    static const int other[] = {BIND_LS_UP, BIND_LS_DOWN, BIND_LS_LEFT, BIND_LS_RIGHT, BIND_RS_UP, BIND_RS_DOWN,
                                BIND_RS_LEFT, BIND_RS_RIGHT, BIND_WALK, BIND_TILT, BIND_GYRO_UP, BIND_GYRO_DOWN,
                                BIND_GYRO_LEFT, BIND_GYRO_RIGHT, BIND_GYRO_TURN_LEFT, BIND_GYRO_TURN_RIGHT,
                                BIND_GYRO_CENTER, BIND_FLY};
    const int other_rows = (int)(sizeof other / sizeof *other) - (control_enabled() ? 0 : 1);  // (the fly row: test builds only)
    switch_table("##binds_other", other, other_rows, fam, cd, cs, ms);

    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(bind_is_default(BIND_DEV_PAD));
    if (ImGui::Button(tr("Reset controller to defaults"))) { bind_capture_cancel(); bind_reset(BIND_DEV_PAD); }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(bind_is_default(BIND_DEV_KEY));
    if (ImGui::Button(tr("Reset keyboard to defaults"))) { bind_capture_cancel(); bind_reset(BIND_DEV_KEY); }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    // the Xbox convention (confirm on the bottom button) in one click, and back again
    if (ImGui::Button(tr("Swap A and B (Xbox: A confirms)"))) { bind_capture_cancel(); bind_swap_ab(); }

    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", tr("Bindings apply to the game only. Esc and F1 always open the in-game menu, and so do the "
                                 "controller's Back + Start held together or its Home / Guide button, so this page can't "
                                 "be locked out. The game's button icons follow the controller bindings."));
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
}
```

`runtime/ui/file_size_cache.h`:

```h
// One lazy size calculation shared by the launcher's pages. Public methods run on the UI thread.
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <string>

class FileSizeCache {
public:
    enum class State { Pending, Ready, Unavailable };
    struct Value { State state = State::Pending; unsigned long long bytes = 0; };
    ~FileSizeCache();
    void reset(const std::string &root);
    void invalidate();
    void set_suspended(bool suspended);
    Value get();
    void stop();
    FileSizeCache() = default;
    FileSizeCache(const FileSizeCache &) = delete;
    FileSizeCache &operator=(const FileSizeCache &) = delete;
private:
    pthread_mutex_t lock_ = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
    pthread_cond_t changed_ = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
    pthread_t thread_{};
    std::atomic<unsigned long long> generation_{0};
    std::string root_;
    Value value_;
    bool started_ = false, stopping_ = false, suspended_ = false, wanted_ = false, queued_ = false;
    void invalidate_locked();
    static void *run(void *);
    struct Attempt { FileSizeCache *cache; unsigned long long generation; };
    static bool cancelled(void *);
};

```

`runtime/ui/file_size_cache.mm`:

```mm
#include "file_size_cache.h"
#include "game_file_size.h"
#include <stdio.h>

FileSizeCache::~FileSizeCache() {
    stop();
    pthread_cond_destroy(&changed_);
    pthread_mutex_destroy(&lock_);
}

void FileSizeCache::invalidate_locked() {
    ++generation_;
    value_ = {};
    wanted_ = queued_ = false;
}

void FileSizeCache::reset(const std::string &root) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock_);
    root_ = root;
    suspended_ = false;
    invalidate_locked();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock_);
}

void FileSizeCache::invalidate() {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock_);
    invalidate_locked();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock_);
}

void FileSizeCache::set_suspended(bool suspended) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock_);
    if (suspended != suspended_) { suspended_ = suspended; invalidate_locked(); }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock_);
}

FileSizeCache::Value FileSizeCache::get() {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock_);
    if (!suspended_ && !wanted_) {
        wanted_ = true;
        if (!started_) {
            int error = pthread_create(&thread_, NULL, run, this);
            if (error) {
                value_.state = State::Unavailable;
                fprintf(stderr, "[launcher] size worker could not start (%d)\n", error);
            } else started_ = true;
        }
        if (started_) { queued_ = true; pthread_cond_signal(&changed_); }
    }
    Value value = value_;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock_);
    return value;
}

bool FileSizeCache::cancelled(void *data) {
    Attempt *attempt = static_cast<Attempt *>(data);
    return attempt->cache->generation_.load() != attempt->generation;
}

void *FileSizeCache::run(void *data) {
    FileSizeCache *cache = static_cast<FileSizeCache *>(data);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&cache->lock_);
    while (!cache->stopping_) {
        while (!cache->queued_ && !cache->stopping_) pthread_cond_wait(&cache->changed_, &cache->lock_);
        if (cache->stopping_) break;
        std::string root = cache->root_;
        Attempt attempt{cache, cache->generation_.load()};
        cache->queued_ = false;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&cache->lock_);
        RtGameFilesSize result = rt_game_files_size_scan(root.c_str(), cancelled, &attempt);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&cache->lock_);
        if (!cancelled(&attempt) && !cache->stopping_) {
            cache->value_ = {result.complete && !result.cancelled ? State::Ready : State::Unavailable, result.bytes};
            if (!result.complete && !result.cancelled) fprintf(stderr, "[launcher] game-file size is incomplete; no total shown\n");
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&cache->lock_);
    return NULL;
}

void FileSizeCache::stop() {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock_);
    stopping_ = true;
    invalidate_locked();
    pthread_cond_signal(&changed_);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock_);
    if (started_) pthread_join(thread_, NULL);
    started_ = stopping_ = false;
}
```

`runtime/ui/game_options.mm`:

```mm
// Savage Wind's settings as pages of the game's own Options screen (pause menu > System > Options): the game draws
// them, with its font, sounds and cursor. The first page has one button per section (Gameplay: the game's own
// options; Video, Audio, Controls: the game's camera options and the mouse; Keyboard, Controller, Language;
// Accessibility: assists) and a Quit button; A on a section shows its page, B goes back. The screen opens from the
// pause menu (System > Options) and from the title screen menu (Options); this replaces the overlay menu in game
// (menu.mm). Quit (here, and in place of the title menu's amiibo settings) asks with the game's own dialog: desktop or
// the Savage Wind start screen.
//
// The game side (tools/patches.py): the screen builds one row per entry of a static option table each time it opens
// (g_site.opt_table: its count, entries, row count and row order; 1.8.2 0x7001cccd98..0x7001cccdb0). The
// first time it opens, the table is pointed at a copy with this file's entries after the game's 14; each opening then
// gets the row order of the page asked for. Rows of these entries have their value, texts and A handled here. A page
// change closes the screen; the title menu's update (rt_opt_title_tick) or the pause System page's Options state
// (rt_opt_pause_tick) opens it again.
//
// Threads: every hook runs on the game's thread, inside the screen's own functions.
#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "i18n.h"
#include "binding_row_layout.h"

extern "C" {
#include "../input_bind.h"
#include "../language.h"
#include "../game_sites.h"
#include "../nvn/output_scale.h"
#include "../problem_report.h"
#include "../motion.h"
#include "../settings.h"
#include "../gamelib.h"
#include "../color_grade.h"
#include "../dlss_fetch.h"
#include "../pc_cursor.h"
#include "../window_size.h"
void guest_call(Cpu *, uint64_t);
Cpu *kernel_current_cpu(void);
void rt_request_reboot(int kind);           // runtime/main.c (1: start the game again)
void menu_request_window_apply(void);       // menu.mm (fullscreen / window size, applied by the window loop)
void menu_size_list_open(void);             // menu.mm (Window size's list, over the screen)
bool menu_size_list_up(void);
bool renderer_gpu_rtx(void);                // vulkan/device.c, metal.m
const char *vk_hdr_icc_description(void);   // runtime/nvn/vulkan/device.c
}

// ---- guest memory (main is mapped at its runtime address: plain pointers)
uint32_t rd32(uint64_t a) { return *(volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)a; }
uint64_t rd64(uint64_t a) { return *(volatile uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)a; }
void wr8(uint64_t a, uint8_t v) { *(volatile uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)a = v; }
void wr32(uint64_t a, uint32_t v) { *(volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)a = v; }
void wr64(uint64_t a, uint64_t v) { *(volatile uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)a = v; }

#define OPT_COUNT (g_site.opt_table)

#define OPT_ORDER (g_site.opt_table + 0x18)

// the game's entries (game data flag names): 1 CameraUpDownReverse, 2 CameraRLReverse, 4 GyroOnOff (motion aiming),
// 7 StickSensitivity, 9 AmiiboItemOnOff, 11 / 12 VoiceLanguage (a button or a level, one per platform),
// 13 DisplaySpecialMode (Toy-Con VR Goggles)
const uint32_t GAME_CAMERA_Y = 1, GAME_CAMERA_X = 2, GAME_GYRO = 4, GAME_CAMERA_SENSITIVITY = 7, GAME_AMIIBO = 9,
               GAME_VOICE_BUTTON = 11, GAME_VOICE_LEVEL = 12, GAME_VR = 13;
const uint32_t MSG_BASE = 9000;  // this file's message ids: MSG_BASE + item * 256 + part (the game's are 0000-0100)
enum { MSG_TITLE = 0, MSG_DESC = 1, MSG_BUTTON = 2, MSG_KEY = 3, MSG_PAD = 4, MSG_VALUE = 16 };
enum { MSG_TITLE_QUIT = 1, MSG_QUIT_QUESTION, MSG_QUIT_DESKTOP, MSG_QUIT_START };  // (storage ids below MSG_BASE)

// Row object (0x98 bytes, FUN_7100d1d828): +0x00 screen, +0x50 entry, +0x54 on/off, +0x58 value, +0x5c max,
// +0x60 min, +0x64 button state, +0x68 flag type
struct Entry {           // the game's option entry (0x30)
    uint64_t name_vtbl;  // sead::SafeString: the game data flag name
    uint64_t name;
    uint32_t kind;       // KIND_*
    uint32_t desc, title, first_value, last_value, button_off, button_on, pad;
};
static_assert(sizeof(Entry) == 0x30);
enum { KIND_TOGGLE = 0, KIND_CHOICE = 1, KIND_BUTTON = 2 };

enum Page { P_MAIN, P_GAMEPLAY, P_VIDEO, P_COLOUR, P_AUDIO, P_CONTROLS, P_BINDS, P_LANGUAGE, P_ACCESS, P_VIDEO_ADV, P_HDR, P_COUNT };
// A_FIXED: a greyed row for an input that can never be rebound (Item.arg: 0 Esc, 1 F2); A_BIND: Item.arg is a binding slot (an input, or BIND_ACTION + an action); the next key, mouse button or controller button binds it
enum Action { A_NONE, A_PAGE, A_BIND, A_BINDS_HEADER, A_RESET_BINDS, A_RESTART, A_QUIT, A_SIZE_LIST, A_FIXED, A_REPORT, A_SAVE_HDR_LOOK };
static char g_report_dir[64];  // Problem report: the zip made this run (its row's description names it)

struct Item {
    int page;
    int kind;
    const char *title, *desc;
    const char *button;                          // KIND_BUTTON: its text (NULL: label(item, -1))
    int (*count)(const Item &);                  // KIND_CHOICE: number of values
    const char *(*label)(const Item &, int v);   // KIND_CHOICE: value v's text
    int (*get)(const Item &);
    void (*set)(const Item &, int v);
    int def;                                     // the default value ("reset to defaults")
    int action, arg;                             // KIND_BUTTON (arg: also a choice's own number)
    const char *(*desc_fn)(const Item &);        // a description made when shown (NULL: desc)
    void (*reset)(const Item &);                 // "reset to defaults" when it isn't set(def)
    bool (*value_off)(const Item &, int v);      // KIND_CHOICE: value v can't be picked yet (shown greyed)
    bool wrap;                                   // KIND_CHOICE: a step past either end goes to the other one
};

std::vector<Item> g_items;
std::vector<Entry> g_entries;
std::vector<uint32_t> g_order[P_COUNT];
std::vector<std::string> g_names;  // the entries' flag names (never a real game data flag)
uint64_t g_installed;              // address of g_entries while the game uses it
int g_cur_page = P_MAIN, g_next_page = P_MAIN;
bool g_reopen;                     // a page change closed the screen: open it again once it has gone
bool g_switching;                  // ... and its next opening shows g_next_page (any other opening: the first page)
uint64_t g_quit_dialog;            // the quit question's dialog while it is up
uint64_t g_quit_owner;             // ... and the screen it came from (title menu or Options; its input is off meanwhile)
bool g_quit_texts;                 // ... and its texts are still to be given (its two-button layout comes next)
uint64_t g_cap_row;                // a binding row whose capture is running
int cap_slot_was = -1;             // ... and its slot (for the redraw once it has ended)
uint64_t g_size_row;               // the Window size row whose list was opened
std::atomic<bool> g_size_redraw;   // ... and a size was picked there (render thread): redraw it
std::vector<uint64_t> g_dirty;     // rows to redraw, one per frame
std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point g_hold_until;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::u16string> g_text;

int nearest(const int *v, int n, float x) {
    int best = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)
        if (fabsf(v[i] - x) < fabsf(v[best] - x)) best = i;
    return best;
}

std::string pct(int v) { return std::to_string(v) + "%"; }

Item toggle(int page, const char *title, const char *desc, int (*get)(const Item &), void (*set)(const Item &, int),
            int def) {
    Item it = {};
    it.page = page, it.kind = KIND_TOGGLE, it.title = title, it.desc = desc, it.get = get, it.set = set, it.def = def;
    return it;
}

Item choice(int page, const char *title, const char *desc, int (*count)(const Item &),
            const char *(*label)(const Item &, int), int (*get)(const Item &), void (*set)(const Item &, int), int def) {
    Item it = toggle(page, title, desc, get, set, def);
    it.kind = KIND_CHOICE, it.count = count, it.label = label;
    return it;
}

// KIND_CHOICE: the values the game's row has. A wrapping choice has two more, 0 and count + 1, one past each end:
// stepping onto one stores the value at the other end (value v is the game's v + 1)
int game_count(const Item &it) { return it.kind != KIND_CHOICE ? 2 : it.count(it) + (it.wrap ? 2 : 0); }
int game_value(const Item &it, int g) {
    int n = it.count(it);
    return it.wrap ? (g - 1 + n) % n : g;
}

Item button(int page, const char *title, const char *desc, const char *text, int action, int arg) {
    Item it = {};
    it.page = page, it.kind = KIND_BUTTON, it.title = title, it.desc = desc, it.button = text, it.action = action;
    it.arg = arg;
    return it;
}

// Window size: the sizes offered now (runtime/window_size.c; fullscreen can offer more)
int winsize_items(WinSize *list) { return winsize_list(list, g_settings.fullscreen); }
int winsize_index(WinSize s) {
    WinSize list[WINSIZE_MAX];
    int n = winsize_items(list);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (list[i].w == s.w && list[i].h == s.h) return i;
    return 0;
}

// A value that can't be picked yet: its name and why ("(coming soon)")
const char *soon(const char *name, const char *why = "(coming soon)") {
    static std::string s[8];
    static int i;
    std::string &o = s[i++ & 7];
    o = std::string(tr(name)) + " " + tr(why);
    return o.c_str();
}

const char *ups_label(const Item &, int x) {
    int u = k_ups_value[x];
    if (u == UPSCALE_OFF) return tr("Off");
    if (u == UPSCALE_METALFX) return tr("MetalFX");
    if (u == UPSCALE_FSR1) return tr("AMD FSR 1");
    if (u == UPSCALE_FSR3) return upscaler_available(u) ? tr("AMD FSR 3") : soon("FSR 3");
    if (u == UPSCALE_FSR4)
        return upscaler_available(u) ? tr("AMD FSR 4") : soon("FSR 4", fsr4_offered() ? "(coming soon)" : "(AMD Radeon only)");
    if (upscaler_available(UPSCALE_DLSS)) {
        static std::string available;
        available = tr("DLSS");
        return available.c_str();
    }
    return soon("DLSS", dlss_fetch_missing() ? "(download it in Savage Wind Configuration)" : "(NVIDIA RTX only)");
}

const char *fps_label(const Item &, int x) {
    static char buf[32];
    if (x == fps_count()) return tr("Match display");  // (settings fps_display)
    if (!fps_at(x)) return tr("Off");
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, tr("%d FPS"), fps_at(x));
    return buf;
}

// What a slot is bound to on the keyboard / mouse and on the controller. An action without a binding of its own shows
// the button its Switch input has (what it follows).
const char *slot_key_text(int slot) {
    if (bind_slot_is_action(slot)) {
        int h = g_act_key[slot - BIND_ACTION];
        if (h == ACT_FOLLOW) {
            int b = act_switch_button(slot - BIND_ACTION);
            h = b < 0 ? ACT_NONE : g_bind_key[b];
        }
        return h == ACT_NONE ? tr("Unbound") : tr(bind_key_label(h));
    }
    return tr(bind_key_label(g_bind_key[slot]));
}
const char *slot_pad_text(int slot) {
    if (bind_slot_is_action(slot)) {
        int h = g_act_pad[slot - BIND_ACTION];
        if (h == ACT_FOLLOW) {
            int b = act_switch_button(slot - BIND_ACTION);
            h = b < 0 ? ACT_NONE : g_bind_pad[b];
        }
        return h == ACT_NONE ? tr("Unbound") : tr(bind_pad_label(h, bind_label_family()));
    }
    return tr(bind_pad_label(g_bind_pad[slot], bind_label_family()));
}
bool slot_has_pad(int slot) { return bind_slot_is_action(slot) || bind_pad_slot(slot); }

const char *bind_label(const Item &it, int) {
    static char buf[160];
    int dev, slot, ms;
    if (bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && slot == it.arg)
        return tr(slot_has_pad(slot) ? "Press a key or button..." : "Press a key...");
    if (slot_has_pad(it.arg)) snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s  |  %s", slot_key_text(it.arg), slot_pad_text(it.arg));
    else snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", slot_key_text(it.arg));
    return buf;
}

void build_items(void) {
    std::vector<Item> &v = g_items;
    // first page: the sections (the game's own options are on Gameplay and Controls)
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Gameplay", "Mini-map, HUD, jump button and more.", "Open", A_PAGE, P_GAMEPLAY));
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Video", "Screen, resolution and image quality.", "Open", A_PAGE, P_VIDEO));
#ifndef __APPLE__
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Colour", "Presets, exposure, contrast, saturation and LUTs.", "Open", A_PAGE, P_COLOUR));
#endif
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Audio", "Volume and sound effects.", "Open", A_PAGE, P_AUDIO));
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Controls", "Camera, motion, d-pad, mouse and button icons.", "Open", A_PAGE, P_CONTROLS));
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Key bindings", "Which key, mouse button or controller button does what.", "Open", A_PAGE, P_BINDS));
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Language", "Language of the texts and of the voices.", "Open", A_PAGE, P_LANGUAGE));
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Accessibility", "Colour vision, and assists that make the game easier.", "Open", A_PAGE,
                       P_ACCESS));
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Problem report",
                       "A zip file to attach to a bug report: the log of the last two runs, your settings and a short "
                       "system summary. No game files and no saves.",
                       "Make", A_REPORT, 0));
    v.back().desc_fn = [](const Item &it) {
        static char buf[256];
        if (!g_report_dir[0]) return it.desc;
        snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, tr("Made %s in the data folder. Attach this file to your report."), g_report_dir);
        return (const char *)buf;
    };
    v.push_back(button(P_MAIN, "Quit game", "To the desktop, or back to the Savage Wind start screen.", "Quit",
                       A_QUIT, 0));

    // Video (fullscreen and the window size are applied by the window loop: menu.mm)
    // Graphics preset (settings.c k_gpreset): sets rows of the Advanced page; "Custom"
    // (settings matching no preset) is shown, never picked
    Item gp = choice(P_VIDEO, "Graphics preset", "Potato: for weak PCs. Original: as on the console. High and Savage: further and sharper.",
                     [](const Item &) { return graphics_preset_count() + 1; },
                     [](const Item &, int x) { return tr(x < graphics_preset_count() ? g_gpreset_names[x] : "Custom"); },
                     [](const Item &) {
                         int p = graphics_preset_current();
                         return p < 0 ? graphics_preset_count() : p;
                     },
                     [](const Item &, int x) { graphics_preset_apply(x); }, GPRESET_ORIGINAL);
    gp.value_off = [](const Item &, int x) { return x >= graphics_preset_count(); };
    v.push_back(gp);
    v.push_back(button(P_VIDEO, "Advanced options", "Draw distance, upscaler, anti-aliasing, shadows, bloom and more.", "Open", A_PAGE, P_VIDEO_ADV));
    v.push_back(toggle(P_VIDEO, "Fullscreen", "Fills the screen. Also F11 or Alt+Enter.",
                       [](const Item &) { return (int)g_settings.fullscreen; },
                       [](const Item &, int x) { g_settings.fullscreen = x; menu_request_window_apply(); }, 0));
    // Fullscreen mode (settings.h FSMODE_*; runtime/window_size.c winsize_apply)
    v.push_back(choice(P_VIDEO, "Fullscreen mode", "Borderless never switches the display. Exclusive always does.",
                       [](const Item &) { return (int)FSMODE_COUNT; },
                       [](const Item &, int x) { return tr(k_fsmode[x]); },
                       [](const Item &) { return g_settings.fullscreen_mode; },
                       [](const Item &, int x) {
                           g_settings.fullscreen_mode = x;
                           if (g_settings.fullscreen) menu_request_window_apply();
                       }, FSMODE_AUTO));
    // Monitor: Automatic, then the displays connected (runtime/window_size.c; listed again at each opening)
    Item disp = choice(P_VIDEO, "Monitor", "The monitor the game is shown on. Automatic: where the window is.",
                       [](const Item &) {
                           WinDisplay ds[WINDISPLAY_MAX];
                           return windisplay_list(ds) + 1;
                       },
                       [](const Item &, int x) {
                           static char buf[4][96];
                           static int k;
                           char *b = buf[k++ & 3];
                           WinDisplay ds[WINDISPLAY_MAX];
                           int n = windisplay_list(ds);
                           if (x < 1 || x > n) return tr("Automatic");
                           snprintf(b, sizeof buf[0], "%d: %s", x, ds[x - 1].name);  // (short: the row is narrow)

                           if (g_settings.upscaler == UPSCALE_OFF) return 0;
                           int base = upscale_mode_base();
                           int q = (g_settings.upscale_quality == UPQ_NATIVE && base)
                                       ? (int)UPQ_QUALITY
                                       : g_settings.upscale_quality;
                           for (int i = base; i < N(k_modes_order); i++)
                               if (k_modes_order[i] == q) return i - base;
                           return 0;
                       },
                       [](const Item &, int x) {
                           if (g_settings.upscaler != UPSCALE_OFF)
                               g_settings.upscale_quality = k_modes_order[x + upscale_mode_base()];
                       },
                       2);
    mode.value_off = [](const Item &, int x) {
        return !upscale_modes_available() || g_settings.upscaler == UPSCALE_OFF ||
               !upscale_mode_offered(k_modes_order[x + upscale_mode_base()]);
    };
    mode.reset = [](const Item &) { g_settings.upscale_quality = UPQ_QUALITY; };  // (also while Off)
    mode.desc_fn = [](const Item &) {
        // (one line: the game's description pane is one English line wide)
        return !upscale_modes_available()           ? tr("Renders smaller, then upscales. Coming in a later version.")
               : g_settings.upscaler == UPSCALE_OFF ? tr("Only with an upscaler: choose one above first.")
                                                    : tr("Ultra Quality is the sharpest, Ultra Performance the fastest.");
    };

    v.push_back(toggle(P_CONTROLS, "Lean to turn",
                       "Tilting the controller left or right, like a steering wheel, also turns the aim.",

    v.push_back(choice(P_CONTROLS, "Motion source", "Where motion aiming and shrine tilting come from.",

    v.back().desc_fn = [](const Item &) {  // (read when the cursor comes to the row)
        static char buf[384];

        motion_status(&st);
        const char *from = st.source == MOTION_FROM_DSU      ? tr("a DSU server")
                           : st.source == MOTION_FROM_DECK   ? tr("the Steam Deck's controller")

        if (st.source != MOTION_FROM_NONE)
            snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, tr("Now from %s, %d readings a second."), from, (int)lroundf(st.rate));

        else snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", tr("No motion sensors. Shrines tilt with the keys or the mouse."));

    v.push_back(choice(P_CONTROLS, "Button icons",

    v.push_back(choice(P_CONTROLS, "HUD button layout",
                       "Where the four face buttons sit on the HUD diamond, from the next start. Automatic: follows your bindings.",
                       [](const Item &) { return N(k_button_layout); },

    // Key bindings: one row per action (key | controller button), then the inputs no action covers. A waits for the
    // next press: a key or mouse button binds the keyboard side, a controller button the controller side
    v.push_back(button(P_BINDS, "", "Press A, then the new key or button. Esc cancels.", "", A_BINDS_HEADER, 0));
    auto bind = [&](int slot, const char *title) {

        it.label = bind_label;
        if (!slot_has_pad(slot)) it.desc = "Press A, then the new key. Esc cancels.";
        v.push_back(it);
    };
    for (int id = 0; id < ACT_COUNT; id++)
        if (!act_hidden(id) && act_name(id)) bind(BIND_ACTION + id, act_name(id));
    // the game's menus: what the Switch buttons do outside the actions, listed by function (never by button name)
    for (int sl : {BIND_PLUS, BIND_MINUS, BIND_UP, BIND_LEFT, BIND_RIGHT, BIND_A, BIND_B, BIND_X, BIND_Y, BIND_L, BIND_R,
                   BIND_ZL, BIND_ZR, BIND_RSTICK})
        bind(sl, bind_input_name(sl));
    // Esc and F2 are hard-wired (the game can always be paused, the cursor freed): shown greyed, never rebound
    v.push_back(button(P_BINDS, "Pause menu / back", "Fixed: this key always works.", "", A_FIXED, 0));
    v.push_back(button(P_BINDS, "Free mouse cursor", "Fixed: this key frees the mouse cursor.", "", A_FIXED, 1));
    for (int sl = BIND_LS_UP; sl <= BIND_RS_RIGHT; sl++) bind(sl, bind_input_name(sl));
    bind(BIND_WALK, bind_input_name(BIND_WALK));
    bind(BIND_TILT, bind_input_name(BIND_TILT));
    v.back().desc = "Hold it and move the mouse to tilt the controller. Press A, then the new key.";
    static const char *const gyro_help[] = {"Tilt upward.", "Tilt downward.", "Tilt left.", "Tilt right.",
                                            "Rotate left on the third axis.", "Rotate right on the third axis.",
                                            "Reset orientation and stop pending rotation."};
    for (int sl = BIND_GYRO_UP; sl <= BIND_GYRO_CENTER; sl++) {  // (the virtual gyro at a shrine apparatus)
        bind(sl, bind_input_name(sl));
        v.back().desc = gyro_help[sl - BIND_GYRO_UP];
    }
    v.push_back(button(P_BINDS, "Reset all bindings", "Every key and button back to its default.", "Reset", A_RESET_BINDS, 0));

    // Language
    v.push_back(choice(P_LANGUAGE, "Text", "Texts and menus. Applies after a restart.",
                       [](const Item &) { return language_text_count(); },  // (Thai: 1.9.0 on)

                       [](const Item &) { return language_text_index(); },

    v.push_back(choice(P_LANGUAGE, "Voices", "The characters' voices. Applies after a restart.",

    v.push_back(choice(P_ACCESS, "Colour vision", k_cvd_desc[0], [](const Item &) { return COLOUR_VISION_COUNT; },

    v.push_back(choice(P_ACCESS, "Correction strength",

                       },
```
