```mm
// Reboot (runtime/main.c): the game is gone - menu and name dialog close; the ImGui context stays.
RT_ON_RESET(menu_reset) {
    set_open(false);
    g_kbd = 0;
    osk_cancel();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&q_lock);
    q_events.clear();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&q_lock);
}

// Performance overlay (F10), in the style of MangoHud: the game's frame rate and frame times, and the machine's load
// and temperatures (runtime/perfmon.c). Numbers the platform doesn't give read "-".
static void perf_cell(const char *fmt, float v) {
    ImGui::TableNextColumn();
    if (v < 0) ImGui::TextDisabled("-");
    else ImGui::Text(fmt, v);
}
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ photo mode (hle/freecam.c, hle/photo.c)
// While the free camera is on: a strip at the bottom with its keys (or the controller's). A picture saved: a notice
// with a thumbnail in the bottom-right corner for a few seconds. Neither is in the picture (that is the game image).
extern "C" bool freecam_active(void);
extern "C" int photo_saved_seq(const char **path);
static void photo_overlay_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale) {
    ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetForegroundDrawList();
    if (freecam_active()) {
        const char *keys = input_last_device() == DEVICE_PAD
            ? tr("Both stick clicks: exit   Left stick: move   ZR / ZL: up, down   D-pad up: filter   D-pad left / right: hour   D-pad down: picture")
            : tr("Home: exit   W A S D: move   E / Q: up, down   Shift / Ctrl: faster, slower   F8: filter   [ ]: hour   F7: picture");
        float fs = ImGui::GetFontSize() * 0.8f;
        ImVec2 ts = ImGui::GetFont()->CalcTextSizeA(fs, FLT_MAX, 0, keys);
        float pad = 10 * scale, y = io.DisplaySize.y - ts.y - 3 * pad;
        ImVec2 a((io.DisplaySize.x - ts.x) * 0.5f - pad, y - pad), b((io.DisplaySize.x + ts.x) * 0.5f + pad, y + ts.y + pad);
        dl->AddRectFilled(a, b, IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 150), 6 * scale);
        dl->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(), fs, ImVec2(a.x + pad, y), IM_COL32(240, 240, 230, 255), keys);
    }
    static int seen = -1;
    static uint64_t tex;
    static int tw, th;
    static double shown_at;
    const char *path;
    int seq = photo_saved_seq(&path);
    if (seen < 0) seen = seq;
    double now = SDL_GetTicks() / 1000.0;
    if (seq != seen) {
        seen = seq;
        shown_at = now;
#ifndef __APPLE__
        if (tex) vk_imgui_texture_free(tex), tex = 0;
        int w, h;
        unsigned char *px = rt_image_rgba(path, &w, &h);
        if (px && w > 0 && h > 0) {  // (a thumbnail 240 wide, nearest pixel: it only has to be recognisable)
            tw = 240, th = (int)((int64_t)h * tw / w);
            if (th < 1) th = 1;
            std::vector<unsigned char> small((size_t)tw * th * 4);
            for (int y = 0; y < th; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < tw; x++)
                    memcpy(&small[((size_t)y * tw + x) * 4], px + (((size_t)y * h / th) * w + (size_t)x * w / tw) * 4, 4);
            for (size_t i = 3; i < small.size(); i += 4) small[i] = 255;
            tex = vk_imgui_texture_rgba(small.data(), tw, th);
        }
        if (px) rt_image_free(px);
#endif
    }
    if (!shown_at) return;
    double age = now - shown_at;
    if (age > 3.0) {
#ifndef __APPLE__
        if (tex) vk_imgui_texture_free(tex), tex = 0;
#endif
        shown_at = 0;
        return;
    }
    int alpha = age < 2.5 ? 255 : (int)(255 * (3.0 - age) / 0.5);
    const char *msg = tr("Picture saved");
    float pad = 10 * scale, iw = tex ? 240 * scale : 0, ih = tex ? th * scale * 240 / tw : 0;
    ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(msg);
    float w = fmaxf(iw, ts.x) + 2 * pad, h = ih + ts.y + 3 * pad;
    ImVec2 a(io.DisplaySize.x - w - 20 * scale, io.DisplaySize.y - h - 20 * scale), b(a.x + w, a.y + h);
    dl->AddRectFilled(a, b, IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, alpha * 170 / 255), 6 * scale);
    if (tex) dl->AddImage((ImTextureID)tex, ImVec2(a.x + pad, a.y + pad), ImVec2(a.x + pad + iw, a.y + pad + ih),
                          ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(1, 1), IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, alpha));
    dl->AddText(ImVec2(a.x + pad, a.y + ih + 2 * pad), IM_COL32(240, 240, 230, alpha), msg);
}

static void perf_overlay_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale) {
    PerfStats s;
    perfmon_snapshot(&s);
    // top right: BOTW keeps its hearts and stamina top left, its map and gauges bottom right
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x - 16 * scale, 16 * scale), 0, ImVec2(1, 0));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0.6f);
    ImGui::Begin("##perf", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize |
                                     ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing);
    ImGui::SetWindowFontScale(0.72f);
    const ImVec4 gpu_c(0.55f, 0.83f, 0.31f, 1), cpu_c(0.18f, 0.59f, 0.80f, 1), ram_c(0.80f, 0.45f, 0.70f, 1),
                 fps_c(0.95f, 0.95f, 0.95f, 1);
    if (g_settings.perf_overlay == PERF_FPS) {
        // (frame generation: the presented frames, generated ones included)
        ImGui::TextColored(fps_c, "%.0f FPS  %.1f ms", s.fps + s.fps_generated, s.frame_ms_avg);
        ImGui::End();
        return;
    }
    if (ImGui::BeginTable("##perft", 4, ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedFit)) {
        ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::TextColored(gpu_c, "GPU");
        perf_cell("%.0f%%", s.gpu_pct); perf_cell("%.0f C", s.gpu_temp_c); perf_cell("%.0f W", s.gpu_power_w);
        ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::TextColored(gpu_c, "VRAM");
        perf_cell("%.2f GB", s.vram_used_mb < 0 ? -1 : s.vram_used_mb / 1024); perf_cell("/ %.1f GB", s.vram_total_mb < 0 ? -1 : s.vram_total_mb / 1024);
        perf_cell("%.0f MHz", s.gpu_clock_mhz);
        ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::TextColored(cpu_c, "CPU");
        perf_cell("%.0f%%", s.cpu_total_pct); perf_cell("%.0f C", s.cpu_temp_c); perf_cell(tr("game %.0f%%"), s.cpu_game_pct);
        ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::TextColored(ram_c, "RAM");
        perf_cell("%.1f GB", s.ram_used_mb / 1024); perf_cell("/ %.1f GB", s.ram_total_mb / 1024); perf_cell(tr("game %.1f GB"), s.ram_game_mb / 1024);
        ImGui::TableNextColumn(); ImGui::TextColored(fps_c, "FPS");
        perf_cell("%.0f", s.fps + s.fps_generated);
        perf_cell("%.1f ms", s.frame_ms_avg); perf_cell(tr("max %.1f ms"), s.frame_ms_max);
        ImGui::EndTable();
    }
    float top = s.frame_ms_max > 50 ? s.frame_ms_max : 50;
    ImGui::PlotLines("##ft", s.frame_ms, PERF_HISTORY, 0, NULL, 0, top, ImVec2(330 * scale, 48 * scale));
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", s.gpu_name[0] ? s.gpu_name : tr("GPU: no NVML / sysfs data"));
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", s.cpu_name);
    // the graphics settings in effect: what the game falls back to (FSR 3 not built in, a mode that isn't offered), not
    // what the menu says
    int up = upscaler_available(g_settings.upscaler) ? g_settings.upscaler : UPSCALE_OFF;
    std::string line = std::string(tr("Upscaler")) + ": ";
    switch (up) {
        case UPSCALE_METALFX: line += tr("MetalFX"); break;
        case UPSCALE_FSR1: line += tr("FSR 1"); break;
        case UPSCALE_FSR3: line += tr("FSR 3"); break;
        case UPSCALE_FSR4: line += tr("FSR 4"); break;
        case UPSCALE_DLSS: line += tr("DLSS"); break;
        default: line += tr("Off");
    }
    int q = upscale_quality_now();
    if (up != UPSCALE_OFF && upscale_factor() > 1.0) {
        char f[16];
        snprintf(f, sizeof f, "%.1f", upscale_factor());
        line += std::string(" ") + (q >= 0 && q < UPQ_COUNT ? std::string(tr(k_upscale_modes[q])) + " " : "") + f + "x";
    }
    // (FSR 3 / 4 and DLSS anti-alias the scene themselves: the setting does nothing then)
    int aa = rt_antialias();
    line += std::string(" | ") + tr("Anti-aliasing") + ": " + (rt_fsr4() ? tr("FSR 4") : rt_fsr3() ? tr("FSR 3") : rt_dlss() ? tr("DLSS") : aa == AA_TAA ? tr("TAA") : aa == AA_SMAA ? tr("SMAA") : g_settings.game_fxaa ? "FXAA" : tr("Off"));
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", line.c_str());
    line.clear();
#ifndef __APPLE__
    {   // the scene's size and the final image's (the HUD and menus render at that one)
        float rx, ry, ox, oy;
        renderer_get_scene_scale(&rx, &ry);
        renderer_get_scale(&ox, &oy);
        if (rx > 0 && ox > 0) {
            char r[48];
            snprintf(r, sizeof r, "%.0f x %.0f -> %.0f x %.0f", 1600.0 * rx, 900.0 * ry, 1920.0 * ox, 1080.0 * oy);
            line = r;
        }
    }
#endif
    if (g_fg_active) line += std::string(line.empty() ? "" : " | ") + tr("Frame generation on");
    if (!line.empty()) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", line.c_str());
    // Link's coordinates; no line at all while there is no Link or the game is in a scene (title, loading, movie, event).
    // Axis letters are not translated.
    float pos[3];
    if (perfmon_position(pos)) ImGui::Text("X %.1f  Y %.1f  Z %.1f", pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
    ImGui::End();
}

static void keyboard_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale) {
    ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), io.DisplaySize, IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 120));
    float w = fminf(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.9f, 1100 * scale);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.5f, io.DisplaySize.y * 0.5f), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, 0), ImGuiCond_Always);
    ImGui::Begin("##kbd", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                    ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);
    ImGui::PushFont(g_font_big);
    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1), "%s", tr("Enter your name"));
    ImGui::PopFont();
    static bool was_open, was_pad;
    bool pad = g_last_pad.load(), appearing = !was_open || pad != was_pad;  // (switching device: focus the new one)
    was_open = true, was_pad = pad;
    if (!pad) {  // keyboard: type straight into the field
        if (appearing) ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        ImGui::PushFont(g_font_big);
        ImGui::InputText("##name", g_kbd_text, (size_t)(g_kbd_max * 4 + 1 < (int)sizeof g_kbd_text ? g_kbd_max * 4 + 1 : sizeof g_kbd_text),
                         ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackCharFilter,
                         [](ImGuiInputTextCallbackData *d) -> int { return d->EventChar < 0x20 ? 1 : 0; });
        ImGui::PopFont();
        if ((int)strlen(g_kbd_text) > g_kbd_max) g_kbd_text[g_kbd_max] = 0;
        ImGui::TextDisabled(tr("Enter  confirm      Esc  cancel      (%d / %d)"), (int)strlen(g_kbd_text), g_kbd_max);
    } else {  // controller: on-screen keyboard (osk.mm, shared with our menus' text fields)
        int r = osk_keys(g_kbd_text, sizeof g_kbd_text, g_kbd_max, appearing, scale, g_font_big);
        if (r) g_kbd = r > 0 ? 2 : 3;  // (Start / + confirms in menu_handle_event too)
    }
    ImGui::End();
    if (g_kbd.load() != 1) was_open = false;
}

// Window size's list, dropped down under the row's button on the game's Options screen (Video), drawn like the game's
// own pop-up lists: the menu is 16:9 in the middle of the window (output_scale.c), the button where its layout has it
static void size_list_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale) {
    static bool was_open;
    static int frames;
    bool appearing = !was_open;
    was_open = true;
    frames = appearing ? 0 : frames + 1;
    float gw = io.DisplaySize.x, gh = gw * 9 / 16;
    if (gh > io.DisplaySize.y) gh = io.DisplaySize.y, gw = gh * 16 / 9;
    float ox = (io.DisplaySize.x - gw) * 0.5f, oy = (io.DisplaySize.y - gh) * 0.5f;
    float x0 = ox + gw * 0.496f, x1 = ox + gw * 0.708f, y0 = oy + gh * 0.318f, bottom = oy + gh * 0.87f;
    float row_h = gh * 0.046f;
    WinSize list[WINSIZE_MAX];
    static char names[WINSIZE_MAX][64];
    int n = winsize_list(list, g_settings.fullscreen), cur = 0;
    WinSize e = winsize_effective(g_settings.fullscreen);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        winsize_name(list[i], tr("native"), names[i], sizeof names[i]);
        if (list[i].w == e.w && list[i].h == e.h) cur = i;
    }
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(x0, y0), ImGuiCond_Always);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(ImVec2(x1 - x0, 0), ImVec2(x1 - x0, bottom - y0));
    if (appearing) ImGui::SetNextWindowFocus();
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 0);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 1.5f * scale);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(4 * scale, 4 * scale));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ItemSpacing, ImVec2(0, 2 * scale));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, ImVec4(0.04f, 0.04f, 0.04f, 0.94f));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, ImVec4(0.62f, 0.62f, 0.58f, 0.9f));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Header, ImVec4(1, 1, 1, 0.10f));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered, ImVec4(1, 1, 1, 0.22f));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_HeaderActive, ImVec4(1, 1, 1, 0.30f));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_NavCursor, ImVec4(0.95f, 0.93f, 0.85f, 1));
    ImGui::Begin("##sizes", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                                      ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize);
    ImGui::PushFont(g_menu_font);
    int picked = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        ImGui::PushID(i);
        ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        float w = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
        if (ImGui::Selectable("##size", i == cur, 0, ImVec2(w, row_h))) picked = i;
        if (appearing && i == cur) {
            ImGui::SetItemDefaultFocus();
            ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);
            ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(g_last_pad.load());
        }
        bool hot = ImGui::IsItemHovered() || ImGui::IsItemFocused();
        ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(names[i]);
        ImU32 col = i == cur ? IM_COL32(236, 194, 84, 255) : hot ? IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 255) : IM_COL32(215, 213, 205, 255);
        ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddText(ImVec2(p.x + (w - ts.x) * 0.5f, p.y + (row_h - ts.y) * 0.5f), col, names[i]);
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    // (test) SAVAGEWIND_SIZE_PICK=<n>: picks size n three seconds after the list is up
    if (const char *t = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_SIZE_PICK"); t && frames == 180) picked = atoi(t) < n ? atoi(t) : cur;
    bool cancel = !appearing && (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false) ||
                                 ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false) ||
                                 (ImGui::IsMouseClicked(0) && !ImGui::IsWindowHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem)));
    // (a press on a size makes it the active item: without that flag the list counted it as a click outside)
    ImGui::PopFont();
    ImGui::End();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor(6);
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(4);
    if (picked >= 0 && picked != cur) {
        g_settings.window_w = list[picked].w, g_settings.window_h = list[picked].h;
        settings_save();
        g_want_window_apply.store(true);
        game_options_size_picked();
    }
    if (picked >= 0 || cancel) {
        g_sizes_hold = SDL_GetTicks() + 300;  // (the A / B that closed it, still down, stays out of the game)
        if (ImGui::IsMouseDown(0)) g_sizes_eat_up = true;  // (and the mouse button's release: the pointer would click the row)
        g_sizes = false;
        was_open = false;
    }
}

// Game thread (runtime/hle/swkbd.c): show the dialog, re-present the last frame until it's answered.
// Returns 1 confirmed (out = text, UTF-8), 0 cancelled.
extern "C" int menu_keyboard_run(const char *initial, int max_len, char *out, int cap) {
    extern void backend_represent(void);
    snprintf(g_kbd_text, sizeof g_kbd_text, "%s", initial ? initial : "");
    g_kbd_max = max_len > 0 && max_len < (int)sizeof g_kbd_text / 4 ? max_len : 8;
    input_reset();
    g_kbd = 1;
    // (test) SAVAGEWIND_KBD_AUTO=<text>: answer at once
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_KBD_AUTO")) { snprintf(g_kbd_text, sizeof g_kbd_text, "%s", getenv("SAVAGEWIND_KBD_AUTO")); g_kbd = 2; }
    while (g_kbd.load() == 1 && !g_rt_unwind) {  // ~60 Hz (a reboot cancels)
        uint64_t t0 = SDL_GetTicks();
        backend_represent();
        uint64_t dt = SDL_GetTicks() - t0;
        if (dt < 16) SDL_Delay((uint32_t)(16 - dt));
    }
    bool ok = g_kbd.load() == 2 && g_kbd_text[0];
    if (ok) snprintf(out, cap, "%s", g_kbd_text);
    g_kbd = 0;
    input_reset();
    return ok;
}

// The tab bar and its pages, into the current window: the in-game menu, and the start screen's Settings (in_game
// false: nothing of the game is loaded yet - the tabs that need it are greyed out; prelaunch: the start screen's own
// first tab, game files and fonts, drawn by launcher.mm).
static void tabs_body(float scale, bool in_game, void (*prelaunch)(float)) {
    // (id: the page; -1 = Prelaunch)
    struct Tab { const char *name; int id; bool on; };
    Tab tabs[11];
    int ntabs = 0;
    if (prelaunch) tabs[ntabs++] = {"Prelaunch", -1, true};
    // (ids 5-7 were Link's Awakening tabs; the ids stay: test hooks)
    static const char *names[] = {"Video", "Audio", "Language", "Saves", "amiibo", "", "", "", "Controls", "Quit", "Cheats"};
    static const int order[] = {8, 0, 1, 2, 4, 3, 10, 9};  // Controls, Video, Audio, Language, amiibo, Saves, Cheats, Quit
    for (int i : order) {  // (Quit: in game only - the start screen has its own QUIT; Saves: on the start screen only,
        if (i == 9 && prelaunch) continue;  //  the game must not be running while its saves change)
        if (i == 3 && !prelaunch) continue;
        if (i == 10 && !in_game) continue;  // (Cheats: in game only)
        tabs[ntabs++] = {names[i], i, true};
    }
    int cur = 0;  // g_tab / g_tab_request hold ids
    for (int i = 0; i < ntabs; i++) if (tabs[i].id == g_tab) cur = i;
    if (!tabs[cur].on) cur = 0;
    // L/R (or Q/E) switch tabs, skipping greyed-out ones (not while typing: Q / E are letters then, and the on-screen
    // keyboard has the controller)
    if (g_tab_request_ext >= 0) { g_tab_request = g_tab_request_ext; g_tab_request_ext = -1; }
    bool any_popup = ImGui::IsPopupOpen("", ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupId), typing = ui_text_busy();
    static int focused_tab = -99;  // the tab the controller's cursor is on (from the frame before; -99: none)
    if (!any_popup && !typing) {
        int step = ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadR1, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_E, false) ? 1
                 : ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadL1, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Q, false) ? -1 : 0;
        if (step) {
            int i = cur;
            do i = (i + step + ntabs) % ntabs; while (!tabs[i].on);
            g_tab_request = tabs[i].id;
            // the cursor on the tab bar goes along (left behind, A on it switched straight back; user 2026-10-11)
            if (focused_tab != -99) g_focus_tab = tabs[i].id, g_focus_frames = 0;
        }
    }
    // Down with the cursor on the tab bar: the page's first row (option rows; other pages keep ImGui's own pick)
    bool down_from_tab = focused_tab != -99 && ImGui::GetCurrentContext()->NavCursorVisible && !any_popup &&
                         (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadDown) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickDown) ||
                          ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_DownArrow));
    opt_focus_first(down_from_tab);
    if (ImGui::BeginTabBar("##tabs", ImGuiTabBarFlags_NoTabListScrollingButtons)) {
        for (int k = 0; k < ntabs; k++) {
            const Tab &t = tabs[k];
            ImGuiTabItemFlags f = g_tab_request == t.id && t.on ? ImGuiTabItemFlags_SetSelected : 0;
            char lbl[160];
            snprintf(lbl, sizeof lbl, prelaunch ? " %s ###%s" : "  %s  ###%s", tr(t.name), t.name);  // (### : ID stays English)
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(!t.on);
            // focus (controller / keyboard): the tab lights up a little with a gold bar along its bottom, instead of
            // ImGui's outline (it sits 4 px outside the tab and the tab bar's clipping could cut its top off on macOS)
            // (focused_tab: from the frame before - colours go in before the tab is drawn)
            bool lit = focused_tab == t.id && ImGui::GetCurrentContext()->NavCursorVisible;
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_NavCursor, ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0));
            if (lit) {
                ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Tab, ImVec4(0.19f, 0.27f, 0.22f, 1));
                ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_TabHovered, ImVec4(0.19f, 0.27f, 0.22f, 1));
            }
            if (g_focus_tab == -1 && !prelaunch) g_focus_tab = 8;  // (no Prelaunch in game: Controls, the first tab)
            bool focus_here = g_focus_tab == t.id || (g_focus_tab == -100 && t.id == g_tab);
            bool open = ImGui::BeginTabItem(lbl, NULL, f);
            ImGui::PopStyleColor(lit ? 3 : 1);
            if (focus_here) {  // the controller's cursor starts on this tab (SetKeyboardFocusHere skips tabs: no tab stop)
                ImGui::SetFocusID(ImGui::GetItemID(), ImGui::GetCurrentWindow());
                ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(true);
                // a few frames: the page's child window appearing makes ImGui pick its first widget once it's laid out
                if (++g_focus_frames >= 4) g_focus_tab = -99, g_focus_frames = 0;
                else g_focus_tab = t.id;
            }
            if (lit) {
                ImVec2 a = ImGui::GetItemRectMin(), b = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
                float h = 4 * scale > 2 ? 4 * scale : 2;
                ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(a.x + 2, b.y - h), ImVec2(b.x - 2, b.y),
                                                          IM_COL32(236, 194, 84, 255));  // (the menu's gold)
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemFocused()) focused_tab = t.id;
            else if (focused_tab == t.id) focused_tab = -99;
            ImGui::EndDisabled();
            if (open) {
                g_tab = t.id;
                ImGui::Spacing();
                // the page's background reaches the ends of the line under the tabs (it sticks out half the window
                // padding each side); the same half goes in as padding, so text and rows stay where they were on a
                // wider card
                float side = IM_TRUNC(ImGui::GetCurrentWindow()->WindowPadding.x * 0.5f);
                float width = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x + 2 * side;
                float max_x = ImGui::GetCurrentWindow()->DC.CursorMaxPos.x;
                ImVec2 at = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
                ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(at.x - side, at.y));
                ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(side, 0));
                ImGui::BeginChild("##page", ImVec2(width, 0), ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding,
                                  ImGuiWindowFlags_NavFlattened);  // (the rest of the window: no hint line)
                ImGui::PopStyleVar();
                // Down from the tab bar, pages that aren't option rows (Prelaunch, Controls): their first control
                // (option-row pages: opt_focus_first)
                if (down_from_tab && (t.id == -1 || t.id == 8)) {
                    opt_focus_first(false);
                    ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
                    ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(true);
                }
                switch (t.id) {
                case -1: prelaunch(scale); break;
                case 0: tab_display(); break;
                case 1: tab_audio(); break;
                case 2: tab_language(in_game); break;
                case 3: saves_tab_draw(); break;
                case 4: tab_amiibo(); break;
                case 8: tab_about(); break;
                case 9: tab_quit(scale, in_game); break;
                case 10: tab_cheats(); break;
                }
                static const char *scroll_test = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_MENU_SCROLL");  // test hook: page scroll, 0..1
                if (scroll_test) ImGui::SetScrollY(ImGui::GetScrollMaxY() * (float)atof(scroll_test));
                ImGui::EndChild();
                // the wider card is paint only: don't let it extend the window's content (a horizontal wheel could pan it)
                ImGui::GetCurrentWindow()->DC.CursorMaxPos.x = ImMax(max_x, ImGui::GetCurrentWindow()->ContentRegionRect.Max.x);
                ImGui::EndTabItem();
            }
        }
        g_tab_request = -2;
        opt_focus_first(false);  // (a page without option rows: nothing took it)
        ImGui::EndTabBar();
    }
}

void menu_tabs_draw(float scale, ImFont *font, ImFont *font_big, bool in_game, void (*prelaunch)(float)) {
    ImFont *f0 = g_font, *f1 = g_font_big;
    g_font = font, g_font_big = font_big;
    ImGuiStyle saved = ImGui::GetStyle();  // the menu's look (the start screen has its own style)
    style_init();
    ImGui::GetStyle().ScaleAllSizes(scale);
    tabs_body(scale, in_game, prelaunch);
    ImGui::GetStyle() = saved;
    g_font = f0, g_font_big = f1;
}

// Logging build (SAVAGEWIND_ACTLOG=1): the actions the game says are pressed / held, live, so a play session can be read off
// the screen as well as the log ("[act] poll N: game says ..."). A big flash of the latest in the top middle, the list left.
static void act_overlay_draw(ImGuiIO &io, float scale) {
    ActLogRow rows[12];
    int n = act_log_rows(rows, 12);
    uint32_t now = SDL_GetTicks();
    const ImGuiWindowFlags fl = ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs |
                                ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings;
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(16 * scale, 170 * scale), 0, ImVec2(0, 0));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0.7f);
    ImGui::Begin("##actlog", NULL, fl);
    ImGui::SetWindowFontScale(0.72f);
    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1), "Actions the game asks for (also in the log)");
    if (!n) ImGui::TextDisabled("press something");
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const ActLogRow &r = rows[i];
        float age = (float)(now - r.last_ms) / 1000.f;
        ImVec4 c = r.holding || age < 1.5f ? ImVec4(1, 0.9f, 0.35f, 1) : age < 8 ? ImVec4(0.92f, 0.92f, 0.92f, 1) : ImVec4(0.6f, 0.6f, 0.6f, 1);
        const char *nm = act_name(r.id);
        ImGui::TextColored(c, "%2d  %s   pressed x%u   held x%u%s", r.id, nm ? nm : "?", r.pressed, r.held,
                           r.holding ? "   [HELD]" : "");
    }
    ImGui::End();
    // the latest, big, fading over 1.5 s; one line per action pressed in that time
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.5f, 60 * scale), 0, ImVec2(0.5f, 0));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0);
    ImGui::Begin("##actbig", NULL, fl | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBackground);
    ImGui::PushFont(g_font_big);
    ImGui::SetWindowFontScale(1.5f);
    int shown = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && shown < 4; i++) {
        float age = (float)(now - rows[i].last_ms) / 1000.f;
        if (age >= 1.5f && !rows[i].holding) continue;
        float a = rows[i].holding ? 1.f : 1.f - age / 1.5f;
        const char *nm = act_name(rows[i].id);
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1, 0.9f, 0.35f, a), "%d%s%s%s", rows[i].id, nm ? " " : "", nm ? nm : "", rows[i].holding ? "  (held)" : "");
        shown++;
    }
    ImGui::PopFont();
    ImGui::End();
}

#ifndef __APPLE__
extern "C" void rec_drain(void);  // (runtime/nvn/vulkan/record.c)
#endif

// Native-style selector prompt. Draw-only: input still belongs to the game.
static void quick_inventory_hint_draw(const ImGuiIO &io) {
    int kind = g_settings.button_icons;
    if (kind <= ICONS_AUTO || kind >= ICONS_COUNT) {
        int family = input_pad_family();
        kind = input_last_device() == DEVICE_KEYBOARD ? ICONS_KEYBOARD :
            family == 1 ? ICONS_XBOX : family == 2 ? ICONS_PLAYSTATION : ICONS_NINTENDO;
    }
    bool keyboard = kind == ICONS_KEYBOARD;
    int family = kind == ICONS_XBOX ? 1 : kind == ICONS_PLAYSTATION ? 2 : 0;
    float canvas = fminf(io.DisplaySize.x / 1280.f, io.DisplaySize.y / 720.f);
    float scale = canvas / 1.5f, fs = 32 * scale, radius = 15 * scale, gap = 10 * scale;
    float y = io.DisplaySize.y * .5f + 23 * canvas;
    struct Prompt { const char *label, *icon; int binding; bool enabled; } prompts[3];
    int count = 0, drop = quick_drop_hint_state();
    if (drop == 1 || drop == 2) prompts[count++] = {tr("Drop"), "\xee\x81\x83", BIND_Y, drop == 2};
    if (quick_inventory_sort_hint()) prompts[count++] = {tr("Sort"), "\xee\x81\x82", BIND_X, true};
    if (drop) prompts[count++] = {tr("Back"), "\xee\x81\x81", BIND_B, true};
    ImFont *fonts[3];
    ImVec2 text[3], key[3];
    const char *buttons[3];
    float badges[3], width = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        fonts[i] = g_hint_font ? g_hint_font : g_menu_font;
        for (const char *p = prompts[i].label; *p;) {
            unsigned code; int n = ImTextCharFromUtf8(&code, p, nullptr);
            if (!n) break;
            p += n;
            if (!fonts[i]->FindGlyphNoFallback((ImWchar)code)) { fonts[i] = g_menu_font; break; }
        }
        int binding = prompts[i].binding;
        buttons[i] = keyboard ? tr(bind_key_label(g_bind_key[binding])) : tr(bind_pad_label(g_bind_pad[binding], family));
        text[i] = fonts[i]->CalcTextSizeA(fs, FLT_MAX, 0, prompts[i].label);
        key[i] = g_font->CalcTextSizeA(fs * .65f, FLT_MAX, 0, buttons[i]);
        badges[i] = g_hint_buttons ? 44 * scale : fmaxf(radius * 2, key[i].x + 14 * scale);
        width += text[i].x + gap + badges[i];
    }
    width += (count - 1) * 60 * scale;
    float x = (io.DisplaySize.x - width) * .5f;
    ImDrawList *draw = ImGui::GetForegroundDrawList();
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        ImFont *font = fonts[i];
        int alpha = prompts[i].enabled ? 255 : 110;
        auto label = [&](ImVec2 pos, ImU32 color) {
            int start = draw->VtxBuffer.Size;
            draw->AddText(font, fs, pos, color, prompts[i].label);
            for (int j = start; font == g_hint_font && j < draw->VtxBuffer.Size; j++)
                draw->VtxBuffer[j].pos.x += (pos.y + fs * .8f - draw->VtxBuffer[j].pos.y) * .18f;
        };
        label(ImVec2(x + scale, y - fs * .5f + scale), IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, alpha / 3));
        label(ImVec2(x, y - fs * .5f), IM_COL32(245, 246, 232, alpha));
        float bx = x + text[i].x + gap;
        if (g_hint_buttons) {
            draw->AddText(g_hint_buttons, 54 * scale, ImVec2(bx - 5 * scale, y - 27 * scale),
                          IM_COL32(245, 246, 232, alpha), prompts[i].icon);
        } else {
            ImVec2 a(bx, y - radius), b(bx + badges[i], y + radius);
            draw->AddRectFilled(a, b, IM_COL32(245, 246, 232, alpha), keyboard ? 4 * scale : radius);
            draw->AddText(g_font, fs * .65f, ImVec2(a.x + (badges[i] - key[i].x) * .5f, y - key[i].y * .5f),
                          IM_COL32(25, 28, 24, alpha), buttons[i]);
        }
        x += text[i].x + gap + badges[i] + 60 * scale;
    }
}

// Everything menu_render draws, in one place: menu_render_needed (the caller's cue to drain the recorder first) and
// menu_render (which decides again, and drains itself) must agree on it. The pointer's hover box, the console and the
// gyro drag were missing here: their frames went to the command buffer while the recorder thread was still filling it.
static bool menu_draws(bool *pointer_hover = NULL, float *pointer_box = NULL, bool *gyro_show = NULL, GyroScene *gyro = NULL) {
    float box[4];
    GyroScene gs;
    bool hover = pc_cursor_hover_box(pointer_box ? pointer_box : box);
    bool gyro_on = pc_gyro_scene_view(gyro ? gyro : &gs);
    if (pointer_hover) *pointer_hover = hover;
    if (gyro_show) *gyro_show = gyro_on;
    return g_open.load() || g_kbd.load() == 1 || g_sizes.load() || console_is_open() || gyro_on || hover ||
           g_settings.perf_overlay != PERF_OFF || act_log_enabled() || quick_inventory_sort_hint() || quick_drop_hint_state();
}

bool menu_render_needed(void) { return menu_draws(); }

#ifdef __APPLE__
void menu_render(id<MTLDevice> dev, id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb, id<MTLTexture> target) {
    const double tw = target.width, th = target.height;
#else
void menu_render(void *cmd, uint32_t target_w, uint32_t target_h) {
    const double tw = target_w, th = target_h;
#endif
    bool open = g_open.load();
    bool kbd = g_kbd.load() == 1;
    bool sizes = g_sizes.load();
    bool con = console_is_open();
    console_collect();
    GyroScene gyro_scene;
    bool gyro_scene_show;
    float pointer_box[4];
    bool pointer_hover;
    if (!menu_draws(&pointer_hover, pointer_box, &gyro_scene_show, &gyro_scene)) {
        if (g_inited) { pthread_mutex_lock(&q_lock); q_events.clear(); pthread_mutex_unlock(&q_lock); }
        return;
    }
#ifndef __APPLE__
    // ImGui records into the frame's command buffer from this thread, which is the recorder's until it has caught up.
    // The caller drains when menu_render_needed said so, but the pointer's hover box can appear (and the console and
    // the gyro drag can open) between that call and this one: draining again here is cheap when nothing is queued.
    rec_drain();
#endif
#ifdef __APPLE__
    if (!g_inited) init(dev);
#else
    if (!g_inited) init();
#endif
    ImGui::SetCurrentContext(g_ctx);
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = ImVec2((float)tw, (float)th);
    io.DisplayFramebufferScale = ImVec2(1, 1);
    static double last;
    double now = SDL_GetTicks() / 1000.0;
    io.DeltaTime = last > 0 && now > last ? (float)(now - last) : 1.0f / 60;
    last = now;
    drain_events(io);
    // fonts are built at 34/56 px for a ~1080 px tall output; scale to the window
    float scale = (float)(th / 1080.0);
    if (scale < 0.45f) scale = 0.45f;
    io.FontGlobalScale = scale;

#ifdef __APPLE__
    MTLRenderPassDescriptor *rp = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
    rp.colorAttachments[0].texture = target;
    rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionLoad;
    rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
#endif
    // spacing/rounding follow the output size too (style tuned for 1080 p)
    static ImGuiStyle base;
    static float style_scale = -1;
    if (style_scale < 0) base = ImGui::GetStyle();
    if (fabsf(style_scale - scale) > 0.01f) {
        ImGui::GetStyle() = base;
        ImGui::GetStyle().ScaleAllSizes(scale);
        style_scale = scale;
    }
    fonts_follow_language();
#ifdef __APPLE__
    ImGui_ImplMetal_NewFrame(rp);
#else
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_NewFrame();
#endif
    ImGui::NewFrame();

    if(pointer_hover&&!open&&!kbd&&!sizes) {
        float s=fminf(io.DisplaySize.x/1280.f,io.DisplaySize.y/(720.f+2*output_ui_extra_y()));
        ImVec2 a(io.DisplaySize.x*.5f+pointer_box[0]*s,io.DisplaySize.y*.5f-pointer_box[3]*s);
        ImVec2 b(io.DisplaySize.x*.5f+pointer_box[2]*s,io.DisplaySize.y*.5f-pointer_box[1]*s);
        bool pressed=pc_cursor_hover_pressed();
        if(pressed)ImGui::GetForegroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(a,b,IM_COL32(250,250,220,45),2.f*s);
        ImGui::GetForegroundDrawList()->AddRect(a,b,pressed?IM_COL32(255,235,155,255):IM_COL32(250,250,220,255),2.f*s,0,2.f*s);
    }

    if (g_settings.perf_overlay != PERF_OFF) perf_overlay_draw(io, scale);
    if (act_log_enabled()) act_overlay_draw(io, scale);
    if (!open && !kbd && !sizes && !con && (quick_inventory_sort_hint() || quick_drop_hint_state())) quick_inventory_hint_draw(io);
    if (!open && !kbd && !sizes && !con) photo_overlay_draw(io, scale);
    if (!open && !kbd && !sizes && !con && gyro_scene_show) gyro_scene_draw(io, scale, gyro_scene);

    if (open) {
        // dim the game behind the menu
        ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), io.DisplaySize, IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 110));
        float w = fminf(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.9f, 1500 * scale), h = io.DisplaySize.y - 2 * 18 * scale;  // (all the height: a slim margin)
        ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.5f, io.DisplaySize.y * 0.5f), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, h), ImGuiCond_Always);
        ImGui::Begin("##menu", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings);
        ImFont *keep_big = g_font_big;  // (the window in the menu's font; header() uses g_font_big)
        g_font_big = g_menu_font_big;
        ImGui::PushFont(g_menu_font);
        // header as on the start screen's Settings: the title, and a close X in the corner (B / Esc too). ("Title
        // screen" - rt_request_reboot(RT_REBOOT_TITLE) - is to find a new home; user 2026-10-11.)
        ImGui::PushFont(g_font_big);
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1), "%s", tr("Settings"));
        ImGui::PopFont();
        {
            float bx = 44 * scale;
            ImGui::SameLine(ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - ImGui::GetStyle().WindowPadding.x - bx);
            ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_NavCursor, ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0));
            bool close = ImGui::InvisibleButton("##close", ImVec2(bx, bx), ImGuiButtonFlags_EnableNav);
            ImGui::PopStyleColor();
            bool hot = ImGui::IsItemHovered() || ImGui::IsItemFocused();
            ImU32 col = hot ? IM_COL32(236, 194, 84, 255) : IM_COL32(220, 216, 205, 255);
            float m = bx * 0.3f, t = (hot ? 3.0f : 2.4f) * scale * 1.5f;
            ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
            if (hot) dl->AddRectFilled(p, ImVec2(p.x + bx, p.y + bx), IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 20), 8 * scale);
            dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p.x + m, p.y + m), ImVec2(p.x + bx - m, p.y + bx - m), col, t);
            dl->AddLine(ImVec2(p.x + bx - m, p.y + m), ImVec2(p.x + m, p.y + bx - m), col, t);
            if (close) set_open(false);
        }

        bool any_popup = ImGui::IsPopupOpen("", ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupId), typing = ui_text_busy();  // (before the
        tabs_body(scale, true, NULL);                                                                          //  pages run)
        // B with nothing focused-deeper closes the menu (not the Esc / B that ends typing: typing is from the frame
        // before, so it's still true the frame a field lets go)
        if (!any_popup && !typing && !ui_text_busy() && ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows) &&
            (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false)))
            set_open(false);
        ImGui::PopFont();
        g_font_big = keep_big;
        ImGui::End();
        osk_draw(g_font_big, scale);  // (a text field activated with the controller)
    }

    if (kbd) keyboard_draw(io, scale);
    if (sizes) size_list_draw(io, scale);
    if (con) console_draw(io, scale, g_font_mono ? g_font_mono : g_font);
    ImGui::Render();
    g_text_busy = open && ui_text_busy();
#ifdef __APPLE__
    id<MTLRenderCommandEncoder> enc = [cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:rp];
    ImGui_ImplMetal_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), cb, enc);
    [enc endEncoding];
#else
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), (VkCommandBuffer)cmd);  // inside the window image's rendering
#endif
}
```

```h
// Settings pages in two panes (runtime/ui/option_rows.mm): option rows on the left - an uppercase label, the value on
// the right (brighter when it isn't the default) - and the selected (controller) or hovered (mouse) row's description on
// the right, instead of tooltips. A / click changes a row (toggle / next value), left / right step it.
//
//   opt_begin("##video", scale);
//   opt_section("Display");
//   if (opt_toggle("Room reverb", &g_settings.reverb, true, "The room reverb effect.")) settings_save();
//   opt_end();
#pragma once

void opt_begin(const char *id, float scale);
void opt_section(const char *title);
bool opt_toggle(const char *label, bool *v, bool def, const char *desc);
// wrap: past the last value back to the first (and the other way); false: stops at the ends
bool opt_choice(const char *label, int *v, const char *const *names, int n, int def, const char *desc, bool wrap = true);
// a long choice: A / click opens the values as a list (*picked: one was picked there), left / right step through them
bool opt_list(const char *label, int *v, const char *const *names, int n, int def, const char *desc, bool *picked);
// A dropdown: the value in a box with ▼; a click (A, Enter) opens the list, left / right don't step through it
bool opt_dropdown(const char *label, int *v, const char *const *names, int n, int def, const char *desc);

// keeps the last available value, *shown is the one on screen (-1: *v). True when *v changed.
bool opt_choice_avail(const char *label, int *v, int *shown, const char *const *names, const bool *avail, int n, int def,
                      const char *desc);
// steps of `step` between lo and hi; fmt formats the value (e.g. "%gx")
bool opt_slider(const char *label, float *v, float lo, float hi, float step, float def, const char *fmt, const char *desc);

// (if given) is shown for lo instead (e.g. "Any")

             const char *lo_name = NULL);
// an action: true when activated
bool opt_button(const char *label, const char *desc);
// one of a set of choices (a ring on the right, filled when selected); true when chosen
bool opt_radio(const char *label, bool selected, const char *desc);
// an action / item row with a value on the right (upper: the label in capitals, as option rows; false: as written,
// e.g. a folder); true when activated
bool opt_action(const char *label, const char *value, const char *desc, bool upper = true);

// keyboard with a controller). True when Enter / the keyboard confirmed a change.
#include <stddef.h>

// that text row is being edited (its buffer is the user's: don't overwrite it)
bool opt_text_editing(const char *label);
// the next row is shown greyed out and can't be changed (e.g. not usable in this mode)
void opt_disable_next(void);
// rows after this sit one step in (+1) or back out (-1): options that belong to the row above
void opt_indent(int step);
void opt_end(void);

// pictures). Call it right after the row, every frame it is drawn; tex is the backend's ImTextureID.

// panes was unreliable - some tabs went to a row further down, some nowhere). Cleared by the next opt_begin / call.
```

`runtime/ui/option_rows.mm`:

```mm
// Two-pane settings pages (see option_rows.h): rows on the left, the selected / hovered row's description on the right.
#include <ctype.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"  // (SetKeyOwner, NavCursorVisible)

#include "i18n.h"
#include "option_rows.h"
#include "osk.h"

static float g_scale = 1;
static std::string g_desc_hover, g_desc_focus, g_desc_shown;  // this frame's hovered / selected row, and the last shown
static std::string g_desc_first;  // the page's first row (shown until a row is selected or hovered)
struct DescImage { unsigned long long tex = 0; int w = 0, h = 0; };
static DescImage g_img_hover, g_img_focus, g_img_shown;  // (the pictures of those rows: opt_desc_image)
static std::vector<unsigned long long> g_img_live;       // the pictures offered this frame

static const ImU32 kGold = IM_COL32(236, 194, 84, 255);
static bool g_next_disabled;
void opt_disable_next(void) { g_next_disabled = true; }
static bool g_value_dim;  // the next row's value is shown greyed (a value that can't be picked yet)
static int g_indent;
static bool g_focus_req, g_take_first;  // (opt_focus_first: requested / this page's first row takes it)
void opt_focus_first(bool on) { g_focus_req = on; }
static bool g_held;  // the last row's left / right has been held a while (steppers go faster)
void opt_indent(int step) { g_indent = g_indent + step < 0 ? 0 : g_indent + step; }

void opt_begin(const char *id, float scale) {
    g_scale = scale;
    static std::string page;  // (another page: its first row's description, not the last page's)
    if (page != id) page = id, g_desc_shown.clear(), g_img_shown = DescImage();
    g_take_first = g_focus_req;
    g_focus_req = false;
    if (g_take_first) ImGui::NavMoveRequestCancel();  // (this frame's Down goes to the first row instead)
    g_indent = 0;
    g_desc_hover.clear(), g_desc_focus.clear();
    g_img_hover = g_img_focus = DescImage(), g_img_live.clear();
    ImVec2 avail = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail();
    ImGui::PushID(id);
    ImGui::BeginChild("##rows", ImVec2(avail.x * 0.48f, avail.y), ImGuiChildFlags_None, ImGuiWindowFlags_NavFlattened);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ItemSpacing, ImVec2(ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x, 4 * scale));  // (rows close)
    g_desc_first.clear();
}

// (labels, values, descriptions and titles are English: shown in the menu language, tr(); IDs stay English)
void opt_section(const char *title) {
    std::string t = tr_upper(tr(title));
    if (ImGui::GetCursorPosY() > ImGui::GetStyle().WindowPadding.y + 1) ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, 10 * g_scale));
    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.55f, 0.58f, 0.52f, 1), "%s", t.c_str());
}

// One row: draws it, handles A / click and left / right while selected. Returns 2 (A / click), -1 / +1 (left / right) or 0.
// arrows: ◀ value ▶ (a choice of several, or a stepper): left / right step it, and the arrows click too
// arrows: ◀ value ▶, left / right step through the values; drop: the value in a box with ▼, a list opens on a click
// (left / right do nothing)
static int row(const char *label, const std::string &value, bool changed, const char *desc, bool upper = true,
               bool arrows = false, bool drop = false) {
    ImGui::PushID(label);
    if (g_indent) ImGui::SetCursorPosX(ImGui::GetCursorPosX() + g_indent * 28 * g_scale);  // (an option of the row above)
    ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    float w = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x, h = ImGui::GetFontSize() * 1.9f;
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_NavCursor, ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0));  // (the row's own border shows the selection)
    bool clicked = ImGui::InvisibleButton("##row", ImVec2(w, h), ImGuiButtonFlags_EnableNav);
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    if (g_take_first) {  // (opt_focus_first)
        g_take_first = false;
        ImGui::SetFocusID(ImGui::GetItemID(), ImGui::GetCurrentWindow());
        ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(true);
        ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0);
    }
    bool off = g_next_disabled;  // (greyed out: still selectable, so its description shows, but it can't change)
    g_next_disabled = false;
    bool dim = off || g_value_dim;
    g_value_dim = false;
    bool hov = ImGui::IsItemHovered(), foc = ImGui::IsItemFocused() && ImGui::GetCurrentContext()->NavCursorVisible;
    int step = clicked && !off ? 2 : 0;
    g_held = false;
    if (foc && !off) {
        if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickLeft) ||
            ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow))
            step = -1;
        if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickRight) ||
            ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_RightArrow))
            step = 1;
        for (ImGuiKey k : {ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft, ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight, ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickLeft,
                           ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickRight, ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, ImGuiKey_RightArrow})
            if (ImGui::GetKeyData(k)->DownDuration > 1.0f) g_held = true;
        // left / right belong to the row (navigation would otherwise try to move sideways)
        for (ImGuiKey k : {ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft, ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight, ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, ImGuiKey_RightArrow})
            ImGui::SetKeyOwner(k, ImGui::GetItemID());
    }
    if (desc) desc = tr(desc);
    if (foc) g_desc_focus = desc ? desc : "";
    if (hov) g_desc_hover = desc ? desc : "";
    if (g_desc_first.empty() && desc) g_desc_first = desc;

    ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    float r = 9 * g_scale, pad = 16 * g_scale, fs = ImGui::GetFontSize();
    dl->AddRectFilled(p, ImVec2(p.x + w, p.y + h), hov || foc ? IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 22) : IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 40), r);
    dl->AddRect(p, ImVec2(p.x + w, p.y + h), hov || foc ? (off ? IM_COL32(236, 194, 84, 120) : kGold)
                                                        : IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, off ? 18 : 38), r, 0,
                hov || foc ? 2.0f : 1.0f);
    std::string t = upper ? tr_upper(tr(label)) : std::string(tr(label));
    float ty = p.y + (h - fs) * 0.5f;
    ImU32 label_col = off ? IM_COL32(110, 110, 102, 255) : IM_COL32(240, 236, 224, 255);  // (greyed out: clearly dim)
    dl->AddText(ImVec2(p.x + pad, ty), label_col, t.c_str());
    float right = p.x + w - pad;  // (the value's right edge)
    if (arrows && !value.empty()) {  // ◀ value ▶, drawn (the fonts have no arrow glyphs); a click on one steps
        float aw = fs * 0.42f, gap = fs * 0.55f, cy = ty + fs * 0.52f;
        float rx = right - aw, lx = rx - gap - ImGui::CalcTextSize(value.c_str()).x - gap - aw;
        ImU32 ac = off ? IM_COL32(110, 110, 100, 255) : hov || foc ? kGold : IM_COL32(170, 170, 160, 255);
        dl->AddTriangleFilled(ImVec2(lx, cy), ImVec2(lx + aw, cy - aw * 0.75f), ImVec2(lx + aw, cy + aw * 0.75f), ac);
        dl->AddTriangleFilled(ImVec2(rx + aw, cy), ImVec2(rx, cy - aw * 0.75f), ImVec2(rx, cy + aw * 0.75f), ac);
        if (clicked && !off) {
            float mx = ImGui::GetIO().MousePos.x, hit = gap;
            if (mx >= lx - hit && mx <= lx + aw + hit) step = -1;
            else if (mx >= rx - hit && mx <= rx + aw + hit) step = 1;
        }
        right = rx - gap;
    }
    if (drop && !value.empty()) {  // [ value  ▼ ], drawn like arrows above
        float aw = fs * 0.42f, gap = fs * 0.55f, cy = ty + fs * 0.52f;
        float vw = ImGui::CalcTextSize(value.c_str()).x, bx0 = right - aw - gap * 2 - vw - gap;
        ImU32 ac = off ? IM_COL32(110, 110, 100, 255) : hov || foc ? kGold : IM_COL32(170, 170, 160, 255);
        dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(bx0, p.y + h * 0.14f), ImVec2(right + gap * 0.4f, p.y + h * 0.86f), IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 70),
                          r * 0.6f);
        dl->AddRect(ImVec2(bx0, p.y + h * 0.14f), ImVec2(right + gap * 0.4f, p.y + h * 0.86f), ac, r * 0.6f, 0, 1.0f);
        float tx = right - gap * 0.4f - aw;
        dl->AddTriangleFilled(ImVec2(tx - aw * 0.75f, cy - aw * 0.45f), ImVec2(tx + aw * 0.75f, cy - aw * 0.45f),
                              ImVec2(tx, cy + aw * 0.55f), ac);
        right = tx - aw - gap;
        if (step == 1 || step == -1) step = 0;
    }
    if (!value.empty()) {
        float vw = ImGui::CalcTextSize(value.c_str()).x, vx = right - vw;
        dl->AddText(ImVec2(vx, ty), dim ? IM_COL32(110, 110, 102, 255) : changed ? IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 255)
                                                                                 : IM_COL32(205, 205, 195, 255), value.c_str());
    }
    ImGui::PopID();
    return step;
}

bool opt_toggle(const char *label, bool *v, bool def, const char *desc) {
    if (!row(label, tr(*v ? "On" : "Off"), *v != def, desc)) return false;  // (any step flips it)
    *v = !*v;
    return true;
}

bool opt_choice(const char *label, int *v, const char *const *names, int n, int def, const char *desc, bool wrap) {
    int cur = *v >= 0 && *v < n ? *v : 0;
    int step = row(label, tr(names[cur]), cur != def, desc, true, true);
    if (!step) return false;
    int nv = cur + (step == 2 ? 1 : step);
    nv = wrap ? (nv + n) % n : nv < 0 ? 0 : nv >= n ? n - 1 : nv;
    if (nv == cur) return false;
    *v = nv;
    return true;
}

static bool list_row(const char *label, int *v, const char *const *names, int n, int def, const char *desc, bool *picked,
                     bool drop) {
    int cur = *v >= 0 && *v < n ? *v : 0;
    int step = row(label, tr(names[cur]), cur != def, desc, true, !drop, drop);
    *picked = false;
    ImVec2 a = ImGui::GetItemRectMin(), b = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
    ImGui::PushID(label);
    static bool test_open;  // (test: SAVAGEWIND_OPT_LIST=<label> opens that list once)
    const char *t = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_OPT_LIST");
    if (step == 2 || (t && !test_open && !strcmp(t, label) && (test_open = true))) ImGui::OpenPopup("##list");
    int nv = step == 1 || step == -1 ? (cur + step + n) % n : cur;
    // the list below the row (above it when there's no room), the current value selected and in view
    float rows_h = ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing() * 12;
    bool up = b.y + rows_h > ImGui::GetMainViewport()->WorkPos.y + ImGui::GetMainViewport()->WorkSize.y;
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(up ? ImVec2(a.x, a.y) : ImVec2(a.x, b.y), ImGuiCond_Appearing, ImVec2(0, up ? 1.0f : 0.0f));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(ImVec2(b.x - a.x, 0), ImVec2(b.x - a.x, rows_h));
    ImVec4 bg = ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_PopupBg);
    bg.w = 1;  // (opaque: the rows below don't show through)
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_PopupBg, bg);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kGold));
    bool open = ImGui::BeginPopup("##list");
    ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
    if (open) {
        bool appearing = ImGui::IsWindowAppearing();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ImGui::PushID(i);
            if (ImGui::Selectable(tr(names[i]), i == cur)) nv = i, *picked = true;
            if (i == cur && appearing) ImGui::SetItemDefaultFocus(), ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
    ImGui::PopID();
    if (nv == cur) return false;
    *v = nv;
    return true;
}

bool opt_list(const char *label, int *v, const char *const *names, int n, int def, const char *desc, bool *picked) {
    return list_row(label, v, names, n, def, desc, picked, false);
}

bool opt_dropdown(const char *label, int *v, const char *const *names, int n, int def, const char *desc) {
    bool picked;
    return list_row(label, v, names, n, def, desc, &picked, true);
}

bool opt_choice_avail(const char *label, int *v, int *shown, const char *const *names, const bool *avail, int n, int def,
                      const char *desc) {
    int cur = *v >= 0 && *v < n ? *v : 0;
    if (*shown < 0 || *shown >= n || (avail[*shown] && *shown != cur)) *shown = cur;  // (changed elsewhere)
    int s = *shown;
    g_value_dim = !avail[s];
    int step = row(label, tr(names[s]), s != def, desc, true, true);
    if (!step) return false;
    s = (s + (step == 2 ? 1 : step) + n) % n;
    *shown = s;
    if (!avail[s] || s == cur) return false;
    *v = s;
    return true;
}

bool opt_slider(const char *label, float *v, float lo, float hi, float step, float def, const char *fmt, const char *desc) {
    char buf[32];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, tr(fmt), *v);
    int s = row(label, buf, fabsf(*v - def) > step * 0.01f, desc, true, true);
    if (!s) return false;
    float eps = step * 0.01f, n = roundf(*v / step) * step + (s == 2 ? step : s * step);
    if (s == 2 && n > hi + eps) n = lo;  // (A / click past the top wraps to the bottom; left / right stop at the ends)
    *v = n < lo ? lo : n > hi ? hi : n;
    return true;
}

bool opt_int(const char *label, int *v, int lo, int hi, int step, int def, const char *fmt, const char *desc,
             const char *lo_name) {
    char buf[48];
    if (lo_name && *v == lo) snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", tr(lo_name));
    else snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, tr(fmt), *v);
    int s = row(label, buf, *v != def, desc, true, true);
    if (!s) return false;
    int d = s == 2 ? step : s * step * (g_held && hi - lo > 40 * step ? 10 : 1);
    int n = *v + d;
    if (s == 2 && n > hi) n = lo;  // (A / click past the top wraps; left / right stop at the ends)
    n = n < lo ? lo : n > hi ? hi : n;
    if (n == *v) return false;
    *v = n;
    return true;
}

void opt_desc_image(unsigned long long tex, int w, int h) {
    g_img_live.push_back(tex);
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered()) g_img_hover = {tex, w, h};
    if (ImGui::IsItemFocused() && ImGui::GetCurrentContext()->NavCursorVisible) g_img_focus = {tex, w, h};
}

bool opt_button(const char *label, const char *desc) { return row(label, "", false, desc) == 2; }

bool opt_radio(const char *label, bool selected, const char *desc) {
    bool off = g_next_disabled;
    bool chosen = row(label, "", false, desc) == 2;
    ImVec2 a = ImGui::GetItemRectMin(), b = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
    float r = ImGui::GetFontSize() * 0.32f, cx = b.x - 16 * g_scale - r, cy = (a.y + b.y) * 0.5f;
    ImDrawList *dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    ImU32 col = off ? IM_COL32(150, 150, 140, 255) : selected ? kGold : IM_COL32(205, 205, 195, 255);
    dl->AddCircle(ImVec2(cx, cy), r, col, 0, 2.0f);
    if (selected) dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(cx, cy), r * 0.55f, col);
    return chosen && !selected;
}

bool opt_action(const char *label, const char *value, const char *desc, bool upper) {
    return row(label, value ? value : "", false, desc, upper) == 2;
}

static ImGuiID g_text_editing;  // the text row turned into a field (one at a time)
bool opt_text_editing(const char *label) { return g_text_editing && g_text_editing == ImGui::GetID(label); }

bool opt_text(const char *label, char *buf, size_t cap, const char *hint, const char *desc) {
    ImGuiID &editing = g_text_editing;
    static int focus;        // frames left to give it the keyboard focus
    ImGuiID id = ImGui::GetID(label);
    if (editing != id) {
        if (row(label, buf[0] ? buf : (hint ? tr(hint) : ""), false, desc) == 2) editing = id, focus = 2;
        return false;
    }
    ImGui::PushID(label);
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
    if (focus > 0) ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(), focus--;
    bool done = ui_input_text("##text", buf, cap, ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue, hint, label);
    if (ImGui::IsItemFocused()) g_desc_focus = desc ? tr(desc) : "";
    if (done || ui_input_text_cancelled() || (focus == 0 && !ImGui::IsItemActive() && !osk_is_open())) editing = 0;
    ImGui::PopID();
    return done;
}

void opt_end(void) {
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    if (const char *t = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_OPT_SCROLL")) ImGui::SetScrollY(ImGui::GetScrollMaxY() * (float)atof(t));  // (test)
    ImGui::EndChild();
    // the description: the hovered row (mouse) wins, else the selected one (controller), else the last shown
    if (!g_desc_hover.empty()) g_desc_shown = g_desc_hover, g_img_shown = g_img_hover;
    else if (!g_desc_focus.empty()) g_desc_shown = g_desc_focus, g_img_shown = g_img_focus;
    else if (g_desc_shown.empty()) g_desc_shown = g_desc_first, g_img_shown = DescImage();
    bool live = false;  // (a picture whose row is gone may have been freed)
    for (unsigned long long t : g_img_live) live |= t == g_img_shown.tex;
    if (!live) g_img_shown = DescImage();
    ImGui::SameLine(0, 0);
    ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos(), avail = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail();
    float gap = 24 * g_scale;
    ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddLine(ImVec2(p.x + gap * 0.5f, p.y), ImVec2(p.x + gap * 0.5f, p.y + avail.y),
                                        IM_COL32(236, 194, 84, 110), 1.0f);
    ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(p.x + gap, p.y));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(14 * g_scale, 6 * g_scale));
    ImGui::BeginChild("##desc", ImVec2(0, avail.y), ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav);
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    if (g_img_shown.tex && g_img_shown.w > 0) {  // the picture of the selected row, above its text
        ImVec2 at = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        ImVec2 room = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail();
        float w = room.x, h = w * g_img_shown.h / g_img_shown.w, most = room.y * 0.45f;  // (the text below has to fit)
        if (h > most) w = w * most / h, h = most, at.x += (room.x - w) * 0.5f;
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(room.x, h + 8 * g_scale));
        ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddImageRounded((ImTextureID)g_img_shown.tex, at, ImVec2(at.x + w, at.y + h), ImVec2(0, 0),
                                                    ImVec2(1, 1), IM_COL32_WHITE, 8 * g_scale);
    }
    ImGui::SetWindowFontScale(1.3f);  // (the description reads at a glance)
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(g_desc_shown.c_str());
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    ImGui::SetWindowFontScale(1.0f);
    ImGui::EndChild();
    ImGui::PopID();
}

```

`runtime/ui/osk.h`:

```h
// On-screen keyboard (ImGui) for controllers, shared by the game's name entry (runtime/ui/menu.mm keyboard_draw,
// runtime/hle/swkbd.c) and every text field in our menus (in-game overlay, start screen): ui_input_text.
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include "imgui.h"

// A text field. Activated with a controller (A on it) it opens the on-screen keyboard and the confirmed text goes
// back into buf; with a mouse / keyboard it's typed into directly. Returns true when the text changed (typed, or OK
// on the on-screen keyboard; with ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue: Enter / OK). title heads the keyboard.
bool ui_input_text(const char *label, char *buf, size_t size, ImGuiInputTextFlags flags = 0, const char *hint = NULL,
                   const char *title = NULL);
// true (once) after the on-screen keyboard of the field just drawn with ui_input_text was cancelled
bool ui_input_text_cancelled(void);

// Once per frame, after the rest of the UI, at the root (outside any window), in the context the field was drawn in.
void osk_draw(ImFont *big, float scale);
bool osk_is_open(void);
void osk_cancel(void);  // (menu closed / reboot: drop it, the field keeps its text)

// Something is being typed in the current context: a text field has keyboard focus or the on-screen keyboard is up.
// Menu shortcuts (back, tabs, close) must not fire then: the keys are text.
bool ui_text_busy(void);

// The typed text (big font) and the key grid, drawn into the current window: d-pad / stick move, A types, B deletes,
// Start / + OK; typed keys work too (Enter OK, Esc cancel). text: ASCII, at most max_chars. Returns 1 OK, -1 cancel,
// 0 still typing.
int osk_keys(char *text, size_t cap, int max_chars, bool appearing, float scale, ImFont *big, bool upper_first = true);

```

`runtime/ui/osk.mm`:

```mm
// On-screen keyboard (see osk.h). A controller has no keys to type with, and ImGui only starts text entry on a
// gamepad's Y (A on a field did nothing): A on any of our text fields opens this keyboard instead.
//
// One keyboard at a time (only one ImGui UI runs: start screen or in-game overlay, one thread each). It is a modal
// popup at the root of the UI, so the menu behind sees "a popup is open" and B / Esc / L / R don't act on it.
#include <ctype.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <string>

#include "i18n.h"
#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"
#include "osk.h"

static struct {
    int open;                        // a field's keyboard is up
    ImGuiID field;                   // the field it types for
    char *buf;                       // ... and its buffer (static in every caller: written on OK)
    size_t size;
    ImGuiInputTextFlags flags;
    char text[128], title[96];
    bool appearing, nav_kbd_off;
    ImGuiID done_field;              // answered: reported by that field's next ui_input_text
    int done, done_frame;            // 1 OK, -1 cancelled; when (a field gone by then never hears of it)
} s;
static std::atomic<bool> s_cancel_req{false};
static bool s_cancelled_now;

bool osk_is_open(void) { return s.open != 0; }
void osk_cancel(void) { s_cancel_req = true; }

bool ui_text_busy(void) {
    ImGuiContext *g = ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    return s.open || (g && (g->IO.WantTextInput || g->WantTextInputNextFrame == 1));
}

bool ui_input_text_cancelled(void) { return s_cancelled_now; }

// (test) SAVAGEWIND_FIELD_FOCUS=<label>:<n>[:edit]: the n-th time field <label> is drawn it gets the nav cursor (a
// controller's A - SAVAGEWIND_HOST_INPUT sdlpad:east - then opens the keyboard); :edit starts typing in it instead.
static int test_focus(const char *label) {
    static const char *spec = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FIELD_FOCUS");
    static int count;
    if (!spec) return 0;
    const char *c = strchr(spec, ':');
    if (!c || strncmp(spec, label, (size_t)(c - spec)) || label[c - spec]) return 0;
    if (++count != atoi(c + 1)) return 0;
    return strstr(c + 1, ":edit") ? 2 : 1;
}

bool ui_input_text(const char *label, char *buf, size_t size, ImGuiInputTextFlags flags, const char *hint, const char *title) {
    ImGuiContext &g = *GImGui;
    int test = test_focus(label);
    if (test == 2) ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
    bool r = hint ? ImGui::InputTextWithHint(label, hint, buf, size, flags) : ImGui::InputText(label, buf, size, flags);
    ImGuiID id = ImGui::GetItemID();
    if (test == 1) { ImGui::FocusItem(); ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(true); }
    // (and in view for the screenshots for a few frames: the focus' own scroll misses on a NavFlattened page)
    static ImGuiID in_view_id;
    static int in_view;
    if (test) in_view_id = id, in_view = 10;
    if (in_view_id == id && in_view > 0 && in_view--) ImGui::SetScrollHereY(0.5f);
    if (test) fprintf(stderr, "[osk] test: %s field %s\n", test == 2 ? "typing in" : "cursor on", label);
    static std::string last;  // (test runs: what the field holds, as it changes)
    const char *tf = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_FIELD_FOCUS");
    if (tf && !strncmp(tf, label, strlen(label)) && tf[strlen(label)] == ':' && last != buf) { last = buf; fprintf(stderr, "[osk] test: %s = \"%s\"%s\n", label, buf, g.ActiveId == id ? " (typing)" : ""); }
    s_cancelled_now = false;
    if (s.done && s.done_field == id && ImGui::GetFrameCount() - s.done_frame <= 1) {
        if (s.done > 0) r = true;
        else s_cancelled_now = true;
        s.done = 0, s.done_field = 0;
    }
    // activated from the controller: A (ImGui's "activate", which leaves a text field alone), Y (its "input"), or a
    // focus request (SetKeyboardFocusHere) while the controller drives the menu. A mouse click types directly.
    bool by_nav = g.NavActivateId == id || (ImGui::IsItemActivated() && g.ActiveIdSource != ImGuiInputSource_Mouse);
    if (by_nav && g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad && !s.open && !(flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly)) {
        if (g.ActiveId == id) ImGui::ClearActiveID();
        s.open = 1, s.appearing = true, s.done = 0;
        s.field = id, s.buf = buf, s.size = size, s.flags = flags;
        snprintf(s.text, sizeof s.text, "%s", buf);
        snprintf(s.title, sizeof s.title, "%s", tr(title ? title : hint ? hint : "Enter text"));
        r = false;
    }
    return r;
}

int osk_keys(char *text, size_t cap, int max_chars, bool appearing, float scale, ImFont *big, bool upper_first) {
    static bool upper = true;
    if (appearing) upper = upper_first;
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    // B deletes: owning it keeps ImGui's nav cancel (which drops the cursor off the keys) from seeing it
    ImGuiID own = ImGui::GetID("##oskkeys");
    ImGui::SetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, own);
    if (max_chars <= 0 || max_chars > (int)cap - 1) max_chars = (int)cap - 1;
    int len = (int)strlen(text), r = 0;
    auto add = [&](char ch) { if (len < max_chars) text[len++] = ch, text[len] = 0; };
    auto del = [&]() { if (len > 0) text[--len] = 0; };

    // typed on a keyboard while it's up: straight into the text
    for (ImWchar c : io.InputQueueCharacters) if (c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7f) add((char)c);
    io.InputQueueCharacters.resize(0);
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Backspace)) del();
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Enter, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_KeypadEnter, false)) r = 1;
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false)) r = -1;
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadStart, false)) r = 1;
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat, own)) del();

    ImGui::PushFont(big);
    ImGui::Text("%s_", text);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    static const char *rows_u[] = {"ABCDEFGHIJ", "KLMNOPQRST", "UVWXYZ-.'!", "0123456789"};
    static const char *rows_l[] = {"abcdefghij", "klmnopqrst", "uvwxyz-.'!", "0123456789"};
    const char **rows = upper ? rows_u : rows_l;
    float k = 70 * scale;
    for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++) {
        for (int i = 0; rows[row][i]; i++) {
            if (i) ImGui::SameLine();
            char lbl[8] = {rows[row][i], 0};
            if (appearing && row == 0 && i == 0) {  // (cursor shown: else the first A only reveals it)
                ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
                ImGui::SetNavCursorVisible(true);
            }
            if (ImGui::Button(lbl, ImVec2(k, k))) add(rows[row][i]);
        }
    }
    if (ImGui::Button(upper ? "abc" : "ABC", ImVec2(k * 2, k))) upper = !upper;
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button(tr("Space"), ImVec2(k * 3, k)) && len > 0) add(' ');
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button(tr("Delete"), ImVec2(k * 2, k))) del();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button(tr("Cancel"), ImVec2(k * 2, k))) r = -1;
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button(tr("OK"), ImVec2(k * 2, k))) r = 1;
    ImGui::TextDisabled(tr("A  type      B  delete      Start / +  OK      (%d / %d)"), len, max_chars);
    return r;
}

// close it (and give the keyboard back to ImGui's navigation)
static void finish(int result) {
    if (result > 0 && s.buf && s.size) {
        if (s.flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsUppercase)
            for (char *p = s.text; *p; p++) *p = (char)toupper((unsigned char)*p);
        snprintf(s.buf, s.size, "%s", s.text);
    }
    s.done = result, s.done_field = s.field, s.done_frame = ImGui::GetFrameCount();
    s.open = 0, s.buf = NULL;
    if (s.nav_kbd_off) ImGui::GetIO().ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard;
    s.nav_kbd_off = false;
}

void osk_draw(ImFont *big, float scale) {
    bool cancel = s_cancel_req.exchange(false);
    if (!s.open) return;
    ImGuiIO &io = ImGui::GetIO();
    ImGuiContext &g = *GImGui;
    if (!ImGui::IsPopupOpen("##osk")) {
        ImGui::OpenPopup("##osk");
        s.appearing = true;
        // keys typed while it's up are text: Space / Enter / arrows must not also press the focused key
        if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard) { io.ConfigFlags &= ~ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard; s.nav_kbd_off = true; }
    }
    g.WantTextInputNextFrame = 1;  // (typing stays on: the backends keep text input enabled; ui_text_busy)
    float w = fminf(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.9f, 1100 * scale);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(io.DisplaySize.x * 0.5f, io.DisplaySize.y * 0.5f), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, 0), ImGuiCond_Always);
    if (!ImGui::BeginPopupModal("##osk", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove |
                                                   ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize)) {
        finish(-1);
        return;
    }
    ImGui::PushFont(big);
    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1), "%s", s.title);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    int max = (int)(s.size < sizeof s.text ? s.size : sizeof s.text) - 1;
    int r = cancel ? -1 : osk_keys(s.text, sizeof s.text, max, s.appearing, scale, big);
    s.appearing = false;
    if (r) {
        ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        finish(r);
    }
    ImGui::EndPopup();
}
```

```mm
#include "quick_hint_font.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"
#include "i18n.h"
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdio.h>
extern "C" {
#include "../rt.h"
#include "../services/archive.h"
#include "../nvn/tegra.h"
#include "../nvn/glyphs.h"
}

namespace {
struct Bitmap {
    std::vector<unsigned char> data;
    bool has(size_t o, size_t n) const { return o <= data.size() && n <= data.size() - o; }
    unsigned u16(size_t o) const { return data[o] | (unsigned)data[o + 1] << 8; }
    unsigned u32(size_t o) const { return u16(o) | u16(o + 2) << 16; }
    unsigned glyph(unsigned ch) const {
        size_t p = u32(0x30);
        for (int hop = 0; p && hop < 128; hop++) {
            if (p < 8 || !has(p - 8, 26) || memcmp(data.data() + p - 8, "CMAP", 4)) break;
            unsigned lo = u32(p), hi = u32(p + 4), method = u16(p + 8);
            if (lo > hi || hi > 0xffff) break;
            if (ch >= lo && ch <= hi) {
                if (method == 0) return u16(p + 16) + ch - lo;
                if (method == 1 && has(p + 16, (size_t)(hi - lo + 1) * 2)) return u16(p + 16 + (ch - lo) * 2);
                if (method == 2) {
                    unsigned count = u16(p + 16);
                    if (!has(p + 18, count * 4)) break;
                    for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; i++)
                        if (u16(p + 18 + i * 4) == ch) return u16(p + 20 + i * 4);
                }
                return 0xffff;
            }
            p = u32(p + 12);
        }
        return 0xffff;
    }
    bool width(unsigned gi, int &left, unsigned &advance) const {
        size_t p = u32(0x2c);
        for (int hop = 0; p && hop < 128; hop++) {
            if (p < 8 || !has(p - 8, 16) || memcmp(data.data() + p - 8, "CWDH", 4)) break;
            unsigned lo = u16(p), hi = u16(p + 2);
            size_t at = p + 8 + (size_t)(gi >= lo ? gi - lo : 0) * 3;
            if (gi >= lo && gi <= hi && has(at, 3)) {
                left = (signed char)data[at]; advance = data[at + 2]; return true;
            }
            p = u32(p + 4);
        }
        return false;
    }
};
struct Cell { int rect; std::vector<unsigned char> pixels; };

// BC4 coverage at a single texel in a linear sheet.
unsigned char coverage(const unsigned char *sheet, unsigned w, unsigned x, unsigned y) {
    const unsigned char *b = sheet + ((size_t)(y / 4) * (w / 4) + x / 4) * 8;
    unsigned char pal[8] = {b[0], b[1]};
    if (b[0] > b[1]) for (unsigned i = 1; i < 7; i++) pal[i + 1] = ((7 - i) * b[0] + i * b[1]) / 7;
    else {
        for (unsigned i = 1; i < 5; i++) pal[i + 1] = ((5 - i) * b[0] + i * b[1]) / 5;
        pal[7] = 255;
    }
    uint64_t bits = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) bits |= (uint64_t)b[2 + i] << (i * 8);
    return pal[(bits >> (3 * ((y % 4) * 4 + x % 4))) & 7];
}

ImFont *append(ImFontAtlas *atlas, const unsigned char *src, size_t size,
               const std::vector<unsigned> &chars, std::vector<Cell> &cells, bool buttons = false) {
    Bitmap f; f.data.assign(src, src + size);
    if (!f.has(0, 0x60) || memcmp(src, "FFNT\xff\xfe", 6) || f.u32(8) != 0x04010000 || f.u32(0xc) != size) return nullptr;
    size_t t = f.u32(0x28);
    if (t < 8 || !f.has(t - 8, 32) || memcmp(src + t - 8, "TGLP", 4)) return nullptr;
    unsigned cw = src[t], ch = src[t + 1], sheets = src[t + 2];
    unsigned cols = f.u16(t + 12), rows = f.u16(t + 14), w = f.u16(t + 16), h = f.u16(t + 18);
    size_t bntx = f.u32(t + 20);
    if (!cw || !ch || !cols || !rows || !sheets || sheets > 16 || !w || !h || w > 2048 || h > 2048 ||
        w % 4 || h % 4 || cols * (cw + 1) > w || rows * (ch + 1) > h ||
        !f.has(bntx, 0x20) || memcmp(src + bntx, "BNTX", 4)) return nullptr;
    // Switch 4.1 font sheets have a single BNTX texture, with a mip pointer
    // relative to the BNTX base. Validate its format and bounds before decoding.
    size_t brti = 0;
    for (size_t p = bntx; f.has(p, 0x78) && p < bntx + 0x1000; p += 4)
        if (!memcmp(src + p, "BRTI", 4)) { brti = p; break; }
    if (!brti || f.u32(brti + 0x1c) != 0x1d01 || f.u32(brti + 0x24) != w || f.u32(brti + 0x28) != h) return nullptr;
    size_t ptr = bntx + f.u32(brti + 0x70);
    if (!f.has(ptr, 8)) return nullptr;
    size_t start = bntx + f.u32(ptr), sheet_size = (size_t)w * h / 2;
    if (!f.has(start, sheet_size * sheets)) return nullptr;
    std::vector<unsigned char> linear(sheet_size * sheets);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sheets; i++)
        tegra_deswizzle(src + start + i * sheet_size, linear.data() + i * sheet_size,
                       w / 4, h / 4, 1, 8, tegra_default_block_height_log2(h / 4), 0);
    // Use exactly the game's icon policy, including raw Switch bindings,
    // keyboard/mouse and controller families. Modified sheets are kept intact
    // by glyphs_apply's content check, just as in the guest renderer.
    if (buttons && sheets == 1)
        glyphs_apply((uintptr_t)(src + start), (uintptr_t)src, (uintptr_t)src + size,
                     0x49, w, h, linear.data(), w / 4, h / 4);
    ImFontConfig cfg;
    cfg.SizePixels = ch;
    snprintf(cfg.Name, sizeof cfg.Name, "quick_selector_bitmap");
    ImFont *font = atlas->AddFontDefault(&cfg);
    for (unsigned code : chars) {
        unsigned gi = f.glyph(code), sheet = gi / (cols * rows), local = gi % (cols * rows), advance;
        int left;
        if (gi == 0xffff || sheet >= sheets || !f.width(gi, left, advance)) continue;
        unsigned x0 = local % cols * (cw + 1), y0 = local / cols * (ch + 1);
        Cell cell;
        cell.rect = atlas->AddCustomRectFontGlyph(font, (ImWchar)code, cw, ch, advance, ImVec2((float)left, 0));
        cell.pixels.resize(cw * ch);
        for (unsigned y = 0; y < ch; y++) for (unsigned x = 0; x < cw; x++)
            cell.pixels[y * cw + x] = coverage(linear.data() + sheet * sheet_size, w, x0 + x, h - 1 - y0 - y);
        cells.push_back(std::move(cell));
    }
    return font;
}
} // namespace

void quick_hint_fonts_load(ImFontAtlas *atlas, ImFont **text, ImFont **buttons) {
    *text = *buttons = nullptr;
    if (!g_romfs_dir) return;
    char path[1200];
    const char *overlay = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_ROMFS_OVERLAY");
    FILE *file = nullptr;
    if (overlay && *overlay) {
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/Font/Font_EU.sbfarc", overlay);
        file = fopen(path, "rb");
    }
    if (!file) {
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/Font/Font_EU.sbfarc", g_romfs_dir);
        file = fopen(path, "rb");
    }
    if (!file) return;
    fseek(file, 0, SEEK_END); long length = ftell(file); rewind(file);
    if (length <= 0 || length > 16 * 1024 * 1024) { fclose(file); return; }
    std::vector<unsigned char> packed(length);
    bool read = fread(packed.data(), 1, length, file) == (size_t)length; fclose(file);
    if (!read) return;
    size_t size;
    unsigned char *archive = yaz0_unpack(packed.data(), packed.size(), &size);
    if (!archive) return;
    std::vector<unsigned> chars;
    for (unsigned c = 32; c < 127; c++) chars.push_back(c);
    for (const char *label : {tr("Sort"), tr("Drop"), tr("Back")}) {
        while (*label) {
            unsigned code; int n = ImTextCharFromUtf8(&code, label, nullptr);
            if (!n) break;
            label += n;
            if (code >= 127 && code <= 0xffff && std::find(chars.begin(), chars.end(), code) == chars.end()) chars.push_back(code);
        }
    }
    std::vector<unsigned> icons;
    for (unsigned c = 0xe040; c <= 0xe043; c++) icons.push_back(c);
    std::vector<Cell> cells;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        uint32_t base, lo, hi;
        if (sarc_find(archive, size, i ? "External_00.bffnt" : "Normal_00.bffnt", &base, &lo, &hi) >= 0)
            *(i ? buttons : text) = append(atlas, archive + base + lo, hi - lo, i ? icons : chars, cells, i != 0);
    }
    free(archive);
    if (cells.empty()) return;
    unsigned char *pixels; int w, h;
    atlas->GetTexDataAsAlpha8(&pixels, &w, &h);
    for (const Cell &cell : cells) {
        const ImFontAtlasCustomRect *r = atlas->GetCustomRectByIndex(cell.rect);
        for (unsigned y = 0; y < r->Height; y++)
            memcpy(pixels + (r->Y + y) * w + r->X, cell.pixels.data() + y * r->Width, r->Width);
    }
    LOG("[quick-hint] loaded game bitmap fonts (%zu glyphs)\n", cells.size());
}
```
