`runtime/ui/saves_tab.mm`:

```mm
// The start screen's Saves tab (Settings, menu.mm tab 3; never in the in-game menu: the game must not be running while
// its saves change). It lists the slots of the save folder with their pictures, imports a Wii U / Cemu save
// (runtime/services/save_convert.c), backs the saves up and opens their folder.
//
// An import runs on a worker thread, in two steps with the player's yes between them: the save is converted into a new
// staging folder next to the save folder (the saves are not touched), then, once confirmed, the save folder is moved
// whole to a dated backup folder and the staged one takes its place. Nothing is deleted at any point. Close to 200
// small files and the game's flag tables: well under a second on an SSD, but reading Bootup.pack can take a few on a
// slow disk, so it is not done on the UI thread.
//
// Save profiles (runtime/services/save_profiles.h) are the first section: the profile in use is the save folder everything
// below works on. Their operations (switch, create, copy, rename, delete) run on the same worker, one at a time.
//
// Dates come from the file times of caption.sav (when the game wrote the slot): the save has no date of its own that
// is known without the game's data. The play time is caption.sav's PlayTime flag when it has one, else not shown.
#ifdef __APPLE__
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#endif
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "i18n.h"
#include "imgui.h"
#include "option_rows.h"
#include "saves_tab.h"

#include "imageload.h"  // (stb_image: the pictures are JPEG)

extern "C" {
#include "../paths.h"
#include "../services/save_convert.h"
#include "../services/save_profiles.h"
#include "../settings.h"
SDL_Window *ui_window(void);
#ifdef __APPLE__
void *ui_metal_device(void);
#else
uint64_t vk_imgui_texture_rgba(const void *rgba, int w, int h);  // runtime/nvn/vulkan/imgui_glue.cpp
void vk_imgui_texture_free(uint64_t tex);
#endif
}
void reveal_folder(const std::string &dir);  // launcher.mm: Explorer / Finder / the file manager

namespace {

enum Phase { IDLE, WORKING, CONFIRM, DONE, LOADING };  // of the worker; DONE: the result stays shown until the next job
enum Kind { NONE, IMPORTED, IMPORT_FAILED, BACKED_UP, BACKUP_FAILED, CANCELLED, EXPORTED, EXPORT_FAILED, PROFILE_DONE, PROFILE_FAILED };  // (new kinds at the end: tools/test_saves_tab.cpp prints the numbers)
enum Job { JOB_CONVERT, JOB_INSTALL, JOB_BACKUP, JOB_LIST, JOB_EXPORT_STAGE, JOB_EXPORT_INSTALL, JOB_PROFILE };
enum ProfileOp { PO_SWITCH, PO_CREATE, PO_COPY, PO_RENAME, PO_DELETE };

std::string g_game_root;                // <root>/romfs/Pack/Bootup.pack has the flag tables
std::atomic<int> g_phase{IDLE};         // written by the worker, read here (release / acquire: the fields below follow it)
pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
std::string g_picked_import, g_picked_export, g_picked_save_dir;  // the folders the dialogs gave (SDL calls back on any thread)
pthread_t g_worker;
bool g_joinable;                       // only the UI / exit thread starts and joins workers
std::atomic<bool> g_cancel{false};
std::atomic<bool> g_dialog{false};      // the folder dialog is open

// the last job's outcome
Kind g_kind = NONE;
int g_code;                             // ScCode of a failure
std::string g_detail;                   // its variable part (a path or a reason)
std::string g_backup;                   // the backup folder made (or to be made)
std::string g_export_dst;               // the destination folder for export
ScReport g_rep;                         // an import/export: the slots and the flag counts
ScStage *g_stage;                       // converted, waiting for the player's yes
std::string g_stage_dir;
bool g_had_saves;                       // the save folder is there: the import backs it up
int g_warnings, g_files;
bool g_seen_done = true, g_popup_shown;

// the slots in the save folder
struct Thumb { uint64_t tex = 0; int w = 0, h = 0; bool tried = false; };
std::vector<ScSlot> g_slots;
std::vector<ScSlot> g_loaded_slots;      // worker writes; the UI takes it after the phase is published
bool g_slots_ready;
int g_list_return_phase;
ScRecovery g_recovery;                  // worker writes it with the slot list
ScCode g_cleanup_code = SC_OK;
std::string g_cleanup_detail;
std::vector<Thumb> g_thumbs;
// the profiles
std::vector<SpProfile> g_profiles;
std::vector<SpProfile> g_loaded_profiles;  // worker writes; the UI takes them with the slots
std::string g_sel;                       // the profile the actions below the list work on (empty: the one in use)
std::string g_loaded_sel;                // worker: the profile to select after its job
bool g_loaded_sel_set;
char g_pname[SP_NAME_MAX + 1];           // the name field
ProfileOp g_pop;                         // the last profile job
SpCode g_pcode;
std::string g_pname_done, g_pdetail;     // its names (what it was done to) and the system's reason
uint64_t g_pbytes;
bool g_delete_open, g_delete_popup_shown;  // the delete confirmation
std::string g_delete_name;
int g_delete_slots;
int g_last_frame = -100;                // the frame the tab was last drawn in: a gap means it was left and is back

std::string save_dir() {
    char buf[1100];
    sp_active_save_dir(NULL, buf, sizeof buf);  // (the same folder the game would use: SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR, else the profile in use)
    std::string d = buf;
    while (d.size() > 1 && (d.back() == '/' || d.back() == '\\')) d.pop_back();
    return d;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ pictures
#ifdef __APPLE__
std::vector<id<MTLTexture>> g_mtl;  // (ImGui only holds the pointer)
#endif

uint64_t texture_rgba(const unsigned char *px, int w, int h) {
#ifdef __APPLE__
    id<MTLDevice> dev = (__bridge id<MTLDevice>)ui_metal_device();
    MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm
                                                                                   width:w height:h mipmapped:NO];
    id<MTLTexture> t = [dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td];
    if (!t) return 0;
    [t replaceRegion:MTLRegionMake2D(0, 0, w, h) mipmapLevel:0 withBytes:px bytesPerRow:(NSUInteger)w * 4];
    g_mtl.push_back(t);
    return (uint64_t)(intptr_t)(__bridge void *)t;
#else
    return vk_imgui_texture_rgba(px, w, h);
#endif
}

void texture_free(uint64_t tex) {
#ifdef __APPLE__
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_mtl.size(); i++)
        if ((uint64_t)(intptr_t)(__bridge void *)g_mtl[i] == tex) { g_mtl.erase(g_mtl.begin() + i); break; }
#else
    vk_imgui_texture_free(tex);
#endif
}

void free_thumbs() {
    for (Thumb &t : g_thumbs)
        if (t.tex) texture_free(t.tex);
    g_thumbs.clear();
}

std::string slot_picture(const ScSlot &s) { return save_dir() + "/save_0/" + s.name + "/caption.jpg"; }

// One picture per frame, so a long list doesn't hold the frame up
void load_one_thumb() {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_slots.size(); i++) {
        Thumb &t = g_thumbs[i];
        if (t.tried || !g_slots[i].has_picture) continue;
        t.tried = true;
        std::string path = slot_picture(g_slots[i]);
        int w, h;
        if (!rt_image_info(path.c_str(), &w, &h) || w <= 0 || h <= 0 || w > 4096 || h > 4096) return;
        unsigned char *px = rt_image_rgba(path.c_str(), &w, &h);
        if (!px) return;
        t.tex = texture_rgba(px, w, h);
        t.w = w, t.h = h;
        rt_image_free(px);
        return;
    }
}

void read_slots() {  // (worker only: no UI or texture calls)
    ScReport r = {};
    g_cleanup_code = sc_cleanup_stages(save_dir().c_str(), g_stage ? g_stage_dir.c_str() : NULL, &g_recovery, &r);
    g_cleanup_detail = r.detail;
    ScSlot *v = NULL;
    int n = sc_list_slots((save_dir() + "/save_0").c_str(), &v);
    g_loaded_slots.clear();
    if (n) g_loaded_slots.assign(v, v + n);
    free(v);
    SpProfile *pv = NULL;
    int pn = sp_list(NULL, &pv);
    g_loaded_profiles.assign(pv, pv + pn);
    free(pv);
    g_slots_ready = true;
}

void take_slots() {
    free_thumbs();
    g_slots.swap(g_loaded_slots);
    g_loaded_slots.clear();
    g_thumbs.assign(g_slots.size(), Thumb());
    g_profiles.swap(g_loaded_profiles);
    g_loaded_profiles.clear();
    if (g_loaded_sel_set) g_sel = g_loaded_sel, g_loaded_sel_set = false;
    bool sel_ok = false;
    for (const SpProfile &p : g_profiles) sel_ok |= g_sel == p.name;
    if (!sel_ok) g_sel.clear();
    g_slots_ready = false;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the worker
struct Work { int what; std::string src, dst; ProfileOp op; };

bool cancel_work(void *) { return g_cancel.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

void *worker(void *p) {
    Work *w = (Work *)p;
    std::string save = save_dir();
    ScReport r = {};
    if (w->what == JOB_LIST) {
        read_slots();
        g_phase.store(g_list_return_phase, std::memory_order_release);
    } else if (w->what == JOB_PROFILE) {
        const char *a = w->src.c_str(), *b = w->dst.c_str();
        sp_cleanup(NULL);  // (what an interrupted copy or delete left)
        SpCode c = SP_OK;
        uint64_t bytes = 0;
        std::string select;  // what is selected afterwards
        switch (w->op) {
        case PO_SWITCH: c = sp_set_active(NULL, a), select = a; break;
        case PO_CREATE: c = sp_create(NULL, b), select = b; break;
        case PO_COPY: c = sp_copy(NULL, a, b, &bytes), select = c == SP_OK ? b : a; break;
        case PO_RENAME: c = sp_rename(NULL, a, b), select = c == SP_OK ? b : a; break;
        case PO_DELETE: c = sp_delete(NULL, a); break;
        }
        g_pop = w->op, g_pcode = c, g_pdetail = c == SP_OK ? "" : sp_detail(), g_pbytes = bytes;
        g_pname_done = w->op == PO_CREATE || w->op == PO_COPY || w->op == PO_RENAME ? w->dst : w->src;
        g_kind = c == SP_OK ? PROFILE_DONE : PROFILE_FAILED;
        g_loaded_sel = select, g_loaded_sel_set = true;
        read_slots();
        g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
    } else if (w->what == JOB_CONVERT) {
        ScFormat *fmt = NULL;
        ScStage *st = NULL;
        char stage[1100], backup[1100];
        sc_stage_path(save.c_str(), stage, sizeof stage);
        sc_backup_path(save.c_str(), backup, sizeof backup);
        ScLock *probe = NULL;  // (only a look: the install takes the lock again for the swap itself)
        bool in_use = sc_lock_take(save.c_str(), &probe) == SC_LOCK_BUSY;
        sc_lock_drop(probe);
        if (in_use) {  // (a game is running: not worth converting for)
            r.code = SC_IN_USE;
        } else if (cancel_work(NULL)) {
            r.code = SC_CANCELLED;
        } else if (rt_is_link(save.c_str()) || rt_is_link((save + "/save_0").c_str())) {
            r.code = SC_LINKED;
        } else if (sc_format_load((g_game_root + "/romfs/Pack/Bootup.pack").c_str(), &fmt, &r) == SC_OK) {
            ScCancel cancel = {cancel_work, NULL};
            sc_convert_cancel(w->src.c_str(), stage, fmt, 0, &cancel, &st, &r);
            sc_format_free(fmt);
        }
        g_code = r.code, g_detail = r.detail;
        g_rep = r;
        if (r.code == SC_OK) {
            g_stage = st, g_stage_dir = stage, g_backup = backup;
            struct stat sb;
            g_had_saves = stat(save.c_str(), &sb) == 0;
            g_phase.store(CONFIRM, std::memory_order_release);
        } else {
            g_kind = r.code == SC_CANCELLED ? CANCELLED : IMPORT_FAILED;
            g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
        }
    } else if (w->what == JOB_INSTALL) {
        ScCode c = sc_stage_install(g_stage, save.c_str(), g_backup.c_str(), &r);
        g_code = c, g_detail = r.detail, g_warnings = r.warnings;
        if (c == SC_OK) {
            g_stage = NULL;
            g_kind = IMPORTED;
            if (!g_had_saves) g_backup.clear();
        } else {
            if (c == SC_MOVED) sc_stage_keep(g_stage);  // (both copies must stay available for recovery)
            else sc_stage_discard(g_stage);
            g_stage = NULL;
            g_kind = IMPORT_FAILED;
        }
        sc_report_free(&r);
        if (c == SC_OK || c == SC_MOVED) read_slots();
        g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
    } else if (w->what == JOB_EXPORT_STAGE) {
        ScFormat *fmt = NULL;
        ScStage *st = NULL;
        char stage[1100];
        sc_stage_export_path(save.c_str(), stage, sizeof stage);
        ScLock *probe = NULL;
        bool in_use = sc_lock_take(save.c_str(), &probe) == SC_LOCK_BUSY;
        sc_lock_drop(probe);
        if (in_use) {
            r.code = SC_IN_USE;
        } else if (cancel_work(NULL)) {
            r.code = SC_CANCELLED;
        } else if (sc_format_load((g_game_root + "/romfs/Pack/Bootup.pack").c_str(), &fmt, &r) == SC_OK) {
            ScCancel cancel = {cancel_work, NULL};
            sc_convert_cancel(w->src.c_str(), stage, fmt, SC_TO_WIIU, &cancel, &st, &r);
            sc_format_free(fmt);
        }
        g_code = r.code, g_detail = r.detail;
        g_rep = r;
        if (r.code == SC_OK) {
            g_stage = st, g_stage_dir = stage, g_export_dst = w->dst;
            g_phase.store(CONFIRM, std::memory_order_release);
        } else {
            g_kind = r.code == SC_CANCELLED ? CANCELLED : EXPORT_FAILED;
            g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
        }
    } else if (w->what == JOB_EXPORT_INSTALL) {
        ScCode c = sc_stage_export(g_stage, w->dst.c_str(), &r);
        g_code = c, g_detail = r.detail, g_warnings = r.warnings;
        if (c == SC_OK) {
            g_stage = NULL;
            g_kind = EXPORTED;
        } else {
            sc_stage_discard(g_stage);
            g_stage = NULL;
            g_kind = EXPORT_FAILED;
        }
        sc_report_free(&r);
        g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
    } else {
        char backup[1100];
        sc_backup_path(save.c_str(), backup, sizeof backup);
        ScCode c = sc_backup(save.c_str(), backup, &r);
        g_code = c, g_detail = r.detail, g_files = r.n_written, g_backup = backup;
        g_kind = c == SC_OK ? BACKED_UP : BACKUP_FAILED;
        sc_report_free(&r);
        g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    delete w;
    return NULL;
}

// No worker takes g_lock or waits for the UI. Join without holding that lock, including on exit from the launcher.
void join_worker() {
    if (g_joinable) pthread_join(g_worker, NULL), g_joinable = false;
}

void drop_stage_at_exit() {
    g_cancel.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);  // conversion can stop between files; installation always finishes
    join_worker();
    if (g_stage) sc_stage_discard(g_stage), g_stage = NULL;
}

void start(int what, const std::string &src = "", const std::string &dst = "", ProfileOp op = PO_SWITCH) {
    static bool registered;
    if (!registered) registered = true, atexit(drop_stage_at_exit);
    join_worker();  // (the last job has published its result and can now be reaped)
    g_cancel.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (what == JOB_LIST) g_list_return_phase = g_phase.load();
    if (what != JOB_INSTALL && what != JOB_EXPORT_INSTALL && what != JOB_LIST) {
        sc_report_free(&g_rep);
        g_kind = NONE, g_code = 0, g_detail.clear(), g_backup.clear(), g_export_dst.clear(), g_warnings = 0, g_files = 0;
    }
    g_seen_done = false;
    g_phase.store(what == JOB_LIST ? LOADING : WORKING, std::memory_order_release);
    Work *w = new Work{what, src, dst, op};
    int err = pthread_create(&g_worker, NULL, worker, w);
    if (!err) g_joinable = true;
    else {
        delete w;
        if (g_stage) sc_stage_discard(g_stage), g_stage = NULL;
        g_code = SC_IO, g_detail = strerror(err);
        g_kind = what == JOB_BACKUP ? BACKUP_FAILED : what == JOB_PROFILE ? PROFILE_FAILED : (what == JOB_EXPORT_STAGE || what == JOB_EXPORT_INSTALL) ? EXPORT_FAILED : IMPORT_FAILED;
        g_pop = op, g_pcode = SP_IO, g_pdetail = strerror(err), g_pname_done = dst.empty() ? src : dst;
        g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
    }
}

void SDLCALL folder_picked_import(void *, const char *const *files, int) {
    if (files && files[0]) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
        g_picked_import = files[0];
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    }
    g_dialog = false;
}

void SDLCALL folder_picked_export(void *, const char *const *files, int) {
    if (files && files[0]) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
        g_picked_export = files[0];
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    }
    g_dialog = false;
}

void SDLCALL folder_picked_save_dir(void *, const char *const *files, int) {
    if (files && files[0]) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
        g_picked_save_dir = files[0];
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    }
    g_dialog = false;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ text
// A folder as the player finds it: relative ones are inside the data folder
std::string shown_path(const std::string &p) {
    bool abs = !p.empty() && (p[0] == '/' || p[0] == '\\' || (p.size() > 1 && p[1] == ':'));
    std::string s = abs ? p : std::string(rt_data_root()) + "/" + p;
#ifdef _WIN32
    for (char &c : s)
        if (c == '/') c = '\\';
#endif
    return s;
}

// "2026-10-03 15:40", or just the day (the same in every language)
std::string fmt_time(time_t t, bool day_only = false) {
    struct tm tmv;
#ifdef _WIN32
    localtime_s(&tmv, &t);
#else
    localtime_r(&t, &tmv);
#endif
    char b[32];
    strftime(b, sizeof b, day_only ? "%Y-%m-%d" : "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", &tmv);
    return b;
}

std::string fmt_play(int64_t sec) {
    char b[48];
    snprintf(b, sizeof b, tr("%d h %02d min"), (int)(sec / 3600), (int)(sec % 3600 / 60));
    return b;
}

std::string fmt(const char *en, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
std::string fmt(const char *en, ...) {
    char b[1600];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, en);
    vsnprintf(b, sizeof b, tr(en), ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return b;
}

std::string slot_list(const ScReport &r) {
    std::string s;
    for (int i = 0; i < r.nslots; i++) s += (i ? ", " : "") + std::string(r.slots[i]);
    return s;
}

// What went wrong: a headline and what to do about it (translated here, when it is shown)
void failure_text(int code, Kind kind, std::string *head, std::string *hint) {
    *hint = "";
    switch (code) {
    case SC_NO_SAVE:
        if (kind == BACKUP_FAILED) { *head = tr("There are no saves to back up yet"); break; }
        if (kind == EXPORT_FAILED) { *head = tr("There are no saves to export yet"); break; }
        *head = tr("No Breath of the Wild save found in that folder");
        *hint = tr("Choose the Cemu profile folder (.../user/80000001) or a folder above it.");
        break;
    case SC_SEARCH_LIMIT:
        *head = tr("The search took too long. Choose a folder closer to the save.");
        break;
    case SC_SWITCH_SAVE:
        *head = tr("That is a Switch save already");
        *hint = tr("Savage Wind uses those as they are: copy its files into the save folder instead.");
        break;
    case SC_WIIU_SAVE:
        *head = tr("That is a Wii U save already");
        *hint = tr("Only Switch saves can be exported to Wii U format.");
        break;
    case SC_BAD_SAVE: *head = tr("A save file is damaged or incomplete"); break;
    case SC_NO_BOOTUP:
        *head = tr("The game files weren't found");
        *hint = tr("Set up the game files first (Prelaunch tab).");
        break;
    case SC_BAD_BOOTUP:
        *head = tr("The game files can't be read");
        *hint = tr("Pack/Bootup.pack looks damaged or is not from version 1.9.0. Set up the game files again.");
        break;
    case SC_LINKED:
        *head = tr("The save folder is a link");
        *hint = tr("Savage Wind doesn't replace a linked folder. Use a normal save folder.");
        break;
    case SC_IN_USE:
        *head = tr("Savage Wind is running in a game");
        *hint = tr("Close the game first, then try again.");
        break;
    case SC_MOVED:
        *head = tr("The import stopped halfway");
        *hint = tr("Your previous saves are safe in the backup folder shown below. Rename that folder to save to get them back.");
        break;
    default:
        *head = tr("Files could not be read or written");
        *hint = tr("Close anything that is using the save folder and try again.");
    }
}

// A profile job that did not work: a headline and what to do about it
void profile_failure_text(int code, std::string *head, std::string *hint) {
    *hint = "";
    switch (code) {
    case SP_NAME_EMPTY: *head = tr("Type a name first"); break;
    case SP_NAME_LONG: *head = fmt("That name is too long (at most %d characters)", (int)SP_NAME_MAX); break;
    case SP_NAME_CHARS:
        *head = tr("That name has characters that can't be used");
        *hint = tr("Use letters, digits, spaces and - _ . ( ) only.");
        break;
    case SP_NAME_RESERVED: *head = tr("That name can't be used"); break;
    case SP_EXISTS: *head = tr("A profile with that name already exists"); break;
    case SP_NOT_FOUND: *head = tr("That profile is not there anymore"); break;
    case SP_IS_DEFAULT: *head = tr("The Default profile can't be renamed or deleted"); break;
    case SP_IS_ACTIVE:
        *head = tr("The profile in use can't be renamed or deleted");
        *hint = tr("Switch to another profile first.");
        break;
    case SP_IN_USE:
        *head = tr("Savage Wind is running in a game with that profile");
        *hint = tr("Close the game first, then try again.");
        break;
    case SP_NO_SPACE:
        *head = tr("Not enough free disk space for the copy");
        *hint = tr("Free some space and try again.");
        break;
    case SP_LINKED:
        *head = tr("That profile folder is a link");
        *hint = tr("Savage Wind doesn't delete linked folders. Remove it yourself if you want it gone.");
        break;
    default:
        *head = tr("Files could not be read or written");
        *hint = tr("Close anything that is using the save folders and try again.");
    }
}

// The last job's result, as lines in the rows' pane
void draw_result(int phase) {
    const ImVec4 gold(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1), bad(1, 0.5f, 0.4f, 1);
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
    if (phase == WORKING) {
        ImGui::TextColored(gold, "%s", tr("Working..."));
    } else if (g_kind == IMPORTED) {
        ImGui::TextColored(gold, "%s", tr("Import finished"));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Slots imported: %s", slot_list(g_rep).c_str()).c_str());
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", fmt("From: %s", shown_path(g_rep.root).c_str()).c_str());
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Flags: %u kept, %u set to defaults (not in the old save), %u dropped (not in this game "
                                     "version).", g_rep.kept, g_rep.defaulted, g_rep.dropped).c_str());
        for (int i = 0; i < g_rep.nslots; i++) {  // (per slot: what the older game did not have, and what the new one dropped)
            unsigned def = 0, drop = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < g_rep.nfiles; k++) {
                const ScFlagFile &f = g_rep.files[k];
                size_t n = strlen(g_rep.slots[i]);
                if (!strncmp(f.file, g_rep.slots[i], n) && f.file[n] == '/') def += f.defaulted, drop += f.dropped;
            }
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", fmt("Slot %s: %u defaulted, %u dropped", g_rep.slots[i], def, drop).c_str());
        }
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Hero's Path: %d files. Album: %d pictures. Compendium: %d pictures.", g_rep.n_tracker,
                                     g_rep.n_album, g_rep.n_pict).c_str());
        if (!g_backup.empty())
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Your previous saves are kept in %s", shown_path(g_backup).c_str()).c_str());
        if (g_warnings)
            ImGui::TextColored(bad, "%s", fmt("%d files of the old save folder could not be copied over; they are in the backup.",
                                              g_warnings).c_str());
    } else if (g_kind == EXPORTED) {
        ImGui::TextColored(gold, "%s", tr("Export finished"));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Slots exported: %s", slot_list(g_rep).c_str()).c_str());
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", fmt("To: %s", shown_path(g_export_dst).c_str()).c_str());
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Flags: %u kept, %u set to defaults (not in the old save), %u dropped (not in this game "
                                     "version).", g_rep.kept, g_rep.defaulted, g_rep.dropped).c_str());
        for (int i = 0; i < g_rep.nslots; i++) {
            unsigned def = 0, drop = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < g_rep.nfiles; k++) {
                const ScFlagFile &f = g_rep.files[k];
                size_t n = strlen(g_rep.slots[i]);
                if (!strncmp(f.file, g_rep.slots[i], n) && f.file[n] == '/') def += f.defaulted, drop += f.dropped;
            }
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", fmt("Slot %s: %u defaulted, %u dropped", g_rep.slots[i], def, drop).c_str());
        }
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Hero's Path: %d files. Album: %d pictures. Compendium: %d pictures.", g_rep.n_tracker,
                                     g_rep.n_album, g_rep.n_pict).c_str());
        if (g_warnings)
            ImGui::TextColored(bad, "%s", fmt("%d files could not be copied over.", g_warnings).c_str());
    } else if (g_kind == BACKED_UP) {
        ImGui::TextColored(gold, "%s", tr("Backup finished"));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("%d files copied to %s", g_files, shown_path(g_backup).c_str()).c_str());
    } else if (g_kind == PROFILE_DONE) {
        const char *n = g_pname_done.c_str();
        ImGui::TextColored(gold, "%s", g_pop == PO_SWITCH   ? fmt("Now using profile %s", n).c_str()
                                       : g_pop == PO_CREATE ? fmt("Profile %s created", n).c_str()
                                       : g_pop == PO_COPY   ? fmt("Profile copied to %s", n).c_str()
                                       : g_pop == PO_RENAME ? fmt("Profile renamed to %s", n).c_str()
                                                            : fmt("Profile %s deleted", n).c_str());
        if (g_pop == PO_SWITCH) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("The game uses this profile's saves the next time you play."));
    } else if (g_kind == PROFILE_FAILED) {
        std::string head, hint;
        profile_failure_text(g_pcode, &head, &hint);
        ImGui::TextColored(bad, "%s", head.c_str());
        if (!hint.empty()) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", hint.c_str());
        if (!g_pdetail.empty() && (g_pcode == SP_IO || g_pcode == SP_NO_SPACE)) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", g_pdetail.c_str());
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("Your profiles were not changed."));
    } else if (g_kind == CANCELLED) {
        ImGui::TextColored(gold, "%s", g_export_dst.empty() ? tr("Import cancelled") : tr("Export cancelled"));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("Nothing was changed."));
    } else if (g_kind == IMPORT_FAILED || g_kind == EXPORT_FAILED || g_kind == BACKUP_FAILED) {
        std::string head, hint;
        failure_text(g_code, g_kind, &head, &hint);
        ImGui::TextColored(bad, "%s", head.c_str());
        if (!hint.empty()) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", hint.c_str());
        if (!g_detail.empty() && g_code != SC_NO_SAVE && g_code != SC_SWITCH_SAVE && g_code != SC_WIIU_SAVE)
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", (g_code == SC_MOVED ? shown_path(g_detail) : g_detail).c_str());  // (that one is the backup folder)
        if (g_code != SC_MOVED) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("Nothing was changed."));
    }
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
}

// "Import this save?" / "Export this save?": what comes in, and where the old saves go first
void draw_confirm(int phase) {
    if (phase == CONFIRM && !g_popup_shown) {
        ImGui::OpenPopup(g_export_dst.empty() ? "##importok" : "##exportok");
        g_popup_shown = true;
    }
    if (phase != CONFIRM) g_popup_shown = false;
    if (!g_export_dst.empty()) {
        if (!ImGui::BeginPopupModal("##exportok", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar)) return;
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1), "%s", tr("Export this save?"));
        ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(fminf(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 34, ImGui::GetIO().DisplaySize.x * 0.7f));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Slots: %s", slot_list(g_rep).c_str()).c_str());
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", fmt("To: %s", shown_path(g_export_dst).c_str()).c_str());
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("Your Savage Wind saves will stay as they are. Existing files in the destination are preserved with a dated .bak suffix."));
        ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
        ImGui::Spacing();
        bool yes = ImGui::Button(tr("Export"), ImVec2(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 9, 0));
        ImGui::SetItemDefaultFocus();
        ImGui::SameLine();
        bool no = ImGui::Button(tr("Cancel"), ImVec2(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 9, 0)) ||
                  ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false);
        if (yes) {
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
            start(JOB_EXPORT_INSTALL, "", g_export_dst);
        } else if (no) {
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
            sc_stage_discard(g_stage);
            g_stage = NULL;
            g_kind = CANCELLED;
            g_seen_done = true;
            g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
        return;
    }
    if (!ImGui::BeginPopupModal("##importok", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar)) return;
    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.93f, 0.76f, 0.33f, 1), "%s", tr("Import this save?"));
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(fminf(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 34, ImGui::GetIO().DisplaySize.x * 0.7f));  // (a small window too)
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Slots: %s", slot_list(g_rep).c_str()).c_str());
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", fmt("From: %s", shown_path(g_rep.root).c_str()).c_str());
    ImGui::Spacing();
    if (g_had_saves) {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("Your current saves are moved to this backup folder first. Nothing is deleted:"));
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", shown_path(g_backup).c_str());
    } else {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("You have no saves yet, so there is nothing to back up."));
    }
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    ImGui::Spacing();
    bool yes = ImGui::Button(tr("Import"), ImVec2(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 9, 0));
    ImGui::SetItemDefaultFocus();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    bool no = ImGui::Button(tr("Cancel"), ImVec2(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 9, 0)) ||
              ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false);
    if (yes) {
        ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        start(JOB_INSTALL);
    } else if (no) {
        ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        sc_stage_discard(g_stage);  // (the converted copy: removed again, the saves were never touched)
        g_stage = NULL;
        g_kind = CANCELLED;
        g_seen_done = true;
        g_phase.store(DONE, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    ImGui::EndPopup();
}

// "Delete profile X?": the one place a profile's saves are removed for good
void draw_delete_confirm(int phase) {
    if (g_delete_open && !g_delete_popup_shown) ImGui::OpenPopup("##profdel"), g_delete_popup_shown = true;
    if (!g_delete_open) g_delete_popup_shown = false;
    if (!ImGui::BeginPopupModal("##profdel", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar)) return;
    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1, 0.5f, 0.4f, 1), "%s", fmt("Delete profile %s?", g_delete_name.c_str()).c_str());
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(fminf(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 34, ImGui::GetIO().DisplaySize.x * 0.7f));
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Its %d slots and everything else saved in it are deleted for good. Your other profiles are not touched.",
                                 g_delete_slots).c_str());
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    ImGui::Spacing();
    bool yes = ImGui::Button(tr("Delete"), ImVec2(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 9, 0));
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::SetItemDefaultFocus();  // (Cancel is the default: a stray A press keeps the profile)
    bool no = ImGui::Button(tr("Cancel"), ImVec2(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 9, 0)) ||
              ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false);
    if (yes && (phase == IDLE || phase == DONE)) {
        ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        g_delete_open = false;
        start(JOB_PROFILE, g_delete_name, "", PO_DELETE);
    } else if (no) {
        ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        g_delete_open = false;
    }
    ImGui::EndPopup();
}

const SpProfile *find_profile(const std::string &name) {
    for (const SpProfile &p : g_profiles)
        if (p.name == name) return &p;
    return NULL;
}

// The Profiles section: the list (the selected one has the filled ring), then what can be done with the selected one
void draw_profiles(bool busy) {
    opt_section("Profiles");
    if (sp_override_active()) {
        opt_disable_next();
        opt_action("Profiles are off", "",
                   "The SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR setting chooses the save folder for this run, so profiles are not used. "
                   "Remove that setting to use profiles.");
        return;
    }
    const SpProfile *used = NULL;
    for (const SpProfile &p : g_profiles)
        if (p.active) used = &p;
    if (g_sel.empty() && used) g_sel = used->name;
    for (const SpProfile &p : g_profiles) {
        std::string label = p.is_default ? tr("Default") : p.name;
        if (p.active) label = fmt("%s (in use)", label.c_str());
        std::string desc = fmt("Slots: %d", p.slots);
        if (p.saved) desc += "\n" + fmt("Last saved %s", fmt_time(p.saved).c_str());
        if (p.is_default) desc += "\n" + std::string(tr("The saves Savage Wind has always used. This profile can't be renamed or deleted."));
        if (busy) opt_disable_next();
        if (opt_radio(label.c_str(), g_sel == p.name, desc.c_str()) && !busy) g_sel = p.name;
    }
    if (g_profiles.empty()) return;
    const SpProfile *sel = find_profile(g_sel);
    if (!sel) return;
    bool in_use = sel->active, locked = sel->is_default || sel->active;

    opt_section("Selected profile");
    if (busy || in_use) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Use this profile", "",
                   "The game starts with this profile's saves from now on. Close the game before you switch: a game that "
                   "is running keeps the profile it started with. Your other profiles are not touched.") && !busy && !in_use)
        start(JOB_PROFILE, sel->name, "", PO_SWITCH);
    if (busy) opt_disable_next();
    opt_text("Name for a new profile", g_pname, sizeof g_pname, tr("Type a name"),
             "The name for Create, Copy and Rename below: letters, digits, spaces and - _ . ( ), up to 32 characters.");
    if (busy) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Create empty profile", "", "Makes a new profile with no saves, named as typed above. The game starts a new "
                                                "adventure in it.") && !busy)
        start(JOB_PROFILE, "", g_pname, PO_CREATE);
    if (busy) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Copy this profile", "", "Makes a complete copy of the selected profile under the name typed above, "
                                            "with all its slots. Both profiles stay separate afterwards.") && !busy)
        start(JOB_PROFILE, sel->name, g_pname, PO_COPY);
    if (busy || locked) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Rename this profile", "", "Gives the selected profile the name typed above. Not for the Default "
                                              "profile or the one in use.") && !busy && !locked)
        start(JOB_PROFILE, sel->name, g_pname, PO_RENAME);
    if (busy || locked) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Delete this profile...", "", "Deletes the selected profile and its saves for good, after asking. Not for "
                                                "the Default profile or the one in use.") && !busy && !locked) {
        g_delete_open = true, g_delete_name = sel->name, g_delete_slots = sel->slots;
    }
    if (opt_action("Open this profile's folder", "", "Opens the selected profile's save folder in your file manager.") && !busy) {
        char dir[1100];
        if (sp_save_dir(NULL, sel->name, dir, sizeof dir)) {
            SDL_CreateDirectory(dir);
            reveal_folder(dir);
        }
    }
}

unsigned long long ui_texture_rgba(const unsigned char *px, int w, int h) { return texture_rgba(px, w, h); }
void ui_texture_free(unsigned long long tex) { texture_free(tex); }

void saves_tab_set_game_files(const char *root) { g_game_root = root; }

bool saves_tab_busy(void) {
    int p = g_phase.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    return p == WORKING || p == CONFIRM || p == LOADING;
}

void saves_tab_unload(void) {
    drop_stage_at_exit();
    free_thumbs();
    g_slots.clear();
    g_loaded_slots.clear();
    g_slots_ready = false;
    g_phase.store(IDLE);
    sc_report_free(&g_rep);
    g_kind = NONE;
    g_export_dst.clear();
    g_last_frame = -100;
}

void saves_tab_draw(void) {
    int frame = ImGui::GetFrameCount();
    if (g_last_frame + 3 < frame) {  // first time, or back after another tab (files may have changed)
        int p = g_phase.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (p == IDLE || p == DONE) start(JOB_LIST);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
        g_picked_import.clear();
        g_picked_export.clear();  // (a folder chosen while the tab was away: not started by surprise)
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    }
    g_last_frame = frame;
    int phase = g_phase.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (phase != WORKING && phase != LOADING && g_slots_ready) take_slots();
    if (phase == DONE && !g_seen_done) g_seen_done = true;
    std::string picked_import, picked_export, picked_save_dir;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    picked_import.swap(g_picked_import);
    picked_export.swap(g_picked_export);
    picked_save_dir.swap(g_picked_save_dir);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    if (!picked_import.empty() && (phase == IDLE || phase == DONE) && !g_recovery.imported[0])
        start(JOB_CONVERT, picked_import), phase = WORKING;
    if (!picked_export.empty() && (phase == IDLE || phase == DONE) && !g_recovery.imported[0])
        start(JOB_EXPORT_STAGE, save_dir(), picked_export), phase = WORKING;
    if (!picked_save_dir.empty() && (phase == IDLE || phase == DONE) && !g_recovery.imported[0]) {
        snprintf(g_settings.save_dir, sizeof g_settings.save_dir, "%s", picked_save_dir.c_str());
        settings_save();
        start(JOB_LIST);
        phase = LOADING;
    }
    load_one_thumb();

    bool working = phase == WORKING || phase == CONFIRM || phase == LOADING;
    bool recovery = !working && g_recovery.imported[0];
    bool busy = working || recovery;
    opt_begin("##saves", ImGui::GetFontSize() / 34);
    draw_profiles(busy);
    opt_section("Import");
    if (busy) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Import from Wii U / Cemu...", "",
                   "Imports a Breath of the Wild save from the Wii U or from Cemu. Choose the Cemu profile folder "
                   "(.../user/80000001) or any folder above it. The Hero's Path, the album and the compendium pictures "
                   "come along. Nothing changes until you confirm, and your current saves are backed up first.") && !busy &&
        !g_dialog.exchange(true))
        SDL_ShowOpenFolderDialog(folder_picked_import, NULL, ui_window(), NULL, false);
    opt_section("Export");
    if (busy || g_slots.empty()) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Export to Wii U / Cemu...", "",
                   "Exports your current saves to Wii U / Cemu format. Choose the destination folder (such as a Cemu "
                   "profile folder, e.g. .../user/80000001). The Hero's Path, the album and the compendium pictures "
                   "are converted. Existing files in the destination are preserved with a dated .bak suffix.") && !busy &&
        !g_slots.empty() && !g_dialog.exchange(true))
        SDL_ShowOpenFolderDialog(folder_picked_export, NULL, ui_window(), NULL, false);
    opt_section("Backup");
    if (busy) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Back up saves", "",
                   "Copies the whole save folder to a new dated folder in save-backups, next to it. Your saves stay "
                   "where they are.") && !busy)
        start(JOB_BACKUP), phase = WORKING, working = busy = true;
    if (busy) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_toggle("Back up at each start", &g_settings.save_backups, false,
                   "A copy of the save folder each time the game starts, if anything in it changed. The last 5 are kept "
                   "in save-backups; the ones you make yourself are never removed."))
        settings_save();
    opt_section("Folder");
    if (working) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Open save folder", "", "Opens the folder with your saves in your file manager.") && !working) {
        if (recovery) reveal_folder(g_recovery.imported);
        else {
            SDL_CreateDirectory(save_dir().c_str());  // (no save yet: the folder is made so there is something to open)
            reveal_folder(save_dir());
        }
    }
    if (busy || sp_override_active()) opt_disable_next();
    if (opt_action("Change save folder...", shown_path(save_dir()).c_str(),
                   "Choose a custom folder on another drive or SSD to store your saves. Existing saves in that folder "
                   "are loaded automatically.") && !busy && !sp_override_active() && !g_dialog.exchange(true))
        SDL_ShowOpenFolderDialog(folder_picked_save_dir, NULL, ui_window(), NULL, false);
    if (g_settings.save_dir[0] && !sp_override_active()) {
        if (busy) opt_disable_next();
        if (opt_action("Reset save folder to default", "",
                       "Revert to using the default save folder inside the game folder.") && !busy) {
            g_settings.save_dir[0] = 0;
            settings_save();
            start(JOB_LIST);
            phase = LOADING;
        }
    }
    if (recovery) {
        opt_section("Result");
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("An earlier import was interrupted. The save folder is missing."));
        if (g_recovery.backup[0])
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Previous saves (if any): %s", shown_path(g_recovery.backup).c_str()).c_str());
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", fmt("Imported saves: %s", shown_path(g_recovery.imported).c_str()).c_str());
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("Close Savage Wind and rename one of these folders to save to recover it. These folders have been kept."));
    } else if (!working && g_cleanup_code != SC_OK) {
        opt_section("Result");
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", tr("Files could not be read or written"));
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", g_cleanup_detail.c_str());
    }
    if (phase == WORKING || phase == DONE) {  // (the worker's fields are read only once it has published them)
        opt_section("Result");
        draw_result(phase);
    }
    opt_section("Slots");
    if (phase == LOADING) {
        opt_disable_next();
        opt_action("Working...", "", "");
    } else if (g_slots.empty()) {
        opt_disable_next();
        opt_action("No saves yet", "",
                   "There are no saves in the save folder yet. They show up here once you have played, or imported one.");
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_slots.size(); i++) {
        const ScSlot &s = g_slots[i];
        std::string label = fmt("Slot %s", s.name), when = s.saved ? fmt_time(s.saved) : "";
        // the row shows the most of date, time and play time that fits beside the label (the pane has all of it)
        std::string options[] = {s.play_seconds >= 0 ? when + "   " + fmt_play(s.play_seconds) : when, when,
                                 s.saved ? fmt_time(s.saved, true) : ""};
        float room = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - 2 * ImGui::GetFontSize() - ImGui::CalcTextSize(tr_upper(label.c_str()).c_str()).x;
        std::string value = options[2];
        for (const std::string &o : options)
            if (ImGui::CalcTextSize(o.c_str()).x <= room) { value = o; break; }
        std::string desc = s.play_seconds >= 0 ? fmt("Saved %s\nPlay time: %s", when.c_str(), fmt_play(s.play_seconds).c_str())
                                               : fmt("Saved %s", when.c_str());
        opt_action(label.c_str(), value.c_str(), desc.c_str());
        if (g_thumbs[i].tex) opt_desc_image(g_thumbs[i].tex, g_thumbs[i].w, g_thumbs[i].h);
    }
    opt_end();
    draw_confirm(phase);
    draw_delete_confirm(phase);
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include "imgui.h"

void splash_load(void);    // after the ImGui renderer backend is up
```

`runtime/ui/splash.mm`:

```mm
// The start screen's background (splash.h). The player's own picture when there is one (rt_user_splash: splash.jpg /
// splash.png in the data folder, decoded with stb_image), shown filling the window; else Savage Wind's own art, drawn
// here: an old forest at a sunlit clearing, the icon's plain sword (docs/icon/icon.svg) in a mossy stone, the grass
// swaying, petals and fireflies. The menu sits on the left, so the clearing is on the right. The start screen lays its
// dark banners over either, which keep its text readable.
#ifdef __APPLE__
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#endif
#include <algorithm>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <vector>

#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_internal.h"  // (ImDrawListSharedData: the white pixel's UV for hand-made geometry)
#include "splash.h"

#include "imageload.h"  // (stb_image, JPEG / PNG: SDL 3.2, which the distributions ship, has no SDL_LoadPNG)

extern "C" {
#include "paths.h"
#ifdef __APPLE__
void *ui_metal_device(void);
#else
uint64_t vk_imgui_texture_rgba(const void *rgba, int w, int h);  // runtime/nvn/vulkan/imgui_glue.cpp
void vk_imgui_texture_free(uint64_t tex);
#endif
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the player's picture
// splash.jpg / .png of the player's first; else, as Settings say (START_PICTURE_*), one of their own screenshots
// (screenshots/ in the data folder: the photo mode's and the d-pad's, full size), or the picture of their latest save
// (the game's own, 256x144: soft, filling the window). Picked once per run, so the start screen and the boot picture
// after it show the same one. Nothing there: Savage Wind's art.
#include <dirent.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <string>
#include "settings.h"
extern "C" const char *sp_session_save_dir(void);  // (services/save_profiles.h)

static bool picture_ext(const char *n) {
    const char *e = strrchr(n, '.');
    return e && (!strcasecmp(e, ".png") || !strcasecmp(e, ".jpg") || !strcasecmp(e, ".jpeg"));
}

static std::string random_screenshot(void) {
    std::vector<std::string> all;
    if (DIR *d = opendir("screenshots")) {  // (the data folder is the working directory, runtime/paths.h)
        while (struct dirent *e = readdir(d))
            if (e->d_name[0] != '.' && picture_ext(e->d_name)) all.push_back(std::string("screenshots/") + e->d_name);
        closedir(d);
    }
    if (all.empty()) return "";
    srand((unsigned)time(NULL));
    return all[(size_t)rand() % all.size()];
}

static void newest_caption(const std::string &dir, int depth, std::string &best, time_t &best_t) {
    DIR *d = depth < 4 ? opendir(dir.c_str()) : NULL;
    if (!d) return;
    while (struct dirent *e = readdir(d)) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        std::string p = dir + "/" + e->d_name;
        struct stat st;
        if (stat(p.c_str(), &st)) continue;
        if (S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) newest_caption(p, depth + 1, best, best_t);
        else if (!strcasecmp(e->d_name, "caption.jpg") && st.st_mtime > best_t) best = p, best_t = st.st_mtime;
    }
    closedir(d);
}

static bool pick_picture(char *out, size_t n) {
    static std::string picked;
    static bool done;
    if (!done) {
        done = true;
        char own[1100];
        if (rt_user_splash(own, sizeof own)) picked = own;
        else if (g_settings.start_picture == START_PICTURE_SCREENSHOT) picked = random_screenshot();
        else if (g_settings.start_picture == START_PICTURE_SAVE) {
            const char *sd = sp_session_save_dir();
            time_t t = 0;
            newest_caption(sd && *sd ? sd : "save", 0, picked, t);
        }
    }
    if (picked.empty()) return false;
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", picked.c_str());
    return true;
}
static ImTextureID g_tex;
static int g_tex_w, g_tex_h;
#ifdef __APPLE__
static id<MTLTexture> g_mtl_tex;  // (ImGui only holds the pointer)
#endif

// A small picture 4x bigger, bilinear, then a box blur three times over (close to a gaussian): the save's 256x144 picture
// fills the window soft instead of in blocks. NULL: no memory (the picture is shown as it is).
static unsigned char *soften(const unsigned char *px, int *pw, int *ph) {
    int w = *pw, h = *ph, W = w * 4, H = h * 4;
    std::vector<float> a((size_t)W * H * 3), b(a.size());
    for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < W; x++) {
            float fx = (x + 0.5f) / 4 - 0.5f, fy = (y + 0.5f) / 4 - 0.5f;
            int x0 = fx < 0 ? 0 : (int)fx, y0 = fy < 0 ? 0 : (int)fy;
            int x1 = x0 + 1 < w ? x0 + 1 : x0, y1 = y0 + 1 < h ? y0 + 1 : y0;
            float tx = fx - x0 < 0 ? 0 : fx - x0, ty = fy - y0 < 0 ? 0 : fy - y0;
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                float p00 = px[(y0 * w + x0) * 4 + c], p10 = px[(y0 * w + x1) * 4 + c];
                float p01 = px[(y1 * w + x0) * 4 + c], p11 = px[(y1 * w + x1) * 4 + c];
                a[((size_t)y * W + x) * 3 + c] = (p00 * (1 - tx) + p10 * tx) * (1 - ty) + (p01 * (1 - tx) + p11 * tx) * ty;
            }
        }
    const int r = 6;
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) {
        for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)  // across
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                float sum = 0;
                for (int k = -r; k <= r; k++) sum += a[((size_t)y * W + std::min(std::max(k, 0), W - 1)) * 3 + c];
                for (int x = 0; x < W; x++) {
                    b[((size_t)y * W + x) * 3 + c] = sum / (2 * r + 1);
                    int out = std::max(x - r, 0), in = std::min(x + r + 1, W - 1);
                    sum += a[((size_t)y * W + in) * 3 + c] - a[((size_t)y * W + out) * 3 + c];
                }
            }
        for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)  // down
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                float sum = 0;
                for (int k = -r; k <= r; k++) sum += b[((size_t)std::min(std::max(k, 0), H - 1) * W + x) * 3 + c];
                for (int y = 0; y < H; y++) {
                    a[((size_t)y * W + x) * 3 + c] = sum / (2 * r + 1);
                    int out = std::max(y - r, 0), in = std::min(y + r + 1, H - 1);
                    sum += b[((size_t)in * W + x) * 3 + c] - b[((size_t)out * W + x) * 3 + c];
                }
            }
    }
    unsigned char *o = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)W * H * 4);
    if (!o) return NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)W * H; i++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) o[i * 4 + c] = (unsigned char)std::min(std::max(a[i * 3 + c] + 0.5f, 0.0f), 255.0f);
        o[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
    }
    *pw = W, *ph = H;
    return o;
}

void splash_load(void) {
    splash_unload();
    char path[1100];
    if (!pick_picture(path, sizeof path)) return;
    int w, h;
    if (!rt_image_info(path, &w, &h) || w <= 0 || h <= 0 || w > 8192 || h > 8192) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[splash] %s: not a JPEG / PNG up to 8192x8192, using the default art\n", path);
        return;
    }
    unsigned char *px = rt_image_rgba(path, &w, &h);
    if (!px) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[splash] %s: %s, using the default art\n", path, rt_image_error());
        return;
    }
    unsigned char *soft = w < 640 ? soften(px, &w, &h) : NULL;
    if (soft) {
        rt_image_free(px);
        px = soft;
    }
#ifdef __APPLE__
    id<MTLDevice> dev = (__bridge id<MTLDevice>)ui_metal_device();
    MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm
                                                                                   width:w height:h mipmapped:NO];
    g_mtl_tex = [dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td];
    if (g_mtl_tex) {
        [g_mtl_tex replaceRegion:MTLRegionMake2D(0, 0, w, h) mipmapLevel:0 withBytes:px bytesPerRow:(NSUInteger)w * 4];
        g_tex = (ImTextureID)(intptr_t)(__bridge void *)g_mtl_tex;
    }
#else
    g_tex = (ImTextureID)vk_imgui_texture_rgba(px, w, h);
#endif
    if (soft) free(px);
    else rt_image_free(px);
    if (g_tex) g_tex_w = w, g_tex_h = h;
    fprintf(stderr, "[splash] %s (%dx%d)%s\n", path, w, h, g_tex ? "" : ": no texture, using the default art");
}

void splash_unload(void) {
    if (!g_tex) return;
#ifdef __APPLE__
    g_mtl_tex = nil;
#else
    vk_imgui_texture_free((uint64_t)g_tex);
#endif
    g_tex = 0;
}

bool splash_is_user(void) { return g_tex != 0; }

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ drawing helpers
static ImU32 rgba(uint32_t rgb, float a = 1) {
    return IM_COL32(rgb >> 16 & 255, rgb >> 8 & 255, rgb & 255, (int)(a * 255 + 0.5f));
}

// A filled (concave) polygon shaded from ca at a to cb at b (a linear gradient). ImGui anti-aliases clockwise
// outlines (on screen, y down) outwards: counter-clockwise ones are turned around first.
static void fill_grad(ImDrawList *dl, const ImVec2 *p, int n, ImVec2 a, ImVec2 b, ImU32 ca, ImU32 cb) {
    float area = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) area += p[i].x * p[(i + 1) % n].y - p[(i + 1) % n].x * p[i].y;
    std::vector<ImVec2> rev;
    if (area < 0) rev.assign(p, p + n), std::reverse(rev.begin(), rev.end()), p = rev.data();
    int v0 = dl->VtxBuffer.Size;
    dl->AddConcavePolyFilled(p, n, IM_COL32_WHITE);
    ImVec2 d(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
    float dd = d.x * d.x + d.y * d.y;
    ImVec4 A = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(ca), B = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(cb);
    for (int i = v0; i < dl->VtxBuffer.Size; i++) {
        ImDrawVert &v = dl->VtxBuffer[i];
        float f = dd > 0 ? ((v.pos.x - a.x) * d.x + (v.pos.y - a.y) * d.y) / dd : 0;
        f = f < 0 ? 0 : f > 1 ? 1 : f;
        float fringe = (float)(v.col >> IM_COL32_A_SHIFT & 255) / 255.0f;  // (0 on the anti-aliased edge)
        v.col = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4(A.x + (B.x - A.x) * f, A.y + (B.y - A.y) * f,
                                                      A.z + (B.z - A.z) * f, (A.w + (B.w - A.w) * f) * fringe));
    }
}

static void fill(ImDrawList *dl, const ImVec2 *p, int n, ImU32 c) { fill_grad(dl, p, n, p[0], p[0], c, c); }

// A soft round glow: inner at the centre, mid at mid_at of the radius, nothing at the edge
static void glow(ImDrawList *dl, ImVec2 c, float r, ImU32 inner, ImU32 mid, float mid_at) {
    const int N = 72;
    ImU32 out = mid & ~IM_COL32_A_MASK;
    ImVec2 uv = dl->_Data->TexUvWhitePixel;
    dl->PrimReserve(N * 3 + N * 6, 1 + 2 * N);
    unsigned base = dl->_VtxCurrentIdx;
    dl->PrimWriteVtx(c, uv, inner);
    for (int ring = 0; ring < 2; ring++)
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            float a = i * 6.2831853f / N, rr = ring ? r : r * mid_at;
            dl->PrimWriteVtx(ImVec2(c.x + cosf(a) * rr, c.y + sinf(a) * rr), uv, ring ? out : mid);
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        unsigned j = (i + 1) % N, a = base + 1 + i, b = base + 1 + j, a2 = a + N, b2 = b + N;
        dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)base), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)a), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)b);
        dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)a), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)b2), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)b);
        dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)a), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)a2), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)b2);
    }
}

// a small repeatable pseudo-random number in 0..1 (where trees, blades of grass and petals go)
static float hash01(uint32_t x) {
    x ^= x >> 16, x *= 0x7feb352d, x ^= x >> 15, x *= 0x846ca68b, x ^= x >> 16;
    return (x & 0xFFFFFF) / 16777216.0f;
}

static ImU32 mix(ImU32 a, ImU32 b, float f) {
    ImVec4 A = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(a), B = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(b);
    return ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4(A.x + (B.x - A.x) * f, A.y + (B.y - A.y) * f, A.z + (B.z - A.z) * f,
                                                 A.w + (B.w - A.w) * f));
}

// A quad with a colour per corner (soft shapes such as the light shafts: no anti-aliasing needed)
static void quad_grad(ImDrawList *dl, ImVec2 a, ImVec2 b, ImVec2 c, ImVec2 d, ImU32 ca, ImU32 cb, ImU32 cc, ImU32 cd) {
    ImVec2 uv = dl->_Data->TexUvWhitePixel;
    dl->PrimReserve(6, 4);
    unsigned i = dl->_VtxCurrentIdx;
    dl->PrimWriteVtx(a, uv, ca), dl->PrimWriteVtx(b, uv, cb), dl->PrimWriteVtx(c, uv, cc), dl->PrimWriteVtx(d, uv, cd);
    dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)i), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)(i + 1)), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)(i + 2));
    dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)i), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)(i + 2)), dl->PrimWriteIdx((ImDrawIdx)(i + 3));
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ Savage Wind's own art
// An old forest at a clearing, drawn here (nothing of the game's): tall trunks fading into a green haze, the canopy
// opening at the upper right, shafts of sunlight through it, mossy rocks, ferns and tall grass swaying in the wind,
// petals drifting and fireflies. The menu and the game files card sit on the left, so the light is on the right.

// The icon's shapes are in its 1024-unit square with the mountain's summit at (512, 515): placed at `o`, `k` pixels
// per unit.
struct Place {
    ImVec2 o;
    float k;
    ImVec2 operator()(float x, float y) const { return ImVec2(o.x + (x - 512) * k, o.y + (y - 515) * k); }
};

// dir: 0 top to bottom, 1 left to right, 2 top left to bottom right, 3 top right to bottom left (across its bounds)
// dir: 0 top to bottom, 1 left to right, 2 top left to bottom right, 3 top right to bottom left (across its bounds)
static void shape(ImDrawList *dl, const Place &P, const float (*pts)[2], int n, uint32_t c0, uint32_t c1,
                  float alpha = 1, int dir = 0) {
    ImVec2 q[16];
    n = n < 16 ? n : 16;
    float y0 = 1e9f, y1 = -1e9f, x0 = 1e9f, x1 = -1e9f;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        q[i] = P(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
        y0 = fminf(y0, q[i].y), y1 = fmaxf(y1, q[i].y), x0 = fminf(x0, q[i].x), x1 = fmaxf(x1, q[i].x);
    }
    ImVec2 a = dir == 3 ? ImVec2(x1, y0) : ImVec2(x0, y0);
    ImVec2 b = dir == 0 ? ImVec2(x0, y1) : dir == 1 ? ImVec2(x1, y0) : dir == 2 ? ImVec2(x1, y1) : ImVec2(x0, y1);
    fill_grad(dl, q, n, a, b, rgba(c0, alpha), rgba(c1, alpha));
}

// Savage Wind's own plain sword (the icon's, docs/icon/icon.svg): pommel, wrapped grip, crossguard, a blade lit on
// its left half; its tip goes into whatever is drawn over it
static void sword(ImDrawList *dl, const Place &P) {
    float k = P.k;
    ImU32 edge = rgba(0x3e5170);
    // blade (its tip in the snow)
    static const float bl[][2] = {{475, 345}, {512, 345}, {512, 640}, {475, 600}};
    static const float br[][2] = {{512, 345}, {549, 345}, {549, 600}, {512, 640}};
    {
        ImVec2 o[5] = {P(472, 342), P(552, 342), P(552, 601), P(512, 645), P(472, 601)};
        fill(dl, o, 5, edge);
    }
    shape(dl, P, bl, 4, 0xeef6ff, 0xffffff, 1, 1);
    shape(dl, P, br, 4, 0xb3c6da, 0x7d93ad, 1, 1);
    // crossguard
    ImVec2 c0 = P(385, 305), c1 = P(640, 345);
    dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(c0.x - 2.5f * k, c0.y - 2.5f * k), ImVec2(c1.x + 2.5f * k, c1.y + 2.5f * k), edge, 12 * k);
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImVec2(c0.x + 6 * k, c0.y), ImVec2(c1.x - 6 * k, c1.y), rgba(0xf1f6fb), rgba(0xf1f6fb),
                                rgba(0x8293a8), rgba(0x8293a8));
    dl->AddRectFilled(c0, ImVec2(c0.x + 10 * k, c1.y), rgba(0xc9d4e1), 10 * k, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersLeft);
    dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(c1.x - 10 * k, c0.y), c1, rgba(0xa9b6c6), 10 * k, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersRight);
    // grip, wrapped
    ImVec2 g0 = P(488, 200), g1 = P(536, 305);
    dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(g0.x - 3 * k, g0.y - 3 * k), ImVec2(g1.x + 3 * k, g1.y + 2 * k), rgba(0x241509), 14 * k);
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(g0, g1, rgba(0x6b4527), rgba(0x3a2414), rgba(0x3a2414), rgba(0x6b4527));
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        float y = 225 + i * 24;
        dl->AddLine(P(490, y), P(534, y + 12), rgba(0xa8703f), 5 * k);
    }
    // pommel
    ImVec2 pc = P(512, 192);
    dl->AddCircleFilled(pc, 31 * k, rgba(0x3e5170), 32);
    dl->AddCircleFilled(pc, 26 * k, rgba(0x8293a8), 32);
    dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(pc.x - 3 * k, pc.y - 4 * k), 20 * k, rgba(0xdbe4ee), 32);
}

// A trunk from above the window down to `ground`, wider at its roots, shaded across (dark to lit, the sun's side)
static void trunk(ImDrawList *dl, float x, float w, float ground, float lean, ImU32 dark, ImU32 lit, float H) {
    ImVec2 p[8] = {ImVec2(x - w * 0.5f + lean, -0.05f * H), ImVec2(x + w * 0.5f + lean, -0.05f * H),
                   ImVec2(x + w * 0.52f, ground - w * 0.9f), ImVec2(x + w * 0.95f, ground),
                   ImVec2(x + w * 0.2f, ground - w * 0.15f), ImVec2(x - w * 0.25f, ground - w * 0.12f),
                   ImVec2(x - w * 0.95f, ground), ImVec2(x - w * 0.52f, ground - w * 0.9f)};
    fill_grad(dl, p, 8, ImVec2(x - w * 0.6f, 0), ImVec2(x + w * 0.6f, 0), dark, lit);
}

// A blade of grass from (x, y), `h` tall, its tip `bend` aside; darker at the root
static void blade(ImDrawList *dl, float x, float y, float w, float h, float bend, ImU32 root, ImU32 tip) {
    ImVec2 p[5] = {ImVec2(x - w, y), ImVec2(x - w * 0.55f + bend * 0.3f, y - h * 0.55f), ImVec2(x + bend, y - h),
                   ImVec2(x + w * 0.55f + bend * 0.3f, y - h * 0.55f), ImVec2(x + w, y)};
    fill_grad(dl, p, 5, ImVec2(x, y), ImVec2(x + bend, y - h), root, tip);
}

// A fern frond: a stem arching from `base` (angle in radians, 0 = right, y down) with leaflets on both sides
static void frond(ImDrawList *dl, ImVec2 base, float ang, float len, float droop, ImU32 dark, ImU32 lit) {
    const int N = 12;
    ImVec2 prev = base;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
        float u = (float)i / N, a = ang + droop * u;
        ImVec2 p(prev.x + cosf(a) * len / N, prev.y + sinf(a) * len / N);
        float l = len * 0.16f * (1 - u * 0.75f), nx = -sinf(a), ny = cosf(a);
        ImU32 c = mix(dark, lit, u);
        for (int side : {-1, 1}) {
            ImVec2 q[3] = {prev, ImVec2(p.x + nx * l * side + cosf(a) * l * 0.3f, p.y + ny * l * side + sinf(a) * l * 0.3f), p};
            dl->AddTriangleFilled(q[0], q[1], q[2], c);
        }
        dl->AddLine(prev, p, dark, len * 0.012f + 1);
        prev = p;
    }
}

// A mossy rock: a rounded, slightly irregular outline, moss on top
static void rock(ImDrawList *dl, ImVec2 c, float r, uint32_t seed, ImU32 moss = rgba(0x6f9c3c),
                 ImU32 base = rgba(0x24321f)) {
    ImVec2 p[14];
    for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
        float a = 3.14159265f + i * 3.14159265f / 13, rr = r * (0.85f + 0.25f * hash01(seed * 31 + i));
        p[i] = ImVec2(c.x + cosf(a) * rr * 1.25f, c.y + sinf(a) * rr * 0.9f);
    }
    fill_grad(dl, p, 14, ImVec2(c.x, c.y - r * 0.9f), ImVec2(c.x, c.y), moss, base);
}

static void forest_art(ImDrawList *dl, ImVec2 sz, float t) {
    float W = sz.x, H = sz.y, s = H / 720.0f;
    // depth: dark green above, the clearing's haze lower down, darker again at the floor
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(W, H * 0.55f), rgba(0x0a2013), rgba(0x123018), rgba(0x2b5a2c),
                                rgba(0x1d4424));
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImVec2(0, H * 0.55f), sz, rgba(0x1d4424), rgba(0x2b5a2c), rgba(0x183a1c),
                                rgba(0x10291a));
    // the light where the canopy opens
    glow(dl, ImVec2(W * 0.80f, H * 0.16f), H * 1.0f, rgba(0xf2ffc0, 0.55f), rgba(0xa8d860, 0.20f), 0.35f);
    // far trunks in the haze, lighter towards the light
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
        float x = (i + 0.2f + 0.6f * hash01(i * 7 + 1)) / 18 * W * 1.1f - W * 0.05f, w = H * (0.010f + 0.014f * hash01(i * 7 + 2));
        float near_sun = 1 - fminf(fabsf(x - W * 0.8f) / (W * 0.5f), 1);
        ImU32 c = mix(rgba(0x3f6a3c, 0.55f), rgba(0x9cc86c, 0.45f), near_sun);
        trunk(dl, x, w, H * (0.70f + 0.03f * hash01(i * 7 + 3)), w * (hash01(i * 7 + 4) - 0.5f) * 2, c, c, H);
    }
    // a haze over the far forest
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImVec2(0, H * 0.48f), ImVec2(W, H * 0.70f), rgba(0xd6f0a6, 0), rgba(0xd6f0a6, 0),
                                rgba(0xd6f0a6, 0.20f), rgba(0xd6f0a6, 0.20f));
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImVec2(0, H * 0.70f), ImVec2(W, H * 0.84f), rgba(0xd6f0a6, 0.20f), rgba(0xd6f0a6, 0.20f),
                                rgba(0xd6f0a6, 0), rgba(0xd6f0a6, 0));
    // the forest floor, lit in the clearing
    {
        ImVec2 g[11] = {ImVec2(0, H * 0.80f), ImVec2(W * 0.14f, H * 0.775f), ImVec2(W * 0.32f, H * 0.79f),
                        ImVec2(W * 0.50f, H * 0.755f), ImVec2(W * 0.66f, H * 0.735f), ImVec2(W * 0.80f, H * 0.73f),
                        ImVec2(W * 0.92f, H * 0.745f), ImVec2(W, H * 0.735f), ImVec2(W, H), ImVec2(0, H)};
        fill_grad(dl, g, 10, ImVec2(0, H * 0.73f), ImVec2(0, H), rgba(0x5a9433), rgba(0x10291a));
        glow(dl, ImVec2(W * 0.80f, H * 0.80f), H * 0.30f, rgba(0xe8ff9c, 0.35f), rgba(0xb8e070, 0.12f), 0.4f);
    }
    // middle trunks, lit on the clearing's side
    static const float mid[][3] = {{0.34f, 0.050f, 0.765f}, {0.43f, 0.036f, 0.755f}, {0.555f, 0.062f, 0.75f},
                                   {0.65f, 0.030f, 0.74f},  {0.885f, 0.045f, 0.75f}, {0.965f, 0.07f, 0.745f}};
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        trunk(dl, W * mid[i][0], H * mid[i][1], H * mid[i][2], H * 0.01f * (i & 1 ? 1 : -1), rgba(0x172d18),
              mid[i][0] > 0.6f ? rgba(0x6a8f44) : rgba(0x3e6034), H);
    rock(dl, ImVec2(W * 0.60f, H * 0.785f), H * 0.045f, 1);
    rock(dl, ImVec2(W * 0.705f, H * 0.765f), H * 0.03f, 2);
    rock(dl, ImVec2(W * 0.935f, H * 0.80f), H * 0.055f, 3);
    // shafts of sunlight through the canopy, slowly breathing
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        float x0 = W * (0.60f + 0.40f * hash01(i * 5 + 40)), a = 1.98f + 0.16f * hash01(i * 5 + 41);  // (down and left)
        float w0 = H * (0.015f + 0.035f * hash01(i * 5 + 42)), len = H * (0.9f + 0.4f * hash01(i * 5 + 43));
        float k = (0.14f + 0.12f * hash01(i * 5 + 44)) * (0.7f + 0.3f * sinf(t * (0.25f + 0.2f * hash01(i * 5 + 45)) + i * 1.7f));
        ImVec2 dir(cosf(a), sinf(a)), n(-dir.y, dir.x), a0(x0, -H * 0.04f), a1(a0.x + dir.x * len, a0.y + dir.y * len);
        float w1 = w0 * 2.6f;
        ImU32 top = rgba(0xf4ffc8, k), end = rgba(0xf4ffc8, 0);
        quad_grad(dl, ImVec2(a0.x - n.x * w0, a0.y - n.y * w0), ImVec2(a0.x + n.x * w0, a0.y + n.y * w0),
                  ImVec2(a1.x + n.x * w1, a1.y + n.y * w1), ImVec2(a1.x - n.x * w1, a1.y - n.y * w1), top, top, end, end);
    }
    // the canopy: dark leaves along the top, opening above the clearing, lit at its edge
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
        float x = hash01(i * 3 + 70) * W * 1.1f - W * 0.05f, r = H * (0.05f + 0.10f * hash01(i * 3 + 71));
        float gap = fabsf(x - W * 0.80f) < W * 0.13f ? 1 : 0;
        float y = H * (-0.06f + 0.16f * hash01(i * 3 + 72)) - gap * H * 0.12f + (x < W * 0.3f ? H * 0.06f : 0);
        dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x, y), r, rgba(0x0b1f0f, 0.97f), 28);
        float toward = x < W * 0.8f ? 1.0f : -1.0f;  // (the leaves facing the light)
        dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x + toward * r * 0.35f, y + r * 0.35f), r * 0.55f, rgba(0x2c5524, 0.85f), 24);
    }
    // near trunks, framing the clearing
    trunk(dl, W * 0.035f, H * 0.12f, H * 0.95f, 0, rgba(0x0b1a0c), rgba(0x22401f), H);
    trunk(dl, W * 0.25f, H * 0.075f, H * 0.90f, H * 0.02f, rgba(0x0d1e0e), rgba(0x2a4a22), H);
    trunk(dl, W * 1.0f, H * 0.14f, H * 0.97f, -H * 0.01f, rgba(0x2c4a24), rgba(0x0b1a0c), H);
    // ferns at the sides, nodding in the wind
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
        bool right = i >= 7;
        float bx = right ? W * (0.70f + 0.30f * hash01(i + 90)) : W * (0.02f + 0.30f * hash01(i + 90));
        ImVec2 b(bx, H * (0.90f + 0.08f * hash01(i + 91)));
        float ang = (right ? -2.2f : -0.95f) + 0.5f * (hash01(i + 92) - 0.5f) + 0.04f * sinf(t * 0.9f + i);
        frond(dl, b, ang, H * (0.16f + 0.10f * hash01(i + 93)), right ? -0.9f : 0.9f, rgba(0x163d18),
              right ? rgba(0x7cc043) : rgba(0x3f7a2c));
    }
    // grass: short in the lit clearing, tall in front, all swaying
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 170; i++) {
        float x = hash01(i * 4 + 200) * W, y = H * (0.75f + 0.08f * hash01(i * 4 + 201)), h = H * (0.02f + 0.04f * hash01(i * 4 + 202));
        float light = 1 - fminf(fabsf(x - W * 0.78f) / (W * 0.45f), 1);
        float bend = h * (0.25f * sinf(t * 1.1f + x * 0.01f) + 0.15f);
        blade(dl, x, y, H * 0.003f, h, bend, rgba(0x2a5a20), mix(rgba(0x5f9a34), rgba(0xd8f58a), light));
    }
    {  // in the clearing's light: Savage Wind's sword in a mossy stone (the old tale, not any game's sword)
        ImVec2 c(W * 0.80f, H * 0.775f);
        float r = H * 0.075f, k = H * 0.30f / 429.0f;  // (the sword from its pommel to the stone: 429 units)
        Place S{ImVec2(c.x, c.y - r * 0.85f - (560 - 515) * k), k};
        glow(dl, S(512, 400), 360 * k, rgba(0xf4ffd0, 0.45f), rgba(0xd8f0a0, 0.15f), 0.4f);
        sword(dl, S);
        // a rough stone block, worn at its edges: grey below, moss on top
        ImVec2 b[8] = {ImVec2(c.x - 1.15f * r, c.y), ImVec2(c.x - 1.05f * r, c.y - 0.62f * r),
                       ImVec2(c.x - 0.86f * r, c.y - 0.90f * r), ImVec2(c.x - 0.2f * r, c.y - 0.97f * r),
                       ImVec2(c.x + 0.62f * r, c.y - 0.93f * r), ImVec2(c.x + 1.0f * r, c.y - 0.7f * r),
                       ImVec2(c.x + 1.12f * r, c.y - 0.25f * r), ImVec2(c.x + 1.18f * r, c.y)};
        fill_grad(dl, b, 8, ImVec2(c.x - r, c.y - r), ImVec2(c.x + r, c.y), rgba(0x7d8a74), rgba(0x353f31));
        ImVec2 m[7] = {ImVec2(c.x - 0.95f * r, c.y - 0.80f * r), ImVec2(c.x - 0.86f * r, c.y - 0.92f * r),
                       ImVec2(c.x - 0.2f * r, c.y - 0.99f * r), ImVec2(c.x + 0.62f * r, c.y - 0.95f * r),
                       ImVec2(c.x + 0.95f * r, c.y - 0.68f * r), ImVec2(c.x + 0.3f * r, c.y - 0.72f * r),
                       ImVec2(c.x - 0.4f * r, c.y - 0.62f * r)};
        fill_grad(dl, m, 7, ImVec2(c.x, c.y - r), ImVec2(c.x, c.y - 0.6f * r), rgba(0xb6dc6a), rgba(0x5f8f34));
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
        float x = hash01(i * 4 + 900) * W * 1.04f - W * 0.02f, y = H * (0.86f + 0.17f * hash01(i * 4 + 901));
        float h = H * (0.07f + 0.14f * hash01(i * 4 + 902)) * (0.7f + (y / H - 0.86f) * 2.5f);
        float light = 1 - fminf(fabsf(x - W * 0.78f) / (W * 0.55f), 1);
        float bend = h * (0.22f * sinf(t * 1.3f + x * 0.006f + hash01(i * 4 + 903) * 2) + 0.12f);
        blade(dl, x, y, H * (0.004f + 0.004f * hash01(i * 4 + 903)), h, bend, rgba(0x0b220d),
              mix(rgba(0x3f7f2a), rgba(0xc8ef6e), light));
    }
    // petals drifting down through the light, and fireflies
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
        float vx = 10 + 20 * hash01(i * 6 + 400), vy = 8 + 14 * hash01(i * 6 + 401), r = (1.6f + 1.6f * hash01(i * 6 + 402)) * s;
        float x = fmodf(hash01(i * 6 + 403) * W - t * vx * s + (W + 40) * 8, W + 40) - 20;
        float y = fmodf(hash01(i * 6 + 404) * H + t * vy * s, H + 40) - 20;
        x += sinf(t * 1.4f + i) * 8 * s;
        ImU32 c = hash01(i * 6 + 405) < 0.5f ? rgba(0xffe4ec, 0.85f) : rgba(0xfff4d8, 0.85f);
        dl->AddEllipseFilled(ImVec2(x, y), ImVec2(r, r * 0.55f), c, t * (1 + hash01(i)) + i, 10);
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        float k = sinf(t * (1.1f + hash01(i * 3 + 600)) + i * 2.1f);
        if (k <= 0) continue;
        ImVec2 p(W * (0.38f + 0.6f * hash01(i * 3 + 601)) + sinf(t * 0.3f + i) * 30 * s,
                 H * (0.45f + 0.45f * hash01(i * 3 + 602)) + cosf(t * 0.4f + i * 1.3f) * 20 * s);
        glow(dl, p, 9 * s, rgba(0xf6ff9a, 0.7f * k), rgba(0xd8f060, 0.2f * k), 0.3f);
    }
    // darker at the edges
    ImU32 v = rgba(0x040c06, 0.55f), z = rgba(0x040c06, 0);
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(W, H * 0.22f), v, v, z, z);
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImVec2(0, H * 0.82f), sz, z, z, v, v);
}

void splash_draw(ImDrawList *dl, ImVec2 sz, float t) {
    if (!g_tex) { forest_art(dl, sz, t); return; }
    // the picture fills the window (cropped to its shape, centred)
    float ia = (float)g_tex_w / g_tex_h, da = sz.x / sz.y;
    ImVec2 uv0(0, 0), uv1(1, 1);
    if (ia > da) uv0.x = (1 - da / ia) * 0.5f, uv1.x = 1 - uv0.x;
    else uv0.y = (1 - ia / da) * 0.5f, uv1.y = 1 - uv0.y;
    dl->AddImage(g_tex, ImVec2(0, 0), sz, uv0, uv1);
    dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), sz, IM_COL32(4, 8, 20, 56));  // (a touch darker: the text stays the brightest)
}
```

`runtime/ui_layout.c`:

```c
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "ui_layout.h"
#include "game_sites.h"
#include "hle.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "settings.h"
#include "framepace.h"
#include "nvn/nvn.h"

static bool ui_range(uint64_t p, uint64_t n) {
    return p >= GUEST_LO && p < GUEST_HI && n <= GUEST_HI - p;
}

// MiniMap's native animation chooses the map presentation before pause state catches up.
// Frame zero is the full map; its end frame is the minimap, also while opening the inventory.
int ui_layout_map_mode(uint64_t screen) {
    if (strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0") || !ui_range(screen, 0x3648)) return -1;
    uint64_t animation = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(screen + 0x3640);
    if (!ui_range(animation, 0x24)) return -1;
    uint64_t resource = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(animation + 0x18);
    if (!ui_range(resource, 0xa)) return -1;
    unsigned end = *(uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(resource + 8);
    float frame = *(float *)(uintptr_t)(animation + 0x20);
    if (!end || !isfinite(frame)) return -1;
    return frame == 0 ? 1 : frame == end ? 0 : -1;
}

static _Thread_local unsigned pane_draw_depth;
RT_ON_RESET(ui_layout_reset) { pane_draw_depth = 0; }

bool rt_ui_layout_pane_draw(Cpu *c, void (*native)(Cpu *)) {
#ifdef __APPLE__
    return false;
#else
    uint64_t pane = c->x[0];
    if (pane_draw_depth || !native || (!g_settings.hud_edges && g_settings.hud_size == 100) ||
        strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0") || !g_site.screen_mgr || !ui_range(pane, 0xf8) ||
        memcmp((const void *)(uintptr_t)(pane + 0xb8), "Pa_QuestName_00", sizeof "Pa_QuestName_00")) return false;
    uint64_t manager = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)g_site.screen_mgr;
    if (!ui_range(manager, 0x38)) return false;
    uint32_t count = *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(manager + 0x28);
    uint64_t screens = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(manager + 0x30);
    if (count <= 0x25 || count > 256 || !ui_range(screens, count * 8)) return false;
    uint64_t hud = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(screens + 8 * 0x25);
    if (!ui_range(hud, 0x3cc8)) return false;
    uint64_t quest = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(hud + 0x3cc0);
    if (!quest || *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(pane + 0xf0) != quest) return false;
    // MainScreen embeds this notification part: its glyph origins and window centers fall
    // into different HUD anchor zones. Keep the complete subtree in its native layout.
    uint64_t wrapper = c->x[2];
    if (!ui_range(wrapper, 0xb8)) return false;
    uint64_t commands = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(wrapper + 0xb0);
    if (!nvn_ui_scope(commands, UI_LAYOUT_DIALOGUE)) return false;
    pane_draw_depth++;
    native(c);  // the entry gate re-enters once, then draws the original subtree normally
    pane_draw_depth--;
    nvn_ui_scope(commands, UI_LAYOUT_NONE);
    return true;
#endif
}

uint64_t ui_layout_begin(Cpu *c) {
#ifdef __APPLE__
    return 0;
#else
    if ((!g_settings.hud_edges && g_settings.hud_size == 100) || !g_site.screen_mgr || strcmp(g_game_version, "1.9.0")) return 0;
    uint64_t manager = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)g_site.screen_mgr;
    if (!ui_range(manager, 0x38)) return 0;
    uint32_t count = *(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(manager + 0x28);
    uint64_t screens = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(manager + 0x30), screen = c->x[0];
    if (count <= 0x4c || count > 256 || !ui_range(screens, count * 8)) return 0;
    const uint64_t *slots = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)screens;
    unsigned kind = screen == slots[0x25] || screen == slots[0x2] || screen == slots[0x1c] ? UI_LAYOUT_HUD : screen == slots[0xc] ? UI_LAYOUT_CONTEXT :
                    screen == slots[0xb] || screen == slots[0x11] || screen == slots[0x27] ||
                    screen == slots[0x2d] || screen == slots[0x4a] || screen == slots[0x4c] ? UI_LAYOUT_DIALOGUE : UI_LAYOUT_NONE;
    // AppMap renders the minimap in play and the full map in pause. Keep their policies separate.
    if (screen == slots[0x2a]) {
        int map = ui_layout_map_mode(screen);
        kind = (map < 0 ? framepace_menu_ui() : map) ? UI_LAYOUT_MENU : UI_LAYOUT_HUD;
    }
    if (screen == slots[0x4a]) kind = UI_LAYOUT_TALK;
    if (!kind || !ui_range(screen, 0x103)) return 0;
    const uint8_t *state = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)screen;
    // The native draw returns here before the render context is required to be initialized.
    if (!state[0x100] || state[0x102] || !state[0xfe] || state[0xff] == 2) return 0;
    uint64_t context = c->x[1];
    if (!kind || !ui_range(context, 0x28)) return 0;
    uint64_t commands = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(context + 0x20);
    if (!ui_range(commands, 0xc0)) return 0;
    // Layout/pane draw receives nn::gfx's wrapper at +8; its NVN object is the pointer at wrapper+0xb0.
    commands = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(commands + 0xb8);
    if (!ui_range(commands, 8)) return 0;
    return nvn_ui_scope(commands, kind) ? commands : 0;
#endif
}

void ui_layout_end(Cpu *c, uint64_t commands) {
    (void)c;
    if (commands) nvn_ui_scope(commands, UI_LAYOUT_NONE);
}

void rt_ui_layout_draw(Cpu *c, void (*native)(Cpu *)) {
    uint64_t commands = ui_layout_begin(c);
    native(c);
    ui_layout_end(c, commands);
}
```
