`tests/test_audio_mix.c`:

```c
// Unit tests for 5.1 surround pass-through, ITU stereo downmix, and 3D binaural headphone spatialization.
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "../runtime/audio_mix.h"

#define CHECK(cond, ...)                                                       \
    do {                                                                       \
        if (!(cond)) {                                                         \
            fprintf(stderr, "FAIL %s:%d: ", __FILE__, __LINE__);               \
            fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__);                                      \
            fprintf(stderr, "\n");                                             \
            return 1;                                                          \
        }                                                                      \
    } while (0)

static int nearf(float a, float b, float eps) { return fabsf(a - b) <= eps; }

static int test_channel_counts(void) {
    CHECK(audio_device_channels(AUDIO_OUT_STEREO) == 2u, "stereo device channels");
    CHECK(audio_device_channels(AUDIO_OUT_SURROUND_51) == 6u, "5.1 device channels");
    CHECK(audio_device_channels(AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D) == 6u, "3D headphones device channels");

    CHECK(audio_output_channels(AUDIO_OUT_STEREO) == 2u, "stereo stream channels");
    CHECK(audio_output_channels(AUDIO_OUT_SURROUND_51) == 6u, "5.1 stream channels");
    CHECK(audio_output_channels(AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D) == 2u, "3D headphones stream channels");
    return 0;
}

static int test_stereo_downmix(void) {
    float out[2] = {0};
    float mono[6] = {0.4f, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    audio_mix_sample(NULL, mono, 1, AUDIO_OUT_STEREO, out);
    CHECK(nearf(out[0], 0.4f, 1e-6f) && nearf(out[1], 0.4f, 1e-6f), "mono -> stereo");

    float in6[6] = {0.2f, -0.1f, 0.5f, 0.4f, 0.3f, -0.2f};
    audio_mix_sample(NULL, in6, 6, AUDIO_OUT_STEREO, out);
    float exp_l = 0.2f + 0.707f * 0.5f + 0.251f * 0.4f + 0.707f * 0.3f;
    float exp_r = -0.1f + 0.707f * 0.5f + 0.251f * 0.4f + 0.707f * (-0.2f);
    CHECK(nearf(out[0], exp_l, 1e-5f) && nearf(out[1], exp_r, 1e-5f),
          "ITU 5.1 -> stereo got (%.5f, %.5f) expected (%.5f, %.5f)", out[0], out[1], exp_l, exp_r);
    return 0;
}

static int test_surround_51_passthrough(void) {
    float out[6] = {0};
    float in6[6] = {0.15f, -0.25f, 0.35f, 0.45f, -0.55f, 0.65f};
    audio_mix_sample(NULL, in6, 6, AUDIO_OUT_SURROUND_51, out);
    for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
        CHECK(nearf(out[k], in6[k], 1e-6f), "5.1 ch %d got %.5f expected %.5f", k, out[k], in6[k]);

    // 2-channel source into a 5.1 stream populates FL/FR and zeroes FC, LFE, BL, BR.
    float in2[6] = {0.5f, -0.5f, 0.9f, 0.9f, 0.9f, 0.9f};
    audio_mix_sample(NULL, in2, 2, AUDIO_OUT_SURROUND_51, out);
    CHECK(nearf(out[0], 0.5f, 1e-6f) && nearf(out[1], -0.5f, 1e-6f), "2ch in 5.1 FL/FR");
    for (int k = 2; k < 6; k++) CHECK(out[k] == 0.0f, "2ch in 5.1 ch %d should be 0", k);
    return 0;
}

static int test_binaural_3d_itd_and_symmetry(void) {
    Audio3DState st_l, st_r;
    audio_3d_reset(&st_l);
    audio_3d_reset(&st_r);

    // Front Left vs Front Right impulse: near ear at sample 0, far ear at sample 12.
    for (int s = 0; s < 48; s++) {
        float in_fl[6] = {s == 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
        float in_fr[6] = {0, s == 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f, 0, 0, 0, 0};
        float out_fl[2] = {0}, out_fr[2] = {0};
        audio_mix_sample(&st_l, in_fl, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out_fl);
        audio_mix_sample(&st_r, in_fr, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out_fr);
        CHECK(nearf(out_fl[0], out_fr[1], 1e-6f) && nearf(out_fl[1], out_fr[0], 1e-6f),
              "front symmetry at sample %d", s);
        if (s == 0) {
            CHECK(out_fl[0] > 0.8f && out_fl[1] == 0.0f, "FL sample 0: direct to L only");
        } else if (s < 12) {
            CHECK(out_fl[0] == 0.0f && out_fl[1] == 0.0f, "FL before ITD at sample %d", s);
        } else if (s == 12) {
            CHECK(out_fl[0] == 0.0f && out_fl[1] > 0.04f, "FL contralateral ITD arrival at sample 12");
        }
    }

    // Back Left vs Back Right impulse: near ear at sample 8, far ear at sample 34.
    audio_3d_reset(&st_l);
    audio_3d_reset(&st_r);
    for (int s = 0; s < 48; s++) {
        float in_bl[6] = {0, 0, 0, 0, s == 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f, 0};
        float in_br[6] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, s == 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f};
        float out_bl[2] = {0}, out_br[2] = {0};
        audio_mix_sample(&st_l, in_bl, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out_bl);
        audio_mix_sample(&st_r, in_br, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out_br);
        CHECK(nearf(out_bl[0], out_br[1], 1e-6f) && nearf(out_bl[1], out_br[0], 1e-6f),
              "rear symmetry at sample %d", s);
        if (s < 8) {
            CHECK(out_bl[0] == 0.0f && out_bl[1] == 0.0f, "BL before rear depth offset at sample %d", s);
        } else if (s == 8) {
            CHECK(out_bl[0] > 0.5f && out_bl[1] == 0.0f, "BL ipsilateral arrival at sample 8");
        } else if (s < 34) {
            CHECK(out_bl[1] == 0.0f, "BL contralateral silent before sample 34 (at %d)", s);
        } else if (s == 34) {
            CHECK(out_bl[1] > 0.03f, "BL contralateral ITD arrival at sample 34");
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int test_binaural_center_lfe_and_headroom(void) {
    Audio3DState st;
    audio_3d_reset(&st);

    // Center channel is perfectly balanced (L == R) with early reflection at sample 2.
    float out0[2] = {0}, out2[2] = {0};
    float fc_imp[6] = {0, 0, 0.5f, 0, 0, 0};
    float zero[6] = {0};
    audio_mix_sample(&st, fc_imp, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out0);
    CHECK(nearf(out0[0], out0[1], 1e-6f) && nearf(out0[0], 0.34f, 1e-5f), "FC direct");
    audio_mix_sample(&st, zero, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out2);
    audio_mix_sample(&st, zero, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out2);
    CHECK(nearf(out2[0], out2[1], 1e-6f) && nearf(out2[0], 0.03f, 1e-5f), "FC 2-sample reflection");

    // LFE low-pass accumulates sub-bass over steady input while attenuating Nyquist alternation.
    audio_3d_reset(&st);
    float lfe_dc = 0.0f, lfe_alt = 0.0f;
    for (int s = 0; s < 240; s++) {
        float in_dc[6] = {0, 0, 0, 0.8f, 0, 0}, out[2];
        audio_mix_sample(&st, in_dc, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out);
        lfe_dc = fabsf(out[0]);
    }
    audio_3d_reset(&st);
    for (int s = 0; s < 240; s++) {
        float in_nyq[6] = {0, 0, 0, (s & 1) ? -0.8f : 0.8f, 0, 0}, out[2];
        audio_mix_sample(&st, in_nyq, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out);
        lfe_alt = fabsf(out[0]);
    }
    CHECK(lfe_dc > 3.0f * lfe_alt, "LFE low-pass should favor bass (dc=%.4f vs nyq=%.4f)", lfe_dc, lfe_alt);

    // Full-scale simultaneous input on all 6 channels stays strictly bounded inside (-1, 1).
    audio_3d_reset(&st);
    float full[6] = {1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f};
    for (int s = 0; s < 128; s++) {
        float out[2] = {0};
        audio_mix_sample(&st, full, 6, AUDIO_OUT_HEADPHONES_3D, out);
        CHECK(out[0] > 0.85f && out[0] < 1.0f && nearf(out[0], out[1], 1e-6f),
              "soft limiter out of bounds at %d: %.6f", s, out[0]);
    }
    CHECK(audio_soft_clip(NAN) == 0.0f, "NaN guard");
    return 0;
}

int main(void) {
    if (test_channel_counts()) return 1;
    if (test_stereo_downmix()) return 1;
    if (test_surround_51_passthrough()) return 1;
    if (test_binaural_3d_itd_and_symmetry()) return 1;
    if (test_binaural_center_lfe_and_headroom()) return 1;
    printf("test_audio_mix: ok\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/test_bloom_scale.c`:

```c
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include "../runtime/nvn/vulkan/bloom_scale.h"

int main(void) {
    const uint64_t reduce = UINT64_C(0x11eb927369affaf0);
    const uint64_t blur = UINT64_C(0x76d0ca9268564299);
    const uint64_t combine = UINT64_C(0xc602d85d67ced2bf);
    // Actual mip chain and odd scratch targets observed in the 4K trace.
    assert(bloom_native_target(reduce, 1, 0x3f, 320, 180, 1));
    assert(bloom_native_target(blur, 1, 0x3f, 160, 90, 1));
    assert(bloom_native_target(blur, 1, 0x3f, 80, 45, 1));
    assert(bloom_native_target(blur, 1, 0x3f, 40, 22, 1));
    assert(bloom_native_target(blur, 1, 0x3f, 20, 11, 1));
    assert(bloom_native_target(combine, 1, 0x3f, 320, 180, 1));
    // A matching size alone must never classify scene, depth or UI work as bloom.
    assert(!bloom_native_target(0, 1, 0x3f, 320, 180, 1));
    assert(!bloom_native_target(blur, 1, 0x34, 320, 180, 1));
    assert(!bloom_native_target(blur, 4, 0x3f, 320, 180, 1));
    assert(!bloom_native_target(blur, 1, 0x3f, 1600, 900, 1));
    assert(!bloom_native_target(blur, 1, 0x3f, 320, 180, 4));
    assert(!bloom_native_target(blur, 1, 0x3f, 0, 0, 1));
    puts("Bloom target guards: PASS (gameplay visual validation pending)");
}
```

`tests/test_cursor_math.c`:

```c
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include "../runtime/pc_cursor_math.h"
int main(void) {
    int sizes[][2]={{1280,720},{1920,1080},{2560,1440},{3840,2160},{2560,1080},{1280,1024},{1920,1200}};
    for(unsigned i=0;i<sizeof sizes/sizeof sizes[0];i++) {
        float w=sizes[i][0],h=sizes[i][1],k=fminf(w/1280,h/720),p[2];
        assert(pc_cursor_to_layout(w,h,w*.5f+550*k,h*.5f+80*k,0,p));
        assert(fabsf(p[0]-550)<.001f&&fabsf(p[1]+80)<.001f);
        assert(pc_cursor_to_layout(w,h,w*.5f-280*k,h*.5f-97*k,0,p));
        assert(fabsf(p[0]+280)<.001f&&fabsf(p[1]-97)<.001f);
        printf("%dx%d: title and inventory coordinates PASS\n",sizes[i][0],sizes[i][1]);
    }
    float p[2];assert(!pc_cursor_to_layout(2560,1080,0,540,0,p));
    assert(!pc_cursor_to_layout(1280,1024,640,0,0,p));
    assert(!pc_cursor_to_layout(0,0,0,0,0,p));
    assert(pc_cursor_to_layout(1280,800,640,24,40,p));
    assert(fabsf(p[1]-376)<.001f);
    assert(pc_cursor_to_layout(1280,800,640,760,40,p));
    assert(fabsf(p[1]+360)<.001f);
    assert(pc_cursor_to_layout(1280,800,640,100,120,p)); // a virtual 4:3 map in a 16:10 window
    assert(fabsf(p[1]-360)<.001f);
    assert(!pc_cursor_to_layout(1280,800,100,400,120,p));

    puts("PASS: aspect ratios, bars and zero-size windows");
    float zooms[]={.07f,.14f,.28f,1.f};
    for(unsigned z=0;z<4;z++)for(int frame=0;frame<300;frame++) {
        float zoom=zooms[z],p[2]={-300+frame*2,-100+frame*.5f};
        float center[2]={-3115.94f+frame,6108.09f-frame*.7f};
        float translation[2]={center[0]*zoom,center[1]*zoom},world[2];
        pc_cursor_map_world(p,translation,zoom,world);
        assert(fabsf(world[0]*zoom+translation[0]-p[0])<.002f);
        assert(fabsf(world[1]*zoom+translation[1]-p[1])<.002f);
        // Dragging by a logical pixel moves the rendered map by that pixel at every zoom.
        float dragged=center[0]+2/zoom;
        assert(fabsf(dragged*zoom-translation[0]-2)<.002f);
    }
    puts("PASS: 1200 moving pointer/pan samples at 4 map zoom levels");
    float middle[2]={0,0},corner[2]={632,280},header[2]={0,330},outside[2]={700,0},delta[2];
    pc_map_navigation(middle,0,0,true,.02f,1,0,delta);assert(delta[0]==0&&delta[1]==0);
    pc_map_navigation(header,0,0,true,.02f,1,0,delta);assert(delta[0]==0&&delta[1]==0);
    pc_map_navigation(outside,0,0,true,.02f,1,0,delta);assert(delta[0]==0&&delta[1]==0);
    pc_map_navigation(corner,0,0,false,.02f,1,0,delta);assert(delta[0]==0&&delta[1]==0);
    for(int fps=30;fps<=120;fps*=2)for(unsigned z=0;z<4;z++) {
        float total=0;
        for(int f=0;f<fps;f++){pc_map_navigation(middle,1,0,false,1.f/fps,zooms[z],0,delta);total+=delta[0]*zooms[z];}
        assert(fabsf(total+360)<.002f);
        pc_map_navigation(corner,0,0,true,1.f/fps,zooms[z],0,delta);
        assert(delta[0]<0&&delta[1]<0);
        assert(fabsf(hypotf(delta[0],delta[1])*zooms[z]-360.f/fps)<.002f);
    }
    pc_map_navigation(middle,1,0,false,10,1,0,delta);assert(fabsf(delta[0]+18)<.001f);
    float expanded_edge[2]={0,320},expanded_header[2]={0,370};
    pc_map_navigation(expanded_edge,0,0,true,.02f,1,40,delta);
    assert(delta[0]==0&&fabsf(delta[1]+7.2f)<.001f);
    pc_map_navigation(expanded_header,0,0,true,.02f,1,40,delta);
    assert(delta[0]==0&&delta[1]==0);
    puts("PASS: map navigation speed at 30/60/120 FPS and 4 zooms; normalized corners, header/outside exclusion, drag/modal suppression and stall limit");
    // The native lower-screen edge is FLT_MAX, not a usable world extent.
    // Mouse dragging, edge scrolling and WASD must stop at the zoom-dependent
    // opposite extent and recover positions left outside by older revisions.
    for(unsigned z=0;z<4;z++) {
        float extent=fmaxf(0,10000-360/zooms[z]);
        float center=0;
        for(unsigned i=0;i<20000;i++)center=pc_map_clamp_center(center+360/zooms[z],-extent,FLT_MAX);
        assert(center==extent);
        for(unsigned i=0;i<20000;i++)center=pc_map_clamp_center(center-360/zooms[z],-extent,FLT_MAX);
        assert(center==-extent);
        assert(pc_map_clamp_center(1e20f,-extent,FLT_MAX)==extent);
        assert(pc_map_clamp_center(-1e20f,-extent,FLT_MAX)==-extent);
    }
    assert(pc_map_clamp_center(11567.6f,-2000,FLT_MAX)==2000);
    assert(pc_map_clamp_center(10,-0.f,0.f)==0);
    assert(pc_map_clamp_center(2000,-1000,1500)==1500); // preserve asymmetric finite limits
    assert(pc_map_clamp_center(-2000,-FLT_MAX,1500)==-1500);
    assert(pc_map_clamp_center(INFINITY,-2000,FLT_MAX)==0);
    puts("PASS: pan limits at every zoom, unbounded native sentinel, all directions and escaped-view recovery");
    // A wheel zoom anchored on the pointer: the world point under it stays under it at every zoom step, for any pointer
    // position and starting view, in and out.
    for(int from=0;from<4;from++)for(int to=0;to<4;to++)for(int frame=0;frame<100;frame++) {
        float point[2]={-620+frame*12.5f,-270+frame*5.5f};
        float center[2]={-3115.94f+frame*40,6108.09f-frame*30};
        float translation[2]={center[0]*zooms[from],center[1]*zooms[from]},world[2];
        pc_cursor_map_world(point,translation,zooms[from],world);
        for(int step=0;step<=10;step++) {
            float zoom=zooms[from]+(zooms[to]-zooms[from])*step/10.f,c[2],under[2];
            pc_map_anchor_center(point,world,zoom,c);
            float t[2]={c[0]*zoom,c[1]*zoom};
            pc_cursor_map_world(point,t,zoom,under);
            assert(fabsf(under[0]-world[0])<.01f&&fabsf(under[1]-world[1])<.01f);
            assert(fabsf(world[0]*zoom+t[0]-point[0])<.01f&&fabsf(world[1]*zoom+t[1]-point[1])<.01f);
        }
    }
    puts("PASS: wheel zoom keeps the world point under the pointer, 1600 pointer/view/zoom-step combinations");
}
```

`tests/test_discord_rpc.c`:

```c
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#define DISCORD_RPC_TEST
#include "../runtime/discord_rpc.c"

int main(void) {
    char j[1024];

    // Escaped text
    assert(discord_activity_json(j, sizeof j, 42, 1000, "Isla \"Eventide\"\\", "", 7) > 0);
    assert(strstr(j, "\"details\":\"Isla \\\"Eventide\\\"\\\\\""));
    assert(!strstr(j, "\"state\""));  // (Discord refuses an empty state)
    assert(strstr(j, "\"pid\":42"));
    assert(strstr(j, "\"start\":1000"));
    assert(strstr(j, "\"nonce\":\"7\""));
    assert(strstr(j, "\"cmd\":\"SET_ACTIVITY\""));

    // UTF-8 goes through as it is
    assert(discord_activity_json(j, sizeof j, 1, 1, "Aldea Kakariko", "Cañón", 1) > 0);
    assert(strstr(j, "\"state\":\"Cañón\""));

    // Too small a buffer fails rather than cuts
    assert(discord_activity_json(j, 16, 1, 1, "Aldea Kakariko", "Necluda", 1) < 0);

    // The frame: op and length, little endian, then the text
    uint8_t f[64];
    int n = discord_frame(f, sizeof f, 1, "{}");
    assert(n == 10);
    assert(f[0] == 1 && f[1] == 0 && f[4] == 2 && f[5] == 0);
    assert(f[8] == '{' && f[9] == '}');
    assert(discord_frame(f, 9, 1, "{}") < 0);

    // The id: digits only
    assert(discord_app_id_valid("1234567890123456789"));
    assert(!discord_app_id_valid(""));
    assert(!discord_app_id_valid("12ab"));

    puts("PASS: discord_rpc");
}
```

```c
#include <stdio.h>

static char details[128], state[128];

static bool text(float x, float z, bool has_link) { return game_place_text(x, z, has_link, details, sizeof details, state, sizeof state); }

static void expect(const char *d, const char *s) {

int main(void) {
    game_place_set_language("EUes");

    assert(!strcmp(game_place_region(-3607.2f, -1805.5f), "Tabanta"));
    assert(!strcmp(game_place_region(1719.0f, -2456.2f), "Eldin"));

    assert(!game_place_name(-9000, 9000));

    assert(text(1811.7f, 982.6f, true));
    expect("Aldea Kakariko", "Picos Gemelos");

    // Leaving a shrine with the map files still cached: only the field's physics and navigation are read again
    game_place_on_read("Pack/Dungeon099.pack");
    game_place_on_read("UI/MapTex/MainField/MapTex3_A-0_0.sbmapt");  // (the map screen, inside the shrine)
    assert(text(5, 5, true));
    expect("Santuario de Ranhtoe", "Interior de santuario");
    game_place_on_read("Physics/StaticCompound/MainField/G-5-0.shksc");
    assert(text(1811.7f, 982.6f, true));
    expect("Aldea Kakariko", "Picos Gemelos");

    game_place_on_read("NavMesh/MainField/27-19.shknm2");
    assert(text(1811.7f, 982.6f, true));

    // Far from every name: exploring, in its region

    assert(found);

    assert(!strcmp(details, "Explorando") && strlen(state) > 0);

    assert(!strcmp(game_place_region(1811.7f, 982.6f), "Dueling Peaks"));
    assert(!strcmp(game_place_region(-1755, -774), "Ridgeland"));
    game_place_on_read("Pack/Title.pack");
    assert(text(0, 0, false));
    expect("In the main menu", "");
    game_place_on_read("Pack/RemainsWater.pack");
    assert(text(48, 3, true));
    expect("Vah Ruta", "Divine Beast");
    game_place_on_read("Pack/Dungeon120.pack");
    assert(text(48, 3, true));
    expect("Shrine", "Inside a shrine");
    game_place_on_read("Pack/Dungeon000.pack");

    game_place_on_read("Map/MainField/D-6/D-6_Static.smubin");
    assert(text(x - 50, z - 50, true));
    assert(!strcmp(details, "Exploring"));
```

`tests/test_hud_button_layout.c`:

```c
#include <assert.h>

#define main unused_fs_main

const TextLanguage g_text_languages[] = {{"Auto", NULL, NULL}};

static size_t append_sec(uint8_t *b, size_t o, const char tag[4], const void *body, uint32_t body_sz) {
    uint32_t sz = 8 + body_sz;
    memcpy(b + o, tag, 4);
    memcpy(b + o + 4, &sz, 4);
    memcpy(b + o + 8, body, body_sz);
    return o + sz;
}

static size_t append_pane(uint8_t *b, size_t o, const char tag[4], const char *name, float x, float y, float rz, float sx) {
    uint8_t body[96] = {0};
    strncpy((char *)body + 4, name, 24);
    float sy = 1.0f, w = 48.0f, h = 48.0f;
    memcpy(body + 36, &x, 4);
    memcpy(body + 40, &y, 4);
    memcpy(body + 56, &rz, 4);
    memcpy(body + 60, &sx, 4);
    memcpy(body + 64, &sy, 4);
    memcpy(body + 68, &w, 4);
    memcpy(body + 72, &h, 4);
    return append_sec(b, o, tag, body, sizeof body);
}

static size_t append_dim_txt(uint8_t *b, size_t o, const char *name, char letter, float x, float y) {
    uint8_t body[0x70] = {0};
    strncpy((char *)body + 4, name, 24);
    memcpy(body + 36, &x, 4);
    memcpy(body + 40, &y, 4);
    float one = 1.0f, fw = 20.4f, fh = 25.5f;
    memcpy(body + 60, &one, 4);
    memcpy(body + 64, &one, 4);
    uint32_t toff = 0x6C;
    memcpy(body + 0x5C, &toff, 4);
    memcpy(body + 0x68, &fw, 4);
    memcpy(body + 0x6C, &fh, 4);
    uint8_t full[0x78] = {0};
    memcpy(full, body, sizeof body);
    full[0x64] = (uint8_t)letter;
    return append_sec(b, o, "txt1", full, sizeof full);
}

static size_t build_synthetic_padocommand(uint8_t *b, int which) {
    memset(b, 0, 2048);
    memcpy(b, "FLYT\xFF\xFE\x14\x00\x00\x02\x08\x05", 12);
    size_t o = 0x14;
    uint8_t txl[40] = {0};
    txl[0] = 1;
    uint32_t toff = 8;
    memcpy(txl + 4, &toff, 4);
    strcpy((char *)txl + 8, (which == 0 || which == 3) ? "Nt_KeyBtnSubBaseAL_00^s" : "Nt_KeyBtnSubBaseBL_00^s");
    o = append_sec(b, o, "txl1", txl, sizeof txl);
    uint8_t fnl[28] = {0};
    fnl[0] = 1;
    uint32_t foff = 8;
    memcpy(fnl + 4, &foff, 4);
    strcpy((char *)fnl + 8, "Normal_00.bffnt");
    o = append_sec(b, o, "fnl1", fnl, sizeof fnl);
    o = append_pane(b, o, "pic1", "P_Base_00", 0.0f, 0.0f, (which == 2 || which == 3) ? 180.0f : 0.0f,
                    which == 2 ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
    static const char letters[4] = {'A', 'B', 'X', 'Y'};
    static const char *const tnames[4] = {"T_A_00", "T_B_00", "T_X_00", "T_Y_00"};
    static const float dim_xy[4][2] = {{26.2f, 0.8f}, {1.0f, -26.0f}, {0.8f, 26.0f}, {-25.5f, -0.2f}};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        if (i != which) o = append_dim_txt(b, o, tnames[i], letters[i], dim_xy[i][0], dim_xy[i][1]);
    static const float act_xy[4][2] = {{26.0f, 0.0f}, {0.0f, -26.0f}, {0.0f, 26.0f}, {-26.0f, 0.0f}};
    o = append_pane(b, o, "pan1", "N_BtnA_00", act_xy[which][0], act_xy[which][1], 0.0f, 1.0f);
    o = append_pane(b, o, "wnd1", "W_Base_00", which == 3 ? 33.0f : -33.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, which == 3 ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
    o = append_pane(b, o, "txt1", "T_Guide_01", which == 3 ? -23.0f : 21.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    o = append_pane(b, o, "pic1", "P_CaptureUse", which == 3 ? -60.0f : 60.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    o = append_pane(b, o, "pan1", "N_Capture_00", act_xy[which][0] + (which == 3 ? -60.0f : 60.0f), act_xy[which][1], 0.0f, 1.0f);
    o = append_pane(b, o, "txt1", "T_Guide_00", which == 3 ? 37.0f : -39.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    o = append_pane(b, o, "pic1", "Nt_KeyTexA_01", which == 3 ? 60.0f : -60.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    o = append_pane(b, o, "pic1", "P_CaptureUse_01", act_xy[which][0] + (which == 3 ? -60.0f : 60.0f), act_xy[which][1], 0.0f, 1.0f);
    uint32_t total = (uint32_t)o;
    memcpy(b + 0xC, &total, 4);
    return o;
}

static const uint8_t *find_pane(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, const char *name) {
    size_t o = b[6] | b[7] << 8;
    while (o + 8 <= n) {
        uint32_t sz;
        memcpy(&sz, b + o + 4, 4);
        if (sz < 8 || o + sz > n) break;
        if (sz >= 84 && (!memcmp(b + o, "pan1", 4) || !memcmp(b + o, "pic1", 4) ||
                         !memcmp(b + o, "wnd1", 4) || !memcmp(b + o, "txt1", 4))) {
            if (!strncmp((const char *)b + o + 12, name, 24)) return b + o;
        }
        o += sz;
    }
    return NULL;
}

static bool nearf(float a, float b) { return fabsf(a - b) < 1e-4f; }

int main(void) {
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_PAD);
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_KEY);

    int pos[4];
    g_settings.button_layout = BUTTON_LAYOUT_AUTO;
    glyphs_hud_positions(pos);
    assert(pos[0] == 0 && pos[1] == 1 && pos[2] == 2 && pos[3] == 3);

    // Automatic follows g_bind_pad swaps (e.g. PS5 Cross / Circle swapped)
    g_bind_pad[BIND_A] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH;
    g_bind_pad[BIND_B] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST;
    glyphs_hud_positions(pos);
    assert(pos[0] == 1 && pos[1] == 0 && pos[2] == 2 && pos[3] == 3);

    // Automatic also follows per-action swaps when g_bind_pad is at default
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_PAD);
    g_act_pad[0] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH;   // Interact
    g_act_pad[14] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST;   // Cancel
    glyphs_hud_positions(pos);
    assert(pos[0] == 1 && pos[1] == 0 && pos[2] == 2 && pos[3] == 3);
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_PAD);

    // Explicit presets
    g_settings.button_layout = BUTTON_LAYOUT_SWAP_AB;
    glyphs_hud_positions(pos);
    assert(pos[0] == 1 && pos[1] == 0 && pos[2] == 2 && pos[3] == 3);

    g_settings.button_layout = BUTTON_LAYOUT_XBOX;
    glyphs_hud_positions(pos);
    assert(pos[0] == 1 && pos[1] == 0 && pos[2] == 3 && pos[3] == 2);

    g_settings.button_layout = BUTTON_LAYOUT_SWAP_XY;
    glyphs_hud_positions(pos);
    assert(pos[0] == 0 && pos[1] == 1 && pos[2] == 3 && pos[3] == 2);

    g_settings.button_layout = BUTTON_LAYOUT_GAMECUBE;
    glyphs_hud_positions(pos);
    assert(pos[0] == 1 && pos[1] == 3 && pos[2] == 0 && pos[3] == 2);

    // Patch synthetic PaDoCommandA/B/X/Y_00 under GameCube layout (A=South, B=West, X=East, Y=North)
    int panes = 0;
    for (int w = 0; w < 4; w++) {
        uint8_t src[2048], dst[2112];
        size_t sn = build_synthetic_padocommand(src, w);
        size_t dn = hud_letters_flyt(src, sn, dst, w, pos, &panes);
        assert(dn > sn);
        const uint8_t *btn = find_pane(dst, dn, "N_BtnA_00");
        const uint8_t *base = find_pane(dst, dn, "P_Base_00");
        const uint8_t *wbase = find_pane(dst, dn, "W_Base_00");
        assert(btn && base && wbase);
        float bx, by, rz, sx, wx, wsx;
        memcpy(&bx, btn + 44, 4);
        memcpy(&by, btn + 48, 4);
        memcpy(&rz, base + 64, 4);
        memcpy(&sx, base + 68, 4);
        memcpy(&wx, wbase + 44, 4);
        memcpy(&wsx, wbase + 68, 4);
        int act = pos[w];
        static const float exp_act[4][2] = {{26.0f, 0.0f}, {0.0f, -26.0f}, {0.0f, 26.0f}, {-26.0f, 0.0f}};
        assert(nearf(bx, exp_act[act][0]) && nearf(by, exp_act[act][1]));
        assert(nearf(rz, (act == 2 || act == 3) ? 180.0f : 0.0f));
        assert(nearf(sx, act == 2 ? -1.0f : 1.0f));
        assert(nearf(wx, act == 3 ? 33.0f : -33.0f));
        assert(nearf(wsx, act == 3 ? -1.0f : 1.0f));
    }
    assert(panes == 12);

    // Settings load/save round-trip for button_layout
    const char *tmp = "build/test_hud_button_layout.ini";
    setenv("SAVAGEWIND_SETTINGS", tmp, 1);
    g_settings.button_layout = BUTTON_LAYOUT_GAMECUBE;
    settings_save();
    FILE *fp = fopen(tmp, "r");
    assert(fp != NULL);
    char buf[4096] = {0};
    fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, fp);
    fclose(fp);
    unlink(tmp);
    assert(strstr(buf, "button_layout = gamecube") != NULL);

    puts("PASS: HUD button layout positions and FLYT patching");
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/test_hud_scale.c`:

```c
#include <assert.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include "../runtime/nvn/hud_scale.h"

#define NEAR(a, b) (fabs((double)(a) - (double)(b)) < 1e-4)

// x and y on screen of a point of a pane, through its view rows and the layer's projection
static void project(const float *v, float m00, float m11, float x, float y, float *nx, float *ny) {
    float vx = v[0] * x + v[1] * y + v[3], vy = v[4] * x + v[5] * y + v[7], vz = v[8] * x + v[9] * y + v[11];
    *nx = m00 * vx / -vz, *ny = m11 * vy / -vz;
}

int main(void) {
    // Pause chrome uses the native outer bands, leaving description borders and inventory rows alone.
    assert(hud_pause_anchor(308, 360) == 1 && hud_pause_anchor(-318, 360) == -1);
    assert(hud_pause_anchor(224, 360) == 0 && hud_pause_anchor(-253, 360) == 0);
    assert(NEAR(hud_pause_edge_dy(.77f, .9f), .1f));
    assert(NEAR(hud_pause_edge_dy(-.8f, .9f), -.1f));
    assert(hud_pause_edge_dy(.9f, 1) == 0 && hud_pause_edge_dy(-.9f, 1.5f) == 0);
    float margin[4] = {100, 100, 100, 100};
    float top[4] = {3900, 100, -2000, 400}, bottom[4] = {3900, 100, -1900, -300};
    float right[4] = {100, 700, 1900, 400}, left[4] = {100, 700, -2000, 300};
    assert(hud_pause_frame_part(margin, 4000, 800, top) == 1);
    assert(hud_pause_frame_part(margin, 4000, 800, bottom) == -1);
    assert(hud_pause_frame_part(margin, 4000, 800, right) == 2);
    assert(hud_pause_frame_part(margin, 4000, 800, left) == 2);
    top[2] += 10;  // arbitrary rectangles and unrelated window margins are rejected
    assert(hud_pause_frame_part(margin, 4000, 800, top) == 0);
    top[2] -= 10; margin[0] = margin[1] = margin[2] = margin[3] = 8;
    assert(hud_pause_frame_part(margin, 4000, 800, top) == 0);

    // Native action-button cluster, its label and shadow all retain the conversation coordinate band.
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        float edge = (float[]){1, .9f, .75f}[i];
        assert(hud_context_keeps(true, 80.0f / 640, -220.0f / 360 * edge, 1, edge));
        assert(hud_context_keeps(true, 190.0f / 640, -216.0f / 360 * edge, 1, edge));
        assert(hud_context_keeps(true, -85.0f / 640, -220.0f / 360 * edge, 1, edge));
        assert(hud_context_keeps(true, 140.0f / 640, -246.0f / 360 * edge, 1, edge));
        assert(!hud_context_keeps(true, 335.5f / 640, -290.0f / 360 * edge, 1, edge));
        assert(!hud_context_keeps(true, 392.0f / 640, -222.0f / 360 * edge, 1, edge));
        assert(!hud_context_keeps(true, 392.0f / 640, -262.0f / 360 * edge, 1, edge));
        assert(!hud_context_keeps(true, .8f, -.7f * edge, 1, edge));  // clock/minimap
        assert(!hud_context_keeps(true, -.7f, -.7f * edge, 1, edge)); // location name
        assert(!hud_context_keeps(true, .2f, .2f, 1, edge));         // quick selector
    }

    assert(!hud_context_keeps(false, 80.0f / 640, -220.0f / 360, 1, 1));

    // Synthetic Y-flipped glyph matrix with an already-tall aspect of 1.6 at 1280x800.
    float text[16] = {1.5f, 0, 0, 190, 0, -2.4f, 0, -550,
                      0, 0, -1, 998, 0, 0, -1, 1000};
    float correction[2];
    assert(hud_combined_shape(text, 128, .9f, correction));
    assert(correction[0] == 1 && correction[1] == 1);
    float glyph_y = text[7] / text[15];
    hud_edge_matrix(text, -.1f);
    assert(NEAR((text[7] / text[15] - glyph_y) * 400, -40));
    // The title's appearance scales X/Y differently. It still needs the same placement as its shadow.
    text[6] = 0;  // restore the unshifted native input before classifying another draw
    text[0] = 1.4f; text[5] = -2.34f;
    assert(hud_combined_shape(text, 128, .9f, correction));
    assert(correction[0] == 1 && correction[1] == 1);
    assert(!hud_combined_shape(text, 560, .9f, correction));
    text[5] = -text[0] * (16.0f / 9.0f);  // cached console projection after resizing
    assert(hud_combined_shape(text, 128, .9f, correction));
    assert(correction[0] == 1 && correction[1] == .9f);
    assert(hud_combined_shape(text, 128, 1.5f, correction));
    assert(NEAR(correction[0], 1 / 1.5f) && correction[1] == 1);
    text[15] = -1;  // screen-space stamp sprites use a different transform
    assert(!hud_combined_shape(text, 128, .9f, correction));

    // The event clears before the final MessageDialog stops drawing.
    bool held = hud_dialogue_holds(false, true, true);
    assert(held);
    held = hud_dialogue_holds(held, false, true);
    assert(held);
    assert(hud_edge_mode(true, .9f, false, false, false, held) == 2);
    assert(hud_edge_moves(2, .8f, .9f));
    assert(!hud_edge_moves(2, -.8f, .9f));
    held = hud_dialogue_holds(held, false, false);
    assert(!held);
    assert(hud_edge_mode(true, .9f, false, false, false, held) == 1);
    assert(!hud_dialogue_holds(false, false, true));  // incidental speech never drew during an event
    assert(!hud_dialogue_holds(true, true, false));  // dialogue closed while another event is still running

    // The zones: the middle third of the screen stays on the centre, the others go to their edge
    assert(hud_anchor(-0.9f, 1) == -1 && hud_anchor(0.9f, 1) == 1 && hud_anchor(0.1f, 1) == 0);
    assert(hud_anchor(-0.3f, 1) == 0 && hud_anchor(-0.34f, 1) == -1);
    assert(hud_anchor(0.5f, 0.75f) == 0.75f);  // (a window wider than 16:9: the HUD's edge is inside the window's)

    // A pane in the top left corner keeps the corner: 50% of the way there, half the size
    float m00 = 1.545f, m11 = 2.747f, v[12] = {1, 0, 0, -600, 0, 1, 0, 300, 0, 0, 1, -1000};
    float x0, y0, x1, y1, a0, b0, a1, b1;
    project(v, m00, m11, 0, 0, &x0, &y0);
    project(v, m00, m11, 100, -50, &x1, &y1);
    hud_scale_view(v, 0.5f, m00, m11, -1, 1);
    project(v, m00, m11, 0, 0, &a0, &b0);
    project(v, m00, m11, 100, -50, &a1, &b1);
    assert(NEAR(a0, -1 + (x0 + 1) * 0.5f) && NEAR(b0, 1 + (y0 - 1) * 0.5f));
    assert(NEAR(a1 - a0, (x1 - x0) * 0.5f) && NEAR(b1 - b0, (y1 - y0) * 0.5f));

    // The same with the view in the matrix (text, the clock): a point, row by row
    float m[16] = {0.002f, 0, 0, 0.8f, 0, -0.003f, 0, -0.8f, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 1};
    hud_scale_matrix(m, 0.5f, 1, -1);
    assert(NEAR(m[3] / m[15], 1 + (0.8f - 1) * 0.5f) && NEAR(m[7] / m[15], -1 + (-0.8f + 1) * 0.5f));
    assert(NEAR(m[0], 0.001f) && NEAR(m[5], -0.0015f));

    // The minimap's scissor in pixels goes with its corner: 1920 wide, the right edge stays
    double p = 1700, n = 200;
    hud_scale_span(&p, &n, 960, 960, 0.5f);
    assert(NEAR(n, 100) && NEAR(p, 1810));
    // and in the middle it stays around the centre
    p = 860, n = 200;
    hud_scale_span(&p, &n, 960, 960, 0.5f);
    assert(NEAR(n, 100) && NEAR(p, 910));

    // Bigger than the game's: from the same corner, 1.5 times the size
    p = 1700, n = 200;
    hud_scale_span(&p, &n, 960, 960, 1.5f);
    assert(NEAR(n, 300) && NEAR(p, 1590));
    float big[12] = {1, 0, 0, -600, 0, 1, 0, 300, 0, 0, 1, -1000};
    project(big, m00, m11, 0, 0, &x0, &y0);
    hud_scale_view(big, 1.5f, m00, m11, -1, 1);
    project(big, m00, m11, 0, 0, &a0, &b0);
    assert(NEAR(a0, -1 + (x0 + 1) * 1.5f) && NEAR(b0, 1 + (y0 - 1) * 1.5f));

    // Hidden HUD (0%): collapses spans, view and combined matrices to the corner/center anchor (#780)
    p = 1700, n = 200;
    hud_scale_span(&p, &n, 960, 960, 0.0f);
    assert(NEAR(n, 0) && NEAR(p, 1920));
    float zero[12] = {1, 0, 0, -600, 0, 1, 0, 300, 0, 0, 1, -1000};
    hud_scale_view(zero, 0.0f, m00, m11, -1, 1);
    project(zero, m00, m11, 0, 0, &a0, &b0);
    assert(NEAR(a0, -1) && NEAR(b0, 1));

    // A quick menu's bar keeps its size; the hearts, the minimap and the clock don't
    assert(hud_quick_keeps(0, 0.27f, 1, 1) && hud_quick_keeps(-0.5f, 0.3f, 1, 1) && hud_quick_keeps(0.64f, 0.63f, 1, 1));
    assert(!hud_quick_keeps(-0.85f, 0.85f, 1, 1) && !hud_quick_keeps(0.8f, -0.75f, 1, 1) && !hud_quick_keeps(0.5f, -0.8f, 1, 1));

    // HUD at edges on taller windows (shape < 1)
    assert(NEAR(hud_edge_dy(0.8f, 0.8f, 0.8f), 0.2f));
    assert(NEAR(hud_edge_dy(-0.8f, 0.8f, 0.8f), -0.2f));
    assert(NEAR(hud_edge_dy(0, 0.8f, 0.8f), 0));
    assert(NEAR(hud_edge_dy(0.8f, 0.8f, 1.2f), 0));  // (wide window: no vertical edge shift)

    // Top and bottom pane view matrices shifted to window edges
    float v_top[12] = {1, 0, 0, -600, 0, 1, 0, 300, 0, 0, 1, -1000};
    project(v_top, m00, m11, 0, 0, &x0, &y0);
    hud_edge_view(v_top, m11, 0.2f);
    project(v_top, m00, m11, 0, 0, &a0, &b0);
    assert(NEAR(a0, x0) && NEAR(b0, y0 + 0.2f));

    float v_bot[12] = {1, 0, 0, 600, 0, 1, 0, -300, 0, 0, 1, -1000};
    project(v_bot, m00, m11, 0, 0, &x0, &y0);
    hud_edge_view(v_bot, m11, -0.2f);
    project(v_bot, m00, m11, 0, 0, &a0, &b0);
    assert(NEAR(a0, x0) && NEAR(b0, y0 - 0.2f));

    // Matrix with view in it (clock, text)
    float m_top[16] = {0.002f, 0, 0, 0.8f, 0, -0.003f, 0, 0.6f, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 1};
    hud_edge_matrix(m_top, 0.2f);
    assert(NEAR(m_top[7] / m_top[15], 0.8f));

    // Scissor vertical offset on 1080h display with shape 0.8 (shift is 540 * 0.2 = 108)
    assert(NEAR(hud_edge_scissor_dy(900, 1080, 0.8), 108.0));
    assert(NEAR(hud_edge_scissor_dy(180, 1080, 0.8), -108.0));
    assert(NEAR(hud_edge_scissor_dy(540, 1080, 0.8), 0.0));

    // HUD at edges: off in a menu, the title and a load; in an event only its top part moves (#599)
    assert(hud_edge_mode(true, 0.9f, false, false, false, false) == 1);
    assert(hud_edge_mode(true, 0.9f, false, false, false, true) == 2);
    assert(!hud_edge_mode(false, 0.9f, false, false, false, false));
    assert(!hud_edge_mode(true, 1, false, false, false, false));
    assert(!hud_edge_mode(true, 0.9f, true, false, false, false));
    assert(!hud_edge_mode(true, 0.9f, false, true, false, false));
    assert(!hud_edge_mode(true, 0.9f, false, false, true, false));
    assert(hud_edge_moves(1, -0.8f, 0.9f) && hud_edge_moves(1, 0.3f, 0.9f) && !hud_edge_moves(0, 0.8f, 0.9f));
    // in an event: the area name (0.53 of the band) and the hearts go to the edge; a chest's item box (its top piece at
    // 0.36) and a talk box (low down) stay in the band
    assert(hud_edge_moves(2, 0.53f * 0.9f, 0.9f) && hud_edge_moves(2, 0.85f * 0.75f, 0.75f));
    assert(!hud_edge_moves(2, 0.36f * 0.9f, 0.9f) && !hud_edge_moves(2, -0.65f * 0.9f, 0.9f));

    // The quick menus' bar is kept in place with HUD at edges alone too, at HUD size 100 (#696)
    assert(hud_quick_tracked(100, true) && hud_quick_tracked(80, false) && !hud_quick_tracked(100, false));
    // and the quick-select frames at 16:10 (shape 0.9): their top pieces (y about 0.33) are inside the kept bar
    assert(hud_quick_keeps(0, 0.33f, 1, 0.9f) && hud_quick_keeps(0.4f, 0.4f, 1, 0.9f));

    // HUD at edges keeps only the bar (pieces up to ~0.41 of the band), not the area name over it (~0.53), at any shape
    assert(hud_quick_bar(0, 0.37f * 0.9f, 1, 0.9f) && hud_quick_bar(-0.4f, 0.40f * 0.75f, 1, 0.75f));
    assert(!hud_quick_bar(0, 0.53f * 0.9f, 1, 0.9f) && !hud_quick_bar(0, 0.53f * 0.75f, 1, 0.75f));
    assert(hud_quick_keeps(0, 0.53f * 0.9f, 1, 0.9f));  // (HUD size still keeps the name at the game's size)
    // The same for scissors, in pixels: at 1024x768 (shape 0.75) the bar's are kept, the minimap's mask is not
    assert(hud_quick_bar_px(512, 280, 1024, 768, 0.75) && hud_quick_bar_px(330, 300, 1024, 768, 0.75));
    assert(!hud_quick_bar_px(919, 622, 1024, 768, 0.75) && !hud_quick_bar_px(100, 60, 1024, 768, 0.75));
    assert(!hud_quick_bar_px(512, 230, 1024, 768, 0.75) && !hud_quick_bar_px(512, 384, 0, 768, 0.75));

    puts("PASS: hud_scale");
}
```

`tests/test_movie_stop.c`:

```c
// Regression tests for movie::Decoder stop/acquire races in runtime/hle/movie.c.
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../runtime/hle.h"
#include "../runtime/settings.h"

Settings g_settings;
const char *g_romfs_dir = "";
volatile int g_inject_plus;

static atomic_int g_work_depth;
static atomic_int g_work_enters;
static atomic_int g_clear_event_calls;
static pthread_mutex_t g_test_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t g_test_cv = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;

uint64_t hle_register(const char *name, HostFn fn) {
    (void)name;
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)fn;
}
void *hle_alloc(uint64_t size) { return calloc(1, (size_t)size); }
uint64_t guest_sym(const char *name) {
    if (!strcmp(name, "_ZN2nn2os10ClearEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE")) return 0x1001ull;
    if (!strcmp(name, "_ZN2nn2os11SignalEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE")) return 0x1002ull;
    return 0;
}
void guest_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr) {
    (void)c;
    if (addr == 0x1001ull) atomic_fetch_add(&g_clear_event_calls, 1);
}
void kernel_host_work_begin(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_test_mu);
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_work_depth, 1);
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_work_enters, 1);
    pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_test_cv);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_test_mu);
}
void kernel_host_work_end(void) { atomic_fetch_sub(&g_work_depth, 1); }
uint64_t input_buttons_now(void) { return 0; }
void rt_fatal_trace(void) { abort(); }

#include "../runtime/hle/movie.c"

void renderer_upload_rgba(NvnTexture *t, const void *rgba, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t stride) {
    (void)t;
    (void)rgba;
    (void)w;
    (void)h;
    (void)stride;
}

#define CHECK(cond, ...)                                                       \
    do {                                                                       \
        if (!(cond)) {                                                         \
            fprintf(stderr, "FAIL %s:%d: ", __FILE__, __LINE__);               \
            fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__);                                      \
            fprintf(stderr, "\n");                                             \
            return 1;                                                          \
        }                                                                      \
    } while (0)

typedef struct {
    uint64_t obj[2];
    Cpu cpu;
    int32_t out_idx;
    int64_t out_pts;
    uint32_t out_flags;
    int32_t out_rem;
} AcqArgs;

static void *worker_acquire(void *arg) {
    AcqArgs *a = (AcqArgs *)arg;
    memset(&a->cpu, 0, sizeof a->cpu);
    a->out_idx = -1;
    a->out_pts = -1;
    a->out_flags = 0xdeadbeefu;
    a->out_rem = -1;
    a->cpu.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)a->obj;
    a->cpu.x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&a->out_idx;
    a->cpu.x[2] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&a->out_pts;
    a->cpu.x[3] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&a->out_flags;
    a->cpu.x[4] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&a->out_rem;
    dec_acquire_output(&a->cpu);
    return NULL;
}

static Decoder *make_video_decoder(uint64_t obj[2]) {
    Cpu c = {0};
    c.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)obj;
    movie_decoder_ctor(&c);
    Decoder *d = (Decoder *)(uintptr_t)obj[1];
    d->video = true;
    d->fps = 30;
    d->events[0] = 0x2001ull;
    d->events[1] = 0x2002ull;
    return d;
}

static int test_stop_rejects_already_stopped_acquire(void) {
    uint64_t obj[2] = {0};
    Decoder *d = make_video_decoder(obj);
    d->ready[0] = (OutReady){2, 33333, 0};
    d->nready = 1;

    Cpu stop_cpu = {0};
    stop_cpu.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)obj;
    dec_stop(&stop_cpu);
    CHECK(d->stopped, "dec_stop sets stopped");

    AcqArgs a = {.obj = {obj[0], obj[1]}};
    worker_acquire(&a);
    CHECK(a.cpu.x[0] == 1, "dec_acquire_output must fail after dec_stop, got x[0]=%llu", (unsigned long long)a.cpu.x[0]);
    CHECK(a.out_idx == -1, "out_idx must not be written when stopped");
    return 0;
}

static int test_stop_wakes_and_aborts_paced_acquire(void) {
    uint64_t obj[2] = {0};
    Decoder *d = make_video_decoder(obj);
    d->playing = true;
    d->clock_ns = av_gettime_relative() * 1000;
    d->clock_us = 0;
    d->ready[0] = (OutReady){4, 90000, 0};  // 90 ms ahead -> enters paced wait
    d->nready = 1;

    atomic_store(&g_work_depth, 0);
    atomic_store(&g_work_enters, 0);

    AcqArgs a = {.obj = {obj[0], obj[1]}};
    pthread_t th;
    CHECK(pthread_create(&th, NULL, worker_acquire, &a) == 0, "pthread_create");

    // Wait until dec_acquire_output has released d->lock and entered the pacing wait.
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_test_mu);
    while (atomic_load(&g_work_enters) == 0) pthread_cond_wait(&g_test_cv, &g_test_mu);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_test_mu);

    int64_t t0 = av_gettime_relative();
    Cpu stop_cpu = {0};
    stop_cpu.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)obj;
    dec_stop(&stop_cpu);
    CHECK(pthread_join(th, NULL) == 0, "pthread_join");
    int64_t elapsed_us = av_gettime_relative() - t0;

    CHECK(a.cpu.x[0] == 1, "paced dec_acquire_output woken by dec_stop must return 1, got %llu",
          (unsigned long long)a.cpu.x[0]);
    CHECK(a.out_idx == -1, "stopped dec_acquire_output must not hand out frame index");
    CHECK(atomic_load(&g_work_depth) == 0, "kernel_host_work_begin/end must stay balanced");
    CHECK(elapsed_us < 50000, "dec_stop should wake paced wait immediately (took %lld us)", (long long)elapsed_us);
    return 0;
}

static int test_stopped_guards_input_and_release(void) {
    uint64_t obj[2] = {0};
    Decoder *d = make_video_decoder(obj);
    d->out_busy[0] = true;
    d->eos_pending = true;
    d->eos_time = 100000;

    Cpu stop_cpu = {0};
    stop_cpu.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)obj;
    dec_stop(&stop_cpu);

    int32_t idx = -1;
    Cpu acq_in = {0};
    acq_in.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)obj;
    acq_in.x[1] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&idx;
    dec_acquire_input(&acq_in);
    CHECK(acq_in.x[0] == 1 && idx == -1, "dec_acquire_input must fail when stopped");

    Cpu send_in = {0};
    send_in.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)obj;
    send_in.x[1] = 0;
    send_in.x[5] = MOVIE_EOS;
    dec_send_input(&send_in);
    CHECK(send_in.x[0] == 1 && d->nready == 0, "dec_send_input must fail and not queue when stopped");

    Cpu rel_out = {0};
    rel_out.x[0] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)obj;
    rel_out.x[1] = 0;
    dec_release_output(&rel_out);
    CHECK(rel_out.x[0] == 0 && d->nready == 0, "dec_release_output must not flush pending frames when stopped");
    return 0;
}

static int test_normal_paced_acquire_succeeds(void) {
    uint64_t obj[2] = {0};
    Decoder *d = make_video_decoder(obj);
    d->clock_ns = av_gettime_relative() * 1000;
    d->clock_us = 0;
    d->ready[0] = (OutReady){3, 20000, 0};  // 20 ms ahead
    d->nready = 1;

    int64_t t0 = av_gettime_relative();
    AcqArgs a = {.obj = {obj[0], obj[1]}};
    worker_acquire(&a);
    int64_t elapsed_us = av_gettime_relative() - t0;

    CHECK(a.cpu.x[0] == 0, "normal paced dec_acquire_output must succeed, got %llu",
          (unsigned long long)a.cpu.x[0]);
    CHECK(a.out_idx == 3 && a.out_pts == 20000 && a.out_flags == 0 && a.out_rem == 0,
          "unexpected output fields idx=%d pts=%lld flags=%u rem=%d", a.out_idx, (long long)a.out_pts, a.out_flags,
          a.out_rem);
    CHECK(elapsed_us >= 10000, "normal paced acquire should wait until due time (elapsed %lld us)",
          (long long)elapsed_us);
    return 0;
}

int main(void) {
    if (test_stop_rejects_already_stopped_acquire()) return 1;
    if (test_stop_wakes_and_aborts_paced_acquire()) return 1;
    if (test_stopped_guards_input_and_release()) return 1;
    if (test_normal_paced_acquire_succeeds()) return 1;
    printf("movie stop tests passed\n");
    return 0;
}
```

```c
void guest_call(Cpu *cpu,uint64_t address){
    if(address==0x7000e30700ull){actions++;last_action=LD32(LD64(cpu->x[0])+0x36c0);}
    else if(address==0x7000e2eed8ull)refreshes++;
    else if(address==0x7000d671d4ull)scroll_updates++;
    else if(address==0x7000d6ea78ull){
        assert(cpu->x[0]==wheel_quest_list&&cpu->x[1]==0);
        float *origin=(float*)(uintptr_t)cpu->x[3];origin[0]=0;origin[1]=-quest_test_origin;
    }
    else if(address==0x7000d6e8e0ull){
        assert(cpu->x[0]==wheel_quest_list&&cpu->x[1]==0);
        float delta;memcpy(&delta,&cpu->v[0],4);quest_view_scrolls++;
        *(float*)(wheel_quest_list+0x2d4)+=delta;
        // Deferred scrolling changes only the target; the game tick moves rows.
        cpu->x[0]=0xdead; // the caller's CPU must be restored
    }
    else if(address==0x7000f6e2c8ull){assert(LD8(cpu->x[0]+0xfc)==1);cpu->x[0]=0;}
    else if(address==0x7000f57da8ull){
        activations++;activated_node=cpu->x[1];ST64(cpu->x[0]+0x48,cpu->x[1]);
        uint64_t owner=LD64(cpu->x[1]+0x20);ST64(owner+0xe0,cpu->x[1]);
        *(float*)(owner+0x3628+0x30)=90;cpu->x[19]=0xdead;
    }else if(address==0x7000e3047cull){
        help_updates++;ST64(cpu->x[0]+0x36c8,LD64(LD64(cpu->x[0]+0x36b8)));
    }else if(address==0x7000123400ull){assert(cpu->x[1]==1);cpu->x[0]=0;}
    else if(address==0x7000d6d710ull){
        // The detail list precedes the real row list in the screen registry.
        cpu->x[0]=cpu->x[0]!=quest_widget?UINT32_MAX:
            cpu->x[1]==quest_nodes[0]?0:cpu->x[1]==quest_nodes[1]?1:UINT32_MAX;
    }else if(address==0x7000d6c54cull){
        if(dlc_test_list&&cpu->x[0]==dlc_test_list){dlc_pages++;ST32(dlc_test_list+0x2dc,cpu->x[1]);return;}
        if(shop_scroll_test_list&&cpu->x[0]==shop_scroll_test_list){shop_test_pages++;last_shop_page=(unsigned)cpu->x[1];cpu->x[0]=0;return;}
        assert(quick_test_list&&cpu->x[0]==quick_test_list&&cpu->x[1]<3);quick_test_moves++;
    }else if(address==0x7000e2785cull){
        assert(cpu->x[0]==quick_test_screen&&cpu->x[1]<3);
        ST32(quick_test_screen+0x387c,LD32(quick_test_screen+0x3884+4*cpu->x[1]));
    }
    else if(address==0x7000d6c870ull){
        assert(cpu->x[0]==quest_widget&&cpu->x[1]<2);
        unsigned index=(unsigned)cpu->x[1];quest_selections++;
        ST32(quest_widget+0x30c,index);ST32(quest_widget+0x310,index);
        // Leave the manager unchanged: the hook must also reconcile visible
        // focus when a native list's router has not applied it yet.
    }else if(address==0x7000f6f800ull){
        if(sensor_test_screen&&cpu->x[0]==sensor_test_screen) {
            assert(!strcmp((char*)(uintptr_t)cpu->x[1],"Pa_SensorBox_00"));
            cpu->x[0]=sensor_test_panel;return;
        }
        unsigned category;assert(cpu->x[0]==quest_screen);
        assert(sscanf((char*)(uintptr_t)cpu->x[1],"Pa_ChallengeCategory_%u",&category)==1&&category<4);
        cpu->x[0]=quest_icons[category];
    }else if(address==0x7000d6c5c4ull){abort();} // Immediate rebuilding is unsafe inside the manager hook.
    else if(address==0x7000d6c244ull){
        assert(cpu->x[0]==quest_master&&cpu->x[1]==0);
        quest_categories_clicked++;last_category=(unsigned)cpu->x[2];cpu->x[19]=0xdead;
    }else if(address==0x7000d6c9b0ull){
        assert(cpu->x[0]==quest_widget&&cpu->x[1]==0&&cpu->x[2]==last_category);
    }else if(address==0x7000123404ull){
        assert(options_box(cpu->x[1],(float*)(uintptr_t)cpu->x[0]));
    }else if(address==0x7001403a88ull){
        assert(cpu->x[0]==quest_screen+0x178&&cpu->x[1]==0x7001e2f4a8ull);page_changes++;
    }else if(address==0x7000123408ull){abort();} // Native clipping mutates focus; never scan through it.
    else if(address==0x700012340cull){cpu->x[0]=1;}
    else if(address==0x7000123410ull){native_decides++;}
    else if(address==0x70013f59f8ull){assert(cpu->x[0]==quantity_screen);}
    else abort();
}
```

```c
    puts("PASS: camera/menu/map transitions, absolute map input, F2, focus, overlay and idle cursor visibility");

    // Pointer support must leave normal play bindings alone: F draws the bow,
    // right mouse raises the shield/locks on, and left mouse attacks.
    mouse_held=true;
    SDL_Event e={0};e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN;e.button.button=SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT;
    input_handle_event(&e);assert(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_ZL));
    assert(!(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_ZR)));
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP;input_handle_event(&e);
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN;e.key.scancode=SDL_SCANCODE_F;
    input_handle_event(&e);assert(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_ZR));
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP;input_handle_event(&e);
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN;e.button.button=SDL_BUTTON_LEFT;
    input_handle_event(&e);assert(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_Y));
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP;input_handle_event(&e);

    // Rebinding "Menu: sort / sensor" to a key must not hijack Attack in play (#608)
    int16_t saved_bind_y = g_bind_key[BIND_Y];
    g_bind_key[BIND_Y] = SDL_SCANCODE_Y;
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN;e.key.scancode=SDL_SCANCODE_Y;
    input_handle_event(&e);
    assert(!(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_Y)));  // Y key does NOT attack in gameplay
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN;e.button.button=SDL_BUTTON_LEFT;
    input_handle_event(&e);
    assert(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_Y));     // mouse left still attacks
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP;input_handle_event(&e);
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP;e.key.scancode=SDL_SCANCODE_Y;input_handle_event(&e);
    g_bind_key[BIND_Y] = saved_bind_y;

    // Scripted/console A/B/X/Y buttons must still reach the game in play
    script_buttons = (1ull << BTN_A) | (1ull << BTN_B) | (1ull << BTN_X) | (1ull << BTN_Y);
    assert((input_buttons_now() & script_buttons) == script_buttons);
    script_buttons = 0;

    puts("PASS: F bow, right-mouse shield/lock-on and left-mouse attack use ordinary bindings");

    // Controller Walk scales both left-stick axes and returns to full speed on release (never cumulative).
    host_test = true;
    g_bind_pad[BIND_WALK] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC2;
    test_lx = 32767; test_ly = -32767;
    test_pad = 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC2;
    recompute_pad(); assert(pad_lx == 13107 && pad_ly == -13107);
    recompute_pad(); assert(pad_lx == 13107 && pad_ly == -13107);
    test_pad = 0; recompute_pad(); assert(pad_lx == 32767 && pad_ly == -32767);
    // Keyboard Walk retains its factory behavior.
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_C] = keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_W] = 1;
    recompute_keyboard(); assert(key_ly == 13107);
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_C] = 0; recompute_keyboard(); assert(key_ly == 32767);
    input_reset();

    // Tilt combines devices: releasing the key while the controller button is held keeps the mouse clutch held.
    g_bind_pad[BIND_TILT] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC3;
    test_pad = 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC3;
    recompute_pad(); assert(tilt_held && motion_tilt);
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_T] = 1; recompute_keyboard();
    test_pad = 0; recompute_pad(); assert(tilt_held && motion_tilt);
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_T] = 0; recompute_keyboard(); assert(!tilt_held && !motion_tilt);
    test_pad = 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC3; recompute_pad();
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_T] = 1; recompute_keyboard();
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_T] = 0; recompute_keyboard(); assert(motion_tilt);
    captured = true; recompute_motion(); assert(!motion_tilt);
    captured = false; recompute_motion(); assert(motion_tilt);
    host_test = false; win_focused = false; recompute_pad(); assert(!motion_tilt && host_buttons == 0);
    win_focused = true; host_test = true;
    test_pad = 0; recompute_pad();
    // A controller Tilt hold also routes the mouse into motion and enables sensorless dual-stick tilt.
    test_pad = 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC3; recompute_pad();
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_MOTION; e.motion.xrel = 5; e.motion.yrel = -3;
    input_handle_event(&e); assert(tilt_mouse_x == 5 && tilt_mouse_y == -3);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_WHEEL; e.wheel.y = 2;
    input_handle_event(&e); assert(tilt_mouse_yaw == 2);
    host_test = false; pad = (SDL_Gamepad *)(uintptr_t)1;
    assert(dualstick_on());
    sensor_pad = true; assert(!dualstick_on()); sensor_pad = false;
    pad = NULL; host_test = true; test_pad = 0; recompute_pad();
    assert(!dualstick_on());

    // Each gyro button feeds the same pitch/roll/yaw/reset state as the keyboard, only in the live context.
    g_settings.pc_gyro = true;
    for (int slot = BIND_GYRO_UP; slot <= BIND_GYRO_CENTER; slot++) {
        g_bind_pad[slot] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC4;
        test_pad = 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC4;
        gyro_active = false; recompute_pad();
        assert(!gyro_pitch && !gyro_roll && !gyro_yaw && !gyro_reset);
        gyro_active = true; recompute_keyboard();  // context change without a new pad event
        assert(gyro_pitch == (slot == BIND_GYRO_UP ? -1 : slot == BIND_GYRO_DOWN ? 1 : 0));
        assert(gyro_roll == (slot == BIND_GYRO_LEFT ? -1 : slot == BIND_GYRO_RIGHT ? 1 : 0));
        assert(gyro_yaw == (slot == BIND_GYRO_TURN_LEFT ? -1 : slot == BIND_GYRO_TURN_RIGHT ? 1 : 0));
        assert(gyro_reset == (slot == BIND_GYRO_CENTER));
        game_menu = true; recompute_motion(); assert(!gyro_pitch && !gyro_roll && !gyro_yaw && !gyro_reset);
        game_menu = false; title_menu = true; recompute_motion(); assert(!gyro_reset && !gyro_pitch && !gyro_roll && !gyro_yaw);
        title_menu = false; captured = true; recompute_motion(); assert(!gyro_reset && !gyro_pitch && !gyro_roll && !gyro_yaw);
        captured = false; win_focused = false; recompute_motion(); assert(!gyro_reset && !gyro_pitch && !gyro_roll && !gyro_yaw);
        win_focused = true;
        g_bind_pad[slot] = -1;
    }
    g_bind_pad[BIND_GYRO_UP] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC4;
    recompute_pad(); assert(gyro_pitch == -1);
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_I] = 1; recompute_keyboard(); assert(gyro_pitch == -1);  // OR, not doubled
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_I] = 0; recompute_keyboard(); assert(gyro_pitch == -1);
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_K] = 1; recompute_keyboard(); assert(gyro_pitch == 0);  // opposite devices cancel
    keys_down[SDL_SCANCODE_K] = 0; test_pad = 0; recompute_pad(); assert(gyro_pitch == 0);
    puts("PASS: controller Walk/Tilt and all gyro bindings, mixed-device holds, menu/focus/context gates");

    // With the PC pointer in a menu, left (click) and right (back) belong to the pointer, but middle click stays the
    // right stick press: Rotate in the inventory (#346).
    pointer_ui=true;mouse_held=false;  // (the menu state update() gives: no relative mode, mouse free)
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN;e.button.button=SDL_BUTTON_MIDDLE;
    input_handle_event(&e);assert(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_RSTICK));
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP;input_handle_event(&e);assert(!(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_RSTICK)));
    // Released after its menu closed (mouse camera off: no relative mode to reset the buttons): never stuck in play.
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN;input_handle_event(&e);assert(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_RSTICK));
    pointer_ui=false;e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP;input_handle_event(&e);
    assert(!(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_RSTICK)));pointer_ui=true;
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN;e.button.button=SDL_BUTTON_LEFT;
    input_handle_event(&e);assert(!(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_Y)));
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP;input_handle_event(&e);
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN;e.button.button=SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT;
    input_handle_event(&e);assert(!(input_buttons_now()&(1ull<<BTN_ZL)));
    e.type=SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP;input_handle_event(&e);
    // A left-button drag in Rotate mode turns Link through the right stick, even with the mouse camera off.
    int32_t sx,sy;g_settings.mouse_sens=g_settings.mouse_sens_y=1;  // (the defaults: unset in this synthetic Settings)
    input_pc_rotate_motion(40,0);mouse_stick(&sx,&sy);assert(sx==0&&sy==0);  // no drag: discarded
    rotate_drag=true;now+=16000000;
    input_pc_rotate_motion(40,0);mouse_stick(&sx,&sy);assert(sx>0&&sy==0);
    now+=16000000;input_pc_rotate_motion(-40,0);mouse_stick(&sx,&sy);assert(sx<0);
    rotate_drag=false;now+=16000000;mouse_stick(&sx,&sy);assert(sx==0&&sy==0);
    puts("PASS: pointer menus keep middle click bound; Rotate-mode drag turns Link through the right stick");

    // PrintScreen captures a screenshot and does not get swallowed by normal button actions
    int shots_before = photo_takes;
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_PRINTSCREEN; e.key.repeat = false;
    input_handle_event(&e);
    assert(photo_takes == shots_before + 1);
    e.key.repeat = true;
    input_handle_event(&e);
    assert(photo_takes == shots_before + 1);  // key repeat ignored
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP;
    input_handle_event(&e);
    assert(photo_takes == shots_before + 1);
    puts("PASS: PrintScreen triggers screenshot capture");
}
```

`tests/test_shrine_sensor.c`:

```c
// Unit test for shrine sensor volume / mute (runtime/shrine_sensor.c).
#include <assert.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "settings.h"
#include "shrine_sensor.h"

static void wr32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 4); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *p, uint16_t v) { memcpy(p, &v, 2); }
static uint16_t rd16(const uint8_t *p) { uint16_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 2); return v; }

static int16_t clamp16(int64_t v) { return v > 32767 ? 32767 : v < -32768 ? -32768 : (int16_t)v; }

// Standard simple DSP-ADPCM coefficients (predictor 0 = simple 1st-order LP)
static const int16_t test_coefs[16] = {
    1600, 0,  1024, 512, 2048, -512, 512, 0,
    0,    0,  800,  200, 1200, -200, 400, 100,
};

static void decode_adpcm(const uint8_t *raw, uint32_t nsamp, const int16_t coefs[16],
                         int16_t h0, int16_t h1, int16_t *out) {
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < nsamp; s++) {
        uint32_t fr = s / 14, k = s % 14;
        uint8_t ps = raw[fr * 8];
        int scale = ps & 15, ci = (ps >> 4) & 7;
        uint8_t b = raw[fr * 8 + 1 + k / 2];
        int nib = (k & 1) ? ((int8_t)(b << 4) >> 4) : ((int8_t)b >> 4);
        int64_t pred = (int64_t)coefs[ci * 2] * h0 + (int64_t)coefs[ci * 2 + 1] * h1;
        int16_t v = clamp16((((int64_t)nib * ((int64_t)2048 << scale)) + pred + 1024) >> 11);
        h1 = h0;
        h0 = v;
        out[s] = v;
    }
}

static size_t build_fwav_bars(uint8_t *buf, size_t cap, uint8_t enc, uint32_t nsamp) {
    memset(buf, 0, cap);

    uint32_t amta1_off = 0x40;
    uint32_t amta2_off = 0xC0;
    uint32_t fwav_off = 0x140;

    // BARS Header
    memcpy(buf, "BARS", 4);
    wr32(buf + 4, (uint32_t)cap);
    memcpy(buf + 8, "\xFF\xFE\x01\x01", 4);
    wr32(buf + 12, 2);
    wr32(buf + 16, 0x11111111);
    wr32(buf + 20, 0x22222222);
    wr32(buf + 24, amta1_off);
    wr32(buf + 28, 0xFFFFFFFFu);
    wr32(buf + 32, amta2_off);
    wr32(buf + 36, fwav_off);

    // AMTA 1 (Sys_Dummy)
    uint8_t *a1 = buf + amta1_off;
    memcpy(a1, "AMTA\xFF\xFE\x00\x04", 8);
    wr32(a1 + 8, 0x70);
    wr32(a1 + 0xC, 0x20);
    wr32(a1 + 0x18, 0x50);
    memcpy(a1 + 0x20, "DATA", 4);
    wr32(a1 + 0x24, 0x28);
    memcpy(a1 + 0x50, "STRG", 4);
    wr32(a1 + 0x54, 0x10);
    strcpy((char *)a1 + 0x58, "Sys_Dummy");

    // AMTA 2 (Sys_Item_SheikSensor)
    uint8_t *a2 = buf + amta2_off;
    memcpy(a2, "AMTA\xFF\xFE\x00\x04", 8);
    wr32(a2 + 8, 0x78);
    wr32(a2 + 0xC, 0x20);
    wr32(a2 + 0x18, 0x50);
    memcpy(a2 + 0x20, "DATA", 4);
    wr32(a2 + 0x24, 0x28);
    memcpy(a2 + 0x50, "STRG", 4);
    wr32(a2 + 0x54, 0x20);
    strcpy((char *)a2 + 0x58, "Sys_Item_SheikSensor");

    // FWAV Header at fwav_off
    // INFO @ +0x40 (size 0x100), DATA @ +0x140
    uint32_t info_rel = 0x40, info_sz = 0x100, data_rel = 0x140;
    uint32_t ch_bytes = enc == 2 ? ((nsamp + 13) / 14) * 8 : enc == 1 ? nsamp * 2 : nsamp;
    uint32_t data_sz = 8 + 0x38 + ch_bytes * 2 + 0x40;
    uint8_t *fw = buf + fwav_off;
    memcpy(fw, "FWAV\xFF\xFE\x40\x00\x00\x02\x01\x00", 12);
    wr32(fw + 0x0C, data_rel + data_sz);
    wr16(fw + 0x10, 2);
    // section 0: INFO (0x7000)
    wr16(fw + 0x14, 0x7000);
    wr32(fw + 0x18, info_rel);
    wr32(fw + 0x1C, info_sz);
    // section 1: DATA (0x7001)
    wr16(fw + 0x20, 0x7001);
    wr32(fw + 0x24, data_rel);
    wr32(fw + 0x28, data_sz);

    uint8_t *info = fw + info_rel;
    memcpy(info, "INFO", 4);
    wr32(info + 4, info_sz);
    info[8] = enc;
    info[9] = 0;  // loop = 0
    wr32(info + 0xC, 48000);
    wr32(info + 0x14, nsamp);

    // Channel table at info + 0x1C (2 channels)
    uint8_t *tab = info + 0x1C;
    wr32(tab, 2);
    uint32_t ci0_rel = 0x18, ci1_rel = 0x30;
    wr16(tab + 4, 0x7100);
    wr32(tab + 8, ci0_rel);
    wr16(tab + 12, 0x7100);
    wr32(tab + 16, ci1_rel);

    uint32_t s0_rel = 0x38, s1_rel = 0x38 + ch_bytes + 0x20;
    uint32_t adpcm0_rel = 0x40, adpcm1_rel = 0x60;
    uint8_t *ci0 = tab + ci0_rel, *ci1 = tab + ci1_rel;
    wr16(ci0, 0x1F00); wr32(ci0 + 4, s0_rel);
    wr16(ci0 + 8, 0x0300); wr32(ci0 + 12, adpcm0_rel);
    wr16(ci1, 0x1F00); wr32(ci1 + 4, s1_rel);
    wr16(ci1 + 8, 0x0300); wr32(ci1 + 12, adpcm1_rel);

    memcpy(ci0 + adpcm0_rel, test_coefs, sizeof test_coefs);
    memcpy(ci1 + adpcm1_rel, test_coefs, sizeof test_coefs);

    uint8_t *wdata = fw + data_rel;
    memcpy(wdata, "DATA", 4);
    wr32(wdata + 4, data_sz);

    uint8_t *p0 = wdata + 8 + s0_rel;
    uint8_t *p1 = wdata + 8 + s1_rel;
    if (enc == 2) {
        uint32_t nfr = (nsamp + 13) / 14;
        for (uint32_t fr = 0; fr < nfr; fr++) {
            p0[fr * 8] = 0x08;  // ci=0, scale=8 (moderate loud signal)
            p1[fr * 8] = 0x08;
            for (int k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
                p0[fr * 8 + 1 + k] = (k & 1) ? 0x2E : 0x4C;
                p1[fr * 8 + 1 + k] = (k & 1) ? 0x3D : 0x5B;
            }
        }
        wr16(ci0 + adpcm0_rel + 32, p0[0]);
        wr16(ci1 + adpcm1_rel + 32, p1[0]);
    } else if (enc == 1) {
        for (uint32_t s = 0; s < nsamp; s++) {
            int16_t v = (int16_t)(10000 * sin(s * 0.2));
            memcpy(p0 + s * 2, &v, 2);
            memcpy(p1 + s * 2, &v, 2);
        }
    }
    wr32(buf + 4, fwav_off + data_rel + data_sz);
    return fwav_off + data_rel + data_sz;
}

static size_t build_bwav_bars(uint8_t *buf, size_t cap) {
    memset(buf, 0, cap);
    uint32_t amta_off = 0x40, bwav_off = 0x100, samp_rel = 0x70;
    memcpy(buf, "BARS", 4);
    wr32(buf + 4, 0x200);
    memcpy(buf + 8, "\xFF\xFE\x01\x00", 4);
    wr32(buf + 12, 1);
    wr32(buf + 16, 0x22222222);
    wr32(buf + 20, amta_off);
    wr32(buf + 24, bwav_off);

    uint8_t *a = buf + amta_off;
    memcpy(a, "AMTA\xFF\xFE\x01\x00", 8);
    wr32(a + 8, 0x78);
    wr32(a + 0xC, 0x20);
    wr32(a + 0x18, 0x50);
    memcpy(a + 0x20, "DATA", 4);
    wr32(a + 0x24, 0x28);
    memcpy(a + 0x50, "STRG", 4);
    wr32(a + 0x54, 0x20);
    strcpy((char *)a + 0x58, "Sys_Item_SheikSensor");

    uint8_t *bw = buf + bwav_off;
    memcpy(bw, "BWAV\xFF\xFE\x00\x01", 8);
    wr16(bw + 0xE, 1);
    wr32(bw + 0x10 + 4, 48000);
    wr32(bw + 0x10 + 0xC, 32);
    wr32(bw + 0x10 + 0x30, samp_rel);
    memset(bw + samp_rel, 0xAB, 32);
    return 0x200;
}

static int peak_pcm16(const int16_t *p, uint32_t n) {
    int pk = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int a = p[i] < 0 ? -p[i] : p[i];
        if (a > pk) pk = a;
    }
    return pk;
}

int main(void) {
    printf("[test_shrine_sensor] starting tests...\n");

    assert(!shrine_sensor_patch_bars(NULL, 0, 50));
    uint8_t junk[32] = {0};
    assert(!shrine_sensor_patch_bars(junk, sizeof junk, 50));

    // 1. FWAV DSP-ADPCM (matches BOTW M_UI.bars format)
    enum { NSAMP = 280 };
    uint8_t bars[4096];
    size_t len = build_fwav_bars(bars, sizeof bars, 2, NSAMP);
    uint8_t orig_bars[4096];
    memcpy(orig_bars, bars, len);

    const uint8_t *fw = bars + 0x140;
    const uint8_t *s0 = fw + 0x140 + 8 + 0x38;
    int16_t pcm[NSAMP];
    decode_adpcm(s0, NSAMP, test_coefs, 0, 0, pcm);
    int orig_pk = peak_pcm16(pcm, NSAMP);
    assert(orig_pk > 1000);

    // Live volume: the sensor's coefficients are noted (both channels share them here: one signature), other
    // coefficients are not the sensor's, and the gain follows the setting
    static const int16_t other[16] = {1, 2, 3};
    assert(!shrine_sensor_voice(test_coefs));
    assert(shrine_sensor_note_bars(bars, len) == 2);
    assert(shrine_sensor_voice(test_coefs) && !shrine_sensor_voice(other));
    assert(shrine_sensor_note_bars(junk, sizeof junk) == 0);
    assert(shrine_sensor_gain(100) == 1.0f && shrine_sensor_gain(0) == 0.0f);
    assert(fabsf(shrine_sensor_gain(50) - 0.35355f) < 1e-4f);
    printf("  [pass] live volume: sensor voices told apart by their ADPCM coefficients\n");

    // Live volume in the game's memory: the sensor's samples are rewritten at each change, back to the original at
    // 100 %, and nothing else is written over
    {
        enum { NB = (NSAMP + 13) / 14 * 8 };
        uint8_t mem[NB], other_mem[NB];
        memcpy(mem, s0, NB);
        assert(!shrine_sensor_render(test_coefs, mem, NB, 100));  // (as shipped already)
        assert(shrine_sensor_render(test_coefs, mem, NB, 50));
        int16_t live[NSAMP];
        decode_adpcm(mem, NSAMP, test_coefs, 0, 0, live);
        int lpk = peak_pcm16(live, NSAMP);
        assert(lpk < orig_pk * 0.45 && lpk > orig_pk * 0.25);
        assert(!shrine_sensor_render(test_coefs, mem, NB, 50));  // (no change: not written again)
        assert(shrine_sensor_render(test_coefs, mem, NB, 0));
        for (int b = 0; b < NB; b++) assert(mem[b] == 0);
        assert(shrine_sensor_render(test_coefs, mem, NB, 100));
        assert(!memcmp(mem, s0, NB));
        memset(other_mem, 0x5a, NB);  // (someone else's samples now)
        assert(!shrine_sensor_render(test_coefs, other_mem, NB, 30));
        for (int b = 0; b < NB; b++) assert(other_mem[b] == 0x5a);
        assert(!shrine_sensor_render(test_coefs, mem, NB - 1, 30));  // (too small)
        printf("  [pass] live volume: samples rewritten in place at each change, back to the original at 100%%\n");
    }

    // 100%: untouched
    assert(shrine_sensor_patch_bars(bars, len, 100));
    assert(memcmp(bars, orig_bars, len) == 0);
    printf("  [pass] FWAV ADPCM 100%% leaves data untouched (peak=%d)\n", orig_pk);

    // 50%: powf(0.5, 1.5) ~= 0.35355
    memcpy(bars, orig_bars, len);
    assert(shrine_sensor_patch_bars(bars, len, 50));
    decode_adpcm(s0, NSAMP, test_coefs, 0, 0, pcm);
    int pk50 = peak_pcm16(pcm, NSAMP);
    double want50 = orig_pk * pow(0.5, 1.5);
    assert(fabs(pk50 - want50) < want50 * 0.05 + 4);
    printf("  [pass] FWAV ADPCM 50%% scales peak %d -> %d (expected ~%.0f)\n", orig_pk, pk50, want50);

    // 10%: powf(0.1, 1.5) ~= 0.03162
    memcpy(bars, orig_bars, len);
    assert(shrine_sensor_patch_bars(bars, len, 10));
    decode_adpcm(s0, NSAMP, test_coefs, 0, 0, pcm);
    int pk10 = peak_pcm16(pcm, NSAMP);
    double want10 = orig_pk * pow(0.1, 1.5);
    assert(fabs(pk10 - want10) < want10 * 0.1 + 4);
    printf("  [pass] FWAV ADPCM 10%% scales peak %d -> %d (expected ~%.0f)\n", orig_pk, pk10, want10);

    // 0%: muted to digital zero
    memcpy(bars, orig_bars, len);
    assert(shrine_sensor_patch_bars(bars, len, 0));
    decode_adpcm(s0, NSAMP, test_coefs, 0, 0, pcm);
    assert(peak_pcm16(pcm, NSAMP) == 0);
    assert(rd16(fw + 0x40 + 0x1C + 0x18 + 0x40 + 32) == 0);
    printf("  [pass] FWAV ADPCM 0%% mutes cleanly to digital zero\n");

    // 2. FWAV PCM16
    len = build_fwav_bars(bars, sizeof bars, 1, 128);
    assert(shrine_sensor_patch_bars(bars, len, 50));
    assert(shrine_sensor_patch_bars(bars, len, 0));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 128 * 2; i++) assert(bars[0x140 + 0x140 + 8 + 0x38 + i] == 0);
    printf("  [pass] FWAV PCM16 50%% and 0%% mute pass\n");

    // 3. BWAV mute respects wave + data_start
    uint8_t bbars[512];
    size_t blen = build_bwav_bars(bbars, sizeof bbars);
    assert(bbars[0x170] == 0xAB);
    assert(shrine_sensor_patch_bars(bbars, blen, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) assert(bbars[0x170 + i] == 0);
    printf("  [pass] BWAV 0%% zeroes wave + data_start\n");

    printf("[test_shrine_sensor] all tests passed successfully!\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/test_textures_format.c`:

```c
// BC5 (NVN format 0x4C) view format: SAVAGEWIND_BC5_UNORM picks BC5_UNORM, else BC5_SNORM. The environment is read
// once (the first fmt_of call), so changing it later in the process must not change the format.
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

VkFormat vk_format(uint32_t f);
bool vk_format_alpha_one(uint32_t f);

static void set_unorm(int on) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _putenv_s("SAVAGEWIND_BC5_UNORM", on ? "1" : "");
#else
    if (on) setenv("SAVAGEWIND_BC5_UNORM", "1", 1);
    else unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_BC5_UNORM");
#endif
}

static double now_ns(void) { return (double)clock() * (1e9 / CLOCKS_PER_SEC); }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    bool want_unorm = getenv("SAVAGEWIND_BC5_UNORM") != NULL;
    VkFormat want = want_unorm ? VK_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM_BLOCK : VK_FORMAT_BC5_SNORM_BLOCK;

    assert(vk_format(0x4C) == want);
    assert(!vk_format_alpha_one(0x4C));

    set_unorm(!want_unorm);
    assert((getenv("SAVAGEWIND_BC5_UNORM") != NULL) != want_unorm);
    assert(vk_format(0x4C) == want);

    assert(vk_format(0x4A) == VK_FORMAT_BC4_SNORM_BLOCK);
    assert(vk_format(0x4B) == VK_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM_BLOCK);
    assert(vk_format(0x4D) == VK_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_BLOCK);
    assert(vk_format(0x4E) == VK_FORMAT_BC7_SRGB_BLOCK);

    puts("PASS: 0x4C honours SAVAGEWIND_BC5_UNORM and reads it only once");

    if (argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--bench")) {
        const int n = 1000000;
        const char *volatile key = "SAVAGEWIND_BC5_UNORM";  // volatile: not hoisted out of the loop
        volatile uintptr_t sink = 0;
        double t0 = now_ns();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) sink ^= (uintptr_t)vk_format(0x4C);
        double cached = (now_ns() - t0) / n;
        t0 = now_ns();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) sink ^= (uintptr_t)getenv(key);
        double raw = (now_ns() - t0) / n;
        printf("vk_format(0x4C): %.2f ns/call; getenv: %.2f ns/call (%.0fx)\n", cached, raw, raw / cached);
        (void)sink;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

```c
#include <assert.h>

GameSites g_site;

void kmutex_lock(KMutex *m) { assert(!pthread_mutex_lock(&m->pm)); }
void kmutex_unlock(KMutex *m) { assert(!pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->pm)); }

uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) { return 1; }

}

static unsigned scope_at(uint64_t at) {
    CmdRec *r = (CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)at;
    if (r->op == CMD_JUMP) r = (CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0];

int main(void) {
    // Unsupported versions and disabled options must not inspect version-specific guest fields.
    Cpu unsupported = {0};g_site.screen_mgr=1;g_game_version="unknown";
    assert(!ui_layout_begin(&unsupported));
    g_game_version="1.9.0";g_settings.hud_edges=false;
    assert(!ui_layout_begin(&unsupported));
    g_site.screen_mgr=0;g_settings.hud_edges=true;
    float crop[27] = {0};crop[23] = 1.8359375f;crop[24] = .440625f;crop[25] = .17777778f;
    assert(hud_capture_crop(crop, .9f, -.1f));
    assert(fabsf((.5f+crop[23]*crop[25])*800-675)<.001f);
    assert(fabsf(crop[25]-.16f)<.00001f);
    crop[22]=.3f;crop[23]=1.1f;crop[25]=.2f;crop[26]=.6f;

    float v0=.5f+crop[25]*(sinf(crop[26])*crop[22]+cosf(crop[26])*crop[23]);
    assert(hud_capture_crop(crop,.9f,-.1f));
    float u1=.5f+crop[24]*(cosf(crop[26])*crop[22]-sinf(crop[26])*crop[23]);
    float v1=.5f+crop[25]*(sinf(crop[26])*crop[22]+cosf(crop[26])*crop[23]);
    assert(fabsf(u1-u0)<1e-6f&&fabsf(v1-(.5f+.9f*(v0-.5f)+.05f))<1e-6f);
    crop[25]=0;assert(!hud_capture_crop(crop,.9f,-.1f));
    uint64_t base = HEAP_BASE;
#ifdef _WIN32
    assert(VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)base, 0x10000, MEM_RESERVE|MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE) == (void *)(uintptr_t)base);
#else
    assert(mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)base, 0x10000, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE,
                MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS|MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0) != MAP_FAILED);
#endif
    uint64_t manager = base + 0x100, slots = base + 0x200, screen = base + 0x1000;
    uint64_t context = base + 0x2000, wrapper = base + 0x3000, commands = base + 0x4000;
    g_site.screen_mgr = base;
    ST64(base, manager); ST32(manager+0x28, 99); ST64(manager+0x30, slots);
    ST64(slots+8*0x25, screen); ST64(context+0x20, wrapper);
    ST64(wrapper+8, 0x11); ST64(wrapper+0xb8, commands);
    Cpu c = {0}; c.x[0] = screen; c.x[1] = context;
    // Inactive layouts must return before touching an unusable render context.
    c.x[1] = 0; assert(!ui_layout_begin(&c));
    rt_ui_layout_draw(&c, native_draw); assert(calls == 1); calls = 0;
    ST8(screen+0x100, 1); ST8(screen+0xfe, 2); c.x[1] = context;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        ST8(screen+0x100, i == 0 ? 0 : 1); ST8(screen+0x102, i == 1);
        ST8(screen+0xfe, i == 2 ? 0 : 3); ST8(screen+0xff, i == 3 ? 2 : 0);
        c.x[1] = 0; assert(!ui_layout_begin(&c));
    }
    ST8(screen+0x100, 1); ST8(screen+0x102, 0); ST8(screen+0xfe, 3); ST8(screen+0xff, 0);
    c.x[1] = context;
    ST64(commands, 0x11); // the previously crashing non-NVN object is rejected without dereference
    assert(!ui_layout_begin(&c));
    Cpu init = {0}; init.x[0] = commands; hle_nvnCommandBufferInitialize(&init);
    assert(!ui_layout_begin(&c)); // initialized but not recording
    cb_of(commands)->recording = true;
    assert(!ui_layout_begin(&c)); // no initial host storage; must not call the guest allocator
    cb_of(commands)->recording = false;
    init.x[0] = commands; hle_nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording(&init);
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(commands);
    cb->gused = cb->gsize + 16; cb->callback = 123;
    uint64_t guest_used = cb->gused;
    Cpu original = c; rt_ui_layout_draw(&c, native_draw);
    original.x[5] = 123;
    assert(!memcmp(&c, &original, sizeof c) && calls == 1 && cb->gused == guest_used);
    CmdRec *begin = (CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)(cb->start + sizeof(CmdRec));
    CmdRec *end = (CmdRec *)((char *)begin + begin->size);
    assert(begin->op == CMD_UI_SCOPE && begin->x[0] == UI_LAYOUT_HUD);
    assert(end->op == CMD_UI_SCOPE && end->x[0] == UI_LAYOUT_NONE);
    // MainScreen3D and Time use the same stable HUD policy as the flat HUD.
    ST64(slots+8*0x25, 0); ST64(slots+8*0x2, screen);
    uint64_t at = cb->mem + cb->used;
    rt_ui_layout_draw(&c, native_draw);
    assert(scope_at(at) == UI_LAYOUT_HUD);
    ST64(slots+8*0x2, 0); ST64(slots+8*0x1c, screen);
    at = cb->mem + cb->used; rt_ui_layout_draw(&c, native_draw);
    assert(scope_at(at) == UI_LAYOUT_HUD);
    ST64(slots+8*0x1c, 0); ST64(slots+8*0x2a, screen);
    for (unsigned paused = 0; paused < 2; paused++) {
        pause_menu = paused; at = cb->mem + cb->used;
        rt_ui_layout_draw(&c, native_draw);
        assert(scope_at(at) == (paused ? UI_LAYOUT_MENU : UI_LAYOUT_HUD));
    }
    // Native MiniMap endpoints, not the global pause state, choose the presentation.
    uint64_t animation = base + 0x6000, resource = base + 0x7000;
    ST64(screen+0x3640, animation); ST64(animation+0x18, resource); ST16(resource+8, 1);
    float map_frame = 0; memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)(animation+0x20), &map_frame, 4);

    map_frame = 1; memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)(animation+0x20), &map_frame, 4);
    pause_menu = true; assert(ui_layout_map_mode(screen) == 0);
    at = cb->mem + cb->used; rt_ui_layout_draw(&c, native_draw); assert(scope_at(at) == UI_LAYOUT_HUD);
    map_frame = NAN; memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)(animation+0x20), &map_frame, 4);

    if (part_begin->op == CMD_JUMP) part_begin = (CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)part_begin->x[0];
    CmdRec *part_end = (CmdRec *)((char *)part_begin+part_begin->size);

    assert(part_end->op == CMD_UI_SCOPE && part_end->x[0] == UI_LAYOUT_NONE);
    assert(rt_ui_layout_pane_draw(&part, native_pane) && calls == previous_calls+2);
    ST64(pane+0xf0, controller+8); assert(!rt_ui_layout_pane_draw(&part, native_pane));
    ST64(pane+0xf0, controller); part.x[2] = 0; assert(!rt_ui_layout_pane_draw(&part, native_pane));
    assert(nvn_ui_scope(commands, UI_LAYOUT_NONE));
    // Nested cached lists restore the executing owner, including bounded overflow.
    HudScope scope = {0};
    hud_scope_enter(&scope, UI_LAYOUT_HUD); hud_scope_enter(&scope, UI_LAYOUT_DIALOGUE);
    assert(scope.kind == UI_LAYOUT_DIALOGUE);

    cmdbuf_shadow_reset();
    assert(!g_command_buffers);

    VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)base, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
#else
    munmap((void *)(uintptr_t)base, 0x10000);
#endif
    puts("PASS: native eligibility, invalid/stopped NVN contexts, balanced deferred scopes, zero guest cost, CPU preservation and lifetime reset");
}
```

`tests/test_window_size.c`:

```c
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "settings.h"
#include "window_size.h"

Settings g_settings;
bool settings_handheld_size(int *w, int *h) { (void)w; (void)h; return false; }
void settings_fps_for_display(float hz) { (void)hz; }

int main(void) {
    const char *aspect = winsize_aspect(1600, 900);
    assert(aspect != NULL);
    assert(!strcmp(aspect, "16:9"));

    char name[64];
    winsize_name((WinSize){1600, 900}, NULL, name, sizeof name);
    assert(!strcmp(name, "1600 x 900  (16:9)"));

    WinSize list[WINSIZE_MAX];
    int n = winsize_list(list, false);
    assert(n > 0);

    bool found = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (list[i].w == 1600 && list[i].h == 900) {
            found = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    assert(found);

    printf("test_window_size: ok\n");
    return 0;
}
```
