`tools/linux/appimage.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# make appimage ARCH=<x86_64|aarch64>: build/dist/Savage_Wind-<version>-<arch>.AppImage, built in Ubuntu 22.04
# containers (podman; tools/linux/Containerfile) so it runs on glibc 2.35+ distributions. Everything is built inside
# the amd64 container - aarch64 cross-compiled against the arm64 image's root filesystem (build/linux/aarch64/sysroot)
# - except the generator helpers, which PyInstaller freezes in a container of their own arch (arm64: QEMU, binfmt).
# No game code inside: the start screen builds it on the player's machine. See docs/linux.md.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
ARCH=${1:?usage: tools/linux/appimage.sh x86_64|aarch64}
case $ARCH in x86_64) PODARCH=amd64 ;; aarch64) PODARCH=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "unknown arch $ARCH"; exit 1 ;; esac

image() {  # arch -> tag (built once, then cached by podman)
    podman build -q --arch "$1" -t "localhost/savagewind-build:$1" -f tools/linux/Containerfile tools/linux >/dev/null
    echo "localhost/savagewind-build:$1"
}
run() {  # image, command...: the checkout mounted at /src
    local img=$1; shift
    podman run --rm --arch "${img##*:}" -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src -e SYSROOT=/src/build/linux/aarch64/sysroot "$img" "$@"
}

AMD=$(image amd64)
if [ "$ARCH" = aarch64 ]; then
    ARM=$(image arm64)
    S=build/linux/aarch64/sysroot
    if [ ! -f "$S/.ok" ]; then  # the arm64 image's files: headers and libraries to cross-compile against
        rm -rf "$S" && mkdir -p "$S"
        c=$(podman create --arch arm64 "$ARM")
        # (anchored: only the top-level pseudo filesystems, not e.g. usr/include/<triple>/sys)
        podman export "$c" | tar -x -C "$S" --anchored --exclude='dev/*' --exclude='proc/*' --exclude='sys/*' 2>/dev/null || true
        podman rm -f "$c" >/dev/null
        # absolute symlinks (libm.so -> /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libm.so.6) would point into this machine's root:
        # relative, so they stay inside the sysroot
        find "$S" -type l -lname '/*' | while read -r l; do
            ln -sfn "$(realpath -m --relative-to="$(dirname "$l")" "$S$(readlink "$l")")" "$l"
        done
        touch "$S/.ok"
    fi
    run "$ARM" tools/linux/gen_helper.sh aarch64
else
    run "$AMD" tools/linux/gen_helper.sh x86_64
fi
run "$AMD" tools/linux/package.sh "$ARCH"

```

`tools/linux/build_deps.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# tools/linux/build_deps.sh <x86_64|aarch64> (inside the build container, tools/linux/appimage.sh): what the AppImage
# links against and ships, from pinned sources into build/linux/<arch>/deps - SDL3, an LGPL-only FFmpeg with just what
# the game's movies need (the configuration of tools/build_deps_windows.sh), shaderc (GLSL -> SPIR-V; Ubuntu 22.04 has
# none), and the headers: Vulkan (newer than 22.04's), Vulkan Memory Allocator. aarch64 is cross-compiled against
# the arm64 image's root filesystem in $SYSROOT. Each part is skipped when its output exists (delete deps/ to redo).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
ARCH=$1
S=$PWD/build/linux/src
P=$PWD/build/linux/$ARCH/deps
W=$PWD/build/linux/$ARCH/deps-build
mkdir -p "$S" "$P/include" "$W"
JOBS=$(nproc)

fetch() {  # url sha256 file
    [ -f "$S/$3" ] || { curl -fsSL -o "$S/$3.part" "$1" && mv "$S/$3.part" "$S/$3"; }
    echo "$2  $S/$3" | sha256sum -c --quiet
}
unpack() { rm -rf "$W/$2" && mkdir -p "$W/$2" && tar -xf "$S/$1" -C "$W/$2" --strip-components 1; }

fetch https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/download/release-3.4.16/SDL3-3.4.16.tar.gz \
      7322236cd12090c3eb40b9728be4d49c76f66ad17d04369584d4ecad5cf77c68 SDL3-3.4.16.tar.gz
fetch https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz \
      8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
fetch https://github.com/google/shaderc/archive/refs/tags/v2026.3.tar.gz \
      ee493ccf1b3038b4ef2fe024664c5eb2dc4bcc1f6b05b33e3909de0e19c81024 shaderc-2026.3.tar.gz
fetch https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/archive/refs/tags/vulkan-sdk-1.4.350.1.tar.gz \
      6d1bb65e49520344cc0a48af3dc02e993781efff14c7ebdcb8ae9fa23ddf7e83 Vulkan-Headers-1.4.350.1.tar.gz
fetch https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator/archive/refs/tags/v3.3.0.tar.gz \
      c4f6bbe6b5a45c2eb610ca9d231158e313086d5b1a40c9922cb42b597419b14e VulkanMemoryAllocator-3.3.0.tar.gz

# cross build: clang targets aarch64 against the sysroot (the arm64 image's -dev packages)
CMAKE_CROSS=()
FF_CROSS=()
if [ "$ARCH" != "$(uname -m)" ]; then
    : "${SYSROOT:?cross build: SYSROOT (the arm64 root filesystem)}"
    TC=$W/toolchain.cmake
    cat > "$TC" <<EOF
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Linux)
set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR $ARCH)
set(CMAKE_SYSROOT $SYSROOT)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER clang)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER clang++)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_TARGET $ARCH-linux-gnu)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_TARGET $ARCH-linux-gnu)
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_INIT -fuse-ld=lld)
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS_INIT -fuse-ld=lld)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM NEVER)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE ONLY)
set(CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE ONLY)
EOF
    CMAKE_CROSS=(-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$TC")
    export PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR=$SYSROOT
    export PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR=$SYSROOT/usr/lib/$ARCH-linux-gnu/pkgconfig:$SYSROOT/usr/share/pkgconfig
    FF_CROSS=(--enable-cross-compile --sysroot="$SYSROOT" --cc="clang --target=$ARCH-linux-gnu --sysroot=$SYSROOT"
              --cxx="clang++ --target=$ARCH-linux-gnu --sysroot=$SYSROOT" --ld="clang --target=$ARCH-linux-gnu --sysroot=$SYSROOT -fuse-ld=lld"
              --nm=llvm-nm --ar=llvm-ar --ranlib=llvm-ranlib --strip=llvm-strip)
else
    FF_CROSS=(--cc=clang --cxx=clang++)
fi

if [ ! -f "$P/include/vulkan/vulkan.h" ]; then
    unpack Vulkan-Headers-1.4.350.1.tar.gz vulkan-headers
    cp -R "$W/vulkan-headers/include/vulkan" "$W/vulkan-headers/include/vk_video" "$P/include/"
fi
if [ ! -f "$P/include/vma/vk_mem_alloc.h" ]; then
    unpack VulkanMemoryAllocator-3.3.0.tar.gz vma
    mkdir -p "$P/include/vma" && cp "$W/vma/include/vk_mem_alloc.h" "$P/include/vma/"
fi

if [ ! -f "$P/lib/libSDL3.so" ]; then
    unpack SDL3-3.4.16.tar.gz sdl
    cmake -S "$W/sdl" -B "$W/sdl/build" -G Ninja "${CMAKE_CROSS[@]}" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
        -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$P" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=lib -DSDL_SHARED=ON -DSDL_STATIC=OFF -DSDL_TESTS=OFF \
        -DSDL_EXAMPLES=OFF -DSDL_RPATH=OFF
    cmake --build "$W/sdl/build" -j"$JOBS" && cmake --install "$W/sdl/build"
fi

if [ ! -f "$P/lib/libavcodec.so" ]; then
    unpack ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz ffmpeg
    (cd "$W/ffmpeg" && ./configure --prefix="$P" "${FF_CROSS[@]}" --arch="$ARCH" --target-os=linux \
        --enable-shared --disable-static --enable-pic \
        --disable-autodetect --disable-programs --disable-doc --disable-network --disable-avdevice --disable-avfilter \
        --disable-swresample --disable-everything \
        --enable-protocol=file --enable-demuxer=matroska,mov \
        --enable-decoder=vp9,vp8,vorbis,opus,h264,aac --enable-parser=vp9,vp8,vorbis,opus,h264,aac \
        && make -j"$JOBS" && make install)
fi
grep -q 'GPL version 3\|--enable-gpl' "$P/lib/pkgconfig/libavcodec.pc" && { echo "deps: FFmpeg is not LGPL"; exit 1; }

# shaderc as one shared library (glslang, SPIRV-Tools inside), the libshaderc_shared the Windows build links too;
# its DEPS file pins the glslang / SPIRV-Tools / SPIRV-Headers commits (utils/git-sync-deps clones them)
if [ ! -f "$P/lib/libshaderc_shared.so" ]; then
    unpack shaderc-2026.3.tar.gz shaderc
    (cd "$W/shaderc" && python3 utils/git-sync-deps)
    cmake -S "$W/shaderc" -B "$W/shaderc/build" -G Ninja "${CMAKE_CROSS[@]}" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
        -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$P" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=lib -DSHADERC_SKIP_TESTS=ON -DSHADERC_SKIP_EXAMPLES=ON \
        -DSHADERC_SKIP_COPYRIGHT_CHECK=ON -DSPIRV_SKIP_TESTS=ON -DSPIRV_SKIP_EXECUTABLES=ON -DENABLE_GLSLANG_BINARIES=OFF \
        -DSPIRV_TOOLS_BUILD_STATIC=ON -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
    cmake --build "$W/shaderc/build" --target shaderc_shared -j"$JOBS"
    mkdir -p "$P/include/shaderc"
    cp "$W/shaderc/libshaderc/include/shaderc/"*.h "$P/include/shaderc/"
    cp -P "$W/shaderc/build/libshaderc/libshaderc_shared.so"* "$P/lib/"
fi
echo "deps ($ARCH): $(cd "$P/lib" && ls *.so | tr '\n' ' ')"
```

`tools/linux/distro_build.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Build the app (start screen only, no game code) natively in each distribution's container. What differs between
# distributions is exactly what a container reproduces: package names, whether SDL3 / FFmpeg / shaderc exist as
# packages and what their libraries are called (libshaderc.so vs libshaderc_shared.so), lld, and the clang version
# (the lifted FP code needs __builtin_elementwise_*). A virtual machine per distribution would test the same thing
# an order of magnitude slower; QEMU matters for other CPU architectures (the aarch64 AppImage), not for this.
#
# Usage: tools/linux/distro_build.sh [image...]     (default: every distribution in DISTROS)
#        ENGINE=docker|podman JOBS=8 tools/linux/distro_build.sh archlinux:latest
#        PKG_CACHE=0 tools/linux/distro_build.sh     (download every package again)
# The source tree is mounted read-only and objects go to /tmp/build inside the container; GEN points nowhere, so a
# checkout with generated/ still builds only the app. Downloaded packages (and
# the package metadata where the package manager keeps it there) stay in one engine volume per distribution,
# swr-pkgcache-<image>, so a second run doesn't download them again; `$ENGINE volume rm` drops one.
set -e
REPO=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
ENGINE=${ENGINE:-$(command -v podman || command -v docker)}
JOBS=${JOBS:-$(nproc)}
PLATFORM=--platform=linux/amd64

# Every distribution here has all its dependencies in its own archives, as the app needs them (see docs/linux.md).
# Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and older, Debian 12 and openSUSE Leap are not in the list: no SDL3 package (build SDL3 from
# source, or use the AppImage).
DISTROS="debian:13 ubuntu:26.04 fedora:44 archlinux:latest opensuse/tumbleweed:latest"

deps_for() {
    case $1 in
        debian*|ubuntu*)  # SDL3 3.2+, clang 19+ / 20+, libshaderc.so; the image's docker-clean deletes the .debs
            echo 'rm -f /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/docker-clean; apt-get update -qq; \
                apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends make clang lld pkg-config \
                libsdl3-dev libavformat-dev libavcodec-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev \
                libvulkan-dev libshaderc-dev zlib1g-dev' ;;
        fedora*)          # SDL3-devel, libshaderc-devel, FFmpeg as the "free" variant
            echo 'dnf install -y -q --setopt=keepcache=True \
                make clang lld pkgconf-pkg-config SDL3-devel libshaderc-devel vulkan-loader-devel zlib-devel \
                ffmpeg-free-devel libavformat-free-devel libavcodec-free-devel libavutil-free-devel \
                libswscale-free-devel' ;;
        arch*)
            echo 'pacman -Syu --noconfirm --quiet --needed \
                base-devel clang lld sdl3 shaderc vulkan-icd-loader vulkan-headers ffmpeg zlib' ;;
        opensuse*)        # Tumbleweed: libavformat-devel is its FFmpeg (headers in /usr/include/ffmpeg), SDL3 as SDL3-devel
            echo 'zypper -q modifyrepo --all --keep-packages; \
                zypper -q --non-interactive --gpg-auto-import-keys refresh; \
                zypper -q --non-interactive install --no-recommends \
                make clang lld pkgconf-pkg-config SDL3-devel shaderc-devel vulkan-devel zlib-devel \
                libavformat-devel libavcodec-devel libavutil-devel libswscale-devel' ;;
        *) return 2 ;;
    esac
}

cache_dir_for() {  # where the image's package manager keeps downloaded packages
    case $1 in
        debian*|ubuntu*) echo /var/cache/apt/archives ;;
        fedora*)         echo /var/cache/libdnf5 ;;
        arch*)           echo /var/cache/pacman/pkg ;;
        opensuse*)       echo /var/cache/zypp ;;
    esac
}

images=${*:-$DISTROS}
failed=
for image in $images; do
    if ! install=$(deps_for "$image"); then
        echo "distro_build.sh: no dependency list for $image" >&2
        failed="$failed $image"
        continue
    fi
    echo "=== $image"
    log=$(mktemp)
    cache=
    volume=swr-pkgcache-$(echo "$image" | tr -c 'a-zA-Z0-9_.\n-' _)
    [ "${PKG_CACHE:-1}" = 0 ] || cache="-v $volume:$(cache_dir_for "$image")"
    if "$ENGINE" run --rm $PLATFORM -v "$REPO":/src:ro $cache -w /src \
            -e SW_INSTALL="$install" -e JOBS="$JOBS" "$image" \
            sh -c 'eval "$SW_INSTALL" || exit 1; make -j"$JOBS" B=/tmp/build GEN=/nonexistent || exit 1; \
                   ldd /tmp/build/savagewind | grep -E "SDL3|avformat|shaderc"' \
            > "$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null; then
        echo "=== $image OK"
        grep -E "SDL3|avformat|shaderc" "$log" | sed "s/^/    /"
    else
        echo "=== $image FAILED (full log: $log)"
        tail -40 "$log" | sed "s/^/    /"
        failed="$failed $image"
        continue
    fi
    rm -f "$log"
done
if [ -n "$failed" ]; then echo "failed:$failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
echo "all distributions built"

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# tools/linux/gen_helper.sh <x86_64|aarch64> (inside the build container of that arch, tools/linux/appimage.sh): the
# game code generator frozen by PyInstaller (tools/swgen.spec, as `make gen-helper`) with Ubuntu 22.04's Python 3.12,
# into build/linux/<arch>/helper/swgen.

V=$L/gen-venv
if [ ! -f "$V/.ok" ]; then
    rm -rf "$V" && python3.12 -m venv "$V"
    "$V/bin/python" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip
    "$V/bin/python" -m pip install -q capstone==5.0.9 unicorn==2.1.4 lz4==4.4.5 pyinstaller==6.22.3
    touch "$V/.ok"
fi
"$V/bin/python" -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --log-level WARN --distpath "$L/helper" --workpath "$L/pyinstaller" \
    tools/swgen.spec
du -sh "$L/helper/swgen"
```

`tools/linux/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# tools/linux/package.sh <x86_64|aarch64> (inside the amd64 build container, tools/linux/appimage.sh): the game built
# against build/linux/<arch>/deps and the game code generator helper (tools/linux/gen_helper.sh) put together
# as an AppDir and packed by appimagetool: build/dist/Savage_Wind-<version>-<arch>.AppImage.
# Shipped next to the executable (usr/bin, where runtime/paths.c rt_resource looks): what the start screen
# builds the game code with on the player's machine (runtime/gamebuild.c: swgen/, zig/ from tools/fetch_zig.sh,
# gamelib-src/), the window icon, the start screen font. No game code: that's built from the player's own files. usr/lib: the libraries from deps/ only - glibc, libstdc++, zlib, the Vulkan loader
# and the GPU drivers are the system's (a bundled loader would not find the user's drivers). No game files or fonts.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
ARCH=$1
L=$PWD/build/linux/$ARCH
P=$L/deps

# libraries: what savagewind needs (DT_NEEDED, recursively) that deps/ provides; anything else must be a system one
needed() { readelf -d "$1" | sed -n 's/.*(NEEDED).*\[\(.*\)\]/\1/p'; }
SYSTEM_LIBS='^(libc|libm|libdl|libpthread|librt|libresolv|libstdc\+\+|libgcc_s|libz|libvulkan)\.so|^ld-linux'
todo=("$APPDIR/usr/bin/savagewind")
while [ ${#todo[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
    f=${todo[0]}; todo=("${todo[@]:1}")
    for n in $(needed "$f"); do
        [ -e "$APPDIR/usr/lib/$n" ] && continue
        if [ -e "$P/lib/$n" ]; then
            cp -L "$P/lib/$n" "$APPDIR/usr/lib/$n"
            patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN' "$APPDIR/usr/lib/$n"
            todo+=("$APPDIR/usr/lib/$n")
        elif ! [[ $n =~ $SYSTEM_LIBS ]]; then
            echo "package: $(basename "$f") needs $n, neither bundled nor a base system library"; exit 1
        fi
    done
done
patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN/../lib' "$APPDIR/usr/bin/savagewind"
if ls "$APPDIR/usr/lib" | grep -iE 'x264|x265|xvid|postproc|vulkan'; then  # (no GPL codecs, no Vulkan loader)
    echo "package: library that must not ship"; exit 1
fi
echo "bundled: $(ls "$APPDIR/usr/lib" | tr '\n' ' ')"

# ---- AppImage (appimagetool runs extracted: no FUSE in the container)
fetch() {  # url sha256 file
    [ -f "build/linux/src/$3" ] || { curl -fsSL -o "build/linux/src/$3.part" "$1" && mv "build/linux/src/$3.part" "build/linux/src/$3"; }
    echo "$2  build/linux/src/$3" | sha256sum -c --quiet
}
fetch https://github.com/AppImage/appimagetool/releases/download/1.9.1/appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage \
      ed4ce84f0d9caff66f50bcca6ff6f35aae54ce8135408b3fa33abfc3cb384eb0 appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage
case $ARCH in
    x86_64) fetch https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/releases/download/20251108/runtime-x86_64 \
                  2fca8b443c92510f1483a883f60061ad09b46b978b2631c807cd873a47ec260d runtime-x86_64 ;;
    aarch64) fetch https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/releases/download/20251108/runtime-aarch64 \
                   00cbdfcf917cc6c0ff6d3347d59e0ca1f7f45a6df1a428a0d6d8a78664d87444 runtime-aarch64 ;;
esac
chmod +x build/linux/src/appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage
mkdir -p build/dist && rm -f "$OUT"
APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 ARCH=$ARCH build/linux/src/appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage --no-appstream \
    --runtime-file "build/linux/src/runtime-$ARCH" "$APPDIR" "$OUT"
ls -la "$OUT"
```

`tools/linux/test_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Scripted test run from a saved point: the game loads a copy of the given save with "Continue", so a test is
# playable in ~30 s instead of starting a new game. tools/run.sh and tools/game_slot.sh are macOS only (vm_stat,
# save_backup_*). Never touches the player's saves or savagewind.ini: everything goes to build/test_run/.
#
#   tools/linux/test_run.sh <save folder> [seconds]     (from anywhere; default 90 s)
#
# <save folder>: one slot, with game_data.sav and caption.sav (as in the game's save folder: 0/, 1/...).
# Any SAVAGEWIND_* the caller sets is passed on, e.g. SAVAGEWIND_TEST_WARP=hateno SAVAGEWIND_TEST_TIME=12
# (runtime/services/test_warp.c). Game buttons after Continue: TEST_INPUT="1400:PLUS:6,1600:R:6" (the
# SAVAGEWIND_INPUT format, frames from start; playable from about frame 1100). SHOTS=<n>: a screenshot every n
# frames in build/test_run/shots/. SHOW=1 shows the window (hidden by default:
# SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN hides it whatever its value).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
save=${1:?usage: tools/linux/test_run.sh <save folder> [seconds]}
secs=${2:-90}
[ -f "$save/game_data.sav" ] || { echo "no game_data.sav in $save" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -x build/savagewind ] || { echo "build/savagewind not built" >&2; exit 1; }

d=build/test_run
rm -rf "$d" && mkdir -p "$d/save/save_0/0" "$d/shots"
cp "$save"/*.sav "$d/save/save_0/0/"
printf 'settings_version = 3\nmenu_tip_seen = 1\nprecompile_shaders = 0\n' > "$d/savagewind.ini"
# "Continue" is the first entry of the title menu: A until the save is loading (the title shows from about frame 250)
input=300:A:4,340:A:4,380:A:4,420:A:4,460:A:4,500:A:4,540:A:4${TEST_INPUT:+,$TEST_INPUT}

vars=(SAVAGEWIND_SETTINGS="$d/savagewind.ini" SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR="$PWD/$d/save" SAVAGEWIND_LAUNCHER_AUTOPLAY=1
      SAVAGEWIND_INPUT="$input")
[ -n "${SHOW:-}" ] || vars+=(SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN=1)
[ -n "${SHOTS:-}" ] && vars+=(SAVAGEWIND_SCREENSHOT_EVERY="$SHOTS")

rm -f build/frame_*.png
status=0
env "${vars[@]}" timeout -s KILL "$secs" ./build/savagewind extracted > "$d/run.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
mv build/frame_*.png "$d/shots/" 2>/dev/null || true
[ "$status" = 137 ] && echo "(stopped after ${secs}s)" || echo "(exited with $status)"
grep -E '^\[(warp|save)\]|mounted host' "$d/run.log" | sort | uniq -c | head -20 || true
echo "log: $d/run.log, $(find "$d/shots" -name '*.png' | wc -l) screenshots in $d/shots"
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# macOS release disk image: build/dist/Savage Wind-<release tag>-macOS.dmg holding "Savage Wind.app" next to an
# Applications shortcut (drag the app onto it to install - how Mac users expect to install). Run after `make app`.
set -e

APP="build/Savage Wind.app"
[ -d "$APP" ] || { echo "no $APP - run make app first" >&2; exit 1; }
VERSION=$(sed -n 's/^#define SAVAGEWIND_VERSION "\(.*\)"/\1/p' runtime/ui/launcher.mm)  # (the release tag)

ln -s /Applications "$STAGE/Applications"
mkdir -p build/dist
rm -f "$OUT"

    -ov "$OUT" >/dev/null
echo "$OUT ($(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1))"
```

`tools/make_update_manifest.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Writes <release folder>/sw-manifest.txt: every file of a release with its size and SHA-256 (runtime/update_core.h).

SW Update checks the files of an update against it, and removes the files of the old version that the new one no
longer has only if the old version's list names them, so nothing a player keeps in the folder is ever touched.

usage: tools/make_update_manifest.py <release folder> <version>
"""
import hashlib
import os
import sys


def main():
    folder, version = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    lines = ['savagewind-update-manifest 1', f'version {version}']
    count = 0
    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(folder):
        dirs.sort()
        for name in sorted(files):
            path = os.path.join(base, name)
            rel = os.path.relpath(path, folder).replace(os.sep, '/')
            if rel == 'sw-manifest.txt':
                continue
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with open(path, 'rb') as f:
                for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
                    digest.update(chunk)
            lines.append(f'f {digest.hexdigest()} {os.path.getsize(path)} {rel}')
            count += 1
    with open(os.path.join(folder, 'sw-manifest.txt'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
    print(f'sw-manifest.txt: {count} files, version {version}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`tools/merge_seed_report.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add the pipelines in players' problem reports to the shipped pipeline seed.

A problem report zip (Options > Problem report) carries the player's pipeline list and shader key log
(pipelines/vk_pipelines.list, pipelines/vk_shader_keys.list): hashes and render state, nothing of the game. This
turns each into a seed with savagewind --export-pipeline-seed (in a scratch cache folder, SAVAGEWIND_PSO_FOREIGN so a
list from another GPU is read, SAVAGEWIND_SEED_TRANSLATOR so its ids are worked out as the player's build named them)
and adds the records the seed doesn't have yet.

What it checks: the export keeps only pipelines whose shaders are in the game's own archives with the keys the
player's key log names, so a damaged or made-up list adds nothing. A list from a build with another file format
(record size, translation format) gives no records. Pipelines a GPU can't build are skipped by the pre-warm, as for
any seed.

    tools/merge_seed_report.py report1.zip [report2.zip ...] [--seed runtime/nvn/vulkan/vk_pipelines.seed]
        [--exe build/savagewind.exe] [--dry-run]

Run it from the checkout's root (the data root with extracted/, like the test scripts).
"""

import argparse
import os
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
import zlib

SEED_MAGIC = b"SWPSEED1"
SEED_HEADER = struct.Struct("<8s6I")  # magic, version, nrecs, key_size, state_size, zsize, reserved
LIST_HEADER = struct.Struct("<8s4I64s")  # magic, version, rec_size, vendor, device, shaders
LIST_FILES = ("vk_pipelines.list", "vk_shader_keys.list")
VENDORS = {0x10DE: "NVIDIA", 0x1002: "AMD", 0x8086: "Intel", 0x13B5: "Arm", 0x5143: "Qualcomm"}


def read_seed(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    magic, version, nrecs, key_size, state_size, zsize, _ = SEED_HEADER.unpack_from(data)
    if magic != SEED_MAGIC or version != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: not a pipeline seed")
    raw = zlib.decompress(data[SEED_HEADER.size:SEED_HEADER.size + zsize])
    size = 4 + 16 + 2 * key_size + state_size
    if len(raw) != nrecs * size:
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: {len(raw)} bytes for {nrecs} records of {size}")
    return (key_size, state_size), [raw[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(raw), size)]


def write_seed(path, layout, recs):
    z = zlib.compress(b"".join(recs), 9)
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
        f.write(SEED_HEADER.pack(SEED_MAGIC, 1, len(recs), layout[0], layout[1], len(z), 0))
        f.write(z)
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def report_seed(zip_path, exe, work):
    """The report's pipeline list as a seed file in work/, or (None, why)."""
    cache = os.path.join(work, "cache")
    os.makedirs(cache)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as z:
        names = set(z.namelist())
        for name in LIST_FILES:
            if "pipelines/" + name not in names:
                return None, "no pipeline list in it (made by an older build)"
            with z.open("pipelines/" + name) as src, open(os.path.join(cache, name), "wb") as dst:
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
    with open(os.path.join(cache, LIST_FILES[0]), "rb") as f:
        head = f.read(LIST_HEADER.size)
    if len(head) < LIST_HEADER.size:
        return None, "the pipeline list is empty"
    magic, version, rec_size, vendor, device, shaders = LIST_HEADER.unpack(head)
    if magic != b"SWPSOLST":
        return None, "the pipeline list is damaged"
    translator = shaders.split(b"\0")[0].decode("ascii", "replace").split("/")[0]
    gpu = f"{VENDORS.get(vendor, hex(vendor))} device {device:#x}"
    out = os.path.join(work, "report.seed")
    env = dict(os.environ, SAVAGEWIND_CACHE_DIR=cache, SAVAGEWIND_PSO_FOREIGN="1",
               SAVAGEWIND_SEED_TRANSLATOR=translator, SAVAGEWIND_HIDDEN="1")
    r = subprocess.run([exe, "--export-pipeline-seed", out], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True,
                       errors="replace", timeout=900)
    lines = [l for l in (r.stdout + r.stderr).splitlines() if "pipeline seed" in l or "pipeline list" in l]
    if r.returncode or not os.path.exists(out):
        return None, f"export failed ({gpu}, exit {r.returncode}): " + " | ".join(lines[-3:] or (r.stdout + r.stderr).splitlines()[-3:])
    return out, f"{gpu}, translator {translator}; " + " | ".join(l.split("] ", 1)[-1] for l in lines[-2:-1])


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("reports", nargs="+", help="problem report zips")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", default="runtime/nvn/vulkan/vk_pipelines.seed")
    ap.add_argument("--exe", default="build/savagewind.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "build/savagewind")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="count the new pipelines, don't write the seed")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    layout, recs = read_seed(a.seed)
    known = set(recs)
    start = len(recs)
    print(f"seed {a.seed}: {start} pipelines")
    for rep in a.reports:
        work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seedrep-")
        try:
            path, info = report_seed(rep, os.path.abspath(a.exe), work)
            if not path:
                print(f"{rep}: nothing added: {info}")
                continue
            lay, got = read_seed(path)
            if lay != layout:
                print(f"{rep}: nothing added: record layout {lay} differs from the seed's {layout}")
                continue
            new = [r for r in got if r not in known]
            known.update(new)
            recs.extend(new)
            print(f"{rep}: {len(got)} pipelines, {len(new)} new ({info})")
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    print(f"total: {len(recs)} pipelines, +{len(recs) - start}")
    if not a.dry_run and len(recs) > start:
        write_seed(a.seed, layout, recs)
        print(f"written {a.seed} ({os.path.getsize(a.seed) / 1024:.1f} KB)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```
