`tools/test_act_site.py`:

```py
"""Per-action hook (tools/patches.py _act_query, docs/ACTIONS.md) without game files: made-up instructions only."""
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools"))
import patches

STP = 0xA9BE7BFD  # stp x29, x30, [sp, #-0x20]!: the first instruction of both queries
base = 0x7000000000
masks = 0x70016D89B4
gen = SimpleNamespace(base=base, nso=SimpleNamespace(image=struct.pack("<I", STP)),
                      sites={"act_hold": base, "act_trig": base, "act_masks": masks})

for kind, name in ((0, "act_hold"), (1, "act_trig")):
    code = patches.PATCHES[name](gen, base)
    call = f"rt_act_query({kind}, c->x[0], c->x[1], c->x[30], {masks:#x}ull)"
    assert call in code, code
    # an answer of the runtime's returns early with the result in w0 ...
    assert "if (r >= 0) { c->x[0] = (uint64_t)r; return; }" in code, code
    # ... and otherwise the replaced stp runs (the frame is pushed, 0x20 bytes) before the game's own code
    assert code.index("return;") < code.index("c->sp = ea;"), code
    assert "c->sp - 0x20" in code and "ST64(ea, c->x[29]); ST64(ea + 8, c->x[30])" in code, code
    assert code.startswith("{") and "}" in code and code.count("{") == code.count("}"), code

assert "held" in patches.PATCHES["act_hold"](gen, base) and "pressed" in patches.PATCHES["act_trig"](gen, base)

for bad in (0xA9BF7BFD, 0xD503201F, 0xA9BD7BFD):  # stp #-0x10! / nop / stp #-0x30!
    gen.nso.image = struct.pack("<I", bad)
    try:
        patches.PATCHES["act_hold"](gen, base)
    except AssertionError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected instruction {bad:#x} accepted")

# a game without the sites (an optional group left out) has no patch for them
assert patches.table({"pc_map_focus": 0x7000001000}).get(base) is None
print("action hook: both queries, early return, the replaced stp, the mask table and opcode rejection PASS")

```

`tools/test_actions.c`:

```c
// Per-action bindings (runtime/hle/bindings.c, docs/ACTIONS.md): which host input drives each of the game's actions,
// the answers to the game's hold / pressed queries, the menus falling back to the Switch layer, two actions on one key,
// the capture and savagewind.ini. No window, controller or game files: a made-up mask table stands in for the game's.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "game_sites.h"
#include "input_bind.h"

GameSites g_site;  // (no game: the HUD prompt check finds no screens)

static uint64_t now;
Uint64 SDL_GetTicks(void) { return now; }
Uint64 SDL_GetTicksNS(void) { return now * 1000000ull; }
int input_pad_family(void) { return 0; }
bool settings_steam_deck(void) { return false; }

// Actions 2 / 3 / 5 / 9 read X / Y / A / B (the pad mask bits are sead's), the rest A
static uint32_t masks[ACT_COUNT];
static int key_down[BIND_MOUSE_LAST + 1];
static int held(int sc) { return sc > 0 && sc <= BIND_MOUSE_LAST && key_down[sc]; }

static const int JUMP = 2, ATTACK = 3, INTERACT = 5, CANCEL = 9;

static void host(uint64_t key_buttons, uint64_t pad_buttons, uint32_t pad_host) {
    act_publish(act_scan_keys(key_buttons, held), act_scan_pad(pad_buttons, pad_host));
}
static int hold(int id) { return rt_act_query(0, 0, (uint64_t)id, 0x1234, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)masks); }
static int trig(int id) { return rt_act_query(1, 0, (uint64_t)id, 0x1234, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)masks); }

static void defaults_are_untouched(void) {
    act_masks(NULL);
    for (int id = 0; id < ACT_COUNT; id++) {
        int b = act_switch_button(id);
        assert(b >= 0 && act_is_default(id));
        assert(g_act_key[id] == g_bind_key[b] && g_act_pad[id] == g_bind_pad[b]);
        key_down[g_act_key[id]] = 1;
        assert(!(act_scan_keys(0, held) >> id & 1));
        key_down[g_act_key[id]] = 0;
        assert(!(act_scan_pad(0, 1u << g_act_pad[id]) >> id & 1));
    }
    act_masks(masks);
    host(1ull << BIND_X, 1ull << BIND_X, 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH);
    act_poll(true);
    for (int id = 0; id < ACT_COUNT; id++) assert(hold(id) == -1 && trig(id) == -1);
    host(0, 0, 0);
    assert(rt_act_query(0, 0, 41, 0, 0) == -1 && rt_act_query(1, 0, 4000000000ull, 0, 0) == -1);
}

static void a_bound_action_follows_its_key(void) {
    act_set(BIND_DEV_KEY, JUMP, SDL_SCANCODE_G);
    assert(!act_is_default(JUMP) && act_is_default(ATTACK));
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0 && trig(JUMP) == 0);
    assert(hold(ATTACK) == -1);  // factory-default actions leave the game in control
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1 && trig(JUMP) == 1);
    act_poll(true);  // still down; the press was read
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1 && trig(JUMP) == 0);
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 0;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0 && trig(JUMP) == 0);
    // the Switch layer's key for the same button no longer reaches the action: Space is X, but Jump left X
    host(1ull << BIND_X, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0);
}

static void a_press_is_not_lost_when_nobody_asked(void) {
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);   // pressed here, but the game does not ask before the next poll
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 0;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(trig(JUMP) == 1);  // still delivered once
    act_poll(true);
    assert(trig(JUMP) == 0);
}

// ...but not kept for long: while a message is up the game asks about no player action, and the press that closed it
// must not jump once the player is asked again
static void a_press_nobody_asked_about_expires(void) {
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 0;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) now += 50, act_poll(true);  // 500 ms of polls nobody read
    assert(trig(JUMP) == 0);
}

static void menus_use_the_switch_layer(void) {
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(false);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == -1 && trig(JUMP) == -1);
    act_poll(true);  // held through the menu closing: held, not newly pressed
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1 && trig(JUMP) == 0);
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 0;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
}

static void two_actions_share_a_key(void) {
    act_set(BIND_DEV_KEY, ATTACK, SDL_SCANCODE_G);
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1 && hold(ATTACK) == 1 && trig(JUMP) == 1 && trig(ATTACK) == 1);
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 0;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0 && hold(ATTACK) == 0);
    act_set(BIND_DEV_KEY, ATTACK, ACT_FOLLOW);
    assert(act_is_default(ATTACK));
}

static void the_default_side_keeps_its_factory_binding(void) {
    // Jump has a key of its own; its controller side is left at the default, which is the Switch button X
    assert(g_act_pad[JUMP] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH);
    host(0, 0, 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1);
    host(0, 0, 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST);  // Attack's default
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0);
    // ... or a controller button of its own
    act_set(BIND_DEV_PAD, JUMP, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER);
    host(0, 1ull << BIND_X, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0);  // X no longer jumps
    host(0, 0, 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1);
    // ... or none
    act_set(BIND_DEV_PAD, JUMP, ACT_NONE);
    host(0, 0, 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0);
    act_set(BIND_DEV_PAD, JUMP, ACT_FOLLOW);
    assert(!act_is_default(JUMP));  // the changed key still keeps both host sides active
    host(0, 0, 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1);
    act_set(BIND_DEV_KEY, JUMP, ACT_FOLLOW);
    assert(act_is_default(JUMP));
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == -1 && trig(JUMP) == -1);
}

static void a_pad_only_override_uses_both_host_sides(void) {
    act_set(BIND_DEV_PAD, JUMP, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER);
    host(1ull << BIND_X, 1ull << BIND_X, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0);  // custom on one device means raw Switch state is ignored on both
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1 && trig(JUMP) == 1);  // unchanged keyboard side uses its factory host key
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE] = 0;
    host(0, 0, 1u << SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1);
    bind_reset_slot(BIND_ACTION + JUMP);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == -1 && trig(JUMP) == -1);
    act_set(BIND_DEV_PAD, JUMP, ACT_NONE);
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0);
    act_reset();
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == -1 && trig(JUMP) == -1);
    assert(bind_settings_load("act_key_2", "G"));
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 1 && trig(JUMP) == 1);
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_G] = 0;
    act_reset();
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == -1 && trig(JUMP) == -1);
}

static void the_switch_button_comes_from_the_game_table(void) {
    assert(act_switch_button(JUMP) == BIND_X && act_switch_button(ATTACK) == BIND_Y);
    assert(act_switch_button(INTERACT) == BIND_A && act_switch_button(CANCEL) == BIND_B);
    assert(act_switch_button(ACT_COUNT) == -1 && act_switch_button(-1) == -1);
}

static void capture_and_settings(void) {
    SDL_Event e = {0};
    act_reset();
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_ACTION + JUMP);
    int dev, slot, ms;
    assert(bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && dev == BIND_DEV_KEY && slot == BIND_ACTION + JUMP);
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_E;  // E is the Switch layer's A key: nothing swaps
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e));
    assert(g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_E && g_bind_key[BIND_A] == SDL_SCANCODE_E);
    int other, serial;
    assert(bind_last_result(&dev, &slot, &other, &serial) == 1 && slot == BIND_ACTION + JUMP && other == -1);
    assert(!strcmp(act_name(JUMP), "Jump") && !strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_ACTION + JUMP), "Jump"));
    assert(act_name(ATTACK + 20) == NULL && !strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_ACTION + 7), "Action"));
    assert(act_hidden(7) && act_hidden(29) && !act_hidden(JUMP) && !act_hidden(13) && !act_hidden(40));
    for (int i = 0; i < ACT_COUNT; i++) assert(act_hidden(i) || act_name(i));  // every action on the page has a name
    // a second action on the same key
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_ACTION + ATTACK);
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_act_key[ATTACK] == SDL_SCANCODE_E && g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_E);
    // a controller button, and a mouse button
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_PAD, BIND_ACTION + INTERACT);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN; e.gbutton.button = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_act_pad[INTERACT] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_ACTION + CANCEL);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN; e.button.button = SDL_BUTTON_X1;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_act_key[CANCEL] == BIND_MOUSE + SDL_BUTTON_X1);
    // Escape cancels and keeps the old one
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_ACTION + CANCEL);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_act_key[CANCEL] == BIND_MOUSE + SDL_BUTTON_X1);
    // BIND_DEV_ANY (the in-game Options page): a key binds the keyboard side, a controller button the other side
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_ANY, BIND_ACTION + 12);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_G;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_act_key[12] == SDL_SCANCODE_G && g_act_pad[12] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_ANY, BIND_ACTION + 12);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN; e.gbutton.button = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_act_pad[12] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST && g_act_key[12] == SDL_SCANCODE_G);
    bind_reset_slot(BIND_ACTION + 12);  // one row back to its default, both sides
    assert(g_act_key[12] == SDL_SCANCODE_LSHIFT && g_act_pad[12] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    // a keyboard-only stick direction ignores a controller button but takes a key
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_ANY, BIND_LS_UP);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN; e.gbutton.button = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST;
    int16_t walk = g_bind_key[BIND_LS_UP];
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_bind_key[BIND_LS_UP] == walk);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_H;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_bind_key[BIND_LS_UP] == SDL_SCANCODE_H);
    bind_reset_slot(BIND_LS_UP);
    assert(g_bind_key[BIND_LS_UP] == walk);
    act_set(BIND_DEV_PAD, ATTACK, ACT_NONE);

    // savagewind.ini: only what differs, and back
    FILE *f = tmpfile();  // not open_memstream: that is POSIX only and this also runs on Windows
    bind_settings_save(f);
    long len = ftell(f);
    char *buf = malloc((size_t)len + 1);
    rewind(f);
    assert(fread(buf, 1, (size_t)len, f) == (size_t)len);
    buf[len] = 0;
    fclose(f);
    assert(strstr(buf, "act_key_2 = E\n") && strstr(buf, "act_key_3 = E\n") && strstr(buf, "act_pad_5 = south\n"));
    assert(strstr(buf, "act_key_9 = Mouse Back\n") && strstr(buf, "act_pad_3 = none\n"));
    assert(!strstr(buf, "act_key_0") && !strstr(buf, "act_pad_2"));
    int16_t key[ACT_COUNT], pad[ACT_COUNT];
    memcpy(key, g_act_key, sizeof key);
    memcpy(pad, g_act_pad, sizeof pad);
    act_reset();
    for (char *line = strtok(buf, "\n"); line; line = strtok(NULL, "\n")) {
        char k[64], v[64];
        if (sscanf(line, "%63s = %63[^\n]", k, v) == 2) bind_settings_load(k, v);
    }
    free(buf);
    assert(!memcmp(key, g_act_key, sizeof key) && !memcmp(pad, g_act_pad, sizeof pad));
    // junk is ignored
    assert(bind_settings_load("act_key_99", "E") && bind_settings_load("act_key_x", "E") &&
           bind_settings_load("act_pad_1", "nonsense"));
    assert(g_act_key[1] == SDL_SCANCODE_LSHIFT && g_act_pad[1] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    act_reset();
    for (int id = 0; id < ACT_COUNT; id++) assert(act_is_default(id));
}

static char *save_bindings(void) {
    FILE *f = tmpfile();
    assert(f);
    bind_settings_save(f);
    long len = ftell(f);
    assert(len >= 0);
    char *buf = malloc((size_t)len + 1);
    assert(buf);
    rewind(f);
    assert(fread(buf, 1, (size_t)len, f) == (size_t)len);
    buf[len] = 0;
    fclose(f);
    return buf;
}

static void load_bindings(char *buf) {
    for (char *line = strtok(buf, "\n"); line; line = strtok(NULL, "\n")) {
        char k[64], v[64];
        assert(sscanf(line, "%63s = %63[^\n]", k, v) == 2);
        assert(bind_settings_load(k, v));
    }
}

static void reset_bindings(void) {
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_KEY);
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_PAD);
    act_reset();  // fresh ini load: no explicit act_* lines have been seen yet
    assert(bind_settings_load("act_schema", "0"));  // simulate a new process loading a legacy file
}

static void migration_and_independent_defaults(void) {
    reset_bindings();
    char legacy[] = "bind_key_x = H\nbind_pad_x = south\nact_key_11 = G\nact_pad_11 = none\n";
    load_bindings(legacy);
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(JUMP) == 0);  // migration refreshed the custom-action gate
    assert(g_bind_key[BIND_X] == SDL_SCANCODE_H && g_bind_pad[BIND_X] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    assert(g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_H && g_act_pad[JUMP] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    assert(g_act_key[11] == SDL_SCANCODE_G && g_act_pad[11] == ACT_NONE);
    assert(g_act_key[19] == SDL_SCANCODE_H && g_act_pad[19] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    char *saved = save_bindings();
    assert(strstr(saved, "act_key_2 = H\n") && strstr(saved, "act_pad_2 = south\n"));
    reset_bindings();
    load_bindings(saved);
    free(saved);
    assert(g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_H && g_act_pad[JUMP] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    assert(g_act_key[11] == SDL_SCANCODE_G && g_act_pad[11] == ACT_NONE);

    // Explicit action lines win in either order, on each device independently (including factory defaults).
    reset_bindings();
    char ordered[] = "act_key_2 = Space\nact_pad_2 = north\nbind_key_x = H\nbind_pad_x = south\n";
    load_bindings(ordered);
    assert(act_is_default(JUMP));
    assert(g_act_key[19] == SDL_SCANCODE_H && g_act_pad[19] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    // Runtime edits to the raw Switch layer never move actions.
    g_bind_key[BIND_X] = SDL_SCANCODE_J;
    g_bind_pad[BIND_X] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST;
    assert(g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE && g_act_pad[JUMP] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH);
    bind_reset_slot(BIND_X);
    assert(g_act_key[19] == SDL_SCANCODE_H);
    bind_reset_slot(BIND_ACTION + 19);
    assert(act_is_default(19));
    act_set(BIND_DEV_KEY, JUMP, SDL_SCANCODE_G);
    act_set(BIND_DEV_PAD, JUMP, ACT_NONE);
    assert(!bind_is_default_slot(BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_ACTION + JUMP));
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_KEY);
    assert(g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE && g_act_pad[JUMP] == ACT_NONE);
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_PAD);
    assert(act_is_default(JUMP) && bind_is_default(BIND_DEV_PAD) && bind_is_default(BIND_DEV_KEY));
    char *defaults = save_bindings();
    assert(!strcmp(defaults, "act_schema = 2\n"));
    free(defaults);
    reset_bindings();
    assert(bind_settings_load("bind_key_x", "none") && g_act_key[JUMP] == ACT_NONE);
    assert(bind_settings_load("bind_pad_x", "none") && g_act_pad[JUMP] == ACT_NONE);
    reset_bindings();
}

static void schema_migration_is_one_time(void) {
    reset_bindings();
    char legacy[] = "bind_key_x = H\nbind_pad_x = south\n";
    load_bindings(legacy);
    assert(g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_H && g_act_pad[JUMP] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    bind_reset_slot(BIND_ACTION + JUMP);
    char *saved = save_bindings();
    assert(!strncmp(saved, "act_schema = 2\n", strlen("act_schema = 2\n")));
    assert(!strstr(saved, "act_key_2 =") && !strstr(saved, "act_pad_2 ="));
    assert(strstr(saved, "bind_key_x = H\n") && strstr(saved, "bind_pad_x = south\n"));
    // Fresh reloads keep Jump at its own defaults and preserve all other migrated values byte for byte.
    for (int round = 0; round < 2; round++) {
        char *copy = malloc(strlen(saved) + 1);
        assert(copy);
        strcpy(copy, saved);
        reset_bindings();
        load_bindings(copy);
        free(copy);
        assert(g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE && g_act_pad[JUMP] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH);
        assert(g_act_key[19] == SDL_SCANCODE_H && g_act_pad[19] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
        host(0, 0, 0);
        act_poll(true);
        assert(hold(JUMP) == -1 && trig(JUMP) == -1 && hold(19) == 0);
        char *again = save_bindings();
        assert(!strcmp(saved, again));
        free(saved);
        saved = again;
    }
    free(saved);
    // Resetting action defaults within a schema-2 session must not re-enable legacy migration.
    act_reset();
    assert(bind_settings_load("bind_key_x", "G") && bind_settings_load("bind_pad_x", "west"));
    assert(g_act_key[JUMP] == SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE && g_act_pad[JUMP] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH);
    reset_bindings();
}

static void capture_pad(int dev, int slot, int button) {
    SDL_Event e = {0};
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN;
    e.gbutton.button = (Uint8)button;
    bind_capture_begin(dev, slot);
    assert(bind_capture_active(NULL, NULL, NULL));
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e));
    assert(!bind_capture_active(NULL, NULL, NULL) && g_bind_pad[slot] == button);
}

static void host_pad_slots(void) {
    reset_bindings();
    for (int slot = BIND_WALK; slot <= BIND_GYRO_CENTER; slot++) {
        assert(bind_pad_slot(slot) && g_bind_pad[slot] == -1);
        assert(bind_is_default_slot(BIND_DEV_PAD, slot));
        capture_pad(BIND_DEV_PAD, slot, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC2);
        assert(!bind_is_default_slot(BIND_DEV_PAD, slot));
        bind_reset_slot(slot);
        capture_pad(BIND_DEV_ANY, slot, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC2);
        bind_reset_slot(slot);
        assert(g_bind_pad[slot] == -1 && bind_is_default_slot(BIND_DEV_PAD, slot));
    }
    for (int slot = BIND_LS_UP; slot <= BIND_RS_RIGHT; slot++) assert(!bind_pad_slot(slot));
    // Host actions share inputs without taking raw menu buttons or another action's binding.
    capture_pad(BIND_DEV_ANY, BIND_WALK, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_B] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH && g_bind_pad[BIND_LS_UP] == 0);
    assert(g_act_pad[12] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);  // independent action, no swap
    capture_pad(BIND_DEV_PAD, BIND_TILT, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_WALK] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    capture_pad(BIND_DEV_PAD, BIND_GYRO_UP, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_TILT] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    capture_pad(BIND_DEV_ANY, BIND_GYRO_DOWN, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_GYRO_UP] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH && g_bind_pad[BIND_TILT] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
    // A trigger is also capturable on the new slots.
    SDL_Event e = {0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_AXIS_MOTION;
    e.gaxis.axis = SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER; e.gaxis.value = 20000;
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_ANY, BIND_WALK);
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e) && g_bind_pad[BIND_WALK] == PADB_LTRIGGER && g_bind_pad[BIND_ZL] == PADB_LTRIGGER);

    // Every added ini name round-trips. Unbinding an existing raw pad slot also survives a save.
    static const char *const names[] = {"walk", "tilt", "gyro_up", "gyro_down", "gyro_left", "gyro_right",
                                        "gyro_turn_left", "gyro_turn_right", "gyro_center"};
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        char key[64]; snprintf(key, sizeof key, "bind_pad_%s", names[i]);
        assert(bind_settings_load(key, "misc2"));
        assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_WALK + i] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC2);
    }
    assert(bind_settings_load("bind_pad_zl", "none"));
    char *saved = save_bindings();
    assert(strstr(saved, "bind_pad_zl = none\n"));
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        char line[64]; snprintf(line, sizeof line, "bind_pad_%s = misc2\n", names[i]);
        assert(strstr(saved, line));
    }
    reset_bindings();
    load_bindings(saved);
    free(saved);
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_WALK + i] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC2);
    assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_ZL] == -1);
    bind_settings_load("bind_pad_walk", "none");
    bind_settings_load("bind_pad_tilt", "bad-button");
    assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_WALK] == -1 && g_bind_pad[BIND_TILT] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_MISC2);
    reset_bindings();
}

static void captures_allow_shared_action_inputs(void) {
    const int captures[] = {BIND_DEV_PAD, BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_DEV_ANY};
    for (unsigned c = 0; c < sizeof captures / sizeof *captures; c++) {
        for (int dev = BIND_DEV_PAD; dev <= BIND_DEV_KEY; dev++) {
            if (captures[c] != BIND_DEV_ANY && captures[c] != dev) continue;
            reset_bindings();
            int16_t *raw = dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_bind_pad : g_bind_key;
            int16_t *actions = dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? g_act_pad : g_act_key;
            const int host = raw[BIND_B];
            SDL_Event e = {0};
            e.type = dev == BIND_DEV_PAD ? SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN : SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN;
            if (dev == BIND_DEV_PAD) e.gbutton.button = (Uint8)host;
            else e.key.scancode = (SDL_Scancode)host;
            // Every host action and game action can share the menu-back input. Only the chosen slot changes.
            for (int n = BIND_WALK; n <= BIND_GYRO_CENTER + ACT_COUNT; n++) {
                int slot = n <= BIND_GYRO_CENTER ? n : BIND_ACTION + n - BIND_GYRO_CENTER - 1;
                int16_t expected_raw[BIND_KEY_COUNT], expected_actions[ACT_COUNT];
                memcpy(expected_raw, raw, sizeof expected_raw);
                memcpy(expected_actions, actions, sizeof expected_actions);
                if (bind_slot_is_action(slot)) expected_actions[slot - BIND_ACTION] = host;
                else expected_raw[slot] = host;
                bind_capture_begin(captures[c], slot);
                assert(bind_capture_event(&e));
                assert(!bind_capture_active(NULL, NULL, NULL));
                assert(!memcmp(raw, expected_raw, sizeof expected_raw));
                assert(!memcmp(actions, expected_actions, sizeof expected_actions));
                int actual_dev, actual_slot, other;
                assert(bind_last_result(&actual_dev, &actual_slot, &other, NULL) == 1);
                assert(actual_dev == dev && actual_slot == slot && other == -1);
            }
            // Direct action edits also leave all existing bindings in place.
            for (int id = 0; id < ACT_COUNT; id++) act_set(dev, id, raw[BIND_A]);
            for (int id = 0; id < ACT_COUNT; id++) assert(actions[id] == raw[BIND_A]);
            assert(raw[BIND_B] == host);
            // Raw Switch slots still swap with each other without displacing any shared host actions.
            int old_a = raw[BIND_A];
            bind_capture_begin(dev, BIND_A);
            assert(bind_capture_event(&e));
            assert(raw[BIND_A] == host && raw[BIND_B] == old_a);
            for (int slot = BIND_WALK; slot <= BIND_GYRO_CENTER; slot++) assert(raw[slot] == host);
            for (int id = 0; id < ACT_COUNT; id++) assert(actions[id] == old_a);
            int other;
            assert(bind_last_result(NULL, NULL, &other, NULL) == 2 && other == BIND_B);
        }
    }
    reset_bindings();
}

static void names_and_groups(void) {
    static const char *const names[] = {"Move forward", "Move back", "Move left", "Move right",
        "Camera up", "Camera down", "Camera left", "Camera right", "Walk", "Tilt (hold)",
        "Gyro tilt up", "Gyro tilt down", "Gyro tilt left", "Gyro tilt right", "Gyro turn left", "Gyro turn right", "Gyro recenter"};
    for (int i = 0; i < 17; i++) assert(!strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_LS_UP + i), names[i]));
    for (int slot = -1; slot <= BIND_KEY_COUNT; slot++) {
        if (bind_key_gyro(slot)) assert(!strcmp(bind_input_group(slot), "gyro"));
        else assert(!bind_input_group(slot));
    }
    static const char *const menu_names[] = {"Menu: confirm", "Menu: back", "Menu: Hero's Path", "Menu: sort / sensor"};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) assert(!strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_A + i), menu_names[i]));
    assert(!strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_PLUS), "Pause menu") && !strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_MINUS), "Map (Sheikah Slate)"));
    assert(!strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_UP), "Quick menu: runes") && !strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_LEFT), "Quick menu: shields"));
    assert(!strcmp(bind_input_name(BIND_RIGHT), "Quick menu: weapons"));
    // no listed input is called by its Switch button
    static const char *const raw[] = {"A", "B", "X", "Y", "L", "R", "ZL", "ZR", "Plus", "Minus", "D-pad Left", "D-pad Up", "D-pad Right"};
    for (int slot = 0; slot < BIND_PAD_COUNT; slot++)
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof raw / sizeof *raw; i++) assert(strcmp(bind_input_name(slot), raw[i]));
}

static void swapped_jump_sprint_masks_keep_keyboard_bindings(void) {
    act_reset();
    masks[2] = 0x2;   // BOTW JumpButtonChange: Jump -> B
    masks[12] = 0x8;  // Sprint -> X
    assert(act_is_default(2) && act_is_default(12));
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(2) == 0 && hold(12) == 0);
    // Keyboard still follows its configured bindings (Space = Jump, Left Shift = Sprint)
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(2) == 1 && trig(2) == 1 && hold(12) == 0 && trig(12) == 0);
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE] = 0;
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_LSHIFT] = 1;
    host(0, 0, 0);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(2) == 0 && trig(2) == 0 && hold(12) == 1 && trig(12) == 1);
    key_down[SDL_SCANCODE_LSHIFT] = 0;
    // Uncustomized controller still follows the game's swapped Switch layout (B = Jump, X = Sprint)
    host(0, 0, 1u << g_bind_pad[BIND_B]);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(2) == 1 && trig(2) == 1 && hold(12) == 0 && trig(12) == 0);
    host(0, 0, 1u << g_bind_pad[BIND_X]);
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(2) == 0 && trig(2) == 0 && hold(12) == 1 && trig(12) == 1);
    host(0, 0, 0);
    // Restoring the 1.9.0 masks returns both to game fallthrough (-1)
    masks[2] = 0x8;
    masks[12] = 0x2;
    act_poll(true);
    assert(hold(2) == -1 && hold(12) == -1);
}

int main(void) {
    static const uint32_t k_masks_190[ACT_COUNT] = {
        0x1, 0x2, 0x8, 0x10, 0x8, 0x1, 0x8, 0x2, 0x8, 0x2, 0x8, 0x8, 0x2, 0x4, 0x2, 0x40, 0x1, 0x80, 0x20, 0x8, 0x2,
        0x10000, 0x20000, 0x10000, 0x20000, 0x2, 0x1, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x4, 0x2, 0x4000, 0x4000, 0x2000, 0x1, 0x20000,
        0x10, 0x20000, 0x1, 0x2, 0x2000};
    memcpy(masks, k_masks_190, sizeof masks);
    act_masks(masks);
    defaults_are_untouched();
    the_switch_button_comes_from_the_game_table();
    swapped_jump_sprint_masks_keep_keyboard_bindings();
    a_bound_action_follows_its_key();
    a_press_is_not_lost_when_nobody_asked();
    a_press_nobody_asked_about_expires();
    menus_use_the_switch_layer();
    two_actions_share_a_key();
    the_default_side_keeps_its_factory_binding();
    a_pad_only_override_uses_both_host_sides();
    capture_and_settings();
    migration_and_independent_defaults();
    schema_migration_is_one_time();
    captures_allow_shared_action_inputs();
    host_pad_slots();
    names_and_groups();
    puts("action bindings: default fallthrough, custom host bindings, schema migration, held / pressed, menus, shared keys, pad capture, contexts, reset and ini passed");
    return 0;
}

```

`tools/test_astc.c`:

```c
// Differential test of runtime/nvn/astc.c against ARM astcenc (tools/test_astc_ref.cpp shim).
// Driven by tools/test_astc.sh. Modes:
//   img [seed]                       synthetic images, encoded by astcenc at all block sizes / qualities
//   rand <blocks per size> [seed]    random 128-bit blocks (illegal, void extent, HDR, ...)
//   mkimg <out.tga> <w> <h> <seed>   write a synthetic test image (for the astcenc CLI)
//   mkrand <out.astc> <bw> <bh> <w> <h> <seed>   write a .astc file of random blocks
//   cmp <in.astc> <ref.tga> <srgb>   decode a .astc file, compare with an astcenc -dl/-ds output
//   bench                            decode throughput
#include "../runtime/nvn/astc.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

int ref_encode(const uint8_t *rgba, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned bw, unsigned bh, int srgb, float quality,
               uint8_t *blocks);
int ref_decode(const uint8_t *blocks, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned bw, unsigned bh, int srgb, uint8_t *rgba);
int ref_block_info(const uint8_t block[16], unsigned bw, unsigned bh, int srgb, int *partitions, int *dual,
                   int cems[4], int *hdr);
void ref_block_dump(const uint8_t block[16], unsigned bw, unsigned bh, int srgb);

static const int k_sizes[14][2] = {{4, 4}, {5, 4}, {5, 5}, {6, 5}, {6, 6}, {8, 5}, {8, 6},
                                   {8, 8}, {10, 5}, {10, 6}, {10, 8}, {10, 10}, {12, 10}, {12, 12}};

// ---- rng ----

static uint64_t g_rng;
static uint64_t rnd64(void) {  // splitmix64
    uint64_t z = (g_rng += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull);
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBull;
    return z ^ (z >> 31);
}
static uint32_t rnd(uint32_t n) { return (uint32_t)(rnd64() % n); }
static double rndf(void) { return (double)(rnd64() >> 11) / 9007199254740992.0; }

// ---- synthetic images ----

static double lerp(double a, double b, double t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }

// value noise, cells of size `cell`
static double vnoise(const double *grid, int gw, double x, double y, double cell) {
    double fx = x / cell, fy = y / cell;
    int ix = (int)fx, iy = (int)fy;
    double tx = fx - ix, ty = fy - iy;
    tx = tx * tx * (3 - 2 * tx); ty = ty * ty * (3 - 2 * ty);
    double a = grid[iy * gw + ix], b = grid[iy * gw + ix + 1];
    double c = grid[(iy + 1) * gw + ix], d = grid[(iy + 1) * gw + ix + 1];
    return lerp(lerp(a, b, tx), lerp(c, d, tx), ty);
}

static void make_image(uint8_t *px, int w, int h, uint64_t seed) {
    uint64_t save = g_rng;
    g_rng = seed * 7919 + 1;
    double cell = 4 + rnd(28);
    int gw = (int)(w / cell) + 3, gh = (int)(h / cell) + 3;
    double *grid = malloc(sizeof(double) * gw * gh * 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < gw * gh * 4; i++) grid[i] = rndf();
    double base[2][4];
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) base[i][c] = rndf();
    int alpha_mode = rnd(5);   // 0 opaque, 1 gradient, 2 noise, 3 binary mask, 4 random per texel
    int gray = rnd(4) == 0;
    double noise_amt = rndf() * 0.6;
    for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            double t = (double)(x + y) / (w + h);
            double v[4];
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                double n = vnoise(grid + c * gw * gh, gw, x, y, cell);
                v[c] = lerp(base[0][c], base[1][c], t) * (1 - noise_amt) + n * noise_amt;
            }
            if (gray) v[1] = v[2] = v[0];
            switch (alpha_mode) {
            case 0: v[3] = 1; break;
            case 1: v[3] = (double)y / h; break;
            case 2: break;
            case 3: v[3] = v[3] > 0.5 ? 1 : 0; break;
            case 4: v[3] = rndf(); break;
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                double q = v[c] < 0 ? 0 : v[c] > 1 ? 1 : v[c];
                px[(y * w + x) * 4 + c] = (uint8_t)(q * 255 + 0.5);
            }
        }
    }
    // flat-coloured shapes with hard edges (and some exactly flat areas -> void-extent blocks)
    int shapes = rnd(12);
    for (int s = 0; s < shapes; s++) {
        uint8_t col[4] = {(uint8_t)rnd(256), (uint8_t)rnd(256), (uint8_t)rnd(256),
                          (uint8_t)(alpha_mode == 0 ? 255 : rnd(256))};
        if (gray) col[1] = col[2] = col[0];
        int cx = rnd(w), cy = rnd(h), rx = 2 + rnd(w / 2 + 1), ry = 2 + rnd(h / 2 + 1), circle = rnd(2);
        for (int y = cy - ry; y < cy + ry; y++) {
            for (int x = cx - rx; x < cx + rx; x++) {
                if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= w || y >= h) continue;
                if (circle) {
                    double dx = (double)(x - cx) / rx, dy = (double)(y - cy) / ry;
                    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > 1) continue;
                }
                memcpy(px + (y * w + x) * 4, col, 4);
            }
        }
    }
    // a patch of raw noise (worst case for the encoder: many partitions / dual plane)
    if (rnd(2)) {
        int x0 = rnd(w), y0 = rnd(h), pw = 1 + rnd(w / 3 + 1), ph = 1 + rnd(h / 3 + 1);
        for (int y = y0; y < y0 + ph && y < h; y++)
            for (int x = x0; x < x0 + pw && x < w; x++)
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++)
                    if (c < 3 || alpha_mode != 0) px[(y * w + x) * 4 + c] = (uint8_t)rnd(256);
    }
    free(grid);
    g_rng = save;
}

// ---- files ----

static int write_tga(const char *path, const uint8_t *px, int w, int h) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) return -1;
    uint8_t hdr[18] = {0};
    hdr[2] = 2;
    hdr[12] = (uint8_t)w; hdr[13] = (uint8_t)(w >> 8); hdr[14] = (uint8_t)h; hdr[15] = (uint8_t)(h >> 8);
    hdr[16] = 32; hdr[17] = 0x28;  // 8 alpha bits, top-left origin
    fwrite(hdr, 1, 18, f);
    for (int i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {
        uint8_t bgra[4] = {px[4 * i + 2], px[4 * i + 1], px[4 * i + 0], px[4 * i + 3]};
        fwrite(bgra, 1, 4, f);
    }
    fclose(f);
    return 0;
}

static uint8_t *read_file(const char *path, size_t *len) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    *len = (size_t)ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *d = malloc(*len);
    if (fread(d, 1, *len, f) != *len) { free(d); d = NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    return d;
}

// TGA types 2 / 10 (RLE), 24 / 32 bpp.
static uint8_t *read_tga(const char *path, int *w, int *h) {
    size_t len;
    uint8_t *d = read_file(path, &len);
    if (!d) return NULL;
    int type = d[2], bpp = d[16], desc = d[17];
    *w = d[12] | d[13] << 8; *h = d[14] | d[15] << 8;
    if ((type != 2 && type != 10) || (bpp != 24 && bpp != 32)) { free(d); return NULL; }
    int bytes = bpp / 8, n = *w * *h;
    uint8_t *px = malloc((size_t)n * 4), *tmp = malloc((size_t)n * 4);
    const uint8_t *p = d + 18 + d[0];
    for (int i = 0; i < n;) {
        int count = 1, raw = 1;
        if (type == 10) { count = (*p & 0x7F) + 1; raw = !(*p & 0x80); p++; }
        for (int k = 0; k < count && i < n; k++, i++) {
            tmp[4 * i + 0] = p[2]; tmp[4 * i + 1] = p[1]; tmp[4 * i + 2] = p[0];
            tmp[4 * i + 3] = bytes == 4 ? p[3] : 255;
            if (raw) p += bytes;
        }
        if (!raw) p += bytes;
    }
    for (int y = 0; y < *h; y++) {
        int sy = (desc & 0x20) ? y : *h - 1 - y;
        memcpy(px + (size_t)y * *w * 4, tmp + (size_t)sy * *w * 4, (size_t)*w * 4);
    }
    free(tmp);
    free(d);
    return px;
}

static int write_astc(const char *path, const uint8_t *blocks, int bw, int bh, int w, int h) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) return -1;
    uint8_t hdr[16] = {0x13, 0xAB, 0xA1, 0x5C, (uint8_t)bw, (uint8_t)bh, 1,
                       (uint8_t)w, (uint8_t)(w >> 8), (uint8_t)(w >> 16),
                       (uint8_t)h, (uint8_t)(h >> 8), (uint8_t)(h >> 16), 1, 0, 0};
    fwrite(hdr, 1, 16, f);
    fwrite(blocks, 16, (size_t)((w + bw - 1) / bw) * ((h + bh - 1) / bh), f);
    fclose(f);
    return 0;
}

// ---- comparison ----

static long g_reported;

// Compares two decodes; returns the number of mismatching texels.
static long compare(const uint8_t *a, const uint8_t *b, int w, int h, int bw, int bh, const uint8_t *blocks,
                    const char *what) {
    long bad = 0;
    int bx = (w + bw - 1) / bw;
    for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            const uint8_t *p = a + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4, *q = b + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4;
            if (!memcmp(p, q, 4)) continue;
            if (bad++ == 0 && g_reported++ < 20) {
                const uint8_t *blk = blocks ? blocks + 16 * ((size_t)(y / bh) * bx + x / bw) : NULL;
                printf("  MISMATCH %s %dx%d texel (%d,%d): ours %02x%02x%02x%02x ref %02x%02x%02x%02x", what, bw, bh,
                       x, y, p[0], p[1], p[2], p[3], q[0], q[1], q[2], q[3]);
                if (blk) {
                    printf(" block ");
                    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) printf("%02x", blk[i]);
                }
                printf("\n");
            }
        }
    }
    return bad;
}

// ---- modes ----

static int mode_img(uint64_t seed) {
    static const float quals[4] = {0.0f, 10.0f, 60.0f, 98.0f};  // fastest, fast, medium, thorough
    static const int dims[3][2] = {{96, 80}, {67, 45}, {130, 33}};  // incl. sizes that cut blocks
    long total_bad = 0, images = 0, texels = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < 14; s++) {
        int bw = k_sizes[s][0], bh = k_sizes[s][1];
        long bad_size = 0;
        for (int srgb = 0; srgb < 2; srgb++) {
            for (int qi = 0; qi < 4; qi++) {
                for (int di = 0; di < 3; di++) {
                    int w = dims[di][0], h = dims[di][1];
                    size_t nb = (size_t)((w + bw - 1) / bw) * ((h + bh - 1) / bh);
                    uint8_t *src = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4), *blocks = malloc(nb * 16);
                    uint8_t *ours = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4), *ref = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
                    make_image(src, w, h, seed * 1000 + s * 100 + srgb * 50 + qi * 10 + di);
                    if (ref_encode(src, w, h, bw, bh, srgb, quals[qi], blocks) ||
                        ref_decode(blocks, w, h, bw, bh, srgb, ref)) {
                        printf("astcenc failed\n");
                        return 2;
                    }
                    astc_decode_ldr(blocks, w, h, bw, bh, srgb, ours);
                    char what[64];
                    snprintf(what, sizeof what, "img q%g %s %dx%d", quals[qi], srgb ? "srgb" : "lin", w, h);
                    bad_size += compare(ours, ref, w, h, bw, bh, blocks, what);
                    images++;
                    texels += (long)w * h;
                    free(src); free(blocks); free(ours); free(ref);
                }
            }
        }
        printf("img %2dx%-2d: %ld mismatching texels\n", bw, bh, bad_size);
        total_bad += bad_size;
    }
    printf("img: %ld images, %ld texels, %ld mismatches\n", images, texels, total_bad);
    return total_bad ? 1 : 0;
}

typedef struct { long err, cnst, part[5], dual, hdr, cem[16]; } Stats;

static void gen_block(uint8_t *b, int bw, int bh, int srgb, Stats *st) {
    uint32_t kind = rnd(100);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        uint64_t v = rnd64();
        memcpy(b + 8 * i, &v, 8);
    }
    if (kind < 15) {  // void extent
        uint32_t m = 0x1FC | (rnd(5) == 0) << 9 | (rnd(10) ? 3u : rnd(4)) << 10;
        uint64_t lo = (m & 0xFFF);
        uint32_t c[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) c[i] = rnd(0x2000);
        uint32_t r = rnd(10);
        if (r < 5) {  // ordered coordinates
            if (c[0] > c[1]) { uint32_t t = c[0]; c[0] = c[1]; c[1] = t; }
            if (c[2] > c[3]) { uint32_t t = c[2]; c[2] = c[3]; c[3] = t; }
        } else if (r < 7) {
            c[0] = c[1] = c[2] = c[3] = 0x1FFF;
        } else if (r < 8) {
            c[1] = c[0];
        }
        lo |= (uint64_t)c[0] << 12 | (uint64_t)c[1] << 25 | (uint64_t)c[2] << 38 | (uint64_t)c[3] << 51;
        memcpy(b, &lo, 8);
    } else if (kind < 60) {  // random, resampled towards blocks the reference accepts
        for (int tries = 0; tries < 16; tries++) {
            if (rnd(2)) b[1] &= ~0x18;  // single partition is far more often legal
            int p, d, cems[4], hdr;
            if (ref_block_info(b, bw, bh, srgb, &p, &d, cems, &hdr) == 2) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
                uint64_t v = rnd64();
                memcpy(b + 8 * i, &v, 8);
            }
        }
    }  // else: fully random
    int p = 0, d = 0, cems[4], hdr = 0;
    int r = ref_block_info(b, bw, bh, srgb, &p, &d, cems, &hdr);
    if (r == 0) st->err++;
    else if (r == 1) st->cnst++;
    else {
        st->part[p]++;
        st->dual += d;
        int any_hdr = 0;  // blocks with an HDR endpoint mode (magenta partition in LDR)
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            st->cem[cems[i]]++;
            any_hdr |= cems[i] == 2 || cems[i] == 3 || cems[i] == 7 || cems[i] == 11 || cems[i] >= 14;
        }
        st->hdr += any_hdr;
    }
}

static int mode_rand(long per_size, uint64_t seed) {
    long total_bad = 0;
    Stats all = {0};
    for (int s = 0; s < 14; s++) {
        int bw = k_sizes[s][0], bh = k_sizes[s][1];
        const int gx = 64, gy = 64;  // blocks per batch
        int w = gx * bw, h = gy * bh;
        uint8_t *blocks = malloc(16 * gx * gy), *ours = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4), *ref = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
        long bad = 0;
        Stats st = {0};
        g_rng = seed * 1000003 + s;
        for (long done = 0; done < per_size; done += gx * gy) {
            int srgb = (int)((done / (gx * gy)) & 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < gx * gy; i++) gen_block(blocks + 16 * i, bw, bh, srgb, &st);
            if (ref_decode(blocks, w, h, bw, bh, srgb, ref)) { printf("astcenc failed\n"); return 2; }
            astc_decode_ldr(blocks, w, h, bw, bh, srgb, ours);
            bad += compare(ours, ref, w, h, bw, bh, blocks, srgb ? "rand srgb" : "rand lin");
        }
        long n = st.err + st.cnst + st.part[1] + st.part[2] + st.part[3] + st.part[4];
        printf("rand %2dx%-2d: %ld blocks (error %ld, void-extent %ld, 1/2/3/4 partitions %ld/%ld/%ld/%ld, "
               "dual %ld, hdr %ld): %ld mismatching texels\n",
               bw, bh, n, st.err, st.cnst, st.part[1], st.part[2], st.part[3], st.part[4], st.dual, st.hdr, bad);
        all.err += st.err; all.cnst += st.cnst; all.dual += st.dual; all.hdr += st.hdr;
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) all.part[i] += st.part[i];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) all.cem[i] += st.cem[i];
        total_bad += bad;
        free(blocks); free(ours); free(ref);
    }
    printf("rand CEM histogram:");
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) printf(" %d:%ld", i, all.cem[i]);
    printf("\nrand: %ld mismatching texels total\n", total_bad);
    return total_bad ? 1 : 0;
}

static int mode_cmp(const char *astc_path, const char *tga_path, int srgb) {
    size_t len;
    uint8_t *d = read_file(astc_path, &len);
    int w, h;
    uint8_t *ref = read_tga(tga_path, &w, &h);
    if (!d || !ref || len < 16 || (d[0] | d[1] << 8 | d[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)d[3] << 24) != 0x5CA1AB13u) {
        printf("cmp: cannot read %s / %s\n", astc_path, tga_path);
        return 2;
    }
    int bw = d[4], bh = d[5];
    int aw = d[7] | d[8] << 8 | d[9] << 16, ah = d[10] | d[11] << 8 | d[12] << 16;
    if (aw != w || ah != h) { printf("cmp: size mismatch\n"); return 2; }
    uint8_t *ours = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
    astc_decode_ldr(d + 16, w, h, bw, bh, srgb, ours);
    // astcenc's CLI writes error texels (NaN) as 0 after its [0,1] clamp: count those separately
    long bad = 0, err_texels = 0;
    for (long i = 0; i < (long)w * h; i++) {
        const uint8_t *p = ours + 4 * i, *q = ref + 4 * i;
        if (!memcmp(p, q, 4)) continue;
        if (p[0] == 0xFF && p[1] == 0 && p[2] == 0xFF && p[3] == 0xFF && !(q[0] | q[1] | q[2] | q[3])) {
            err_texels++;
            continue;
        }
        if (bad++ < 5)
            printf("  MISMATCH cmp %s texel %ld: ours %02x%02x%02x%02x ref %02x%02x%02x%02x\n", astc_path, i, p[0],
                   p[1], p[2], p[3], q[0], q[1], q[2], q[3]);
    }
    printf("cmp %s (%dx%d, %dx%d, %s): %ld mismatching texels%s\n", astc_path, w, h, bw, bh, srgb ? "srgb" : "lin", bad,
           err_texels ? " (+ error texels: ours magenta, CLI 0000)" : "");
    if (err_texels) printf("    error texels: %ld\n", err_texels);
    return bad ? 1 : 0;
}

static int mode_bench(void) {
    for (int s = 0; s < 14; s++) {
        int bw = k_sizes[s][0], bh = k_sizes[s][1];
        int w = 1024, h = 1024;
        size_t nb = (size_t)((w + bw - 1) / bw) * ((h + bh - 1) / bh);
        uint8_t *src = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4), *blocks = malloc(nb * 16), *out = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
        make_image(src, w, h, 42 + s);
        ref_encode(src, w, h, bw, bh, 0, 10.0f, blocks);
        clock_t t0 = clock();
        int reps = 0;
        do { astc_decode_ldr(blocks, w, h, bw, bh, false, out); reps++; } while (clock() - t0 < CLOCKS_PER_SEC / 2);
        double secs = (double)(clock() - t0) / CLOCKS_PER_SEC;
        printf("bench %2dx%-2d: %.1f Mtexel/s (%.1f MB/s RGBA8 out)\n", bw, bh, reps * (double)w * h / secs / 1e6,
               reps * (double)w * h * 4 / secs / 1e6);
        free(src); free(blocks); free(out);
    }
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: see header\n"); return 2; }
    const char *m = argv[1];
    if (!strcmp(m, "img")) return mode_img(argc > 2 ? strtoull(argv[2], 0, 0) : 1);
    if (!strcmp(m, "rand") && argc > 2) return mode_rand(atol(argv[2]), argc > 3 ? strtoull(argv[3], 0, 0) : 1);
    if (!strcmp(m, "bench")) return mode_bench();
    if (!strcmp(m, "mkimg") && argc > 5) {
        int w = atoi(argv[3]), h = atoi(argv[4]);
        uint8_t *px = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
        make_image(px, w, h, strtoull(argv[5], 0, 0));
        return write_tga(argv[2], px, w, h);
    }
    if (!strcmp(m, "mkrand") && argc > 7) {
        int bw = atoi(argv[3]), bh = atoi(argv[4]), w = atoi(argv[5]), h = atoi(argv[6]);
        g_rng = strtoull(argv[7], 0, 0);
        size_t nb = (size_t)((w + bw - 1) / bw) * ((h + bh - 1) / bh);
        uint8_t *blocks = malloc(nb * 16);
        Stats st = {0};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < nb; i++) gen_block(blocks + 16 * i, bw, bh, 0, &st);
        return write_astc(argv[2], blocks, bw, bh, w, h);
    }
    if (!strcmp(m, "cmp") && argc > 4) return mode_cmp(argv[2], argv[3], atoi(argv[4]));
    if (!strcmp(m, "blk") && argc > 5) {  // blk <32 hex digits> <bw> <bh> <srgb>: debug one block
        uint8_t b[16], ours[144 * 4], ref[144 * 4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) sscanf(argv[2] + 2 * i, "%2hhx", &b[i]);
        int bw = atoi(argv[3]), bh = atoi(argv[4]), srgb = atoi(argv[5]);
        ref_block_dump(b, bw, bh, srgb);
        astc_decode_block(b, bw, bh, srgb, ours);
        ref_decode(b, bw, bh, bw, bh, srgb, ref);
        for (int i = 0; i < bw * bh; i++)
            printf("  t%d ours %02x%02x%02x%02x ref %02x%02x%02x%02x%s\n", i, ours[4 * i], ours[4 * i + 1],
                   ours[4 * i + 2], ours[4 * i + 3], ref[4 * i], ref[4 * i + 1], ref[4 * i + 2], ref[4 * i + 3],
                   memcmp(ours + 4 * i, ref + 4 * i, 4) ? "  <--" : "");
        return 0;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "bad arguments\n");
    return 2;
}
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Differential test of runtime/nvn/astc.c against ARM's astcenc (Apache-2.0), built from source into
# build/ (gitignored, never committed). Usage: tools/test_astc.sh [random blocks per block size] [seed]
# Windows: needs the MSYS2 ucrt64 clang toolchain. macOS: Xcode clang works too.
set -e
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
N="${1:-1048576}"
SEED="${2:-1}"
[ -d /c/msys64/ucrt64/bin ] && export PATH="/c/msys64/ucrt64/bin:/c/msys64/usr/bin:$PATH"
EXE=""; [ -n "$WINDIR" ] && EXE=".exe"

REF="$ROOT/build/astc-encoder"
SRC="$REF/Source"
OUT="$ROOT/build/astc_test"
mkdir -p "$OUT/obj"
[ -d "$REF" ] || git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ARM-software/astc-encoder.git "$REF"
echo "astcenc: $(git -C "$REF" log -1 --format='%h %s')"

# astcenc: portable (no-SIMD) build
DEFS="-DASTCENC_NEON=0 -DASTCENC_SVE=0 -DASTCENC_SSE=0 -DASTCENC_AVX=0 -DASTCENC_POPCNT=0 -DASTCENC_F16C=0"
sed -e 's/@astcencoder_VERSION@/local/' -e 's/@astcencoder_YEAR@/2026/' "$SRC/astcenccli_version.h.in" > "$OUT/obj/astcenccli_version.h"
# MinGW: winpthreads' pthread.h clashes with the CLI's Win32 pthread emulation -> rename it
sed -e 's/^#include <cstring>$/#include <cstring>\n#define pthread_t ae_pthread_t\n#define pthread_attr_t ae_pthread_attr_t\n#define pthread_create ae_pthread_create\n#define pthread_join ae_pthread_join/' \
    "$SRC/astcenccli_platform_dependents.cpp" > "$OUT/obj/astcenccli_platform_dependents.cpp"
pids=()
for f in "$SRC"/*.cpp "$OUT/obj/astcenccli_platform_dependents.cpp"; do
    [ "$f" = "$SRC/astcenccli_platform_dependents.cpp" ] && continue
    o="$OUT/obj/$(basename "$f" .cpp).o"
    [ -f "$o" ] && continue
    clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -DNDEBUG $DEFS -I"$OUT/obj" -I"$SRC" -c "$f" -o "$o" &
    pids+=($!)
done
for p in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$p"; done
LIB=$(ls "$OUT"/obj/astcenc_*.o)
[ -f "$OUT/astcenc$EXE" ] || clang++ "$OUT"/obj/*.o -o "$OUT/astcenc$EXE"

clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 $DEFS -I"$SRC" -c "$ROOT/tools/test_astc_ref.cpp" -o "$OUT/test_astc_ref.o"
clang -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -c "$ROOT/runtime/nvn/astc.c" -o "$OUT/astc.o"
clang -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -c "$ROOT/tools/test_astc.c" -o "$OUT/test_astc.o"
clang++ "$OUT/test_astc.o" "$OUT/astc.o" "$OUT/test_astc_ref.o" $LIB -o "$OUT/test_astc$EXE"
T="$OUT/test_astc$EXE"
A="$OUT/astcenc$EXE"
[ "$N" = build ] && exit 0  # tools/test_astc.sh build: just build (then run build/astc_test/test_astc blk ...)

fail=0
echo "== 1. astcenc CLI round trip (-cl/-cs then -dl/-ds into .tga) =="
mkdir -p "$OUT/cli"
"$T" mkimg "$OUT/cli/in.tga" 157 93 "$SEED"
for bs in 4x4 5x4 5x5 6x5 6x6 8x5 8x6 8x8 10x5 10x6 10x8 10x10 12x10 12x12; do
    for q in -fastest -medium -thorough; do
        for p in l s; do
            "$A" -c$p "$OUT/cli/in.tga" "$OUT/cli/t.astc" $bs $q -silent >/dev/null
            "$A" -d$p "$OUT/cli/t.astc" "$OUT/cli/t.tga" -silent >/dev/null
            srgb=0; [ $p = s ] && srgb=1
            "$T" cmp "$OUT/cli/t.astc" "$OUT/cli/t.tga" $srgb | grep -v ': 0 mismatching' || true
            "$T" cmp "$OUT/cli/t.astc" "$OUT/cli/t.tga" $srgb >/dev/null || fail=1
        done
    done
done
echo "CLI round trip done"
echo "== 2. astcenc CLI on random-block .astc files (-dl/-ds) =="
for bs in "4 4" "6 6" "8 5" "8 8" "10 10" "12 12"; do
    set -- $bs
    "$T" mkrand "$OUT/cli/r.astc" $1 $2 $((64 * $1)) $((64 * $2)) "$SEED"
    for p in l s; do
        srgb=0; [ $p = s ] && srgb=1
        "$A" -d$p "$OUT/cli/r.astc" "$OUT/cli/r.tga" -silent >/dev/null
        "$T" cmp "$OUT/cli/r.astc" "$OUT/cli/r.tga" $srgb || fail=1
    done
done
echo "== 3. library: synthetic images, every block size, 4 qualities, LDR + sRGB =="
"$T" img "$SEED" || fail=1
echo "== 4. library: $N random blocks per block size =="
"$T" rand "$N" "$SEED" || fail=1
echo "== 5. throughput =="
"$T" bench
[ $fail = 0 ] && echo "ALL PASS" || { echo "FAILURES"; exit 1; }
```

`tools/test_astc_ref.cpp`:

```cpp
// C shim over ARM astcenc (reference codec) for tools/test_astc.c. Built by tools/test_astc.sh
// against a local clone in build/astc-encoder (never committed).
#include "astcenc.h"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

namespace {

struct Ctx { unsigned bw, bh; bool srgb, dec; float quality; astcenc_context *ctx; };
std::vector<Ctx> g_ctx;

astcenc_context *get_ctx(unsigned bw, unsigned bh, bool srgb, bool dec, float quality) {
    for (auto &c : g_ctx)
        if (c.bw == bw && c.bh == bh && c.srgb == srgb && c.dec == dec && (dec || c.quality == quality)) return c.ctx;
    astcenc_config cfg;
    // decode_unorm8 = the 8-bit decode the CLI uses for -dl / -ds into 8-bit images
    unsigned flags = ASTCENC_FLG_USE_DECODE_UNORM8 | (dec ? ASTCENC_FLG_DECOMPRESS_ONLY : 0);
    astcenc_profile prof = srgb ? ASTCENC_PRF_LDR_SRGB : ASTCENC_PRF_LDR;
    if (astcenc_config_init(prof, bw, bh, 1, dec ? ASTCENC_PRE_MEDIUM : quality, flags, &cfg) != ASTCENC_SUCCESS) {
        fprintf(stderr, "astcenc_config_init failed\n");
        return nullptr;
    }
    astcenc_context *ctx = nullptr;
    if (astcenc_context_alloc(&cfg, 1, &ctx, nullptr) != ASTCENC_SUCCESS) {
        fprintf(stderr, "astcenc_context_alloc failed\n");
        return nullptr;
    }
    g_ctx.push_back({bw, bh, srgb, dec, quality, ctx});
    return ctx;
}

}  // namespace

extern "C" int ref_encode(const uint8_t *rgba, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned bw, unsigned bh, int srgb,
                          float quality, uint8_t *blocks) {
    astcenc_context *ctx = get_ctx(bw, bh, srgb != 0, false, quality);
    if (!ctx) return -1;
    void *slices[1] = {(void *)rgba};
    astcenc_image img = {w, h, 1, ASTCENC_TYPE_U8, slices};
    astcenc_swizzle swz = {ASTCENC_SWZ_R, ASTCENC_SWZ_G, ASTCENC_SWZ_B, ASTCENC_SWZ_A};
    size_t len = (size_t)((w + bw - 1) / bw) * ((h + bh - 1) / bh) * 16;
    astcenc_error e = astcenc_compress_image(ctx, &img, &swz, blocks, len, 0);
    astcenc_compress_reset(ctx);
    return e == ASTCENC_SUCCESS ? 0 : -1;
}

// Decodes to RGBA8 (U8 output: astcenc infers decode_unorm8 from it, as its CLI does for 8-bit images).
// The U8 store clamps the error colour (NaN) to 0, so a second F32 decode finds the error texels: magenta.
extern "C" int ref_decode(const uint8_t *blocks, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned bw, unsigned bh, int srgb,
                          uint8_t *rgba) {
    astcenc_context *ctx = get_ctx(bw, bh, srgb != 0, true, 0);
    if (!ctx) return -1;
    astcenc_swizzle swz = {ASTCENC_SWZ_R, ASTCENC_SWZ_G, ASTCENC_SWZ_B, ASTCENC_SWZ_A};
    size_t len = (size_t)((w + bw - 1) / bw) * ((h + bh - 1) / bh) * 16;
    void *slices8[1] = {rgba};
    astcenc_image img8 = {w, h, 1, ASTCENC_TYPE_U8, slices8};
    astcenc_error e = astcenc_decompress_image(ctx, blocks, len, &img8, &swz, 0);
    astcenc_decompress_reset(ctx);
    if (e != ASTCENC_SUCCESS) return -1;
    std::vector<float> f((size_t)w * h * 4);
    void *slices[1] = {f.data()};
    astcenc_image img = {w, h, 1, ASTCENC_TYPE_F32, slices};
    e = astcenc_decompress_image(ctx, blocks, len, &img, &swz, 0);
    astcenc_decompress_reset(ctx);
    if (e != ASTCENC_SUCCESS) return -1;
    static const uint8_t magenta[4] = {0xFF, 0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)w * h; i++) {
        bool nan = false;
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) nan |= std::isnan(f[4 * i + c]);
        if (nan) memcpy(rgba + 4 * i, magenta, 4);
    }
    return 0;
}

// Debug dump of the reference's view of one block.
extern "C" void ref_block_dump(const uint8_t block[16], unsigned bw, unsigned bh, int srgb) {
    astcenc_context *ctx = get_ctx(bw, bh, srgb != 0, true, 0);
    astcenc_block_info bi;
    if (!ctx || astcenc_get_block_info(ctx, block, &bi) != ASTCENC_SUCCESS) return;
    printf("ref: error %d const %d hdr %d dual %d (comp %u) partitions %u (index %u) color levels %u weight levels %u "
           "grid %ux%u\n", bi.is_error_block, bi.is_constant_block, bi.is_hdr_block, bi.is_dual_plane_block,
           bi.dual_plane_component, bi.partition_count, bi.partition_index, bi.color_level_count,
           bi.weight_level_count, bi.weight_x, bi.weight_y);
    for (unsigned p = 0; p < bi.partition_count; p++)
        printf("  cem %u ep0 %g %g %g %g ep1 %g %g %g %g\n", bi.color_endpoint_modes[p],
               bi.color_endpoints[p][0][0], bi.color_endpoints[p][0][1], bi.color_endpoints[p][0][2],
               bi.color_endpoints[p][0][3], bi.color_endpoints[p][1][0], bi.color_endpoints[p][1][1],
               bi.color_endpoints[p][1][2], bi.color_endpoints[p][1][3]);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < bi.texel_count; i++)
        printf("  t%u p%u w %g %g\n", i, bi.partition_assignment[i], bi.weight_values_plane1[i],
               bi.weight_values_plane2[i]);
}

// Block statistics for coverage: returns 0 error, 1 constant, 2 normal; fills partitions / dual / CEMs.
extern "C" int ref_block_info(const uint8_t block[16], unsigned bw, unsigned bh, int srgb, int *partitions,
                              int *dual, int cems[4], int *hdr) {
    astcenc_context *ctx = get_ctx(bw, bh, srgb != 0, true, 0);
    astcenc_block_info bi;
    if (!ctx || astcenc_get_block_info(ctx, block, &bi) != ASTCENC_SUCCESS) return -1;
    *hdr = bi.is_hdr_block;
    if (bi.is_error_block) return 0;
    if (bi.is_constant_block) return 1;
    *partitions = (int)bi.partition_count;
    *dual = bi.is_dual_plane_block;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) cems[i] = i < (int)bi.partition_count ? (int)bi.color_endpoint_modes[i] : -1;
    return 2;
}
```

`tools/test_bind_capture.c`:

```c
// A capture starts while the game's confirm input is held. Its release must reach input.c, or confirm is still
// held when the capture ends and the game's Options screen immediately starts another capture (#175).
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "input_bind.h"

static uint64_t now;
Uint64 SDL_GetTicks(void) { return now; }
int input_pad_family(void) { return 1; }
bool settings_steam_deck(void) { return false; }

// Model the held state on the other side of the same event routing as the window loop. No window or controller.
static bool held;
static void release_to_game(SDL_Event e) {
    assert(!bind_capture_event(&e));
    held = false;
}

static void waiting(void) {
    int dev, slot, ms;
    assert(bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms));
}

static void ended(int expected) {
    int dev, slot, other, serial, ms;
    assert(!bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms));
    assert(bind_last_result(&dev, &slot, &other, &serial) == expected);
    assert(!held);
}

int main(void) {
    SDL_Event e = {0};
    held = true;
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_RIGHT);
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_E;
    release_to_game(e); waiting();  // releasing confirm must not assign a binding
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_B;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e));
    assert(g_bind_key[BIND_RIGHT] == SDL_SCANCODE_B);
    ended(1);

    held = true;
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_RIGHT);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_UP; e.button.button = SDL_BUTTON_LEFT;
    release_to_game(e); waiting();
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_BUTTON_DOWN; e.button.button = SDL_BUTTON_X1;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e));
    assert(g_bind_key[BIND_RIGHT] == BIND_MOUSE + SDL_BUTTON_X1);
    ended(1);

    held = true;
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_PAD, BIND_RIGHT);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_UP; e.gbutton.button = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST;
    release_to_game(e); waiting();
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN; e.gbutton.button = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e)); ended(2);  // B already uses the south button: swap

    const int devices[] = {BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_DEV_PAD};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof devices / sizeof *devices; i++) {
        int dev = devices[i];
        for (int axis = SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER; axis <= SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER; axis++) {
            held = true;
            bind_capture_begin(dev, BIND_A);
            e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_AXIS_MOTION;
            e.gaxis.axis = axis; e.gaxis.value = 0;
            release_to_game(e); waiting();
            e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE;
            assert(bind_capture_event(&e)); ended(3);
        }
    }

    held = true;
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY, BIND_A);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_E;
    release_to_game(e); now += BIND_CAPTURE_MS;
    ended(4);  // idle timeout also leaves confirm released

    // A new binding still needs a press, and sticks must not navigate the remapping UI during capture.
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_PAD, BIND_A);
    e = (SDL_Event){0}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_AXIS_MOTION;
    e.gaxis.axis = SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX; e.gaxis.value = 20000;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e)); waiting();
    e.gaxis.axis = SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e));
    assert(g_bind_pad[BIND_A] == PADB_LTRIGGER);
    ended(2);  // ZL already uses the left trigger
    // Optional gyro bindings may overlap normal keys and each other without mutating existing bindings.
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_KEY);
    int camera_up=g_bind_key[BIND_RS_UP];
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY,BIND_GYRO_DOWN);
    e=(SDL_Event){0};e.type=SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN;e.key.scancode=SDL_SCANCODE_I;
    assert(bind_capture_event(&e));assert(g_bind_key[BIND_GYRO_DOWN]==SDL_SCANCODE_I);
    assert(g_bind_key[BIND_GYRO_UP]==SDL_SCANCODE_I&&g_bind_key[BIND_RS_UP]==camera_up);
    bind_capture_begin(BIND_DEV_KEY,BIND_GYRO_CENTER);
    e.key.scancode=SDL_SCANCODE_H;assert(bind_capture_event(&e));
    assert(g_bind_key[BIND_GYRO_CENTER]==SDL_SCANCODE_H&&g_bind_key[BIND_RS_UP]==camera_up);
    puts("binding capture: confirm releases, assignments, cancellation and timeout passed");
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_botw_save_convert.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Self-contained tests for botw_save_convert.py. No game files needed: the flag table is built by hand.

    python tools/test_botw_save_convert.py
"""
import os
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import botw_save_convert as c  # noqa: E402

_read = c._read


def make_format(revision=0x4730):
    fmt = c.Format.__new__(c.Format)
    fmt.revision = revision
    specs = [  # name, kind, element count, InitValue
        ('Rupees', 's32_data', 1, 0),
        ('SavePos', 'vector3f_data', 1, [[1.0, 2.0, 3.0]]),
        ('Name', 'string64_data', 1, 'Link'),
        ('Open', 'bool_data', 1, 1),
        ('Respawn', 'bool_data', 1, 132),        # InitValue is not the state for these
        ('Weather', 's32_array_data', 3, [{'Values': [0, 0, 0]}]),
        ('Brand', 's32_data', 1, 7),             # only in the target revision
    ]
    fmt.flags = {}
    for name, kind, count, init in specs:
        h = c.crc32_name(name)
        base = kind.replace('_array_data', '').replace('_data', '')
        fmt.flags[h] = c.Flag(name, h, kind, c._WORDS[base] * count, init)
    fmt.files = {'game_data.sav': sorted(fmt.flags)}
    return fmt


def build(fmt, e, values, skip=(), revision=None):
    """A save file: header, entries sorted by hash, footer. `values` maps name -> list of raw 4-byte words."""
    out = struct.pack(e + 'III', revision or fmt.revision, 0xFFFFFFFF, 1)
    for h in sorted(fmt.flags):
        if fmt.flags[h].name in skip:
            continue
        for w in values[fmt.flags[h].name]:
            out += struct.pack(e + 'I', h) + w
    return out + c.FOOTER


def i32(e, v):
    return struct.pack(e + 'i', v)


def f32(e, v):
    return struct.pack(e + 'f', v)


def text(s, words):
    return s.encode().ljust(words * 4, b'\0')


def sample(e):
    return {
        'Rupees': [i32(e, 1234)],
        'SavePos': [f32(e, 10.5), f32(e, -2.0), f32(e, 300.25)],
        'Name': [text('Epona', 16)[i:i + 4] for i in range(0, 64, 4)],
        'Open': [i32(e, 1)],
        'Respawn': [i32(e, 0)],
        'Weather': [i32(e, 1), i32(e, 2), i32(e, 3)],
        'Brand': [i32(e, 99)],
    }


class ConvertTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.fmt = make_format()

    def run_convert(self, data, to):
        return c.convert_flags(data, self.fmt, 'game_data.sav', to, [])

    def test_detects_byte_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(c.detect_endian(build(self.fmt, '<', sample('<'))), '<')
        self.assertEqual(c.detect_endian(build(self.fmt, '>', sample('>'), revision=0x471B)), '>')

    def test_same_format_is_identity(self):
        data = build(self.fmt, '<', sample('<'))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_convert(data, '<'), data)

    def test_big_to_little(self):
        be = build(self.fmt, '>', sample('>'), revision=0x471B)
        out = self.run_convert(be, '<')
        self.assertEqual(out, build(self.fmt, '<', sample('<')))

    def test_strings_are_not_byte_swapped(self):
        be = build(self.fmt, '>', sample('>'), revision=0x471B)
        _, _, runs = c.read_entries(self.run_convert(be, '<'))
        raw = b''.join(runs[c.crc32_name('Name')])
        self.assertTrue(raw.startswith(b'Epona\0'))

    def test_floats_survive(self):
        be = build(self.fmt, '>', sample('>'))
        _, _, runs = c.read_entries(self.run_convert(be, '<'))
        self.assertEqual([struct.unpack('<f', w)[0] for w in runs[c.crc32_name('SavePos')]], [10.5, -2.0, 300.25])

    def test_missing_flag_gets_default_and_header_uses_target_revision(self):
        be = build(self.fmt, '>', sample('>'), skip=('Brand',), revision=0x471B)
        out = self.run_convert(be, '<')
        self.assertEqual(struct.unpack_from('<I', out, 0)[0], 0x4730)
        _, _, runs = c.read_entries(out)
        self.assertEqual(struct.unpack('<i', runs[c.crc32_name('Brand')][0])[0], 7)

    def test_bool_default_ignores_respawn_numbers(self):
        be = build(self.fmt, '>', sample('>'), skip=('Open', 'Respawn'))
        _, _, runs = c.read_entries(self.run_convert(be, '<'))
        self.assertEqual(struct.unpack('<I', runs[c.crc32_name('Open')][0])[0], 1)
        self.assertEqual(struct.unpack('<I', runs[c.crc32_name('Respawn')][0])[0], 0)

    def test_unknown_flags_are_dropped(self):
        other = make_format()
        extra = c.Flag('Gone', c.crc32_name('Gone'), 's32_data', 1, 0)
        other.flags[extra.hash] = extra
        src = build(other, '>', dict(sample('>'), Gone=[i32('>', 5)]))
        _, _, runs = c.read_entries(self.run_convert(src, '<'))
        self.assertNotIn(extra.hash, runs)

    def test_array_length_change_is_padded_with_defaults(self):
        longer = make_format()
        flag = next(f for f in longer.flags.values() if f.name == 'Weather')
        flag.words = 2
        src = build(longer, '>', sample('>') | {'Weather': [i32('>', 1), i32('>', 2)]})
        _, _, runs = c.read_entries(self.run_convert(src, '<'))
        self.assertEqual([struct.unpack('<i', w)[0] for w in runs[c.crc32_name('Weather')]], [1, 2, 0])

    def test_round_trip_through_the_other_console(self):
        le = build(self.fmt, '<', sample('<'))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_convert(self.run_convert(le, '>'), '<'), le)

    def test_tracker_header_and_body(self):
        be = bytes([0, 0x20, 0x2F, 0, 0x01, 0x2C, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x11]) + bytes([1, 2, 3, 4])
        le = bytes([0, 0x20, 0x2F, 0, 0x2C, 0x01, 0, 0, 0x11, 0, 0, 0]) + bytes([4, 3, 2, 1])
        self.assertEqual(c.convert_tracker(be), le)
        self.assertEqual(c.convert_tracker(le), be)

    def test_tracker_only_swaps_when_the_byte_order_changes(self):
        be = bytes([0, 0x20, 0x2F, 0, 0x01, 0x2C, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x11]) + bytes([1, 2, 3, 4])
        le = c.convert_tracker(be)
        for src_e, to_e, track, want in (('>', '<', be, le), ('<', '>', le, be), ('<', '<', le, le), ('>', '>', be, be)):
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                os.makedirs(os.path.join(tmp, 'src', '0'))
                os.makedirs(os.path.join(tmp, 'src', 'tracker'))
                with open(os.path.join(tmp, 'src', '0', 'game_data.sav'), 'wb') as f:
                    f.write(build(self.fmt, src_e, sample(src_e)))
                with open(os.path.join(tmp, 'src', 'tracker', 'trackblock00.sav'), 'wb') as f:
                    f.write(track)
                _, out = c.convert_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'src'), os.path.join(tmp, 'dst'), self.fmt, to_e,
                                           None, 'convert', False, dry_run=True)
                self.assertEqual(out['tracker/trackblock00.sav'], want, (src_e, to_e))

    def test_rejects_garbage(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            c.read_entries(b'\x00' * 40)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            c.detect_endian(b'\x01\x02')

    def test_folder_conversion_never_overwrites(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            src = os.path.join(tmp, 'src', '0')
            os.makedirs(src)
            with open(os.path.join(src, 'game_data.sav'), 'wb') as f:
                f.write(build(self.fmt, '>', sample('>')))
            dst = os.path.join(tmp, 'dst')
            c.convert_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'src'), dst, self.fmt, '<', None, 'skip', False)
            path = os.path.join(dst, '0', 'game_data.sav')
            first = _read(path)
            with open(path, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(b'mine')
            report, _ = c.convert_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'src'), dst, self.fmt, '<', None, 'skip', False)
            self.assertEqual(_read(path), b'mine')
            self.assertTrue(any('skipped' in line for line in report))
            c.convert_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'src'), dst, self.fmt, '<', None, 'skip', True)
            self.assertEqual(_read(path), first)
            self.assertTrue(any(n.startswith('game_data.sav.bak-') for n in os.listdir(os.path.dirname(path))))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

`tools/test_console_core.c`:

```c
// Tests for the in-game console's lines, history and completion (runtime/console_core.c).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../runtime/console_core.h"

static int failures, checks;
#define CHECK(cond) do { checks++; if (!(cond)) { failures++; printf("FAIL line %d: %s\n", __LINE__, #cond); } } while (0)
#define CHECK_STR(got, want) do { const char *g_ = (got); checks++; if (!g_ || strcmp(g_, (want))) { failures++; printf("FAIL line %d: got \"%s\" want \"%s\"\n", __LINE__, g_ ? g_ : "(null)", (want)); } } while (0)

int main(void) {
    ConKind k;
    // ---- lines
    CHECK(console_line_count() == 0 && !console_line(0, &k));
    unsigned rev = console_revision();
    console_print(CON_INPUT, "pos");
    CHECK(console_revision() != rev);
    console_print(CON_TEXT, "a\nb\r\n\nlast");
    CHECK(console_line_count() == 5);
    CHECK_STR(console_line(1, &k), "a"); CHECK(k == CON_TEXT);
    CHECK_STR(console_line(2, NULL), "b");        // \r\n
    CHECK_STR(console_line(3, NULL), "");         // empty lines stay
    CHECK_STR(console_line(4, NULL), "last");
    CHECK(!console_line(5, NULL) && !console_line(-1, NULL));
    for (int i = 0; i < CON_LINES + 50; i++) { char t[16]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, "n%d", i); console_print(CON_NOTE, t); }
    CHECK(console_line_count() == CON_LINES);
    CHECK_STR(console_line(CON_LINES - 1, NULL), "n449");   // the newest stay
    CHECK_STR(console_line(0, NULL), "n50");
    console_clear();
    CHECK(console_line_count() == 0);

    // ---- history
    CHECK(console_history_step(-1, "x") == NULL);           // nothing yet
    console_history_add("pos");
    console_history_add("pos");                             // a repeat of the last is not stored twice
    console_history_add("");
    console_history_add("hour 12");
    console_history_add("goto 1 2 3");
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(-1, "typing"), "goto 1 2 3");
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(-1, "ignored"), "hour 12");
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(-1, "ignored"), "pos");
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(-1, "ignored"), "pos");  // stays on the oldest
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(1, ""), "hour 12");
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(1, ""), "goto 1 2 3");
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(1, ""), "typing");       // down past the newest brings the half typed line back
    CHECK(console_history_step(1, "typing") == NULL);       // and no further
    console_history_step(-1, "again");
    console_history_rewind();
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(-1, "new"), "goto 1 2 3");   // a rewound walk starts at the newest again
    console_history_add("report");                          // sending ends a walk
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(-1, ""), "report");
    for (int i = 0; i < CON_HISTORY + 10; i++) { char t[16]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, "c%d", i); console_history_add(t); }
    for (int i = 0; i < CON_HISTORY + 5; i++) console_history_step(-1, "");
    CHECK_STR(console_history_step(-1, ""), "c10");         // only the last CON_HISTORY stay

    // ---- completion
    const char *names[] = {"camera", "cell", "echo", "exit", "fly", "frames", "get", "goto"};
    char out[64];
    CHECK(console_complete("ca", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 1);  CHECK_STR(out, "camera ");
    CHECK(console_complete("c", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 2);   CHECK_STR(out, "c");        // camera, cell: nothing more in common
    CHECK(console_complete("e", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 2);   CHECK_STR(out, "e");
    CHECK(console_complete("ex", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 1);  CHECK_STR(out, "exit ");
    CHECK(console_complete("f", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 2);   CHECK_STR(out, "f");
    CHECK(console_complete("fr", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 1);  CHECK_STR(out, "frames ");
    CHECK(console_complete("", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 8);    CHECK_STR(out, "");
    CHECK(console_complete("zz", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 0);  CHECK_STR(out, "zz");
    CHECK(console_complete("goto 1", names, 8, out, sizeof out) == 0); CHECK_STR(out, "goto 1");   // only the first word
    const char *sib[] = {"teleport", "teleport2", "telemetry"};
    CHECK(console_complete("t", sib, 3, out, sizeof out) == 3);     CHECK_STR(out, "tele");        // the common start
    CHECK(console_complete("tele", sib, 3, out, sizeof out) == 3);  CHECK_STR(out, "tele");
    CHECK(console_complete("telep", sib, 3, out, sizeof out) == 2); CHECK_STR(out, "teleport");

    printf("console core: %d checks, %d failed\n", checks, failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}
```
