`tools/test_control.c`:

```c
// Tests for the command layer behind the control endpoint and the in-game console (runtime/control.c): who may run
// what, the console's queue and its text, the table help prints, completion. No game needed; run it twice:
//   test_control                    a normal player: only the player safe commands exist for the console
//   SAVAGEWIND_DEV=1 test_control dev   developer commands too (make test-control runs both)
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../runtime/control.h"

// ---- stubs for what control.c takes from the rest of the runtime
uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) { return 1; }
void rt_fatal_trace(void) { abort(); }
void control_game_frame(uint64_t frame) { (void)frame; }
void control_place_frame(void) {}

static int failures, checks;
#define CHECK(cond) do { checks++; if (!(cond)) { failures++; printf("FAIL line %d: %s\n", __LINE__, #cond); } } while (0)
#define CHECK_STR(got, want) do { checks++; if (strcmp((got), (want))) { failures++; printf("FAIL line %d: got \"%s\" want \"%s\"\n", __LINE__, (got), (want)); } } while (0)

static void cmd_place(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    (void)argc; (void)argv;
    control_field_num(r, "x", 0.1);               // 0.10000000000000001 in the JSON
    control_field_num(r, "y", 1234.5678912345);
    control_field_int(r, "frame", 3000000000ll);
    control_field_bool(r, "held", true);
    control_field_str(r, "name", "quote \" and \\ and \n newline");
    control_copy(r, "swr:1 x=1.00 y=2.00 z=3.00");
}
static void cmd_lines(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    (void)argc; (void)argv;
    control_field_int(r, "hidden", 1);
    control_text(r, "first line");
    control_text(r, "second %d", 2);
}
static void cmd_echo(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) { char k[16]; snprintf(k, sizeof k, "a%d", i); control_field_str(r, k, argv[i]); }
    control_field_int(r, "argc", argc);
}
static void cmd_boom(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) { (void)argc; (void)argv; control_fail(r, "boom: it failed"); }
static void cmd_secret(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) { (void)argc; (void)argv; control_field_bool(r, "ran", true); }
static void cmd_nested(int argc, char **argv, ControlReply *r) {
    (void)argc; (void)argv;
    control_field_int(r, "n", 2);
}

void control_game_init(void) {
    static const ControlCmd cmds[] = {
        {"place", "", "a place", cmd_place, CONTROL_PLAYER},
        {"lines", "", "text lines", cmd_lines, CONTROL_PLAYER},
        {"echo", "<words...>", "echo the arguments", cmd_echo, CONTROL_PLAYER},
        {"boom", "", "always fails", cmd_boom, CONTROL_PLAYER},
        {"nested", "", "a number", cmd_nested, CONTROL_PLAYER},
        {"secret", "<x> <y> <z>", "developer only", cmd_secret, 0},
        {"sneaky", "", "developer only, no flags written", cmd_secret},
    };
    control_register(cmds, (int)(sizeof cmds / sizeof *cmds));
}

static ControlConsoleResult run(const char *line) {
    ControlConsoleResult r;
    control_exec_line(line, true, &r);
    return r;
}
static void expect(const char *line, bool failed, const char *text) {
    ControlConsoleResult r = run(line);
    if (r.failed != failed || strcmp(r.text ? r.text : "", text)) {
        failures++;
        printf("FAIL \"%s\": failed=%d text=\"%s\"\n   want failed=%d text=\"%s\"\n", line, r.failed, r.text ? r.text : "(null)", failed, text);
    }
    checks++;
    control_console_free(&r);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    bool dev = argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "dev");
    // (the environment says which mode: the Makefile sets SAVAGEWIND_DEV=1 for the dev run; no setenv, Windows has none)
    if (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_CONTROL") || (getenv("SAVAGEWIND_DEV") != NULL) != dev) {
        printf("run it through make test-control (SAVAGEWIND_DEV=1 and the argument dev go together, SAVAGEWIND_CONTROL unset)\n");
        return 2;
    }
    control_init();
    CHECK(control_enabled() == dev);
    CHECK(!control_endpoint_on());

    // ---- text of a reply: fields as key: value, numbers shortened, strings unescaped
    expect("place", false, "x: 0.1\ny: 1234.568\nframe: 3000000000\nheld: true\nname: quote \" and \\ and \n newline");
    {
        ControlConsoleResult r = run("place");
        CHECK(r.copy && !strcmp(r.copy, "swr:1 x=1.00 y=2.00 z=3.00"));  // for the clipboard
        control_console_free(&r);
    }
    expect("lines", false, "first line\nsecond 2");           // a command's own lines replace the field listing
    expect("boom", true, "boom: it failed");
    expect("nested", false, "n: 2");
    expect("echo", false, "argc: 1");
    expect("echo a \"b c\" d", false, "a1: a\na2: b c\na3: d\nargc: 4");
    expect("echo \"q\\\"uote\" \"back\\\\slash\"", false, "a1: q\"uote\na2: back\\slash\nargc: 3");
    expect("echo \"open", true, "unterminated double quote");
    expect("   echo    spaced   ", false, "a1: spaced\nargc: 2");

    // ---- who may run what
    if (dev) {
        expect("secret 1 2 3", false, "ran: true");
        expect("sneaky", false, "ran: true");
    } else {
        expect("secret 1 2 3", true, "Unknown command: secret");
        expect("sneaky", true, "Unknown command: sneaky");   // no flags written: developer only, never by accident
        expect("ping", true, "Unknown command: ping");
    }
    expect("nonsense", true, "Unknown command: nonsense");
    {   // the socket side (not the console) always has the full set, and the same word reaches the same handler
        ControlConsoleResult r;
        control_exec_line("secret 1 2 3", false, &r);
        CHECK(!r.failed && r.text && !strcmp(r.text, "ran: true"));
        control_console_free(&r);
    }

    // ---- help: sorted table, only what the console may run
    {
        ControlConsoleResult r = run("help");
        CHECK(!r.failed && r.text);
        CHECK(strstr(r.text, "place") != NULL);
        CHECK(strstr(r.text, "echo <words...>") != NULL);
        CHECK(strstr(r.text, "secret") == NULL ? !dev : dev);
        const char *b = strstr(r.text, "boom"), *e = strstr(r.text, "echo"), *h = strstr(r.text, "help");
        CHECK(b && e && h && b < e && e < h);                      // sorted
        control_console_free(&r);
    }

    // ---- completion
    {
        const char *names[16];
        int n = control_console_names("", names, 16);
        CHECK(n == (dev ? 10 : 7));   // help, ping, exit and 7 test commands, or only the player safe ones (help, exit, 5 test ones)
        n = control_console_names("e", names, 16);
        CHECK(n >= 1 && !strcmp(names[0], "echo"));
        n = control_console_names("sec", names, 16);
        CHECK(n == (dev ? 1 : 0));
        n = control_console_names("zzz", names, 16);
        CHECK(n == 0);
        n = control_console_names("", names, 2);
        CHECK(n == (dev ? 10 : 7));   // the count is the full count; only `max` pointers are written
    }

    // ---- the console's queue: lines run in control_frame(), results come back in order
    {
        ControlConsoleResult r;
        CHECK(!control_console_poll(&r));
        CHECK(!control_console_submit("   "));
        CHECK(control_console_submit("echo one"));
        CHECK(control_console_submit("boom"));
        CHECK(control_console_submit("lines"));
        CHECK(!control_console_poll(&r));   // nothing runs until a frame
        control_frame(1);
        CHECK(control_console_poll(&r) && !r.failed && !strcmp(r.text, "a1: one\nargc: 2"));
        control_console_free(&r);
        CHECK(control_console_poll(&r) && r.failed && !strcmp(r.text, "boom: it failed"));
        control_console_free(&r);
        CHECK(control_console_poll(&r) && !r.failed && !strcmp(r.text, "first line\nsecond 2"));
        control_console_free(&r);
        CHECK(!control_console_poll(&r));
        // a full queue says no instead of growing
        int accepted = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) accepted += control_console_submit("echo x");
        CHECK(accepted == 16);
        control_frame(2);
        int got = 0;
        while (control_console_poll(&r)) { got++; control_console_free(&r); }
        CHECK(got == 16);
        CHECK(control_console_submit("echo again"));   // room again once read
        control_frame(3);
        CHECK(control_console_poll(&r)); control_console_free(&r);
        char huge[2000];
        memset(huge, 'a', sizeof huge - 1); huge[sizeof huge - 1] = 0;
        CHECK(!control_console_submit(huge));
    }

    printf("%s: %d checks, %d failed\n", dev ? "dev" : "player", checks, failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}
```

`tools/test_dlc_check.c`:

```c
// Synthetic downloadable-content validator tests; no game files needed. make test-dlc-check
#include "dlc_check.h"

#include <assert.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#endif

static unsigned g_checks;
#define CHECK(x) do { assert(x); ++g_checks; } while (0)

static const char *const ALL_DLC1_DIRS[] = {
    "Game", "Map", "Movie", "NavMesh", "Pack", "Physics", "Sound", "System", "Terrain", "UI", "Voice",
};

static char g_root[2048];

static void mk_dir_abs(const char *p) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    CreateDirectoryA(p, NULL);
#else
    mkdir(p, 0700);
#endif
}

static void mk_dir(const char *rel) {
    char tmp[4096];
    assert(snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s/%s", g_root, rel) < (int)sizeof tmp);
    for (char *s = tmp + strlen(g_root) + 1; *s; s++) {
        if (*s == '/') {
            *s = 0;
            mk_dir_abs(tmp);
            *s = '/';
        }
    }
    mk_dir_abs(tmp);
}

static void write_bytes(const char *rel, const void *data, size_t len) {
    char p[4096], dir[4096];
    assert(snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", g_root, rel) < (int)sizeof p);
    strcpy(dir, rel);
    char *slash = strrchr(dir, '/');
    if (slash) {
        *slash = 0;
        mk_dir(dir);
    }
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "wb");
    assert(f != NULL);
    if (len) assert(fwrite(data, 1, len, f) == len);
    assert(fclose(f) == 0);
}

static void write_str(const char *rel, const char *s) {
    write_bytes(rel, s, strlen(s));
}

static void rm_tree_abs(const char *p) {
    struct stat st;
    if (stat(p, &st) != 0) return;
    if (!S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) {
        assert(unlink(p) == 0);
        return;
    }
    DIR *d = opendir(p);
    assert(d != NULL);
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, "..")) continue;
        char sub[4096];
        assert(snprintf(sub, sizeof sub, "%s/%s", p, e->d_name) < (int)sizeof sub);
        rm_tree_abs(sub);
    }
    closedir(d);
    assert(rmdir(p) == 0);
}

static void reset_root(void) {
    DIR *d = opendir(g_root);
    assert(d != NULL);
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, "..")) continue;
        char sub[4096];
        assert(snprintf(sub, sizeof sub, "%s/%s", g_root, e->d_name) < (int)sizeof sub);
        rm_tree_abs(sub);
    }
    closedir(d);
}

int main(void) {
    CHECK(rt_dlc_check(NULL).state == RT_DLC_NONE);
    CHECK(rt_dlc_check("").state == RT_DLC_NONE);
    CHECK(rt_dlc_verify(NULL).state == RT_DLC_NONE);

#ifdef _WIN32
    char temp[1024];
    assert(GetTempPathA(sizeof temp, temp) > 0);
    snprintf(g_root, sizeof g_root, "%ssw-dlc-%lu-%llu", temp, (unsigned long)GetCurrentProcessId(),
             (unsigned long long)GetTickCount64());
    for (char *c = g_root; *c; c++)
        if (*c == '\\') *c = '/';
    mk_dir_abs(g_root);
#else
    strcpy(g_root, "/tmp/sw-dlc-XXXXXX");
    assert(mkdtemp(g_root) != NULL);
#endif

    // 1. Base game only: no DLC, no warning.
    write_str("exefs/main", "NSO0");
    write_str("romfs/System/Version.txt", "1.6.0\n");
    RtDlcCheck c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_NONE && c.present_mask == 0);
    CHECK(rt_dlc_verify(g_root).state == RT_DLC_NONE);

    // 2. DLC merged into romfs/ (#188, #242).
    write_str("romfs/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_MERGED && c.present_mask == 0);
    reset_root();
    write_str("romfs/Pack/AocMainField.pack", "SARC");
    CHECK(rt_dlc_check(g_root).state == RT_DLC_MERGED);

    // 3. Misnamed DLC folder in root (#383), while ignoring save/ and cache/.
    reset_root();
    write_str("save/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");
    write_str("cache/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");
    CHECK(rt_dlc_check(g_root).state == RT_DLC_NONE);
    write_str("dlc1/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_MISNAMED && !strcmp(c.detail, "dlc1"));
    reset_root();
    write_str("dlc%s/romfs/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");  // nested + '%' sanitized
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_MISNAMED && !strcmp(c.detail, "dlc?s"));

    // 4. Only one of the two DLC folders (#470).
    reset_root();
    write_str("aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");
    write_str("aoc1/Pack/AocMainField.pack", "SARC");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_ONLY_ONE && c.only_pack == 1 && c.present_mask == 1u && !strcmp(c.version, "3.0"));
    reset_root();
    write_str("aoc2/System/AocVersion.txt", "1.0\n");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_ONLY_ONE && c.only_pack == 2 && c.present_mask == 2u);

    // 5. Nested RomFS inside aoc1 (e.g. aoc1/romfs/System/AocVersion.txt) and base game mistaken for DLC.
    reset_root();
    write_str("aoc1/romfs/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");
    write_str("aoc2/System/AocVersion.txt", "1.0\n");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE && c.nested && !strcmp(c.detail, "aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt"));
    reset_root();
    write_str("aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");
    write_str("aoc1/System/Version.txt", "1.6.0\n");
    write_str("aoc2/System/AocVersion.txt", "1.0\n");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE && !c.nested);

    // 6. Swapped aoc1 and aoc2 (data pack in aoc2).
    reset_root();
    write_str("aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt", "1.0\n");
    write_str("aoc2/System/AocVersion.txt", "3.0\n");
    write_str("aoc2/Pack/AocMainField.pack", "SARC");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_SWAPPED && c.present_mask == 3u);

    // 7. Wrong version: older Switch DLC 2.0 (lacking Movie/) and Wii U "0300".
    reset_root();
    write_str("aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt", "2.0\r\n");
    write_str("aoc1/Pack/AocMainField.pack", "SARC");
    write_str("aoc2/System/AocVersion.txt", "1.0\n");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_WRONG_VERSION && !strcmp(c.version, "2.0"));
    write_str("aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt", "0300\n");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_WRONG_VERSION && !strcmp(c.version, "0300"));
    write_str("aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt", "2.%s\n");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_WRONG_VERSION && !strcmp(c.version, "2.?s"));

    // 8. Incomplete 3.0 tree: missing folder, empty pack, empty Movie/.
    reset_root();
    write_str("aoc1/System/AocVersion.txt", "\xEF\xBB\xBF" "3.0\r\n");
    write_str("aoc2/System/AocVersion.txt", "1.0\n");
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < sizeof ALL_DLC1_DIRS / sizeof ALL_DLC1_DIRS[0]; i++) {
        char d[64];
        snprintf(d, sizeof d, "aoc1/%s", ALL_DLC1_DIRS[i]);
        mk_dir(d);
    }
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE && !strcmp(c.detail, "aoc1/Voice"));
    mk_dir("aoc1/Voice");
    write_bytes("aoc1/Pack/AocMainField.pack", "", 0);
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE && !strcmp(c.detail, "aoc1/Pack/AocMainField.pack"));
    write_str("aoc1/Pack/AocMainField.pack", "SARC-DATA");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_INCOMPLETE && !strcmp(c.detail, "aoc1/Movie"));

    // 9. Complete valid DLC 3.0: both fast check and deep RomFS layout + read verification pass.
    write_str("aoc1/Movie/Demo655_0.mp4", "MP4-VIDEO");
    c = rt_dlc_check(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_READY && c.present_mask == 3u && !strcmp(c.version, "3.0"));
    c = rt_dlc_verify(g_root);
    CHECK(c.state == RT_DLC_READY && c.files == 4 && c.bytes == 8 + 4 + 9 + 9 && !strcmp(c.version, "3.0"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(rt_dlc_state_name(c.state), "ready"));

    rm_tree_abs(g_root);
    printf("test_dlc_check: %u checks passed\n", g_checks);
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_dsu.c`:

```c
// Focused Linux and Windows tests; include motion.c to exercise the real fusion and source switching without game
// assets.
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#undef near  // (windef.h's 16-bit pointer keywords, in the way of the helper below)
#undef far
#else
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif
#include <zlib.h>
#include "../runtime/hle/motion.c"
#include "../runtime/deck_imu.h"  // (motion.c has it on Linux only; its decoder is tested on every system)

Settings g_settings;
static uint64_t clock_ns = 1000000000ull;
uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) { return clock_ns; }
bool pc_gyro_keyboard_active(void) { return false; }  // (runtime/pc_gyro_scene.c: no shrine apparatus here)
bool settings_handheld(void) { return false; }  // (runtime/settings.c: a desktop, no handheld sensors)

static void checksum(uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    memset(p + 8, 0, 4);
    uint32_t crc = crc32(0, p, n);  // independent zlib oracle
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) p[8+i] = crc >> (i*8);
}
static void u32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) p[i] = v >> (i*8); }
static void f32(uint8_t *p, float f) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, &f, 4); u32(p, v); }
static void packet(uint8_t p[100], uint32_t type, uint32_t seq, uint64_t ts) {
    memset(p, 0, 100);
    memcpy(p, "DSUS", 4);
    p[4] = 0xe9, p[5] = 3;
    p[6] = type == 0x100001 ? 16 : 84;
    u32(p + 12, 42); u32(p + 16, type);
    p[21] = p[22] = 2; p[31] = 1;
    u32(p + 32, seq); u32(p + 68, ts); u32(p + 72, ts >> 32);
    f32(p + 80, -1); // flat DSU gravity
    checksum(p, p[6] + 16);
}
static void near(double a, double b) { assert(fabs(a-b) < 1e-6); }

static void parsing(void) {
    uint8_t p[101], req[28]; DsuPacket d;
    packet(p, 0x100002, 7, 123456);
    assert(dsu_decode(p, 100, &d));
    assert(d.sequence == 7 && d.timestamp == 123456 && d.server == 42);
    near(d.acc[0], 0); near(d.acc[1], 0); near(d.acc[2], -1);
    // Independent expected mapping, including each gyro axis and a tilted acceleration.
    f32(p+76, .25); f32(p+80, -.5); f32(p+84, .75);
    f32(p+88, 180); f32(p+92, 90); f32(p+96, -45); checksum(p, 100);
    assert(dsu_decode(p, 100, &d));
    near(d.acc[0], .25); near(d.acc[1], -.75); near(d.acc[2], -.5);
    near(d.gyro[0], PI); near(d.gyro[1], -PI/4); near(d.gyro[2], -PI/2);
    for (int n = 0; n < 100; n++) assert(!dsu_decode(p, n, &d));
    p[100] = 99; assert(dsu_decode(p, 101, &d)); // protocol permits trailing bytes
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) { p[i] ^= 0x80; assert(!dsu_decode(p, 100, &d)); p[i] ^= 0x80; }
    f32(p+88, NAN); checksum(p,100); assert(!dsu_decode(p,100,&d));
    f32(p+88, INFINITY); checksum(p,100); assert(!dsu_decode(p,100,&d));
    packet(p,0x100002,1,100); p[20]=4; checksum(p,100); assert(!dsu_decode(p,100,&d));
    p[20]=0; p[6]=83; checksum(p,99); assert(!dsu_decode(p,100,&d));
    // Captured SteamDeckGyroDSU 2.1 version-reply layout (padding included in CRC, type zero).
    memset(p,0,24); memcpy(p,"DSUS",4); p[4]=0xe9; p[5]=3; p[6]=6; p[20]=0xe9; p[21]=3;
    checksum(p,24); assert(dsu_decode(p,24,&d) && d.type==0x100000);
    p[23]=1; assert(!dsu_decode(p,24,&d)); p[23]=0;
    u32(p+16,0x100000); checksum(p,22); assert(dsu_decode(p,22,&d));
    for (uint32_t type=0x100000; type<=0x100002; type++) {
        size_t n=dsu_request(req,123,type,2);
        assert(n==(type==0x100000 ? 20 : 28));
        uint32_t crc=(uint32_t)req[8] | (uint32_t)req[9]<<8 | (uint32_t)req[10]<<16 | (uint32_t)req[11]<<24;
        memset(req+8,0,4); assert(crc==crc32(0,req,n));
        assert(req[12]==123 && req[6]==n-16);
        if (type==0x100001) assert(req[20]==4 && req[27]==3);
        if (type==0x100002) assert(req[20]==1 && req[21]==2);
    }
}

static void freshness(void) {
    DsuClient c={.fd=-1,.slot=0,.server=42}; DsuPacket d; uint8_t p[100];
    packet(p,0x100002,UINT32_MAX,100); assert(dsu_decode(p,100,&d));
    assert(dsu_accept(&c,&d,clock_ns));
    assert(!dsu_accept(&c,&d,clock_ns+1)); // duplicate must not keep motion alive
    d.sequence=0; d.timestamp++; assert(dsu_accept(&c,&d,clock_ns+2)); // wrap
    d.sequence=UINT32_MAX; d.timestamp++; assert(!dsu_accept(&c,&d,clock_ns+3));
    d.sequence=1; d.timestamp=c.timestamp; assert(!dsu_accept(&c,&d,clock_ns+4));
    dsu_expire(&c,clock_ns+2+DSU_TIMEOUT_NS-1); assert(c.fresh);
    dsu_expire(&c,clock_ns+2+DSU_TIMEOUT_NS); assert(!c.fresh && c.slot==-1);
    c.slot=0; d.sequence=1; d.timestamp=1; assert(dsu_accept(&c,&d,clock_ns+DSU_RETRY_NS));
    d.slot=1; assert(!dsu_accept(&c,&d,clock_ns));
    d.slot=0; d.mac[0]=1; assert(!dsu_accept(&c,&d,clock_ns));
}

// The test's own end of the connection, a UDP socket on the loopback: Winsock's or POSIX's (from #860).
#ifdef _WIN32
static intptr_t peer_open(void) {
    WSADATA wsa;
    assert(!WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsa));
    SOCKET s = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
    assert(s != INVALID_SOCKET);
    DWORD ms = 1000;  // (blocking with a timeout: a reply that never comes fails the test)
    setsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, (const char *)&ms, sizeof ms);
    return (intptr_t)s;
}
static void peer_close(intptr_t fd) { closesocket((SOCKET)fd); }
static long peer_recv(intptr_t fd, uint8_t *p, size_t n, struct sockaddr_in *from, socklen_t *len) {
    return recvfrom((SOCKET)fd, (char *)p, (int)n, 0, (struct sockaddr *)from, len);
}
static long peer_send(intptr_t fd, const uint8_t *p, size_t n, const struct sockaddr_in *to, socklen_t len) {
    return sendto((SOCKET)fd, (const char *)p, (int)n, 0, (const struct sockaddr *)to, len);
}
static void set_env(const char *name, const char *value) { _putenv_s(name, value); }
#else
static intptr_t peer_open(void) {
    int fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM | SOCK_NONBLOCK, 0);
    assert(fd >= 0);
    return fd;
}
static void peer_close(intptr_t fd) { close((int)fd); }
static long peer_recv(intptr_t fd, uint8_t *p, size_t n, struct sockaddr_in *from, socklen_t *len) {
    return recvfrom((int)fd, p, n, 0, (struct sockaddr *)from, len);
}
static long peer_send(intptr_t fd, const uint8_t *p, size_t n, const struct sockaddr_in *to, socklen_t len) {
    return sendto((int)fd, p, n, 0, (const struct sockaddr *)to, len);
}
static void set_env(const char *name, const char *value) { setenv(name, value, 1); }
#endif

static int sample_count;
static void count_sample(const DsuPacket *p, uint32_t gen, void *u) { (void)p; (void)gen; (void)u; sample_count++; }
static void network(void) {
    intptr_t fd=peer_open();
    struct sockaddr_in addr={.sin_family=AF_INET,.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK)};
    assert(!bind(fd,(struct sockaddr *)&addr,sizeof addr));
    socklen_t len=sizeof addr; assert(!getsockname(fd,(struct sockaddr *)&addr,&len));
    char endpoint[64]; snprintf(endpoint,sizeof endpoint,"127.0.0.1:%u",ntohs(addr.sin_port));
    DsuClient c; assert(dsu_init(&c,endpoint,123));
    dsu_poll(&c,clock_ns,count_sample,NULL);
    uint8_t p[100], r[128]; struct sockaddr_in client; len=sizeof client;
    assert(peer_recv(fd,r,sizeof r,&client,&len)==20); assert(r[16]==0);
    assert(peer_recv(fd,r,sizeof r,NULL,NULL)==28); assert(r[16]==1);
    packet(p,0x100001,0,0); assert(peer_send(fd,p,32,&client,len)==32);
    dsu_poll(&c,clock_ns+1,count_sample,NULL); assert(c.slot==0);
    assert(peer_recv(fd,r,sizeof r,NULL,NULL)==28); assert(r[16]==2 && r[20]==1 && r[21]==0);
    packet(p,0x100002,10,1000); assert(peer_send(fd,p,100,&client,len)==100);
    dsu_poll(&c,clock_ns+2,count_sample,NULL); assert(c.fresh && sample_count==1);
    // Restart with new server ID; discovery resets the counter/timestamp epoch.
    packet(p,0x100001,0,0); u32(p+12,99); checksum(p,32);
    peer_send(fd,p,32,&client,len); dsu_poll(&c,clock_ns+3,count_sample,NULL);
    assert(c.server==99 && !c.fresh);
    packet(p,0x100002,1,1); u32(p+12,99); checksum(p,100);
    peer_send(fd,p,100,&client,len); dsu_poll(&c,clock_ns+4,count_sample,NULL);
    assert(c.fresh && sample_count==2);
    dsu_poll(&c,clock_ns+DSU_TIMEOUT_NS+5,count_sample,NULL); assert(!c.fresh && c.slot==-1);
    // Same-ID restart / late server availability recovers via periodic discovery.
    packet(p,0x100001,0,0); u32(p+12,99); checksum(p,32);
    peer_send(fd,p,32,&client,len); dsu_poll(&c,clock_ns+DSU_RETRY_NS,count_sample,NULL);
    packet(p,0x100002,0,0); u32(p+12,99); checksum(p,100);
    peer_send(fd,p,100,&client,len); dsu_poll(&c,clock_ns+DSU_RETRY_NS+1,count_sample,NULL);
    assert(c.fresh && sample_count==3);
    dsu_close(&c); peer_close(fd);
    assert(!dsu_init(&c,"localhost:26760",1)); assert(!dsu_init(&c,"127.0.0.1:0",1));
}

static void selection(void) {
    set_env("SAVAGEWIND_DSU","off");
    backend.enabled=true;
    SDL_Event e={0}; e.gsensor.sensor=SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL; e.gsensor.sensor_timestamp=100;
    e.gsensor.data[1]=SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY;
    motion_sensor_event(&e); assert(!g.sensors);
    e.gsensor.sensor=SDL_SENSOR_GYRO; e.gsensor.data[1]=0;
    motion_sensor_event(&e); assert(backend.source==1 && g.started);
    near(g.acc[2],-1);
    // Keep upstream's native recovery for controllers with a frozen device clock.
    hs.period = .004;
    clock_ns += 4000000;
    e.gsensor.timestamp = clock_ns;
    e.gsensor.data[0] = .2f;
    motion_sensor_event(&e);
    assert(backend.source == 1 && hs.stalled && hs.fused);
    e.gsensor.data[0] = 0;
    // Invalid SDL data must not refresh the native source.
    uint64_t received = backend.gyro_time;
    clock_ns++;
    e.gsensor.timestamp++;
    e.gsensor.data[0] = NAN;
    motion_sensor_event(&e);
    assert(backend.gyro_time == received);
    e.gsensor.data[0] = 0;
    e.gsensor.timestamp = 0;
    DsuPacket d={.acc={0,0,-1},.gyro={1,2,3},.timestamp=100};
    dsu_sample(&d,1,NULL); assert(backend.source==1); // SDL priority
    clock_ns+=DSU_TIMEOUT_NS; motion_poll(); assert(!g.sensors && backend.source==0);
    dsu_sample(&d,1,NULL); assert(backend.source==2 && g.started);
    g.bias[0]=1; dsu_sample(&d,2,NULL); near(g.bias[0],0); // device epoch resets calibration
    clock_ns++;
    e.gsensor.sensor=SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL; e.gsensor.sensor_timestamp=200; e.gsensor.data[1]=SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY;
    motion_sensor_event(&e); assert(backend.source==2); // cannot mix DSU gyro with SDL accel
    e.gsensor.sensor=SDL_SENSOR_GYRO; e.gsensor.data[1]=0;
    motion_sensor_event(&e); assert(backend.source==1);
    // Source changes must not synthesize angular velocity in the game-facing states.
    g_settings.motion_sens=1;
    update(clock_ns); select_motion(2); g.started=true; g.q=g.aim_q=euler_quat(1,.4,.3);
    update(clock_ns+20000000);
    for(int i=0;i<3;i++) near(s.ring[s.head].gyro[i],0);
    static char fake;  // (a controller being closed: never read again)
    backend.pad = (SDL_Gamepad *)&fake;
    motion_pad_removed(backend.pad);
    assert(!backend.enabled && !backend.pad);
}
// SDL's sensor fusion (the device's own sensor, no data rate) gives way to a DSU server that answers; a controller's
// own sensors (with a rate) don't, and without DSU the fused sensor is still used (from #860).
static void unrated(void) {
    backend.enabled=true; backend.unrated=true; backend.dsu.fresh=false;
    select_motion(SRC_NONE);
    clock_ns+=4*DSU_TIMEOUT_NS;
    SDL_Event e={0}; e.gsensor.sensor=SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL; e.gsensor.timestamp=clock_ns; e.gsensor.data[1]=SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY;
    motion_sensor_event(&e);
    e.gsensor.sensor=SDL_SENSOR_GYRO; e.gsensor.data[1]=0; e.gsensor.timestamp=clock_ns+1;
    motion_sensor_event(&e); assert(backend.source==SRC_PAD);
    DsuPacket d={.acc={0,0,-1},.timestamp=1000};
    dsu_sample(&d,7,NULL); assert(backend.source==SRC_PAD);  // no DSU server answering: the fused sensor
    backend.dsu.fresh=true;
    dsu_sample(&d,7,NULL); assert(backend.source==SRC_DSU && g.started);
    e.gsensor.timestamp=clock_ns+2; motion_sensor_event(&e);
    assert(backend.source==SRC_DSU);  // SDL doesn't take it back while DSU answers
    assert(native_fresh(clock_ns) && !native_first(clock_ns));  // (motion_poll: DSU before the fresh fused sensor)
    backend.unrated=false;  // a controller with its own sensors
    e.gsensor.sensor=SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL; e.gsensor.timestamp=clock_ns+3; e.gsensor.data[1]=SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY;
    motion_sensor_event(&e);
    e.gsensor.sensor=SDL_SENSOR_GYRO; e.gsensor.data[1]=0; e.gsensor.timestamp=clock_ns+4;
    motion_sensor_event(&e); assert(backend.source==SRC_PAD);
    backend.dsu.fresh=false;
    static char fake;
    backend.unrated=true; backend.pad=(SDL_Gamepad *)&fake;
    motion_pad_removed(backend.pad); assert(!backend.unrated && backend.source==SRC_NONE);
}
// Exercise the game-facing path from initially overhead and vertical poses, including
// crossing both poles. At unit sensitivity the output must preserve the physical
// rotation, with no frozen axes or synthetic yaw/roll half-turns. (Sensitivity and
// inversion act on the world's axes since #136: tools/test_motion_sensors.c.)
static void overhead(void) {
    const double poses[] = {0, 79, 89.9, 90, 90.1, 120, 179, 180, -90, -120};
    const int ticks[] = {1, 4, 16};
    for (unsigned rate = 0; rate < sizeof ticks / sizeof ticks[0]; rate++)
    for (unsigned p = 0; p < sizeof poses / sizeof poses[0]; p++)
    for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; axis++)
    for (int inverted = 0; inverted < 1; inverted++) {
        motion_reboot_reset();
        g_settings.motion_sens = inverted ? .5 : 1;
        g_settings.motion_invert = inverted ? MOTION_INVERT_UD | MOTION_INVERT_LR : 0;
        memset(&g, 0, sizeof g);
        g.sensors = g.started = true;
        g.q = g.aim_q = euler_quat(.3, poses[p] * PI / 180, .2);
        backend.source = 2;
        clock_ns += 1000000000;
        update(clock_ns);
        update(clock_ns += SAMPLE_NS);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) assert(fabs(s.ring[s.head].gyro[i]) < 1e-6);
        g.gyro_ts = clock_ns - ticks[rate] * SAMPLE_NS;
        Mat initial;
        memcpy(initial, s.m, sizeof initial);
        for (int j = 1; j <= 200; j++) {
            // 20 degrees/s about one controller axis, through the singularity.
            double raw[3] = {0};
            raw[axis] = 20 * PI / 180;
            sensor_gyro(raw, clock_ns);
            // q and -q encode the same orientation.
            if (j & 1) g.aim_q = (Quat){-g.aim_q.w, -g.aim_q.x, -g.aim_q.y, -g.aim_q.z};
            update(clock_ns += ticks[rate] * SAMPLE_NS);
            const SixAxisState *st = &s.ring[s.head];
            double scale = axis == 1 ? 1 : inverted ? -.5 : 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                assert(isfinite(st->gyro[i]));
                assert(fabs(st->gyro[i] - (i == axis ? scale * 20 / 360 : 0)) < 1e-5);
            }
            // Independent Rodrigues matrix for a single local-axis rotation.
            double a = j * ticks[rate] * .1 * PI / 180 * scale;
            int u = (axis + 1) % 3, v = (axis + 2) % 3;
            double r[3][3] = {{1,0,0},{0,1,0},{0,0,1}};
            r[u][u] = r[v][v] = cos(a); r[u][v] = -sin(a); r[v][u] = sin(a);
            for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++) for (int col = 0; col < 3; col++) {
                double expected = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) expected += initial[row][k] * r[k][col];
                assert(fabs(st->dir[col][row] - expected) < 2e-5);
            }
        }
        update(clock_ns += SAMPLE_NS);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) assert(fabs(s.ring[s.head].gyro[i]) < 1e-6);
    }
    puts("Overhead/vertical poses, pole crossings, all axes, polling rates, quaternion signs, sensitivity/inversion and rest passed");
}
// Replay identical timestamped 250 Hz sensor input with different game polling
// schedules. No wall clock, GPU, display refresh rate or running game is involved.
static void fps_independence(void) {
    const int rates[] = {250, 20, 30, 60, 120, 200, 1000, 0};
    for (int config = 0; config < 3; config++) {
        Mat reference;
        for (unsigned rate = 0; rate < sizeof rates / sizeof rates[0]; rate++) {
            motion_reboot_reset();
            memset(&g, 0, sizeof g);
            g.q = g.aim_q = euler_quat(0, 120 * PI / 180, 0);
            g.sensors = g.started = true;
            g_settings.motion_sens = config == 0 ? 1 : config == 1 ? .5 : 2;
            g_settings.motion_invert = config == 2 ? MOTION_INVERT_UD | MOTION_INVERT_LR : 0;
            uint64_t start = clock_ns += 1000000000;
            update(clock_ns);
            g.gyro_ts = start;
            uint64_t next = start;
            unsigned poll = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= 4000; j++) {
                clock_ns = start + j * 1000000ull;
                // Alternating axes make frame-wise sensitivity scaling differ
                // from processing each sensor increment (rotations don't commute).
                if (j % 4 == 0) {
                    double sample = j / 4;
                    double raw[3] = {1.3 * sin(sample * .053), .8 * cos(sample * .071), 1.1 * cos(sample * .037)};
                    sensor_gyro(raw, clock_ns);
                }
                if (clock_ns >= next) {
                    update(clock_ns);
                    poll++;
                    next = rates[rate] ? start + poll * 1000000000ull / rates[rate]
                                      : clock_ns + (poll % 5 == 0 ? 180000000 : 17000000);
                }
            }
            update(clock_ns);
            if (!rate) memcpy(reference, s.m, sizeof reference);
            else {
                double error = 0;
                for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++)
                    error = fmax(error, fabs(s.m[r][c] - reference[r][c]));
                if (error > 2e-5) fprintf(stderr, "FPS dependence: config %d rate %d matrix error %.8f\n", config, rates[rate], error);
                assert(error < 2e-5);
            }
        }
    }
    puts("Identical 250 Hz motion at 20/30/60/120/200/250/1000 FPS and stalls: identical final orientation passed");
}
// The Steam Deck's state report (runtime/deck_imu.c) against SDL's HIDAPI Steam Deck axes and motion_sensor_event's
// SDL -> Switch mapping, written out independently here.
static void deck_report(void) {
    const short acc[3] = {-1126, 1366, 16586}, gyro[3] = {1638, -820, 300};  // (as read from a Deck lying flat, then turned)
    uint8_t p[64] = {1, 0, 9, 64};
    u32(p + 4, 77);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        p[24 + 2*i] = acc[i] & 0xff, p[25 + 2*i] = (uint16_t)acc[i] >> 8;
        p[30 + 2*i] = gyro[i] & 0xff, p[31 + 2*i] = (uint16_t)gyro[i] >> 8;
    }
    DsuPacket d;
    uint32_t num;
    assert(deck_imu_decode(p, 64, &d, &num) && num == 77);
    const double G = 9.80665, rad = 2000.0 / 32768 * PI / 180;
    double sa[3] = {acc[0] / 32768.0 * 2 * G, acc[2] / 32768.0 * 2 * G, -acc[1] / 32768.0 * 2 * G};
    double sg[3] = {gyro[0] * rad, gyro[2] * rad, -gyro[1] * rad};
    double ea[3] = {-sa[0] / G, sa[2] / G, -sa[1] / G}, eg[3] = {sg[0], -sg[2], sg[1]};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) assert(fabs(d.acc[i] - ea[i]) < 1e-9 && fabs(d.gyro[i] - eg[i]) < 1e-9);
    assert(d.acc[2] < -0.95);  // flat: gravity down the Switch's Z
    p[2] = 1; assert(!deck_imu_decode(p, 64, &d, &num));  // another report type
    p[2] = 9; assert(!deck_imu_decode(p, 35, &d, &num));
    memset(p + 24, 0, 6); assert(!deck_imu_decode(p, 64, &d, &num));  // no motion in it
    puts("Steam Deck state report: axes and scale as SDL's driver passed");
}
int main(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _set_error_mode(_OUT_TO_STDERR);  // (a failed assert prints and exits instead of opening a dialog)
#endif
    parsing(); freshness(); network(); selection(); unrated(); overhead(); fps_independence(); deck_report(); puts("DSU tests passed"); }
```

`tools/test_file_size_cache.cpp`:

```cpp
// A held scanner proves requests/invalidation never wait for filesystem work.
#include <assert.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include "game_file_size.h"

static bool fail_create;
static int create_thread(pthread_t *thread, const pthread_attr_t *attr, void *(*run)(void *), void *arg) {
    return fail_create ? EAGAIN : pthread_create(thread, attr, run, arg);
}
#define pthread_create create_thread
#include "../runtime/ui/file_size_cache.mm"
#undef pthread_create

static std::mutex lock;
static std::condition_variable changed;
static unsigned entered, released;
static bool incomplete;
static bool ignore_cancel;
static std::string scanned_root;
extern "C" RtGameFilesSize rt_game_files_size_scan(const char *root, bool (*cancelled)(void *), void *user) {
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> guard(lock);
    unsigned call = ++entered;
    scanned_root = root;
    changed.notify_all();
    while (released < call && (ignore_cancel || !cancelled(user))) changed.wait_for(guard, std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    if (!ignore_cancel && cancelled(user)) return {0, false, true};
    return {1000 + call, !incomplete, false};
}
static void wait_entered(unsigned n) {
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> guard(lock);
    assert(changed.wait_for(guard, std::chrono::seconds(3), [=]{ return entered >= n; }));
}
static void release(unsigned n) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(lock); released = n; changed.notify_all();
}
static FileSizeCache::Value wait_ready(FileSizeCache &cache) {
    auto until = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(3);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < until) {
        auto value = cache.get();
        if (value.state != FileSizeCache::State::Pending) return value;
        std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    assert(false); return {};
}
int main() {
    FileSizeCache cache;
    cache.reset("first");
    assert(cache.get().state == FileSizeCache::State::Pending);
    wait_entered(1);
    for (int i=0; i<1000; ++i) assert(cache.get().state == FileSizeCache::State::Pending);
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(lock); assert(entered == 1); }
    release(1);
    auto value = wait_ready(cache);
    assert(value.state == FileSizeCache::State::Ready && value.bytes == 1001);
    assert(cache.get().bytes == value.bytes);  // the other page shares the same result

    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(lock); ignore_cancel = true; }
    cache.invalidate(); cache.get(); wait_entered(2);
    cache.reset("second"); cache.get(); release(2); wait_entered(3);
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(lock); assert(scanned_root == "second"); }
    assert(cache.get().state == FileSizeCache::State::Pending);
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(lock); ignore_cancel = false; }
    release(3); value = wait_ready(cache); assert(value.bytes == 1003);

    cache.set_suspended(true);
    for (int i=0; i<1000; ++i) assert(cache.get().state == FileSizeCache::State::Pending);
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(lock); assert(entered == 3); }
    cache.set_suspended(false); cache.get(); wait_entered(4);
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(lock); incomplete = true; }
    release(4); value = wait_ready(cache); assert(value.state == FileSizeCache::State::Unavailable);
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(lock); incomplete = false; }

    cache.invalidate(); cache.get(); wait_entered(5);
    cache.stop();  // cancellation releases a scanner even though the test hasn't released it
    cache.reset("third"); cache.get(); wait_entered(6); release(6);
    assert(wait_ready(cache).bytes == 1006);
    cache.stop();
    fail_create = true; cache.reset("failure");
    assert(cache.get().state == FileSizeCache::State::Unavailable);
    for (int i=0; i<100; ++i) assert(cache.get().state == FileSizeCache::State::Unavailable);
    cache.stop(); fail_create = false;
    printf("file-size cache: held scan, reuse, invalidation, root switch, suspension, error, cancellation and restart passed\n");
}
```

`tools/test_game_file_size.c`:

```c
// Synthetic file-size checks; no game data. make test-game-file-size
#include <assert.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <winioctl.h>
#else
#include <fcntl.h>
#endif
#include "game_file_size.h"

static unsigned checks;
#define CHECK(x) do { assert(x); ++checks; } while (0)
static char root[2048];
static void path(char *out, const char *name) { assert(snprintf(out, 4096, "%s/%s", root, name) < 4096); }
#ifdef _WIN32
static void wide(const char *s, wchar_t *out) {
    wchar_t plain[4096];
    assert(MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, s, -1, plain, 4096));
    for (wchar_t *c = plain; *c; ++c) if (*c == L'/') *c = L'\\';
    assert(swprintf(out, 4096, L"\\\\?\\%ls", plain) > 0);
}
#endif
static void directory(const char *name) {
    char p[4096]; path(p, name);
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t w[4096]; wide(p, w); assert(CreateDirectoryW(w, NULL));
#else
    assert(mkdir(p, 0700) == 0);
#endif
}
static void file(const char *name, unsigned long long bytes) {
    char p[4096]; path(p, name);
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t w[4096]; wide(p, w);
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(w, GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, CREATE_NEW, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    assert(h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE);
    DWORD ignored;
    assert(DeviceIoControl(h, FSCTL_SET_SPARSE, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, &ignored, NULL));
    LARGE_INTEGER size; size.QuadPart = bytes;
    assert(SetFilePointerEx(h, size, NULL, FILE_BEGIN) && SetEndOfFile(h));
    CloseHandle(h);
#else
    int fd = open(p, O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_WRONLY, 0600); assert(fd >= 0);
    assert(ftruncate(fd, (off_t)bytes) == 0); close(fd);
#endif
}
static unsigned polls;
static bool cancel(void *unused) { (void)unused; return ++polls >= 3; }
static void check_size(unsigned long long bytes) {
    RtGameFilesSize size = rt_game_files_size_scan(root, NULL, NULL);
    CHECK(size.complete && !size.cancelled && size.bytes == bytes);
    CHECK(rt_game_files_size(root) == bytes);
}
static void remove_entry(const char *name, bool dir) {
    char p[4096]; path(p, name);
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t w[4096]; wide(p, w);
    bool ok = dir ? RemoveDirectoryW(w) : DeleteFileW(w);
    assert(ok || GetLastError() == ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND);
#else
    assert((dir ? rmdir(p) : unlink(p)) == 0 || errno == ENOENT);
#endif
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc == 3 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--scan")) {
        RtGameFilesSize size = rt_game_files_size_scan(argv[2], NULL, NULL);
        printf("bytes=%llu complete=%d cancelled=%d\n", size.bytes, size.complete, size.cancelled);
        return size.complete && !size.cancelled ? 0 : 1;
    }
    CHECK(!rt_game_files_size_scan(NULL, NULL, NULL).complete);
    CHECK(!rt_game_files_size_scan("", NULL, NULL).complete);
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t temp[1024], tmp[2048]; assert(GetTempPathW(1024, temp));
    swprintf(tmp, 2048, L"%lssw-size-%lu-%llu", temp, GetCurrentProcessId(), GetTickCount64());
    assert(CreateDirectoryW(tmp, NULL));
    assert(WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, tmp, -1, root, sizeof root, NULL, NULL));
#else
    strcpy(root, "/tmp/sw-size-XXXXXX"); assert(mkdtemp(root));
#endif
    printf("fixture=%s\n", root);
    check_size(0);
    directory("romfs"); directory("romfs/sub"); directory("exefs"); directory("unrelated");
    file("romfs/sub/.hidden", 23); file("exefs/main", 17); file("unrelated/skip", 999);
    directory("aoc1"); file("aoc1/data", 31); check_size(71);
    file("romfs/Gr\xc3\xb6\xc3\x9f" "e.bin", 43); check_size(114);
    file("romfs/large", 4294967313ULL); check_size(4294967427ULL);
    char deep[2048] = "romfs";
    for (int i=0; i<16; ++i) { strcat(deep, "/long-directory-name"); directory(deep); }
    char leaf[2048]; snprintf(leaf, sizeof leaf, "%s/data", deep); file(leaf, 29);
    check_size(4294967456ULL);
    remove_entry(leaf, false);
    for (int i=0; i<16; ++i) { remove_entry(deep, true); *strrchr(deep, '/') = 0; }
    RtGameFilesSize size = rt_game_files_size_scan(root, cancel, NULL);
    CHECK(size.cancelled && !size.complete && polls == 3);
#ifndef _WIN32
    char link[4096], outside[4096]; path(link, "romfs/linked"); path(outside, "unrelated");
    assert(symlink(outside, link) == 0); check_size(4294967427ULL);
    char blocked[4096]; path(blocked, "romfs/sub"); assert(chmod(blocked, 0000) == 0);
    size = rt_game_files_size_scan(root, NULL, NULL);
    if (geteuid() != 0) CHECK(!size.complete && !size.cancelled);
    assert(chmod(blocked, 0700) == 0);
    char unreadable[4096]; path(unreadable, "exefs/main"); assert(chmod(unreadable, 0000) == 0);
    check_size(4294967427ULL);  // file contents need not be readable to total metadata
    assert(chmod(unreadable, 0600) == 0);
    char gone[4096]; path(gone, "romfs/sub/.hidden"); assert(unlink(gone) == 0); check_size(4294967404ULL);
    remove_entry("romfs/linked", false);
#endif
    char saved[2048]; strcpy(saved, root);
    directory("unrelated/Gr\xc3\xb6\xc3\x9f" "e");
    strcat(root, "/unrelated/Gr\xc3\xb6\xc3\x9f" "e");
    directory("romfs"); file("romfs/data", 13); check_size(13);
    remove_entry("romfs/data", false); remove_entry("romfs", true);
    strcpy(root, saved);
    remove_entry("unrelated/Gr\xc3\xb6\xc3\x9f" "e", true);
    remove_entry("romfs/sub/.hidden", false); remove_entry("romfs/sub", true);
    remove_entry("romfs/Gr\xc3\xb6\xc3\x9f" "e.bin", false); remove_entry("romfs/large", false);
    remove_entry("romfs", true); remove_entry("exefs/main", false); remove_entry("exefs", true);
    remove_entry("aoc1/data", false); remove_entry("aoc1", true);
    remove_entry("unrelated/skip", false); remove_entry("unrelated", true); remove_entry("", true);
    printf("game-file size: %u checks passed\n", checks);
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_game_sites.py`:

```py
"""tools/game_sites.py without game files: the lists agree, and patterns find made-up code wherever it moves.

- VERSIONS == runtime/game_versions.h (the configuration screen's list), the runtime's sites (runtime/game_sites.h)
  and tools/patches.py's are all in SITES, and every supported version's KNOWN table lists every site;
- patterns: the masks keep an instruction's own bits and drop what moves (branch offsets, ADRP pages, the low 12
  bits an ADD / LDR / STR adds to a page in the pattern); the same code at another address, with other targets, is
  found again, and code / call / ref / got / data / end give the right addresses;
- resolve(): a known build's table is the self-check (another address is an error) and the fallback (a pattern that
  finds nothing or several places), a new build needs every pattern to find one place.

Usage: test_game_sites.py
"""
import os
import re
import struct
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace

import game_sites as gs
import patches

ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..')
BASE = gs.MAIN_BASE
checks = 0


def check(cond, what):
    global checks
    if not cond:
        sys.exit(f'FAIL: {what}')
    checks += 1


# ---- instructions (made up, not the game's)
def adrp(rd, pc, to):
    imm = ((to & ~0xFFF) - (pc & ~0xFFF)) >> 12
    return 0x90000000 | ((imm & 3) << 29) | (((imm >> 2) & 0x7FFFF) << 5) | rd


def add_lo12(rd, rn, to): return 0x91000000 | ((to & 0xFFF) << 10) | (rn << 5) | rd
def ldr_x(rt, rn, off): return 0xF9400000 | ((off >> 3) << 10) | (rn << 5) | rt  # ldr xt, [xn, #off]
def ldr_s(rt, rn, off): return 0xBD400000 | ((off >> 2) << 10) | (rn << 5) | rt  # ldr st, [xn, #off]
def str_w(rt, rn, off): return 0xB9000000 | ((off >> 2) << 10) | (rn << 5) | rt  # str wt, [xn, #off]
def bl(pc, to): return 0x94000000 | (((to - pc) >> 2) & 0x3FFFFFF)
def cbz(rt, pc, to): return 0xB4000000 | ((((to - pc) >> 2) & 0x7FFFF) << 5) | rt


NOP, RET = 0xD503201F, 0xD65F03C0
STP, MOV_FP = 0xA9BF7BFD, 0x910003FD  # stp x29, x30, [sp, #-0x10]! / mov x29, sp
LDP = 0xA8C17BFD


def body(pc, data, got, callee):
    """A made-up function at pc: (words, {what: (instruction offset, kind, expected address)})"""
    w = [STP, MOV_FP,
         adrp(8, pc + 8, data), add_lo12(8, 8, data),        # x8 = data
         str_w(9, 8, 0x10),                                   # (a struct offset: kept)
         bl(pc + 20, callee),
         adrp(10, pc + 24, got), ldr_x(10, 10, got & 0xFFF),  # x10 = [got]
         ldr_s(0, 10, 0),
         cbz(0, pc + 36, pc + 48),
         0x52800541,  # mov w1, #42
         LDP, RET]
    return w, {'code': (0, 'code', pc), 'call': (5, 'call', callee), 'ref': (3, 'ref', data),
               'page': (2, 'ref', data & ~0xFFF), 'got': (7, 'got', None)}


def image(fn_at, data, got, callee, got_value, filler=0x40):
    """An NSO-like main module: .text (filler, the function, filler), .data holding the GOT entry"""
    text_size = 0x1000
    words = [NOP] * (text_size // 4)
    fw, sites = body(BASE + fn_at, data, got, callee)
    words[fn_at // 4:fn_at // 4 + len(fw)] = fw
    for i in range(filler // 4):  # (something else that looks a bit alike: the pattern must not stop there)
        words[i] = STP if i % 7 == 0 else MOV_FP if i % 7 == 1 else NOP
    data_off, size = 0x2000, 0x4000
    img = bytearray(size)
    struct.pack_into(f'<{len(words)}I', img, 0, *words)
    struct.pack_into('<Q', img, got - BASE, got_value)  # (module-relative, as before relocation)
    nso = SimpleNamespace(image=bytes(img), text=(0, text_size), data=(data_off, 0x1000), size=size,
                          build_id='00' * 16)
    return gs.Main(nso), sites


def main():
    # ---- the lists agree
    h = open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'runtime', 'game_versions.h'), encoding='utf-8').read()
    hv = re.findall(r'X\("([^"]*)", "([0-9a-f]*)", ([01]), \d+, \d+(?:ull)?\)', h)  # (the RomFS counts: the setup's alone)
    check(hv == [(v.name, v.build_id, str(int(v.supported))) for v in gs.VERSIONS],
          f'runtime/game_versions.h {hv} == game_sites.VERSIONS')
    names = {s.name for s in gs.SITES}
    check(len(names) == len(gs.SITES), 'site names are unique')
    rt = re.findall(r'X\((\w+)\)', open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'runtime', 'game_sites.h'), encoding='utf-8').read())
    check(rt and set(rt) <= names, f'the runtime\'s sites are in SITES: {set(rt) - names}')
    check(set(patches.PATCHES) <= names, f'tools/patches.py\'s sites are in SITES: {set(patches.PATCHES) - names}')
    for v in gs.VERSIONS:
        if v.supported:
            listed = set(gs.KNOWN.get(v.name, {}))
            check(names - gs.OPTIONAL <= listed <= names, f'{v.name}: KNOWN lists every site (optional ones may be left '
                  f'out): {names - gs.OPTIONAL - listed or listed - names}')
    check(gs.OPTIONAL <= names, f'optional sites are in SITES: {gs.OPTIONAL - names}')
    header = open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'runtime', 'game_sites.h'), encoding='utf-8').read()
    optional_runtime = set(re.findall(r'X\((\w+)\)', header.split('#define GAME_SITES_OPTIONAL(X)')[1].split('typedef struct')[0]))
    check(optional_runtime <= gs.OPTIONAL, 'optional runtime helpers belong to optional pattern groups')
    check(all(gs.compile_pattern(p) for s in gs.SITES if s.pattern
              for p in ([q for q, _ in s.pattern] if isinstance(s.pattern, list) else [s.pattern])),
          'every pattern compiles')

    # ---- masks
    check(gs.make_pattern([bl(0x1000, 0x5000)]) == '94000000/fc000000', 'bl: only the opcode')
    check(gs.make_pattern([adrp(3, 0x1000, 0x123456000), add_lo12(3, 3, 0x123456789), ldr_x(4, 3, 0x18)]) ==
          '90000003/9f00001f 91000063/ffc003ff f9400c64', 'adrp + add: page and low bits masked; then a struct offset')
    check(gs.make_pattern([ldr_x(4, 3, 0x18)]) == 'f9400c64', 'ldr without an adrp in the pattern: kept')
    check(gs.make_pattern([cbz(1, 0, 0x40)]) == 'b4000001/ff00001f', 'cbz: register kept, offset masked')

    # ---- the same code elsewhere, with other targets
    a, sa = image(0x400, 0x7000002468, 0x7000002a10, 0x7000000040, 0x3abc)
    b, sb = image(0x800, 0x7000002f30, 0x7000002b08, 0x7000000100, 0x3ff0)
    pat = gs.make_pattern(a.text_words(BASE + 0x400, 13))
    check(gs.make_pattern(b.text_words(BASE + 0x800, 13)) == pat, 'moved code: the same pattern')
    for m, s, at in ((a, sa, 0x400), (b, sb, 0x800)):
        check(m.find(pat) == [BASE + at], f'found at {at:#x} only ({[hex(x) for x in m.find(pat)]})')
        for what, (k, kind, want) in s.items():
            got = m.target(kind, BASE + at + 4 * k)
            if kind == 'got':
                want = BASE + struct.unpack_from('<Q', m.nso.image, (0x2a10 if m is a else 0x2b08))[0]
            check(got == want, f'{what} at {at:#x}: {got:#x} (want {want:#x})')
    found, n = b.locate(gs.Site('x', 'data', '', 0))
    check((found, n) == (BASE + 0x2000, 1), 'data: where .data starts')
    check(b.locate(gs.Site('x', 'end', '', 0))[0] == BASE + 0x4000, 'end: where the image ends')
    a.fdes = []  # (no unwind info: a window around the instruction)
    p, back = a.pattern_for(BASE + 0x400 + 4 * 7, 'got')
    check(back >= 1 and a.find(p) == [BASE + 0x400 + 4 * 7 - 4 * back], 'pattern_for: starts at its ADRP or above')

    # ---- resolve(): the table checks and falls back
    sites = [gs.Site('fn', 'code', pat, 0), gs.Site('callee', 'call', pat, 5), gs.Site('data', 'ref', pat, 3)]
    saved = gs.SITES
    try:
        gs.SITES = sites
        r = gs.resolve(b)
        check(r == {'fn': BASE + 0x800, 'callee': 0x7000000100, 'data': 0x7000002f30}, f'new build by pattern: {r}')
        try:
            gs.resolve(b, {'fn': BASE + 0x804})
            check(False, 'a table that disagrees with the pattern is refused')
        except gs.SiteError:
            check(True, '')
        gs.SITES = [gs.Site('fn', 'call', [('d503201f 12345678', 0), (pat, 5)], 0)]  # (a version's own pattern)
        check(gs.resolve(b) == {'fn': 0x7000000100}, 'a list of patterns: the first that finds one place')
        gs.SITES = [gs.Site('fn', 'code', 'd503201f d503201f', 0)]  # (several places)
        logs = []
        check(gs.resolve(b, {'fn': BASE + 0x800}, logs.append) == {'fn': BASE + 0x800} and logs,
              'several places: the table, with a warning')
        try:
            gs.resolve(b)
            check(False, 'several places and no table: refused')
        except gs.SiteError as e:
            check('matches 2 places or more' in str(e), str(e))
        saved_groups, saved_optional = gs.OPTIONAL_GROUPS, gs.OPTIONAL
        try:
            gs.OPTIONAL_GROUPS = [('fn', 'gone')]
            gs.OPTIONAL = {'fn', 'gone'}
            gs.SITES = [gs.Site('fn', 'code', pat, 0), gs.Site('gone', 'code', 'd503201f 12345678', 0),
                        gs.Site('data', 'ref', pat, 3)]
            logs = []
            check(gs.resolve(b, None, logs.append) == {'data': 0x7000002f30} and logs,
                  'an optional site not found: its whole group left out, with a note')
            gs.SITES = [gs.Site('fn', 'code', pat, 0), gs.Site('gone', 'code', pat, 1)]
            check(gs.resolve(b) == {'fn': BASE + 0x800, 'gone': BASE + 0x804}, 'an optional group found: kept')
        finally:
            gs.OPTIONAL_GROUPS, gs.OPTIONAL = saved_groups, saved_optional
    finally:
        gs.SITES = saved

    # ---- versions
    check(gs.supported_version('cd57b23fa4bbad65' + '0' * 48).name == '1.9.0', '1.9.0 by build id')
    check(gs.supported_version('de0b6ac4efc1dda7f80f6d7598ec7a7d' + '0' * 32) is None, '1.8.2 is no longer known')
    check(gs.supported_version('ff' * 32) is None, 'an unknown build')
    try:
        gs.for_module(b.nso, BASE)
        check(False, 'an unknown main module is refused')
    except gs.SiteError as e:
        check('not a version Savage Wind knows' in str(e), str(e))
    # Entry hooks must retain the original guest stack/register effects on the
    # unhandled path, and refuse a mismatched instruction rather than corrupt it.
    for name, word, stack in [('pc_map_focus', 0xa9be7bfd, 0x20),
                              ('pc_map_focus_target', 0xd100c3ff, 0x30),
                              ('pc_map_focus_now', 0xd100c3ff, 0x30)]:
        g = SimpleNamespace(base=BASE, nso=SimpleNamespace(image=struct.pack('<I', word)))
        code = patches.PATCHES[name](g, BASE)
        check(f'c->sp -= {stack:#x};' in code and 'return;' in code, f'{name}: guarded original stack effect')
        if stack == 0x20:
            check('ST64(c->sp, c->x[29])' in code and 'ST64(c->sp + 8, c->x[30])' in code,
                  'map focus STP preserves guest FP and LR')
        g.nso.image = struct.pack('<I', NOP)
        try:
            patches.PATCHES[name](g, BASE)
            check(False, f'{name}: mismatched opcode accepted')
        except AssertionError:
            check(True, f'{name}: mismatched opcode refused')
    print(f'ok: {checks} checks')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```c
// Optional feature helpers may be absent without hiding a missing required site.
#include <assert.h>
#include "../runtime/gamelib.c"

int main(void) {
    GameLibSite required[] = {
#define SITE(n) {#n, 0x1234},
        GAME_SITES(SITE)
#undef SITE
    };
    GameLibSite complete[] = {
#define SITE(n) {#n, 0x5678},
        GAME_SITES(SITE)
        GAME_SITES_OPTIONAL(SITE)
#undef SITE
    };
    uint32_t count = sizeof complete / sizeof complete[0];
    GameLibTables tables = {.version = "synthetic", .sites = complete, .nsites = &count};
    assert(take_sites(&tables));
    assert(g_site.pouch_sort == 0x5678);
    count = sizeof required / sizeof required[0];
    tables.sites = required;
    assert(take_sites(&tables));
    assert(!strcmp(g_game_version, "synthetic"));
    assert(g_site.opt_table == 0x1234);
#define CLEARED(n) assert(g_site.n == 0);
    GAME_SITES_OPTIONAL(CLEARED)
#undef CLEARED
    count--;
    assert(!take_sites(&tables));
    assert(strstr(g_error, "main_end"));
    puts("ok: optional helpers clear between libraries; required sites remain mandatory");
}
```

```cpp
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdio>
#include "../runtime/ui/gyro_drag.h"
static int arc_calls,axis_calls;
static float last_q[4];
extern "C" void motion_gizmo_arcball(float w,float x,float y,float z){arc_calls++;last_q[0]=w;last_q[1]=x;last_q[2]=y;last_q[3]=z;}
static GyroScene s;
static void frame(int w,int h,ImVec2 p,bool down){
 auto &io=ImGui::GetIO();io.DisplaySize=ImVec2((float)w,(float)h);io.DeltaTime=1.f/60;
 io.AddMousePosEvent(p.x,p.y);io.AddMouseButtonEvent(0,down);

 for(const auto &size:sizes){
  int w=size[0],h=size[1];float k=h/1080.f;
  s={};s.active=true;s.generation++;
  ImVec2 p(w*.75f,h*.6f);
  frame(w,h,p,false);arc_calls=axis_calls=0;
  frame(w,h,p,true);assert(arc_calls==0&&axis_calls==0); // no initial click jump
  frame(w,h,p,true);assert(arc_calls==0);
  p.x+=40*k;p.y-=25*k;frame(w,h,p,true);
  assert(arc_calls==1&&axis_calls==0);double norm=0;for(float q:last_q)norm+=q*q;
  assert(fabs(norm-1)<1e-5&&fabs(last_q[1])>1e-3&&fabs(last_q[3])>1e-3);
  frame(w,h,p,true);assert(arc_calls==1); // stationary mouse retains the grip
  p.x+=20*k;frame(w,h,p,true);assert(arc_calls==2&&axis_calls==0);
  arc_calls=1;
  frame(w,h,p,true);assert(arc_calls==1); // stationary mouse retains pose
  frame(w,h,p,false);p.x+=20*k;frame(w,h,p,false);assert(arc_calls==1);
  frame(w,h,p,true);assert(arc_calls==1); // re-grip is also jump-free
  s.active=false;p.y+=20*k;frame(w,h,p,true);assert(arc_calls==1); // leaving stops drag
  frame(w,h,p,false);
  printf("%dx%d: drag, hold/re-grip, exit, no visible geometry PASS\n",w,h);
 }
 ImGui::DestroyContext();
}
```

`tools/test_gyro_site.py`:

```py
"""Activation-hook instruction guard; synthetic instructions only."""
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"tools"))
import patches
base=0x7000000000
for offset in (0x100,-0x100):
    word=0x94000000|((offset//4)&0x3ffffff)
    gen=SimpleNamespace(base=base,nso=SimpleNamespace(image=struct.pack("<I",word)))
    code=patches._gyro_scene_actor(gen,base)
    assert f"f_{base+offset:x}(c)" in code
    assert f"c->x[30] = {base+4:#x}ull" in code
    assert code.index(f"f_{base+offset:x}(c);")<code.index("rt_gyro_scene_actor(c")
gen.nso.image=struct.pack("<I",0xd503201f)
try:
    patches._gyro_scene_actor(gen,base)
except AssertionError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("unexpected instruction accepted")
print("activation hook: forward/backward BL, link register, call order and opcode rejection PASS")
```

```c
// Runs lifted single-instruction tests (tools/test_lift.py); prints final state per case. Portable (Windows / POSIX).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <sys/mman.h>
#endif

#include "cpu.h"

extern GuestFn tests[];
extern int ntests;

#define BUF 0x7200000000ull
#define BUF_SIZE 0x40000

void rt_dispatch(Cpu *c) { (void)c; }
void rt_svc(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)imm; (void)pc; }
void rt_brk(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)imm; (void)pc; abort(); }
void rt_udf(Cpu *c, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)pc; abort(); }
uint64_t rt_ticks(void) { return 0; }
volatile int g_fnprof;
void fnprof_hit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) { (void)addr; (void)lr; (void)x0; }

static void *map_file(const char *path, uint64_t addr, size_t *size) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) { perror(path); exit(1); }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    *size = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    size_t len = (*size + 0x3fff) & ~0x3fffull;
#ifdef _WIN32
    // (reservations start on 64 KB boundaries: sdk's base is only page-aligned)
    uint64_t lo = addr & ~0xffffull;
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)lo, len + (addr - lo), MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (p == (void *)lo) p = (void *)addr;
#else
    void *p = mmap((void *)addr, len, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
#endif
    if (p != (void *)addr) { fprintf(stderr, "map %llx failed\n", (unsigned long long)addr); exit(1); }
    if (fread(p, 1, *size, f) != *size) { perror(path); exit(1); }
    fclose(f);
    return p;
}

static uint32_t crc_tab[256];
static uint32_t crc32_buf(const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {  // (zlib's crc32, as test_lift.py hashes Unicorn's memory)
    uint32_t c = 0xffffffffu;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) c = crc_tab[(c ^ p[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >> 8);
    return c ^ 0xffffffffu;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 5) return 2;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        uint32_t c = i;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320u ^ (c >> 1) : c >> 1;
        crc_tab[i] = c;
    }
    uint64_t base = strtoull(argv[4], 0, 16);
    size_t isz, bsz;
    map_file(argv[1], base, &isz);
    map_file(argv[2], BUF, &bsz);
    uint8_t *pristine = malloc(BUF_SIZE);
    memcpy(pristine, (void *)BUF, BUF_SIZE);
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[3], "rb");
    if (!f) { perror(argv[3]); return 1; }
    struct { uint64_t k, pc, x[32], sp, nzcv; __uint128_t v[32]; } in;
    static Cpu c;
    while (fread(&in, sizeof in, 1, f) == 1) {
        memcpy((void *)BUF, pristine, BUF_SIZE);
        memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
        memcpy(c.x, in.x, sizeof c.x);
        c.sp = in.sp;
        c.nzcv = in.nzcv;
        memcpy(c.v, in.v, sizeof c.v);
        c.excl_addr = ~0ull;
        tests[in.k](&c);
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) printf("%llx ", (unsigned long long)c.x[i]);
        printf("%llx %llx %llx ", (unsigned long long)c.sp, (unsigned long long)(c.nzcv & 0xf0000000ull),
               (unsigned long long)c.pc);
        printf("%08x", crc32_buf((const uint8_t *)BUF, BUF_SIZE));
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
            printf(" %016llx%016llx", (unsigned long long)(uint64_t)(c.v[i] >> 64), (unsigned long long)(uint64_t)c.v[i]);
        printf("\n");
    }
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_hour.c`:

```c
// The clock command against a world whose time reloads from alternating game-data buffers each update.
#include <assert.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../runtime/services/test_warp.c"

GameSites g_site;

static unsigned char world[0x600], manager[0x160];
static unsigned char data_manager[0xc30], buffers[2][0x40], flags[2][0x28];
static uint64_t vtable[8], flag_vtables[2][18], wrappers[2], arrays[2][1];
static uint32_t calc_code[32];
static const uint32_t getter_code[2][2] = {{0xbd401000, 0xd65f03c0}, {0xbd401800, 0xd65f03c0}};
static const unsigned value_offsets[2] = {0x10, 0x18};
static uint64_t world_ptr, managers[1];
static float game_time;
static uint64_t frame;
static unsigned pokes;

#define CALC (MAIN_BASE + 0x1000)
#define DATA_SITE (MAIN_BASE + 0x10100)

bool control_mem_peek(uint64_t addr, void *buf, size_t n) {
    if (addr == DATA_SITE && n == 8) {
        uint64_t ptr = (uintptr_t)data_manager;
        memcpy(buf, &ptr, n);
        return true;
    }
    if (addr == CALC && n == sizeof calc_code) { memcpy(buf, calc_code, n); return true; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        if (addr == CALC + 0x1000 + 8 * i && n == 8) { memcpy(buf, getter_code[i], n); return true; }
#define READABLE(object) if (addr >= (uintptr_t)(object) && n <= sizeof(object) && \
    addr - (uintptr_t)(object) <= sizeof(object) - n) { memcpy(buf, (void *)(uintptr_t)addr, n); return true; }
    READABLE(manager)
    READABLE(data_manager)
    READABLE(buffers)
    READABLE(flags)
    READABLE(vtable)
    READABLE(flag_vtables)
    READABLE(wrappers)
    READABLE(arrays)
#undef READABLE
    return false;
}

bool control_mem_poke(uint64_t addr, const void *buf, size_t n) {
    bool flag = addr >= (uintptr_t)flags && n <= sizeof flags && addr - (uintptr_t)flags <= sizeof flags - n;
    bool gate = addr == (uintptr_t)manager + 0x14e && n == 1;
    bool speed = addr == (uintptr_t)manager + 0xc4 && n == 4;
    if (!flag && !gate && !speed) return false;
    pokes++;
    memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, buf, n);
    return true;
}

static void expect(float hour, bool held) {
    bool actual_held;
    assert(fabsf(test_warp_hour(&actual_held) - hour) < 0.0001f);
    assert(actual_held == held);
}

static float speed(void) {
    float value;
    memcpy(&value, manager + 0xc4, sizeof value);
    return value;
}

static void tick(float delta) {
    // A buffer swap must retain the held value, and release must leave the native clock in charge.
    uint64_t swap = wrappers[0];
    wrappers[0] = wrappers[1];
    wrappers[1] = swap;
    int source = frame % 2;
    memcpy(&game_time, flags[source] + value_offsets[source], sizeof game_time);
    game_time = fmodf(game_time + delta * speed(), 360.0f);
    if (!manager[0x14e] && game_time >= 165) game_time = 165;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) memcpy(flags[i] + value_offsets[i], &game_time, sizeof game_time);
    memcpy(manager + 0xb8, &game_time, sizeof game_time);
    test_warp_frame(++frame);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    (void)argv;
    bool held;
    assert(test_warp_hour(&held) < 0);
    world_ptr = (uintptr_t)world;
    managers[0] = (uintptr_t)manager;
    uint32_t count = 1;
    uint64_t array = (uintptr_t)managers;
    memcpy(world + 0x5c0, &count, sizeof count);
    memcpy(world + 0x5c8, &array, sizeof array);
    g_site.world_mgr = (uintptr_t)&world_ptr;
    g_site.main_data = MAIN_BASE + 0x10000;
    g_site.main_end = MAIN_BASE + 0x20000;
    uint64_t vt = (uintptr_t)vtable;
    memcpy(manager, &vt, sizeof vt);
    vtable[6] = CALC;
    // ADRP x8, DATA_SITE's page; ADD x8, x8, its low 12 bits; LDR x20, [x8]; CBNZ x20.
    uint32_t pages = (DATA_SITE - CALC) >> 12;
    calc_code[0] = 0x90000008 | (pages & 3) << 29 | (pages >> 2) << 5;
    calc_code[1] = 0x91000108 | (DATA_SITE & 0xfff) << 10;
    calc_code[2] = 0xf9400114;
    calc_code[3] = 0xb5000034;
    float initial_speed = 0.25f;
    memcpy(manager + 0xc4, &initial_speed, sizeof initial_speed);
    game_time = 165;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        wrappers[i] = (uintptr_t)buffers[i];
        arrays[i][0] = (uintptr_t)flags[i];
        uint64_t wrapper = (uintptr_t)&wrappers[i], array_ptr = (uintptr_t)arrays[i];
        uint64_t flag_vt = (uintptr_t)flag_vtables[i];
        flag_vtables[i][0x88 / 8] = CALC + 0x1000 + 8 * i;
        memcpy(flags[i], &flag_vt, sizeof flag_vt);
        uint32_t hash = crc32_of("WM_Time");
        memcpy(data_manager + 0xbd8 + 8 * i, &wrapper, sizeof wrapper);
        memcpy(buffers[i] + 0x28, &count, sizeof count);
        memcpy(buffers[i] + 0x30, &array_ptr, sizeof array_ptr);
        memcpy(flags[i] + value_offsets[i], &game_time, sizeof game_time);
        if (i == 1) memcpy(flags[i] + 0x1c, &hash, sizeof hash);
    }
    uint64_t primary = (uintptr_t)flags[1];
    memcpy(flags[0] + 8, &primary, sizeof primary);
    tick(0);
    if (argc > 1) {
        expect(18, true);
        tick(1);
        expect(18, true);
        assert(game_time == 270 && speed() == 0 && manager[0x14e] == 1);
        test_warp_hold_hour(-1);
        assert(speed() == initial_speed);
        tick(1);
        expect(18 + 0.25f / 15, false);
        puts("hour: environment native-clock hold passed");
        return 0;
    }
    expect(11, false);
    assert(!pokes && manager[0x14e] == 0 && speed() == initial_speed);
    test_warp_set_hour(10);
    expect(10, false);
    tick(1);
    expect(10 + 0.25f / 15, false);
    test_warp_hold_hour(test_warp_hour(NULL));
    float frozen = test_warp_hour(NULL);
    assert(speed() == 0);
    unsigned frozen_pokes = pokes;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        tick(1);
        expect(frozen, true);
        assert(fabsf(game_time / 15 - frozen) < 0.0001f);
    }
    assert(pokes == frozen_pokes);
    // Setting a frozen clock preserves its state and updates both backing buffers immediately.
    test_warp_set_hour(15);
    expect(15, true);
    tick(1);
    assert(game_time == 225 && speed() == 0);
    test_warp_hold_hour(-1);
    expect(15, false);
    assert(speed() == initial_speed);
    tick(1);
    expect(15 + 0.25f / 15, false);
    unsigned released_pokes = pokes;
    for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) tick(1);
    assert(pokes == released_pokes);
    expect(fmodf(225.25f + 250, 360) / 15, false);
    // Paused presentation frames do not accumulate an offset or change native speed.
    float paused = test_warp_hour(NULL);
    for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) test_warp_frame(++frame);
    expect(paused, false);
    test_warp_hold_hour(paused);
    for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) test_warp_frame(++frame);
    expect(paused, true);
    test_warp_hold_hour(-1);
    tick(1);
    expect(paused + 0.25f / 15, false);
    // Multiple commands in one batch, including repeated freeze, must not save zero as the native speed.
    test_warp_hold_hour(6);
    test_warp_hold_hour(6);
    test_warp_set_hour(7);
    test_warp_hold_hour(-1);
    expect(7, false);
    assert(speed() == initial_speed);
    tick(1);
    expect(7 + 0.25f / 15, false);
    test_warp_hold_hour(-1);
    tick(1);
    expect(7 + 0.5f / 15, false);
    test_warp_set_hour(23.99f);
    tick(1);
    expect((23.99f * 15 + 0.25f - 360) / 15, false);
    test_warp_hold_hour(24);
    tick(1);
    expect(24, true);
    assert(game_time == 0);
    test_warp_hold_hour(-1);
    expect(0, false);
    tick(1);
    expect(0.25f / 15, false);
    test_warp_set_hour(24);
    expect(0, false);
    // Preserve a nondefault native speed as well.
    float custom_speed = 0.125f;
    memcpy(manager + 0xc4, &custom_speed, sizeof custom_speed);
    test_warp_hold_hour(17);
    tick(1);
    assert(game_time == 255);
    test_warp_hold_hour(-1);
    assert(speed() == custom_speed);
    tick(1);
    expect(17 + custom_speed / 15, false);
    // An unrelated flag at the same handle must never be overwritten.
    uint32_t bad_hash = 0;
    memcpy(flags[1] + 0x1c, &bad_hash, sizeof bad_hash);
    float before = game_time;
    test_warp_set_hour(5);
    float value;
    memcpy(&value, flags[0] + value_offsets[0], sizeof value);
    assert(value == before);
    // A hold requested before GameDataMgr is ready must retry without leaving native speed at zero.
    test_warp_hold_hour(5);
    assert(speed() == custom_speed);
    uint32_t hash = crc32_of("WM_Time");
    memcpy(flags[1] + 0x1c, &hash, sizeof hash);
    test_warp_frame(++frame);
    tick(1);
    expect(5, true);
    assert(game_time == 75 && speed() == 0);
    test_warp_hold_hour(-1);
    assert(speed() == custom_speed);
    test_warp_reset();
    tick(0);
    expect(game_time / 15, false);
    // A running set before world creation is applied once, without turning into a hold.
    world_ptr = 0;
    test_warp_set_hour(8);
    assert(test_warp_hour(&held) < 0 && !held);
    memcpy(flags[1] + 0x1c, &hash, sizeof hash);
    world_ptr = (uintptr_t)world;
    test_warp_frame(++frame);
    expect(8, false);
    tick(1);
    expect(8 + custom_speed / 15, false);
    puts("hour: running set, native freeze, release, speed, pause and rollover passed");
    return 0;
}
```
