`tools/test_prof_lifecycle.py`:

```py
"""Recorder lifecycle regressions using the real C recorder, without game files or a GPU."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

from tools import swprof


class LifecycleTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_case(self, name):
        exe = Path(os.environ.get('SWPROF_TEST_BIN', 'build/test_prof_lifecycle')).resolve()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            run = subprocess.run([str(exe), name], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
            self.assertEqual(run.returncode, 0, run.stdout + run.stderr)
            paths = [line[5:] for line in run.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('FILE ')]
            if name == 'exit':
                paths = [str(p) for p in Path(d, 'profile').glob('*.swprof')]
            return swprof.Capture(str(Path(d) / paths[-1])) if paths else None

    def test_pending_signal_after_stop(self):
        self.run_case('pending')

    def test_sampler_skips_a_thread_reaped_after_snapshot(self):
        self.run_case('reaped-snapshot')

    def test_delayed_realtime_request_after_stop(self):
        self.run_case('pending-rt')

    def test_gpu_tail_is_recorded_after_cpu_stop(self):
        cap = self.run_case('gpu-tail')
        self.assertEqual(len(cap.gpu), 1)
        self.assertEqual(cap.counters['delayed GPU'][0][1], 1)

    def test_cancelled_environment_stop_cannot_stop_another_capture(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.run_case('cancel-env').frame_marks)

    def test_producers_racing_repeated_stop_and_start(self):
        cap = self.run_case('stress')
        self.assertTrue(cap.frame_marks)
        self.assertTrue(all(b >= a for zs in cap.zones for a, b, _ in zs))

    def test_normal_exit_finishes_the_file(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.run_case('exit').frame_marks)

    def test_old_scopes_cannot_enter_a_new_capture(self):
        cap = self.run_case('cross')
        old = {sid for sid, name in cap.sites.items() if name in ('old zone', 'old accumulator')}
        self.assertFalse([r for zs in cap.zones for r in zs if r[2] in old])
        self.assertFalse([r for acc in cap.acc for r in acc if r[1] in old])

    def test_single_frame_has_both_boundaries(self):
        cap = self.run_case('one')
        self.assertEqual([n for _, n in cap.frame_marks], [100, 101])
        self.assertEqual(swprof.analyse(cap)['frames']['count'], 1)

    def test_final_totals_survive_worker_exit(self):
        cap = self.run_case('final')
        calls = sum(n for acc in cap.acc for _, sid, n, _ in acc if cap.sites[sid] == 'final total')
        self.assertEqual(calls, 1)

    def test_partial_accumulator_flush_preserves_unstored_totals_and_frame(self):
        cap = self.run_case('full-acc')
        totals = [(frame, cap.sites[sid], calls, round(ms * cap.ticks_per_ms))
                  for acc in cap.acc for frame, sid, calls, ms in acc]
        self.assertEqual(sorted(totals), [(10, 'pending tally', 1, 0), (10, 'pending total', 1, 222),
                                         (10, 'stored total', 1, 111)])

    def test_writer_failure_allows_a_later_capture(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.run_case('write-failure').frame_marks)

```

`tools/test_quick_drop_action.c`:

```c
// Mock native functions: verify in-menu deletion, refresh, identity checks
// and exactly-once dispatch while the D-pad remains held.
#include <assert.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include "../runtime/quick_drop_action.c"

Settings g_settings;
GameSites g_site;
const char *g_game_version = "1.9.0";
static uint64_t buttons;
static int depth, discarded, original_calls, tag_calls, lookup_calls, missing;
static int actor_drops, schedules, snapshots;
static uint64_t saved_cache[4];
static uint64_t native_equipment, current_player, frame, consumed;
static bool owner_attached, weak_links, retain_failure, interleave_drop, protect_after_discard, consume_scheduler_immediately, snapshot_failure;
static int sweeps;
static int widget_count, widget_cursor;
static bool sword_special;
static bool lookup_ok = true, tag_important, tag_notdrop, trash, equip_ban, event, popup, player_ban;
static uint64_t inventory[2][2];
static int counts[2];
static const uint64_t screen = GUEST_LO + 0x2100000, mgr = GUEST_LO + 0x2200000;
static const uint64_t item = GUEST_LO + 0x2280000, stack = GUEST_LO + 0x2300000;
static const uint64_t actor = GUEST_LO + 0x2310000, bg = GUEST_LO + 0x2320000;
static const uint64_t info = GUEST_LO + 0x2400000, player_info = GUEST_LO + 0x2410000;
static const uint64_t player = GUEST_LO + 0x2420000;
static const uint64_t links = GUEST_LO + 0x2430000, equipment = GUEST_LO + 0x2440000, equipment_vt = GUEST_LO + 0x2450000;
static const uint64_t equipment_block = GUEST_LO + 0x2460000, player_block = GUEST_LO + 0x2470000;
static const uint64_t ui_manager = GUEST_LO + 0x2500000, ui_input = GUEST_LO + 0x2570000;

void *hle_alloc(uint64_t size) { assert(size == 0x50); return (void *)(uintptr_t)links; }
void input_consume_buttons(uint64_t mask) { consumed |= mask; }
uint64_t renderer_present_count(void) { return frame; }
static void actor_original(Cpu *c) {
    assert(c->x[0] == equipment); actor_drops++;
    ST8(equipment + 0x920, 2); ST8(equipment + 0x934, 1);
    c->x[0] = 1; c->pc = 0x1234; c->v[0] = 0x4567;
}

static void observed_actor(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t actor = c->x[0];
    uint64_t token = rt_quick_drop_actor_begin(actor, g_site.quick_drop_actor_method);
    actor_original(c);
    rt_quick_drop_actor_end(token, actor, c->x[0]);
}

static void consume_native_drop(Cpu *context) {
    assert(LD8(player + drop_pending_offset(equipped_drop.actor_category)));
    Cpu native = *context; native.x[0] = equipment; native.x[30] = 0x7001223f54ull;
    observed_actor(&native);
    native_equipment = 0;
    ST8(player + drop_pending_offset(equipped_drop.actor_category), 0);
    ST8(equipment + 0x920, 0xff); ST8(equipment + 0x934, 0);
    owner_attached = false;
}
uint64_t input_buttons_now(void) { return buttons; }
static void original(Cpu *c) { (void)c; original_calls++; }
GuestFn dispatch_lookup(uint64_t address) {
    if (missing && address == 0x700108e7a0ull) return NULL;
    return address == 0x70007acaa0ull ? actor_original : original;
}
void guest_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t fn) {
    assert(c->x[3] == 0);
    assert(c->sp == stack - 0x100);
    if (fn == g_site.pouch_lock) { assert(c->x[0] == mgr + 0x28 || c->x[0] == player + 0xeb8 || c->x[0] == player + 0x13a0 || c->x[0] == player + 0x13e8 || c->x[0] == player + 0x1430); depth++; c->x[0] = 0; }
    else if (fn == g_site.pouch_unlock) { assert(c->x[0] == mgr + 0x28 || c->x[0] == player + 0xeb8 || c->x[0] == player + 0x13a0 || c->x[0] == player + 0x13e8 || c->x[0] == player + 0x1430); assert(depth > 0); depth--; c->x[0] = 0; }
    else if (fn == g_site.pouch_page_count) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr && c->x[1] < 2);
        c->x[0] = counts[c->x[1]];
    } else if (fn == g_site.pouch_page_item) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr && c->x[1] < 2 && c->x[2] < 2);
        c->x[0] = inventory[c->x[1]][c->x[2]];
    } else if (fn == 0x7000d388b0ull) { assert(c->x[0] == 0); c->x[0] = trash; }
    else if (fn == 0x7000d35b80ull) { assert(c->x[0] == 0); c->x[0] = equip_ban; }
    else if (fn == 0x7000d1499cull) c->x[0] = event;
    else if (fn == 0x7000e7e750ull) c->x[0] = popup;
    else if (fn == 0x7000cc6fd0ull) { assert(c->x[0] == player_info); c->x[0] = current_player; }
    else if (fn == 0x7000d940c4ull) { assert(c->x[0] == mgr); c->x[0] = equipment_vt + 0x600; }
    else if (fn == 0x7000d9f4a8ull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr && LD8(item + 0x25));
        snapshots++;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) { saved_cache[i] = LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8); ST64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8, 0); }
        // Native snapshot is derived from flags in the locked live pouch,
        // independently of the cache values that happened to exist on entry.
        for (unsigned tab = 0; tab < 2; tab++) for (int slot = 0; slot < counts[tab]; slot++) {
            uint64_t candidate = inventory[tab][slot];
            if (!candidate) continue;
            unsigned type = LD32(candidate + 0x18);
            if (type < 4 && LD8(candidate + 0x24) && !snapshot_failure)
                ST64(mgr + 0x447e0 + type * 8, candidate);
        }
    }
    else if (fn == 0x7000cbe480ull) {
        assert(discarded == 1 && quick_drop_action_busy() && snapshots == 1);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) assert(LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8) == saved_cache[i]);
        assert(LD8(player + drop_pending_offset(equipped_drop.actor_category)) || actor_drops == 1);
        assert(quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(UINT64_MAX) == UINT64_C(0xff0000));
        assert(c->x[0] == player && c->x[1] == equipment_vt + 0x600 && c->x[2] == 0xffffffffu);
        schedules++; ST8(player + 0x1120 + equipped_drop.actor_category, 1);
        ST32(player + 0xc98, LD32(player + 0xc98) | 0x20);
        if (consume_scheduler_immediately) {
            consume_native_drop(c);
            ST8(player + 0x1120 + equipped_drop.actor_category, 0);
        }
    }
    else if (fn == 0x7000570128ull) { assert(c->x[0] == player && c->x[1] <= 2); c->x[0] = native_equipment; }
    else if (fn == 0x7001517e60ull) {
        uint64_t out = c->x[0], target = c->x[1], block = LD64(target + 0x68);
        assert((out == links || out == links + 0x10) && c->x[2] == 1);
        if (retain_failure) { c->x[0] = 0; return; }
        ST64(out, block); ST32(out + 8, LD32(target + 0x60)); ST8(out + 0xc, 1);
        ST32(block + 0x50, LD32(block + 0x50) + 1); c->x[0] = 1;
    }
    else if (fn == 0x7001517abcull) {
        uint64_t index = c->x[0], out = c->x[1], block = LD64(index);
        assert((index == links || index == links + 0x10) && c->x[2] == 0);
        assert(out == links + 0x20 || out == links + 0x38);
        uint64_t target = LD32(index + 8) == LD32(block + 0x40) ? LD64(block + 0x48) : 0;
        ST8(out, target && !weak_links); ST64(out + 8, target); c->x[0] = target;
    }
    else if (fn == 0x7001517f8cull) {
        uint64_t index = c->x[0]; assert(index == links || index == links + 0x10);
        if (LD8(index + 0xc)) { uint64_t block = LD64(index); assert(LD32(block + 0x50)); ST32(block + 0x50, LD32(block + 0x50) - 1); }
        ST8(index + 0xc, 0); ST32(index + 8, UINT32_MAX);
    }
    else if (fn == 0x7001126464ull) { ST8(c->x[0], 0); ST64(c->x[0] + 8, 0); }
    else if (fn == 0x7001517e0cull) { assert(c->x[0] == equipment + 0x938 || c->x[0] == equipment + 0x958); c->x[0] = owner_attached; }
    else if (fn == 0x7000cc0334ull) { assert(c->x[0] == player); c->x[0] = player_ban; }
    else if (fn == 0x700108dc0cull) {
        assert(c->x[0] == info && c->x[1] == stack - 0xf0 && c->x[2] == stack - 0xd0);
        assert(!strcmp((char *)(uintptr_t)c->x[2], (char *)(uintptr_t)actor));
        assert(c->x[2] >= GUEST_LO && c->x[2] < GUEST_HI);
        lookup_calls++;
        c->x[0] = lookup_ok;
    } else if (fn == 0x700108e7a0ull) {
        assert(c->x[0] == info && c->x[1] == stack - 0xf0);
        assert(c->x[2] == 0x4850af43u || c->x[2] == 0x4873f474u);
        tag_calls++;
        c->x[0] = c->x[2] == 0x4850af43u ? tag_important : tag_notdrop;
    } else if (fn == 0x7000d97f68ull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr && c->x[1] == 0);
        assert(!LD8(item + 0x25));
        sweeps++;
        for (int tab = 0; tab < 2; tab++) {
            int kept = 0;
            for (int slot = 0; slot < counts[tab]; slot++)
                if (inventory[tab][slot] != item) inventory[tab][kept++] = inventory[tab][slot];
            counts[tab] = kept;
            while (kept < 2) inventory[tab][kept++] = 0;
        }
        c->x[0] = 0;
    } else if (fn == 0x7000e27c2cull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == screen);
        ST32(screen + 0x3880, counts[0]);
        ST64(screen + 0x37c8, inventory[0][0]);
        ST32(screen + 0x3878, -1);
    } else if (fn == 0x7000e28070ull) {
        // Native e28070: ordinary swords, shields and bows have an
        // unequip slot; special sword mode has no extra slot.
        int extra = LD32(screen + 0x3738) != 0 || !sword_special ||
            (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c) == -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
            int index = i - extra;
            ST32(screen + 0x3884 + i * 4,
                 index >= 0 && index < (int)LD32(screen + 0x3880) ? index : -1);
        }
    } else if (fn == 0x7000d665a4ull) {
        assert(depth == 1);
        widget_cursor = c->x[1]; widget_count = c->x[2];
    } else if (fn == 0x7000e278c0ull) {
        assert(depth == 1);
    } else if (fn == 0x7000d9784cull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr && c->x[1] < 2 && c->x[2] < 2);
        assert(inventory[c->x[1]][c->x[2]] == item);
        if (native_equipment) {
            assert(quick_drop_action_busy() && schedules == 0 && snapshots == 1);
            assert(LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + (uint64_t)LD32(item + 0x18) * 8) == item);
            assert(quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(UINT64_MAX) == UINT64_C(0xff0000));
        }
        discarded++;
        if (native_equipment) ST8(player + drop_pending_offset(equipped_drop.actor_category), 1);
        ST8(item + 0x25, 0);
        ST32(item + 0x20, 0);
        if (interleave_drop) {
            // Another guest worker consumes the established drop before the
            // scheduler runs. Reversed ordering would unequip without intent.
            assert(schedules == 0 && LD8(player + drop_pending_offset(equipped_drop.actor_category)));
            consume_native_drop(c);
        }
        if (protect_after_discard) assert(!mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)item, 0x1000, PROT_NONE));
        c->x[0] = 0;
    } else { fprintf(stderr, "unexpected native call %llx\n", (unsigned long long)fn); assert(0); }
    // Cloned Cpu must isolate all guest register clobbers from interrupted code.
    c->x[4] = 0xdead;
    c->nzcv = 0xbeef;
}

static Cpu cpu(void) {
    Cpu c = {0}; c.x[0] = screen; c.x[4] = 44; c.nzcv = 55; c.sp = stack; return c;
}
static void setup(void) {
    quick_drop_action_reset();
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)screen, 0, 0x3900);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)mgr, 0, 0x45000);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)item, 0, 0x100);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)player, 0, 0x2000);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)equipment, 0, 0x1000);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)links, 0, 0x100);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)equipment_block, 0, 0x100);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)player_block, 0, 0x100);
    ST64(equipment + 0x68, equipment_block); ST32(equipment + 0x60, 42);
    ST32(equipment_block + 0x40, 42); ST64(equipment_block + 0x48, equipment);
    ST64(player + 0x68, player_block); ST32(player + 0x60, 73);
    ST32(player_block + 0x40, 73); ST64(player_block + 0x48, player);
    ST8(player + 0x64, 1);
    ST8(equipment + 0x64, 1); ST8(equipment + 0x920, 0);
    ST64(equipment + 0x190, equipment + 0x1000);
    ST64(equipment, equipment_vt); ST64(equipment_vt + 0x588, 0x70007acaa0ull);
    ST64(equipment + 0x10, actor);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)ui_manager, 0, 0x65000);
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)ui_input, 0, 0x120);
    ST64(ui_manager + 0x649f0, ui_input);
    current_player = player; native_equipment = 0; frame = 1; consumed = 0;
    owner_attached = true; weak_links = retain_failure = interleave_drop = protect_after_discard = consume_scheduler_immediately = snapshot_failure = false; actor_drops = schedules = snapshots = 0;
    g_site.player_info = 0x7001e13ed0ull;
    ST64(g_site.player_info, player_info);
    ST64(0x7001e39450ull, info);
    ST64(item + 0x30, actor);
    strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)actor, "Weapon_Sword_001");
    ST32(item + 0x18, 0); ST32(item + 0x20, 15); ST8(item + 0x25, 1);
    ST64(screen + 0x3640, mgr); ST64(screen + 0x37b8, bg);
    ST32(screen + 0x3878, 1); ST32(screen + 0x387c, 0); ST32(screen + 0x3738, 0);
    ST32(bg + 0x20, 0); ST32(mgr + 0x44498, 2);
    memset(inventory, 0, sizeof inventory); inventory[0][0] = item;
    counts[0] = 1; counts[1] = 0;
    buttons = 0; depth = discarded = original_calls = tag_calls = lookup_calls = 0;
    sweeps = 0; widget_count = widget_cursor = -1; sword_special = false;
    trash = equip_ban = event = popup = player_ban = tag_important = tag_notdrop = false;
    lookup_ok = true;
    assert(quick_drop_action_init());
}
static void request(Cpu *c) {
    Cpu before = *c;
    quick_drop_action_request(c, screen, mgr, item, 0, 0, (char *)(uintptr_t)actor);
    assert(!memcmp(c, &before, sizeof before)); assert(depth == 0);
}
static void hidden(void) { /* Requests now execute in the open menu. */ }
static void reject_case(Cpu *c) { request(c); assert(!pending_drop.item && discarded == 0); }

int main(void) {
    void *mapped = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)GUEST_LO, 0x4000000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                        MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
    assert(mapped == (void *)(uintptr_t)GUEST_LO);
    g_settings.quick_drop = true;
    g_site.pouch_page_count = 0x7000d970a8ull;
    g_site.pouch_page_item = 0x7000d992acull;
    g_site.quick_sort_modal = 0x7000e7e750ull;
    g_site.player_drop_forbidden = 0x7000cc0334ull;
    g_site.actor_info_lookup = 0x700108dc0cull;
    g_site.actor_info_has_tag = 0x700108e7a0ull;
    g_site.pouch_discard = 0x7000d9784cull;
    g_site.player_equipment = 0x7000570128ull;
    g_site.pouch_default_name = 0x7000d940c4ull;
    g_site.player_schedule_equip = 0x7000cbe480ull;
    g_site.pouch_equipped_snapshot = 0x7000d9f4a8ull;
    g_site.actor_index_assign = 0x7001517e60ull;
    g_site.actor_index_resolve = 0x7001517abcull;
    g_site.actor_index_release = 0x7001517f8cull;
    g_site.actor_link_release = 0x7001126464ull;
    g_site.actor_link_alive = 0x7001517e0cull;
    g_site.pouch_cleanup = 0x7000d97f68ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_refill = 0x7000e27c2cull;
    g_site.quick_sort_mapping = 0x7000e28070ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_cursor = 0x7000d665a4ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_labels = 0x7000e278c0ull;
    g_site.pouch_lock = 0x7000eaff08ull;
    g_site.pouch_unlock = 0x7000eaff18ull;
    g_site.player_actor = 0x7000cc6fd0ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_event = 0x7000d1499cull;
    g_site.quick_sort_player_busy = 0x7000d35b80ull;
    g_site.quick_drop_trash_prohibited = 0x7000d388b0ull;
    g_site.quick_drop_actor_method = 0x70007acaa0ull;
    g_site.actor_info = 0x7001e39450ull;
    missing = 1; assert(!quick_drop_action_init());
    missing = 0; assert(quick_drop_action_init() && drop_ready);
    assert(quick_drop_action_init());
    setup(); Cpu c = cpu();
    request(&c);
    assert(pending_drop.item == item && !discarded && tag_calls == 2 && lookup_calls == 1);
    assert(LD8(screen + 0x38e4) != 2);
    // Held D-pad and visible background no longer block the action.
    ST32(bg + 0x20, 0x3f800000); buttons = 1 << 14;
    Cpu before = c; quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(discarded == 1 && sweeps == 1 && !snapshots && !pending_drop.item && depth == 0 && !memcmp(&c, &before, sizeof c));
    assert(counts[0] == 0 && inventory[0][0] == 0);
    quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(discarded == 1);
    assert(LD32(screen + 0x3880) == 0 && (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c) == -1);
    assert(LD8(screen + 0x38e4) != 2 && LD32(screen + 0x3738) == 0);
    // Removing the first of two entries retains a usable cursor on its neighbor.
    setup(); inventory[0][1] = item + 0x100; counts[0] = 2;
    request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(discarded == 1 && LD32(screen + 0x3880) == 1);
    assert(LD32(screen + 0x387c) == 0 && LD64(screen + 0x37c8) == item + 0x100);
    assert(LD8(screen + 0x38e4) != 2);
    // One remaining sword plus the unequip slot must both remain visible.
    assert(widget_count == 2 && widget_cursor == 1);
    for (int category = 0; category <= 2; category++) {
        setup(); ST32(screen + 0x3738, category);
        inventory[0][1] = item + 0x100; counts[0] = 2;
        request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
        assert(discarded == 1 && counts[0] == 1);
        assert(widget_count == 2 && widget_cursor == 1);
    }
    setup(); sword_special = true;
    inventory[0][1] = item + 0x100; counts[0] = 2;
    request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(widget_count == 1 && widget_cursor == 0);
    // Resolve by identity again if inventory ordering changed before execution.
    setup(); request(&c); inventory[0][0] = 0; counts[0] = 0;
    inventory[1][0] = item; counts[1] = 1; hidden(); quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(discarded == 1);
    // Stale/mutated requests cancel without destructive fallback.
    setup(); request(&c); ST32(item + 0x20, 14); hidden(); quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!discarded && !pending_drop.item);
    setup(); request(&c); inventory[0][0] = 0; hidden(); quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!discarded && !pending_drop.item);
    setup(); request(&c); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); hidden(); quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!discarded);
    // The equipment cache can change after preflight, independently of the
    // item's flag. Staged unequipped requests cannot become equipped drops.
    setup(); request(&c); ST64(mgr + 0x447e0, item); hidden(); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(!discarded && !pending_drop.item);
    setup(); request(&c); trash = true; hidden(); quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!discarded);
    // Enqueue guards, including every native restriction and actor lookup failure.
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(!discarded && !quick_drop_action_busy()); // empty snapshot does not prove a live equipped actor
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x25, 0); reject_case(&c);
    setup(); ST32(item + 0x20, 0); reject_case(&c);
    setup(); ST32(item + 0x18, 2); reject_case(&c);
    setup(); strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)actor, "Weapon_Sword_070"); reject_case(&c);
    setup(); strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)actor, "Weapon_Sword_502"); reject_case(&c);
    setup(); trash = true; reject_case(&c);
    setup(); equip_ban = true; reject_case(&c);
    setup(); event = true; reject_case(&c);
    setup(); popup = true; reject_case(&c);
    setup(); popup = true; event = true; reject_case(&c);
    setup(); player_ban = true; reject_case(&c);
    setup(); ST8(player + 0xcf8, 4); reject_case(&c);
    setup(); lookup_ok = false; reject_case(&c); assert(!tag_calls);
    setup(); tag_important = true; reject_case(&c);
    setup(); tag_notdrop = true; reject_case(&c);
    setup(); request(&c); Cpu other = c; other.x[0] = screen + 0x10000;
    hidden(); quick_drop_action_close(&other); assert(!discarded && pending_drop.item);
    quick_drop_action_close(&other); assert(LD8(other.x[0] + 0x38e4) == 0);
    quick_drop_action_reset(); assert(!pending_drop.item);
    // An interrupted menu must not execute an old request on a later visit.
    setup(); request(&c); ST8(screen + 0x38e4, 2);
    quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!pending_drop.item && !discarded);
    ST8(screen + 0x38e4, 0); quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!discarded);
    setup(); request(&c); ST32(screen + 0x3738, 3);
    quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!pending_drop.item && !discarded);
    setup(); request(&c); ST32(screen + 0x3738, 1);
    quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!pending_drop.item && !discarded);
    setup(); request(&c); Cpu bad_stack = c; bad_stack.sp |= 1;
    quick_drop_action_close(&bad_stack); assert(!pending_drop.item && !discarded);
    setup(); request(&c); assert(pending_drop.item == item);
    quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(discarded == 1);
    // Turning the switch off also cancels an already queued request.
    setup(); request(&c); assert(pending_drop.item == item);
    g_settings.quick_drop = false;
    quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(!pending_drop.item && !discarded);
    request(&c); assert(!pending_drop.item && !discarded);

    g_settings.quick_drop = true;
    // Native consumer cannot advance under the selector. Each category closes
    // first, issues one discard and waits for actual actor detach/placement.
    for (int job_context = 0; job_context < 2; job_context++) for (int category = 0; category < 3; category++) {
        setup();
        weak_links = job_context;
        int type = category == 0 ? 0 : category == 1 ? 3 : 1;
        strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)actor, category == 0 ? "Weapon_Sword_001" : category == 1 ? "Weapon_Shield_001" : "Weapon_Bow_001");
        ST32(item + 0x18, type); ST32(screen + 0x3738, category);
        ST8(item + 0x24, 1);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (i != (unsigned)type) ST64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8, equipment + 0x100 + i * 8);
        assert(!LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + type * 8)); // native quick menu leaves this snapshot empty
        native_equipment = equipment;
        buttons = 1 | (1 << 3) | (1 << 14);
        request(&c); assert(quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_PENDING);
        before = c; quick_drop_action_close(&c);
        assert(!memcmp(&c, &before, sizeof c) && discarded == 1 && !sweeps);
        assert(quick_drop_action_busy() && LD8(screen + 0x38e4) == 2 && schedules == 1 && snapshots == 1);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) assert(LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8) == saved_cache[i]);
        assert(LD32(player + 0xc98) & 0x20);
        assert(LD32(screen + 0x387c) == LD32(screen + 0x3878));
        assert((consumed & buttons) == buttons);
        assert(LD8(player + drop_pending_offset(category)));
        quick_drop_action_close(&c); request(&c); assert(discarded == 1);
        // No runtime item dereference is permitted after native invalidation.
        assert(!mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)item, 0x1000, PROT_NONE));
        quick_drop_action_tick(&c); assert(!sweeps && quick_drop_action_busy());
        // A cleared flag alone does not prove consumer work or world placement.
        ST8(player + drop_pending_offset(category), 0);
        quick_drop_action_tick(&c); assert(!sweeps && quick_drop_action_busy()); // getter still holds outgoing actor
        native_equipment = 0;
        ST8(equipment + 0x920, 0xff);
        quick_drop_action_tick(&c); assert(!sweeps && quick_drop_action_busy());
        // A foreign actor, method, result or transaction cannot acknowledge
        // this drop merely because the same virtual callback ran.
        uint64_t token = rt_quick_drop_actor_begin(equipment, g_site.quick_drop_actor_method);
        assert(token && !rt_quick_drop_actor_begin(equipment, g_site.quick_drop_actor_method + 4));
        rt_quick_drop_actor_end(token + 1, equipment, 1);
        rt_quick_drop_actor_end(token, equipment + 0x100, 1);
        rt_quick_drop_actor_end(token, equipment, 0);
        assert(!atomic_load(&drop_actor_consumed));
        // Only the real matching virtual call records consumption.
        Cpu native = cpu(); native.x[0] = equipment; native.x[30] = 0x7001223f54ull;
        Cpu native_expected = native; actor_original(&native_expected); actor_drops = 0;
        observed_actor(&native); assert(actor_drops == 1 && !memcmp(&native, &native_expected, sizeof native));
        quick_drop_action_tick(&c); assert(!sweeps && quick_drop_action_busy());
        ST8(equipment + 0x934, 0); ST8(equipment + 0x920, 0xff);
        quick_drop_action_tick(&c); assert(!sweeps); // owner links still attached
        owner_attached = false;
        quick_drop_action_tick(&c); assert(!sweeps); // queued default update still pending
        ST8(player + 0x1120 + category, 0);
        assert(!mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)item, 0x1000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE));
        quick_drop_action_tick(&c);
        assert(sweeps == 1 && discarded == 1 && !quick_drop_action_busy());
        assert(quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_COMPLETE);
        quick_drop_action_tick(&c); assert(sweeps == 1 && actor_drops == 1);
    }
    // A conflicting populated category snapshot and duplicate equipped flags
    // reject rather than using a rebuilt snapshot to hide ambiguous identity.
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); native_equipment = equipment;
    ST64(mgr + 0x447e0, item + 0x100); reject_case(&c); assert(!snapshots);
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); native_equipment = equipment;
    inventory[0][1] = item + 0x100; counts[0] = 2;
    ST32(item + 0x118, 0); ST8(item + 0x124, 1); ST8(item + 0x125, 1);
    request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(!discarded && !schedules && !snapshots && !quick_drop_action_busy());
    // Snapshot preparation can fail without changing any of its four prior
    // words, item validity, actor ownership, input gate, or inventory.
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); native_equipment = equipment; snapshot_failure = true;
    for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; i++) ST64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8, equipment + i * 8);
    request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(snapshots == 1 && !discarded && !schedules && !quick_drop_action_busy());
    assert(LD8(item + 0x25) && LD8(item + 0x24) && !LD8(links + 0xc) && LD32(links + 8) == UINT32_MAX);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) assert(LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8) == saved_cache[i]);
    // Every cached native action/edge is cleared on admission and each UI
    // update, while a worker may interleave between discard and scheduling.
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); ST64(mgr + 0x447e0, item); native_equipment = equipment;
    Cpu ui = cpu(); ui.x[0] = ui_manager;
    ST32(ui_input + 0x114, UINT32_MAX); ST32(ui_input + 8, UINT32_MAX);
    quick_drop_action_tick(&ui); // capture manager input before Menu::execute
    assert(LD32(ui_input + 0x114) == UINT32_MAX); // inactive driver leaves input alone
    interleave_drop = protect_after_discard = true;
    request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(discarded == 1 && schedules == 1 && actor_drops == 1 && !sweeps);
    assert(!LD32(ui_input + 0x114) && !LD32(ui_input + 8));
    assert(quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_PENDING && quick_drop_action_busy());
    for (int poll = 0; poll < 7; poll++) {
        ST32(ui_input + 0x114, UINT32_MAX); ST32(ui_input + 8, UINT32_MAX);
        before = ui; quick_drop_action_tick(&ui);
        assert(!memcmp(&ui, &before, sizeof ui));
        assert(!LD32(ui_input + 0x114) && !LD32(ui_input + 8) && !sweeps);
        assert(quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(UINT64_MAX) == UINT64_C(0xff0000));
    }
    g_settings.quick_drop = false; frame += 700;
    quick_drop_action_tick(&ui);
    assert(quick_drop_action_busy() && quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_PENDING && !sweeps);
    assert(quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(UINT64_MAX) == UINT64_C(0xff0000));
    ST8(player + 0x1120, 0);
    assert(!mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)item, 0x1000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE));
    quick_drop_action_tick(&ui);
    assert(!quick_drop_action_busy() && quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_COMPLETE);
    assert(sweeps == 1 && discarded == 1 && schedules == 1 && actor_drops == 1);
    assert(quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(UINT64_MAX) == UINT64_MAX);
    g_settings.quick_drop = true;
    // Scheduler may execute immediately too, with the source item page
    // inaccessible already. Completion still awaits the guest driver/sweep.
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); ST64(mgr + 0x447e0, item); native_equipment = equipment;
    protect_after_discard = consume_scheduler_immediately = true;
    request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(discarded == 1 && schedules == 1 && actor_drops == 1 && !sweeps);
    assert(quick_drop_action_busy() && quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_PENDING);
    assert(!mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)item, 0x1000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE));
    quick_drop_action_tick(&ui);
    assert(!quick_drop_action_busy() && quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_COMPLETE);
    assert(sweeps == 1 && discarded == 1 && actor_drops == 1);
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); ST64(mgr + 0x447e0, item); native_equipment = equipment;
    weak_links = true; request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(discarded == 1 && schedules == 1 && quick_drop_action_busy());
    assert(LD32(equipment_block + 0x50) == 1 && LD32(player_block + 0x50) == 1);
    assert(!LD64(links + 0x28) && !LD64(links + 0x40)); // callback links released
    consume_native_drop(&c); ST8(player + 0x1120, 0); quick_drop_action_tick(&c);
    assert(!quick_drop_action_busy() && quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_COMPLETE);
    assert(!LD32(equipment_block + 0x50) && !LD32(player_block + 0x50));
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); native_equipment = equipment;
    retain_failure = true; request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(!discarded && !schedules && !quick_drop_action_busy());
    assert(quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_REJECTED && !LD8(links + 0xc));
    // Generation mismatch must stop before stale actor fields are read.
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); native_equipment = equipment;
    weak_links = true; request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    ST32(equipment_block + 0x40, 43);
    assert(!mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)equipment, 0x1000, PROT_NONE));
    quick_drop_action_tick(&c);
    assert(quick_drop_action_busy() && equipped_drop.recovery && !sweeps);
    assert(!mprotect((void *)(uintptr_t)equipment, 0x1000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE));
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); ST64(mgr + 0x447e0, item); native_equipment = equipment;
    ST8(player + 0x1120, 1); request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(!discarded && !quick_drop_action_busy() && quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_REJECTED);
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); ST64(mgr + 0x447e0, item); native_equipment = equipment;
    ST8(player + 0x13e0, 1); request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c);
    assert(!discarded && !quick_drop_action_busy() && quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_REJECTED);
    setup(); ST8(item + 0x24, 1); ST64(mgr + 0x447e0, item); native_equipment = equipment;
    request(&c); quick_drop_action_close(&c); assert(quick_drop_action_busy());
    current_player = player + 0x2000; frame += 700; quick_drop_action_tick(&c);
    assert(equipped_drop.recovery && quick_drop_action_busy() && discarded == 1 && !sweeps);
    assert(quick_drop_action_result() == QUICK_DROP_PENDING);
    g_settings.quick_drop = false; quick_drop_action_close(&c); quick_drop_action_tick(&c);
    assert(quick_drop_action_busy()); // settings/timeout cannot roll back invalidation
    quick_drop_action_reset(); assert(!quick_drop_action_busy());

    puts("quick-drop action tests passed");
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_quick_drop_codegen.py`:

```py
"""Checked native drop hooks, using synthetic AArch64 and no game files."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch
import gen
import patches

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BASE, TARGET = 0x7000000000, 0x7000000020
RET, NOP = 0xd65f03c0, 0xd503201f
for actor_call in (False, True):
    for locals_ in (None, gen.Locals()):
        for link in (False, True):
            branch = (0x94000000 if link else 0x14000000) | ((TARGET - BASE) // 4)
            body = [0xa9bf7bfd, 0xd63f0100, 0xa8c17bfd, RET] if actor_call else [0xd10183ff, 0x910183ff, RET]
            words = [branch, RET] + [NOP] * 6 + body
            image = struct.pack(f'<{len(words)}I', *words)
            fake = SimpleNamespace(text=(0, len(image)), image=image, build_id='00' * 16, syms=[], relocs=[])
            with patch.object(gen, 'Nso', return_value=fake), patch.object(gen, 'eh_frame_extents', return_value=[]):
                m = gen.Module('main', 'synthetic.nso', BASE, simd='c', locals_=locals_)
            site = 'quick_drop_actor_call' if actor_call else 'quick_drop_tick'
            address = TARGET + (4 if actor_call else 0)
            m.patches = patches.table({site: address})
            refs = set()
            caller = '\n'.join(m._emit_body(BASE, BASE + (8 if link else 4), set(), {}, refs, 'plain'))
            callee = '\n'.join(m._emit_body(TARGET, TARGET + len(body) * 4, set(), {}, set(), 'plain'))
            assert TARGET in refs and 'rt_dispatch(c)' not in caller
            assert callee.count('rt_dispatch(c)') == int(actor_call)
            m.nso.image = bytes(len(image))
            try:
                m.patches[address](m, address)
            except AssertionError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError('changed instruction accepted')
            source = f'''
#include <assert.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "cpu.h"
volatile int g_fnprof;
void fnprof_hit(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t d) {{ (void)a; (void)b; (void)d; }}
static Cpu expected;
static int ticks, begins, dispatches, ends;
static uint64_t token;
void quick_drop_action_tick(Cpu *c) {{ assert(!memcmp(c, &expected, sizeof *c)); ticks++; }}
uint64_t rt_quick_drop_actor_begin(uint64_t actor, uint64_t method) {{
    assert(actor == 0x1111 && method == 0x5555); begins++; return token;
}}
void rt_dispatch(Cpu *c) {{
    assert(c->x[0] == 0x1111 && c->pc == 0x5555 && c->x[30] == {TARGET + 8:#x}ull);
    dispatches++; c->x[0] = 1; c->x[3] = 0xdeadbeef; c->v[0] = 0x2222; c->nzcv = 0x70000000; c->pc = 0x7777;
}}
void rt_quick_drop_actor_end(uint64_t seen, uint64_t actor, uint64_t result) {{
    assert(seen == token && actor == 0x1111 && result == 1); ends++;
}}
void {gen.fname(TARGET)}(Cpu *c);
{caller}
{callee}
int main(void) {{
    for (int pending = 0; pending < 2; pending++) {{
        _Alignas(16) unsigned char stack[256] = {{0}};
        Cpu c = {{0}};
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) c.x[i] = 0x100 + i;
        c.x[0] = 0x1111; c.x[8] = 0x5555;
        c.sp = (uintptr_t)(stack + sizeof stack); c.nzcv = 0xa0000000; c.pc = 0x1234;
        expected = c; expected.x[30] = {BASE + 4 if link else 0x100 + 30:#x}ull;
        token = pending ? 0x42 : 0;
        {gen.fname(BASE)}(&c);
        if ({int(actor_call)}) {{
            expected.x[0] = 1; expected.x[3] = 0xdeadbeef; expected.v[0] = 0x2222;
            expected.nzcv = 0x70000000; expected.pc = 0x7777;
            assert(dispatches == pending + 1 && begins == dispatches && ends == dispatches);
        }} else assert(ticks == pending + 1);
        assert(!memcmp(&c, &expected, sizeof c));
    }}
}}
'''
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='quick-drop-codegen-') as directory:
                exe = Path(directory) / 'check'
                subprocess.run([os.environ.get('CC', 'clang'), '-std=gnu11', '-O1', '-fno-strict-aliasing',
                                '-I', str(ROOT / 'runtime'), '-x', 'c', '-', '-o', str(exe), '-lm'],
                               input=source, text=True, check=True)
                subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True)
print('ok: direct tick hooks, checked BLR actor observation, native result/LR/FP/flags with and without locals')
```

```c
// Real HID fill pipeline and equipped action gate, without game/renderer.
#include <assert.h>
#include "../runtime/hle.h"
#undef HLE_FUNC

#include "../runtime/quick_drop_action.c"

Settings g_settings;
void act_poll(bool live) { (void)live; }
uint64_t g_watch_lo, g_watch_hi;
static uint64_t test_frame = 100, pointer_injection, control_injection;
static bool game_menu = true;
bool menu_input_captured(void) { return false; }
bool menu_cursor_free(void) { return false; }
bool framepace_title_ui(void) { return false; }
bool framepace_menu_ui(void) { return game_menu; }

    (void)lx; (void)ly; (void)rx; (void)ry; *buttons |= control_injection;
}
static uint64_t sample(void) {
    uint64_t state[5]; uint32_t id = 0; Cpu cpu = {0};
    cpu.x[0] = (uintptr_t)state; cpu.x[1] = (uintptr_t)&id;
    fill_state(&cpu);
    assert(*(int32_t *)((uint8_t *)state + 16) == 22000);
    assert(*(int32_t *)((uint8_t *)state + 24) == -22000);
    return state[1];
}
int main(void) {
    uint64_t back = 1ull << BTN_B, right = 1ull << BTN_RIGHT, attack = 1ull << BTN_Y;
    assert(unconsumed_buttons(right | attack) == (right | attack));
    input_consume_buttons(right | back);
    assert(unconsumed_buttons(right | back | attack) == attack);
    assert(unconsumed_buttons(right | back) == 0);
    assert(unconsumed_buttons(right) == 0);
    assert(unconsumed_buttons(back | right) == back);
    assert(unconsumed_buttons(0) == 0);
    assert(unconsumed_buttons(right | back) == (right | back));
    unconsumed_buttons(0);

    script_lx = 22000; script_rx = -22000;

    script_buttons = attack; key_buttons = 1ull << BTN_MINUS; pad_buttons = 1ull << BTN_ZR;
    pointer_injection = 1ull << BTN_A;
    control_injection = (1ull << BTN_L) | right;
    menu_confirm = true; g_inject_plus = 1;
    const uint64_t actions = attack | (1ull << BTN_MINUS) | (1ull << BTN_ZR) |
        (1ull << BTN_A) | (1ull << BTN_PLUS) | control_injection;
    assert(sample() == (actions | directions)); // baseline exercises all injection stages

    atomic_store(&equipped_drop.active, true);
    g_settings.quick_drop = false; // admitted cleanup/gate survives settings changes
    for (int frame = 0; frame < 5; frame++, test_frame++)
        for (int poll = 0; poll < 7; poll++) assert(sample() == directions);
    for (unsigned bit = 0; bit < 32; bit++) {
        control_injection = 1ull << bit;
        uint64_t expected = directions | (control_injection & UINT64_C(0xff0000));
        assert(sample() == expected);
    }
    // New injections arriving after admission are not in the original raw
    // snapshot. Exercise each late producer while the real gate stays active.
    script_buttons = key_buttons = pad_buttons = pointer_injection = control_injection = 0;
    menu_confirm = false; test_frame += 20; assert(sample() == directions);
    pointer_injection = 1ull << BTN_A; assert(sample() == directions);
    pointer_injection = 0; assert(sample() == directions);
    menu_confirm = true; assert(sample() == directions);
    menu_confirm = false; assert(sample() == directions);
    g_inject_plus = 1; assert(sample() == directions); assert(sample() == directions);
    control_injection = (1ull << BTN_MINUS) | (1ull << BTN_R); assert(sample() == directions);
    script_buttons = attack; key_buttons = 1ull << BTN_MINUS; pad_buttons = 1ull << BTN_ZR;
    pointer_injection = 1ull << BTN_A; menu_confirm = true;
    control_injection = (1ull << BTN_L) | right;
    assert(sample() == directions);
    atomic_store(&equipped_drop.active, false);
    // Inputs observed while busy remain consumed until released, including
    // pointer/Enter/latched Plus/control inputs absent from the raw snapshot.
    assert(sample() == directions);
    script_buttons = key_buttons = pad_buttons = pointer_injection = control_injection = 0;
    menu_confirm = false; test_frame += 20; assert(sample() == directions);
    script_buttons = actions;
    assert(sample() == (actions | directions)); // release allows a genuinely new press
    atomic_store(&equipped_drop.active, true);
    assert(quick_drop_action_filter_buttons(UINT64_MAX) == UINT64_C(0xff0000));
    atomic_store(&equipped_drop.active, false);
    puts("input consumption and equipped HID gate tests passed");
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_quick_drop_menu.c`:

```c
// Selector edges and exact locked identity lookup; no game files or window.
#include <assert.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include "../runtime/quick_drop.c"

GameSites g_site;
static bool enabled = true, available = true, duplicate;
static uint64_t buttons, consumed;
static int depth, locks, unlocks, requests;
static QuickDropResult result;
static const uint64_t mgr = 0x7240000000ull, screen = 0x7240050000ull;
static const uint64_t item = 0x7240048000ull, name = 0x7240055000ull;
bool quick_drop_action_enabled(void) { return enabled; }
bool quick_drop_action_init(void) { return available; }
QuickDropResult quick_drop_action_result(void) { return result; }
uint64_t input_buttons_now(void) { return buttons; }
void input_consume_buttons(uint64_t mask) { consumed |= mask; }
void quick_drop_action_close(Cpu *c) { (void)c; }
void quick_drop_action_request(Cpu *c, uint64_t s, uint64_t m, uint64_t p, int tab, int slot, const char *n) {
    (void)c;
    assert(s == screen && m == mgr && p == item && tab == 0 && slot == 1 && !depth);
    assert(!strcmp(n, "Weapon_Sword_001"));
    requests++; result = QUICK_DROP_PENDING;
}
void guest_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t entry) {
    if (entry == g_site.pouch_lock) { assert(c->x[0] == mgr + 0x28 && !depth); depth++; locks++; }
    else if (entry == g_site.pouch_unlock) { assert(c->x[0] == mgr + 0x28 && depth == 1); depth--; unlocks++; }
    else if (entry == g_site.pouch_page_count) { assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr); c->x[0] = c->x[1] == 0 || duplicate ? 2 : 0; }
    else if (entry == g_site.pouch_page_item) { assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr); c->x[0] = c->x[2] == 1 ? item : 0; }
    else assert(0);
    c->x[4] = 0xdead; c->pc = 0xbeef; c->nzcv = 0x10000000; c->v[0] = 0x1234;
}
static void edge(Cpu *c, uint64_t b) {
    buttons = 0; rt_quick_drop_menu(c);
    buttons = b; rt_quick_drop_menu(c);
}
int main(void) {
    void *memory = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)mgr, 0x60000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                        MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
    assert(memory == (void *)(uintptr_t)mgr);
    g_site.pouch_lock = 1; g_site.pouch_unlock = 2;
    g_site.pouch_page_count = 3; g_site.pouch_page_item = 4;
    ST64(screen + 0x3640, mgr); ST32(screen + 0x3738, 0);
    ST32(screen + 0x3878, 0); ST32(screen + 0x387c, 1); ST32(screen + 0x3880, 2);
    ST64(screen + 0x37d0, item); ST32(mgr + 0x44498, 2);
    ST8(item + 0x25, 1); ST32(item + 0x20, 2000); ST64(item + 0x30, name);
    strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)name, "Weapon_Sword_001");
    Cpu c = {.sp = mgr + 0x5f000, .nzcv = 0xa0000000}; c.x[0] = screen; c.x[4] = 44; c.v[0] = 99;
    Cpu before = c;
    buttons = QUICK_DROP_BUTTON; rt_quick_drop_begin(&c); rt_quick_drop_menu(&c);
    assert(!requests && quick_drop_hint_state() == 2);
    edge(&c, QUICK_DROP_BUTTON);
    assert(requests == 1 && (consumed & QUICK_DROP_BUTTON));
    rt_quick_drop_menu(&c); assert(requests == 1);
    assert(!memcmp(&c, &before, sizeof c) && !depth && locks == unlocks);
    duplicate = true; edge(&c, QUICK_DROP_BUTTON); assert(requests == 1); duplicate = false;
    ST32(screen + 0x3880, 0); edge(&c, QUICK_DROP_BUTTON); assert(requests == 1);
    ST32(screen + 0x3880, 2); consumed = 0;
    edge(&c, QUICK_BACK_BUTTON | QUICK_DROP_BUTTON | (1 << 14));
    assert(requests == 1 && LD8(screen + 0x38e4) == 2);
    assert(LD32(screen + 0x387c) == LD32(screen + 0x3878));
    assert(consumed == (QUICK_BACK_BUTTON | (1 << 14)));
    assert(!memcmp(&c, &before, sizeof c));
    enabled = false; ST8(screen + 0x38e4, 0);
    edge(&c, QUICK_DROP_BUTTON); assert(requests == 1 && !quick_drop_hint_state());
    enabled = true; available = false;
    edge(&c, QUICK_DROP_BUTTON); assert(requests == 1);
    quick_drop_reset(); assert(!menu_screen && !menu_buttons && !atomic_load(&drop_hint));
    puts("ok: held-Y entry, one request per edge, exact locked identity, CPU preservation, Back priority and disabled guards");
}
```

```cpp
// Exercise real game-font decoding without booting the guest. Supply a RomFS
// directory from the user's dump; no font fixtures are stored in the repository.
#include <assert.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include "../runtime/ui/quick_hint_font.mm"
extern "C" {
#include "../runtime/settings.h"
#include "../runtime/input_bind.h"
const char *g_romfs_dir;
Settings g_settings;
static int device = DEVICE_PAD, family;
int input_last_device(void) { return device; }
int input_pad_family(void) { return family; }
bool pc_cursor_preview_active(void) { return false; }
bool pc_cursor_sensor_active(void) { return false; }
bool rt_resource(const char *name, const char *dev_rel, char *out, size_t cap) {
    (void)name;
    snprintf(out, cap, "%s", dev_rel);
    FILE *file = fopen(out, "rb");
    if (!file) return false;
    fclose(file);
    return true;
}
}
const char *tr(const char *s) {
    return !strcmp(s, "Sort") ? "Сортировать" : !strcmp(s, "Drop") ? "Выбросить" : !strcmp(s, "Back") ? "Назад" : s;
}

static std::vector<unsigned char> button_mask(int kind) {
    ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImFontAtlas *atlas = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts;
    atlas->AddFontDefault();
    g_settings.button_icons = kind;
    ImFont *text, *buttons;
    quick_hint_fonts_load(atlas, &text, &buttons);
    assert(buttons);
    unsigned char *pixels; int w, h;
    atlas->GetTexDataAsAlpha8(&pixels, &w, &h);
    const ImFontGlyph *g = buttons->FindGlyphNoFallback(0xe042);
    assert(g && g->Visible);
    std::vector<unsigned char> result;
    for (int y = (int)(g->V0 * h); y < (int)(g->V1 * h); y++)
        for (int x = (int)(g->U0 * w); x < (int)(g->U1 * w); x++) result.push_back(pixels[y * w + x]);
    ImGui::DestroyContext();
    return result;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    assert(argc == 2);
    unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_ROMFS_OVERLAY");
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_PAD);
    bind_reset(BIND_DEV_KEY);
    g_settings.button_icons = ICONS_NINTENDO;
    ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImFontAtlas *atlas = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts;
    atlas->AddFontDefault();
    ImFont *text, *buttons;
    g_romfs_dir = "/nonexistent";
    quick_hint_fonts_load(atlas, &text, &buttons);
    assert(!text && !buttons); // missing optional resources preserve fallback
    g_romfs_dir = argv[1];
    quick_hint_fonts_load(atlas, &text, &buttons);
    assert(text && buttons);
    assert(text->FindGlyphNoFallback(0x440)); // Cyrillic р from the translated Sort label
    assert(text->FindGlyphNoFallback(0x412)); // Cyrillic В from Drop
    assert(text->FindGlyphNoFallback(0x44b)); // ы from Drop
    assert(text->FindGlyphNoFallback(0x421)); // С appears only in the translated Sort label
    assert(buttons->FindGlyphNoFallback(0xe041));
    assert(text->CalcTextSizeA(32, FLT_MAX, 0, "Сортировать").x > 100);
    const ImFontGlyph *a = text->FindGlyphNoFallback('A');
    assert(a && a->Visible && a->AdvanceX > 15);
    unsigned char *rgba; int w, h;
    atlas->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&rgba, &w, &h);
    assert(w > 0 && h > 0);
    // Native letters and icon masks must contain coverage, not blank rectangles.
    const ImFontGlyph *masks[] = {a, buttons->FindGlyphNoFallback(0xe041)};
    for (const ImFontGlyph *g : masks) {
        int lit = 0;
        for (int y = (int)(g->V0 * h); y < (int)(g->V1 * h); y++)
            for (int x = (int)(g->U0 * w); x < (int)(g->U1 * w); x++)
                lit += rgba[(y * w + x) * 4 + 3] > 128;
        assert(lit > 30);
    }
    // Invalid font headers must fail without registering custom cells.
    unsigned char damaged[128] = {};
    std::vector<Cell> cells;
    assert(!append(atlas, damaged, sizeof damaged, {65}, cells));
    assert(!append(atlas, damaged, 4, {65}, cells));
    assert(cells.empty());
    ImGui::DestroyContext();

    auto native = button_mask(ICONS_NINTENDO);
    auto xbox = button_mask(ICONS_XBOX);
    auto ps = button_mask(ICONS_PLAYSTATION);
    auto keyboard = button_mask(ICONS_KEYBOARD);
    assert(native != xbox && xbox != ps && ps != keyboard);
    g_bind_pad[BIND_X] = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH;
    auto ps_remapped = button_mask(ICONS_PLAYSTATION);
    assert(ps_remapped != ps);
    g_bind_key[BIND_X] = SDL_SCANCODE_Q;
    auto key_remapped = button_mask(ICONS_KEYBOARD);
    assert(key_remapped != keyboard);
    g_bind_key[BIND_X] = BIND_MOUSE + SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT;
    auto mouse = button_mask(ICONS_KEYBOARD);
    assert(mouse != key_remapped);
    device = DEVICE_PAD; family = 2;
    assert(button_mask(ICONS_AUTO) == ps_remapped);
    device = DEVICE_KEYBOARD;
    assert(button_mask(ICONS_AUTO) == mouse);

    // A synthetic replacement sheet must retain its own art, like a mod.
    std::vector<unsigned char> modified(0x20000, 0), linear(0x20000, 0x5a), before = linear;
    uint64_t source = (uintptr_t)modified.data();
    assert(!glyphs_apply(source, source, source + modified.size(), 0x49, 256, 1024,
                         linear.data(), 64, 256));
    assert(linear == before);

    // A replacement archive takes precedence over the base game's font. Use
    // deliberately invalid synthetic bytes, never a bundled game fixture.
    char overlay[] = "/tmp/quick-sort-font-XXXXXX";
    assert(mkdtemp(overlay));
    std::string directory = std::string(overlay) + "/Font";
    std::string file = directory + "/Font_EU.sbfarc";
    assert(!mkdir(directory.c_str(), 0700));
    FILE *replacement = fopen(file.c_str(), "wb");
    assert(replacement && fwrite("synthetic", 1, 9, replacement) == 9);
    fclose(replacement);
    setenv("SAVAGEWIND_ROMFS_OVERLAY", overlay, 1);
    ImGui::CreateContext();
    atlas = ImGui::GetIO().Fonts;
    atlas->AddFontDefault();
    quick_hint_fonts_load(atlas, &text, &buttons);
    assert(!text && !buttons);
    ImGui::DestroyContext();
    unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_ROMFS_OVERLAY");
    assert(!unlink(file.c_str()) && !rmdir(directory.c_str()) && !rmdir(overlay));
    puts("ok: bitmap text, Cyrillic, four icon families, pad/key/mouse remaps, Auto, modified sheets and overlay precedence");
}
```

```c
// Native sort boundaries: instance identity, category mapping, input priority,
// unchanged guest registers/equipment, and strict pre-mutation rejection.
#include <assert.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include "../runtime/quick_inventory_sort.c"

const char *g_game_version = "1.9.0";
static const uint64_t mgr = 0x7240000000ull, screen = 0x7240050000ull;
static const uint64_t item_base = 0x7240048000ull, widget = 0x7240054000ull;
static uint64_t buttons, consumed, live[20];
static bool unknown, duplicate, event, modal, missing_helper;
static int depth, locks, unlocks, sorts, fill_calls, widget_calls, labels, category, count = 3;
static int expected_cursor, expected_cells;

Settings g_settings = {.quick_sort = true};
GameSites g_site;
uint64_t input_buttons_now(void) { return buttons; }
void input_consume_buttons(uint64_t b) { consumed |= b; }
static void noop(Cpu *c) { (void)c; }
GuestFn dispatch_lookup(uint64_t entry) { (void)entry; return missing_helper ? NULL : noop; }

static void fill(void) {
    int equipped = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        ST64(screen + 0x37c8 + i * 8, live[i]);
        if (LD8(live[i] + 0x24)) equipped = i;
    }
    ST32(screen + 0x3880, count);
    ST32(screen + 0x3878, equipped); ST32(screen + 0x387c, equipped);
}
static void mapping(void) {
    // Exercise both widget-map shapes; production derives the extra cell from
    // the native mapping rather than assuming a category-specific count.
    int extra = category != 2;
    for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) ST32(screen + 0x3884 + i * 4, -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) ST32(screen + 0x3884 + (i + extra) * 4, i);
}
void guest_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t entry) {
    if (entry == 0x7000eaff08ull) {
        assert(c->x[0] == mgr + 0x28 && depth == 0); depth++; locks++;
    } else if (entry == 0x7000eaff18ull) {
        assert(c->x[0] == mgr + 0x28 && depth == 1); depth--; unlocks++;
    } else if (entry == 0x7000d1499cull) c->x[0] = event;
    else if (entry == 0x7000d35b80ull) c->x[0] = 0;
    else if (entry == 0x7000e7e750ull) c->x[0] = modal;
    else if (entry == 0x7000d91414ull) {
        assert(depth == 1); c->x[0] = unknown ? -1 : sort_types[category];
    } else if (entry == 0x7000d970a8ull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr && c->x[1] < 1); c->x[0] = count;
    } else if (entry == 0x7000d992acull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr && c->x[1] == 0 && c->x[2] < (unsigned)count);
        c->x[0] = duplicate ? live[0] : live[c->x[2]];
    } else if (entry == 0x7000d980a0ull) {
        static const int native[] = {0, 2, 1};
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == mgr && c->x[1] == (unsigned)native[category] && c->x[2] == 0);
        sorts++;
        // Rotate instances, including duplicates with distinct modifiers.
        uint64_t last = live[count - 1];
        for (int i = count - 1; i > 0; i--) live[i] = live[i - 1];
        live[0] = last;
    } else if (entry == 0x7000e27c2cull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == screen && c->x[1] == (unsigned)category); fill_calls++; fill();
    } else if (entry == 0x7000e28070ull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == screen); mapping();
    } else if (entry == 0x7000d665a4ull) {
        assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == widget && c->x[1] == (unsigned)expected_cursor &&
               c->x[2] == (unsigned)expected_cells); widget_calls++;
    } else if (entry == 0x7000e278c0ull) { assert(depth == 1 && c->x[0] == screen); labels++; }
    else { fprintf(stderr, "unexpected sort guest call: %" PRIx64 "\n", entry); abort(); }
    c->x[10] = 0xdead; c->pc = 0xbeef; c->v[0] = 0x1234; c->nzcv = 0xa0000000;
}
static void setup(int cat) {
    category = cat;
    ST64(screen + 0x3640, mgr); ST64(screen + 0x37a8, widget);
    ST32(screen + 0x3738, cat); ST8(screen + 0x38e4, 0); ST32(mgr + 0x44498, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ST64(mgr + 0x447e0 + i * 8, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        uint64_t item = live[i] = item_base + i * 0x100;
        ST32(item + 0x18, sort_types[cat]); ST32(item + 0x20, 100 - i);
        ST8(item + 0x24, i == 0); ST8(item + 0x25, 1);
        ST64(item + 0x30, item_base + 0x3000); ST32(item + 0x80, i + 7);
    }
    strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)(item_base + 0x3000), "Weapon_SameName");
    ST64(mgr + 0x447e0 + sort_types[cat] * 8, item_base);
    fill(); mapping(); ST32(screen + 0x387c, 1);
}
static void edge(Cpu *c, uint64_t b) {
    buttons = 0; rt_quick_inventory_sort_menu(c);
    buttons = b; rt_quick_inventory_sort_menu(c);
}
int main(void) {
    void *mem = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)mgr, 0x60000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                    MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
    assert(mem == (void *)(uintptr_t)mgr);
    g_site.pouch_lock = 0x7000eaff08ull;
    g_site.pouch_unlock = 0x7000eaff18ull;
    g_site.pouch_page_count = 0x7000d970a8ull;
    g_site.pouch_page_item = 0x7000d992acull;
    g_site.pouch_item_type = 0x7000d91414ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_event = 0x7000d1499cull;
    g_site.quick_sort_player_busy = 0x7000d35b80ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_modal = 0x7000e7e750ull;
    g_site.pouch_sort = 0x7000d980a0ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_refill = 0x7000e27c2cull;
    g_site.quick_sort_mapping = 0x7000e28070ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_cursor = 0x7000d665a4ull;
    g_site.quick_sort_labels = 0x7000e278c0ull;
    missing_helper = true; assert(!quick_inventory_sort_init());
    missing_helper = false; g_game_version = "other"; assert(!quick_inventory_sort_init());
    g_game_version = "1.9.0"; assert(quick_inventory_sort_init());
    Cpu c = {.sp = mgr + 0x46000, .nzcv = 0xc0000000};
    c.x[0] = screen; c.x[3] = 31; c.v[0] = 99; c.pc = 0x7000123456;
    Cpu original = c;
    for (int cat = 0; cat < 3; cat++) {
        setup(cat); buttons = SORT_X; rt_quick_inventory_sort_begin(&c);
        int before = sorts; rt_quick_inventory_sort_menu(&c); assert(sorts == before);
        unsigned char saved_items[0x300]; memcpy(saved_items, (void *)(uintptr_t)item_base, sizeof saved_items);
        uint64_t selected_item = live[1]; expected_cursor = 2 + (cat != 2); expected_cells = count + (cat != 2);
        edge(&c, SORT_X);
        assert(sorts == before + 1 && LD64(screen + 0x37c8 + LD32(screen + 0x387c) * 8) == selected_item);
        assert(LD64(screen + 0x37c8 + LD32(screen + 0x3878) * 8) == item_base);
        assert(LD64(mgr + 0x447e0 + sort_types[cat] * 8) == item_base);
        assert(!memcmp(saved_items, (void *)(uintptr_t)item_base, sizeof saved_items));
        rt_quick_inventory_sort_menu(&c); assert(sorts == before + 1); // held: no repeat
        expected_cursor = cat != 2; edge(&c, SORT_X);
        assert(sorts == before + 2 && LD64(screen + 0x37c8 + LD32(screen + 0x387c) * 8) == selected_item);
        assert(!memcmp(&c, &original, sizeof c) && depth == 0 && locks == unlocks);
    }
    setup(0); buttons = 0; rt_quick_inventory_sort_begin(&c);
    int before = sorts;
    edge(&c, SORT_X | 2); edge(&c, SORT_X | 1); edge(&c, SORT_X | 8); assert(sorts == before);
    unknown = true; edge(&c, SORT_X); unknown = false; assert(sorts == before);
    duplicate = true; edge(&c, SORT_X); duplicate = false; assert(sorts == before);
    event = true; edge(&c, SORT_X); event = false; assert(sorts == before);
    modal = true; edge(&c, SORT_X); modal = false; assert(sorts == before);
    g_settings.quick_sort = false; edge(&c, SORT_X); g_settings.quick_sort = true; assert(sorts == before);
    ST8(live[1] + 0x25, 0); edge(&c, SORT_X); ST8(live[1] + 0x25, 1); assert(sorts == before);
    ST32(live[1] + 0x18, 3); edge(&c, SORT_X); ST32(live[1] + 0x18, 0); assert(sorts == before);
    ST32(screen + 0x3738, 3); edge(&c, SORT_X); ST32(screen + 0x3738, 0); assert(sorts == before);
    ST8(screen + 0x38e4, 2); edge(&c, SORT_X); ST8(screen + 0x38e4, 0); assert(sorts == before);
    c.sp++; edge(&c, SORT_X); c = original; assert(sorts == before);
    ST32(screen + 0x3880, 21); edge(&c, SORT_X); ST32(screen + 0x3880, 3); assert(sorts == before);
    ST64(screen + 0x37d0, GUEST_LO + 0x1000); // unmapped stale UI pointer: never dereference it
    edge(&c, SORT_X); ST64(screen + 0x37d0, live[1]); assert(sorts == before);
    c.x[0] += 0x100; edge(&c, SORT_X); c = original;
    rt_quick_inventory_sort_menu(&c); assert(sorts == before); // new screen suppresses old edge
    // Synthetic unequip survives; source selected/equipped identities stay distinct.
    ST32(screen + 0x387c, -1); expected_cursor = 0; expected_cells = 4;
    edge(&c, SORT_X); assert(sorts == before + 1 && (int32_t)LD32(screen + 0x387c) == -1);
    // Full-capacity gear with an unequip cell has 21 widget positions. The
    // selected last instance moves to index zero and remains visible there.
    count = 20; setup(0); ST32(screen + 0x387c, 19);
    uint64_t last = live[19]; expected_cursor = 1; expected_cells = 21;
    edge(&c, SORT_X);
    assert(sorts == before + 2 && LD32(screen + 0x387c) == 0 && LD64(screen + 0x37c8) == last);
    quick_inventory_sort_publish(screen); assert(quick_inventory_sort_hint());
    atomic_store(&sort_hint_time, sort_now() - 200); assert(!quick_inventory_sort_hint());
    quick_inventory_sort_reset(); assert(!quick_inventory_sort_hint());
    assert(!memcmp(&c, &original, sizeof c) && depth == 0 && locks == unlocks);
    assert(fill_calls == sorts && labels == sorts && widget_calls == sorts && consumed == SORT_X);
    munmap(mem, 0x60000);
    puts("ok: native sort categories, duplicate instance identity, equipment, CPU/locks, edges, cancel priority and guards");
}
```

`tools/test_quick_inventory_sort_codegen.py`:

```py
"""Synthetic entry patches reached through ordinary direct calls and tail calls.

Run with the generator's Python environment and clang; no game files required.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

import gen
import patches

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BASE, TARGET = 0x7000000000, 0x7000000020
RET, NOP = 0xd65f03c0, 0xd503201f


def module(words, locals_):
    fake = SimpleNamespace(text=(0, len(words) * 4), image=struct.pack(f'<{len(words)}I', *words),
                           build_id='00' * 16, syms=[], relocs=[])
    with patch.object(gen, 'Nso', return_value=fake), patch.object(gen, 'eh_frame_extents', return_value=[]):
        return gen.Module('main', 'synthetic.nso', BASE, simd='c', locals_=locals_)


for site, word, restore, hook in (
        ('quick_sort_enter', 0xfc1d0fe8, 0xfc4307e8, 'rt_quick_inventory_sort_begin'),
        ('quick_sort_menu', 0xa9be7bfd, 0xa8c27bfd, 'rt_quick_inventory_sort_menu')):
    for locals_ in (None, gen.Locals()):
        for link in (False, True):
            branch = (0x94000000 if link else 0x14000000) | ((TARGET - BASE) // 4)
            words = [branch, RET] + [NOP] * 6 + [word, restore, RET]
            m = module(words, locals_)
            m.patches = patches.table({site: TARGET})
            refs = set()
            caller = '\n'.join(m._emit_body(BASE, BASE + (8 if link else 4), set(), {}, refs, 'plain'))
            callee = '\n'.join(m._emit_body(TARGET, TARGET + 12, set(), {}, set(), 'plain'))
            assert TARGET in refs and f'{gen.fname(TARGET)}(c)' in caller
            assert 'rt_dispatch(c)' not in caller
            assert callee.count(f'{hook}(c)') == 1
            # Every replaced instruction is checked, rather than silently
            # applying a 1.9.0 layout to a different prologue.
            m.nso.image = bytes(len(m.nso.image))
            try:
                m.patches[TARGET](m, TARGET)
            except AssertionError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError('changed prologue was accepted')

            source = f'''
#include <assert.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "cpu.h"
volatile int g_fnprof;
void fnprof_hit(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t d) {{ (void)a; (void)b; (void)d; }}
static Cpu expected;
static int calls;
void rt_quick_drop_begin(Cpu *c) {{ assert(!memcmp(c, &expected, sizeof *c)); }}
void rt_quick_drop_menu(Cpu *c) {{ assert(!memcmp(c, &expected, sizeof *c)); }}
void {hook}(Cpu *c) {{ assert(!memcmp(c, &expected, sizeof *c)); calls++; }}
void {gen.fname(TARGET)}(Cpu *c);
{caller}
{callee}
int main(void) {{
    _Alignas(16) unsigned char stack[256] = {{0}};
    Cpu c = {{0}};
    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) c.x[i] = 0x100 + i;
    c.sp = (uintptr_t)(stack + sizeof stack);
    c.v[8] = 0x123456789abcdef0ull;
    c.nzcv = 0xa0000000;
    c.pc = 0x1234;
    expected = c;
    expected.x[30] = {BASE + 4 if link else 0x100 + 30:#x}ull;
    {gen.fname(BASE)}(&c);
    assert(calls == 1);
    assert(!memcmp(&c, &expected, sizeof c));
}}
'''
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='quick-sort-codegen-') as directory:
                exe = Path(directory) / 'check'
                subprocess.run([os.environ.get('CC', 'clang'), '-std=gnu11', '-O1', '-fno-strict-aliasing',
                                '-I', str(ROOT / 'runtime'), '-x', 'c', '-', '-o', str(exe), '-lm'],
                               input=source, text=True, check=True)
                subprocess.run([str(exe)], check=True)

print('ok: entry patch checks, direct BL/B coverage, original stack/register/FP/flags with and without locals')
```
