`tools/test_romfs.c`:

```c
// Checks runtime/romfs_image.c (the RomFS image the game reads, served from a folder) without the game's files: a
// folder of made-up files is laid out and read back through the image, and every file is found the way the game
// finds it (by its name's hash, in the image's own tables). Also: reads at random offsets against one whole read,
// reads from several threads at once over more files than the reader keeps open, and the romfs.bin fallback.
//   make build/test_romfs && build/test_romfs [seed]      (works in build/romfs_test, removed afterwards)
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "platform.h"  // (Windows: POSIX mkdir)
#include "romfs_image.h"

#define ROOT "build/romfs_test"
#define EMPTY 0xFFFFFFFFu

static uint64_t g_rng;
static uint64_t rnd(void) {  // splitmix64
    uint64_t z = (g_rng += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull);
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebull;
    return z ^ (z >> 31);
}

static int g_fail;
#define CHECK(c, ...) \
    do { if (!(c)) { g_fail++; fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: " __VA_ARGS__); fputc('\n', stderr); } } while (0)

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the made-up folder
typedef struct { char rel[400]; uint8_t *data; size_t size; } TestFile;
static TestFile g_files[200];
static int g_nfiles;
static char g_made[300][420];  // everything created, to remove in reverse order
static int g_nmade;

static void make_dir(const char *rel) {
    snprintf(g_made[g_nmade], sizeof g_made[0], ROOT "/romfs%s%s", *rel ? "/" : "", rel);
    mkdir(g_made[g_nmade++], 0755);
}

static void make_file(const char *rel, size_t size, bool listed) {
    uint8_t *d = malloc(size ? size : 1);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i++) d[i] = (uint8_t)rnd();
    snprintf(g_made[g_nmade], sizeof g_made[0], ROOT "/romfs/%s", rel);
    FILE *f = fopen(g_made[g_nmade++], "wb");
    if (!f || fwrite(d, 1, size, f) != size || fclose(f)) { fprintf(stderr, "can't write %s\n", rel); exit(2); }
    if (!listed) { free(d); return; }
    TestFile *t = &g_files[g_nfiles++];
    snprintf(t->rel, sizeof t->rel, "%s", rel);
    t->data = d, t->size = size;
}

static void make_tree(void) {
    mkdir("build", 0755);
    mkdir(ROOT, 0755);
    make_dir("");
    make_dir("Pack");
    make_dir("Sound");
    make_dir("Sound/Resource");
    make_dir("Sound/Resource/Stream");
    make_dir("Empty");
    make_file("Version.txt", 5, true);
    make_file("zero.bin", 0, true);
    make_file("one.bin", 1, true);
    make_file("Pack/odd.pack", 17, true);  // (the next file's data starts 16-byte aligned)
    make_file("Pack/big.pack", (3u << 20) + 7, true);
    make_file("Sound/Resource/Stream/deep.bfstm", 4096, true);
    char name[400];
    memset(name, 'n', 200);
    snprintf(name + 200, sizeof name - 200, ".long");
    make_file(name, 33, true);
    make_file(".DS_Store", 10, false);  // (hidden files aren't the game's: left out)
    for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++) {      // (more files than the reader keeps open)
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "Sound/Resource/s%02d.bars", i);
        make_file(name, 100 + rnd() % 5000, true);
    }
}

static void remove_tree(void) {
    for (int i = g_nmade - 1; i >= 0; i--) remove(g_made[i]);
    remove(ROOT "/romfs.bin");
    remove(ROOT "/moved");
    rmdir(ROOT);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ finding a file as the game does
static uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
static uint64_t rd64(const uint8_t *p) { uint64_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 8); return v; }
static uint32_t name_hash(uint32_t parent, const char *name, size_t n) {
    uint32_t h = parent ^ 123456789u;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) h = ((h >> 5) | (h << 27)) ^ (uint8_t)name[i];
    return h;
}

// the entry of name under parent in a table (dir entries: 0x18 bytes before the name, files: 0x20), EMPTY if none
static uint32_t lookup(const uint8_t *img, const uint64_t *h, bool dir, uint32_t parent, const char *name, size_t n) {
    uint64_t hash_off = dir ? h[1] : h[5], hash_size = dir ? h[2] : h[6], meta = dir ? h[3] : h[7];
    uint32_t head = dir ? 0x18 : 0x20, next_at = dir ? 0x10 : 0x18;
    uint32_t e = rd32(img + hash_off + 4 * (name_hash(parent, name, n) % (hash_size / 4)));
    while (e != EMPTY) {
        const uint8_t *p = img + meta + e;
        if (rd32(p) == parent && rd32(p + head - 4) == n && !memcmp(p + head, name, n)) return e;
        e = rd32(p + next_at);
    }
    return EMPTY;
}

static void check_files(const uint8_t *img, uint64_t size) {
    uint64_t h[10];
    memcpy(h, img, sizeof h);
    CHECK(h[0] == 0x50 && h[9] == 0x200, "header");
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nfiles; i++) {
        const TestFile *t = &g_files[i];
        uint32_t dir = 0;
        const char *s = t->rel, *slash;
        while (dir != EMPTY && (slash = strchr(s, '/'))) {
            dir = lookup(img, h, true, dir, s, (size_t)(slash - s));
            s = slash + 1;
        }
        uint32_t f = dir == EMPTY ? EMPTY : lookup(img, h, false, dir, s, strlen(s));
        CHECK(f != EMPTY, "%s not found in the tables", t->rel);
        if (f == EMPTY) continue;
        const uint8_t *e = img + h[7] + f;
        uint64_t off = h[9] + rd64(e + 8), n = rd64(e + 16);
        CHECK(n == t->size, "%s: size %llu, want %zu", t->rel, (unsigned long long)n, t->size);
        CHECK(off % 16 == 0, "%s: data not 16-byte aligned", t->rel);
        CHECK(off + n <= size && !memcmp(img + off, t->data, n), "%s: data differs", t->rel);
    }
    CHECK(lookup(img, h, false, 0, ".DS_Store", 9) == EMPTY, ".DS_Store is in the image");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ reads
static bool same_read(RomfsImage *img, const uint8_t *whole, uint64_t size, uint64_t off, uint64_t n, uint8_t *buf) {
    if (romfs_image_pread(img, buf, n, off) != (ssize_t)n) return false;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (buf[i] != (off + i < size ? whole[off + i] : 0)) return false;
    return true;
}

static uint64_t random_off(uint64_t size) {
    switch (rnd() % 4) {
    case 0: return rnd() % 0x400;         // the header
    case 1: return size - rnd() % 0x2000;  // the tables, and past the end
    default: return rnd() % size;
    }
}

typedef struct { RomfsImage *img; const uint8_t *whole; uint64_t size, seed; int bad; } Reader;

static void *reader(void *arg) {
    Reader *r = arg;
    uint8_t *buf = malloc(1 << 16);
    uint64_t z = r->seed;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4000; i++) {
        z = z * 6364136223846793005ull + 1442695040888963407ull;  // (own generator: rnd() isn't thread-safe)
        uint64_t off = (z >> 11) % r->size, n = 1 + (z >> 40) % (1 << 16);
        if (!same_read(r->img, r->whole, r->size, off, n, buf)) r->bad++;
    }
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    g_rng = argc > 1 ? strtoull(argv[1], NULL, 0) : 1;
    remove_tree();
    make_tree();
    char why[256] = "";
    RomfsImage *img = romfs_image_open(ROOT "/romfs", why, sizeof why);
    if (!img) { fprintf(stderr, "romfs_image_open: %s\n", why); remove_tree(); return 1; }
    uint64_t size = romfs_image_size(img);
    uint8_t *whole = malloc(size);
    CHECK(romfs_image_pread(img, whole, size, 0) == (ssize_t)size, "whole read");
    check_files(whole, size);

    uint8_t *buf = malloc(1 << 20);
    int bad = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 20000; i++) {
        uint64_t off = random_off(size), n = 1 + rnd() % (rnd() % 8 ? 4096 : 1 << 20);
        if (!same_read(img, whole, size, off, n, buf)) bad++;
    }
    CHECK(!bad, "%d of 20000 random reads differ", bad);

    Reader r[8];
    pthread_t t[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        r[i] = (Reader){img, whole, size, rnd(), 0};
        pthread_create(&t[i], NULL, reader, &r[i]);
    }
    bad = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) pthread_join(t[i], NULL), bad += r[i].bad;
    CHECK(!bad, "%d of 32000 reads from 8 threads differ", bad);
    romfs_image_close(img);

    // an older version's romfs.bin, with no folder there
    FILE *f = fopen(ROOT "/romfs.bin", "wb");
    CHECK(f && fwrite(whole, 1, size, f) == size && !fclose(f), "writing romfs.bin");
    CHECK(!rename(ROOT "/romfs", ROOT "/moved"), "moving the folder away");
    img = romfs_image_open(ROOT "/romfs", why, sizeof why);
    CHECK(img && romfs_image_size(img) == size, "romfs.bin fallback: %s", img ? "wrong size" : why);
    if (img) CHECK(same_read(img, whole, size, 0x200, 4096, buf), "romfs.bin fallback: data differs");
    romfs_image_close(img);
    rename(ROOT "/moved", ROOT "/romfs");

    free(buf), free(whole);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nfiles; i++) free(g_files[i].data);
    remove_tree();
    printf("%s: %d files, %llu-byte image\n", g_fail ? "FAILED" : "ok", g_nfiles, (unsigned long long)size);
    return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}

```

`tools/test_save_convert.c`:

```c
// Test program for the save importer (runtime/services/save_convert.c), with no SDL and no game files. Built and driven
// by tools/test_save_convert.py (make test-save-convert), which compares its output with tools/botw_save_convert.py.
//
//   test_save_convert convert --src <folder> --bootup <Bootup.pack> --dst <new folder> [--allow-switch]
//       sc_format_load + sc_convert into <new folder>/save_0, then one line per converted file, as the Python tool
//       reports it; exit status 0 when it converted, 1 when it refused (the reason follows RESULT)
//   test_save_convert slots <save_0 folder>
//       sc_list_slots: SLOT <name> <saved (unix time)> <play seconds or -1> <has picture>
//   test_save_convert holdlock <save folder> / locked <save folder>
//       a second process holding the game's lock on the save folder, and one asking whether it is held
//   test_save_convert selftest <scratch folder>
//       the safety of backup, install and discard in folders made under <scratch folder> (left for the caller to
//       remove): the player's saves are never lost
#include <assert.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static int fail_realloc_at, realloc_calls;
static void *test_realloc(void *p, size_t n) {
    if (++realloc_calls == fail_realloc_at) { errno = ENOMEM; return NULL; }
    return realloc(p, n);
}
#define realloc test_realloc
#include "../runtime/services/save_convert.c"  // (the whole file: the test reaches its helpers)
#undef realloc

static int convert_cmd(int argc, char **argv) {
    const char *src = NULL, *bootup = NULL, *dst = NULL;
    unsigned flags = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--src") && i + 1 < argc) src = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--bootup") && i + 1 < argc) bootup = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--dst") && i + 1 < argc) dst = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--allow-switch")) flags |= SC_ALLOW_SWITCH;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--to") && i + 1 < argc && !strcmp(argv[++i], "wiiu")) flags |= SC_TO_WIIU;
    }
    if (!src || !bootup || !dst) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: test_save_convert convert --src <folder> --bootup <Bootup.pack> --dst <new folder>\n");
        return 2;
    }
    ScReport r = {0};
    ScFormat *fmt = NULL;
    ScStage *stage = NULL;
    if (sc_format_load(bootup, &fmt, &r) != SC_OK || sc_convert(src, dst, fmt, flags, &stage, &r) != SC_OK) {
        printf("RESULT error %d %s\n", r.code, r.detail);
        sc_format_free(fmt);
        sc_report_free(&r);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("ROOT %s\n", r.root);
    for (int i = 0; i < r.nfiles; i++) {
        const ScFlagFile *f = &r.files[i];
        printf("FILE %s 0x%X 0x%X %u %u %u %u\n", f->file, f->src_rev, f->dst_rev, f->kept, f->defaulted, f->dropped, f->resized);
    }
    printf("COUNTS slots=%d tracker=%d album=%d pict=%d written=%d\n", r.nslots, r.n_tracker, r.n_album, r.n_pict, r.n_written);
    printf("RESULT ok\n");
    sc_format_free(fmt);
    sc_report_free(&r);
    sc_stage_keep(stage);  // (the converted folder stays: the caller compares it)
    return 0;
}

// Fail each reallocation in turn, including after files have already been written.
static int oom_cmd(const char *src, const char *bootup, const char *dst) {
    for (int at = 1; ; at++) {
        realloc_calls = 0, fail_realloc_at = at;
        ScReport r = {0};
        ScFormat *fmt = NULL;
        ScStage *st = NULL;
        ScCode c = sc_format_load(bootup, &fmt, &r);
        if (c == SC_OK) c = sc_convert(src, dst, fmt, 0, &st, &r);
        bool reached = realloc_calls >= at;
        fail_realloc_at = 0;
        if (c != SC_OK && (st || exists(dst))) {
            fprintf(stderr, "allocation %d left a stage behind\n", at);
            return 1;
        }
        sc_stage_discard(st);
        sc_format_free(fmt);
        sc_report_free(&r);
        if (!reached) { printf("PASS %d allocation failures\n", at - 1); return 0; }
    }
}

typedef struct { int checks, after; } CancelAfter;
static bool cancel_after(void *p) {
    CancelAfter *c = p;
    return ++c->checks >= c->after;
}

static int cancel_cmd(const char *src, const char *bootup, const char *dst) {
    ScReport r = {0};
    ScFormat *fmt = NULL;
    if (sc_format_load(bootup, &fmt, &r) != SC_OK) return 1;
    for (int at = 1; ; at++) {
        CancelAfter state = {0, at};
        ScCancel cancel = {cancel_after, &state};
        ScStage *st = NULL;
        ScCode c = sc_convert_cancel(src, dst, fmt, 0, &cancel, &st, &r);
        if ((c != SC_OK && c != SC_CANCELLED) || (c == SC_CANCELLED && (st || exists(dst)))) return 1;
        sc_stage_discard(st);
        sc_report_free(&r);
        if (c == SC_OK) break;
    }
    sc_format_free(fmt);
    puts("PASS cancellation removes the stage");
    return 0;
}

// test_save_convert slots <save_0 folder>: one line per slot
static int slots_cmd(const char *dir) {
    ScSlot *v;
    int n = sc_list_slots(dir, &v);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        printf("SLOT %s %lld %lld %d\n", v[i].name, (long long)v[i].saved, (long long)v[i].play_seconds, v[i].has_picture);
    free(v);
    return 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- selftest
static int failures;
#define CHECK(c) do { if (!(c)) { printf("FAIL %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #c); failures++; } } while (0)

static void put(const char *dir, const char *rel, const char *text) {
    char p[1100], *s;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, rel);
    for (s = p + 1; (s = strchr(s, '/')); *s++ = '/') {
        *s = 0;
        mkdir(p, 0755);
    }
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "wb");
    assert(f);
    fputs(text, f);
    fclose(f);
}

static char *slurp(const char *dir, const char *rel) {
    char p[1100];
    static char buf[256];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, rel);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, f);
    buf[n] = 0;
    fclose(f);
    return buf;
}

static bool is_text(const char *dir, const char *rel, const char *want) {
    char *got = slurp(dir, rel);
    return got && !strcmp(got, want);
}

static bool has(const char *dir, const char *rel) {
    char p[1100];
    struct stat st;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", dir, rel);
    return stat(p, &st) == 0;
}

// An old save folder (save_0 with a slot, an SD card folder) and a staged one, in a scratch folder
static void setup(const char *root, bool with_old) {
    if (with_old) {
        put(root, "save/save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD");
        put(root, "save/save_0/tracker/t0", "OLDTRACK");
        put(root, "save/sdcard/note.txt", "SD");
    }
}

// A staged folder as sc_convert leaves it, but made by hand: <name>/save_0/0/game_data.sav = "NEW", with the list of
// what was made
static ScStage *fake_stage(const char *root, const char *name) {
    (void)root;
    put(name, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "NEW");
    ScStage *s = calloc(1, sizeof *s);
    snprintf(s->dir, sizeof s->dir, "%s", name);
    static const char *const rel[] = {"", "/save_0", "/save_0/0", "/save_0/0/game_data.sav"};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        char p[1100];
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s%s", name, rel[i]);
        made_add(&s->made, p, i < 3);
    }
    return s;
}

static char *scratch(const char *base, char *out, size_t cap) {
    static int counter;
    snprintf(out, cap, "%s/t%d", base, ++counter);
    mkdir(base, 0755);
    assert(mkdir(out, 0755) == 0);
    return out;
}

static void selftest(const char *base) {
    char root[1100], root2[1100], root3[1100], root4[1100];
    scratch(base, root, sizeof root);
    char save[1100], backup[1100], stage[1100];
    snprintf(save, sizeof save, "%s/save", root);

    // 1. install over an existing save: the old folder is moved whole to the backup, the new one takes its place,
    // and what the import doesn't replace (the SD card folder) is still there
    setup(root, true);
    sc_backup_path(save, backup, sizeof backup);
    CHECK(strstr(backup, "/save-backups/save-") != NULL);
    sc_stage_path(save, stage, sizeof stage);
    CHECK(strstr(stage, "/save-import-") != NULL);
    ScStage *st = fake_stage(root, stage);
    ScReport r = {0};
    CHECK(sc_stage_install(st, save, backup, &r) == SC_OK);
    CHECK(is_text(save, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "NEW"));
    CHECK(!has(save, "save_0/tracker/t0"));
    CHECK(is_text(save, "sdcard/note.txt", "SD"));
    CHECK(is_text(backup, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD"));
    CHECK(is_text(backup, "save_0/tracker/t0", "OLDTRACK"));
    CHECK(is_text(backup, "sdcard/note.txt", "SD"));
    CHECK(!has(stage, ""));
    sc_report_free(&r);

    // 2. the staged folder is gone when the swap happens: the second step fails and the first is undone
    scratch(base, root2, sizeof root2);
    snprintf(save, sizeof save, "%s/save", root2);
    setup(root2, true);
    sc_backup_path(save, backup, sizeof backup);
    sc_stage_path(save, stage, sizeof stage);
    st = fake_stage(root2, stage);
    char gone[1100];
    snprintf(gone, sizeof gone, "%s/gone", root2);
    rename(stage, gone);  // (the stage's folder is no longer there)
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    CHECK(sc_stage_install(st, save, backup, &r) == SC_IO);
    CHECK(is_text(save, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD"));
    CHECK(is_text(save, "sdcard/note.txt", "SD"));
    CHECK(!has(backup, ""));
    CHECK(!has(root2, "save-backups"));
    // A retry must keep a backup folder that was already there, and everything in it.
    put(root2, "save-backups/keep.txt", "KEEP");
    CHECK(sc_stage_install(st, save, backup, &r) == SC_IO);
    CHECK(is_text(root2, "save-backups/keep.txt", "KEEP"));
    sc_stage_discard(st);
    sc_report_free(&r);

    // 3. no old save: nothing to back up, the staged folder just becomes the save folder
    scratch(base, root3, sizeof root3);
    snprintf(save, sizeof save, "%s/save", root3);
    sc_backup_path(save, backup, sizeof backup);
    sc_stage_path(save, stage, sizeof stage);
    st = fake_stage(root3, stage);
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    CHECK(sc_stage_install(st, save, backup, &r) == SC_OK);
    CHECK(is_text(save, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "NEW"));
    CHECK(!has(backup, ""));
    sc_report_free(&r);

    // 4. a backup copy: the save stays, the copy is the same; a backup that can't be made leaves nothing
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
    sc_backup_path(save, backup, sizeof backup);
    {   // (an old file time on the original)
        char a1[1100];
        struct utimbuf old = {1500000000, 1500000000};
        snprintf(a1, sizeof a1, "%s/save_0/0/game_data.sav", save);
        utime(a1, &old);
    }
    CHECK(sc_backup(save, backup, &r) == SC_OK && r.n_written == 1);
    CHECK(is_text(backup, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "NEW") && is_text(save, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "NEW"));
    {   // (the file time of a copy is the original's)
        char a1[1100], b1[1100];
        struct stat sa, sb;
        snprintf(a1, sizeof a1, "%s/save_0/0/game_data.sav", save);
        snprintf(b1, sizeof b1, "%s/save_0/0/game_data.sav", backup);
        CHECK(stat(a1, &sa) == 0 && stat(b1, &sb) == 0 && sa.st_mtime == sb.st_mtime && sb.st_mtime == 1500000000);
    }
    CHECK(sc_backup(save, backup, &r) == SC_IO);  // (exists already: untouched)
    CHECK(is_text(backup, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "NEW"));
    char nosave[1100], blocked[1100];
    snprintf(nosave, sizeof nosave, "%s/none", root3);
    CHECK(sc_backup(nosave, backup, &r) == SC_NO_SAVE);
    put(root3, "blocker", "x");  // a file where the backup's parent folder should be
    snprintf(blocked, sizeof blocked, "%s/blocker/inside", root3);
    CHECK(sc_backup(save, blocked, &r) == SC_IO);
    CHECK(!has(root3, "blocker/inside"));
    sc_report_free(&r);

    // 5. a backup that fails halfway removes what it copied, and only that
    {
        scratch(base, root4, sizeof root4);
        char s4[1100], b4[1100], deep[1100];
        snprintf(s4, sizeof s4, "%s/save", root4);
        snprintf(b4, sizeof b4, "%s/b", root4);
        put(root4, "save/a/one", "1");
        put(root4, "save/b/two", "2");
        snprintf(deep, sizeof deep, "%s/save/b/two", root4);
        memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
#ifndef _WIN32
        chmod(deep, 0);  // unreadable: the copy of it fails (not for root, which reads anything)
        ScCode c = sc_backup(s4, b4, &r);
        chmod(deep, 0644);
        if (geteuid() != 0) {
            CHECK(c == SC_IO);
            CHECK(!has(b4, ""));
        }
#else
        (void)deep;
#endif
        CHECK(is_text(s4, "a/one", "1"));
        sc_report_free(&r);
    }

    // 6. discarding a stage removes what the conversion made, not what somebody put there since
    st = fake_stage(root3, stage);
    put(stage, "save_0/0/mine.txt", "MINE");
    sc_stage_discard(st);
    CHECK(!has(stage, "save_0/0/game_data.sav"));
    CHECK(is_text(stage, "save_0/0/mine.txt", "MINE"));

    // 7. the profile folder is found below the one picked
    char prof[1100];
    put(root3, "cemu/mlc01/usr/save/00050000/101c9500/user/80000001/0/game_data.sav", "x");
    put(root3, "cemu/mlc01/usr/save/00050000/101c9500/user/common/readme", "x");
    snprintf(nosave, sizeof nosave, "%s/cemu", root3);
    CHECK(sc_find_profile(nosave, prof, sizeof prof) == SC_OK && strstr(prof, "/user/80000001") != NULL);
    snprintf(nosave, sizeof nosave, "%s/cemu/mlc01/usr/save/00050000/101c9500/user/common", root3);
    CHECK(sc_find_profile(nosave, prof, sizeof prof) == SC_NO_SAVE);

    // An expired search has its own result, including when the chosen folder has no save.
    CHECK(find_profile_root(nosave, prof, sizeof prof, false, time(NULL) - PROFILE_SECONDS - 1, NULL) == SC_SEARCH_LIMIT);
    Search over = {0};
    over.t0 = time(NULL), over.visits = PROFILE_VISITS + 1;
    find_profile(nosave, 0, &over);
    CHECK(search_over(&over) && !over.have_any);
    for (int depth = 9; depth <= 10; depth++) {
        scratch(base, root, sizeof root);
        char deep[1100];
        snprintf(deep, sizeof deep, "%s", root);
        for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) strcat(deep, "/d");
        put(deep, "0/game_data.sav", "x");
        CHECK(sc_find_profile(root, prof, sizeof prof) == SC_OK && !strcmp(prof, deep));
    }

    // a folder holding a Switch profile first in name order and a Wii U one after it: the Wii U one
    {
        static const char sw[] = {0x30, 0x47, 0, 0}, wiiu[] = {0, 0, 0x47, 0x1B};
        char f[1100];
        put(root3, "both/a/0/game_data.sav", "");
        snprintf(f, sizeof f, "%s/both/a/0/game_data.sav", root3);
        FILE *fp = fopen(f, "wb");
        assert(fp);
        fwrite(sw, 1, 4, fp), fclose(fp);
        put(root3, "both/b/0/game_data.sav", "");
        snprintf(f, sizeof f, "%s/both/b/0/game_data.sav", root3);
        fp = fopen(f, "wb");
        assert(fp);
        fwrite(wiiu, 1, 4, fp), fclose(fp);
        snprintf(nosave, sizeof nosave, "%s/both", root3);
        CHECK(sc_find_profile(nosave, prof, sizeof prof) == SC_OK && strstr(prof, "/both/b") != NULL);
        remove(f);
        CHECK(sc_find_profile(nosave, prof, sizeof prof) == SC_OK && strstr(prof, "/both/a") != NULL);
    }

    // Cleanup removes only dated import folders, keeps a live stage, and never touches unrelated folders.
    {
        scratch(base, root, sizeof root);
        setup(root, true);
        snprintf(save, sizeof save, "%s/save", root);
        const char *old = "save-import-20261029-100000", *live = "save-import-20261030-100000";
        put(root, "save-import-20261029-100000/save_0/0/game_data.sav", "STALE");
        put(root, "save-import-20261030-100000/save_0/0/game_data.sav", "LIVE");
        put(root, "save-import-not-ours/mine", "KEEP");
        put(root, "other/mine", "KEEP");
        snprintf(stage, sizeof stage, "%s/%s/", root, live);
        ScRecovery recovery;
        CHECK(sc_cleanup_stages(save, stage, &recovery, &r) == SC_OK);
        CHECK(!recovery.imported[0] && !has(root, old) && has(root, live));
        CHECK(is_text(root, "save-import-not-ours/mine", "KEEP") && is_text(root, "other/mine", "KEEP"));
        CHECK(is_text(save, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD"));

        // A missing save means an interrupted swap: keep every import, and name the newest dated backup.
        snprintf(gone, sizeof gone, "%s/gone", root);
        CHECK(rename(save, gone) == 0);
        CHECK(sc_cleanup_stages(save, NULL, &recovery, &r) == SC_OK);
        CHECK(recovery.imported[0] && !recovery.backup[0] && has(root, live));
        put(root, "save-import-20261029-100000/save_0/0/game_data.sav", "STALE");
        put(root, "save-backups/save-20261029-100000/save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLDER");
        put(root, "save-backups/save-20261030-100000-9/save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD");
        put(root, "save-backups/save-20261030-100000-10/save_0/0/game_data.sav", "NEWER");
        CHECK(sc_cleanup_stages(save, NULL, &recovery, &r) == SC_OK);
        CHECK(has(root, old) && has(root, live) && !has(save, ""));
        CHECK(strstr(recovery.imported, live) && strstr(recovery.backup, "save-20261030-100000-10"));
        sc_report_free(&r);
#ifndef _WIN32
        // A link that looks like an abandoned stage never exposes its target to the cleanup.
        CHECK(rename(gone, save) == 0);
        snprintf(stage, sizeof stage, "%s/save-import-20261028-100000", root);
        CHECK(symlink(gone, stage) == 0);
        CHECK(sc_cleanup_stages(save, NULL, &recovery, &r) == SC_OK);
        struct stat link_st;
        CHECK(lstat(stage, &link_st) == 0 && S_ISLNK(link_st.st_mode));
        CHECK(is_text(save, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD"));
        sc_report_free(&r);
#endif
    }

    // 8. slots
    put(root3, "ls/2/game_data.sav", "x");
    put(root3, "ls/10/caption.sav", "x");
    put(root3, "ls/10/caption.jpg", "x");
    put(root3, "ls/1/other.txt", "x");  // (not a slot)
    put(root3, "ls/word/game_data.sav", "x");
    snprintf(nosave, sizeof nosave, "%s/ls", root3);
    ScSlot *slots;
    int n = sc_list_slots(nosave, &slots);
    CHECK(n == 2 && slots[0].number == 2 && slots[1].number == 10 && slots[1].has_picture && !slots[0].has_picture);
    CHECK(slots[1].saved > 0 && slots[1].play_seconds == -1);
    free(slots);
    snprintf(nosave, sizeof nosave, "%s/not-there", root3);
    CHECK(sc_list_slots(nosave, &slots) == 0);
    free(slots);
#ifndef _WIN32
    // 9. a save folder that is a link is not moved (that would move the link, not the saves)
    {
        char real[1100], link[1100];
        put(root3, "real/save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD");
        snprintf(real, sizeof real, "%s/real", root3);
        snprintf(link, sizeof link, "%s/linked", root3);
        CHECK(symlink(real, link) == 0);
        sc_backup_path(link, backup, sizeof backup);
        sc_stage_path(link, stage, sizeof stage);
        st = fake_stage(root3, stage);
        memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
        CHECK(sc_stage_install(st, link, backup, &r) == SC_LINKED);
        CHECK(is_text(real, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD") && !has(backup, ""));
        sc_stage_discard(st);
        sc_report_free(&r);
    }
#endif
    // 10. a running game's lock: import and backup refuse and change nothing; once the lock is let go they work, and a lock
    // file that is there but not held (a game that has ended) is no obstacle
    {
        char root5[1100];
        scratch(base, root5, sizeof root5);
        setup(root5, true);
        char save5[1100], backup5[1100], stage5[1100];
        snprintf(save5, sizeof save5, "%s/save", root5);
        sc_backup_path(save5, backup5, sizeof backup5);
        sc_stage_path(save5, stage5, sizeof stage5);
        ScLock *game = NULL, *second = NULL;
        CHECK(sc_lock_take(save5, &game) == SC_LOCK_OK && game);
        CHECK(has(root5, "save.lock") && !has(save5, ".lock"));  // (next to the folder: the swap never moves it)
        CHECK(sc_lock_take(save5, &second) == SC_LOCK_BUSY && !second);
        memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
        CHECK(sc_backup(save5, backup5, &r) == SC_IN_USE && !has(backup5, ""));
        st = fake_stage(root5, stage5);
        memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
        CHECK(sc_stage_install(st, save5, backup5, &r) == SC_IN_USE);
        CHECK(is_text(save5, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD") && has(stage5, "save_0") && !has(backup5, ""));
        sc_lock_drop(game);
        memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
        CHECK(sc_backup(save5, backup5, &r) == SC_OK && is_text(backup5, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "OLD"));
        sc_report_free(&r);
        char backup5b[1100];
        snprintf(backup5b, sizeof backup5b, "%s/backup-2", root5);
        memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
        CHECK(sc_stage_install(st, save5, backup5b, &r) == SC_OK && is_text(save5, "save_0/0/game_data.sav", "NEW"));
        sc_report_free(&r);
        CHECK(sc_lock_take(save5, &second) == SC_LOCK_OK);  // (the import let go of it again)
        sc_lock_drop(second);
        // a folder the lock file can't be made in: nothing to wait for
        char nowhere[1100];
        snprintf(nowhere, sizeof nowhere, "%s/no-such-folder/save", root5);
        CHECK(sc_lock_take(nowhere, &second) == SC_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE && !second);
    }

    // 11. export: delivers files to destination and preserves colliding files with .bak suffix
    {
        char root6[1100], stage6[1100], dst6[1100];
        scratch(base, root6, sizeof root6);
        snprintf(stage6, sizeof stage6, "%s/stage", root6);
        snprintf(dst6, sizeof dst6, "%s/cemu_profile", root6);
        put(dst6, "0/game_data.sav", "CEMU_OLD");
        put(dst6, "1/game_data.sav", "CEMU_SLOT1");
        put(stage6, "0/game_data.sav", "CEMU_NEW");
        ScStage *st6 = calloc(1, sizeof *st6);
        snprintf(st6->dir, sizeof st6->dir, "%s", stage6);
        memset(&r, 0, sizeof r);
        CHECK(sc_stage_export(st6, dst6, &r) == SC_OK);
        CHECK(is_text(dst6, "0/game_data.sav", "CEMU_NEW"));
        CHECK(is_text(dst6, "1/game_data.sav", "CEMU_SLOT1"));
        CHECK(!has(stage6, ""));
        char d0[PATH_CAP];
        snprintf(d0, sizeof d0, "%s/0", dst6);
        int nd0;
        char **vd0 = names_list(d0, &nd0);
        bool found_bak = false;
        for (int i = 0; vd0 && i < nd0; i++)
            if (strstr(vd0[i], "game_data.sav.bak-")) found_bak = true;
        if (vd0) names_free(vd0, nd0);
        CHECK(found_bak);
        sc_report_free(&r);
    }
    printf(failures ? "SELFTEST FAIL (%d)\n" : "SELFTEST PASS\n", failures);
}

// holdlock <save folder>: holds the game's lock until the process is stopped (tests: a second process as the game)
static int holdlock_cmd(const char *save) {
    ScLock *l = NULL;
    if (sc_lock_take(save, &l) != SC_LOCK_OK) { puts("NOLOCK"); return 1; }
    puts("READY");
    fflush(stdout);
    for (;;) sleep(60);
}

// locked <save folder>: BUSY, FREE (and let go again) or UNAVAILABLE
static int locked_cmd(const char *save) {
    ScLock *l = NULL;
    ScLockResult c = sc_lock_take(save, &l);
    puts(c == SC_LOCK_BUSY ? "BUSY" : c == SC_LOCK_OK ? "FREE" : "UNAVAILABLE");
    sc_lock_drop(l);
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc >= 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "convert")) return convert_cmd(argc, argv);
    if (argc == 5 && !strcmp(argv[1], "cancel")) return cancel_cmd(argv[2], argv[3], argv[4]);
    if (argc == 5 && !strcmp(argv[1], "oom")) return oom_cmd(argv[2], argv[3], argv[4]);
    if (argc == 3 && !strcmp(argv[1], "holdlock")) return holdlock_cmd(argv[2]);
    if (argc == 3 && !strcmp(argv[1], "locked")) return locked_cmd(argv[2]);
    if (argc >= 3 && !strcmp(argv[1], "slots")) return slots_cmd(argv[2]);
    if (argc >= 3 && !strcmp(argv[1], "selftest")) {
        selftest(argv[2]);
        return failures != 0;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "usage: test_save_convert convert ... | slots <folder> | selftest <scratch folder>\n");
    return 2;
}
```

`tools/test_save_convert.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compares the save importer in C (runtime/services/save_convert.c) with the Python tool it follows
(tools/botw_save_convert.py): both convert the same save, and every output file has to match byte for byte.

    python3 tools/test_save_convert.py                  synthetic cases (no game files needed) + the C safety tests
    python3 tools/test_save_convert.py --src <Cemu profile folder> --bootup <Pack/Bootup.pack>
                                                        your own save and game files: both implementations convert the
                                                        real save and every file is compared (nothing is written
                                                        outside a temporary folder; the files are never copied anywhere)

The synthetic cases build a small Bootup.pack by hand (SARC, Yaz0 and BYML writers below), so the whole path is
exercised: reading the pack, the flag tables, the conversion, the folder level and the refusals. One PASS / FAIL line
per case; the exit status is 1 when anything failed. Needs a C compiler (cc, clang or gcc; CC=... picks one) unless
--exe gives a test program that is already built (make test-save-convert builds build/test_save_convert).

The last cases run the start screen's Saves tab itself without a window (tools/test_saves_tab.cpp: Dear ImGui builds its
frames in memory, the real importer runs on its worker thread, the question is answered with a click on Import or the Escape key) on copies
of a synthetic save folder. They need a C++ compiler and SDL3's headers (SDL3_INCLUDE=<folder> if they are not on the
default path); without those they are skipped, and --no-ui skips them.
"""
import argparse
import os
import random
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import zlib

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import botw_save_convert as py  # noqa: E402

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Writers for the containers of a pack (the converter itself only reads them)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def byml(doc):
    """Little-endian BYML v2 of a dict / list / str / bool / int / float tree."""
    names, strs = set(), set()

    def collect(v):
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            for k, x in v.items():
                names.add(k)
                collect(x)
        elif isinstance(v, list):
            for x in v:
                collect(x)
        elif isinstance(v, str):
            strs.add(v)
    collect(doc)
    names, strs = sorted(names), sorted(strs)
    out = bytearray(16)

    def pad():
        while len(out) % 4:
            out.append(0)

    def table(items):
        start = len(out)
        offs, body = [], b''
        base = 4 + 4 * (len(items) + 1)
        for s in items:
            offs.append(base + len(body))
            body += s.encode() + b'\0'
        offs.append(base + len(body))
        out.extend(bytes([0xC2]) + len(items).to_bytes(3, 'little') + b''.join(struct.pack('<I', o) for o in offs) + body)
        pad()
        return start
    name_off, str_off = table(names), table(strs)

    def scalar(v):
        if isinstance(v, bool):
            return 0xD0, int(v)
        if isinstance(v, int):
            return (0xD1, v & 0xFFFFFFFF) if -2**31 <= v < 2**31 else (0xD3, v)
        if isinstance(v, float):
            return 0xD2, struct.unpack('<I', struct.pack('<f', v))[0]
        return 0xA0, strs.index(v)

    def node(v):
        if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
            kids = [node(x) for x in (v.values() if isinstance(v, dict) else v)]  # children first
            pad()
            at = len(out)
            if isinstance(v, list):
                out.extend(bytes([0xC0]) + len(v).to_bytes(3, 'little') + bytes(t for t, _ in kids))
                pad()
                out.extend(b''.join(struct.pack('<I', x) for _, x in kids))
            else:
                out.extend(bytes([0xC1]) + len(v).to_bytes(3, 'little'))
                for k, (t, x) in sorted(zip(v.keys(), kids), key=lambda e: names.index(e[0])):
                    out.extend(names.index(k).to_bytes(3, 'little') + bytes([t]) + struct.pack('<I', x))
            return (0xC0 if isinstance(v, list) else 0xC1), at
        return scalar(v)
    _, root = node(doc)
    out[0:16] = b'YB' + struct.pack('<HIII', 2, name_off, str_off, root)
    return bytes(out)


def sarc(files):
    """Little-endian SARC of {name: bytes}."""
    def h(n):
        r = 0
        for ch in n.encode():
            r = (r * 0x65 + ch) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        return r
    items = sorted(files.items(), key=lambda kv: h(kv[0]))
    names, data, nodes = b'', b'', []
    for n, d in items:
        while len(data) % 4:
            data += b'\0'
        nodes.append((h(n), 0x01000000 | len(names) // 4, len(data), len(data) + len(d)))
        data += d
        names += n.encode() + b'\0'
        while len(names) % 4:
            names += b'\0'
    sfat = b'SFAT' + struct.pack('<HHI', 12, len(items), 0x65) + b''.join(struct.pack('<IIII', *x) for x in nodes)
    sfnt = b'SFNT' + struct.pack('<HH', 8, 0) + names
    data_off = (0x14 + len(sfat) + len(sfnt) + 0x3F) & ~0x3F
    head = b'SARC' + struct.pack('<HHIIHH', 0x14, 0xFEFF, data_off + len(data), data_off, 0x100, 0)
    return head + sfat + sfnt + b'\0' * (data_off - 0x14 - len(sfat) - len(sfnt)) + data


def yaz0(d):
    """Yaz0 with back references to the last 16 distances (so the decoder's short and long match forms both occur)."""
    out = bytearray(b'Yaz0' + struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + b'\0' * 8)
    i = 0
    while i < len(d):
        flag, flag_at = 0, len(out)
        out.append(0)
        for bit in range(8):
            if i >= len(d):
                break
            best, dist = 0, 0
            for k in range(1, min(16, i) + 1):
                n = 0
                while n < 0x111 and i + n < len(d) and d[i + n] == d[i + n - k]:
                    n += 1
                if n > best:
                    best, dist = n, k
            if best >= 3:
                dd = dist - 1
                if best >= 0x12:
                    out += bytes([dd >> 8, dd & 0xFF, best - 0x12])
                else:
                    out += bytes([(best - 2) << 4 | dd >> 8, dd & 0xFF])
                i += best
            else:
                flag |= 0x80 >> bit
                out.append(d[i])
                i += 1
        out[flag_at] = flag
    return bytes(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A small game: the flag tables of the old (Wii U) revision the saves come from and the new (Switch) one
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NEW_REV, OLD_REV = 0x4730, 0x471B
BULK = 600   # plain s32 flags on top of the named ones: enough that the hash order matters


def specs(old):
    """(name, kind, element count, InitValue) of the game revision; `old` is the Wii U one the saves come from."""
    s = [
        ('Rupees', 's32_data', 1, 0),
        ('Hearts', 's32_data', 1, 12),
        ('Big', 's32_data', 1, 4000000000),
        ('Neg', 's32_data', 1, -5),
        ('Ratio', 'f32_data', 1, 1.5),
        ('SavePos', 'vector3f_data', 1, {'Values': [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]}),
        ('Look', 'vector2f_data', 1, [{'Values': [0.5, -1.5]}]),
        ('Quat', 'vector4f_data', 1, [[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]),
        ('Name', 'string64_data', 1, 'Link'),
        ('Place', 'string256_data', 1, 'Hyrule'),
        ('Tag', 'string_data', 1, 'abc'),
        ('Open', 'bool_data', 1, 1),
        ('OpenF', 'bool_data', 1, 1.0),
        ('Respawn', 'bool_data', 1, 132),
        ('Weather', 's32_array_data', 2 if old else 3, [{'Values': [0] * (2 if old else 3)}]),
        ('Names', 'string64_array_data', 3 if old else 2, [{'Values': ['a', 'bb', 'ccc'][:3 if old else 2]}]),
        ('Spots', 'vector2f_array_data', 2, [{'Values': [[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]]}]),
        ('Brightness', 's32_data', 1, 5),
        ('Volume', 'f32_data', 1, 0.75),
        ('PlayTime', 's32_data', 1, 0),
    ]
    s += [('Bulk%04d' % i, 's32_data', 1, i) for i in range(BULK)]
    s += [('OnlyOld1', 's32_data', 1, 0), ('OnlyOld2', 'bool_data', 1, 0)] if old else \
         [('NewA', 's32_data', 1, 7), ('NewB', 'bool_data', 1, 1), ('NewC', 'string64_data', 1, 'x' * 70),
          ('NewD', 'vector3f_data', 1, [[9.5, 8.5, 7.5]]), ('NewE', 'f32_array_data', 2, [{'Values': [0.25, 0.5]}])]
    return s


def hash_value(v):
    return struct.unpack('<i', struct.pack('<I', v))[0] if v & 0x80000000 and v % 2 else v   # a mix of D1 and D3


def files_of(names, old):
    """Which flag file each flag is in (a flag can be in several)."""
    game = [n for n in names if n not in ('Brightness', 'Volume', 'PlayTime', 'OnlyOld2')]
    return {'game_data.sav': game, 'caption.sav': ['Rupees', 'Hearts', 'PlayTime', 'Name'],
            'option.sav': ['Brightness', 'Volume'] + (['OnlyOld2'] if old else [])}


def make_bootup(path, old=False, revision=None, split=2):
    sp = specs(old)
    names = [x[0] for x in sp]
    docs = {}
    for n, kind, count, init in sp:
        e = {'DataName': n, 'DeleteRev': -1, 'HashValue': hash_value(py.crc32_name(n)), 'InitValue': init,
             'IsEventAssociated': True}
        docs.setdefault(kind, []).append(e)
    gd = {}
    for i, (kind, entries) in enumerate(sorted(docs.items())):
        gd['%s_%d.bgdata' % (kind, i)] = byml({kind: entries})
    gd['revival_bool_data_0.bgdata'] = byml({'revival_bool_data': [{'DataName': 'Skipped', 'HashValue': 1, 'InitValue': {}}]})
    fm = {}
    k = 0
    for fname, members in files_of(names, old).items():
        members = [m for m in members if m in names]
        chunk = max(1, len(members) // split)
        for j in range(0, len(members), chunk):
            doc = {'save_info': [{'directory_num': 8, 'revision': revision or (OLD_REV if old else NEW_REV)}],
                   'file_list': [{'file_name': fname, 'addable': False},
                                 [{'HashValue': hash_value(py.crc32_name(m))} for m in members[j:j + chunk]]]}
            fm['saveformat_%d.bgsvdata' % k] = byml(doc)
            k += 1
    pack = sarc({'GameData/gamedata.ssarc': yaz0(sarc(gd)), 'GameData/savedataformat.ssarc': yaz0(sarc(fm)),
                 'Layout/Common.sblarc': b'unrelated', 'Actor/Pack/Other.sbactorpack': b'\0' * 64})
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(pack)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Synthetic saves
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def flag_file(rng, specs_, members, e, revision, skip=(), play=None):
    """A flag save file of the old revision, in byte order e, with random values."""
    by = {py.crc32_name(n): (n, kind, count, init) for n, kind, count, init in specs_}
    out = bytearray(struct.pack(e + 'III', revision, 0xFFFFFFFF, 1))
    for h in sorted(py.crc32_name(m) for m in members):
        n, kind, count, init = by[h]
        if n in skip:
            continue
        base = kind.replace('_array_data', '').replace('_data', '')
        words = py._WORDS[base] * count
        for w in range(words):
            if base.startswith('string'):
                word = bytes(rng.choice(b'abcdefghij\0') for _ in range(4))
            elif n == 'PlayTime' and play is not None:
                word = struct.pack(e + 'i', play)
            elif base == 'bool':
                word = struct.pack(e + 'I', rng.choice((0, 1)))
            elif base == 'f32' or base.startswith('vector'):
                word = struct.pack(e + 'f', rng.uniform(-1000, 1000))
            else:
                word = struct.pack(e + 'I', rng.getrandbits(32))
            out += struct.pack(e + 'I', h) + word
    return bytes(out) + py.FOOTER


def make_profile(path, seed=1, e='>', slots=(0, 1, 2), tracker=True, extras=True, options=True, captions=True):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    sp = specs(True)
    files = files_of([x[0] for x in sp], True)
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)

    def w(rel, data):
        full = os.path.join(path, *rel.split('/'))
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full), exist_ok=True)
        with open(full, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(data)
    for s in slots:
        w('%d/game_data.sav' % s, flag_file(rng, sp, files['game_data.sav'], e, OLD_REV))
        if captions:
            w('%d/caption.sav' % s, flag_file(rng, sp, files['caption.sav'], e, OLD_REV, play=3600 * (s + 1) + 61))
            w('%d/caption.jpg' % s, b'\xff\xd8\xff' + bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(300)) + b'\xff\xd9')
    if options:
        w('option.sav', flag_file(rng, sp, files['option.sav'], e, OLD_REV))
    if tracker:
        for i in range(4):
            w('tracker/trackblock%02d.sav' % i, bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(4096)))
        w('tracker/odd.sav', b'123456789a')       # not a multiple of 4: copied as it is
        w('tracker/empty.sav', b'')
    if extras:
        for i in range(5):
            w('album/img%03d.jpg' % i, bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(200 + i)))
        w('album/UPPER.JPG', b'upper')
        w('album/notes.txt', b'not a picture')
        for i in range(7):
            w('pict_book/%03d.jpg' % i, bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(150 + i)))
    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Running the two implementations and comparing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def tree(path):
    out = {}
    for d, _, files in os.walk(path):
        for n in files:
            full = os.path.join(d, n)
            with open(full, 'rb') as f:
                out[os.path.relpath(full, path).replace(os.sep, '/')] = f.read()
    return out


def run_python(src, bootup, dst, to_endian='<'):
    """-> (files {rel: bytes} or None, stats {file: tuple}, counts {name: n}, error text)"""
    try:
        fmt = py.Format(bootup)
        report, results = py.convert_profile(src, dst, fmt, to_endian, None, 'convert', False)
    except (SystemExit, Exception) as ex:  # noqa: BLE001 (the Python tool raises ValueError, SystemExit, ...)
        return None, {}, {}, 'python: %s: %s' % (type(ex).__name__, ex)
    stats, counts, slot = {}, {}, None
    for line in report:
        m = re.match(r'slot (\d+)$', line)
        if m:
            slot = m.group(1)
        elif line == 'options':
            slot = None
        m = re.match(r'  (\S+)\s+revision 0x([0-9A-F]+) -> 0x([0-9A-F]+), (\d+) flags kept, (\d+) defaulted, (\d+) dropped, (\d+) resized$', line)
        if m:
            stats[(slot + '/' if slot is not None else '') + m.group(1)] = (int(m.group(2), 16), int(m.group(3), 16)) + tuple(int(m.group(i)) for i in range(4, 8))
        m = re.match(r'(album|pict_book): (\d+) pictures copied$', line)
        if m:
            counts[m.group(1)] = int(m.group(2))
    return {k: v for k, v in tree(dst).items()}, stats, counts, None


def run_c(exe, src, bootup, dst, extra=()):
    """-> (files or None, stats, counts, error text, exit code)"""
    p = subprocess.run([exe, 'convert', '--src', src, '--bootup', bootup, '--dst', dst, *extra],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    if p.returncode != 0:
        line = [x for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if x.startswith('RESULT')]
        return None, {}, {}, (line[0] if line else 'C: no result: ' + p.stderr[:300]), p.returncode
    stats, counts = {}, {}
    for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
        t = line.split()
        if t[:1] == ['FILE']:
            stats[t[1]] = (int(t[2], 16), int(t[3], 16)) + tuple(int(x) for x in t[4:8])
        elif t[:1] == ['COUNTS']:
            counts = dict(x.split('=') for x in t[1:])
    files = tree(dst if '--to' in extra else os.path.join(dst, 'save_0'))
    return files, stats, {k: int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}, None, 0


def compare(py_out, c_out):
    """-> list of differences between the two {rel: bytes} trees"""
    diffs = []
    for k in sorted(set(py_out) | set(c_out)):
        if k not in c_out:
            diffs.append('only Python wrote ' + k)
        elif k not in py_out:
            diffs.append('only C wrote ' + k)
        elif py_out[k] != c_out[k]:
            a, b = py_out[k], c_out[k]
            at = next((i for i in range(min(len(a), len(b))) if a[i] != b[i]), min(len(a), len(b)))
            diffs.append('%s differs (sizes %d / %d, first difference at byte %d)' % (k, len(a), len(b), at))
    return diffs


class Runner:
    def __init__(self, exe, tmp):
        self.exe, self.tmp, self.failed, self.n = exe, tmp, 0, 0

    def result(self, name, problems, note=''):
        self.n += 1
        if problems:
            self.failed += 1
            print('FAIL  %s' % name)
            for p in problems[:8]:
                print('        ' + p)
            if len(problems) > 8:
                print('        ... %d more' % (len(problems) - 8))
        else:
            note = note.replace(self.tmp, '<tmp>')
            print('PASS  %s%s' % (name, ('  (' + note + ')') if note else ''))

    def both(self, name, src, bootup, c_extra=(), expect_same=True, tag=None):
        """Converts src with both and compares everything; with expect_same False only that both refuse is checked."""
        tag = tag or re.sub(r'\W', '_', name)
        pdst, cdst = os.path.join(self.tmp, tag + '_py'), os.path.join(self.tmp, tag + '_c')
        t0 = time.time()
        pf, ps, pc, perr = run_python(src, bootup, pdst)
        t1 = time.time()
        cf, cs, cc, cerr, code = run_c(self.exe, src, bootup, cdst, c_extra)
        t2 = time.time()
        problems = []
        if pf is None or cf is None:
            problems.append('Python and C disagree on whether it converts: %s | %s' % (perr or 'ok', cerr or 'ok'))
            return self.result(name, problems)
        problems += compare(pf, cf)
        if ps != cs:
            for k in sorted(set(ps) | set(cs)):
                if ps.get(k) != cs.get(k):
                    problems.append('report of %s: Python %s, C %s' % (k, ps.get(k), cs.get(k)))
        for k in ('album', 'pict_book'):
            if pc.get(k, 0) != cc.get('album' if k == 'album' else 'pict', 0):
                problems.append('%s count: Python %s, C %s' % (k, pc.get(k, 0), cc.get('album' if k == 'album' else 'pict', 0)))
        if not pf:
            problems.append('nothing was converted')
        self.result(name, problems, '%d files, Python %.2f s, C %.2f s' % (len(cf), t1 - t0, t2 - t1))

    def both_to_wiiu(self, name, src, bootup, tag=None):
        tag = tag or re.sub(r'\W', '_', name)
        pdst, cdst = os.path.join(self.tmp, tag + '_py'), os.path.join(self.tmp, tag + '_c')
        t0 = time.time()
        pf, ps, pc, perr = run_python(src, bootup, pdst, to_endian='>')
        t1 = time.time()
        cf, cs, cc, cerr, code = run_c(self.exe, src, bootup, cdst, extra=('--to', 'wiiu'))
        t2 = time.time()
        problems = []
        if pf is None or cf is None:
            problems.append('Python and C disagree on whether it converts: %s | %s' % (perr or 'ok', cerr or 'ok'))
            return self.result(name, problems)
        problems += compare(pf, cf)
        if ps != cs:
            for k in sorted(set(ps) | set(cs)):
                if ps.get(k) != cs.get(k):
                    problems.append('report of %s: Python %s, C %s' % (k, ps.get(k), cs.get(k)))
        for k in ('album', 'pict_book'):
            if pc.get(k, 0) != cc.get('album' if k == 'album' else 'pict', 0):
                problems.append('%s count: Python %s, C %s' % (k, pc.get(k, 0), cc.get('album' if k == 'album' else 'pict', 0)))
        if not pf:
            problems.append('nothing was converted')
        self.result(name, problems, '%d files, Python %.2f s, C %.2f s' % (len(cf), t1 - t0, t2 - t1))

    def refused(self, name, src, bootup, code, c_extra=(), python_too=True, tag=None):
        """C has to refuse with `code` (and leave no output); Python has to refuse as well."""
        tag = tag or re.sub(r'\W', '_', name)
        cdst = os.path.join(self.tmp, tag + '_c')
        cf, _, _, cerr, rc = run_c(self.exe, src, bootup, cdst, c_extra)
        problems = []
        if cf is not None or rc != 1:
            problems.append('C converted (or crashed: exit %d) instead of refusing' % rc)
        elif not cerr.startswith('RESULT error %d ' % code):
            problems.append('wrong reason: %s (wanted code %d)' % (cerr, code))
        if os.path.exists(cdst):
            problems.append('C left %s behind' % cdst)
        if python_too:
            pf, _, _, perr = run_python(src, bootup, os.path.join(self.tmp, tag + '_py'))
            if pf is not None:
                problems.append('Python converted what C refuses')
        self.result(name, problems, cerr or '')


# the codes of ScCode (save_convert.h)
NO_SAVE, SWITCH_SAVE, BAD_SAVE, NO_BOOTUP, BAD_BOOTUP, IO, WIIU_SAVE = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 12


def build_exe(tmp, cc=None):
    exe = os.path.join(tmp, 'test_save_convert' + ('.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else ''))
    for c in ([cc] if cc else [os.environ.get('CC'), 'cc', 'clang', 'gcc']):
        if not c or not shutil.which(c):
            continue
        cmd = [c, '-std=gnu11', '-O1', '-D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64', '-I' + os.path.join(ROOT, 'runtime'), '-o', exe,
               os.path.join(HERE, 'test_save_convert.c'), os.path.join(ROOT, 'runtime', 'services', 'archive.c')]
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if p.returncode == 0:
            return exe
        print('compiling with %s failed:\n%s' % (c, p.stderr[-2000:]))
    sys.exit('no C compiler found (set CC, or pass --exe)')


def synthetic(r):
    tmp = r.tmp
    boot = os.path.join(tmp, 'Bootup.pack')
    make_bootup(boot)

    prof = make_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'cemu', 'mlc01', 'usr', 'save', '00050000', '101c9500', 'user', '80000001'), seed=1)
    r.both('Wii U save, 3 slots, options, Hero\'s Path, album, compendium', prof, boot)
    p = subprocess.run([r.exe, 'oom', prof, boot, os.path.join(tmp, 'oom_stage')], capture_output=True, text=True)
    r.result('each reallocation can fail without a crash or a leftover stage',
             [] if p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.startswith('PASS ') else [p.stdout + p.stderr])
    p = subprocess.run([r.exe, 'cancel', prof, boot, os.path.join(tmp, 'cancel_stage')], capture_output=True, text=True)
    r.result('cancellation during search and between files discards the stage',
             [] if p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.startswith('PASS ') else [p.stdout + p.stderr])
    r.both('picked folder above the profile (with other folders beside it)', os.path.join(tmp, 'cemu'), boot)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(tmp, 'cemu', 'mlc01', 'usr', 'save', '00050000', '101c9500', 'user', 'common'), exist_ok=True)

    # the Saves tab dates a slot by the file time of its caption.sav: converted and copied files keep their source's
    dated = make_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'dated', 'user', '80000001'), seed=8)
    stamps = {'0/caption.sav': 1500000000, '1/game_data.sav': 1500000100, '0/caption.jpg': 1500000200,
              'tracker/trackblock00.sav': 1500000300, 'album/img000.jpg': 1500000400, 'option.sav': 1500000500}
    for rel, t in stamps.items():
        os.utime(os.path.join(dated, *rel.split('/')), (t, t))
    cf, _, _, cerr, _ = run_c(r.exe, dated, boot, os.path.join(tmp, 'dated_c'))
    problems = [cerr] if cf is None else []
    for rel, t in stamps.items():
        out = os.path.join(tmp, 'dated_c', 'save_0', *rel.split('/'))
        if cf is not None and int(os.stat(out).st_mtime) != t:
            problems.append('%s: file time %d, wanted %d' % (rel, int(os.stat(out).st_mtime), t))
    r.result('converted and copied files keep the file time of their source', problems)

    only = make_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'only_game_data'), seed=2, slots=(0,), tracker=False, extras=False, options=False,
                        captions=False)
    r.both('a single slot with nothing but game_data.sav', only, boot)
    r.both('ten slots (names sort as text)', make_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'many'), seed=3, slots=tuple(range(11)),
                                                          tracker=False, extras=False), boot)

    if sys.platform == 'win32':
        # the game's .exe reads UTF-8 paths (runtime/platform/windows.manifest); this test program has no such manifest
        print('SKIP  folders with non-ASCII names (this test program has no UTF-8 manifest like the game\'s .exe)')
    else:
        uni = os.path.join(tmp, 'Spielstände 日本語 ñ')
        make_profile(os.path.join(uni, 'user', '80000001'), seed=1)
        r.both('folders with non-ASCII names', uni, boot, tag='unicode')

    # the game's own revision differs: more flags in the target, fewer in the old one (already covered); another revision number
    boot2 = os.path.join(tmp, 'Bootup2.pack')
    make_bootup(boot2, revision=0x471E)
    r.both('another game revision (0x471E)', prof, boot2)

    # a Switch save: refused, or converted with the test flag, tracker copied as it is
    sw = make_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'switch', 'user', '80000001'), seed=4, e='<')
    r.refused('a Switch save is refused and nothing is written', sw, boot, SWITCH_SAVE, python_too=False)
    r.both('a Switch save with the test flag: same as Python, Hero\'s Path unchanged', sw, boot, c_extra=('--allow-switch',),
           tag='switch_allowed')
    r.both_to_wiiu('export to Wii U: Switch save -> big-endian, same as Python byte for byte', sw, boot)
    r.refused('export to Wii U with a Wii U save is refused', prof, boot, WIIU_SAVE, c_extra=('--to', 'wiiu'), python_too=False)

    # refusals: nothing may be left behind
    empty = os.path.join(tmp, 'empty')
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(empty, 'a', 'b'))
    r.refused('a folder with no save in it', empty, boot, NO_SAVE)
    r.refused('a folder that is not there', os.path.join(tmp, 'nowhere'), boot, NO_SAVE)
    r.refused('Bootup.pack missing', prof, os.path.join(tmp, 'no_such.pack'), NO_BOOTUP, python_too=False)
    junk = os.path.join(tmp, 'junk.pack')
    with open(junk, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(os.urandom(5000))
    r.refused('Bootup.pack that is not a pack', prof, junk, BAD_BOOTUP, python_too=False)
    with open(boot, 'rb') as f:
        half = f.read()
    cut = os.path.join(tmp, 'cut.pack')
    with open(cut, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(half[:len(half) // 2])
    r.refused('Bootup.pack cut in half', prof, cut, BAD_BOOTUP, python_too=False)

    def damaged(name, how, code=BAD_SAVE):
        p = make_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'dmg_' + re.sub(r'\W', '_', name), 'user', '80000001'), seed=5)
        target = os.path.join(p, '2', 'game_data.sav')   # slots 0 and 1 convert fine before this one fails
        with open(target, 'rb') as f:
            d = f.read()
        with open(target, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(how(d))
        r.refused(name, p, boot, code)
    damaged('a save copied only halfway (no footer)', lambda d: d[:len(d) // 2])
    damaged('a save cut inside an entry', lambda d: d[:-6] + b'\xff\xff\xff\xff')
    damaged('a save that is not a flag file', lambda d: b'\0' * 64)
    damaged('a save with entries out of order', lambda d: d[:12] + d[20:28] + d[12:20] + d[28:])
    p = make_profile(os.path.join(tmp, 'dmg_caption', 'user', '80000001'), seed=6)
    with open(os.path.join(p, '1', 'caption.sav'), 'wb') as f:
        f.write(b'broken')
    r.refused('a damaged caption.sav', p, boot, BAD_SAVE)

    # slots as the tab lists them
    s0 = os.path.join(tmp, 'listing')
    make_profile(s0, seed=7, slots=(1, 0, 10, 2), e='<', tracker=False, extras=False)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(s0, 'tracker'))
    os.utime(os.path.join(s0, '10', 'caption.sav'), (1700000000, 1700000000))
    os.remove(os.path.join(s0, '2', 'caption.sav'))
    os.remove(os.path.join(s0, '2', 'caption.jpg'))
    os.utime(os.path.join(s0, '2', 'game_data.sav'), (1600000000, 1600000000))
    p = subprocess.run([r.exe, 'slots', s0], capture_output=True, text=True)
    rows = [l.split() for l in p.stdout.splitlines()]
    want = [['SLOT', '0', None, '3661', '1'], ['SLOT', '1', None, '7261', '1'], ['SLOT', '2', '1600000000', '-1', '0'],
            ['SLOT', '10', '1700000000', '39661', '1']]
    problems = []
    if [x[:2] for x in rows] != [x[:2] for x in want]:
        problems.append('slots listed: %s' % [x[1] for x in rows])
    for got, w in zip(rows, want):
        if (w[2] is not None and got[2] != w[2]) or got[3:] != w[3:]:
            problems.append('slot %s: %s, wanted %s' % (w[1], got[2:], w[2:]))
    r.result('slot list: numeric order, saved time, play time from caption.sav, picture', problems)

    # the C safety tests: backup, install, rollback, discard
    scratch = os.path.join(tmp, 'selftest')
    p = subprocess.run([r.exe, 'selftest', scratch], capture_output=True, text=True)
    r.result('backup, install, rollback, discard and stale cleanup keep the player\'s saves', [] if 'SELFTEST PASS' in p.stdout else
             (p.stdout + p.stderr).splitlines()[-8:])

    # a second process as the running game: it holds the save folder's lock, the importer sees it, and the lock goes away
    # with the process however that ends (a crashed game leaves nothing stale)
    held = os.path.join(tmp, 'lock_held', 'save')
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(held))

    def lock_state():
        return subprocess.run([r.exe, 'locked', held], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    problems = []
    if lock_state() != 'FREE':
        problems.append('a lock nobody holds is not free: ' + lock_state())
    game = subprocess.Popen([r.exe, 'holdlock', held], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    if game.stdout.readline().strip() != 'READY':
        problems.append('the holder did not get the lock')
    elif lock_state() != 'BUSY':
        problems.append('a lock held by another process is not seen as held: ' + lock_state())
    game.kill()   # (not a clean exit: the game crashed)
    game.wait()
    if lock_state() != 'FREE':
        problems.append('the lock outlived its process: ' + lock_state())
    r.result('the game\'s lock on the save folder is seen by another process and ends with it', problems)


def build_ui(tmp):
    """Builds tools/test_saves_tab.cpp -> path, or (None, why)."""
    cxx = next((c for c in (os.environ.get('CXX'), 'c++', 'clang++', 'g++') if c and shutil.which(c)), None)
    cc = next((c for c in (os.environ.get('CC'), 'cc', 'clang', 'gcc') if c and shutil.which(c)), None)
    if not cxx or not cc:
        return None, 'no C++ compiler'
    sdl = []
    if os.environ.get('SDL3_INCLUDE'):
        sdl = ['-isystem', os.environ['SDL3_INCLUDE']]
    elif shutil.which('pkg-config'):
        p = subprocess.run(['pkg-config', '--cflags', 'sdl3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        sdl = p.stdout.split() if p.returncode == 0 else []
    im, rt, st = (os.path.join(ROOT, 'third_party', 'imgui'), os.path.join(ROOT, 'runtime'),
                  os.path.join(ROOT, 'third_party', 'stb'))
    d = os.path.join(tmp, 'ui')
    os.makedirs(d)
    cxxflags = ['-std=c++17', '-O0', '-D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64', '-I' + im, '-I' + rt, '-I' + os.path.join(rt, 'ui'), '-I' + st] + sdl
    jobs = [(cxx, ['-x', 'c++'] + cxxflags, os.path.join(im, n + '.cpp')) for n in ('imgui', 'imgui_draw', 'imgui_tables', 'imgui_widgets')]
    jobs += [(cxx, ['-x', 'c++'] + cxxflags, os.path.join(rt, 'ui', 'option_rows.mm')),
             (cxx, cxxflags, os.path.join(HERE, 'test_saves_tab.cpp'))]
    cflags = ['-std=gnu11', '-O1', '-D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64', '-I' + rt, '-I' + st]
    jobs += [(cc, cflags, os.path.join(rt, 'imageload.c')), (cc, cflags + ['-DSC_TEST'], os.path.join(rt, 'services', 'save_convert.c')),
             (cc, cflags, os.path.join(rt, 'services', 'archive.c')),
             (cc, cflags, os.path.join(rt, 'services', 'save_profiles.c'))]
    procs, objs = [], []
    for i, (c, flags, src) in enumerate(jobs):
        o = os.path.join(d, '%d.o' % i)
        objs.append(o)
        procs.append(subprocess.Popen([c, '-c'] + flags + ['-o', o, src], stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True))
    errs = [p.communicate()[1] for p in procs]
    bad = [e for p, e in zip(procs, errs) if p.returncode]
    if bad:
        return None, ('SDL3 headers not found (set SDL3_INCLUDE)' if 'SDL3/SDL.h' in bad[0] else bad[0][-600:])
    exe = os.path.join(d, 'test_saves_tab' + ('.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else ''))
    p = subprocess.run([cxx, '-o', exe] + objs + ['-lpthread'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return (exe, None) if p.returncode == 0 else (None, p.stderr[-600:])


def ui_run(exe, scenario, save, game, src=None, cwd=None):
    cmd = [exe, scenario, '--save', save, '--game', game] + (['--src', src] if src else [])
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180, cwd=cwd)
    out = {}
    for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
        k, _, v = line.partition(' ')
        out[k] = v
    return p.returncode, out, p.stdout + p.stderr[-500:]


def ui_cases(r):
    exe, why = build_ui(r.tmp)
    if not exe:
        print('SKIP  the Saves tab on its own (%s)' % why)
        return
    base = os.path.join(r.tmp, 'ui_world')
    game = os.path.join(base, 'game')
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(game, 'romfs', 'Pack'))
    make_bootup(os.path.join(game, 'romfs', 'Pack', 'Bootup.pack'))
    cemu = make_profile(os.path.join(base, 'cemu', 'user', '80000001'), seed=11)
    py_out = run_python(cemu, os.path.join(game, 'romfs', 'Pack', 'Bootup.pack'), os.path.join(base, 'py_expected'))[0]

    picture = os.path.join(r.tmp, 'picture.jpg')   # a picture the tab can show (the synthetic saves hold random bytes)
    subprocess.run([exe, 'jpeg', picture], check=True)
    with open(picture, 'rb') as f:
        picture = f.read()

    def fresh(name, saves=True):
        """A data folder with the player's Switch save in data/save (and an SD card folder), and its copy."""
        data = os.path.join(r.tmp, 'ui_' + name)
        save = os.path.join(data, 'save')
        os.makedirs(data)
        if saves:
            make_profile(os.path.join(save, 'save_0'), seed=9, e='<', slots=(0, 1), tracker=True, extras=True)
            for slot in (0, 1):
                with open(os.path.join(save, 'save_0', str(slot), 'caption.jpg'), 'wb') as f:
                    f.write(picture)
            os.makedirs(os.path.join(save, 'sdcard'))
            with open(os.path.join(save, 'sdcard', 'note.txt'), 'w') as f:
                f.write('SD')
        return data, save, (tree(save) if saves else {})

    def leftovers(data):
        return sorted(n for n in os.listdir(data) if n.startswith('save-import-'))

    # import over an existing save, the question answered with a click on Import
    data, save, before = fresh('import')
    rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, 'import', save, game, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(cemu)), cwd=data)
    problems = []
    if rc != 0 or o.get('DONE') is None:
        problems.append('the harness failed (exit %d): %s' % (rc, log[-400:]))
    else:
        if o.get('KIND') != '1':
            problems.append('not imported: %s' % o)
        problems += ['new save: ' + x for x in compare(py_out, {k[len('save_0/'):]: v for k, v in tree(save).items() if k.startswith('save_0/')})]
        backups = os.path.join(data, 'save-backups')
        names = os.listdir(backups) if os.path.isdir(backups) else []
        if len(names) != 1:
            problems.append('wanted one backup folder, found %s' % names)
        else:
            if tree(os.path.join(backups, names[0])) != before:
                problems.append('the backup is not the old save folder')
            if os.path.join(backups, names[0]) != o.get('BACKUP'):
                problems.append('the popup named another folder: %s' % o.get('BACKUP'))
        if tree(save).get('sdcard/note.txt') != b'SD':
            problems.append('the SD card folder was not carried over')
        if leftovers(data):
            problems.append('staging folder left behind: %s' % leftovers(data))
        if o.get('TEXTURES') != 'created=2 freed=2':
            problems.append('pictures: %s' % o.get('TEXTURES'))
        if o.get('PICTURES') != '2' or o.get('SLOTS') != '2' or o.get('SLOTS_AFTER') != '3':
            problems.append('slot list: %s' % {k: o.get(k) for k in ('SLOTS', 'PICTURES', 'SLOTS_AFTER')})
    r.result('Saves tab: import over an existing save (popup, backup, swap, list)', problems)

    # Escape on the popup: everything as it was
    data, save, before = fresh('cancel')
    rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, 'cancel', save, game, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(cemu)), cwd=data)
    problems = []
    if rc != 0 or o.get('KIND') != '5':
        problems.append('not cancelled: %s' % log[-300:])
    if tree(save) != before:
        problems.append('the save folder changed')
    if leftovers(data) or os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, 'save-backups')):
        problems.append('left behind: %s' % os.listdir(data))
    r.result('Saves tab: Escape on the confirmation changes nothing and removes the staged copy', problems)

    # no save yet: nothing to back up, the import just makes the folder
    data, save, _ = fresh('first', saves=False)
    rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, 'import', save, game, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(cemu)), cwd=data)
    problems = []
    if rc != 0 or o.get('KIND') != '1':
        problems.append('not imported: %s' % log[-300:])
    else:
        problems += compare(py_out, {k[len('save_0/'):]: v for k, v in tree(save).items() if k.startswith('save_0/')})
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, 'save-backups')) or leftovers(data):
            problems.append('left behind: %s' % os.listdir(data))
    r.result('Saves tab: first import, with no save folder yet', problems)

    # refusals picked in the tab: the message, and the save folder exactly as it was
    sw = make_profile(os.path.join(base, 'switch_pick', 'user', '80000001'), seed=4, e='<')
    empty = os.path.join(base, 'empty_pick')
    os.makedirs(empty)
    bad = make_profile(os.path.join(base, 'bad_pick', 'user', '80000001'), seed=5)
    with open(os.path.join(bad, '1', 'game_data.sav'), 'r+b') as f:
        f.truncate(100)
    for name, folder, code, g in (('a Switch save', os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(sw)), '2', game),
                                  ('a folder with no save', empty, '1', game),
                                  ('a damaged save', os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(bad)), '3', game),
                                  ('game files without Bootup.pack', os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(cemu)), '4', os.path.join(base, 'nogame'))):
        data, save, before = fresh('refuse_' + re.sub(r'\W', '_', name))
        rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, 'pick', save, g, folder, cwd=data)
        problems = []
        if rc != 0 or o.get('KIND') != '2' or o.get('CODE') != code:
            problems.append('wanted a refusal with code %s: %s' % (code, {k: o.get(k) for k in ('KIND', 'CODE', 'DETAIL')}))
        if tree(save) != before:
            problems.append('the save folder changed')
        if leftovers(data) or os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, 'save-backups')):
            problems.append('left behind: %s' % os.listdir(data))
        r.result('Saves tab: %s is refused and nothing changes' % name, problems)

    # another Savage Wind is in game (its lock is held): import and backup refuse, with the message, and change nothing
    for scenario, kind in (('locked-import', '2'), ('locked-backup', '4')):
        data, save, before = fresh(scenario.replace('-', '_'))
        rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, scenario, save, game, cemu, cwd=data)
        problems = []
        if rc != 0 or o.get('KIND') != kind or o.get('CODE') != '11':
            problems.append('wanted a refusal with code 11 (in use): %s' % {k: o.get(k) for k in ('KIND', 'CODE', 'DETAIL')} or log[-300:])
        if tree(save) != before:
            problems.append('the save folder changed')
        if leftovers(data) or os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, 'save-backups')):
            problems.append('left behind: %s' % [x for x in os.listdir(data) if x != 'save'])
        r.result('Saves tab: %s while a game is running is refused and nothing changes' % scenario.split('-')[1], problems)

    for scenario in ('quit-convert', 'quit-confirm', 'quit-install'):
        data, save, before = fresh(scenario)
        rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, scenario, save, game, cemu, cwd=data)
        problems = []
        if rc != 0:
            problems.append(log[-600:])
        if leftovers(data):
            problems.append('staged folder left behind: %s' % leftovers(data))
        if scenario == 'quit-install':
            backups = os.path.join(data, 'save-backups')
            names = os.listdir(backups) if os.path.isdir(backups) else []
            if len(names) != 1 or tree(os.path.join(backups, names[0])) != before:
                problems.append('the previous saves were not backed up intact')
            problems += compare(py_out, {k[len('save_0/'):]: v for k, v in tree(save).items() if k.startswith('save_0/')})
        elif tree(save) != before:
            problems.append('the original save folder changed')
        r.result('Saves tab: %s joins the worker and leaves intact saves' % scenario, problems)

    data, save, before = fresh('recovery', saves=False)
    stage = os.path.join(data, 'save-import-20261030-123456')
    backup = os.path.join(data, 'save-backups', 'save-20261030-123456')
    make_profile(os.path.join(stage, 'save_0'), seed=21)
    make_profile(os.path.join(backup, 'save_0'), seed=22)
    old_stage, old_backup = tree(stage), tree(backup)
    rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, 'recovery', save, game, cwd=data)
    r.result('Saves tab: interrupted installation keeps both copies and names the recovery folders',
             [] if (rc == 0 and o.get('RECOVERY_IMPORT') == stage and o.get('RECOVERY_BACKUP') == backup
                    and not os.path.exists(save) and tree(stage) == old_stage and tree(backup) == old_backup) else [log[-600:]])

    # the Back up saves button
    data, save, before = fresh('backup')
    rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, 'backup', save, game, cwd=data)
    problems = []
    backups = os.path.join(data, 'save-backups')
    names = os.listdir(backups) if os.path.isdir(backups) else []
    if rc != 0 or o.get('KIND') != '3' or len(names) != 1:
        problems.append('no backup: %s' % log[-300:])
    else:
        if tree(os.path.join(backups, names[0])) != before or tree(save) != before:
            problems.append('the copy or the save folder differs')
        if o.get('FILES') != str(len(before)):
            problems.append('files counted: %s, copied: %d' % (o.get('FILES'), len(before)))
    r.result('Saves tab: Back up saves copies the save folder and leaves it where it is', problems)
    data, save, before = fresh('backup_none', saves=False)
    rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, 'backup', save, game, cwd=data)
    r.result('Saves tab: Back up saves with no saves says so and makes nothing',
             [] if (rc == 0 and o.get('KIND') == '4' and o.get('CODE') == '1' and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(data, 'save-backups'))) else [log[-300:]])


    # save profiles: create / copy / switch / refuse / delete through the tab's jobs; the player's own save folder is never touched
    data, save, before = fresh('profiles')
    rc, o, log = ui_run(exe, 'profiles', save, game, cwd=data)
    problems = []
    if rc != 0 or o.get('DONE') is None:
        problems.append('the harness failed (exit %d): %s' % (rc, log[-600:]))
    else:
        if tree(save) != before:
            problems.append('the Default save folder changed')
        left = sorted(os.listdir(os.path.join(data, 'save-profiles')))
        if left != ['Mine']:
            problems.append('profiles left: %s' % left)
        elif tree(os.path.join(data, 'save-profiles', 'Mine', 'save')) != before:
            problems.append('the copy is not the Default save folder')
        if open(os.path.join(data, 'save_profile.txt')).read().strip() != 'Default':
            problems.append('active profile: %s' % open(os.path.join(data, 'save_profile.txt')).read())
    r.result('Saves tab: profiles (create, copy, switch, refusals, delete) leave the Default saves alone', problems)


def real(r, src, bootup, allow_switch):
    if not os.path.isfile(bootup):
        sys.exit('Bootup.pack not found: %s' % bootup)
    r.both('your save: %s' % src, src, bootup, c_extra=('--allow-switch',) if allow_switch else (), tag='real')


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument('--src', help='your Wii U / Cemu profile folder (or a folder above it): compare both on the real save')
    ap.add_argument('--bootup', help='your Pack/Bootup.pack (with --src)')
    ap.add_argument('--exe', help='a built test_save_convert (default: built from the sources into a temporary folder)')
    ap.add_argument('--cc', help='C compiler to build it with')
    ap.add_argument('--allow-switch', action='store_true', help='with --src: the save is a Switch one')
    ap.add_argument('--no-ui', action='store_true', help='skip the cases that run the Saves tab (they need a C++ compiler and SDL3 headers)')
    ap.add_argument('--keep', action='store_true', help='keep the temporary folder (printed at the end)')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if bool(a.src) != bool(a.bootup):
        ap.error('--src and --bootup go together')
    tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='swr_save_convert_')
    try:
        exe = a.exe or build_exe(tmp, a.cc)
        r = Runner(exe, tmp)
        if a.src:
            real(r, a.src, a.bootup, a.allow_switch)
        else:
            synthetic(r)
            if not a.no_ui:
                ui_cases(r)
        print('%d of %d cases passed' % (r.n - r.failed, r.n))
        return 1 if r.failed else 0
    finally:
        if a.keep:
            print('kept: ' + tmp)
        else:
            shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```
