`tools/test_save_profiles.c`:

```c
// Test program for the save profiles (runtime/services/save_profiles.c): names, listing, create / copy / rename /
// delete, the active profile, the legacy `save` folder, and the failure paths. No SDL and no game files; the profiles
// are tiny fake folders made under a temporary directory (never a real save). Built and run by make test-save-profiles.
#include <assert.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <utime.h>
#include <dirent.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include "../runtime/platform/win_compat.h"  // (setenv, unsetenv, mkdir with a mode)
#include <windows.h>
#include <direct.h>
#include <io.h>
#endif
#include "../runtime/services/save_profiles.h"
#include "../runtime/services/save_convert.h"
#include "../runtime/settings.h"

Settings g_settings;  // (save_profiles.c reads save_dir: Options > Saves > Save folder, empty here)

static int checks;
// A directory link: a symlink here, a junction on Windows (needs no privilege there)
static int make_link(const char *target, const char *link) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    char cmd[2400], t[1100], l[1100];
    snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%s", target), snprintf(l, sizeof l, "%s", link);
    for (char *c = t; *c; c++) if (*c == '/') *c = '\\';
    for (char *c = l; *c; c++) if (*c == '/') *c = '\\';
    snprintf(cmd, sizeof cmd, "cmd /c mklink /J \"%s\" \"%s\" >nul", l, t);
    return system(cmd) == 0 ? 0 : -1;
#else
    return symlink(target, link);
#endif
}

static void drop_link(const char *link) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    RemoveDirectoryA(link);
#else
    unlink(link);
#endif
}

static int mk_tmp_root(char *out, size_t cap) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    const char *t = getenv("TEMP");
    snprintf(out, cap, "%s/sp-test-%d", t ? t : ".", (int)getpid());
    for (char *c = out; *c; c++) if (*c == '\\') *c = '/';
    return mkdir(out, 0755) == 0 || errno == EEXIST ? 0 : -1;
#else
    snprintf(out, cap, "/tmp/sp-test-XXXXXX");
    return mkdtemp(out) ? 0 : -1;
#endif
}

#define CHECK(c) do { checks++; if (!(c)) { fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: check failed: %s (%s)\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #c, sp_detail()); exit(1); } } while (0)

static char root[512];

static void mk(const char *rel) {  // mkdir -p of root/rel
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", root, rel);
    for (char *q = p + strlen(root) + 1; *q; q++)
        if (*q == '/') { *q = 0; mkdir(p, 0755); *q = '/'; }
    mkdir(p, 0755);
}

static void put(const char *rel, const char *text) {
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", root, rel);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "wb");
    assert(f);
    fputs(text, f);
    fclose(f);
}

static char *get(const char *rel) {  // contents, or NULL
    static char buf[256];
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", root, rel);
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, f);
    buf[n] = 0;
    fclose(f);
    return buf;
}

static bool there(const char *rel) {
    char p[1100];
    struct stat st;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", root, rel);
    return stat(p, &st) == 0;
}

// A fake slot: only what sc_list_slots looks for (a numbered folder with a game_data.sav) and a marker with the profile's name
static void slot(const char *save_rel, int n, const char *marker) {
    char rel[256];
    snprintf(rel, sizeof rel, "%s/save_0/%d", save_rel, n);
    mk(rel);
    strcat(rel, "/game_data.sav");
    put(rel, marker);
}

static bool listed(const char *name) {
    SpProfile *v;
    int n = sp_list(root, &v);
    bool found = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) found |= !strcmp(v[i].name, name);
    free(v);
    return found;
}

static void rmrf(const char *p) {
    char cmd[1200];
    snprintf(cmd, sizeof cmd, "rm -rf '%s'", p);
    if (system(cmd)) {}
}

static uint64_t tiny_disk(const char *dir) { (void)dir; return 1000; }
static uint64_t huge_disk(const char *dir) { (void)dir; return UINT64_MAX / 2; }

static void test_names(void) {
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("100%") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("100 percent") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("My save (2)") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a-b_c.d") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("") == SP_NAME_EMPTY);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name(NULL) == SP_NAME_EMPTY);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("   ") == SP_NAME_EMPTY);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name(" lead") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("trail ") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name(".hidden") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("dot.") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("..") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name(".") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a..b") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("../etc") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a/b") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a\\b") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("C:") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a:b") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a*b") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a?b") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a\"b") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("a<b>c|d") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("tab\there") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("new\nline") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("caf\xc3\xa9") == SP_NAME_CHARS);  // (non-ASCII: the Windows ANSI API can't be trusted with it)
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("Default") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("DEFAULT") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("nul") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("CON") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("com1") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("LPT9") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("nul.txt") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("Aux.save") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("com0") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("com10") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_validate_name("console") == SP_OK);
    char lng[64];
    memset(lng, 'a', sizeof lng);
    lng[SP_NAME_MAX] = 0;
    CHECK(sp_validate_name(lng) == SP_OK);
    lng[SP_NAME_MAX] = 'a';
    lng[SP_NAME_MAX + 1] = 0;
    CHECK(sp_validate_name(lng) == SP_NAME_LONG);
    // nothing invalid gets a path
    char out[1100];
    CHECK(!sp_save_dir(root, "../x", out, sizeof out));
    CHECK(!sp_save_dir(root, "a/b", out, sizeof out));
    CHECK(sp_save_dir(NULL, "Default", out, sizeof out) && !strcmp(out, "save"));
    CHECK(sp_save_dir(NULL, "Mine", out, sizeof out) && !strcmp(out, "save-profiles/Mine/save"));
}

static void test_legacy(void) {
    // an install that has never heard of profiles: only save/
    slot("save", 0, "legacy-0");
    put("save/save_0/option.sav", "opt");
    SpProfile *v;
    int n = sp_list(root, &v);
    CHECK(n == 1 && v[0].is_default && v[0].active && !strcmp(v[0].name, "Default") && v[0].slots == 1 && v[0].saved > 0);
    free(v);
    unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR");
    char out[1100], want[1100];
    sp_active_save_dir(root, out, sizeof out);
    snprintf(want, sizeof want, "%s/save", root);
    CHECK(!strcmp(out, want));
    char name[64];
    sp_active(root, name, sizeof name);
    CHECK(!strcmp(name, "Default"));
    CHECK(!there("save_profile.txt") && !there("save-profiles"));  // (looking creates nothing)
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"), "legacy-0"));
    // without any save folder at all
    sp_active_save_dir("/nonexistent-root", out, sizeof out);
    CHECK(!strcmp(out, "/nonexistent-root/save"));
}

static void test_override(void) {
    char out[1100];
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "Over") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "Over") == SP_OK);
    setenv("SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR", "/tmp/scratch-save", 1);
    sp_active_save_dir(root, out, sizeof out);
    CHECK(!strcmp(out, "/tmp/scratch-save") && sp_override_active());
    sp_session_begin();
    CHECK(!strcmp(sp_session_save_dir(), "/tmp/scratch-save"));
    unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR");
    CHECK(!sp_override_active());
    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "Default") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "Over") == SP_OK);
}

static void test_create_switch(void) {
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "Full 100") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(there("save-profiles/Full 100/save"));
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "full 100") == SP_EXISTS);          // case-insensitive duplicate
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "FULL 100") == SP_EXISTS);
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "Default") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "../evil") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "") == SP_NAME_EMPTY);
    CHECK(!there("evil") && !there("../evil"));
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "alpha") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "Beta") == SP_OK);
    SpProfile *v;
    int n = sp_list(root, &v);
    CHECK(n == 4);
    CHECK(!strcmp(v[0].name, "Default") && !strcmp(v[1].name, "alpha") && !strcmp(v[2].name, "Beta") && !strcmp(v[3].name, "Full 100"));
    CHECK(v[0].active && !v[1].active && v[1].slots == 0);
    free(v);

    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "full 100") == SP_OK);           // (looked up without regard to case, stored as it is spelled)
    char name[64], out[1100], want[1100];
    sp_active(root, name, sizeof name);
    CHECK(!strcmp(name, "Full 100"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("save_profile.txt"), "Full 100\n"));
    unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR");
    sp_active_save_dir(root, out, sizeof out);
    snprintf(want, sizeof want, "%s/save-profiles/Full 100/save", root);
    CHECK(!strcmp(out, want));
    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "nope") == SP_NOT_FOUND);
    sp_active(root, name, sizeof name);
    CHECK(!strcmp(name, "Full 100"));
    // a garbled or stale file falls back to Default
    put("save_profile.txt", "../../etc\n");
    sp_active(root, name, sizeof name);
    CHECK(!strcmp(name, "Default"));
    put("save_profile.txt", "gone\n");
    sp_active(root, name, sizeof name);
    CHECK(!strcmp(name, "Default"));
    put("save_profile.txt", "alpha\r\n");
    sp_active(root, name, sizeof name);
    CHECK(!strcmp(name, "alpha"));
    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "Default") == SP_OK);
    // stray things in save-profiles are not profiles
    mk("save-profiles/.tmp-x");
    mk("save-profiles/bad:name");
    put("save-profiles/afile", "x");
    n = sp_list(root, &v);
    CHECK(n == 4);
    free(v);
    rmrf((snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s/save-profiles/bad:name", root), out));
    rmrf((snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s/save-profiles/.tmp-x", root), out));
    rmrf((snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s/save-profiles/afile", root), out));
}

static void test_copy(void) {
    // the "100% save" scenario: a profile with its own slots, copied from the player's own
    slot("save-profiles/Full 100/save", 0, "full-0");
    slot("save-profiles/Full 100/save", 1, "full-1");
    put("save-profiles/Full 100/save/save_0/option.sav", "full-opt");
    sp_free_space_hook = huge_disk;
    uint64_t bytes = 0;
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Full 100", "Dev copy", &bytes) == SP_OK);
    CHECK(bytes > 0);
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("save-profiles/Dev copy/save/save_0/1/game_data.sav"), "full-1"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("save-profiles/Dev copy/save/save_0/option.sav"), "full-opt"));
    // independent from here on: a change in the copy does not reach the original
    put("save-profiles/Dev copy/save/save_0/1/game_data.sav", "changed");
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("save-profiles/Full 100/save/save_0/1/game_data.sav"), "full-1"));
    // no temp folder is left
    DIR *d;
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save-profiles", root);
    d = opendir(p);
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) CHECK(strncmp(e->d_name, ".tmp-", 5) != 0 && strncmp(e->d_name, ".deleting-", 10) != 0);
    closedir(d);

    // copying the legacy Default profile; it stays untouched
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Default", "Mine", NULL) == SP_OK);
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("save-profiles/Mine/save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"), "legacy-0"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"), "legacy-0"));
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "", "Mine2", NULL) == SP_OK);

    // refusals
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Full 100", "dev COPY", NULL) == SP_EXISTS);
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Full 100", "Default", NULL) == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Full 100", "a/b", NULL) == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "missing", "Other", NULL) == SP_NOT_FOUND);
    CHECK(!there("save-profiles/Other"));

    // low disk space: fails cleanly before copying anything
    sp_free_space_hook = tiny_disk;
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Full 100", "TooBig", NULL) == SP_NO_SPACE);
    CHECK(!there("save-profiles/TooBig"));
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save-profiles", root);
    d = opendir(p);
    while ((e = readdir(d))) CHECK(strncmp(e->d_name, ".tmp-", 5) != 0);
    closedir(d);
    sp_free_space_hook = huge_disk;

    // a source in use by a running game (its lock held): refused, nothing left behind
    ScLock *lock = NULL;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save-profiles/Full 100/save", root);
    CHECK(sc_lock_take(p, &lock) == SC_LOCK_OK);
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Full 100", "Locked", NULL) == SP_IN_USE);  // (flock is per open file description: a second open conflicts)
    CHECK(!there("save-profiles/Locked"));
    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "Full 100") == SP_IN_USE);
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Full 100", "Other name") == SP_IN_USE);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "Full 100") == SP_IN_USE);
    CHECK(there("save-profiles/Full 100/save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"));
    sc_lock_drop(lock);
    CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Full 100", "Locked", NULL) == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "Locked") == SP_OK);

    // a broken copy (a file that can't be read) leaves no half profile
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save-profiles/Full 100/save/save_0/0/game_data.sav", root);
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (0) {  // (no chmod 000 there)
#else
    if (geteuid() != 0) {
#endif
        chmod(p, 0000);
        CHECK(sp_copy(root, "Full 100", "Broken", NULL) == SP_IO);
        chmod(p, 0644);
        CHECK(!there("save-profiles/Broken"));
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save-profiles", root);
        d = opendir(p);
        while ((e = readdir(d))) CHECK(strncmp(e->d_name, ".tmp-", 5) != 0);
        closedir(d);
    }
}

static void test_rename_delete(void) {
    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "Mine") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Mine", "Renamed") == SP_IS_ACTIVE);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "Mine") == SP_IS_ACTIVE);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "mine") == SP_IS_ACTIVE);          // (the name's case doesn't get around it)
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Default", "X") == SP_IS_DEFAULT);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "Default") == SP_IS_DEFAULT);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "") == SP_IS_DEFAULT);
    CHECK(there("save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"));
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "nope") == SP_NOT_FOUND);
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "nope", "x") == SP_NOT_FOUND);

    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Dev copy", "Dev renamed") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(!there("save-profiles/Dev copy") && there("save-profiles/Dev renamed/save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"));
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Dev renamed", "mine") == SP_EXISTS);   // (taken: it is the active one, in another case)
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Dev renamed", "Full 100") == SP_EXISTS);
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Dev renamed", "full 100") == SP_EXISTS);
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Dev renamed", "../x") == SP_NAME_CHARS);
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Dev renamed", "Default") == SP_NAME_RESERVED);
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Dev renamed", "") == SP_NAME_EMPTY);
    CHECK(there("save-profiles/Dev renamed"));
    CHECK(sp_rename(root, "Dev renamed", "DEV RENAMED") == SP_OK);  // (only the letters' case)
    CHECK(listed("DEV RENAMED") && !listed("Dev renamed"));

    // delete: the others are never touched
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "dev renamed") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(!listed("DEV RENAMED") && !there("save-profiles/DEV RENAMED"));
    CHECK(there("save-profiles/Full 100/save/save_0/1/game_data.sav"));
    CHECK(there("save-profiles/Mine/save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"));
    CHECK(there("save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"));
    DIR *d;
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save-profiles", root);
    d = opendir(p);
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) CHECK(strncmp(e->d_name, ".deleting-", 10) != 0);
    closedir(d);

    // a profile that is a link is not deleted (what it points to is not ours to remove)
    char target[1100], link[1100];
    snprintf(target, sizeof target, "%s/elsewhere", root);
    mkdir(target, 0755);
    put("elsewhere/precious", "keep");
    snprintf(link, sizeof link, "%s/save-profiles/Linked", root);
    CHECK(make_link(target, link) == 0);
    CHECK(listed("Linked"));
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "Linked") == SP_LINKED);
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("elsewhere/precious"), "keep"));
    drop_link(link);

    // a link INSIDE a profile is removed as a link, never followed
    CHECK(sp_create(root, "WithLink") == SP_OK);
    snprintf(link, sizeof link, "%s/save-profiles/WithLink/save/out", root);
    CHECK(make_link(target, link) == 0);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "WithLink") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(!strcmp(get("elsewhere/precious"), "keep"));

    // switching back and forth never touches data
    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "Full 100") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_set_active(root, "Default") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "Mine") == SP_OK);
    CHECK(sp_delete(root, "Mine2") == SP_OK);
}

static void test_cleanup(void) {
    mk("save-profiles/.deleting-a/save");
    put("save-profiles/.deleting-a/save/f", "x");
    mk("save-profiles/.tmp-old/save");
    mk("save-profiles/.tmp-new/save");
    char p[1100];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save-profiles/.tmp-old", root);
#ifdef _WIN32
    {  // (utime can't open a folder here)
        HANDLE h = CreateFileA(p, FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, NULL,
                               OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, NULL);
        FILETIME ft = {0, 0x01B21DD2};  // (about 1970; any time long ago)
        CHECK(h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && SetFileTime(h, NULL, NULL, &ft));
        CloseHandle(h);
    }
#else
    struct utimbuf old = {1, 1};  // (1970)
    utime(p, &old);
#endif
    sp_cleanup(root);
    CHECK(!there("save-profiles/.deleting-a"));
    CHECK(!there("save-profiles/.tmp-old"));
    CHECK(there("save-profiles/.tmp-new"));  // (could be a copy running right now in another Savage Wind)
    CHECK(there("save-profiles/Full 100/save/save_0/0/game_data.sav"));
}

int main(void) {
    char tmpl[1100];
    if (mk_tmp_root(tmpl, sizeof tmpl)) { perror("temp folder"); return 1; }
    snprintf(root, sizeof root, "%s", tmpl);
    unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR");
    test_names();
    test_legacy();
    test_override();
    test_create_switch();
    test_copy();
    test_rename_delete();
    test_cleanup();
    rmrf(root);
    printf("save profiles: %d checks passed\n", checks);
    return 0;
}

```

`tools/test_saves_tab.cpp`:

```cpp
// Runs the start screen's Saves tab (runtime/ui/saves_tab.mm) without a window or a renderer: Dear ImGui builds its
// frames and draw lists as usual (its asserts catch an unbalanced ID stack, a popup that isn't closed, ...), the SDL
// folder dialog and the GPU textures are replaced by stand-ins, and a scenario clicks through the tab with synthetic
// keys and a click. tools/test_save_convert.py builds and drives it (skipped with --no-ui) and checks the files afterwards.
//
//   test_saves_tab jpeg <path>                 a small real JPEG (the synthetic saves hold random bytes as pictures)
//   test_saves_tab <scenario> --save <save folder> --game <game files folder> [--src <folder>]
//     scenario: import   pick the folder, click Import in the question, wait for the result
//               cancel   pick the folder, then Escape in the question
//               pick     only pick the folder (a refusal shows as the result)
//               backup   the Back up saves button
//               locked-import, locked-backup   the same, with another "game" holding the save folder's lock
//               profiles create, copy, switch, refuse, delete through the profile jobs and the delete question (the
//                        working directory is the data root; --save is not used as an override then)
// Output: lines "KEY value" for the script to read (KIND is the Kind enum, CODE an ScCode); exit status 1 when the tab
// itself misbehaved.
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>  // _mkdir
#include <stdlib.h>  // _putenv_s
#include <windows.h>
#endif
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

#include "imgui_internal.h"  // (a window by name)
#include "../runtime/services/save_convert.h"
static ScCode tab_convert(const char *, const char *, const ScFormat *, unsigned, const ScCancel *, ScStage **, ScReport *);
#define sc_convert_cancel tab_convert
#include "../runtime/ui/saves_tab.mm"  // (the whole file: the test reaches its state)
#undef sc_convert_cancel

#include "stb_image_write.h"

// Pause at an actual file boundary, or between the installation renames. Exit must release the worker and join it.
static std::atomic<bool> g_pause_convert{false}, g_pause_install{false}, g_paused{false};
struct Gate { const ScCancel *cancel; ScReport *report; };
static bool gated_cancel(void *p) {
    Gate *g = (Gate *)p;
    if (g_pause_convert && g->report->n_written) {
        g_paused = true;
        while (!g->cancel->requested(g->cancel->data)) std::this_thread::yield();
    }
    return g->cancel->requested(g->cancel->data);
}
static ScCode tab_convert(const char *src, const char *dst, const ScFormat *fmt, unsigned flags,
                          const ScCancel *cancel, ScStage **stage, ScReport *r) {
    Gate gate = {cancel, r};
    ScCancel check = {gated_cancel, &gate};
    return sc_convert_cancel(src, dst, fmt, flags, &check, stage, r);
}
extern "C" void sc_test_before_install(void) {
    if (!g_pause_install) return;
    g_paused = true;
    while (!g_cancel.load()) std::this_thread::yield();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- stand-ins
static int g_created, g_freed;

extern "C" {
SDL_Window *ui_window(void) { return NULL; }
uint64_t vk_imgui_texture_rgba(const void *, int, int) { return 1000 + (uint64_t)++g_created; }
void vk_imgui_texture_free(uint64_t) { g_freed++; }
const char *rt_data_root(void) { return "."; }
bool rt_is_link(const char *p) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    DWORD a = GetFileAttributesA(p);  // (a junction or symlink is a reparse point)
    return a != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES && (a & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT);
#else
    struct stat st;
    return lstat(p, &st) == 0 && S_ISLNK(st.st_mode);
#endif
}
#ifdef _WIN32
bool SDL_CreateDirectory(const char *p) { return _mkdir(p) == 0 || errno == EEXIST; }
#else
bool SDL_CreateDirectory(const char *p) { return mkdir(p, 0755) == 0 || errno == EEXIST; }
#endif
void SDL_ShowOpenFolderDialog(SDL_DialogFileCallback, void *, SDL_Window *, const char *, bool) {}
}
void reveal_folder(const std::string &dir) { printf("REVEAL %s\n", dir.c_str()); }
const char *tr(const char *en) { return en; }
Settings g_settings;         // (Saves > Back up at each start, #537)
extern "C" void settings_save(void) {}
std::string tr_upper(const char *s) {
    std::string r = s;
    for (char &c : r) c = (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
    return r;
}
bool ui_input_text(const char *, char *, size_t, ImGuiInputTextFlags, const char *, const char *) { return false; }
bool ui_input_text_cancelled(void) { return false; }
bool osk_is_open(void) { return false; }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the frames
static ImGuiIO *g_io;
static bool g_picture_drawn;  // some frame drew one of the save pictures

static void frame() {
    g_io->DeltaTime = 1 / 60.0f;
    ImGui::NewFrame();
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(0, 0));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(1500, 1000));
    ImGui::Begin("settings", NULL, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings);
    saves_tab_draw();
    ImGui::End();
    ImGui::Render();
    for (ImDrawList *l : ImGui::GetDrawData()->CmdLists)
        for (const ImDrawCmd &c : l->CmdBuffer)
            if (c.GetTexID() >= 1000) g_picture_drawn = true;
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(4));
}

static void frames(int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) frame();
}

static bool until(bool (*done)(), int max_frames = 3000) {  // (the worker runs on its own thread)
    for (int i = 0; i < max_frames && !done(); i++) frame();
    return done();
}

static void key(ImGuiKey k) {
    g_io->AddKeyEvent(k, true);
    frame();
    g_io->AddKeyEvent(k, false);
    frame();
}

static void pick(const std::string &folder) {
    const char *list[] = {folder.c_str(), NULL};
    folder_picked_import(NULL, list, 0);
}

static bool in_confirm() { return g_phase.load() == CONFIRM; }
static bool asks_or_ends() { int p = g_phase.load(); return p == CONFIRM || p == DONE; }
static bool is_done() { return g_phase.load() == DONE; }
static bool is_working() { return g_phase.load() == WORKING; }


static int run(const std::string &scenario, const std::string &src) {
    int bad = 0;
    auto check = [&](bool ok, const char *what) {
        printf("%s %s\n", ok ? "ok" : "BAD", what);
        bad += !ok;
    };
    frame();
    check(until([] { return g_phase.load() != LOADING; }), "the slot list loads on the worker");
    frames(40);  // (the list and its pictures, one a frame)
    printf("SLOTS %zu\n", g_slots.size());
    int shown = 0;
    for (const Thumb &t : g_thumbs) shown += t.tex != 0;
    printf("PICTURES %d\n", shown);
    // the mouse over the rows: a slot's picture comes up in the pane on the right
    for (int y = 40; y < 900 && !g_picture_drawn; y += 14) {
        g_io->AddMousePosEvent(300, (float)y);
        frames(2);
    }
    check(g_slots.empty() || shown == 0 || g_picture_drawn, "a slot's picture is drawn when its row is hovered");
    g_io->AddMousePosEvent(-1000, -1000);
    if (scenario == "profiles") {
        auto job = [&](ProfileOp op, const char *a, const char *b) {
            start(JOB_PROFILE, a, b, op);
            bool ok = until(is_done);
            frames(5);  // (the result and the new list are taken)
            return ok;
        };
        check(!sp_override_active(), "no save folder override: profiles are on");
        check(g_profiles.size() == 1 && g_profiles[0].is_default && g_profiles[0].active, "only the Default profile at first");
        snprintf(g_pname, sizeof g_pname, "Full 100");
        check(job(PO_CREATE, "", g_pname) && g_kind == PROFILE_DONE && g_profiles.size() == 2 && g_sel == "Full 100", "create selects the new profile");
        snprintf(g_pname, sizeof g_pname, "full 100");
        check(job(PO_COPY, "Default", g_pname) && g_kind == PROFILE_FAILED && g_pcode == SP_EXISTS, "a duplicate name in other case is refused");
        snprintf(g_pname, sizeof g_pname, "../x");
        check(job(PO_CREATE, "", g_pname) && g_kind == PROFILE_FAILED && g_pcode == SP_NAME_CHARS, "a path in the name is refused");
        snprintf(g_pname, sizeof g_pname, "Mine");
        check(job(PO_COPY, "Default", g_pname) && g_kind == PROFILE_DONE && g_sel == "Mine", "copy of Default");
        check(job(PO_SWITCH, "Mine", "") && g_kind == PROFILE_DONE, "switch");
        check(save_dir() == "save-profiles/Mine/save", "the tab now works on the profile's folder");
        check(g_slots.size() == 2, "the slot list is the profile's");
        check(job(PO_DELETE, "Mine", "") && g_kind == PROFILE_FAILED && g_pcode == SP_IS_ACTIVE, "the profile in use is not deleted");
        // the delete question: Escape keeps the profile, no popup is left open (ImGui asserts on an unbalanced one)
        g_sel = "Full 100";
        g_delete_open = true, g_delete_name = "Full 100", g_delete_slots = 0;
        frames(5);
        check(ImGui::FindWindowByName("##profdel") != NULL, "the delete question is a window of its own");
        key(ImGuiKey_Escape);
        frames(3);
        check(!g_delete_open && find_profile("Full 100"), "Escape keeps the profile");
        check(job(PO_DELETE, "Full 100", "") && g_kind == PROFILE_DONE && g_profiles.size() == 2 && !find_profile("Full 100"), "delete");
        check(job(PO_SWITCH, "Default", "") && g_kind == PROFILE_DONE && save_dir() == "save", "back to Default");
        return bad;
    }
    if (scenario == "recovery") {
        check(g_recovery.imported[0] && g_recovery.backup[0], "the recovery message names both folders");
        check(!saves_tab_busy(), "recovery has no running worker");
        printf("RECOVERY_IMPORT %s\nRECOVERY_BACKUP %s\n", g_recovery.imported, g_recovery.backup);
        return bad;
    }
    if (scenario == "quit-convert") {
        g_pause_convert = true;
        start(JOB_CONVERT, src);
        check(until([] { return g_paused.load(); }), "conversion has written a file and is still working");
        check(is_working(), "exit begins during WORKING");
        exit(bad ? 1 : 0);  // (the launcher's Quit and window close use this same path)
    }
    ScLock *game = NULL;  // (held to the end of the run: the running game of another Savage Wind)
    if (scenario == "locked-import" || scenario == "locked-backup")
        check(sc_lock_take(save_dir().c_str(), &game) == SC_LOCK_OK, "the stand-in game takes the lock");
    if (scenario == "backup" || scenario == "locked-backup") {
        start(JOB_BACKUP);
        check(until(is_done), "the backup finishes");
        frames(10);
        printf("KIND %d\nCODE %d\nFILES %d\nBACKUP %s\n", (int)g_kind, g_code, g_files, g_backup.c_str());
        return bad;
    }
    pick(src);
    frames(2);
    if (!until(asks_or_ends) || !in_confirm()) {
        check(is_done(), "an import that cannot start ends with a result");
        frames(10);
        printf("KIND %d\nCODE %d\nDETAIL %s\n", (int)g_kind, g_code, g_detail.c_str());
        return bad;
    }
    frames(10);  // (the question is up)
    printf("STAGE %s\nBACKUP %s\nHADSAVES %d\n", g_stage_dir.c_str(), g_backup.c_str(), (int)g_had_saves);
    if (scenario == "quit-confirm") exit(bad ? 1 : 0);
    if (scenario == "quit-install") {
        g_pause_install = true;
        start(JOB_INSTALL);
        check(until([] { return g_paused.load(); }), "installation is between the two renames");
        check(is_working(), "exit begins during WORKING");
        drop_stage_at_exit();  // also runs again at exit: joining and cleanup must be idempotent
        check(!g_joinable && !g_stage, "cleanup joins the installer and releases the stage");
        check(g_kind == IMPORTED, "installation finishes before cleanup returns");
        return bad;
    }
    if (scenario == "pick") {
        key(ImGuiKey_Escape);
        until(is_done, 60);
        return bad;
    }
    if (scenario == "cancel") {
        g_last_frame = -100;  // returning to the tab must not clean up the copy waiting for confirmation
        frame();
        struct stat st;
        check(in_confirm() && g_stage && stat(g_stage_dir.c_str(), &st) == 0, "a waiting stage survives reopening the tab");
        key(ImGuiKey_Escape);
        check(until(is_done, 120), "Escape in the question ends it");
        frames(10);
        printf("KIND %d\n", (int)g_kind);
        return bad;
    }
    // a click on the Import button: the question's window is found by name, the button is the first one on its last line
    ImGuiWindow *ask = ImGui::FindWindowByName("##importok");
    check(ask != NULL, "the question is a window of its own");
    if (ask) {
        const ImGuiStyle &st = ImGui::GetStyle();
        float bh = ImGui::GetFontSize() + 2 * st.FramePadding.y;
        g_io->AddMousePosEvent(ask->Pos.x + st.WindowPadding.x + ImGui::GetFontSize() * 4.5f,
                               ask->Pos.y + ask->Size.y - st.WindowPadding.y - bh / 2);
        frames(2);
        g_io->AddMouseButtonEvent(0, true);
        frame();
        g_io->AddMouseButtonEvent(0, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < 20 && !is_working() && !is_done(); i++) frame();
    }
    bool clicked = is_working() || is_done();
    check(clicked, "a click on Import in the question starts the import");
    if (!clicked) start(JOB_INSTALL);  // (the click missed: the rest of the scenario still runs)
    check(until(is_done), "the import finishes");
    frames(60);  // (the result, the new list and its pictures)
    printf("KIND %d\nCODE %d\nDETAIL %s\nWARNINGS %d\n", (int)g_kind, g_code, g_detail.c_str(), g_warnings);
    printf("SLOTS_AFTER %zu\n", g_slots.size());
    printf("IMPORTED_SLOTS %s\nFLAGS %u %u %u\n", slot_list(g_rep).c_str(), g_rep.kept, g_rep.defaulted, g_rep.dropped);
    return bad;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    std::string scenario = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "", save, game, src;
    if (argc >= 3 && scenario == "jpeg") {  // a real picture for the slots (the synthetic saves hold random bytes)
        std::vector<unsigned char> px(64 * 36 * 3);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < px.size(); i++) px[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 7);
        return stbi_write_jpg(argv[2], 64, 36, 3, px.data(), 90) ? 0 : 1;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i < argc; i++) {
        if (i + 1 < argc && !strcmp(argv[i], "--save")) save = argv[++i];
        else if (i + 1 < argc && !strcmp(argv[i], "--game")) game = argv[++i];
        else if (i + 1 < argc && !strcmp(argv[i], "--src")) src = argv[++i];
    }
    if (scenario.empty() || save.empty() || game.empty()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: test_saves_tab jpeg <path> | import|cancel|pick|backup --save <dir> --game <dir> [--src <dir>]\n");
        return 2;
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    _putenv_s("SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR", scenario == "profiles" ? "" : save.c_str());
#else
    if (scenario == "profiles") unsetenv("SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR");  // (profiles are what is tested)
    else setenv("SAVAGEWIND_SAVE_DIR", save.c_str(), 1);
#endif
    saves_tab_set_game_files(game.c_str());
    ImGui::CreateContext();
    g_io = &ImGui::GetIO();
    g_io->IniFilename = NULL;
    g_io->ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard;
    g_io->DisplaySize = ImVec2(1920, 1080);
    g_io->Fonts->AddFontDefault();
    unsigned char *atlas;
    int aw, ah;
    g_io->Fonts->GetTexDataAsRGBA32(&atlas, &aw, &ah);
    int bad = run(scenario, src);
    printf("TEXTURES created=%d freed=%d\n", g_created, g_freed);
    saves_tab_unload();
    ImGui::DestroyContext();
    printf("DONE 1\n");
    return bad ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```c
// Translate dumped shaders to MSL and compile them with the Metal compiler.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "../runtime/nvn/maxwell/shader.h"

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    int ok = 0, bad = 0, tfail = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        FILE *f = fopen(argv[i], "rb");
        static uint8_t buf[0x10000];
        size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f);
        fclose(f);
        int stage = strstr(argv[i], "_s1_") ? STAGE_FRAGMENT : STAGE_VERTEX;
        ShaderKey key = {0};
        key.flip_y = true;
        ShaderInfo *s = maxwell_translate(buf, n, stage, &key);
        if (!s->msl) { printf("%s: TRANSLATE FAIL: %s\n", argv[i], s->error); tfail++; continue; }
        char out[512];
        snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s.metal", argv[i]);
        f = fopen(out, "w"); fputs(s->msl, f); fclose(f);
        char cmd[1024];
        snprintf(cmd, sizeof cmd, "xcrun -sdk macosx metal -c %s -o /tmp/x.air 2> %s.err", out, out);
        if (system(cmd) == 0) ok++; else { bad++; printf("%s: METAL COMPILE FAIL (see %s.err)\n", argv[i], out); }
    }
    printf("translated+compiled %d, compile failures %d, translation failures %d\n", ok, bad, tfail);
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_shaders.m`:

```m
// Translate dumped shaders to MSL and compile them with Metal (runtime compiler).
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "../runtime/nvn/maxwell/shader.h"

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    id<MTLDevice> dev = MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
    int ok = 0, bad = 0, tfail = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        FILE *f = fopen(argv[i], "rb");
        static uint8_t buf[0x10000];
        size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f);
        fclose(f);
        int stage = strstr(argv[i], "_s1_") ? STAGE_FRAGMENT : (strstr(argv[i], "cs_") || strstr(argv[i], "_s5_")) ? STAGE_COMPUTE : STAGE_VERTEX;
        // bound the code by the compiler-constant offset from the control dump, as the runtime does
        char cpath[512];
        snprintf(cpath, sizeof cpath, "%s", argv[i]);
        char *cp = strstr(cpath, "_code.bin");
        if (cp) {
            strcpy(cp, "_ctrl.bin");
            FILE *cf = fopen(cpath, "rb");
            if (cf) {
                uint8_t ctrl[0x800];
                if (fread(ctrl, 1, sizeof ctrl, cf) == sizeof ctrl) {
                    uint32_t coff = *(uint32_t *)(ctrl + 0x700);
                    if (coff && coff < n) n = coff;
                }
                fclose(cf);
            }
        }
        ShaderKey key = {0};
        key.flip_y = true;
        ShaderInfo *s = maxwell_translate(buf, n, stage, &key);
        if (!s->msl) { printf("%s: TRANSLATE FAIL: %s\n", argv[i], s->error); tfail++; continue; }
        char out[512];
        snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s.metal", argv[i]);
        f = fopen(out, "w"); fputs(s->msl, f); fclose(f);
        NSError *err = nil;
        id<MTLLibrary> lib = [dev newLibraryWithSource:@(s->msl) options:nil error:&err];
        if (lib && [lib newFunctionWithName:@"main0"]) ok++;
        else { bad++; printf("%s: COMPILE FAIL\n%s\n", argv[i], err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); }
    }
    printf("ok %d, compile failures %d, translation failures %d\n", ok, bad, tfail);
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_simd.py`:

```py
"""Differential test of the portable FP/SIMD lowering (lifter --simd=c) against Unicorn (Cortex-A57).

No NSO needed: the FP/SIMD data-processing space (bits 27..25 = 111), the FP/SIMD load/store space and CRC32
are enumerated (every opcode bit combination, random register fields), each encoding's validity is compared
between Unicorn and the lifter, then a stratified sample of valid encodings is compiled (clang) and run with
random interesting operands (NaNs, infinities, denormals, +-0, saturation edges, random FPCR.DN/FZ/RMode/AHP)
against Unicorn: X0-X30, SP, NZCV, V0-V31 and (for stores) memory must match. FPSR is not compared (the
lowering doesn't model the cumulative exception bits or QC).

Usage: test_simd.py [--encodings N] [--cases K] [--seed S] [--jobs J] [--no-validity] [--filter HEX/MASK] [--locals]

--locals: each instruction runs as gen.py --locals makes it (registers and flags in C locals, gen.single_with_locals).
"""
import argparse
import functools
import os
import platform
import random
import signal
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import zlib
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import unicorn as uc
from unicorn import arm64_const as A

from gen import single_with_locals
from lifter import Lifter, Unsupported

print = functools.partial(print, flush=True)
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BUF, BUF_SIZE = 0x7200000000, 0x20000
BASE_AREA = BUF + 0x8000
CODE, CODE_SIZE = 0x7210000000, 0x400000
IN_FMT = '<QQ32QQQ'
OUT_SIZE = 31 * 8 + 3 * 8 + 32 * 16
UC_INVALID = (uc.UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID, uc.UC_ERR_EXCEPTION)

F32 = [0, 0x80000000, 0x7f800000, 0xff800000, 0x7fc00000, 0xffc00000, 0x7fa00001, 0xff812345, 0x7fd00abc,
       0x00000001, 0x80000001, 0x007fffff, 0x807fffff, 0x00400000, 0x00800000, 0x80800000, 0x00800001, 0x7f7fffff,
       0xff7fffff, 0x3f800000, 0xbf800000, 0x3f000000, 0xbf000000, 0x40000000, 0x40400000, 0x3fc00000, 0xbfc00000,
       0x40200000, 0x40100000, 0x4f000000, 0xcf000000, 0x4f800000, 0x5f000000, 0xdf000000, 0x5f800000, 0x4effffff,
       0x4f7fffff, 0x5effffff, 0x5f7fffff, 0x3effffff, 0x3f7fffff, 0x7effffff, 0x01000000, 0x3e800000, 0x7e800000,
       0x7e7fffff, 0x00200000, 0x001fffff, 0x00200001, 0x47800000, 0x477fe000, 0x477ff000, 0x38800000, 0x33800000,
       0x33000000, 0x387fc000, 0x3f7ff000, 0x46fffe00, 0x80000000 | 0x00200000, 0x7f000000, 0x7f7ffffe]
F64 = [0, 1 << 63, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0xfff8000000000000,
       0x7ff4000000000001, 0xfff0000000012345, 0x7ffc00000abcdef0, 1, (1 << 63) | 1, 0x000fffffffffffff,
       0x0008000000000000, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff,
       0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0x4000000000000000, 0x4008000000000000,
       0x3ff8000000000000, 0xbff8000000000000, 0x4004000000000000, 0x41e0000000000000, 0xc1e0000000000000,
       0x41f0000000000000, 0x43e0000000000000, 0xc3e0000000000000, 0x43f0000000000000, 0x41dfffffffc00000,
       0x41efffffffe00000, 0x43dfffffffffffff, 0x43efffffffffffff, 0x3fdfffffffffffff, 0x7fdfffffffffffff,
       0x7fd0000000000000, 0x0004000000000000, 0x0003ffffffffffff, 0x47efffffe0000000, 0x47efffff00000000,
       0x36a0000000000000, 0x3810000000000000, 0x380fffffffffffff, 0x47f0000000000000, 0x3e70000000000000,
       0x3f0ffc0000000000, 0x40effc0000000000, 0x40effe0000000000, 0x3e6ffffffff00000, 0x369fffffffffffff,
       0x3810000010000000, 0x381000000fffffff, 0x3e80000000000000]
F16 = [0, 0x8000, 0x7c00, 0xfc00, 0x7e00, 0xfe00, 0x7d00, 0x7e55, 0x0001, 0x8001, 0x03ff, 0x0400, 0x7bff, 0xfbff,
       0x3c00, 0xbc00, 0x3800, 0x4000, 0x3e00, 0x7fff, 0xffff]


def rand_lane(r, sz):
    """Random interesting integer lane of 8 << sz bits."""
    bits_ = 8 << sz
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.35:
        return r.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, (1 << bits_) - 1, (1 << bits_) - 2, 1 << (bits_ - 1), (1 << (bits_ - 1)) - 1,
                         (1 << (bits_ - 1)) + 1, 0x80 % (1 << bits_), 0x7f, bits_ - 1, bits_, bits_ + 1,
                         (1 << bits_) - bits_, 1 << (bits_ // 2)])
    if k < 0.5:
        return r.getrandbits(r.randint(1, bits_))
    if k < 0.6:
        return ((1 << bits_) - r.getrandbits(r.randint(1, bits_ - 1))) & ((1 << bits_) - 1)
    return r.getrandbits(bits_)


def rand_f32(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.4:
        return r.choice(F32)
    if k < 0.8:
        e = r.choice([r.randint(110, 145), r.randint(0, 255), r.randint(120, 135)])
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 31) | (e << 23) | (r.getrandbits(23) if r.random() < 0.7 else
                                                        r.getrandbits(4) << 19)
    return struct.unpack('<I', struct.pack('<f', r.choice([r.uniform(-4, 4), float(r.randint(-300, 300)) + 0.5,
                                                           float(r.randint(-5, 5)), r.uniform(-1e6, 1e6)])))[0]


def rand_f64(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.4:
        return r.choice(F64)
    if k < 0.8:
        e = r.choice([r.randint(1000, 1050), r.randint(0, 2047), r.randint(1020, 1030), r.randint(0, 40),
                      r.randint(2000, 2047), r.randint(860, 920)])
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 63) | (e << 52) | (r.getrandbits(52) if r.random() < 0.7 else
                                                        r.getrandbits(6) << 46)
    return struct.unpack('<Q', struct.pack('<d', r.choice([r.uniform(-4, 4), float(r.randint(-300, 300)) + 0.5,
                                                           r.uniform(-1e12, 1e12)])))[0]


def rand_v(r):
    k = r.random()
    out = 0
    if k < 0.3:
        for i in range(4):
            out |= rand_f32(r) << (32 * i)
    elif k < 0.55:
        for i in range(2):
            out |= rand_f64(r) << (64 * i)
    elif k < 0.6:
        for i in range(8):
            out |= (r.choice(F16) if r.random() < 0.5 else r.getrandbits(16)) << (16 * i)
    elif k < 0.9:
        sz = r.randrange(4)
        for i in range(16 >> sz):
            out |= rand_lane(r, sz) << ((8 << sz) * i)
    else:
        out = r.getrandbits(128)
    if r.random() < 0.15:  # upper half zero, like most 64-bit results
        out &= (1 << 64) - 1
    return out


def rand_x(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.3:
        return r.choice([0, 1, 2, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x8000000000000000, 0xFFFFFFFF,
                         0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0x100000000, 0xFFFFFFFF80000000, 0x8000000000000001, 0xFFFFFF,
                         0x1000001, 0x20000000000001, 0xFFFFFFFFFF000001])
    if k < 0.45:
        return rand_f32(r) | (r.getrandbits(32) << 32 if r.random() < 0.3 else 0)
    if k < 0.6:
        return rand_f64(r)
    if k < 0.75:
        return r.getrandbits(r.randint(1, 64))
    if k < 0.8:
        return (-r.getrandbits(r.randint(1, 63))) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    return r.getrandbits(64)


def rand_fpcr(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.55:
        return 0
    v = 0
    if r.random() < 0.4:
        v |= 1 << 25  # DN
    if r.random() < 0.4:
        v |= 1 << 24  # FZ
    if r.random() < 0.4:
        v |= r.randrange(4) << 22  # RMode
    if r.random() < 0.15:
        v |= 1 << 26  # AHP
    return v


def is_ldst(w):
    return (w >> 25) & 1 == 0 and (w >> 27) & 1 == 1


def is_store(w):
    if not is_ldst(w):
        return False
    if (w & 0x3B000000) == 0x18000000:  # literal
        return False
    if (w & 0xBE000000) == 0x0C000000:  # structures: L = bit 22
        return not (w >> 22) & 1
    if (w >> 27) & 7 == 0b101:  # pair
        return not (w >> 22) & 1
    return not (w >> 22) & 1


def is_literal(w):
    return (w & 0x3F000000) == 0x1C000000


def class_key(w):
    """Opcode signature: register fields (Rd, Rn, Rm) cleared."""
    if is_ldst(w):
        return w & 0xFFE0FC00 if (w & 0xBE000000) == 0x0C000000 else w & 0xFFFFFC00
    return w & 0xFFE0FC00


def candidates(r):
    """Every opcode bit pattern of the FP/SIMD data-processing and load/store spaces, random registers."""
    out = []
    for p in range(1 << 19):
        hi, mid = p >> 15, p & 0x7FFF
        rr = r.getrandbits(10)
        out.append((hi << 28) | (0b111 << 25) | (mid << 10) | rr)  # data processing
        out.append((hi << 28) | (1 << 27) | (1 << 26) | (mid << 10) | rr)  # loads/stores
    for sf in (0, 1):
        for C in (0, 1):
            for sz in range(4):
                for _ in range(4):
                    out.append((sf << 31) | (0b0011010110 << 21) | (r.getrandbits(5) << 16) | (0b010 << 13) |
                               (C << 12) | (sz << 10) | r.getrandbits(10))
    return out


class Emu:
    def __init__(self):
        mu = uc.Uc(uc.UC_ARCH_ARM64, uc.UC_MODE_ARM)
        mu.ctl_set_cpu_model(A.UC_CPU_ARM64_A57)
        mu.mem_map(BUF, BUF_SIZE)
        mu.mem_map(CODE, CODE_SIZE)
        mu.reg_write(A.UC_ARM64_REG_CPACR_EL1, 0x300000)
        self.mu = mu
        self.xregs = [A.UC_ARM64_REG_X0 + i for i in range(29)] + [A.UC_ARM64_REG_X29, A.UC_ARM64_REG_X30]
        self.qregs = [A.UC_ARM64_REG_Q0 + i for i in range(32)]
        self.out_regs = self.xregs + [A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP, A.UC_ARM64_REG_NZCV] + self.qregs

    def run(self, pc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v):
        mu = self.mu
        mu.reg_write_batch(list(zip(self.xregs, x[:31])) + list(zip(self.qregs, v)) +
                           [(A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP, sp), (A.UC_ARM64_REG_NZCV, nzcv), (A.UC_ARM64_REG_FPCR, fpcr)])
        mu.emu_start(pc, pc + 4, count=1)
        o = mu.reg_read_batch(self.out_regs)
        return o[:31], o[31], o[32] & 0xF0000000, o[33:]


def validity(lifter, ws, emu):
    """Map word -> (lifter ok, unicorn ok); words are placed at CODE + 4i."""
    mu = emu.mu
    res = {}
    step = CODE_SIZE // 4
    for base in range(0, len(ws), step):
        chunk = ws[base:base + step]
        mu.mem_write(CODE, struct.pack(f'<{len(chunk)}I', *chunk))
        mu.ctl_remove_cache(CODE, CODE + CODE_SIZE)
        state = list(zip(emu.xregs, [BASE_AREA] * 31)) + [(A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP, BASE_AREA)]
        for i, w in enumerate(chunk):
            pc = CODE + 4 * i
            try:
                lifter.lift(w, pc)
                lok = True
            except Unsupported:
                lok = False
            if i % 32 == 0:
                mu.reg_write_batch(state)
            try:
                mu.emu_start(pc, pc + 4, count=1)
                uok = True
            except uc.UcError as e:
                uok = e.errno not in UC_INVALID
            res[w] = (lok, uok)
    return res


def make_case(r, w):
    fpcr = rand_fpcr(r)
    v = [rand_v(r) for _ in range(32)]
    nzcv = r.getrandbits(4) << 28
    sp = BASE_AREA + r.randrange(0, 0x100, 16)
    if is_ldst(w):
        x = [BASE_AREA + r.randrange(0, 0x100) for _ in range(31)]
        rm = (w >> 16) & 31
        if rm < 31 and rm != (w >> 5) & 31:
            reg_off = (w & 0x3B200C00) == 0x38200800  # register offset
            post_reg = (w & 0xBF800000) in (0x0C800000, 0x0D800000)
            if reg_off or post_reg:
                x[rm] = r.randrange(0, 0x100)
    else:
        x = [rand_x(r) for _ in range(31)]
    return fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v


def compile_tests(work, bodies, jobs, cflags):
    cc = os.environ.get('CC', 'clang')
    flags = ['-O1'] + cflags.split() + ['-fno-strict-aliasing', '-Wno-unused-label', '-I',
             os.path.join(ROOT, 'runtime')]
    n = max(1, min(jobs, len(bodies) // 200 + 1))
    per = (len(bodies) + n - 1) // n
    srcs, procs = [], []
    for j in range(n):
        path = os.path.join(work, f'tests_{j}.c')
        with open(path, 'w') as f:
            f.write('#include "cpu.h"\n')
            for k in range(j * per, min(len(bodies), (j + 1) * per)):
                f.write(f'void t{k}(Cpu *c) {{ {bodies[k]} }}\n')
        srcs.append(path)
    with open(os.path.join(work, 'table.c'), 'w') as f:
        f.write('#include "cpu.h"\n')
        f.write(''.join(f'void t{k}(Cpu *c);\n' for k in range(len(bodies))))
        f.write('GuestFn tests[] = {' + ','.join(f't{k}' for k in range(len(bodies))) + '};\n')
        f.write(f'int ntests = {len(bodies)};\n')
    srcs += [os.path.join(work, 'table.c'), os.path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'test_simd_harness.c')]
    objs = []
    for s in srcs:
        o = s[:-2] + '.o' if s.startswith(work) else os.path.join(work, 'harness.o')
        objs.append(o)
        procs.append(subprocess.Popen([cc] + flags + ['-c', s, '-o', o]))
    for p in procs:
        if p.wait():
            raise SystemExit('compile failed')
    exe = os.path.join(work, 'harness.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'harness')
    subprocess.check_call([cc, '-o', exe] + objs)
    return exe


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--encodings', type=int, default=20000)
    ap.add_argument('--cases', type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 4)
    ap.add_argument('--no-validity', action='store_true', help='skip the full validity enumeration')
    ap.add_argument('--filter', help='only encodings with (w & MASK) == VAL, as VAL/MASK in hex')
    ap.add_argument('--show', type=int, default=40)
    ap.add_argument('--locals', action='store_true', help='registers and flags in C locals (gen.py --locals)')
    ap.add_argument('--cflags', default='-march=x86-64-v3' if platform.machine().lower() in ('amd64', 'x86_64') else '',
                    help='extra compiler flags for the lifted tests')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    r = random.Random(args.seed)
    t0 = time.time()
    lifter = Lifter(0, 'c')
    emu = Emu()
    cands = candidates(r)
    if args.filter:
        val, mask = (int(x, 16) for x in args.filter.split('/'))
        cands = [w for w in cands if (w & mask) == val]
    if args.no_validity:
        sample = r.sample(cands, min(len(cands), args.encodings * 4))
        val = validity(lifter, sample, emu)
    else:
        val = validity(lifter, cands, emu)
    agree = Counter()
    only = defaultdict(list)
    for w, (lok, uok) in val.items():
        agree[(lok, uok)] += 1
        if lok != uok:
            only['lifter' if lok else 'unicorn'].append(w)
    print(f'validity: {len(val)} encodings, both valid {agree[(True, True)]}, both invalid {agree[(False, False)]}, '
          f'lifter-only {agree[(True, False)]}, unicorn-only {agree[(False, True)]} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)')
    import capstone
    md = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64, capstone.CS_MODE_ARM)

    def dis(w):
        d = next(md.disasm(struct.pack('<I', w), 0), None)
        return f'{d.mnemonic} {d.op_str}' if d else '?'

    for kind in ('lifter', 'unicorn'):
        ws = only[kind]
        if ws:
            byname = Counter(dis(w).split(' ')[0] for w in ws)
            print(f'  {kind}-only by mnemonic: {dict(byname.most_common(30))}')
            for w in ws[:args.show // 2]:
                print(f'    {w:08x} {dis(w)}')

    # stratified sample of valid encodings: one per opcode signature first
    valid = [w for w, (lok, uok) in val.items() if lok and uok]
    r.shuffle(valid)
    seen, pick = set(), []
    for w in valid:
        k = class_key(w)
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            pick.append(w)
    picked = set(pick)
    rest = [w for w in valid if w not in picked]
    pick = (pick + rest)[:args.encodings]
    # place at CODE + 4i; literal loads get an offset into the code region
    code = []
    for i, w in enumerate(pick):
        pc = CODE + 4 * i
        if is_literal(w):
            tgt = CODE + r.randrange(0, (len(pick) * 4 + 0x1000) & ~3, 4)
            w = (w & ~(0x7FFFF << 5)) | ((((tgt - pc) >> 2) & 0x7FFFF) << 5)
            pick[i] = w
        code.append(w)
    code_bytes = struct.pack(f'<{len(code)}I', *code) + bytes(0x1000 + 64)
    bodies = []
    for i, w in enumerate(pick):
        ins = lifter.lift(w, CODE + 4 * i)
        bodies.append(single_with_locals(ins.code) if args.locals else ins.code)
    work = os.path.join(ROOT, 'build', 'test_simd' + ('_locals' if args.locals else ''))
    os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
    t1 = time.time()
    exe = compile_tests(work, bodies, args.jobs, args.cflags)
    print(f'compiled {len(bodies)} tests ({time.time() - t1:.0f}s)')

    mu = emu.mu
    mu.mem_write(CODE, code_bytes)
    mu.ctl_remove_cache(CODE, CODE + CODE_SIZE)
    buf0 = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(4096)) * (BUF_SIZE // 4096)
    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
    with open(os.path.join(work, 'code.bin'), 'wb') as f:
        f.write(code_bytes)
    with open(os.path.join(work, 'buf.bin'), 'wb') as f:
        f.write(buf0)
    cases, expect = [], []
    t2 = time.time()
    for k, w in enumerate(pick):
        pc = CODE + 4 * k
        st = is_store(w)
        for _ in range(args.cases):
            fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = make_case(r, w)
            try:
                res = emu.run(pc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v)
            except uc.UcError:
                if st:
                    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
                continue
            mh = 0
            if st:
                mh = zlib.crc32(bytes(mu.mem_read(BUF, BUF_SIZE)))
                mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
            cases.append((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, st))
            expect.append(res + (mh,))
    print(f'unicorn: {len(cases)} cases ({time.time() - t2:.0f}s)')
    with open(os.path.join(work, 'cases.bin'), 'wb') as f:
        for k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, st in cases:
            f.write(struct.pack(IN_FMT, k, fpcr, *(x + [0]), sp, nzcv))
            for q in v:
                f.write(q.to_bytes(16, 'little'))
            f.write(struct.pack('<QQ', int(st), 0))
    outp = os.path.join(work, 'out.bin')
    t3 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([exe] + [os.path.join(work, n) for n in ('code.bin', 'buf.bin', 'cases.bin')] + [outp],
                       capture_output=True)
    if p.returncode:
        print('harness failed', p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[-2000:])
    data = open(outp, 'rb').read() if os.path.exists(outp) else b''
    ran = len(data) // OUT_SIZE
    print(f'harness: {ran} cases ({time.time() - t3:.0f}s)')
    fails = {}
    nfail = 0
    for i, ((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, st), (ex, esp, enz, ev, emh)) in enumerate(zip(cases, expect)):
        rec = data[i * OUT_SIZE:(i + 1) * OUT_SIZE]
        if len(rec) < OUT_SIZE:
            break
        hx_ = struct.unpack_from('<31Q', rec, 0)
        hsp, hnz, hmh = struct.unpack_from('<QQQ', rec, 248)
        hv = [int.from_bytes(rec[272 + 16 * j:288 + 16 * j], 'little') for j in range(32)]
        diffs = [f'x{j}: got {hx_[j]:x} want {ex[j]:x}' for j in range(31) if hx_[j] != ex[j]]
        if hsp != esp:
            diffs.append(f'sp: got {hsp:x} want {esp:x}')
        if hnz != enz:
            diffs.append(f'nzcv: got {hnz:x} want {enz:x}')
        if st and hmh != emh:
            diffs.append('memory differs')
        for j in range(32):
            if hv[j] != ev[j]:
                diffs.append(f'v{j}: got {hv[j]:032x} want {ev[j]:032x} (in {v[j]:032x})')
        if diffs:
            nfail += 1
            w = pick[k]
            if w not in fails:
                ins = [f'v{j}={v[j]:032x}' for j in sorted({(w >> 5) & 31, (w >> 16) & 31, w & 31})]
                fails[w] = (fpcr, diffs[:3], ins)
    print(f'{len(pick)} encodings, {len(cases)} cases: {nfail} failing cases, {len(fails)} failing encodings '
          f'({time.time() - t0:.0f}s total)')
    byname = Counter(dis(w).split(' ')[0] for w in fails)
    if fails:
        print('  failing by mnemonic:', dict(byname.most_common(40)))
    for w, (fpcr, d, ins) in list(fails.items())[:args.show]:
        print(f'  {w:08x} {dis(w):40} fpcr={fpcr:x} {"; ".join(d)}')
        print(f'      {" ".join(ins)}')
    # The harness stopped early (a crash: an instruction the host CPU lacks, a fault in the lifted code): the cases it
    # didn't run are failures too, not a pass. Each result is flushed as it's written, so the next one is where.
    if p.returncode or ran < len(cases):
        try:
            how = f'signal {signal.Signals(-p.returncode).name}' if p.returncode < 0 else f'exit status {p.returncode:#x}'
        except ValueError:
            how = f'exit status {p.returncode}'
        where = ''
        if ran < len(cases):
            w = pick[cases[ran][0]]
            where = f' at case {ran} ({w:08x} {dis(w)}, fpcr={cases[ran][1]:x})'
        print(f'  harness stopped{where}: {how}; {len(cases) - ran} of {len(cases)} cases not run')
        return 1
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tools/test_simd_harness.c`:

```c
// Runs lifted FP/SIMD tests (tools/test_simd.py) on the host; portable (Windows / POSIX).
// argv: code.bin buf.bin cases.bin out.bin. Prints nothing on success.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <sys/mman.h>
#endif

#include "cpu.h"

extern GuestFn tests[];
extern int ntests;

#define BUF 0x7200000000ull
#define BUF_SIZE 0x20000
#define CODE 0x7210000000ull

void rt_dispatch(Cpu *c) { (void)c; }
void rt_svc(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)imm; (void)pc; }
void rt_brk(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)imm; (void)pc; abort(); }
void rt_udf(Cpu *c, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)pc; abort(); }
uint64_t rt_ticks(void) { return 0; }
volatile int g_fnprof;
void fnprof_hit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) { (void)addr; (void)lr; (void)x0; }

static void *map_at(uint64_t addr, size_t len) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)addr, len, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
#else
    void *p = mmap((void *)addr, len, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
#endif
    if (p != (void *)addr) {
        fprintf(stderr, "map %llx failed\n", (unsigned long long)addr);
        exit(1);
    }
    return p;
}

static size_t load(const char *path, void *dst, size_t max) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) { perror(path); exit(1); }
    size_t n = fread(dst, 1, max, f);
    fclose(f);
    return n;
}

static uint32_t crc_tab[256];
static uint32_t crc32_buf(const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    uint32_t c = 0xffffffffu;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) c = crc_tab[(c ^ p[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >> 8);
    return c ^ 0xffffffffu;
}

struct In { uint64_t k, fpcr, x[32], sp, nzcv; u128 v[32]; uint64_t memchk, pad; };
struct Out { uint64_t x[31], sp, nzcv, mem; u128 v[32]; };

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 5) return 2;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        uint32_t c = i;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? (c >> 1) ^ 0xEDB88320u : c >> 1;
        crc_tab[i] = c;
    }
    map_at(CODE, 0x400000);
    load(argv[1], (void *)CODE, 0x400000);
    uint8_t *buf = map_at(BUF, BUF_SIZE);
    uint8_t *pristine = malloc(BUF_SIZE);
    load(argv[2], pristine, BUF_SIZE);
    memcpy(buf, pristine, BUF_SIZE);
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[3], "rb"), *o = fopen(argv[4], "wb");
    if (!f || !o) return 1;
    static struct In in;
    static struct Out out;
    static Cpu c;
    while (fread(&in, sizeof in, 1, f) == 1) {
        memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
        memcpy(c.x, in.x, sizeof c.x);
        c.sp = in.sp;
        c.nzcv = in.nzcv;
        rt_fpcr_write(&c, in.fpcr);  // (x86-64: FZ is MXCSR's DAZ / FTZ, as in the game)
        memcpy(c.v, in.v, sizeof c.v);
        c.excl_addr = ~0ull;
        tests[in.k](&c);
        memcpy(out.x, c.x, sizeof out.x);
        out.sp = c.sp;
        out.nzcv = c.nzcv & 0xf0000000ull;
        out.mem = 0;
        if (in.memchk) {
            out.mem = crc32_buf(buf, BUF_SIZE);
            memcpy(buf, pristine, BUF_SIZE);
        }
        memcpy(out.v, c.v, sizeof out.v);
        fwrite(&out, sizeof out, 1, o);
        fflush(o);  // (a crash keeps every result before it: tools/test_simd.py names the case it stopped at)
    }
    fclose(o);
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_softfma.c`:

```c
// Checks runtime/simd_softfma.h (the game code's fma without FMA instructions) bit for bit against the FMA
// instructions, in every MXCSR rounding mode with and without FTZ / DAZ. Needs a CPU with FMA.
//   clang -O1 -mfma -Iruntime tools/test_softfma.c -o build/test_softfma && build/test_softfma [millions] [seed]
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <xmmintrin.h>

#include "simd_softfma.h"

#ifndef __FMA__
#error "build with -mfma: the FMA instructions are the reference"
#endif

static uint64_t g_rng;
static uint64_t rnd(void) {  // splitmix64
    uint64_t z = (g_rng += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull);
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebull;
    return z ^ (z >> 31);
}

// an operand of a format (MB fraction bits, EB exponent bits) with its exponent near e (biased), or a special value
static uint64_t operand(int MB, int EB, int e) {
    const int emax = (1 << EB) - 1;
    uint64_t sgn = rnd() & 1, frac = rnd() & ((1ull << MB) - 1);
    switch (rnd() % 16) {
    case 0: frac = 0; break;                                     // a power of two
    case 1: frac = (1ull << MB) - 1 - (rnd() & 7); break;        // all ones, nearly
    case 2: frac &= ~((1ull << (rnd() % MB)) - 1); break;        // few significant bits
    case 3: e = 0; break;                                        // a denormal (or zero)
    case 4: {                                                    // special values
        static const int be[] = {0, 0, 1, -1, -2};
        int b = be[rnd() % 5];
        e = b < 0 ? emax + b + 1 : b;  // (-1: inf / NaN, -2: the largest finite exponent)
        if (rnd() & 1) frac = rnd() & 1 ? 0 : 1;
        break;
    }
    }
    if (e < 0) e = 0;
    if (e > emax) e = emax;
    return sgn << (MB + EB) | (uint64_t)e << MB | frac;
}

typedef struct { uint64_t x, y, z; } Case;

// operands whose sum lands where the rounding is hard: exponents near each other, cancellation, the underflow and
// overflow edges
static Case make_case(int MB, int EB, int dbl) {
    const int bias = (1 << (EB - 1)) - 1;
    Case c;
    int kind = rnd() % 6;
    if (kind == 0) {  // anything
        c.x = rnd(), c.y = rnd(), c.z = rnd();
        if (!dbl) c.x &= 0xffffffff, c.y &= 0xffffffff, c.z &= 0xffffffff;
        return c;
    }
    int target;  // the product's biased exponent
    switch (kind) {
    case 1: target = 1 + (int)(rnd() % 6) - 3; break;            // the underflow edge
    case 2: target = 2 * bias - (int)(rnd() % 4); break;         // the overflow edge
    case 3: target = -(int)(rnd() % (MB + 4)); break;            // product below the denormals
    default: target = (int)(rnd() % (2 * bias + 1)); break;
    }
    int ex = (int)(rnd() % (2 * bias + 1)) - bias + bias;  // x anywhere, y to reach target
    int ey = target - ex + bias;
    c.x = operand(MB, EB, ex), c.y = operand(MB, EB, ey);
    int ez = target + (int)(rnd() % 7) - 3;
    if (rnd() % 4 == 0) ez = target - (int)(rnd() % (3 * MB));  // far below
    c.z = operand(MB, EB, ez);
    if (rnd() % 3 == 0) {  // z near -x*y: cancellation
        unsigned csr = _mm_getcsr();
        _mm_setcsr(0x1f80);
        if (dbl) {
            double x, y, z;
            memcpy(&x, &c.x, 8), memcpy(&y, &c.y, 8);
            z = -(x * y);
            memcpy(&c.z, &z, 8);
        } else {
            float x, y, z;
            uint32_t ux = (uint32_t)c.x, uy = (uint32_t)c.y, uz;
            memcpy(&x, &ux, 4), memcpy(&y, &uy, 4);
            z = -(x * y);
            memcpy(&uz, &z, 4);
            c.z = uz;
        }
        _mm_setcsr(csr);
        c.z += (uint64_t)(int64_t)((int)(rnd() % 5) - 2);  // a few ulp off
        if (!dbl) c.z &= 0xffffffff;
    }
    return c;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    long n = (argc > 1 ? atol(argv[1]) : 2) * 1000000;
    g_rng = argc > 2 ? strtoull(argv[2], NULL, 0) : 1;
    long fails = 0, done = 0;
    for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int dbl = i & 1;
        Case c = dbl ? make_case(52, 11, 1) : make_case(23, 8, 0);
        unsigned mode = (unsigned)(rnd() & 15);
        unsigned csr = 0x1f80 | (mode & 3) << 13 | (mode & 4 ? 0x40u : 0) | (mode & 8 ? 0x8000u : 0);
        uint64_t want, got;
        int nan_want, nan_got;
        if (dbl) {
            volatile double x, y, z;
            memcpy((double *)&x, &c.x, 8), memcpy((double *)&y, &c.y, 8), memcpy((double *)&z, &c.z, 8);
            _mm_setcsr(csr);
            double w = __builtin_fma(x, y, z), g = simd_soft_fma_d(x, y, z);
            _mm_setcsr(0x1f80);
            memcpy(&want, &w, 8), memcpy(&got, &g, 8);
            nan_want = w != w, nan_got = g != g;
        } else {
            volatile float x, y, z;
            uint32_t ux = (uint32_t)c.x, uy = (uint32_t)c.y, uz = (uint32_t)c.z, uw, ug;
            memcpy((float *)&x, &ux, 4), memcpy((float *)&y, &uy, 4), memcpy((float *)&z, &uz, 4);
            _mm_setcsr(csr);
            float w = __builtin_fmaf(x, y, z), g = simd_soft_fma_s(x, y, z);
            _mm_setcsr(0x1f80);
            memcpy(&uw, &w, 4), memcpy(&ug, &g, 4);
            want = uw, got = ug;
            nan_want = w != w, nan_got = g != g;
        }
        done++;
        if (nan_want && nan_got) continue;
        if (want != got) {
            if (fails++ < 20)
                printf("%s rc=%u daz=%d ftz=%d  x=%016llx y=%016llx z=%016llx  want %016llx got %016llx\n",
                       dbl ? "fma " : "fmaf", mode & 3, !!(mode & 4), !!(mode & 8), (unsigned long long)c.x,
                       (unsigned long long)c.y, (unsigned long long)c.z, (unsigned long long)want,
                       (unsigned long long)got);
        }
    }
    printf("%ld cases (fma and fmaf, every rounding mode, FTZ / DAZ): %ld failing\n", done, fails);
    return fails != 0;
}
```

`tools/test_steam_shortcuts.c`:

```c
// make test-steam-shortcuts: Steam's shortcuts.vdf read and written (runtime/steam_shortcuts.c), on made-up files and,
// given as arguments, on real ones (copies): every entry kept byte for byte, ours added once and then updated in place.
#include "../runtime/steam_shortcuts.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static int fails;
#define CHECK(x) do { if (!(x)) { printf("FAILED line %d: %s\n", __LINE__, #x); fails++; } } while (0)

static const SteamEntry OURS[2] = {
    {"Savage Wind", "\"/home/u/Games/Savage_Wind.AppImage\"", "\"/home/u/Games/\"", "/home/u/icon.png", "--game"},
    {"Savage Wind Configuration", "\"/home/u/Games/Savage_Wind.AppImage\"", "\"/home/u/Games/\"", "/home/u/icon.png", "--config"},
};
static const SteamEntry MOVED[2] = {
    {"Savage Wind", "\"/mnt/sd/Savage_Wind.AppImage\"", "\"/mnt/sd/\"", "", "--game"},
    {"Savage Wind Configuration", "\"/mnt/sd/Savage_Wind.AppImage\"", "\"/mnt/sd/\"", "", "--config"},
};

static bool has(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, const char *s) {
    size_t l = strlen(s);
    for (size_t i = 0; i + l <= n; i++)
        if (!memcmp(b + i, s, l)) return true;
    return false;
}

static void with_file(const uint8_t *in, size_t n, const char *what) {
    int before = steam_vdf_count(in, n), already = 0;
    CHECK(before >= 0);
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {  // (ours there already, from an earlier copy: updated, not added)
        char a1[80], a2[80];
        snprintf(a1, sizeof a1, "AppName%c%s%c", 0, OURS[k].name, 0);
        snprintf(a2, sizeof a2, "appname%c%s%c", 0, OURS[k].name, 0);
        size_t l = 9 + strlen(OURS[k].name);
        bool found = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + l <= n && !found; i++) found = !memcmp(in + i, a1, l) || !memcmp(in + i, a2, l);
        already += found;
    }
    uint8_t *same = NULL, *a = NULL, *b = NULL, *c = NULL;
    size_t sn = 0, an = 0, bn = 0, cn = 0;
    char why[200];
    // nothing to add: the very same bytes back
    CHECK(steam_vdf_upsert(in, n, OURS, 0, &same, &sn, why, sizeof why));
    if (n) CHECK(sn == n && !memcmp(same, in, n));
    CHECK(steam_vdf_upsert(in, n, OURS, 2, &a, &an, why, sizeof why));
    CHECK(steam_vdf_count(a, an) == before + 2 - already);
    CHECK(has(a, an, "Savage Wind Configuration") && has(a, an, "--config") && has(a, an, "--game"));
    // the original entries are still there, unchanged, at the start
    if (n > 2 && !already) CHECK(an > n && !memcmp(a, in, n - 2));
    // again: nothing added twice
    CHECK(steam_vdf_upsert(a, an, OURS, 2, &b, &bn, why, sizeof why));
    CHECK(bn == an && !memcmp(a, b, an));
    // the AppImage moved: the same two entries point at it
    CHECK(steam_vdf_upsert(b, bn, MOVED, 2, &c, &cn, why, sizeof why));
    CHECK(steam_vdf_count(c, cn) == before + 2 - already);
    CHECK(has(c, cn, "/mnt/sd/Savage_Wind.AppImage") && !has(c, cn, "/home/u/Games/Savage_Wind.AppImage"));
    printf("  %s: %d shortcuts, %d of ours already there, then updated in place\n", what, before, already);
    free(same), free(a), free(b), free(c);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    with_file(NULL, 0, "no file yet");
    static const uint8_t empty[] = "\0shortcuts\0\x08\x08";
    with_file(empty, sizeof empty - 1, "empty list");

    uint8_t *out = NULL;
    size_t on = 0;
    char why[200] = "";
    static const uint8_t junk[] = "\0shortcuts\0\x01name\0no end";
    CHECK(!steam_vdf_upsert(junk, sizeof junk - 1, OURS, 2, &out, &on, why, sizeof why) && why[0]);
    static const uint8_t unknown[] = "\0shortcuts\0\x09odd\0\x08\x08";
    CHECK(!steam_vdf_upsert(unknown, sizeof unknown - 1, OURS, 2, &out, &on, why, sizeof why));
    static const uint8_t trailing[] = "\0shortcuts\0\x08\x08xx";
    CHECK(!steam_vdf_upsert(trailing, sizeof trailing - 1, OURS, 2, &out, &on, why, sizeof why));
    CHECK(steam_vdf_count(junk, sizeof junk - 1) == -1);

    uint32_t id = steam_shortcut_appid("\"/a\"", "b");
    CHECK(id & 0x80000000u);
    CHECK(id == steam_shortcut_appid("\"/a\"", "b") && id != steam_shortcut_appid("\"/a\"", "c"));

    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {  // real files (copies)
        FILE *f = fopen(argv[i], "rb");
        if (!f) { printf("FAILED: can't read %s\n", argv[i]); fails++; continue; }
        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
        long n = ftell(f);
        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
        uint8_t *b = (uint8_t *)malloc((size_t)n);
        if (fread(b, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) fails++;
        fclose(f);
        with_file(b, (size_t)n, argv[i]);
        free(b);
    }
    printf(fails ? "steam shortcuts: %d FAILED\n" : "steam shortcuts: all passed\n", fails);
    return fails != 0;
}
```
