```py
        self.assertAlmostEqual(zones['outer']['self_ms'], 5)

    def test_empty_frame_selection_does_not_fall_back_to_whole_capture(self):
        res = swprof.analyse(self.crossing_capture(), 100, 200)
        self.assertFalse(res['top_self'])
        self.assertFalse(res['gpu'].get('rows'))


GAME, RUNTIME, OTHER = 0x10000000, 0x20000000, 0x30000000
MODULES = [(GAME, 0x1000, GAME, swprof.MOD_GAME, 'game.dll'), (RUNTIME, 0x1000, RUNTIME, swprof.MOD_RUNTIME, 'swr.exe'),
           (OTHER, 0x1000, OTHER, swprof.MOD_OTHER, 'driver.dll')]


class SamplerTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """100 ms of one thread ("main", os id 100), a sample every ms: 60 in game code, 10 in the runtime, 10 in the driver
    called from the runtime, and 20 inside a "kernel wait" zone (those would be in game code otherwise)."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.dir.cleanup)
        sites = {1: 'kernel wait'}
        recs = [(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, swprof.FRAME), (0, 100 * TPM, 0, 1, 0, swprof.FRAME),
                (0, 80 * TPM, 100 * TPM, 0, 1, swprof.ZONE)]
        for ms in range(100):
            if ms < 60 or ms >= 80:
                stack = [GAME + 0x10, GAME + 0x20, RUNTIME + 0x300]
            elif ms < 70:
                stack = [RUNTIME + 0x100, GAME + 0x20]
            else:
                stack = [OTHER + 0x5, RUNTIME + 0x200, GAME + 0x20]
            recs.append((1, ms * TPM, 100, 7, 0, swprof.SAMPLE | (len(stack) << 8)))
            stack += [0] * (-len(stack) % 3)
            for i in range(0, len(stack), 3):
                recs.append((1, stack[i], stack[i + 1], stack[i + 2], 0, swprof.STACK))
        self.path = os.path.join(self.dir.name, 's.swprof')
        with open(self.path, 'wb') as fh:
            fh.write(build(sites, ['main', 'sampler'], recs, MODULES))

    def test_reads_modules_and_samples(self):
        cap = swprof.Capture(self.path)
        self.assertEqual([m[3] for m in cap.modules], [swprof.MOD_GAME, swprof.MOD_RUNTIME, swprof.MOD_OTHER])
        self.assertEqual(len(cap.samples), 100)
        self.assertEqual(cap.samples[0][3], [GAME + 0x10, GAME + 0x20, RUNTIME + 0x300])
        self.assertEqual(cap.samples[65][3], [RUNTIME + 0x100, GAME + 0x20])  # (padding is cut off)

    def test_split_and_runtime_functions(self):
        res = swprof.analyse(swprof.Capture(self.path))
        sp = res['sampler']
        self.assertEqual(sp['samples'], 100)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(sp['interval_ms'], 1.0, delta=0.01)
        main = next(t for t in sp['threads'] if t['name'] == 'main')
        self.assertEqual((main['game'], main['runtime'], main['driver/system'], main['waiting']), (60.0, 10.0, 10.0, 20.0))
        self.assertEqual(sp['runtime_self'][0]['name'], 'runtime+0x100')
        self.assertEqual(sp['runtime_callers_of_driver'][0]['name'], 'runtime+0x200')
        incl = {r['name']: r['samples'] for r in sp['runtime_inclusive']}
        self.assertEqual(incl, {'runtime+0x100': 10, 'runtime+0x200': 10, 'runtime+0x300': 60})  # (waiting is not counted)
        self.assertIn('no runtime binary', sp['symbols_note'])

    def test_report_mentions_the_note_and_no_game_address(self):
        res = swprof.analyse(swprof.Capture(self.path))
        text = swprof.text_report(res, 10, 33.4)
        self.assertIn('Do not put game addresses', text)
        self.assertNotIn(hex(GAME)[2:], text)

    def test_wait_found_by_the_stack(self):
        # the driver samples sit under a runtime wait function with no zone around them: waiting, not driver/system
        exe = os.path.join(self.dir.name, 'swr')
        with open(exe, 'wb') as fh:
            fh.write(b'\x7fELF' + b'\0' * 100)
        done = mock.Mock(stdout='0000000000000100 T render_frame\n0000000000000200 t kwait\n')
        with mock.patch.object(swprof.shutil, 'which', return_value='/usr/bin/nm'), \
                mock.patch.object(swprof.subprocess, 'run', return_value=done):
            res = swprof.analyse(swprof.Capture(self.path), exe=exe)
        sp = res['sampler']
        main = next(t for t in sp['threads'] if t['name'] == 'main')
        self.assertEqual((main['game'], main['runtime'], main['driver/system'], main['waiting']), (60.0, 10.0, 0.0, 30.0))
        self.assertEqual([(r['name'], r['samples']) for r in sp['runtime_waits']], [('kwait', 10)])
        self.assertEqual(sp['runtime_callers_of_driver'], [])

    def test_vulkan_semaphore_wait_found_by_stack_without_a_completed_zone(self):
        exe = os.path.join(self.dir.name, 'swr')
        with open(exe, 'wb') as fh:
            fh.write(b'\x7fELF' + b'\0' * 100)
        done = mock.Mock(stdout='0000000000000100 T render_frame\n0000000000000200 T vk_wait_seq\n')
        with mock.patch.object(swprof.shutil, 'which', return_value='/usr/bin/nm'), \
                mock.patch.object(swprof.subprocess, 'run', return_value=done):
            res = swprof.analyse(swprof.Capture(self.path), exe=exe)
        main = next(t for t in res['sampler']['threads'] if t['name'] == 'main')
        self.assertEqual((main['driver/system'], main['waiting']), (0, 30))
        self.assertEqual(res['sampler']['runtime_callers_of_driver'], [])
        self.assertEqual(res['sampler']['runtime_waits'][0]['name'], 'vk_wait_seq')
        self.assertEqual(res['slow_frames'][0]['samples']['waiting'], 30)

    def test_gpu_wait_zone_classifies_single_pc_samples_without_symbols(self):
        cap = swprof.Capture(self.path)
        cap.sites[1] = 'gpu_wait'
        cap.samples = [(90, 100, 7, [OTHER + 5])]
        res = swprof.analyse(cap)
        main = res['sampler']['threads'][0]
        self.assertEqual((main['driver/system'], main['waiting']), (0, 100))
        self.assertFalse(res['top_self'])
        self.assertEqual(res['top_waits'][0]['name'], 'gpu_wait')

    def test_symbols(self):
        exe = os.path.join(self.dir.name, 'swr')
        with open(exe, 'wb') as fh:
            fh.write(b'\x7fELF' + b'\0' * 100)
        nm = '0000000000000100 T render_frame\n0000000000000200 t helper\n0000000000000300 T wait_thing\n0000000000000400 D data\n'
        done = mock.Mock(stdout=nm)
        with mock.patch.object(swprof.shutil, 'which', return_value='/usr/bin/nm'), \
                mock.patch.object(swprof.subprocess, 'run', return_value=done):
            sym = swprof.Symbols(exe, MODULES[1])
        self.assertEqual(sym.name(RUNTIME + 0x150), 'render_frame')
        self.assertEqual(sym.name(RUNTIME + 0x200), 'helper')
        self.assertEqual(sym.name(RUNTIME + 0x300 + (1 << 21)), 'runtime+0x%x' % (0x300 + (1 << 21)))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

```

`tools/test_translate.c`:

```c
// Fuzz test for the Maxwell shader translator (runtime/nvn/maxwell/translate.c).
//
//  1. MSL must not change (built with MSL_REF only): every program is translated by the current translate.c
//     (key.glsl = 0) and by a reference MSL-only translator (an older translate.c compiled with old_* symbol names,
//     see tools/test_translate.sh); the MSL text and all ShaderInfo fields must be identical.
//  2. GLSL must compile: the same program with key.glsl = 1 is compiled in-process with shaderc (Vulkan 1.3) and
//     the SPIR-V validated with SPIRV-Tools.
//
// Programs are synthesized from the opcode patterns translate.c recognizes (every OPM(value, mask) and the
// half-precision `(op & mask) == value` tests, read from the source file): the unmasked bits are random, with
// register / predicate / cbuf / texture / attribute / branch fields biased towards meaningful values.
//
// usage: test_translate <translate.c> <count> <seed> [msl|glsl|glsl-bda|both] [dump_dir]
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../runtime/nvn/maxwell/shader.h"

#ifdef WITH_GLSL
#include <shaderc/shaderc.h>
#include <spirv-tools/libspirv.h>
#endif

#ifdef MSL_REF
// the reference translator (same ShaderKey prefix and ShaderInfo layout)
ShaderInfo *old_maxwell_translate(const uint8_t *code, size_t max_size, int stage, const ShaderKey *key);
void old_maxwell_free(ShaderInfo *s);
extern uint64_t old_maxwell_gmem_base, old_maxwell_gmem_size;
#endif

static uint64_t rng_state, g_seed;
static uint64_t rnd64(void) {  // splitmix64
    uint64_t z = (rng_state += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull);
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebull;
    return z ^ (z >> 31);
}
static uint32_t rnd(uint32_t n) { return (uint32_t)(rnd64() % n); }

typedef struct { uint64_t val, mask; } Pat;
static Pat pats[512];
static int npats;

static void load_patterns(const char *path) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) { perror(path); exit(1); }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    char *s = malloc(n + 1);
    fread(s, 1, n, f);
    s[n] = 0;
    fclose(f);
    for (char *p = s; (p = strstr(p, "OPM(0x")); p += 4) {
        unsigned long long v, m;
        if (sscanf(p, "OPM(0x%llxull, 0x%llxull)", &v, &m) == 2 && npats < 512) {
            bool dup = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < npats; i++) dup |= pats[i].val == v && pats[i].mask == m;
            if (!dup) pats[npats++] = (Pat){v, m};
        }
    }
    for (char *p = s; (p = strstr(p, "(op & 0x")); p += 4) {  // emit_half: 16-bit opcode tests
        unsigned m, v;
        if (sscanf(p, "(op & 0x%x) == 0x%x", &m, &v) == 2 && npats < 512) pats[npats++] = (Pat){(uint64_t)v << 48, (uint64_t)m << 48};
    }
    free(s);
    if (npats < 50) { fprintf(stderr, "only %d patterns found in %s\n", npats, path); exit(1); }
}

static uint64_t setf(uint64_t w, int lo, int n, uint64_t v) {
    uint64_t m = ((1ull << n) - 1) << lo;
    return (w & ~m) | ((v << lo) & m);
}
static uint64_t getf(uint64_t w, int lo, int n) { return (w >> lo) & ((1ull << n) - 1); }
static bool is(uint64_t w, uint64_t v, uint64_t m) { return (w & m) == v; }

static uint32_t rreg(void) { uint32_t x = rnd(100); return x < 8 ? 255 : x < 12 ? 250 + rnd(5) : rnd(24); }

static const uint32_t attr_addrs[] = {0x70, 0x74, 0x78, 0x7c, 0x80, 0x84, 0x88, 0x8c, 0x90, 0x94, 0x98, 0x9c, 0xa0,
                                      0xb0, 0xc0, 0x100, 0x270, 0x27c, 0x2f8, 0x2fc, 0x3fc, 0x6c, 0x2e0, 0x2e4, 0x40};

// one random instruction at byte offset pc of a program of `total` bytes
static uint64_t gen_insn(uint32_t pc, uint32_t total) {
    if (rnd(400) == 0) {  // unknown instruction (but no cbuf index >= 17: the translators index arrays of 18)
        uint64_t w = rnd64();
        w = setf(w, 34, 5, rnd(17));
        return setf(w, 36, 5, rnd(17)) & ~(1ull << 38);
    }
    const Pat *p = &pats[rnd(npats)];
    uint64_t w = rnd64();
    if (rnd(100) < 90) w = setf(w, 0, 8, rreg());
    if (rnd(100) < 90) w = setf(w, 8, 8, rreg());
    if (rnd(100) < 70) w = setf(w, 20, 8, rreg());
    if (rnd(100) < 80) w = setf(w, 39, 8, rreg());
    w = setf(w, 16, 4, rnd(100) < 70 ? 7 : rnd(16));  // predicate guard (mostly PT)
    w = (w & ~p->mask) | p->val;
    // cbuf index fields: hardware has 18 buffers; 17 clashes with the gmem binding (both translators reject it)
    if (is(w, 0xef90000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull)) w = setf(w, 36, 5, rnd(17));  // LDC
    else if (getf(w, 34, 5) >= 17) w = setf(w, 34, 5, rnd(17));
    // texture index: few textures so that slots get reused
    if (is(w, 0xd000000000000000ull, 0xf400000000000000ull) || is(w, 0xc038000000000000ull, 0xfc38000000000000ull) ||
        is(w, 0xdf48000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull) || is(w, 0xdeb8000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull))
        w = setf(w, 36, 13, rnd(100) < 90 ? rnd(4) : rnd(8192));
    if (is(w, 0xdf48000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull) && rnd(100) < 90) w = setf(w, 22, 6, 1);  // TXQ dimension
    // attribute addresses (LD / ST a[], IPA)
    uint32_t aa = attr_addrs[rnd(sizeof attr_addrs / sizeof attr_addrs[0])] + (rnd(100) < 30 ? 4 * rnd(4) : 0);
    if (is(w, 0xefd8000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull) || is(w, 0xeff0000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull)) {
        w = setf(w, 20, 10, aa);
        if (rnd(100) < 85) w = setf(w, 8, 8, 255);  // not indexed
    }
    if (is(w, 0xe000000000000000ull, 0xff00000000000000ull)) {
        w = setf(w, 28, 10, aa);
        if (rnd(100) < 90) w = setf(w, 38, 1, 0);
        w = (w & ~p->mask) | p->val;
    }
    if (is(w, 0xf0c8000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull)) {  // S2R
        static const uint32_t srs[] = {0x00, 0x12, 0x21, 0x22, 0x23, 0x25, 0x26, 0x27, 0x50};
        w = setf(w, 20, 8, srs[rnd(sizeof srs / sizeof srs[0])]);
    }
    if (is(w, 0x5080000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull) && rnd(100) < 90) {  // MUFU: valid functions
        static const uint32_t fns[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8};
        w = setf(w, 20, 4, fns[rnd(7)]);
    }
    if (is(w, 0x5bc0000000000000ull, 0xffe0000000000000ull) || is(w, 0x4bc0000000000000ull, 0xffe0000000000000ull) ||
        is(w, 0x36c0000000000000ull, 0xfee0000000000000ull) || is(w, 0x53c0000000000000ull, 0xffe0000000000000ull))
        if (rnd(100) < 90) w = setf(w, 48, 4, 0);  // PRMT default mode
    // P2R / R2P .CC and BFE .BREV are unsupported: mostly off
    static const uint64_t bit40_ops[] = {0x38e8, 0x5ce8, 0x4ce8, 0x38f0, 0x5cf0, 0x4cf0, 0x5c00, 0x4c00, 0x3800};
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++)
        if ((w >> 48 & (bit40_ops[i] & 0xff00 ? (bit40_ops[i] >> 8 == 0x38 ? 0xfef8 : 0xfff8) : 0)) == bit40_ops[i] && rnd(100) < 90)
            w = setf(w, 40, 1, 0);
    if (is(w, 0x5098000000000000ull, 0xfff8000000000000ull) && rnd(100) < 90) return gen_insn(pc, total);  // CSET fails
    // branch targets inside the program
    uint64_t top12 = w & 0xfff0000000000000ull;
    if (top12 == 0xe240000000000000ull || top12 == 0xe290000000000000ull || top12 == 0xe2a0000000000000ull ||
        top12 == 0xe2b0000000000000ull || top12 == 0xe250000000000000ull) {
        if (rnd(100) < 90) {
            int64_t target = (int64_t)rnd(total / 8) * 8;
            int64_t off = target - (int64_t)pc - 8;
            if (off == -8) off = 8;  // not a self-branch (that ends the program)
            w = setf(w, 20, 24, (uint64_t)off & 0xFFFFFF);
        }
        w = setf(w, 5, 1, 0);
        w = (w & ~p->mask) | p->val;
    }
    return w;
}

static size_t gen_program(uint8_t *buf, size_t cap, int stage) {
    memset(buf, 0, cap);
    size_t hdr = stage == STAGE_COMPUTE ? 0 : 0x80;
    if (stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
        uint32_t omap = rnd(100) < 40 ? 0xF : rnd(100) < 50 ? (uint32_t)rnd64() : (uint32_t)rnd64() & 0xFF;
        memcpy(buf + 0x30 + 0x48, &omap, 4);
        uint32_t dw = rnd(4) == 0 ? 2 : 0;
        memcpy(buf + 0x30 + 0x4C, &dw, 4);
    }
    int groups = 1 + rnd(rnd(100) < 70 ? 3 : 10);
    uint32_t total = (uint32_t)(groups + 1) * 32;
    uint64_t *code = (uint64_t *)(buf + hdr);
    int i = 0;
    for (int g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
        code[i++] = rnd64();  // scheduling word
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++, i++) code[i] = gen_insn((uint32_t)i * 8, total);
    }
    code[i++] = 0x001f8000fc0007e0ull;
    code[i++] = 0xe30000000007000full;  // EXIT
    code[i++] = 0xe2400fffff87000full;  // BRA self (end of program)
    code[i++] = 0xe2400fffff87000full;
    return hdr + (size_t)i * 8 + 64;
}

static void gen_key(ShaderKey *k, int stage) {
    memset(k, 0, sizeof *k);
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) k->attr_kind[i] = rnd(100) < 80 ? 0 : rnd(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) k->rt_kind[i] = rnd(100) < 80 ? 0 : rnd(3);
    k->depth_minus_one = rnd(2);
    k->flip_y = rnd(2);
    if (stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT && rnd(2)) k->vs_out_mask = (uint32_t)rnd64();
}

#ifdef MSL_REF
static bool same_info(const ShaderInfo *a, const ShaderInfo *b) {
    if ((a->msl == NULL) != (b->msl == NULL)) return false;
    if (a->msl && strcmp(a->msl, b->msl)) return false;
    ShaderInfo x = *a, y = *b;
    x.msl = y.msl = NULL;
    return !memcmp(&x, &y, sizeof x);
}
#endif

static void dump(const char *dir, const char *tag, long n, const char *src, const char *err, const uint8_t *prog, size_t len) {
    if (!dir) return;
    char path[512];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s_%llu_%ld.txt", dir, tag, (unsigned long long)g_seed, n);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) return;
    fprintf(f, "// %s\n", err ? err : "");
    if (prog) {
        fprintf(f, "// program:");
        for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i += 8) fprintf(f, " %016llx", (unsigned long long)*(const uint64_t *)(prog + i));
        fprintf(f, "\n");
    }
    fputs(src ? src : "(null)", f);
    fclose(f);
}

// Directed checks of cbuf_reach (how far register-indexed constant reads reach): a vertex program that reads
// c[3][(R20 << 4) + 0x160] in a loop over R20 = first .. 1 (count down), with R20 from first_insn.
static uint64_t mov32i(int d, uint32_t v) { return 0x0100000000000000ull | (uint64_t)v << 20 | 7ull << 16 | (uint64_t)d; }
static uint64_t mov(int d, int src) { return 0x5c98078000070000ull | (uint64_t)src << 20 | (uint64_t)d; }
static bool reach_case(const char *name, uint64_t first_insn, uint32_t want_dyn, uint32_t want_size) {
    static uint8_t prog[0x80 + 16 * 8 + 64];
    memset(prog, 0, sizeof prog);
    uint64_t *code = (uint64_t *)(prog + 0x80);
    code[0] = code[4] = code[8] = 0x001f8000fc0007e0ull;  // scheduling words
    code[1] = first_insn;
    code[2] = 0x3818000000000000ull | 4ull << 39 | 0x160ull << 20 | 20ull << 8 | 7ull << 16 | 0;  // ISCADD R0, R20, 0x160, 4
    code[3] = 0xef90000000000000ull | 3ull << 36 | 4ull << 48 | 0ull << 8 | 7ull << 16 | 1;       // LDC R1, c[3][R0]
    code[5] = 0x1c00000000000000ull | 0xffffffffull << 20 | 20ull << 8 | 7ull << 16 | 20;          // IADD32I R20, R20, -1
    code[6] = 0x3660000000000000ull | 4ull << 49 | 1ull << 48 | 7ull << 39 | 20ull << 8 | 7ull << 16 | 0 << 3 | 7;  // ISETP.GT P0, R20, 0
    code[7] = 0xe240000000000000ull | (uint64_t)(-48 & 0xffffff) << 20 | 0ull << 16 | 0xf;          // @P0 BRA (to code[2])
    code[9] = mov(2, 1);  // (the read kept)
    code[10] = 0xe30000000007000full;  // EXIT
    code[11] = 0xe2400fffff87000full;  // BRA self
    ShaderKey key;
    memset(&key, 0, sizeof key);
    key.glsl = 1;
    ShaderInfo *si = maxwell_translate(prog, sizeof prog, STAGE_VERTEX, &key);
    bool ok = si->msl && (si->cbuf_mask & 8) && (si->cbuf_dynamic & 8) == want_dyn && si->cbuf_size[3] == want_size;
    if (!ok) printf("cbuf reach %s: FAILED (%s; dynamic %#x, size %u; want %#x, %u)\n", name, si->msl ? "translated" : si->error,
                    si->cbuf_dynamic, si->cbuf_size[3], want_dyn, want_size);
    maxwell_free(si);
    return ok;
}

static bool reach_tests(void) {
    bool ok = reach_case("constant start", mov32i(20, 2), 0, 512);  // reads 0x170 and 0x180: 25 vec4s
    ok &= reach_case("unknown start", mov(20, 21), 8, 0x10000);
    ok &= reach_case("past 64 KB", mov32i(20, 0x1000), 8, 0x10000);  // (the clamp reads the last vec4)
    printf("cbuf reach: %s\n", ok ? "3 checks passed" : "FAILED");
    return ok;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 4) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <translate.c> <count> <seed> [msl|glsl|glsl-bda|both] [dump_dir]\n", argv[0]); return 2; }
    load_patterns(argv[1]);
    long count = atol(argv[2]);
    rng_state = g_seed = strtoull(argv[3], NULL, 0);
    const char *mode = argc > 4 ? argv[4] : "both";
    const char *dir = argc > 5 ? argv[5] : NULL;
    bool do_msl = strcmp(mode, "glsl") != 0 && strcmp(mode, "glsl-bda") != 0, do_glsl = strcmp(mode, "msl") != 0;
    maxwell_gmem_bda = !strcmp(mode, "glsl-bda");  // (global memory by address: Turnip)
    maxwell_gmem_base = 0x80000000ull;
    maxwell_gmem_size = 0x10000000ull;
#ifdef MSL_REF
    old_maxwell_gmem_base = maxwell_gmem_base;
    old_maxwell_gmem_size = maxwell_gmem_size;
#else
    if (do_msl) { fprintf(stderr, "built without MSL_REF: glsl mode only\n"); do_msl = false; }
#endif
#ifdef WITH_GLSL
    shaderc_compiler_t comp = shaderc_compiler_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_t opt = shaderc_compile_options_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_set_target_env(opt, shaderc_target_env_vulkan, shaderc_env_version_vulkan_1_3);
    shaderc_compile_options_set_source_language(opt, shaderc_source_language_glsl);
    spv_context spv = spvContextCreate(SPV_ENV_VULKAN_1_3);
#else
    if (do_glsl) { fprintf(stderr, "built without WITH_GLSL: msl mode only\n"); do_glsl = false; }
#endif
    bool reach_ok = reach_tests();
    static uint8_t prog[0x80 + 64 * 32 + 128];
    long msl_ok = 0, msl_fail = 0, msl_diff = 0, gl_ok = 0, gl_tfail = 0, gl_tfail_only = 0, gl_cfail = 0, gl_vfail = 0;
    long by_stage[3] = {0};
    char reasons[64][96];
    long reason_n[64];
    int nreasons = 0;
    for (long n = 0; n < count; n++) {
        int stage = rnd(3) == 0 ? STAGE_VERTEX : rnd(2) ? STAGE_FRAGMENT : STAGE_COMPUTE;
        size_t len = gen_program(prog, sizeof prog, stage);
        ShaderKey key;
        gen_key(&key, stage);
        bool msl_good = true;
        if (do_msl) {
            ShaderInfo *a = maxwell_translate(prog, len, stage, &key);
#ifdef MSL_REF
            ShaderInfo *b = old_maxwell_translate(prog, len, stage, &key);
            if (!same_info(a, b)) {
                if (msl_diff < 20) dump(dir, "msl_diff", n, a->msl, b->msl, prog, len);
                msl_diff++;
            }
            old_maxwell_free(b);
#endif
            if (a->msl) msl_ok++; else msl_fail++;
            msl_good = a->msl != NULL;
            maxwell_free(a);
        }
#ifdef WITH_GLSL
        if (do_glsl) {
            key.glsl = 1;
            ShaderInfo *g = maxwell_translate(prog, len, stage, &key);
            if (!g->msl) {
                gl_tfail++;
                if (msl_good && do_msl) gl_tfail_only++;
                {  // tally the reasons (GLSL-only: the MSL translation succeeded)
                    char r[96];
                    snprintf(r, sizeof r, "%s%.24s", msl_good && do_msl ? "GLSL-only " : "", g->error);
                    for (char *q = r; *q; q++) if (*q >= '0' && *q <= '9') *q = '#';
                    int i = 0;
                    while (i < nreasons && strcmp(reasons[i], r)) i++;
                    if (i == nreasons && nreasons < 64) { strcpy(reasons[nreasons], r); reason_n[nreasons++] = 0; }
                    if (i < 64) reason_n[i]++;
                }
            } else {
                shaderc_shader_kind kind = stage == STAGE_VERTEX ? shaderc_vertex_shader
                                         : stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? shaderc_fragment_shader : shaderc_compute_shader;
                shaderc_compilation_result_t res = shaderc_compile_into_spv(comp, g->msl, strlen(g->msl), kind, "fuzz", "main", opt);
                if (shaderc_result_get_compilation_status(res) != shaderc_compilation_status_success) {
                    if (gl_cfail < 50) dump(dir, "glsl_compile", n, g->msl, shaderc_result_get_error_message(res), prog, len);
                    gl_cfail++;
                } else {
                    spv_diagnostic diag = NULL;
                    spv_const_binary_t bin = {(const uint32_t *)shaderc_result_get_bytes(res), shaderc_result_get_length(res) / 4};
                    spv_validator_options vo = spvValidatorOptionsCreate();
                    spv_result_t vr = spvValidateWithOptions(spv, vo, &bin, &diag);
                    spvValidatorOptionsDestroy(vo);
                    if (vr != SPV_SUCCESS) {
                        if (gl_vfail < 50) dump(dir, "glsl_validate", n, g->msl, diag ? diag->error : "?", prog, len);
                        gl_vfail++;
                    } else {
                        gl_ok++;
                        by_stage[stage == STAGE_VERTEX ? 0 : stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? 1 : 2]++;
                        if (dir && gl_ok <= (getenv("TT_DUMP_OK") ? atol(getenv("TT_DUMP_OK")) : 40)) dump(dir, "glsl_ok", n, g->msl, NULL, prog, len);
                    }
                    spvDiagnosticDestroy(diag);
                }
                shaderc_result_release(res);
            }
            maxwell_free(g);
        }
#endif
    }
    if (do_msl) printf("MSL: %ld programs, %ld translated, %ld failed in both, %ld DIFFERENCES\n", count, msl_ok, msl_fail, msl_diff);
    if (do_glsl) {
        printf("GLSL: %ld compiled+validated (vs %ld / fs %ld / cs %ld), %ld compile failures, %ld validation failures, "
               "%ld translation failures (%ld where MSL translated)\n",
               gl_ok, by_stage[0], by_stage[1], by_stage[2], gl_cfail, gl_vfail, gl_tfail, gl_tfail_only);
        for (int i = 0; i < nreasons; i++) printf("  translation failure: %-36s %ld\n", reasons[i], reason_n[i]);
    }
    return (msl_diff || gl_cfail || gl_vfail || !reach_ok) ? 1 : 0;
}
```

`tools/test_translate.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Fuzz test for runtime/nvn/maxwell/translate.c (see tools/test_translate.c): every GLSL translation compiles
# (shaderc, Vulkan 1.3) and validates (SPIRV-Tools). With REF set, also MSL output byte-identical to a reference
# MSL-only translator: REF is a commit holding one, e.g. LAS Recomp's 652e234 (the commit before its GLSL backend;
# not in this repository: git fetch --depth 1 https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp.git
# 652e2340f416d0472878ff1b756abc73b4fb9d8d). The Metal backend isn't maintained here (CONTRIBUTING.md).
# usage: [REF=<commit>] tools/test_translate.sh [count] [jobs] [mode glsl|glsl-bda|msl|both]
# Exits 1 when any job finds differences or compile / validation failures.
# Needs clang + shaderc + SPIRV-Tools (Windows: MSYS2 ucrt64; macOS: brew install shaderc spirv-tools; Debian /
# Ubuntu: libshaderc-dev spirv-tools; or GLSL=0 for the MSL comparison only).
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
COUNT=${1:-20000}
JOBS=${2:-8}
MODE=${3:-glsl}
OUT=build/test_translate
mkdir -p "$OUT/old" "$OUT/dump"
CC=${CC:-clang}
OBJS="$OUT/new.o"
DEFS=""
$CC -O2 -Wall -c runtime/nvn/maxwell/translate.c -o "$OUT/new.o"
if [ "$MODE" != glsl ] && [ "$MODE" != glsl-bda ]; then
  if [ -z "$REF" ]; then
    echo "mode $MODE compares the MSL with a reference translator: set REF (see the top of this script)" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  git show "$REF:runtime/nvn/maxwell/translate.c" > "$OUT/old/translate.c"
  git show "$REF:runtime/nvn/maxwell/shader.h" > "$OUT/old/shader.h"
  # the reference's copies of every symbol the current translator defines get an old_ prefix
  RENAME=$(nm "$OUT/new.o" | awk '$2 ~ /^[TDBRC]$/ { s = $3; sub(/^_/, "", s); printf "-D%s=old_%s ", s, s }')
  PRE=""
  case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*) PRE="-include malloc.h";; esac
  $CC -O2 -w $PRE $RENAME -c "$OUT/old/translate.c" -o "$OUT/old.o"
  OBJS="$OBJS $OUT/old.o"
  DEFS="-DMSL_REF"
fi
if [ "${GLSL:-1}" = 1 ]; then
  # shaderc is libshaderc_shared (MSYS2, Arch, from source) or libshaderc (Debian / Ubuntu, Homebrew); SPIRV-Tools is
  # shared where shipped, static C++ code behind its C API on Debian / Ubuntu (-lstdc++). Each probed with the call
  # the test makes, shared names first.
  SHADERC=-lshaderc_shared
  echo 'extern void *shaderc_compiler_initialize(void); int main(void){return shaderc_compiler_initialize()!=0;}' |
    $CC -x c - $SHADERC -o "$OUT/probe" 2>/dev/null || SHADERC=-lshaderc
  SPIRV=-lSPIRV-Tools-shared
  echo 'extern void *spvContextCreate(int); int main(void){return spvContextCreate(0)!=0;}' |
    $CC -x c - $SPIRV -o "$OUT/probe" 2>/dev/null || SPIRV="-lSPIRV-Tools -lstdc++"
  $CC -O2 -Wall $DEFS -DWITH_GLSL tools/test_translate.c $OBJS -o "$OUT/test_translate" $SHADERC $SPIRV
else
  $CC -O2 -Wall $DEFS tools/test_translate.c $OBJS -o "$OUT/test_translate"
fi
rm -f "$OUT"/dump/* "$OUT"/log_*.txt
PER=$(( (COUNT + JOBS - 1) / JOBS ))
PIDS=""
i=0
while [ $i -lt "$JOBS" ]; do
  "$OUT/test_translate" runtime/nvn/maxwell/translate.c "$PER" $((i * 7919 + ${SEED:-1})) "$MODE" "$OUT/dump" > "$OUT/log_$i.txt" 2>&1 &
  PIDS="$PIDS $!"
  i=$((i + 1))
done
FAIL=0
for p in $PIDS; do wait "$p" || FAIL=1; done
cat "$OUT"/log_*.txt
exit $FAIL
```

```cpp
int main() {
    constexpr uint64_t base = 0x7000000000ull;

    void *mem = VirtualAlloc((void *)base, 0x20000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);

                     MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);

    assert(mem == (void *)base);
    // Both parts keep the native row plate, centred on the row.
    const auto geometry = binding_row_layout();

    assert(geometry.key.x + geometry.key.width < geometry.pad.x);
    // Both columns and the label sit inside the (widened) row band, and the row is centred.
    const float half_band = binding_row_plate_width * .5f;
    assert(geometry.label_right - geometry.label_width >= -half_band);
    assert(geometry.key.x >= -half_band && geometry.pad.x + geometry.pad.width <= half_band);
    assert(fabsf((geometry.label_right - geometry.label_width) + (geometry.pad.x + geometry.pad.width)) <= 24.f);
    assert(geometry.key.width > 0 && geometry.pad.width > 0);
    uint64_t root = base + 0xa000;
    const char *names[] = {"T_Text_00", "T_Text_01", "N_Cursor_00", "B_Hit_00", "W_Base_00",
                          "W_Base_01", "W_BaseLine_02", "W_BaseLine_01", "W_Decide_00", "Window_00", "W_Base_02"};
    wr64(root + 0x28, root + 0x208);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 11; i++) {

        strcpy((char *)(uintptr_t)(pane + 0xb8), names[i]);
        wr64(pane + 0x28, pane + 0x20);

        two_float(pane, 0x48, 1.f); two_float(pane, 0x50, i == 10 ? 540.f : 276.f);

    assert(!(*(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(panes.plate + 0x58) & 1));
    two_geometry(panes, geometry.pad);
    assert(!(*(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(panes.plate + 0x58) & 1));
    two_geometry(panes, geometry.key);
    assert(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(panes.frames[0] + 0x50) == geometry.key.width);
    assert(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(panes.frames[1] + 0x50) == geometry.key.width);
    assert(*(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(panes.frames[0] + 0x58) & 0x10);
    // Column headers share the column centers and widths, hide all button chrome, and scale uniformly.
    assert(binding_row_header_scale > 0.f && two_header_scale() == binding_row_header_scale);
    for (int col = 0; col < 2; col++) {
        const auto column = col ? geometry.pad : geometry.key;
        two_header_geometry(panes, column, binding_row_header_scale);
        assert(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(root + 0x30) == column.center());
        assert(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(panes.texts[0] + 0x30) == 0.f);
        assert(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(panes.texts[0] + 0x48) == binding_row_header_scale);
        assert(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(panes.texts[0] + 0x4c) == binding_row_header_scale);
        assert(fabsf(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(panes.texts[0] + 0x50) * binding_row_header_scale - column.width) < 1e-3f);
        for (uint64_t frame : panes.frames) assert(!(*(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(frame + 0x58) & 1));
        assert(!(*(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(panes.plate + 0x58) & 1));
    }
    uint64_t header = base + 0xf00, row = base + 0x1000, next = base + 0x1100, ordinary = base + 0x1200;
    uint64_t screen = base + 0x2000;
    g_site.opt_table = base; g_site.opt_two_help = base + 0x8000; g_site.opt_screen_rows = 0x36b0;
    g_installed = 1; wr64(OPT_ENTRIES, g_installed);
    g_items.push_back(button(P_BINDS, "", "test", "", A_BINDS_HEADER, 0));
    wr32(header + 0x50, GAME_ENTRIES); wr64(header, screen);
    wr64(header + 0x20, base + 0x5e00); wr64(header + 0x28, base + 0x5f00);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        g_items.push_back(button(P_BINDS, "test", "test", nullptr, A_BIND, BIND_ACTION + i));
        uint64_t r = i == 0 ? row : i == 1 ? next : ordinary;
        wr32(r + 0x50, GAME_ENTRIES + 1 + i); wr64(r, screen);
        wr64(r + 0x20, base + 0x6000 + i * 0x200);
        wr64(r + 0x28, base + 0x6100 + i * 0x200);
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_items.size(); i++) g_entries[GAME_ENTRIES + i].kind = KIND_BUTTON;
    uint64_t row_list = base + 0x2400, order_list = base + 0x2500, msg_out = base + 0x2600;

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4; i++) wr32(order_list + 4 * i, GAME_ENTRIES + i);

    auto bright = [](const TwoRow &r) { return *(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(r.band + two_mat_alpha[0]) == two_band_selected; };

    assert(rt_opt_msg(MSG_BASE + MSG_TITLE, msg_out) && std::u16string((const char16_t *)(uintptr_t)rd64(msg_out)).empty());
    assert(rt_opt_pointer_kind(header) == -1 && rt_opt_two_column(header) == -1);
    assert(rt_opt_two_control(header) == rd64(row + 0x20) && rd64(screen + 0x36c8) == row);
    int dev, slot, ms;
    wr32(screen + 0x36c0, 0);
    assert(rt_opt_decide(header) == 2 && !bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms));
    assert(rt_opt_two_callback(screen, rd64(header + 0x28), 2) == 1 && !bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms));
    focused_row = 0;
    assert(rt_opt_two_callback(screen, rd64(header + 0x28), 0) == 1 && focused_row == row);
    act_reset();
    wr64(screen + 0x36c8, row); wr32(screen + 0x36c0, 0);
    assert(rt_opt_decide(row) == 2);
    assert(bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && dev == BIND_DEV_KEY && slot == BIND_ACTION);
    int before = g_act_key[0];
    SDL_Event e = {}; e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN; e.gbutton.button = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH;
    bind_capture_event(&e);
    assert(bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && g_act_key[0] == before);
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_F8;
    bind_capture_event(&e); assert(!bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && g_act_key[0] == SDL_SCANCODE_F8);
    rt_opt_two_horizontal(screen, 2);
    assert(!bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && focused_kind == KIND_BUTTON && focused_row == row);
    assert(rd32(screen + 0x36c0) == 3);
    rt_opt_decide(row); assert(!bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms)); // idle is not confirmation
    wr32(screen + 0x36c0, 0); rt_opt_decide(row);
    assert(bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && dev == BIND_DEV_PAD);
    before = g_act_pad[0]; e.type = SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN; e.key.scancode = SDL_SCANCODE_F10;
    bind_capture_event(&e); assert(bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && g_act_pad[0] == before);
    e.type = SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DOWN; e.gbutton.button = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH;
    bind_capture_event(&e); assert(g_act_pad[0] == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH && g_act_key[0] == SDL_SCANCODE_F8);
    // Native confirmed callbacks can arrive before the screen update sets its action code.
    wr32(screen + 0x36c0, 3);
    rt_opt_two_callback(screen, rd64(row + 0x28), 2);
    assert(bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && dev == BIND_DEV_PAD);
    assert(rd32(screen + 0x36c0) == 3);
    bind_capture_cancel();
    // Up/down enters a different row's left control but preserves the right column.
    test_cpu.x[19] = 17; test_cpu.v[0] = 23;
    assert(rt_opt_two_callback(screen, rd64(next + 0x20), 0));
    assert(focused_row == next && focused_kind == KIND_BUTTON && rd64(screen + 0x36c8) == next);
    assert(test_cpu.x[19] == 17 && test_cpu.v[0] == 23 && help_count == 1);
    // The selected row's band is bright over the whole row, the other row's faint. The unselected button of the selected
    // row gets the darkener under it, the selected button's box is a little see-through.
    assert(on(r0.band) && on(r1.band) && !bright(r0) && bright(r1));
    assert(on(r1.disable) && !on(r0.disable) && r1.dark_col == 0);
    assert(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(r1.dark + 0x30) == r1.dark_x[0]);
    assert(hovered(r1, 1) && !hovered(r1, 0) && !hovered(r0, 0) && !hovered(r0, 1));
    // Explicit mouse hover selects either device even after crossing rows.
    rt_opt_two_pointer(row, KIND_CHOICE);
    assert(rt_opt_two_callback(screen, rd64(row + 0x20), 0) && rt_opt_two_column(row) == 0);
    assert(bright(r0) && !bright(r1) && on(r0.disable) && !on(r1.disable) && r0.dark_col == 1);
    assert(*(float *)(uintptr_t)(r0.dark + 0x30) == r0.dark_x[1] && hovered(r0, 0) && !hovered(r0, 1));
    // A redraw by the game that hides the toggle part again is undone on the next update.
    wr8(r0.tog + 0x58, 0x10); wr8(r0.band + two_mat_alpha[0], 0x02);
    two_band_refresh(screen);
    assert(on(r0.tog) && bright(r0));
    assert(!rt_opt_two_callback(screen, rd64(ordinary + 0x28), 0));
    assert(!bright(r0) && !bright(r1) && !on(r0.disable) && !on(r1.disable) && !hovered(r0, 0));
    assert(rt_opt_two_column(ordinary) == -1 && !rt_opt_two_control(ordinary));
    wr32(screen + 0x36c0, 0); rt_opt_decide(ordinary);
    assert(bind_capture_active(&dev, &slot, &ms) && dev == BIND_DEV_ANY);
    bind_capture_cancel();
    puts("PASS: real Options hooks and capture engine, separate devices, navigation, mouse, CPU preservation, fallback");
}
```

`tools/test_two_button_sites.py`:

```py
"""The spike must fall back as a group if even one pattern fails on a known build."""
import game_sites as gs

class MissingPattern:
    def locate(self, site):
        return (None, 0) if site.name == gs.OPT_TWO_SITES[-1] else (gs.KNOWN['1.9.0'].get(site.name), 1)

found = gs.resolve(MissingPattern(), gs.KNOWN['1.9.0'])
assert not set(gs.OPT_TWO_SITES) & found.keys(), 'a KNOWN address must not enable an unverified spike'
assert found['opt_decide'] == gs.KNOWN['1.9.0']['opt_decide'], 'existing Options handling survives'
print('two-button sites: one failed pattern disables the whole spike PASS')

# Guard every site and both failure modes, including a unique match at a wrong address.
for missing in gs.OPT_TWO_SITES:
    for wrong, hits in ((None, 0), (None, 2), (gs.KNOWN['1.9.0'][missing] + 4, 1)):
        class OneBadSite:
            def locate(self, site):
                return (wrong, hits) if site.name == missing else (gs.KNOWN['1.9.0'].get(site.name), 1)
        assert not set(gs.OPT_TWO_SITES) & gs.resolve(OneBadSite(), gs.KNOWN['1.9.0']).keys()
print('all spike sites: missing, ambiguous and mismatched signatures fall back PASS')
```

`tools/test_ui_layout_codegen.py`:

```py
"""Synthetic tests for the independently resolved UI draw thunk; no game data required."""
import struct
from types import SimpleNamespace
import game_sites
import patches

base, thunk, native = 0x7100000000, 0x7100000080, 0x7100000020
gates = (0x39440008, 0x7100011f, 0x39440809, 0x3943f80a,
         0x3943fc0b, 0x7a401920, 0x7a400944, 0x7a421964)
image = bytearray(0x100)
branch = 0x14000000 | (((native - thunk) // 4) & 0x3ffffff)
struct.pack_into('<I', image, thunk - base, branch)
struct.pack_into('<8I', image, native - base, *gates)
g = SimpleNamespace(base=base, nso=SimpleNamespace(image=image),
                    sites={'ui_layout_draw': thunk, 'ui_layout_native': native})
code = patches._ui_layout_draw(g, thunk)
assert f'rt_ui_layout_draw(c, f_{native:x}); return;' in code
assert 'c->sp' not in code and 'c->x[' not in code
assert patches.table(g.sites)[thunk] is patches._ui_layout_draw
assert ('ui_layout_draw', 'ui_layout_native', 'ui_layout_pane') in game_sites.OPTIONAL_GROUPS
for at, wrong in [(thunk, branch | 0x80000000), (thunk, branch + 1),
                  *[(native + 4*i, word ^ 1) for i, word in enumerate(gates)]]:
    saved = struct.unpack_from('<I', image, at - base)[0]
    struct.pack_into('<I', image, at - base, wrong)
    try:
        patches._ui_layout_draw(g, thunk)
    except AssertionError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f'accepted a changed instruction at {at:#x}')
    struct.pack_into('<I', image, at - base, saved)
print('PASS: UI tail thunk dispatch, unchanged guest ABI and rejection of stale branch/gate instructions')

pane = base + 0xc0
struct.pack_into('<I', image, pane-base, 0x39416008)
g.sites['ui_layout_pane'] = pane
code = patches._ui_layout_pane(g, pane)
assert f'if (rt_ui_layout_pane_draw(c, f_{pane:x})) return;' in code
assert 'c->x[8] = LD8(c->x[0] + 0x58);' in code
assert patches.table(g.sites)[pane] is patches._ui_layout_pane
struct.pack_into('<I', image, pane-base, 0x39416009)
try:
    patches._ui_layout_pane(g, pane)
except AssertionError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('accepted a changed pane entry instruction')
print('PASS: independent reentrant pane gate preserves the native entry and rejects stale instructions')
```

`tools/test_update_appimage.c`:

```c
// tools/test_update_appimage.py builds this: the AppImage update on its own, without the game.
// usage: test_update_appimage <check|apply|back> <work folder> <current version>; prints key=value lines.
#include "../runtime/update_appimage.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 4) return 2;
    UpdateProblem p = {{0}};
    UcRelease r;
    bool available = false, ok;
    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "back")) ok = appimage_go_back(&p);
    else {
        ok = appimage_find_update(argv[2], argv[3], &r, &available, &p);
        if (ok && available && !strcmp(argv[1], "apply")) {
            volatile float progress = 0;
            ok = appimage_install(argv[2], &r, &progress, &p);
            if (ok) {
                printf("status=installed\n");
                fflush(stdout);
                appimage_relaunch(&p);
                ok = false;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!ok) printf("status=error\ncode=%s\ntitle=%s\nwhat=%s\n", p.code, p.title, p.what);
    else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "back")) printf("status=back\n");
    else printf("status=%s\nversion=%s\n", available ? "available" : "current", available ? r.version : "");
    return !ok;
}
```

`tools/test_update_appimage.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""An AppImage updating itself, every way it can go wrong (Linux; make test-update-appimage).

Builds the update code with a throwaway key and a test feed, then for each scenario makes a stand-in AppImage (a shell
script) in a temporary folder and serves made-up releases from a local server, with the system's real curl.
"""
import hashlib
import http.server
import json
import os
import shutil
import socket
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
TMP = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='update_appimage_test_')
OLD = '0.5.1-alpha.5'
NEW = '0.5.2-alpha.5'
ARCH = os.uname().machine
NAME = f'Savage_Wind-{NEW}-{ARCH}.AppImage'


def run(cmd, **kw):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, **kw)
    if p.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(f'{cmd[0]} failed: {p.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[-1500:]}')
    return p


def build():
    prebuilt = os.environ.get('SW_TEST_PREBUILT')  # (a machine without a compiler: the three files from another)
    if prebuilt:
        return tuple(os.path.join(prebuilt, n) for n in ('key.pem', 'other.pem', 'tool'))
    key = os.path.join(TMP, 'key.pem')
    other = os.path.join(TMP, 'other.pem')
    for k in (key, other):
        run(['openssl', 'ecparam', '-genkey', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-noout', '-out', k])
    pub = run([sys.executable, 'tools/sign_update.py', '--public', key], cwd=ROOT).stdout.decode().strip()
    header = os.path.join(TMP, 'key.h')
    with open(header, 'w') as f:
        f.write(f'#define SW_UPDATE_TEST_PUBKEY "{pub}"\n')
    exe = os.path.join(TMP, 'tool')
    run(['clang', '-O1', '-Wall', '-DSW_UPDATE_TEST', '-include', header, '-Iruntime', '-o', exe, 'tools/test_update_appimage.c',
         'runtime/update_appimage.c', 'runtime/update_core.c', 'runtime/update_crypto.c'], cwd=ROOT)
    return key, other, exe


KEY, OTHER, TOOL = build()


def script(tag, health=73):
    return (f'#!/bin/sh\n# {tag}\nif [ "$1" = --update-health ]; then exit {health}; fi\n'
            'echo "$0 $*" >> "$(dirname "$0")/started.txt"\n').encode()


def sign(data, key=KEY):
    p = os.path.join(TMP, 'to-sign')
    with open(p, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)
    run([sys.executable, 'tools/sign_update.py', p, key], cwd=ROOT)
    with open(p + '.sig', 'rb') as f:
        return f.read()


class Server:
    def __init__(self):
        owner = self
        self.routes = {}
        self.hits = []

        class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'

            def log_message(self, *a):
                pass

            def do_GET(self):
                owner.hits.append((self.path, self.headers.get('Range')))
                r = owner.routes.get(self.path)
                if callable(r):
                    return r(self)
                status, body, headers = r if r else (404, b'nope', {})
                rng = self.headers.get('Range')
                if rng and status == 200 and self.path.endswith('.AppImage'):
                    start = int(rng.split('=')[1].rstrip('-'))
                    if start >= len(body):
                        self.send_response(416)
                        self.send_header('Content-Length', '0')
                        self.end_headers()
                        return
                    body, status = body[start:], 206
                self.send_response(status)
                for k, v in headers.items():
                    self.send_header(k, v)
                self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)

        self.httpd = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), H)
        self.port = self.httpd.server_address[1]
        threading.Thread(target=self.httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

    def url(self, p):
        return f'http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}{p}'

    def publish(self, data, sig=None, digest=True, size=None):
        assets = [{'name': NAME, 'browser_download_url': self.url('/d/' + NAME), 'size': size or len(data),
                   'digest': 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() if digest else None}]
        if sig is not False:
            assets.append({'name': NAME + '.sig', 'browser_download_url': self.url('/d/s.sig'), 'size': 128, 'digest': None})
            self.routes['/d/s.sig'] = (200, sig if sig is not None else sign(data), {})
        self.routes['/feed'] = (200, json.dumps([{'tag_name': 'v' + NEW, 'draft': False, 'html_url': 'x', 'assets': assets}]).encode(), {})
        self.routes['/d/' + NAME] = (200, data, {})


S = Server()
NEW_FILE = script('new')


class App:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.dir = os.path.join(TMP, name)
        shutil.rmtree(self.dir, ignore_errors=True)
        os.makedirs(self.dir)
        self.path = os.path.join(self.dir, 'Savage_Wind-old.AppImage')
        self.old = script('old')
        with open(self.path, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(self.old)
        os.chmod(self.path, 0o755)
        with open(os.path.join(self.dir, 'mine.txt'), 'w') as f:
            f.write('mine')
        self.work = os.path.join(TMP, name + '-work')
        os.makedirs(self.work, exist_ok=True)

    def run(self, cmd, env=None, feed=None):
        e = dict(os.environ, APPIMAGE=self.path, SW_UPDATE_TEST_FEED=feed or S.url('/feed'))
        e.update(env or {})
        p = subprocess.run([TOOL, cmd, self.work, OLD], env=e, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
        self.result = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in p.stdout.decode().splitlines() if '=' in line)
        return self.result

    def read(self, n=None):
        with open(n or self.path, 'rb') as f:
            return f.read()

    def has(self, suffix):
        return os.path.exists(self.path + suffix)

    def assert_old(self):
        assert self.read() == self.old, 'the AppImage changed'
        assert os.stat(self.path).st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR
        assert not self.has('.old')
        assert self.read(os.path.join(self.dir, 'mine.txt')) == b'mine'


def expect(r, code):
    assert r.get('status') == 'error' and r.get('code') == code, f'expected {code}, got {r}'
    assert r.get('title') and r.get('what'), r


SC = {}


def scenario(f):
    SC[f.__name__] = f
    return f


@scenario
def update_ok():
    a = App('ok')
    S.publish(NEW_FILE)
    a.run('apply')
    assert a.read() == NEW_FILE, 'not replaced'
    assert os.stat(a.path).st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR, 'not executable'
    assert a.read(a.path + '.old') == a.old, 'the old one must stay until set up'
    assert not a.has('.part')
    assert b'--config' in a.read(os.path.join(a.dir, 'started.txt')), 'not reopened'
    assert a.read(os.path.join(a.dir, 'mine.txt')) == b'mine'


@scenario
def go_back():
    a = App('back')
    S.publish(NEW_FILE)
    a.run('apply')
    assert a.run('back')['status'] == 'back'
    assert a.read() == a.old and not a.has('.old')


@scenario
def nothing_to_go_back_to():
    a = App('noback')
    expect(a.run('back'), 'no_backup')


@scenario
def check_only():
    a = App('check')
    S.publish(NEW_FILE)
    r = a.run('check')
    assert r['status'] == 'available' and r['version'] == NEW, r
    a.assert_old()


@scenario
def no_releases():
    a = App('none')
    S.routes['/feed'] = (200, b'[]', {})
    assert a.run('apply')['status'] == 'current'


@scenario
def unsigned_not_offered():
    a = App('unsigned')
    S.publish(NEW_FILE, sig=False)
    assert a.run('apply')['status'] == 'current'
    a.assert_old()


@scenario
def resumes():
    a = App('resume')
    data = NEW_FILE + b'#' * 200000
    S.publish(data)
    with open(a.path + '.part', 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data[:1000])
    S.hits.clear()
    a.run('apply')
    assert a.read() == data
    assert any(h[1] == 'bytes=1000-' for h in S.hits), S.hits


@scenario
def stale_part_downloaded_again():

    S.publish(NEW_FILE)
    with open(a.path + '.part', 'wb') as f:
        f.write(b'x' * len(NEW_FILE))
    a.run('apply')
    assert a.read() == NEW_FILE


@scenario

    s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))

@scenario

@scenario
def read_only_folder():
    if os.geteuid() == 0:
        return
    a = App('ro')
    S.publish(NEW_FILE)
    os.chmod(a.dir, 0o555)
    try:

@scenario

    S.publish(NEW_FILE)
    expect(a.run('apply', env={'APPIMAGE': ''}), 'not_appimage')


def main():
    want = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ''
    names = [n for n in SC if want in n]
    failed = []
    for n in names:
        try:
            SC[n]()
            print(f'  ok    {n}', flush=True)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001  (every scenario runs; the failures are listed at the end)
            failed.append(n)
            print(f'  FAIL  {n}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}', flush=True)
    print(f'{len(names) - len(failed)} of {len(names)} scenarios passed')
    if failed:
        print('failed:', ', '.join(failed), '| fixtures in', TMP)
        return 1
    shutil.rmtree(TMP, ignore_errors=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```

`tools/test_update_core.c`:

```c
// make test-update-core: the plain logic of SW Update (runtime/update_core.c), with made-up releases and file lists.
#include "../runtime/update_core.h"
#include "../runtime/update_crypto.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static int fails;
#define CHECK(x) do { if (!(x)) { printf("FAILED line %d: %s\n", __LINE__, #x); fails++; } } while (0)

#define H64 "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
#define ASSET(n, u, s) "{\"name\":\"" n "\",\"browser_download_url\":\"" u "\",\"size\":" #s ",\"digest\":\"sha256:" H64 "\"}"
#define RELEASE(tag, draft, assets) \
    "{\"tag_name\":\"" tag "\",\"draft\":" draft ",\"prerelease\":true,\"body\":\"notes \\\"quoted\\\" \\u00e9\"," \
    "\"html_url\":\"https://example.test/" tag "\",\"author\":{\"login\":\"x\",\"n\":[1,2,{\"a\":null}]},\"assets\":[" assets "]}"
#define ZIP(v) ASSET("SavageWind-" v "-windows.zip", "https://example.test/" v ".zip", 1000)
#define SIG(v) ASSET("SavageWind-" v "-windows.zip.sig", "https://example.test/" v ".sig", 128)

static void versions(void) {
    CHECK(uc_version_valid("0.5.1-alpha.5"));
    CHECK(uc_version_valid("v0.5.1"));
    CHECK(uc_version_valid("1.0.0-rc.2"));
    CHECK(!uc_version_valid(""));
    CHECK(!uc_version_valid("0.5"));
    CHECK(!uc_version_valid("0.5.1-"));
    CHECK(!uc_version_valid("0.5.1-alpha"));
    CHECK(!uc_version_valid("0.5.1-gamma.1"));
    CHECK(!uc_version_valid("0.5.1 alpha.5"));
    CHECK(!uc_version_valid("latest"));
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("0.5.1-alpha.5", "0.5.0-alpha.5") > 0);
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("v0.5.0-alpha.5", "0.5.0-alpha.5") == 0);
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("0.4.1-alpha.4", "0.5.0-alpha.5") < 0);
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("0.10.0-alpha.1", "0.9.0-alpha.9") > 0);
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("0.5.0-alpha.10", "0.5.0-alpha.9") > 0);
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("1.0.0", "1.0.0-rc.9") > 0);
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("1.0.0-beta.1", "1.0.0-alpha.9") > 0);
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("1.0.0-rc.1", "1.0.0-beta.9") > 0);
    CHECK(uc_version_cmp("junk", "0.0.1") < 0);
}

static void pick(void) {
    UcRelease r;
    int unsig = -1;
    static const char newest_first[] =
        "[" RELEASE("v0.5.2-alpha.5", "false", ZIP("0.5.2-alpha.5") "," SIG("0.5.2-alpha.5")) ","
            RELEASE("v0.5.1-alpha.5", "false", ZIP("0.5.1-alpha.5") "," SIG("0.5.1-alpha.5")) ","
            RELEASE("v0.5.0-alpha.5", "false", ZIP("0.5.0-alpha.5")) "]";
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(newest_first, "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, &unsig) == UC_PICK_UPDATE);
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.version, "0.5.2-alpha.5"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.tag, "v0.5.2-alpha.5"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.zip_name, "SavageWind-0.5.2-alpha.5-windows.zip"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.zip_url, "https://example.test/0.5.2-alpha.5.zip"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.sig_url, "https://example.test/0.5.2-alpha.5.sig"));
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.digest, H64));
    CHECK(r.zip_size == 1000);
    CHECK(unsig == 0);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(newest_first, "0.5.2-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_CURRENT);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(newest_first, "9.0.0", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_CURRENT);

    static const char oldest_first[] =
        "[" RELEASE("v0.5.1-alpha.5", "false", ZIP("0.5.1-alpha.5") "," SIG("0.5.1-alpha.5")) ","
            RELEASE("v0.6.0-alpha.6", "false", ZIP("0.6.0-alpha.6") "," SIG("0.6.0-alpha.6")) "]";
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(oldest_first, "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_UPDATE);
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.version, "0.6.0-alpha.6"));

    static const char passed_over[] =
        "[" RELEASE("v0.9.0-alpha.9", "true", ZIP("0.9.0-alpha.9") "," SIG("0.9.0-alpha.9")) ","
            RELEASE("nightly", "false", ZIP("nightly") "," SIG("nightly")) ","
            RELEASE("v0.8.0-alpha.8", "false", ASSET("Savage_Wind-0.8.0-alpha.8-x86_64.AppImage", "https://example.test/a", 5)) ","
            RELEASE("v0.7.0-alpha.7", "false", ZIP("0.7.0-alpha.7")) ","
            RELEASE("v0.5.1-alpha.5", "false", ZIP("0.5.1-alpha.5") "," SIG("0.5.1-alpha.5")) "]";
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(passed_over, "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, &unsig) == UC_PICK_UPDATE);
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.version, "0.5.1-alpha.5"));
    CHECK(unsig == 1);

    CHECK(uc_pick_release("[]", "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_CURRENT);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release("", "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_BAD_JSON);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release("<html>Rate limited</html>", "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_BAD_JSON);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release("{\"message\":\"Not Found\"}", "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_BAD_JSON);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release("[{\"tag_name\":\"v1.0.0\"", "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_BAD_JSON);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release("[{\"tag_name\":\"v1.0.0\",}]", "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_BAD_JSON);
    static char deep[4096];
    memset(deep, '[', sizeof deep - 1);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(deep, "0.5.0-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_BAD_JSON);
}

static void manifests(void) {
    UcManifest m;
    char why[120];
    static const char good[] =
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\r\nversion 0.5.1-alpha.5\n"
        "f " H64 " 12 savagewind.exe\nf " H64 " 0 zig/lib/empty file.txt\n";
    CHECK(uc_manifest_parse(good, &m, why, sizeof why));
    CHECK(m.count == 2);
    CHECK(!strcmp(m.version, "0.5.1-alpha.5"));
    CHECK(m.files[0].size == 12);
    CHECK(!strcmp(m.files[1].path, "zig/lib/empty file.txt"));
    CHECK(uc_manifest_find(&m, "SAVAGEWIND.EXE") != NULL);
    CHECK(uc_manifest_find(&m, "savagewind.ex") == NULL);
    CHECK(uc_manifest_find(&m, "zig/lib/empty") == NULL);
    uc_manifest_free(&m);

    static const char *const bad[] = {
        "",
        "hello\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 2\nversion 0.5.1\nf " H64 " 1 a\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nf " H64 " 1 a\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion nope\nf " H64 " 1 a\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion 0.5.1\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion 0.5.1\nf abc 1 a\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion 0.5.1\nf " H64 " x a\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion 0.5.1\nf " H64 " 1\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion 0.5.1\nf " H64 " 1 ../evil.exe\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion 0.5.1\nf " H64 " 1 C:/evil.exe\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion 0.5.1\nf " H64 " 1 a\nf " H64 " 1 A\n",
        "savagewind-update-manifest 1\nversion 0.5.1\nwhat is this\n",
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof bad / sizeof *bad; i++) {
        why[0] = 0;
        if (uc_manifest_parse(bad[i], &m, why, sizeof why)) { printf("FAILED: bad manifest %d accepted\n", (int)i); fails++; }
        else CHECK(why[0]);
    }
}

// A signature made with openssl (tools/sign_update.py) over "savage wind test vector"
#define TV_PUB "a5c179244b1d44abe6005b0157ad01948b76ac78f462cdced1c3187ea51dbd349a791b854a6451c83de7953786eed112b439eea9a4ea9d08ee377223427ddcb8"
#define TV_SIG "60a93460ab42565d2c131c39a7adc90496444140547c4f20a4762ae6d5f04018f6e26e87201d17a9b5d1f03da0d57c2662f655643234162d6f2b48cf542259d0"
#define TV_HASH "d0be736eda79f98fa648fa79ac66b75f9273008f10d91ca17df977480165502e"

static void crypto(void) {
    uint8_t h[32], want[32], sig[64], pub[64], t[64];
    UcSha256 c;
    uc_sha256_init(&c);
    uc_sha256_update(&c, "abc", 3);
    uc_sha256_final(&c, h);
    uc_hex_decode("ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad", want, 32);
    CHECK(!memcmp(h, want, 32));
    uc_sha256_init(&c);
    uc_sha256_update(&c, "savage wind test vector", 23);
    uc_sha256_final(&c, h);
    uc_hex_decode(TV_HASH, want, 32);
    CHECK(!memcmp(h, want, 32));

    CHECK(uc_hex_decode(TV_SIG, sig, 64) && uc_hex_decode(TV_PUB, pub, 64));
    CHECK(uc_p256_verify(want, sig, pub));
    uint8_t bad[32];
    memcpy(bad, want, 32);
    bad[5] ^= 1;
    CHECK(!uc_p256_verify(bad, sig, pub));
    memcpy(t, sig, 64);
    t[3] ^= 1;
    CHECK(!uc_p256_verify(want, t, pub));
    memcpy(t, sig, 64);
    t[60] ^= 1;
    CHECK(!uc_p256_verify(want, t, pub));
    memcpy(t, pub, 64);
    t[10] ^= 1;  // (not on the curve)
    CHECK(!uc_p256_verify(want, sig, t));
    memset(t, 0, 64);
    CHECK(!uc_p256_verify(want, t, pub));  // r = s = 0
    memset(t, 0xFF, 64);
    CHECK(!uc_p256_verify(want, t, pub));  // r, s above the order
}

static void appimage_assets(void) {
    UcRelease r;
    static const char list[] =
        "[" RELEASE("v0.5.2-alpha.5", "false",
            ASSET("Savage_Wind-0.5.2-alpha.5-x86_64.AppImage", "https://example.test/x", 7) ","
            ASSET("Savage_Wind-0.5.2-alpha.5-x86_64.AppImage.sig", "https://example.test/x.sig", 1) ","
            ASSET("Savage_Wind-0.5.2-alpha.5-aarch64.AppImage", "https://example.test/a", 9) ","
            ASSET("Savage_Wind-0.5.2-alpha.5-aarch64.AppImage.sig", "https://example.test/a.sig", 1) ","
            ZIP("0.5.2-alpha.5")) "]";
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(list, "0.5.1-alpha.5", "-x86_64.AppImage", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_UPDATE);
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.zip_url, "https://example.test/x") && !strcmp(r.sig_url, "https://example.test/x.sig") && r.zip_size == 7);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(list, "0.5.1-alpha.5", "-aarch64.AppImage", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_UPDATE);
    CHECK(!strcmp(r.zip_url, "https://example.test/a") && !strcmp(r.sig_url, "https://example.test/a.sig") && r.zip_size == 9);
    CHECK(uc_pick_release(list, "0.5.1-alpha.5", "-windows.zip", &r, NULL) == UC_PICK_CURRENT);  // (no signature for the zip)
}

// The files a made-up folder has: "dir|name" entries
static const char *g_files[8];
static bool has_file(const char *dir, const char *name) {
    char k[600];
    snprintf(k, sizeof k, "%s|%s", dir, name);
    for (int i = 0; g_files[i]; i++)
        if (!strcmp(g_files[i], k)) return true;
    return false;
}
#define FILES(...) do { const char *f_[] = {__VA_ARGS__, NULL}; memcpy(g_files, f_, sizeof f_); } while (0)
#define INSTALLED(dir, up, rl) uc_launcher_installed(dir, up, has_file, rl)
#define IS(x, want) CHECK((x) && !strcmp((x), want))

static void launchers(void) {
    const char *d = "D:\\Games\\Savage Wind", *u = "D:\\Games";
    FILES("x|y");
    CHECK(!INSTALLED(d, u, NULL));  // a plain folder: SW Update's
    CHECK(!INSTALLED(d, u, ""));
    CHECK(!INSTALLED(d, u, "0"));
    IS(INSTALLED(d, u, "1"), "RecompLauncher");
    FILES("D:\\Games\\Savage Wind|.quiver-version");
    IS(INSTALLED(d, u, NULL), "Quiver Launcher");
    FILES("D:\\Games|.quiver-version");  // (the zip's top folder kept)
    IS(INSTALLED(d, u, NULL), "Quiver Launcher");
    CHECK(!INSTALLED(d, "", NULL));  // (no folder above: nothing looked for there)
    FILES("D:\\Games\\Savage Wind|version.txt");
    IS(INSTALLED(d, u, NULL), "GitHub Launcher");
    FILES("D:\\Games|version.txt");  // a lone version.txt above: anyone's
    CHECK(!INSTALLED(d, u, NULL));
    FILES("D:\\Games|version.txt", "D:\\Games|LastPlayed.txt");
    IS(INSTALLED(d, u, NULL), "GitHub Launcher");
    FILES("D:\\Games|version.txt", "D:\\Games|selected_executable.txt");
    IS(INSTALLED(d, u, NULL), "GitHub Launcher");
    FILES("x|y");
    IS(INSTALLED("C:\\Recomp Library\\Savage Wind", "C:\\Recomp Library", NULL), "RecompLauncher");
    IS(INSTALLED("/home/p/Games/Recomp Library/savage-wind", "/home/p/Games/Recomp Library", NULL), "RecompLauncher");
    IS(INSTALLED("C:\\RECOMP LIBRARY", "C:", NULL), "RecompLauncher");
    CHECK(!INSTALLED("C:\\My Recomp Library Backup\\Savage Wind", "C:\\My Recomp Library Backup", NULL));
    CHECK(!INSTALLED("/home/p/Games/Savage Wind", "/home/p/Games", NULL));
}

static void inside(void) {
    CHECK(uc_path_inside("/tmp/.mount_SavageAbc/usr/bin/savagewind", "/tmp/.mount_SavageAbc"));
    CHECK(uc_path_inside("/tmp/.mount_SavageAbc/usr/bin/savagewind", "/tmp/.mount_SavageAbc/"));
    CHECK(!uc_path_inside("/tmp/.mount_SavageAbcd/usr/bin/savagewind", "/tmp/.mount_SavageAbc"));  // (a longer name)
    CHECK(!uc_path_inside("/home/p/src/SavageWindRecomp/build/savagewind", "/tmp/.mount_QuiverX"));  // inherited
    CHECK(!uc_path_inside("/tmp/.mount_SavageAbc", "/tmp/.mount_SavageAbc"));
    CHECK(!uc_path_inside("/usr/bin/savagewind", ""));
}

int main(void) {
    versions();
    launchers();
    inside();
    crypto();
    appimage_assets();
    pick();
    paths();
    manifests();

}
```

`tools/test_vibration.c`:

```c
// Synthetic HID -> SDL checks, with no game files or physical controller. make test-vibration
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <time.h>
#include "../runtime/hle/vibration.c"
#include "../runtime/services/hid_set.c"

Settings g_settings = {.rumble = true, .rumble_strength = 100};

static uint64_t now;
static unsigned calls;
static uint16_t motor_low, motor_high;
static uint32_t duration;
static int rumble_delay_ms;
static void sleep_ms(int ms) {
    struct timespec ts = {.tv_sec = ms / 1000, .tv_nsec = (long)(ms % 1000) * 1000000L};
    nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
}
static double mono_ms(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0;
}
Uint64 SDL_GetTicks(void) { return now; }
bool SDL_RumbleGamepad(SDL_Gamepad *pad, Uint16 low, Uint16 high, Uint32 ms) {
    assert(pad);
    if (rumble_delay_ms > 0) sleep_ms(rumble_delay_ms);
    motor_low = low; motor_high = high; duration = ms; calls++;
    return true;
}
static void update_sync(SDL_Gamepad *pad, bool focused) {
    vibration_update(pad, focused);
    vibration_flush();
}
const char *SDL_GetError(void) { return "test"; }

// Unrelated HID / settings dependencies. Keep the returned vibration object callable.
static Service returned_service;
Service *service_new(const char *name, ServiceHandler handler, void *state) {
    returned_service = (Service){.name = name, .handler = handler, .state = state};
    return &returned_service;
}
void ipc_return_object(IpcResp *resp, Service *s) { resp->objects[resp->nobjects++] = s; }
KSharedMem *kernel_create_shared_memory(uint64_t size, void (*on_map)(KSharedMem *), uint32_t *handle) {
    (void)size; (void)on_map; (void)handle; abort();
}
KEvent *kernel_create_event_pair(uint32_t *w, uint32_t *r) { (void)w; (void)r; abort(); }
const char *language_text_code(void) { return "en-US"; }

static IpcResp command(uint32_t cmd, const void *data, uint32_t size) {
    IpcReq req = {.cmd = cmd, .data = data, .data_size = size};
    IpcResp resp = {0};
    hid(NULL, &req, &resp);
    return resp;
}

int main(void) {
    const uint32_t left = 0x00000003, right = 0x00010003;
    SDL_Gamepad *pad = (SDL_Gamepad *)(uintptr_t)1;
    vibration_reset();
    IpcResp resp = command(205, NULL, 0);
    assert(resp.data_size == 1 && resp.data[0] == 1);
    resp = command(203, NULL, 0);
    assert(resp.nobjects == 1 && resp.objects[0]->handler == active_vibration_devices);
    IpcReq activate = {0}; IpcResp activated = {0};
    resp.objects[0]->handler(resp.objects[0], &activate, &activated);
    assert(activated.result == 0);
    resp = command(200, &right, sizeof right);
    assert(resp.data_size == 8 && resp.data[0] == 1 && resp.data[4] == 2);

    // Single-device command: the value starts at byte 4, not at the aligned user id at byte 24.
    uint8_t packet[32] = {0};
    VibrationValue value = {.25f, 160, .5f, 320};
    memcpy(packet, &left, 4); memcpy(packet + 4, &value, sizeof value);
    command(201, packet, sizeof packet);
    update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 16384 && motor_high == 32768 && duration == 100);
    unsigned before = calls;
    now = 49; update_sync(pad, true); assert(calls == before);
    now = 50; update_sync(pad, true); assert(calls == before + 1);
    resp = command(202, packet, 16);
    assert(resp.data_size == sizeof value && memcmp(resp.data, &value, sizeof value) == 0);
    command(201, packet, 4);  // truncated: leave the current effect alone
    assert(vibration_get(left).low_amplitude == .25f);

    uint32_t handles[] = {left, right};
    VibrationValue batch[] = {{.75f, 100, .1f, 200}, {.2f, 180, .9f, 400}};
    IpcReq req = {.cmd = 206, .nx = 2, .x = {
        {(uintptr_t)handles, sizeof handles}, {(uintptr_t)batch, sizeof batch}}};
    resp = (IpcResp){0}; hid(NULL, &req, &resp);
    update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 49151 && motor_high == 58982);
    // Bound iteration by the shorter buffer; an incomplete trailing value must not be read.
    batch[0].low_amplitude = .6f; req.x[1].size = sizeof(VibrationValue) + 1;
    hid(NULL, &req, &resp);
    assert(vibration_get(left).low_amplitude == .6f && vibration_get(right).high_amplitude == .9f);

    // The player's toggle stops active motors without changing the game's HID permission.
    g_settings.rumble = false;
    update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 0 && motor_high == 0 && vibration_permitted());
    command(201, packet, sizeof packet);
    assert(vibration_get(left).low_amplitude == 0);
    vibration_reset();
    assert(!g_settings.rumble);  // returning to the title screen preserves the preference
    g_settings.rumble = true;
    update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 0 && motor_high == 0);  // no stale effect after re-enabling
    command(201, packet, sizeof packet);
    update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 16384 && motor_high == 32768);

    // Rumble strength scales the motor output proportionally.
    g_settings.rumble_strength = 50;
    update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 8192 && motor_high == 16384);
    g_settings.rumble_strength = 100;
    update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 16384 && motor_high == 32768);

    uint8_t allow = 0; command(204, &allow, 1);
    update_sync(pad, true); assert(motor_low == 0 && motor_high == 0);
    command(201, packet, sizeof packet);
    assert(vibration_get(left).low_amplitude == 0);
    allow = 1; command(204, &allow, 1);
    update_sync(pad, true); assert(motor_low == 0);  // do not resume an old effect

    value = (VibrationValue){NAN, 160, INFINITY, 320};
    vibration_send(left, &value); update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 0 && motor_high == 0);
    value = (VibrationValue){-1, 160, 2, 320};
    vibration_send(left, &value); update_sync(pad, true);
    assert(motor_low == 0 && motor_high == 65535);
    value = (VibrationValue){1, 160, 1, 320};
    vibration_send(0x00000103, &value);  // player 2: must not drive player 1
    assert(vibration_get(left).low_amplitude == 0);
    vibration_send(0, &value); assert(vibration_get(left).low_amplitude == 0);
    update_sync(pad, false); assert(motor_high == 0);
    update_sync(pad, true); assert(motor_high == 0);
    vibration_send(0x00002003, &value);  // handheld aliases the same physical controller
    update_sync(pad, true); assert(motor_low == 65535);
    update_sync(NULL, false);
    update_sync(pad, true); assert(vibration_get(left).low_amplitude == 0);
    vibration_send(left, &value); command(210, NULL, 0);
    update_sync(pad, true); assert(motor_low == 0);
    vibration_send(left, &value); vibration_reset();
    update_sync(pad, true); assert(motor_low == 0 && vibration_permitted());

    // Slow blocking SDL_RumbleGamepad (e.g. Bluetooth DualSense on Windows) must not block vibration_update,
    // and rapid updates while in flight must coalesce to the latest request.
    rumble_delay_ms = 40;
    unsigned before_slow = calls;
    double t0 = mono_ms();
    for (int step = 1; step <= 10; step++) {
        value = (VibrationValue){step * 0.1f, 160, 0, 320};
        vibration_send(left, &value);
        vibration_update(pad, true);
    }
    double elapsed = mono_ms() - t0;
    assert(elapsed < 20.0);
    vibration_flush();
    assert(motor_low == 65535 && calls - before_slow < 10);
    vibration_pad_closed(pad);
    rumble_delay_ms = 0;

    puts("vibration: HID packets, batching, motors, focus, disconnect, async rumble and reboot checks passed");
    return 0;
}
```

`tools/test_vk_gpl_dynamic.c`:

```c
// Headless GPU regression: an independently compiled fragment library must read set 1's dynamic UBO,
// even though set 0 (not known to that library) also has dynamic UBOs. No game data is needed.
// Build with: cc tools/test_vk_gpl_dynamic.c -o test_vk_gpl_dynamic -lvulkan -lshaderc_shared
// Default tests the workaround and monolithic control. --dynamic-fragment also tests the broken path.
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <shaderc/shaderc.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define CHECK(expr) do { VkResult r = (expr); if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: %d\n", #expr, r); exit(2); } } while (0)
static VkDevice dev;
static VkPhysicalDevice phys;
static VkQueue queue;
static uint32_t family;
static VkPipelineCache cache;
static VkShaderModule vs, fs;
static VkCommandPool pool;
static VkDescriptorPool dpool;
static VkBuffer buf;
static VkDeviceMemory mem;
static void *mapped;
static VkImage image;
static VkImageView view;
static VkDeviceSize alignment;

static uint32_t memory_type(uint32_t bits, VkMemoryPropertyFlags flags) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties p;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(phys, &p);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p.memoryTypeCount; i++)
        if ((bits & (1u << i)) && (p.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & flags) == flags) return i;
    fprintf(stderr, "no memory type %#x\n", flags); exit(2);
}
static VkShaderModule shader(const char *src, shaderc_shader_kind kind) {
    shaderc_compiler_t c = shaderc_compiler_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_t o = shaderc_compile_options_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_set_target_env(o, shaderc_target_env_vulkan, shaderc_env_version_vulkan_1_3);
    shaderc_compilation_result_t r = shaderc_compile_into_spv(c, src, strlen(src), kind, "fixture", "main", o);
    if (shaderc_result_get_compilation_status(r) != shaderc_compilation_status_success) {
        fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", shaderc_result_get_error_message(r)); exit(2);
    }
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO,
        .codeSize = shaderc_result_get_length(r), .pCode = (const uint32_t *)shaderc_result_get_bytes(r)};
    VkShaderModule m; CHECK(vkCreateShaderModule(dev, &ci, NULL, &m));
    shaderc_result_release(r); shaderc_compile_options_release(o); shaderc_compiler_release(c);
    return m;
}
static VkPipelineLayout layout(VkDescriptorSetLayout a, VkDescriptorSetLayout b, int n, bool independent) {
    VkDescriptorSetLayout sets[] = {a, b};
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
        .flags = independent ? VK_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INDEPENDENT_SETS_BIT_EXT : 0, .setLayoutCount = n, .pSetLayouts = sets};
    VkPipelineLayout p; CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(dev, &ci, NULL, &p)); return p;
}
static VkPipeline pipeline(VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo *ci, uint32_t flags) {
    VkGraphicsPipelineLibraryCreateInfoEXT li = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_CREATE_INFO_EXT,
        .pNext = ci->pNext, .flags = flags};
    if (flags) { ci->pNext = &li; ci->flags = VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_LIBRARY_BIT_KHR; }
    ci->sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
    VkPipeline p; CHECK(vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(dev, cache, 1, ci, NULL, &p)); return p;
}
static int draw(bool libraries, bool dynamic_fragment) {
    VkDescriptorSetLayout sl[2];
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b = {.binding = 3, .descriptorCount = 1,
            .descriptorType = i == 0 || dynamic_fragment ? VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC : VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER,
            .stageFlags = i ? VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT : VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT};
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .bindingCount = 1, .pBindings = &b};
        CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(dev, &ci, NULL, &sl[i]));
    }
    VkPipelineLayout full = layout(sl[0], sl[1], 2, libraries);

        VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo c1 = {.stageCount = 1, .pStages = stages, .pViewportState = &viewport, .pRasterizationState = &rs, .layout = vl};
        libs[1] = pipeline(&c1, VK_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_PRE_RASTERIZATION_SHADERS_BIT_EXT);
        VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo c2 = {.stageCount = 1, .pStages = stages + 1, .pMultisampleState = &ms, .pDepthStencilState = &ds, .layout = fl};

            .pInputAssemblyState = &ia, .pViewportState = &viewport, .pRasterizationState = &rs, .pMultisampleState = &ms,

    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, buf, 1, &copy);

    CHECK(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &submit, VK_NULL_HANDLE)); CHECK(vkQueueWaitIdle(queue));
    float *result = (float *)((char *)mapped + alignment * 3);
    printf("%s, fragment %s: %.9g %.9g %.9g %.9g (expected 7 11 13 17)\n", libraries ? "independent GPL" : "whole", dynamic_fragment ? "dynamic" : "static", result[0], result[1], result[2], result[3]);
    int bad = result[0] != 7 || result[1] != 11 || result[2] != 13 || result[3] != 17;
    vkDestroyPipeline(dev, p, NULL);
    if (libraries) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) vkDestroyPipeline(dev, libs[i], NULL); vkDestroyPipelineLayout(dev, vl, NULL); vkDestroyPipelineLayout(dev, fl, NULL); }
    vkDestroyPipelineLayout(dev, full, NULL);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(dev, sl[i], NULL);

    bool reproduce = argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--dynamic-fragment");

    vkDestroyImageView(dev, view, NULL); vkDestroyImage(dev, image, NULL); vkFreeMemory(dev, imem, NULL);

    vkDestroyDescriptorPool(dev, dpool, NULL); vkDestroyCommandPool(dev, pool, NULL); vkDestroyPipelineCache(dev, cache, NULL);
    vkDestroyDevice(dev, NULL); vkDestroyInstance(instance, NULL);
```

```c
// cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror tools/test_vk_heap_range.c -lvulkan -lshaderc_shared
// Default checks legal windowed SSBO access; --physical checks bounded physical pointers.
// --oversized reproduces the invalid whole-heap descriptor (an expected validation error).
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <shaderc/shaderc.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>

static uint32_t memory_type(VkPhysicalDevice phys, uint32_t bits) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties p; vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(phys, &p);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p.memoryTypeCount; i++)
        if ((bits & (1u << i)) && (p.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) ==
            (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT)) return i;
    fprintf(stderr, "no coherent host memory\n"); exit(2);
}
static VkShaderModule shader(const char *src) {
    shaderc_compiler_t c = shaderc_compiler_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_t o = shaderc_compile_options_initialize();
    shaderc_compile_options_set_target_env(o, shaderc_target_env_vulkan, shaderc_env_version_vulkan_1_3);
    shaderc_compilation_result_t r = shaderc_compile_into_spv(c, src, strlen(src), shaderc_compute_shader, "heap-range", "main", o);
    if (shaderc_result_get_compilation_status(r) != shaderc_compilation_status_success) { fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", shaderc_result_get_error_message(r)); exit(2); }
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = shaderc_result_get_length(r), .pCode = (const uint32_t *)shaderc_result_get_bytes(r)};
    VkShaderModule m; CHECK(vkCreateShaderModule(dev, &ci, NULL, &m));
    shaderc_result_release(r); shaderc_compile_options_release(o); shaderc_compiler_release(c); return m;
}
```
